english: Chapter 1: Prisoners of the Drow
zh_tw: 第1章：卓爾的囚徒

english: Deep beneath the surface of the world lies the Underdark, a realm of endless labyrinthine tunnels and caverns where the sun never shines. The Underdark is filled with races and creatures too numerous to count or list, and foremost among these are the dark elves—the drow. Hated and feared even by their fellow dwellers in darkness, the drow raid other settlements in the Underdark as well as the surface world, taking prisoners back with them. Rendered {@condition unconscious} with {@item drow poison}, then collared and shackled, these prisoners are eventually sold as slaves or entertainment in the dark elves' subterranean cities.
zh_tw: 在世界表面之下深處是幽暗地域，一個由無盡的迷宮般隧道和洞穴組成的領域，那裡太陽永不照耀。幽暗地域充滿了數不勝數的種族和生物，其中最突出的便是卓爾——卓爾。甚至被同為黑暗住民的同伴所憎恨和恐懼，卓爾襲擊幽暗地域的其他聚居地以及地表世界，將階下囚帶回。這些囚犯被{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}弄得{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，然後戴上項圈和鐐銬，最終在卓爾的地下城市中被賣作奴隸或娛樂品。

english: The adventurers have all had the misfortune of falling to such a fate. Captured by the drow, they are prisoners at one of the dark elves' outposts, awaiting transportation to Menzoberranzan, the City of Spiders. Whether they came into the Underdark seeking knowledge or fortune, or were just in the wrong place at the wrong time, they were ripe prey for a drow raid.
zh_tw: 冒險者們都不幸遭遇了這樣的命運。他們被卓爾俘虜，成為了其中一個卓爾前哨站的囚犯，等待著被運送到蜘蛛之城——魔索布萊城。無論他們是出於尋求知識或財富的目的進入幽暗地域，還是僅僅在錯誤的時間出現在錯誤的地點，他們都是卓爾突襲的合適獵物。

english: The setup of {@i Out of the Abyss} is such that the characters need have no connections with events in the Underdark, or with each other, prior to the start of the adventure. They can meet and get to know each other as prisoners of the drow. Players who would like their characters to have a stronger Underdark connection can choose from the background options in {@adventure appendix A|OotA|17}.
zh_tw: 《{@i 逃離深淵}的設定使得角色在冒險開始之前不需要與幽暗地域的事件或彼此有任何聯絡。他們可以作為卓爾囚犯相遇並相互瞭解。希望角色與幽暗地域有更強聯絡的玩家可以從{@adventure 附錄A|OotA|17}的背景選項中進行選擇。

english: "Prisoners of the Drow" assumes the characters start at 1st level, and that they will achieve 2nd level (if not 3rd) by the end of this chapter of the adventure. Given the challenges of the adventure and the dangers of the Underdark, you can start the characters at a higher level (2nd or 3rd) to make things a bit easier for the players.
zh_tw: "卓爾的囚徒"假定角色從1級開始，並且他們將在本冒險章節結束時達到2級（如果不是3級）。鑑於冒險的挑戰和幽暗地域的危險性，你可以讓角色從更高階別（2級或3級）開始，以使事情對玩家來說更輕鬆一些。

english: Escape!
zh_tw: 逃生！

english: The characters' goal in this chapter of the adventure is straightforward: escape from the drow outpost of Velkynvelve, with an eye toward escaping from the Underdark. However, this goal is complicated by the adventurers' lack of familiarity with their surroundings. Even if the prisoners can get away from the drow, where will they go and how will they survive?
zh_tw: 本章節中角色的目標很明確：從卓爾前哨站維爾京維爾夫逃脫，目標是逃離幽暗地域。然而，這個目標由於冒險者對周圍環境的不熟悉而變得複雜。即使囚犯能夠逃離卓爾，他們將去哪裡，又將如何生存？

english: Restraints
zh_tw: 束縛

english: All the drow's prisoners, including the characters, wear iron slave collars along with manacles connected to iron belts by a short length of chain. This leaves the prisoners {@condition restrained}, but doesn't affect their movement or speed.
zh_tw: 所有卓爾的囚犯，包括角色們，在脖子上戴著鐵製的奴隸項圈，並且手腕上戴著與鐵製腰帶透過一小段鏈條相連的手銬。這使得囚犯們處於{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態，但不影響他們的移動或速度。

english: In addition to being manacled, spellcasters don't have any spell components or focuses, initially limiting their spellcasting ability. (Wizard characters don't need their spellbooks to cast spells, but will be unable to change their prepared spells without them. As such, give wizard characters some leeway in determining which spells they had previously prepared before being captured.) Moreover, spellcasting isn't possible inside the slave pen because of its magical wards (see area 11).
zh_tw: 除了被銬住之外，施法者沒有任何法術成分或焦點，最初限制了他們的施法能力。（法師角色不需要他們的法術書就能施法，但沒有法術書就無法改變他們準備的法術。因此，給法師角色一些靈活性來確定他們在被捕之前準備的法術。）此外，由於其魔法結界（見區域11），在奴隸圍欄內施法是不可能的。

english: Slipping out of manacles requires a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check, while breaking them requires a successful {@dc 20} Strength check. A character can unlock the manacles using thieves' tools with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. The manacles have 15 hit points. The iron collars can be broken with a successful {@dc 20} Strength check. The collars have 12 hit points. A character who fails a check to break a collar, break a set of manacles, or escape from a set of manacles can't attempt checks of that kind again until he or she finishes a long rest. A character can still use the {@action Help} action to aid another character, however.
zh_tw: 掙脫手銬需要成功透過一次 {@dc 20} 敏捷檢定，而破壞手銬則需要成功透過一次 {@dc 20} 力量檢定。角色可以使用盜賊工具透過一次成功 {@dc 15} 的敏捷檢定來解開手銬。手銬有15點生命值。鐵項圈可以透過一次成功 {@dc 20} 的力量檢定來破壞。項圈有12點生命值。如果角色在破壞項圈、破壞手銬或逃脫手銬的檢定中失敗，則必須完成一次長休後才能再次嘗試此類檢定。然而，角色仍然可以使用 {@action Help||協助} 動作來幫助其他角色。

english: The Adventure Begins
zh_tw: 冒險開始

english: The characters begin the adventure in the slave pens of Velkynvelve. Stripped of everything but their underclothing, they are at the mercy of the dark elves and in the company of other prisoners, many of who aren't what they seem.
zh_tw: 角色們在維爾京維爾夫的奴隸圍欄中開始他們的冒險。除了內衣之外，他們被剝奪了一切，完全受黑暗精靈的擺佈，並且與其他許多看似並非其表面所是的囚犯們在一起。

english: Captured by the drow! You wouldn't wish this fate upon anyone, yet here you are—locked in a dark cave, the cold, heavy weight of metal tight around your throat and wrists. You are not alone. Other prisoners are trapped in here with you, in an underground outpost far from the light of the sun. Your captors include a cruel drow priestess who calls herself Mistress Ilvara of House Mizzrym. Over the past several days, you've met her several times, robed in silken garments and flanked by two male drow, one of whom has a mass of scars along one side of his face and neck. Mistress Ilvara likes to impress her will with scourge in hand and remind you that your life now belongs to her. "Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive." Her words echo in your memory, even as you plot your escape.
zh_tw: 被卓爾俘虜！你不會希望任何人遭受這種命運，然而你卻在這裡——被鎖在一個黑暗的洞穴裡，冰冷沉重的金屬緊緊地環繞著你的喉嚨和手腕。你並不孤單。其他囚犯也和你一起被困在這裡，在一個遠離陽光的地下前哨站。你的俘虜者包括一個殘酷的卓爾女祭司，她自稱為米茲瑞姆家族的伊爾瓦拉女士。在過去的幾天裡，你已經幾次見到她，她身穿絲綢長袍，旁邊有兩個男性卓爾，其中一個的臉部和頸部一側有大片疤痕。伊爾瓦拉女士喜歡手持鞭子來強調她的意志，並提醒你，你現在的生命屬於她。"接受你的命運，學會服從，你可能會生存下來。"她的話在你的記憶中迴響，即使你正在策劃你的逃脫。

english: Assume that each player character has been a prisoner in Velkynvelve for {@dice 1d10} days. (Roll separately for each character.) The characters spend most of this time locked in the slave pen, emerging occasionally under heavy guard to perform menial chores for their captors' amusement (see "Hard Labor").
zh_tw: 假設每個玩家角色在維爾京維爾夫已經作為囚犯待了{@dice 1d10}天。（每個角色分別擲骰。）角色們大部分時間都被鎖在奴隸圍欄裡，偶爾在重兵看守下出來，為了他們俘虜的娛樂而做一些雜務（見"苦力"）。

english: Feel free to play out any interaction between the drow, the player characters, and the other prisoners. This is an opportunity to reveal who the characters are and to flesh out their backgrounds and personalities through roleplaying, even as you introduce some of their fellow prisoners. Ilvara's newest consort, Shoor, wants to impress his mistress, while Jorlan, her former consort, sullenly does his duty but casts a curious eye over the prisoners. Any hostile move is met with poisoned crossbow bolts from the drow, and possibly a strike from Ilvara's scourge or a {@spell ray of sickness} spell. The giant spiders attack and poison anyone who attacks the drow. The drow don't kill any of the prisoners (leaving them {@condition unconscious} at 0 hit points) but have no compunction about beating them.
zh_tw: 請隨意演繹卓爾、玩家角色和其他囚犯之間的互動。這是一個透過角色扮演揭示角色身份、背景和個性的機會，同時也可以介紹一些他們的同伴囚犯。伊爾瓦拉的新寵修爾(修爾)想要給她的女主人留下深刻印象，而她的前寵喬蘭(喬蘭)則悶悶不樂地履行他的職責，但對囚犯們投以好奇的目光。任何敵對的舉動都會遭到卓爾的毒藥十字弓箭，以及可能來自伊爾瓦拉的鞭擊或{@spell ray of sickness||致病射線}法術。巨型蜘蛛會攻擊並毒害任何攻擊卓爾的人。卓爾不會殺死任何囚犯（將他們留置在0生命值時處於{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態），但對他們進行毆打卻毫不手軟。

english: In the Slave Pen
zh_tw: 在奴隸圍欄

english: Velkynvelve's slave pen is closed with a heavy iron gate bolted into the stone. See area 11 for more information about the slave pen, including options for opening or breaking through the gate.
zh_tw: 維爾京維爾夫的奴隸圍欄被一扇沉重的鐵門關閉，鐵門用螺栓固定在石頭上。有關奴隸圍欄的更多資訊，包括開啟或破開大門的選項，請見區域11。

english: The prisoners are provided with clay chamber pots, and one of the duties of slaves is to empty them into the pool during their shift. There are no other comforts in the slave pen. Prisoners must sit or lie on the stone floor, and are fed only once each day—a thin mushroom broth served in small clay bowls passed through gaps in the bars of the gate.
zh_tw: 囚犯們被提供陶土便器，奴隸們的一項職責是在他們的輪班期間將它們倒入池中。奴隸圍欄裡沒有其他舒適設施。囚犯們必須坐在或躺在石地板上，每天只被餵食一次——一碗稀薄的蘑菇湯，透過柵欄的縫隙用小陶碗遞送。

english: Scavenged Possessions
zh_tw: 搜尋到的財物

english: The player characters have not been idle during their captivity. Have each player roll a {@dice d20}, and add the number of days ({@dice 1d10}) that player's character has been imprisoned in Velkynvelve. The result determines what, if anything, the character has in his or her possession when the adventure begins.
zh_tw: 角色扮演者在囚禁期間並未閒著。讓每位玩家擲一個{@dice d20}骰子，並加上角色被囚禁在維爾京維爾夫的天數（{@dice 1d10}）。結果決定當冒險開始時，角色手中擁有什麼物品，如果有的話。

english: Fellow Prisoners
zh_tw: 同獄囚犯

english: The characters are held with ten other prisoners, captured during various raids and likewise awaiting transportation to Menzoberranzan. Some can expect to be sold as slaves, while others await death at the hands of the drow or their pets. Regardless of what they might think of the adventurers—and each other—outside the slave pens, all the NPCs have good reason to cooperate in order to escape and survive.
zh_tw: 角色們與另外十名囚犯一起被關押，這些囚犯在各種襲擊中被捕獲，同樣等待著被運送到魔索布萊城。一些人可能被當作奴隸出售，而其他人則等待著被卓爾或他們的寵物處死。不管他們對冒險者——以及彼此——在奴隸圍欄之外的看法如何，所有NPC都有充分的理由合作以逃脫和生存。

english: Buppido
zh_tw: 布皮多

english: A male {@creature derro|OotA}, {@creature Buppido|OotA} is surprisingly gregarious and talkative, demonstrating a keen mind and a disarming manner. This pleasant facade conceals the soul of an insane killer. {@creature Buppido|OotA} secretly believes he is the living incarnation of the derro god Diinkarazan—an avatar of murder offering bloody sacrifices to create a path of carnage through the Underdark for his people to follow to glory. He rationalizes any setbacks (including his capture and imprisonment) as part of his "divine plan." His killings are carefully ritualized, following an exacting process of cutting open the victims and arranging their organs.
zh_tw: 一名男性{@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}，{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}出奇地健談且善於交際，展現出敏銳心靈和令人放鬆警惕的舉止。這愉快的表象下隱藏著一個瘋狂殺手的靈魂。{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}暗自相信自己是迪洛矮人之神迪因卡拉薩恩的活體化身——一個謀殺的化身，透過血腥獻祭為他的族人開闢一條穿越幽暗地域的殺戮之路，以追隨榮耀。他將任何挫折（包括被捕和禁錮術）都合理化為他"神聖計劃"的一部分。他的殺戮經過精心儀式化，遵循著精確的流程：切開受害者並排列他們的器官。

english: Although mad, {@creature Buppido|OotA} is cunning and capable of hiding his true nature to serve his own ends. Because he believes he is a god, he is convinced that he can't be killed (or at least that the death of his mortal form means nothing to him), so he is completely fearless. He assumes everything is part of his divine plan, and enthusiastically participates in any plot to escape from the drow so he can continue his holy work. {@creature Buppido|OotA} is happy to consider his fellow prisoners allies until such time as he no longer needs them, or becomes convinced that the omens point toward the need for one or more of them to be sacrificed to his greater glory.
zh_tw: 儘管瘋了，{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}卻是狡猾的，並且能夠隱藏他的真實本性以服務於自己的目的。因為他相信自己是神，他確信自己不會被殺死（或者至少認為他的凡人形態的死亡對他來說無關緊要），所以他是完全無畏的。他假設一切都是他神聖計劃的一部分，並熱情地參與任何從卓爾手中逃脫的陰謀，以便繼續他的聖工。{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}很樂意將他的同伴囚犯視為盟友，直到他不再需要他們，或者確信徵兆指向需要犧牲他們中的一個或更多人以獲得他更大的榮耀。

english: Prince Derendil
zh_tw: 德倫迪爾王子

english: This hulking {@creature quaggoth} is the most menacing-looking prisoner in the slave pens, and the other prisoners give him a wide berth. If any of the characters speak to him, however, the quaggoth replies in urbane Elvish. He explains that he is not, in fact, a quaggoth, but a gold elf prince polymorphed into quaggoth form by a curse. He claims to be {@creature Prince Derendil|OotA} of the kingdom of Nelrindenvane in the High Forest. His crown was usurped by the evil wizard Terrestor, who trapped him in this form and exiled him from his people.
zh_tw: 這個龐大的{@creature quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}是奴隸圍欄中最具有威脅性的囚犯，其他囚犯都遠遠地避開他。然而，如果任何角色與他交談，幽邃熊怪會用優雅的精靈語回答。他解釋說，他實際上不是幽邃熊怪，而是一個被詛咒變成了幽邃熊怪形態的金精靈王子。他聲稱自己是高森林中奈林登凡王國的{@creature Prince Derendil|OotA|德倫迪爾王子}。他的王冠被邪惡的法師特瑞斯托篡奪，他被變成了這種形態並被流放離開他的人民。

english: Although Derendil behaves like the highborn prince he believes himself to be, he responds to stress—and particularly threats—like a quaggoth: violently tearing foes limb from limb and rending their flesh with sharp claws and teeth. He comes back to himself only after battle, or when someone reinforces his "true identity" to snap him out of it. Derendil laments that he is slowly but surely losing himself to the savagery of his quaggoth form.
zh_tw: 儘管德倫迪爾表現得像他自認為的高貴王子，但他對壓力——尤其是威脅——的反應卻像一個幽邃熊怪：暴力地將敵人撕裂四肢，用鋒利的爪子和牙齒撕扯他們的肉體。只有在戰鬥結束後，或者當有人強調他的"真實身份"來讓他恢復自我時，他才會恢復過來。德倫迪爾哀嘆自己正逐漸但確定無疑地失去自我，沉淪於他幽邃熊怪形態的野蠻之中。

english: In fact, Derendil is simply mad, touched by the delusions of the demon lord Fraz-Urb'luu. The kingdom of Nelrindenvane doesn't exist, and all of "Derendil's" recollections and personality are an illusion created by the Demon Prince of Deception. The quaggoth refuses to believe the truth, and any incontrovertible evidence as to his real nature sends him into a murderous rage.
zh_tw: 實際上，德倫迪爾只是瘋了，被惡魔領主弗拉茲厄魯的幻覺所影響。奈林登凡王國並不存在，而"德倫迪爾"的所有回憶和個性都是由欺詐惡魔王子創造的幻象。幽邃熊怪拒絕相信真相，任何確鑿的證據關於他的真實本性都會使他陷入狂暴的憤怒。

english: Eldeth Feldrun
zh_tw: 艾爾德絲·費爾德倫

english: A female shield dwarf {@creature scout} from Gauntlgrym, Eldeth is high spirited and proud of both her heritage and her people's achievement in reclaiming the ancient dwarven kingdom; she suggests Gauntlgrym as a destination to escape from the Underdark. Eldeth is stubborn and hates the drow and all other "corrupt dark dwellers" such as the derro and duergar.
zh_tw: 一位來自岡特格瑞姆的女性盾矮人{@creature scout||斥侯}，艾爾德絲精神飽滿，對自己祖先的遺產以及她的人民在奪回古代矮人王國方面取得的成就感到自豪；她建議岡特格瑞姆作為逃離幽暗地域的目的地。艾爾德絲固執己見，憎恨卓爾以及所有其他"腐敗的黑暗居民"，比如迪洛矮人和灰矮人。

english: Eldeth wants to get back home, but she is also defiant and self sacrificing—and therefore among the most likely prisoners to perish before getting the opportunity. If that happens, Eldeth asks a character she trusts to promise to carry word of her fate back to her family in Gauntlgrym, along with her shield and warhammer if they are recovered. This might win the characters the approval of Eldeth's kin when they later visit Gauntlgrym.
zh_tw: 艾爾德絲想要回家，但她也具有反抗精神和自我犧牲的品質——因此她是最有可能在有機會之前就喪命的囚犯之一。如果發生這種情況，艾爾德絲請求她信任的角色承諾將她的命運傳回岡特格瑞姆的家人，如果找到了她的盾牌和戰錘，也一併帶回。這可能會在角色們後來訪問岡特格瑞姆時贏得艾爾德絲家人的好感。

english: Jimjar
zh_tw: 吉姆賈爾

english: A male deep gnome {@creature spy}, {@creature Jimjar|OotA} is a feckless rogue with a devil-may-care attitude, a fondness for coin, and an obsession with betting on virtually anything and everything. Once he knows the characters, {@creature Jimjar|OotA} regularly offers them bets on things from their own efforts ("I bet you ten gold you can't get past that sentry without being seen") to the outcomes of random events ("I bet you twenty gold this tunnel is the right way"). He sometimes uses betting to goad others into doing things, but characters can easily turn the tables knowing that {@creature Jimjar|OotA} finds it difficult to refuse a wager. His behavior is unusual for the dour deep gnomes, and others of his kind (including {@creature Topsy|OotA} and {@creature Turvy|OotA}) find {@creature Jimjar|OotA} annoying at best, and unstable and potentially mad at worst.
zh_tw: 一個男性地底侏儒{@creature spy||間諜}，{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}是一個無憂無慮的流氓，他有一種無憂無慮的態度，對金錢的喜愛，以及對幾乎任何事情和一切事物下注的痴迷。一旦他了解了角色們，{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}就會定期向他們提供賭注，從他們自己的努力（"我賭你十金幣，你不能不被看到就透過那個哨兵"）到隨機事件的結果（"我賭你二十金幣這條隧道是正確的路"）。他有時利用下注來刺激別人做事，但角色們可以輕易地扭轉局面，知道{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}發現很難拒絕賭注。他的行為對於嚴肅的地底侏儒來說很不尋常，他的同類（包括{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西}和{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}）認為{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}至多煩人，最壞則不穩定且可能瘋狂。

english: {@creature Jimjar|OotA} is always true to his word, and he manages to keep exact track of his debits and credits in his head, paying up on his bets (or demanding payment) as soon as possible. He's not above pocketing a little extra coin when no one is watching, and he has an amazing ability to secret significant wealth on his person.
zh_tw: {@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}總是言而有信，他能夠精確地記住自己的債務和信用，並且儘可能快地支付賭注（或要求支付）。他不排斥在沒有人注意的時候悄悄拿走一些額外的硬幣，並且他有一種驚人的能力，可以在身上秘密攜帶大量的財富。

english: {@creature Jimjar|OotA} feels as though there's something odd about the twins {@creature Topsy|OotA} and {@creature Turvy|OotA}, but he keeps his opinion to himself unless asked. He does his best to get along with everyone, although some find his gregariousness and constant wagers grating.
zh_tw: {@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}感覺雙胞胎{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西}和{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}有些奇怪，但他除非被問及，否則會保留自己的意見。他盡力與每個人相處，儘管有些人覺得他的社交能力和不斷的打賭令人煩惱。

english: Ront
zh_tw: 榮特

english: A male {@creature orc} from the Iceshield tribe, {@creature Ront|OotA} fled from the slaughter of a band of orcs at the hands of the dwarves, falling down a shaft and wandering in the Underdark before being captured by the drow. He's ashamed of his cowardly act and knows that Gruumsh, the god of the orcs, is punishing him. But he also doesn't want to die, or at least not in drow captivity. {@creature Ront|OotA} is mean, stupid, and hateful, but he also knuckles under to authority and threats. He especially hates Eldeth, as his tribe is at war with her people.
zh_tw: 來自冰盾部落的一位男性{@creature orc||獸人}，{@creature Ront|OotA|榮特}從一群矮人屠殺獸人的過程中逃離，掉入一個礦井，在幽暗地域中徘徊，最後被卓爾捕獲。他對自己懦弱的行為感到羞愧，並知道獸人的神格烏什正在懲罰他。但他也不想死，至少不是在卓爾的囚禁中死去。{@creature Ront|OotA|榮特}是個刻薄、愚蠢、充滿仇恨的人，但他也屈服於權威和威脅。他特別討厭艾爾德絲，因為他的部落與她的族人處於戰爭狀態。

english: {@creature Ront|OotA} engages in threatening behavior and bullying toward the other prisoners unless someone stands up to him.
zh_tw: {@creature Ront|OotA|榮特} 對其他囚犯進行威脅行為和欺凌，除非有人站出來反抗他。

english: Sarith Kzekarit
zh_tw: 薩里斯·克澤卡里特

english: A male {@creature drow}, Sarith is sullen and keeps to himself, rebuffing attempts to talk to him. He is disgraced by his imprisonment but is resigned to his fate, since there doesn't appear to be anything he can do about it. Sarith is accused of murdering one of his fellow drow warriors in a fit of madness, but he has no memory of it. He varies between believing the whole thing is a setup to discredit and destroy him, and fearing that it is all true—which, in fact, it is. He is being held until he can be sent back to Menzoberranzan as a sacrifice to Lolth and an example to others.
zh_tw: 薩里斯是一隻男性{@creature drow||卓爾}，他鬱鬱寡歡，喜歡獨處，拒絕與人交談。他因被監禁而感到恥辱，但已接受了自己的命運，因為似乎沒有他能做的事情。薩里斯被指控在一次瘋狂發作中殺害了他的一位卓爾同胞戰士，但他對此沒有任何記憶。他在相信整個事件是一個為了詆譭和摧毀他而設定的陷阱，以及擔心這一切都是真的之間徘徊——事實上，確實如此。他被關押著，直到他能被送回魔索布萊城，作為對羅絲的犧牲和對其他人的警示。

english: Unknown even to the other drow, Sarith is infected with tainted spores from myconids corrupted by Zuggtmoy, the Demon Queen of Fungi. The initial infestation of the spores caused Sarith's bout of madness, and his health and sanity continue to deteriorate as the spores grow within his brain.
zh_tw: 即使是其他卓爾也不知道，薩里斯被來自祖格莫伊——真菌惡魔女王——腐化的菌人的汙染孢子所感染。孢子的初次感染導致了薩里斯的瘋狂發作，隨著孢子在他的大腦中生長，他的健康和理智繼續惡化。

english: Shuushar the Awakened
zh_tw: 覺醒者舒沙爾

english: A {@creature kuo-toa}, Shuushar is likely to be one of the more unusual creatures any of the adventurers have met. The aquatic hermit is a calm and peaceful presence. He is aware of his people's well-deserved reputation for madness, and claims to have spent a lifetime in contemplation and solitary meditation to overcome that legacy. He appears to have been successful, exuding an aura of enlightened balance. Shuushar is even calm and accepting of his current imprisonment, merely saying that it is what it is, and who can say what end it might eventually lead toward?
zh_tw: 作為一隻{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}，舒沙爾可能是冒險者們遇到的更不尋常的生物之一。這位水生隱士是一個平靜而平和的存在。他意識到他的人民因瘋狂而臭名昭著，聲稱他已經花了一生的時間在沉思和獨自冥想中來克服這一遺產。他似乎已經成功了，散發出一種開明平衡的氣息。舒沙爾甚至對他的當前監禁保持冷靜和接受，只是說事情就是這樣，誰能說它最終會導致什麼結果呢？

english: Although Shuushar is by far the most sane, stable, and honest of the adventurers' fellow prisoners, he is also the most useless to their immediate goals. The kuo-toa hermit is a complete pacifist. He doesn't fight or cause harm to any other creature, even refusing to defend himself or others. He gladly accompanies the party if permitted to do so, however, helping them in any way he can other than violating his most sacred vow.
zh_tw: 儘管舒沙爾是最理智、最穩定、最誠實的囚犯之一，他對冒險者的即時目標也是最無用的。這個寇濤魚人隱士是一個徹底的和平主義者。他不戰鬥，也不對任何其他生物造成傷害，甚至拒絕自衛或保護他人。然而，如果被允許，他很樂意陪伴隊伍，以任何不違反他最神聖誓言的方式幫助他們。

english: Shuushar is familiar with Sloobludop, the kuo-toa town near the Darklake, and has navigated the twisting routes of the Darklake for many years. He hopes to share his enlightenment with his fellow kuo-toa, although he isn't aware of recent events in Sloobludop (see {@area chapter 3|112|x} for details).
zh_tw: 舒沙爾熟悉斯盧布多普，那是位於黑暗湖畔的寇濤魚人小鎮，他已經在黑暗湖曲折的路線上航行多年。他希望能夠與他的寇濤魚人同胞分享他的啟迪，儘管他並不瞭解斯盧布多普最近的事件（詳見{@area 第三章|112|x}）。

english: Stool
zh_tw: 圓凳

english: {@creature Stool|OotA} is a {@creature myconid sprout} captured by {@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA}. {@creature Stool|OotA} is lonely and {@condition frightened}, wanting only to return to its home in Neverlight Grove. If befriended by the characters, {@creature Stool|OotA} gladly offers to guide them to its home, promising them sanctuary with its folk, although it isn't aware of the dangers posed by Zuggtmoy's influence on the myconids (see {@adventure chapter 5|OotA|4}).
zh_tw: {@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳} 是一個被 {@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA|薩里斯·克澤卡里特} 捕獲的 {@creature myconid sprout||蕈人幼體}。{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳} 感到孤獨和 {@condition frightened||恐懼}，只想回到它在 無光林地 的家。如果角色們與它成為朋友，{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳} 會欣然提供指引他們到它的家，並承諾他們可以與它的族人一起獲得庇護，儘管它沒有意識到祖格莫伊對菌人生物的影響所帶來的危險（見 {@adventure 第五章|OotA|4}）。

english: {@creature Stool|OotA} uses rapport spores to establish telepathic communication with other creatures, and it does so to communicate with characters who are kind and friendly toward it. The myconid will also help establish communication with Underdark denizens with whom the characters don't share a language. Once it becomes attached to one or more of the adventurers, {@creature Stool|OotA} behaves somewhat like an enthusiastic and curious younger sibling, sticking close to the characters and asking all kinds of questions.
zh_tw: {@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}使用親和孢子與其他生物建立心靈感應溝通，它這樣做是為了與對它友好和善良的角色交流。菌人生物還會幫助與幽暗地域居民建立溝通，這些居民與角色們沒有共同語言。一旦它對一個或多個冒險者產生依賴，{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}的行為有點像一個熱情好奇的弟弟或妹妹，緊跟角色並提出各種問題。

english: Topsy and Turvy
zh_tw: 託普西和特威

english: Twin deep gnomes, {@creature Topsy|OotA} and her brother {@creature Turvy|OotA} are originally from Blingdenstone in the Underdark. They were captured by the drow while out gathering mushrooms in the tunnels near their home. Like most other svirfneblin, {@creature Topsy|OotA} has a stringy mop of hair while {@creature Turvy|OotA} only has a few tufts of hair atop his otherwise bald head. {@creature Topsy|OotA} is by far the more social of the two. {@creature Turvy|OotA} constantly mumbles and mutters darkly, with {@creature Topsy|OotA} repeating or translating what her brother says.
zh_tw: 一對地底侏儒，{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西} 和她的兄弟 {@creature Turvy|OotA|特威} 原本來自幽暗地域的布靈登石城。他們在離家附近的隧道里採集蘑菇時被卓爾捕獲。像大多數地底侏儒一樣，{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西} 有著一頭蓬鬆的頭髮，而 {@creature Turvy|OotA|特威} 除了頭頂上幾撮頭髮外，其他部分都是禿頂。{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西} 明顯比她的兄弟更善於社交。{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威} 總是不停地嘟囔和低聲抱怨，而 {@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西} 則重複或翻譯她兄弟所說的話。

english: {@creature Topsy|OotA} and {@creature Turvy|OotA} hide the fact that they are {@creature Wererat||wererats}. Infected with the curse of lycanthropy, neither deep gnome has entirely embraced it yet, and they struggle to control their wererat instincts and urges. They are fearful of what potential allies might do if they learn the truth, and are looking out for each other and their own survival. With their transformations controlled by the unseen cycle of the moon, you can use the twins' impending change as a wild card in the adventure. They've been prisoners for less than a month, meaning the full moon is coming.
zh_tw: {@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西}和{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}隱藏了他們是{@creature Wererat||鼠人}的事實。受到鼠人詛咒的感染，這兩位地底侏儒還沒有完全接受它，他們努力控制著自己的鼠人本能和衝動。他們擔心如果潛在的盟友得知真相會怎麼做，並且他們在互相照顧和為自己的生存而努力。他們的變形受到月亮不可見週期的控制，你可以在冒險中使用這對雙胞胎即將到來的變化作為一個野牌。他們被囚禁還不到一個月，這意味著滿月即將到來。

english: A Motley Crew
zh_tw: 一群雜牌軍

english: The other prisoners who manage to escape with the player characters are likely to become their companions for a substantial part of the adventure, so it is good to lay the groundwork for those relationships early on. Some of the NPCs might not survive the initial escape attempt. Others might be lost to the dangers of the Underdark—or might reveal their true colors and betray the party. A few could become true companions. Keep in mind the other prisoners have their own personalities and goals, but are generally willing to cooperate for their own benefit. Their knowledge of the Underdark should encourage the player characters to keep them around at least initially.
zh_tw: 那些設法與玩家角色一起逃脫的其他囚犯很可能會成為他們冒險中相當一部分時間的同伴，因此及早為這些關係奠定基礎是好的。一些NPC可能無法在最初的逃脫嘗試中倖存下來。其他人可能會在幽暗地域的危險中迷失——或者可能會露出他們的真面目並背叛隊伍。少數幾個可能會成為真正的同伴。請記住，其他囚犯有自己的個性和目標，但通常願意為了自己的利益而合作。他們對幽暗地域的瞭解應該鼓勵玩家角色至少在最初階段讓他們留下來。

english: Since managing such a large cast of NPCs can be quite involved, enlist the aid of the players if you wish, having each of them take on the role of managing one or more of the party's companions. The player generally decides what that NPC is doing, with the knowledge that you, as Dungeon Master, can overrule them as needed by the story. Not only does this make the secondary characters easier to manage, it helps the players get to know them and strengthens the bonds between the NPCs and the adventurers.
zh_tw: 由於管理如此眾多的NPC可能會相當複雜，如果你願意，可以請玩家幫忙，讓他們中的每一個承擔起管理一個或多個隊伍夥伴的角色。玩家通常決定那個NPC在做什麼，但要知道，作為地下城主，你可以根據故事需要隨時推翻他們的決定。這不僅使次要角色更易於管理，還有助於玩家瞭解他們，並加強NPC與冒險者之間的聯絡。

english: What the Prisoners Know
zh_tw: 囚犯們所知道的

english: Allow the characters to freely mingle and interact with their fellow prisoners or even the drow guards, although the guards rarely talk to the "surface-dweller scum." Of all the prisoners, only Eldeth and {@creature Jimjar|OotA} speak fluent Common. The others speak Undercommon (or at least understand it). {@creature Ront|OotA} knows some Common, while Derendil speaks Elvish. {@creature Stool|OotA}'s rapport spores can establish telepathic communication to allow everyone to speak freely. The guards aren't observant enough to notice.
zh_tw: 允許角色自由地與他們的囚犯同伴或甚至是卓爾守衛交流，儘管守衛很少與'地表居民渣滓'交談。在所有囚犯中，只有艾爾德絲和{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}能流利地說通用語。其他人說幽暗地域語（或至少能理解它）。{@creature Ront|OotA|榮特}懂得一些通用語，而德倫迪爾說精靈語。{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}的親和孢子可以建立心靈感應溝通，讓每個人都能自由交談。守衛們並沒有足夠警覺去注意到。

english: You might wish to consult the social interaction rules in the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}, in which case the other prisoners are initially indifferent toward the characters. Handle the interactions using roleplaying, Charisma checks, or a balance of the two as best suits your group and the way the adventure unfolds.
zh_tw: 你可能希望參考{@i 城主指南}中的社互動動規則，在這種情況下，其他囚犯最初對角色持中立態度。根據你所在的團隊以及冒險的展開方式，使用角色扮演、魅力檢定或兩者結合來處理這些互動。

english: The characters can learn the following things from talking with their fellow prisoners, some of who have been captives of the drow for a tenday or two:
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過與他們的囚犯同伴交談瞭解到以下資訊，其中一些人已經被卓爾囚禁了十天或更長時間：

english: There are nineteen drow at the outpost, including Ilvara, Shoor, and Jorlan, as well as another priestess named Asha. There are also a dozen quaggoths and a number of giant spiders.
zh_tw: 前哨站有十九名卓爾，包括伊爾瓦拉、修爾和喬蘭，還有另一位名叫阿莎的女祭司。此外還有一些幽邃熊怪和一些巨型蜘蛛。

english: Three drow guards watch the slave pen from the hanging guard tower across the rope bridge, visible through the locked gate.
zh_tw: 三名卓爾守衛從繩橋對面的懸掛警衛塔上監視著奴隸圍欄，透過上鎖的大門可以看到他們。

english: The cell has some sort of antimagic effect on it (see area 11 for details).
zh_tw: 這個牢房對它有一種反魔法效果（詳見區域11）。

english: Jorlan the drow warrior suffered disfiguring injuries recently. Before then, he seemed more in Ilvara's favor. Now Shoor seems to have displaced him.
zh_tw: 卓爾戰士喬蘭最近遭受了毀容的傷害。在此之前，他似乎更受到伊爾瓦拉的青睞。現在修爾似乎取代了他的位置。

english: Jorlan used to have a wand that shot globs of sticky material able to trap targets. Now Shoor carries it, as another sign of their change in status.
zh_tw: 喬蘭過去有一根魔杖，能夠射出粘稠物質的球體來困住目標。現在修爾攜帶它，作為他們地位變化的另一個標誌。

english: It might be a matter of days or tendays before a contingent from Menzoberranzan arrives to take prisoners back to the drow city.
zh_tw: 可能需要幾天或幾十天的時間，來自魔索布萊城的一支隊伍才會到達，將囚犯帶回卓爾的城市。

english: Additionally, the drow {@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA} knows the following:
zh_tw: 此外，卓爾{@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA|薩里斯·克澤卡里特}知道以下內容：

english: A gray ooze lives in the pool. It's harmless, feeding off waste unless disturbed.
zh_tw: 一個灰色軟泥怪生活在池中。它本身無害，靠吃廢物為生，除非被打擾。

english: A supply patrol from Menzoberranzan is a few days overdue, which is unusual.
zh_tw: 來自魔索布萊城的補給巡邏隊已經逾期幾天，這是不尋常的。

english: Hard Labor
zh_tw: 艱苦勞動

english: The drow divide their prisoners into three roughly equal-sized groups and put them to work for a third of the day, supervised by the quaggoths. Their menial tasks include filling and hauling water barrels, operating the lift, cleaning any or all parts of the outpost (whether they need it or not), emptying chamber pots, food preparation and service, washing dishes, and laundry. The prisoners are also given cruel or pointless tasks to occupy them, and for the dark elves' amusement. Such labors include moving or stacking rocks, coiling ropes, and organizing supplies, with prisoners forced to redo work that doesn't meet the drow's arbitrary standards.
zh_tw: 卓爾將他們的囚犯分成三組大致相等大小的群體，並讓他們工作一天的三分之一時間，由幽邃熊怪監督。他們的雜務包括裝滿和搬運水桶、操作升降機、清潔前哨站的任何或所有部分（無論是否需要）、倒空便盆、準備食物和服務、洗碗和洗衣。囚犯們還被賦予殘酷或毫無意義的任務來佔據他們的時間，併為卓爾的娛樂。這樣的勞動包括移動或堆放石頭、卷繩和組織物資，囚犯被迫重做不符合卓爾任意標準的勞動。

english: Characters might or might not work together, depending on how the drow split them up. Prisoners known to be friendly to each other are usually kept apart, and no more than two or three prisoners are allowed to work at a single task at once.
zh_tw: 角色們是否會合作，取決於卓爾如何將他們分開。通常，彼此友好的囚犯會被分開，並且一次只允許兩到三名囚犯共同執行單一任務。

english: The drow and quaggoths are cruel and capricious, but also somewhat bored and looking for amusement. The quaggoths are poor conversationalists, hateful and mistrustful toward the prisoners. The drow are more inclined to talk, if only to boast of their superiority. Characters might trick them into dropping useful bits of information, such as how long the journey to Menzoberranzan is expected to take, or that the outpost is relatively close to the Darklake.
zh_tw: 卓爾和幽邃熊怪既殘忍又任性，但也有些無聊，正在尋找娛樂。幽邃熊怪不善交談，對囚犯懷有仇恨和不信任。卓爾更願意交談，哪怕只是為了誇耀他們的優越性。角色們可能透過欺騙讓他們無意中透露一些有用的資訊，比如前往魔索布萊城之旅預計需要多長時間，或者這個前哨站距離黑暗湖相對較近。

english: Bad Dreams
zh_tw: 噩夢

english: The characters' sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images. Dark shadows seem to move and reach out toward them as the characters wander lost through endless mazes of tunnels. Oily tentacles slide to brush up against them, while a great buzzing and howling rises in the distance. Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects. At least one or more of the characters should wake in a cold sweat from these nightmares after every rest, feeling as though something is out there in the dark depths—something far worse than the drow.
zh_tw: 角色們在奴隸圍欄中的睡眠是不安和多夢的，充滿了奇怪的夢境和令人不安的影象。當角色們在無盡的隧道迷宮中迷失時，黑暗的影子似乎在移動並向他們伸出。油膩的觸手滑過來輕拂他們，遠處傳來巨大的嗡嗡聲和嚎叫聲。化膿的傷口在孢子云或蛆蟲或昆蟲的爬行群中爆開。至少有一個或更多的角色應該在每次休息後從這些噩夢中驚醒，感到好像有什麼東西在黑暗深處——比卓爾更糟糕的東西。

english: You need not explain the cause of these dreams and images at this time. Characters can chalk them up to the conditions in the slave pen, or to the aftereffects of {@item drow poison}, but they are omens of what is happening in the Underdark. Spellcasters, particularly clerics and warlocks, might be most prone to these dreams, but they can visit any or all of the characters.
zh_tw: 此時你無需解釋這些夢境和影象的起因。角色們可以將其歸因於奴隸圍欄中的狀態，或是{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}的後續效應，但它們其實是幽暗地域中正在發生之事的預兆。施法者，尤其是牧師和魔契師，可能最容易受到這些夢境的影響，但它們也可能降臨在任何或所有角色身上。

english: Fight!
zh_tw: 戰鬥！

english: Most of the other prisoners aren't looking for trouble, and even killers such as {@creature Buppido|OotA} are careful to bide their time. Still, both Derendil and {@creature Ront|OotA} have quick tempers, and Sarith the drow is prone to bouts of violence as Zuggtmoy's spores take over his mind. It's possible the characters could provoke a fight. If they do, some of the prisoners (including the deep gnomes) egg on the fighters while others keep their distance or even try to break up the brawl.
zh_tw: 大多數其他囚犯並不尋求麻煩，即使是像{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}這樣的殺手也會謹慎地等待時機。儘管如此，德倫迪爾和{@creature Ront|OotA|榮特}都容易發脾氣，而卓爾薩里斯由於祖格莫伊的孢子控制了他的心智，容易陷入暴力發作。角色們有可能引發一場打鬥。如果他們這麼做了，一些囚犯（包括地底侏儒）會煽動打鬥者，而其他人則保持距離，甚至試圖平息這場混戰。

english: Any violent conflict draws the attention of the drow guards, who initially order any prisoners to stand down from a fight, threatening them with hand crossbows from outside the gate. If necessary, they shoot prisoners with poisoned crossbow bolts to incapacitate them. (See {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Poisons} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for information on {@item drow poison}.) The guards let any fight play out for their own amusement as long as the prisoners don't seem likely to actually kill one another.
zh_tw: 任何暴力衝突都會引起卓爾警衛們的注意，他們最初會命令階下囚停止戰鬥，並用牢門外的手弩威脅它們。如有必要，他們會用淬毒弩箭射擊囚犯使其失能。（關於{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}的資訊，請參閱{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Poisons}的{@i 城主指南}。）只要囚犯們看起來不太可能真的互相殘殺，警衛們就會讓任何戰鬥繼續下去以供他們自己娛樂。

english: Feeding Time
zh_tw: 餵食時間

english: If a prisoner becomes too much trouble, or if the drow need to mete out a lesson on the price of disobedience, they make a gruesome spectacle of feeding a malcontent to the giant spiders in the webs beneath Velkynvelve. Drow guards or quaggoth servants throw the bound prisoner over the edge into the webs, where the spiders quickly converge to bite the victim, injecting their venom. Once the victim is {@condition paralyzed}, the spiders wrap their meal up in webbing.
zh_tw: 如果一個囚犯變得太麻煩，或者如果卓爾需要展示不服從的代價，他們會在維爾京維爾夫下方的蛛網中，將不滿者餵給巨型蜘蛛，製造出一場可怕的場面。卓爾守衛或幽邃熊怪僕從將被捆綁的囚犯扔到網中，蜘蛛會迅速聚集過來咬受害者，注入它們的毒液。一旦受害者處於{@condition paralyzed||麻痺}狀態，蜘蛛就會用蛛網包裹他們的食物。

english: This event is a convenient opportunity to get rid of one or more of the other prisoners before the escape attempt if you don't want them around. As well, you can drive home the cruelty and threat of the drow by eliminating an NPC with whom the characters have formed a bond.
zh_tw: 如果你不希望其他囚犯在逃脫嘗試之前還在身邊，這個事件是一個方便的機會來擺脫他們中的一個或多個。同樣，你可以透過消除一個角色們已經建立了聯絡的NPC來強化卓爾的殘忍和威脅。

english: The Drow
zh_tw: 卓爾

english: The garrison at Velkynvelve consists of twelve {@creature drow}, five {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors}, a junior drow priestess named {@creature Asha Vandree|OotA|Asha} (use the {@creature priest} stat block in the {@i Monster Manual}, but add the Fey Ancestry, Innate Spellcasting, and Sunlight Sensitivity features of the {@creature drow} stat block), and the outpost's commander, a senior {@creature drow priestess of Lolth} named Ilvara. The drow have the assistance of a pack of twelve {@creature Quaggoth||quaggoths} and six trained {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders}.
zh_tw: 維爾京維爾夫的駐軍由十二名{@creature drow||卓爾}、五名{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}、一位名叫{@creature Asha Vandree|OotA|阿莎}的初級卓爾女祭司（使用{@creature priest||祭司}的資料塊（位於{@i 怪物圖鑑}中），但需新增{@creature drow||卓爾}資料塊中的妖精血統、天生施法和陽光敏感特性），以及前哨的指揮官，一位名叫伊爾瓦拉的高階{@creature drow priestess of Lolth||卓爾羅絲女祭司}組成。卓爾們還有十二隻{@creature Quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}和六隻經過訓練的{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}作為幫手。

english: Prominent Drow
zh_tw: 顯赫的卓爾

english: {@creature Ilvara Mizzrym|OotA}
zh_tw: {@creature Ilvara Mizzrym|OotA|伊爾瓦拉·米茲瑞姆}

english: Drow priestess and commander of the outpost
zh_tw: 卓爾女祭司兼前哨站指揮官

english: {@creature Asha Vandree|OotA}
zh_tw: {@creature Asha Vandree|OotA|阿莎·範德里}

english: Junior priestess
zh_tw: 初級女祭司

english: {@b Shoor Vandree}
zh_tw: {@b 修爾·範德里}

english: Drow elite warrior. Ilvara's lieutenant and lover, and Asha's distant cousin
zh_tw: 卓爾精英戰士。伊爾瓦拉的副手和情人，阿莎的遠房表親

english: {@b Jorlan Duskryn}
zh_tw: {@b 喬蘭·杜斯克林}

english: Maimed drow elite warrior. Ilvara's former lieutenant and lover.
zh_tw: 殘疾的卓爾精英戰士。伊爾瓦拉的前副官和情人。

english: Ilvara Mizzrym
zh_tw: 伊爾瓦拉·米茲瑞姆

english: The commander of Velkynvelve is an ambitious drow priestess looking to rise in the esteem of Lolth and her house. She considers command of a mere outpost a stepping stone in her ascension. The posting is beneath her, and she treats both it and her prisoners with contempt. But she also knows the posting is temporary, and she intends to wring every advantage from it in the meantime.
zh_tw: 維爾京維爾夫的指揮官是一位有抱負的卓爾女祭司，她希望在羅絲和她所屬家族的聲望中提升自己的地位。她認為指揮一個簡單的前哨站是她晉升的墊腳石。這個職位對她來說太低了，她對它和她的囚犯都持有蔑視態度。但她也知道這個職位是暫時的，並且她打算在此期間從中榨取每一個優勢。

english: A member of a drow house with a long history as slavers, Ilvara is a cruel mistress who enjoys taunting and tormenting enemies and underlings alike. In addition to a scourge, she wields a {@item tentacle rod}. Although she has taken Shoor Vandree as her lover, Ilvara cares no more about him than she did about Jorlan Duskryn, the lover she discarded due to his crippling injuries.
zh_tw: 伊爾瓦拉是一個有著悠久奴隸販子歷史的卓爾家族的成員，她是一個殘忍的女主人，喜歡嘲弄和折磨敵人和下屬。除了使用鞭子，她還持有一根{@item tentacle rod||觸鬚權杖}（觸手法杖）。儘管她已經將修爾·範德里作為她的情人，但伊爾瓦拉對他並不比她對喬蘭·達斯克林——她因他的嚴重傷害而拋棄的情人——更關心。

english: Asha Vandree
zh_tw: 阿莎·範德里

english: A junior drow priestess under Ilvara's guidance, Asha initially considered Ilvara an example to emulate. That changed after she saw how Ilvara treated Jorlan Duskryn, a seasoned drow warrior who was the commander's lover up until he was badly wounded. Ilvara discarded Jorlan without a second thought, showing Asha the foolishness of expecting any reward for loyalty.
zh_tw: 作為伊爾瓦拉指導下的一名初級卓爾女祭司，阿莎最初將伊爾瓦拉視為效仿的榜樣。但在她看到伊爾瓦拉如何對待喬蘭·杜斯克林——一位經驗豐富的卓爾戰士，也是指揮官的情人，直到他受了重傷——之後，她的看法發生了改變。伊爾瓦拉毫不猶豫地拋棄了喬蘭，向阿莎展示了期待忠誠得到回報是多麼愚蠢。

english: Asha is ambitious enough to know she could assume command of the outpost if anything was to happen to Ilvara, but not courageous enough to challenge her superior openly. She also knows that she would have to impress her superiors in the City of Spiders for any such field promotion to become permanent. As such, Asha moves cautiously, fanning the fires of Jorlan's hatred while keeping her own hands clean of any plotting.
zh_tw: 阿莎足夠有野心，知道如果伊爾瓦拉發生什麼事，她可以接管前哨站的指揮權，但她沒有足夠的勇氣公開挑戰她的上級。她還知道，她必須在蜘蛛之城給上級留下深刻印象，才能使任何此類現場晉升成為永久性的。因此，阿莎謹慎行事，煽動喬蘭的仇恨之火，同時保持自己不參與任何陰謀。

english: Shoor Vandree
zh_tw: 修爾·範德里

english: This drow elite warrior has assumed the role of Ilvara's lieutenant and lover after the injuries suffered by his predecessor, Jorlan Duskryn. Shoor is relatively young and quite arrogant for a drow male, proud of his abilities and accomplishments. He is still flush with his success in winning the favor of Ilvara and advancing his position within the outpost, which shows in his swagger and the way he lords it over every other male in Velkynvelve, particularly Jorlan. Still insecure in his position, Shoor feels the need to demonstrate his skill and effectiveness to his mistress and to find ways to please her.
zh_tw: 這名卓爾精英戰士在其前任喬蘭·達斯克林受傷後，接替了伊爾瓦拉的副官兼情人一職。作為一名卓爾男性，修爾相對年輕且相當傲慢，對自己的能力與成就頗為自豪。他仍沉浸於贏得伊爾瓦拉青睞並在前哨站晉升地位的喜悅中，這種成功體現在他趾高氣揚的舉止，以及對維爾京維爾夫其他男性（尤其是喬蘭）頤指氣使的態度中。由於對自己的地位仍缺乏安全感，修爾覺得有必要向女主人展示自己的才能與效率，並設法取悅於她。

english: As Ilvara's lieutenant, Shoor carries a {@item wand of viscid globs|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}), which once belonged to Jorlan and is used to capture and restrain prisoners.
zh_tw: 作為伊爾瓦拉的副手，修爾攜帶著一根{@item wand of viscid globs|OotA|粘球魔杖}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}），它曾經屬於喬蘭，用於捕捉和約束囚犯。

english: Jorlan Duskryn
zh_tw: 喬蘭·杜斯克林

english: Jorlan turned a talent for inflicting pain into skill as a warrior, and a certain roguish charm into a way to ingratiate himself with his female superiors. He quickly made himself useful to {@creature Ilvara Mizzrym|OotA} as both the field commander of the Velkynvelve garrison and as her lover, enjoying all the benefits that came with both roles.
zh_tw: 喬蘭將施加痛苦的天賦轉化為作為戰士的技能，並將一種特定的流氓魅力轉化為取悅女性上司的方式。他很快在{@creature Ilvara Mizzrym|OotA|伊爾瓦拉·米茲瑞姆}那裡變得有用，既是維爾京維爾夫守軍的戰場指揮官，也是她的情人，享受著這兩個角色帶來的所有好處。

english: Jorlan thought that Lolth favored him, or at least that his charms had deflected her malice, until he had the misfortune of a run-in with a black pudding on an otherwise routine raid. Ilvara's healing magic saved his life but couldn't undo the terrible damage wrought by the ooze's acid. With his once-handsome face melted and scarred, and his sword hand twisted and missing two fingers, Jorlan was no longer the warrior he once was.
zh_tw: 喬蘭曾認為羅絲眷顧他，或者至少他的個人魅力已經轉移了她的惡意，直到他在一次平常的突襲中不幸遭遇了一隻黑色史萊姆。伊爾瓦拉的治癒魔法救了他的命，但無法消除史萊姆酸液造成的可怕傷害。他曾經英俊的面容被融化和留下疤痕，他的劍手扭曲且失去了兩個手指，喬蘭不再是他曾經的戰士。

english: Ilvara relieved Jorlan of duty during his recuperation, replacing him with the young bravo Shoor Vandree. When she then took Shoor to her bed, Jorlan realized his recovery would never be sufficient to regain what he had lost. His heartbreak and loss has since become a virulent hatred for Ilvara and Shoor that slowly eats at him. Jorlan finds the idea of suicide or reckless self-destruction beneath him, however—unless he can find a way to take Ilvara and her new lover with him.
zh_tw: 伊爾瓦拉在喬蘭康復期間解除了他的職務，用年輕的勇士修爾·範德里取代了他。當她隨後將修爾帶到她的床上時，喬蘭意識到他的康復永遠不足以重新獲得他所失去的。他的心碎和失落從此變成了對伊爾瓦拉和修爾的強烈仇恨，這慢慢侵蝕著他。喬蘭覺得自殺或魯莽的自我毀滅是不值得的——除非他能找到一種方法，讓伊爾瓦拉和她的新婚情人與他一同離去。

english: Jorlan knows full well that the sympathy the priestess Asha shows him is an attempt to manipulate him. But he's willing to play along for the time being, hoping to draw Asha closer and potentially use her against Ilvara when the time is right.
zh_tw: 喬蘭非常清楚女祭司阿莎對他的同情是一種試圖操縱他的嘗試。但他願意暫時合作，希望將阿莎拉得更近，並在適當的時候可能利用她來對抗伊爾瓦拉。

english: Because of his injuries, Jorlan has disadvantage on attack rolls, Dexterity checks, and Dexterity saving throws.
zh_tw: 由於受傷，喬蘭在攻擊骰、敏捷檢定和敏捷豁免檢定上具有劣勢。

english: Drow Warriors
zh_tw: 卓爾戰士

english: The remaining drow males garrisoning Velkynvelve are named Balok, Bemeril, Guldor, Honemmeth, Imbros, Jaezred, Jevan, Kalannar, Malagar, Nadal, Nym, and Sorn.
zh_tw: 駐紮在維爾京維爾夫的其餘卓爾男性分別名為巴洛克、貝梅里爾、古爾多、霍內梅斯、伊姆布羅斯、傑茲雷德、傑萬、卡拉納爾、馬拉加爾、納達爾、尼姆和索恩。

english: Roleplaying the Drow
zh_tw: 扮演卓爾

english: The drow are arrogant, cruel, and vicious, viewing their slaves as little more than livestock and treating them with cold disregard. Even the lowest drow understands the inferiority of other creatures, behaving toward the prisoners like sneering nobility. With their superiors, however, the drow are fawning sycophants with a passive-aggressive edge. The males defer to the females, the rank-and-file warriors defer to the elite warriors, and everyone defers to the priestess Ilvara.
zh_tw: 卓爾是傲慢、殘忍和惡毒的，他們將奴隸視為牲畜，對他們冷漠無情。即使是最低等的卓爾也明白其他生物的低等，對囚犯們表現得像嘲笑的貴族。然而，對於他們的上級，卓爾則是諂媚的馬屁精，帶有被動攻擊的邊緣。男性對女性讓步，普通戰士對精英戰士讓步，所有人都對女祭司伊爾瓦拉讓步。

english: Velkynvelve
zh_tw: 維爾京維爾夫

english: The drow outpost is located high in a cavern, built 100 feet above the rocky floor. The outpost consists of a series of small caves in the cavern walls and four "hanging towers"—hollowed-out stalactites connected by walkways, stairs, and rope bridges. The towers are concealed by the thick webs of giant spiders stretched below them, so that only the lowermost parts of the stalactites are visible from the cavern floor.
zh_tw: 卓爾前哨站位於洞穴高處，建造在離岩石地面100尺的空中。前哨站由洞穴壁上一系列小洞穴和四個"懸掛塔樓"組成——這些是被挖空的鐘乳石，透過走道、樓梯和繩橋相連。塔樓被下方巨大蜘蛛的厚網所隱藏，因此從洞穴地面只能看到鐘乳石的最低部分。

english: With the small amount of {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} used in the outpost shielded from the cavern floor below, one might walk the entire length of the cleft without becoming aware of the outpost overhead, hidden in the darkness above the range of torches and lanterns. The giant spiders also serve as guards, dropping down on their web strands to prey upon creatures that find their way into the cavern. Similarly, drow warriors can drop to the cave floor on lines of spider silk to ambush enemies.
zh_tw: 由於這個前哨站只使用了少量的{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}，並且被下方的洞窟地板所庇護，一個人可能走完整條裂隙而不會察覺到隱藏在上方黑暗中的前哨站，它位於火把和提燈的照明範圍之外。巨蜘蛛也充當著警衛，它們會沿著蛛絲線縷降下，捕食那些進入洞窟的生物。同樣地，卓爾戰士也可以沿著蜘蛛絲線降落到洞穴地面上伏擊敵人。

english: Three caves and two hanging towers surrounding a platform make up the main part of the outpost for the drow warriors. The largest of the hanging towers is reserved for the priestesses and the shrine of Lolth, while the other is a guard tower opposite the cave used to hold slaves. North of the slave pen is the den of the outpost's quaggoth servants. Watch posts lie at either end of the outpost, near the northern and southern entrances to the cavern.
zh_tw: 三個洞穴和兩個懸掛塔圍繞著一個平臺構成了卓爾戰士的主要前哨站。最大的懸掛塔是為女祭司和羅絲神殿預留的，而另一個則是位於奴隸洞穴對面的警衛塔。奴隸圍欄的北部是前哨站幽邃熊怪僕人的巢穴。觀察哨位於前哨站的兩端，靠近洞穴的北部和南部入口。

english: Velkynvelve: General Features
zh_tw: 維爾京維爾夫：總體特徵

english: The following features apply throughout the outpost.
zh_tw: 以下特點適用於整個前哨站。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: The interior spaces of the outpost are dimly illuminated by lanterns containing phosphorescent fungi, while the exterior is dark.
zh_tw: 前哨站的內部空間由含有熒光菌的燈籠微弱照亮，而外部則是黑暗的。

english: Sound
zh_tw: 聲音

english: A small waterfall pouring into the cavern creates a constant background noise, negating the cave's tendency to amplify and carry sounds. Checks made to hear things in the cavern are made normally.
zh_tw: 一個小瀑布流入洞穴，創造了持續的背景噪音，抵消了洞穴放大和傳遞聲音的傾向。在洞穴中進行的聽力檢查按正常進行。

english: Stairs
zh_tw: 樓梯

english: These 5-foot-wide stairs are carved into the stone sides of the cavern between several of the cave entrances.
zh_tw: 這些5尺寬的樓梯被雕刻在洞穴入口之間的石頭側面。

english: Bridges
zh_tw: 橋

english: Bridges of spider silk rope connect the walkways to the guard tower and the entrance to the priestess's tower. The swaying bridges are {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for non-drow.
zh_tw: 蛛絲繩橋將步道與守衛塔以及祭司塔的入口相連。對於非卓爾來說，這些搖晃的橋是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: Falling
zh_tw: 墜落

english: A creature pushed off the stairs, a bridge, or the edge of a platform must attempt a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature falls, landing in the webs stretched beneath the outpost. On a successful save, a creature grabs hold of the edge and hangs there until it can climb back up with a {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check made as part of its movement. A failed Strength check means the creature is unable to move and must check again, while failure by 5 or more means a fall to the webs.
zh_tw: 被推下樓梯、橋樑或平臺邊緣的生物必須嘗試進行 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定。若失敗，該生物將墜落，落在前哨站下方張開的蛛網上。若成功透過檢定，生物將抓住邊緣並懸掛在那裡，直到它能夠在移動時進行 {@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定以爬回原處。力量檢定失敗意味著生物無法移動並必須再次進行檢定，而若失敗值超過5點或更多，則意味著生物將墜落在蛛網上。

english: Webs
zh_tw: 蛛網

english: The dense webs of giant spiders kept by the drow conceal the outpost from below. A creature falling into the webs becomes {@condition restrained}. As an action, a {@condition restrained} creature can attempt a {@dc 12} Strength check to break free from the webs. The webs can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 15 hp per 10-foot section, vulnerability to fire, and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage). Each foot of movement in the webs costs 1 extra foot, and any creature other than a spider that enters the webs or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength or Dexterity check to avoid becoming {@condition restrained}. Any movement in the webs attracts the attention of the giant spiders, which attack and feed on trapped creatures.
zh_tw: 卓爾飼養的巨型蜘蛛密集的蛛網從下方遮蔽了前哨站。掉入蛛網的生物會被{@condition restrained||束縛}。作為一個動作，被{@condition restrained||束縛}的生物可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 12}的力量檢定以掙脫蛛網。蛛網也可以被攻擊並摧毀（AC 10，每10尺部分的生命值為15，對火傷害易傷，對鈍擊、毒素和心靈傷害免疫）。在蛛網中每移動一尺需要額外消耗一尺的移動力，任何非蜘蛛的生物進入蛛網或在其回合開始時位於蛛網中，必須成功透過一次{@dc 12}的力量或敏捷檢定，以避免被{@condition restrained||束縛}。在蛛網中的任何移動都會引起巨型蜘蛛的注意，它們會攻擊並捕食被困的生物。

english: A creature falling from the webbing to the cavern floor takes {@dice 10d6} bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 從蛛網墜落到洞穴地面的生物受到{@dice 10d6}點鈍擊傷害。

english: Map 1.1: Velkynvelve
zh_tw: 地圖 1.1: 維爾京維爾夫

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Areas of Velkynvelve
zh_tw: 維爾京維爾夫區域

english: 1. Southern Watch Post
zh_tw: 1. 南部觀察哨

english: Near the southern passage from the cavern is an alcove used as a watch post.
zh_tw: 在洞穴通往南方通道的附近有一個壁龕，被用作守望點。

english: Two {@creature drow} are stationed here at all times, keeping watch over the passage and noting the approach of any creatures. The duty is long and dull, so the watchers are sometimes distracted. A successful Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check made against the guards' passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 12 allows characters to pass unnoticed. Any light from the passage or the cavern below automatically draws the guards' attention, however.
zh_tw: 這裡始終有兩名{@creature drow||卓爾}駐守，監視著通道並注意任何生物的接近。職責漫長而枯燥，因此守衛有時會分心。成功的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿})檢定，對抗守衛的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分12，允許角色未被注意地透過。然而，來自通道或下方洞穴的任何光線都會自動吸引守衛的注意。

english: The drow guards are under orders to report intruders immediately, and to keep them under observation. They take no other action unless ordered or unless they see signs of a significant threat. In that case, they blow a high, shrill note on a warning trumpet to alert the whole outpost.
zh_tw: 卓爾守衛接到命令，要立即報告入侵者，並對他們進行監視。除非接到命令或看到重大威脅的跡象，否則他們不會採取其他行動。在那種情況下，他們會在警報號角上吹響高而尖銳的音符，以警告整個前哨站。

english: 2. Barracks
zh_tw: 2. 營房

english: Stone steps lead from the watch post to a 1-foot-thick platform of zurkhwood (see "{@adventure Fungi of the Underdark|OotA|0|Fungi of the Underdark}" earlier in chapter 2) extending between two of the hanging towers and into three adjoining caverns.
zh_tw: 石階從瞭望塔通向一個1尺厚的祖克木平臺（見第二章前面"{@adventure 幽暗地域的真菌|OotA|0|Fungi of the Underdark}"），它延伸在兩座懸掛塔樓之間，並通向三個相鄰的洞穴。

english: The two southernmost caves serve as barracks for the rank-and-file drow warriors of the outpost. Six warriors dwell in each barracks, each set up with a pallet, a small zurkhwood chest for holding personal possessions and equipment, and a side table. Spider silk rope webbing on the cavern walls is set with hooks for hanging lanterns and other items, but the barracks are rarely lit.
zh_tw: 最南端的兩個洞穴作為前哨站普通卓爾戰士的兵營。每個兵營有六名戰士居住，每個兵營都配備了一個床墊、一個小的祖克木箱子來存放個人物品和裝備，以及一個邊桌。洞穴牆壁上的蜘蛛絲繩網設有掛鉤，用來掛燈籠和其他物品，但兵營很少點亮。

english: One {@creature drow} is present in each of the barracks caves at any time, resting in a meditative trance. A resting drow rises at any significant light or noise, ready to attack.
zh_tw: 在任何時候，每個兵營洞穴中都至少有一名{@creature drow||卓爾}，處於冥想般的休眠狀態。任何顯著的光線或噪音都會使休眠的卓爾甦醒，準備攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The equipment of the resting drow is stored under his pallet: a shortsword, a hand crossbow with a case of 20 hand crossbow bolts, a chain shirt, and a 100-foot coil of silk rope with a small grappling hook at the end.
zh_tw: 休息中的卓爾的裝備存放在他的草墊下：一把短劍、一把帶有20支手弩箭的手弩、一件鎖子甲，以及一卷100尺長的絲繩，繩端有一個小抓鉤。

english: Each of the six chests in each barracks contains a flask of {@item drow poison} used to treat crossbow bolts (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). One flask has enough poison to treat 20 bolts. Each chest also contains two sets of clothing and {@dice 1d4} items from the {@book Trinkets|PHB|5|Trinkets} table in chapter 5 of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
zh_tw: 每個軍營中的六個寶箱各含有一個用於處理弩矢的{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}扁瓶（參見{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}於{@i 城主指南}第八章）。一個扁瓶有足夠處理20支弩箭的毒藥。每個箱子還包含兩套衣物和{@dice 1d4}件來自{@book 飾品|PHB|5|Trinkets}表格的物品（見{@i 玩家手冊}第五章）。

english: 3. Main Hall
zh_tw: 3. 主廳

english: This cave serves as a gathering and eating place for the drow warriors of the outpost. It has four circular tables carved from zurkhwood, each surrounded by five chairs. Part of the hall is used as a food preparation and storage area, containing stocks of dried and fresh fungi, dried fruits, cheeses, preserved meat, and a few clay jars of spices. A heavy iron brazier provides heat for cooking along with {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}, but much of the food is served cold.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴作為前哨站卓爾戰士的聚集和用餐地點。它有四張由祖克木雕刻而成的圓形桌子，每張桌子周圍有五把椅子。大廳的一部分被用作食物準備和儲藏區，存放著乾製和新鮮的真菌、乾果、乳酪、醃肉以及幾罐香料。一個沉重的鐵製火盆為烹飪提供熱量和{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}，但大部分食物都是冷食。

english: At any time, there is a 25 percent chance that {@dice 1d4} {@creature drow} are in the main hall eating or entertaining themselves with dice or card games. If any drow are present, {@dice 1d4} {@creature Quaggoth||quaggoths} are also on hand, serving and cleaning. If there are no drow in the main hall, there is a 25 percent chance that a lone {@creature quaggoth} is here performing its duties.
zh_tw: 任何時候，有25%的機率{@dice 1d4}名{@creature drow||卓爾}在主廳吃飯或透過骰子或紙牌遊戲自娛自樂。如果任何卓爾在場，還有{@dice 1d4}名{@creature Quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}在場，提供服務和清潔。如果主廳沒有卓爾，有25%的機率有一隻孤獨的{@creature quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}在這裡履行其職責。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: There is nothing of value in the main hall apart from what the drow have on them, but characters can loot the larder for the equivalent of up to 30 days of rations, limited by what they can carry. Each day of rations for one character weighs 2 pounds.
zh_tw: 主廳裡除了卓爾身上的東西之外，沒有什麼有價值的東西，但角色們可以從食品儲藏室中掠奪相當於最多30天的口糧，這取決於他們能攜帶的量。每個角色一天的口糧重2磅。

english: 4. Elite Barracks
zh_tw: 4. 精英兵營

english: The two hanging towers flanking the platform are the quarters of the elite warriors of the outpost, except for the commander's lieutenant (currently Shoor Vandree) who has his own quarters in the priestess's tower. Each hanging tower has two chambers, with a rope ladder running between the upper and lower chamber through a zurkhwood trapdoor. The elite warriors have finer furniture, including zurkhwood chairs and small tables around which they sit.
zh_tw: 位於平臺兩側的兩座懸掛塔樓是前哨站精英戰士的住所，除了指揮官的副手（目前是修爾·範德里），他在女祭司塔樓有自己的房間。每個懸掛塔樓有兩個房間，透過一個祖克木門的活板門，有一條繩梯連線上層和下層房間。精英戰士擁有更好的傢俱，包括祖克木椅子和他們圍坐的小桌子。

english: One off-duty {@creature drow elite warrior} rests in one of the chambers here at any given time. There is a 50 percent chance that one {@creature quaggoth} is also present, carrying out chores such as cleaning up or delivering water. Either reacts hostilely to intruders, but they might choose to flee and warn the outpost rather than attack, depending on the odds.
zh_tw: 在任何給定時間，一名休班的{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}在此處的一個房間中休息。有50%的機率，還有一名{@creature quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}在場，執行諸如打掃或送水等雜務。兩者對入侵者都有敵意反應，但根據勝算，他們可能會選擇逃跑並警告前哨站，而不是攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The equipment of the resting drow warrior is stowed beneath his pallet: a shortsword, a hand crossbow with a case of 20 bolts, a chain shirt, and a 100-foot coil of silk rope with a small grappling hook at the end.
zh_tw: 休息中的卓爾戰士的裝備存放在他的草墊下：一把短劍、一把帶有20支弩箭的手弩、一件鎖子甲，以及一卷100尺長的絲繩，繩端有一個小抓鉤。

english: Each of the chests in the four chambers contains a flask of {@item drow poison} used to treat crossbow bolts. One flask has enough poison to treat 20 bolts. Each chest also contains two changes of clothing, {@dice 2d6} sp, {@dice 1d8} gp, and {@dice 1d4} items from the Trinkets table in chapter 5, "{@book Equipment|PHB|5|Trinkets}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
zh_tw: 四個房間中的每個箱子都裝有一瓶用於處理弩箭的{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}。一瓶毒藥足以處理20支弩箭。每個箱子還包含兩套換洗衣物、{@dice 2d6}銀幣、{@dice 1d8}金幣和來自第五章"{@book 裝備|PHB|5|Trinkets}"中飾品表的{@dice 1d4}件物品，出自{@i 玩家手冊}。

english: 5. Lift
zh_tw: 5. 升降機

english: Attached to the edge of the barracks platform is a winch-and-basket device consisting of a large swinging arm that carries a thin cord of strong spider silk. The cord runs through a series of pulleys from a hand-cranked horizontal spool to a heavy woven basket suspended at the end. The basket is kept up on the platform except when it is in use.
zh_tw: 兵營平臺邊緣連線著一個絞盤和籃子裝置，由一個大型擺動臂構成，攜帶著一根細而強韌的蜘蛛絲繩。這根繩索透過一系列滑輪從手搖水平捲筒延伸到末端懸掛的重型編織籃子。籃子通常存放在平臺上，除非在使用中。

english: Two {@creature quaggoth} attendants remain by the lift to watch for a signal from below for the basket to be lowered. They are on guard in case anyone other than a drow or one of their own kind approaches.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}守衛留在升降機旁邊，等待下方的訊號以降低籃子。他們保持警戒，以防除了卓爾或他們自己族類之外的任何人接近。

english: Using the Lift
zh_tw: 使用升降機

english: Up to four Medium creatures can fit somewhat snugly in the basket, which is swung out over the edge of the platform and lowered to the cavern floor below by turning the spool using attached handles. This requires a successful {@dc 18} Strength check, normally provided by two quaggoth servants (one of which makes the check while the other assists with the {@action Help} action). Once on the cave floor, the basket can be loaded with other passengers or up to 800 pounds of cargo, then lifted back up to the platform in the same way. It takes 4 rounds for the basket to move between the platform and the floor under normal operation.
zh_tw: 最多可以容納四個中等體型的生物，籃子被搖出平臺邊緣，並透過使用附帶的把手轉動卷軸將其降至下方的洞穴地面。這需要一個成功的 {@dc 18} 力量檢定，通常由兩個幽邃熊怪僕人來完成（其中一個進行檢定，另一個使用 {@action Help||協助} 動作來幫助）。一旦到達洞穴地面，籃子可以裝載其他乘客或最多800磅的貨物，然後以同樣的方式被抬回平臺。在正常操作下，籃子從平臺移動到地面需要4輪時間。

english: 6. Shrine to Lolth
zh_tw: 6. 羅絲神龕

english: A steep rope bridge leads from the walkway ledge to the uppermost level of the largest hanging tower, called the priestess's tower. The floor of this circular chamber is covered by dark silken mats with a pale web-strand pattern woven through them in silvery thread. In the middle of the chamber (at the center of the web) stands a broad pedestal carved from zurkhwood, with a 10-foot-high sculpted spider at its head. The carving is so lifelike that anyone initially entering the chamber and seeing it in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to recognize it. On a failure, a character mistakes it for a real giant spider.
zh_tw: 一座陡峭的繩橋從走道巖架通向最大的懸塔的最頂層，這座塔被稱為女祭司之塔。這個圓形密閣的地板上覆蓋著帶有蒼白的蛛絲圖案的黑色絲綢墊，圖案由銀色絲線編織而成。在密閣的中間（蛛網的中心）立著一個由祖克木雕刻而成的寬闊基座，其頂部有一隻10尺高的雕刻蜘蛛。這座雕像栩栩如生，任何初次進入密閣並在{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}中看到它的人必須成功透過一次{@dc 12}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能認出它。若檢定失敗，角色會誤以為它是一隻真正的巨蜘蛛。

english: This place is a shrine to Lolth, the drow's spider goddess, and also serves as quarters for {@creature Asha Vandree|OotA|Asha}, the junior priestess. She tends the shrine, overseeing routine rituals and offerings to Lolth.
zh_tw: 這個地方是獻給卓爾蜘蛛女神羅絲的聖地，同時也是初級祭司{@creature Asha Vandree|OotA|阿莎}的住所。她負責照看聖地，監督向羅絲的日常儀式和獻祭。

english: Roll a {@dice d6} when the characters enter the shrine to determine who they might meet.
zh_tw: 當角色進入神龕時，擲一個{@dice d6}骰子來決定他們可能遇到誰。

english: Shrine Activity
zh_tw: 神殿活動

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Activity
zh_tw: 用途

english: Asha is in the room alone, resting
zh_tw: 阿莎獨自一人在房間裡休息

english: Asha and {@dice 1d4} {@creature drow} are engaged in worship
zh_tw: 阿莎和{@dice 1d4} {@creature drow||卓爾}正在參與崇拜

english: The shrine is empty
zh_tw: 神龕是空的

english: The back half of the chamber, behind the altar, is piled with a semicircle of pillows and cushions. Resting among these is a {@creature giant spider} trained and kept by the priestesses. The cushions give the spider sufficient concealment to hide from anyone entering the tower from the front. A character must succeed on a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check contested by the spider's Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to spot it before it moves.
zh_tw: 在祭壇後面的房間後半部分，堆放著半圓形的枕頭和墊子。其中休息著一隻由女祭司訓練和養護的{@creature giant spider||巨蜘蛛}。這些墊子為蜘蛛提供了足夠的隱蔽，使其能夠從塔樓正面進來的人隱藏起來。一個角色必須在感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定上成功，與蜘蛛的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定相對抗，才能在它移動之前發現它。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The altar is flanked by a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each. They hold thick black candles, lit only when a ritual is being performed in the shrine.
zh_tw: 祭壇兩側各有一個沉重的銀燭臺，每個價值25金幣。它們託著粗厚的黑色蠟燭，只有在神龕進行儀式時才會點燃。

english: The eight "eyes" of the spider statue are eight pieces of polished jet—four small ones worth 5 gp each and four larger ones worth 10 gp each. Any non-drow who possesses these gems falls under a curse from Lolth. All spiders and spiderlike creatures attack the bearer of the stones on sight, and such creatures have advantage on checks to detect the possessor of the stones. The curse lasts until all the stones are given into the safekeeping of a drow worshiper of Lolth or the gems are subject to a {@spell remove curse} spell.
zh_tw: 蜘蛛雕像的八個"眼睛"是由八個打磨過的黑玉製成——四個小的價值每個5金幣，四個大的價值每個10金幣。任何非卓爾擁有這些寶石的人都會遭受羅絲的詛咒。所有蜘蛛和類似蜘蛛的生物會在看到寶石持有者時攻擊，並且這些生物在檢定中對發現寶石持有者有優勢。詛咒會持續直到所有的寶石被安全地交給一個卓爾的羅絲信徒保管，或者寶石受到{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}法術的影響。

english: 7. Ilvara's Quarters
zh_tw: 7. 伊爾瓦拉的住處

english: A rope ladder leads down from the shrine into this chamber, which serves as private quarters to Mistress Ilvara, priestess of Lolth and commander of Velkynvelve.
zh_tw: 一條繩梯從神龕通往這個房間，這裡是伊爾瓦拉女士的私人住處，她是羅絲的女祭司和維爾京維爾夫的指揮官。

english: Inside, the walls are hung with black mesh resembling a spider's web, extending from a central spot on the ceiling out to the walls, then draped down like curtains. Thick, woven mats cover the floor, while a low platform is covered with cushions and pillows to make a broad, divan-like bed. One side of the chamber contains a small table and two chairs, while the other holds a small shrine to Lolth, draped in white silk. A heavy chest of black-stained zurkhwood sits at the foot of the bed.
zh_tw: 內部，牆壁上掛著類似蜘蛛網的黑色網狀物，從天花板的中心點延伸到牆壁，然後像窗簾一樣垂下。厚實的編織墊子覆蓋著地板，而一個低平臺被墊子和枕頭覆蓋，形成一個寬闊的沙發床。房間的一側有一張小桌子和兩把椅子，而另一側則有一個供奉羅絲的小神龕，上面披著白色絲綢。一個沉重的黑染祖克木箱子放在床腳。

english: {@creature Drow Priestess of Lolth||Ilvara} retreats to her quarters for privacy, rest, and meditation. Roll a {@dice d6}. On 1–2, the priestess is here. On a roll of 1, {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||Shoor Vandree} is also here with her. Ilvara is furious if anyone dares to enter her quarters unbidden. If the characters catch her here, she casts {@spell web}, {@spell conjure animals}, or {@spell insect plague} to bedevil them while she flees and calls for help. If Shoor is with Ilvara, he attacks to cover her escape.
zh_tw: {@creature Drow Priestess of Lolth||伊爾瓦拉} 退回到她的房間尋求隱私、休息和冥想。擲一個 {@dice d6}。如果是 1-2，女祭司就在這裡。如果是 1，{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||修爾·範德里} 也會和她在一起。如果有人敢未經允許進入她的房間，伊爾瓦拉 會非常憤怒。如果角色們在這裡抓到她，她會施放 {@spell web||蛛網術}、{@spell conjure animals||咒喚獸群} 或者 {@spell insect plague||疫病蟲群} 來困擾他們，同時她逃跑並呼救。如果 修爾 和 伊爾瓦拉 在一起，他會攻擊以掩護她逃跑。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: The chest is locked, and Ilvara keeps the key in a hidden pocket on the inside of her belt. The lock is trapped with a poison needle tipped with {@item drow poison} (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}), which is activated if any attempt is made to open the lock without the proper key. The victim takes 1 piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also {@condition unconscious} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. A successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check reveals the trap. A character using thieves' tools can make a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check to disarm it. Picking the lock requires thieves' tools and another successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 箱子被鎖上了，且伊爾瓦拉將鑰匙藏在她腰帶內側的隱藏口袋中。鎖上裝有塗有{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}（見{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}，位於{@i 城主指南}第八章）的毒針陷阱，如果沒有正確的鑰匙嘗試開鎖就會觸發。受害者受到1穿刺傷害且必須成功透過{@dc 13}的體質豁免檢定否則會陷入{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態1小時。如果豁免檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，目標還會在{@condition poisoned||中毒}的同時陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態。成功的{@dc 20}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定可以發現這個陷阱。使用盜賊工具的角色可以嘗試成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來解除它。撬開鎖需要盜賊工具和另一個成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The side table holds a small silver-framed mirror worth 10 gp. The small shrine to Lolth is carved of zurkhwood and bone, and inlaid with semiprecious stones. It is worth 50 gp if the characters can find a buyer for it.
zh_tw: 邊桌上放著一面價值10金幣的小銀框鏡子。供奉羅絲的小神龕是用祖克木和骨頭雕刻而成，並鑲嵌著半寶石。如果角色們能找到買家，它價值50金幣。

english: The chest contains a variety of silken garments and personal items. There is a silver chain headdress set with small onyx stones, worth 50 gp, and a drawstring bag containing two {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}. A small leather purse contains 24 gp, 30 sp, and a small moonstone worth 20 gp, while another purse is Ilvara's spare spell component pouch.
zh_tw: 箱子裡裝有各種絲質衣物和個人物品。有一件鑲有小縞瑪瑙石的銀鏈頭飾，價值50金幣，以及一個裝有兩瓶{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}的束口袋。一個小皮革錢包裡裝有24金幣、30銀幣和一塊價值20金幣的小月長石，而另一個錢包是伊爾瓦拉備用的法術材料袋。

english: Additionally, the chest contains any valuables once held by the characters and NPCs, including any spellbooks, components, focuses, and magic items lost to the adventurers.
zh_tw: 此外，箱子裡包含了角色和NPC曾經持有的任何貴重物品，包括所有丟失給冒險者的法術書、元件、焦點和魔法物品。

english: 8. Shoor's Quarters
zh_tw: 8. 修爾的住處

english: The lowermost and smallest chamber of the priestess's tower belongs to the commander's lieutenant, the leader of the elite warriors of the outpost. Shoor Vandree, Ilvara's current favorite, is the present occupant. The area's former occupant, Jorlan Duskryn, has been displaced to the elite barracks after his recent injuries.
zh_tw: 女祭司塔中最低也是最小的房間屬於指揮官的副手，前哨站精英戰士的領袖。修爾·範德里，伊爾瓦拉目前的寵兒，是現在的居住者。該區域的前居住者，喬蘭·杜斯克林，在最近的受傷後被轉移到精英兵營。

english: The chamber contains cushions laid out across floor mats, a small carved table with two chairs, and a sturdy zurkhwood chest.
zh_tw: 這個房間內擺放著鋪在地墊上的墊子，一張雕刻的小桌子和兩把椅子，以及一個堅固的祖爾木箱子。

english: Shoor spends most of his off-duty time in Ilvara's quarters, attending to his mistress or awaiting her. Unless you wish him to be found here, his quarters are unoccupied.
zh_tw: 修爾大部分的休息時間都在伊爾瓦拉的房間裡，要麼服侍他的女主人，要麼等待她。除非你希望他在這裡被發現，否則他的房間是空著的。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: The chest is locked, and Shoor keeps the key in his belt pouch. The lock is trapped with a poison needle trap identical to the one in Ilvara's quarters.
zh_tw: 箱子被鎖住了，修爾將鑰匙放在他的腰帶包裡。這個鎖被設定了一個與伊爾瓦拉房間裡相同的毒針陷阱。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The table holds a pewter pitcher and a pair of matched goblets, worth a total of 1 gp.
zh_tw: 桌子上放著一個錫制的水壺和一對配套的高腳杯，總共價值1金幣。

english: The chest contains Shoor's personal items and clothing, as well as a small purse containing 20 gp, a black velvet mask stitched with silver thread in a spiderweb pattern (worth 25 gp), a set of bone dice engraved with Elvish characters (worth 10 gp), a small black velvet bag containing a spider-shaped onyx brooch (worth 50 gp), and a flask of strong, syrupy blue liquor (worth 10 gp). The liquor leaves anyone who drinks it pleasantly {@condition poisoned} for {@dice 1d4} hours.
zh_tw: 箱子裡裝有修爾的個人物品和衣物，還有一小袋裝有20金幣的錢包，一個用銀色線縫製蜘蛛網圖案的黑色天鵝絨面具（價值25金幣），一套刻有精靈文字的骨制骰子（價值10金幣），一個裝有蜘蛛形狀的黑曜石胸針的黑色天鵝絨小袋（價值50金幣），以及一瓶濃烈、粘稠的藍色液體（價值10金幣）。這種液體讓喝下它的人愉快地處於{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態，持續{@dice 1d4}小時。

english: 9. Waterfall
zh_tw: 9. 瀑布

english: Water vents through a crack in the ceiling near the eastern wall between the stalactites of the priestess's tower and the guard tower, creating a small waterfall that pours down to the cavern floor and forms a natural pool (see area 14). Quaggoths gather small barrels of water from the head of the waterfall to serve the outpost's needs.
zh_tw: 水從女祭司塔和守衛塔之間東牆附近的天花板裂縫中噴出，形成了一個小瀑布，傾瀉到洞穴地面上並形成一個天然水池（見區域14）。幽邃熊怪收集瀑布源頭的小桶水以滿足前哨站的需求。

english: The water makes the stone wall within 10 feet of it difficult to scale. Any creature attempting to do so has disadvantage on checks made to climb. Any character who falls lands in the pool below, taking no damage.
zh_tw: 水使得它周圍10尺內的石牆難以攀爬。任何嘗試攀爬的生物在攀爬檢定時具有劣勢。任何掉落的角色會落在下面的水池中，不受到傷害。

english: 10. Guard Tower
zh_tw: 10. 守衛塔

english: The fourth hanging tower, connected by rope bridges to the slave pen and the walkway alongside the priestess's tower, serves as a guard tower for observing the cavern, the western passage, and the slave pen.
zh_tw: 第四個懸掛塔樓透過繩橋與奴隸圍欄和女祭司塔樓旁的走道相連，用作警衛塔，用於監視洞穴、西通道和奴隸圍欄。

english: The lower chamber of the tower is occupied by two {@creature drow} and one {@creature drow elite warrior} on guard duty. It contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs, a smaller side table, and spider silk webbing set with hooks for hanging equipment.
zh_tw: 塔樓的下層由兩名{@creature drow||卓爾}和一名{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}駐守。室內有一張祖克木桌和三把椅子、一張較小的邊桌，以及帶有掛鉤用於懸掛裝備的蛛絲網。

english: As at the watch posts, guard duty here is a dull affair, and the guards are usually distracted enough (talking or passing the time with dice games) that prisoners can move or act unnoticed with a successful Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check contested by the guards' passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score.
zh_tw: 與瞭望塔一樣，這裡的守衛工作是一件枯燥的事情，守衛們通常心不在焉（聊天或透過擲骰子游戲消磨時間），這使得囚犯可以在成功的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定與守衛的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分競爭中不被注意地移動或行動。

english: The tower's upper chamber stores extra arms and armor for the outpost. Characters who gain entrance to the armory can easily loot it (see "Treasure").
zh_tw: 塔的上層房間存放著前哨站額外的武器和盔甲。進入軍械庫的角色可以輕易地掠奪它（見"寶藏"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The contents of the armory include the following:
zh_tw: 軍械庫的內容包含以下物品：

english: 6 chain shirts
zh_tw: 6件鎖子甲

english: 6 suits of studded leather armor
zh_tw: 6套鑲釘皮甲

english: 6 shields
zh_tw: 6面盾牌

english: 6 hand crossbows
zh_tw: 6把手弩

english: 20 cases of hand crossbow bolts, each case containing 20 bolts
zh_tw: 20盒手持弩箭，每盒包含20支箭

english: 6 shortswords and 10 daggers
zh_tw: 6把短劍和10把匕首

english: 6 bags of caltrops (20 caltrops per bag)
zh_tw: 6袋釘刺（每袋20個釘刺）

english: 4 100-foot-long coils of silk rope
zh_tw: 4卷100尺長的絲綢繩索

english: 2 building hammers (not usable as weapons)
zh_tw: 2把建築用錘子（不可用作武器）

english: 2 bags of iron spikes (10 spikes per bag)
zh_tw: 2袋鐵釘（每袋10根釘子）

english: 11. Slave Pen
zh_tw: 11. 奴隸圍欄

english: This cave is built to hold captives until they are sent to Menzoberranzan to be sold as slaves.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴是用來關押俘虜，直到他們被送往魔索布萊城去當奴隸賣掉。

english: The gate to the slave pen is kept locked. A character using thieves' tools can pick the lock with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check. A character using makeshift tools can attempt the same check but has disadvantage. A lock-picking attempt might draw the attention of the guards, requiring a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check contested by the guards' passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score to carry it off without notice. Each of the guards on duty in the other areas of the outpost has a key to the gate hanging from a belt ring. Breaking the gate's lock and forcing it open requires a successful {@dc 20} Strength check.
zh_tw: 奴隸圈的門一直鎖著。使用盜賊工具的角色可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 20} 敏捷檢定來撬開鎖。使用臨時工具的角色可以嘗試相同的檢定，但處於劣勢。撬鎖的嘗試可能會引起守衛的注意，需要進行一個敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，與守衛的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）分數進行對抗，以在不引起注意的情況下完成。在哨站其他區域值班的每個守衛的腰帶環上都掛著一把門鑰匙。強行開啟門鎖並破門需要一個成功的 {@dc 20} 力量檢定。

english: Magical Wards
zh_tw: 魔法結界

english: The drow have placed powerful wards on the slave pen to inhibit spellcasters and shield the area against scrying attempts.
zh_tw: 卓爾在奴隸圍欄上施加了強大的防護咒語，以抑制施法者並防止該區域被窺探。

english: Spells cast within the slave pen have no effect, and any slot or magic item charge expended to cast such a spell is consumed. The wards don't suppress or negate spell effects that originate outside the slave pen. For example, a creature under the effect of an {@spell invisibility} spell remains {@condition invisible} when it enters the slave pen.
zh_tw: 在奴隸圍欄內施放的法術沒有效果，任何用於施放此類法術的法術位或魔法物品充能也會被消耗。這些結界不會壓制或抵消來自奴隸圍欄外部的法術效果。例如，當一個生物進入奴隸圍欄時，它仍然處於{@spell invisibility||隱形}法術的效果下，保持{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態。

english: Creatures inside the slave pen can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
zh_tw: 在奴隸圍欄內的生物不能成為任何占卜魔法的目標，也不能透過魔法窺視感測器被感知。

english: 12. Quaggoth Den
zh_tw: 12. 幽邃熊怪巢穴

english: Beyond the slave pen and down a set of stone steps, this cave is used as a den by the dozen quaggoths that serve the drow of Velkynvelve. The interior is littered with nest-like mounds of debris and the scattered bones of the quaggoths' past meals.
zh_tw: 在奴隸圍欄之外，順著一組石階下去，這個洞穴被服務於維爾京維爾夫卓爾的十幾個幽邃熊怪用作巢穴。內部散落著類似巢穴的雜物堆和幽邃熊怪過去餐食的散落骨頭。

english: These servants of the drow use the den only to sleep and eat, with {@dice 1d4} {@creature Quaggoth||quaggoths} resting here at any given time. The quaggoths attack any creature that comes into their den that isn't a drow, a spider, or one of their kind. They don't initially attack unknown quaggoths or drow on sight, but they know all those assigned to the outpost and will question strangers. Derendil and Sarith's status as prisoners is known to them.
zh_tw: 這些卓爾的僕人僅使用這個巢穴來睡覺和進食，任何時候都有{@dice 1d4}只{@creature Quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}在此休息。幽邃熊怪會攻擊任何進入它們巢穴的生物，除非是卓爾、蜘蛛或它們自己的同類。它們不會立即攻擊未知的幽邃熊怪或卓爾，但它們認識所有被分配到前哨站的成員，並且會質問陌生人。德倫迪爾和薩里斯作為囚犯的身份是它們所知道的。

english: 13. Northern Watch Post
zh_tw: 13. 北方觀察哨

english: This small alcove just past and below the quaggoth den has the same features as the watch post at area 1.
zh_tw: 這個小壁龕位於幽邃熊怪巢穴的下方，與區域1的守望點具有相同的特徵。

english: Two {@creature drow} are stationed here on watch, typically hating that duty for its proximity to the quaggoth den, the slave pen, and the pool.
zh_tw: 這裡駐紮著兩個{@creature drow||卓爾}站崗，他們通常討厭這項職責，因為它靠近幽邃熊怪獸穴、奴隸圍欄和水池。

english: 14. Pool
zh_tw: 14. 池塘

english: Water pouring down from the waterfall at area 9 forms a 20-foot-deep pool before flowing out into an underground river that travels several miles before spilling into the Darklake. Since the drow take the water they need from the top of the waterfall, they use the pool to dump waste and garbage. Although this fouls the surface of the pool, the constant flow keeps the water beneath the surface clear.
zh_tw: 從區域9的瀑布傾瀉下來的水形成了一個20尺深的水池，然後流入一條地下河，在流入黑暗湖之前流經數英里。由於卓爾從瀑布頂部取水所需，他們使用這個水池來傾倒廢物和垃圾。儘管這汙染了水池的表面，但不斷的水流保持了水面以下的水清澈。

english: A {@creature gray ooze} lurks in the pool's shallows, blending perfectly with the dark, wet stone. It feeds on the waste dumped into the pool, along with the occasional creature that finds its way into the cavern or falls into the pool.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature gray ooze||灰泥怪}潛伏在池邊淺水區，與黑暗潮溼的石頭完美融合。它以倒入池中的廢物為食，偶爾也會有誤入洞穴或掉入池中的生物成為它的食物。

english: The inhabitants of Velkynvelve remain unaware that the recent arrival of the demon lord Juiblex in the Underdark has made this ooze particularly aggressive and malevolent. In addition to attacking any creature in the pool, the ooze surges up to 10 feet out of the pool to attack creatures at its edge. When it does so, creatures within 30 feet of the ooze telepathically sense a voice cry out, "Flesh for the Faceless Lord!"
zh_tw: 維爾京維爾夫的居民們並不知道惡魔領主朱庇萊克斯最近到達幽暗地域，使得這種軟泥變得特別具有攻擊性和惡意。除了攻擊池中的任何生物外，軟泥還會湧出池外最多10尺來攻擊池邊的生物。當它這樣做時，距離軟泥30尺內的生物會心靈感應地感知到一個聲音呼喊："給無面領主的肉體！"

english: Means of Escape
zh_tw: 逃生手段

english: Unless they want to spend the rest of their lives as drow slaves, the characters should quickly begin looking for ways they can escape. Though the task will not be easy, the characters can take advantage of certain opportunities if they use their heads.
zh_tw: 除非他們想作為卓爾的奴隸度過餘生，否則角色們應該儘快開始尋找逃脫的方法。雖然這項任務並不容易，但如果角色們動動腦筋，他們可以利用某些機會。

english: Acquisitions
zh_tw: 收購

english: One or more of the characters might have useful items in their possession (see "Scavenged Possessions"), and working outside the slave pen creates new opportunities for the characters to acquire and hide small items, including makeshift weapons or tools, or even lift a key to the slave pen from a guard. What they can acquire depends on the work they do and where they go. Use the description of the different locations throughout the outpost as a guide to opportunities. Taking something without being noticed requires a successful Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check contested by the Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks of any active observers, or using an observer's passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score as the base DC. A prisoner that fails the check is commanded to relinquish the item, on pain of death.
zh_tw: 一個或多個角色可能擁有有用的物品（見"搜尋到的財物"），在奴隸圍欄外工作為角色們創造了新的機會去獲取和隱藏小物品，包括臨時武器或工具，甚至可能從守衛那裡偷取奴隸圍欄的鑰匙。他們能獲取什麼取決於他們所做的工作和他們去的地方。使用前哨站不同地點的描述作為機會的指南。在不被注意的情況下拿走某物需要成功的敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手})檢定，與任何活躍觀察者的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定競爭，或使用觀察者的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分作為基礎難度等級。一個囚犯如果檢定失敗，將被命令交出物品，否則將面臨死亡的威脅。

english: What equipment and treasures the characters claim during their escape depend on how much of the outpost they are able to explore before fleeing. For some characters, it might be a fun challenge to escape into the Underdark with little more than the clothes on their backs. For others (including spellcasters who need spellbooks or components), consider placing the party's captured equipment (normally in Ilvara's quarters) in an alternate location if the characters are intent on escaping without exploring all of the outpost, such as the elite drow barracks (area 4) or the armory (area 10).
zh_tw: 角色們在逃脫過程中能夠獲得什麼裝備和財寶，取決於他們在逃跑前能夠探索前哨站的多少區域。對於一些角色來說，帶著身上僅有的衣服逃入幽暗地域可能是一種有趣的挑戰。對於其他角色（包括需要法術書或法術元件的施法者），如果角色們打算在沒有探索整個前哨站的情況下逃脫，可以考慮將隊伍被俘獲的裝備（通常在伊爾瓦拉的房間裡）放置在另一個位置，例如精英卓爾兵營（區域4）或軍械庫（區域10）。

english: Jorlan's Gambit
zh_tw: 喬蘭的計劃

english: When the initial contact between the adventurers and the other prisoners has been played out, Jorlan Duskryn arranges to bring the prisoners their food during his guard duty. (Shoor delights in giving Jorlan such menial work). Standing at the gate to the slave pen and passing in bowls, he mutters to the nearest character: "If I could give you a means to escape from here, would you take it?"
zh_tw: 當冒險者和其他囚犯之間的初次接觸已經上演後，喬蘭·杜斯克林安排在守衛時給囚犯們送食物。（修爾喜歡給喬蘭這樣卑微的工作）。站在奴隸圍欄的大門口，遞進碗時，他低聲對最近的一個角色說："如果我能給你們一個從這裡逃脫的手段，你們會接受嗎？"

english: If the answer is affirmative, Jorlan quickly and quietly proposes to leave the gate to the slave pen unlocked, as well as to create a distraction during the changing of the guards on duty. He tells the characters about the armory, located in the chamber above the guard post in the hanging guard tower in front of the slave pen. The escapees can jump down into the webs below, then over the edge into the pool, making their escape from there.
zh_tw: 如果答案是肯定的話，喬蘭會迅速而安靜地提議讓奴隸圍欄的門保持解鎖狀態，並在守衛換崗時製造一個幹擾。他告訴角色們有關軍械庫的資訊，它位於奴隸圍欄前方懸掛的守衛塔的警衛站上方的房間內。逃犯可以跳入下方的網中，然後跳過邊緣進入水池，從那裡逃脫。

english: Jorlan doesn't particularly care if the prisoners actually escape, which is why he doesn't offer any further help or warn them about the {@creature gray ooze} in the pool. It suits him just as well if the prisoners are killed during their attempt to flee. He simply wants to create an embarrassing incident for Shoor and Ilvara.
zh_tw: 喬蘭並不特別關心囚犯是否真的逃脫，這就是為什麼他沒有提供進一步的幫助或警告他們水池中的{@creature gray ooze||灰泥怪}。如果囚犯在逃跑嘗試中被殺，對他來說也完全合適。他只是想為修爾和伊爾瓦拉制造一個尷尬的事件。

english: Jorlan furtively glances around as he speaks quickly to the characters. If they question him or ask for changes to the plan, he insists it is all he can do. If they accept, he is true to his word, leaving the gate unlocked close to the next guard shift change and delaying the replacement guards for a few minutes.
zh_tw: 喬蘭在說話時偷偷地四處張望。如果他們質疑他或要求改變計劃，他堅持說這是他能做的一切。如果他們接受，他會信守諾言，在下一次守衛換崗前不鎖門，並延遲替換守衛幾分鐘。

english: A Flight of Demons
zh_tw: 惡魔的飛行

english: During a guard change, the prisoners hear a horrible droning buzz echoing through the cavern, followed by inhuman shrieking. Alarm horns sound out as four {@creature chasme} demons pursue a pair of {@creature vrock} demons into the cavern from the northern passage. The demons swoop and buzz around, initially ignoring other creatures as both groups savagely assault each other. The demons' arrival catches all of the drow off guard.
zh_tw: 在換崗期間，囚犯們聽到一個可怕的嗡嗡聲在洞穴中迴盪，接著是不像人類的尖叫聲。警報號角響起，四個{@creature chasme||喀嘶魔}惡魔追逐著一對{@creature vrock||鷲魔}惡魔從北邊通道進入洞穴。惡魔們在周圍盤旋和嗡嗡作響，最初忽略了其他生物，因為兩組惡魔在激烈地互相攻擊。惡魔的到來讓所有的卓爾措手不及。

english: The drow rush to defend the outpost from a possible attack. The demons initially buzz past the hanging towers, leaving the walkways and caverns out of range of the effects of their droning and screeching. However, drow and quaggoths in the towers are close enough to be affected.
