The aerial battle eventually circles around the platform and the towers of the elite warriors as the demons savagely tear into each other.
zh_tw: 卓爾衝出來保衛前哨站，防止可能的攻擊。惡魔們最初從懸掛塔樓旁邊嗡嗡飛過，讓步道和洞穴遠離他們嗡嗡聲和尖叫聲的影響範圍。然而，塔樓中的卓爾和幽邃熊怪足夠近，會受到影響。空中戰鬥最終圍繞著平臺和精英戰士的塔樓盤旋，惡魔們激烈地相互撕咬。

english: The drow move to engage the demons and defend the outpost, leaving the characters with an opportunity to escape. You can combine this event with Jorlan's offer to leave the gate unlocked, making it easy for the characters to slip away. Alternatively (or if they refuse Jorlan's offer), the characters can use the distraction to engineer their own breakout, then decide how to get down to the cavern floor and where to go after that.
zh_tw: 卓爾移動去與惡魔交戰並保衛前哨站，給角色們提供了逃跑的機會。你可以將這個事件與喬蘭的提議結合起來，讓他把大門開著，讓角色們容易溜走。或者（如果他們拒絕了喬蘭的提議），角色們可以利用分散注意力的機會策劃自己的越獄，然後決定如何到達洞穴地面以及之後去哪裡。

english: Describe the chaos of the demon attack and the drow's response as the escaped prisoners try to flee. The characters can follow Jorlan's suggestion to drop into the webs and then dive into the pool, possibly dealing with a {@creature giant spider} or two and the {@creature gray ooze} along the way. Alternatively, they can look for another way down. Reaching the lift requires getting past the drow clustered on the platform and then attempting to operate it during the attack, which might prove difficult.
zh_tw: 描述惡魔襲擊造成的混亂以及卓爾的反應，同時逃脫的囚犯試圖逃跑。角色們可以按照喬蘭的建議，跳入網中，然後跳入池中，途中可能需要對付一兩隻{@creature giant spider||巨蜘蛛}和{@creature gray ooze||灰泥怪}。或者，他們可以尋找另一種下降的方式。到達升降臺需要穿過聚集在平臺上的卓爾，然後在襲擊期間嘗試操作它，這可能證明是困難的。

english: If you want to provide an additional challenge for the characters, a {@creature vrock} tumbles almost in front of them as they reach the cavern floor or move toward their chosen exit. The demon is badly wounded, but even with only 11 hit points remaining and having expended its spores and stunning screech abilities, it is still quite dangerous. It screeches at the characters, but if they do nothing to threaten it for 1 round, the demon takes wing and launches itself back into the fight overhead.
zh_tw: 如果你想為角色們提供額外的挑戰，當他們到達洞穴地面或朝他們選擇的出口移動時，一隻{@creature vrock||鷲魔}幾乎在他們面前翻滾。這個惡魔受了重傷，但即使只剩下11點生命值，並且已經用盡了它的孢子和眩暈尖叫能力，它仍然非常危險。它對角色們尖叫，但如果他們在1輪內沒有威脅它，這個惡魔就會振翅飛起，重新加入上方的戰鬥。

english: If the adventurers take on the fallen vrock and defeat or escape from it, award them a quarter of its usual XP value, or 575 XP, given its weakened state.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們面對倒下的鷲魔並擊敗或逃離它，鑑於它的虛弱狀態，獎勵他們其通常經驗值的四分之一，或者575經驗值。

english: If Jorlan is alive when the demons attack, he might use the distraction to free the prisoners (as described in "Jorlan's Gambit"). Any character who asks Jorlan about the demons gets a stern reply: "The demons are not my doing. Fight them at your own risk."
zh_tw: 如果惡魔攻擊時喬蘭還活著，他可能會利用這個機會釋放囚犯（如在"喬蘭的計劃"中所描述）。任何詢問喬蘭關於惡魔的角色都會得到一個嚴厲的回答："惡魔不是我搞來的。自己承擔風險去戰鬥。"

english: Leaving Velkynvelve
zh_tw: 離開維爾京維爾夫

english: The characters have three choices for leaving Velkynvelve: the north, west, and south passages.
zh_tw: 角色們有三個離開維爾京維爾夫的選擇：北邊、西邊和南邊的通道。

english: North Passage
zh_tw: 北通道

english: This leads toward Menzoberranzan (see {@area chapter 15|4e4|x}) and, eventually, Blingdenstone (see {@adventure chapter 6|OotA|5}). Most of the characters' fellow prisoners discourage travel toward the drow city, and the deep gnomes suggest Blingdenstone as a route out of the Underdark. The party can also follow a circuitous route westward toward the Darklake (see {@adventure chapter 3|OotA|2}).
zh_tw: 這條路通向魔索布萊城（見{@area 第十五章|4e4|x}），最終到達布靈登石城（見{@adventure 第六章|OotA|5}）。大多數角色的同獄囚犯不鼓勵前往卓爾城市，而地底侏儒建議布靈登石城作為離開幽暗地域的路線。隊伍也可以選擇向西繞行至黑暗湖（見{@adventure 第三章|OotA|2}）。

english: West Passage
zh_tw: 西通道

english: This leads most directly toward the Darklake (see {@adventure chapter 3|OotA|2}), although the party could eventually veer south toward Gracklstugh (see {@adventure chapter 4|OotA|3}).
zh_tw: 這條路最直接地通向黑暗湖（見{@adventure 第三章|OotA|2}），儘管隊伍最終可以向南轉向格拉克斯圖格（見{@adventure 第四章|OotA|3}）。

english: South Passage
zh_tw: 南通道

english: This leads toward the duergar city of Gracklstugh (see {@adventure chapter 4|OotA|3}), following a south-westerly route. Characters might need to pass under the battling demons, but the cavern floor is well out of range of their droning and screeching. The demons locked in combat ignore the escaping prisoners, with the possible exception of a fallen vrock (see "{@area A Flight of Demons|048|x}").
zh_tw: 這條路線通向西南方向的灰矮人城市格拉克斯圖格（見{@adventure 第四章|OotA|3}）。角色們可能需要從戰鬥中的惡魔下方透過，但洞穴地面遠離了他們的嗡嗡聲和尖叫聲。陷入戰鬥的惡魔忽視了逃跑的囚犯，可能的例外是一隻倒下的鷲魔（見"{@area 惡魔的飛行|048|x}"）。

english: Whichever route the characters take, chapter 2 covers their passage through the Underdark toward their eventual destination.
zh_tw: 無論角色選擇哪條路線，第二章涵蓋了他們穿越幽暗地域前往最終目的地的過程。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: In addition to the XP awards earned for overcoming the creatures in this chapter, escaping from Velkynvelve earns the characters a special award of 150 XP (divided equally among all party members).
zh_tw: 除了因克服本章中的生物而獲得的經驗值獎勵外，從維爾京維爾夫逃脫還將使角色們獲得一個特別的獎勵，即150經驗值（平均分配給所有隊伍成員）。

english: Chapter 2: Into Darkness
zh_tw: 第2章：進入黑暗

english: Once the adventurers escape from Velkynvelve, they'll want to escape the Underdark. Already miles beneath the surface, they must make their way through an endless maze of passages and caverns, avoid pursuit by the drow, and find a route to the world above—all the while dealing with the dangers of the Underdark and struggling to find the resources they need to survive.
zh_tw: 一旦冒險者們從維爾京維爾夫逃脫，他們就會想要逃離幽暗地域。已經在地表下方數英里處，他們必須穿越無盡的通道和洞穴迷宮，避免被卓爾追擊，並找到通往上界的道路——在此過程中，他們需要應對幽暗地域的諸多危險，並努力尋找生存所需的資源。

english: This chapter presents guidelines for the characters' travels between the various Underdark locales detailed in the other chapters of {@i Out of the Abyss}. Specific areas (including the Darklake region in {@adventure chapter 3|OotA|2}) offer modifications to these guidelines to suit those areas' particular qualities. This chapter also offers guidelines for the drow pursuit of the escaped prisoners, along with additional encounters you can place along the adventurers' route as they travel.
zh_tw: 本章為角色們在{@i 逃離深淵}其他章節中詳述的幽暗地域各個地點之間的旅行提供了指導方針。特定區域（包括{@adventure 第三章|OotA|2}中的黑暗湖地區）會根據這些區域的特質對這些指導方針進行調整。本章還提供了關於卓爾追捕逃犯的指導方針，以及在冒險者旅行路線上可以放置的額外遭遇。

english: Where to Go?
zh_tw: 去哪裡？

english: The players' first question upon escaping from Velkynvelve is likely, "Where do we go next?" The adventurers must find a way out of the Underdark and back to the surface world. Their NPC companions have destinations of their own in mind, and are the ones best able to navigate the subterranean realms. As such, the adventurers will be dependent on their guidance. The NPCs can offer directions and suggestions as follows:
zh_tw: 玩家從維爾京維爾夫逃脫後的第一個問題很可能是，"我們接下來去哪裡？"冒險家們必須找到一條出路，離開幽暗地域回到地表世界。他們的角色同伴（NPC）心中有自己的目的地，並且是最能夠駕馭地下王國的人。因此，冒險家們將依賴於他們的引導。NPC們可以提供如下方向和建議：

english: {@creature Buppido|OotA} knows how to reach Gracklstugh from the southern route out of Velkynvelve. He can also find a route to Gracklstugh from the Darklake. {@creature Buppido|OotA} urges the characters to go to Gracklstugh to acquire better equipment, and out of a desire to return to his people. He also intends to murder the characters one by one along the way, believing them to be divine offerings delivered into his hands.
zh_tw: {@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}知道如何從維爾京維爾夫出發，透過南線到達格拉克斯圖格。他也可以找到從黑暗湖到格拉克斯圖格的路線。{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}敦促角色們前往格拉克斯圖格以獲取更好的裝備，並且出於返回他的人民的願望。他還打算在路上一個接一個地謀殺角色們，認為他們是神靈賜予他手中的祭品。

english: {@creature Prince Derendil|OotA}, the delusional quaggoth, can't offer any useful directions, but he gladly accompanies the party, eager to go to the surface world.
zh_tw: {@creature Prince Derendil|OotA|德倫迪爾王子}，這個妄想的幽邃熊怪，無法提供任何有用的方向，但他很高興地陪伴隊伍，渴望前往地表世界。

english: {@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA} is unfamiliar with this region of the Underdark and can't navigate, but she has a +5 bonus on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks and can help out in that regard.
zh_tw: {@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA|艾爾德絲·費爾德倫} 對幽暗地域的這個區域不熟悉，無法導航，但她在感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定上有+5的加值，在這方面可以提供幫助。

english: {@creature Jimjar|OotA} can guide the party to Blingdenstone from the north route out of Velkynvelve. The svirfneblin city will give the characters access to the surface, although {@creature Jimjar|OotA} is fine with visiting other interesting places along the way, as well as taking {@creature Stool|OotA} back to its home.
zh_tw: {@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾} 可以引導隊伍從維爾京維爾夫的北邊路線前往布靈登石城。這個地底侏儒城市將為角色們提供通往地表的途徑，儘管 {@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾} 也樂於沿途訪問其他有趣的地方，並將 {@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳} 帶回其家中。

english: {@creature Ront|OotA} is unfamiliar with the Underdark and can't navigate. He's willing to stick with the adventurers as long as they seek a destination that gets him back to the surface world.
zh_tw: {@creature Ront|OotA|榮特}對幽暗地域不熟悉，無法導航。只要冒險者們尋找的目的地能讓他回到地表世界，他就願意跟隨他們。

english: {@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA} is the best potential guide in the group, but also the most deceptive. He can navigate to any region of the Underdark shown on the map, but will encourage the characters to travel to Neverlight Grove (see {@adventure chapter 5|OotA|4}). He claims to want to take advantage of {@creature Stool|OotA}'s offer of sanctuary, but it is actually the influence of Zuggtmoy's demon-tainted spores upon his mind.
zh_tw: {@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA|薩里斯·克澤卡里特}是團隊中最佳的潛在嚮導，但也是最具有欺騙性的。他能夠導航到地圖上顯示的幽暗地域任何區域，但會鼓勵角色們前往無光林地（見{@adventure 第五章|OotA|4}）。他聲稱想要利用{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}提供的庇護所，但實際上這是祖格莫伊的惡魔汙染孢子對他心智的影響。

english: Shuushar can navigate through the Darklake once the party is within three miles of any part of it. He's willing to travel with the characters and guide them, and suggests visiting the kuo-toa town of Sloobludop to acquire boats. Shuushar wishes to return to his own people in hopes of guiding them to the enlightenment he has achieved.
zh_tw: 舒沙爾一旦確定隊伍進入黑暗湖三英里範圍內的任何部分，就能導航。他願意與角色們同行並引導他們，並建議訪問寇濤魚人族的小鎮斯盧布多普以獲取船隻。舒沙爾希望返回自己的族人那裡，希望引導他們達到他已經實現的啟迪。

english: {@creature Stool|OotA} can't navigate and has no knowledge of the local area, but it desperately wants to return home to Neverlight Grove, pleading with the characters to take it there. It claims that its people will be grateful and offer the party shelter and aid, and describes its sovereign as wise in the hidden ways of the Underdark.
zh_tw: {@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳} 不能導航，對當地區域一無所知，但它非常渴望回到它的家——無光林地，並懇求角色們帶它去那裡。它聲稱它的人民將會非常感激，併為隊伍提供庇護和幫助，並描述它的君主對幽暗地域隱藏的道路非常瞭解。

english: {@creature Topsy|OotA} and {@creature Turvy|OotA} can navigate to Blingdenstone, but they're reluctant to do so. As such, they are likely to support any suggestion that will not take them to their former home. Once they feel safer, they're likely to strike out on their own, just as they were before the drow captured them.
zh_tw: {@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西} 和 {@creature Turvy|OotA|特威} 能夠導航到布靈登石城，但他們不願意這麼做。因此，他們可能會支援任何不會帶他們回到他們前家園的建議。一旦他們感到更安全，他們可能會像在卓爾捕獲他們之前一樣，獨自出發。

english: On Their Own
zh_tw: 自力更生

english: In the event that none of the prisoners who manage to escape with the party can navigate in the Underdark—or none that the characters are willing to heed at any rate—the adventurers will be forced to wander. The party remains lost until the characters encounter creatures able to give them directions or intent on capturing them. Such creatures can include kuo-toa from Sloobludop, duergar slavers or merchants from Gracklstugh, the goblins from the Silken Paths encounter, or even their drow pursuers intent on dragging them back to Velkynvelve.
zh_tw: 如果沒有任何逃出與隊伍一起的囚犯能夠在幽暗地域中導航——或者至少沒有角色願意聽從的——冒險家們將被迫漫無目的地徘徊。隊伍會一直保持迷路狀態，直到角色們遇到能夠給他們指路的生物，或者打算捕獲他們的生物。這些生物可能包括來自斯盧布多普的寇濤魚人人，來自格拉克斯圖格的灰矮人奴隸販子或商人，來自絲綢之路遭遇的地精，甚至可能是打算將他們拖回維爾京維爾夫的卓爾追蹤者。

english: Underdark Travel
zh_tw: 幽暗地域旅行

english: The Underdark is a vast network of caverns, tunnels, vaults, and passages stretching from one end of Faerûn to the other. Its physical features are even more varied than those of the surface world. Subterranean rivers, fungus fields, deep gorges, underground cities, yawning chasms—the adventurers will have to deal with all these features and more.
zh_tw: 幽暗地域是一個從費倫一端延伸到另一端的巨大洞穴、隧道、拱頂和通道網路。它的物理特徵甚至比地表世界還要多樣化。地下河流、真菌地、深谷、地下城市、巨大裂縫 - 冒險者們將不得不應對所有這些特徵以及更多。

english: Much of the party's travel through the Underdark is handled abstractly, using the rules and advice in chapter 8, "{@book Adventuring|PHB|8|Travel Pace}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}. The following specific guidelines apply to travel in the Underdark during this adventure.
zh_tw: 隊伍在幽暗地域中的大部分旅行是抽象處理的，使用《{@i 玩家手冊}》第8章"{@book 冒險|PHB|8|Travel Pace}"中的規則和建議。在此冒險期間的幽暗地域旅行適用以下具體指導方針。

english: Travel Pace
zh_tw: 旅行步調

english: Travel pace in the Underdark is significantly slower than for overland travel. Not only are the tunnels and passages often {@quickref difficult terrain||3} with uneven surfaces, but routes in the Underdark are rarely direct, and the characters must follow available passages and their various twists and turns, climbs and descents. Creatures that can burrow through solid rock (such as purple worms) move at their normal burrowing speed, but this isn't likely an option for the party.
zh_tw: 在幽暗地域的行進速度比陸地旅行要慢得多。幽暗地域的隧道和通道通常是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}，表面不平坦，而且幽暗地域的路線很少是直接的，角色們必須沿著可用的通道及其各種曲折、升降前進。能夠穿過堅固岩石的生物（如紫蟲）以它們正常的挖掘速度移動，但這對隊伍來說可能不是一個選擇。

english: Encounter Setup
zh_tw: 遭遇設定

english: When an encounter occurs during the adventurers' journey, a number of factors will play into its setup and potential difficulty.
zh_tw: 當冒險者的旅程中發生遭遇時，許多因素將影響其設定和潛在難度。

english: Space and Marching Order
zh_tw: 空間和行進順序

english: Ask the players to establish two marching orders for the characters—one for moving single file and one for moving two abreast. Then when an encounter occurs, roll a {@dice d6}. On a roll of 1–2, the party is traveling through a narrow passageway, so position the adventurers in the single-file marching order. On a roll of 3–4, the characters are traveling through a standard passageway and can use the two-abreast marching order. On a roll of 5–6, the encounter occurs in a large open area, so allow the players to position the characters wherever they like.
zh_tw: 要求玩家為角色建立兩種行進指令——一種是單列行進，另一種是雙列行進。然後當遭遇發生時，擲一個 {@dice d6}。如果是 1-2，隊伍正在透過狹窄的通道，所以將冒險者按照單列行進指令排列。如果是 3-4，角色正在透過標準的通道，可以使用雙列行進指令。如果是 5-6，遭遇發生在一個大型開闊區域，所以允許玩家隨意安排角色的位置。

english: Illumination
zh_tw: 照明

english: Roll a {@dice d6} to determine how an encounter area is illuminated. On a roll of 1–3, the area is dimly lit by the phosphorescent moss and lichen common in the Underdark, or by {@i faerzress} (see "{@area Faerzress|05f|x}"). On a roll of 4–6, the area is dark except for whatever light sources the characters might have.
zh_tw: 擲一個{@dice d6}來確定遭遇區域的照明情況。如果擲出1-3，該區域由幽暗地域常見的熒光苔蘚和地衣，或由{@i 妖光}（見"{@area 妖光|05f|x}"）提供微弱照明。如果擲出4-6，該區域除了角色可能擁有的光源外，是黑暗的。

english: Noticing Threats
zh_tw: 發覺威脅

english: The passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) scores of characters in the party count toward noticing hidden threats only if both the following conditions are met:
zh_tw: 只有當滿足以下兩個條件時，隊伍中角色的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分才計入發現隱藏威脅：

english: The characters are able to see the threat (due to illumination or {@sense darkvision}) or otherwise perceive it.
zh_tw: 角色能夠看到威脅（由於照明或{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺})或以其他方式感知到它。

english: The characters aren't engaged in other activities, including navigating or foraging.
zh_tw: 角色們沒有參與其他活動，包括導航或覓食。

english: A fast pace imposes a −5 penalty to passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) scores to notice threats. You might also decide that only characters in a particular rank of the marching order are able to notice a specific threat.
zh_tw: 快速步伐對被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分施加了−5的懲罰，以注意到威脅。你也可以決定，只有行進順序中特定等級的角色才能注意到特定威脅。

english: Surprise
zh_tw: 出其不意

english: When an encounter occurs, determine if the adventurers or their foes are {@status surprised}, as normal. The adventurers can achieve surprise only if all the following conditions are met:
zh_tw: 當遭遇發生時，按照常規判斷冒險者或他們的敵人是否被{@status surprised||突襲}。冒險者只有在滿足以下所有條件時才能取得突襲：

english: The encounter occurs while the party is moving (not stopped or camped).
zh_tw: 遭遇發生在隊伍移動時（不是停止或紮營）。

english: The party elected the stealth option while moving at a slow pace.
zh_tw: 隊伍選擇了隱秘選項，同時以緩慢的速度移動。

english: At least one party member is capable of noticing the threat and communicating it to the rest of the group.
zh_tw: 至少有一名隊伍成員能夠察覺到威脅並將其傳達給團隊其他成員。

english: Navigating
zh_tw: 導航

english: Becoming lost is a serious risk in the twisting tunnels of the Underdark, and travelers can wander in circles without knowing it. Creatures unfamiliar with a given region of the Underdark are automatically lost, wandering in a random direction for every 4 hours of travel until they encounter an area they are familiar with (which could be a very long time).
zh_tw: 在幽暗地域曲折的隧道中迷路是一個嚴重的風險，旅行者可能會在不知不覺中繞圈子。不熟悉幽暗地域某個區域的生物會自動迷路，每旅行4小時就會隨機朝一個方向遊蕩，直到他們遇到一個他們熟悉的區域（這可能需要很長時間）。

english: Even creatures that know the routes of the Underdark aren't immune. For each day of travel, and any time the characters set out again after finishing a short or long rest, the party's navigator makes a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. If the party is moving at a slow pace, the navigator gains a +5 bonus to the check, while a fast pace imposes a −5 penalty. A failed check result means the characters become lost, wandering in a random direction for {@dice 1d6} hours before the navigator can make a new check to find the right path.
zh_tw: 即使那些熟知幽暗地域路線的生物也不能倖免。每當旅行一天，或是角色們在完成短暫或長時間休息後再次出發時，隊伍的領航員需要進行一次 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。如果隊伍以緩慢的速度移動，領航員在檢定中獲得+5加值，而快速移動則施加-5減值。如果檢定失敗，角色們會迷路，在領航員能夠再次進行新的檢定向正確方向前進之前，他們會隨機方向漫遊 {@dice 1d6} 小時。

english: Mapping
zh_tw: 繪製地圖

english: A character not focused on any other task—including watching for danger while traveling—can record the group's progress through the Underdark and create a map of the route. Such a map can be a useful resource in later chapters of the adventure when the characters retrace their steps. Having a map allows the party to navigate that area without any chance of becoming lost.
zh_tw: 一個沒有專注於任何其他任務的角色——包括在旅行時警惕危險——可以記錄團隊穿越幽暗地域的進展，並製作路線圖。這樣的地圖在冒險的後續章節中，當角色們重走他們的路線時，可能是一個有用的資源。擁有地圖可以讓隊伍在那個區域導航而不會有迷路的風險。

english: Foraging
zh_tw: 覓食

english: Unless they obtain a supply of food and water, the adventurers must forage to survive on their journey. Finding sustenance in the Underdark is difficult but not impossible. Characters can gather food and water if the party travels at a normal or slow pace. A foraging character makes a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. The DC is typically 15, but might be as high as 20 in some parts of the Underdark. Food and water requirements for characters are described in chapter 8, "{@book Adventuring|PHB|8|Food and Water}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
zh_tw: 除非他們獲得食物和水的補給，否則冒險者們必須在旅途中覓食以求生存。在幽暗地域中尋找食物和水是困難的，但並非不可能。如果隊伍以正常或緩慢的速度行進，角色可以收集食物和水。覓食的角色需要進行一次感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。DC通常為15，但在幽暗地域的某些區域可能高達20。角色對食物和水的需求詳見《{@i 玩家手冊}》第8章"{@book 冒險|PHB|8|Food and Water}"。

english: In addition to foraging, spells such as {@spell create food and water} and {@spell goodberry} can help provision the party, and there's always a chance for the characters to encounter others from whom they can buy or steal provisions. Additionally, many creatures the adventurers might meet and kill can be butchered, but the meat they yield spoils after a single day if uneaten. Eating spoiled meat might require a Constitution saving throw to keep the meal down, a Wisdom saving throw to avoid acquiring a level of madness from the awful experience (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" later in this chapter), or both.
zh_tw: 除了覓食，諸如{@spell create food and water||造糧術}和{@spell goodberry||神莓術}這樣的法術可以幫助補給隊伍，而且角色們總有機會遇到他們可以從中購買或偷竊補給的其他人。此外，冒險者可能會遇到的許多生物可以被屠宰，但如果未被食用，它們產生的肉在一天後就會變質。食用變質的肉可能需要進行一次體質豁免檢定以保持食物不下肚，進行一次感知豁免檢定以避免從這次可怕的經歷中獲得瘋狂等級（見本章後面的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"），或兩者都需要。

The characters' need to forage and acquire supplies serves as a motivator to drive them to explore and visit different parts of the Underdark. The more desperate their need becomes—as levels of {@condition exhaustion} rack up—the more risk players will likely be willing to take.
zh_tw: 角色們需要覓食和獲取物資，這成為驅使他們探索和訪問幽暗地域不同部分的動力。隨著他們的需求變得更加迫切——隨著累積的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級——玩家們可能願意冒更大的風險。

english: Time-Keeping
zh_tw: 時間記錄

english: With no sunlight, visible sky, seasons, or weather in the Underdark, most characters can only track the passage of time based on their periods of rest. Most Underdark creatures do the same (if they care about timekeeping at all), unless there is a local means of keeping time.
zh_tw: 幽暗地域沒有陽光、可見的天空、季節或天氣，大多數角色只能根據他們的休息週期來追蹤時間的流逝。大多數幽暗地域的生物也做同樣的事情（如果他們關心時間記錄的話），除非有當地的時間記錄手段。

english: Faerzress
zh_tw: 妖光

english: An unusual magical energy the drow call {@i faerzress} pervades much of the Underdark. The origin of this mysterious arcane power is unknown. Legend claims it is an ancient elven magic dating back to the time when the dark elves were first exiled from the world above. The drow and other Underdark creatures use the properties of areas suffused with {@i faerzress} to protect their settlements.
zh_tw: 一種卓爾稱之為{@i 妖光}的不尋常魔法能量瀰漫在幽暗地域的大部分地區。這種神秘的奧術力量的起源尚不清楚。傳說它是一種古老的精靈魔法，可以追溯到卓爾首次被從地面世界流放的時代。卓爾和其他幽暗地域的生物利用充滿{@i 妖光}的區域的特性來保護他們的定居點。

english: Areas suffused with {@i faerzress} can range in size from a few dozen feet across to several miles in diameter, and feature the following effects:
zh_tw: 充滿{@i 妖光}的區域可以從小几十尺寬到直徑數英里不等，並具有以下效果：

english: Areas suffused with {@i faerzress} are always filled with {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}.
zh_tw: 瀰漫著{@i 妖光}的區域總是充滿{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。

english: A creature in an area suffused with {@i faerzress} has advantage on saving throws against any divination spells. If a divination spell doesn't allow a saving throw, the caster must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw to cast the spell. Failing this save means the spell is wasted and has no effect.
zh_tw: 處於充滿{@i 妖光}區域內的生物在對抗任何預言系法術的豁免檢定中具有優勢。如果預言系法術不允許豁免檢定，施法者必須成功透過一次{@dc 15}的體質豁免檢定才能施放該法術。此次豁免檢定失敗意味著法術被浪費且不會產生任何效果。

english: Any creature attempting to teleport into, within, or out of a {@i faerzress-}suffused area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@dice 1d10} force damage and the teleportation attempt fails. Even if the save succeeds, the teleportation attempt can suffer a mishap as if the destination was known only by description, regardless of how familiar the destination actually is. See the table in the {@spell teleport} spell for more information.
zh_tw: 任何試圖傳送到、在內部傳送或離開一個充滿{@i 妖光}區域的生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}體質豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，該生物會受到{@dice 1d10}點力場傷害，且傳送嘗試失敗。即使檢定成功，傳送嘗試也可能出現意外，就像目的地僅透過描述所知一樣，無論實際熟悉程度如何。更多資訊請參見{@spell teleport||傳送術}法術中的表格。

english: Areas suffused with {@i faerzress} have become tainted by the chaos of the demon lords. When a spell is cast in a {@i faerzress}-suffused area, the caster rolls a {@dice d20}. On a roll of 1, the spell has an additional effect, determined by rolling on the Wild Magic Surge table in chapter 3, "{@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB|Classes}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
zh_tw: 被{@i 妖光}滲透的區域已被惡魔領主的混沌所汙染。當在受{@i 妖光}影響的區域施法時，施法者需投擲一個{@dice d20}。若結果為1，該法術將產生額外效果，具體效果透過第三章"{@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB|狂野魔法浪涌}"中的狂野魔法爆發表決定，該表位於{@i 玩家手冊}中。

english: Though {@i faerzress} can't be dispelled, its effects are temporarily suppressed in the area of an {@spell antimagic field}.
zh_tw: 儘管{@i 妖光}不能被驅散，但在{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}的作用範圍內其效果會被暫時壓制。

english: Equipment
zh_tw: 裝備

english: The equipment the characters have on hand will depend on what they were able to salvage or steal in their escape from Velkynvelve. Indeed, one of the primary reasons for the party to visit known settlements in the Underdark is to acquire proper equipment and provisions.
zh_tw: 角色們手頭上的裝備將取決於他們在逃離維爾京維爾夫時能夠搶救或偷到的東西。事實上，隊伍訪問幽暗地域已知定居點的主要原因之一是為了獲取適當的裝備和供應品。

english: Crafting
zh_tw: 手作

english: Characters can use downtime during their travels to craft equipment, provided they are proficient with the necessary tools and have access to them (see "{@book Downtime Activities|PHB|8|Downtime Activities}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Player's Handbook}). Having to improvise tools doubles the crafting time, and some items require materials that are hard to find in the Underdark, including wood and other surface-world plants. Leather, bone, or zurkhwood (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" later in this chapter) might substitute in some cases. Crafting can include modifying scavenged or salvaged items to fit other needs, such as creating a makeshift suit of armor from gathered pieces of armor and other materials.
zh_tw: 角色在旅行期間可以利用休息時間來製作裝備，前提是他們熟練使用必要的工具並且能夠獲取這些工具（參見{@book 休整期活動|PHB|8|Downtime Activities}，在第8章的{@i 玩家手冊}中）。如果不得不臨時製作工具，製作時間將加倍，而某些物品所需的材料在幽暗地域中難以獲取，包括木材和其他地表世界的植物。在某些情況下，可以使用皮革、骨頭或祖克木（參見本章後面的{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}）作為替代材料。製作包括對拾荒或回收的物品進行改裝以滿足其他需求，例如用收集到的盔甲碎片和其他材料製作一套臨時盔甲。

english: Components
zh_tw: 成分

english: Spellcasters might be without material components for their spells (see "{@book Components|PHB|10|Components}" in chapter 10 of the {@i Player's Handbook}). They can acquire component pouches and spellcasting focuses from defeated enemy spellcasters, settlements, and traders, or they can craft such items during their downtime activities while traveling.
zh_tw: 施法者可能沒有他們法術所需的材料成分（參見{@book 成分|PHB|10|Components}，第10章，{@i 玩家手冊}）。他們可以從被擊敗的敵人施法者、定居點和商人那裡獲得元件袋和施法者法器，或者在旅行的休息活動中製作這些物品。

english: Madness
zh_tw: 瘋狂

english: At the best of times, the Underdark is a bizarre, alien, and inhospitable world, but the influence of the demon lords has transformed it into a domain of madness and chaos. {@i Faerzress} acts as a catalyst, spreading the demon lords' madness throughout the Underdark.
zh_tw: 在最好的情況下，幽暗地域是一個奇異、陌生且不適宜居住的世界，但是惡魔領主的影響已經將其轉變為瘋狂和混亂的領域。{@i 妖光}作為一種催化劑，將惡魔領主的瘋狂傳播到整個幽暗地域。

english: Once the party escapes Velkynvelve and strikes out into the Underdark, begin taking into account the effects of demonic madness on the characters' sanity (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). At various times in the adventure, characters will be called upon to make a saving throw to resist some madness-inducing effect. In addition, you can have one or more characters make a saving throw against madness whenever one of the following events occurs:
zh_tw: 當隊伍逃離維爾京維爾夫並深入幽暗地域時，開始考慮惡魔瘋狂對角色心智的影響（見{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}，{@i 城主指南}第8章）。在冒險的不同階段，角色將需要進行豁免檢定以抵抗某些引發瘋狂的效果。此外，每當以下事件之一發生時，您可以要求一個或多個角色進行對抗瘋狂的豁免檢定：

english: The characters encounter or witness something particularly alien or disturbing (such as a demon lord).
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了或目睹了一些特別陌生或令人不安的事物（例如惡魔領主）。

english: The characters stay in a {@i faerzress}-suffused area for a long time (eight or more consecutive hours).
zh_tw: 角色們在一個充滿{@i 妖光}的區域停留了很長時間（連續八小時或更久）。

english: A character takes psychic damage, particularly in an area suffused with faerzress.
zh_tw: 一個角色受到了心靈傷害，特別是在充滿妖光的區域。

english: In {@i Out of the Abyss}, madness is measured in three levels:
zh_tw: 在{@i 逃離深淵}中，瘋狂被分為三個等級：

english: Madness Levels
zh_tw: 瘋狂等級

english: Level
zh_tw: 等級

english: Effect
zh_tw: 效應

english: Bout of short-term madness (lasts {@dice 1d10} minutes)
zh_tw: 短暫的瘋狂發作（持續{@dice 1d10}分鐘）

english: Bout of long-term madness (lasts {@dice 1d10 × 10} hours)
zh_tw: 長期瘋狂的發作（持續{@dice 1d10 × 10}小時）

english: Bout of indefinite madness (lasts until cured)
zh_tw: 不定期限的瘋狂發作（直到治癒為止）

english: A creature's madness level starts at 0. When the creature fails a madness saving throw, its madness level increases by 1, and the creature immediately suffers the level's effect (as determined by rolling on the Short-Term Madness, Long-Term Madness, or Indefinite Madness table in the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}, as appropriate). When the effect ends, the creature's madness level doesn't change. Any time the creature's madness level increases, it suffers the effect of the new level.
zh_tw: 一個生物的瘋狂等級從0開始。當該生物未透過瘋狂豁免檢定，其瘋狂等級增加1，該生物立即承受該等級的效果（透過擲骰子從{@i 城主指南}中的短期瘋狂、長期瘋狂或永久性瘋狂表中確定，視情況而定）。當效果結束時，該生物的瘋狂等級不會改變。每當該生物的瘋狂等級增加時，其都會承受新等級的效果。

english: If a creature with level 3 madness fails a madness saving throw, its madness level becomes 1. In this way, characters can potentially accumulate multiple forms of madness.
zh_tw: 如果一個擁有3級瘋狂的生物未能透過瘋狂豁免檢定，它的瘋狂等級變為1。以這種方式，角色可能會累積多種瘋狂的形式。

english: Bouts of short- and long-term madness can be cured as described in the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}. Given the demonic source of the madness, {@spell remove curse} and {@spell Dispel Evil and Good||dispel evil} are also effective as cures. A {@spell greater restoration} spell or more powerful magic is needed to cure indefinite madness and also resets a creature's madness level to 0.
zh_tw: 短期和長期瘋狂的發作可以按照{@i 城主指南}中所述的方法治癒。鑑於這種瘋狂的惡魔來源，{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}和{@spell Dispel Evil and Good||驅逐邪惡}也是有效的治療方法。治癒無限期瘋狂需要使用{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}或更強大的魔法，同時將生物的瘋狂等級重置為0。

english: Death
zh_tw: 死亡

english: Allowing the chips to fall where they may in combat emphasizes the challenging nature of this adventure. However, if the characters start falling just as fast, you might want to give the players some opportunities to return dead characters to life during the lower levels of their progress through {@i Out of the Abyss.}
zh_tw: 讓戰鬥中的局勢自然發展體現了這次冒險的挑戰性。然而，如果角色們也迅速倒下，你或許需要在主角們進行{@i 逃離深淵。}的初期階段，給予玩家們一些機會讓死去的角色復活。

english: A {@item spell scroll} of {@spell raise dead} can turn up among some treasure, either when it is needed or for the characters to save for later. A successful {@dc 15} spellcasting ability check is required for a lower-level character to use such a scroll.
zh_tw: 一張 {@item spell scroll||法術卷軸} 中的 {@spell raise dead||死者復活} 可能會在一些寶藏中出現，無論是在需要時還是讓角色儲存以備後用。較低等級的角色使用這樣的卷軸需要成功的 {@dc 15} 施法能力檢定。

english: A strange {@i faerzress} effect can bring a fallen character back to life, but not without a cost. The restored character's madness level increases by 1 upon being restored to life (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" earlier in this chapter).
zh_tw: 一種奇怪的{@i 妖光}效果可以使一個倒下的角色復活，但並非沒有代價。被復活的角色的瘋狂等級在復活時增加1（見本章前面的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。

english: If a fallen character's body is lost or left behind, the party's drow pursuers find it. The drow high priestess casts {@spell raise dead} on the corpse so that the character can be questioned. The character might escape later, or can be reunited with the other adventurers in a later chapter of the adventure when the drow catch up to them.
zh_tw: 如果一個倒下角色的身體丟失或被留下，隊伍的卓爾追擊者會發現它。卓爾的高階女祭司對屍體施放{@spell raise dead||死者復活}法術，以便可以審問該角色。這個角色可能稍後逃脫，或者在冒險的後面章節中，當卓爾追上他們時，可以與其他冒險者團聚。

english: If a player character is permanently slain, think about the ways a player might introduce a new character to the party in the midst of a journey through the Underdark.
zh_tw: 如果一個玩家角色被永久性地擊敗，考慮一下玩家可能會如何在穿越幽暗地域的旅途中引入一個新角色加入隊伍。

english: Convert one of the group's existing nonplayer character allies—including fellow escaped prisoners from Velkynvelve—into a player character. Drow, dwarf, and deep gnome characters are all easily playable. You can even allow a player to take control of a more unusual NPC until a new character can join the group. This is particularly suitable if the player has already been managing that NPC (see "{@area A Motley Crew|013|x}" in chapter 1).
zh_tw: 將團隊中現有的非玩家角色盟友——包括來自維爾京維爾夫的共同逃脫的囚犯——轉換為玩家角色。卓爾、矮人和地底侏儒角色都很容易扮演。你甚至可以允許一個玩家接管一個更不尋常的NPC，直到新角色可以加入團隊。如果玩家已經管理過那個NPC（見第1章中的"{@area 一群雜牌軍|013|x}"），這尤其合適。

english: A creature encounter could reveal a potential new party member, such as a surface dweller lost in the Underdark or sent there to investigate rumors of strange happenings. An escaped slave from another Underdark settlement is another possibility.
zh_tw: 一次生物遭遇可能會揭示一個潛在的新隊伍成員，例如一個在幽暗地域迷路或被派去調查奇怪事件的地表居民。另一個可能是來自其他幽暗地域定居點的逃脫奴隸。

english: A monster encountered by the party might be holding other victims or hostages (a giant spider with a still-living victim wrapped up in its web, or troglodytes holding prisoners destined for their larder, for example). Once the monsters are defeated, a former captive might join the group.
zh_tw: 被隊伍遇到的怪物可能持有其他受害者或人質（例如，一隻巨蜘蛛將其仍然活著的受害者包裹在它的網中，或穴蜥人囚禁著註定要成為他們食物儲藏室的囚犯）。一旦怪物被擊敗，前俘虜可能會加入團隊。

english: Characters might meet up with new party members in any of the Underdark settlements they visit during the adventure, particularly visitors or locals with a strong reason to leave in a hurry.
zh_tw: 在冒險過程中，角色們可能會在他們訪問的任何一個幽暗地域定居點遇到新的隊友，特別是那些有強烈理由急於離開的訪客或當地人。

english: Fungi of the Underdark
zh_tw: 幽暗地域的真菌

english: The Underdark is home to a tremendous variety of fungi with a variety of different uses. Characters can encounter different examples of the Underdark's flora in their travels. Identifying a species of fungi and its potential uses requires a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) check, but Underdark inhabitants are familiar with many of these species automatically.
zh_tw: 幽暗地域是各種用途繁多的真菌的家園。角色在他們的旅途中可能會遇到幽暗地域植物的不同例子。識別一種真菌及其潛在用途需要透過一個 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Nature||自然}）檢定，但幽暗地域的居民會自動熟悉這些物種中的許多種類。

english: Edible Fungi
zh_tw: 可食用真菌

english: Edible fungi provide food and water. Basic food and water requirements for characters are covered in chapter 8, "{@book Adventuring|PHB|8|Food and Water}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
zh_tw: 可食用真菌提供食物和水。角色的基本食物和水的需求在第8章"{@book 冒險|PHB|8|Food and Water}"中有所提及，該章節位於{@i 玩家手冊}中。

english: Barrelstalk
zh_tw: 桶柄菇

english: A barrelstalk is a large, cask-shaped fungus that can be tapped and drained of the fresh water stored within it. A single barrelstalk contains {@dice 1d4 + 4} gallons of water and yields {@dice 1d6 + 4} pounds of food.
zh_tw: 桶形真菌是一種大型的桶狀真菌，可以被敲擊並從中提取儲存的淡水。一個桶形真菌包含{@dice 1d4 + 4}加侖的水，並能產出{@dice 1d6 + 4}磅的食物。

english: Bluecap
zh_tw: 藍帽

english: Dubbed the "grain of the Underdark," a bluecap is inedible, but its spores can be ground to make a nutritious, bland flour. Bread made from bluecap flour is known as sporebread or bluebread. One loaf is equivalent to 1 pound of food.
zh_tw: 被稱為"幽暗地域之糧"的藍帽菌不可食用，但其孢子可以磨成粉，製成營養豐富、味道平淡的麵粉。用藍帽菌麵粉製成的麵包被稱為孢子麵包或藍麵包。一條麵包等同於1磅食物。

english: Fire Lichen
zh_tw: 火苔

english: Pale orange-white in color, fire lichen thrives on warmth, so it grows in regions of geothermal heat. Fire lichen can be ground and fermented into a hot, spicy paste, which is spread on sporebread or added to soups or stews to flavor them. Duergar also ferment fire lichen into a fiercely hot liquor.
zh_tw: 火地衣的顏色是蒼白的橙白色，它在溫暖的環境中生長得很好，因此它生長在地熱區域。火地衣可以研磨併發酵成一種辣味的醬料，塗在孢子麵包上或加入湯或燉菜中調味。灰矮人也把火地衣發酵成一種非常辣的烈酒。

english: Ripplebark
zh_tw: 漣漪樹皮

english: Ripplebark is a shelf-like fungus that resembles a mass of rotting flesh. It is surprisingly edible. Though it can be eaten raw, it tastes better roasted. A single sheet of ripplebark yields {@dice 1d4 + 6} pounds of food.
zh_tw: 波紋樹皮是一種類似腐爛肉體的架子狀真菌。它出人意料地是可以食用的。儘管可以生吃，但烤著吃味道更佳。一張波紋樹皮可以提供{@dice 1d4 + 6} 磅的食物。

english: Trillimac
zh_tw: 崔利馬克

english: A trillimac is a mushroom that grows to a height of four to five feet, and has a broad gray-green cap and a light gray stalk. The cap's leathery surface can be cut and cleaned for use in making maps, hats, and scrolls (its surface takes on dyes and inks well). The stalk can be cleaned, soaked in water for an hour, then dried to make a palatable food akin to bread. Each trillimac stalk provides {@dice 1d6 + 4} pounds of food.
zh_tw: 褶扇菇是一種蘑菇，可以長到四到五尺高，擁有一個寬闊的灰綠色菌蓋和一個淺灰色的菌柄。菌蓋的皮革質感表面可以被切割和清潔，用於製作地圖、帽子和卷軸（其表面吸收染料和墨水效果良好）。菌柄可以清潔後浸泡在水中一小時，然後乾燥，製成類似麵包的可口食物。每個褶扇菇菌柄提供{@dice 1d6 + 4}磅的食物。

english: Waterorb
zh_tw: 水球菌

english: A waterorb is a bulbous fungus that grows in shallow water. A mature waterorb can be squeezed like a sponge, yielding a gallon of drinkable water and a pound of edible (if chewy and somewhat tasteless) food.
zh_tw: 水球菌是一種生長在淺水中的球狀真菌。成熟的水球菌可以像海綿一樣被擠壓，能擠出一加侖的飲用水和一磅可食用的（如果嚼勁十足且味道有些平淡）食物。

english: Zurkhwood
zh_tw: 祖克木

english: Zurkhwood is a massive mushroom that can reach a height of thirty to forty feet. Its large grain-like spores are edible and nutritionally equivalent to {@dice 1d4 + 4} pounds of food, but zurkhwood is more important for its hard and woody stalks. Zurkhwood is one of the few sources of timber in the Underdark, used to make furniture, containers, bridges, and rafts, among other things. Skilled crafters can use stains, sanding, and polishing to bring out different patterns in zurkhwood.
zh_tw: 祖克木是一種巨大的蘑菇，可以達到三十到四十尺的高度。它那大粒狀的孢子是可食用的，營養價值相當於{@dice 1d4 + 4}磅的食物，但祖克木更重要的是其堅硬而木質的莖。祖克木是幽暗地域中少數木材來源之一，用來製作傢俱、容器、橋樑和筏子等。熟練的工匠可以使用染色、打磨和拋光來展現祖克木的不同紋理。

english: Exotic Fungi
zh_tw: 異國真菌

english: The fungi species described in this section have strange properties but no nutritional value.
zh_tw: 這一節中描述的真菌種類具有奇怪的特性，但沒有營養價值。

english: Nightlight
zh_tw: 夜光菌

english: A nightlight is a tall and tube-shaped bioluminescent mushroom that grows to a height of {@dice 1d6 + 4} feet and emits {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} in a 15-foot radius and {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} for an additional 15 feet. A nightlight that is uprooted or destroyed goes dark after 1 round. If a living nightlight is touched, either by a creature or an object, its light goes out until it is touched again.
zh_tw: 夜光菌是一種高大、管狀的發光蘑菇，生長高度可達{@dice 1d6 + 4}尺，並散發出半徑15尺的{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}和額外15尺的{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。一株被連根拔起或摧毀的夜光菌會在1輪後熄滅。如果一個活著的夜光菌被生物或物件觸碰，它的光會熄滅，直到再次被觸碰。

english: Nilhogg's Nose
zh_tw: 尼爾霍格之鼻

english: A Nilhogg's nose is a small mushroom that grants any creature that eats it advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks based on smell for {@dice 1d4} hours. However, the creature suffers disadvantage on saving throws against effects based on smell for the same amount of time.
zh_tw: 尼爾霍格的鼻子是一種小蘑菇，任何吃掉它的生物在接下來的{@dice 1d4}小時內，基於嗅覺的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定上獲得優勢。然而，在同一時間內，該生物在對抗基於嗅覺的效果的豁免檢定上會受到劣勢。

english: Ormu
zh_tw: 歐姆苔

english: A bioluminescent green moss that grows in warm and damp areas, ormu is particularly common near steam tunnels and vents. It sheds {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} in a 5-foot radius, and can be harvested, dried, and made into a phosphorescent powder or pigment.
zh_tw: 奧姆苔蘚是一種生長在溫暖潮溼區域的生物發光綠色苔蘚，在蒸汽隧道和通風口附近尤為常見。它在5尺半徑內散發出{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}，可以被採集、乾燥並製成磷光粉末或顏料。

english: Timmask
zh_tw: 提馬斯克

english: Also known as "the devil's mushroom," a timmask is a two-foot-tall toadstool with orange and red stripes across its beige cap. Uprooting or destroying a timmask causes it to expel a 15-foot-radius cloud of poisonous spores. Creatures in the area must succeed at a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned}. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature is under the effect of a {@spell confusion} spell with a duration of 1 minute. When the spell effect ends, the {@condition poisoned} condition also ends.
zh_tw: 也被稱為"惡魔蘑菇"，提姆面具是一種兩尺高的毒菌，它的米色菌蓋上有著橙色和紅色的條紋。拔起或摧毀提姆面具會導致它釋放一個半徑為15尺的有毒孢子云。區域內的生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 14}的體質豁免檢定，否則會受到{@condition poisoned||中毒}的影響。當以這種方式{@condition poisoned||中毒}時，生物會受到{@spell confusion||困惑術}法術的影響，持續時間為1分鐘。當法術效果結束時，{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態也會結束。

english: Tongue of Madness
zh_tw: 瘋狂之舌

english: Tongue of madness is an edible fungus that looks somewhat like a large human tongue. A creature that eats a tongue of madness must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or compulsively speak aloud its every thought for the next hour. The effect can be ended with a {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 瘋狂之舌是一種可食用的真菌，外觀有些像巨大的人舌。食用瘋狂之舌的生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 體質豁免檢定，否則在接下來的一小時內會不由自主地大聲說出自己的每一個想法。該效果可以透過 {@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術} 或類似的魔法來結束。

english: Torchstalk
zh_tw: 火把草

english: A one- to two-foot-tall mushroom with a combustible cap, a single torchstalk burns for 24 hours once lit. There is a 1-in-6 chance that a torchstalk explodes when lit, bursting into a cloud of fiery spores. Creatures within 10 feet of an exploding torchstalk take 3 ({@dice 1d6}) fire damage.
zh_tw: 這種蘑菇高一至兩尺，菌蓋可燃；一株火把菇點燃後可燃燒24小時。點燃時有六分之一的機率爆炸，散成一團燃燒的孢子。爆炸火把菇10尺內的生物受到3（{@dice 1d6}）點火焰傷害。

english: Narrating the Journey
zh_tw: 敘述旅程

english: As the adventurers make their way through the Underdark, it helps to improvise descriptions of what they experience to add flavor to the journey. As you do, try to stress two key points.
zh_tw: 當冒險者們穿越幽暗地域時，即興描述他們的經歷有助於為旅程增添趣味。在這樣做時，嘗試強調兩個關鍵點。

english: First, the trek is long and arduous. The party is traveling underground, over incredibly difficult and rough terrain, without any of the comforts of the surface world. Food and water are scarce. The darkness never ends. The players should feel as though their characters are in peril throughout their travels, never knowing when something is set to leap at them from the shadows.
zh_tw: 首先，這次徒步旅行漫長而艱苦。隊伍正在地下行進，穿越難以置信的困難和崎嶇的地形，沒有任何地面世界的舒適。食物和水都很稀缺。黑暗永無止境。玩家們應該感覺到他們的角色在旅途中始終處於危險之中，永遠不知道什麼時候有東西會從陰影中跳出來攻擊他們。

english: Second, the Underdark is an exotic, alien landscape unlike anything found on the surface world. Throughout its twisted passageways and impossibly large caverns, characters might find bizarre reminders of lost and forgotten civilizations, unearthly flora and fauna, and incredible geography. Little is as it seems, and much is difficult to explain, or even to describe.
zh_tw: 第二，幽暗地域是一個奇異的、與地表世界截然不同的異域景觀。在其曲折的通道和難以置信的巨大洞穴中，角色們可能會發現失落和被遺忘的文明的奇異遺蹟，超凡的動植物，以及難以置信的地理特徵。事物很少像它們看起來那樣，很多東西難以解釋，甚至難以描述。

english: Drow Pursuit
zh_tw: 卓爾追擊

english: A party of drow from Velkynvelve pursue their escaped prisoners into the Underdark. The drow priestess Ilvara becomes increasingly obsessed with the adventurers, believing they are involved in some secret conspiracy, or perhaps some test of her worthiness. The longer the pursuit, the more determined she is to retake them and have the opportunity to teach them the error of defying her.
zh_tw: 一隊來自維爾京維爾夫的卓爾追逐他們逃跑的囚犯進入幽暗地域。卓爾女祭司伊爾瓦拉越來越痴迷於這些冒險者，相信他們涉及某個秘密陰謀，或者可能是對她價值的某種考驗。追逐的時間越長，她就越決心重新捕獲他們，並有機會教導他們反抗她的錯誤。

english: The drow party consists of Ilvara ({@creature drow priestess of Lolth}), the {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} Jorlan and Shoor, and the junior priestess {@creature Asha Vandree|OotA} (use the {@creature priest} stat block in the {@i Monster Manual}, but add the Fey Ancestry, Innate Spellcasting, and Sunlight Sensitivity features of the {@creature drow} stat block). The hunting party also includes four {@creature drow} warriors who serve as forward scouts. If any of the drow NPCs did not survive chapter 1, replace them with newly arrived reinforcements from Menzoberranzan under the command of Ilvara, or another priestess of her caliber.
zh_tw: 卓爾小隊由伊爾瓦拉（{@creature drow priestess of Lolth||卓爾羅絲女祭司}）、兩名{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}喬蘭和修爾，以及初級女祭司{@creature Asha Vandree|OotA|阿莎·範德里}（使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的{@creature priest||祭司}屬性塊，但新增{@creature drow||卓爾}屬性塊中的妖精血脈、天生施法和陽光敏感受性特性）組成。狩獵隊還包括四名作為前方偵察兵的{@creature drow||卓爾}戰士。如果任何卓爾NPC在第一章中未能倖存，用新到來的來自魔索布萊城的由伊爾瓦拉或其他同等級女祭司指揮的增援部隊替換他們。

english: Tracking the Party
zh_tw: 追蹤隊伍

english: The drow must track the party through the Underdark on foot, as there are no mounts available at Velkynvelve and Ilvara doesn't wait for an already-late relief detachment from Menzoberranzan to arrive. This limits how quickly the dark elves can move to catch up, since they must seek out signs of their quarry's passage, occasionally doubling back to pick up their trail again.
zh_tw: 由於維爾京維爾夫沒有可用的坐騎，且伊爾瓦拉不會等待來自魔索布萊城的已經遲到的增援分隊到達，卓爾必須步行穿越幽暗地域追蹤隊伍。這限制了卓爾追趕的速度，因為他們必須尋找目標行進的跡象，偶爾需要返回重新找到他們的蹤跡。

english: Pursuit Level
zh_tw: 追擊等級

english: The closeness of the drow pursuit is measured by a pursuit level. It begins at 4, with the drow not far behind the characters. If the pursuit level reaches 5, the drow forward scouts catch up to them, and the drow leaders arrive not long thereafter (see "{@area Catching Up|07b|x}"). If the pursuit level drops to 0, the party has eluded the drow until circumstances bring both factions into contact again (see "{@area Eluding Pursuit|07c|x}").
zh_tw: 卓爾追擊的緊迫程度是透過追擊等級來衡量的。它從4開始，卓爾緊隨角色們之後。如果追擊等級達到5，卓爾的前哨偵察兵會追上他們，不久之後卓爾的領袖也會到達（見"{@area 趕上|07b|x}"）。如果追擊等級降至0，隊伍就暫時擺脫了卓爾的追擊，直到情況再次使雙方接觸（見"{@area 逃避追擊|07c|x}"）。

english: Characters can increase or decrease the pursuit level in the following ways:
zh_tw: 角色可以透過以下方式增加或減少追擊等級：

english: Decrease the pursuit level by 1 for each day the party travels at a fast pace.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍每天以快速步伐行進，則追擊等級每天減少1。

english: Decrease the pursuit level by 1 if a character spends time covering up the party's trail that day, requiring a successful {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色花時間掩蓋隊伍的蹤跡，且成功透過一次 {@dc 16} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定，則將追捕等級降低1。

english: Decrease the pursuit level by 1 each time the characters cross or traverse some feature that obscures their trail, such as a subterranean river.
zh_tw: 每次角色穿越或經過某種可以掩蓋他們蹤跡的地形特徵時，比如地下河，追擊等級就減少1。

english: Decrease the pursuit level by 1 if the party splits into two or more groups. Each group becomes a separate party for purposes of determining random encounters and whether or not the group becomes lost.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍分成兩個或更多小組，追擊等級減少1。每個小組成為確定隨機遭遇和小組是否迷路的獨立隊伍。

english: Increase the pursuit level by 1 each time the party has a random encounter with one or more creatures, unless the encounter is bypassed or avoided entirely.
zh_tw: 每次隊伍與一個或多個生物發生隨機遭遇時，除非遭遇被完全繞過或避免，否則追擊等級增加1。

english: Increase the pursuit level by 1 for each day the adventurers travel at a slow pace.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者每天以慢速步伐行進，則追擊等級每天增加1。

english: Certain terrain encounters increase or decrease the pursuit level. See the individual descriptions in the "Random Encounters" section.
zh_tw: 某些地形遭遇會增加或減少追擊等級。詳見"隨機遭遇"部分的各個描述。

english: The players might come up with additional ways of evading pursuit. Adjudicate these as you see fit. For example, if the characters convince a randomly encountered creature to let them pass by telling them about the wealthy drow following them, you might reduce the pursuit level by 1 as the drow are forced to deal with the encounter before they can resume tracking the party. Similarly, the adventurers could lay traps to slow down their pursuers, or they might convince a friendly creature to lie to the drow about which way the party went.
zh_tw: 玩家們可能會想出額外的逃避追擊的方法。根據你的判斷來裁定這些情況。例如，如果角色們說服一個偶然遇到的生物讓他們透過，告訴他們關於跟隨他們的富有卓爾，你可能會將追擊等級降低1，因為卓爾被迫在繼續追蹤隊伍之前處理這次遭遇。同樣，冒險家們可以設定陷阱來減慢追擊者的速度，或者他們可能說服一個友好的生物對卓爾撒謊，告訴他們隊伍走的方向。

english: If you choose to skip over a few days of travel (as described under "{@area Summarizing Travel|0ac|x}" later in this chapter), the pursuit level doesn't change during that time.
zh_tw: 如果您選擇跳過旅行中的幾天（如本章後面"{@area 旅行總結|0ac|x}"所述），那段時間內追擊等級不會改變。

english: Catching Up
zh_tw: 趕上

english: When the pursuit level reaches 5, the drow forward scouts spot the party. At this point, the pursuit might become an encounter if the characters spot the drow and engage them. The characters might try to run, at which point a chase ensues (see "{@book Chases|DMG|8|Chases}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}), or they might stand and fight. They might even try to set up some sort of ambush, since the front ranks of the party are likely out of sight of the drow when they first catch up.
zh_tw: 當追捕等級達到5時，卓爾前方偵察兵會發現隊伍。此時，如果角色們發現卓爾並與其交戰，追捕可能會變成遭遇戰。角色們可能會嘗試逃跑，這時就會發生追逐（參見第8章中的"{@book 追逐|DMG|8|Chases}"選自{@i 城主指南}），或者他們可能會選擇站定並戰鬥。他們甚至可能會嘗試設定某種伏擊，因為當卓爾首次追上時，隊伍的前排很可能不在卓爾的視線範圍內。

english: If the adventurers flee and successfully escape, they lower the pursuit level to 4 and begin avoiding their pursuers again. If they fight the drow, run the encounter. The drow scouts focus on maintaining close pursuit and peppering the characters with poisoned hand crossbow bolts. After {@dice 1d6 + 4} rounds, the remainder of the drow party (Ilvara, Asha, Jorlan, and Shoor) catches up and joins the encounter.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者逃跑併成功逃脫，他們將追擊等級降低到4，並再次開始躲避追擊者。如果他們與卓爾戰鬥，進行遭遇戰。卓爾偵察兵專注於保持近距離追擊，並用塗有毒藥的手弩箭射擊角色。在{@dice 1d6 + 4}回合後，卓爾隊伍的其餘成員（伊爾瓦拉、阿莎、喬蘭和修爾）趕上並加入遭遇戰。

english: Eluding Pursuit
zh_tw: 逃避追擊

english: If the adventurers lower the pursuit level to 0, the drow lose the trail unless circumstances allow them to locate the characters again. This might include the characters spending a day or more in a place where they are recognized, or where they talk openly about their escape from Velkynvelve. If the characters pass through an area watched over by drow scouts or spies, Ilvara will inevitably hear word of the characters' location. When this occurs, increase the pursuit level to 1 and begin tracking it again as the drow pick up the trail once more.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們將追擊等級降至0，卓爾將失去追蹤線索，除非有情況使他們能夠再次定位角色。這可能包括角色們在一個他們被認出的地方，或者在他們公開談論他們從維爾京維爾夫逃脫的地方停留一天或更長時間。如果角色們穿過一個由卓爾偵察兵或間諜監視的區域，伊爾瓦拉將不可避免地聽到關於角色們位置的訊息。當這種情況發生時，將追擊等級提高到1，並開始再次追蹤，因為卓爾再次拾起追蹤線索。

english: Narrow Escapes
zh_tw: 險惡的逃脫

english: If an encounter with the drow is going badly and you don't want the characters recaptured, you can always have fate intercede on their behalf with another encounter or event offering a distraction.
zh_tw: 如果與卓爾的遭遇戰進行得不順利，而你又不希望角色們再次被捕，你總是可以讓命運代表他們介入，透過另一次遭遇或事件提供幹擾。

english: For example, a wandering stone giant, a purple worm, or a pack of savage gnolls whipped into a frenzy by Yeenoghu might show up just as the drow have the characters cornered, giving them a chance to run. Likewise, a minor earthquake (caused by instability from the demonic incursion or a wild magic surge) might cause a cave-in, cutting off a tunnel between the party and their pursuers, and dropping the pursuit level by 1 or 2.
zh_tw: 例如，一個漫遊的石巨人、一隻紫色蠕蟲，或者一群被耶諾古（耶諾古）煽動成狂暴狀態的野蠻鬣狗人可能會在卓爾將角色們逼入困境時出現，給他們一個逃跑的機會。同樣，一次小規模地震（由惡魔入侵造成的不穩定或野性魔法湧動引起）可能會導致塌方，阻斷隊伍和追擊者之間的隧道，使追擊等級下降1或2。

english: Don't do this so often that the players feel they haven't earned it, but use it as an option to keep the pursuit going rather than coming to an anticlimactic conclusion.
zh_tw: 不要頻繁到讓玩家感覺他們沒有贏得它，而是將其作為一種選擇來保持追擊的進行，而不是以一個反高潮的結論結束。

english: Capture
zh_tw: 被捕

english: The drow try to capture the escaped prisoners if at all possible, since Ilvara wants the pleasure of teaching them a lesson about disobedience. If the dark elves reduce any characters to 0 hit points, those characters are knocked out rather than dying (see "{@book Knocking a Creature Out|PHB|9|Knocking a Creature Out}" in chapter 9 of the {@i Player's Handbook}). Even if one or more of the characters are accidentally killed, Ilvara is obsessed enough to cast {@spell raise dead} to restore them to life (assuming the character's soul is willing to return).
zh_tw: 卓爾會儘可能地嘗試抓捕逃犯，因為伊爾瓦拉想要享受教訓他們不服從的樂趣。如果卓爾將任何角色生命值降至0，那些角色會被擊暈而非死亡（參見{@book 擊暈|PHB|9|Knocking a Creature Out}，在{@i 玩家手冊}第九章）。即使一個或多個角色意外死亡，伊爾瓦拉也會執著到施放{@spell raise dead||死者復活}來將他們復生（假設角色的靈魂願意迴歸）。

english: Captured characters are disarmed, their hands bound with spider silk rope, and gagged. The drow march them back to Velkynvelve unless Menzoberranzan is closer, in which case Ilvara takes them there instead. The characters will need to come up with a new plan of escape, ideally before Ilvara has the opportunity to torture them or sell them into slavery in the City of Spiders. If they escape her clutches again, the drow priestess continues her pursuit until she is dead or the party leaves the Underdark (see {@adventure chapter 7|OotA|6}).
zh_tw: 被俘的角色會被繳械，雙手被蛛絲繩捆綁，並被塞住嘴巴。卓爾將他們押送回維爾京維爾夫，除非魔索布萊城更近，這時伊爾瓦拉會把他們帶到那裡。角色們需要制定新的逃脫計劃，最好在伊爾瓦拉有機會折磨他們或將他們賣到蜘蛛城為奴之前。如果他們再次逃脫她的魔掌，這位卓爾祭司會繼續追捕，直到她死亡或隊伍離開幽暗地域（詳見{@adventure 第七章|OotA|6}）。

english: Random Encounters
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇

english: Each day of travel through the Underdark, check twice to see if the characters encounter anything unusual: once while they are traveling, and again while they are camped or resting. Roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Random Encounters table to determine what, if anything, they encounter. Characters might encounter special terrain, one or more creatures, or a combination of the two.
zh_tw: 穿越幽暗地域的每一天，檢查兩次看看角色是否遇到了任何不尋常的事物：一次在他們旅行時，另一次在他們露營或休息時。擲一個{@dice d20}，並參照隨機遭遇表來確定他們是否遇到了什麼，如果有的話。角色可能會遇到特殊的地形、一個或多個生物，或者兩者的組合。

english: Any random encounter that occurs while the party is camped is automatically a creature encounter, in which case determine the encounter by rolling a {@dice d20} and consulting the Creature Encounter table.
zh_tw: 當隊伍紮營時發生的任何隨機遭遇自動視為生物遭遇，在這種情況下，透過擲一個{@dice d20}並查閱生物遭遇表來確定遭遇。

english: The characters come upon an eerie cavern littered with countless bones of various creatures. Whether the site is a natural graveyard for some Underdark species or the former lair of a fearsome predator, the characters can potentially gather useful material for crafting among the bones.
zh_tw: 角色們來到一個陰森的洞穴，洞穴裡散佈著各種生物的無數骨頭。無論這個地方是某些幽暗地域物種的自然墓地，還是某個可怕捕食者的前巢穴，角色們都可能在骨頭中收集到有用的材料，用於製作物品。

english: When the party enters a boneyard, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the table to determine what creatures, if any, are present. The undead rise up out of the bones and attack when the first characters are halfway across the cavern.
zh_tw: 當隊伍進入骨場時，擲一個 {@dice d20} 並查閱表格以確定是否有任何生物存在。當第一個角色走到洞穴的一半時，不死生物會從骨頭中升起並發動攻擊。

english: Cliff and Ladder
zh_tw: 懸崖和梯子

english: A cliff {@dice 2d4 × 10} feet high blocks the party's passage, but a rolled-up rope ladder is visible at the top. If someone can climb the cliff—requiring a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check—and toss down the ladder, the characters can proceed. Otherwise, they lose a day's travel finding another route. If the characters remove the ladder once they are at the top, they decrease the drow pursuit level by 1.
zh_tw: 一道{@dice 2d4 × 10}尺高的懸崖阻擋了隊伍的去路，但在懸崖頂部可以看到一個捲起的繩梯。如果有人能攀爬懸崖—需要進行一次成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定—並將繩梯扔下來，角色們就可以繼續前進。否則，他們需要花費一天的時間尋找另一條路線。如果角色們在到達頂部後移走繩梯，他們將卓爾追擊等級降低1級。

english: Crystal Clusters
zh_tw: 水晶簇

english: The adventurers pass through a {@i faerzress}-suffused area containing fist-sized chunks of quartz that shed {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} in a 10-foot radius. A sharp blow to one of the crystals, including throwing it so it impacts a hard surface, causes it to burst in a 10-foot-radius flash of blinding light. Any creature within the radius must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. A creature {@condition blinded} by this effect repeats the Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, it is no longer {@condition blinded}.
zh_tw: 冒險者們穿過一片瀰漫著{@i 妖光}的區域，其中含有拳頭大小的石英塊，它們在半徑10尺範圍內散發出{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。對其中一塊水晶的猛烈敲擊（包括將其投擲到堅硬表面上使其撞擊）會導致其爆發出一陣半徑10尺的致盲閃光。範圍內的任何生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 10}的體質豁免檢定，否則陷入{@condition blinded||目盲}狀態1分鐘。受此效應{@condition blinded||目盲}的生物在其每個回合結束時重複進行體質豁免檢定。豁免成功則不再{@condition blinded||目盲}。

english: The characters can harvest up to twelve of the crystals in total, but taking the time to do so increases the drow pursuit level by 1.
zh_tw: 角色們總共可以採集到十二顆水晶，但花時間這樣做會使卓爾追擊等級增加1。

english: Fungus Cavern
zh_tw: 真菌洞穴

english: The adventurers stumble upon a cavern filled with fungi and mushrooms of all sizes and types. See "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" and choose some interesting examples.
zh_tw: 冒險者們偶然發現了一個洞穴，裡面充滿了各種大小和型別的真菌和蘑菇。見"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"並選擇一些有趣的例子。

english: Gas Leak
zh_tw: 氣體洩漏

english: The adventurers come upon a cavern with a dangerous natural gas leak. Any member of the party with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 14 or higher detects signs of the gas. The characters' travel pace for the day is slowed by half as they circumvent the area, but there are no ill effects. If the gas goes undetected, each character in the area must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 5 ({@dice 1d10}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Any open flames brought into the area cause the gas to explode. Each creature in the explosion must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 冒險者們遇到一個有危險天然氣洩漏的洞穴。隊伍中被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）值達到14或更高的成員可以察覺到天然氣的跡象。角色們在繞過該區域時，當天的行進速度減慢一半，但不會有不良影響。如果天然氣未被發現，區域內的每個角色必須進行一次{@dc 12}體質豁免檢定，檢定失敗受到5（{@dice 1d10}）點毒素傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。任何帶入該區域的明火都會導致天然氣爆炸。爆炸範圍內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免檢定，檢定失敗受到10（{@dice 3d6}）點火焰傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。

english: Gorge
zh_tw: 峽谷

english: The characters must make a difficult climb down a gorge {@dice 2d4 × 100} feet deep and up the other side, or find a way around it. Their travel pace for the day is slowed by half unless they come up with a plan to cross the gorge quickly.
zh_tw: 角色們必須艱難地下降到一個峽谷，峽谷深度為{@dice 2d4 × 100}尺，並爬到另一邊，或者找到繞過峽谷的方法。除非他們想出一個快速過峽谷的計劃，否則他們當天的行進速度會減慢一半。

english: High Ledge
zh_tw: 高崖

english: The characters must walk along an 18-inch-wide ledge that skirts a ravine {@dice 2d6 × 10} feet deep. The party's travel pace for the day is slowed by half, and each character must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw to avoid a fall. Precautions such as roping everyone together let each character make the save with advantage. Increase the pursuit level of the drow by 1.
zh_tw: 角色們必須沿著一個18吋寬的巖壁行走，巖壁圍繞著一個深 {@dice 2d6 × 10} 尺的峽谷。隊伍當天的行進速度減半，並且每個角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定以避免墜落。採取諸如將每個人用繩索相連的預防措施可以讓每個角色在檢定中獲得優勢。將卓爾的追擊等級提高1級。

english: Horrid Sounds
zh_tw: 可怕的聲音

english: For hours, the party's travel is plagued by terrible shrieks, moans, and incoherent gibbering echoing through nearby passages, without any apparent origin. Each character must make a successful {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the character's madness level increases by 1.
zh_tw: 數小時裡，隊伍的行程被可怕的尖叫聲、呻吟聲和雜亂無章的囈語所困擾，這些聲音在附近的通道中迴盪，卻沒有任何明顯的來源。每個角色必須進行一次成功的 {@dc 11} 感知豁免。如果豁免失敗，角色的瘋狂等級增加1。

english: Lava Swell
zh_tw: 熔岩高地

english: As the party traverses a long and winding corridor, a tremor opens up a lava-filled fissure behind them. Each character must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw to avoid the lava swell, taking 21 ({@dice 6d6}) fire damage on a failed save. Decrease the drow pursuit level by 1.
zh_tw: 當隊伍穿過一條漫長而曲折的走廊時，一陣震動在他們身後開啟了一道充滿熔岩的裂縫。每個角色都必須進行一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免來躲避熔岩湧動，若豁免失敗則受到 21 ({@dice 6d6}) 點火焰傷害。將卓爾追捕等級降低 1。

english: Muck Pit
zh_tw: 泥潭

english: The adventurers must wade through a broad, 3-foot-deep pit of slimy muck. The muck is {@quickref difficult terrain||3} and characters have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws while within it, but their travel pace for the day is slowed by half if they go around it.
zh_tw: 冒險者們必須趟過一個寬闊的、3尺深的黏滑泥坑。泥坑是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}，角色在其中時敏捷豁免檢定具有劣勢，但如果他們繞過它，當天的旅行步伐會減慢一半。

english: Rockfall
zh_tw: 巖崩

english: As the adventurers make their way through a long, twisting cavern, a tremor sets off a rockfall. Each party member must attempt three {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throws, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) bludgeoning damage on each failed save. Any {@condition incapacitated} creature not moved out of the area is buried under rubble, taking an additional {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage at the end of each of its turns until the creature is dug out or dead. Decrease the drow pursuit level by 1.
zh_tw: 當冒險者們穿越一條漫長而曲折的洞穴時，一次震動引發了落石。每個隊伍成員必須嘗試三次 {@dc 12} 敏捷豁免判定，每次豁免失敗將受到 10 ({@dice 3d6}) 點鈍擊傷害。任何 {@condition incapacitated||無力} 的角色如果沒有被移出該區域，將被埋在瓦礫下，在其每個回合結束時受到額外的 {@dice 1d6} 點鈍擊傷害，直到被挖出或死亡。將卓爾追擊等級降低1級。

english: Rope Bridge
zh_tw: 繩橋

english: A ravine {@dice 2d4 × 10} feet wide and {@dice 2d4 × 10} feet deep cuts across the party's path, spanned by an old rope bridge. If the characters cut the bridge after they pass, the drow pursuit level decreases by 1.
zh_tw: 一條鴻溝，寬度為{@dice 2d4 × 10}尺，深度為{@dice 2d4 × 10}尺，橫跨在隊伍的路徑上，由一座老舊的繩橋連線。如果角色們透過後切斷繩橋，卓爾的追擊等級將減少1。

english: Ruins
zh_tw: 功虧一簣

english: The adventurers come across a small ruin hidden in the Underdark. This might be the creation of a subterranean race or a surface ruin that collapsed and sank long ago. If the characters search the ruins, there is a 50 percent chance of them finding {@dice 1d4} trinkets (see chapter 5, "{@book Equipment|PHB|5|Trinkets}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}). Roll on the Trinkets table or choose appropriate ones.
zh_tw: 冒險者發現幽暗地域中隱藏的一小片廢墟。這可能是地下種族的建築，也可能是很久以前坍塌並沉入地下的地表遺跡。角色若搜尋廢墟，有50%的機率找到{@dice 1d4}件小飾物（見{@i 玩家手冊}第5章「{@book 裝備|PHB|5|Trinkets}」）。在小飾物表上擲骰，或選擇合適的物品。

english: Shelter
zh_tw: 避難所

english: The party stumbles upon a cave that is sheltered and easily defended. If the characters camp here, they can finish a long rest without any chance of an encounter while they are resting.
zh_tw: 隊伍偶然發現一個既遮蔽又易於防守的洞穴。如果角色們在這裡紮營，他們可以在休息時不受任何遭遇的幹擾完成一次長休。

english: Sinkhole
zh_tw: 陷坑

english: One random party member steps on and collapses a sinkhole, and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling into a 20-foot-deep pit and taking 7 ({@dice 2d6}) bludgeoning damage. Climbing out of the pit requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 一名隨機隊伍成員踩踏並引發了一個塌陷，必須成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 敏捷豁免檢定，以避免掉入一個 20 尺深的坑中並受到 7 ({@dice 2d6}) 點鈍擊傷害。爬出坑需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 力量 ({@skill Athletics||運動}) 檢定。

english: Slime or Mold
zh_tw: 粘液或黴菌

english: As the adventurers pass through a small cavern, they encounter a patch of slime or mold. Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the table to determine what type of slime or mold is present (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for details on these threats).
zh_tw: 當冒險者們穿過一個小洞穴時，他們遇到了一片粘液或黴菌。擲一個{@dice d6}並參考表格來確定存在的粘液或黴菌型別（詳見{@i 城主指南}第5章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"，瞭解這些威脅的詳細資訊）。

zh_tw: 一片綠色粘液

english: Steam Vent
zh_tw: 蒸汽噴口

english: A hot steam vent erupts beneath a random party member, who must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) fire damage.
zh_tw: 一股熱蒸汽噴口隨機出現在一名隊員下方，該隊員必須成功進行一個 {@dc 12} 敏捷豁免，否則將受到 7 點（{@dice 2d6}）火焰傷害。

english: Underground Stream
zh_tw: 地下溪流

english: A waterway {@dice 2d4 × 5} feet wide cuts across the party's path. The stream is shallow and easily crossed, and the characters can drink and refresh their water supplies. Edible fish inhabit the stream, so that the DC of any foraging attempts for food in this area is reduced to 10. Crossing the stream reduces the drow pursuit level by 1.
zh_tw: 一條寬度為{@dice 2d4 × 5}尺的水路橫穿隊伍的路徑。溪流很淺，容易過河，角色們可以飲水並補充他們的水供應。溪流中有可食用的魚，因此在該區域任何覓食食物的嘗試的難度等級降至10。過河將卓爾的追擊等級降低1。

english: Warning Sign
zh_tw: 警告標誌

english: The characters enter a cavern dotted with stalagmites and stalactites. Those with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 11 or higher spot the sigil to the right carved into one of the stalagmites.
zh_tw: 角色們進入一個點綴著石筍和鐘乳石的洞穴。那些被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分為11或更高的人會注意到刻在其中一個石筍上的符文。

english: The sigil is a drow warning sign that means "Demons ahead!" Any non-drow creature that touches the symbol must make a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's madness level increases by 1.
zh_tw: 這個符號是一個卓爾的警告標誌，意思是"前方有惡魔！"任何非卓爾生物接觸這個符號必須進行一次{@dc 10}的感知豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，該生物的瘋狂等級增加1。

english: If the characters take a long rest within one mile of the warning sign, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the table to determine what, if anything, they encounter at the end of their rest.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在警告標誌一英里範圍內進行長休息，擲一個{@dice d20}並參照表格以確定他們在休息結束時遇到了什麼，如果有的話。

english: Webs

zh_tw: 角色們偶然遇到了光輝協會的一名成員，這是一個由高度智慧的怪物組成的派系，他們聯合起來解決所有幽暗地域的問題。學會正在調查被{@i 妖光}充斥的區域，以確定這是否與學會所擔心的某種"惡魔入侵"有關。擲一個{@dice d10}骰子來決定角色們遇到了哪位學會成員。

zh_tw: 遭遇

english: {@creature Y|OotA} the {@creature derro savant|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19})
zh_tw: {@creature Y|OotA|歪} {@creature derro savant|OotA|迪洛矮人學者}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）

zh_tw: {@creature orog||魔獸人} {@creature Blurg|OotA|布勒格}

zh_tw: {@creature Grazilaxx|OotA|格拉齊拉克斯}，{@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}

english: {@creature Skriss|OotA} the {@creature troglodyte}
zh_tw: {@creature troglodyte||穴蜥人} {@creature Skriss|OotA|斯克里斯}

english: {@creature Sloopidoop|OotA} the {@creature kuo-toa archpriest}
zh_tw: {@creature kuo-toa archpriest||寇濤大祭司} {@creature Sloopidoop|OotA|斯盧皮杜普}

english: Every member of the Society of Brilliance has an alignment of neutral, an Intelligence of 18 (+4), and fluency in multiple languages including Dwarvish, Elvish, and Undercommon (although {@creature Grazilaxx|OotA} prefers to communicate using telepathy). Its statistics are unchanged otherwise. Members are erudite and talkative, preferring diplomacy and debate over violence (though they defend themselves if attacked).
zh_tw: 光輝協會的每個成員都有中立的陣營，智力為18（+4），並且能流利使用多種語言，包括矮人語、精靈語和幽暗地域語（儘管{@creature Grazilaxx|OotA|格拉齊拉克斯}更傾向於使用心靈感應進行交流）。除此之外，它的狀態沒有變化。成員們博學多識且健談，更傾向於外交和辯論而非暴力（儘管如果受到攻擊，他們會自衛）。

english: Each society member can cast the {@spell teleport} spell once per day, but the intended destination must be within 30 feet of another society member. This teleport effect can be disrupted (see "{@area Faerzress|05f|x}" earlier in the chapter), which is how society members sometimes end up in far corners of the Underdark, separated from their fellows.
zh_tw: 每個社會成員每天可以施展一次{@spell teleport||傳送術}法術，但預定目的地必須在另一個社會成員30尺範圍內。這種傳送效果可能會被幹擾（見本章前面的"{@area 妖光|05f|x}"），這就是社會成員有時如何最終出現在幽暗地域的遙遠角落，與同伴分離的原因。

english: Members of the Society of Brilliance are aware that paths to the surface world exist but haven't explored any of them (their concerns are with the Underdark, after all). If the characters seem intent on reaching the surface, a society member might suggest they look for a guide in one of the Underdark's larger settlements, such as Blingdenstone or Gracklstugh. The society member can provide detailed verbal directions that characters can follow to reach whichever Underdark settlement they desire. However, the society member can't guarantee that the route is safe. If characters are searching for something else, the society member provides whatever assistance it can.
zh_tw: 光輝協會的成員知道通往地表世界的路徑存在，但還沒有探索過它們（畢竟他們的關注點在於幽暗地域）。如果角色們似乎決心到達地表，協會的成員可能會建議他們在幽暗地域的較大定居點之一，如布靈登石城或格拉克斯圖格尋找嚮導。協會成員可以提供詳細的口頭指引，供角色們遵循以達到他們所希望的任何幽暗地域定居點。然而，協會成員無法保證路線的安全。如果角色們正在尋找其他東西，協會成員會提供儘可能的幫助。

english: Spore Servants
zh_tw: 孢子僕從

english: One or more creatures killed and reanimated by Zuggtmoy's spores observe the characters as they pass by. The spore servants don't communicate and don't attack except in self-defense. Roll a {@dice d10} and consult the table to determine what the characters encounter.
zh_tw: 一隻或多隻被祖格莫伊的孢子殺死並復活的生物在角色們經過時觀察他們。孢子僕從不進行交流，也不主動攻擊，除非是出於自衛。擲一個{@dice d10}，並參照表格來確定角色們遇到了什麼。

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|drow spore servants} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19})
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4}名{@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|卓爾孢子奴僕}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）

english: {@dice 1d6} {@creature Duergar Spore Servant|OotA|duergar spore servants} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19})
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 只 {@creature Duergar Spore Servant|OotA|灰矮人孢子奴僕}（見 {@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Hook Horror Spore Servant|OotA|hook horror spore servants} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19})
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Hook Horror Spore Servant|OotA|恐爪怪孢子奴僕}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）

zh_tw: {@dice 1d8} {@creature Quaggoth Spore Servant||幽邃熊怪孢子奴僕}

english: Traders
zh_tw: 交易者

english: These traders ply the tunnels of the Underdark, traveling from settlement to settlement. Roll a {@dice d4} and consult the table to determine what appears.
zh_tw: 這些商人在幽暗地域的隧道中穿梭，從一個定居點旅行到另一個定居點。擲一個 {@dice d4} 並查閱表格以確定出現了什麼。

english: d4
zh_tw: d4

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnomes}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}

english: {@dice 2d4} {@creature drow}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4} {@creature drow||卓爾}

english: {@dice 2d4} {@creature duergar}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4} {@creature duergar||灰矮人}

english: {@dice 2d4} {@creature kuo-toa}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4} {@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}

english: Deep gnome and drow traders have a 50 percent chance of having half their number in {@creature Giant Lizard||giant lizards} as mounts and pack animals. Duergar traders have a 50 percent chance of having half their number in {@creature Male Steeder|MTF|male steeders} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) as pack animals. If there are male steeders present, there is a 50 percent chance that the traders are escorted by a {@creature duergar kavalrachni|MTF} astride a {@creature female steeder|MTF} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19} for both).
zh_tw: 地底侏儒和卓爾商人有50%的機率擁有一半數量的{@creature Giant Lizard||巨蜥}作為坐騎和馱獸。灰矮人商人有50%的機率擁有一半數量的{@creature Male Steeder|MTF|雄性騎蛛}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）作為馱獸。如果有雄性角馬在場，那麼有50%的機率商人由一名騎在{@creature duergar kavalrachni|MTF|灰矮人凱沃拉騎兵}上的{@creature female steeder|MTF|雌性騎蛛}護送（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}中的兩者資訊）。

english: The traders carry goods worth {@dice 5d4 × 10} gp plus ten days of provisions per member of their party; they are willing to sell up to 20 percent of either. If drow traders see the adventurers and have the opportunity to report it, increase the drow pursuit level by 1.
zh_tw: 商人們攜帶的商品價值為{@dice 5d4 × 10}金幣，外加他們隊伍中每個成員的十天補給；他們願意出售其中的最多20%。如果卓爾商人看到冒險者並有機會上報，將卓爾追擊等級提高1。

english: Summarizing Travel
zh_tw: 旅行總結

english: Instead of checking for random encounters every day, you can skip over or summarize parts of the characters' journey. Roll {@dice 1d6 + 1} for the number of days between encounters, with the usual chance of the encounter being a terrain encounter, a creature encounter, or both (as described under "Random Encounters"). For example, if roll a result of 4, you would tell the players: "You've been making your way through the tunnels and passages for four days..." before describing the circumstances of the encounter to them.
zh_tw: 你可以跳過或總結角色旅程中隨機遭遇的部分，而不是每天檢查隨機遭遇。擲{@dice 1d6 + 1}來決定遭遇之間的天數，遭遇通常有地形遭遇、生物遭遇或兩者兼有的可能性（如"隨機遭遇"下所述）。例如，如果擲出4點，你可以告訴玩家："你們已經穿過隧道和通道四天了......"然後再向他們描述遭遇的情況。

english: With this approach, encourage players to describe what their characters do—or even see and experience—during the intervening time. In addition to downtime activities such as crafting, characters have plenty of opportunities for interaction. If the players are handling the roles of some or all of their nonplayer character companions (see "{@area A Motley Crew|013|x}" in chapter 1), ask them to elaborate on the activities of those characters as well, filling in details as you see fit. Players can also suggest and spin out stories about things their characters have experienced during the intervening time, including arduous climbs, swinging across gorges, or dodging piercers, and you can do the same. This additional storytelling aspect adds color and background to the journey while keeping the pace relatively brisk.
zh_tw: 用這種方法，鼓勵玩家描述他們的角色在這段時間裡做了什麼——甚至看到和經歷了什麼。除了像製作這樣的閒暇活動外，角色還有大量互動的機會。如果玩家正在扮演他們一些或全部非玩家角色夥伴的角色（見第1章中的"{@area 一群雜牌軍|013|x}"），請他們詳細說明那些角色的活動，補充你認為合適的細節。玩家也可以提出並展開關於他們的角色在這段時間裡經歷的事情的故事，包括艱苦的攀爬、蕩過峽谷或躲避石錐怪，你也可以這樣做。這個額外的講故事環節為旅程增添了色彩和背景，同時保持了相對較快的節奏。

english: Set Encounters
zh_tw: 設定遭遇

english: You can use the following four encounters during the party's travels in the Underdark between the locations in chapters 3 through 7, inserting them as desired. They provide more detailed challenges for the characters, as well as giving them chances to encounter some potential allies. If the characters need an XP boost as they work through subsequent chapters, these encounters can help provide it.
zh_tw: 您可以在第3至7章中角色們在幽暗地域旅行的地點之間使用以下四次遭遇，根據需要插入它們。它們為角色們提供了更詳細的挑戰，並給予他們機會遇到一些潛在的盟友。如果角色們在完成後續章節時需要經驗值提升，這些遭遇可以幫助提供。

english: The Silken Paths
zh_tw: 絲綢之路

english: The Silken Paths are a network of spider webs crisscrossing a 500-foot-deep, 2,000-foot-wide chasm that stretches for nearly five miles. The major strands of the webs are traversable but, due to the fact that old webs disintegrate over time and the giant spiders inhabiting the chasm are constantly spinning new ones, the Silken Paths are ever-changing.
zh_tw: 絲綢之路是由蜘蛛網構成的網路，這些蜘蛛網交錯覆蓋在一個深500尺、寬2000尺的裂縫上，這個裂縫延伸了將近五英里。這些網的主要脈絡是可以穿越的，但由於舊的蛛網會隨時間分解，以及棲息在裂縫中的巨型蜘蛛不斷在織造新的蛛網，絲綢之路是不斷變化的。

english: The chasm has numerous passages at varying heights leading away from it. It is rare for a web strand to connect one opening with another on the same "level." Characters navigating the Silken Paths need to follow sloping strands as well as climb and cross over several strands to reach their intended destination. This is quite hazardous, but there simply isn't any easy way around the chasm. The characters can easily get lost in the mass of strands stretching across the chasm unless they have help.
zh_tw: 這個裂縫在不同高度有許多通往遠離它的通道。蛛網的脈絡很少會在同一"層級"上連線一個開口與另一個。在絲綢之路中導航的角色需要沿著傾斜的脈絡行進，並且需要攀爬和跨越多個脈絡以到達他們的目的地。這是相當危險的，但是裂縫周圍確實沒有容易的繞行之路。除非他們得到幫助，否則角色們很容易在橫跨裂縫的脈絡中迷路。

english: The Web Runners
zh_tw: 蛛網行者

english: The Web Runners are a pair of thrill-seeking {@creature Goblin||goblins} named {@creature Yuk Yuk|OotA} and {@creature Spiderbait|OotA}. They have lived in the Underdark for as long as either can remember, with much of their time spent treasure hunting and surviving in the Silken Paths. The goblins are prone to daring (and often foolish) stunts. That either of them is still alive is a testament to their luck and skill. Modify their statistics as follows:
zh_tw: 蛛網行者是一對尋求刺激的{@creature Goblin||地精}，名叫{@creature Yuk Yuk|OotA|育克育克}和{@creature Spiderbait|OotA|蜘蛛誘餌}。他們在幽暗地域生活了他們能記起的所有時間，大部分時間都在尋寶和在絲綢之路中生存。這些地精傾向於大膽（通常是愚蠢的）特技。他們中的任何一個仍然活著證明瞭他們的運氣和技能。按以下方式修改他們的具體數值：

english: Both goblins are neutral.
zh_tw: 這兩個地精都是中立的。

english: Add {@skill Acrobatics} +6 and {@skill Athletics} +3 to the goblins' list of skills.
zh_tw: 在地精的技能列表中增加{@skill Acrobatics||體操} +6和{@skill Athletics||運動} +3。

english: The goblins have advantage on checks made to avoid being {@status surprised}.
zh_tw: 地精們在避免被{@status surprised||突襲}的檢定上有優勢。

english: The goblins notice the adventurers as they approach the Silken Paths and are willing to act as guides and helpers—for a fee, of course. They'll settle for 2 gp per day each, but {@creature Yuk Yuk|OotA} (who does all the negotiating) is just as likely to ask for something flashy belonging to one of the characters. He might also ask for some unspecified favor, to be paid when the goblins and the adventurers get to wherever they're going and part ways. He might ask for first pick of any loot the party uncovers in the Silken Paths, and will expect and ask for a share of the treasure regardless.
zh_tw: 地精們注意到冒險家們接近絲綢之路，並願意充當嚮導和助手——當然，這是需要付費的。他們願意接受每人每天2金幣的費用，但是{@creature Yuk Yuk|OotA|育克育克}（負責所有談判）同樣可能要求得到角色之一的某件顯眼的物品。他還可能要求某種未明確的幫助，等到地精和冒險家們到達目的地並分道揚鑣時再兌現。他可能會要求先挑選絲綢之路中發現的任何戰利品，並且無論怎樣都會期望並要求分享寶藏。

english: {@creature Yuk Yuk|OotA} and {@creature Spiderbait|OotA} each carry a gourd of grease, which they apply to their feet so that they can "surf the webs." While sliding down webs, they move at twice their normal walking speed.
zh_tw: {@creature Yuk Yuk|OotA|育克育克}和{@creature Spiderbait|OotA|蜘蛛誘餌}各自攜帶著一葫蘆的油脂，他們將其塗抹在腳上，以便他們可以"在網上衝浪"。在沿著蛛網滑下時，他們的移動速度是他們正常行走速度的兩倍。

english: The Web Runners are as good as their word when it comes to their services, and they can teach the characters a thing or two. While they travel with the two goblins, the characters have advantage on checks made to avoid being {@status surprised}. The goblins know the Silken Paths well enough not to become lost in them.
zh_tw: 說到服務，蛛網行者們言而有信，他們可以教角色們一些技巧。當角色們與兩個地精同行時，在避免被{@status surprised||突襲}的檢定上有優勢。地精們對絲綢之路非常熟悉，不會在其中迷路。

english: If the adventurers make a good impression on the Web Runners and if the party's goals appear to offer interesting opportunities to do new and dangerous things, the goblins offer to stay on after crossing the Silken Paths, and to help guide the characters through the Underdark. The two won't leave the Underdark, however. {@creature Yuk Yuk|OotA} will try to negotiate a suitable fee, but the goblins might simply tag along, content to earn any fair share of whatever the party acquires.
zh_tw: 如果冒險家們給織網者留下了好印象，並且隊伍的目標似乎提供了做新鮮和危險事情的有趣機會，地精們會提出在穿越絲綢之路後留下來，並幫助引導角色們穿越幽暗地域。然而，這兩個地精不會離開幽暗地域。{@creature Yuk Yuk|OotA|育克育克}會嘗試協商一個合適的費用，但地精們可能只是跟隨，滿足於獲得隊伍獲得的任何公平份額。

english: Silken Paths: General Features
zh_tw: 絲綢之路：一般特徵

english: As characters traverse the Silken Paths, keep in mind the following features.
zh_tw: 當角色穿越絲綢之路時，請注意以下特點。

english: Difficult Terrain
zh_tw: 困難地形

english: Any creature with a climbing speed can walk along the webs at that speed. For all other creatures, the webs are {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Any creature that falls can potentially become entangled in the webs (see "Falling").
zh_tw: 任何具有攀爬速度的生物可以沿著蛛網以該速度行走。對於所有其他生物來說，蛛網是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。任何墜落的生物都可能被蛛網糾纏（見"墜落"）。

english: Falling
zh_tw: 墜落

english: Whenever a creature takes damage while traversing the Silken Paths, or whenever the webs upon which it is walking break, the creature must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature manages to avoid a fall by grabbing nearby web strands. On a failure, the creature falls {@dice 1d10 × 10} feet. If the distance fallen is less than the distance to the chasm floor, the creature becomes entangled in webs and {@condition restrained}; otherwise, it hits the floor and takes damage from the fall as normal. A {@condition restrained} creature can make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns, freeing itself and ending the {@condition restrained} condition on a success. Another creature can use its action to help a {@condition restrained} creature within its reach, granting advantage on that creature's next saving throw to end the effect.
zh_tw: 每當生物在穿越絲綢之路時受到傷害，或者它所行走的網斷裂時，該生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免。如果豁免成功，該生物透過抓住附近的網絲避免了墜落。如果豁免失敗，該生物將墜落 {@dice 1d10 × 10} 尺。如果墜落距離小於到裂谷地面的距離，該生物會被網纏住並 {@condition restrained||束縛}；否則，它會撞到地面並像通常一樣受到墜落傷害。被 {@condition restrained||束縛} 的生物可以在其每個回合結束時進行一次 {@dc 12} 力量豁免，成功則可以掙脫並結束 {@condition restrained||束縛} 狀態。另一個生物可以使用其動作幫助其觸及範圍內的 {@condition restrained||束縛} 生物，在下次豁免中賦予優勢以結束該效果。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: The chasm is dark. Carrying a light source attracts hostile creatures, increasing the chance of an encounter to 1–3 on a {@dice d6}.
zh_tw: 這個裂谷很暗。攜帶光源會吸引敵對生物，將遭遇的機率提高到在{@dice d6}上擲出1-3。

english: Fire
zh_tw: 火焰

english: Webs burn away when exposed to any attack or effect that deals fire damage. This causes several strands to break, and all creatures within 30 feet of the affected area must make a saving throw to avoid falling (see "Falling").
zh_tw: 當蛛網暴露於任何造成火焰傷害的攻擊或效果時，它們會燃燒殆盡。這會導致多條蛛網絲斷裂，所有在受影響區域30尺範圍內的生物都必須進行豁免檢定以避免墜落（見"墜落"）。

english: Silken Path Encounters
zh_tw: 絲綢之路遭遇戰

english: For every 500 feet the party travels through the webs, check for a random encounter by rolling a {@dice d6}. An encounter occurs on a roll of 1 unless one or more party members are carrying light sources, in which case an encounter occurs on a roll of 1–3. Roll on the Silken Paths Encounters table or choose a suitable encounter when one occurs.
zh_tw: 每當隊伍在蛛網中行進500尺，就擲一個{@dice d6}來檢查是否發生隨機遭遇。除非隊伍中有一個或多個成員攜帶光源，否則在擲出1的情況下會發生遭遇，如果攜帶光源，則在擲出1-3的情況下會發生遭遇。當發生遭遇時，參照絲綢之路遭遇表或選擇一個合適的遭遇。

zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Darkmantle||暗幕魔獸}

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature drow} and {@dice 1d4} {@creature quaggoth} slaves
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4}名{@creature drow||卓爾}和{@dice 1d4}名{@creature quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}奴隸

english: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}
