english: Web break
zh_tw: 蛛網斷裂

english: Cocooned Halfling
zh_tw: 被繭包裹的半身人

english: The characters find a still-living lightfoot halfling cocooned in webbing. He is {@condition poisoned} and {@condition paralyzed} for the next hour.
zh_tw: 角色們發現了一個仍然活著的輕足半身人，他被蛛網包裹著。在接下來的一個小時內，他將處於{@condition poisoned||中毒}和{@condition paralyzed||麻痺}狀態。

english: Fargas Rumblefoot was a member of an adventuring band looking for a long-lost tomb when they were attacked by a pack of mad gnolls. Fargas escaped, got lost in the Silken Paths, and was attacked by the spiders. If rescued, he promises to show the characters the way to the tomb in exchange for a share of its treasures (see "{@area Lost Tomb of Khaem|0d9|x}" later in this chapter). Fargas is a chaotic good halfling {@creature spy}. In addition to his armor and weapons, he carries a {@item potion of invisibility}.
zh_tw: 法加斯·隆步是一支探險隊伍的成員，他們在尋找一座失落已久的墓穴時遭到了一群瘋狂的鬣狗人的襲擊。法加斯逃脫了，卻在絲綢之路中迷路，並被蜘蛛攻擊。如果被救出，他承諾將向角色們展示通往墓穴的路，以換取寶藏的一部分（見本章後面的"{@area 遺失的卡姆墓|0d9|x}"）。法加斯是一個混亂善良的半身人{@creature spy||間諜}。除了他的盔甲和武器，他還攜帶著一瓶{@item potion of invisibility||隱形藥水}。

english: Darkmantles
zh_tw: 暗幕魔獸

english: These subterranean hunters swoop down and attack the party.
zh_tw: 這些地下獵人俯衝下來攻擊隊伍。

english: Drow and Quaggoth Slaves
zh_tw: 卓爾和幽邃熊怪奴隸

english: These hateful {@creature drow} and their murderous {@creature quaggoth} slaves are navigating the Silken Paths on their way through the Underdark. If Derendil is with the party, he can use an action to make a {@dc 15} Charisma check, turning the quaggoth slaves against their drow masters on a success. If the drow are disposed of, Derendil can repeat the check to turn the surviving quaggoths into his followers. Should Derendil perish, these quaggoths can't be controlled and fight to the death.
zh_tw: 這些充滿仇恨的 {@creature drow||卓爾} 和他們兇殘的 {@creature quaggoth||幽邃熊怪} 奴隸正在沿著絲綢之路穿行幽暗地域。如果德倫迪爾與隊伍同行，他可以使用一個動作進行一次 {@dc 15} 的魅力檢定，若成功則可以讓幽邃熊怪奴隸反抗他們的卓爾主人。如果卓爾被消滅，德倫迪爾可以重複檢定，使倖存的幽邃熊怪成為他的追隨者。如果德倫迪爾死亡，這些幽邃熊怪將無法被控制並會戰鬥至死。

english: If any drow escape the encounter, increase the pursuit level of the party's drow pursuers by 1.
zh_tw: 如果有任何卓爾在遭遇戰中逃脫，提高隊伍卓爾追蹤者的追擊等級1級。

english: Giant Spiders
zh_tw: 巨蜘蛛

english: {@creature Giant Spider||Giant spiders} are the most common inhabitants of the Silken Paths, and they are drawn to vibrations in the webs that indicate potential prey.
zh_tw: {@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}是絲綢之路上最常見的居民，它們會被蛛網中表明潛在獵物的振動所吸引。

english: Mimic
zh_tw: 擬身怪

english: This creature pretends to be an iron chest entangled in the webs. When the characters draw close to examine it, the {@creature mimic} attacks.
zh_tw: 這個生物偽裝成一個被蛛網糾纏的鐵箱。當角色靠近檢查時，{@creature mimic||擬身怪}發起攻擊。

english: Spectator
zh_tw: 觀察者眼魔

english: Freed from its service to a long-dead drow wizard, this mad aberration now floats through the web-filled chasm. It communicates with the characters telepathically, warning them about "demons rising in the dark." The creature becomes increasingly paranoid and convinced that the characters are themselves demons, come to bind it into servitude, at which point it attacks and tries to destroy them.
zh_tw: 這個瘋狂的異變生物曾服務於一個早已死去的卓爾法師，現在它在充滿蛛網的深淵中漂浮。它透過心靈感應與角色們溝通，警告他們關於"黑暗中升起的惡魔"。這個生物變得越來越偏執，並確信角色們本身就是惡魔，來束縛它為奴，此時它會攻擊並試圖摧毀他們。

english: Web Break
zh_tw: 蛛網斷裂

english: A strand of web under one randomly determined party member snaps. Each creature walking on that web strand must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw as described under "Falling" in the "Silken Paths: General Features" sidebar. Immediately check for another encounter after the saving throws are resolved.
zh_tw: 隨機確定一名隊伍成員所在一根蛛絲斷裂。行走在該蛛絲上的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免，如同"絲綢之路：一般特性"側邊欄中的"墜落"所述。在豁免檢定完成後，立即檢查是否觸發另一場遭遇。

english: Hook Horror Hunt
zh_tw: 恐爪怪狩獵

english: The characters enter an area where a band of gnolls lured to the Underdark by the demon lord Yeenoghu are hunting a mated pair of hook horrors. Having left guards at the main entrance to the lair (area 5), the gnoll pack lord has split its remaining hunters into two groups, both of which are attempting to flush out the hook horrors to win the right to tear them apart.
zh_tw: 角色們進入了一個區域，一群被惡魔領主耶諾古引誘到幽暗地域的鬣狗人正在獵捕一對恐爪怪。鬣狗人族群首領在巢穴（區域5）的主要入口處留下了守衛，將其剩餘的獵人分成了兩組，這兩組都試圖將恐爪怪趕出來，以贏得將它們撕裂的權利。

english: The adventurers wander into the area from a second entrance to the caverns (area 1) and become embroiled in the hunt. Whether they choose to avoid the hunting party, aid the hook horrors, or negotiate their way out of the situation is up to the players.
zh_tw: 冒險者們從洞穴（區域1）的第二個入口進入該區域，並捲入了狩獵行動。他們選擇避開狩獵隊伍、幫助恐爪怪，還是透過談判擺脫局面，這取決於玩家的選擇。

english: Hook Horror Lair: General Features
zh_tw: 恐爪怪巢穴：一般特徵

english: As characters explore the hook horror lair, keep in mind the following features.
zh_tw: 當角色探索恐爪怪巢穴時，請記住以下特徵。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: The tunnels are completely dark, which doesn't hinder either the gnolls or the hook horrors.
zh_tw: 隧道里一片漆黑，但這並不妨礙鬣狗人或恐爪怪。

english: Tight Passages
zh_tw: 狹窄通道

english: Tunnels marked "P" on the map are narrow enough that Large creatures such as the hook horrors must squeeze through them, spending 1 extra foot of movement for every foot of passage. Medium or smaller creatures can move through such areas normally.
zh_tw: 在地圖上標記為"P"的隧道足夠狹窄，以至於像恐爪怪這樣的大型生物必須擠過去，每透過一尺的距離需要額外花費1尺的移動力。中等或更小的生物可以透過這些區域正常移動。

english: Map 2.2: The Hook Horror Lair
zh_tw: 地圖 2.2: 恐爪怪巢穴

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Hook Horrors
zh_tw: 1. 恐爪怪

english: The characters hear clacking noises as they approach this point in the passageway. Suddenly, two {@creature Hook Horror||hook horrors} dash from the side passage, moving from area 2A toward area 3. The hook horrors attack only in self-defense and are more afraid of the giggling, rampaging gnolls than they are of the characters.
zh_tw: 當角色們接近通道中的這一點時，他們聽到了咔噠聲。突然，兩個{@creature Hook Horror||恐爪怪}從旁邊的通道衝出來，從區域2A向區域3移動。恐爪怪只在自衛時攻擊，它們對咯咯笑的、橫衝直撞的鬣狗人比對角色們更感到害怕。

english: The gnolls are two chambers behind the hook horrors, reaching this point on the following round, unless the characters move toward them (in which case the two groups converge in area 2A).
zh_tw: 鬣狗人們位於恐爪怪後方的兩個房間，除非角色們向他們移動（在這種情況下，兩組將在2A區域匯合），否則將在下一輪到達這一點。

english: 2A. Gnoll Hunters
zh_tw: 2A. 鬣狗人獵人

english: Four {@creature Gnoll||gnolls} move into this area the round after the hook horrors move past the party, then follow their quarry into area 1 on the following round.
zh_tw: 恐爪怪經過隊伍後的下一輪，四隻{@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}進入這個區域，然後在接下來的一輪跟隨它們的獵物進入1號區域。

english: The gnolls can't resist attacking any other creatures that cross their path while shrieking "Sacrifices for Yeenoghu!" in their own tongue. (Even if no one in the party speaks Gnoll, the name of the demon lord is clearly recognizable.)
zh_tw: 鬣狗人們無法抗拒攻擊任何在他們的路上穿越的其他生物，同時尖叫著用他們自己的語言說'為耶諾古獻祭！'。（即使隊伍中沒有人說鬣狗人語，惡魔領主的名字也清晰可辨。）

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Sounds of combat or calls from the gnolls might attract their pack mates in areas 2B and 5.
zh_tw: 戰鬥的聲音或鬣狗人的呼喊可能會吸引2B和5號區域的同族。

english: 2B. Gnoll Hunters
zh_tw: 2B. 鬣狗人獵人

english: The rest of the gnoll hunters race through these caverns in search of the hook horrors. Unless they are drawn elsewhere, four {@creature Gnoll||gnolls} and a {@creature gnoll pack lord} are here.
zh_tw: 其餘的鬣狗人獵人在這些洞穴中穿梭尋找恐爪怪。除非他們被引到別處，否則這裡有四隻{@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}和一個{@creature gnoll pack lord||鬣狗人頭領}。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The gnoll pack lord carries two bloodstones worth 50 gp each and a brown tourmaline worth 100 gp.
zh_tw: 鬣狗人族群領袖攜帶著兩顆價值各50金幣的血石和一顆價值100金幣的棕色電氣石。

english: 3. Cornered
zh_tw: 3. 走投無路

english: The fleeing hook horrors make their way here, where they wait in ambush for any creatures that follow them. The passage is narrow enough that Medium creatures must move single file through it. The cave appears to be a dead end, and the hook horrors fight to the death against any creatures that enter.
zh_tw: 逃跑的恐爪怪來到這裡，他們在這裡埋伏等待任何跟隨他們的生物。通道狹窄到中等體型的生物必須單列透過。洞穴看起來像是一個死衚衕，恐爪怪會與任何進入的生物戰鬥至死。

english: Characters who take the time to search the cave spot a hole in the 10-foot-high ceiling (marked C on the map), which requires a successful {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to climb up into. It leads to area 4.
zh_tw: 花時間搜尋洞穴的角色會發現10尺高的天花板上有一個洞（地圖上標記為C），需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 12} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定才能爬上去。它通往區域4。

english: 4. Hook Horror Nest
zh_tw: 4. 恐爪怪巢穴

english: The sandy floor of this cavern holds a clutch of four 1-foot-diameter eggs with rocky outer shells, all half-buried in a shallow pit. These are hook horror eggs, and any character that touches an egg can feel it trembling.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴的沙質地面上有一個由四個直徑1尺、外殼堅硬的蛋組成的巢，它們都半埋在一個淺坑裡。這些是恐爪怪的蛋，任何觸控蛋的角色都能感覺到它在顫抖。

english: Each hour, there is a 10 percent chance that one of the eggs hatches. The {@creature infant hook horror|OotA} that emerges imprints on the first creature it sees. It thereafter follows that creature around like its parent, demanding to be fed. If the characters manage to keep the hook horror alive, it eventually reaches adulthood after six months. Track its growth using the Hook Horror Maturation table.
zh_tw: 每小時，有一個10%的機率其中一個蛋會孵化。孵化出來的{@creature infant hook horror|OotA|幼體恐爪怪}會對它看到的第一個生物產生印記。之後，它會像跟隨父母一樣跟隨那個生物，要求被餵食。如果角色們設法讓恐爪怪存活下來，六個月後它最終會成年。使用恐爪怪成熟度表格追蹤它的成長。

zh_tw: AC 13；39（{@dice 6d8 + 12}）生命值；速度 20 尺，攀爬 20 尺；力量 15（+2）；鉤爪攻擊{@hit 4}命中，觸及範圍5尺，命中時造成5（{@dice 1d6 + 2}）穿刺傷害；挑戰等級2（450 XP）

english: 5. Gnoll Camp
zh_tw: 5. 鬣狗人營地

english: The gnolls have a small camp set up here to prevent the hook horrors from fleeing in this direction.
zh_tw: 鬣狗人們在這裡設立了一個小營地，以阻止恐爪怪朝這個方向逃跑。

english: Three {@creature Gnoll||gnolls} guard the camp and attack any creatures emerging from the tunnels that are not of their kind.
zh_tw: 三隻{@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}守衛著營地，攻擊任何從隧道中出現的非同類生物。

english: The Oozing Temple
zh_tw: 流動的神廟

english: A tremor causes a cave-in and traps the adventurers in a maze of tunnels with no obvious way out. With a dwindling air supply and water rising in the tunnels, the characters are forced to find a means of escape. Complicating matters, part of the maze belongs to a forgotten temple that now serves as the lair of servants of the demon lord Juiblex.
zh_tw: 一場震動導致塌方，將冒險者困在了一個沒有明顯出路的迷宮般的隧道中。隨著空氣供應的減少和隧道中水位的上升，角色們被迫尋找逃生的方法。使情況更加複雜的是，迷宮的一部分屬於一個被遺忘的神廟，現在成為了惡魔領主朱庇萊克斯的僕人們的巢穴。

english: The Oozing Temple: General Features
zh_tw: 軟泥寺廟：一般特徵

english: As characters explore the Oozing Temple, keep in mind the following features.
zh_tw: 當角色探索軟泥寺廟時，請記住以下特徵。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Except where specified otherwise, the tunnels and chambers are dark.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，隧道和房間都是黑暗的。

english: Air
zh_tw: 氣

english: The air is stale and perceptibly thin. The temple contains enough air for the oozes, plus 160 hours of breathable air for one creature, divided by the number of creatures present. For example, a party of four adventurers has 40 hours of air. Characters who are at rest and not undertaking activities such as moving or fighting consume half as much air.
zh_tw: 空氣是陳舊且明顯稀薄的。寺廟中的空氣足夠軟泥怪使用，外加為一個生物提供160小時的可呼吸空氣，按在場生物的數量均分。例如，一隊四名冒險者有40小時的空氣。休息且不進行如移動或戰鬥等活動的角色消耗的空氣是一半。

english: Once half of the breathable air is consumed, the characters suffer one level of {@condition exhaustion} (see {@book appendix A|PHB|11} of the {@i Player's Handbook}). For each additional 10 percent of the air used up, the characters suffer one additional level of {@condition exhaustion}. At 90 percent, the characters are unable to move. When the air is used up, they die. Once the first level of {@condition exhaustion} sets in, the characters become aware that they are running out of air, and know roughly how much they have left.
zh_tw: 一旦可呼吸的空氣消耗了一半，角色將遭受一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}（參見{@book 附錄A|PHB|11}，選自{@i 玩家手冊}）。每額外消耗10%的空氣，角色將額外遭受一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。當空氣消耗達到90%時，角色將無法移動。當空氣耗盡時，角色將死亡。一旦第一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}生效，角色將意識到他們正在耗盡空氣，並大致知道剩餘的空氣量。

english: A lit torch or its equivalent uses up air as a character does. Briefer but hotter magical effects consume 1 hour of air per die of fire damage per round. For example, a {@spell fireball} spell that deals {@dice 8d6} fire damage consumes 8 hours of air, while a {@spell fire bolt} that deals {@dice 1d10} fire damage consumes 1 hour of air per use.
zh_tw: 點燃的火把或其等效物會像角色一樣消耗空氣。短暫但更熱的魔法效果每輪消耗等同於火傷害骰數的小時數。例如，造成{@dice 8d6}火傷害的{@spell fireball||火球術}法術會消耗8小時的空氣，而造成{@dice 1d10}火傷害的{@spell fire bolt||火焰箭}法術每次使用會消耗1小時的空氣。

english: Water
zh_tw: 水

english: In addition to running low on air, the characters become aware that the tunnels and chambers are filling with water flowing in from area 6. The water rises at a rate of 1 foot per hour, meaning most of the tunnels and chambers will be completely flooded within 10 hours. Areas filled with waist-deep water are {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for the characters. Once the water is over their heads, they have to swim.
zh_tw: 除了空氣逐漸減少，角色們還意識到隧道和房間正在被從區域6流入的水填滿。水以每小時1尺的速度上升，這意味著大多數隧道和房間將在10小時內被完全淹沒。充滿齊腰深水的區域對角色來說是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。一旦水超過他們的頭頂，他們就得游泳。

english: Map 2.3: The Oozing Temple
zh_tw: 地圖 2.3: 滴落的神廟

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Boxed In
zh_tw: 1. 困局

english: As the characters make their way through a 10-foot-high tubular passage, a tremor shakes the area and drops part of the ceiling on them. Each party member must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@dice 1d10}) bludgeoning damage from falling debris.
zh_tw: 當角色們穿過一條 10 尺高的管狀通道時，一陣震動搖撼了該區域，部分天花板塌落砸向他們。每個隊員都必須成功透過一次 {@dc 13} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則將因墜落的碎片受到 5 ({@dice 1d10}) 點鈍擊傷害。

english: Once the dust clears, the characters realize that fallen rock has buried both ends of the passageway. However, a new passage has opened in one of the walls, offering a possible escape route. It's clear that the route the party was following has been permanently blocked by tons of rubble, and runs the risk of triggering another collapse if the characters attempt to dig out.
zh_tw: 塵埃落定後，角色們意識到掉落的岩石已經埋葬了通道的兩端。然而，一堵牆上新開了一個通道，提供了可能的逃生路線。很明顯，隊伍原本走的路線已經被數噸的碎石永久性地堵住了，如果角色們試圖挖掘出去，還有可能引發另一次坍塌。

english: 2. Dripping Death
zh_tw: 2. 滴落的死亡

english: Whether finished stone or rough rock, the walls of these 10-foot-high areas glisten with dark, dripping water.
zh_tw: 無論是經過打磨的石頭還是粗糙的岩石，這些10尺高的區域的牆壁上都閃爍著黑暗的滴水。

english: Each of these keyed areas holds a {@creature gray ooze} that pours through cracks in the ceiling to attack any creatures that enter.
zh_tw: 這些標記區域的每一個都隱藏著一個{@creature gray ooze||灰泥怪}，它會透過天花板的裂縫傾瀉而下，攻擊任何進入的生物。

english: 3. Glabbagool
zh_tw: 3. 格拉巴布林

english: This area contains the skeletal remains of a drow, along with a dark metal mace and a scattering of coins. However, the characters are quick to notice that these items appear to hover above the stone floor.
zh_tw: 這個區域包含了一個卓爾的骨骼殘骸，還有一把黑色的金屬釘頭錘和一些散落的硬幣。然而，角色們很快注意到這些物品似乎懸浮在石地板上方。

english: All the visible items are trapped within the body of a {@creature gelatinous cube} named {@creature Glabbagool|OotA}—or at least, that's what it has chosen to call itself. Unlike most gelatinous cubes, this monster has an Intelligence of 10 (+0) and telepathy out to a range of 60 feet (see the {@i Monster Manual} introduction for telepathy rules).
zh_tw: 所有可見的物品都被困在一個名為{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}的{@creature gelatinous cube||凝膠方塊}體內——至少，這是它選擇自稱的名字。與大多數膠質立方體不同，這個怪物的智力為10（+0），並且擁有60尺範圍內的心靈感應（心靈感應規則請參閱{@i 怪物圖鑑}的引言）。

english: Juiblex's arrival in the Underdark has granted {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} sentience and awareness. The ooze is genuinely curious about other creatures and wants to learn more about the world. It defends itself if attacked, but doesn't otherwise try to harm the characters, instead asking who they are, where they come from, and why they have come to the temple.
zh_tw: 朱庇萊克斯降臨幽暗地域，賦予了{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}感知力和意識。這個軟泥怪真心對其他生物感到好奇，想要更多地瞭解這個世界。如果遭到攻擊，它會自衛，但除此之外，它不會試圖傷害角色，而是詢問他們是誰，來自哪裡，以及為什麼來到寺廟。

english: Other oozes won't attack {@creature Glabbagool|OotA}, so it can block a passageway to help the adventurers fend them off. However, the cube can't safely move past characters in a passageway. {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} might ask to accompany the adventurers if it likes or is intrigued by them. Unfortunately, the ooze's speed of 15 feet means that characters accompanied by it can travel only at a slow place (see "{@area Travel Pace|052|x}" at the beginning of this chapter).
zh_tw: 其他軟泥怪不會攻擊{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}，所以它可以堵住通道來幫助冒險者抵禦它們。然而，立方體不能安全地透過通道中的人物。如果{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}喜歡或對冒險者感興趣，它可能會要求跟隨冒險者。不幸的是，這個軟泥怪的速度為15尺意味著與它同行的角色只能緩慢前進（見本章開頭的"{@area 旅行步調|052|x}"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@creature Glabbagool|OotA}'s body contains a mace along with 14 ep and the mostly digested body of a drow. It will disgorge the items for the characters if they win its trust.
zh_tw: {@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}的身體內含有一把釘頭錘以及14枚金幣，還有一具卓爾的大部分已消化的屍體。如果角色們贏得了它的信任，它會將這些物品吐出來給他們。

english: The mace is a common magic item. While attuned the weapon, its wielder can use an action to make the head of the mace alight with green flame, or use an action to extinguish the flame. While the mace is "lit," it glows as brightly as a torch and deals an extra 1 fire damage on a hit.
zh_tw: 這把釘頭錘是一件常見的魔法物品。當武器被調整後，其持有者可以使用動作使釘頭錘的頭部點燃綠色火焰，或者使用動作熄滅火焰。當釘頭錘被"點燃"時，它像火炬一樣發光，並且在擊中時額外造成1點火焰傷害。

english: 4. Pudding Pits
zh_tw: 4. 布丁坑

english: This chamber is divided into four hallways and floored with heavy flagstones, the walls carved with worn and faded bas-reliefs. These show strange, swirling shapes that might be waves, tentacles, or some combination thereof.
zh_tw: 這個房間被劃分為四條走廊，地面鋪設著沉重的石板，牆壁上雕刻著磨損和褪色的浮雕。這些浮雕展示著奇怪的旋渦形狀，可能是波浪、觸手或兩者的某種組合。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: The squares marked on the map have been undermined, leaving a 10-foot-deep pit beneath each one. A successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check enables a character to notice that the stone is weakened.
zh_tw: 地圖上標記的方塊已被挖空，每個方塊下方留下了一個10尺深的坑。成功的{@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定能使角色注意到石頭已被削弱。

english: More than 50 pounds of weight on an undermined area causes it to collapse. A creature standing in the area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw to grab the edge of the pit, after which the creature must succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to scramble out. On a failed saving throw or a failed check, the creature falls into the pit and takes {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 在鬆軟區域放置超過50磅的重物會導致其坍塌。站在該區域的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 11} 敏捷豁免才能抓住坑的邊緣，之後該生物還必須成功透過一個 {@dc 11} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}檢定才能爬出。如果豁免或檢定失敗，該生物將掉入坑中並受到 {@dice 1d6} 點鈍擊傷害。

english: At the bottom of each pit is a {@creature black pudding}, which attacks any creature that falls in. If denied a victim, or if it devours a fallen creature quickly, the pudding climbs up the sides to attack any dangling creatures, or to move into the hallway in search of prey.
zh_tw: 每個坑的底部都有一個{@creature black pudding||黑布丁}，它會攻擊任何掉入其中的生物。如果找不到受害者，或者它迅速吞食了一個掉入的生物，這個布丁會爬上坑壁攻擊任何懸掛的生物，或者移動到走廊中尋找獵物。

english: 5. Fountain of Madness
zh_tw: 5. 瘋狂之泉

english: This room contains a stone fountain with a raised edge. The basin contains shallow, brackish water. At the center of the pool, the rubble of a broken statue rest atop a pedestal. All that remains recognizable are a pair of clawed stone feet clutching the pedestal's top. Carved into the walls are seven niches. Water seeps into one niche through a crack in the wall. The two niches that flank it are empty. Strange, formless sculptures occupy the four remaining niches.
zh_tw: 這個房間包含一個帶有抬高邊緣的石制噴泉。盆內盛著淺淺的、略帶鹹味的水。在水池中央，一個破碎雕像的殘骸躺在基座上。唯一還能認出來的是一對爪形的石腳緊握著基座的頂部。牆壁上雕刻著七個壁龕。水透過牆上的裂縫滲透進其中一個壁龕。旁邊的兩個壁龕是空的。四個剩餘的壁龕中擺放著奇怪的、無固定形狀的雕塑。

english: The "sculptures" are actually four {@creature Gray Ooze||gray oozes} held in magical stasis. They liquefy and attack when any one of them is touched or damaged.
zh_tw: 這些"雕塑"實際上是四個處於魔法停滯狀態的{@creature Gray Ooze||灰泥怪}。當它們中的任何一個被觸控或受損時，它們會液化並發動攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Hidden beneath the dark waters of the fountain are 112 sp, 41 gp, three green-gold bracelets worth 25 gp each, a drow {@item +1 dagger} (the hilt has a spider design), a {@item potion of greater healing}, and a vial containing {@item oil of slipperiness}.
zh_tw: 隱藏在噴泉黑暗水域下的是112枚銀幣，41枚金幣，三個價值各25金幣的綠金手鐲，一把帶有蜘蛛圖案的卓爾{@item +1 dagger||+1 匕首}，一瓶{@item potion of greater healing||高等治療藥水}，以及一個裝有{@item oil of slipperiness||滑溜之油}的小瓶。

english: 6. Water Chamber
zh_tw: 6. 水室

english: Characters approaching this rough-walled cave hear the sound of pouring water. The water enters through cracks in the 10-foot-high ceiling. Given the rate at which the water flows in, the characters can easily conclude that the cracks were caused by the tremor they experienced, and it's only a matter of time before the water floods the entire complex.
zh_tw: 接近這個粗糙牆壁洞穴的角色聽到了倒水的聲音。水透過10尺高的天花板上的裂縫進入。根據水流的速度，角色們可以很容易地推斷出這些裂縫是由他們所經歷的震動造成的，而且整個建築群被水淹沒只是時間問題。

english: The water rises at a rate of 1 foot per hour until the tunnels are completely flooded. However, chipping away at any of the cracks causes more of the ceiling to collapse, doubling the amount of water pouring into the complex but also revealing a diverted underground river that is the source of the water. Once the water level rises to the ceiling, the flow is slowed and the characters can swim upward for 30 feet to reach the water's surface. They find themselves in a larger cavern from which they can resume their journey.
zh_tw: 水位以每小時1尺的速度上升，直到隧道完全被淹沒。然而，敲擊任何裂縫會導致更多的天花板坍塌，使湧入綜合體的水增加一倍，同時也揭示了一個被轉移的地下河流，這是水的來源。一旦水位上升到天花板，水流就會減慢，角色們可以向上遊30尺到達水面。他們發現自己在一個更大的洞穴中，從這裡可以繼續他們的旅程。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} is with the party, the intelligent gelatinous cube floats upward as the water rises and squeezes through a crack in the ceiling to escape the flooded temple and remain with the characters.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}與隊伍同行，這個有智慧的凝膠狀立方體會隨著水位上升而向上浮動，並透過天花板上的裂縫逃脫，以躲避被洪水淹沒的寺廟並繼續跟隨角色們。

english: Lost Tomb of Khaem
zh_tw: 遺失的卡姆墓

english: In ages past, at the height of Faerûn's great empires of magic, the half-elf sorcerer Brysis of Khaem was interred in a floating tomb. After the fall of the empire of Netheril and its flying cities, Brysis's tomb plummeted into a crevasse and wound up in the Underdark, where it has remained for centuries. The rise of the demon lords has awakened Brysis from the eternal sleep of death as a wraith, served by specters who were once her loyal retainers. Brysis yearns to accumulate enough life force to leave the confines of her tomb, to which her spirit is bound.
zh_tw: 在古代，當費倫的魔法帝國處於鼎盛時期時，半精靈法師布莉西絲被安葬在一個漂浮的墓穴中。在尼瑟爾帝國及其飛行城市衰落後，布莉西絲的墓穴墜入裂縫，最終落在了幽暗地域中，在那裡它已經存在了幾個世紀。惡魔領主的崛起喚醒了布莉西絲，使她作為一個邪靈的幽靈從死亡的永恆睡眠中甦醒，由曾經是她忠誠的侍從的幽靈們服侍。布莉西絲渴望積累足夠的生命力，以離開她的靈魂所束縛的墓穴。

english: The adventurers might discover the tomb by accident or with the aid of Fargas Rumblefoot, the halfling from the Silken Paths encounter. Either way, when they're nearby, read the following to the players:
zh_tw: 冒險者可能是偶然發現這座墓穴，或者在絲綢之路遭遇中的半身人法加斯·隆步的幫助下找到它。無論哪種方式，當他們接近時，請向玩家宣讀以下內容：

english: A soft feminine voice sounds out in your mind suddenly, faint and distant. "Hello? Is someone there... ? Oh please, I need your help! I have been trapped in the dark for so long... so very long. Please, won't you help to free me?"
zh_tw: 一個柔和的女性聲音突然在你的腦海中響起，微弱而遙遠。"你好？有人在那裡嗎......？哦，請你幫幫我！我被困在黑暗中太久了......非常非常久。請你們，能幫我獲得自由嗎？"

english: The characters receive an impression of the direction to the entrance of the tomb, but the mysterious voice doesn't respond to any queries. As they follow the voice, a narrow side passage takes them to a dirty marble wall with a deep-set door made of bronze-encased stone, green with age (see the "Lost Tomb of Khaem: General Features" sidebar).
zh_tw: 角色們收到了關於墓穴入口方向的印象，但神秘的聲音對任何詢問都沒有回應。當他們跟隨這個聲音時，一條狹窄的側通道帶他們來到一面佈滿灰塵的大理石牆前，牆上有一扇深嵌的門，由青銅包裹的石頭製成，因年代久遠而泛綠（見"卡姆的失落墓穴：一般特徵"側邊欄）。

english: Lost Tomb of Khaem: General Features
zh_tw: 卡姆的失落墓穴：一般特徵

english: As characters explore the Lost Tomb of Khaem, keep in mind the following features.
zh_tw: 當角色們探索卡姆的失落墓穴時，請記住以下特點。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Room ceilings are 15 feet high. The hallways connecting them are 10 feet high.
zh_tw: 房間的天花板高15尺。連線它們的走廊高10尺。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: Each door in the tomb is a 10-foot-by-10-foot slab of solid marble encased in a thin layer of beaten bronze. The bronze has turned green with age. The door pivots on a central axis, creating narrow openings on either side while open. The door is also heavy and tight-fitting, requiring a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to open or close.
zh_tw: 墳墓中的每一扇門都是一個10尺見方的實心大理石板，外層包裹著一層薄薄的鍛青銅。青銅因年代久遠而變成了綠色。這扇門以中央軸為支點旋轉，開啟時兩側會形成狹窄的開口。門非常沉重且緊貼門框，需要投擲{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來開啟或關閉。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Except as otherwise noted, the interior of the tomb is dark.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，墓穴內部是黑暗的。

english: Chaotic Magic
zh_tw: 混亂魔法

english: The tomb was crafted during an age of high magic, and it has become suffused with {@i faerzress}. The ancient and chaotic energy now permeating the structure causes any spell cast within the tomb to trigger a roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in chapter 3, "{@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB|Classes}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
zh_tw: 這座陵墓是在一個高度魔法的時代打造的，它已經充斥著{@i 妖光}。現在瀰漫在建築中的古老而混亂的能量會導致在陵墓內施放的任何法術觸發第3章"{@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB|狂野魔法浪涌}"中的狂野魔法湧動表，選自{@i 玩家手冊}。

english: Map 2.4: The Lost Tomb
zh_tw: 地圖 2.4: 失落的墓穴

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Entrance Room
zh_tw: 1. 入口室

english: A stone diorama stands to the right of the entrance, depicting the sorcerer Brysis Khaem as a Netherese noble in her prime, surrounded by attendants, slaves, and other trappings of wealth and power. A vista of fantastic floating cities covers the wall to the left of the entrance.
zh_tw: 入口右側有一個石制浮雕，描繪了巫師布莉西絲·卡姆作為尼瑟斯貴族在其鼎盛時期的形象，周圍有隨從、奴隸以及其他財富和權力的象徵。入口左側的牆壁上描繪著奇異的浮空城市景觀。

english: Staircase and Landing
zh_tw: 樓梯和平臺

english: Across from the entrance, empty stone torch sconces flank a dusty staircase descending 20 feet to a landing. Set into the back wall of the landing is a Netherese calendar stone. Beyond this landing, the staircase resumes its descent, stopping at three more landings of bare stone and descending a total of 100 feet before arriving at area 2.
zh_tw: 入口對面，空蕩蕩的石制火炬座圍繞著一個佈滿灰塵的樓梯，向下延伸20尺到達一個平臺。平臺的後牆上嵌著一塊尼瑟瑞爾日曆石。越過這個平臺，樓梯繼續向下延伸，在三個光禿禿的石制平臺上停下，總共下降100尺後到達區域2。

english: 2. Shrine
zh_tw: 2. 神殿

english: The stairs lead down to this shrine, where shreds of dusty tapestries lie scattered across the floor. Friezes on the walls are defaced with deep gouges, making them unrecognizable. An altar of pale gray marble stands gouged and cracked against one wall.
zh_tw: 樓梯通向這個神龕，神龕地面上散佈著塵土飛揚的掛毯碎片。牆上的浮雕被深深的劃痕破壞，變得無法辨認。一座灰白色的大理石祭壇靠在一面牆上，上面佈滿了劃痕和裂縫。

english: A successful {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check reveals that the damage to this room is relatively recent, and that the creatures that caused it left no tracks of any kind in the layer of dust on the floor.
zh_tw: 一個成功的 {@dc 13} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定揭示，這個房間的損壞相對較新，並且造成損壞的生物在地板上的灰塵層中未留下任何痕跡。

english: 3. Servants' Sarcophagi
zh_tw: 3. 僕人的石棺

english: Four stone sarcophagi mark the resting places of Brysis's most faithful servants. The lid of each sarcophagus bears the sculpted image of a robed human figure in repose. Brysis's four servants have arisen at her command as {@creature Specter||specters}. If anyone touches or otherwise disturbs a sarcophagus, all four specters emerge from their sarcophagi, howling in fury, and attack. The specters can pursue their prey beyond the confines of the tomb, if necessary.
zh_tw: 四個石制的石棺標誌著布莉西絲最忠誠的僕人安息之地。每個石棺的蓋子上都雕刻著一個穿著長袍的人類形象。布莉西絲的四個僕人在她的命令下作為{@creature Specter||惡靈}復活了。如果有人觸碰或以其他方式打擾了石棺，所有四個幽靈都會從他們的石棺中出現，憤怒地嚎叫，併發起攻擊。如果必要，幽靈可以追逐他們的獵物到墓穴之外。

english: Opening a sarcophagus lid requires a successful {@dc 17} Strength check and reveals treasure within (see "Treasure").
zh_tw: 開啟石棺蓋需要成功透過一次 {@dc 17} 力量檢定，並且會揭示其中的寶藏（見"寶藏"）。

english: A character inspecting the northeast sarcophagus and succeeding on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check notices that the sarcophagus is built on hidden stone rollers. It can be moved aside with a successful {@dc 10} Strength check to reveal a 4-foot-square hole in the floor, and in the ceiling of a similarly sized chamber directly below this one (area 5). If the characters move the sarcophagus but leave the chamber without exploring the tomb below, they hear the same telepathic voice that called out to them initially, saying, "Please! Don't leave! I'm here, below!"
zh_tw: 一個角色在檢查東北角的石棺並透過一個 {@dc 15} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定時，會注意到石棺建在隱藏的石輪上。透過一個成功的 {@dc 10} 力量檢定，石棺可以被移開，露出地板上一個4尺見方的洞，以及正下方一個大小相似的房間的天花板（區域5）。如果角色移開了石棺但沒有探索下方的墓室就離開了房間，他們會聽到最初呼喚他們的心靈感應聲音，說："求求你！別走！我在這裡，下面！"

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each sarcophagus contains mummified remains, the tattered remnants of ancient burial garments, and treasure of Netherese origin.
zh_tw: 每個石棺內都裝有木乃伊化的遺體、古代葬禮服裝的殘餘以及尼瑟斯起源的寶藏。

english: The northeast sarcophagus contains two gold bracelets worth 50 gp each and a ceremonial wand (nonmagical) made of chiseled ivory worth 25 gp.
zh_tw: 東北方向的石棺內含有兩個各值50金幣的金手鐲，以及一個由雕琢象牙製成的儀式用魔杖（無魔法），價值25金幣。

english: The northwest sarcophagus contains an onyx ring worth 50 gp and a silver necklace set with two azurites and a carnelian worth 250 gp.
zh_tw: 西北角的石棺內含有一枚價值50金幣的縞瑪瑙戒指和一條鑲嵌有兩顆藍色方鈉石和一塊紅玉髓的銀項鍊，價值250金幣。

english: The southwest sarcophagus contains a ewer made of beaten gold worth 25 gp and a walking stick worth 75 gp. The walking stick is made of varnished yew with a golden handle shaped like a scorpion.
zh_tw: 西南方向的石棺內含有一個價值25金幣的金質水壺和一個價值75金幣的手杖。手杖由上了漆的紫杉木製成，帶有金質的蠍子形狀把手。

english: The southeast sarcophagus contains a gold censer with platinum filigree worth 250 gp.
zh_tw: 東南角的石棺內含有一個鑲有白金鏤空花紋的金香爐，價值250金幣。

english: 4. False Tomb
zh_tw: 4. 假墓

english: Stone blocks standing against the western and eastern walls are carved with niches, inside which rest a dozen clay canopic jars containing desiccated organs. These organs belong to Brysis's servants, who are entombed in area 4.
zh_tw: 靠在東西牆的石塊上雕刻有壁龕，壁龕內放置著一打裝有乾燥器官的陶製卡諾皮克罐。這些器官屬於布莉西絲的僕人，他們被安葬在區域4。

english: In the middle of the room rests a wide stone sarcophagus atop a black marble bier. The lid of the sarcophagus is inlaid with dust-covered mosaics depicting great floating cities high above a beautiful landscape. The lid of the sarcophagus looks incredibly heavy but is made lighter by an ancient spell that has survived to this day. The lid can be pushed aside with a successful {@dc 10} Strength check. The sarcophagus contains a life-sized statue of Brysis, sculpted and painted to make it appear that she is sleeping comfortably. The statue is affixed to the inside of the sarcophagus with {@item sovereign glue} and can't be moved. There is no treasure to be found.
zh_tw: 在房間中央，一個寬大的石棺安放在黑色大理石的靈床上。石棺的蓋子鑲嵌著被灰塵覆蓋的馬賽克，描繪了高懸在美麗風景之上的巨大浮空城市。石棺的蓋子看起來異常沉重，但由於一個流傳至今的古老法術，它變得輕盈了。透過一個成功的{@dc 10}力量檢定可以將蓋子推開。石棺內有一尊與真人大小相同的布莉西絲雕像，經過雕刻和上色，使她看起來正在舒適地安睡。雕像用{@item sovereign glue||至尊膠}固定在石棺內部，無法移動。這裡沒有寶藏可尋。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: Opening the sarcophagus triggers a {@spell magic mouth} spell that calls out in a booming voice, "You have disturbed the tomb of Brysis of Khaem! Accursed are you, most miserable of creatures!" Each creature in the room, whether it hears the booming voice or not, must make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature is cursed with disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws. The creature can repeat the saving throw after 24 hours have elapsed, ending the effect on itself with a successful save. Otherwise, a {@spell remove curse} spell ends this effect, as does destroying the wraith in area 5.
zh_tw: 開啟石棺會觸發一個{@spell magic mouth||魔嘴術}法術，以洪亮的聲音喊道："你打擾了卡姆的布莉西絲之墓！你被詛咒了，你這最悲慘的生物！"房間內的每個生物，無論是否聽到這洪亮的聲音，都必須進行一次{@dc 15}的魅力豁免。若失敗，該生物將被詛咒，攻擊擲骰和豁免擲骰都具有劣勢。該生物可以在24小時後重複進行豁免，若成功，則結束其身上的效果。否則，一個{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}法術可以結束此效果，在區域5摧毀怨魂也可以結束此效果。

english: If Brysis's wraith is destroyed, both the {@spell magic mouth} and the curse on the sarcophagus cease to function.
zh_tw: 如果布莉西絲的邪靈被摧毀，{@spell magic mouth||魔嘴術}和石棺上的詛咒都會停止運作。

english: 5. True Tomb
zh_tw: 5. 真正墓室

english: Brysis's true tomb is hidden below area 3 and has murals on the walls decorated with rich pigments and inlays of semiprecious stones. A gilded sarcophagus stands atop a stone bier along the west wall. An {@condition invisible} stone chest rests at the foot of the sarcophagus. Characters searching the area thoroughly locate the chest. The chest becomes visible within an {@spell antimagic field}, and a successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 19}) also ends the {@spell invisibility} effect.
zh_tw: 布莉西絲的真正陵墓隱藏在區域3下方，牆壁上裝飾著豐富的顏料和半寶石鑲嵌的壁畫。一個鍍金的石棺沿西牆放置在一個石制棺架上。一個{@condition invisible||隱形}的石箱位於石棺的腳部。角色們徹底搜尋該區域時會找到這個箱子。箱子在{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}中變得可見，成功的{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 19}）也會結束{@spell invisibility||隱形}效果。

english: Brysis of Khaem has arisen as a murderous {@creature wraith}, bound to her tomb until she can steal enough life force to leave it. She arises from within the sarcophagus and attacks when creatures enter this chamber. She gloats about how the characters' deaths will free her from this prison, and how her victims will serve her even in death.
zh_tw: 卡姆的布莉西絲已經化身為一個殺人的{@creature wraith||邪靈}，束縛在她的墓穴中，直到她能竊取足夠的生命力才能離開。當生物進入這個房間時，她從石棺中出現並發動攻擊。她誇耀說角色們的死亡將使她從這個監獄中解脫出來，以及她的受害者即使在死後也會為她服務。

english: On initiative count 1 in the round in which Brysis attacks, the characters hear the telepathic voice that first called to them. "In the sarcophagus! I can help you!" See "Treasure" for more information.
zh_tw: 在布莉西絲發動攻擊的那個回合的先攻計數1時，角色們聽到了最初呼喚他們的傳心聲音。"在石棺裡！我能幫你們！"更多資訊見"寶藏"。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The thin gold sheath covering Brysis's sarcophagus can be pried loose and is worth 250 gp. Inside the stone sarcophagus, lying atop Brysis's withered and mummified corpse, is a magic sword called {@item Dawnbringer|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}). This intelligent weapon is the source of the telepathic messages.
zh_tw: 覆蓋在布莉西絲石棺上的薄金鞘可以被撬開，價值250金幣。在石棺內部，躺在布莉西絲枯萎的木乃伊屍體上方的是一把名為{@item Dawnbringer|OotA|黎明使者}的魔法劍（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}）。這把智慧武器是心靈感應資訊的來源。

english: The stone chest is unlocked and contains the other treasures Brysis took with her into the afterlife: 4,000 sp, 1,200 gp, eleven zircons (worth 50 gp each), a {@item necklace of fireballs}, a {@item philter of love}, and a {@item potion of greater healing}.
zh_tw: 石箱未上鎖，內含布莉西絲帶入來世的其他寶藏：4000枚銀幣，1200枚金幣，十一顆紫水晶（每顆價值50金幣），一條{@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}，一瓶{@item philter of love||迷情媚藥}，以及一瓶{@item potion of greater healing||高等治療藥水}。

english: Chapter 3: The Darklake
zh_tw: 第3章：黑暗湖

english: Though its name might evoke images of a single subterranean body of water, the Darklake is a network of underground rivers, natural tunnels, and canals that connect innumerable water-filled caverns and chambers. This vast waterway stretches over a hundred miles across, with ceilings that are miles high in some places and depths that are unfathomable.
zh_tw: 儘管它的名字可能會讓人想象到一個單一的地下水域，但黑暗湖實際上是一個由地下河流、自然隧道和運河組成的網路，它們連線著無數充滿水的洞穴和房間。這個龐大的水道延伸超過一百英里，有些地方的天花板高達數英里，深度深不可測。

english: Long ago, duergar engineers extended and widened many of the interconnecting passages of the Darklake. They also constructed locks for raising and lowering watercraft to different levels within it, opening up large portions of the network for travel. Many Underdark creatures are experienced in navigating the Darklake, including the kuo-toa—fishlike humanoids known for their insane obsession with unraveling the secret patterns of the Underdark. Still, better to trust a kuo-toa guide than attempt to traverse the Darklake alone and become lost within it forever.
zh_tw: 很久以前，灰矮人工程師擴充套件並拓寬了黑暗湖的許多相互連線的通道。他們還建造了船閘，用於升降船隻到湖內的不同水平，為旅行開放了網路的大部分區域。許多幽暗地域的生物都擅長在黑暗湖中航行，包括寇濤魚人人——以解開幽暗地域秘密模式而聞名的魚形類人生物。然而，與其獨自穿越黑暗湖並永遠迷失其中，不如相信寇濤魚人人嚮導。

english: The adventurers can use the Darklake to reach many destinations in the Underdark. More importantly, water travel makes it difficult for their drow pursuers to track them. The kuo-toa town of Sloobludop is located on the eastern edge of the Darklake, and is a potential source of watercraft and navigational aid. But as they seek out these resources, the characters learn of terrible powers loose in the Underdark—worse than the drow, the kuo-toa, or any other threat of this dark realm.
zh_tw: 冒險者可以利用黑暗湖到達幽暗地域的許多目的地。更重要的是，水上旅行使得他們的卓爾追蹤者難以追蹤他們。寇濤魚人（寇濤）小鎮斯盧布多普位於黑暗湖的東邊緣，是水上交通工具和導航幫助的潛在來源。但是當他們尋求這些資源時，角色們瞭解到幽暗地域中釋放出了可怕的力量——比卓爾、寇濤魚人或這個黑暗領域中的任何其他威脅都要糟糕。

english: Traversing the Darklake
zh_tw: 穿越黑暗湖

english: The adventurers need to find a way to cross the Darklake on the way to their ultimate destination—out of the Underdark and back to the surface world. They might attempt to find a guide or hire passage in Sloobludop, but other possibilities could also present themselves.
zh_tw: 冒險者們需要找到一種方法穿越黑暗湖，前往他們的最終目的地——離開幽暗地域，回到地表世界。他們可能試圖在斯盧布多普找到嚮導或租用船隻，但也可能呈現出其他可能性。

english: Modes of Travel
zh_tw: 旅行方式

english: The adventurers might find different ways to cross the Darklake, depending on how long they traverse it and who or what they encounter along the way.
zh_tw: 冒險者可能會找到不同的方法來穿越黑暗湖，這取決於他們穿越它的時間長短，以及沿途遇到的人或事。

english: Since there is no wind in the Underdark, all water travel involves either rowing at 1½ miles per hour, or floating with prevailing currents at 1 mile per hour. Characters can work in shifts to row more than 8 hours per day, but crewing a boat for longer than that is considered a forced march (see {@book chapter 8|PHB|8|Travel Pace} of the {@i Player's Handbook}).
zh_tw: 由於幽暗地域中沒有風，所有的水上旅行要麼以每小時1½英里的速度划船，要麼隨主流以每小時1英里的速度漂浮。角色可以輪班划船，每天超過8小時，但持續划船超過這個時間被視為強制行軍（參見{@book 第八章|PHB|8|Travel Pace}，選自{@i 玩家手冊}）。

english: Boat
zh_tw: 船

english: Most craft navigating the waters of the Darklake are zurkhwood vessels piloted by the kuo-tua or the duergar. These boats are equivalent to keelboats (see the {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles} table in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 在黑暗湖水域航行的船隻大多是由寇濤或灰矮人駕駛的祖克木船。這些船隻等同於龍骨船（參見{@i 城主指南}第5章中的{@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||空中與水上載具}表格）。

english: Makeshift Raft
zh_tw: 臨時筏子

english: Characters can also construct makeshift rafts using materials at hand. For example, the cap of a giant zurkhwood mushroom can be hollowed out to make a coracle equivalent to a rowboat, but with half a rowboat's hit points (see the {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles} table in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). This is a downtime crafting activity requiring one day's work per raft.
zh_tw: 角色也可以使用手頭的材料製作臨時木筏。例如，可以用巨大澤克木蘑菇的菌帽挖空製作類似划艇的小船，但其生命值只有划艇的一半（見{@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||空中與水上載具}表，位於{@i 城主指南}第5章）。這是一項休整期製作活動，每製作一個木筏需要一天的工作時間。

english: An even more makeshift craft might involve a character sitting in a floating barrel or other watertight container, either steering with a paddle or flowing with the current. Such a vessel has a speed of 1 mph, requires a crew of 1, allows for no passengers or cargo, and has AC 11, hp 20, and damage threshold 0.
zh_tw: 一個更加臨時湊合的船隻可能包括一個角色坐在一個漂浮的桶或其他防水容器裡，要麼用槳划行，要麼隨波逐流。這樣的船隻速度為每小時1英里，需要1名船員，不允許搭載乘客或貨物，並且具有AC 11，hp 20，以及傷害閾值0。

english: Swimming
zh_tw: 游泳

english: Swimming in the Darklake is a poor choice given the number of dangerous creatures inhabiting it. Check for a creature encounter each hour that characters are swimming, rather than every 4 hours of travel. A swimming character must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw for each hour of swimming or gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}.
zh_tw: 在黑暗湖中游泳是個糟糕的選擇，因為這裡棲息著許多危險的生物。角色在游泳期間，每小時需進行一次生物遭遇檢定，而不是每4小時旅行一次。游泳的角色每小時必須成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 體質豁免檢定，否則將獲得一級 {@condition exhaustion||力竭}。

english: Characters not actively swimming but simply clinging to something that floats (including the wreckage of a boat or raft) can drift with the current at a speed of 1 mph. Check for creature encounters each hour that characters float in the water, and call for Constitution checks against {@condition exhaustion} for every 8 hours of travel.
zh_tw: 沒有積極游泳而只是緊抓浮動物（包括船或筏的殘骸）的角色可以隨流而下，速度為每小時1英里。角色在水中漂浮時，每小時檢查一次生物遭遇，並要求進行體質檢查以對抗{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，每8小時旅行進行一次。

english: Other Options
zh_tw: 其他選項

english: Travelers can mix and match modes of travel, and a sizable party might need multiple boats or rafts. A creature with a swimming speed (including a polymorphed character) can travel without risk of fatigue for up to 8 hours, and can even serve as a mount for a creature smaller than it. Water-breathing (or non-breathing) creatures can swim underwater or even walk across the bottom of shallow sections of the Darklake, but need {@sense darkvision} or a source of light to see.
zh_tw: 旅者們可以組合不同的旅行方式，較龐大的隊伍可能需要多艘船隻或木筏。擁有游泳速度的生物（包括被變形術改變的角色）可以無疲勞風險地旅行長達8小時，甚至可以充當比其體型更小生物的坐騎。具備水中呼吸能力（或無需呼吸）的生物可以在水下游泳，甚至步行穿越黑暗湖淺水區的底部，但需要{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}或光源才能視物。

english: The Darklake: General Features
zh_tw: 黑暗湖：一般特徵

english: The following features commonly apply to the Darklake region.
zh_tw: 以下特徵通常適用於黑暗湖區域。

english: Darkness
zh_tw: 黑暗術

english: True to its name, most of the Darklake exists in pitch blackness. The only light available is whatever the characters are able to provide.
zh_tw: 正如其名，黑暗湖的大部分地區都處於漆黑一片的狀態。唯一可用的光源是角色們能夠提供的光源。

english: Caves and Tunnels
zh_tw: 洞穴和隧道

english: The Darklake is a giant labyrinth of lakes, waterways, and canals that connect myriad caverns and chambers. Some of these caverns are massive, with immeasurably deep water and vaulted ceilings far outside the range of any light. Others are narrow, with only a few feet of space between the ceiling and the surface of the water. Some are completely submerged, navigable only by those able to breathe underwater.
zh_tw: 黑暗湖是一個由湖泊、水道和運河組成的巨大迷宮，它們連線著無數的洞穴和房間。其中一些洞穴非常龐大，有著深不可測的水和遠在任何光源範圍之外的拱形天花板。還有一些洞穴很狹窄，天花板和水面之間只有幾尺的空間。有些則完全被淹沒，只有能夠水下呼吸的生物才能航行。

english: Navigation
zh_tw: 導航

english: Without the sky or the stars to navigate by, any successful passage of the Darklake relies on one's familiarity with its intricate network of caverns, passages, and currents. Experienced navigators know how to find and read ancient duergar runes carved along the Darklake's tunnels, though most of these "road signs" are nearly worn away by the passage of time. Such knowledge is something that takes years, if not decades, of wandering the Darklake to acquire.Those without the skill to navigate the Darklake (including the adventurers) must employ maps or guides. If the characters manage to acquire a map, they can make Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks normally to avoid becoming lost.
zh_tw: 沒有天空或星星可以導航，任何成功穿越黑暗湖的旅程都依賴於對其錯綜複雜的洞穴、通道和水流的熟悉程度。有經驗的導航者知道如何找到並解讀雕刻在黑暗湖隧道中的古老灰矮人符文，儘管這些"路標"大多數已經被時間的流逝磨損得幾乎看不見了。這樣的知識需要在黑暗湖中漫遊數年甚至數十年才能獲得。那些沒有穿越黑暗湖技能的人（包括冒險者）必須使用地圖或嚮導。如果角色們設法獲得一張地圖，他們可以正常進行感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定以避免迷路。

english: Foraging
zh_tw: 覓食

english: The characters can forage for food while traversing the Darklake, primarily by fishing and gathering edible fungi (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2). Much of the water of the Darklake is unsafe to drink, making it important to seek out springs and other clean sources of water feeding into it.
zh_tw: 角色們在穿越黑暗湖時可以尋找食物，主要是透過捕魚和採集可食用的真菌（見第2章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）。黑暗湖的大部分水都不安全飲用，因此尋找泉水和其他清潔水源對它進行補給非常重要。

english: Random Encounters
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇

english: Every 4 hours that the characters are on the Darklake, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Darklake Random Encounters table to determine what, if anything, they encounter. If the characters aren't moving—anchored or ashore, for example—any encounter is automatically a creature encounter.
zh_tw: 角色們在黑暗湖上每過4小時，擲一個{@dice d20}並查閱黑暗湖隨機遭遇表，以確定他們是否遇到了什麼。如果角色們沒有移動——比如拋錨或靠岸——任何遭遇自動被視為生物遭遇。

english: Collision
zh_tw: 碰撞

english: This terrain encounter occurs only if one or more party members are traveling by raft or boat, and there's a strong current. Have everyone aboard the vessel make a {@dc 13} group Dexterity check to avoid hitting a wall or other large obstacle directly ahead. If the group check succeeds, the collision is avoided. Otherwise, the vessel takes {@dice 2d10} bludgeoning damage from the collision, and everyone aboard must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength or Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling overboard.
zh_tw: 此地形遭遇僅在隊伍中有一個或多個成員乘坐木筏或船隻，並且有強流時發生。讓船上的每個人進行一次 {@dc 13} 群體敏捷檢定，以避免直接撞上正前方的牆壁或其他大型障礙物。如果群體檢定成功，則避免了碰撞。否則，船隻因碰撞受到 {@dice 2d10} 點鈍擊傷害，船上的每個人都必須成功進行一次 {@dc 10} 力量或敏捷豁免以避免落水。

english: Falls or Locks
zh_tw: 瀑布或水閘

english: Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 12 or better can hear the roar of a waterfall ahead. A successful {@dc 14} group Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check is necessary to steer or swim away from the falls. Otherwise, the characters go over, falling {@dice 1d6 × 10} feet into a pool or river {@dice 1d6 × 5} feet deep. A creature swept over the falls must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage per 10 feet fallen. A successful save indicates that the creature avoids a hard landing in the water below.
zh_tw: 任何角色的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）分數達到12或更高，可以聽到前方瀑布的轟鳴聲。要成功操縱或遊離瀑布，需要進行一個成功的{@dc 14}集體力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。否則，角色會跌落，落入{@dice 1d6 × 10}尺深的池塘或河流{@dice 1d6 × 5}尺深處。被瀑布衝下的生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 11}敏捷豁免檢定，否則每跌落10尺會受到{@dice 1d6}點鈍擊傷害。成功的豁免檢定意味著生物避免了在水中硬著陸。

english: There is a 50 percent chance that any waterfall area contains a duergar-built lock designed to traverse it, in which case there is no risk of going over the falls. It takes a successful {@dc 11} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to figure out how to operate the lock. Once a lock is opened, it takes 1 hour for the water level to lower so the party can proceed.
zh_tw: 任何瀑布區域有50%的機率包含一個由灰矮人建造的鎖，用於穿越瀑布，這種情況下不會有墜入瀑布的風險。需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 11} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定以弄清楚如何操作這個鎖。一旦鎖被開啟，水位下降需要1小時，隊伍才能繼續前進。

english: Island
zh_tw: 島嶼

english: A small island rises from the water ahead. An island with no hostile creatures makes a good place for the party to take a long rest. There is a 50 percent chance that the island has one or more types of fungi growing atop it (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2). Otherwise, the island is barren rock.
zh_tw: 前方水中升起了一個小島。一個沒有敵對生物的小島是隊伍進行長休的好地方。小島上有50%的機率生長著一種或多種真菌（見第2章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）。否則，這個島嶼就是貧瘠的岩石。

english: Low Ceiling
zh_tw: 低矮的天花板

english: The clearance of the cave or passage lowers suddenly to 3 feet above the water's surface. Each Medium character must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or take {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage from hitting the ceiling before the passage ends.
zh_tw: 洞穴或通道的淨空突然降至水面以上3尺。每個中型生物必須成功透過 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則在通道結束前會因撞擊頂部而受到 {@dice 1d4} 點鈍擊傷害。

english: Rockfall
zh_tw: 巖崩

english: Loose rocks fall from the ceiling above. Each character must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be hit by a chunk of falling stone for {@dice 2d6} bludgeoning damage. If the characters are traveling in a boat or raft, their vessel takes {@dice 2d6} bludgeoning damage for each successful save; in other words, each rock that misses a character hits the boat or raft instead. Roll the damage for each rock striking a vessel separately to see if it overcomes the vessel's damage threshold.
zh_tw: 鬆散的岩石從天花板上掉下來。每個角色必須成功進行一個 {@dc 12} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則被掉落的石塊擊中，受到 {@dice 2d6} 鈍擊傷害。如果角色們在船或木筏上旅行，每次成功豁免時，他們的船隻也會受到 {@dice 2d6} 鈍擊傷害；換句話說，每塊未命中角色的岩石會擊中船或木筏。分別擲出每個擊中船隻的岩石的傷害，以檢視它是否超過了船隻的傷害閾值。

english: Rough Current
zh_tw: 急流

english: The waters here are especially turbulent. If the characters are traveling by boat or raft, the crew must succeed on a {@dc 13} group Dexterity check to maintain control. If the group check fails, the vessel takes {@dice 2d6} bludgeoning damage, and each occupant must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength or Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling overboard.
zh_tw: 這裡的水域特別湍急。如果角色們乘船或木筏旅行，船員必須成功透過一個 {@dc 13} 群體敏捷檢定以保持控制。如果群體檢定失敗，船隻將受到 {@dice 2d6} 的鈍擊傷害，每個乘員必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 力量或敏捷豁免檢定以避免落水。

english: Run Aground
zh_tw: 擱淺

english: This terrain encounter occurs only if one or more party members are traveling by raft or boat. The vessel hits a shallow area or sandbar and runs aground. The characters can push the vessel back into the water with a successful {@dc 10} group Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. While characters are pushing their boat free, there is a 50 percent chance that one or more creatures attack them; in this event, roll on the Darklake Creature Encounters table to determine what attacks.
zh_tw: 這種地形遭遇僅在有一個或多個隊伍成員乘坐木筏或船隻旅行時發生。船隻撞上淺水區或沙洲並擱淺。角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 集體力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定將船隻推回水中。當角色正在推動船隻脫離時，有50%的機率會有一個或多個生物攻擊他們；在這種情況下，請在黑暗湖生物遭遇表中擲骰以確定攻擊的生物。

english: Stone Teeth
zh_tw: 石牙

english: This terrain encounter occurs only if one or more party members are traveling by raft or boat, and there's a strong current. Stalagmites jutting up from the bottom of a tunnel are hidden just below the waterline. Spotters must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to notice the "stone teeth," allowing the vessel's crew to attempt a {@dc 12} group Dexterity check to navigate through them. If the group check succeeds, the vessel passes through unscathed. Failure to notice or navigate through the stone teeth deals {@dice 6d6} piercing damage to the boat or raft.
zh_tw: 這種地形遭遇僅在隊伍中有一名或多名成員乘木筏或船行進，且水流湍急時發生。石筍從隧道底部突起，隱藏在水面下。觀察者必須成功透過一個 {@dc 13} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定以注意到這些"石牙"，從而讓船員嘗試一個 {@dc 12} 群體敏捷檢定來透過它們。如果群體檢定成功，船隻將安全透過。未能注意到或透過石牙將給船隻或木筏造成 {@dice 6d6} 穿刺傷害。

english: Tight Passage
zh_tw: 狹窄通道

english: The adventurers encounter an especially tight passage, requiring a successful {@dc 12} group Dexterity check to navigate a boat or raft through it. If the group check succeeds, the boat slips through. Otherwise, the boat gets stuck, requiring a successful {@dc 14} group Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to push it free. While characters are pushing their boat free, there is a 50 percent chance that one or more creatures attack them; in this event, roll on the Darklake Creature Encounters table to determine what attacks.
zh_tw: 冒險者們遇到了一條特別狹窄的通道，需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 12} 群體敏捷檢定來駕駛船隻或木筏穿越。如果群體檢定成功，船隻順利透過。否則，船隻會被卡住，需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 14} 群體力量檢定（{@skill Athletics||運動}）來將其推開。當角色們正在推開船隻時，有50%的機率會有一到多個生物攻擊他們；在這種情況下，請在黑暗湖生物遭遇表中擲骰以確定是何種生物發動攻擊。

english: Whirlpool
zh_tw: 漩渦

english: An underwater crevasse or drain creates a small vortex in this area, much like the whirlpool effect of the {@spell control water} spell (save {@dc 14}).
zh_tw: 一個水下裂縫或排水口在這個區域形成了一個小漩渦，類似於 {@spell control water||操控水體} 法術的漩渦效果（豁免 {@dc 14}）。

english: Aquatic Troll
zh_tw: 水生巨魔

english: An aquatic {@creature troll} swims up from the depths. It has the abilities of a normal troll, but can also breathe water and has a swimming speed of 30 feet.
zh_tw: 一隻水生的{@creature troll||巨魔}從深處游上來。它擁有普通巨魔的能力，但也可以在水中呼吸，並且游泳速度為30尺。

english: Darkmantles
zh_tw: 暗幕魔獸

english: These creatures cling to the ceiling as the adventurers approach, cloaking themselves in darkness as they unfurl and attack. A creature in a boat or on a raft that tries and fails to detach a {@creature darkmantle} from itself or another creature must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall out of the vessel and into the water.
zh_tw: 當冒險者接近時，這些生物緊貼在天花板上，在黑暗中掩護自己，同時展開並發動攻擊。在船上或木筏上的生物如果嘗試並失敗將自己或另一個生物從一隻 {@creature darkmantle||暗幕魔獸} 上脫離，必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則會從船上掉入水中。

english: Duergar
zh_tw: 灰矮人

english: A keelboat crewed by {@creature duergar} is traversing the Darklake on business. The gray dwarves parley with the adventurers—or attack them if the opportunity looks ripe to capture them and sell them as slaves in Gracklstugh. If the duergar surprise all the characters, they turn {@condition invisible}, making it appear that their boat is abandoned so as to lure the adventurers on board before they attack.
zh_tw: 一艘由{@creature duergar||灰矮人}駕駛的平底船正在穿越黑暗湖進行業務。灰色矮人們與冒險者們進行談判——或者如果有機會捕捉他們並把他們作為奴隸賣到格拉克斯圖格，就會攻擊他們。如果灰矮人使所有角色感到驚訝，他們會變為{@condition invisible||隱形}，使得他們的船看起來像是被遺棄了，以此誘使冒險者們上船，然後他們再進行攻擊。

english: Roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Duergar Keelboat Cargo table to determine what, if anything, the duergar are transporting in their keelboat.
zh_tw: 擲一個{@dice d20}骰子，並參照灰矮人龍骨船貨物表來確定灰矮人在他們的船上運輸了什麼，如果有的話。

english: Duergar Keelboat Cargo
zh_tw: 灰矮人龍骨船貨物

english: Cargo
zh_tw: 貨物

english: None
zh_tw: 無

english: {@dice 1d20 × 100} pounds of unrefined iron ore
zh_tw: {@dice 1d20 × 100} 磅未精煉的鐵礦石

english: {@dice 1d4} zurkhwood crates filled with mining tools
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} 裝滿採礦工具的祖克木木箱

english: {@dice 2d4} zurkhwood casks of harvested fungi (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2)
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4} 祖爾克伍德桶裝收穫的真菌（見第2章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）

english: A locked iron chest containing {@dice 3d6 × 100} gp and a random magic item (roll once on Magic Item Table B in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Random Treasure} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 一個上鎖的鐵箱，裡面裝有{@dice 3d6 × 100} gp和一個隨機魔法物品（在{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Random Treasure}的{@i 城主指南}中的魔法物品表B上擲一次骰）。

english: Green Hag
zh_tw: 綠鬼婆

english: Nanny Plunk is a {@creature green hag} who likes to taunt and lead travelers astray. She might instead bargain with the characters with her knowledge of the Darklake, especially if her life or freedom is at stake. If this encounter occurs again, it might be with Nanny or one of her sisters, Maven Delve or Dame Spiderwort.
zh_tw: 南妮·普蘭克是一隻{@creature green hag||綠鬼婆}，她喜歡戲弄旅行者並引導他們誤入歧途。如果她的生命或自由受到威脅，她可能會與角色們交易她對黑暗湖的瞭解。如果這次遭遇再次發生，可能是與南妮或她的姐妹們，瑪文·德爾夫或黛姆·蜘蛛草。

english: Grell
zh_tw: 觸鬚怪

english: A {@creature grell} descends from the cavern ceiling, attempting to grab and paralyze one party member, then fly off with its victim.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature grell||觸鬚怪}從洞穴頂部降落，試圖抓住並癱瘓一名隊伍成員，然後帶著受害者飛走。

english: Ixitxachitl
zh_tw: 伊希鰩魚

english: These creatures attack any party members in the water. Otherwise, they follow the party and wait for an opportunity to strike. If denied a meal for too long, they begin to gnaw on the hull of a boat or the underside of a raft, hoping to sink it (this tactic is ineffective against craft with a high damage threshold).
zh_tw: 這些生物會攻擊在水中的任何隊伍成員。否則，它們會跟隨隊伍並等待襲擊的機會。如果長時間沒有進食，它們會開始啃食船的船體或筏子的底部，希望將其弄沉（這種策略對具有高傷害閾值的船隻無效）。

english: Kuo-toa
zh_tw: 寇濤

english: These {@creature kuo-toa} pole a keelboat toward Sloobludop (or away from the town if it has been attacked; see the end of this chapter). If the characters have not been to Sloobludop, the kuo-toa might try to capture them and bring them there. See "{@area The Day's Catch|11d|x}" for details.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}正在劃著一艘平底船向斯盧布多普（或遠離城鎮，如果城鎮遭到攻擊；見本章末尾）。如果角色們還沒有去過斯盧布多普，寇濤魚人可能會試圖捕獲他們並將他們帶到那裡。詳情請見"{@area 一天的收穫|11d|x}"。

english: Roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Kuo-toa Keelboat Cargo table to determine what, if anything, the Kuo-toa are transporting in their keelboat.
zh_tw: 擲一個{@dice d20}，並參照寇濤魚人 龍骨船貨物表來確定寇濤魚人在他們的尖尾船上運輸了什麼，如果有的話。

english: Kuo-toa Keelboat Cargo
zh_tw: 寇濤龍骨船貨物

english: Cargo
zh_tw: 貨物

zh_tw: 無

english: {@dice 1d4} nets; each net has a 50 percent chance of containing {@dice 3d6} dead, edible quippers
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} 個網；每個網有50%的機率包含{@dice 3d6}只已死亡且可食用的食人魚

english: {@dice 1d4} nets; each net has a 50 percent chance of containing {@dice 1d4} living stirges
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4}個網；每個網有50%的機率包含{@dice 1d4}只活的吸血蝨

english: {@dice 1d4} pieces of broken, barnacle-encrusted statuary, each worth 50 gp; each weighing {@dice 1d4 × 5} pounds; and each depicting a weird alien creature, a long-forgotten god, or fragment thereof.
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} 件破碎的、被藤壺覆蓋的雕像，每件價值 50 gp；每件重 {@dice 1d4 × 5} 磅；每件都描繪著一個奇怪的外星生物、一個被遺忘已久的神祇或其碎片。

english: Merrow
zh_tw: 邁羅人魚

english: These worshipers of Demogorgon have been driven into a frenzy by his arrival in the Underdark. They immediately attack, trying to capsize or wreck boats as they utter the war cry, "Blood and salt for the Prince of Demons!" in Abyssal.
zh_tw: 這些狄摩高根的崇拜者因他來到幽暗地域而陷入瘋狂。他們立即發起攻擊，試圖翻船或破壞船隻，同時用深淵語高呼戰鬥口號：'為了惡魔之王的血與鹽！'

english: A {@creature merrow} can use its action to capsize a boat or raft within 5 feet of it. Anyone in the boat can thwart the merrow by using a reaction to make a Strength check contested by the merrow's Strength check. If the merrow wins the contest, the vessel capsizes.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature merrow||邁羅人魚}可以使用它的行動能力在距離它5尺內的船隻或筏子上翻。船上的任何人可以透過使用反應來進行力量檢定，與邁羅人魚的力量檢定進行競爭。如果邁羅人魚贏得競爭，船隻就會翻覆。

english: Stirges
zh_tw: 蚊蝠們

english: These {@creature Stirge||stirges} cling to the ceiling like bats. If the party is aware of the stirges, the characters can make a {@dc 13} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to slip past the stirges without disturbing them. If the group check succeeds, the stirges ignore the party. Otherwise, the stirges descend and attack the nearest party members.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Stirge||蚊蝠}像蝙蝠一樣附著在天花板上。如果隊伍察覺到了蚊蝠的存在，角色們可以進行一個{@dc 13}群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，嘗試在不驚動它們的情況下悄悄繞過。如果群體檢定成功，蚊蝠會忽略隊伍。否則，蚊蝠會降落並攻擊最近的隊員。

english: Swarm of Quippers
zh_tw: 食人魚群

english: A {@creature swarm of quippers} keeps pace with the characters, attacking anyone in the water. If an hour passes and no meal has presented itself, the quippers stop following the party.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature swarm of quippers||食人魚群}與角色保持同步，攻擊任何在水中的人。如果一個小時過去了，沒有食物出現，利齒魚群就會停止跟隨隊伍。

english: Water Weird
zh_tw: 水詭

english: Bound to some long-lost site beneath the surface of the water, this neutral evil elemental rises to attack when the characters pass by.
zh_tw: 繫結在水下某個早已失落的地方，這個中立邪惡的元素生物在角色經過時出現並發動攻擊。

english: Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the Weird Discoveries table to determine what the {@creature water weird} is guarding.
zh_tw: 擲一個{@dice d6}骰子，並參照奇怪的發現表來確定{@creature water weird||水詭}正在守護什麼。

zh_tw: d6

zh_tw: 發現

english: Sunken altar dedicated to a forgotten deity
zh_tw: 沉沒的祭壇，獻給被遺忘的神祇

english: Sunken statue with 500 gp black pearls for eyes; a thief who removes one or both gems becomes the target of a {@spell contagion} spell (save {@dc 14}).
zh_tw: 帶有價值500金幣的黑珍珠眼睛的沉沒雕像；盜走一顆或兩顆寶石的小偷將成為一個{@spell contagion||疫病術}法術的目標（豁免 {@dc 14}）。

english: Sunken, sealed sarcophagus containing a {@creature mummy} and {@dice 1d4} art objects (roll on the 250 gp Art Objects table in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Random Treasure} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide})
zh_tw: 沉沒且密封的石棺，內含{@creature mummy||木乃伊}和{@dice 1d4}件藝術物品（按照{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Random Treasure}中的250金幣藝術物品表擲骰，該表來自{@i 城主指南}）

english: Sloobludop
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普

english: {@b Population}: 500 kuo-toa
zh_tw: {@b 人口}: 500寇濤魚人

english: {@b Government}: The archpriest Ploopploopeen once ruled in the name of the Sea Mother, the goddess Blibdoolpoolp. He was recently challenged and displaced by his daughter Bloppblippodd, archpriest of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father.
zh_tw: {@b 政治}: 大祭司普魯普魯平曾以海母神，女神布里博杜普的名義統治。他最近被他的女兒布洛普布利波德挑戰並取代，布洛普布利波德是深海之父利穆格古恩的大祭司。

english: {@b Defense}: All kuo-toa rally to the village's defense, including whips and monitors serving the priesthood.
zh_tw: {@b 防禦}: 所有寇濤魚人團結起來保衛村莊，包括為神職服務的鞭子和監視者。

english: {@b Commerce}: The kuo-toa trade with various races of the Underdark near the Darklake, in addition to providing ferry service and navigation.
zh_tw: {@b 商業}: 寇濤魚人與黑暗湖附近幽暗地域的各個種族進行貿易，此外還提供擺渡服務和導航。

english: {@b Organizations}: Two major shrines and several other minor ones.
zh_tw: {@b 組織}: 兩個主要的神殿和幾個其他的小神殿。

english: Sloobludop is a kuo-toa village on the eastern edge of the Darklake. From a distance, it looks like a massive tangle of reeds stretching up into the darkness, lit by glowing spots of phosphorescence. Upon closer approach, a series of rickety towers can be seen, lashed together by rope and plank bridges set in haphazard patterns. Even above ground, the kuo-toa build in line with their three-dimensional aquatic sensibilities, constructing their "great city" as if it were underwater.
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普是黑暗湖東邊的一個寇濤魚人村莊。從遠處看，它看起來像一團伸入黑暗中的巨大的蘆葦叢，被髮光的熒光點照亮。走近一些，可以看到一系列搖搖欲墜的塔樓，由繩索和木板橋以隨意的模式捆綁在一起。即使在地面上，寇濤魚人也按照他們三維的水生感覺建造，建造他們的"大城市"，就好像它在水下一樣。

english: Sloobludop simmers with religious fervor and sectarian tension. While many of the kuo-toa still worship the goddess Blibdoolpoolp, a faction has shifted its worship to Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father, a vision influenced by the manifestation of the demon prince Demogorgon from the depths of the Darklake. Initially, the archpriest of Blibdoolpoolp tolerated this—but then his own daughter declared herself an archpriest of Leemooggoogoon, and the cult began to grow.
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普充滿了宗教熱情和宗派緊張。儘管許多寇濤魚人仍然崇拜女神布里博杜普，但一個派系已將其崇拜轉向了深海之父利穆格古恩，這一願景受到了來自黑暗湖深處的惡魔王子狄摩高根顯現的影響。起初，布里博杜普的大祭司容忍了這一點——但隨後他自己的的女兒自稱為利穆格古恩的大祭司，並且這個邪教開始增長。

english: Sloobludop: General Features
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普：一般特徵

english: Sloobludop spreads out along the rocky shore of the waters of a broad cavern lake, with high fences of woven netting to the north and south of the village boundaries.
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普沿著一個寬闊的洞穴湖的岩石岸邊延伸開來，在村莊邊界的北部和南部有高高的編織網圍欄。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Sloobludop's cavern is almost entirely dark except for a few spots of {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} from phosphorescent fungus and coral, or from glowing cave-fish glands. The kuo-toa recoil from areas of bright illumination, becoming hostile if {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} is brought among them.
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普的洞窟幾乎完全黑暗，只有少數幾處因磷光真菌、珊瑚或發光的洞穴魚腺體而產生的{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。寇濤魚人會避開明亮光照的區域，如果{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}出現在它們之中，它們會變得敵對。

english: Bridges and Platforms
zh_tw: 橋樑和平臺

english: Bridges and platforms are haphazardly strung throughout the city, connecting various levels of structures with each other as well as crisscrossing open spaces. Characters can move at a normal pace across the platforms and bridges, but this puts strain on their poor construction. Whenever one or more characters move at normal speed across a bridge or platform, roll a {@dice d6}. On a roll of 1, a bridge flips or breaks to drop characters to the platform below, or a platform tilts to tip the characters into the water. These areas can be navigated safely by treating them as {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 橋樑和平臺在城市中隨意懸掛，將不同層次的建築物相互連線，同時也穿越開放空間。角色可以在平臺上以正常速度移動，但這會給它們脆弱的構造帶來壓力。每當一個或多個角色以正常速度穿過橋樑或平臺時，擲一個{@dice d6}。如果擲出1，橋樑會翻轉或斷裂，使角色掉到下面的平臺上，或者平臺傾斜，將角色傾倒入水中。這些區域可以安全地作為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}來導航。

english: Language
zh_tw: 語言

english: None of the inhabitants of Sloobludop speak Common or any surface-world language, which might present a challenge for the characters. The fish-folk speak Undercommon, and {@creature Stool|OotA} the myconid sprout can establish communication using its rapport spores if it is present. Shuushar the kuo-toa monk can also translate if he accompanies the party.
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普的居民沒有人說通用語或任何地表世界的語言，這可能會給角色們帶來挑戰。這些魚人講地底通用語，如果{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}這個菌人植物幼體在場，它可以使用它的共鳴孢子建立溝通。如果寇濤魚人和尚舒沙爾陪伴隊伍，他也可以進行翻譯。

english: Slouching Toward Sloobludop
zh_tw: 向斯盧布多普傾斜

english: The characters can choose to go to Sloobludop for several reasons:
zh_tw: 角色們有幾個原因可以選擇前往斯盧布多普：

english: They need a boat (and possibly a guide) to navigate the Darklake. Travel along the waterways of the Darklake is an excellent way to throw off their drow pursuers (see {@area chapter 2|078|x} for details).
zh_tw: 他們需要一艘船（可能還需要一名嚮導）來穿越黑暗湖。沿著黑暗湖的水道航行是擺脫卓爾追捕者的絕佳方式（詳細資訊請參閱{@area 第二章|078|x}）。

english: Staying a short while in Sloobludop can provide a respite from pursuit, since the drow are reluctant to provoke the kuo-toa needlessly. Reduce the pursuit level by 1 while the characters consider their next move.
zh_tw: 在斯盧布多普短暫停留可以為逃避追蹤提供喘息之機，因為卓爾不願無端挑釁寇濤魚人。當角色們考慮下一步行動時，降低追蹤等級1。

english: The characters need supplies and equipment, and hope the kuo-toa might be willing to trade for whatever they can offer. Alternatively, the characters might try to steal what they need from the kuo-toa.
zh_tw: 角色們需要補給和裝備，並希望寇濤魚人願意為他們能提供的東西進行交易。或者，角色們可能會嘗試從寇濤魚人那裡偷取他們需要的東西。

english: Shuushar might point out any of the previous reasons, or wish to go to Sloobludop to rejoin his people, feeling he has important guidance to offer them.
zh_tw: 舒沙爾可能會指出前面提到的任何一個原因，或者希望前往斯盧布多普重新加入他的人民，感覺他有重要的指導可以提供給他們。

english: Shuushar might not be the only one with "higher guidance." One or more characters might experience dreams or visions guiding them toward Sloobludop—not realizing that such dreams are simply further manifestations of the madness growing in the Underdark.
zh_tw: 舒沙爾可能不是唯一一個擁有"更高指引"的人。一個或多個角色可能會經歷夢境或幻象，引導他們前往斯盧布多普——並沒有意識到這些夢境只是幽暗地域中日益增長的瘋狂進一步的表現。

english: Notable Kuo-toa in Sloobludop
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普的著名寇濤魚人

english: A number of important kuo-toa have the ability to influence the adventurers' fate in Sloobludop.
zh_tw: 一些重要的寇濤魚人有能力影響冒險者在斯盧布多普的命運。

zh_tw: 顯赫的寇濤魚人

english: Archpriest of the Blibdoolpoolp the Sea Mother
zh_tw: 海洋之母布利布多波波的首席祭司

zh_tw: {@b 布洛普布利波德（'布洛普'）})

zh_tw: 普魯普魯平的女兒，現在自稱為深父利穆格古恩的首席祭司；惡魔汙染

english: {@b Glooglugogg ("Gloog"})

english: Ploopploopeen's son, kuo-toa whip, and loyal worshiper of the Sea Mother
zh_tw: 普魯普魯平的兒子，寇濤驅策者，海洋之母的忠誠信徒

english: {@b Klibdoloogut ("Klib"})
zh_tw: {@b 克利布多洛格特（"克利布"）})
