english: Roleplaying the Kuo-Toa
zh_tw: 扮演寇濤魚人

english: Though the kuo-toa are mad, at least some of that madness comes from an utterly alien mind-set. Although amphibious air dwellers, the kuo-toa still largely behave as aquatic creatures. Thus, much of what they do on land is a bizarre approximation of life under the water.
zh_tw: 儘管寇濤魚人瘋狂，至少他們的瘋狂部分來自於一個完全不同的思維方式。雖然寇濤魚人是兩棲空氣生物，但他們仍然主要表現得像水生生物。因此，他們在陸地上的許多行為是對水下生活的奇異模仿。

english: Kuo-toa names are a long series of gargling syllables, and their voices have a bubbly, gargling quality. However, the kuo-toa communicate as much through gesture as speech. They have difficulty standing still, and are prone to quick, darting movements. They pace constantly, walking in circles around creatures talking to them. A kuo-toa priest speaking to a group of followers doesn't stand at a podium but wanders aimlessly while the crowd follows like a school of fish.
zh_tw: 寇濤魚人的名字是一連串的咯咯音節，他們的聲音具有泡沫般的咯咯質感。然而，寇濤魚人透過手勢和言語進行交流。他們難以保持靜止，容易快速而突然地移動。他們不斷地踱步，在與他們交談的生物周圍走圈。一個寇濤魚人祭司在對一群信徒講話時，不會站在講臺上，而是漫無目的地徘徊，而人群則像一群魚一樣跟隨。

english: Kuo-toa prefer their leaders to be physically above their subordinates. (If no dais or platform is available for leaders, they have been known to literally stand on top of prostrate underlings.) However, leaders tend to dwell on the lowest levels of buildings because these are considered the safest areas in a settlement, due to their proximity to the water.
zh_tw: 寇濤更傾向於他們的領導者在物理上高於他們的下屬。（如果沒有講臺或平臺供領導者使用，他們被知道會字面意義上站在俯臥的下屬之上。）然而，領導者傾向於居住在建築物的最低層，因為由於接近水源，這些區域被認為是定居點中最安全的區域。

english: Since the kuo-toa are fishlike, they lack eyelids. This isn't only unnerving in conversation (a kuo-toa never blinks), but it also means that kuo-toa all look the same sleeping as awake—and virtually all kuo-toa sleepwalk, making things even more confusing. There is a 25 percent chance that any individual kuo-toa the party encounters in Sloobludop is sleepwalking, ignoring everyone around it and moving in a shuffling gait from place to place.
zh_tw: 由於寇濤魚人類似魚類，他們沒有眼瞼。這不僅在交談中令人不安（寇濤魚人從不眨眼），而且意味著寇濤魚人睡覺時看起來和醒著時一樣——實際上幾乎所有寇濤魚人都會夢遊，這使得情況更加混亂。在斯盧布多普遇到的任何個別寇濤魚人有25%的機率在夢遊，忽略周圍的每個人，以拖沓的步伐從一個地方移動到另一個地方。

english: Shuushar Connection
zh_tw: 舒沙爾連線

english: If Shuushar accompanies the party, the kuo-toa monk can be helpful in communicating with his people at Sloobludop. However, keep in mind that Shuushar is either a heretic or a holy man depending on which kuo-toa he's speaking to, and how they view things at that particular moment. The mysterious monk could serve as an ace in the hole to help the party out, or he could just as easily cause trouble with his stubborn refusal to acknowledge his fellow kuo-toa's religious obsessions as anything other than "dangerous illusions," combined with his preference for nonviolent solutions.
zh_tw: 如果舒沙爾陪伴隊伍，這位寇濤魚人僧侶在與斯盧布多普的同胞溝通時可能會有所幫助。然而，請注意，舒沙爾根據他與之交談的寇濤魚人以及他們那一刻的看法，可能是異教徒或聖者。這位神秘的僧侶可以作為幫助隊伍的王牌，或者由於他固執地拒絕承認他的同胞對宗教的執著除了"危險的幻覺"之外的任何東西，以及他傾向於非暴力解決方案，同樣容易引發麻煩。

english: The Day's Catch
zh_tw: 一天的收穫

english: When the adventurers come within an hour's travel of Sloobludop, they encounter a party of eight {@creature kuo-toa} led by a {@creature kuo-toa monitor}. The fish-folk immediately attack, but their tactics show that they are attempting to capture the characters. The kuo-toa leave any fallen opponents {@condition unconscious} at 0 hit points, intending to bring them back to Sloobludop as live offerings to the Deep Father. They bind prisoners with tough cords of gut, each with 2 hit points and requiring a successful {@dc 17} Strength check to break.
zh_tw: 當冒險者們距離斯盧布多普不到一小時的路程時，他們會遇到一隊由{@creature kuo-toa monitor||寇濤監察者}帶領的八名{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}。這些魚人立即發動攻擊，但他們的戰術表明他們正試圖捕獲這些角色。庫圖人在對手生命值降為0時將他們{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，並打算將他們帶回斯盧布多普作為獻給深海之父的活祭品。他們會用堅韌的腸繩綁住俘虜，每根腸繩有2點生命值，需要成功的{@dc 17}力量檢定來掙脫。

english: The Enemy of My Enemy
zh_tw: 我的敵人的敵人

english: On the way to Sloobludop after the previous encounter, the characters run into another kuo-toa patrol, this one made up of six {@creature kuo-toa} and two {@creature Kuo-toa Monitor||kuo-toa monitors}, led by the {@creature kuo-toa archpriest} Ploopploopeen. If the characters are prisoners of the first kuo-toa patrol, the newcomers ambush them and fight to free the characters. Otherwise (or after the fight), Ploopploopeen attempts to communicate in Undercommon, then casts {@spell tongues} if none of the characters speak it. Read the following:
zh_tw: 在前往斯盧布多普的路上，繼上次遭遇之後，角色們又遇到了一隊寇濤魚人巡邏隊，這隊由六隻{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}和兩隻{@creature Kuo-toa Monitor||寇濤監察者}組成，由{@creature kuo-toa archpriest||寇濤大祭司}普魯普魯平帶領。如果角色們是第一隊寇濤魚人巡邏隊的俘虜，新來的隊伍會伏擊他們並戰鬥以解救角色們。否則（或戰鬥後），普魯普魯平會嘗試用地底通用語交流，如果角色們中沒有人會說，則施放{@spell tongues||巧言術}。閱讀以下內容：

english: "I am Ploopploopeen, archpriest of the Sea Mother Blibdoolpoolp. She answers my prayers by delivering you. Help us, and you will be rewarded for your service."
zh_tw: "我是普魯普魯平，海洋之母布莉朵普嚕的祭司長。她回應我的祈禱，將你送到此地。幫助我們，你將因你的服務得到獎賞。"

english: If the characters talk with Ploopploopeen, the archpriest explains his intentions as the kuo-toa escort the party to Sloobludop. If the characters refuse, the kuo-toa attempt to capture them, as with the previous patrol.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與普魯普魯平交談，這位大祭司在寇濤魚人護送隊伍前往斯盧布多普時解釋了他的意圖。如果角色們拒絕，寇濤魚人會像之前的巡邏隊一樣試圖捕獲他們。

english: Ploopploopeen explains that the inhabitants of Sloobludop have lived in harmonious service to the will of the Sea Mother for some time. Oh, there were occasional "visionaries" who stirred up trouble (at this, he might cast a walleyed glance at Shuushar) but nothing of any great concern. A few weeks ago, Bloppblippodd, Ploopploopeen's own daughter, experienced a powerful vision of "Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father," proclaiming him the new god of her people. She has backed up her claims with a great increase in her magical power, and new followers have flocked to her.
zh_tw: 普魯普魯平解釋說，斯盧布多普的居民已經和諧地服務於海洋之母的意志有一段時間了。哦，偶爾會有一些"幻想家"製造麻煩（這時，他可能會對舒沙爾投去斜視的目光），但這都不是什麼大問題。幾周前，布洛普布利波德，普魯普魯平自己的女兒，經歷了一個關於"深父利穆格古恩"的強大幻象，宣稱他是她人民的新神。她透過自己魔法力量的巨大提升來支援她的主張，並且新的追隨者紛紛加入她。

english: "We are split in two," Ploopploopeen explains, "fighting among ourselves." The followers of the Deep Father have been making an increasing number of offerings on his altar—killing blood sacrifices then casting bloody chum into the waters of the Darklake, where it is consumed by... something.
zh_tw: "我們分裂成兩部分，"普魯普魯平解釋說，"彼此爭鬥。"深父的追隨者一直在他的祭壇上進行越來越多的獻祭——進行血腥的血祭然後將血腥的魚餌投入黑暗湖的水域，被...某個東西所消耗。

english: Baiting the Hook
zh_tw: 設定誘餌

english: The archpriest of the Sea Mother tells the characters he wants to use them as bait. The archpriest of the Deep Father needs humanoid sacrifices, and the party represents a prize collection in that regard. Ploopploopeen will offer the characters as a "token of peace and reconciliation" to get closer to the archpriest of the Deep Father—except the adventurers will not be helpless prisoners, but infiltrators. Ploopploopeen wants the characters to disrupt the upstart faction's rituals, allowing his true believers of the Sea Mother to cut off the head of the cult. The archpriest promises that the characters will be "well rewarded" for their aid.
zh_tw: 海洋之母的大祭司告訴角色們他想用他們作為誘餌。深父的大祭司需要類人生物的祭品，而隊伍在這方面代表了一筆珍貴的收藏。普魯普魯平打算將角色們作為"和平與和解的象徵"來接近深父的大祭司——除了冒險者們不會是無助的囚犯，而是滲透者。普魯普魯平希望角色們破壞那個新興派系的儀式，讓他海洋之母的真正信徒能夠斬斷邪教的頭顱。大祭司承諾，角色們將因他們的幫助而得到"豐厚的獎賞"。

english: If the characters refuse, Ploopploopeen tries to turn them over anyway, still using them as bait to get his own kuo-toa loyalists closer to his daughter's cult. However, he no longer depends on or supports the characters as allies, leaving them to survive on their own.
zh_tw: 如果角色們拒絕，普魯普魯平仍然試圖無論如何都要將他們交出去，仍然利用他們作為誘餌，讓他自己的寇濤魚人忠誠者更接近他女兒的邪教。然而，他不再依賴或支援角色們作為盟友，讓他們自己生存。

english: No matter whether the characters approach the final encounter as willing participants or prisoners, the kuo-toa make no effort to bind them or take their weapons, believing in the power of their superior numbers and the divine might of their competing gods.
zh_tw: 無論角色們是作為願意的參與者還是囚犯接近最後的遭遇，寇濤魚人都不會努力去捆綁他們或拿走他們的武器，他們相信他們數量上的優越和他們競爭的神的神聖力量。

english: A Kuo-Toan Koan
zh_tw: 寇濤魚人的禪宗公案

english: The kuo-toa are aquatic creatures. As such, they have no real need for the boats they use to ply the Darklake, even as boating remains a significant part of their culture.
zh_tw: 寇濤魚人是水生生物。因此，他們實際上並不需要用來在黑暗湖航行的船隻，即使划船仍然是他們文化的重要組成部分。

english: It might well be that the kuo-toa's former masters—the mind flayers—used them as ferry pilots and navigators in the Underdark, and the fish-folk continue to do so out of habit or some deep-seated need. Certainly, their relative usefulness to the other races of the Underdark has served the kuo-toa well. Only the duergar have shown any interest in navigating the waters of the Darklake on their own, and not even they do it as well as the kuo-toa.
zh_tw: 很可能寇濤魚人的前主人——靈吸怪——在幽暗地域中使用他們作為擺渡飛行員和導航員，而魚人出於習慣或某種根深蒂固的需求繼續這樣做。當然，他們對幽暗地域其他種族的相對有用性對寇濤魚人來說很有幫助。只有灰矮人表現出了獨自航行黑暗湖水域的興趣，甚至他們也沒有寇濤魚人做得好。

english: There is a persistent myth among the inhabitants of Sloobludop that the maze of tunnels, passages, and pools of the Darklake is a kind of meditation—a spiritual journey. Kuo-toa who navigate that maze long enough will awaken to a great revelation for their people. As with many of the strange beliefs of the kuo-toa, this one might only need time to become a reality.
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普的居民中流傳著一個持久的神話，認為黑暗湖的隧道、通道和水池的迷宮是一種冥想——一種精神之旅。長時間在那個迷宮中航行的寇濤魚人將為他們的人民覺醒到一個偉大的啟示。就像寇濤魚人的許多奇怪信仰一樣，這一個可能只需要時間就能成為現實。

english: Map 3.1: Sloobludop
zh_tw: 地圖 3.1: 斯盧布多普

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Gate
zh_tw: 1. 大門

english: Sloobludop is enclosed to the north and south by outer "walls" of heavy netting with sharp bone hooks woven into them. In the middle of each wall is a gate through which creatures can safely pass. Any creature wishing to crawl through the netting can do so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. On a failure, the creature takes {@dice 1d8} piercing damage and becomes {@condition restrained} in the netting, requiring a successful {@dc 12} Strength check as an action to break free.
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普的南北兩側被厚重的網牆所包圍，網牆上編織著鋒利的骨鉤。每面牆的中間都有一道門，生物可以安全透過。任何想要穿過網牆的生物可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定來做到。如果失敗，該生物受到 {@dice 1d8} 穿刺傷害，並在網牆中被 {@condition restrained||束縛}，需要透過一個成功的 {@dc 12} 力量檢定作為一個動作來掙脫。

english: Stationed outside each gate are four {@creature Kuo-toa Whip||kuo-toa whips}. They confront anyone who approaches. Party members escorted by other kuo-toa can pass through the gate unchallenged. If the characters are unescorted, any kuo-toa they meet attempt to capture them. Roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1–7, captives are taken to area 3. On an 8–18, captives are taken to area 4. On a 19–20, the guards are evenly split and immediately begin to brawl for the right to take the characters as prisoners.
zh_tw: 每個大門外面都駐守著四名{@creature Kuo-toa Whip||寇濤驅策者}。他們對任何接近的人進行質問。如果隊伍成員由其他寇濤魚人陪同，他們可以不受挑戰地透過大門。如果角色們沒有陪同，他們遇到的任何寇濤魚人都會試圖捕獲他們。投擲一個{@dice d20}。如果是1-7，俘虜被帶到區域3。如果是8-18，俘虜被帶到區域4。如果是19-20，守衛們平均分成兩半，並立即開始爭鬥，爭奪將角色作為俘虜的權利。

english: 2. Docks
zh_tw: 2. 碼頭

english: A half-dozen kuo-toan keelboats are moored here. Although kuo-toa will negotiate terms for ferrying the characters across the Darklake, none leave without permission (see below). Party members can attempt to steal one or more of the boats, but doing so requires a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check (and the kuo-toa are able to sense {@condition invisible} creatures). The kuo-toa pursue any stolen boats, intending to capture the thieves as offerings to appease their gods.
zh_tw: 六艘寇濤魚人的龍骨船停泊在此。雖然寇濤魚人會與角色們商議渡過黑暗湖的條件，但未經允許，沒有船會離開（見下文）。隊伍成員可以嘗試偷取一艘或多艘船，但這需要成功的 {@dc 16} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定（且寇濤魚人能感知到 {@condition invisible||隱形} 的生物）。寇濤魚人會追捕任何被盜的船隻，意圖抓住竊賊作為獻祭以安撫他們的神明。

english: Five groups of three {@creature Kuo-toa Monitor||kuo-toa monitors} led by a {@creature kuo-toa whip} patrol the platforms at the water's edge. They ensure no vessel enters or leaves without submitting to "auguries" to determine if a crew's actions are pleasing to the god of the hour—in this case, the Deep Father.
zh_tw: 由一隻{@creature kuo-toa whip||寇濤驅策者}領導的五個小組，每組三隻{@creature Kuo-toa Monitor||寇濤監察者}在水邊的平臺巡邏。他們確保沒有船隻未經"占卜"就進入或離開，以確定船員的行為是否取悅了當前小時的神——在這種情況下，是深父。

english: The auguries consist of a half-hour ritual, during which the whip casts bones, shells, and other tokens and reads the resulting omens. Roll a {@dice d20}. On 1–8, the whip finds the omens favorable; on 9–18, he finds them unfavorable; and on 19–20, the auguries are unclear, and the whip feels the need to consult the archpriest of the Deep Father (area 4).
zh_tw: 占卜包括半小時的儀式，在這期間鞭子投擲骨頭、貝殼和其他標記物，並解讀結果的預兆。擲一個 {@dice d20}。如果是 1-8，鞭子發現預兆是有利的；如果是 9-18，他發現它們是不利的；如果是 19-20，占卜結果不明確，鞭子感到需要諮詢深海之父（區域 4）的大祭司。

english: If the characters met or spoke with the archpriest of the Deep Father before coming here, the whip automatically refuses their request to leave.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在來到這裡之前已經見過或與深父的大祭司交談過，鞭手會自動拒絕他們離開的請求。

english: 3. Shrine of the Sea Mother
zh_tw: 3. 海洋之母神殿

english: When the characters arrive here, on their own or escorted, read the following to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們獨自或被護送到達這裡時，請向玩家們閱讀以下內容：

english: A nine-foot-tall statue stands here. Its body is roughly carved from some kind of wood in the shape of a humanoid female, its head and forearms formed from the severed head and claws of a giant albino crayfish. These parts are lashed on with strands of gut, and emit an overpowering stench of rotting shellfish. Shells, brightly colored stones, mushrooms, and rotting fish are piled at the statue's feet and strung in garlands around its neck. Four stern kuo-toa slowly circle the statue, alert and on guard, while a few others mill about, gazing up at the statue and bowing repeatedly while chanting.
zh_tw: 一個九尺高的雕像立在這裡。它的身體由某種木材粗略雕刻成類人女性的形狀，頭部和前臂由一隻巨大的白化龍蝦的斷頭和爪子組成。這些部分用腸線綁著，散發出強烈的腐爛殼類海鮮的惡臭。貝殼、鮮豔的彩色石頭、蘑菇和腐爛的魚堆積在雕像的腳下，並串成花環掛在它的脖子上。四隻嚴肅的寇濤魚人慢慢地繞著雕像轉圈，保持警惕和守衛，而其他一些則在周圍徘徊，一邊仰望雕像一邊反覆鞠躬並吟唱。

english: All creatures that come here are expected to make an offering to the Great Sea Mother Blibdoolpoolp. A successful {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check recalls that Blibdoolpoolp is a scavenger goddess, meaning that discarded and recovered items are worthy offerings—and the more personal the better. Regurgitating at the goddess's feet is considered a sincere show of faith (and a behavior faithful kuo-toa might display if the characters wait long enough).
zh_tw: 所有來到此處的生物都被期望向大海母親布麗布杜普爾普獻上祭品。成功的 {@dc 13} 智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}) 檢定會讓你想起布麗布杜普爾普是一位拾荒女神，這意味著丟棄和回收的物品都是值得的祭品——越是個人化的越好。在女神的腳下嘔吐被認為是一種真誠的信仰表現（如果你等待時間夠長，忠實的寇濤魚人也會表現出這種行為）。

english: Four {@creature Kuo-toa Monitor||kuo-toa monitors} guard the statue at all times, and there are always {@dice 2d4} {@creature kuo-toa} worshipers around it offering prayers. Currently the shrine is tended by Glooglugogg, a {@creature kuo-toa whip} and son of Ploopploopeen, the archpriest of the Sea Mother. The guards are wary of anyone, including other kuo-toa, due to recent tensions.
zh_tw: 四名{@creature Kuo-toa Monitor||寇濤監察者}時刻守衛著雕像，周圍總是有{@dice 2d4}名{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}信徒在向它祈禱。目前，神龕由格魯格魯戈照料，他是{@creature kuo-toa whip||寇濤驅策者}，也是海洋之母的大祭司普魯普魯平的兒子。由於最近的緊張局勢，守衛們對任何人都保持警惕，包括其他寇濤魚人。

english: Ploopploopeen claims a small hovel adjacent to the shrine, where he is attended by four {@creature kuo-toa}. This is where he brings the characters if they are his "guests."
zh_tw: 普魯普魯平聲稱擁有一個緊鄰神殿的小棚屋，由四名{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}侍候。如果角色們是他的"客人"，他會帶他們到這裡。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The home of the archpriest contains a closet full of "offerings" taken from less fortunate travelers or culled from the depths of the lake. This includes 500 cp, 2,000 sp, 150 gp, 27 pp, a strand of matched pearls worth 1,000 gp total, two {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}, a {@item potion of water breathing}, and a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell light}.
zh_tw: 大祭司的家中有一個裝滿從不太幸運的旅行者那裡拿走的"供品"的壁櫥，或者是從湖底深處收集的。這包括500枚銅幣，2000枚銀幣，150枚金幣，27枚鉑金幣，一串價值總計1000金幣的匹配珍珠，兩瓶{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}，一瓶{@item potion of water breathing||水下呼吸藥水}，以及一張{@spell light||光亮術}的{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸}。

english: 4. Altar of the Deep Father
zh_tw: 4. 深父祭壇

english: When the characters visit the altar of the Deep Father, read the following to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們參觀深父祭壇時，請向玩家們閱讀以下內容：

english: The idol to Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father consists of a large hide cut roughly in the shape of a manta ray and stretched out on cords between two support poles. A dead, splayed-out manta ray is pinned to the center of the hide. Two dead octopuses are draped across the top, their tentacles pinned and artfully arrayed, their heads tied together and painted with red and blue pigments. The idol reeks of decay, and the broad stone altar below the idol is stained dark with blood.
zh_tw: 利穆格古恩的偶像由一張大皮製成，皮子被粗略地剪成魟魚的形狀，用繩索在兩個支撐杆之間展開。一隻死去的、展開的魟魚被釘在皮子的中心。兩隻死去的章魚橫掛在頂部，它們的觸手被釘住並巧妙地排列，它們的頭部被綁在一起，並用紅色和藍色顏料塗畫。這個偶像散發著腐爛的惡臭，偶像下方寬闊的石祭壇上沾滿了血跡。

english: Six {@creature kuo-toa} work at the altar, cleaning up and arranging offerings. Klibdoloogut, a {@creature kuo-toa whip} dedicated to the Deep Father, stands in front of the altar with two {@creature Kuo-toa Monitor||kuo-toa monitors}. Offerings are usually living creatures killed on the altar, although an offering of one's own blood also satisfies the whip. Humanoids other than kuo-toa are immediately taken into custody to be brought before the archpriest of the Deep Father, who summarily condemns them to be sacrificed.
zh_tw: 六名{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}在祭壇工作，清理並安排供品。克利布多洛古特，一位致力於深父的{@creature kuo-toa whip||寇濤驅策者}，站在祭壇前，旁邊有兩名{@creature Kuo-toa Monitor||寇濤監察者}。供品通常是在祭壇上殺死的生物，儘管獻上自己的血也能讓鞭手滿意。除了寇濤魚人之外的人形生物會立即被拘留，然後帶到深父的大祭司面前，大祭司會立即宣判他們被獻祭。

english: Bloppblippodd, a female {@creature kuo-toa archpriest} of the Deep Father, lives on the bottom floor of a squat hovel near the altar. She is a bloodthirsty sadist absolutely assured that her divine vision will raise her in glory to rule her people. Bound and gagged against the far wall is a duergar prisoner (see "{@area The Offering|12a|x}").
zh_tw: 布洛普布利波德，一位女性{@creature kuo-toa archpriest||寇濤大祭司}，致力於深父，居住在祭壇附近的一座低矮棚屋的底層。她是一個嗜血的虐待狂，絕對確信她的神聖幻象將提升她的榮耀，統治她的人民。在遠處的牆上，一個被捆綁和塞口的灰矮人囚犯（見"{@area 供品|12a|x}"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Bloppblippodd's hovel contains wealth accumulated since her rise to power: 1,000 cp, 500 sp, 290 gp, an embroidered silk handkerchief with a spider design worth 25 gp, three azurite gems worth 10 gp each, a duergar-made bronze cup worth 25 gp, and a silver choker with a spider design worth 30 gp.
zh_tw: 布洛普布利波德的棚屋包含了她掌權以來積累的財富：1000枚銅幣，500枚銀幣，290枚金幣，一條繡有蜘蛛圖案的價值25金幣的繡花絲質手帕，三顆每顆價值10金幣的天青石寶石，一個灰矮人制造的價值25金幣的青銅杯，以及一個價值30金幣的帶有蜘蛛圖案的銀質頸圈。

english: The Offering
zh_tw: 供品

english: If allowed to do so, Ploopploopeen brings the characters to his quarters near the Shrine of the Deep Mother. There they meet Glooglugogg, who loudly tells his father in Undercommon that he sees no need for outsiders to be involved in sacred matters. The archpriest dismisses his son's concerns with a negligent wave, telling Glooglugogg that he must flow with the currents of the goddess's visions. The whip relents but throws the characters a hostile glare.
zh_tw: 如果被允許，普魯普魯平會把角色們帶到他在深母神殿附近的住處。在那裡，他們遇到了格魯格魯戈格，他大聲用下界語告訴他的父親，他認為沒有必要讓外來者參與神聖事務。大祭司用一種漫不經心的手勢駁回了他的兒子的擔憂，告訴格魯格魯戈格他必須順應女神幻象的潮流。鞭手雖然讓步，但對角色們投以敵意的目光。

english: Within the hour, twelve {@creature kuo-toa} led by a {@creature kuo-toa monitor} arrive at Ploopploopeen's quarters. The archpriest of the Sea Mother admits the monitor and informs him that he, his whip, and the prisoners will accompany them to see the archpriest of the Deep Father. They are escorted to the altar of the Deep Father near the docks, where Bloppblippodd awaits them. Describe the scene to the players as given in that area, then read the following boxed text; if none of the characters speak Undercommon, the exchange is gibberish to them, though Shuushar can translate.
zh_tw: 一小時內，由一隻{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}帶領的十二名{@creature kuo-toa monitor||寇濤監察者}抵達普魯普魯平的住處。海洋之母的大祭司接待了監督者，並通知他，他、他的鞭手和囚犯將陪同他們去見深父的大祭司。他們被護送到碼頭附近的深父祭壇，布洛普布利波德正在那裡等候他們。按照那個區域所給的描述，向玩家們描述場景，然後閱讀以下加框文字；如果角色中沒有人說下界語，交流對他們來說是胡言亂語，儘管舒沙爾可以翻譯。

english: The archpriest of the Sea Mother steps forward across the span of the altar toward the kuo-toa waiting for him there. "The time has come," he says, "for us to acknowledge your divine vision and welcome it. I have brought these as offerings." He gestures toward all of you, standing within a circle of guards behind him. "Will you not accept them?" "You are wise, father," the younger archpriest replies. "I accept your offering in the name of the Deep Father. May their blood nourish and strengthen him!" A burbling cheer goes up from the surrounding kuo-toa, their fists raised in the air.
zh_tw: 海洋之母的大祭司跨過祭壇的跨度走向那裡等待他的寇濤魚人。"時機已到，"他說，"讓我們承認你的神視並歡迎它。我帶來了這些作為供品。"他指向你們所有人，站在他身後的守衛圈中。"你不接受他們嗎？""你很明智，父親，"年輕的大祭司回答。"我以深父的名義接受你的供品。願他們的血滋養並強化他！"周圍的寇濤魚人發出冒泡的歡呼聲，他們的拳頭在空中舉起。

english: The followers of the Deep Father are already preparing to sacrifice a bruised and bedraggled {@creature duergar} named Hemeth—an arms smuggler who was looking to cut a deal with one or both factions of the kuo-toa, but instead found himself captured for his trouble. He's willing to cooperate with the characters to save his own skin, and will even return the favor given the opportunity (see chapter 4, "{@adventure Gracklstugh|OotA|3}").
zh_tw: 深父的追隨者們已經在準備犧牲一個受傷且衣衫襤褸的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}名叫赫梅斯——一個武器走私者，他本想與寇濤魚人的其中一個或兩個派系達成交易，但結果卻因為自己的麻煩而被俘。他願意與角色們合作以保全自己的性命，並且如果有機會，他甚至會回報這個人情（見第4章，"{@adventure 格拉克斯圖格|OotA|3}"）。

english: The Ritual
zh_tw: 儀式

english: Kuo-toa parade around the altar in a wide circle as they chant. Part of their path sends them splashing and wading through the shallows of the Darklake. The characters quickly can't tell one faction of fish-folk from the other, but they see the archpriest of the Sea Mother and his whip moving toward the altar.
zh_tw: 寇濤圍繞著祭壇在一個寬闊的圓圈裡遊行，邊走邊吟唱。他們行進的一部分讓他們在黑暗湖的淺水區濺水和涉水。角色們很快就分不清一個派系的魚人和另一個派系的區別，但他們看到海洋之母的大祭司和他的鞭手正朝祭壇移動。

english: Bloppblippodd calls for the sacrifices to be brought forth, and one {@creature kuo-toa} per character jumps to do her bidding. They prod the characters with their spears to herd them toward a slight depression 20 feet from the altar, with a large grate at its center. The characters can see that the stonework of the depression is stained with the blood of innumerable sacrifices, and they can hear the gentle lapping of the Darklake coming up through the grate. The chanting grows louder.
zh_tw: 布洛普布利波德要求將祭品帶上前來，每個角色面前的一名{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}跳出來執行她的命令。他們用長矛戳刺角色，將他們趕到離祭壇20尺遠的一個輕微凹陷處，中心有一個大格柵。角色們可以看到凹陷處的石工作被無數祭品的血染汙，他們還能聽到黑暗湖輕輕拍打的聲音從格柵中傳來。吟唱聲變得更響。

english: When the sacrifices are brought forward, Bloppblippodd gestures toward the altar, whereupon her father suddenly attacks, striking her with his scepter. Kuo-toa loyal to him surge forward to attack, while the guards that brought the characters forward stand in shock. They are {@status surprised} and can't move or take an action on their first turn of the combat, and they can't take reactions until that first turn ends.
zh_tw: 當祭品被帶到前面時，布洛普布利波德向祭壇示意，這時她的父親突然攻擊，用他的權杖擊打她。忠於他的寇濤魚人湧上前來攻擊，而將角色們帶到前面的守衛則處於震驚之中。他們被{@status surprised||突襲}，在戰鬥的第一回合不能移動或採取行動，並且在那第一回合結束之前不能進行反應。

english: As the two {@creature Kuo-toa Archpriest||archpriests} and their followers fight, the characters can intervene on either side or attempt to slip away during the melee.
zh_tw: 當兩位{@creature Kuo-toa Archpriest||大祭司}及其追隨者戰鬥時，角色們可以介入任一方，或者嘗試在混戰中溜走。

english: On round 3 of the fight, characters notice kuo-toa crying out and flailing in the shallows of the Darklake. Several are pulled under or strike at unseen foes beneath the surface. The water foams red with blood.
zh_tw: 在戰鬥的第三回合，角色們注意到寇濤魚人在黑暗湖的淺水區中呼喊並掙扎。一些寇濤魚人被拉到水下或攻擊看不見的敵人。湖水因鮮血而泛起泡沫。

english: Dozens of {@creature ixitxachitl|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) are responsible for the attacks in the water. They have been drawn by the kuo-toa ritual and feast on any creatures they can reach, including party members in the water. The sudden frenzy sets a wave of panic through the kuo-toa. The young archpriest calls out "Leemooggoogoon!" just as her father strikes a final, fatal blow, dropping her before the profane altar. (If any character is also engaging the archpriest of the Deep Father, allow that character to strike the final blow.)
zh_tw: 數十隻{@creature ixitxachitl|OotA|伊希鰩魚}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）是水中攻擊的罪魁禍首。它們被寇濤魚人的儀式吸引過來，並以它們能夠觸及的任何生物為食，包括在水中的隊伍成員。突然的狂亂在寇濤魚人中引發了一陣恐慌。年輕的大祭司在她的父親發出最後的致命一擊時呼喊出"利穆格古恩！"，她在褻瀆的祭壇前倒下。（如果任何角色也在與深父的大祭司交戰，允許那個角色發出最後的一擊。）

english: Demogorgon Rises!
zh_tw: 狄摩高根崛起！

english: Although Bloppblippodd falls, the ritual still achieves a terrible success. Read the following:
zh_tw: 儘管布洛普布利波德倒下了，儀式仍然取得了可怕的成功。閱讀以下內容：

english: Another sound rises above the burbling cries of the kuo-toa. The dark surface of the water farther out bubbles and begins to foam. A thick, oily tentacle bursts forth, followed by another. Then two monstrous heads break the surface, both resembling hideous, angry baboons with wickedly curved tusks. Both heads are attached to a single torso, and the monster's red eyes burn with bloodlust and madness. The creature rising from the Darklake must stand thirty feet tall or more, with water cascading down its back and shoulders. Upon reaching its full height, the great demon throws back both its heads and roars!
zh_tw: 在寇濤魚人的咕噥呼喊聲之上，另一種聲音升起。遠處的黑暗水面開始冒泡並開始起泡。一隻厚實、油膩的觸手突然伸出，接著是另一隻。然後兩個怪物般的頭顱突破水面，都像是醜陋、憤怒的狒狒，長著邪惡彎曲的獠牙。兩個頭顱都附著在單一的軀幹上，這個怪物的紅色眼睛充滿了殺戮欲和瘋狂。從黑暗湖中升起的生物必須有三十尺或更高，水從它的背部和肩膀上傾瀉而下。在達到其全高時，這個巨大的惡魔向後甩動它的兩個頭並咆哮！

english: The kuo-toa offerings and the fervor of his worshipers in the Darklake have drawn the attention of {@creature Demogorgon|MTF} (see {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}). Upon witnessing the rise of the Prince of Demons, each party member must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or gain a level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2). The kuo-toa become {@condition incapacitated} for {@dice 1d10} minutes, crying out "Leemooggoogoon!" over and over again.
zh_tw: 黑暗湖中的魚人祭品及其信徒的狂熱吸引了{@creature Demogorgon|MTF|狄摩高根}的注意（參見{@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20}）。目睹狄摩高根的崛起後，每個隊伍成員必須透過一次{@dc 13}的魅力豁免檢定，否則將獲得一級瘋狂（參見第2章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。魚人會{@condition incapacitated||無力}長達{@dice 1d10}分鐘，並不斷地大喊"利穆格古恩！"

english: Demogorgon wades toward Sloobludop, heads roaring and gibbering, tentacles flailing and smashing the water. In 4 rounds, he comes within reach of the shoreline and lashes out, smashing docks and sending bodies flying with each sweep of his tentacles. When the demon lord attacks, some kuo-toa recover their wits enough to flee, while others cower, {@condition paralyzed} with fear.
zh_tw: 狄摩高根涉水向斯盧布多普前進，頭部咆哮和尖叫，觸手揮舞並砸向水面。在4回合內，他接近了岸邊並伸出攻擊，破壞碼頭並用觸手的每次揮動將身體拋飛。當惡魔領主攻擊時，一些寇濤魚人恢復了足夠的理智以逃跑，而其他則畏縮不前，因恐懼而{@condition paralyzed||麻痺}。

english: Escaping the Demon Lord
zh_tw: 逃離惡魔領主

english: Hopefully, the players exercise the better part of valor and flee as soon as they see the demon lord. If they confront him, they are almost certainly doomed. Fortunately for them, Demogorgon is focused on smashing the kuo-toa settlement and pays little heed to the puny creatures fleeing from him. The characters thus have a good chance of getting away if they act quickly. They might first need to deal with companions overcome by bouts of madness, however, and they need to decide how they intend to escape.
zh_tw: 希望玩家們能夠明智地選擇逃跑，一旦看到惡魔領主就立即行動。如果他們選擇對抗他，幾乎肯定註定要失敗。幸運的是，狄摩高根專注於摧毀寇濤魚人的定居點，對那些從他身邊逃跑的微不足道的生物幾乎沒有注意。因此，如果角色們行動迅速，他們有很好的逃離線會。然而，他們可能首先需要處理那些因瘋狂發作而無法自控的同伴，並且他們需要決定他們打算如何逃脫。

english: Escape by Land
zh_tw: 陸地逃脫

english: Fleeing by land requires dodging terrified kuo-toa, and even fighting fish-folk driven to a killing frenzy against the characters for having drawn this doom down upon them. Roll a {@dice d20}. On a 17–20, {@dice 2d4} {@creature kuo-toa} attack the characters during their escape.
zh_tw: 透過陸地逃跑需要躲避驚恐的寇濤魚人人，甚至還要與被逼入殺戮狂暴狀態的魚人戰鬥，因為角色們吸引了這場災難。擲一個{@dice d20}。如果擲出17到20，{@dice 2d4} {@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}在角色們逃跑時攻擊他們。

english: Escape by Water
zh_tw: 水上逃脫

english: The adventurers can steal boats from the docks and paddle them along the shore away from the attacking demon lord. The {@creature ixitxachitl|OotA} attack anyone in the water, but most are occupied with slaughtering kuo-toa fleeing into the Darklake. A near miss from one of Demogorgon's tentacles might require each character to make a {@dc 10} Strength or Dexterity saving throw (player's choice), with failure indicating that the character has been thrown overboard by a wave.
zh_tw: 冒險者們可以從碼頭偷船，沿著海岸划船遠離正在攻擊的惡魔領主。{@creature ixitxachitl|OotA|伊希鰩魚} 會攻擊水中的任何人，但大多數都忙於屠殺逃入黑暗湖的寇濤魚人。狄摩高根的一隻觸手差點選中船隻，可能要求每個角色進行一次{@dc 10}力量或敏捷豁免檢定（玩家選擇），失敗意味著角色被大浪掀翻落水。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: The adventurers end this chapter with a terrible realization: Demogorgon is loose in the Underdark! Initially, they might blame the kuo-toa ritual or the ixitxachitl. But as they learn more about what has happened, the need to escape the Underdark becomes even more urgent.
zh_tw: 冒險者們在這一章節結束時意識到了一個可怕的事實：狄摩高根在幽暗地域中自由行動！起初，他們可能會責怪寇濤魚人的儀式或伊克西塔克裡。但隨著他們對發生的事情瞭解更多，逃離幽暗地域的需求變得更加迫切。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: In addition to the XP awards earned for the creatures the party overcomes in this chapter, the characters earn 400 XP (divided equally among all party members) for surviving the encounter with the Cult of the Deep Father and their brush with the Prince of Demons.
zh_tw: 除了因為克服本章中的生物而獲得的XP獎勵外，角色們因在與深父邪教的遭遇以及與惡魔王子的擦肩而過中倖存下來，獲得了400 XP（平均分配給所有隊伍成員）。

english: Chapter 4: Gracklstugh
zh_tw: 第4章：格拉克斯圖格

english: Visitors to the duergar city of Gracklstugh are greeted by its hot and acrid air, followed by the angry red glare of the eternally burning smelters fueling the city's metal works, its clanging heart, and the forges kept alive by the flames of {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}, the red dragon that holds the title of Wyrmsmith. Gracklstugh toils endlessly, its smiths churning out the best armor and weapons among the Underdark races. Those who do business here refer to Gracklstugh as "the City of Blades."
zh_tw: 來到灰矮人城市格拉克斯圖格的遊客首先會感受到這裡熾熱而刺鼻的空氣，接著是永遠燃燒的熔爐所散發出的憤怒紅焰，這些熔爐為城市的金屬加工提供動力，是其喧囂的心臟，而被{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的火焰所維持的熔爐更是永不停歇，這位紅龍冠有龍匠的頭銜。格拉克斯圖格無休止地勞作，其鐵匠們生產出了幽暗地域種族中最好的盔甲和武器。在這裡做生意的商人們習慣稱格拉克斯圖格為"刀鋒之城"。

english: As merciless as it can be, Gracklstugh is a major bastion of civilization in the Underdark with active trade routes. For the characters, this means a potential chance to find a way back to the surface world—and just as importantly, to shake off the drow that pursue them. However, the adventurers will quickly realize that the power of the demon lords is a threat even here, getting an even closer glimpse of the Underdark's decay as the madness of the Abyss continues to spread.
zh_tw: 儘管格拉克斯圖格可能無情，但它是幽暗地域中文明的主要堡壘，擁有活躍的貿易路線。對於角色們來說，這意味著有潛在的機會找到回到地表世界的道路——同樣重要的是，擺脫追捕他們的卓爾。然而，冒險者們很快就會意識到，惡魔領主的力量即使在這裡也是一個威脅，隨著無底深淵的瘋狂繼續蔓延，他們將更加近距離地目睹幽暗地域的衰敗。

english: Built within the walls of a deep cavern southwest of the Darklake, Gracklstugh is the commercial, political, and spiritual center of the duergar, all of whom look to the Deepking with respect. The city has an open shore along the Darklake, while several caverns and passages connect Gracklstugh to other parts of the Underdark to facilitate travel and trade.
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格建在黑暗湖西南的一個深邃洞穴的牆壁之內，是灰矮人人的商業、政治和精神中心，所有人都尊敬深王。這座城市沿著黑暗湖有一個開放的海岸，同時還有數個洞穴和通道將格拉克斯圖格與幽暗地域的其他部分連線起來，以便於旅行和貿易。

english: The characters have a chance to witness and shape events in the city that point toward the danger Gracklstugh faces—and how unprepared the city is for it. But with each moment the characters spend in the City of Blades, they run the risk of having escaped the drow only to be enslaved by the duergar.
zh_tw: 角色們有機會目睹並影響這座城市的事件，這些事件指向格拉克斯圖格面臨的危險——以及這座城市對此的準備不足。但是，角色們在刃之城度過的每一刻，他們都冒著剛逃離卓爾卻又被灰矮人人奴役的風險。

english: Going to Gracklstugh
zh_tw: 前往格拉克斯圖格

english: Despite its dangers, Gracklstugh does have a few things to offer... or at least that's what some of the characters' fellow escapees tell them.
zh_tw: 儘管有危險，格拉克斯圖格確實有一些可以提供的東西......至少這是一些角色的同伴逃亡者告訴他們的。

english: {@creature Buppido|OotA} (see {@area chapter 1|008|x}) and Hemeth (see {@area chapter 3|12a|x}) are the only NPCs who actively suggest going to Gracklstugh. They know that duergar have no love for the drow, and their draconian laws keep all foreigners in check, which should provide some measure of sanctuary from drow pursuit. Gracklstugh is as good a place as any in the Underdark to sell stolen gear and buy more useful equipment. Additionally, the duergar trade actively with other subterranean and surface-dwelling races. Gracklstugh's Blade Bazaar might be the ideal place to find traders or explorers heading to the surface world.
zh_tw: {@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}（見{@area 第一章|008|x}）和赫梅斯（見{@area 第三章|12a|x}）是唯一積極建議前往格拉克斯圖格的NPC。他們知道灰矮人人對卓爾沒有好感，他們嚴格的法律能夠控制所有外國人，這應該能夠提供一定程度的庇護，以避免卓爾的追擊。在幽暗地域中，格拉克斯圖格是一個出售贓物和購買更有用裝備的好地方。此外，灰矮人人還積極與其他地下和地表種族進行貿易。格拉克斯圖格的刀刃市集可能是尋找前往地表世界的商人或探險家的理想之地。

english: If {@creature Buppido|OotA} or Hemeth isn't with the party, others can provide the above information. Sarith resists plans to travel to the city at first, conscious of the low regard the duergar have for drow. He changes his mind quickly, however, as Zuggtmoy's spores drive him to seek a densely populated area where he can spread his contagion.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}或赫梅斯不在隊伍中，其他人可以提供上述資訊。薩里斯最初反對前往這座城市的計劃，意識到灰矮人人對卓爾評價不高。然而，隨著祖格莫伊的孢子驅使他尋找一個人口密集的地區來傳播他的瘟疫，他很快就改變了主意。

english: It's also possible the party arrives at Gracklstugh involuntarily. Duergar slavers scour the Underdark in search of new "merchandise," and they might deceive or outright capture the characters and bring them to their city's slave markets. The random encounters in chapters 2 and 3 can easily set up this scenario.
zh_tw: 也有可能，隊伍是在非自願的情況下到達格拉克斯圖格的。灰矮人奴隸販子在幽暗地域搜尋新的"商品"，他們可能會欺騙或直接捕獲角色們，並將他們帶到自己城市的奴隸市場。第2章和第3章中的隨機遭遇很容易設定出這種情況。

english: Gracklstugh and Drow Pursuit
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格與卓爾追擊

english: Taking refuge in Gracklstugh has its advantages. Each day they spend in the duergar capital, the characters can attempt a {@dc 16} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to move around cautiously, with success indicating that they avoid drawing attention to themselves. The characters can also attempt a {@dc 13} group Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check to assess the mood in the city, with success allowing them to avoid trouble before it starts. Characters who lie low for the day have advantage on this Wisdom check.
zh_tw: 在格拉克斯圖格避難有其優勢。每當角色們在灰矮人的首都度過一天，他們可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 16}團隊敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，以謹慎地四處移動，成功則意味著他們沒有引起注意。角色們還可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 13}團隊感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定，以評估城市的情緒，成功則可以在麻煩開始之前避免它們。當天低調行事的角色在進行這次感知檢定時具有優勢。

english: Success with either check reduces the party's pursuit level by 1 (see "{@area Drow Pursuit|078|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 任何一項檢查成功都可以使隊伍的追擊等級降低1（見第2章中的"{@area 卓爾追擊|078|x}"）。

english: Arriving in Gracklstugh
zh_tw: 到達格拉克斯圖格

english: The Darklake District is a likely entry point to the city for the characters, whether they arrive via the water or travel one of the many tunnels leading to the district's gates. Non-duergar arriving from tunnels that lead to other districts are stopped and escorted to the Darklake District under heavy guard, as every other district is normally off limits to outsiders, and trespassers risk being confronted by an {@condition invisible} patrol of four duergar.
zh_tw: 黑暗湖區是角色們進入城市的可能入口，無論是透過水路到達還是穿過通往該區大門的眾多隧道之一。透過隧道從其他區域到達的非灰矮人人會被截停並由重兵護送到黑暗湖區，因為其他每個區域通常對外人是禁止的，闖入者有被一隊{@condition invisible||隱形}的四名灰矮人巡邏隊對峙的風險。

english: The party's fellow escapees know that trying to enter through the main entrances is a sure way to get enslaved, unless one of the characters is an epic liar who can convince the guards the party is a legitimate diplomatic or trade delegation. Anyone with a merchant or criminal background has heard rumors that the Zhentarim trade in the Underdark, but posing as Zhentarim has its own risks, as such claims are bound to be questioned. A character who is actually a member of the Zhentarim can buy the adventurers a couple of days inside the city before the duergar slavers start taking their measure.
zh_tw: 同伴逃亡者知道，試圖透過主要入口進入是被奴役的可靠途徑，除非隊伍中的某個角色是一個史詩級的騙子，能夠說服守衛隊伍是一個合法的外交或貿易代表團。任何具有商人或犯罪背景的人都聽說過渣爾塔利姆（散塔林會）在幽暗地域進行貿易的傳言，但冒充渣爾塔利姆也有其自身的風險，因為這樣的主張肯定會受到質疑。如果隊伍中真的有渣爾塔利姆的成員，可以在城市裡為冒險者們爭取幾天的時間，然後灰矮人奴隸販子就會開始對他們進行評估。

english: Arriving by way of the Darklake Docks is easier and more discreet. If the characters are traveling by boat, {@creature Buppido|OotA} can guide them to a deserted pier where they can dock quietly. He warns them that they have to keep a low profile and head directly to the only inn in the city devoted to outsiders. The Ghohlbrorn's Lair is frequented by merchants, mercenaries, and other foreigners who can offer information about traveling elsewhere in the Underdark—or perhaps even to the surface world.
zh_tw: 透過黑暗湖碼頭到達更為容易且隱蔽。如果角色們乘船旅行，{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}可以引導他們到一個人跡罕至的碼頭，在那裡他們可以安靜地停靠。他警告他們必須保持低調，直接前往城市中唯一一家致力於接待外來者的旅店。戈爾布隆巢穴（戈霍爾伯恩的巢穴）是商人、僱傭兵以及其他外國人經常光顧的地方，他們可以提供關於在幽暗地域其他地方旅行的資訊——或者甚至是前往地表世界的資訊。

english: Gracklstugh: General Features
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格: 總體特徵

english: Sweltering heat and cloying smoke cling to every corner of the duergar city, spewing from smelters housed inside massive stalagmites and stalactites. These protrude from the cavern's floor and ceiling like the teeth of some great maw.
zh_tw: 令人窒息的高溫和令人作嘔的煙霧瀰漫在灰矮人城市的每個角落，從巨大的石筍和石柱內的大型冶煉爐中噴湧而出。這些石筍和石柱從洞穴的地面和天花板突出，就像某種巨大嘴巴的牙齒。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Gracklstugh's glowing forges and smithies operate continuously. Most of the city is dimly lit by a hellish red glow, with patches of darkness here and there.
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格的鍛造爐和鐵匠鋪持續發光。這座城市大部分地方都被地獄般的紅色光芒微弱地照亮，這裡那裡有些黑暗的區域。

english: Noise
zh_tw: 響聲

english: The clanging and clacking of hammers and machinery echoes constantly throughout the city. Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to listen in Gracklstugh have disadvantage.
zh_tw: 鐵錘和機械的叮噹聲和咔嗒聲在城市中不斷迴響。在格拉克斯圖格進行的聆聽（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢查具有劣勢。

english: Smoke and Haze
zh_tw: 煙霧和霾

english: Despite vents dug into the walls and ceiling of the city's great cavern, fumes from smelters and forges linger at ground level (as does the gas tapped in Laduguer's Furrow). Visitors might contract the illness known as grackle-lung (see the Grackle-lung sidebar).
zh_tw: 儘管在城市的巨大洞穴的牆壁和天花板上挖有通風口，但冶煉爐和鍛造爐產生的煙霧仍然在地面層徘徊（就像拉杜格溝壑中抽取的氣體一樣）。訪客可能會患上被稱為鴉肺病的疾病（見鴉肺病側邊欄）。

english: Random Encounters
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇

english: With routine patrols of heavily armed gray dwarves who can turn {@condition invisible}, Gracklstugh is a relatively safe place for those who know where they belong and stay there. However, tensions are rising because of the influence of Demogorgon, and the characters have many opportunities to participate in events unfolding in the city. At the end of each long rest, roll a {@dice d20}; on a roll of 17–20, an encounter takes place. Roll another {@dice d20} and consult the Random Encounters in Gracklstugh table; if the characters are outside the Darklake District, treat any entry marked with an asterisk as a "Duergar Patrol" encounter instead.
zh_tw: 由於有全副武裝的灰色灰矮人進行常規巡邏，並且他們能夠變得{@condition invisible||隱形}，對於那些知道自己屬於哪裡並留在那裡的人來說，格拉克斯圖格是一個相對安全的地方。然而，由於狄摩高根的影響，緊張局勢正在升級，角色們有很多機會參與城市中正在展開的事件。在每次長休結束時，擲一個{@dice d20}；如果擲出17-20，就會發生一次遭遇。再擲一個{@dice d20}，並參照格拉克斯圖格的隨機遭遇表；如果角色們不在黑暗湖區域，將任何帶有星號的條目視為"灰矮人巡邏隊"遭遇。

english: Abusive Duergar Guards
zh_tw: 虐待狂灰矮人守衛

english: The characters come upon two {@creature duergar} guards beating a duergar merchant and shouting accusations of heresy. Any Underdark native accompanying the party urges the characters not to intervene on the merchant's behalf, telling them this isn't their business and warning them that any interference might get them arrested or killed. Bystanders look a little surprised or concerned but don't intervene, not even to aid the {@condition unconscious} merchant once the guards leave.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到兩名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}守衛正在毆打一名杜爾加商人，並大聲指控他異端邪說。任何隨行的幽暗地域本地人都會勸告角色不要為商人介入，告訴他們這不關他們的事，並警告他們任何干涉都可能導致他們被捕或被殺害。旁觀者看起來有些驚訝或擔憂，但他們也沒有介入，甚至在守衛離開後也沒有幫助那名{@condition unconscious||昏迷}的商人。

english: If the characters investigate the circumstances leading to the assault, bystanders tell them that one of the guards noticed a golden pin the merchant was wearing inside his collar. Though adornment for adornment's sake is something duergar society frowns upon, the guards' violent response was unnatural—a hint of the growing madness festering inside the City of Blades.
zh_tw: 如果角色們調查導致襲擊的情況，旁觀者告訴他們其中一名守衛注意到商人衣領內側佩戴的一枚金色別針。儘管灰矮人社會不贊成無謂的裝飾，但守衛的暴力反應是不正常的——這是刀鋒之城內部日益增長的瘋狂跡象。

english: Deep Gnome Merchant
zh_tw: 地底侏儒商人

english: A female {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} named Ariana and her {@creature earth elemental} bodyguard approach the party. Ariana aims to deliver a cargo of gemstones, but she can't find the duergar merchant she's supposed to meet. She assumes the characters are smugglers and tries to unload her goods: ten sparkly garnets worth 100 gp each. Ariana keeps the gems in a {@item bag of holding}, which isn't for sale.
zh_tw: 一位名叫阿麗娜的女性{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}和她的{@creature earth elemental||土元素}保鏢接近了隊伍。阿麗娜打算運送一批寶石，但找不到她本應該遇到的灰矮人商人。她認為角色們是走私者，並試圖卸下她的貨物：十顆閃閃發光的石榴石，每顆價值100金幣。阿麗娜將寶石存放在一個{@item bag of holding||次元袋}中，這個袋子並不出售。

english: The merchant whom Ariana is looking for was recently arrested and executed for selling stolen jewelry. You can decide whether Ariana's interest in the characters attracts the attention of a duergar patrol.
zh_tw: 阿麗亞娜正在尋找的商人最近因出售被盜珠寶而被逮捕並處決。你可以決定阿麗亞娜對角色們的興趣是否吸引了灰矮人巡邏隊的注意。

english: Subsequent occurrences of this encounter are with other deep gnome merchants who ignore the characters unless approached. They carry nothing of value.
zh_tw: 這次遭遇之後，角色們會遇到其他的地底侏儒商人，除非被接近，否則他們會忽略角色們。他們身上沒有攜帶任何有價值的東西。

english: Derro Rioters
zh_tw: 迪洛矮人狂暴者

english: A mob of {@creature derro|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) rampages through the streets. Five of them detach from the mob to attack the characters. Four duergar patrols (see "Duergar Patrol") arrive when the characters kill the last derro, but they simply nod at the characters before repressing the rest of the mob. Word quickly spreads that the characters helped the city guard control the unruly derro scum. At your discretion, give the characters advantage on checks made to interact with any duergar in the city until such time as the benefit no longer seems appropriate.
zh_tw: 一群{@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）在街道上橫衝直撞。其中五個脫離群體攻擊角色。當角色殺死最後一個迪洛矮人時，四支灰矮人巡邏隊（見"灰矮人巡邏隊"）到達，但他們只是向角色點頭示意後鎮壓了剩餘的暴徒。訊息迅速傳開，稱角色協助城市警衛控制了不守規矩的迪洛矮人渣滓。根據你的判斷，在與城市中任何灰矮人互動時給予角色優勢，直到這種增益不再適用為止。

english: Drow Emissary
zh_tw: 卓爾使者

english: A {@creature drow} proudly wearing the insignia of a drow house travels with an entourage of {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature quaggoth} slaves. The drow is in Gracklstugh to retrieve a cargo of duergar metalwork and knows nothing about the recent events in Velkynvelve. Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the Drow House Loyalty table to determine the house to which the drow is affiliated.
zh_tw: 一個穿著卓爾家族徽章的{@creature drow||卓爾}自豪地旅行，帶著一隊{@dice 1d4 + 1}個{@creature quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}奴隸隨行。這個卓爾在格拉克斯圖格是為了取回一批灰矮人金屬工藝品，並且對維爾京維爾夫最近發生的事件一無所知。擲一個{@dice d6}並查閱卓爾家族忠誠度表，以確定卓爾所屬的家族。

english: Drow House Loyalty
zh_tw: 卓爾家族忠誠

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: House
zh_tw: 家族

english: House Baenre
zh_tw: 班瑞家族

english: House Faen Tlabbar
zh_tw: 費恩·特拉巴爾家族

english: House Xorlarrin
zh_tw: 索拉林家族

english: House Faen Tlabbar and House Mizzrym are bitter rivals. If the drow emissary belongs to House Faen Tlabbar and the characters divulge that they are enemies or former prisoners of House Mizzrym, the drow warns the party about Xalith (see "{@area Signs of Pursuit|184|x}" later in the chapter).
zh_tw: 費恩·特拉巴爾家族和米茲瑞姆家族是死敵。如果卓爾使者屬於費恩·特拉巴爾家族，而角色透露他們是米茲瑞姆家族的敵人或前囚徒，卓爾使者會警告隊伍關於札莉絲的事（參見本章後面的"{@area 追擊的跡象|184|x}"）。

english: House Baenre and House Xorlarrin are current allies of House Mizzrym. A drow emissary allied with House Mizzrym who knows that the characters are escaped prisoners from Velkynvelve seeks out Xalith and warns her that the characters are in Gracklstugh.
zh_tw: 班瑞家族和索拉林家族是米茲瑞姆家族的當前盟友。一個與米茲瑞姆家族結盟的卓爾使者，如果知道角色們是從維爾京維爾夫逃脫的囚犯，會尋找札莉絲並警告她角色們在格拉克斯圖格。

english: Roleplaying the Duergar and Derro
zh_tw: 扮演灰矮人和迪洛矮人

english: The gray dwarves are dour, joyless, and all business. They live by a simple but exacting code of law, honor, hard work, and seeing all non-duergar as lesser creatures. Duergar are ruthless but not unnecessarily cruel, and pragmatism drives their every decision. Though they treat the adventurers with contempt, their first thought is to enslave them or use them rather than kill them.
zh_tw: 灰矮人嚴肅、沒有樂趣，只關心生意。他們遵循一套簡單但嚴格的法律、榮譽、辛勤工作，並視所有非灰矮人為低等生物。灰矮人無情但不無端殘忍，實用主義驅使他們做出每一個決定。儘管他們對冒險者表示輕蔑，但他們首先考慮的是奴役他們或利用他們，而不是殺死他們。

english: The duergar of Gracklstugh are beginning to suffer the effects of the arrival of the demon lords—and specifically the influence of Demogorgon. Many are developing tics, habits, and behaviors that fly against their core beliefs, including guards flaunting their corrupt behavior, the use of adornment for adornment's sake, and disloyalty to their clans. Of late, the folk of Gracklstugh have become increasingly more violent, abandoning their characteristic cunning and stoic pragmatism for wanton malice and petty displays of self-entitlement.
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格的灰矮人開始遭受惡魔領主到來的影響——特別是狄摩高根的影響。許多人開始表現出與他們核心信仰相悖的抽搐、習慣和行為，包括守衛們公然展示他們的腐敗行為，為了裝飾而裝飾，以及對家族的不忠。最近，格拉克斯圖格的居民變得越來越暴力，放棄了他們特有的狡猾和冷靜的實用主義，轉而表現出無端的惡意和瑣碎的自我權利展示。

english: Unlike the disciplined duergar, the derro are sloppy, erratic, and utterly insane. Their temperament is fickle, and their speech hard to follow. The one guaranteed emotion they have when interacting with others is seething hatred, and they make no effort to hide it. Their eyes are shifty, their teeth grind, and they look as though they would rather be somewhere else. They hate everyone and everything, but surface-dwellers are particular targets of their loathing.
zh_tw: 與紀律嚴明的灰矮人不同，迪洛矮人人邋遢、多變，並且完全瘋狂。他們的情緒變化無常，他們的言語難以理解。他們在與他人互動時唯一可以保證的情感是沸騰的仇恨，並且他們並不試圖隱藏它。他們的眼神遊移不定，牙齒磨得咯咯作響，看起來好像寧願在其他地方。他們憎恨每個人和每件事，但地表居民是他們特別厭惡的目標。

english: Their inherent insanity means that the derro suffer no ill effect from the demon lords' presence, their minds already too volatile and mercurial.
zh_tw: 迪洛矮人人天生的瘋狂意味著他們不會因為惡魔領主的存在而受到任何不良影響，他們的思想已經過於不穩定和多變。

english: Duergar Patrol
zh_tw: 灰矮人巡邏隊

english: A patrol consists of {@dice 1d4 + 2} {@creature duergar}, all but two of whom are {@condition invisible}. {@condition Invisible} duergar can sneak up on a character by making a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check with advantage, contested by the character's passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score.
zh_tw: 一支巡邏隊由 {@dice 1d4 + 2} 名 {@creature duergar||灰矮人} 組成，其中除了兩個外，其餘都是 {@condition Invisible||隱形} 的。{@condition invisible||隱形} 灰矮人可以透過進行帶有優勢的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢查，與角色的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分相對抗，從而悄無聲息地接近一個角色。

english: Mad Duergar
zh_tw: 瘋狂的灰矮人

zh_tw: 角色們遇到了一個患有永久性瘋狂症的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}。擲一個{@dice d10}並查閱瘋狂灰矮人表以確定隊伍遇到了什麼。

zh_tw: 一個掃街者，他糾纏著角色們，指控他們是為卓爾工作的間諜。

english: A cloaked guard who thinks he's {@creature Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V|OotA} drafts the party to help him slay {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}, convinced that the dragon is possessed by a demon lord.
zh_tw: 一個自以為是{@creature Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V|OotA|深王霍加·鋼影五世}的披風守衛徵召隊伍幫他消滅{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}，堅信這條巨龍被惡魔領主附身了。

english: A merchant who accuses the characters of theft and calls out for a duergar patrol to arrest them.
zh_tw: 一個商人指控角色們盜竊，並呼叫灰矮人巡邏隊來逮捕他們。

english: A weaponsmith convinced that one of the characters is a long-lost member of her clan and who insists on giving the party food and shelter.
zh_tw: 一個鐵匠堅信角色中的一位是她失散多年的家族成員，並堅持要為隊伍提供食物和住所。

english: Orc Mercenaries
zh_tw: 獸人僱傭兵

english: These {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Orc||orcs} have come to Gracklstugh as caravan guards, and see the characters as a chance to bully some surface dwellers. The orcs try to goad the characters into striking first, then quickly stand down, knowing that a patrol (see "Duergar Patrol") will arrive {@dice 1d6} rounds after combat starts.
zh_tw: 這些{@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Orc||獸人}來到格拉克斯圖格擔任商隊護衛，並且將角色們視為欺負一些地表居民的機會。獸人試圖挑釁角色們先動手，然後迅速退縮，因為他們知道巡邏隊（見"灰矮人巡邏隊"）會在戰鬥開始後的{@dice 1d6}回合到達。

zh_tw: 奴隸商隊

zh_tw: 這隻{@creature adult red dragon||成年紅龍}正在外出進行例行巡視，保持城市熔爐的火焰燃燒。{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}長期以來一直在留意城中可能為他效力的僱傭兵。如果他發現了這些角色，可能會對他們產生興趣。關於"{@area 瑟姆貝爾喬德的巢穴|1a0|x}"的資訊以及可能與這隻紅龍發生額外遭遇的潛在情況，請參閱該區域。

english: Factions of Gracklstugh
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格的派系

english: The Deepkingdom is a feudal state with the Deepking as the absolute monarch, who passes the crown to descendants or relatives in his Steelshadow clan. Each clan is led by a {@i laird}, who rules over his or her own holdings and directs the clan in dedicating its efforts toward a particular trade or craft. A caste of priests called {@i thuldar} officiate all rituals and record the Deepkingdom's lore. However, ultimate political and religious power is held by the Deepking and the lairds.
zh_tw: 深王國是一個以深王為絕對君主的封建國家，深王將王位傳給他的後代或鋼鐵陰影氏族中的親屬。每個氏族由一位{@i 領主}領導，族長統治自己的領地，並指導氏族專注於特定的貿易或手藝。被稱為{@i 圖爾達}的祭司階層主持所有儀式並記錄深王國的傳說。然而，最終的政治和宗教權力掌握在深王和族長們手中。

english: Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V
zh_tw: 深王霍加·鋼影五世

english: Deepking Horgar V ascended to the throne in 1372 DR. He is a ruthless and canny ruler who engages in secret meetings with all the city's councils and clans to keep their members guessing what he's up to, hands out favors out of the blue, and lets it be known that he'll use any trick to maintain his hold on power. This includes hiring assassins through third parties to take care of potential troublemakers (see "Empty-Scabbard Killers," below). This strategy keeps all the city's factions at each other's throats and out of Horgar's way.
zh_tw: 深王霍加五世在1372年DR（《龍槍紀年》）登基。他是一個無情且精明的統治者，與城市中所有的議會和家族進行秘密會晤，讓他們的成員猜測他的動向，突然給予恩惠，並公開表示他願意使用任何手段來維持權力。這包括透過第三方僱傭刺客來處理潛在的麻煩製造者（見下文的"空劍鞘殺手"）。這一策略使城市中的所有派系相互敵對，遠離霍加的道路。

english: Council of Lairds
zh_tw: 領主議會

english: This advisory body represents the interests of the different clans that have pledged allegiance to the Deepking. The lairds hold council to resolve disputes and discuss future plans. Each clan has its own holdings in Gracklstugh and specializes in a certain craft or service.
zh_tw: 這個諮詢機構代表那些已經向深王宣誓效忠的不同家族的利益。領主們舉行議會來解決爭端和討論未來的計劃。每個家族在格拉克斯圖格都有自己的領地，並專門從事某種特定的工藝或服務。

english: Council of Savants
zh_tw: 智者議會

english: The Council of Savants is a circle of derro savants who enjoy all the privileges and trappings of a governing body while the rest of their people live in squalor. Only the best thirty-six savants are admitted into the council, and succession almost always includes an incumbent member's demise. The savants control members of some duergar clans through magic and guile, and are always looking for ways to expand their influence.
zh_tw: 智者議會是一個由迪洛矮人狂人智者組成的圈子，他們享有所有治理機構的特權和標誌，而他們的人民卻生活在貧困之中。只有最優秀的三十六位智者被允許加入議會，而繼任幾乎總是包括現任成員的死亡。智者們透過魔法和詭計控制著一些灰矮人氏族的成員，並且總是在尋找擴大他們影響力的方法。

english: Secrets of Gracklstugh
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格的秘密

english: Wary outsiders visiting Gracklstugh quickly learn the most important details of life in the city.
zh_tw: 謹慎的外來者訪問格拉克斯圖格時很快就會瞭解到這座城市生活中最重要的細節。

english: Unseen Sentries
zh_tw: 無形哨兵

english: The duergar power of invisibility plays a significant role in their society. The potential presence of unseen spies everywhere enforces honesty among duergar. Slaves rarely, if ever, talk or act against their masters, never knowing who might be watching.
zh_tw: 灰矮人的隱形能力在他們的社會中扮演著重要的角色。無處不在的隱形間諜潛在存在，強制要求灰矮人保持誠實。奴隸很少，如果有的話，會談論或反抗他們的主人，因為他們從不知道誰可能在監視。

english: A City Divided
zh_tw: 分裂之城

english: Not only is the layout of Gracklstugh divided, so are its people. Nearly five hundred years ago, the derro launched a Uniting War against the Deepkingdom, but were swiftly crushed, and the survivors brought back to Gracklstugh in chains. Though their status as slaves was eventually set aside, the derro have always been second-class citizens, living in squalor and scrounging food and resources, even as their leaders on the Council of Savants live in secret opulence.
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格的佈局是分裂的，它的人民也是如此。將近五世紀前，迪洛矮人人發動了一場針對深王國的統一戰爭，但很快就被粉碎了，生還者被帶回格拉克斯圖格，戴著鐐銬。儘管他們作為奴隸的地位最終被擱置，但迪洛矮人人一直是二等公民，生活在骯髒的環境中，勉強維持食物和資源，即使他們在智者議會的領袖們卻秘密地生活在奢華之中。

english: Frugal and Monolithic
zh_tw: 節儉且單一

english: The gray dwarves value efficiency, stoicism, and hard work, and these values are exemplified in their capital. Everything the duergar make or build has a purpose and function; the only aesthetic they value in architecture is imposing vastness, and even that is secondary to a building's structural function. The only ornamentations found in Gracklstugh are iconic representations of rank and function within duergar society, and the only music is the ceaseless rhythmic hammering in the forges. The duergar consider art a frivolous pursuit, and only rarely appreciate or create it.
zh_tw: 灰矮人重視效率、堅忍和辛勤工作，這些價值觀在他們的首都得到了體現。杜爾加爾製造或建造的每件東西都有其目的和功能；在建築中，他們唯一重視的美學是宏偉的廣闊感，即便這在建築的結構功能面前也是次要的。在格拉克斯圖格中，唯一能找到的裝飾是代表杜爾加爾社會中等級和功能的象徵性表示，唯一的音樂是鍛造場中不斷的節奏性敲打聲。杜爾加爾認為藝術是一種輕浮的追求，很少欣賞或創造它。

english: Merchant Council
zh_tw: 商人議會

english: The lairds and merchants who sit at this council make sure that trade and commerce flow smoothly. They employ slave labor to maintain trade routes in the dangerous Underdark, and are always open to hiring explorers to check out leads on potential new routes. Expendable outsiders hired as caravan guards always take point and receive little aid or support from the caravan masters. Despite these unfair assignments, the duergar always live up to their bargains, paying survivors as promised.
zh_tw: 坐在這個議會中的領主和商人確保貿易和商業順暢進行。他們僱傭奴隸勞動力來維護危險的幽暗地域中的貿易路線，並且總是願意僱傭探險家去調查潛在的新路線。作為商隊護衛被僱傭的可消耗的外來者總是擔任先鋒，並且從商隊大師那裡得到很少的援助或支援。儘管這些任務不公平，灰矮人總是履行他們的協議，按承諾向生還者支付報酬。

english: Gracklstugh Military
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格軍事

english: In addition to the clans' regular armies, Gracklstugh trains specialized warriors whose oaths of service always supersede their original loyalties. See {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19} for more information.
zh_tw: 除了各氏族的常規軍隊外，格拉克斯圖格還訓練了專門的戰士，他們的服役誓言總是優先於他們原本的忠誠。更多資訊請參閱{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}。

english: Stone Guard
zh_tw: 石衛

english: This force of five hundred veteran warriors serves the Deepking as bodyguards, elite troops, and secret police.
zh_tw: 這支由五百名經驗豐富的戰士組成的部隊為深王服務，擔任保鏢、精英部隊和秘密警察的角色。

english: Darkhafts
zh_tw: 黑暗使者

english: Members of the Deepking's secret corps of psionic agents, the darkhafts often travel with duergar merchants as overseers and spies.
zh_tw: 深王的秘密靈能特工團隊，暗靈者經常作為監督者和間諜與灰矮人商人一起旅行。

english: Kavalrachni
zh_tw: 卡瓦爾拉奇尼

english: The vicious kavalrachni ride giant tarantulas known as steeders (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}). Most kavalrachni come from Clan Xundom.
zh_tw: 兇惡的卡瓦拉奇尼騎乘著被稱為斯蒂德的巨型狼蛛（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）。大多數卡瓦拉奇尼來自熊多姆氏族。

english: Xarrorn
zh_tw: 扎羅恩

english: These specialists train with deadly flame lances forged in Gracklstugh. Most xarrorn come from Clan Xardelvar.
zh_tw: 這些專家使用在格拉克斯圖格鍛造的致命火焰長矛進行訓練。大多數火矛戰士來自札德爾瓦家族。

english: Despite reports that the darkhafts and the Stone Guards have received about the growing crisis outside the city's walls, hubris and the onset of madness prevents them from mounting any sort of response or campaign, blind to the corruption that festers around them.
zh_tw: 儘管有關城牆外日益增長的危機的報告已經送達黑暗使者和岩石衛隊，但傲慢和瘋狂的開始阻止了他們發起任何形式的回應或行動，他們對周圍蔓延的腐敗視而不見。

english: Grackle-Lung
zh_tw: 格萊克肺

english: The constant smog in Gracklstugh causes grackle-lung in living, breathing creatures, resulting in persistent, wracking coughs and the spewing of thick, black phlegm. Whenever a living, breathing creature finishes a long rest in Gracklstugh, it must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On each failed save, the creature gains one level of {@condition exhaustion} as its airways become increasingly clogged. A creature that reaches level 6 {@condition exhaustion} dies, as normal.
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格的持續煙霧導致生活在其中的生物患上了煙肺病，表現為持續劇烈的咳嗽和咳出濃稠的黑痰。每當一個有生命的呼吸生物在格拉克斯圖格完成一次長休息後，它必須進行一次{@dc 11}體質豁免檢定。每失敗一次豁免，該生物就會因呼吸道逐漸堵塞而獲得一層{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。當生物達到6層{@condition exhaustion||力竭}時，會像平常一樣死亡。

english: A creature with one or more levels of {@condition exhaustion} brought on by grackle-lung must succeed on a Constitution check to take the {@action Dash} action. If the check fails, the action cannot be attempted. If the creature attempts to cast a spell with a verbal component, it must succeed on a Constitution check or be unable to complete the spell, causing the spell to fail with no effect. The DC for each check is 10 + the creature's current {@condition exhaustion} level.
zh_tw: 由於鴉肺病引起的1級或多級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}的生物必須透過一次體質檢定才能採取{@action Dash||疾走}行動。如果檢定失敗，則無法嘗試該行動。如果生物試圖施放需要口頭成分的法術，它必須透過一次體質檢定，否則無法完成法術，導致法術失敗且無效果。每次檢定的難度等級為10加上生物當前的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級。

english: If a creature's {@condition exhaustion} level drops below 1, it no longer suffers the effects of grackle-lung and becomes immune to it for the next week. Duergar and derro are inured to grackle-lung, making Constitution checks against it with advantage. Any spell or effect that cures disease also cures grackle-lung, effectively removing all levels of {@condition exhaustion} brought on by the affliction.
zh_tw: 如果一個生物的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級降到1以下，它就不再受格拉克肺病的影響，並在接下來的一週內對其免疫。灰矮人和迪洛矮人對格拉克肺病有抵抗力，對其進行體質檢查時具有優勢。任何治癒疾病的法術或效果也能治癒格拉克肺病，有效地移除由該疾病引起的所有{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級。

english: Clan Cairngorm
zh_tw: 凱恩戈姆氏族

english: The stone giants of Clan Cairngorm lead quiet lives of art and contemplation in Gracklstugh. Although reclusive and averse to conflict, the giants have sworn an ancient oath of loyalty to the Deepking, and have been serving his line for as long as any can remember. This oath, however, was given only to the Steelshadow clan. If the throne passes to another dynasty, the stone giants will cease to be the city's allies.
zh_tw: 凱恩戈姆氏族的石巨人在格拉克斯圖格過著安靜的藝術和沉思生活。儘管他們隱居且厭惡衝突，但巨人向深王宣誓了古老的忠誠誓言，併為他的血脈服務了很長時間，時間之長以至於無人能記。然而，這個誓言只給了鋼影氏族。如果王位傳給了另一個王朝，石巨人將不再是這座城市的盟友。

english: The leader of the stone giants is Stonespeaker Hgraam, a priest of Skoraeus Stonebones, the god of his people. Hgraam is wise and knowledgeable. He has sensed that some great evil has broken into the Underdark, but isn't aware of the threat's danger or extent. The giants will rise to defend Gracklstugh if any demons dare to invade, but they are unaware of the danger creeping into the city from within.
zh_tw: 石巨人的領袖是石語者哈格拉姆，他是斯科爾阿斯·斯通邦斯的祭司，也是他人民的神。哈格拉姆既明智又博學。他已經感知到某種巨大的邪惡已經侵入了幽暗地域，但並不瞭解這種威脅的危險程度或範圍。如果有任何惡魔敢於入侵，巨人將會起來保衛格拉克斯圖格，但他們沒有意識到危險正從城市內部悄悄逼近。

english: Keepers of the Flame
zh_tw: 火焰守護者

english: This order of psionic clerics tends to {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s needs, enjoying great influence and helping Horgar V stay ahead of the machinations of the Council of Savants.
zh_tw: 這支靈能牧師隊伍主要照顧{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的需求，享有很大的影響力，並且幫助霍加五世在智者議會的陰謀中保持領先地位。

english: The Keepers of the Flame are currently distracted by their ongoing vendetta against the Gray Ghosts, who recently stole a valuable dragon egg that would have hatched {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s eventual successor. Complicating matters, {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} himself is growing stronger and more resistant to the clerics' coaxing, appeasement, and psionic manipulation.
zh_tw: 火焰守護者目前正因與灰鬼的持續仇殺而分心，灰鬼最近偷走了一顆寶貴的龍蛋，這本將孵化出{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的最終繼任者。使情況更加複雜的是，{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}自身正變得越來越強大，並且對牧師們的哄騙、安撫和靈能操控越來越具有抵抗力。

english: Themberchaud the Wyrmsmith
zh_tw: 瑟姆貝爾喬德，龍匠

english: This {@creature adult red dragon} keeps the city's smelters and forges ablaze, receiving treasure, free meals, and constant pampering in exchange. {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} doesn't know that, like other Wyrmsmiths before him, he is doomed to be slain before he grows too strong, replaced by a new red hatchling. However, the line of succession was interrupted when the Gray Ghosts stole a red dragon egg from the Keepers of the Flame.
zh_tw: 這頭{@creature adult red dragon||成年紅龍}讓城市的熔爐和鍛爐持續燃燒，以此換取財寶、免費餐食和不斷的寵愛。{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}並不知道，像他之前的其他龍焰匠一樣，他註定在變得過於強大之前被殺死，並由一條新的紅龍幼崽取代。然而，當灰鬼從火焰守護者手中偷走了一顆紅龍蛋時，這一繼承線被打斷了。

english: The Wyrmsmith is beginning to chafe under the Keepers' control. He now wonders why he is content with a mere trickle of gold and a paltry handful of slaves, when he could simply force the entire city to bend knee to him and give him everything he desires. For now, his actions are limited by how little he cares about the duergar and how much the Keepers speak "on his behalf." But he has begun taking an interest in the affairs of Gracklstugh and the opportunity to recruit new servants from outside the Keepers of the Flame, using his outings to rekindle forges and smelters as a means to keep an eye out for promising subjects.
zh_tw: 龍匠開始對守護者的控制感到不滿。他現在想知道，為什麼他會滿足於一點點黃金和少數幾個奴隸，當他可以簡單地迫使整個城市向他屈服並給他他想要的一切。目前，他的行動受到他對灰矮人的關心程度以及守護者代表他發言的多少的限制。但他已經開始對格拉克斯圖格的事務產生興趣，並有機會從火焰守護者之外招募新僕人，利用他的出行重新點燃鍛造爐和冶煉廠，作為尋找有前途物件的手段。

english: Gray Ghosts
zh_tw: 灰鬼

english: The Gray Ghosts are the only true thieves' guild in Gracklstugh and the Deepkingdom. Its members are duergar and derro outcasts, plus the odd escaped slave.
zh_tw: 灰鬼是格拉克斯圖格和深王國中唯一真正的盜賊公會。其成員包括灰矮人和迪洛矮人狂人中的棄兒，以及偶爾逃脫的奴隸。

english: The Keepers of the Flame caught and executed the Gray Ghosts' previous leader, who stole their red dragon egg but never revealed its whereabouts. The relentless vendetta forced the thieves into hiding and restricted their activities, but they persevere thanks to the three renegade derro savants who are their current leaders: Uskvil and the twin sisters Aliinka and Zubriska.
zh_tw: 火焰守護者捕獲並處決了灰鬼的前領袖，他偷走了他們的紅龍蛋，但從未透露其下落。無情的復仇迫使盜賊們躲藏起來，限制了他們的活動，但由於三位叛變的迪洛矮人狂人智者——他們目前的領袖：烏斯維爾和雙胞胎姐妹艾琳卡和祖布里斯卡——的幫助，他們依然堅持著。

english: Empty-Scabbard Killers
zh_tw: 空鞘殺手

english: The {@i Forak-Erach-Naek} ("Empty-Scabbard Killers" in Common) are a folktale in Gracklstugh, their name derived from an ancient, obscure Dwarvish dialect. They are an order of psionic assassins practicing disciplines unknown to even the savviest derro or the wisest priest. More than a myth, these killers have been plying their trade for centuries, their motives unknown and their methods inscrutable.
zh_tw: {@i 弗拉克－艾拉克－奈克}（通用語中的"空鞘殺手"）是格拉克斯圖格的一個民間傳說，他們的名字源自一種古老且晦澀的矮人方言。他們是一群靈能刺客，他們所練習的技巧甚至對最精明的迪洛矮人狂人或最睿智的牧師來說都是未知的。這些殺手不僅僅是神話，他們已經從事這個行業數百年，他們的動機不明，方法深不可測。

english: The Empty-Scabbard Killers are {@creature Duergar Soulblade|MTF|duergar soulblades} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) who roam the streets of Gracklstugh searching for psionically gifted children to abduct and train. They also keep an eye out for worthy {@i calassabrak} (see below), offering them a chance to join a new community from which they can strike back at those who cast them out.
zh_tw: 空鞘殺手是{@creature Duergar Soulblade|MTF|灰矮人魂刃使}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}），他們在格拉克斯圖格城的街道上游蕩，尋找具有靈能力量的兒童將其綁架並訓練。他們還密切關注著有價值的{@i 卡拉薩布拉克}（見下文），為他們提供一個加入新社群的機會，在那裡他們可以向那些驅逐他們的人發起反擊。

english: Life in the City of Blades
zh_tw: 在刃城的生活

english: The duergar are called gray dwarves not only because of the color of their skin, but also because of their drab and joyless lifestyle. While they make no time for merriment, the duergar have a culture as rich and complex as any other, and nowhere is this so evident as in Gracklstugh.
zh_tw: 杜爾加爾被稱為灰矮人，不僅因為他們的皮膚顏色，還因為他們單調乏味的生活方式。儘管他們沒有時間享樂，但杜爾加爾的文化和其他任何種族一樣豐富複雜，這一點在格拉克斯圖格尤為明顯。

english: Work never stops in the City of Blades, and the gray dwarves take pride in efficiency and perfection even as they abhor waste and carelessness. They are merciless masters to the derro and slaves who toil and suffer under them.
zh_tw: 在刃城，工作從未停止，灰矮人以效率和完美為榮，同時他們憎惡浪費和粗心大意。他們對在他們手下辛勤勞作和受苦的迪洛矮人狂人和奴隸是無情的主人。

english: Strict Hierarchy
zh_tw: 嚴格的等級制度

english: By appearance and bearing, all duergar know their place and where they belong. Whether as individuals, families, or entire clans, duergar below other duergar in the social order don't seek to bring their rivals down through intrigue and deceit. Rather, they roll up their sleeves and work harder to increase their prestige through the fruits of their labor.
zh_tw: 從外表和舉止來看，所有的灰矮人都知道他們的位置和歸屬。無論是作為個體、家庭還是整個家族，在社會等級中低於其他灰矮人的灰矮人不會透過陰謀和欺騙來打倒他們的對手。相反，他們捲起袖子，更加努力地工作，透過他們的勞動成果來提升他們的聲望。

english: All the honor and honesty the duergar apply among themselves doesn't apply to outsiders. The gray dwarves constantly try to manipulate contracts to take advantage of foreign merchants, looking for any excuse to enslave random visitors who appear weak or vulnerable—including adventurers.
zh_tw: 灰矮人對自己人所持有的所有榮譽和誠實並不適用於外人。他們不斷試圖操縱合同，以利用外國商人，尋找任何藉口奴役那些看起來軟弱或易受攻擊的隨機訪客——包括冒險者。

english: Though they aren't moved by vanity, duergar are extremely proud of their work, and praising the quality of duergar crafting can sometimes help outsiders in their dealings with the gray dwarves.
zh_tw: 儘管灰矮人不為虛榮所動，但他們對自己的工作非常自豪，讚揚灰矮人工藝的質量有時可以幫助外人與灰矮人打交道。

english: Subsistence
zh_tw: 生計

english: Duergar clans use caverns under Gracklstugh and choice outlying caves to farm a variety of plants and fungi. These crops are complemented by meat from Underdark beasts and fish from the Darklake. Not even the duergar risk drinking water from the Darklake, however, and with clean streams in short supply, the people of Gracklstugh cover this scarcity with Darklake Stout, the signature ale brewed by the Muzgardt clan.
zh_tw: 灰矮人氏族使用格拉克斯圖格下的洞穴和精選的外圍洞穴來種植各種植物和真菌。這些作物由來自幽暗地域的野獸肉和來自黑暗湖的魚補充。然而，即使是灰矮人也不敢喝黑暗湖的水，而且由於清潔的溪流供應不足，格拉克斯圖格的人們用穆茲加特氏族釀造的標誌性愛爾啤酒——黑暗湖烈性黑啤來掩蓋這種稀缺。

english: Outcasts
zh_tw: 邊緣棄兒

english: The bottom rung in Gracklstugh society is mostly occupied by the underclass of the derro. Enslaved by the duergar centuries ago, then freed, the derro aren't allowed to hold honest jobs, and their rights are hardly ever recognized by the duergar. Even slaves are held in higher regard. Derro scuttle about like vermin and are mostly confined to hovels built along the walls of Laduguer's Furrow in the West Cleft District and East Cleft District.
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格社會最底層主要是由迪洛矮人的下層階級佔據。幾個世紀前被灰矮人奴役，後來被釋放，迪洛矮人不允許從事正當工作，他們的權利幾乎從未得到灰矮人的認可。甚至奴隸也更受尊重。迪洛矮人像害蟲一樣四處逃竄，主要被限制在拉杜格溝壑壑沿著西裂谷區和東裂谷區牆壁建造的簡陋小屋中。

english: Another kind of outcasts are those duergar who dishonor their clans so grievously they are stripped of all but their lives: the {@i calassabrak}, meaning "the flawed who aren't to be trusted" in Dwarvish. They are shunned by other duergar, many eventually taking their lives rather than face an existence apart from family and clan. Those who live on become bitter and tough, with many leaving Gracklstugh as hermits or adventurers, or turning to crime and a life in the shadows. Members of both the Gray Ghosts and the Empty-Scabbard Killers include a significant number of calassabrak, no longer bound by oath, honor, and duty.
zh_tw: 另一種被排斥者是那些嚴重玷汙自己氏族榮譽的灰矮人，他們除了生命之外被剝奪了一切：即矮人語中的{@i 卡拉薩布拉克}，意為"不可信任的有缺陷者"。他們被其他灰矮人排斥，許多人最終選擇結束自己的生命，而不是面對與家庭和氏族分離的生活。那些繼續生存下來的人變得痛苦而堅韌，許多人離開格拉克斯圖格成為隱士或冒險者，或者轉向犯罪和在陰影中生活。灰鬼和空鞘殺手的成員中包括相當數量的卡拉薩布拉克，他們不再受誓言、榮譽和責任的束縛。

english: The Downward Spiral
zh_tw: 向下螺旋

english: The madness of the demon lords has not reached Gracklstugh in full, but it already has a foothold through the work of the derro and their savants.
zh_tw: 惡魔領主的瘋狂尚未完全降臨到格拉克斯圖格，但透過迪洛矮人狂人及其智者的工作，它已經在這裡站穩了腳跟。

english: A splinter group of the Council of Savants began worshiping Demogorgon even before the current crisis, and their foul rituals accelerated the spread of madness in the city. To make things worse, the divided nature of the city, both geographically and socially, resonates strongly with the dual aspect of Demogorgon. The derro cultists plan to offer the entire city to their newly arrived master.
zh_tw: 智者議會的一個分裂派系在當前危機之前就開始崇拜狄摩高根，他們邪惡的儀式加速了城市中瘋狂的傳播。更糟糕的是，城市在地理和社會上的分裂性質與狄摩高根的雙重面貌強烈共鳴。迪洛矮人邪教徒計劃將整個城市獻給他們新到的主人。

english: Many duergar NPCs the characters interact with are showing the first signs of infection. Though their madness has not yet overwhelmed them, it manifests in behavior such as Errde Blackskull's conspiracy theories, Gorglak's corruption, and Gartokkar Xundorn's paranoia.
zh_tw: 許多與角色互動的灰矮人NPC表現出了感染的最初跡象。儘管他們的瘋狂尚未完全壓倒他們，但它在行為上表現出來，例如艾德·黑顱的陰謀論，戈格拉克的腐敗，和加爾托卡·桑多恩的偏執。

english: Religion
zh_tw: 宗教

english: Duergar don't pray, but their religion is tightly woven into their everyday life. Deities worshiped in Gracklstugh include the following.
zh_tw: 灰矮人不祈禱，但他們的宗教緊密地編織在他們的日常生活中。在格拉克斯圖格受到崇拜的神祇包括以下這些。

english: Laduguer
zh_tw: 拉杜格

english: The patron of the duergar is a god of self-reliance, defense, and survival. His clerics have access to the War domain.
zh_tw: 灰矮人的守護神是自力更生、防禦和生存的神。他的牧師可以接觸到戰爭領域。

english: Deep Duerra
zh_tw: 深地·杜拉

english: Laduguer's mortal daughter who then ascended, Deep Duerra is the goddess of cooperation and dominance. War is her domain as well.
zh_tw: 拉杜格爾的凡人女兒，後來昇華的深地杜艾拉是合作與統治的女神。戰爭也是她的領域。

english: Diirinka
zh_tw: 迪林卡

english: The patron of the derro betrayed his twin brother Diinkarazan to escape with the secrets of magic. He embodies cruelty, insanity, and cleverness. His clerics have access to the Trickery domain.
zh_tw: 迪洛矮人狂人的守護神背叛了他的雙胞胎兄弟迪林卡拉贊，帶著魔法的秘密逃脫。他體現了殘忍、瘋狂和聰明。他的牧師可以接觸到詭詐領域。

english: Skoraeus Stonebones
zh_tw: 司寇雷烏斯·巖骨

english: Stone giants revere the King of the Rock, god of buried things, whose clerics can access the Knowledge and Life domains. Stonespeaker Hgraam, a powerful spellcaster, is Skoraeus's only priest in Gracklstugh.
zh_tw: 石巨人崇拜岩石之王，埋藏之物的神，其牧師可以接觸知識與生命領域。石語者哈格拉姆，一位強大的施法者，是斯科爾阿斯在格拉克斯圖格唯一的祭司。

english: Law and Order
zh_tw: 律法與秩序

english: Minor crime is relatively rare in Gracklstugh. The duergar live by a strict code of honor, and their laws are few, simple, and practical. Both guards and regular citizens can be {@condition invisible} and watching, which keeps any potential criminals and dissenters uncertain and fearful. A laird may punish any member of his or her clan who commits a crime, but offenses between clans are immediately brought before the Council of Lairds, which resolves matters swiftly and harshly. The code of punishment is simple. Because dishonor, mutilation and imprisonment are a waste of resources and create weakness in society, a duergar who intentionally commits any crime receives a death sentence. Accidental crime by a duergar is compensated by goods or work equivalent to the damages. Derro, slaves or outsiders caught committing any crime can be executed on the spot by any duergar present.
zh_tw: 在格拉克斯圖格，輕微犯罪相對較少。灰矮人遵循嚴格的榮譽準則，他們的法律很少、簡單且實用。無論是守衛還是普通市民都可能處於{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態並進行監視，這使得任何潛在的罪犯和不滿者都感到不確定和恐懼。領主可以懲罰其氏族中犯罪的任何成員，但氏族之間的冒犯會立即被帶到領主議會前，議會會迅速而嚴厲地解決問題。懲罰的準則很簡單。因為恥辱、傷殘和監禁都是資源的浪費，並在社會中造成弱點，故意犯罪的灰矮人將被判處死刑。灰矮人意外犯罪則透過等同於損害的商品或工作來補償。迪洛矮人狂人、奴隸或外人在犯罪時，任何在場的灰矮人都可以立即執行處決。

english: Gracklstugh
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格

english: {@b Population}: 10,000 duergar, 2,000 derro, 50 stone giants, and an unknown number of slaves (quaggoths, grimlocks, orcs, shield dwarves, svirfneblin, and a few kobolds and goblinoids)
zh_tw: {@b 人口}: 10,000 灰矮人，2,000 迪洛矮人狂人，50 石巨人，以及數量不明的奴隸（幽邃熊怪，幽邃盲族，獸人，盾矮人，地底侏儒，以及一些狗頭人和地精類生物）

english: {@b Government}: Absolute monarchy
zh_tw: {@b 政治}: 絕對君主制

english: {@b Defense}: Large standing army with specialized corps; every duergar is trained for battle, and the citizens of the city create a formidable militia
zh_tw: {@b 防禦}: 擁有大型常備軍和特種部隊；每個灰矮人都接受戰鬥訓練，城市的居民構成了一支強大的民兵隊伍

english: {@b Commerce}: Weapons and armor of high quality; various fungi, molds, and exotic creatures for food; trade from across the Underdark and the surface world
zh_tw: {@b 商業}: 高質量的武器和盔甲；各種真菌、黴菌和外來食物；來自幽暗地域和地表世界的貿易

english: {@b Organizations}: The Council of Lairds, the Council of Savants, the Merchant Council, the Keepers of the Flame, Clan Cairngorm, the Gray Ghosts, and others
zh_tw: {@b 組織}: 領主議會，智者議會，商人議會，火焰守護者，凱恩戈姆氏族，灰鬼，以及其他組織

english: The cavern housing Gracklstugh is split in two by a rift called Laduguer's Furrow, after the duergar patron god. The north half comprises Northfurrow District, where common workers and the clans devoted to minor crafts make their home, and Darklake District, open to foreigners and where the city's merchants engage in trade with visitors. As befits a major settlement in a dangerous realm, Gracklstugh places no restrictions on the weapons or gear characters can carry or trade.
zh_tw: 容納格拉克斯圖格的洞穴被一個名為拉杜格溝壑的裂縫一分為二，以灰矮人的守護神命名。北半部包括北犁溝區，那裡是普通工人和致力於次要工藝的氏族的家園，以及黑暗湖區，對外國人開放，城市的商人與訪客進行貿易。作為一個位於危險領域的重要定居點，格拉克斯圖格對角色可以攜帶或交易的武器或裝備沒有任何限制。

english: Twelve stone bridges lead to Southfurrow District, and then farther south to Flowstone District. These boroughs are reserved for the more prestigious clans and the largest smelters and forges {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} ignites during his flights. The Wyrmsmith's lair and the cavern complex the stone giants of Cairngorm Clan call home both connect to these districts.
zh_tw: 十二座石橋通向南溝區，再往南則是流石區。這些區域是為那些更為顯赫的氏族和最大的熔爐與鍛造廠保留的，{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}在他的飛行中會點燃這些地方。龍匠的巢穴以及凱恩戈姆氏族的石巨人們稱之為家的洞穴群都與這兩個區域相連。

english: Welcome to the City of Blades
zh_tw: 歡迎來到刃城

english: Entering the city is the first major hurdle the characters must surmount in Gracklstugh. Unless they heed {@creature Buppido|OotA}'s advice to arrive by way of the Darklake (or come up with the idea on their own), the characters reach one of the gates. (See "{@area Arriving in Gracklstugh|137|x}" earlier in this chapter.)
zh_tw: 進入城市是角色在格拉克斯圖格必須克服的第一大障礙。除非他們聽從{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}的建議，透過黑暗湖抵達（或自己想出這個主意），否則角色會到達其中一個大門。（參見本章前文的"{@area 到達格拉克斯圖格|137|x}"）

english: City Gates
zh_tw: 城門

english: The pragmatic nature of the duergar means that all Gracklstugh's entrance gates are similar in design, for ease of maintenance and the training of guards.
zh_tw: 灰矮人的實用主義意味著格拉克斯圖格的所有入口大門在設計上都是相似的，便於維護和守衛的訓練。

english: The ground at your feet has been getting smoother and flatter, a welcome respite from the uneven passages to which you have grown wearily accustomed. Eventually, stone tiles become more noticeable, turning the path into a proper road. You can see spots of light in the distance, blue-white and too regularly placed to be phosphorescent mushrooms.
zh_tw: 你腳下的地面變得越發平滑和平坦，這讓你從已經習以為常的不平坦通道中解脫出來，感到非常欣慰。最終，石板變得更加明顯，將小徑變成了一條像樣的道路。你可以在遠處看到點點光亮，它們呈藍白色，排列得太規則，不可能是熒光蘑菇。

english: The lights are proper lamps flanking two massive stone gates blocking the tunnel. Before you get a chance to examine the intricate carvings on the gates' surface, a harsh voice hisses from a slit on the cavern wall that was not there before.
zh_tw: 燈光是從兩扇阻擋隧道入口的巨大石閘兩側的燈具中照出的。你還沒來得及細看閘門表面精妙的雕飾，一個刺耳的聲音便從巖壁上先前並不存在的一道縫隙中嘶嘶傳來。

english: "State your names and business!" the voice orders in Dwarvish. Other similar slits open, revealing the tips of a dozen crossbow bolts. Behind you, a metallic din announces a group of six heavily armored dwarves appearing out of thin air, their swords leveled at you from behind sturdy metal shields.
zh_tw: "報上你們的名字和來意！"聲音用矮人語命令道。其他類似的縫隙開啟，露出了一打十字弓弩箭的尖端。在你們身後，一陣金屬撞擊聲宣佈了一群六個重灌甲矮人憑空出現，他們手持劍從堅固的金屬盾牌後面對準了你們。

english: When the characters first reached the road, six {@creature duergar} watching invisibly started following them at a safe distance. Twelve more {@creature duergar} soldiers are stationed in guardhouses concealed within the rocky walls of the cavern, all of them aiming heavy crossbows at the party.
zh_tw: 當角色們初次抵達這條路時，六名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}正隱形地監視著，並開始以安全的距離尾隨他們。另有十二名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}士兵駐紮在洞穴巖壁內隱藏的崗哨中，所有人都用重型十字弓瞄準著隊伍。

english: The duergar are hostile, and the guard who spoke follows up on every answer the characters give. One character can take the lead in the interrogation by speaking for the party and making a {@dc 15} Charisma check ({@skill Deception} and {@skill Persuasion} apply; {@skill Intimidation} or {@skill Performance} are met with scorn). Depending on how believable the party's story is and how the other adventurers behave during the questioning, you might allow the character to make the check with advantage or impose disadvantage.
zh_tw: 灰矮人是敵對的，發言的守衛會對角色給出的每一個回答進行追查。一個角色可以透過代表隊伍發言並進行一個 {@dc 15} 魅力檢定（適用 {@skill Deception||欺瞞} 和 {@skill Persuasion||說服}； {@skill Intimidation||威嚇} 或 {@skill Performance||表演} 會遭到嘲笑）來主導審訊。根據隊伍故事的可信度以及其他冒險者在審問期間的行為，你可以允許角色在檢定中獲得優勢或施加劣勢。

english: The guard grudgingly lets the characters pass if the check succeeds, and refuses them entrance if it fails. If the check fails by 5 or more, the guard gives the order to arrest the characters, announcing that they are now slaves of the duergar (see "Getting Captured" below).
zh_tw: 如果檢定成功，守衛會不情願地讓角色們透過；如果失敗，則拒絕他們進入。如果檢定失敗超過5點，守衛會下令逮捕角色們，並宣佈他們現在是灰矮人的奴隸（見下文的"被捕"部分）。

english: The first time the characters are allowed inside the city or turned away from a gate, a secret door on the wall opens, revealing Gorglak, a {@creature duergar Stone Guard|MTF} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}).
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次被允許進入城市或被拒之門外時，牆上的一扇暗門開啟，揭示了戈格拉克，一名{@creature duergar Stone Guard|MTF|灰矮人岩石守衛}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）。

english: "Well." The duergar removes his helmet, revealing the gray skin of his kind. He musses his white beard as he walks closer, switching to Common as he lowers his voice. There is a discomfiting glint in his eyes and his smile. "You are clearly lying. I ought to just send you to the slave pens, but... you amuse me. What do you have that is worth your freedom?"
zh_tw: "嗯。" 灰矮人摘下頭盔，露出了他種族的灰色皮膚。他一邊走來一邊弄亂自己的白鬍子，壓低聲音，換成了通用語。他眼中閃爍著令人不安的光芒，微笑中也帶著些許狡黠。"你們顯然在撒謊。我本應該直接把你們送到奴隸圍欄，但是......你們讓我覺得有趣。你們有什麼值得換取自由的東西嗎？"

english: The duergar waits for your answer, his gaze touching on each of you in turn as he smiles in anticipation.
zh_tw: 灰矮人等待著你們的回答，他的目光依次掃過你們每一個人，帶著期待的微笑。

english: If they are with the party, {@creature Topsy|OotA} and {@creature Turvy|OotA}, {@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA}, {@creature Jimjar|OotA}, and {@creature Buppido|OotA} can whisper to the characters that few duergar are so blatantly corrupt as Gorglak seems to be. A successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check lets a character notice that Gorglak is eying the adventurers' weapons (especially any drow weapons or magic weapons they might have), and that there's something odd about his behavior. The madness creeping into Gracklstugh has made Gorglak obsessed with rare weapons. He's willing to go to great extents to acquire new weapons of exquisite design for his growing collection.
zh_tw: 如果他們與隊伍在一起， {@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西} 和 {@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}、{@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA|薩里斯·克澤卡里特}、{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾} 以及 {@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多} 可以低聲告訴角色，很少有灰矮人會像戈格拉克那樣公然腐敗。一次成功的 {@dc 12} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定能讓角色注意到戈格拉克正在盯著冒險者的武器（尤其是他們可能擁有的任何卓爾武器或魔法武器），並且他的行為有些古怪。格拉克斯圖格逐漸蔓延的瘋狂讓戈格拉克對稀有武器產生了強烈的痴迷。他願意不擇手段地為他日益增長的收藏獲得設計精美的武器。

english: Offering Gorglak a worthy weapon for his collection gets the characters through the gate. Any other bribe requires one of the characters to succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, or Gorglak is insulted and has the party arrested. If the characters are too open about the negotiation, Gorglak has them arrested and pretends he didn't say anything.
zh_tw: 為戈格拉克提供一把值得收藏的武器可以讓角色們透過大門。任何其他賄賂都需要其中一名角色成功透過一次 {@dc 13} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，否則戈格拉克會感到被侮辱並逮捕整個隊伍。如果角色們在談判中過於公開，戈格拉克會逮捕他們並假裝自己什麼都沒說過.

english: If Gorglak finds the characters' bribe appealing, he refuses to accept it then and there, instead directing them to find one Werz Saltbaron in the Darklake Docks and hand the bribe to him. Gorglak tells the characters that he will check with Werz at the end of his shift, and will find the characters and arrest them if they have not paid by then.
zh_tw: 如果戈格拉克覺得角色們的賄賂有吸引力，他當時不會接受，而是指示他們去找位於黑暗湖碼頭的沃茲·鹽爵，並將賄賂交給他。戈格拉克告訴角色們，他會在換崗結束時與沃茲核實，並如果他們到那時還沒有支付，就會找到角色們並將他們逮捕。
