english: Characters allowed through the gate are escorted to the Darklake District by four {@creature duergar} guards, two of whom are {@condition invisible}. Once the party reaches the edge of the district, the guards leave and return to the posts.
zh_tw: 被允許透過大門的角色將由四名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}守衛護送到黑暗湖區，其中兩名守衛處於{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態。一旦隊伍到達該區域的邊緣，守衛便會離開並返回崗位。

english: Buppido's Escape
zh_tw: 布皮多的逃脫

english: {@creature Buppido|OotA} has a secret agenda in Gracklstugh. If he is still with the party, the derro looks for the first opportunity to slip away and return to his hidden lair and "shrine" in the Whorlstone Tunnels (see "Whorlstone Tunnels").
zh_tw: {@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多} 在格拉克斯圖格有一個秘密議程。如果他仍然和隊伍在一起，迪洛矮人狂人會尋找第一個機會溜走，返回他在渦石隧道（見"渦石隧道"）中隱藏的巢穴和"神殿"。

english: Darklake Docks
zh_tw: 黑暗湖碼頭

english: Arriving at the Darklake Docks requires a combination of skill, ingenuity, and luck. Vigilance is a little more relaxed here because the guards at Overlake Hold can spot any obvious threat coming from the waters.
zh_tw: 到達黑暗湖碼頭需要技巧、聰明才智和運氣的結合。這裡警戒稍微放鬆，因為湖上堡的守衛可以發現來自水域的任何明顯威脅。

english: After hours of tense navigation, you glimpse an orange glow in the distance. Soon you hear faint metallic echoes, growing louder as you come closer.
zh_tw: 經過數小時的緊張航行，你在遠處瞥見一抹橙色的光芒。隨著你越來越接近，你聽到微弱的金屬回聲，聲音越來越大。

english: Firelight illuminates massive columns with structures built around their bases. The cold air of the Underdark is becoming warmer even at this distance, and you can now see a variety of piers made from zurkhwood, stone, and plain rock jutting out along the edge of a huge cavern.
zh_tw: 火光照亮巨大的石柱，柱腳周圍環繞著建築。即使相隔這麼遠，幽暗地域的冰冷空氣也已漸漸變暖。如今你們能看見巨洞邊緣伸出的各式碼頭，有的以祖克木搭建，有的以石材砌成，有的則直接利用天然岩石。

english: As the characters draw closer, they can see that the eastern docks are the least crowded. If {@creature Buppido|OotA} is with them, he guides them to a natural rock pier on the eastern edge of the cavern. Otherwise, the characters must make a successful {@dc 14} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check or a {@dc 15} group Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check to guide their boat safely and inconspicuously to an empty dock. If the group check fails, nearby guards notice the characters but don't immediately identify them as a threat. However, you can choose to impose disadvantage on any checks the characters make to remain inconspicuous during their first day in Gracklstugh.
zh_tw: 當角色們靠近時，他們可以看到東邊的碼頭是最不擁擠的。如果{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}與他們在一起，他會引導他們到洞穴東邊的一個天然岩石碼頭。否則，角色們必須成功透過一個{@dc 14}群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定或一個{@dc 15}群體感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定來將他們的船安全且不引人注目地引導到一個空碼頭。如果群體檢定失敗，附近的守衛會注意到角色們，但不會立即將他們視為威脅。然而，你可以選擇在角色們在格拉克斯圖格的第一天裡，對他們保持不引人注目的任何檢定額外施加劣勢。

english: Map 4.1: Gracklstugh
zh_tw: 地圖 4.1: 格拉克斯圖格

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Getting Captured
zh_tw: 被抓

english: Even after making it inside the city, the characters must tread carefully, as the duergar use the slightest pretext to arrest them. Even trying to haggle with a duergar merchant might inspire a call for the guards to take the characters away. Getting caught stealing is punishable by death on the spot, but guards or the offended party might see some value in enslaving the culprits instead, so the characters can be shackled and shipped beyond the Darklake District. Resisting arrest is a truly bad idea; every duergar around is reinforcement.
zh_tw: 即使成功進入城市，角色們也必須小心行事，因為灰矮人會以最微小的藉口逮捕他們。即使試圖與灰矮人商人討價還價也可能引起呼叫守衛將角色們帶走。被抓到偷竊將當場被處以死刑，但守衛或受害方可能看到將罪犯奴役的價值，因此角色們可能會被銬上並運送到黑暗湖區之外。抗拒逮捕是一個非常糟糕的想法；周圍的每一個灰矮人都是增援。

english: If the characters get arrested, you can interrupt their transfer with a random encounter or lead them to other planned encounters. The "Rampaging Giant" encounter (which takes place in the Darklake District) is the most likely event to interrupt a prisoner transfer. Alternatively, an agent of the Keepers of the Flame can stop the guards before they take the characters to Overlake Hold (see "{@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s Lair" for information regarding the keepers' interest in foreign mercenaries).
zh_tw: 如果角色們被捕，你可以透過隨機遭遇打斷他們的轉移，或者引導他們進入其他計劃好的遭遇。"狂暴巨人"遭遇（發生在黑暗湖區）是最有可能打斷囚犯轉移的事件。另外，火焰守護者的特工可以在守衛將角色們帶到湖上堡之前阻止他們（有關火焰守護者對外國傭兵的興趣，參見"{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的巢穴"）。

english: Possible offers of employment in the Blade Bazaar can also be turned into timely rescues for the adventurers. Otherwise, they end up in Overlake Hold, interrogated by Errde Blackskull.
zh_tw: 在刀刃市集可能提供的僱傭機會也可以及時轉變為對冒險者的救援。否則，他們最終會到達湖上堡，由艾德·黑顱審問。

english: Darklake District
zh_tw: 黑暗湖區

english: The Darklake District gives an illusion of openness. The streets are relatively wide to allow for merchant carts and wagons to pass, and the buildings aren't as crowded around stalagmites as in the southern districts. Openness doesn't mean welcoming, however. The duergar who ply their trades here are wary of all the foreigners confined by law to this part of the city.
zh_tw: 黑暗湖區給人一種開放的錯覺。街道相對寬敞，以便商人的手推車和馬車透過，建築物不像南部區域那樣擁擠在石筍周圍。然而，開放並不意味著歡迎。在這裡從事交易的灰矮人對所有依法被限制在城市這部分的外國人保持警惕。

english: A wave of heat slams against you as an acrid smog rises to choke the air out of your lungs. The Darklake spreads out beyond a jumble of buildings and streets, reflecting the lights of countless fires burning across the city within hollowed-out columns and stalagmites.
zh_tw: 一股熱浪衝擊著你，同時一股刺鼻的煙霧升起，幾乎讓你窒息。黑暗湖在一片建築和街道的混亂中延伸開來，反射著城市中無數火光在挖空的柱子和石筍中燃燒的光芒。

english: Though the streets are crowded, you move easily within the surging throng of buyers, merchants, and slaves. You aren't the only outsiders here, as you spy drow, svirfneblin, derro, orcs, and other races in the crowds. The shouting of people blends with the sound of distant hammering to create a constant, distracting din.
zh_tw: 儘管街道擁擠，你仍然能在湧動的買家、商人和奴隸群中輕鬆移動。你們不是這裡唯一的外來者，因為你看到卓爾、地底侏儒、迪洛矮人、獸人以及其他種族在人群中。人們的叫喊聲與遠處打鐵的聲音混合在一起，營造出一種持續的、令人分心的嘈雜聲。

english: Behind the forbidding walls separating the Darklake District from the rest of the city stand the docks, markets, and shops where Gracklstugh's commerce and trade are conducted. The many duergar merchants—along with drow, svirfneblin, orcs, and others—pay little attention to the characters unless they are looking to do business.
zh_tw: 在將黑暗湖區與城市其他部分隔開的令人生畏的牆壁後面，是碼頭、市場和商店，那裡進行著格拉克斯圖格的商業和貿易活動。眾多的灰矮人商人——以及卓爾、地底侏儒、獸人和其他種族——除非角色們想要做生意，否則他們很少關注角色們。

english: Guards posted at the gates make it clear to the characters that non-duergar are restricted to the Darklake District, and the characters have better luck asking other outsiders for directions rather than trying to engage the duergar locals. They are directed to the Blade Bazaar if they wish to sell anything they might be carrying with them. For gossip and a meal, the Shattered Spire tavern is recommended, while lodging for non-duergar can be had at the Ghohlbrorn's Lair inn.
zh_tw: 守衛在大門處明確告知角色們，非灰矮人人僅限於黑暗湖區，角色們向其他外來者詢問方向會比試圖與灰矮人當地人交流有更好的運氣。如果他們想要出售任何隨身攜帶的物品，可以前往刀刃市集。想要閒聊和用餐的話，推薦去破碎尖塔酒館，而非灰矮人人的住宿可以在戈爾布隆巢穴旅館找到。

english: At any point during which the characters move from point to point in the Darklake District, they can witness one or more of the following events.
zh_tw: 在角色們在黑暗湖區域從一個點移動到另一個點的任何時候，他們可以目睹以下一個或多個事件。

english: Rampaging Giant
zh_tw: 肆虐巨人

english: This encounter triggers possible side quests through which the characters can learn about the influence of Demogorgon in Gracklstugh. You can use this event any time during the party's stay in the city. Holding it for later use gives characters a chance to notice the little things wrong among the duergar, while using it right away can help characters avoid being enslaved if they are arrested at any point during their visit.
zh_tw: 這次遭遇觸發了可能的支線任務，角色們可以透過這些任務瞭解狄摩高根在葛拉格拉克斯圖格的影響。你可以在隊伍在城市逗留期間的任何時間使用這個事件。將其保留到後期使用可以讓角色們有機會注意到灰矮人中微小的異常，而立即使用則可以幫助角色們避免在訪問期間的任何時候被逮捕時被奴役。

english: The rhythmic hammering of the city's forges is drowned for a second by a thundering roar and the sound of crumbling rock. Duergar and visitors alike turn to look as a two-headed, gray-skinned giant bursts through a gate, howling madly and lashing out left and right, littering the plaza with rock and stone debris. As he bellows, one of his swings connects with a duergar soldier, whose broken body flies through the air and crashes near you with a sickening crunch.
zh_tw: 城市鍛造廠有節奏的敲打聲被一聲雷鳴般的吼叫和岩石崩裂聲暫時淹沒。灰矮人和訪客們都轉過頭來，目睹一個雙頭的灰膚巨人衝破一扇大門，瘋狂地嚎叫著，左右亂打，將岩石和石頭碎片撒滿廣場。當他咆哮時，他的一擊打中了一個灰矮人士兵，那破碎的身體飛向空中，最後在你附近發出令人作嘔的碎裂聲。

english: A {@creature stone giant} from Cairngorm Cavern has succumbed to a demonic curse that has caused him to grow a disfigured second head. A successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check reveals that the giant is crazed and terrified. Use the stone giant stat block with the following modifications:
zh_tw: 一位來自凱恩戈姆洞穴的 {@creature stone giant||石巨人} 已經屈服於一種惡魔詛咒，這使他長出了一個畸形的第二個頭。一個成功的 {@dc 12} 感知 ({@skill Insight||洞悉}) 檢定揭示了該巨人已經瘋狂且恐懼。使用石巨人屬性塊，並作如下修改：

english: The giant has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, or knocked {@condition unconscious}.
zh_tw: 這個巨人在進行感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定時具有優勢，並且在對抗被{@condition blinded||目盲}（失明）、{@condition charmed||魅惑}（魅惑）、{@condition deafened||耳聾}（失聰）、{@condition frightened||恐懼}（恐懼）、{@condition stunned||震懾}（昏迷）或被擊成{@condition unconscious||昏迷}（失去意識）的豁免投骰時也具有優勢。

english: The giant is unarmed. As an action, it can make two unarmed strikes ({@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target). On a hit, the giant deals 13 ({@dice 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 巨人處於徒手狀態。作為一個動作，它可以進行兩次徒手打擊（命中{@hit 9}，觸及範圍10尺，單一目標）。命中時，巨人造成13（{@dice 2d6 + 6}）鈍擊傷害。

english: The rampage happens in a broad plaza, so there is plenty of space for the different combatants to maneuver.
zh_tw: 這場肆虐發生在一個寬闊的廣場上，因此不同的戰鬥者有足夠的空間進行機動。

english: The giant moves in the characters' direction and lashes out. Two {@creature duergar} guards and two {@creature duergar xarrorn|MTF} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) respond to the giant's roaring, racing in to join the fight in the second round. They are well trained and do their best to help, but to avoid additional complexity during the encounter, assume that the duergar act at the end of the initiative order and deal a flat total of 10 damage to the giant each round.
zh_tw: 巨人朝著角色的方向移動並發動攻擊。兩名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}守衛和兩名{@creature duergar xarrorn|MTF|灰矮人薩隆長槍兵}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）對巨人的咆哮做出反應，在第二輪中迅速加入戰鬥。他們訓練有素，並盡力協助，但為了避免戰鬥中的額外複雜性，假設灰矮人在先攻順序的最後行動，並在每輪中對巨人造成總計10點傷害。

english: Bystanders take cover at once, but {@creature duergar} citizens are ready to jump in if the guards fail to contain the threat. The giant ignores characters attacking from range and attacks opponents in melee at random, including the duergar. Both the giant and the guards fight until they drop to 0 hit points.
zh_tw: 圍觀者立刻尋找掩護，但是{@creature duergar||灰矮人}市民已經準備好，如果守衛無法控制威脅就立即介入。巨人無視遠端攻擊的角色，並隨機攻擊近戰的對手，包括灰矮人。巨人和守衛都會戰鬥直到他們的生命值降至0。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Without the characters' help, the guards and assisting citizens bring down the stone giant with few casualties. If the characters are prisoners under escort when the giant attacks, the guards who engage the giant are their escort. The characters can use this chance to escape, or they can help, albeit with disadvantage on attack rolls if they are shackled. The duergar are pragmatists and release characters who help them deal with the giant's threat, but they attempt to arrest them again after the combat is over.
zh_tw: 如果沒有角色們的幫助，守衛和協助的市民會以很少的傷亡擊敗石巨人。如果角色們在巨人攻擊時是被押送的囚犯，與巨人交戰的守衛就是他們的押送者。角色們可以利用這個機會逃跑，或者他們可以幫忙，儘管如果他們被銬住，在攻擊檢定時會有劣勢。灰矮人是實用主義者，會釋放幫助他們應對巨人威脅的角色，但戰鬥結束後他們會再次試圖逮捕他們。

english: Once the crazed giant is put down, another stone giant comes through the shattered gate, but this one looks perfectly sane. He reaches the fallen giant at the same time as a squad of three {@creature Duergar Stone Guard|MTF|duergar stone guards} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}).
zh_tw: 一旦瘋狂的巨人被擊敗，另一個石巨人穿過破碎的大門出現，但這個看起來完全清醒。他與一隊三名{@creature Duergar Stone Guard|MTF|灰矮人岩石守衛}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）同時到達倒下的巨人身邊。

english: The guards who fought alongside the characters explain the situation, neither downplaying nor exalting the characters' actions. The characters can speak to the newly arrived giant while the duergar confer. The giant introduces himself as Dorhun, apprentice to Stonespeaker Hgraam. He reveals that the fallen giant's name is Rihuud, and that he was another of the Stonespeaker's apprentices. Rihuud was "communing with the stone" in Cairngorm Cavern when he went mad, sprouted a second head, and stormed out.
zh_tw: 與角色並肩作戰的守衛們解釋了情況，既沒有貶低也沒有過分誇讚角色們的行為。角色們可以在灰矮人商議時與新到的巨人交談。巨人自我介紹為多爾洪，石語者哈格拉姆的學徒。他透露倒下的巨人名叫裡胡德，也是石語者的學徒之一。裡胡德在凱恩戈姆洞穴"與石頭交流"時發瘋了，長出了第二個頭，並衝了出來。

english: If the party was not previously arrested and didn't participate in the fight, the Stone Guards start questioning bystanders, who eventually point out the characters as new arrivals to the city.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍之前沒有被逮捕並且沒有參與戰鬥，岩石衛隊開始詢問旁觀者，他們最終會指出角色們是城市的新來者。

english: If the characters knocked Rihuud {@condition unconscious} instead of dealing a lethal blow, a grateful Dorhun asks them to visit Cairngorm Cavern before they leave the city, informing the Stone Guards of this. The importance of the Stonespeaker means that the Stone Guards will escort the party across the city to meet with him, though they don't hide their displeasure at doing so.
zh_tw: 如果角色們將裡胡德擊成{@condition unconscious||昏迷}而不是給予致命一擊，感激的多爾洪會要求他們在離開城市前訪問凱恩戈姆洞穴，並告知岩石衛隊這一情況。石語者的重要性意味著岩石衛隊會護送隊伍穿越城市去見他，儘管他們在這麼做時並不掩飾他們的不悅。

english: Flashing Badges
zh_tw: 出示徽章

english: Working for either the Stone Guard or the Keepers of the Flame grants characters a degree of freedom in Gracklstugh, as they can show the insignia given to them by each faction if they are detained. At least one character in the party must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check to convince duergar not to detain the party any longer, but characters who show the insignia have advantage on the check.
zh_tw: 為石衛或火焰守護者效力的角色在格拉克斯圖格享有一定程度的自由，因為他們如果被拘留，可以展示各自派系授予他們的徽章。隊伍中至少需要一名角色成功透過一個{@dc 14}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定來說服灰矮人不再拘留隊伍，但展示徽章的角色在這次檢定中獲得優勢。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: Divide 1,740 XP equally among the characters if they cooperate with the guards to defeat the two-headed stone giant.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與守衛合作擊敗雙頭石巨人，將1740經驗值平均分配給角色。

english: Guests of the Stone Guard
zh_tw: 石衛的客人

english: Whenever circumstances see the Stone Guards develop an interest in the party (including being arrested or witnessing the giant's rampage without taking part), the characters are ordered to follow a squad of duergar to Overlake Hold for further questioning.
zh_tw: 無論何時，如果岩石衛隊對隊伍產生興趣（包括被逮捕或目睹巨人的暴走而不參與），角色們將被命令跟隨一隊灰矮人前往湖上堡進行進一步詢問。

english: From this point, the adventure can take different paths depending on how you want to proceed. Talk to the players about their preference, or decide on your own what happens next:
zh_tw: 從這一點開始，冒險可以根據你想要進行的方式採取不同的路徑。與玩家討論他們的偏好，或者自己決定接下來會發生什麼：

english: Gartokkar Xundorn intervenes on behalf of the Keepers of the Flame, which can lead to a meeting with {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} (see "{@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s Lair").
zh_tw: 加爾托卡·桑多恩代表火焰守護者進行幹預，這可能導致與{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的會面（見"{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的巢穴"）。

english: The characters can continue to Overlake Hold and meet with Captain Errde Blackskull (see "Overlake Hold").
zh_tw: 角色們可以繼續前往湖上堡與艾德·黑顱上尉會面（見"湖上堡"）。

english: The {@creature drow scout|OotA} Xalith approaches the Stone Guards, claiming the characters as escaped property of her mistress, Ilvara (see "Signs of Pursuit" in the "Blade Bazaar" section). The Stone Guards arrest the characters and take them to Overlake Hold, pending negotiations with the drow. At this point, they also meet Captain Errde Blackskull.
zh_tw: {@creature drow scout|OotA|卓爾斥候} 札莉絲接近岩石衛隊，聲稱這些角色是她主人伊爾瓦拉（見"刀刃市集"部分中的"追擊跡象"）的逃走財產。岩石衛隊逮捕了這些角色並將他們帶到湖上堡，等待與卓爾族的談判。此時，他們還遇到了艾德·黑顱隊長。

english: {@creature Droki|OotA} (see "{@creature Droki|OotA}" in the "Blade Bazaar" section) accidentally bumps into the patrol, creating a distraction that allows the characters to escape.
zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}（見"刀刃市集"章節中的'{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}'）意外地撞到了巡邏隊，製造了一個幹擾，讓角色們有機會逃脫。

english: A successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check convinces the Stone Guards not to arrest the characters, provided the characters agree to visit Overlake Hold once their business in Gracklstugh is concluded. The party remains under watch at all times by an {@condition invisible} {@creature duergar Stone Guard|MTF}(see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}). If it seems like the characters have done what they came to do, the {@condition invisible} duergar reminds them to make good on their promise to visit Overlake Hold.
zh_tw: 一次成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定可以說服岩石衛隊不逮捕角色，前提是角色同意在格拉克斯圖格的業務結束後前往湖上堡壘。團隊始終受到一個 {@condition invisible||隱形} 的 {@creature duergar Stone Guard|MTF|灰矮人岩石守衛} 的監視（參見 {@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）。如果角色似乎已經完成了他們來此的目的，{@condition invisible||隱形} 的杜爾加會提醒他們履行承諾前往湖上堡壘。

english: Blade Bazaar
zh_tw: 刀刃市集

english: This marketplace is named after the most abundant goods the duergar offer, but the shops here sell almost everything available in the city, along with stalls set up by visiting merchants. The din of people arguing, mostly in Dwarvish, nearly drowns out the hammering coming from the city's forges, and the crowds here offer a good chance to slip away from pursuers.
zh_tw: 這個市場以灰矮人提供的最豐富的商品命名，但這裡的商店幾乎出售城市中所有可用的商品，還有由來訪商人設立的攤位。人們爭論的聲音，主要是矮人語，幾乎淹沒了來自城市鍛造廠的敲打聲，而這裡的擁擠人群提供了一個逃離追蹤者的好機會。

english: Characters can unload some of the treasures they might be carrying. Nonmagical weapons, armor, and shields can be purchased in the Blade Bazaar.
zh_tw: 角色們可以卸下他們可能攜帶的一些財寶。在刀刃市集可以購買到非魔法武器、盔甲和盾牌。

english: Merchant Madness
zh_tw: 商人瘋狂

english: Characters who look around the bazaar notice a number of odd things:
zh_tw: 四處張望市場的角色注意到一些奇怪的事情：

english: A duergar merchant can't stop insulting customers when they are trying to sell something, but becomes a picture of politeness when they want to buy.
zh_tw: 一個灰矮人商人在嘗試賣東西時無法停止侮辱顧客，但在他們想要購買時卻變得非常禮貌。

english: A number of duergar merchants give different prices to buy or sell every time they are asked about the same items, and insist that the characters dealing with them are the ones changing their terms.
zh_tw: 一些灰矮人商人每次被問及相同物品的買賣價格時，都會給出不同的價格，並堅稱是與他們打交道的角色在改變他們的條件。

english: A duergar merchant suddenly turns {@condition invisible} in the middle of a transaction, but keeps speaking as if nothing has happened.
zh_tw: 一個灰矮人商人在交易過程中突然變得{@condition invisible||隱形}，但仍然繼續說話，好像什麼都沒有發生一樣。

english: A duergar merchant threatens to kill the characters as a haggling technique, then denies ever saying so.
zh_tw: 一位灰矮人商人以威脅要殺死角色作為討價還價的技巧，隨後否認自己曾說過這樣的話。

english: A duergar merchant constantly asks the opinion of a nonexistent twin brother, claiming that he is {@condition invisible}.
zh_tw: 一位灰矮人商人不斷地詢問一個不存在的雙胞胎兄弟的意見，聲稱他是{@condition invisible||隱形}。

english: Ylsa's Deal
zh_tw: 伊爾莎的交易

english: Ylsa Henstak is a female duergar member of the Merchant Council. She's a canny caravan master and prides herself on always arriving at her destination ahead of schedule. If the characters ask around for merchants who know how to reach the surface, they are directed to Ylsa. Though she has no caravans scheduled anytime soon, she does make the characters an offer.
zh_tw: 伊爾莎·亨斯塔克 是商議會中的一位女性灰矮人成員。她是一位精明的商隊首領，並且自豪於總是能提前到達目的地。如果角色們詢問知道如何到達地表的商人，他們會被指引到 伊爾莎。儘管她近期沒有安排任何商隊，但她確實給角色們提供了一個提議。

english: Ylsa invites the characters into her well-guarded office, where she shows them a pile of coins and jewelry from all over the surface world. The hoard consists of 80 gp in mixed coinage, three gold rings worth 25 gp each, and two gem-inlaid necklaces worth 250 gp each. She has tracked the pieces to derro, who use them to pay for food. If the characters can figure out how the derro are getting surface currency and jewelry, Ylsa will provide the adventurers with directions for at least the next stage of their journey, including valuable advice on routes to Blingdenstone (see {@adventure chapter 6|OotA|5}) and the Wormwrithings (see {@adventure chapter 12|OotA|11}).
zh_tw: 伊爾莎邀請角色們進入她守衛森嚴的辦公室，在那裡她向他們展示了一堆來自地表世界的硬幣和珠寶。這個寶藏包括80金幣的混合貨幣，三個每個價值25金幣的金戒指，以及兩個鑲嵌寶石的項鍊，每個價值250金幣。她追蹤到這些財寶是迪洛矮人使用的，他們用這些來支付食物。如果角色們能夠弄清楚迪洛矮人是如何獲得地表貨幣和珠寶的，伊爾莎將為冒險家們提供至少下一階段旅程的指引，包括前往布靈登石城（見{@adventure 第六章|OotA|5}）和蠕蟲扭道（見{@adventure 第十二章|OotA|11}）的寶貴建議。

english: Droki
zh_tw: 卓奇

english: Attentive characters can spot a curious figure darting between the stalls and shops of the Blade Bazaar. Every time they roam the market, they have a 20 percent chance to see a derro dressed in rags styled as an imitation of a fancy jacket, wearing a wide-brimmed hat with two tentacles from a displacer beast sewn into the hat's crown. A large satchel hangs from his shoulder, and he's always muttering to himself.
zh_tw: 細心的角色可以在刀刃市集的攤位和商店之間發現一個奇怪的人物。每當他們在市場閒逛時，有20%的機率看到一個穿著破爛的迪洛矮人，他穿著模仿花哨夾克的破布，戴著一頂寬邊帽，帽子的頂部縫著兩個從移位獸身上取下來的觸手。他的肩上掛著一個大袋子，總是自言自語。

english: Duergar merchants glare scornfully at this derro, and none will discuss him with the characters. If a character asks about him in the Ghohlbrorn's Lair, a successful {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check yields up the name "{@creature Droki|OotA}," and identifies the wily derro as a courier and supplier of goods who works for disreputable employers.
zh_tw: 灰矮商人對這個迪洛矮人投以輕蔑的目光，且無人願意和角色們討論他。如果角色在戈爾布隆巢穴中詢問關於他的事情，一次成功的 {@dc 12} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定可得到名字"{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}"，並認出這個狡猾的迪洛矮人是一名信使和貨物供應商，為不光彩的僱主工作。

english: Catching {@creature Droki|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) is the objective of quests from Errde Blackskull (see "Overlake Hold") and Gartokkar Xundorn (see "{@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s Lair"), but if the characters pursue the courier openly, he flees for the West Cleft District. Pursuing characters quickly lose sight of the derro as he vanishes into the crowd. See "Finding {@creature Droki|OotA}" in the "Whorlstone Tunnels" section for more information on what {@creature Droki|OotA} is carrying if the characters catch him.
zh_tw: 捕捉{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）是艾德·黑顱（見"湖上堡"）和加爾托卡·桑多恩（見"{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的巢穴"）的任務目標，但如果角色們公開追蹤信使，他會逃往西裂谷區。追蹤的角色們很快就在人群中失去了迪洛矮人的蹤跡。有關角色們如果抓住他，{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}攜帶了什麼的更多資訊，請見"渦石隧道"部分中的"尋找{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}"。

english: Chasing Droki
zh_tw: 追逐卓奇

english: If the characters decide to wait for {@creature Droki|OotA} to enter the West Cleft or somehow follow him here, use the chase rules in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Chases} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, adapting the results for urban complications to a cave full of hateful derro. If {@creature Droki|OotA} loses them, the characters must resort to less convenient means of finding the Whorlstone Tunnels.
zh_tw: 如果角色們決定等待{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}進入西裂隙或設法跟隨他來到這裡，請使用{@book 城主指南|DMG}中的{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Chases}規則，並將城市複雜環境調整為充滿仇恨的迪洛矮人洞穴。如果{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}甩掉了他們，角色們將不得不採用不太方便的方法來尋找渦石隧道。

english: If the characters do manage to catch {@creature Droki|OotA} in the West Cleft, he drops limp and babbles, but is suspiciously amenable and shows the characters the entrance to the tunnels. See the "Whorlstone Tunnels" section for how to roleplay {@creature Droki|OotA}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們確實在西裂谷區成功抓住了{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}，他會癱軟下來並胡言亂語，但出人意料地順從，並帶領角色們找到通往隧道的入口。關於如何扮演{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}，請見"渦石隧道"部分。

english: Signs of Pursuit
zh_tw: 追擊的跡象

english: If the characters arrive in Gracklstugh with a drow pursuit level of 3 or higher (see "{@area Drow Pursuit|078|x}" in chapter 2), Ilvara has already sent a party ahead of them, guessing correctly that the escaped prisoners might seek refuge with the duergar.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在到達格拉克斯圖格時，卓爾追擊等級達到3或更高（見第2章中的"{@area 卓爾追擊|078|x}"），伊爾瓦拉已經派了一隊人馬先行一步，正確猜測逃脫的囚犯可能會尋求灰矮人的庇護。

english: Characters with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 15 or higher spot six {@creature drow} watching them in the Blade Bazaar. One of them is Xalith Masq'il'yr, a female drow allied with House Mizzrym. Any of the party's NPC companions who know the duergar well can guess that these drow won't want to attract the duergar's attention to their "lost property." Doing so would likely involve having to pay the gray dwarves a reward for the adventurers' capture. This gives the characters a chance to evade their pursuers, but they need to stay out of sight.
zh_tw: 被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）值為15或更高的角色會在刀刃市集發現六名{@creature drow||卓爾}正在注視著他們。其中一位是札莉絲·瑪斯奎伊爾，一位與米茲瑞姆家族結盟的女性卓爾。任何瞭解灰矮人的隊伍NPC同伴都可以推測，這些卓爾並不希望將灰矮人的注意力吸引到他們的"遺失財物"上。這樣做很可能會迫使灰矮人要求對捕獲的冒險者進行獎勵。這為角色們提供了一個機會來擺脫追捕者，但他們需要保持隱蔽。

english: Xalith speaks to the duergar only if the characters are arrested. Otherwise, she sends a messenger to Ilvara and makes sure the characters don't go anywhere without her knowing. If the characters fail to lose themselves in the city (see "{@area Gracklstugh and Drow Pursuit|136|x}" earlier in this chapter), their pursuit level increases by 1 every {@dice 1d4} days until Ilvara arrives.
zh_tw: 札莉絲只在角色被捕時與灰矮人交談。否則，她會派一個信使去伊爾瓦拉那裡，並確保角色們在沒有她知情的情況下不會去任何地方。如果角色們未能在城市中隱匿自己（見本章前面的"格拉克斯圖格和卓爾追擊{@area 格拉克斯圖格與卓爾追擊|136|x}"），他們的追擊等級每{@dice 1d4}天就會增加1，直到伊爾瓦拉到達。

english: Alternatively, the adventurers might decide to turn the tables on the drow. Characters might figure out a way to quietly neutralize Xalith and her squad, perhaps tricking them into damaging a duergar merchant's property or forcing them outside Darklake District, where even drow are forbidden to go. Doing so decreases the pursuit level by 2. However, if combat ever breaks out between the characters and the drow, a squad of five {@creature Duergar Stone Guard|MTF|duergar stone guards} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) and five {@creature duergar} warriors arrive within {@dice 1d4} rounds and arrest the lot of them (see "Getting Captured").
zh_tw: 另外，冒險者們可能決定扭轉局面對抗卓爾。角色們可能會想出一種方法來悄無聲息地使札莉絲和她的小隊失去作用，或許透過誘使他們破壞灰矮人商人的財產，或迫使他們走出黑暗湖區域，在那裡即使是卓爾也禁止進入。這樣做會將追擊等級降低2。然而，如果角色們和卓爾之間爆發戰鬥，一隊五個{@creature Duergar Stone Guard|MTF|灰矮人岩石守衛}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）和五個{@creature duergar||灰矮人}戰士將在{@dice 1d4}回合內到達並將他們全部逮捕（見"被捕"）。

english: Darklake Brewery
zh_tw: 黑暗湖釀酒廠

english: This huge, ramshackle brewery is built of stone blocks stacked to make walls between the {@condition petrified} stems of a small forest of gigantic mushrooms. Big copper vats steam within, filling the air with a heavy, yeasty stink. Dozens of copper kegs stand nearby, and burly gray dwarves swarm over the place, mashing fungus, mixing fermenting masses, and filling casks with freshly brewed ale. This complex is the workplace and home of Clan Muzgardt, the duergar clan in charge of brewing Darklake Stout and in control of the brewing and importation of other spirits. Non-duergar aren't welcome inside the brewery.
zh_tw: 這座巨大的、搖搖欲墜的釀酒廠由石塊堆砌而成，坐落在一片由巨型蘑菇組成的小森林中，牆壁間夾雜著{@condition petrified||石化}的蘑菇莖。內部的大銅槽冒著蒸汽，空氣中瀰漫著濃烈的酵母味。旁邊擺放著數十個銅製酒桶，強壯的灰矮人在這裡忙碌地工作，他們搗碎真菌、混合發酵物，並將新鮮釀造的麥酒裝入木桶中。這個建築群是穆茲加德特氏族的工作場所和家園，該氏族負責釀造黑暗湖黑啤酒，並管理其他酒類的釀造和進口。非灰矮人不允許進入釀酒廠。

english: Darklake Docks
zh_tw: 黑暗湖碼頭

english: These busy docks are used primarily by flat-bottomed rafts made of zurkhwood and lacquered puffball floats. Some of these ramshackle barges come with oars or paddle wheels. The rafts look ungainly, but each can carry tons of trade goods.
zh_tw: 這些繁忙的碼頭主要用於由祖克木製成的平底筏和漆過的蘑菇浮筒。一些破舊的駁船配有槳或槳輪。這些筏看起來笨拙，但每艘都能承載數噸的貿易貨物。

english: The characters land at the easternmost inlet if they arrive at Gracklstugh by way of the Darklake, near the Ghohlbrorn's Lair inn. If they instead arrived through a gate and successfully bribed Gorglak, they might come here looking for his contact, Werz Saltbaron.
zh_tw: 如果角色們透過黑暗湖到達格拉克斯圖格，他們會在最東邊的入海口登陸，靠近戈爾布隆巢穴旅館。如果他們透過傳送門到達，並且成功賄賂了戈格拉克，他們可能會來到這裡尋找他的聯絡人沃茲·鹽爵。

english: Assassins Interrupted
zh_tw: 刺客被打斷

english: The characters spot a male duergar merchant at the end of a pier. Suddenly, two {@condition invisible} duergar appear next to him and stab him viciously with glowing swords. The assassins' faces are masked and hooded. The characters have 2 rounds to distract the two {@creature Duergar Soulblade|MTF|duergar soulblades} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) before they finish off the merchant.
zh_tw: 角色們在碼頭盡頭發現了一個男性灰矮人商人。突然，兩個{@condition invisible||隱形}灰矮人出現在他旁邊，用發光的劍狠狠地刺他。刺客們戴著面具和兜帽。角色們有2輪時間分散這兩個{@creature Duergar Soulblade|MTF|灰矮人魂刃使}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）的注意力，否則他們將殺死商人。

english: The merchant is Werz Saltbaron. If the characters save him, he is grudgingly grateful and says he has no idea why the assassins targeted him. A successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check suggests he's lying. He flees the scene, but not before telling the characters to meet him at the Shattered Spire the following day so he can reward them properly.
zh_tw: 商人是沃茲·鹽爵。如果角色們救了他，他勉強表示感激，並說他不知道刺客為何以他為目標。一個成功的 {@dc 12} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定表明他在撒謊。他逃離了現場，但在離開前告訴角色們第二天在碎裂尖塔與他見面，以便他能夠適當地獎勵他們。

english: The characters have 1 minute to search the assassins before a patrol of four {@creature duergar} arrives. The glowing weapons wielded by the assassins are nowhere to be found, but one of the assassins has a piece of fish-skin parchment bearing Werz's likeness drawn in charcoal.
zh_tw: 角色們有1分鐘的時間來搜尋刺客，之後一隊由四個{@creature duergar||灰矮人}組成的巡邏隊就會到達。刺客所持的發光武器已經無處可尋，但其中一名刺客身上有一張用炭筆描繪了沃茲肖像的魚皮羊皮紙。

english: Access to the Whorlstone Tunnels
zh_tw: 進入渦石隧道的通道

english: Hidden next to the easternmost pier, a disabled drainage pipe is the Gray Ghosts' access point to a secret cavern system beneath Gracklstugh (see "Whorlstone Tunnels"). It takes a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to notice the pipe beneath piles of refuse. Within, loose bars block the 5-foot-wide passage, but removing them activates an alarm that warns the Gray Ghosts inside the caverns. A character can notice the alarm's trigger—a thin wire connected to the top of one of the bars—with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, and can disable it with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity check using thieves' tools.
zh_tw: 隱藏在最東端的碼頭旁邊，一條廢棄的排水管是灰鬼通往格拉克斯圖格地下秘密洞穴系統的入口（參見"渦渦石隧道"）。需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能注意到垃圾堆下的管道。管道內，鬆動的鐵條擋住了5尺寬的通道，但移除它們會觸發警報，警告洞穴內的灰鬼。角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 14} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定注意到觸發警報的機制——一根連線到其中一個鐵條頂部的細線，並可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 12} 敏捷檢定使用盜賊工具來解除它。

english: Nearly 100 feet into the pipe, a hatch on the floor opens into a rough-hewn well. A ladder extends down 80 feet to another hatch on the floor, which leads to area 8 in the Whorlstone Tunnels.
zh_tw: 在管道內近100尺處，地板上的一個艙口通向一個粗糙的井。一個梯子向下延伸80尺，通向另一個地板上的艙口，這個艙口通往渦石隧道區域8。

english: Overlake Hold
zh_tw: 湖上堡

english: Dunglorrin Torune, which translates as Overlake Hold, is a fortress and temple dedicated to Laduguer carved into the heart of a massive stalagmite on the shore of the Darklake. It is also the home of the Deepking and the center of government. Dunglorrin Torune bristles with forge chimneys from which smoke billows and ledges from which catapults can hurl stones at waterborne invaders. (If necessary, use the mangonel statistics in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Siege Equipment} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.)
zh_tw: 東洛林·託魯尼，意為"湖上堡"，是一座要塞兼神廟，供奉著拉杜格爾，它被雕刻在黑暗湖岸邊一根巨大的石筍中心。它也是深王的住所和政府中心。東洛林·託魯尼佈滿了鍛造煙囪，煙囪中煙霧滾滾，還有可以從投石機上向水上入侵者投擲石塊的突出巖壁。（如有必要，使用{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Siege Equipment}（選自{@book 城主指南|DMG}）中的投石機資料。）

english: Conscripted by the Stone Guard
zh_tw: 被石衛徵召

english: If the characters are arrested, they are taken to the hold's dungeons, where they receive a chance to earn their freedom by serving the Stone Guard.
zh_tw: 如果角色們被捕，他們將被帶到要塞的地牢，在那裡他們有機會透過為石衛服務來贏得自由。

english: After waiting a long while in a dungeon cell carved out of impressively thick stone, you are taken to a dark office and met by an imposing female gray dwarf. She is fully armored and bears an insignia you have not seen on any other duergar. She is flanked by two Stone Guards who remain by the door.
zh_tw: 在由極其厚重的石頭雕琢而成的地牢牢房裡等待良久之後，你被帶進一間陰暗的辦公室，迎面遇見的是一位威嚴的女性灰矮人。她渾身披甲，佩戴著你從未在其他灰矮人身上見過的徽記。兩名留在門邊的岩石衛隊兵護衛在她兩側。

english: "I am Captain Errde Blackskull, commander of the Stone Guard," she says, giving each of you a calculating look. "Let me start by saying you are worth nothing here in Gracklstugh. Most of those in my command would sell you off in a heartbeat as the cheapest manual labor. However, I've learned to make much better use of adventurers like you."
zh_tw: "我是艾德·黑顱隊長，石衛隊的指揮官，"她說，用一種計算的眼神打量著你們每一個人。"讓我先說明，在格拉克斯圖格，你們一文不值。在我的指揮下，大多數人會毫不猶豫地把你們當作最便宜的勞力賣掉。然而，我已經學會了如何更好地利用像你們這樣的冒險者。"

english: Search for Droki
zh_tw: 尋找卓奇

english: Errde explains that her guards have been tracking the movements of a derro named {@creature Droki|OotA}. Despite his presence in the Darklake District, the derro has managed to avoid capture, as if he somehow knows in advance where the duergar patrols will be—{@condition invisible} or otherwise. All the Stone Guards know is that {@creature Droki|OotA} lives in the West Cleft District, a place the duergar enter only in force and where their presence would likely provoke a chaotic uprising. Errde wants the characters to follow {@creature Droki|OotA}, see what he does and where he goes, and report back. Or if they see an opportunity, seize him and either bring him in for questioning, or kill him and bring back evidence of his activities.
zh_tw: 艾德解釋說，她的守衛一直在追蹤一個名叫{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}的迪洛矮人。儘管他在黑暗湖區域出現，但這個迪洛矮人設法避免了被捕，就好像他提前知道灰矮人巡邏隊會出現在哪裡一樣，無論是{@condition invisible||隱形}還是其他方式。所有岩石衛隊所知道的是{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}住在西裂谷區，這是一個灰矮人只有在大部隊的情況下才會進入的地方，而他們的存在很可能會激起一場混亂的起義。艾德希望角色們跟蹤{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}，看看他做了什麼，去了哪裡，並回報。或者如果他們看到一個機會，抓住他，要麼帶他回來審問，要麼殺了他並帶回他活動的證據。

english: Errde's tone turns dark as she voices her suspicions that {@creature Droki|OotA} is linked to a conspiracy involving the Council of Savants, and maybe even elements among the clan lairds. She describes in detail how discovering the conspiracy and purging the corrupt will earn her great favor with the Deepking. Errde swears (truthfully) that she will arrange for the characters to get safe passage out of Gracklstugh if they do as she asks.
zh_tw: 艾德的語氣變得陰沉，她表達了她的懷疑，認為{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}與涉及智者議會的陰謀有關，甚至可能與家族首領中的一些元素有關。她詳細描述了如何發現陰謀並清除腐敗分子將為她贏得深王的極大青睞。艾德發誓（真實地）如果角色們按照她的要求去做，她會安排他們安全地離開格拉克斯圖格。

english: Search for Corruption
zh_tw: 尋找腐敗

english: Errde's suspicions of conspiracy have her looking for signs of corruption creeping among the people of Gracklstugh. She rewards the characters if they bring her evidence of such corruption that has escaped the eyes of her warriors. The characters can build a case if they witness odd events throughout Gracklstugh, such as some of the random encounters and the behavior of merchants in the Blade Bazaar. For every three such events they report, the characters can attempt a {@dc 15} group Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, but they only need to succeed once to convince Errde and complete this quest. Errde then promises to outfit the characters with supplies and gear when they leave Gracklstugh, from the Stone Guards' own armory. Each character can claim a total of 350 gp worth of equipment, including weapons, armor, and common potions and scrolls.
zh_tw: 艾德的懷疑使她認為在格拉克斯圖格人民中潛藏著腐敗的跡象。如果角色們能提供她戰士們未曾注意到的腐敗證據，她將給予獎勵。如果角色們在格拉克斯圖格各地目擊到奇怪的事件，比如一些隨機遭遇和刀刃市集商人的行為，他們可以構建一個案件。每報告三起這樣的事件，角色們可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 15}群體魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，但他們只需成功一次即可說服艾德並完成此任務。艾德隨後承諾在角色們離開格拉克斯圖格時，從岩石衛隊自己的軍械庫中為他們提供補給和裝備。每個角色可以領取總價值350金幣的裝備，包括武器、盔甲以及常見的藥劑和卷軸。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters refuse Errde's offer after being arrested, they spend a few days imprisoned and then are sold back to the drow. Xalith and her squad meet up with Ilvara and then return to Velkynvelve, if the characters can't manage to escape from their captors.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在被捕後拒絕艾德的提議，他們將被監禁幾天，然後被賣回給卓爾。札莉絲和她的小組與伊爾瓦拉會合，然後返回到維爾京維爾夫，如果角色們不能設法從他們的捕獲者那裡逃脫。

english: If the characters accept Errde's offer, she gives them insignias allowing them to move as far south as Laduguer's Furrow without being accosted by guards. The adventurers need only to show the insignias discreetly when confronted, and should keep them hidden otherwise. They are then released without fanfare. Errde knows about the stone giants' invitation if the characters spared the two-headed giant's life, and advises the characters to heed it before looking for {@creature Droki|OotA}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們接受了艾德的提議，她會給他們徽章，允許他們向南移動到拉杜格溝壑而不被守衛攔截。冒險家們只需要在被質問時謹慎地展示這些徽章，並在其他時候保持隱藏。然後他們將無聲無息地被釋放。艾德知道如果角色們饒了雙頭巨人的生命，石巨人的邀請，她建議角色們在尋找{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}之前聽從這個邀請。

english: The characters' pursuit level is reduced to 0 and remains so while they are in Errde's employ inside Gracklstugh. If they end their employment, the Stone Guards stop covering for them and their pursuit level increases as normal if Xalith is in town (see "Signs of Pursuit" in the "Blade Bazaar" section). Otherwise, it remains at 0 until some other action raises it again.
zh_tw: 角色們的追擊等級降至0，並在他們在格拉克斯圖格為艾德工作期間保持不變。如果他們結束僱傭關係，岩石衛隊隊將不再為他們掩護，如果札莉絲在城裡（見"刀刃市集"部分中的"追擊跡象"），他們的追擊等級將按正常情況增加。否則，它將保持在0，直到其他行動再次提高它。

english: The Shattered Spire
zh_tw: 破碎的尖塔

english: A broken stalagmite juts out from the Darklake about forty feet from the shore, forming the foundation of a tavern built with fungi stalks in a manner similar to a log cabin. A bridge woven of rothé wool allows patrons to cross the water to visit.
zh_tw: 一個斷裂的石筍從黑暗湖中伸出，距離岸邊大約四十尺，形成了一個以蘑菇莖建造的酒館的基礎，建造方式類似於木屋。一座由洛斯獸羊毛編織的橋讓顧客可以過水來訪。

english: Meeting Werz
zh_tw: 遇見沃茲

english: If the characters rescued Werz Saltbaron from the assassins (see "Darklake Docks"), he meets them at the Shattered Spire at the designated date and time. As modest thanks for saving him, he gives each character an obsidian gemstone worth 10 gp. He then offers them a job, delivering a sack full of raw gemstones (worth 100 gp total) to a svirfneblin named Kazook Pickshine in Blingdenstone, no questions asked.
zh_tw: 如果角色們從刺客手中救出了沃茲·鹽爵（見"黑暗湖碼頭"），他會在約定的日期和時間在破碎尖塔與他們見面。作為對他救命之恩的微薄感謝，他給每個角色一個價值10金幣的黑曜石寶石。然後，他為他們提供了一份工作，將一袋生寶石（總共價值100金幣）送到布靈登石城，交給一個名叫卡祖克·閃鎬的地底侏儒那裡，不問任何問題。

english: {@creature Jimjar|OotA}, {@creature Topsy|OotA}, and {@creature Turvy|OotA} know of Kazook Pickshine and can provide basic information about the gnome alchemist (see {@adventure chapter 6|OotA|5}). The deep gnomes also recognize that Werz's gems resemble empty {@i spell gems}, similar to those used in the defense of Blingdenstone. The gems, mundane in their current form, are actually raw stones used in the crafting of {@i spell gems}. Werz met Kazook in Mantol-Derith (see {@adventure chapter 9|OotA|8}), and the two have been trading recently behind their superiors' backs. He declines to mention this, though, deflecting any questions by mentioning that Blingdenstone is a good place to find a way out of the Underdark.
zh_tw: {@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}、{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西}和{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}知道卡祖克·閃鎬，並能提供有關這位侏儒鍊金術士的基本資訊（見{@adventure 第六章|OotA|5}）。這些地底侏儒也認出沃茲的寶石看起來像空的{@i 法術寶石}，類似於用於布靈登石城防禦的那些。這些寶石在目前的形式下是普通的，實際上是用於製作{@i 法術寶石}的原始石頭。沃茲在曼塔-岱瑞絲（見{@adventure 第九章|OotA|8}）遇到了卡祖克，兩人最近一直在背後與上級進行交易。然而，他拒絕提及這一點，透過提到布靈登石城是找到離開幽暗地域的好地方來轉移任何問題。

english: Bar Fight
zh_tw: 酒吧打鬥

english: While the characters are in the tavern, two {@creature duergar} who had been just talking business suddenly fly into a rage and start brawling. If the characters don't intervene to stop the fight, other patrons do. No guards appear unless weapons or spells come out, and the fight stops as soon as any of the brawlers is {@condition restrained} or knocked {@condition unconscious}. Neither of the duergar remember why they started fighting.
zh_tw: 當角色們在酒館中時，兩名原本正在談生意的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}突然暴怒並開始鬥毆。如果角色們不介入制止打鬥，其他顧客會出手。除非使用武器或法術，否則不會有衛兵出現，當任何鬥毆者被{@condition restrained||束縛}或被擊{@condition unconscious||昏迷}時，打鬥就會停止。兩名灰矮人都不記得他們為何開始打架。

english: The Ghohlbrorn's Lair
zh_tw: 戈爾布隆巢穴

english: This inn is the only establishment in Gracklstugh that accepts non-duergar guests. "Ghohlbrorn" means "bulette" in Dwarvish, and the inn is built inside a small cavern complex beneath the Blade Bazaar at the northern end of the Darklake District. Its halls are cold and damp. A central chamber serves as a dining room, branching out into different small, twisting halls along which the rooms are excavated. It's dark, cramped, and uncomfortable, but safe and defensible.
zh_tw: 這家旅館是格拉克斯圖格唯一接受非灰矮人客人的設施。'戈爾布隆'在矮人語中意為'鯊蜥獸'，旅館建在黑暗湖區域北部刀刃市集下的一個小型洞穴群內。它的走廊又冷又潮溼。一箇中央大廳作為餐廳，分叉成不同的小而曲折的走廊，沿著這些走廊挖掘出房間。這裡黑暗、狹窄、不舒適，但安全且易於防守。

english: Rumor Mill
zh_tw: 謠言工廠

english: The inn's dining hall gives characters a chance to mingle with non-duergar who are visiting Gracklstugh. Characters seeking information can, with a successful {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) or Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, find out the following information, or you can simply roleplay their interactions with random patrons.
zh_tw: 旅店的餐廳為角色們提供了與訪問格拉克斯圖格的非灰矮人交流的機會。尋找資訊的角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）或智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，獲得以下資訊，或者你可以簡單地扮演他們與隨機顧客的互動。

english: The general gist of the information is that trade routes out of Gracklstugh have become more dangerous recently. The fauna and more primitive denizens of the Underdark are all riled up about something. Among the tales told by the travelers, second-hand stories about demons attacking isolated settlements are common.
zh_tw: 這些資訊的大致意思是，最近從格拉克斯圖格出發的貿易路線變得更加危險。幽暗地域的動物和更原始的居民都因為某些事情而變得激動。在旅行者講述的故事中，關於惡魔襲擊孤立定居點的二手故事很常見。

english: Laduguer's Furrow
zh_tw: 拉杜格溝壑

english: Long ago, an earthquake split the cavern that houses Gracklstugh, leaving a rift nearly two hundred feet deep and five hundred feet wide. Laduguer's Furrow has a packed-gravel floor and extends roughly a quarter mile beyond the natural walls of the city in both directions. Each end of the rift has a steeply sloping floor, carved with a set of stairs and a wide ramp for both pedestrians and wagons. Vents along the walls release potent gases that sappers of Clan Xardelvar tap for industrial applications, including the crafting of the magical flame lances used by xarrorn warriors.
zh_tw: 很久以前，一次地震撕裂了容納格拉克斯圖格的洞穴，留下了一個近兩百尺深、五百尺寬的裂縫。拉杜格溝壑有一個壓實的礫石地面，並且大致向城市自然牆的兩個方向延伸了四分之一英里。裂縫的每個末端都有一個陡峭的斜坡地面，上面刻有一組樓梯和一條供行人和馬車使用的寬闊坡道。沿著牆壁的通風口釋放出強烈的氣體，札德爾瓦家族的挖掘者們為工業應用而開發這些氣體，包括製造火矛戰士戰士使用的魔法火焰長矛。

english: The chasm is Gracklstugh's main residential zone, with homes built on the top part of its north and south sides. Outsiders are normally forbidden from this area.
zh_tw: 裂谷是格拉克斯圖格的主要居住區，房屋建在其南北兩側的頂部。外人通常被禁止進入這個區域。

english: Abandoned Guardhouses
zh_tw: 廢棄的警衛室

english: Near the western gate of Laduguer's Furrow, the duergar built a series of guardhouses to keep an eye on derro slaves living in the West Cleft. These were abandoned when Deepking Tarngardt, grandfather of the current monarch, liberated the derro, allowing them to spread from the West Cleft District into the East Cleft District. The guardhouses now stand empty, providing an ideal place to lie low and keep an eye on traffic in and out of the eastern derro boroughs.
zh_tw: 在拉杜格溝壑渠的西大門附近，灰矮人建造了一系列警衛屋，用以監視居住在西裂谷的迪洛矮人奴隸。當深王塔恩加德特——即現任君主的祖父——解放了迪洛矮人，允許他們從西裂谷區擴散到東裂谷區時，這些警衛屋就被廢棄了。現在這些警衛屋空無一人，為低調潛伏並監視進出東部迪洛矮人區的交通提供了一個理想之地。

english: Great Gates
zh_tw: 宏偉之門

english: The openings that Laduguer's Furrow creates in the walls of Gracklstugh's cavern are blocked by massive structures of bars and scaffolding, each set with several gates. Gates are guarded by two visible {@creature duergar} soldiers and {@dice 1d4 + 3} {@condition invisible} ones.
zh_tw: 拉杜格溝壑在格拉克斯圖格洞穴的牆壁上創造的開口被巨大的欄杆和腳手架結構所阻擋，每扇門都有幾個門。每扇門由兩名可見的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}士兵和{@dice 1d4 + 3}名{@condition invisible||隱形}的士兵守衛。

english: West Cleft and East Cleft Districts
zh_tw: 西裂谷和東裂谷區

english: East and west of Laduguer's Furrow gates are areas that serve as home to Gracklstugh's unwanted derro population. The West Cleft District was the original abode for the city's derro slaves and remains a dark and dangerous ghetto. The East Cleft District was more recently settled after the derro earned their freedom, though it is only slightly less rough than West Cleft.
zh_tw: 拉杜格溝壑東邊和西邊的大門區域是格拉克斯圖格不受歡迎的迪洛矮人人的家園。西裂谷區最初是城市迪洛矮人奴隸的居住地，至今仍然是一個黑暗且危險貧民區。東裂谷區是在迪洛矮人獲得自由後較近期才定居的，儘管它只比西裂谷稍微不那麼粗糙。

english: The homes of the derro are mostly burrows carved into the walls and simple structures piled atop one another. The dirty and cluttered streets of both districts formed as dwellings spread and came together, and not as a product of planning. The derro population is much greater and their tunnels extend much farther than the duergar believe. The derro are close to mounting an insurrection, held back only by their own lack of organization and by their leaders in the Council of Savants having grown too used to their privileges to foment rebellion.
zh_tw: 迪洛矮人的住所大多是在牆壁上挖掘的洞穴和簡單堆疊在一起的結構。兩個區域的街道都髒亂不堪，這是因為住所擴散並聚集在一起而形成的，而不是規劃的產物。迪洛矮人的人口數量要大得多，他們的隧道也比灰矮人認為的延伸得更遠。迪洛矮人即將發動起義，只是由於他們自身缺乏組織，以及他們在智者議會的領袖們已經過於習慣他們的特權，不願煽動叛亂而被阻止。

english: Entering Derro Territory
zh_tw: 進入迪洛矮人領地

english: The derro are automatically hostile toward anyone entering their warrens, especially surfacers.
zh_tw: 迪洛矮人對任何進入他們巢穴的人，特別是地表居民，都會自動錶現出敵意。

english: As you pass through the gates, the stench in the air changes from acrid and metallic to fetid and repugnant, the fires of industry replaced by squalor. The homes in this part of Gracklstugh are crudely carved from the rock or are just holes in the walls, arranged in no apparent order. The chatter in the air is unnerving, with hundreds of derro muttering, screaming at each other, and otherwise reveling in their insanity. Those who spot you look at you with a burning hatred.
zh_tw: 當你們穿過大門時，空氣中的氣味從辛辣和金屬味變為惡臭和令人厭惡，工業的火焰被骯髒所取代。格拉克斯圖格這一部分的房屋是從岩石中粗略雕刻而成，或者僅僅是牆壁上的洞，沒有明顯的順序。空氣中的喋喋不休令人不安，成百上千的迪洛矮人在喃喃自語、互相尖叫，以及以其他方式沉浸在他們的瘋狂中。那些注意到你的人帶著燃燒的仇恨看著你。

english: At the end of each hour the adventurers stay inside either derro area, there is a 25 percent chance that {@dice 2d4} {@creature derro|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) attack without warning. If the characters kill any derro, the chance of another attack becomes 50 percent every half hour.
zh_tw: 冒險者在任一迪洛矮人區域內每停留一小時結束時，有25%的機率遭遇{@dice 2d4}只{@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）無預警攻擊。若角色殺死任何迪洛矮人，後續攻擊機率將變為每半小時50%。

english: Sneaking through the senseless arrangement of the burrows is relatively easy, as the derro are normally too preoccupied with their own mad scheming to notice a group trying not to attract attention. The characters can attempt a {@dc 10} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check, with success negating the need to roll for a possible attack at the end of each hour or half hour.
zh_tw: 在穿越這些毫無章法的洞穴時，潛行相對容易，因為迪洛矮人通常過於專注於自己的瘋狂計劃，而不會注意到一群試圖不引起注意的人。角色可以嘗試進行一次 {@dc 10} 群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，成功則無需在每小時或每半小時結束時為可能的攻擊投擲骰子。

english: Other means of subterfuge such as illusions, climbing along the walls, or using flying or levitation magic automatically avoid detection, but invisibility of any kind activates magical wards placed by derro savants to guard against duergar intrusion. When a ward activates in response to the presence of an {@condition invisible} creature, nearby derro fly into a frenzy, creating a chaotic mob meant to drive away {@condition invisible} duergar patrols. Derro make active Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks contested by the characters' Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks if a ward is activated. Characters using {@spell detect magic} actively can spot the {@condition invisible} sensor of a ward before it activates. Otherwise, {@condition invisible} characters encounter a ward every 15 minutes they move through derro territory.
zh_tw: 其他形式的偽裝手段，如幻術、沿牆壁攀爬、或使用飛行或浮空魔法，會自動避免被察覺，但任何形式的隱形都會啟用由迪洛矮人學者放置的魔法防護，以防範灰矮人的入侵。當針對{@condition invisible||隱形}生物的魔法防護被啟用時，附近的迪洛矮人會陷入瘋狂，形成一支混亂的暴徒，意在驅趕{@condition invisible||隱形}的灰矮人巡邏隊。迪洛矮人會進行主動的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，與角色的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定進行對抗，如果魔法防護被啟用。角色若主動使用{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}，可以在魔法防護啟用前發現其{@condition invisible||隱形}的感應器。否則，{@condition invisible||隱形}的角色在穿越迪洛矮人領地時，每15分鐘就會遇到一個魔法防護。

english: Access to the Whorlstone Tunnels
zh_tw: 進入渦石隧道的通道

english: Between a cluster of hovels in West Cleft lies the most well-used entrance to the Whorlstone Tunnels (see "Whorlstone Tunnels"). A narrow fissure in the chasm wall is hidden by scraps of cloth, gray sheets of canvas, and moldy boxes. The fissure is tall and wide enough for a Medium creature to squeeze through the first 10 feet, and then continues for 50 feet at an average 5 feet in width, with a gentle downward slope.
zh_tw: 在西裂谷的一群小屋之間，有一個通往渦石隧道（見"渦石隧道"）最常用的入口。一個狹窄的裂縫在裂谷壁上，被破布、灰色帆布片和發黴的箱子隱藏著。這個裂縫足夠高和寬，可以讓一箇中等體型的生物擠過最初的10尺，然後以平均5尺的寬度繼續延伸50尺，呈輕微向下的斜坡。

english: Ever since the foul irruption of the demon lords into the Underdark, the fissure is easier to find, as it sometimes leaks wisps of eerie fog created by {@i faerzress}. Otherwise, finding it requires careful searching and a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Each character can make this check at the end of each hour the party spends in the West Cleft warrens looking for the Whorlstone Tunnels' entrance.
zh_tw: 自從惡魔領主們邪惡地湧入幽暗地域後，這道裂隙更容易被發現，因為它有時會洩漏出由{@i 妖光}創造的詭異霧氣。否則，找到它需要仔細搜尋，並透過一次成功的{@dc 15} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定。每個角色在隊伍於西裂隙區域尋找渦石隧道入口的每小時結束時，都可以進行這項檢定。

english: Any attempt to question the locals without an effective means of disguise or manipulation, such as enchantment or illusion magic, is doomed to fail, as the derro are more likely to attack the characters than answer their questions. Even then, the derro are often incoherent, and a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check is needed to obtain useful information. A successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check also works, but has a 50 percent chance of inspiring the derro to flee or attack.
zh_tw: 任何在沒有有效偽裝或操控手段（如附魔或幻術魔法）的情況下質問當地人的嘗試都註定會失敗，因為迪洛矮人更有可能攻擊角色而不是回答他們的問題。即使如此，迪洛矮人的言論往往語無倫次，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定才能獲得有用的資訊。成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定也同樣有效，但有 50% 的機率會促使迪洛矮人逃跑或攻擊。

english: Halls of Sacred Spells
zh_tw: 神聖咒語大廳

english: The Halls of Sacred Spells comprise a temple of Diirinka carved into a stalagmite in Northfurrow District. Here, the derro Council of Savants meets and plots, living in luxurious quarters and hiding such opulence from their fellow derro. All areas of the Halls of Sacred Spells except the central worship chamber are forbidden to derro who aren't savants. Duergar don't enter this place, whose main doors are false and carved into the rock. The savants enter and leave using spells such as {@spell dimension door} and {@spell passwall}, while lesser derro access the worship chamber through secret tunnels from the West Cleft.
zh_tw: 神聖法術大廳是位於北溝渠區的一個由石筍雕刻而成的迪林卡神廟。在這裡，迪洛矮人智者議會會面並策劃，居住在豪華的住所中，並將這種奢華隱藏在他們的同胞迪洛矮人之外。除了中央禮拜室外，神聖法術大廳的所有區域都禁止非智者的迪洛矮人進入。灰矮人不進入這個地方，其主門是假的，雕刻在岩石中。智者們使用如{@spell dimension door||任意門}和{@spell passwall||穿牆術}等法術進出，而較低等級的迪洛矮人則透過西裂谷的秘密隧道進入禮拜室。

english: Cairngorm Cavern
zh_tw: 凱恩戈姆洞穴

english: A long tunnel opens in Southfurrow District, extending several hundred feet and into the home of the stone giants of Clan Cairngorm. The tribe is named after the ancient oath of fealty their ancestors swore to the bearers of the Cairngorm Crown, the traditional regalia of Deepkingdom monarchs. The giants lead simple, uncomplicated lives, and their dwellings reflect this.
zh_tw: 一條長長的隧道在南溝區(南溝區)開啟，延伸數百尺，通向石巨人凱恩戈姆家族的家園。這個部落的命名源於他們的祖先對凱恩戈姆王冠的持有者——深王國君主的傳統服飾——所發的古老效忠誓言。這些巨人過著簡單、不復雜的生活，他們的住所也反映了這一點。

english: The stone giants value their privacy, and duergar are normally not allowed inside Cairngorm Cavern. An exception is made for the Deepking, who holds meetings here with the giants' leader, Stonespeaker Hgraam, when necessary.
zh_tw: 石巨人重視他們的隱私，通常不允許灰矮人進入凱恩戈姆洞穴。一個例外是深王，當他需要時，會在這裡與巨人的領袖石語者哈格拉姆舉行會談。

english: Audience with the Stonespeaker
zh_tw: 與石語者會面

english: If the adventurers helped stop the rampaging giant in the Darklake District (and especially if they didn't kill him), Hgraam is expecting them by the entrance to the Cairngorm Caverns. Though the stone giant is short on pleasantries, he gives the characters what information he can in response to their questions, including ways to return to the "dreamlands," as the stone giants call the surface world. Because he has never left the Underdark, the paths he knows have come to him only as whispers through the stone. As such, you can easily shape his advice to your players' plans.
zh_tw: 如果冒險家們幫助制止了黑暗湖區域的狂暴巨人（特別是如果他們沒有殺死他），哈格拉姆會在凱恩戈姆洞穴的入口處等待他們。儘管這位石巨人在禮貌上有所欠缺，但他會盡自己所能回答角色們的問題，包括返回石巨人所稱的"夢境之地"即地表世界的方法。因為他從未離開過幽暗地域，他所知道的路徑只是透過石頭傳來的耳語。因此，你可以很容易地根據你玩家的計劃塑造他的建議。

english: Additionally, Hgraam gives the characters a warning:
zh_tw: 此外，哈格拉姆給角色們一個警告：

english: "Something evil stirs in the Underdark. The rock itself cries in pain and horror, and a madness creeps from the blackest depths. Pay heed to the signs surrounding you. A cave with two faces. Rock devoured, and the land overgrown. The pebble believes itself flesh. The earth rejects its wards, and the tunnels shake in fury. By these portents, you shall know of evil's presence and of evil's face. This is what the stones tell me."
zh_tw: "在幽暗地域中，有某種邪惡正在攪動。岩石本身在痛苦和恐懼中哭泣，瘋狂從最黑暗的深處蔓延。注意你們周圍的徵兆。有兩個面孔的洞穴。岩石被吞噬，土地荒蕪。卵石自視為肉體。大地拒絕其守衛，隧道在憤怒中震動。透過這些徵兆，你將知曉邪惡的存在和邪惡的面貌。這就是石頭告訴我的。"

english: This cryptic message refers to the demon lords and the madness their presence is spreading, but Hgraam has not deciphered it yet.
zh_tw: 這個隱晦的資訊涉及到惡魔領主及其存在所傳播的瘋狂，但哈格拉姆還沒有破譯它。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: As the characters prepare to leave, Hgraam calls for his apprentice Dorhun, who arrives bearing a polished crystal the length of a human forearm. Hgraam offers the crystal to the characters as a token of his gratitude, telling them it might be helpful in the future.
zh_tw: 當角色們準備離開時，哈格拉姆召喚他的學徒多爾洪，他帶著一塊磨光的水晶到來，長度相當於一個人類的前臂。哈格拉姆將水晶作為感謝的象徵提供給角色們，並告訴他們它在未來可能會有所幫助。

english: The {@item stonespeaker crystal|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}) resonates strongly with conjuration and divination magic. If the characters keep the crystal after escaping the Underdark, it will be of use if they return to deal with the demonic incursion, as it is linked to the mysterious library of Gravenhollow and has additional properties when used there (see {@adventure chapter 11|OotA|10}).
zh_tw: {@item stonespeaker crystal|OotA|石語者水晶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}）與召喚和占卜魔法強烈共鳴。如果角色們在逃離幽暗地域後保留這塊水晶，它將在他們返回處理惡魔入侵時派上用場，因為它與刻文谷的神秘圖書館相連，並在那裡使用時具有額外的屬性（見{@adventure 第十一章|OotA|10}）。

english: Themberchaud's Lair
zh_tw: 瑟姆貝爾喬德的巢穴

english: At the far southeast corner of Gracklstugh's cavern, the entrance to {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s lair is guarded by the Keepers of the Flame. Not that anyone would be foolish enough to trespass into the Wyrmsmith's home, but ever since the Gray Ghosts stole a red dragon egg meant to hatch {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s successor, the Keepers aren't taking any chances.
zh_tw: 在格拉克斯圖格洞穴的東南角，{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的巢穴入口由火焰守護者守衛著。並不是說會有人愚蠢到擅自進入龍匠的家，但自從灰鬼偷走了一個註定孵化成{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}繼任者的紅龍蛋之後，守護者們就沒有放鬆警惕。

english: For some time now, the Keepers have been actively seeking capable mercenaries in Gracklstugh and taking any opportunity to press them into service. If an agent of the order intervened in the characters' arrest (see "Getting Captured"), the leader of the Keepers of the Flame—Gartokkar Xundorn—is notified by magical messaging. He waits for the characters as they are brought to the dragon's cavern—but {@creature Adult Red Dragon||Themberchaud} is watching too.
zh_tw: 最近一段時間，守護者一直在格拉克斯圖格積極尋找有能力的僱傭兵，並抓住一切機會強行徵召他們。如果組織的一名特工介入了角色的被捕（見"被捕"），火焰守護者的領袖——加爾托卡·桑多恩——會透過魔法傳訊得知此事。他會在角色被帶到龍穴時等待他們——但{@creature Adult Red Dragon||瑟姆貝爾喬德}也在注視著這一切。

english: The dragon speaks Dwarvish to its servants as the characters approach. Read the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們接近時，龍用矮人語對其僕人說話。閱讀以下內容：

english: As the duergar priests lead you to a building carved from the stone just outside a huge cave entrance, the ground trembles slightly, and a thunderous voice echoes against every wall.
zh_tw: 當灰矮人祭司帶領你們走向一個從石頭雕刻而成的建築，就在一個巨大洞穴入口的外面時，地面輕微地震動，雷鳴般的聲音在每面牆上回響。

english: "Gartokkar," the voice calls as a reptilian behemoth comes into view, it scales the color of lava, its bright yellow eyes glowing in the shadows of the cave before coming into the light. "You didn't say I was having surfacers for dinner today."
zh_tw: "加爾托卡，"當一個爬行的巨獸進入視野時，聲音呼喚著，它的鱗片是熔岩的顏色，在洞穴的陰影中明亮的黃色眼睛在進入光明之前閃爍。"你沒說今天晚餐有地表人。"

english: The dragon chuckles at his own wit. His massive body gives the distinct impression that he is overweight, indicating eating habits that don't bode well.
zh_tw: 這條龍對自己的機智輕笑。他巨大的身體給人留下了明顯的超重印象，這預示著他的飲食習慣並不好。

english: "Foreigners," the duergar priest says with great reverence, "meet the Father of Flame, the Everburning, and the Foundry's Heart—{@creature Themberchaud|OotA}, the Wyrmsmith of Gracklstugh."
zh_tw: "外來者，"灰矮人牧師以極大的敬意說道，"見一見火焰之父，永恆燃燒者，鑄造廠之心——{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}，格拉克斯圖格的龍匠。"

english: Agents of the Wyrmsmith
zh_tw: 龍匠的代理人

english: Like most of his kind, {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} is vain and proud. He's pampered, but also restless. The {@creature adult red dragon} has been aware for several years that his handlers are withholding things from him, but rather than demand disclosure, he has waited and observed. He wants agents of his own, and sees the interest of the Keepers in the adventurers as an opportunity.
zh_tw: 像大多數同類一樣，{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德} 虛榮且驕傲。他被嬌生慣養，但也焦躁不安。這隻{@creature adult red dragon||成年紅龍} 已經意識到多年以來他的管理者對他有所隱瞞，但他沒有要求揭露真相，而是選擇等待和觀察。他希望擁有自己的代理人，並將守護者對冒險者的興趣視為一個機會。

english: The dragon demands to speak with the characters in private, with his nervous duergar handlers having no choice but to acquiesce. When they escort the characters into the dragon's lair, {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} is resting on a mountain of gold. He tells the keepers to leave him alone with the adventurers, hissing that any {@condition invisible} lurkers will be turned to ash. Once alone, he asks the characters their names, backgrounds, how they found themselves in the Underdark, and the events that led them to Gracklstugh.
zh_tw: 這條龍要求私下與角色們交談，他緊張的灰矮人管理者別無選擇，只能同意。當他們護送角色們進入龍的巢穴時，{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}正躺在一堆金子上休息。他告訴守護者們讓他單獨與冒險家們在一起，嘶嘶地說任何{@condition invisible||隱形}潛伏者都會被化為灰燼。一旦單獨，他詢問角色們的名字、背景、他們是如何發現自己在幽暗地域的，以及導致他們來到格拉克斯圖格的事件。

english: {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} makes the characters an offer: become his agents in Gracklstugh, and gain his protection. Their first mission is to do whatever the Keepers of the Flame ask them to—but to report to {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} before reporting to them.
zh_tw: {@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}向角色們提出了一個提議：成為他在格拉克斯圖格的代理人，並得到他的保護。他們的第一個任務是做火焰守護者要求他們做的任何事情——但在向他們報告之前先向{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}報告。

english: The dragon doesn't wait for the characters to respond, since his ego can't accept the notion that anyone would refuse him. He assigns Gartokkar to be their liaison, orders badges of gold be given to them, and sends them off.
zh_tw: 龍沒有等待角色們回應，因為他的自負無法接受有人會拒絕他。他指派加爾托卡作為他們的聯絡人，命令給予他們金質徽章，並送他們離開。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The characters might be tempted to inspect {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s hoard from where they stand, as the dragon doesn't allow them to get closer than 60 feet in front of him. The hoard consists of 3,000 pp, 20,000 gp, 45,000 sp, 150,000 cp, six 1,000 gp fire opals, ten 500 gp peridots, thirty 100 gp garnets, a gourd containing {@item oil of sharpness}, a {@item potion of flying}, a {@item potion of longevity}, and a {@item potion of supreme healing}. The magic items are buried under coins and not visible at a glance. One must dig through the coins to find them.
zh_tw: 角色們可能會被誘惑去檢查{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的寶藏，因為龍不允許他們靠近他前面60尺以內的地方。寶藏包括3000枚白金幣，20000金幣，45000銀幣，150000銅幣，六顆價值1000金幣的火蛋白石，十顆價值500金幣的橄欖石，三十顆價值100金幣的石榴石，一個裝有{@item oil of sharpness||銳鋒之油}的葫蘆，一瓶{@item potion of flying||飛行藥水}，一瓶{@item potion of longevity||延壽藥水}，和一瓶{@item potion of supreme healing||極效治療藥水}。魔法物品被埋在硬幣下面，一眼望去並不可見。人們必須挖掘硬幣才能找到它們。

english: A character who tries to get closer receives a friendly warning in the form of a growl, a stare, and claws clicking on the floor. {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} uses his breath weapon on any character who tries again, or who attempts to sneak past him and fails. Then he calmly carries on as if nothing happened.
zh_tw: 試圖靠近的角色會收到一個友好的警告，形式是咆哮、凝視和爪子在地板上點選。如果有人再次嘗試，或者試圖偷偷溜過去但失敗，{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}會使用他的吐息武器。然後他會平靜地繼續，就好像什麼也沒發生過一樣。

english: A Task for the Keepers
zh_tw: 守護者的任務

english: When the characters are done with {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}, they exit the lair to where Gartokkar waits to take them to the guard house where the Keepers of the Flame keep watch. He darkly asks what business the dragon had with them, but what the characters choose to tell him (and whether they intend to follow up on the dragon's orders) is up to them.
zh_tw: 當角色們完成與{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的事務後，他們離開巢穴，來到加爾托卡等待他們的地方，他將帶他們去火焰守護者守衛的警衛室。他陰沉地詢問龍與他們有何事務，但角色們選擇告訴他什麼（以及他們是否打算跟進龍的命令）取決於他們自己。

english: The power of the Keepers of the Flame derives in equal measure from their psionic abilities, the leadership of the Deepking, and their influence over {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}. They lost face when the Gray Ghosts stole the valuable red dragon egg that would hatch {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s replacement, and they have been waging war on the thieves' guild ever since. But with the egg still lost and their control over {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} waning, the Keepers are exploring all options in their war against the Gray Ghosts.
zh_tw: 火焰守護者的力量同樣來源於他們的靈能能力、深王的領導以及他們對{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的影響力。當灰鬼偷走了會孵化{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}替代者的寶貴紅龍蛋時，他們失去了面子，從那時起他們一直在與盜賊公會進行戰爭。但是隨著龍蛋仍然丟失以及他們對{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的控制力逐漸減弱，守護者們正在探索他們與灰鬼戰爭的所有選擇。

english: The psionic Keepers have sensed a great disturbance in the Underdark—a phenomenon that Gartokkar compares to a hole having been torn through the world. The Keepers have no idea about the demonic incursion, however, and even if the characters tell Gartokkar what they know, he is fixated on the idea that the Gray Ghosts are behind the disturbance, dismissing anything else as delusions, ignorance, or outright lies.
zh_tw: 靈能守護者感知到幽暗地域發生了巨大的動盪——加爾托卡將其比作世界被撕裂了一個洞的現象。然而，守護者們並不知道惡魔入侵的情況，即使角色們告訴加爾托卡他們所知道的，他仍然堅持認為是灰鬼在背後操縱動盪，將其他任何說法都視為幻覺、無知或徹頭徹尾的謊言。

english: In his paranoia, Gartokkar wants the characters to confirm the Gray Ghosts' involvement and to bring back whatever powerful magic the thieves used to cause the disturbance. The Keepers have identified a Gray Ghost agent—a derro called {@creature Droki|OotA}, who carries messages and supplies for the thieves' guild (see "{@creature Droki|OotA}" in the "Blade Bazaar" section). {@creature Droki|OotA} uses the West Cleft to contact his employers, and Gartokkar wants the party to follow this derro and locate the Gray Ghosts.
zh_tw: 由於他的偏執，加爾托卡希望角色們確認灰鬼的參與，並帶回那些小偷用來製造混亂的強大魔法。守護者們已經識別出了一個灰鬼的代理人——一個叫{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}的迪洛矮人，他為盜賊公會傳遞訊息和物資（見"刀刃市集"部分中的"{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}"）。{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}使用西裂谷與他的僱主聯絡，加爾托卡希望隊伍跟蹤這個迪洛矮人並找到灰鬼。

english: If the characters accept his offer, Gartokkar gives them a holy symbol of Laduguer after an acolyte arrives with gold pins featuring {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s profile. The symbol and the badges grant characters the right to travel beyond the Darklake District, though they are still limited from moving freely in the city (see the "Flashing Badges" sidebar). If they refuse, they are turned over to the Stone Guards for arrest and delivery to Overlake Hold.
zh_tw: 如果角色們接受了他的提議，加爾托卡在一位侍僧帶著帶有{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}側面像的金質徽章到來後，會給他們一個拉杜格的聖徽。這個聖徽和徽章賦予角色們超越黑暗湖區域旅行的權利，儘管他們在城市中的行動仍然受到限制（見"閃光徽章"邊欄）。如果他們拒絕，他們將被交給岩石衛隊隊逮捕並送往湖上堡。

english: Whorlstone Tunnels
zh_tw: 渦石隧道

english: The Whorlstone Tunnels are a cavern system extending partially underneath Gracklstugh, away from the mines and passages the city's inhabitants use regularly. The derro savants who first found the tunnels didn't reveal their discovery to anyone, and to this day only a handful among the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts know about them.
zh_tw: 渦石隧道是一個洞穴系統，部分地延伸在格拉克斯圖格下方，遠離城市居民經常使用的礦井和通道。最初發現這些隧道的迪洛矮人智者並沒有向任何人透露他們的發現，直到今天，只有智者議會和灰鬼中的少數人知道它們的存在。

english: The long, gently curving tunnels have relatively regular dimensions. They are known for their unusual rock formations and abundant patches of fungi, and for being suffused with {@i faerzress} (see {@area chapter 2|05f|x}).
zh_tw: 這些長而輕輕彎曲的隧道尺寸相對規則。它們以不尋常的岩石形態和豐富的真菌斑塊而聞名，並且充滿了{@i 妖光}（見{@area 第二章|05f|x}）。

english: There are currently two factions using the tunnels for their own ends. The Gray Ghosts have an alchemical laboratory and a fungal garden supplying them with poisons, and the leaders of the guild conceal a secret in the form of a mysterious black obelisk in the farthest cave (see area 16). The other group is a budding cult of derro demon worshipers led by a renegade member of the Council of Savants. Sensing that the demon lords are somehow using {@i faerzress} to spread chaos and madness, the demon worshipers have begun conducting rituals to infect Gracklstugh. Intent on weakening the city and breaking the power of King Horgar Steelshadow V, the cultists plan to inflict a curse on the stone giants of Clan Cairngorm that causes them to grow second heads, driving them insane.
zh_tw: 目前有兩個派系為了自己的目標而使用這些隧道。灰鬼有一個鍊金實驗室和一個供應毒藥的真菌花園，公會的領導者在最遠的洞穴（見區域16）中隱藏了一個神秘的黑色方尖碑作為秘密。另一組是由智者議會的一名叛逆成員領導的迪洛矮人惡魔崇拜者的新興邪教。感覺到惡魔領主不知何故使用{@i 妖光}傳播混亂和瘋狂，惡魔崇拜者開始進行儀式以感染格拉克斯圖格。邪教徒決心削弱這座城市，打破霍加·鋼影五世國王的權力，他們計劃給凱恩戈姆族的石巨人施加一詛咒，使他們長出第二個頭，使他們瘋狂。

english: Whorlstone Tunnels: General Features
zh_tw: 渦石隧道：一般特徵

english: The following features are prevalent throughout the Whorlstone Tunnels.
zh_tw: 以下特徵在渦石隧道中普遍存在。

english: Ceilings and Floors
zh_tw: 天花板和地板

english: The average ceiling height is 50 feet, dropping to 25 feet in narrow tunnels.
zh_tw: 平均天花板高度為50尺，在狹窄的隧道中降低至25尺。

english: Narrow Tunnels
zh_tw: 狹窄隧道

english: The narrowest tunnels are barely 2 feet wide at their widest points. A Tiny creature can move through these tunnels unimpeded, while a Small creature must squeeze to pass through them. Medium and larger creatures can't fit through these narrow passageways.
zh_tw: 最狹窄的隧道，即使最寬處也僅有2尺。微型生物能不受阻礙地穿行，小型生物則必須擠身透過。中型及更大的生物無法進入這些狹窄通道。

english: Faerzress
zh_tw: 妖光

english: The Whorlstone Tunnels are suffused with {@i faerzress} (see "{@area Faerzress|05f|x}" in chapter 2 for effects). {@i Faerzress} has also altered the physical appearance of the complex, creating spiral patterns on the walls and ceilings. These spirals are what give the complex its name. Because of these weird spiraling patterns, saving throws to resist {@i faerzress}-induced madness are made with disadvantage.
zh_tw: 渦石隧道充滿了{@i 妖光}（見第2章中的"{@area 妖光|05f|x}"瞭解效果）。{@i 妖光}還改變了這個建築群的物理外觀，在牆壁和天花板上形成了螺旋圖案。這些螺旋圖案賦予了這個建築群它的名字。由於這些奇怪的螺旋圖案，抵抗{@i 妖光}引起的瘋狂的豁免檢定具有劣勢。

english: Foul Water
zh_tw: 腐化水源

english: Water from the Darklake drips from stalactites and trickles through cracks in the walls, forming narrow streams and shallow pools throughout the Whorlstone Tunnels. Any creature that drinks the foul water must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned}. The {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each hour to end the effect.
zh_tw: 來自黑暗湖的水從鐘乳石上滴落，順著牆壁的裂縫流淌，在渦石隧道中形成了狹窄的溪流和淺水坑。任何飲用這汙水的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 12} 體魄豁免檢定，否則會陷入 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 狀態。{@condition poisoned||中毒} 的生物可以在每一小時結束時重複進行豁免檢定來結束此效果。

english: Edible Fungi
zh_tw: 可食用真菌

english: Edible fungi (including pygmywort and bigwig) are abundant in the Whorlstone Tunnels. Characters can attempt {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to forage here.
zh_tw: 在渦石隧道中，可食用真菌（包括縮身菇和大頭菇）非常豐富。角色可以在此嘗試 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定來進行採集。

english: Faerzress-Suffused Fungi
zh_tw: 充滿妖光的真菌

english: The Whorlstone Tunnels are home to two unique kinds of {@i faerzress}-suffused mushrooms: bigwigs and pygmyworts. Any character who studies these mushrooms can identify their magical effects with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) check, an {@spell identify} spell, or by trial and error. A single nibble of a mushroom alters a character's size by a few inches for 5 minutes, so characters foraging for food might discover the mushrooms' magic by accident. The size-altering effects of eating multiple bigwigs or pygmyworts aren't cumulative, although their durations are. These mushrooms lose their properties if they are taken outside the Whorlstone Tunnels for 1 hour or more.
zh_tw: 渦石隧道是兩種獨特的{@i 妖光}蘑菇的家園：巨冠菇和縮身菇。任何研究這些蘑菇的角色都可以透過成功透過{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Nature||自然}）檢定、{@spell identify||鑑定術}法術或試錯法來識別它們的魔法效果。咬一口蘑菇會使角色的身高在5分鐘內改變幾吋，因此尋找食物的角色可能會意外發現蘑菇的魔法。食用多個巨冠菇或縮身菇的尺寸改變效果不會疊加，儘管它們的持續時間會疊加。如果這些蘑菇被帶出渦石隧道超過1小時，它們將失去其魔法屬性。

english: Bigwig
zh_tw: 巨冠菇

english: A bigwig is a four-inch-tall mushroom with a thin stem and a wide purple cap. A creature that eats one can choose to make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw to not be affected by the mushroom's magic. If the creature fails or forgoes the saving throw, it grows in size as though under the enlarge effect of an {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell. The effect lasts for 1 hour. Ten minutes before the effect ends, the creature feels a tingling sensation, at which point it can sustain its current size by eating another wurple. The effect ends if the creature eats a pygmywort mushroom or is magically reduced to its normal size (using the reduce effect of an {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell, for example).
zh_tw: 一個巨冠菇是一個四吋高的蘑菇，有著細長的莖和寬大的紫色傘蓋。一個生物如果吃了它，可以選擇進行一次 {@dc 12} 體質豁免來不被蘑菇的魔法影響。如果生物失敗或放棄豁免，它會像受到 {@spell enlarge/reduce||變巨/縮小術} 法術的擴大效果一樣增大體型。該效果持續1小時。在效果結束前十分鐘，生物會感到一陣刺痛感，此時它可以透過再吃一個紫蘑菇來維持當前體型。如果生物吃了一個侏儒菇或被魔法縮小到正常體型（例如使用 {@spell enlarge/reduce||變巨/縮小術} 法術的縮小效果），該效果將結束。

english: Pygmywort
zh_tw: 縮身菇

english: A pygmywort is a mushroom with a one-inch-long stem and a stubby blue cap with white dots. A creature that eats one can choose to make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw to not be affected by the mushroom's magic. If the creature fails or forgoes the saving throw, it shrinks in size as though under the reduce effect of an {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell. The effect lasts for 1 hour. Ten minutes before the effect ends, the creature feels a tingling sensation, at which point it can sustain its current size by eating another pygmywort. The effect ends if the creature eats a bigwig mushroom or is magically enlarged to its normal size (using the enlarge effect of an {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell, for example).
zh_tw: 侏儒菇是一種蘑菇，具有一吋長的莖和帶有白點的粗短藍色菌蓋。食用它的生物可以選擇進行一次 {@dc 12} 體質豁免來不受蘑菇魔法的影響。如果該生物豁免失敗或放棄豁免，它的體型會縮小，就像受到 {@spell enlarge/reduce||變巨/縮小術} 法術的縮小效果影響一樣。這種效果持續1小時。在效果結束前十分鐘，該生物會感到一陣刺痛感，此時它可以透過食用另一個侏儒菇來維持當前體型。如果該生物食用了大亨菇或被魔法放大到正常體型（例如使用 {@spell enlarge/reduce||變巨/縮小術} 法術的放大效果），則效果終止。

english: Random Encounters
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇

english: As the characters explore the Whorlstone Tunnels, they can run into various creatures or hazards. Check for an encounter whenever the characters are moving along a stretch of tunnel or at the end of a long rest. Roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Whorlstone Tunnels Encounters table to determine what, if anything, they encounter.
zh_tw: 當角色們探索渦石隧道時，他們可能會遇到各種生物或危險。每當角色們沿著隧道的一段移動或在長休結束時，檢查一次遭遇。擲一個{@dice d20}並查閱渦石隧道遭遇表，以確定他們遇到了什麼，如果有的話。

english: Carrion Crawler
zh_tw: 食腐蟲

english: There's a 50 percent chance that the {@creature carrion crawler} is feasting on the putrid flesh of a dead grimlock and ignores the party unless disturbed. Otherwise, it is scouring tunnels for food and attacks the party on sight. It prefers to attack while clinging to the ceiling.
zh_tw: 有50%的機率{@creature carrion crawler||食腐蟲}正在享用一具死去的幽邃盲族的腐肉，並且除非被打擾，否則會忽略隊伍。否則，它正在隧道中搜尋食物，並且會立即攻擊隊伍。它喜歡在附著在天花板上時進行攻擊。

english: Demon Pack
zh_tw: 惡魔群

english: This pack consists of a {@creature quasit} leading {@dice 1d4 + 2} {@creature Dretch||dretches}. The quasit turns {@condition invisible} and tries to escape when only two dretches remain; if it succeeds, the cultists in area 14 are alerted. Replace any subsequent demon pack random encounter with {@dice 1d4} {@creature derro|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}).
zh_tw: 這群惡魔由一隻{@creature quasit||小惡魔}帶領著{@dice 1d4 + 2}只{@creature Dretch||怯魔}。當僅剩兩隻怯魔時，小惡魔會進入{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態並試圖逃脫；若成功逃脫，區域14的邪教徒們會被驚動。將後續任何惡魔群隨機遭遇替換為{@dice 1d4}名{@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）。

english: Flumph
zh_tw: 呋嚕

english: This creature telepathically asks the characters to rid the cave complex of the derro cultists (see area 14) because it knows what they're trying to do and wants to stop them. If the characters agree and seem friendly, the {@creature flumph} offers to accompany them indefinitely. It will not willingly leave the Underdark, however.
zh_tw: 這個生物透過心靈感應請求角色們清除洞穴群落中的迪洛矮人邪教徒（見區域14），因為它知道他們試圖做什麼，並希望阻止他們。如果角色們同意並表現出友好，{@creature flumph||呋嚕}願意無限期地陪伴他們。然而，它不會自願離開幽暗地域。

english: Gray Ooze
zh_tw: 灰泥怪

english: There's a 50 percent chance that this ooze has psionic abilities (use the psychic variant of the {@creature gray ooze}, as described in the {@i Monster Manual}).
zh_tw: 該軟泥怪有50%的機率擁有靈能能力（使用{@creature gray ooze||灰泥怪}的靈能變體，如{@i 怪物圖鑑}中所述）。

english: Moldy Quaggoth Spore Servants
zh_tw: 發黴的幽邃熊怪孢子奴僕

english: A patch of yellow mold (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}) covers each spore servant. Each time a spore servant is touched or takes damage, it releases a cloud of yellow mold spores until the mold patch is destroyed.
zh_tw: 一片黃色黴菌（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第5章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"）覆蓋在每個孢子僕從身上。每當孢子僕從被觸碰或受到傷害時，它會釋放一片黃色黴菌孢子云，直到黴菌斑被摧毀。

english: Two-Headed Grimlocks
zh_tw: 雙頭幽邃盲族

english: The {@creature Grimlock||grimlocks} living in the Whorlstone Tunnels keep to themselves, feeding on fungi and vermin. The derro have tried to enslave them, without much success. In a weird example of détente, members of the two races have learned to avoid one another. Each grimlock has sprouted a screaming second head, which has no effect on its statistics.
zh_tw: 生活在渦石隧道中的{@creature Grimlock||幽邃盲族}自給自足，以真菌和害蟲為食。迪洛矮人試圖奴役他們，但並沒有太大成功。在一種奇怪的和解示例中，兩個種族的成員已經學會相互避開。每個幽邃盲族都長出了第二個尖叫的頭，這對它的具體數值沒有影響。

english: Xorn
zh_tw: 石鼎獸

english: This creature has been working its way through the rock of the Whorlstone Tunnels, consuming vast amounts of {@i faerzress}-infused stone. The change in the {@i faerzress} brought on by the arrival of the demon lords has left the {@creature xorn} confused and easily angered. It tries to bargain for metal or gems to eat, and attacks if refused. If the adventurers feed the xorn and can communicate with it, the creature can tell them that it sensed a great planar upheaval recently, though it knows nothing about the demons or their spreading madness.
zh_tw: 這個生物一直在渦石隧道的岩石中穿行，消耗大量的含有{@i 妖光}的石頭。惡魔領主到來引起的{@i 妖光}變化讓{@creature xorn||石鼎獸}感到困惑並容易發怒。它試圖透過交換金屬或寶石來獲取食物，如果被拒絕就會攻擊。如果冒險者們能餵養石鼎獸並與它溝通，這個生物可以告訴他們，它最近感覺到了一次巨大的位面動盪，儘管它對惡魔或他們傳播的瘋狂一無所知。

english: Yellow Mold
zh_tw: 黃黴菌

english: The characters notice a patch of yellow mold (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}) growing on something of interest, determined by rolling a {@dice d4} and consulting the Beneath the Yellow Mold table. Tampering with the mold-encrusted object causing the yellow mold to release its deadly spores.
zh_tw: 角色們注意到一片黃色黴菌（見第5章中的{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}，來自{@book 城主指南|DMG}）生長在一個感興趣的物體上，透過擲一個{@dice d4}並參考黃色黴菌下方的表格來確定。幹擾被黴菌覆蓋的物體會導致黃色黴菌釋放其致命的孢子。

english: Finding Droki
zh_tw: 尋找卓奇

english: If the characters are on a quest to find {@creature Droki|OotA}, read the following boxed text when his path crosses with theirs.
zh_tw: 如果角色們正在尋找{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}的任務中，當他的路徑與他們交叉時，請閱讀以下框內文字。

english: The dirty derro is easy to recognize: a pale face under a floppy hat fitted with two tentacle-like things that bob up and down in time with his brisk pace. He keeps muttering a repetitive series of phrases to himself at different volumes, failing to notice you. "{@creature Droki|OotA} is late! They will be so angry! Stupid, stupid, stupid! Delays, blocks, procrastination, obstructions, pfah! No time, no rhyme, not mine! No! Time!"
zh_tw: 這個髒兮兮的迪洛矮人很容易辨認：蒼白的面孔下戴著一頂鬆軟的帽子，帽子上裝有兩個類似觸手的東西，隨著他輕快的步伐上下襬動。他不停地以不同的音量自言自語重複一系列短語，沒有注意到你。"{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}遲到了！他們會很生氣的！愚蠢，愚蠢，愚蠢！拖延，阻礙，耽擱，妨礙，呸！沒有時間，沒有節奏，不是我的！不！時間！"

english: {@creature Droki|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) has errands to perform. The characters can shadow him or chase him down, but both the Darklake District and the derro territories provide him with abundant places to hide and paths down which he can lose pursuers, and he knows them all. Inside the Whorlstone Tunnels, however, the derro is distracted by ever-present threats, giving the party the best chance to catch him. The characters can fight {@creature Droki|OotA} by the tunnels' entrance or follow him farther in, depending on their end goals. If they follow {@creature Droki|OotA}, he goes to area 1a, eats a pygmywort mushroom, and disappears into a narrow tunnel (see the "Whorlstone Tunnels: General Features" sidebar).
zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）有差事要辦。角色們可以跟蹤他或者追捕他，但黑暗湖區域和迪洛矮人領土為他提供了豐富的藏身之處和逃脫追蹤者的路徑，他知道所有的這些地方。然而，在渦石隧道內，這個迪洛矮人因為不斷出現的威脅而分心，這給了隊伍最好的機會抓住他。角色們可以在隧道入口處與{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}戰鬥，或者根據他們的最終目標跟隨他深入隧道。如果他們跟蹤{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}，他會去到區域1a，吃下一個矮人菌蘑菇，並消失在一個狹窄的隧道中（見"渦石隧道：一般特徵"側邊欄）。

english: {@creature Droki|OotA}'s route takes him all around the Whorlstone Tunnels, and he's too scatterbrained to notice anyone following him. {@creature Droki|OotA}'s route is marked with red arrows on the map of the Whorlstone Tunnels. He eats a pygmywort mushroom whenever he needs to navigate a narrow tunnel. As he approaches areas 7 and 8, he eats a bigwig mushroom, reverts to normal size, delivers the Gray Ghost parcel (see "Treasure"), and collects his payment from Lorthio the {@creature duergar alchemist|OotA} (see area 8). {@creature Droki|OotA} then heads north to area 9, where he sneaks quietly around the central pool so as not to disturb its occupant. Upon reaching area 11, he greets the derro there before eating another pygmywort mushroom and traveling through the narrow tunnel leading to area 12. He eats another bigwig and reverts to normal size before making his delivery to the cultists in that area. After visiting the cultists, {@creature Droki|OotA} makes his way out of the Whorlstone Tunnels.
zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}的路線貫穿整個渦石隧道，他太心不在焉了，沒有注意到有人跟蹤他。{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}的路線在渦石隧道的地圖上用紅色箭頭標記。每當他需要穿過狹窄的隧道時，就會吃一個縮身菇蘑菇。當他接近7號和8號區域時，他會吃一個巨冠菇蘑菇，恢復正常體型，遞送灰鬼包裹（見"寶藏"），並從{@creature duergar alchemist|OotA|灰矮人鍊金術士}洛希歐（見8號區域）那裡收取他的報酬。然後，{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}向北前往9號區域，他悄悄地繞過中央水池，以免打擾那裡的居住者。到達11號區域後，他向那裡的迪洛矮人問好，然後吃另一個縮身菇蘑菇，穿過通往12號區域的狹窄隧道。在向那個區域的邪教徒遞送之前，他又吃了一個巨冠菇並恢復正常體型。拜訪過邪教徒後，{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}離開了渦石隧道。

english: If the characters hinder or attack {@creature Droki|OotA}, he screams in fright and knocks his feet together, activating his {@item boots of speed}. If a chase ensues, resolve the outcome using the chase rules in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Chases} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. {@creature Droki|OotA} has advantage in his Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks, as he knows the Whorlstone Tunnels well. If he loses the characters, he resumes his errands as if nothing had happened.
zh_tw: 如果角色阻礙或攻擊{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}，他會驚恐地尖叫並敲擊雙腳，啟用他的{@item boots of speed||速度之靴}。如果隨後發生追逐，使用{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Chases}（選自{@book 城主指南|DMG}）中的追逐規則來決定結果。{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}在{@skill Stealth||隱匿}（敏捷）檢定上具有優勢，因為他非常熟悉渦石隧道的地形。如果他甩掉角色，他會若無其事地繼續他的差事。
