english: If {@creature Droki|OotA} manages to escape, characters can pick up his trail by searching any area through which the derro passed and succeeding on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check.
zh_tw: 如果 {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇} 成功逃脫，角色可以透過搜尋迪洛矮人經過的任何區域並進行一次 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定來追蹤他的蹤跡。

english: Roleplaying Droki
zh_tw: 扮演卓奇

english: {@creature Droki|OotA} hates everyone in general and surfacers in particular. He gnashes his teeth if he has to address the characters, taking every opportunity to be insulting and misleading. If the characters look through his satchel while he's still conscious, he throws an epic tantrum and becomes intractable until knocked {@condition unconscious}.
zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇} 通常對所有人都抱有敵意，特別是對地表居民。如果他不得不與角色們交談，他會咬牙切齒，抓住每一個機會進行侮辱和誤導。如果角色們在他還有意識的時候翻看他的揹包，他會大發雷霆，變得難以駕馭，直到被擊昏{@condition unconscious||昏迷}。

english: {@creature Droki|OotA} is also obsessed with things happening where and when they should. If he is captured before he runs his errands in the Whorlstone Tunnels, he constantly complains about the characters altering fate by delaying him, and a good tactic to pressure him is to threaten to hold him indefinitely. He prefers to escape than to fight, except if the characters take his satchel.
zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}也對事物在正確的時間和地點發生著迷。如果他在渦石隧道中辦事前被捕，他會不斷抱怨角色們透過耽擱他來改變命運，而給他施加壓力的一個好策略是威脅無限期地扣留他。他更願意逃跑而不是戰鬥，除非角色們拿走了他的揹包。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Killing or incapacitating {@creature Droki|OotA} gives the characters the chance to rummage through his belongings. He wears {@item boots of speed} and a hat that is one of a kind. He sewed two stuffed displacer beast tentacles to the hat in the hopes of them attacking his enemies on their own, a delusion he volunteers if the characters question him. The hat might be worth something to a collector of oddities, but is otherwise worthless.
zh_tw: 擊殺或使{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}失去行動能力將給角色們機會翻找他的物品。他穿著{@item boots of speed||速度之靴}和一頂獨一無二的帽子。他在帽子上縫了兩根經過填充的移位獸觸角，希望它們能自行攻擊敵人，如果角色們詢問他，他會自願說出這一妄想。這頂帽子可能對收藏奇怪物品的人有點價值，否則毫無價值。

english: {@creature Droki|OotA}'s satchel is made of stitched darkmantle hide and contains the following items:
zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}的揹包由縫合的暗幕魔獸製成，包含以下物品：

english: 1 gp and 10 sp
zh_tw: 1金幣和10 sp

english: A {@item spell scroll} of {@spell see invisibility}
zh_tw: 一個{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸} of {@spell see invisibility||識破隱形}

english: Two {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}
zh_tw: 兩瓶{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}

english: A worthless collection of dead vermin (spiders, centipedes, and the like) in various states of decomposition
zh_tw: 一堆毫無價值的死害蟲（蜘蛛、蜈蚣等）在不同程度的腐爛狀態

english: Pages of lizard-skin parchment held together between two leather covers from two different books. The pages are full of mad scribbles and arcane formulas, but a character proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) can study them for 1 hour to discover that they constitute a spellbook containing the {@spell Tenser's floating disk} and {@spell feign death} spells.
zh_tw: 由兩本不同書籍的兩個皮革封面夾著的蜥蜴皮羊皮紙頁。這些頁面充滿了瘋狂的塗鴉和神秘公式，但一個在智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）上熟練的角色可以研究它們1小時，以發現它們構成了一本包含{@spell Tenser's floating disk||譚森浮碟術}和{@spell feign death||假死術}法術的咒語書。

english: A strange lump of black metal, which {@creature Droki|OotA} intends to deliver to the Gray Ghosts (see below)
zh_tw: 一塊奇怪的黑色金屬塊，{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}打算將其交給灰鬼（見下文）

english: A scroll in a copper tube and four small pouches containing stone giant toenail clippings and skin flecks, which {@creature Droki|OotA} intends to deliver to the cultists (see below). Each pouch is tagged with a different name, and the scroll contains a list of names matching those on the tags, together with descriptions. One of the names is "Dorhun," with a description corresponding to Stonespeaker Hgraam's apprentice. The rest of the names belong to other stone giants of Clan Cairngorm.
zh_tw: 一個裝在銅管裡的卷軸和四個小袋子，包含石巨人的腳趾甲屑和皮膚碎片，{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}打算將其交給邪教徒（見下文）。每個袋子都標有不同的名字，卷軸包含與標籤上的名字相匹配的名字列表，以及描述。其中一個名字是"多爾洪"，描述與石語者哈格拉姆的學徒相符。其餘的名字屬於凱恩戈姆家族的其他石巨人。

english: The derro might have other items depending on whether he is allowed to make his deliveries and collect his payments, as follows.
zh_tw: 迪洛矮人可能擁有其他物品，這取決於他是否被允許完成他的送貨和收款，如下所示。

english: Delivery to the Gray Ghosts
zh_tw: 向灰鬼交付

english: {@creature Droki|OotA} intends to deliver the strange lump of black metal to the Gray Ghosts, receiving payment from Lorthio the alchemist (see area 8) in the form of a mithral medallion worth 125 gp. The medallion is a holy symbol of Laduguer, set with a carving depicting an arrow breaking on a shield. Characters not sanctioned by the Keepers of the Flame to carry the symbol will be arrested by the guards (see "Getting Captured") if they are caught with it in Gracklstugh.
zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}打算將這塊奇怪的黑色金屬塊交給灰鬼，從鍊金術士洛希歐那裡（見區域8）以一塊價值125金幣的秘銀護符的形式接受付款。這個護符是拉杜格的聖徽，上面刻有一支箭在盾牌上斷裂的圖案。未經火焰守護者批准攜帶這個聖徽的角色，如果被發現在格拉克斯圖格攜帶它，將被守衛逮捕（見"被捕"）。

english: Delivery to the Cultists
zh_tw: 向邪教徒交付

english: {@creature Droki|OotA} intends to deliver the scroll and the pouches of stone giant toenail clippings and skin flecks (ritual components) to the derro cultists (see area 12). {@creature Droki|OotA} is paid for this delivery with a {@item potion of invisibility} and an hourglass worth 50 gp.
zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}打算將卷軸和裝有石巨人腳趾甲碎片和皮膚屑（儀式成分）的小袋交給迪洛矮人邪教徒（見區域12）。{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}為這次送貨得到的報酬是一瓶{@item potion of invisibility||隱形藥水}和一個價值50金幣的沙漏。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: Capturing the derro and taking him to Errde Blackskull earns the characters 150 XP each.
zh_tw: 捕獲迪洛矮人並將他帶到艾德·黑顱那裡，每個角色可以獲得150 XP。

english: Map 4.2: Gracklstugh—The Whorlstone Tunnels
zh_tw: 地圖 4.2: 格拉克斯圖格 - 渦石隧道

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Areas of the Tunnels
zh_tw: 隧道區域

english: 1. Entrance
zh_tw: 1. 入口

english: The narrow corridor from the West Cleft opens into a long cavern lined with stalactites and stalagmites. Water drips from the stalactites, forming small pools on the floor.
zh_tw: 西裂隙的狹窄通道通向一個佈滿鐘乳石和石筍的長洞穴。水從鐘乳石上滴落，在地面上形成小水窪。

english: The glow of {@i faerzress} casts an eerie soft light across this cavern, swirling into spiral patterns and casting dancing shadows from the jagged pillars lining the walls. The air smells and tastes slightly metallic, and the sound around you is strangely muted. The dripping of water makes no echo, as if you stood in open air.
zh_tw: {@i 妖光}的光芒在這個洞穴中投下了一種奇異的柔和光線，旋轉成螺旋圖案，從排列牆壁的參差不齊的柱子上投射出跳躍的影子。空氣聞起來和嚐起來有輕微的金屬味，周圍的聲音異常地被抑制了。滴水聲沒有回聲，就好像你站在開闊的空氣中一樣。

english: This place offers many hiding places for characters to lay in ambush. {@i Faerzress} prevents sounds of combat from being heard outside in the West Cleft or farther into the tunnels.
zh_tw: 這個地方為角色提供了許多藏身之處，可以設下埋伏。{@i 妖光}會阻止戰鬥的聲音傳到西裂隙或更遠的隧道外面。

english: If the characters wait here for {@creature Droki|OotA}, he appears after {@dice 2d12} hours. In the middle of that wait, each character must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the character feels only a mild discomfort. A character who rolls a natural 20 on the save receives flashes of the future, gaining the benefit of the Lucky feat (see chapter 6, "{@feat lucky||Customization Options}," in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}) until the start of his or her next long rest. If the character already has the Lucky feat, he or she gains an extra 3 luck points to spend. On a failed save, a character sees disturbing images within the shimmering {@i faerzress} light and has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws until he or she finishes a short rest outside this area.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在這裡等待{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}，他將在{@dice 2d12}小時後出現。在等待的過程中，每個角色必須進行一個{@dc 14}的感知豁免檢定。成功時，角色只會感到輕微的不適。如果在檢定中擲出自然20，角色會接收到未來的片段，獲得幸運專長的效果（參見第6章"{@feat lucky||自定義選項}"在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中），直到他或她的下一次長休開始。如果角色已經擁有幸運專長，他或她將獲得額外的3點幸運點數。如果豁免檢定失敗，角色會在閃爍的{@i 妖光}光芒中看到令人不安的景象，並在能力檢定和豁免檢定中處於劣勢，直到他或她在此區域外完成一次短休。

english: If the characters caught {@creature Droki|OotA} in Gracklstugh and brought him here, they must make the saving throw at some point during their interrogation. Knowing the power of the cavern, {@creature Droki|OotA} bides his time, giving nonsensical answers and hissing at the characters. He makes his move to escape after the characters make their saving throws, fleeing by the route described in the "Finding {@creature Droki|OotA}" section.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在格拉克斯圖格抓住了{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}並把他帶到這裡，在審問過程中他們必須在某個時刻進行豁免檢定。知道洞穴的力量，{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}耐心等待，給出無意義的答案並對角色們發出嘶嘶聲。在角色們進行豁免檢定後，他會找機會逃跑，透過"找到{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}"部分描述的路線逃走。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If {@creature Buppido|OotA} is with the party, he takes advantage of any distraction to slip away, taking refuge in area 1b.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}與隊伍在一起，他會利用任何分心的機會悄悄溜走，躲藏在1b區域。

english: 1a. Pool Bypass
zh_tw: 1a. 泳池旁路

english: A relatively small cave branches off the main tunnel. If the characters are shadowing {@creature Droki|OotA}, read the following boxed text aloud to the players.
zh_tw: 一個相對較小的洞穴從主隧道分叉出來。如果角色們正在跟蹤{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}，請向玩家們大聲朗讀以下框內文字。

english: {@creature Droki|OotA} stands before a tall yet narrow crack in the wall. He stares at the crack for a moment, then leans down and rummages among the fungi, cackling with glee as he plucks a short mushroom and eats it whole. As he finishes the last bite, you see him shrink down to a doll's size, then run into the crack.
zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}站在牆上一個高而窄的裂縫前。他盯著裂縫看了一會兒，然後俯身在真菌中翻找，一邊咯咯笑著一邊摘下一個短蘑菇並整個吃掉。當他吃完最後一口時，你看到他縮小到一個娃娃的大小，然後跑進了裂縫。

english: The far side of the small cavern has a narrow crack in the wall surrounded by patches of pygmywort and bigwig mushrooms ({@dice 1d10 + 10} of each). The crack forms the entrance of a narrow, naturally-formed tunnel.
zh_tw: 小洞穴的遠端牆上有一條狹窄的裂縫，周圍長滿了矮人草和巨冠菇蘑菇（每種各{@dice 1d10 + 10}株）。這個裂縫形成了一個狹窄的天然形成的隧道入口。

english: 1b. Buppido's Lair
zh_tw: 1b. 布皮多的巢穴

english: The derro {@creature Buppido|OotA} discovered the Whorlstone Tunnels months ago but never dared to explore beyond the first couple of chambers. He settled in this area and erected a grisly altar to himself, to support the delusion that he is a god.
zh_tw: 迪洛矮人{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}幾個月前發現了渦石隧道，但從不敢探索超出前幾個房間。他在這個區域安頓下來，併為自己建立了一個令人毛骨悚然的祭壇，以支援他是神的妄想。

english: If {@creature Buppido|OotA} returns to Gracklstugh, he abandons the characters at the first opportunity and makes his way to this place. If he is here when the characters arrive, read the following boxed text aloud to the players. Modify the text as appropriate if {@creature Buppido|OotA} isn't present.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}返回格拉克斯圖格，他會在第一時間拋棄角色們，前往這個地方。如果他在角色們到達時已經在這裡，請向玩家們大聲朗讀以下加框的文字。如果{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}不在場，請適當修改文字。

english: As you venture into the cavern, a stench of rotting meat rises. The floor is carpeted with humanoid remains in varying stages of decomposition, arranged in a spiral pattern around the cave's center. An off-key humming comes from a hunched figure working busily at something on the floor.
zh_tw: 當你們進入洞穴時，腐爛肉的惡臭撲鼻而來。地板上鋪滿了處於不同腐爛階段的人形遺骸，它們以螺旋圖案排列在洞穴中心周圍。一個彎腰的身影在地板上忙碌地工作，發出走調的哼聲。

english: "Oh, there you are!" The figure is {@creature Buppido|OotA}. He wipes his hands on his vest and smiles viciously. "I didn't expect you to find me here, with my shrine nearly finished! And power! My faithful are finally honoring me! Are you...? Yes. Yes, I sense that you are ready to receive my truth into your hearts!"
zh_tw: "哦，你們在這兒！"這個身影是{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}。他在背心上擦了擦手，惡狠狠地笑了。"我沒想到你們會在這裡找到我，我的神龕快要完成了！還有力量！我的信徒們終於開始向我致敬了！你們是......？是的。是的，我感覺到你們已經準備好將我的真理接納到你們心中！"

english: The humanoid remains on the floor make the entire cavern {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Characters can identify the remains as belonging to several derro, deep gnomes, and goblins, as well as a couple grimlocks.
zh_tw: 地面上的人形遺體使整個洞穴成為了{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。角色們可以辨認出這些遺體屬於幾個迪洛矮人、深侏儒和地精，以及兩個地底蠻人。

english: {@creature Buppido|OotA} is a typical {@creature derro|OotA} and attacks the characters regardless of their intentions. On his first turn, he uses a bonus action to channel the power of this "shrine," raising six {@creature Skeleton||skeletons} to aid him. The undead assemble from the remains on the floor to form shambling, mismatched bodies. Each skeleton has two skulls, although this has no effect on its abilities.
zh_tw: {@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}是一個典型的{@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}且會攻擊角色們無論他們的意圖如何。在他的第一回合，他會使用一個附贈動作來引導這個"聖壇"的法力，召喚六名{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}來援助他。死靈們從地板上的遺骸中組裝成蹣跚而行、不匹配的身體。每個骷髏都有兩個頭骨，儘管這對它的屬性無效果。

english: {@creature Buppido|OotA} fights with insane confidence and seems surprised if the party defeats him, screaming incoherent last words about the end of the world. The skeletons fight until destroyed even if {@creature Buppido|OotA} is defeated first.
zh_tw: {@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}以瘋狂的自信戰鬥，如果隊伍擊敗了他，他會顯得驚訝，尖叫著關於世界末日的語無倫次的遺言。即使{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}首先被擊敗，骷髏們也會戰鬥到被摧毀。

english: If {@creature Buppido|OotA} was killed in Velkynvelve or at some point in the characters' travels through the Underdark, replace him with a {@creature carrion crawler} feeding on the dead remains.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}在維爾京維爾夫或角色們穿越幽暗地域的某個地方被殺死，用一隻{@creature carrion crawler||食腐蟲}取而代之，讓它在死者的殘骸上進食。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: When the monsters are defeated, the {@creature ghost} of a deep gnome named Pelek pokes its head up out of the ground, blinks, and then emerges fully. The ghost is friendly and tells the adventurers that {@creature Buppido|OotA} killed him not too long ago, then chopped him into pieces to join the other body parts in the shrine. Pelek explains how he was traveling from Blingdenstone when he fell in with {@creature Buppido|OotA}. He knows little about the Whorlstone Tunnels, but he has observed a shrunken derro with a funny hat ({@creature Droki|OotA}) entering and leaving the narrow tunnels. Pelek doesn't know about the pygmywort mushrooms.
zh_tw: 當怪物被擊敗後，一個名為佩勒克的地底侏儒的{@creature ghost||幽魂}從地面上升起，眨了眨眼，然後完全顯現出來。這個幽靈很友好，並告訴冒險家們{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}不久前殺了他，然後將他剁成碎片，加入到神龕中的其他身體部位。佩勒克解釋說他是從布靈登石城旅行時遇到了{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}。他對渦石隧道知之甚少，但他觀察到一個戴著有趣帽子的縮小迪洛矮人({@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇})進入和離開了狹窄的隧道。佩勒克不知道關於矮人菌蘑菇的事。

english: Pelek asks the characters to take one or more parts of him to Blingdenstone and bury his remains there, so that his spirit can rest. It's impossible to tell which body parts are his, and looking around is a gruesome task that speaks loudly to {@creature Buppido|OotA}'s madness. Pelek recalls that the strange magic that pervades the tunnels animated one of his severed hands, and it scuttled away through one of the narrow tunnels. (Characters might encounter it in area 13.) Pelek points out that characters can recognize the hand because it was wearing an obsidian ring. If the characters need more reasons to go to Blingdenstone, Pelek adds that the svirfneblin who live there know many ways to the surface.
zh_tw: 佩勒克請求角色們把他的一個或多個身體部位帶到布靈登石城並在那裡埋葬他的遺體，這樣他的靈魂就可以安息。不可能分辨出哪些身體部位是他的，環顧四周是一項令人毛骨悚然的任務，充分說明瞭{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}的瘋狂。佩勒克回憶說，瀰漫在隧道中的那種奇怪魔法讓他的一隻手脫離軀體動了起來，它穿過狹窄的隧道逃走了（角色們可能會在區域13中遇到它）。佩勒克指出，角色們可以透過它戴著黑曜石戒指來認出這隻手。如果角色們需要更多前往布靈登石城的理由，佩勒克補充說，居住在那裡的地底侏儒知道許多通往地表的路。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Scattered around the floor are 10 gp, 11 sp, and a damp piece of lizard-skin parchment with the words "Worship {@creature Buppido|OotA}" written in shaky Dwarvish.
zh_tw: 地板上散落著10金幣，11銀幣，以及一張潮溼的蜥蜴皮羊皮紙，上面用顫抖的矮人語寫著"崇拜{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}"。

english: 2. Diseased Pool
zh_tw: 2. 病疫池塘

english: This pool is fed by a river that flows from the Darklake. The river carries many things from the subterranean lake, including the carcasses of countless creatures, fouling the pool (see the "Whorlstone Tunnels: General Features" sidebar).
zh_tw: 這個水池是由來自黑暗湖的河流補給的。河流從地下湖攜帶了許多東西，包括無數生物的屍體，這些汙染物使得水池變得汙濁（見"渦石隧道：一般特徵"側邊欄）。

english: The tunnel slopes down to the edge of a large pool that fills the cavern ahead. The opposite shore is nearly one hundred feet away, but nothing can be seen beneath the surface of the black water.
zh_tw: 隧道向下傾斜至一個大型水池的邊緣，這個水池填滿了前方的洞穴。對岸幾乎有一百尺遠，但黑色水面下什麼都看不見。

english: The water is heated by a thermal spring and pleasantly warm. However, the pool is disease-ridden. Any creature that starts its turn in the water must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is infected with cackle fever (see "{@book Diseases|DMG|8|Diseases}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). Gnomes are immune.
zh_tw: 溫泉水加熱了池水，使其溫暖宜人。然而，這池水卻充滿了疾病。任何在水中開始其回合的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 13} 體質豁免檢定。若檢定失敗，該生物將感染瘋狂熱症（詳見 {@book 疾病|DMG|8|Diseases} 在 {@book 城主指南|DMG} 的第8章中）。侏儒對此免疫。

english: The characters can try to get around the pool without swimming it, by using magic or climbing along the walls. Climbing the slippery walls of the cavern requires a successful {@dc 13} {@skill Athletics} check. On a failed check, a character falls into the water.
zh_tw: 角色們可以嘗試透過使用魔法或沿著牆壁攀爬來繞過水池而不必游泳。攀爬洞穴的溼滑牆壁需要成功的 {@dc 13} {@skill Athletics||運動} 檢定。如果檢定失敗，角色會掉入水中。

english: 3. Parade of Fools
zh_tw: 3. 愚人行

english: Myconids journeying through the Underdark were attracted to the enriched fungal life in the Whorlstone Tunnels and made a stop here. They are friendly, but there is something seriously wrong with them.
zh_tw: 穿越幽暗地域的菌人被渦石隧道中豐富的真菌生活所吸引，並在此停留。它們很友好，但它們有些嚴重的不對勁。

english: The tunnel opens into a natural cave, wherein you see several fungal creatures dancing to a silent tune. Three of them stand five feet tall, while the others are half as tall. One of the small ones stands apart from the rest, its movements not nearly as frantic. Hunched nearby are two larger creatures that resemble apes covered with mushroom growths and yellow mold.
zh_tw: 隧道通向一個天然洞穴，你看到幾個真菌生物在無聲的旋律中跳舞。其中有三個高達五尺，其他的則只有一半高。一個小個子與其它生物分開站立，它的動作遠沒有那麼瘋狂。在附近彎腰的是兩個更大的生物，它們看起來像是被蘑菇生長和黃黴覆蓋的類人猿。

english: Characters who know anything about myconids know that myconids don't dance. If {@creature Stool|OotA} is with the party, it points this out. This group is composed of three {@creature Myconid Adult||myconid adults} and five {@creature Myconid Sprout||myconid sprouts}. {@creature Stool|OotA} recognizes one of the sprouts—the one not dancing—as his buddy, {@creature Rumpadump|OotA} (see "Development"). The ape-like creatures are two {@creature Quaggoth Spore Servant||quaggoth spore servants}, and each one is covered with a patch of yellow mold (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). Whenever a quaggoth spore servant is touched or takes damage, it releases a cloud of yellow mold spores until its mold patch is destroyed.
zh_tw: 任何瞭解菌人族的人都知道菌人族不跳舞。如果{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}和隊伍在一起，它會指出這一點。這個群體由三個{@creature Myconid Adult||蕈人成體}和五個{@creature Myconid Sprout||蕈人幼體}組成。{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}認出了其中一個幼苗——那個沒有跳舞的——是它的朋友，{@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普}（見"發展"）。那兩個猿猴般生物是兩個{@creature Quaggoth Spore Servant||幽邃熊怪孢子奴僕}，每個都覆蓋著一塊黃色黴菌（見"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"中《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》的第5章）。每當誇格寄生孢子僕從被觸碰或受到傷害時，它會釋放一團黃色黴菌孢子，直到其黴菌斑被摧毀。

english: The myconids are too swept up in their silent revelry to notice the characters. If the adventurers attack, the myconid adults fight fiercely while the sprouts run and hide. The spore servants join the fray if either they or the myconids are threatened. Otherwise, they remain motionless.
zh_tw: 菌人們完全沉浸在他們無聲的狂歡中，沒有注意到角色們。如果冒險家們發動攻擊，菌人成年體會激烈戰鬥，而幼苗則會逃跑並躲藏。如果胞子僕從或菌人受到威脅，它們會加入戰鬥。否則，它們將保持靜止不動。

english: If the characters try to communicate with the myconids, they release rapport spores so that everyone can speak telepathically. The leader of the myconids is an adult named Voosbur, who speaks on behalf of the others. Sharing thoughts with these sentient mushrooms is an odd and strangely intoxicating experience (and feels quite different than the rapport the characters might have shared with {@creature Stool|OotA}). Voosbur happily tells the party how its "troupe" was attracted by the special mushrooms in these tunnels, and it tells the characters about the magical properties of the pygmywort and bigwig mushrooms. Voosbur further explains that the myconids didn't wander into this area, but arrived here by traveling "through the Lady's dream." Voosbur describes "the Lady" as a powerful being that loves and guides all myconids. He offers to share "the Lady's gift" with the characters, allowing them to travel "through the Lady's dream" as the myconids do. Characters who accept the offer gain Zuggtmoy's gift (see the sidebar).
zh_tw: 如果角色們試圖與菌人交流，他們會釋放親和孢子，這樣每個人都可以心靈感應地交談。菌人的領袖是一個名叫沃斯布爾的成年人，他代表其他人發言。與這些有感知能力的蘑菇分享思想是一種奇怪且異常令人陶醉的體驗（與角色可能與{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}共享的親和感覺非常不同）。沃斯布爾高興地告訴隊伍它的'劇團'是被這些隧道中的特殊蘑菇吸引過來的，它還告訴角色們縮身菇和巨冠菇的魔法屬性。沃斯布爾進一步解釋說，菌人不是無意中走到這個區域的，而是透過'女士的夢'旅行到這裡的。沃斯布爾將'女士'描述為一個強大而愛並指導所有菌人的存在。他提出與角色們分享'女士的禮物'，允許他們像菌人一樣'透過女士的夢'旅行。接受這個提議的角色將獲得祖格莫伊的禮物（見邊欄）。

english: If present, {@creature Stool|OotA} tells the characters it has no idea what Voosbur is talking about. Additionally, {@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA} starts to act erratically, trying to warn the characters away from the myconids, but unable to shake off the influence of Zuggtmoy's spores.
zh_tw: 如果存在，{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}告訴角色它不知道沃斯布爾在說什麼。此外，{@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA|薩里斯·克澤卡里特}開始行為異常，試圖警告角色遠離菌人，但無法擺脫祖格莫伊孢子的影響。

english: The myconid sprout standing by itself is named {@creature Rumpadump|OotA}. It sends a subtle warning as a feeling of distress through its own rapport spores in response to Voosbur's offer, saying that the other myconids aren't behaving right.
zh_tw: 獨自站立的菌人幼苗名為{@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普}。它透過自己的感應孢子傳送了一個微妙的警告，作為對沃斯布爾提議的反應，表達出一種不安的感覺，說其他菌人生物的行為不正常。

english: Roleplaying Rumpadump
zh_tw: 角色扮演蘭帕丹普

english: {@creature Rumpadump|OotA} is as introverted as {@creature Stool|OotA} is outgoing, preferring to hang back and not use its rapport spores unless absolutely necessary. Whether {@creature Stool|OotA} is present or not, {@creature Rumpadump|OotA} can guide the characters to Neverlight Grove (see {@adventure chapter 5|OotA|4}), where the sovereigns might know of a way out of the Underdark. However, the myconid sprout is worried that Voosbur's "strange spores" might have infected the rest of the myconids back home.
zh_tw: {@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普} 像 {@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳} 那樣內向，更喜歡退居幕後，除非絕對必要，否則不會使用它的交情孢子。無論 {@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳} 是否在場，{@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普} 都可以引導角色到達 無光林地（見 {@adventure 第五章|OotA|4}），在那裡的君主們或許知道如何從幽暗地域逃脫。然而，這個菌人幼苗擔心 沃斯布爾 的"奇怪孢子"可能已經感染了家鄉的其他菌人。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Voosbur takes no offense if the characters refuse his offer to teach them how to travel "the Lady's dream," simply bidding them farewell as the myconids resume their dancing. If the characters have shown {@creature Rumpadump|OotA} any kindness, it asks their permission to join the party, especially if {@creature Stool|OotA} is present. At the same time, Sarith breaks away from the party to join the myconids. The drow turns one last time to give the characters a look of terror and despair before his face loses all expression. He and the dancing myconids then enter a mushroom patch and use the {@spell tree stride} ability granted by Zuggtmoy's blessing to vanish from sight.
zh_tw: 如果角色們拒絕 沃斯布爾 提供的教授他們如何旅行"女士之夢"的提議，沃斯布爾 並不生氣，他只是簡單地向他們告別，然後菌人們恢復他們的舞蹈。如果角色們對 {@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普} 表現出任何善意，它會請求加入隊伍，尤其是如果 {@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳} 在場的話。同時，薩里斯 脫離隊伍加入菌人。這個卓爾最後一次回頭，向角色們投以恐懼和絕望的目光，然後他的臉失去了所有表情。他和跳舞的菌人們隨後進入一個蘑菇地，利用祖格莫伊的祝福賦予的 {@spell tree stride||樹躍術} 能力，從視線中消失。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: Award 50 XP to each character if the party parlayed with the myconids.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍與菌人進行了談判，給每個角色獎勵50經驗值。

english: 4. Fungi Thicket
zh_tw: 4. 真菌叢

english: This tunnel juncture is blocked by a thicket of fungi. The thicket is an ecosystem unto itself, with its own challenges for those who wish to cross it.
zh_tw: 這個隧道的交匯處被一片真菌叢阻擋。這片真菌叢本身就是一個生態系統，對於想要穿越它的人來說，它有自己的挑戰。

english: A dense fungi forest blocks your way, its tallest specimens growing some five feet high. Even as you assess the best way to pass through it, a hissing sound starts to rise—like uncounted tiny voices whispering in tongues you don't understand.
zh_tw: 一片密集的真菌森林阻擋了你的去路，其中最高的樣本高達五尺。正當你評估最好的透過方式時，一種嘶嘶聲開始升起——就像無數細小的聲音在你聽不懂的方言中低語。

english: Although creepy, the hissing sound is harmless, caused by air whistling through perforated mushrooms in the thicket of fungi. The characters can cross this area by forcing their way through it, or by eating pygmywort mushrooms first to move through without disturbing the other fungi present. If the characters are chasing {@creature Droki|OotA}, he uses the thicket to his advantage, eating a pygmywort to sneak his way across. At reduced size, he leaves no trail that normal-sized pursuers can follow.
zh_tw: 儘管令人毛骨悚然，嘶嘶聲其實是無害的，這是由於空氣透過真菌叢中的穿孔蘑菇時發出的哨聲。角色們可以透過強行穿過這個區域，或者先吃下矮人草菇來移動，而不會打擾到其他存在的真菌。如果角色們正在追逐 {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}，他會利用這個區域的優勢，吃下一個矮人草菇悄悄穿過。在縮小的體型下，他沒有留下任何正常大小追蹤者可以跟隨的蹤跡。

english: Tiny creatures can move through the thicket at no penalty. For Small and Medium creatures, the thicket is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. While in the thicket, Tiny and Small creatures have {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} against Medium creatures and can hide.
zh_tw: 微型生物能在菇叢中移動，不受任何減值。對小型與中型生物而言，菇叢是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。身處菇叢時，微型與小型生物對抗中型生物時具有{@quickref Cover||3||半身掩護}，且可以躲藏。

english: Creatures can negate the movement penalty by destroying the fungi before crossing the thicket. Each 5-foot-square area of fungi has AC 10 and 10 hit points. Any attack that deals fire damage has a 50 percent chance of igniting a torchstalk mushroom (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 生物在穿過叢林前摧毀真菌可以抵消移動懲罰。每5尺的真菌區域有AC 10和10點生命值。任何造成火焰傷害的攻擊有50%的機率點燃火把菌（見第2章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）。

english: The first time a Small or larger character reaches the tunnel intersection, two {@creature Swarm of Insects||swarms of insects} (centipedes) emerge from nests under the thicket and attack. Two more {@creature Swarm of Insects||swarms of insects} (spiders) arrive on the second round of combat, plus another {@creature Swarm of Centipedes||swarm of insects (centipedes)} on the third round.
zh_tw: 第一次有一個小型或更大的角色到達隧道交叉口時，兩個{@creature Swarm of Insects||昆蟲叢集}（蜈蚣）會從灌木叢下的巢穴中出現併發起攻擊。在戰鬥的第二輪，另外兩個{@creature Swarm of Insects||昆蟲叢集}（蜘蛛）會抵達，在第三輪，還會有一個{@creature Swarm of Centipedes||蟲群（蜈蚣）}抵達。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The abundance of fungi in the thicket makes it easy to forage here. Among the common, inedible fungi are the following edible and exotic fungi, most of which are described in {@area chapter 2|067|x}:
zh_tw: 灌木叢中豐富的真菌使得在這裡覓食變得容易。在常見的不可食用真菌中，有以下可食用的外來真菌，其中大部分在{@area 第二章|067|x}中有所描述：

english: {@dice 1d6} barrelstalks
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 桶菌

english: {@dice 3d6} bluecaps
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6}藍帽怪

english: {@dice 1d6} patches of fire lichen
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 片火地衣

english: {@dice 1d6} nightlights
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 夜光蟲

english: {@dice 1d6} Nilhogg's noses
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 尼爾霍格的鼻子

english: {@dice 1d6} sheets of ripplebark
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 張波紋樹皮

english: {@dice 1d6} timmasks
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 面罩怪

english: {@dice 1d6} torchstalks
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 火炬莖

english: {@dice 1d6} tongues of madness
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 瘋狂之舌

english: {@dice 1d6} trillimacs
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 特里米拉克

english: {@dice 2d6} bigwigs (see "{@i Faerzress}-Suffused Fungi")
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 巨冠菇（見"{@i 妖光}充斥的真菌"）

english: {@dice 2d6} pygmyworts (see "{@i Faerzress}-Suffused Fungi")
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6}縮身菇（見"{@i 妖光}-滲透真菌"）

english: Zuggtmoy's Gift
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊的禮物

english: A myconid with Zuggtmoy's gift can, as an action once per day, release a 20-foot-radius cloud of demon-tainted spores. Any other creature within the area that isn't already "blessed" with Zuggtmoy's gift must make a Constitution saving throw, with a save DC of 8 + the myconid's Constitution modifier + the myconid's proficiency bonus. A creature that forgoes or fails the saving throw becomes infected. While infected with Zuggtmoy's gift, the creature gains the ability to cast a special version of the {@spell tree stride} spell that has no components. This spell allows the infected creature to move through patches of mold and fungi instead of trees. Once it casts this spell, the infected creature can't cast the spell again until it finishes a long rest.
zh_tw: 擁有祖格莫伊之賜的菌人，每天可以作為一次行動，釋放一個20尺半徑的惡魔汙染孢子云。區域內任何尚未被祖格莫伊之賜"祝福"的其他生物必須進行一次體質豁免檢定，豁免難度為8加上菌人的體質調整值加上菌人的熟練加值。放棄或未透過豁免檢定的生物將被感染。被祖格莫伊之賜感染的生物獲得了施放一個特殊版本的{@spell tree stride||樹躍術}法術的能力，該法術無需任何材料。這個法術允許被感染的生物透過真菌和黴菌區域而不是樹木移動。一旦它施放了這個法術，被感染的生物在完成一次長休之前不能再施放這個法術。

english: Any creature infected with Zuggtmoy's gift has disadvantage on attack rolls against plant creatures. In addition, whenever an infected creature finishes a short or long rest, it must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature lapses into a state of euphoric bliss. While in this state, the creature can't take actions, bonus actions, or reactions, and must use all of its movement to dance and twirl about. At the end of its turn, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the euphoric bliss effect on a success.
zh_tw: 任何感染了祖格莫伊之禮的生物在對抗植物生物時攻擊檢定處於劣勢。此外，每當一個受感染的生物完成短休或長休時，它必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，該生物會陷入一種極度愉悅的狀態。在這種狀態下，該生物無法執行動作、附加動作或反應，並且必須使用所有移動力來跳舞和旋轉。在它的回合結束時，該生物可以重複進行一次豁免檢定，成功則結束極度愉悅的效果。

english: A {@spell remove curse} or {@spell greater restoration} spell rids a creature of Zuggtmoy's gift.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}或{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}法術可以解除生物身上的祖格莫伊之賜。

english: 5. Raucous Mesa
zh_tw: 5. 喧鬧的臺地

english: This chamber was sculpted by {@i faerzress} with the side effect of trapping sound.
zh_tw: 這個房間是由{@i 妖光}雕琢而成，副作用是困住聲音。

english: The glow of {@i faerzress} shifts across this chamber as if pushed by an unseen wind. It flows toward and around a large mesa and continues to spiral upward, but the ceiling of the cavern is too dark and high to see. You hear murmurs and whispers coming from atop the mesa, which grow louder as you approach. Its stacked levels resemble steps in a staircase, but a ramp running from top to bottom provides an easy way up.
zh_tw: {@i 妖光}的光芒在這個房間裡移動，彷彿被看不見的風吹動。它流向一個大臺地並環繞著它螺旋上升，但是洞穴的天花板太暗太高，看不見。你聽到從臺地上傳來的低語和耳語，當你接近時，它們變得越來越響。它的堆疊層級類似於樓梯的臺階，但是從頂部到底部的斜坡提供了一個容易上升的方式。

english: Climbing the mesa reveals that its steps aren't concentric circles but the bands of a spiral, rising from the cavern floor to the mesa's top.
zh_tw: 攀登這座平頂山揭示了它的臺階不是同心圓，而是螺旋狀的條紋，從洞穴底部一直延伸到平頂山的頂部。

english: The west wall has a noticeable crack leading to a narrow tunnel, which can be used as a shortcut to area 7 if the characters are small enough to fit through it (see the "Whorlstone Tunnels: General Features" sidebar). {@creature Droki|OotA} uses this narrow tunnel on his travels.
zh_tw: 西牆有一個明顯的裂縫，通向一個狹窄的隧道，如果角色足夠小能夠透過它，這個隧道可以作為到達區域7的捷徑（見"渦石隧道：一般特徵"側邊欄）。{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇} 在他的旅行中使用這個狹窄的隧道。

english: Characters at the top of the mesa hear the murmur of the chamber more clearly, and can recognize it as disparate sounds. They hear the rhythmic clank and roar of Gracklstugh's forges, the low rumble of {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s displeasure, the mad screaming of derro, and even hints and snatches of conversations. The {@i faerzress} in this place echoes the sounds produced in Gracklstugh above, creating a storm of noise.
zh_tw: 在臺地頂端的角色能夠更清晰地聽到大廳中的低語，並能識別出這些是不同來源的聲音。他們能聽到格拉克斯圖格冶煉廠有節奏的叮噹聲和轟鳴聲，{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}不滿的低沉咆哮，瘋狂尖叫的迪洛矮人，甚至還能捕捉到一些談話的片段。此處的{@i 妖光}迴盪著來自上方格拉克斯圖格的聲音，形成了一陣噪音風暴。

english: A character can use an action to focus on specific sounds but must make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw, taking 7 ({@dice 2d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A character who fails the saving throw by 5 or more gains one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2) as his or her mind is overwhelmed by what is heard.
zh_tw: 一個角色可以使用一個動作來專注於特定聲音，但必須進行一次{@dc 12}的感知豁免檢定，若失敗則受到7（{@dice 2d6}）點心靈傷害，成功則只受到一半傷害。若豁免檢定失敗且差值超過5，則該角色獲得一級瘋狂（見第2章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"），因其心智被聽到的內容所淹沒。

english: A character who exceeds the saving throw DC by 5 or more can ask one question about Gracklstugh that can be answered by overhearing any sound or conversation occurring within the previous tenday in the city above or in the Whorlstone Tunnels. This can include discovering {@creature Droki|OotA}'s current location by following his insane mutterings.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色超過豁免檢定的難度等級5或更多，他可以提出一個關於格拉克斯圖格的問題，這個問題可以透過偷聽在過去十天內在上方城市或渦石隧道中發生的任何聲音或對話來回答。這可以包括透過追蹤他的瘋狂自言自語來發現{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}的當前位置。

english: A character can focus on the sound in the chamber a number of times equal to his or her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). After that, the character no longer has the ability to tell sounds apart.
zh_tw: 一個角色可以根據他或她的感知調整值（最少1次）集中注意力在房間中的聲音上。之後，該角色不再有能力分辨聲音。

english: 6. Dire Den
zh_tw: 6. 險惡巢穴

english: This small network of tiny grottos leads into one of the dens of the Gray Ghosts, but it is the current residence of a warped creature called the {@creature Spider King|OotA}. The characters must travel through narrow tunnels to reach this area (see the "Whorlstone Tunnels: General Features" sidebar).
zh_tw: 這個由小洞穴組成的小網路通向灰鬼的一個巢穴，但目前是一個叫做{@creature Spider King|OotA|蜘蛛王}的扭曲生物的居所。角色們必須穿過狹窄的隧道才能到達這個區域（見"渦石隧道：一般特徵"側邊欄）。

english: The glow of {@i faerzress} in these tunnels reveals sticky white strands clinging to the walls. The strands become more dense as you move farther in.
zh_tw: 這些隧道中的{@i 妖光}光芒揭示了粘性的白色絲線附著在牆壁上。隨著你向內深入，這些絲線變得更加密集。

english: Map 4.3: Lair of the Spider King
zh_tw: 地圖 4.3：蜘蛛王的巢穴

english: The northeastern cave is the lair of the {@creature Spider King|OotA}—a two-headed giant spider warped by demonic influences into a vaguely humanoid shape. This horrific creature uses the {@creature giant spider} stat block with the following modifications:
zh_tw: 東北方的洞穴是{@creature Spider King|OotA|蜘蛛王}的巢穴——一隻被惡魔力量扭曲成大致人形的雙頭巨人蜘蛛。這個恐怖的生物使用{@creature giant spider||巨蜘蛛}的統計資料塊，並進行了以下修改：

english: The {@creature Spider King|OotA} has 44 hit points, a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 14, a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) modifier of +4, and the following saving throw bonuses: Constitution +3, Wisdom +2.
zh_tw: {@creature Spider King|OotA|蜘蛛王} 擁有44點生命值，被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分為14，感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）調整值為+4，以及以下豁免檢定加值：體質+3，感知+2。

english: Because of its two heads, the {@creature Spider King|OotA} has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.
zh_tw: 由於它有兩個頭，{@creature Spider King|OotA|蜘蛛王} 在進行感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定時具有優勢，並且在對抗被{@condition blinded||目盲}、{@condition charmed||魅惑}、{@condition deafened||耳聾}、{@condition frightened||恐懼}、{@condition unconscious||昏迷}以及被打{@condition stunned||震懾}的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

english: The {@creature Spider King|OotA} senses when intruders enter its domain and can't be {@status surprised} by them. Along with two normal {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} (its attendants), the {@creature Spider King|OotA} waits in ambush. It moves to the entrance of its chamber in an attempt to keep the characters bottled up, while the two giant spiders approach along the walls and ceiling, getting into position above creatures on the floor. The {@creature Spider King|OotA} and the giant spiders fight to the death, but they don't follow prey that flees.
zh_tw: {@creature Spider King|OotA|蜘蛛王}能感知到入侵者進入其領地，不會被他們{@status surprised||突襲}。它與兩隻普通的{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}（它的隨從）一起埋伏。{@creature Spider King|OotA|蜘蛛王}移動到其巢穴入口，試圖將角色們困住，而兩隻巨型蜘蛛則沿著牆壁和天花板前進，從上方對地面上的生物進行定位。{@creature Spider King|OotA|蜘蛛王}和巨型蜘蛛戰鬥至死，但它們不會追擊逃跑的獵物。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Sounds of combat here alert the duergar in area 7.
zh_tw: 這裡的戰鬥聲音會提醒區域7的灰矮人。

english: 7. Gray Ghost Garden
zh_tw: 7. 灰影花園

english: The Gray Ghosts use this chamber to grow a variety of fungi for use in alchemical experiments.
zh_tw: 灰鬼使用這個房間種植各種真菌，用於鍊金實驗。

english: Double doors blocks the western tunnel. The doors are made of thick zurkhwood and reinforced with crudely forged steel. The sturdy lock can be opened with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. A successful {@dc 20} Strength check will break the doors down.
zh_tw: 雙扇門擋住了西邊的隧道。這些門由厚實的祖克木製成，並用粗糙鍛造的鋼加固。堅固的鎖可以透過使用盜賊工具進行成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來開啟。成功的{@dc 20}力量檢定可以將門砸開。

english: The smell of rot is strong in this room, coming from a large depression at the center, where dozens of fungi of many species grow. A barrel-shaped copper tank sits at the edge of the pit. Attached to the tank is a tall copper pipe that arcs over the pit. Crates line one wall.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡腐朽的氣味非常強烈，來自中心的一個大型凹陷處，那裡生長著許多不同種類的真菌。一個桶狀的銅罐位於坑邊。罐子上連線著一根高高的銅管，橫跨在坑上方。板條箱排列在一面牆上。

english: Map 4.4: Gray Ghost Garden
zh_tw: 地圖 4.4：灰影花園

english: Three {@creature duergar} work here. They are members of the Gray Ghosts who have been assigned gardening duty. They attack as soon as they see intruders. If the characters arrive through the crack in the east wall (see "Fungi Pit"), they can hide among the fungi and try to catch the duergar by surprise. If the characters make a lot of noise in area 6 or force their way through the doors to the west, the duergar turn {@condition invisible} and attack as soon as the characters arrive.
zh_tw: 三名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}在這裡工作。他們是灰鬼的成員，被分配了園藝任務。他們一看到入侵者就會發動攻擊。如果角色透過東牆的裂縫進入（見"真菌坑"），他們可以藏在真菌中，試圖出其不意地抓住灰矮人。如果角色在區域6製造很多噪音或強行透過西邊的門，灰矮人會變成{@condition invisible||隱形}，並在角色到達時立即攻擊。

english: At the start of combat, two duergar use their Enlarge action while the third opens the valve on the copper tank and aims its nozzle at the characters. During the second round of combat on the same initiative count as the duergar, the {@creature duergar alchemist|OotA} from area 8 joins the fight. If the other duergar fall, the alchemist turns {@condition invisible} and tries to escape.
zh_tw: 戰鬥開始時，兩名灰矮人使用他們的放大行動，而第三名灰矮人開啟銅罐的閥門，並將噴嘴對準角色。在第二回合的戰鬥中，與灰矮人相同的先攻計數時，來自區域8的{@creature duergar alchemist|OotA|灰矮人鍊金術士}加入戰鬥。如果其他灰矮人倒下，鍊金術士會變成{@condition invisible||隱形}並試圖逃跑。

english: Fungi Pit
zh_tw: 真菌坑

english: The pit is 5 feet deep and filled with various kinds of fungi. It is {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for Small and Medium creatures, and Tiny creatures have {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} while amid the fungi.
zh_tw: 這座坑深5尺，長滿各種真菌。對小型與中型生物而言，這裡是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}；微型生物身處真菌叢中時則具有{@quickref Cover||3||半身掩護}。

english: A crack in the east wall forms the mouth of a narrow tunnel that leads from the floor of the pit to area 6; see the "Whorlstone Tunnels: General Features" sidebar for more information on narrow tunnels.
zh_tw: 東牆上的一條裂縫形成了一條狹窄隧道的入口，從坑底通往區域6；有關狹窄隧道的更多資訊，請參閱"渦石隧道：一般特徵"側邊欄。

english: The abundance of fungi in the thicket makes it easy to forage here. Among the common, inedible fungi are the following edible and exotic fungi, most of which are described in {@area chapter 2|067|x}:
zh_tw: 灌木叢中豐富的真菌使得在這裡覓食變得容易。在常見的不可食用真菌中，有以下可食用的外來真菌，其中大部分在{@area 第二章|067|x}中有所描述：

english: {@dice 1d6} barrelstalks
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 桶菌

english: {@dice 3d6} bluecaps
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6}藍帽怪

english: {@dice 1d6} Nilhogg's noses
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 尼爾霍格的鼻子

english: {@dice 2d6} sheets of ripplebark
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6}張波紋樹皮

english: {@dice 1d6} timmasks
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 面罩怪

english: {@dice 1d6} torchstalks
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 火炬莖

english: {@dice 2d6} trillimacs
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 特里米拉克

english: {@dice 2d6} bigwigs (see "{@i Faerzress}-Suffused Fungi")
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 巨冠菇（見"{@i 妖光}充斥的真菌"）

english: {@dice 2d6} pygmyworts (see "{@i Faerzress}-Suffused Fungi")
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6}縮身菇（見"{@i 妖光}-滲透真菌"）

english: A character proficient and equipped with a poisoner's kit can also collect {@dice 1d6} doses of assassin's blood poison from the fungi pit (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
zh_tw: 一個熟練且裝備了毒藥師工具的角色還可以從真菌坑中收集{@dice 1d6}劑量的刺客之血毒藥（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第8章中的"{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}"）。

english: Sprinkler Tank
zh_tw: 灑水罐

english: The copper tank is a sprinkler used by the duergar to fertilize the fungi in the pit. The copper pipe that extends from the tank is 10 feet long and can be turned so that its nozzle points in any direction. The nozzle is pointed toward the pit by default.
zh_tw: 這個銅罐是一個灑水裝置，由灰矮人用來給坑中的真菌施肥。從罐子延伸出來的銅管長10尺，可以轉動，使其噴嘴指向任何方向。預設情況下，噴嘴指向坑內。

english: Any creature can use an action to open or close a valve on the tank, releasing a cloud of pungent fertilizer that fills a 30-foot cube. The cloud grows 10 feet per side each round the valve remains open. The cloud has the same effect as a {@spell stinking cloud} spell (save {@dc 12}), but the effect ends {@dice 1d4 + 1} rounds after the valve is closed or the tank runs out of fertilizer. The tank contains enough fertilizer to spray for 10 rounds.
zh_tw: 任何生物都可以用一個動作開啟或關閉儲罐上的閥門，釋放出一團刺鼻的肥料雲，充滿30尺的立方體。在閥門保持開啟的每一輪，雲團每邊增長10尺。雲團具有與 {@spell stinking cloud||臭雲術} 法術相同的效果（豁免 {@dc 12}），但在閥門關閉或儲罐肥料耗盡後 {@dice 1d4 + 1} 輪效果結束。儲罐含有足夠的肥料可以噴灑10輪。

english: As an action or a bonus action, a creature can turn the pipe 90 degrees in any direction.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作或附贈動作，生物可以將管子向任何方向旋轉90度。

english: Crates
zh_tw: 板條箱

english: The crates along the north wall are made of zurkhwood and stacked 5 feet high, and climbing on top of them costs 5 feet of movement. Most of the crates are empty, but four of them contain harvested, edible fungi. Each crate of fungi weighs 50 pounds, contains the equivalent of 20 days of rations, and can be sold in Gracklstugh or another Underdark settlement for 25 gp.
zh_tw: 靠北牆的板條箱由祖克木製成，堆疊了5尺高，爬上它們需要5尺的移動力。大多數板條箱是空的，但其中四個裝有收穫的、可食用的真菌。每個裝有真菌的板條箱重50磅，包含相當於20天的口糧，並且在格拉克斯圖格或另一個幽暗地域的定居點可以賣25金幣。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters keep any duergar alive for questioning, it takes a successful {@dc 16} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check to gain an answer to a single question. The characters can ask only three questions total before the surviving duergar become incoherent and start frothing at the mouth—a form of madness brought on by demon-tainted {@i faerzress}. Any spell or effect that cures indefinite madness also restores a duergar's sanity (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
zh_tw: 如果角色們留活口審問灰矮人，需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 16} 魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定才能獲得一個問題的答案。角色們總共只能問三個問題，之後倖存的灰矮人就會變得語無倫次，並開始口吐白沫——這是由惡魔汙染的 {@i 妖光}引發的一種瘋狂。任何治療永久瘋狂的咒語或效果也能恢復灰矮人的理智（詳情見《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》第8章的"{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}"）。

english: The duergar stationed here are tasked with protecting the fungi garden and helping the alchemist in his work. They use a trapdoor in area 8 to move between the Whorlstone Tunnels and the Darklake Docks in Gracklstugh. They have been ordered not to explore the rest of the Whorlstone Tunnels, though their leaders sometimes go farther into the tunnels on unknown business.
zh_tw: 駐守在這裡的灰矮人負責保護真菌花園，並幫助鍊金術士完成他的工作。他們使用區域8的一個活板門在渦石隧道和格拉克斯圖格的黑暗湖碼頭之間移動。他們被命令不要探索渦石隧道的其餘部分，儘管他們的領袖有時會因未知的事務更深入隧道。

english: 8. Gray Alchemist
zh_tw: 8. 灰袍鍊金術士

english: The Gray Ghosts have claimed this cave as both a safe house and a laboratory, where their alchemists can work in relative peace and isolation.
zh_tw: 灰鬼將這個洞穴作為安全屋和實驗室，他們的鍊金術士可以在這裡相對平靜和隔離地工作。

english: This area is surprisingly clean and orderly, split into two levels connected by a ramp made from zurkhwood planks. The upper level contains a fully furnished laboratory, while the lower level has two bunk beds. The wall of the lower level is set with a closed door.
zh_tw: 這個區域出人意料地乾淨有序，被分割成兩個層次，由祖克木製成的坡道連線。上層設有一個裝置齊全的實驗室，而下層有兩張雙層床。下層的牆壁上設有一扇關閉的門。

english: Unless he is drawn to sounds of combat in area 7, a {@creature duergar alchemist|OotA} (see the sidebar) named Lorthio Bukbukken works on the upper level of this area. Lorthio's laboratory contains a work table, a desk, a case of shelves lined with vials, and a dome-shaped oven. All furnishings are made of zurkhwood except the oven, which is made of stone.
zh_tw: 除非他被區域7中的戰鬥聲吸引，否則名為洛希歐·布克布肯的{@creature duergar alchemist|OotA|灰矮人鍊金術士}（見側邊欄）會在這片區域的上層工作。洛希歐的實驗室裡有一個工作臺、一張桌子、一個擺滿小瓶的架子，以及一個圓頂形的爐子。所有的傢俱都是祖克木製成的，除了爐子，它是石頭製成的。

english: The lower level is 10 feet below the laboratory and contains two bunk beds and two small chests, all made of zurkhwood (See "Treasure" below for information on the contents of the chests). The door is barred on this side and has closed peepholes at dwarf's-eye height. Opening the peepholes allows one to see into the room beyond. The bar is easily lifted from this side, but breaking down the door requires a successful {@dc 20} Strength check.
zh_tw: 下層位於實驗室下方10尺處，包含兩張雙層床和兩個小箱子，全部由紫木製成（有關箱子內容的資訊，請參閱下方的"寶藏"部分）。門在這一側被閂住，並在矮人眼睛的高度設有關閉的窺視孔。開啟窺視孔可以看見裡面的房間。從這一側可以輕鬆抬起門閂，但要想破門而入，則需要成功透過一項 {@dc 20} 的力量檢定。

english: The room east of the door is empty except for an iron ladder that climbs 60 feet to a stone trapdoor embedded in the ceiling. The trapdoor is unlocked, and above it a narrow, spiraling tunnel leads to the Darklake Docks.
zh_tw: 門東邊的房間除了一個鐵梯子外是空的，梯子向上爬升60尺到達嵌在天花板中的石質活板門。活板門是未上鎖的，它上方有一條狹窄的螺旋形隧道，通往黑暗湖碼頭。

english: Duergar Alchemist
zh_tw: 灰矮人鍊金術士

english: A {@creature duergar alchemist|OotA} carries two vials of acid and two flasks of alchemist's fire. It uses the normal {@creature duergar} stat block but replaces the Javelin attack option with the following attack options:
zh_tw: 一個{@creature duergar alchemist|OotA|灰矮人鍊金術士}攜帶兩瓶酸液和兩個鍊金術士的火瓶。它使用標準的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}統計資料塊，但將標槍攻擊選項替換為以下攻擊選項：

english: Acid Vial
zh_tw: 強酸瓶

english: {@i Ranged Weapon Attack}: {@hit 4} to hit, range 20 ft., one target. {@i Hit}: 7 ({@dice 2d6}) acid damage.
zh_tw: {@i 遠端武器攻擊}: {@hit 4} 命中，範圍 20 尺，單一目標。{@i 命中}: 7 ({@dice 2d6}) 強酸傷害。

english: Alchemist's Fire
zh_tw: 熾火膠

english: {@i Ranged Weapon Attack}: {@hit 4} to hit, range 20 ft., one target. {@i Hit}: 2 ({@dice 1d4}) fire damage at the start of each of the target's turns. A creature can end this damage by using its action to make a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.
zh_tw: {@i 遠端武器攻擊}：{@hit 4}命中，範圍20尺，單一目標。{@i 命中}：在目標的每個回合開始時造成2（{@dice 1d4}）火焰傷害。一個生物可以用動作進行一次成功的{@dc 10}敏捷檢定來熄滅火焰以結束此傷害。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Sounds of combat here alert the duergar in area 7. They use their Enlarge actions before heading this way.
zh_tw: 這裡的戰鬥聲會提醒區域7的灰矮人。他們會在使用放大行動後再朝這邊來。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If the characters spend 1 hour ransacking the lab, they can assemble two herbalism kits, one poisoner's kit, and ten healer's kits. In the (unlocked) zurkhwood chests, they find {@dice 1d6} vials of acid, {@dice 1d6} flasks of alchemist's fire, two {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}, one {@item potion of greater healing}, one {@item potion of fire breath}, and one {@item potion of psychic resistance}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們花費1小時搜查實驗室，他們可以組裝兩個草藥工具包，一個毒藥工具包，以及十個治療工具包。在（未上鎖的）祖克木木箱中，他們發現{@dice 1d6}瓶酸液，{@dice 1d6}個鍊金術士之火的燒瓶，兩個{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}，一瓶{@item potion of greater healing||高等治療藥水}，一瓶{@item potion of fire breath||火焰吐息藥水}，以及一瓶{@item potion of psychic resistance||心靈抗性藥水}。

english: Depending on whether or not {@creature Droki|OotA} delivered his parcel and took his payment, the desk contains either a lump of black metal or a holy symbol of Laduguer made of mithral (see "Finding {@creature Droki|OotA}"). The desk also holds alchemical recipes scrawled in Dwarvish on torn strips of parchment. A character who studies these scraps for an hour and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check can piece together the formulas for crafting vials of acid and flasks of alchemist's fire. The character can gather enough ingredients in the laboratory to craft {@dice 1d4} of each. The character who knows the recipe and has the proper ingredients can craft a vial of acid or flask of alchemist's fire in 1 hour.
zh_tw: 根據{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}是否成功送達包裹並取得報酬，桌上要麼會有一塊黑色金屬，要麼會有一個由秘銀製成的拉杜格神聖符號（詳見"尋找{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}"）。桌子上還有一些寫在破損羊皮紙上的矮人語鍊金配方。一個角色如果花費一小時研究這些碎片，並透過了{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，可以拼湊出製作酸液瓶和鍊金師之火燒瓶的配方。角色可以在實驗室裡收集到足夠的材料來製作每種{@dice 1d4}個。知道配方並擁有適當材料的角色可以在1小時內製作一個酸液瓶或鍊金師之火燒瓶。

english: A character who searches the desk and succeeds on a {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check also finds a letter hidden in a secret compartment. The letter is written in Dwarvish on a patch of lizard hide:
zh_tw: 一個角色搜尋桌子併成功透過了 {@dc 12} 智力 ({@skill Investigation||調查}) 檢定，還會發現藏在秘密隔間裡的一封信。信是用矮人語寫在蜥蜴皮上的：

english: I don't need your poison anymore. I'll deal with Werz Saltbaron myself. Bring me an elf blade, one with the swirlies carved on the steel, and I'll forget you failed me. And I don't want to see any of your goons near my post. The captain is poking around, and I could use a scapegoat.
zh_tw: 我不再需要你的毒藥了。我會親自對付沃茲·鹽爵。給我帶來一把精靈的刀，一把鋼上雕刻有旋渦花紋的，我會忘記你讓我失望的事。而且我不想看到你們任何一個手下在我的崗位附近。隊長正在四處打探，我可能需要一個替罪羊。

english: –Gorglak
zh_tw: ——戈格拉克

english: If the characters capture Lorthio and question him about the letter, he reveals one of the following bits of information each time a character succeeds on a {@dc 13} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check:
zh_tw: 如果角色們抓住洛希歐並詢問他關於信件的事，每當一個角色成功進行 {@dc 13} 魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定時，他會透露以下資訊之一：

english: Gorglak is a warrior of the Stone Guard stationed at one of the outer gates near the Darklake District.
zh_tw: 戈格拉克是石衛隊的一名戰士，駐紮在靠近黑暗湖區的外圍大門之一。

english: Gorglak is an avid collector of weird weapons.
zh_tw: 戈格拉克是一位熱衷於收集奇異武器的收藏家。

english: Gorglak is easily bribed.
zh_tw: 戈格拉克很容易被賄賂。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: Presenting Gorglak's letter to Captain Errde Blackskull earns each character 50 XP for retrieving evidence of corruption within the ranks of the Stone Guard.
zh_tw: 向艾德·黑顱隊長出示戈格拉克的信件，每個角色因揭露石衛隊內部腐敗的證據而獲得50經驗值。

english: 9. Fountain of Evil
zh_tw: 9. 邪惡之泉

english: Foul water from the Darklake spills into this cave, forming a pool. See the "Whorlstone Tunnels: General Features" sidebar for the effects of drinking foul water. The ceiling in this cave is 80 feet high.
zh_tw: 來自黑暗湖的惡臭水體流入這個洞穴，形成了一個水池。有關飲用惡臭水體的效果，請參見"渦石隧道：一般特徵"側邊欄。這個洞穴的天花板高80尺。

english: The chamber splits into two paths surrounding a large pool, filled by water trickling from stalactites along the ceiling. The western path forms a ramp above the pool's surface, while the eastern path runs level with the water and continues into a tunnel opening. The water turns darker toward the center of the pool, where it transforms from a gentle swirl into a churning vortex.
zh_tw: 這個房間分成兩條圍繞大型水池的小徑，水池由洞頂鐘乳石滴下的水充滿。西邊的小徑形成了一個位於水池上方的坡道，而東邊的小徑與水面齊平，並延伸進入一個隧道口。水在水池中心變得更暗，從輕柔的漩渦變成了翻騰的旋渦。

english: A {@creature water weird} bound to the pool years has been corrupted by the demonic influence infecting these tunnels, turning it evil and giving it a dark hunger.
zh_tw: 一個多年被繫結在水池中的{@creature water weird||水詭}已經被侵染這些隧道的惡魔力量腐蝕，變得邪惡，並賦予了它一種黑暗的渴望。

english: The western path slopes upward to a maximum height of 60 feet above the pool's surface. If the characters take this upper path, the water weird attacks them when they are 30 feet above the surface of the pool, as it was bound here to protect the path leading to area 16. The water weird can command the pool's water to erupt like a geyser, effectively lifting the water weird up to the characters' level and putting them within its reach. Any character the water weird successfully grapples is dropped in the pool, taking no damage from the fall. The pool is 30 feet deep in the middle and 5 feet deep near the shore.
zh_tw: 西邊的路徑向上傾斜，最高點位於水池表面以上60尺。如果角色們走這條上面的路徑，當他們位於水池表面以上30尺時，水詭會攻擊他們，因為它被繫結在這裡保護通往區域16的路徑。水詭可以指揮水池中的水像間歇泉一樣噴發，有效地將水詭升至角色們的水平，並使他們處於其攻擊範圍內。任何被水詭成功抓住的角色將被放入水池中，從掉落中不會受到傷害。水池中間深30尺，靠近岸邊處深5尺。

english: If the characters follow {@creature Droki|OotA} into this chamber, they see him sneaking carefully along the eastern path. They can attempt to follow him with a group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check contested by the water weird's passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score. If more than half the characters fail the check, the water weird notices them and attacks. If the characters are attacked by the water weird while following {@creature Droki|OotA}, the wily derro realizes he's being shadowed and makes a run for it.
zh_tw: 如果角色們跟隨{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}進入這個房間，他們會看到他正沿著東邊的路徑小心地潛行。他們可以嘗試用群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定與水詭的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分進行對抗。如果有超過一半的角色未能透過檢定，水詭會注意到他們並發動攻擊。如果角色們在追蹤{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}時被水詭攻擊，這個狡猾的迪洛矮人意識到自己被跟蹤了，會轉身逃跑。

english: 10. Cultist Pens
zh_tw: 10. 邪教徒圍欄

english: The insane derro cultists have been buying cave bears from Underdark hunters and smuggling them through Gracklstugh. For what purpose is anyone's guess.
zh_tw: 那些瘋狂的迪洛矮人邪教徒一直在從幽暗地域的獵人那裡購買洞穴熊，並透過格拉克斯圖格走私它們。至於他們的目的，誰也猜不到。

english: A large gate made of iron bars blocks the northwest entrance and is usually locked. One of the derro cultists carries the key. The lock can be opened with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. A creature with a Strength of 20 or higher can force the gate open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength check.
zh_tw: 一扇由鐵條製成的大門擋住了西北入口，通常上鎖。其中一名迪洛矮人邪教徒攜帶著鑰匙。使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定可以開啟鎖。力量達到20或更高的生物可以透過一次成功的{@dc 25}力量檢定強行開啟大門。

english: The first thing you notice as you enter the room is a heavy, unpleasant musk in the air, coming from cages assembled from scrap iron on both sides of the chamber. A spiral path circles into the center of the room, marked off by small stone pylons.
zh_tw: 你進入房間時首先注意到的是空氣中濃重、令人不快的麝香味，它來自房間兩側由廢舊鐵料組裝成的籠子。一條螺旋形的小徑環繞至房間中心，由小石柱隔開。

english: Two derro stand by a large cauldron in front of a tent near the cave's center. Both are talking while apparently ignoring each other. In the cages, three hulking brown bears appear to be resting.
zh_tw: 兩個迪洛矮人站在洞穴中心附近的帳篷前的大鍋旁。他們邊說話邊顯然在忽視對方。在籠子裡，三隻魁梧的棕熊似乎在休息。

english: The two {@creature derro|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) are cultists. One of them is complaining about "the master" while the other talks about something he once fished out of the Darklake.
zh_tw: 那兩個{@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）是邪教徒。其中一個正在抱怨"大師"，而另一個則在談論他曾經從黑暗湖中釣出來的東西。

english: Map 4.5: Cultist Pens
zh_tw: 地圖 4.5：邪教徒圍欄

english: The three cave bears (use the {@creature polar bear} statistics) are alert, despite appearances to the contrary. Characters hoping to sneak past them must succeed on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks contested by the bears' passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 13. On their first turn, the cultists move to free the bears. Each cage is closed with a simple bolt that can be unlatched with an action. Once the first two bears are set free, the third bear breaks out of its cage on its own.
zh_tw: 這三隻洞穴熊（使用{@creature polar bear||白熊}的具體數值）是警覺的，儘管外表看起來不是這樣。希望能夠悄無聲息地爬過它們的角色必須在敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定中成功，與熊的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分13相對抗。在他們的第一回合，邪教徒移動去釋放熊。每個籠子都用一個簡單的門閂關閉，可以用一個動作開啟。一旦前兩隻熊被釋放，第三隻熊會自己破籠而出。

english: A crack in the south wall leads to a narrow tunnel that wends toward area 12. Medium and larger creatures are too big to fit through this narrow tunnel (see the "Whorlstone Tunnels: General Features" sidebar).
zh_tw: 南牆上的一條裂縫通向一條蜿蜒通往區域12的狹窄隧道。中型和更大的生物體積太大，無法穿過這條狹窄的隧道（見"渦石隧道：一般特徵"側邊欄）。

english: Spiral Path
zh_tw: 螺旋路徑

english: This path helps to channel the ritual magic the cultists use to tame the cave bears. Though the ritual is currently inactive, the area radiates a faint aura of enchantment under the scrutiny of a {@spell detect magic} spell.
zh_tw: 這條路徑有助於引導邪教徒用來馴服洞穴熊的儀式魔法。儘管儀式目前處於非活躍狀態，但在{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術的探查下，這個區域散發出微弱的附魔氣息。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Inside the tent are two flea-ridden bedrolls, a zurkhwood bucket containing edible fungi (the equivalent of two days of rations), and a wineskin full of Darklake Stout.
zh_tw: 帳篷裡有兩卷滿是跳蚤的睡袋，一個裝有可食用真菌的祖克木桶（相當於兩天的口糧），以及一個裝滿黑暗湖烈性黑啤酒的酒囊。

english: 11. Quasit Playground
zh_tw: 11. 小惡魔遊樂場

english: Some of the cult's more powerful derro savants keep quasits as familiars, and the wee demons discovered this tunnel network. They use the tunnels as shortcuts to deliver messages across the areas of the Whorlstone Tunnels controlled by the cultists, or simply to hide from their duties. Shrinking down allows the characters to more easily navigate this area.
zh_tw: 邪教中一些更強大的迪洛矮人智者保留著誇茲特作為寵物，這些小惡魔發現了這個隧道網路。他們利用隧道作為捷徑，在邪教徒控制的渦石隧道各區域之間傳遞資訊，或者僅僅為了逃避他們的職責。縮小體型可以讓角色更容易地在這個區域中穿行。

english: The narrow tunnel is lit by the same dim, ambient light found throughout this complex. Ahead, you hear the high-pitched cackling of several creatures.
zh_tw: 這條狹窄的隧道被整個建築群中發現的那種昏暗的環境光線照亮。前方，你聽到幾個生物發出的尖銳的咯咯笑聲。

english: Four {@creature Quasit||quasits} are wrestling each other farther along in the tunnel. If they notice the characters, they attack.
zh_tw: 四個{@creature Quasit||小惡魔}在隧道深處相互摔跤。如果它們注意到角色們，它們會發動攻擊。

english: When two quasits are reduced to 0 hit points, the two remaining ones turn {@condition invisible} and flee. However, they make enough noise in doing so for the characters to follow them by sound. If any quasit escapes, the cultists in area 12 can't be {@status surprised} and prepare an ambush.
zh_tw: 當兩個小惡魔降至0生命值時，剩下的兩個會變為{@condition invisible||隱形}並逃跑。然而，它們在逃跑時製造了足夠的噪音，角色們可以透過聲音追蹤它們。如果有任何小惡魔逃脫，區域12的邪教徒將無法被{@status surprised||突襲}，並準備伏擊。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters manage to capture and interrogate a quasit, the creature readily surrenders the name of {@creature Narrak|OotA}—the {@creature derro savant|OotA} leading the cultists in the Whorlstone Tunnels (see area 12). In exchange for its life, the quasit reveals that the cult plans to curse Gracklstugh's stone giants with madness as a means to sowing chaos in the city.
zh_tw: 如果角色們設法捕獲並審問一個小惡魔，這個生物很願意供出{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}——領導著渦石隧道中邪教徒的{@creature derro savant|OotA|迪洛矮人學者}（見區域12）。作為交換其生命的條件，小惡魔透露邪教計劃用瘋狂詛咒格拉克斯圖格的石巨人，以此作為在城市中播下混亂的手段。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: Each character earns a special award of 50 XP if the party learns of {@creature Narrak|OotA}'s plans from a quasit.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍從小惡魔那裡得知了{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}的計劃，每個角色將獲得50 XP的特別獎勵。

english: 12. Cultist Hideout
zh_tw: 12. 邪教徒藏身之處

english: {@creature Droki|OotA} enters this cavern from the east, via a narrow tunnel that comes up through a crack in the cavern floor (see the "Narrow Tunnels" section of the "Whorlstone Tunnels: General Features" sidebar).
zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇} 從東邊透過一條狹窄的隧道進入這個洞穴，隧道透過洞穴地面上的一條裂縫通上來（見"渦石隧道：一般特徵"側邊欄中的"狹窄隧道"部分）。

english: West of the cavern is a shrieker that serves as an alarm system (see "Fungi Patches") and a pit trap (see "Trap").
zh_tw: 洞穴的西側有一個尖叫菌，它作為報警系統（見"真菌區"）以及一個坑洞陷阱（見"陷阱"）。

english: The smell of brimstone and foul chemicals emanates from this large chamber. The light of campfires shows a natural platform where five derro are droning a cacophonous chant. A two-headed dog stirs inside a cage, while another derro nearby plays with a crossbow and watches the dog nervously.
zh_tw: 這個大廳裡散發著硫磺和惡臭化學物質的氣味。營火的光芒映照出一個天然平臺，上面有五個迪洛矮人在發出刺耳的吟唱。一隻雙頭狗在籠子裡動來動去，而另一個迪洛矮人在附近玩弄著十字弓，緊張地看著這隻狗。

english: A green glow rises suddenly from a magic circle at the center of the platform, where a small humanoid statue is the focus of the chanting ritual. As you watch, a lump sprouts from the statue's neck, enlarging and reshaping itself with each unholy verse to take the form of a second head.
zh_tw: 突然間，一個綠色的光芒從平臺中心的魔法陣中升起，那裡有一個小型人形雕像，是吟唱儀式的焦點。當你觀察時，雕像的頸部長出一個腫塊，隨著每一個邪惡的詩句，它不斷增大並重塑自己，形成了第二個頭顱的形狀。

english: Map 4.6: Cultist Hideout
zh_tw: 地圖 4.6：邪教徒藏身之地

english: {@creature Narrak|OotA}, a {@creature derro savant|OotA}, belongs to a fringe group within the Council of Savants using demonology as a path to power. Since the arrival of the demon lords, he has gathered and bullied several apprentices to participate in rituals aimed to sow chaos in Gracklstugh. {@creature Narrak|OotA} knows the stone giants are a pillar of the Deepking's power, and that cursing them with Demogorgon's madness will be an appropriate first step toward delivering the entire city to the demon lord.
zh_tw: {@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}，一個{@creature derro savant|OotA|迪洛矮人學者}，屬於智者議會內一個邊緣團體，他們使用惡魔學作為通往力量的道路。自從惡魔領主到來後，他聚集並恐嚇了幾名學徒參與儀式，目的是在格拉克斯圖格製造混亂。{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}知道石巨人是深王權力的支柱，用狄摩高根的瘋狂詛咒他們是將整個城市交給惡魔領主的合適第一步。

english: The cage by the tunnel holds a {@creature death dog}, watched over by a nervous {@creature derro|OotA} cultist. Atop the platform, {@creature Narrak|OotA} and four more {@creature derro|OotA} cultists are performing a ritual around the statue at its center. (Statistics for {@creature Narrak|OotA} and the derro can be found in {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}.) The cultists' chanting is punctuated with {@creature Narrak|OotA} calling out the name "Demogorgon!" Also atop the platform, resting comfortably in an fungi-filled alcove (and initially out of the party's view), is {@creature Narrak|OotA}'s bodyguard—a female {@creature ettin} named Grula-Munga.
zh_tw: 隧道旁的籠子裡關著一隻{@creature death dog||亡命惡犬}，由一個緊張的{@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}邪教徒看守著。平臺上，{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}和另外四個{@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}邪教徒正在中央的雕塑周圍進行儀式。（{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}和迪洛矮人的資料可以在{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}中找到。）邪教徒們的吟唱不時被{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}高呼的名字"狄摩高根！"打斷。同樣在平臺上，舒適地躺在一個充滿真菌的壁龕裡（最初未被隊伍發現）的是{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}的保鏢——一個名叫格魯拉－蒙加的女性{@creature ettin||雙頭巨人}。

english: When intruders appear, the cultists cease their chanting and take up positions along the edge of the platform as Grula-Munga rises to her feet and picks up her weapons. At the same time, the cultist standing next to the cage releases the death dog. {@creature Narrak|OotA} continues his part in the ritual until the characters kill the death dog or one of the cultists, at which point he joins the battle. The door to the death dog's cage is held shut with a simple clasp and requires an action to open.
zh_tw: 當入侵者出現時，邪教徒停止他們的吟唱並沿著平臺邊緣佔據位置，同時格魯拉－蒙加站起來拿起她的武器。與此同時，站在籠子旁邊的邪教徒釋放了死亡犬。{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}繼續他的儀式部分，直到角色們殺死死亡犬或其中一個邪教徒，此時他才加入戰鬥。死亡犬的籠門是用一個簡單的扣子關上的，需要一個動作來開啟。

english: If any of the quasits escaped from area 11, they warn the cultists that intruders are near. Otherwise, the characters might catch the cultists by surprise. The quasits remain {@condition invisible} and stay close to {@creature Narrak|OotA}.
zh_tw: 如果有任何小惡魔從區域11逃脫，它們會警告邪教徒入侵者接近了。否則，角色們可能會出其不意地抓住邪教徒。小惡魔保持{@condition invisible||隱形}並靠近{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}。

english: Fungi Patches
zh_tw: 真菌區

english: Fungi is rampant throughout this area, growing in large patches on the floors and walls.
zh_tw: 這個區域的真菌生長非常猖獗，在地板和牆壁上形成了大片的菌斑。

english: Two thick fungi patches grow by each wall in the western tunnel. Clinging to the north wall is a {@creature shrieker} that party members can recognize with a successful {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) check. The shrieker starts screaming as soon as anyone comes within 30 feet of it.
zh_tw: 在西部的隧道中，每個牆邊都長著兩塊厚厚的真菌斑塊。附著在北牆上的是一個{@creature shrieker||尖叫菌}，隊員可以透過成功的{@dc 12}智力（{@skill Nature||自然}）檢定來識別它。一旦有人進入尖叫菌30尺範圍內，它就會開始尖叫。

english: The crack in the floor by the east wall is surrounded by a thick fungus patch that is {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for Small and Medium characters, and provides {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} for Tiny creatures. Growing among the common fungi are {@dice 2d6} bigwigs and {@dice 2d6} pygmyworts.
zh_tw: 東牆旁的地板裂縫被濃密菇叢包圍；對小型與中型角色而言，這裡是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}，並能為微型生物提供{@quickref Cover||3||半身掩護}。普通真菌間生長著{@dice 2d6}株巨冠菇和{@dice 2d6}株縮身菇。

english: Platform
zh_tw: 平臺

english: The cavern floor rises to form a natural 5-foot-high platform. A glowing ritual circle dominates the top of the platform. Any non-derro that enters or touches the circle must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2). Whether the save succeeds or fails, the creature can't be affected by the circle in this way again. In addition, non-evil creatures within the circle have disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
zh_tw: 洞穴的地面隆起，形成了一個天然的5尺高平臺。一個發光的儀式圓環佔據了平臺的頂部。任何非迪洛矮人進入或觸碰這個圓環必須成功透過一個{@dc 13}的感知豁免檢定，否則將獲得一級瘋狂（見第2章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。無論豁免成功或失敗，該生物都不會再次以這種方式受到圓環的影響。此外，圓環內的非邪惡生物在攻擊檢定和豁免檢定上具有劣勢。

english: The statue within the ritual circle is 2 feet tall, weighs 100 pounds, and looks vaguely like a crouching stone giant with a lump on its neck where a second head is beginning to form. The statue is engraved with profane symbols, with the name "Dorhun" scribed in Dwarvish into its back. A successful {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Religion}) check allows a character to recognize the profane symbols as being related to Demogorgon.
zh_tw: 儀式圈內的雕像高2尺，重100磅，外表隱約像一隻蹲伏的石頭巨人，脖子上有一個腫塊，正在形成一個第二顆頭。雕像上刻有褻瀆的符號，背面用矮人語刻著"多爾洪"這個名字。成功的 {@dc 16} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘} 或 {@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定可以讓角色認出這些褻瀆符號與狄摩高根有關。

english: A search of the platform uncovers a similar but broken statue near a locked iron chest and a pile of books (see "Treasure" for more information on the chest and books). The broken statue is similar to the statue in the circle, except it has the name "Rihuud" carved into its back and its second head is fully formed. If Rihuud is dead, the broken statue turns to dust when the characters touch it. If the characters spared Rihuud's life, a successful {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Religion}) check reveals that the second head is a conduit for the curse's magic, and that removing it and returning it to Stonespeaker Hgraam in Cairngorm Cavern will allow the elder giant to end Rihuud's curse.
zh_tw: 對平臺的搜尋揭示了一個類似但破損的雕像，位於一個鎖著的鐵箱和一摞書旁邊（有關箱子和書籍的更多資訊，請參閱"寶藏"部分）。這尊破損的雕像與圓圈中的雕像相似，不同之處在於它的背面刻有名字"裡胡德"，而且它的第二顆頭已經完全形成。如果裡胡德已死，當角色觸控這尊破損的雕像時，它會化為塵土。如果角色饒恕了裡胡德的性命，一次成功的{@dc 12}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}或{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定將揭示第二顆頭是詛咒魔法的傳導器，將其移除並歸還給凱恩戈姆洞穴的石語者哈格拉姆將允許這位巨人長老解除裡胡德的詛咒。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: The tunnel west of this cavern contains a hidden pit (see "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). Debris conceals the lid, which is made of thin zurkhwood that breaks when a creature weighing 50 pounds or more steps on it. (A character of reduced size might not weigh enough to break the lid.) The pit is 10 feet deep, and its floor is covered by a patch of green slime (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). Any creature that falls into the pit takes {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage and automatically fails its Dexterity saving throw to avoid the slime.
zh_tw: 該洞窟西側的隧道中有一個隱藏的陷阱（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第5章中的"{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}"）。碎片遮蓋了蓋子，蓋子由薄木板製成，當重量超過50磅的生物踩上去時會被破壞。（體型縮小的角色可能不足以破壞蓋子。）陷阱深10尺，底部覆蓋著一片綠色粘液（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第5章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"）。任何掉入陷阱的生物都會受到{@dice 1d6}點鈍擊傷害，並自動無法透過敏捷豁免來避開粘液。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If the characters return the broken statue (or, at the very least, its second head) to Stonespeaker Hgraam, he gives them an emerald worth 500 gp as a reward, as well as his promise to vouch for them in anything they seek to accomplish in Gracklstugh.
zh_tw: 如果角色們將破碎的雕像（或者至少是它的第二個頭）帶回給石語者哈格拉姆，他會給他們一顆價值500金幣的翡翠作為獎勵，並且承諾在他們在格拉克斯圖格尋求完成的任何事情中為他們擔保。

english: {@creature Narrak|OotA} has a key around his neck that opens the lock on the iron chest, which can also be picked with thieves' tools and a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check. The chest contains a jar of {@item Keoghtom's ointment} and a small leather bag containing 45 gp and 15 sp.
zh_tw: {@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克} 脖子上掛著一把能開啟鐵箱鎖的鑰匙，也可以用盜賊工具並透過 {@dc 17} 的敏捷檢定來撬開。箱子裡有一罐 {@item Keoghtom's ointment||卡夫統靈藥} 和一個裝有 45 金幣和 15 銀幣的小皮袋。

english: The books have pages made from trillimac caps (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2). They contain the mad scribblings of {@creature Narrak|OotA} and his fellow derro savants. A character proficient in {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Investigation}, or {@skill Religion} can spend 8 hours poring through them; subtract {@dice 1d4} hours if the character reads Dwarvish. At the end of this time, the character knows that the books outline two rituals: one that causes a one-headed creature to sprout a second head, and another that allows the grafting of a severed head onto a living creature. The notes fail to mention that the ritual's caster must be suffering from some form of madness to perform either ritual successfully.
zh_tw: 這些書的頁面是由褶扇菇（見第2章中的"幽暗地域的真菌{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）製成的。它們包含了{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}和他的迪洛矮人學者同伴的瘋狂塗鴉。一個熟練於{@skill Arcana||奧秘}、{@skill Investigation||調查}或{@skill Religion||宗教}的角色可以花費8小時仔細研究它們；如果角色閱讀矮人語，則減去{@dice 1d4}小時。在這段時間結束時，角色知道這些書概述了兩個儀式：一個使單頭生物長出第二個頭，另一個允許將一個被割下的頭嫁接到一個活生生的生物上。筆記沒有提到，為了成功執行任何一個儀式，施法者必須遭受某種形式的瘋狂。

english: Tucked in one book are two scrolls: one that bears a list of six stone giant names (including Rihuud's and Dorhun's) and another that is actually a letter written in broken Dwarvish:
zh_tw: 一本書中夾著兩卷卷軸：一卷上面列出了六個石巨人的名字（包括裡胡德和多爾洪），另一卷實際上是用破碎的矮人語寫的信：

english: {@creature Narrak|OotA}—Need more scrolls! Stonespeaker Hgraam has traps traps traps. But {@creature Droki|OotA} is wily too and very small! I can hear talk, and in talk they say names, and I hear names and write names and give you names so you give me time. But you have to give me more scrolls. Magicky spelly scrolls!
zh_tw: {@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}—需要更多的卷軸！石語者哈格拉姆有陷阱陷阱陷阱。但是{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}也太狡猾了，而且非常小！我能聽到談話，談話中他們說名字，我聽到名字，寫下名字，給你名字，這樣你給我時間。但你必須要給我更多的卷軸。魔法的咒語卷軸！

english: —{@creature Droki|OotA}
zh_tw: —{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: Award 100 XP to each character for discovering Demogorgon's influence on the cultists.
zh_tw: 每個角色因發現狄摩高根對邪教徒的影響而獲得100經驗值。

english: The characters can complete a quest by turning over the books, scrolls, and letter to Errde Blackskull. Award 150 XP to each character when they deliver the items. If the characters ask Errde about {@creature Narrak|OotA}, she tells them that he was a junior member of the Council of Savants.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過將書籍、卷軸和信件交給艾德·黑顱來完成一個任務。當他們交付這些物品時，每個角色將獲得150 XP。如果角色們向艾德詢問{@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}，她會告訴他們他是智者議會的初級成員。

english: 13. Dumping Pit
zh_tw: 13. 傾倒坑

english: Victims of {@creature Narrak|OotA}'s experiments are dumped here. Exposure to the {@i faerzress} has begun to animate the corpses.
zh_tw: {@creature Narrak|OotA|納拉克}的實驗受害者被丟棄在這裡。接觸{@i 妖光}已經開始讓屍體活化。

english: This cavern is one enormous pit that reeks of death and decomposed flesh. The glow of {@i faerzress} is everywhere, seeming to flow like fog around dark shapes shambling across the pit floor. A single derro watches from atop a 15-foot-high ledge. A crack in the southeast wall of the pit leads to a narrow tunnel and is flanked by mounds of fungi and offal.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴是一個巨大的深坑，散發著死亡和腐爛肉體的惡臭。{@i 妖光}的光輝無處不在，像霧氣一樣在深坑底部蹣跚的黑暗生物周圍流動。一個單獨的迪洛矮人從15尺高的巖壁上監視著。深坑東南牆上的裂縫通向一條狹窄的隧道，兩側堆滿了真菌和腐爛物。

english: The pit is 15 feet deep, and the ledge that overlooks it is lined with pointy bits of scrap metal to make any climbing attempt perilous. A creature trying to reach the top of the ledge must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a failed check, a creature takes 3 ({@dice 1d6}) slashing damage and remains in the pit. The pit's floor is {@quickref difficult terrain||3} due to the many corpses and body parts strewn around.
zh_tw: 這個坑深15尺，俯瞰它的邊緣上佈滿了尖銳的廢金屬碎片，使得任何攀爬嘗試都變得極其危險。一個試圖到達坑頂的生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 力量 ({@skill Athletics||運動}) 檢定。如果檢定失敗，生物將受到3點 ({@dice 1d6}) 切割傷害，並繼續留在坑中。由於坑底散佈著許多屍體和肢體碎片，坑底被視為 {@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: A single {@creature derro|OotA} stands on the ledge overlooking the pit, which contains seven shambling {@creature Zombie||zombies}—three duergar and four grimlocks. The grimlock zombies are drawn to noise, while the duergar zombies attack any living creatures they see in the pit. Meanwhile, the derro uses its crossbow to take shots at any living creatures it sees.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}迪洛矮人站在俯瞰坑陷的巖架上，坑陷中有七具蹣跚的{@creature Zombie||喪屍}喪屍——三具灰矮人且四具幽邃盲族。幽邃盲族喪屍們被響聲吸引，而灰矮人喪屍會攻擊他們在坑陷中看到的任何活體生物。同時，迪洛矮人用它的十字弓射擊它看到的任何活體生物。

english: A {@creature crawling claw} wearing an obsidian ring on one stubby finger (see "Treasure") lurks amid the offal mounds. These mounds are {@quickref difficult terrain||3} to Small and Medium creatures, and the fungi growing atop them provide cover to Tiny creatures. The shriveled gray hand once belonged to Pelek the svirfneblin (see "Development").
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature crawling claw||蠕行之爪}潛伏在內臟堆中，短粗的手指上戴著黑曜石戒指（見「寶藏」）。對小型與中型生物而言，這些堆積物是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}；堆上生長的真菌則能為微型生物提供掩護。這隻乾癟的灰色手掌原本屬於地底侏儒佩勒克（見「後續發展」）。

english: The crack in the southeast wall between the mounds leads to a narrow, meandering tunnel, the floor of which is sunk below a foot of foul water. See the "Whorlstone Tunnels: General Features" sidebar for rules on narrow tunnels and foul water.
zh_tw: 東南牆和土堆之間的裂縫通向一條狹窄、曲折的隧道，隧道的地面低於一尺深的汙水。有關狹窄隧道和汙水規則，請參見"渦石隧道：通用特性"側邊欄。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@i Faerzress} has transformed Pelek's obsidian ring into a single-use magic item. When a living creature puts it on, the ring disappears, and the creature's skin becomes as hard as obsidian for the next hour. For as long as the effect lasts, the creature gains the benefit of a {@spell stoneskin} spell.
zh_tw: {@i 妖光}已將佩勒克的黑曜石戒指轉變為一次性使用的魔法物品。當一個活物戴上它時，戒指消失，該生物的皮膚在接下來的一小時內變得像黑曜石一樣堅硬。只要效果持續，該生物就會獲得{@spell stoneskin||石膚術}法術的好處。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters capture and interrogate the derro, he talks willingly if they agree to spare him. He knows as much as the quasits in area 11.
zh_tw: 如果角色們捕獲並審問迪洛矮人，只要他們同意饒他一命，他會願意交談。他知道的和區域11中的誇西特（小惡魔s）一樣多。

english: Killing the crawling claw and burying its remains in Blingdenstone lays Pelek's spirit to rest (see area 1b).
zh_tw: 殺死爬行爪並將其遺骸埋葬在布靈登石城（布靈登石城）可以安撫佩勒克的靈魂（見區域1b）。

english: 14. Obelisk
zh_tw: 14. 方尖碑

english: The Gray Ghosts believe that the mysterious obelisk in this cavern is an important source of magical power, and they are intent on rebuilding it. The obelisk was broken long ago. However, shards of the obelisk that appear throughout the Underdark are magically absorbed into it as soon as they touch its metal surface. The leaders of the Gray Ghosts are obsessed with finding missing shards and completing this monolith, but not even they know what will happen when the obelisk is made whole again.
zh_tw: 灰影（灰鬼）相信這個洞穴中神秘的方尖碑是魔法力量的重要來源，他們決心重建它。方尖碑很久以前就斷裂了。然而，遍佈幽暗地域的方尖碑碎片一旦接觸到它的金屬表面，就會被神奇地吸收進去。灰影的領袖們痴迷於尋找遺失的碎片並完成這座獨石碑，但即使是他們也不知道當方尖碑再次完整時會發生什麼。

english: After a steady upward climb, the tunnel opens into a huge, well-lit chamber. The glow of {@i faerzress} and bioluminescent fungi compete with shafts of white light that fall upon naturally formed shelves along the walls as well as a rocky mesa at the center of the cavern. Crudely formed ramps connect the different levels of the mesa up to the height of its two topmost tiers, which are linked by a sturdy bridge. Atop one of those tiers sits a large red egg. Atop the other stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections, as though small parts of it were somehow chipped away.
zh_tw: 在持續向上攀爬之後，隧道通向一個巨大且光線充足的房間。{@i 妖光}的光芒和生物發光真菌與白光束競相閃耀，映照在牆壁自然形成的架子上以及洞穴中央的岩石臺地上。粗糙建造的斜坡將臺地的不同層次連線起來，直到其最高兩層，這兩層由一座堅固的橋樑相連。在其中一層的頂上放置著一顆巨大的紅蛋。在另一層的頂上矗立著一座50尺高的方尖碑，由光滑的黑色金屬製成，帶有一些明顯的瑕疵，彷彿其某些部分不知何故被鑿掉了。

english: A female derro stands close to the obelisk, gently patting and stroking its surface. The obelisk flashes once, the glow of {@i faerzress} around the cavern flaring in response. The derro squeals with glee as she snatches an object up from the ground, then writes something down in a small notebook.
zh_tw: 一位女性迪洛矮人站在方尖碑旁，輕輕拍打併撫摸著它的表面。方尖碑閃爍了一次，洞穴周圍的{@i 妖光}也隨之閃爍了一下。迪洛矮人高興地尖叫著抓起地上的一個物體，然後在一個小筆記本上寫下了一些東西。

english: The chamber is brightly lit, as if by sunlight. The sunlight is just a natural trick caused by crystal growths reflecting and amplifying the light of the bioluminescent fungi growing on the walls. The characters realize this if they climb near the ceiling of the cavern, where the optical trick is easy to discern.
zh_tw: 這個大廳非常明亮，就像被陽光照亮一樣。陽光其實是由水晶生長物反射和放大牆壁上生長的生物發光真菌的光所形成的自然現象。如果角色們爬到洞穴的天花板附近，他們就能很容易地發現這個光學把戲。

english: Map 4.7: Obelisk Chamber
zh_tw: 地圖 4.7：方尖碑大廳

english: The different levels of the mesa are separated by 10-foot-high cliffs. Climbing a cliff requires a successful {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Pliinki, a mad {@creature derro savant|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}), stands atop of the mesa. Hidden on a shelf above the cavern's entrance, a {@creature spectator} tasked with guarding this area sees the characters as soon as they walk 15 feet into the cavern. The spectator screeches an alarm and attacks, killing non-derro with glee. As it fights, it projects telepathic ramblings into the characters' minds, mostly dealing with how exciting it is to have intruders to kill and how even more exciting things will be when the obelisk is complete.
zh_tw: 臺地的不同層級被10尺高的懸崖分隔。攀爬懸崖需要透過一個{@dc 12}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。普林基，一個瘋狂的{@creature derro savant|OotA|迪洛矮人學者}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}），站在臺地頂部。隱藏在洞穴入口上方壁架上的{@creature spectator||觀察者眼魔}負責守衛這個區域，當角色們走進洞穴15尺時就會看到他們。觀察者眼魔發出警報術並攻擊，欣喜若狂地殺死非迪洛矮人。在戰鬥時，它會將心靈感應的胡言亂語投射到角色們的腦海中，主要是關於有入侵者可殺是多麼令人興奮，以及當方尖碑完成時事情會變得更加令人興奮。

english: Pliinki shouts crass obscenities at the characters in a raspy voice while commanding the spectator to dispose of them. Both she and the spectator fight to the death.
zh_tw: 普林基用嘶啞的聲音對角色們大聲咒罵粗俗的髒話，同時命令觀察者眼魔除掉他們。她和觀察者眼魔都戰鬥到死。

english: Obelisk
zh_tw: 方尖碑

english: Made from a black metal of alien origin, this monolith is perfectly smooth except for the cracks and chipped-off edges where it was splintered by some unknown force. The obelisk is 15 feet per side at its base, stands 50 feet tall, and tapers slowly to a pyramidal cap.
zh_tw: 這座方尖碑由一種外星起源的黑色金屬製成，除了被某種未知力量撕裂的裂縫和崩掉的邊緣外，它完美光滑。方尖碑在基座處每邊長15尺，高50尺，逐漸變細至金字塔形的頂蓋。

english: Any character proficient in {@skill Arcana} can tell that the obelisk's fractures are leaking quasi-magical energy. The character further understands that feeding magical energy into the obelisk might activate its latent magic. Spending a spell slot of any level while touching the obelisk activates it and teleports everyone on the mesa to a location in the Underdark just outside the northwest gate of Gracklstugh.
zh_tw: 任何熟練掌握{@skill Arcana||奧秘}的角色都能察覺到方尖碑的裂縫正在洩露準魔法能量。角色進一步理解到，向方尖碑注入魔法能量可能會啟用其潛在的魔法。在觸控方尖碑的同時消耗任意等級的法術位可以啟用它，並將高原上的每個人傳送到幽暗地域的一個地方，就在格拉克斯圖格西北門外。

english: The character who expended the spell slot knows the teleport effect can be repeated, but that this power is only temporary—a fluke due to the recent disruption of {@i faerzress} throughout the Underdark. Both the potency and the nature of the effect could change within a week or two, and this teleport effect likely bears no relation to the obelisk's actual purpose.
zh_tw: 消耗法術位的角色知道傳送效果可以重複，但這種力量只是暫時的——這是由於最近{@i 妖光}在幽暗地域中受到幹擾而導致的異常現象。效果的強度和性質可能在一兩週內發生變化，而且這種傳送效果很可能與方尖碑的實際用途無關。

english: If the characters took the lump of metal from {@creature Droki|OotA} or the Gray Ghosts, they notice the obelisk is made from the same material. If the lump is touched to the obelisk, it is instantly absorbed, repairing a crack on its surface.
zh_tw: 如果角色們從{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}或灰影（灰鬼）那裡拿到了那塊金屬，他們會注意到方尖碑也是由相同的材料製成。如果將這塊金屬接觸到方尖碑，它會被立即吸收，修復其表面的一條裂縫。

english: Red Dragon Egg
zh_tw: 紅龍蛋

english: The egg atop the northeast mesa is an unhatched dragon egg that the Gray Ghosts stole from the Keepers of the Flame. The 4-foot-tall, 3-foot-diameter egg weighs 180 pounds, and without fire to keep it warm, the egg can't hatch. If and when the egg does hatch, a {@creature red dragon wyrmling} emerges and bonds with the first creature it sees.
zh_tw: 位於東北方高原上的蛋是一個未孵化的龍蛋，灰影（灰鬼）從火焰守護者那裡偷來的。這個4尺高、3尺直徑的蛋重180磅，沒有火來保持溫暖，蛋就不能孵化。如果蛋孵化了，一隻{@creature red dragon wyrmling||紅龍雛龍}就會出現，並與它看到的第一個生物建立聯絡。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏
