english: A Day in Neverlight Grove
zh_tw: 無光林地的一天

english: The myconid way of life is simple, contemplative, and cyclical. Myconids work for eight hours farming their fungi fields, scouting for resources, and maintaining their defenses. After their labors, they spend eight hours in telepathic communion with each other in what they call "melding." They then rest for eight hours before starting the cycle anew.
zh_tw: 菌人生物的生活方式是簡單、沉思和迴圈的。菌人生物工作八小時，耕種他們的真菌田地，尋找資源，維護他們的防禦。勞動結束後，他們花八小時在他們稱之為"融合"的心靈感應交流中。然後他們休息八小時，然後重新開始這個迴圈。

english: Many of the myconids in the grove are more extroverted than might be expected of their normally shy species. Characters who communicate with the myconids by way of their rapport spores note that the creatures seem to be preparing for a celebration of some sort, proclaiming "The day of joy is nigh!" and exhorting others to "Rejoice in the true union that will meld us all!" These are the myconids affected by Zuggtmoy, and their behavior is cause for concern among the unaffected, including {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA} and its allies.
zh_tw: 林中的許多菌人比他們通常害羞的種族所預期的要外向得多。透過和諧孢子與菌人交流的角色們注意到，這些生物似乎正在準備某種慶祝活動，宣稱"歡樂的日子即將到來！"並敦促其他人"為將我們所有人融合在一起的真正聯合而歡欣！"這些是受到祖格莫伊影響的菌人，它們的行為在未受影響的菌人中引起了關注，包括{@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞}及其盟友。

english: Two Sovereigns
zh_tw: 兩位君主

english: Myconid communities normally have only a single sovereign—the largest among them, who stands alone and outside of any circle (see below). Two years ago, {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA} arrived in the grove with its two circles, and Sovereign Phylo welcomed the new myconids gladly, grateful for Basidia's offer to share the burdens of leading all the circles in the grove. The two sovereigns have been close friends ever since, sharing authority and responsibilities with no conflict. Each knows that an individual myconid has only so much time in the cycle of life, and that when both have passed, a single sovereign will take their place after their bodies are returned to nourish the soil.
zh_tw: 菌人社群通常只有一個統治者——它們當中最大的一個，獨自站立在任何圈子之外（見下文）。兩年前，{@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞}帶著它的兩個圈子來到了樹林，君主菲洛非常高興地歡迎了這些新的菌人，感激巴斯狄亞提出共享領導樹林中所有圈子的重擔。自那以後，兩位統治者一直是親密的朋友，共享權力和責任，沒有任何衝突。每個都知道，一個個體菌人在生命的迴圈中只有有限的時間，當兩者都逝去後，一個單一的統治者將在他們的身體迴歸土壤後取而代之。

english: Circles
zh_tw: 圓形

english: The circles in Neverlight Grove are divided by specialized function, with each circle performing a specific role in the colony. Seven circles are present in the grove, each containing an average of twenty myconids—the Circle of Hunters, the Circle of Explorers, the Circle of Sowers, the Circle of Builders, the Circle of Growers, plus the recently formed Inner Circle and Circle of Masters. Each circle gathers around a circle mound—a pile of rocks and soil upon which mold, lichen, and mushrooms are encouraged to grow. The myconids of a circle gather around their own mound to meld and sleep.
zh_tw: 無光林地中的圈子根據專業功能劃分，每個圈子在菌落中扮演特定的角色。林中共有七個圈子，每個圈子平均有二十個菌人——獵人之環、探險者之環、播種者之環、建造者之環、生長者之環，以及最近成立的內圈和大師之環。每個圈子圍繞著一個圈子土堆——一堆石頭和土壤，上面鼓勵生長黴菌、地衣和蘑菇。一個圈子的菌人聚集在自己的土堆周圍融合和睡眠。

english: After becoming enthralled by Zuggtmoy, Phylo decided the myconids would meld exclusively within their own circle, and only the circle leaders would meld with the other circle leaders and the sovereigns. Phylo asserted that this would make all the circles' meldings far more efficient, thereby making the tending of the grove that much easier. Most of the grove's myconids have gone along with this new and unusual concept, swayed by Phylo's claims that a higher level of communal harmony will be achieved.
zh_tw: 在被祖格莫伊迷住之後，菲洛決定菌人將只在自己圈子內進行融合，而且只有圈子領袖會與其他圈子領袖和君主進行融合。菲洛堅稱這將使所有圈子的融合更加高效，從而使照料森林變得更加容易。林中的大多數菌人被菲洛所說的更高程度的共同和諧所說服，接受了這一新穎而不尋常的概念。

english: Basidia believes that Phylo's separation of the circles is contrary to the unity and harmony of the myconid way of life, and that this segregation isolates individuals from the experiences of others outside their circle. Basidia has likewise expressed concern about the unnaturalness of the Inner Circle and the Circle of Masters. However, Basidia's views are either dismissed or ignored by Phylo and its allies, who zealously claim that exciting changes are coming for the grove.
zh_tw: 巴斯狄亞認為菲洛對圈子的分離違背了菌人人生活方式的統一和諧，這種隔離使個體無法體驗圈子之外其他人的經歷。巴斯狄亞同樣對內圈和大師之環的不自然性表示了擔憂。然而，菲洛及其盟友要麼忽視要麼無視巴斯狄亞的觀點，他們熱情地聲稱森林即將發生激動人心的變化。

english: A more recent development has Basidia even more disturbed when the adventurers arrive in Neverlight Grove. {@creature Yestabrod|OotA}, the leader of the Circle of Masters, has not attended an Inner Circle melding for several days now, instead sending a representative (see "The Circle of Masters" in area 5). Times in Neverlight Grove are strange and worrisome indeed.
zh_tw: 當冒險者們到達無光林地時，巴斯狄亞更加不安。{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}，大師之環的領袖，已經好幾天沒有參加內部圈子的融合了，而是派出了一個代表（見區域5中的"大師之環"）。無光林地中的時光確實奇怪且令人擔憂。

english: Roleplaying the Myconids
zh_tw: 扮演菌人

english: Myconids lead lives completely unlike the experiences of any surface dweller. The only things they have in common with humanoids are the need for sustenance, the desire to live, and the joy of socialization, although they practice each of these things in different ways than humanoids. Truly alien creatures, myconids have difficulty telling flesh-and-blood humanoids apart.
zh_tw: 菌人的生活方式與地表居民的經歷完全不同。他們與類人生物唯一共有的是需要食物、生存慾望以及社交的樂趣，儘管他們在這些方面的做法與類人生物不同。菌人是真正異類的存在，他們很難區分血肉之軀的類人生物。

english: Myconids are innocent about matters of ethics and morality, their lives centered on living fully each day and worrying little about the future and nothing at all about the past. Despite the communal nature of their existence, they are individuals with their own unique interests and distinct personalities. They gravitate toward simple, shared joys, living by the wisdom and insight their melding provides. Because of their naive and sharing ways, as well as their fungal nature, they are extremely vulnerable to the corrupting influence of Zuggtmoy.
zh_tw: 菌人對倫理和道德問題很天真，他們的生活以充分地活在當下為中心，對未來幾乎不擔憂，對過去則完全不關心。儘管他們的存在具有共同體性質，但他們仍是具有自己獨特興趣和鮮明個性的個體。他們傾向於簡單、共享的快樂，根據他們的融合所提供的感知和洞察力生活。由於他們天真、分享的方式以及他們的真菌本質，他們極易受到祖格莫伊腐敗影響的侵害。

english: The myconids of Neverlight Grove are beginning to reel from the Lady of Decay's influence, with many blissfully welcoming her madness, while others bravely try to resist it. Myconids affected by Zuggtmoy abandon the growth of life as the core of their being in favor of decay and death. More horrifying is that they do so with childlike innocence, reveling in the corruption of all life with a sense of wonder and joy, unable to grasp the evil they have embraced.
zh_tw: 無光林地的菌人開始受到腐朽女士的影響，許多菌人幸福地歡迎她的瘋狂，而其他菌人則勇敢地嘗試抵抗。受祖格莫伊影響的菌人放棄了生命成長作為它們存在的核心，轉而偏愛腐爛和死亡。更令人恐懼的是，它們以孩童般的純真這樣做，帶著驚奇和喜悅的心情沉醉於所有生命的墮落，無法理解它們所擁抱的邪惡。

english: Melding
zh_tw: 融合

english: Myconids share everything through melding. Rapport spores carry a tiny bit of all myconids to the other myconids in their circle, to be absorbed and reside within them, and creating a telepathic familial bond. When the myconids of a circle gather to meld, they share their individual insights, fears, hopes, and dreams. Through the melding, all myconids join together to form the heart and soul of a colony.
zh_tw: 菌人透過融合來分享一切。和諧孢子攜帶著菌人圈子中所有菌人的微小部分，傳遞給圈子中的其他菌人，被吸收並居住在他們體內，從而創造出一種心靈感應的家庭紐帶。當一個圈子的菌人聚集起來進行融合時，他們分享各自的見解、恐懼、希望和夢想。透過融合，所有的菌人聯合起來，形成了一個菌落的心靈和靈魂。

english: Zuggtmoy's Influence
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊的影響

english: Initially weakened by the summoning ritual that wrenched her from the Abyss, Zuggtmoy found her way to Neverlight Grove, drawn by the strength of its fungal vitality. Upon her arrival, she quickly assessed the situation, realizing the shortest path to gain control of the grove would be to sway and corrupt its original sovereign to serve her until she recovered her strength.
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊最初因召喚儀式從無底深淵中被撕裂出來而變得虛弱，她被無光林地的真菌活力所吸引，找到了前往那裡的路。到達之後，她迅速評估了情況，意識到獲得控制森林的最快捷方式是影響並腐蝕其原始君主，使其為她服務，直到她恢復力量。

english: After being welcomed to the grove by Phylo, Zuggtmoy melded with the sovereign in secret, seducing it with the promise of a paradise for the mushroom folk if Phylo would lead them to become her followers on the Material Plane. Its mind completely lost inside the demon queen's insidiously mad vision, Phylo became enthralled by the promise of plentiful soil and moisture, perpetual rot, and beautiful transcendent dreams to be shared in a never-ending communal melding—all offered to the grove's folk as generous and wondrous gifts from the Lady of Decay.
zh_tw: 在菲洛歡迎來到樹林之後，祖格莫伊秘密地與統治者融合，用如果菲洛帶領他們成為物質界她的追隨者就能為蘑菇人帶來天堂的承諾來誘惑它。菲洛的思想完全迷失在惡魔女王陰險瘋狂的幻象中，被豐富的土壤和水分、永恆的腐爛以及在無盡的共同融合中分享的美麗超驗夢想的承諾所迷惑——所有這些都作為腐朽女士慷慨奇妙的禮物提供給樹林的人民。

english: Everyday melding has now become a subtle ideological war between supporters of the two myconid sovereigns. Phylo is slowly convincing the mushroom folk to follow the new path. Basidia and its dwindling supporters argue against the new way, even as they lose ground (and allies) each time the circles of the grove share consciousness.
zh_tw: 日常融合現在已經成為兩個菌人君主支持者之間的微妙意識形態戰爭。菲洛正慢慢說服菌人人走上新的道路。巴斯狄亞及其日益減少的支持者反對新方式，即使在森林的圈子每次共享意識時，他們都在失去陣地（和盟友）。

english: As more and more myconids unwittingly become vessels for Zuggtmoy's spores, Neverlight Grove becomes a more extravagantly festive place. The quiet, contemplative joy of the mushroom folk's way of life is being inexorably replaced by decadent, enraptured euphoria—and the madness that euphoria hides.
zh_tw: 隨著越來越多的菌人在不知不覺中成為祖格莫伊孢子的容器，無光林地變成了一個更加奢華的節日場所。菌人人生活方式中平靜、沉思的喜悅正在被不可逆轉地被墮落、陶醉的狂喜所取代——以及這種狂喜所隱藏的瘋狂。

english: Neverlight Grove
zh_tw: 無光林地

english: {@b Population}: 150 myconids and spore servants
zh_tw: {@b 人口}: 150個菌人和孢子僕從

english: {@b Government}: Organized circles ruled by larger specimens called circle leaders; even larger specimens called sovereigns rule the entire colony
zh_tw: {@b 政治}：由被稱為圈子領袖的較大個體組織成的圈子進行統治；被稱為統治者的更大型個體統治整個菌落

english: {@b Defense}: Spore servants and awakened zurkhwoods
zh_tw: {@b 防禦}: 孢子僕從和覺醒的祖爾克森林

english: {@b Commerce: None}
zh_tw: {@b 商業：無}

english: {@b Organizations}: Seven myconid circles; Zuggtmoy's servants
zh_tw: {@b 組織}：七個菌人圈子；祖格莫伊的僕從

english: Myconids have lived in Neverlight Grove for untold generations, experiencing little or no change in their lives until recently. Now their world is being altered faster than many of the fungus folk can keep up with—as is their world view, twisted by the chaotic and corrupting influence of the Demon Queen of Fungi.
zh_tw: 菌人已經在無光林地生活了無數代，直到最近他們的生活幾乎沒有或沒有變化。現在他們的世界變化速度比許多真菌族人能夠跟上的還要快——他們對世界的看法也在被真菌惡魔女王混亂和腐敗的影響所扭曲。

english: Upon her arrival in the Underdark, Zuggtmoy found Neverlight Grove and took up residence there. The myconids welcomed her, sealing their fate. Through telepathically shared dreams, corruption has taken root deep within the colony, warping the myconids' normally placid and peaceful nature into something restive and rapturous. A few realize what is happening and try to resist, but internal strife is alien to the myconids—they will not prevail without outside aid to save them.
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊到達幽暗地域後發現了無光林地，並在那裡定居。菌人歡迎了她，這註定了他們的命運。透過心靈感應共享的夢境，腐敗已經在菌落深處紮根，將菌人通常平靜和和平的本性扭曲成不安和狂喜的東西。少數人意識到了正在發生的事情並試圖抵抗，但內部衝突對菌人來說是陌生的——沒有外部援助，他們將無法自救。

english: Neverlight Grove: General Features
zh_tw: 無光林地：通用特性

english: Visitors encounter the following features throughout Neverlight Grove.
zh_tw: 訪客在無光林地中遇到了以下特點。

english: Underground Marsh
zh_tw: 地下沼澤

english: Water trickles into the large cavern from many places, forming terraces, pools, and streams. This creates an underground marsh ideal for the growth of fungi and the myconids.
zh_tw: 水從許多地方滴入大洞穴，形成梯田、水池和小溪。這創造了一個適合真菌和菌人生長的地下沼澤。

english: Abundant Fungi
zh_tw: 豐富的真菌

english: Mushrooms, molds, and fungi grow in abundance in Neverlight Grove, creating a bizarre yet beautiful tapestry of color.
zh_tw: 蘑菇、黴菌和真菌在無光林地中生長茂盛，創造出一幅奇異而美麗的色彩圖案。

english: Quiet Cacophony
zh_tw: 寧靜的嘈雜

english: Myconids don't speak. They communicate telepathically by emitting their rapport spores. As a result, they live quiet lives. Strange music and singing echoes from the large cavern behind the grove, just loud enough to be noticeable.
zh_tw: 菌人不說話。他們透過散發和諧孢子進行心靈感應溝通。因此，他們過著安靜的生活。奇怪的音樂和歌聲從森林後面的大洞穴中迴盪，聲音剛好足夠引起注意。

english: Otherworldly Light
zh_tw: 超凡之光

english: Luminescent lichen grows across the cavern and spreads to the larger mushrooms, bathing the grove in soft hues of yellow, blue, and violet. {@quickref Vision and Light||2||Dim light} suffuses the entire grove and lends the grove a dreamlike quality.
zh_tw: 發光地衣遍佈洞窟並蔓延到更大的蘑菇上，使樹林沐浴在柔和的黃、藍、紫色調中。{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}瀰漫整個樹林，賦予樹林一種夢幻般的質感。

english: Sentinel Mushrooms
zh_tw: 哨兵蘑菇

english: To defend themselves, myconids have cultivated and guided the growth of awakened zurkhwoods (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) to serve as a kind of palisade around the grove.
zh_tw: 為了自衛，菌人培育並引導了覺醒的祖爾克森林（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）的生長，使其成為圍繞森林的一種柵欄。

english: Zuggtmoy's Spores
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊的孢子

english: This malevolent disease is spread by myconids transformed by Zuggtmoy's demonic influence (see "{@adventure Myconids|OotA|19}" in appendix C).
zh_tw: 這種惡性疾病是由祖格莫伊的惡魔影響下變異的菌人傳播的（見附錄C中的"{@adventure 菌人|OotA|19}"）。

english: A transformed myconid can release the spores in a cloud that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on it, and the cloud lingers for 1 minute. Any flesh-and-blood creature in the cloud when it appears, or that enters it later, must make a Constitution saving throw. The save DC is 8 + the myconid's Constitution modifier + the myconid's proficiency bonus. On a successful save, the creature can't be infected by these spores for 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature is infected with a disease called the spores of Zuggtmoy and also gains a random form of indefinite madness (determined by rolling on the Madness of Zuggtmoy table in {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}) that lasts until the creature is cured of the disease or dies. While infected in this way, the creature can't be reinfected, and it must repeat the saving throw at the end of every 24 hours, ending the infection on a success. On a failure, the infected creature's body is slowly taken over by fungal growth, and after three such failed saves, the creature dies and is reanimated as a spore servant if it's a type of creature that can be (see the "Myconids" entry in the {@i Monster Manual}).
zh_tw: 一個變異的菌人人可以在以它為中心的10尺半徑球體內釋放孢子云，孢子云持續1分鐘。任何血肉之軀的生物在孢子云出現時位於其中，或稍後進入其中，必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免檢定的DC是8加上菌人人的體質調整值加上菌人人的熟練加值。成功豁免的生物在24小時內不會被這些孢子感染。失敗的生物將感染一種名為祖格莫伊孢子的疾病，並同時獲得一種隨機的無限期瘋狂形式（透過擲骰在{@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20}中的祖格莫伊瘋狂表上決定），直到該生物治癒疾病或死亡。以這種方式感染時，生物不會被再次感染，並必須在每個24小時結束時重複豁免檢定，成功則結束感染。失敗時，感染生物的身體將逐漸被真菌生長所佔據，連續三次失敗後，該生物死亡，並在它是可以被復活的生物型別的情況下，作為孢子僕從復活（見{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的"菌人人"條目）。

english: Map 5.1: Neverlight Grove
zh_tw: 地圖 5.1：無光林地

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Fungal Wilds
zh_tw: 1. 真菌荒野

english: The myconids cultivate this stretch of wilderness as their first line of defense, creating a living palisade. Fungal creatures and wild Underdark beasts form a rich ecosystem here.
zh_tw: 菌人們將這片荒野作為他們的第一道防線進行耕種，創造了一個活生生的柵欄。真菌生物和野生的幽暗地域野獸在這裡形成了一個豐富的生態系統。

english: Pale cream and beige stalks grow thick and tall, resembling a surface world forest. Fungi grow in profusion everywhere, and it's hard to find anything resembling a path between them. The giant caps of zurkhwood mushrooms obscure your view of the cavern's ceiling, but luminescent fungi there give off a shimmering aura. With each step taken on the soggy ground, a rank scent of decay rises around you.
zh_tw: 蒼白的奶油色和米色莖幹生長得又粗又高，讓人聯想到地表世界的森林。真菌到處生長茂盛，很難找到任何類似路徑的東西。祖爾克木蘑菇的巨大傘蓋遮擋了你對洞穴天花板的視線，但是那裡的發光真菌散發出閃爍的光環。每在溼軟的地面上走一步，周圍就會升起一股腐爛的強烈氣味。

english: Circle of Hunters
zh_tw: 獵人之環

english: A circle mound sits at the edge of the wilds but still inside them. It belongs to the Circle of Hunters—myconids that pursue creatures in the wilds. In spite of their name, the hunters don't kill their prey, but merely track down creatures that have died near the grove. The hunters bring the remains of such creatures back to be reanimated by their sovereigns, until they are eventually allowed to rot and join the cavern's detritus bed.
zh_tw: 一個圈子土堆位於荒野的邊緣，但仍在其中。它屬於獵人之環——在荒野中追蹤生物的菌人。儘管他們的名字中有"獵人"二字，但這些獵人並不殺死獵物，而只是追蹤那些在森林附近死亡的生物。獵人將這些生物的遺體帶回，讓君主們重新賦予它們生命，直到它們最終被允許腐爛並加入洞穴的殘骸層。

english: Loobamub
zh_tw: 盧巴姆布

english: The circle leader of the hunters, this tall and lean myconid shares Basidia's concerns about Phylo's new way, though it is still capable of resisting Phylo's corrupted meldings when it joins with the Inner Circle. Loobamub keeps its opinions to itself, but its wariness spreads to the other hunters when they meld, cementing their loyalty to Basidia. Loobamub redirects the spore servants and awakened zurkhwoods Phylo creates away from its circle's territory.
zh_tw: 作為獵人之環的領袖，這個高大瘦削的菌人人與巴斯狄亞一樣對菲洛的新方式感到擔憂，儘管它在與內圈融合時仍能抵抗菲洛的腐敗融合。盧巴姆布保留自己的意見，但它的謹慎態度在它們融合時傳播給了其他獵人，鞏固了他們對巴斯狄亞的忠誠。盧巴姆布將菲洛創造的孢子僕從和覺醒的祖爾克森林重新導向，遠離其圈子的領土。

english: Loobamub is happy to enlist the party's aid in dealing with a few unwelcome monsters that have found their way into the fungal wilds. In particular, the circle leader asks the adventurers to kill a {@creature grick alpha} and then take its carcass to Basidia for reanimation. A {@creature shambling mound} is also exhausting the soil in the grove and needs to be put down for the good of the colony. These encounters can occur wherever you wish.
zh_tw: 盧巴姆布很高興能夠獲得隊伍的幫助，以應對一些不受歡迎的怪物，這些怪物找到了進入真菌荒野的方法。特別是，圈子領袖要求冒險者殺死一隻{@creature grick alpha||阿爾法穴居攫怪}，然後將其屍體帶給巴斯狄亞進行復活。一個{@creature shambling mound||蔓生怪}也在耗盡樹林中的土壤，為了菌落的利益，需要將其清除。這些遭遇可以在您希望的任何地方發生。

english: 2. Northern Terraces
zh_tw: 2. 北部梯田

english: The terraces lining the northern walls are suffused with {@i faerzress}, and the myconids reserve these areas for cultivating certain fungi.
zh_tw: 北部的梯田被{@i 妖光}所滲透，菌人保留這些區域用於培育特定種類的真菌。

english: Water trickling from the walls of this vast cavern are channeled into a crude but effective terraced irrigation system. A thick, sweet smell fills the air from the thousands of fungi of all colors and sizes, many glowing with a strange, inviting light.
zh_tw: 從這個巨大洞穴牆壁上滴落的水被引導到一個簡陋但有效的梯田灌溉系統中。成千上萬的各種顏色和大小的真菌充滿了空氣，其中許多散發著一種奇異的誘人光芒，空氣中瀰漫著濃鬱的甜美氣息。

english: Circle of Builders
zh_tw: 建造者之環

english: This circle is found in the middle terrace, but its members travel to the top and the edges of the cave to harvest the resilient fungi used in their craft.
zh_tw: 這個圈子位於中間梯田，但其成員會前往洞穴的頂部和邊緣，以採集用於他們工藝的堅韌真菌。

english: Gasbide
zh_tw: 加斯拜德

english: The builders' circle leader is a pioneering would-be architect and a supporter of Sovereign Phylo. Already driven mad by Zuggtmoy's spores, Gasbide dreams of bizarre, elaborate structures no myconids would ever need, inspired by visions of Abyssal palaces.
zh_tw: 建造者圈子的領袖是一位開拓性的準建築師，也是君主菲洛的支持者。加斯比德已經被祖格莫伊的孢子逼瘋，他夢想著建造一些菌人從未需要過的奇異而複雜的結構，這些靈感來自於深淵宮殿的幻象。

english: If Gasbide interacts with the characters using rapport spores, it demands descriptions of surface-world structures, bristling with an excitement seldom seen in myconids. It asks for exasperatingly minor details such as the precise dimensions of bricks or the density of lumber. Gasbide reveals through the rapport that it dreams of building a fungal tower "even greater than Yggmorgus." It hopes to break through the Underdark to the surface world, possibly "with the aid of Araumycos." Gasbide has no conscious knowledge of what Araumycos is, sensing only that it is part of the great celebration to come. See "{@area Yggmorgus|257|x}" (at the end of this chapter) and chapter 16, "{@adventure The Fetid Wedding|OotA|15}," for more information.
zh_tw: 如果加斯拜德透過和諧孢子與角色互動，它會要求描述地表世界的結構，表現出在菌人中很少見的興奮。它會詢問令人惱火的細節，例如磚塊的精確尺寸或木材的密度。透過和諧，加斯拜德透露它夢想建造一座"甚至比伊格莫格斯還要偉大"的真菌塔。它希望穿透幽暗地域到達地表世界，可能"在阿勞麥柯的幫助下"。加斯拜德沒有意識到阿勞麥柯是什麼，只知道它是即將到來的偉大慶典的一部分。有關更多資訊，請參見"{@area 伊格莫格斯|257|x}"（本章末尾）和第16章"{@adventure 惡臭的婚禮|OotA|15}"。

english: Circle of Growers
zh_tw: 種植者圈子

english: The circle mound of the growers is on the top terrace, near the cavern wall. The growers are the colony's farmers, ensuring the soil beneath the pools remains fertile and tending the fungi there.
zh_tw: 生長者之環的土堆位於頂部梯田，靠近洞穴牆壁。生長者是菌落的農民，確保水池下的土壤保持肥沃，並照料那裡的真菌。

english: Hebopbe
zh_tw: 赫波貝

english: The leader of the growers doesn't care much for Phylo's new ideas. But though it misses mass meldings, Hebopbe doesn't see Basidia's protests as worthy of concern. Hebopbe is infected by Zuggtmoy's spores, but isn't yet under her control.
zh_tw: 種植者的領袖不太關心菲洛的新想法。儘管它懷念集體融合，赫波比（赫波貝）並不認為巴斯狄亞的抗議值得關注。赫波比被祖格莫伊的孢子感染，但尚未受到她的控制。

english: 3. Central Basin
zh_tw: 3. 中央盆地

english: This depression in the cavern floor is the main part of the myconid colony. The central circle mound was only recently created, and is now a kind of "town square" where all the grove's myconids gather for mass meldings. These have become rare, however, reserved for when Phylo wants to stoke the myconids' enthusiasm for the celebration that only those infected by Zuggtmoy know about. This leaves the uninfected confused but happy that something joyous is about to happen.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴地面的凹陷是菌人人菌落的主要部分。中央土堆最近才剛剛建成，現在是一種"市政廣場"，所有森林的菌人人聚集在這裡進行大規模融合。然而，這些活動已經變得罕見，僅在菲洛想要激發菌人人對只有被祖格莫伊感染的人才知道的慶祝活動的熱情時才會舉行。這讓未被感染的人感到困惑，但同時也為即將發生的快樂事情感到高興。

english: Beyond the mud and mushrooms that spread across the cavern, a large, clear pool sits in the midst of the fungal grove. A central mound seems to be the only dry spot in sight, though a small cliff rises above the cavern floor far across the clearing, with giant mushrooms visible in the distance. Bioluminescent fungi trace strange constellations along the cavern's ceiling and walls, showing the darkness of the ravine and a mist-shrouded smaller cavern beyond.
zh_tw: 越過洞穴中蔓延的泥濘和蘑菇，一個大型清澈的水池位於真菌森林的中心。中央土堆似乎是視野中唯一的乾燥地點，儘管在遠處的空地上有一座小懸崖升起，遠處可以看到巨大的蘑菇。生物發光的真菌在洞穴的天花板和牆壁上勾勒出奇異的星座，顯示出峽谷的黑暗和霧氣籠罩的更小的洞穴。

english: Inner Circle
zh_tw: 內環

english: The central mound is the base of the colony's two {@creature Myconid Sovereign||myconid sovereigns}, Phylo and Basidia. They hold court together with three {@creature myconid adult} councilors named Brelup, Posbara, and Breberil. Ten {@creature Awakened Zurkhwood|OotA|awakened zurkhwoods} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) protect the mound and obey either of the sovereigns.
zh_tw: 中央的土丘是該殖民地的兩個{@creature Myconid Sovereign||蕈人王}，菲洛和巴斯狄亞的基地。他們與三個名為佈雷盧普、波斯巴拉和佈雷貝裡爾的{@creature myconid adult||蕈人成體}議員共同主持法庭。十株{@creature Awakened Zurkhwood|OotA|覺醒的祖克木}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）保護著土丘，並服從其中任何一位君主的命令。

english: Sovereign Phylo
zh_tw: 君主菲洛

english: The sovereign towers above the other myconids, its multiple caps swaying with the sinuous shifting of its thick stalk as it moves. Once it spreads its rapport spores, Phylo welcomes the characters with honest enthusiasm—doubly so if they have returned {@creature Stool|OotA} and {@creature Rumpadump|OotA} to their home.
zh_tw: 君主高聳於其他菌人之上，當它移動時，其厚重的莖幹蜿蜒擺動，多個菌蓋隨之搖曳。一旦散佈出其共鳴孢子，菲洛會以真誠的熱情歡迎角色——如果他們帶回了{@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普}和{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}回到家園，更是如此。

english: "You are safe, friendly softers. You arrive at a wondrous time, for Neverlight Grove is on the verge of something great, something marvelous! Celebrate, as the day of joy is nigh!
zh_tw: 你們是安全的，友好的軟體生物。你們在一個奇妙的時刻到來，因為無光林地即將發生一些偉大的事情，一些了不起的事情！慶祝吧，因為充滿喜悅的日子即將到來！

english: Phylo invites the characters to stay as long as they wish, inviting them to explore and enjoy the many delights of Neverlight Grove. He politely asks that they avoid the eastern plateau because the Circle of Masters is preparing "a wondrous and glorious surprise" in the Garden of Welcome. Phylo offers to give them a peek the next day if they want. If Sarith is with the characters, he suggests they accept this offer, saying that keeping on the sovereign's good side will help the party in the long term. In truth, he is attempting to deliver the adventurers to Zuggtmoy.
zh_tw: 菲洛邀請角色們隨心所欲地停留，邀請他們探索並享受無光林地的許多樂趣。他禮貌地要求他們避開東部高原，因為大師之環正在歡迎花園準備"一個奇妙而輝煌的驚喜"。菲洛提出如果他們願意，第二天可以讓他們偷看一眼。如果薩里斯和角色們在一起，他建議他們接受這個提議，說保持君主的青睞將有助於隊伍長遠。實際上，他正試圖將冒險者們交給祖格莫伊。

english: Phylo goes on about how "the Great Seeder" who lives beyond the garden can answer any questions they have. The sovereign describes this entity in favorable terms, using "she" and "her" as it does so. Because myconids have no concept of gender, this unusual speech is further indication of Phylo's madness. However, the sovereign dodges any question about who the Great Seeder actually is, saying it is important for the characters to experience her first hand.
zh_tw: 菲洛繼續講述'偉大的播種者'，她居住在花園之外，能夠回答他們所有的問題。這位統治者用'她'和'她的'來描述這個實體，用詞非常正面。由於菌人沒有性別概念，這種不尋常的言辭進一步表明了菲洛的瘋狂。然而，統治者回避了所有關於偉大的播種者究竟是誰的問題，說對角色們來說，親身體驗她是很重要的。

english: Sovereign Basidia
zh_tw: 君主巴斯狄亞

english: A successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check reveals that {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA} is uncomfortable with Phylo's behavior. {@creature Stool|OotA} and {@creature Rumpadump|OotA} can easily discern that the harmony between Phylo and Basidia is off. At the earliest opportunity, Basidia volunteers to show the characters around, or finds another opportunity to rapport with them privately.
zh_tw: 一個成功的 {@dc 12} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定可以揭示出 {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞} 對菲洛的行為感到不適。 {@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳} 和 {@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普} 能輕易察覺到菲洛與巴薩迪亞之間的和諧關係出現了問題。一旦有機會，巴薩迪亞會主動提出帶領角色們參觀，或者尋找其他機會與他們私下建立融洽的關係。

english: When alone with the characters, Basidia warns them about staying in Neverlight Grove too long. It tells them another group of "softers" (the name myconids use for fleshy creatures) arrived not too many cycles ago and accepted Phylo's offer. They were taken to the Garden of Welcome and Basidia hasn't seen them since, nor has Phylo made any further mention of them (see "Questions for the Sovereigns"). Basidia also tells the characters that the Circle of Masters is taking most of the carcasses the Circle of Hunters bring in, and are sending groups of myconids outside the grove without telling anybody.
zh_tw: 當與角色們單獨在一起時，巴斯狄亞警告他們不要在無光林地逗留太久。它告訴他們，另一群"軟體生物"（菌人用來稱呼肉體生物的名字）不久前到達，並接受了菲洛的提議。他們被帶到了歡迎花園，巴斯狄亞從那以後就沒有再見到他們，菲洛也沒有再提及他們（見"向君主提問"）。巴斯狄亞還告訴角色們，大師之環正在接收獵人之環帶來的大部分屍體，並且正在向森林外派遣菌人的小組，而沒有告訴任何人。

english: If Basidia rapports with Sarith or any other non-myconid infected with Zuggtmoy's spores, it senses the alien nature of the demon lord's corruption. It can't identify Zuggtmoy's spores, but knows only that it has not encountered them before. This is unusual, Basidia tells the party, since most myconid sovereigns recognize all spores produced by myconids throughout the Underdark.
zh_tw: 如果巴斯狄亞與薩里斯或任何其他被祖格莫伊孢子感染的非菌人接觸，它能感受到惡魔領主腐敗的外來本質。它無法識別祖格莫伊的孢子，但只知道它以前從未遇到過它們。巴斯狄亞告訴隊伍，這是不尋常的，因為大多數菌人統治者都能識別出整個幽暗地域菌人產生的所有孢子。

english: Questions for the Sovereigns
zh_tw: 向君主提問

english: If the characters ask the sovereigns to help them return to the surface world, both are apologetic that they know of no routes. However, Basidia notes that during its colony's migration, the many travelers from the surface world they encountered were mostly merchants on their way to or from Blingdenstone, Gracklstugh, or Menzoberranzan.
zh_tw: 如果角色們請求君主幫助他們返回地表世界，兩位君主都會表示歉意，因為他們不知道有任何路線。然而，巴斯狄亞指出，在他們菌落的遷徙過程中，遇到的來自地表世界的許多旅行者大多是前往或來自布靈登石城、格拉克斯圖格或魔索布萊城的商人。

english: If the adventurers ask the sovereigns about any drow in the area, Basidia tells them about a drow patrol that just recently arrived. However, Phylo immediately interrupts, telling the characters that the drow were here a few days ago, but left shortly after Phylo showed them the Garden of Welcome. A successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check reveals that Basidia seems puzzled by Phylo's answer. If pressed, Basidia simply says it didn't know the drow had already left.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們向君主詢問該地區的任何卓爾，巴斯狄亞會告訴他們一支剛剛抵達的卓爾巡邏隊。然而，菲洛立即打斷了他，告訴角色們這些卓爾幾天前曾來過，但在菲洛帶他們參觀了歡迎花園後不久就離開了。成功的{@dc 12}感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定揭示出巴斯狄亞似乎對菲洛的回答感到困惑。如果追問下去，巴斯狄亞只是說它並不知道卓爾已經離開了。

english: Quest: Into the Garden
zh_tw: 任務：進入花園

english: Basidia offers to give the party a guided tour of all the circles in areas 1 through 4, where it introduces them to the respective circle leaders, pointing out which leaders support it, and which ones support Sovereign Phylo. Basidia uses this time away from Phylo to express its fear that Phylo has contracted some sort of "diseased spore." Basidia thinks that a clue to the spore's nature might be found in the Garden of Welcome. Basidia asks the characters to investigate the garden, fearing to do so itself in case it also falls victim to Phylo's disease.
zh_tw: 巴斯狄亞主動提出帶領隊伍參觀1至4區域的所有圈子，在那裡它向他們介紹了各自的圈子領袖，並指出哪些領袖支援它，哪些支援君主菲洛。巴斯狄亞利用這段時間遠離菲洛，表達了它對菲洛感染了某種"病原孢子"的擔憂。巴斯狄亞認為，關於孢子性質的線索可能在歡迎花園中找到。巴斯狄亞請求角色們調查花園，因為它擔心如果親自去調查，也可能成為菲洛疾病的受害者。

english: As a sign of friendship, Basidia gives the characters a moldy scroll case containing a {@item scroll of protection} against fiends. Basidia promises an additional reward (see "Treasure") if the characters investigate the Garden of Welcome on its behalf. Basidia can also brew potions out of the different molds and fungi in the grove, storing them in hollow gourd-like mushrooms. Basidia can craft a common or uncommon potion in eight hours, or a rare potion in two days.
zh_tw: 作為友誼的象徵，巴斯狄亞給角色們一個發黴的卷軸盒，裡面裝有一張防護邪惡生物的{@item scroll of protection||守護卷軸}。如果角色們代表巴斯狄亞調查歡迎花園，它承諾會給予額外的獎勵（見"寶藏"）。巴斯狄亞還可以利用森林中不同的黴菌和真菌釀造藥水，將它們儲存在像葫蘆一樣的空心蘑菇中。巴斯狄亞可以在八小時內製作出普通或不常見的藥水，或者在兩天內製作出稀有藥水。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If the characters complete Basidia's quest, the myconid sovereign digs up a small box buried in the earth and gives it to them. The box contains curiosities Basidia has collected from dead travelers over the years. The box is unlocked, made of fine wood inlaid with silver, and worth 25 gp by itself. It contains three amethysts (100 gp each), four small diamonds (50 gp each), and one large diamond (500 gp).
zh_tw: 如果角色們完成了巴斯狄亞的任務，這位菌人君主會挖出一個埋藏在土中的小盒子並將其交給他們。盒子裡裝有巴斯狄亞多年來從死去的旅行者那裡收集的珍品。盒子沒有上鎖，由鑲嵌著銀飾的優質木材製成，光盒子本身就價值25金幣。它包含三顆紫水晶（每顆100金幣），四顆小鑽石（每顆50金幣），以及一顆大鑽石（500金幣）。

english: If the characters kill the grick alpha, the umber hulk, or the shambling mound in the Fungal Wilds and bring the carcasses to Basidia, the sovereign rewards each character with a {@item potion of greater healing} stored in a hollow gourd-like mushroom.
zh_tw: 如果角色們殺死了真菌荒野中的穴居攫怪阿爾法、掘土巨怪或蔓生怪，並將它們的屍體帶給巴斯狄亞，這位君主會獎勵每個角色一瓶裝在類似葫蘆的空心蘑菇中的{@item potion of greater healing||高等治療藥水}。

english: Circle of Sporers
zh_tw: 孢子者之環

english: This circle mound is devoted to sporing new myconids. Freshly spored myconids are only a few inches tall and have no awareness, but they grow quickly into myconid sprouts.
zh_tw: 這個圈子土堆致力於新菌人人的孢子化。新孢子化的菌人人只有幾吋高，沒有意識，但它們會迅速成長為菌人人芽苗。

english: Yrberop
zh_tw: 伊爾貝羅普

english: The circle leader is infected by Zuggtmoy's madness. It is always swaying to music only it can hear, but those in rapport with Yrberop can hear a faint echo of its internal cacophony. Yrberop is enthusiastic about Phylo's plan to spread the happiness brought by the Great Seeder to everyone in the Underdark and beyond. For that to happen, the colony needs many more sprouts.
zh_tw: 圈子領袖被祖格莫伊的瘋狂感染了。它總是在隨著只有它自己能聽到的音樂搖擺，但與伊爾貝羅普建立和諧的人可以聽到其內心混亂的微弱回聲。伊爾貝羅普對菲洛傳播由偉大播種者帶來的快樂到幽暗地域及更遠地方的計劃感到非常熱情。為了實現這一目標，菌落需要更多的芽苗。

english: If the characters confer with Basidia, {@creature Stool|OotA}, or {@creature Rumpadump|OotA}, these myconids tell them this push to expand the population is unusual, given the balance that the myconids have endeavored to maintain in Neverlight Grove for so long.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與巴斯狄亞、{@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普}或{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}商議，這些菌人會告訴他們，這種推動人口擴張的行為很不尋常，因為菌人長期以來一直努力在無光林地維持平衡。

english: Yrberop loses track of any conversation after a short while and begins talking to the newly spored myconids instead. Characters who communicate with Yrberop in rapport and succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check can make out some of the words and impressions in the circle leader's lullaby. It sings of the Great Seeder and "her" wedding to the Great Body, and how every myconid is invited, bringing joy to all in the world below and above.
zh_tw: 伊爾貝羅普 在短時間內失去了對話的線索，開始與新生的菌人交談。能夠與 伊爾貝羅普 建立聯絡併成功透過 {@dc 13} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的角色可以聽出這位首領搖籃曲中的一些詞句和印象。它歌唱著偉大播種者與她與偉大軀體的婚禮，以及每個菌人都被邀請，為地下與地上的世界帶來歡樂。

english: Chuul Spore Servants
zh_tw: 甲伏怪孢子僕從

english: Behind the myconid breeding grounds is a narrow path leading up to a plateau and the Garden of Welcome (area 5). Two {@creature Chuul Spore Servant|OotA|chuul spore servants} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) guard this path. They don't allow anyone to pass without Yrberop's permission, which the circle leader doesn't grant, even at Basidia's request.
zh_tw: 在菌人繁育地的後方，有一條狹窄的小路通向一個高原和歡迎花園（區域5）。兩名{@creature Chuul Spore Servant|OotA|甲伏怪孢子奴僕}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）守衛著這條小路。沒有伊爾貝羅普的許可，他們不允許任何人透過，即使是在巴斯狄亞的請求下，圓環領袖也不會批准。

english: 4. Southern Terraces
zh_tw: 4. 南部梯田

english: The terraces along the southern rim of the cavern are narrower and not as fertile as the northern ones.
zh_tw: 洞穴南部邊緣的梯田比北部的更窄，也沒有北部的那麼肥沃。

english: These terraces are quiet and calm. The only sounds here are soft, "ploopy" splashes as water drips from stalactites above onto the caps of oversized mushrooms sprouting from mushy earth.
zh_tw: 這些梯田安靜而寧靜。這裡唯一的聲音是當水從上方的鐘乳石滴落到鬆軟土地上生長出的超大蘑菇的傘蓋上時，發出的柔和的"撲通"聲。

english: Circle of Explorers
zh_tw: 探險者之環

english: This circle is the smallest in Neverlight Grove, since it is merely the temporary home for restless myconids that brave the Underdark as scouts, patrols, and pathfinders.
zh_tw: 這是無光林地最小的環社，因為它只是那些不安於室、勇闖幽暗地域擔任斥候、巡邏者與探路者的菌人暫時的家。

english: Rasharoo
zh_tw: 拉沙魯

english: This circle leader is loyal to Basidia. Frequent trips outside the grove have allowed Rasharoo to notice the changes in Phylo and the entire colony more sharply, and it now trusts nothing and no one except Basidia. Its paranoia isn't the product of Zuggtmoy's corruption, however, but of the rising madness gripping the Underdark from the intrusion of the demon lords. If the characters demonstrate sympathy with Basidia or if the sovereign is with them, Rasharoo discloses it has a few escape plans ready, and has nutrient caches hidden along exit tunnels in case Basidia decides it is better to abandon the grove and return to a nomadic lifestyle.
zh_tw: 這位圈子領袖忠於巴斯狄亞。頻繁地出森林旅行使得拉沙魯更加敏銳地注意到了菲洛和整個菌落的變化，現在它除了巴斯狄亞之外誰也不信任。然而，它的偏執不是祖格莫伊腐敗的產物，而是惡魔領主入侵幽暗地域所帶來的日益增長的瘋狂所導致的。如果角色們表現出對巴斯狄亞的同情，或者君主和他們在一起，拉沙魯會透露它已經準備了一些逃生計劃，並在出口隧道中隱藏了營養儲備，以防巴斯狄亞決定放棄森林，迴歸遊牧生活方式。

english: Characters can climb the eastern corner of the top terrace to reach area 5, and Rasharoo gladly helps them if they head to the Garden of Welcome at Basidia's request.
zh_tw: 角色們可以爬上頂部梯田的東側角到達5號區域，如果他們應巴斯狄亞的請求前往歡迎花園，拉沙魯會很高興地幫助他們。

english: Developments
zh_tw: 發展

english: Among the myconids, Rasharoo and its circle are the adventurers' best hope of finding a way back to the surface. Rasharoo knows many promising paths, but since myconids have no interest in the sunlit world, it has never followed them all the way there. The circle leader helps the characters only after they complete Basidia's quest, assigning one of its explorers to guide the characters to their destination.
zh_tw: 在菌人中，拉沙魯及其圈子是冒險者找到返回地表的最佳希望。拉沙魯知道許多有希望的路徑，但由於菌人對陽光下的世界沒有興趣，它從未完全跟隨它們到達那裡。圈子領袖只有在角色們完成巴斯狄亞的任務後才會幫助他們，指派其一名探險者引導角色們到達目的地。

english: 5. Garden of Welcome
zh_tw: 5. 歡迎花園

english: Phylo has converted this unused terrace for the exciting new ideas that Zuggtmoy has inspired in it—ideas that are "too incredible" for the rest of the colony to absorb at once. This so-called garden is just a sample of the horrors that Zuggtmoy, the Demon Queen of Fungi, intends to bring to the Underdark.
zh_tw: 菲洛已經將這個未使用的梯田轉變為祖格莫伊激發給它的激動人心的新想法——這些想法對於菌落的其他成員來說"太不可思議"，無法一次性吸收。這個所謂的花園只是祖格莫伊，真菌惡魔女王，打算帶給幽暗地域的恐怖的一小部分。

english: This plateau rises higher than the other terraces, screened by a natural fence of soaring zurkhwood stalks. Muffled murmuring can be heard from atop the plateau.
zh_tw: 這個高原比其他梯田更高，被高聳的祖爾克木莖自然圍欄遮擋。從高原上方可以聽到沉悶的低語聲。

english: Circle of Masters
zh_tw: 大師之環

english: The newest circle in the colony, the Circle of Masters is formed exclusively by myconids touched by Zuggtmoy. These myconids share Phylo's vision of happiness spread through Zuggtmoy's spores, experimenting on the carcasses brought to them by the hunters—or on live prisoners they hunt in their own expeditions outside the grove. Their mound lies at the center of an obscene garden.
zh_tw: 菌落中最新的圈子，大師之環完全由被祖格莫伊觸碰的菌人組成。這些菌人分享菲洛透過祖格莫伊孢子傳播幸福的視野，他們在獵人帶給他們的屍體上進行實驗——或者在他們自己的森林外探險中捕獵的活體囚犯上進行實驗。他們的土堆位於一個不雅花園的中心。

english: Yestabrod
zh_tw: 葉斯塔布朗

english: Mutated by Zuggtmoy's spores, the circle leader has become an abomination. No longer recognizable as a myconid, it looks like a fungal larva slithering along the ground. Mold and lichen grow in hypnotic patterns along its ringed stalk, and it puffs clouds of spores from a slit resembling a mouth. It can use this orifice to actually speak, rather than depending on rapport spores. It no longer attends melds with the other leaders, instead sending its representative.
zh_tw: 由於祖格莫伊的孢子而變異，圈領導者已經變成了一個令人憎惡的怪物。它不再被認作是菌人，看起來像是一個在地面上蜿蜒爬行的真菌幼蟲魔。黴菌和苔蘚在它有環的莖上以催眠般的模式生長，它從一個類似嘴巴的裂縫中噴出孢子云。它可以使用這個孔洞實際說話，而不再依賴親和孢子。它不再參加與其他領導者的融合，而是派遣其代表。

english: Garden of Horror
zh_tw: 恐怖花園

english: As the characters enter the garden, they make a frightening discovery.
zh_tw: 當角色們進入花園時，他們做出了一個令人害怕的發現。

english: The low muttering grows louder as you reach the top, turning into a symphony of moans, cries, and hisses. The only light comes from a few glowing mushrooms along the edge, but even in the gloom, you can't miss the source of the sounds. The heads of creatures of a dozen humanoid Underdark races peek from the ground, mold and fungi growing around them.
zh_tw: 當你到達頂部時，低沉的嘟囔聲變得更大，變成了呻吟、哭泣和嘶嘶聲的交響樂。唯一的光源來自邊緣的一些發光蘑菇，但即使在昏暗中，你也不會錯過聲音的來源。來自幽暗地域種族的十幾個類人生物的頭從地面上探出頭來，周圍生長著黴菌和真菌。

english: One voice calls out loudly in Undercommon—a female drow fighting to speak. "Please... for your gods of light... kill me!" She manages to stir within her living grave, raising a spider medallion half-embedded in the bloated growth that was once her hand. Half her face is rotten and pustulate, a bed for the sprouting of scores of tiny mushrooms. "The Great Seeder... trap... she's here... the Lady of Decay... Zuggtmoy..."
zh_tw: 一個聲音在地底共通語中大聲呼喊——一位女性卓爾拼命地說話。"求求你......為了你們光明的神祇......殺了我吧！"她設法在她活著的墳墓中攪動，舉起一個半嵌在她曾經是手的腫脹生長物中的蜘蛛徽章。她半張臉腐爛化膿，成為無數細小蘑菇發芽的溫床。"偉大的播種者......陷阱......她在這裡......腐朽女士......祖格莫伊......"

english: The drow is Xinaya, a young acolyte of Lolth. She was leading a routine scouting patrol out of Velkynvelve before Ilvara contacted her with a {@spell sending} spell. The patrol was ordered to search near the grove for the characters, anticipating that the escapees might seek shelter among the peaceful mushroom folk.
zh_tw: 卓爾族是希娜雅，羅絲的年輕侍從。在伊爾瓦拉用{@spell sending||短訊術}法術聯絡她之前，她正帶領著一支例行偵察巡邏隊從維爾京維爾夫出發。巡邏隊被命令在樹林附近搜尋角色們，預計逃脫者可能會在和平的蘑菇族中尋找庇護。

english: Upon her arrival, Xinaya made the mistake of accepting Phylo's invitation to visit the Garden of Welcome, where she and her patrol quickly became victims of the myconids' madness. She begs the adventurers to end her suffering and warn her people about the presence of the Demon Queen of Fungi in the Underdark, unaware of the madness that has already erupted in Menzoberranzan and throughout the Underdark (see {@adventure chapter 15|OotA|14}). Xinaya is too far gone to be saved, and any amount of damage kills her.
zh_tw: 到達後，希娜雅犯了一個錯誤，接受了菲洛的邀請參觀歡迎花園，她和她的巡邏隊很快就成為了菌人瘋狂的受害者。她懇求冒險者結束她的痛苦，並警告她的人民有關真菌惡魔女王在幽暗地域中的存在，她不知道瘋狂已經在魔索布萊城和整個幽暗地域中爆發（見{@adventure 第十五章|OotA|14}）。希娜雅已經無法挽回，任何傷害都能殺死她。

english: After the characters speak with Xinaya, {@creature Yestabrod|OotA} appears (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}). The master of the foul garden takes delight in toying with trespassers.
zh_tw: 在角色們與希娜雅交談後，{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}出現（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）。這個邪惡花園的主人喜歡捉弄入侵者。

english: The moans of the garden's victims suddenly take on a new tone of fear as something moves across the foul ground. A disgusting larval creature rises up before you, showing only vestigial fungal growths that hint that it might once have been a myconid.
zh_tw: 隨著某種東西在骯髒的地面上移動，花園受害者的呻吟突然帶上了新的恐懼調子。一個令人作嘔的幼蟲狀生物出現在你們面前，只顯示出殘餘的真菌生長，暗示它可能曾經是一個菌人。

english: "Welcome, travelers." The aberrant myconid's voice gurgles and spits as it speaks both aloud and in your minds at once. "Are you here for the wedding rehearsal? Friends of the bride or her intended? No matter! Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body!"
zh_tw: "歡迎，旅行者們。"這個變異的菌人的聲音咕嘟咕嘟，說話時既大聲又在你們心中同時響起。"你們是來參加婚禮彩排的嗎？是新娘的朋友還是她未婚夫的朋友？沒關係！讓偉大的播種者的愛擁抱你們，當你們成為她選中的，偉大的身體的一部分！

english: As the garden comes alive with screams from its buried victims, {@creature Yestabrod|OotA} raises two {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|drow spore servants} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}). At the same time, two {@creature Myconid Adult||myconid adults} from the Circle of Masters emerge from the surrounding growth, all of the creatures following the circle leader as he attacks.
zh_tw: 當花園中被埋葬的受害者的尖叫聲響起時，{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}召喚了兩個{@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|卓爾孢子奴僕}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）。與此同時，兩個來自大師之環的{@creature Myconid Adult||蕈人成體}從周圍的生長物中出現，所有生物都跟隨圈領頭者攻擊。

english: If {@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA} (see {@area chapter 1|008|x}) is still with the party, he screams in agony as {@creature Yestabrod|OotA} attacks. The characters can only watch as the drow's head splits open, releasing a cloud of infecting spores and turning him into another {@creature drow spore servant|OotA} that joins the fight.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Sarith Kzekarit|OotA|薩里斯·克澤卡里特}（見{@area 第一章|008|x}）仍然與隊伍在一起，他會在{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}攻擊時痛苦地尖叫。角色們只能眼睜睜地看著卓爾的頭部裂開，釋放出一團感染孢子，將他變成另一個加入戰鬥的{@creature drow spore servant|OotA|卓爾孢子奴僕}。

english: If {@creature Yestabrod|OotA} is slain and there are still drow spore servants active, they go limp and stop attacking, at which point the myconids from the Circle of Masters attempt to flee.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}被擊殺，並且還有卓爾孢子僕從在活動，它們會癱軟並停止攻擊，此時來自大師之環的菌人會嘗試逃跑。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Xinaya's equipment is piled in a heap not far from where she was buried. Characters searching the pile find a suit of {@item +2 studded leather armor}, a {@item +2 shortsword}, and a {@item bag of holding} containing two {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} ({@spell remove curse} and {@spell spider climb}), 40 days of rations, and 320 sp. The drow spore servants wear chain shirts and carry shortswords. All of the armor and weapons found here are of drow construction (see the "Drowcraft Items" sidebar in {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}).
zh_tw: 希娜雅的裝備被堆放在她被埋的地方不遠處。搜尋這堆東西的角色們找到了一套{@item +2 studded leather armor||+2 鑲釘皮甲}，一把{@item +2 shortsword||+2 短劍}，以及一個{@item bag of holding||次元袋}，裡面裝有兩張{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}和{@spell spider climb||蛛行術}），40天的口糧和320枚銀幣。卓爾孢子僕從穿著鍊甲衫並攜帶短劍。這裡找到的所有盔甲和武器都是卓爾製造（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}中的"卓爾工藝物品"側欄）。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: In addition to the normal creature XP for this encounter, the characters earn a special award of 1,000 XP (divided equally among all party members) for defeating {@creature Yestabrod|OotA} and its minions.
zh_tw: 除了這次遭遇戰的正常生物經驗值外，角色們擊敗{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}及其手下後，還將獲得1000經驗值的特殊獎勵（平均分配給所有隊伍成員）。

english: Wedding Rehearsal
zh_tw: 婚禮彩排

english: After the confrontation with {@creature Yestabrod|OotA}, the characters can hear sound and movement from the cavern to the northeast. Read the following boxed text if the characters investigate.
zh_tw: 在與{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}的對抗之後，角色們可以聽到來自東北方向洞穴的聲音和動靜。如果角色們進行調查，請閱讀以下框內文字。

english: Echoes spill from the misty cavern beyond, a cacophony of wheezing voices that wrap together like some kind of discordant music. The remaining heads planted in the Garden of Welcome begin to croak and groan, joining the horrible song.
zh_tw: 回聲從遠處朦朧的洞穴中傳出，一種喘息的聲音混雜在一起，就像某種不和諧的音樂。種植在歡迎花園中的剩餘頭顱開始發出呱呱和呻吟聲，加入到這可怕的歌曲中。

english: Through the mist that shrouds the smaller cavern, you see the parade of creatures responsible for the melody. Their bodies are only vaguely humanoid, with clusters of luminescent lichen and tumescent growths forming chaotic patterns on their decaying flesh, their voices stabbing into your minds, both insane and gleeful in equal parts:
zh_tw: 穿過籠罩著較小洞穴的霧氣，你看到了負責旋律的生物遊行。它們的身體只是模糊地類似人類，身上長滿了發光的地衣和膨脹的腫塊，在腐爛的肉體上形成了混亂的圖案，它們的聲音刺入你們的心靈，既瘋狂又同樣歡樂：

english: {@i From rocky bed the toadstool rose,}
zh_tw: {@i 從岩石床上，毒蕈升起，}

english: {@i From chaos dark, her love She shows.}
zh_tw: {@i 她從混沌的黑暗中，展現了她的愛。}

english: {@i Wish! Yearn! Laugh}!
zh_tw: {@i 願望！渴望！笑}!

english: {@i The Lady will be wed!}
zh_tw: {@i 女士將要結婚！}

english: {@i Crave! Hunger! Dance}!
zh_tw: {@i 渴望！飢餓！跳舞！}!

english: {@i Her joyous spores will spread!}
zh_tw: {@i 她的喜悅孢子將傳播！}

english: {@i Youth is gone, beauty rots,}
zh_tw: {@i 青春已逝，美麗凋零，}

english: {@i Araumycos and Zuggtmoy}!
zh_tw: {@i 阿勞麥柯和祖格莫伊}!

english: {@i Joined together, heart to heart,}
zh_tw: {@i 心心相印，聯結在一起，}

english: {@i Becoming one 'til death do part!}
zh_tw: {@i 直到死亡將我們分開，我們才成為一體！}

english: {@i Hail! Hail! Hail}!
zh_tw: {@i 萬歲！萬歲！萬歲！}!

english: The entourage is composed of twelve {@creature Bridesmaid of Zuggtmoy|OotA|bridesmaids of Zuggtmoy} and six {@creature Chamberlain of Zuggtmoy|OotA|chamberlains of Zuggtmoy}(see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19} for both), all of which are lost in their own reverie. They are in the midst of conducting an obscene ritual of some sort—like a parody of a wedding ceremony.
zh_tw: 隨行人員由十二個{@creature Bridesmaid of Zuggtmoy|OotA|祖格莫伊的伴娘}和六個{@creature Chamberlain of Zuggtmoy|OotA|祖格莫伊的宮廷總管}組成（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}中的兩者），它們都沉浸在自己的幻想中。它們正在進行某種淫穢的儀式——就像一場婚禮儀式的諷刺。

english: Zuggtmoy's thralls make their way to {@creature Yestabrod|OotA}'s garden, attacking only if the characters stand in their way.
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊的奴僕們前往{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}的花園，只有在角色們阻礙他們的路時才會發動攻擊。

english: Any character reduced to 0 hit points in this encounter is knocked {@condition unconscious} rather than killed. If all the characters are knocked {@condition unconscious}, the party wakes up in a fungi-filled cave {@dice 1d6 + 4} miles away from Neverlight Grove, with or without their NPC companions (at your discretion). Their drow pursuit level decreases by 1, and each character is infested with Zuggtmoy's spores (see the "Neverlight Grove: General Features" sidebar).
zh_tw: 在這次遭遇中，任何角色降至0生命值會被擊成{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態，而不是被殺死。如果所有角色都被擊成{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，隊伍會在一個充滿真菌的洞穴中醒來，距離無光林地有{@dice 1d6 + 4}英里遠，是否帶有他們的NPC同伴由你決定。他們的卓爾追擊等級降低1級，每個角色都被祖格莫伊的孢子寄生（見"無光林地：一般特徵"側邊欄）。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If left alone, the thralls enact a mock wedding, with a chamberlain and a bridesmaid standing in for Araumycos and Zuggtmoy. {@creature Yestabrod|OotA}, if alive, assumes the role of priest to preside over the vows. If {@creature Yestabrod|OotA} is dead, three spore servants rise from the garden and carry its corpse, moving it like a puppet to play out the part of priest. At this point of the ceremony, any onlookers experience a vision.
zh_tw: 如果無人幹擾，這些奴僕會上演一場模擬婚禮，由一個管家和一個伴娘分別扮演阿勞麥柯和祖格莫伊。如果{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}還活著，它將扮演牧師的角色來主持誓言。如果{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}已死，三個孢子僕從會從花園中升起，攜帶它的屍體，像操縱木偶一樣讓它扮演牧師的角色。在這個儀式的這個階段，任何旁觀者都會經歷一個幻象。

english: The tableau of the mock wedding is replaced by a vision of the inside of a great tower. Spiraling stairs and balconies are carved into its walls, with the interior lit by phosphorescent patches of mold growing in whorls. In the center of the open space floats a humanoid figure, womanlike in form, but made entirely of fungi and mold. She is easily three times the height of the fungal bridesmaids that move up and down the spiraling stairs, tending to their giant mistress. They croon a strange, soothing song as they weave the substance of the giant figure into delicate lichen veils and a long, mycelium train like a bridal gown.
zh_tw: 模擬婚禮的場景被一座巨大塔樓內部的幻象所取代。螺旋樓梯和陽臺被雕刻在牆壁上，室內由生長成螺旋形的熒光黴菌斑塊照亮。在開放空間的中心漂浮著一個人形生物，形態像女性，但完全由真菌和黴菌構成。她很容易是那些在螺旋樓梯上上下下、照顧她們巨大女主人的真菌伴娘的三倍高。她們哼唱著一首奇怪而舒緩的歌曲，同時將巨大身影的物質編織成精緻的地衣面紗和一條長長的、類似婚紗的菌絲裙襬。

english: The vision ends when the ceremony does, after which the creatures file solemnly back to Yggmorgus. Characters witnessing the wedding rehearsal and the accompanying vision must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 這個幻象在儀式結束時消失，之後這些生物莊嚴地返回伊格莫格斯。目睹婚禮彩排及伴隨幻象的角色必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 感知豁免檢定，否則會獲得一級瘋狂（見第二章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。

english: If the characters share their experience with Basidia, the sovereign leads the two circles loyal to it out of Neverlight Grove before it is too late. Alternatively, the characters can follow the wedding procession into Yggmorgus and witness the further horrors waiting for the Underdark if Zuggtmoy rises in power.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與巴斯狄亞分享他們的經歷，這位君主會及時帶領忠於它的兩個圈子離開無光林地。或者，角色們可以跟隨婚禮隊伍進入伊格莫格斯，並目睹祖格莫伊掌權後幽暗地域等待的更多恐怖。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: In addition to the XP gained for defeating Zuggtmoy's bridesmaids or chamberlains, each characters gains 100 XP for witnessing the wedding rehearsal.
zh_tw: 除了擊敗祖格莫伊的伴娘或管家所獲得的經驗值外，每個角色因目睹婚禮彩排額外獲得100經驗值。

english: Yggmorgus
zh_tw: 伊格莫格斯

english: When Zuggtmoy arrived in the Underdark, she was immediately drawn to Neverlight Grove and its fungal riches. She cultivated Yggmorgus, a mushroom of titanic proportions, from the rich, rotting soil.
zh_tw: 當祖格莫伊到達幽暗地域時，她立刻被無光林地及其豐富的真菌資源所吸引。她從肥沃的腐爛土壤中培育出了伊格莫格斯，一種巨大無比的蘑菇。

english: Conveniently secluded from the rest of the Underdark, Yggmorgus is a perfect base of operations for the Demon Queen of Fungi. She has completely enthralled Phylo, and the hapless sovereign is growing a myconid and spore servant army for her. Zuggtmoy has also become aware of Araumycos, the largest fungal life form—and possibly the largest creature of any kind—in the world. Araumycos is a vast fungus colony with a single mind, which fills the caverns and tunnels of the Underdark in an area the size of the High Forest. Araumycos is so interwoven with the fabric of the world that control of it would grant Zuggtmoy nearly unlimited power in her new home.
zh_tw: 伊格莫格斯恰好隱匿於幽暗地域的其他地方之外，是真菌女王進行行動的完美基地。她已經完全迷住了菲洛，這位不幸的君主正在為她培養一個由菌人生物和孢子僕從組成的軍隊。祖格莫伊也意識到了阿勞麥柯，這是世界上最大的真菌生命形式——甚至可能是任何種類中最大的生物。阿勞麥柯是一個巨大的真菌群落，擁有單一的意識，它遍佈於幽暗地域的洞穴和隧道，覆蓋了像高森林那麼大的區域。阿勞麥柯與世界的構造如此交織在一起，以於控制它將賦予祖格莫伊在她的這個新家中幾乎無限的權力。

english: Though Yggmorgus can't be seen clearly from the main cavern of Neverlight Grove, the unholy lights and sounds there can be discerned and sometimes even felt. Characters who ask the myconids about it receive mixed responses. Sovereign Phylo and those loyal to it enter a state of near bliss when they speak about Yggmorgus, as if it was a paradise. {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA} and its followers give wary answers. Phylo's secrecy means that they aren't sure what lies beyond the ravine.
zh_tw: 雖然伊格莫格斯無法從無光林地主洞穴中清晰看到，但不潔的光芒和聲音仍可被察覺，有時甚至能感受到。角色詢問菌人對它的看法時，會得到不同的回應。君主菲洛及其忠誠信徒在談論伊格莫格斯時近乎狂喜，彷彿它是一個天堂。{@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞}及其追隨者則給出謹慎的回答。菲洛的保密意味著他們並不確定峽谷之外有什麼。

english: Giant Mushroom Tower
zh_tw: 巨型蘑菇塔

english: The cavern around Yggmorgus is huge, and the giant mushroom nearly fills it from floor to ceiling.
zh_tw: 伊格莫格斯周圍的洞穴非常巨大，巨型蘑菇幾乎從地面延伸到天花板填滿了它。

english: You have no clear reference to judge the towering mushroom's size at this distance. Thousands of smaller fungi cling to the main stalk, which itself splits into several lesser stalks, each long enough with a cap big enough to be the top of a great tower. The cavern floor surrounding the stalk is covered by a carpet of fungi. An eerie luminescence pours through slitted windows carved into the trunk, with the same cacophony of atonal music heard earlier echoing within. A stench of rot and decay wraps around you, seemingly threatening to penetrate your flesh and pervade your soul.
zh_tw: 在這個距離上，你沒有明確的參照物來判斷這個巨大蘑菇的大小。成千上萬的小真菌附著在主莖上，主莖本身又分成幾個較小的莖，每個都足夠長，頂部的帽子足夠大，可以成為一座高大塔樓的頂部。圍繞莖部的洞穴地面被真菌覆蓋成一片。一種奇異的微光透過雕刻在樹幹上的裂縫窗戶傾瀉而入，與之前聽到的不和諧音樂的混響聲迴盪在其中。腐爛和衰敗的惡臭圍繞著你，似乎威脅著要穿透你的肉體，瀰漫你的靈魂。

english: {@creature Yestabrod|OotA}'s Garden of Welcome is a pale reflection of the true horrors surrounding Yggmorgus. A 20-foot-high crescent-shaped ledge hugs the cavern wall and gradually slopes down to the lower basin. The ledge is covered with a carpet of moss and fungi, scores of variously sized lumps, and pockmarks where pools of vile fluids suppurate and ooze, some drying out and scabbing over. The entire ledge is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Characters venturing this close to Yggmorgus must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 耶斯塔布羅德（{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}）的歡迎花園只是伊格莫格斯（伊格莫格斯）周圍真正恐怖的一個蒼白縮影。一個20尺高的新月形巖臺緊貼著洞穴牆壁，逐漸向下傾斜至低窪盆地。巖臺上覆蓋著厚厚的地衣和真菌，散佈著大小不一的腫塊和坑洞，其中一些坑洞中充滿了腐敗的液體，有的已經乾涸並結痂。整個巖臺被視為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。冒險接近伊格莫格斯的角色必須成功透過一項{@dc 11}的感知豁免檢定，否則將獲得一級瘋狂（見第2章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。

english: Characters can discern the shapes of writhing creatures inside each lump. Most of these are humanoids, though a few of the lumps are occupied by what appear to be gricks, nothics, and giant spiders. This is the Great Garden of Rot, nourished both by the creatures subsumed within it and the {@i faerzress} pervading this cavern.
zh_tw: 角色們可以辨識出每個腫塊內扭曲生物的形狀。這些生物大多是類人生物，儘管一些腫塊中似乎被穴居攫怪、諾斯怪和巨型蜘蛛佔據。這是偉大的腐爛花園，既由其中包含的生物滋養，也由這個洞穴中瀰漫的{@i 妖光}滋養。

english: As if on cue, one of the lumps closest to the characters bubbles up and bursts. A dense cloud of spores and dark, reeking fluid explodes outward, even as the characters hear a piercing scream of agony and terror. Inside the pockmark left behind by the burst is one of Xinaya's drow scouts—or at least what's left of him. Other than a face, long white hair, and a breastplate, it is impossible to distinguish where the drow ends, and the rot and fungi consuming him begins. The drow feebly thrashes, his screams rising ever higher in pitch, until he locks eyes with one of the characters and abruptly stops screaming. A brief moment of lucidity replaces his terror, even as his eyes roll back into his head in some kind of bizarre euphoria as he goes limp and slowly sinks back down into the fungal muck. Characters witnessing this must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness.
zh_tw: 就在此時，離角色們最近的腫塊突然冒泡並爆裂開來。一團密集的孢子與黑色惡臭液體向外噴湧，同時角色們聽到了一聲撕心裂肺的痛苦與恐懼的尖叫。在爆裂留下的凹坑中，是希娜雅的一名卓爾偵察兵——或者說至少是他的殘骸。除了一張臉、長長的白髮和一件胸甲外，幾乎無法分辨出卓爾的軀體從哪裡結束，而吞噬著他的腐爛與真菌從哪裡開始。卓爾虛弱地掙扎著，他的尖叫聲越來越高，直到他與其中一名角色對視，突然停止了尖叫。短暫的清醒取代了他的恐懼，儘管他的眼睛翻向腦後，彷彿陷入某種怪異的狂喜中，隨後他癱軟下來，慢慢沉回真菌泥漿中。目睹這一幕的角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 13} 的感知豁免，否則將獲得一級瘋狂。

english: Throughout the entire cavern, loud moans and cries of agony answer the drow's screams in a terrifying and deafening chorus, drowning out all other sounds until eventually winding down into a low susurration of groans and burbles. The entire stalk of the giant mushroom seems to shudder, almost as if in delight.
zh_tw: 整個洞穴中，響亮的呻吟聲和痛苦的哭泣聲回應著卓爾的尖叫，形成了一個可怕而震耳欲聾的合唱，淹沒了所有其他聲音，直到最後逐漸減弱成低沉的呻吟和冒泡聲。巨大的蘑菇莖似乎在顫抖，就好像在享受一樣。

english: Characters who descend to the cavern's lower basin witness the next spectacle of unspeakable horror spawned by the Lady of Decay.
zh_tw: 角色們下到洞穴的下層盆地時，目睹了由腐朽女士孕育的下一個難以言說的恐怖景象。

english: Mad Dance
zh_tw: 瘋狂之舞

english: Scores of deformed creatures dance around the base of the giant fungal tower. The revelers are a motley collection of humanoids and various other creatures, all sporting tumors, cankers, and putrid patches of flesh all over their bodies. They are joined by dancing fungi vaguely shaped and twisted into forms resembling humanoids. Some of these creatures are spore servants enthralled to the Demon Queen of Fungi. Others are myconids and other fungal life forms infested with Zuggtmoy's spores.
zh_tw: 成群的畸形生物圍繞著巨型真菌塔的底部跳舞。這些狂歡者是各種人形生物和其他生物的大雜燴，他們的身體上佈滿了腫瘤、瘡瘍和腐爛的肉體。他們被形狀扭曲、類似人形的跳舞真菌加入。其中一些生物是孢子僕從，被真菌女王迷住。其他的是菌人和其他被祖格莫伊孢子寄生的真菌生命形式。

english: The dancing creatures pay no attention to trespassers unless they are attacked. In that event, {@dice 1d6} {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|drow spore servants} and {@dice 1d6} {@creature Hook Horror Spore Servant|OotA|hook horror spore servants} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19} for both) stop dancing and turn on their attackers.
zh_tw: 這些跳舞的生物不會注意入侵者，除非它們遭到攻擊。在那種情況下，{@dice 1d6}個{@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|卓爾孢子奴僕}和{@dice 1d6}個{@creature Hook Horror Spore Servant|OotA|恐爪怪孢子奴僕}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}中的兩者）停止跳舞，轉而攻擊入侵者。

english: Voices can be heard cackling and chatting amiably about Sovereign Phylo's success at "bringing so many new guests to attend the party!" The characters see drow dancing as if their bones were melting, duergar roaring with mock merriment and vomiting slime, and even nothics laughing madly as they leap and caper.
zh_tw: 可以聽到聲音在咯咯地笑和友好地交談，談論君主菲洛在"帶來這麼多新客人參加派對！"方面的成功。角色們看到卓爾跳舞，彷彿他們的骨頭在融化；灰矮人假裝高興地吼叫並嘔吐粘液；甚至諾斯怪瘋狂地笑著跳躍和嬉戲。

english: If the characters observe the mad dance for a few rounds, they see a form rising up out of the fungal muck. It is the {@creature drow scout|OotA} whose terrible end they just witnessed, wading out to join the other revelers in their mad dance. A character who witnesses this grotesque moment must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness.
zh_tw: 如果角色們觀察這場瘋狂舞蹈幾個回合，他們會看到一具形體從真菌淤泥中升起。那是剛剛目睹了可怕結局的{@creature drow scout|OotA|卓爾斥候}，涉水而出，加入其他狂歡者的瘋狂舞蹈。目睹這一荒誕時刻的角色必須成功透過一次{@dc 15}感知豁免檢定，否則將獲得一級瘋狂。

english: Great Palace
zh_tw: 宏偉宮殿

english: Yggmorgus is the home that Zuggtmoy, the Demon Queen of Fungi, has carved for herself inside the great mushroom. The general layout is simple enough, with the hollowed stalk of the mushroom making a towering central hall in which Zuggtmoy floats, surrounded by spiraling balconies where her growing number of bridesmaids attend her, singing as they weave her bridal gown to prepare for the fateful wedding day.
zh_tw: 伊格莫格斯是真菌女王祖格莫伊為自己在巨大蘑菇內部雕刻的家園。總體佈局相當簡單，蘑菇的空心莖部構成了一個高聳的中央大廳，祖格莫伊在其中漂浮，周圍是螺旋形的陽臺，她的伴娘們在這些陽臺上圍著她唱歌，她們編織她的婚紗，為命運的婚禮日做準備。

english: If the adventurers enter Yggmorgus, they come face to face with {@creature Zuggtmoy|MTF} (see {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}), attended by twelve {@creature Bridesmaid of Zuggtmoy|OotA|bridesmaids of Zuggtmoy} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}). Fortunately for them, Zuggtmoy is deep in meditation as her gown and veil are being prepared. She doesn't move, although she can speak and use her other abilities. Her bridesmaids attempt to chase off intruders, wailing and scolding them about how it is unlucky for them to see the bride before it is time. If the characters don't withdraw immediately, Zuggtmoy awakens and uses her Mind Control Spores ability to send them away, using her Infestation Spores only if the characters insist on engaging the demon lord here and now.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們進入伊格莫格斯，他們將直面{@creature Zuggtmoy|MTF|祖格莫伊}（見{@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20}），由十二名{@creature Bridesmaid of Zuggtmoy|OotA|祖格莫伊的伴娘}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）隨侍。幸運的是，祖格莫伊正沉浸在冥想中，她的禮服和麵紗正在準備中。她不會移動，儘管她可以說話並使用她的其他能力。她的伴娘們會試圖趕走入侵者，哀嚎並責罵他們，說他們在這個時間見到新娘是不吉利的。如果角色們不立即撤退，祖格莫伊會甦醒並使用她的心靈控制孢子能力將他們驅散，只有在角色們堅持在這裡與惡魔領主對抗時才會使用她的侵染孢子。

english: Dozens of spore servants and myconids respond to Zuggtmoy's telepathic call if their mistress is in danger, attacking the characters heedless of their own safety. Any attack that successfully deals damage to Zuggtmoy damages her gown, driving the demon queen into a rage to attack the intruders.
zh_tw: 如果祖格莫伊處於危險之中，成群的孢子僕從和菌人響應她的心靈感應召喚，不顧自身安危攻擊角色們。任何成功對祖格莫伊造成傷害的攻擊都會損毀她的禮服，激怒這位惡魔女王去攻擊入侵者。

english: Leaving Neverlight Grove
zh_tw: 離開無光林地

english: Leaving the myconid enclave is easier than finding it. Whether they politely avoid Phylo's invitation or flee for their lives and sanity from the Demon Queen of Fungi, the adventurers can easily receive the aid of {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA} and the circles still loyal to it. Where the characters go next is up to them—a decision dependent upon where they have been, the pursuing drow, and whatever they have acquired (food, potions, treasure from the doomed drow patrol, and so on) during their visit to the grove.
zh_tw: 離開菌人的領地比找到它要容易得多。無論是禮貌地迴避菲洛的邀請，還是為了生命和理智逃離真菌女王，冒險者們都可以輕鬆地得到{@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞}及其仍然忠誠的圈子的援助。接下來角色們去哪裡取決於他們自己——這個決定取決於他們去過哪裡、追擊的卓爾以及他們在拜訪林地期間所獲取的東西（食物、藥水、從註定的卓爾巡邏隊那裡得到的寶藏等等）。

english: Depending on how the characters interacted with the myconids and what tasks they accomplished for their hosts, they might depart in the company of a myconid guide, or even two whole circles of myconids fleeing the grove before Zuggtmoy's madness takes them. Sovereign Phylo doesn't stop the characters or {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA} from leaving, still convinced the cause it embraces is one of joy and prosperity for its people.
zh_tw: 根據角色們與菌人生物的互動方式以及他們為東道主完成的任務，他們可能會在一位菌人嚮導的陪同下離開，甚至可能是兩個完整的菌人圈子在祖格莫伊的瘋狂席捲他們之前逃離樹林。君主菲洛沒有阻止角色們或{@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞}離開，仍然堅信它所擁抱的事業是為其人民帶來歡樂與繁榮。

english: In all probability, the characters leave the fungal grove with dire and horrific news. They have witnessed the effect a single demon lord can have on the Material Plane—and they realize far more and worse things are coming.
zh_tw: 角色們很可能帶著嚴峻和恐怖的訊息離開真菌樹林。他們已經目睹了一個單一惡魔領主對物質界的影響——並且他們意識到還有更多更糟糕的事情即將到來。

english: Regardless of how many battles the characters might have had inside Neverlight Grove, discovering that a demon lord is on the loose on the Material Plane is a major revelation. Moreover, if they were in Sloobludop to witness the rise of Demogorgon, they now know that more than one demon lord is at large, hinting at the magnitude of the threat.
zh_tw: 無論角色們在無光林地內經歷了多少戰鬥，發現一個惡魔領主在物質界橫行是一個重大的啟示。此外，如果他們在斯盧布多普目睹了狄摩高根的崛起，他們現在知道不止一個惡魔領主在自由行動，這暗示了威脅的嚴重程度。

english: If the adventurers simply passed through the grove and enjoyed the hospitality of the doomed myconids, they leave with only suspicions about their odd behavior, which can help them later in piecing together the greater mystery in the Underdark.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者只是穿過樹林並享受了註定要滅亡的菌人的熱情款待，他們離開時只會對他們奇怪的行為產生懷疑，這可以在後來幫助他們拼湊出幽暗地域更大的謎團。

english: If the adventurers learned nothing about the presence of Zuggtmoy or her plans, you might pass the information on to them by having a friendly myconid such as {@creature Stool|OotA} or {@creature Rumpadump|OotA} come to them just as they are leaving. The myconid enters rapport and shows them a vision of the Garden of Welcome and Yggmorgus, saying these images come from the minds of other myconids in the grove, and asking what these "strange dreams" mean.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者對祖格莫伊的存在或她的計劃一無所知，你可以透過一個友好的菌人生物，比如{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}或{@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普}，在他們離開時找到他們，將資訊傳遞給他們。菌人生物進入心靈感應，並展示了歡迎花園和伊格莫格斯的幻象，說這些影象來自樹林中其他菌人生物的思想，並詢問這些"奇怪的夢"意味著什麼。

english: Chapter 6: Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 第6章：布靈登石城

english: Blingdenstone, once called the City of Speaking Stones, is a deep gnome settlement founded more than two millennia ago. The deep gnomes, insular and secretive by nature, care little about histories and legacies, and thus most of the ruined city's past is lost to time.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城，曾被稱為會說話的石頭之城，是一個地底侏儒在兩千多年前建立的定居點。地底侏儒天性孤僻且神秘，對歷史和遺產不太關心，因此這座廢棄城市大部分的過去已經隨著時間的流逝而遺失。

english: For centuries, Blingdenstone remained hidden and isolated from the rest of the Underdark, thanks to a combination of misdirection and magic. It wasn't until they provided shelter to a drow exile named Drizzt Do'Urden that the deep gnomes began to take a more active interest in the world outside their caverns. Perceiving the threat the drow represented to all the peoples of the Underdark, the deep gnomes abandoned their isolation when they came to the defense of the dwarves of Mithral Hall, defeating an invading drow force from Menzoberranzan.
zh_tw: 幾個世紀以來，布靈登石城隱藏著，與幽暗地域的其他地區隔絕，這要歸功於誤導和魔法的結合。直到他們為一位名叫崔斯特·杜堊登的卓爾流亡者提供庇護，地底侏儒才開始對洞穴外面的世界產生更積極的興趣。地底侏儒意識到卓爾對幽暗地域所有種族構成的威脅，當他們為米斯拉爾廳的矮人提供防禦，擊敗來自魔索布萊城的入侵卓爾勢力時，他們放棄了孤立。

english: This alliance, however, would spell Blingdenstone's doom. The vengeful drow bided their time, rebuilt their forces, and sent their armies out to strike back hard against the svirfneblin, returning in great force to lay siege to Blingdenstone. The deep gnomes were no match for the drow army. Thousands of svirfneblin were slaughtered, and those survivors who didn't escape to Mithral Hall or the surface world were dragged back in chains to Menzoberranzan as slaves.
zh_tw: 然而，這個聯盟卻預示著布靈登石城的厄運。復仇心切的卓爾等待時機，重建了他們的軍隊，並派出軍隊猛烈反擊地底侏儒，以強大的力量返回圍攻布靈登石城。地底侏儒不是卓爾軍隊的對手。成千上萬的地底侏儒遭到屠殺，那些沒有逃到米斯拉爾廳或地表世界的生還者被鐵鏈鎖住，拖回魔索布萊城當奴隸。

english: Within the past decade or so, the deep gnomes have returned to reclaim, resettle, and rebuild their city. The ultimate success of their efforts, however, hangs by a slender thread. Most of the ruined city is a dangerous place and remains closed off, with tunnels and chambers barricaded with gates or deliberately caused cave-ins. The svirfneblin must contend with incursions by wererat squatters, insane elementals, ghosts, and a plague of invading oozes controlled by {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}—a mad deep gnome under the influence of the demon lord Juiblex. Before they can offer the party any help, the deep gnomes likely need some themselves.
zh_tw: 在過去的大約十年左右時間裡，地底侏儒已經返回來重新奪回、重新定居並重建他們的城市。然而，他們的努力最終是否成功，仍然岌岌可危。大部分被毀的城市是一個危險的地方，仍然被封閉，隧道和房間被用門封鎖或故意引發塌方。地底侏儒必須與鼠人非法定居者、瘋狂的元素生物、鬼魂，以及由{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}控制的入侵軟泥怪瘟疫作鬥爭——這是一個受到惡魔領主朱庇萊克斯影響的瘋狂地底侏儒。在他們能夠為隊伍提供任何幫助之前，地底侏儒可能自己也需要一些幫助。

english: Going to Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 前往布靈登石城

english: Blingdenstone is an obvious destination for characters seeking refuge from their drow pursuers and a way out of the Underdark. The deep gnomes continue to have regular dealings with the surface world.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城對於尋求躲避卓爾追蹤者以及逃離幽暗地域的角色來說是一個明顯的目標。地底侏儒繼續與地表世界保持定期的交易。

english: Among the party's fellow escapees, the deep gnome {@creature Jimjar|OotA} is the most enthusiastic about visiting Blingdenstone, and he can lead the adventurers there. {@creature Topsy|OotA} and {@creature Turvy|OotA} also know the way, but they are noticeably less willing to go to the settlement because of the fear and shame they feel regarding their lycanthropic affliction. The shield dwarf scout {@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA} isn't sure how to reach the gnome settlement, but is in favor of going there if it offers a route to the surface or to Gauntlgrym. If the characters allow {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} (the sentient gelatinous cube from "{@area The Oozing Temple|0ca|x}" in chapter 2) to accompany them, it feels a certain pull toward Blingdenstone, and is curious enough to guide the characters there.
zh_tw: 在隊伍的逃亡者中，地底侏儒{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}最熱衷於訪問布靈登石城，他可以帶領冒險者們前往那裡。{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西}和{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}也知道路，但由於他們對於自己的狼人疾病感到恐懼和羞恥，他們明顯不太願意去這個定居點。盾矮人偵察兵{@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA|艾爾德絲·費爾德倫}不確定如何到達侏儒定居點，但如果那裡提供了通往地面或岡特格瑞姆的路線，他支援去那裡。如果角色們允許{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}（來自第二章中的"{@area 流動的神廟|0ca|x}"的有感知能力的凝膠立方體）陪同他們，它對布靈登石城有一種特定的吸引力，並且足夠好奇，可以引導角色們前往那裡。

english: Drow Pursuers
zh_tw: 卓爾族追擊者

english: The svirfneblin settlement is a haven for the characters. For good reason, the deep gnomes rarely allow drow into Blingdenstone, and only then with a heavily armed escort. A drow character must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check to enter escorted. However, if any deep gnomes are traveling with the party, having them vouch for the drow allows the escort to be waived at your discretion.
zh_tw: 斯維夫尼布林定居點是角色們的避風港。出於充分理由，地底侏儒很少允許卓爾進入布靈登石城，即使允許也必須有重灌護送。一個卓爾角色必須透過一個 {@dc 15} 魅力 ({@skill Persuasion||說服}) 檢定才能在被護送的情況下進入。然而，如果任何地底侏儒與隊伍同行，並且他們為卓爾作保，你可以自行決定免除護送要求。

english: The party's drow pursuers won't attempt to follow the characters into Blingdenstone. The party's pursuit level (see "{@area Drow Pursuit|078|x}" in chapter 2) doesn't change while they are in the svirfneblin settlement.
zh_tw: 隊伍的卓爾族追擊者不會試圖跟隨角色進入布靈登石城。當他們在地底侏儒定居點時，隊伍的追擊等級（參見第二章中的'{@area 卓爾追擊|078|x}'）不會改變。

english: If the party's pursuit level is 3 or higher when they arrive at Blingdenstone, Ilvara and her party are watching the tunnels leaving the settlement. The pursuit level increases to 5 when the characters leave Blingdenstone, possibly leading to a chase or straight into chapter 7, "{@adventure Escape From the Underdark|OotA|6}."
zh_tw: 如果隊伍到達布靈登石城時的追擊等級為3或更高，伊爾瓦拉和她的隊伍會監視著離開定居點的隧道。當角色們離開布靈登石城時，追擊等級提升至5，可能會導致追逐或直接進入第七章，'{@adventure 逃離幽暗地域|OotA|6}'。

english: Arriving at Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 抵達布靈登石城

english: Blingdenstone has a reputation for being a dangerous ruin inhabited only by monsters and other undesirables. Others think of it as a budding settlement well on its way to recovery. Once the characters reach the gates, they can see that the truth lies somewhere in between.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城以其危險的廢墟而聞名，據說只有怪物和其他不受歡迎的人居住。其他人則認為它是一個正在恢復中的新興定居點。一旦角色們到達大門口，他們會發現真相介於兩者之間。

english: The characters must prove their goodwill to the deep gnomes before they are allowed inside. Once the characters win the gnomes' trust, they are welcomed into Inner Blingdenstone, and to what food and comfort the locals can readily provide.
zh_tw: 角色們必須先向地底侏儒證明他們的善意才能被允許進入。一旦角色們贏得了侏儒的信任，他們將被歡迎進入內布靈登石城，並且當地人會提供他們所能提供的任何食物和舒適。

english: Roleplaying the Svirfneblin
zh_tw: 扮演地底侏儒

english: Deep gnomes are a dour lot, reserved and careful in their dealings with outsiders. They make the assumption that every non-svirfneblin means to do them harm—which is understandable given their history. They speak softly in caves and tunnels where sound carries, eyes darting furtively, looking for signs of danger.
zh_tw: 地底侏儒是一群嚴肅的人，他們在與外來者打交道時保守且謹慎。他們假設每一個非地底侏儒都有意傷害他們——鑑於他們的歷史，這是可以理解的。他們在洞穴和隧道中輕聲說話，眼睛偷偷地掃視，尋找危險的跡象。

english: Despite their harsh outlook, svirfneblin are still gnomes, and many are as benevolent and joyful as their surface cousins. They reveal these aspects most easily among their own kind, and to those they come to trust.
zh_tw: 儘管他們的生活觀很嚴酷，地底侏儒仍然是侏儒，許多地底侏儒和他們地表的表親一樣仁慈和快樂。他們最願意在同類之間，以及對那些他們開始信任的人展現這些特質。

english: The svirfneblin assign defined roles to each gender but hold females and males in equal standing. It is ancient custom for there to be both a king and a queen with equal responsibilities. Svirfneblin males are hunters, explorers, laborers, and warriors, while females are managers, judges, politicians, and caretakers. Deep gnomes sometimes forget this is not the case with other races, and that males are capable of careful thought just as much as females can fight.
zh_tw: 地底侏儒為每個性別分配了明確的角色，但男女享有平等的地位。自古以來，就有國王和王后共同承擔同等責任的傳統。地底侏儒的男性是獵人、探險者、勞動者和戰士，而女性則是管理者、法官、政治家和看護者。地底侏儒有時會忘記這並不是其他種族的情況，男性同樣能夠進行細緻的思考，就像女性也能戰鬥一樣。

english: Changing Svirfneblin Attitudes
zh_tw: 改變地底侏儒的態度

english: The general attitude of deep gnomes toward strangers is hostile—not necessarily opposed, but deeply suspicious. This attitude can be shifted to indifferent and then friendly as the characters help the svirfneblin openly (see "{@book Social Interaction|DMG|8|Social Interaction}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 地底侏儒對陌生人的普遍態度是敵對的——不一定是敵對，但非常懷疑。當角色們公開幫助地底侏儒時，這種態度可以轉變為中立，然後友好（見{@book 交涉|DMG|8|Social Interaction}，在{@i 城主指南}第8章中）。

english: Some deeds in Blingdenstone reward the characters with an automatic attitude shift, while others require a {@dc 15} group Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. If the group check succeeds, the attitude of the svirfneblin shifts by one. If characters are rude or act in a way to make the deep gnomes more suspicious toward them, they must also make another group check. If this group check fails, the deep gnomes' attitude worsens by one.
zh_tw: 在布靈登石城的一些行為會為角色帶來自動的態度轉變，而其他行為則需要進行一次 {@dc 15} 群體魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。如果群體檢定成功，地底侏儒的態度會提升一級。如果角色表現粗魯或以某種方式使地底侏儒對他們更加懷疑，他們還必須進行另一項群體檢定。如果這次群體檢定失敗，地底侏儒的態度會惡化一級。
