english: Leaders of Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 布靈登石城的領袖

english: By deep gnome tradition, Blingdenstone is governed jointly by a king and queen, but the svirfneblin have had no true sovereigns while living as refugees for the good part of a century. Dorbo and Senni Diggermattock are talented miners, but they have become even more capable as community leaders. They spent years planning an expedition to Blingdenstone, paying adventurers to scout and keep an eye on the territory while they organized their people across the dwarven holds and surface-world cities that had received them.
zh_tw: 根據地底侏儒的傳統，布靈登石城由國王和王后共同治理，但在作為難民生活了近一個世紀的大部分時間裡，地底侏儒沒有真正的君主。多爾博和森妮·掘鋤是天才礦工，但作為社群領袖，他們變得更加能幹。他們花了多年時間策劃前往布靈登石城的探險，支付冒險者去偵察並監視領土，同時他們在矮人領地和接收他們的地表城市中組織他們的人民。

english: After a decade of careful and determined planning, the Diggermattocks led a force back to Blingdenstone to reclaim it. While they have not yet been crowned, everybody treats them as the de facto rulers of the settlement.
zh_tw: 經過十年的謹慎和堅定規劃，掘鋤家族帶領一支隊伍回到布靈登石城進行收復。儘管他們尚未加冕，但每個人都將他們視為定居點的實際統治者。

english: Chief Dorbo oversees rebuilding industry, opening mines, and organizing patrols to explore parts of the ruined city that remain uninhabited by the svirfneblin. He is also responsible for rebuilding and commanding the new settlement's defenses. Like most svirfneblin, Dorbo is serious and aggressive when dealing with outsiders; for all of that, however, he is also a loving and caring husband and a thoughtful leader of his people, devoted to the vision that he and his wife share of a Blingdenstone rebuilt and reborn.
zh_tw: 多爾博酋長負責監督重建工業，開放礦場，並組織巡邏隊探索那些由地底侏儒未居住的廢墟城市區域。他還負責重建並指揮新定居點的防禦。和大多數地底侏儒一樣，多爾博在處理外來者時嚴肅而好鬥；儘管如此，他也是一個充滿愛心和關懷的丈夫，一個深思熟慮的領導者，致力於他和他的妻子共同分享的布靈登石城重建與重生的願景。

english: Quartermaster Senni takes the count and measure of everything, ensuring her husband's efforts are well supported and efficient. She oversees the trade efforts and caravans to Mithral Hall, Gauntlgrym, and Mantol-Derith. She manages and helps to maintain Blingdenstone's magical infrastructure, and is intimately familiar with security conditions across the settlement. As quartermaster, she assigns homes to the ever-increasing numbers of svirfneblin returning to Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 軍需官森妮負責統計和衡量一切，確保她丈夫的努力得到良好支援和高效運作。她負責監督貿易活動和前往米斯拉爾廳、岡特格瑞姆、曼塔-岱瑞絲的商隊。她管理並幫助維護布靈登石城的魔法基礎設施，並對定居點各地的安全狀況瞭如指掌。作為軍需官，她為不斷增加的返回布靈登石城的地底侏儒分配住房。

english: Miners' Guild
zh_tw: 礦工公會

english: The svirfneblin base most of their economic subsistence on their ability to mine ores and gems. The settlement is largely self-sufficient, but it still relies on the duergar of Mantol-Derith for tools, weapons, and supplies.
zh_tw: 地底侏儒主要依靠他們的採礦能力和寶石開採來維持經濟生活。這個定居點在很大程度上自給自足，但它仍然依賴於曼塔-岱瑞絲的灰矮人提供工具、武器和補給。

english: Because the Blingdenstone economy depends on mining, the Miners' Guild holds a lot of power in Blingdenstone. Led by the Pickshine family, the Miners' Guild oversees all of Blingdenstone's mines, as well as the mining, cutting, and enchanting of {@item Spell Gem|OotA|spell gems} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}), both for the settlement's defense and for trade export.
zh_tw: 由於布靈登石城的經濟依賴於採礦，礦工公會在布靈登石城擁有很大的權力。由皮克夏因家族領導的礦工公會負責監督布靈登石城的所有礦山，以及{@item Spell Gem|OotA|法術寶石}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}）的開採、切割和附魔，這些寶石既用於定居點的防禦，也用於貿易出口。

english: Stoneheart Enclave
zh_tw: 石心聚落

english: This group of svirfneblin spellcasters once trained under the Emerald Enclave but eventually splintered off, choosing to focus solely on earth elemental magic. After doing so, they absorbed the surviving priesthood serving the deep gnome deities Segojan Earthcaller (the god of deep earth and nature) and Callarduran Smoothhands (the god of stone and mining).
zh_tw: 這群斯維爾芬布人施法者曾經在翠綠閒庭接受訓練，但最終分裂出來，選擇專注於地元素魔法。這樣做之後，他們吸收了為地底侏儒神祇塞戈詹·地語者（大地與自然的神）和卡拉杜蘭·巧手（石頭與礦業的神）服務的倖存神職人員。

english: The Stoneheart Enclave is in charge of summoning earth elementals to help defend Blingdenstone. They also use their magic to aid in various engineering tasks, such as widening burrows, closing off tunnels, or establishing {@item spell gem|OotA} emplacements and defensive measures. When needed, the spellcasters of the Stoneheart Enclave serve as extraplanar diplomats, forging occasional agreements with xorn and galeb duhr to aid Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 石心聚落負責召喚土元素來幫助保衛布靈登石城。他們還利用自己的魔法協助各種工程任務，例如拓寬洞穴、封閉隧道，或建立{@item spell gem|OotA|法術寶石}設施和防禦措施。在需要時，石心聚落的施法者擔任跨位面外交官，偶爾與石鼎獸和石人達成協議，以援助布靈登石城。

english: The enclave's leader is Yantha Coaxrock, a young female mage who splits her time and energy between conducting magical research in Blingdenstone, aiding the svirfneblin enclave in Mantol-Derith (see {@adventure chapter 9|OotA|8}), and working with the rest of the Stoneheart Enclave.
zh_tw: 這個據點的領導人是年輕的女性法師揚薩·寇克斯洛克，她將時間和精力分配在布靈登石城進行魔法研究、援助在曼塔-岱瑞絲（見{@adventure 第九章|OotA|8}）的地底侏儒據點，以及與石心據點的其他成員合作上。

english: Burrow Wardens
zh_tw: 地穴守衛

english: Most of the honored protectors of the svirfneblin died during the drow invasion, and the rest perished while protecting their people during their flight from Blingdenstone to Mithral Hall. Only the memory of their valiant effort remains today—and even that is fading due to the deep gnomes' penchant for forgetting their own history.
zh_tw: 斯維爾芬布人中大多數受尊敬的保護者在卓爾入侵期間死亡，其餘的在從布靈登石城逃往米斯拉爾大廳時保護他們的人民而犧牲。今天，只有他們英勇努力的記憶留存下來——甚至這份記憶也因為地底侏儒忘記自己歷史的習慣而逐漸淡去。

english: In the last year, a handful of svirfneblin youths have been training in secret under the rather terrifying care of the veteran Burrow Warden Jadger, who lingers on as a ghost. In life, Jadger was an expert in the Underdark and its many denizens, as well as how to fight them. He is grooming his brightest student, Trisk Adamantelpiece, to command the new burrow wardens, who are preparing to announce their existence to the Diggermattocks and demand recognition as the new Burrow Wardens of Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 在過去的一年裡，少數地底侏儒青年在經驗豐富的地道守望者賈傑爾的可怕關懷下秘密接受訓練，賈傑爾作為一個鬼魂仍然徘徊不去。在生前，賈傑爾是幽暗地域及其眾多生物的專家，以及如何與它們戰鬥。他正在培養他最聰明的學生特里斯克·精金披肩，以指揮新的地穴守衛者，他們正準備向掘鋤家族宣佈他們的存在，並要求作為布靈登石城的新地穴守衛者得到認可。

english: Ghosts of Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 布靈登石城的幽靈

english: Although not truly organized, the ghosts of the svirfneblin killed during the drow attack are an undeniable presence. The settlers have been wise enough to mark haunted burrows off from their reclamation plans. But as new svirfneblin arrive and need accommodation, space is starting to become a problem. There are far more ghosts in the ruined settlement than anyone expected, and each ghost is different. Some are harmless, appearing only as echoes of the event that led to their deaths. Others are fully aware—and often hostile and dangerous.
zh_tw: 儘管不是真正有組織的，但在卓爾攻擊中被殺的地底侏儒的幽靈是一個不可否認的存在。定居者們足夠明智地將鬧鬼的地穴從他們的收復計劃中標記出來。但是隨著新的地底侏儒的到來並需要住宿，空間開始成為一個問題。在廢墟定居點中的幽靈比任何人預期的都要多，而且每個幽靈都不同。有些是無害的，只作為導致他們死亡的事件的回聲出現。其他的則完全有意識——通常具有敵意且危險。

english: Ogrémoch's Bane
zh_tw: 歐雷莫克之災

english: Ogrémoch's Bane is a drifting cloud of transparent, magical dust that first appeared in Blingdenstone over a century ago. Believed to be sentient, it is found roaming the Rockblight section of the settlement. Elemental creatures touched by the cloud fall under its control.
zh_tw: 歐雷莫克之災是一團漂浮的透明魔法塵埃，一個多世紀前首次出現在布靈登石城。它被認為具有感知能力，被發現在定居點的岩石疫病區域漫遊。被雲觸碰的元素生物會落入其控制之下。

english: The cloud's origin remains a mystery, but it is known to have something to do with Ogrémoch, Prince of Evil Earth. A medusa named Neheedra serves Ogrémoch's Bane and leads some of the elemental creatures that have become enslaved by the evil cloud (see the "Rockblight" section and area 19 in particular).
zh_tw: 雲的起源仍然是個謎，但眾所周知它與邪惡之土的王子歐雷莫克有關。一個名叫妮希德拉的美杜莎為歐雷莫克之災服務，並領導著一些被邪惡雲層奴役的元素生物（詳見"岩石之光"章節以及特別提到的區域19）。

english: Clan Goldwhisker
zh_tw: 金鬚族

english: After Blingdenstone's fall, a gang of wererats tried to make a home in the ruined city. The last handful of svirfneblin hiding in Blingdenstone after the drow armies abandoned the city managed to kill or drive off the wererats, but many of the deep gnomes became infected with lycanthropy.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城陷落後，一群鼠人試圖在這座廢墟城市中安家。在卓爾軍隊放棄這座城市後，最後一批躲藏在布靈登石城的地底侏儒設法殺死或趕走了鼠人，但許多地底侏儒感染了鼠人病。

english: Today, deep gnome wererats claims a large chunk of the ruins under the name of Clan Goldwhisker, holding territory against new settlers and engaging in urban warfare against them. The pack leader is the cunning and charismatic Chipgrin, whose concern for his pack's safety has him hoping to negotiate a truce with the Diggermattocks and stop his svirfneblin cousins from seeing his people as dangerous monsters fit only for extermination. Chipgrin is all too aware of the threat posed by Ogrémoch's Bane and the oozes plaguing the settlement, and he hopes that making common cause against those threats will force the other svirfneblin to recognize Clan Goldwhisker's right to remain in Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 如今，地底侏儒鼠人以金鬚氏族之名佔據了廢墟的一大部分，他們對新定居者佔有領土，並與之進行城市戰爭。鼠人群的領袖是狡猾且富有魅力的奇普格林，他對自己群落安全的關心讓他希望能與掘鋤家族談判達成停火，並阻止他的地底侏儒表親們將他的族人視為只能被消滅的危險怪物。奇普格林非常清楚歐雷莫克之災以及困擾定居點的軟泥怪所帶來的威脅，他希望共同對抗這些威脅將迫使其他地底侏儒承認金鬚氏族在布靈登石城逗留的權利。

english: The Pudding King's "Court"
zh_tw: 布丁王的"宮廷"

english: The so-called Pudding King holds court in the deepest sections of Blingdenstone. He was part of the first settler mission led by the Diggermattocks, but the other svirfneblin soon shunned him for his many disturbing habits, among them his preoccupation with capturing and studying oozes, and his penchant for stealing and hoarding food until it rotted... and then talking to it.
zh_tw: 所謂的布丁國王在布靈登石城的最深處主持法庭。他是由掘鋤家族領導的首批定居者任務的一部分，但其他地底侏儒很快就因為他許多令人不安的習慣而避開他，其中包括他對捕獲和研究軟泥怪的痴迷，以及他偷竊和囤積食物直到腐爛...然後和它說話的傾向。

english: The shunned deep gnome eventually struck out on his own. He spent years living among the oozes of the region, eventually subjugating a black pudding he calls "{@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA}" and a gray ooze he calls "Prince Livid." When the demon lords arrived in the Underdark, he followed the oozes drawn by Juiblex's presence, immediately throwing himself down before the Faceless Lord and pledging his eternal loyalty. His previous name and existence ended in that moment, and now there is only {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}.
zh_tw: 這位被排斥的地底侏儒最終獨自出發。他在該地區的軟泥怪中生活了多年，最終征服了一隻他稱為"{@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA|烏木公主}"的黑色布丁，以及一隻他稱為"青灰王子"的灰色軟泥怪。當惡魔領主們來到幽暗地域時，他跟隨被朱庇萊克斯吸引的軟泥怪，立刻在無面之主面前跪下，宣誓他永恆的忠誠。他之前的名字和存在在那一刻結束了，現在只有{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}。

english: Juiblex granted {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} the power to summon and command oozes, then ordered him to return to Blingdenstone and claim it as part of the Faceless Lord's new domain. {@creature The Pudding King|OotA} slipped back into the closed-off areas of Blingdenstone and set up court, summoning all manner of oozes along the way and rendering portions of the ruined city uninhabitable and dangerous to outsiders.
zh_tw: 朱庇萊克斯賦予了{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}召喚和指揮軟泥怪的力量，然後命令他返回布靈登石城，並宣稱它是無面領主新領地的一部分。{@creature The Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}潛入布靈登石城被封閉的區域，並在那裡建立了自己的法庭，沿途召喚了各種軟泥怪，使得這座廢墟城市的部分區域變得不適合居住，對外人來說也變得危險。

english: Utterly insane and channeling a terrible power, {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} sits upon his throne with his "children" at his side, summoning ever more loyal subjects with each passing day. When he is ready, he will send them forth to cover and devour everything, transforming Blingdenstone and its people into one giant mound of slime and goo formed in the image of his master, the Faceless Lord.
zh_tw: 完全瘋狂並駕馭著可怕的力量，{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}坐在他的王座上，身邊是他的"孩子們"，每天都在召喚更多忠誠的臣民。當他準備好時，他將派遣他們去覆蓋併吞噬一切，將布靈登石城及其人民轉化為一座巨大的粘液和粘漿的土堆，以其主人無面之主的形象塑造。

english: Blingdenstone Outskirts
zh_tw: 布靈登石城郊區

english: The quarries, mines, mushroom fields, and forges of Blingdenstone are located outside the settlement, accessible by tunnels and passages beyond the main gate. Trade caravans headed toward Blingdenstone are either re-routed to the outlying mines, farms, and forges, or they are stopped at the city gate, where their cargo is searched, unloaded, and distributed by agents of Quartermaster Senni. This keeps unwanted riffraff out of the city proper and protects Blingdenstone's security.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城的採石場、礦山、蘑菇田和鍛造場都位於定居點之外，可以透過主門之外的隧道和通道進入。前往布靈登石城的貿易商隊要麼被重新引導到外圍的礦場、農場和鍛造場，要麼在城門口被攔截，他們的貨物由軍需官森妮的代理人檢查、解除安裝和分配。這可以防止不受歡迎的閒雜人等進入城市，並保護布靈登石城的安全。

english: The deep gnomes working in the mines, farms, and forges outside the settlement spend less time enjoying the leisure and company of their kin and friends back home. The rising madness of the demon lords affects these brave pioneers more than those who live within the relative security of the reclaimed parts of Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 在定居點外的礦井、農場和鍛造場工作的地底侏儒，享受休閒和與家鄉親人朋友相聚的時間較少。惡魔領主日益增長的瘋狂對這些勇敢的開拓者的影響，比那些生活在布靈登石城收復區域相對安全中的人們要大。

english: Svirfneblin in the outskirts are more curt with strangers, and a few might even try to steal from them. Taskmasters at each location are now feeling themselves driven to the point of near tyranny, demanding that their workers toil ever harder. Some miners pocket gemstones they dig out, while others are drawn to possess things the adventurers are carrying.
zh_tw: 郊區的地底侏儒對陌生人更加無禮，一些人甚至可能試圖從他們那裡偷竊。每個地點的工頭現在感覺自己被逼到了近乎暴政的地步，要求他們的工人更加努力地勞作。一些礦工把挖到的寶石私藏起來，而其他人則被吸引去佔有冒險者攜帶的物品。

english: Problems Cubed
zh_tw: 問題立方

english: If the gelatinous cube {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} travels with the party (see {@adventure chapter 4|OotA|3}), its presence poses a few challenges in Blingdenstone. The recent ooze attacks have the deep gnomes rattled, and an intelligent, telepathic gelatinous cube is something beyond their understanding. The characters have to convince the svirfneblin to allow their unusual companion inside, or tell it to remain outside the settlement. If left outside, {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} might eventually find its way in through the wererat warrens, giving the characters insight into how the other oozes are getting in, or appearing in the nick of time to help the characters if they find themselves in peril.
zh_tw: 如果果凍立方體{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}與隊伍同行（參見{@adventure 第四章|OotA|3}），它的存在會給布靈登石城帶來一些挑戰。最近泥怪的攻擊讓地底侏儒們感到不安，而一個具有智慧且能心靈感應的果凍立方體超出了他們的理解範圍。角色們必須說服地底侏儒允許這個不同尋常的同伴進入，或者讓它留在定居點外。如果留在外面，{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}可能會最終透過鼠人洞穴找到進入的方法，讓角色們瞭解其他泥怪是如何進入的，或者在角色們陷入危險時及時出現提供幫助。

english: Entémoch's Boon
zh_tw: 恩特莫克之恩

english: This large cavern is located west of Blingdenstone (see the map of Underdark regions and locations in {@area chapter 2|051|x}) and has always been a closely guarded secret. Most svirfneblin who knew of it perished during the drow invasion of Blingdenstone. A few members of the Stoneheart Enclave have heard of its existence, but have either dismissed it as legend or have simply been too preoccupied with the reclaiming and rebuilding of Blingdenstone to search for it.
zh_tw: 這個大型洞穴位於布靈登石城的西邊（見《第五章》中幽暗地域地區和地點的地圖{@area 第二章|051|x}），一直是一個嚴密保守的秘密。大多數知道它的地底侏儒在卓爾入侵布靈登石城期間喪生。石心避難所的少數成員聽說過它的存在，但要麼將其視為傳說，要麼因為忙於收復和重建布靈登石城而無暇尋找它。

english: The cave is two days' walk of the settlement, its entrance a small tunnel leading to a ledge high above the cavern floor. The cave is lined with stalagmites and stalactites, but the dominant feature is the summoning circle at its center. The circle was once used by the svirfneblin to summon Entémoch, a prince of elemental earth, and his energies suffused the entire cavern, empowering elemental summoning within its confines.
zh_tw: 洞穴位於定居點兩天步行路程之外，其入口是一個通往洞穴地面上方高臺的小隧道。洞穴內佈滿了石筍和鐘乳石，但最顯著的特徵是位於中心的召喚圈。這個圓圈曾被地底侏儒用來召喚恩特摩克，一位元素土的王子，他的能量瀰漫在整個洞穴中，賦予了其內部元素召喚的力量。

english: If the circle is used to cast a spell that summons an earth elemental, the spell's duration becomes {@dice 1d4 + 6} days and the spell requires no concentration. The summoned elemental never becomes hostile toward the spell's caster or its companions. To gain these benefits, the caster must provide material components in the form of gems with a total value of 10 gp per Hit Die of the elemental summoned.
zh_tw: 若使用這座法陣施放召喚土元素的法術，法術持續時間會變成{@dice 1d4 + 6}天，且不需要專注。召喚出的元素絕不會敵視施法者或其同伴。要獲得這些好處，施法者必須提供寶石作為材料成分；寶石總價值為所召喚元素每顆生命骰10金幣。

english: Finding Entémoch's Boon
zh_tw: 尋找恩特莫克之恩

english: Locating the tunnel that leads to Entémoch's Boon is a great service for the svirfneblin, and might be a quest set for the adventurers (see "{@area Blingdenstone Factions|2f6|x}" later in this chapter). Despite how close the cavern is to Blingdenstone, finding it is no easy task.
zh_tw: 找到通往恩特莫克之恩的隧道對地底侏儒來說是一項重大的服務，也可能是為冒險者們設定的任務（見本章後面的"布靈登石城派系{@area 布靈登石城派系|2f6|x}"）。儘管洞穴離布靈登石城很近，但找到它並不容易。

english: Characters can search for the tunnel by traveling at a slow pace in its general vicinity. Each day they search, have the characters make a {@dc 20} group Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) or group Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. If the group check succeeds, the characters find a curious waymarker: a small pyramid of carefully stacked stones next to the mouth of an otherwise unassuming tunnel.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過慢速移動在隧道的大致附近進行搜尋。每次他們搜尋時，讓角色們進行一次 {@dc 20} 的群體智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）或群體感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。如果群體檢定成功，角色們會發現一個奇怪的路標：一個由精心堆疊的石頭構成的小金字塔，位於一個原本不起眼的隧道入口旁。

english: After locating the waymarker and following the tunnel next to it, the party can make a {@dc 20} group Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. On a failure, the party wastes a day searching for the next waymarker. If the group check succeeds, the characters find their next lead after {@dice 2d6} hours: a tunnel whose entrance is flanked by the sculpted faces of a male and female deep gnome. This tunnel features many side tunnels concealed by rock formations. The party must make a {@dc 20} group Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}), Wisdom ({@skill Perception}), or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. If this group check succeeds, the party finds Entémoch's Boon; if the check fails, the characters waste a day of exploration searching for it.
zh_tw: 在定位到路標並沿著其旁邊的隧道前進後，隊伍可以進行一次{@dc 20}的群體智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）或感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。如果失敗，隊伍會浪費一天時間尋找下一個路標。如果群體檢定成功，角色們在{@dice 2d6}小時後找到下一個線索：一個入口兩側雕刻著男性和女性深侏儒面孔的隧道。這條隧道有許多被岩石構造隱藏的側隧道。隊伍必須進行一次{@dc 20}的群體智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）、感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）或感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。如果這次群體檢定成功，隊伍將找到恩特莫克之恩；如果檢定失敗，角色們將浪費一整天時間進行探索搜尋。

english: Finding Entémoch's Boon allows the characters to make a check to improve the attitude of the deep gnomes (see "Changing Svirfneblin Attitudes").
zh_tw: 找到恩特莫克之恩允許角色進行檢定以改善地底侏儒的態度（見"改變地底侏儒態度"）。

english: Random Encounters
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇

english: For each day of exploration, check for random encounters using the tables in {@area chapter 2|07f|x} and adjust the drow pursuit level as necessary.
zh_tw: 對於每天的探索，使用《第五章》中的表格{@area 第二章|07f|x}檢查隨機遭遇，並根據需要調整卓爾追擊等級。

english: The Beasts of Entémoch's Boon
zh_tw: 恩特莫克之恩的野獸

english: Characters who explore the cavern find shattered bits of statuary. A successful {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check confirms that the stone bits are the remains of {@condition petrified} cave vermin. Unless they leave the cavern immediately, the characters are accosted by a mated pair of {@creature Basilisk||basilisks} that call Entémoch's Boon home.
zh_tw: 探索洞穴的角色會發現破碎的雕像碎片。成功的 {@dc 17} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定確認這些石頭碎片是 {@condition petrified||石化} 的洞穴害蟲的殘骸。除非他們立即離開洞穴，否則角色將遭遇一對在此地安家的 {@creature Basilisk||石化蜥蜴}。

english: Once the basilisks are defeated, characters can resume their exploration of the cave and find three basilisk eggs in a nest made of pulverized stone. Each egg is a 6-inch-diameter, 20-pound sphere with a pebbled-gray shell as hard as stone. Left alone, the eggs hatch in {@dice 1d4 + 1} months. An {@creature infant basilisk|OotA} that emerges imprints on the first creature it sees. It thereafter follows that creature around like its parent, demanding to be fed. If the characters manage to keep the basilisk alive, it reaches adulthood after twelve months. Track its growth using the Basilisk Maturation table.
zh_tw: 一旦擊敗了蜥蜴，角色們可以繼續探索洞穴，並在一個由粉碎石頭製成的巢中找到三個蜥蜴蛋。每個蛋直徑6吋，重20磅，有一個像石頭一樣堅硬的卵石灰色外殼。如果無人幹擾，這些蛋將在{@dice 1d4 + 1}個月內孵化。孵化出來的{@creature infant basilisk|OotA|幼年蜥蜴怪}會對它看到的第一個生物產生印記。之後，它會像跟隨父母一樣跟隨那個生物，要求被餵食。如果角色設法讓蜥蜴存活下來，它將在十二個月後成年。使用蜥蜴成長表來追蹤它的成長。

english: Whiteshell Mine
zh_tw: 白殼礦場

english: Blingdenstone's largest salt mine is half a day's travel to the south. Like many of Blingdenstone's resource sites, the road to the mine is easy to miss by casual travelers, but sentries hiding along the way can recognize friendly visitors (such as those in the company of {@creature Jimjar|OotA}, {@creature Topsy|OotA}, or {@creature Turvy|OotA}) and guide them along the proper tunnels.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城最大的鹽礦位於南方，需要半天的行程。和布靈登石城的許多資源點一樣，通往礦區的道路很容易被普通旅行者錯過，但是沿途隱藏的哨兵可以識別友好的訪客（比如那些和{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}、{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西}或{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}在一起的人）並引導他們沿著正確的隧道前進。

english: Whiteshell Mine is an interconnected network of small caverns dug into the vast salt veins lining this area of the Underdark. The mine produces enough salt to supply both the Blingdenstone settlers and sell in the market hub of Mantol-Derith. The mine has a cavern devoted to keeping the giant cave lizards the svirfneblin use as beasts of burden.
zh_tw: 白殼礦場是一系列相互連線的小洞穴，這些洞穴挖掘在幽暗地域這個區域的廣闊鹽脈中。這個礦場生產的鹽足以供應布靈登石城定居者的需求，並在曼塔-岱瑞絲的市場中心出售。礦場有一個洞穴專門用於飼養地底侏儒用作馱獸的巨大洞穴蜥蜴。

english: The deep gnome Perigrog Scrapedust runs the mine with a fair but demanding hand. He believes that the more the mine produces, the more he can export, and the quicker Blingdenstone can be returned to its former glory.
zh_tw: 地底侏儒佩裡格羅格·斯克拉皮德斯特以公正但要求嚴格的方式管理著礦山。他相信礦山產出越多，他能出口的就越多，布靈登石城就能更快地恢復其昔日的輝煌。

english: Pickshine Mines
zh_tw: 光採礦場

english: Renamed after the largest and most influential family in the Miners' Guild, the Pickshine Mines comprise several mines scattered in a wide circle around Blingdenstone. The deep gnomes have engineered the access tunnels in such a way that only one known entrance leads to the mine complex, and this entrance is defended by four {@creature galeb duhr} disguised to look like ordinary boulders and a dozen {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnomes}.
zh_tw: 光採礦場是以礦工公會中最大且最有影響力的家族命名的，由幾個散佈在布靈登石城周圍的大圈中的礦場組成。地底侏儒設計了入口隧道，使得只有一個已知的入口通向礦場複合體，這個入口由四個偽裝成普通巨石的{@creature galeb duhr||石人}和一打{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}守衛。

english: The largest mine shafts include veins of common metals such as iron and copper, as well as many veins of rarer minerals such as mithral and adamantine. The mines also hold crystal caverns where the svirfneblin harvest all manner of gems.
zh_tw: 最大的礦井包含普通金屬如鐵和銅的礦脈，以及許多稀有礦物如秘銀和精金的礦脈。礦井中還有水晶洞穴，地底侏儒在那裡收割各種寶石。

english: All the main routes to Blingdenstone intersect near the mine complex's main entrance, meaning the characters are likely to pass it before arriving in Blingdenstone. If they stop there, they meet Dasco Pickshine, the {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} overseer in charge of general operations. Dasco is willing to let the characters tag along with a cargo of ores heading for Blingdenstone, happy to have the extra security.
zh_tw: 所有通往布靈登石城的主要路線都在礦區主入口附近交匯，這意味著角色們在到達布靈登石城之前很可能會經過這裡。如果他們停下來，他們會遇見達斯科·皮克沙因，負責總體運營的{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}主管。達斯科願意讓角色們跟隨前往布靈登石城的礦石貨物隊伍，很高興有額外的安保。

english: Stoneheart Quarry
zh_tw: 石心採石場

english: The Stoneheart Enclave has its headquarters in this cavern suffused with {@i faerzress} and elemental energy. This quarry doesn't provide stone for construction, since Blingdenstone builders need only take a pick to any wall to find their building materials. Rather, this cavern provides the small army of earth elementals aiding the settlers, and its magical stone is used in the creation of items such as {@item Elemental Gem||earth elemental gems}, {@item Ring of Earth Elemental Command||rings of earth elemental command}, and {@item Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals||stones of controlling earth elementals}. Elementals entering into the Material Plane here, whether by spell or other means, have an additional 2 Hit Dice.
zh_tw: 石心避難所的總部設在這個充滿{@i 妖光}和元素能量的洞穴中。這個採石場不提供建築材料，因為布靈登石城的建築者只需要用鎬頭敲擊任何牆壁就能找到他們的建築材料。相反，這個洞穴為定居者提供了一支小型的土元素軍隊，它的魔法石頭被用於製作諸如{@item Elemental Gem||土元素寶石}、{@item Ring of Earth Elemental Command||土元素指揮戒指}和{@item Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals||控制土元素的寶石}等物品。無論是透過法術還是其他方式，進入物質位面的元素生物在這裡都有額外的2點生命骰。

english: Normally, Yantha Coaxrock leads the operations in the quarry. While she is in Mantol-Derith (see {@adventure chapter 9|OotA|8}), her apprentice Nomi Pathshutter is in charge of the druids and wizards of the Stoneheart Enclave.
zh_tw: 通常情況下，揚薩·寇克斯洛克負責採石場的運營。當她身處曼塔-岱瑞絲時（見{@adventure 第九章|OotA|8}），她的學徒諾米·封徑則負責石心魔宗的德魯伊和法師們。

english: Elemental Healing
zh_tw: 元素治癒

english: Nomi Pathshutter is aware of Ogrémoch's Bane and has made it her life's work to protect elementals from its influence. She studies samples of corrupted elementals as part of her efforts, and rewards characters who bring her a sample from any out-of-control earth elemental creature found in the unexplored areas of Blingdenstone. She pays 10 gp per Hit Die of the creature from which the sample was taken.
zh_tw: 諾米·封徑意識到了歐雷莫克之災，並將其作為自己一生的工作來保護元素生物不受其影響。她作為努力的一部分，研究了被腐化的元素生物樣本，並獎勵那些給她帶來布靈登石城未探索區域中失控土元素生物樣本的角色。她為從生物身上取得的樣本支付每生命骰10金幣。

english: Doors of Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 布靈登石城之門

english: Heavy stone doors reinforced with steel or adamantine are found throughout the deep gnome settlement. Unless otherwise indicated, a door in Blingdenstone has AC 18, 40 hit points, a damage threshold of 15, resistance to thunder damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 整個地底侏儒定居點中都可以看到用鋼或精金加固的沉重石門。除非另有說明，在布靈登石城的門具有AC 18，40生命值，傷害閾值為15，對雷鳴傷害有抗性，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: Map 6.1: Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 地圖 6.1: 布靈登石城

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Outer Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 外圍布靈登石城

english: Everything in Outer Blingdenstone was designed to thwart would-be invaders.
zh_tw: 外布靈登石城的一切都是為了挫敗潛在的入侵者而設計的。

english: 1. Stairs
zh_tw: 1. 樓梯

english: Rising up to a broad terrace before the gate, these wide stairs are built for gnomish feet. They are {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for Medium and larger creatures.
zh_tw: 這些寬闊的樓梯建在大門前，通向一個寬闊的露臺，它們是為侏儒的腳設計的。對於中等體型及更大的生物來說，它們是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: 1a. Cart Lift
zh_tw: 1a. 手推車升降機

english: At the top of the stairs is a large entrance on the west wall, where wagons are secured on stone sleds pulled by a chain up a steep slope. The hoisting mechanism is at the top of the lift is operated by an {@creature earth elemental}, although any creature with a Strength of 20 or any group of creatures with the combined strength to lift 600 pounds can operate it.
zh_tw: 樓梯頂部是西牆上的一個大型入口，那裡的馬車被固定在石制雪橇上，由鏈條牽引著沿陡峭的斜坡上升。升降機制位於升降平臺的頂部，由一個{@creature earth elemental||土元素}操作，儘管任何力量達到20或任何一組能合力舉起600磅的生物也可以操作它。

english: The lift's tunnel is wide enough for the sleds but has little clearance above them. The floor is part of the mechanism and is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Climbing in and out of a sled costs 10 feet of movement.
zh_tw: 升降機的隧道足夠寬，可以容納雪橇，但雪橇上方的空間非常有限。隧道地面是機械的一部分，屬於{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。進出雪橇需要消耗10尺的移動力。

english: 2. Main Gate
zh_tw: 2. 主城門

english: The main gate of Blingdenstone is a door made of steel and mithral, inlaid with a secret magic-resistant alloy and plated with adamantine. The gate has AC 23, 60 hit points, a damage threshold of 20, resistance to thunder damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城的主門是由鋼鐵和秘銀製成的門，鑲嵌有秘密的魔法抗性合金，並鍍有精金。這扇門的AC為23，有60點生命值，傷害閾值為20，對雷鳴傷害有抗性，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: The terrace between the top of the stairs and the gate has a slight upward slope. The slope imposes disadvantage on checks made to ram the gate.
zh_tw: 樓梯頂部和大門之間的露臺有輕微的上坡。這個斜坡使試圖撞開大門的檢定具有劣勢。

english: Eight {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnomes} guard the gate. One of them carries a {@item spell gem|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}) that contains a {@spell see invisibility} spell and uses it to scan for {@condition invisible} creatures when the party arrives. Arriving characters are questioned to determine their intentions. The guards are thorough but not threatening; as long as the characters seem benign, they are granted entry. Four of the guards escort them through the maze (area 3) and the gauntlet (area 4) to Inner Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 八名{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}守衛著大門。其中一名攜帶了一顆{@item spell gem|OotA|法術寶石}（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}），其中儲存了{@spell see invisibility||識破隱形}法術，並在隊伍抵達時使用它來偵測{@condition invisible||隱形}生物。抵達的角色會被詢問以確定他們的意圖。守衛們非常細緻但並不威脅；只要角色們看起來無害，他們就會被允許進入。四名守衛會陪同他們穿過迷宮（區域 3）和考驗（區域 4）到達內布靈登石城。

english: Having {@creature Jimjar|OotA}, {@creature Topsy|OotA}, or {@creature Turvy|OotA} in the party helps smooth the characters' entrance to Blingdenstone. This is especially important if the party contains one or more drow, whose presence would otherwise demand an armed escort at all times within the settlement.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍中有{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}、{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西}或{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}，將有助於角色順利進入布靈登石城。如果隊伍中有一或多名卓爾，這一點尤其重要，因為卓爾的存在否則將要求在定居點內始終需要武裝護送。

english: If the characters reveal that they are fleeing the drow, the guards decide that Chief Dorbo Diggermattock should hear their tale. The armed escort that brings the characters into the settlement leads them to an audience with the chief in area 14.
zh_tw: 如果角色們透露他們正在逃離卓爾族，守衛們決定首領多爾博·掘鋤應該聽聽他們的故事。護送角色們進入定居點的武裝護送隊伍帶領他們去見首領，地點在14區。

english: 3. Maze
zh_tw: 3. 迷宮

english: Map 6.2: Outer Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 地圖 6.2: 布靈登石城外圍

english: Between the gate and Blingdenstone proper, the svirfneblin built the maze: a twisting and turning path that runs between 10-foot-high walls studded with nails. Climbing a nail-studded wall requires a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Even with a successful check, a creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw to avoid the nails, taking {@dice 1d4} piercing damage on a failed save. The path slopes up and down, so sections can be flooded or inundated with poisonous smoke. At certain points, the path narrows to allow Small creatures through; Medium creatures must squeeze, and Large creatures can't fit through at all unless they have an amorphous form.
zh_tw: 在城門和布靈登石城之間，地底侏儒建造了一個迷宮：這是一個蜿蜒曲折的小路，兩旁是10尺高的釘牆。攀爬釘牆需要成功的{@dc 13}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。即使檢定成功，生物也必須成功進行一次{@dc 13}敏捷豁免以避免被釘子刺中，豁免失敗會受到{@dice 1d4}穿刺傷害。道路起伏不平，因此某些部分可能被水淹沒或瀰漫著有毒煙霧。在某些地方，道路會變窄，僅允許小型生物透過；中型生物必須擠過去，而大型生物除非擁有無定形的形態，否則根本無法透過。

english: A second path is inaccessible from the main gate, traveling above the winding path. This upper path is festooned with towers and battlements where defenders can fire freely at creatures attempting to make their way along the lower path. A paved road runs along the western wall of the cavern, onto which wagons and draft animals are hoisted so they can bypass the maze. The hoist mechanism can be destroyed with the single pull of a lever if invaders manage to hijack it.
zh_tw: 從主門無法進入第二條路徑，它位於蜿蜒路徑上方。這條上層路徑裝飾有塔樓和城垛，守衛者可以從那裡自由射擊試圖沿著下層路徑前進的生物。一條鋪砌的道路沿著洞穴的西牆延伸，馬車和拉車動物透過它被吊起，以便它們可以繞過迷宮。如果入侵者設法劫持了吊車機制，可以透過拉動一個槓桿來摧毀它。

english: 4. Gauntlet
zh_tw: 4. 障礙賽

english: Blingdenstone's last line of defense is a wide, winding tunnel behind a gate similar to the one in area 1.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城的最後一道防線是位於一扇類似於區域1中的那個大門後面的寬闊曲折的隧道。

english: Gate Towers
zh_tw: 門塔

english: Flanking the gate are two stone towers embedded in the cavern walls. Peering through shuttered windows in each tower are four {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnomes}, eight in all. These gnomes operate winches that open and close the gate. If the characters are traveling with a deep gnome escort, the gates open as they approach, allowing access to the tunnel beyond. If the characters arrive here unescorted, the gnomes refuse to open the gate.
zh_tw: 大門兩側是嵌入洞穴壁中的兩座石塔。在每個塔樓的百葉窗內，有四名{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}，總共八名。這些侏儒操作絞車來開啟和關閉大門。如果角色們有地底侏儒護送，當他們接近時大門會開啟，允許進入後面的隧道。如果角色們未帶護送來到這裡，侏儒們拒絕開門。

english: Tunnel
zh_tw: 隧道

english: The tunnel has a 30-foot-high ceiling, and embedded in its walls are {@item Spell Gem|OotA|spell gems} spaced 30 feet apart and 15 feet above the rough-hewn floor. The gems are set in sockets and held in place with {@item sovereign glue}, and each gem contains a {@spell symbol} spell. Any deep gnome who can see a gem can activate the spell within it by using its action to speak the proper command word. Any attempt to pry a {@item spell gem|OotA} from the wall destroys the gem.
zh_tw: 隧道有30尺高的天花板，在牆壁中嵌入的是每隔30尺、距離粗糙地面15尺高的{@item Spell Gem|OotA|法術寶石}。這些寶石安裝在插座中，並用{@item sovereign glue||至尊膠}固定，每顆寶石內都含有一個{@spell symbol||徽記術}法術。任何能看到寶石的地底侏儒都可以使用動作說出正確的命令詞來啟用寶石內的法術。任何試圖從牆上撬下{@item spell gem|OotA|法術寶石}的行為都會破壞寶石。

english: At the north end of the tunnel is a smaller door made of stone reinforced with adamantine (see the "Doors of Blingdenstone" sidebar). Fifteen-foot-high ledges in alcoves flank the door. The ledges are currently unguarded, and the stone door opens easily to reveal the caves of Inner Blingdenstone beyond.
zh_tw: 隧道北端有一扇較小的門，由石料加固精金製成（見"布靈登石城的門"邊欄）。門兩側的凹室中設有15尺高的壁架。壁架目前無人守衛，石門輕易開啟，顯露出布靈登石城內部的洞穴。

english: Inner Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 內布靈登石城

english: {@b Population}: 300 deep gnomes (svirfneblin)
zh_tw: {@b 人口}: 300名地底侏儒(地底侏儒)

english: {@b Government}: Work collective led by Dorbo and Senni Diggermattock
zh_tw: {@b 政治}：由多爾博和森妮·掘鋤領導的工作集體

english: {@b Defense}: Militia, summoned earth elementals
zh_tw: {@b 防禦}：民兵，召喚的土元素

english: {@b Commerce}: Salt, gemstones, and rare minerals
zh_tw: {@b 商業}: 鹽、寶石和稀有礦物

english: {@b Organizations}: The Miners' Guild, the Stoneheart Enclave
zh_tw: {@b 組織}：礦工公會，石心飛地

english: The defenses in Outer Blingdenstone paint a picture of a paranoid people under siege, but once past the final gates, the true character of the settlement is revealed. Warm, cozy, and welcoming, Blingdenstone is a rarity in the Underdark.
zh_tw: 外布靈登石城的防禦工事描繪出一個處於圍攻之下的偏執民族的畫面，但一旦透過最後的大門，定居點的真正特色便顯露出來。溫暖、舒適、熱情好客，布靈登石城在幽暗地域中實屬罕見。

english: Read the following boxed text when the characters first arrive in Inner Blingdenstone, omitting the second paragraph if they arrive unescorted.
zh_tw: 當角色們首次到達布靈登石城內部時，請閱讀以下加框文字；如果他們是無人陪同到達的，則省略第二段。

english: You leave the dark tunnel behind and step into what looks like another world. These aren't sinister drow caverns or harsh, bare stone, but a subterranean land of warm colors and welcoming smells. The deep gnomes you see going about their business glance up at you with suspicion, but you instinctively understand that you face no threat here. One of the guards escorting you abandons his severe frown to give a deep nod as he prompts you past the inner gate. "Welcome to Blingdenstone, travelers."
zh_tw: 你離開了身後的黑暗隧道，步入了一個看似另一個世界的地方。這裡不是陰險的卓爾洞穴，也不是粗糙、光禿的石頭，而是一片地下的溫暖色彩和熱情的氣味之地。你看到的地底侏儒忙於自己的事情，他們抬頭用懷疑的眼光看著你，但你本能地明白在這裡你並不面臨威脅。護送你的一名守衛放下了他嚴肅的皺眉，深深地點頭，示意你透過內門。"歡迎來到布靈登石城，旅行者們。"

english: 5. Reception Hall
zh_tw: 5. 接待大廳

english: This busy cavern welcomes visitors to Blingdenstone and connects the most important chambers of the new settlement. Two sealed tunnels here lead to the Goldwhisker Warrens. One is closed off by a deliberately caused cave-in to the south, and the other by reinforced, locked, and guarded gates.
zh_tw: 這個繁忙的洞穴歡迎遊客來到布靈登石城，並連線了新定居點最重要的房間。這裡有兩個封閉的隧道通往金鬚族的洞穴。一個因故意造成的山體滑坡而在南方被封閉，另一個則由加固、上鎖並有人守衛的大門封閉。

english: 6. Barracks
zh_tw: 6. 兵營

english: This chamber is above the main level of Blingdenstone, and houses off-duty svirfneblin currently assigned to defend the entrance.
zh_tw: 這個房間位於布靈登石城主層之上，並且安置了當前被分配保衛入口的下班地底侏儒。

english: Inner Blingdenstone: General Features
zh_tw: 內布靈登石城：總體特徵

english: Inner Blingdenstone covers the areas the svirfneblin have recovered from supernatural squatters and other dangers, now secured by mundane and magical means.
zh_tw: 內布靈登石城覆蓋了地底侏儒從超自然佔據者和其他危險中恢復並由世俗和魔法手段確保安全的區域。

english: Chambers
zh_tw: 房間

english: Blingdenstone is not a single cavern, but a network of interconnected caves and pockets the svirfneblin have widened and worked for use as homes, workshops, vending stalls, places of worship, storerooms, and the like. Other than the private homes of svirfneblin families, all chambers are tall enough for Medium creatures to walk around without difficulty, and common areas are even larger.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城不是一個單一的洞穴，而是地底侏儒擴充套件並加工的一系列相互連線的洞穴和空間網路，用作住宅、車間、售貨攤、禮拜場所、儲藏室等。除了地底侏儒家庭的私人住宅外，所有房間都足夠高，讓中等體型的生物能夠毫不費力地四處走動，公共區域甚至更加寬敞。

english: It is rare for cavern walls to be bare in Blingdenstone. The walls of large caverns are studded with stairs and ramps leading to balconies and hollows serving as storage or shops. The largest caverns are crisscrossed by walkways allowing svirfneblin and visitors to reach connecting tunnels high above the floor.
zh_tw: 在布靈登石城，洞穴牆壁很少是光禿的。大型洞穴的牆壁上佈滿了通往陽臺和作為儲藏室或商店的凹室的樓梯和坡道。最大的洞穴中佈滿了交錯的步道，允許地底侏儒和訪客到達地面上方的連線隧道。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: The caverns of Inner Blingdenstone are brightly lit with a mix of bioluminescent fungi, caged giant fire beetles, and magic. The light from these chambers spills into short connecting tunnels lacking their own illumination, creating areas of {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. Longer tunnels have their own light, usually magically produced.
zh_tw: 內布靈登石城的洞窟被髮光真菌、籠養巨火甲蟲和魔法混合照亮。這些房間的光線會灑入缺乏自身照明的短連線隧道，創造出{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}的區域。較長的隧道則擁有自己的光源，通常是魔法產生的。

english: Connecting Tunnels
zh_tw: 連線隧道

english: Svirfneblin and other Small races can walk through tunnels with ease, but Medium or larger creatures must duck and squeeze—a feature intended to control invaders' movements. Most tunnels have smooth floors, but those around the periphery of the reclaimed areas are strewn with rubble and debris.
zh_tw: 地底侏儒和其他小型種族可以輕鬆地穿過隧道，但中等體型或更大的生物必須低頭並擠過去——這是為了控制入侵者的移動而設計的。大多數隧道的地面都很平滑，但在收復區域周邊的隧道則散佈著碎石和殘骸。

english: Some of the connecting tunnels in Blingdenstone are trapped. The most common traps are collapsing roofs and spiked pits (see "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Many tunnels slope down before rising up again, allowing the gnomes to flood them. All tunnel traps are inactive in Inner Blingdenstone, but the svirfneblin can quickly activate them in case of emergency.
zh_tw: 在布靈登石城的一些連線隧道中設有陷阱。最常見的陷阱是塌陷的屋頂和尖刺坑（見{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}，選自{@i 城主指南}第5章）。許多隧道先向下傾斜，然後再次上升，使侏儒們可以將其淹沒。在內布靈登石城的隧道陷阱均處於非啟用狀態，但在緊急情況下，地底侏儒可以迅速啟用它們。

english: 7. Traders' Grotto
zh_tw: 7. 商人之洞

english: This cavern serves as Blingdenstone's central market. All manner of fungi once grew in the moist grotto, but a miscast spell turned them to stone centuries ago. Blingdenstone's merchants gather here in makeshift stalls amid the stone stalks to hawk their wares and barter with one another. Arriving caravans lower their cargo to warehouses carved out beneath the grotto.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴是布靈登石城的中心市場。各種真菌曾生長在潮溼的巖洞中，但在幾個世紀前，一個施法失誤將它們變成了石頭。布靈登石城的商人們在這裡臨時搭建的貨攤中聚集，在石質的菌柄之間兜售他們的商品並相互交換。到達的商隊將他們的貨物下放到巖洞下方挖掘出的倉庫中。

english: Kazook Pickshine
zh_tw: 卡祖克·閃鎬

english: If the characters accepted Werz Saltbaron's errand in Gracklstugh (see {@area chapter 4|186|x}), they can deliver Werz's sack of gems to Kazook Pickshine, who has a stall in the Traders' Grotto. Kazook is a {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome}. If the characters approach him openly and present the sack to him, he muffles a gasp as he looks around, then quickly ushers the characters into the stall, admonishing them to talk quietly and not be so open. He inspects the gems, weighs them by hand while looking at the characters with suspicion, then pays them for the delivery with a zircon worth 50 gp.
zh_tw: 如果角色在格拉克斯圖格（見{@area 第四章|186|x}）接受了沃茲·鹽爵的差事，他們可以將沃茲的一袋寶石交給在商人洞穴擁有攤位的卡祖克·閃鎬。卡祖克是一名{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}。如果角色公開地接近他並將袋子交給他，他會壓低聲音倒吸一口氣，四處張望，然後迅速將角色帶入攤位內，告誡他們小聲說話，不要如此公開。他檢查了寶石，用手掂量著，同時帶著懷疑的目光看著角色，然後用一顆價值50金幣的鋯石支付了他們的送貨費用。

english: Gelatinous Cube Incursion
zh_tw: 凝膠立方體入侵

english: The first time the characters visit the Traders' Grotto without an escort, a clanging bell sounds near the main entrance. When this happens, read the following boxed text to the players.
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次在沒有護送的情況下訪問商人巖洞時，主入口附近會響起一聲鈴鐺。當這種情況發生時，請向玩家朗讀以下加框文字。

english: The deep gnomes around you all draw weapons and retreat as you see a guard stumble back, then rise up in the air. A strange shimmer around him reveals the surface of the gelatinous cube that has engulfed him.
zh_tw: 你周圍的地底侏儒都拔出武器並撤退，你看到一名守衛向後絆倒，然後升到空中。他周圍奇怪的閃爍揭示了已經吞沒他的凝膠立方體的表面。

english: Two {@creature Gelatinous Cube||gelatinous cubes} seep through a collapsed tunnel between the Traders' Grotto and area 24 of the Goldwhisker Warrens. Both cubes advance, attempting to engulf and consume any other creatures in their paths until they are destroyed.
zh_tw: 兩個{@creature Gelatinous Cube||凝膠方塊}透過商人巖洞和金鬚鼠窩區24號區域之間的坍塌隧道滲透進來。這兩個立方體前進，試圖吞噬並消耗它們路徑上的任何其他生物，直到它們被摧毀。

english: The trapped svirfneblin is named {@creature Mev Flintknapper|OotA} (use the {@creature veteran} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual}, but also give Mev the Stone Camouflage, Gnome Cunning, and Innate Spellcasting features of a {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome}). He has already taken 10 acid damage and takes another 21 ({@dice 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns until pulled free with a successful {@dc 12} Strength check. The attempt requires an action, and any creature making the attempt takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) acid damage is it reaches into the cube.
zh_tw: 被困的地底侏儒名叫{@creature Mev Flintknapper|OotA|梅夫·弗林特納普}（使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的{@creature veteran||老兵}資料，但梅夫還擁有{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}的石頭偽裝、侏儒狡詐和天生施法能力）。他已經受到了10點酸蝕傷害，並且在立方體每回合開始時還會受到21點（{@dice 6d6}）酸蝕傷害，直到透過一個成功的{@dc 12}力量檢定將他拉出來。這個嘗試需要一個動作，任何進行嘗試的生物在將手伸入立方體時會受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）酸蝕傷害。

english: If {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} is with the characters, it attempts to intimidate the other cubes by interposing itself between them and the characters. At your discretion, allow {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} to use the {@action Help} action to assist the characters' attacks.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}與角色們在一起，它會試圖透過自己插在其他立方體和角色們之間來恐嚇其他立方體。根據您的判斷，允許{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}使用{@action Help||協助}行動來協助角色們的攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Once destroyed, the hostile cubes spill their contents on the ground: 12 gp and a {@item +1 shortsword} of drow manufacture (see the "{@adventure Drowcraft Items|OotA|18}" sidebar in appendix B).
zh_tw: 一旦被摧毀，這些敵對的立方體將它們的內容灑在地上：12金幣和一個由卓爾製造的{@item +1 shortsword||+1 短劍}（見附錄B中的"{@adventure 卓爾製品|OotA|18}"側邊欄）。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: After the gelatinous cube encounter, svirfneblin inform the characters that incursions by oozes are becoming more frequent. In every case, it seems as though the oozes are trying to make their way toward the abandoned northwest section of the city (labeled "The Pudding Court" on the map of Blingdenstone).
zh_tw: 在遭遇凝膠立方體之後，地底侏儒告訴角色們，凝膠體的侵入變得越來越頻繁。在每一種情況下，似乎凝膠體都在試圖前往城市西北部被遺棄的區域（在布靈登石城地圖上標記為"布丁宮廷"）。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: The characters gain a special award of 100 XP each for delivering Werz's sack of gems to Kazook Pickshine.
zh_tw: 角色們因將沃茲的寶石袋交給卡祖克·閃鎬而獲得了每人100 XP的特別獎勵。

english: If the characters managed to rescue Mev, or made a sincere effort to do so, award each of them 50 XP, and allow the characters to make a group Charisma check to improve the deep gnomes' attitude (see "Changing Svirfneblin Attitudes").
zh_tw: 如果角色設法救出了梅芙，或者真誠地努力這麼做了，給每個角色獎勵50經驗值（XP），並允許角色們進行一次團隊魅力檢定，以改善地底侏儒的態度（見"改變斯維爾芬布人態度"）。

english: 8. The Ruby in the Rough
zh_tw: 8. 粗獷的紅寶石

english: The Stoneheart Enclave agreed to join the Diggermattock effort to resettle Blingdenstone in exchange for help reclaiming this temple known as the Ruby in the Rough. The temple is dedicated to Segojan Earthcaller, the svirfneblin god of deep earth and nature. The rituals and day-to-day duties of the temple are overseen by a deep gnome named {@creature Glyphic Shroomlight|OotA}, a nervous young novice doing his best in a situation requiring a much older and more experienced cleric (use the {@creature acolyte} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual}, but also give Glyphic the Stone Camouflage, Gnome Cunning, and Innate Spellcasting features of a {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome}).
zh_tw: 石心會同意加入掘鋤家族重新定居布靈登石城的行動，以換取協助奪回這座被稱為"粗獷的紅寶石"的廟宇。這座廟宇供奉著地底侏儒的深土與自然之神塞高詹·喚地者。廟宇的儀式和日常職責由一位名叫{@creature Glyphic Shroomlight|OotA|符文蘑菇燈}的地底侏儒監督，他是一個緊張的青年新手，在需要更年長、更有經驗的牧師的情況下盡力而為（使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的{@creature acolyte||侍僧}具體數值，但同時也賦予格利菲克{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}的岩石偽裝、狡黠和天生施法特性）。

english: Despite the desecration of the drow invasion and the decades of scavenging and raiding in its aftermath, the old city's honored dead still rest securely in the catacombs beneath the temple. A passage on the east side of the cavern leads down into this network of small linked caverns accessible only through the temple.
zh_tw: 儘管卓爾的入侵褻瀆了這片土地，以及隨後數十年的掠奪和襲擊，但老城中受尊敬的死者仍然安全地安息在神廟下方的墓穴中。洞穴東側的一條通道通向這個只有透過神廟才能進入的、由許多小洞穴相互連線的墓穴網路。

english: The catacombs are built along a mostly regular grid, making it easy for characters to find their way among standing statues and funerary niches. If the characters come here following rumors of ghosts, it's only a matter of time before they meet Burrow Warden Jadger, a ghost from the time of the drow invasion.
zh_tw: 墓穴是沿著一個大體規則的網格建造的，這使得角色在站立的雕像和墓葬壁龕之間容易找到自己的路。如果角色們因為關於鬼魂的傳言來到這裡，他們遇到地道守望者賈傑爾——一個來自卓爾入侵時期的鬼魂——只是時間問題。

english: If the characters recovered Pelek's severed hand in the "{@area Whorlstone Tunnels|1a5|x}" section of chapter 4, they can lay Pelek's spirit to rest by placing his remains in the catacombs. If they do this, the ghost of Burrow Warden Jadger appears before them.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在第4章的'{@area 渦石隧道|1a5|x}'部分中找到了佩勒克的斷手，他們可以透過將他的遺體放置在地下墓穴中來安撫佩勒克的靈魂。如果他們這樣做了，地道守望者賈傑爾的幽靈將出現在他們面前。

english: Burrow Warden Jadger
zh_tw: 地道守望者賈傑爾

english: Jadger's {@creature ghost} greets the characters but disappears through a wall if they attack. (Word quickly gets around the settlement of the adventurers' rudeness, negatively shifting the gnomes' attitude toward the characters.) Jadger speaks candidly about who he is and what happened to him. After gaining any sense that the characters are seeking information from the svirfneblin, he asks them to perform two tasks involving laying other svirfneblin spirits to rest:
zh_tw: 賈傑爾的{@creature ghost||幽魂}向角色們打招呼，但如果他們攻擊，它會穿過牆壁消失。（關於冒險者的粗魯行為的訊息很快在定居點傳開，導致侏儒們對角色們的態度轉為負面。）賈傑爾坦率地講述了自己是誰以及他身上發生了什麼。在感覺到角色們正在向地底侏儒尋求資訊之後，他要求他們完成兩個任務，涉及安撫其他地底侏儒的靈魂：

english: Destroy Vazuk, a deep gnome who is mad with grief and a threat to the other residents of Blingdenstone. His specter can be found haunting his old home in area 12a.
zh_tw: 消滅瓦祖克，一個因悲痛而瘋狂並對布靈登石城其他居民構成威脅的地底侏儒。他的靈魂可以在12a區域他的舊居中找到。

english: Recover the remains of a deep gnome named Udhask and bring them to the catacombs. Jadger knows that the deep gnome died somewhere in Rockblight, the northeast section of Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 找回名為烏達斯克的地底侏儒的遺骸並將它們帶到地下墓穴。賈傑爾知道這位地底侏儒死在布靈登石城東北區域的岩石荒蕪之地某處。

english: Jadger tells the characters he will answer one question for each ghost laid to rest (including Pelek from Gracklstugh, if the characters have returned his hand here). His knowledge of the Underdark is considerable, though somewhat outdated.
zh_tw: 賈傑爾告訴角色們，每安葬一個鬼魂，他會回答一個問題（包括來自格拉克斯圖格的佩勒克，如果角色們已經把他的手帶回到這裡）。他對幽暗地域的瞭解相當豐富，儘管有些過時。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: If the party returns Pelek's remains to the catacombs, each character gains a special award of 100 XP.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍將佩勒克的遺骸歸還到地下墓穴，每個角色將獲得100 XP的特別獎勵。

english: The Way Home
zh_tw: 回家的路

english: The svirfneblin know of routes from Blingdenstone to both the surface world and Gauntlgrym. If you want to keep the characters adventuring in the Underdark, Blingdenstone should either be their last destination after having explored the other areas in the initial chapters of the adventure, or they should be kept busy with other commitments and quests before returning to the surface world. These quests could come either from the deep gnomes or from earlier chapters of the adventure.
zh_tw: 斯維爾芬布人知道從布靈登石城到地表世界和岡特格瑞姆的路線。如果你想讓角色們繼續在幽暗地域冒險，布靈登石城應該是他們在探索了冒險初始章節中的其他區域後的最後一個目的地，或者在返回地表世界之前，他們應該忙於其他的承諾和任務。這些任務可能來自地底侏儒，也可能來自冒險的早期章節。

english: The svirfneblin won't help the party reach the surface world until their attitude toward the characters is friendly. The characters can achieve this through minor acts and services (see "{@area Changing Svirfneblin Attitudes|264|x}" earlier in this chapter), as certain svirfneblin ask for their help. If the characters leave the svirfneblin without providing them assistance in dealing with their troubles, the deep gnomes' attitude toward the characters is hostile if they ever return to Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 地底侏儒在對角色們的態度變得友好之前，不會幫助隊伍到達地表世界。角色們可以透過小行為和服務（見本章前面的'{@area 改變地底侏儒的態度|264|x}'）達到這一點，因為某些地底侏儒會請求他們的幫助。如果角色們離開地底侏儒，沒有幫助他們解決他們的問題，那麼地底侏儒對角色們的態度在他們再次回到布靈登石城時將是敵對的。

english: 9. Cultivation Cave
zh_tw: 9. 培育洞穴

english: This cavern complex is devoted to the cultivation of useful fungi the svirfneblin use in their cooking and crafting, including the following edible and exotic fungi:
zh_tw: 這個洞穴群落專門用於培育地底侏儒在烹飪和製作中使用的有用真菌，包括以下幾種可食用和異域的真菌：

english: {@dice 3d6} barrelstalks
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} 桶形真菌

english: {@dice 6d6} bluecaps
zh_tw: {@dice 6d6}個藍帽怪

english: {@dice 3d6} Nilhogg's noses
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} 尼洛霍格的鼻子

english: {@dice 3d6} torchstalks
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} 火把菌

english: {@dice 3d6} trillimacs
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} 特里米拉克

english: Two blocked-off tunnels lead north and northeast to areas that have not been resettled. All elementals are kept away from the passages because the Stoneheart Enclave believes they lead to the caverns where Ogrémoch's Bane lurks.
zh_tw: 兩個被封閉的隧道分別向北和東北方向通向尚未重新定居的區域。所有的元素生物都被隔離在通道之外，因為石心聚落相信它們通往歐雷莫克之災潛伏的洞穴。

english: 10. Staging Area
zh_tw: 10. 集結區

english: This cave is fortified with barricades and defended by eight {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnomes} and four {@creature Cave Badger|OotA|cave badgers} (see "Random Encounters in Blingdenstone"). There are no earth elementals reinforcing security here because the passage on the north wall—sealed at either end with a locked door—leads to areas where the deep gnomes have confirmed the influence of Ogrémoch's Bane.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴設有路障防禦，並由八名{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}和四隻{@creature Cave Badger|OotA|洞穴獾}守衛（見"布靈登石城的隨機遭遇"）。這裡沒有土元素加強安全，因為北牆上的通道——兩端各有一扇鎖住的門——通向地底侏儒已確認受歐雷莫克之災影響的區域。

english: Unseen Evil
zh_tw: 不可見的邪惡

english: The leader of the guards is a wryly cynical svirfneblin named Sark Axebarrel, who warns the characters of reports of a medusa lurking in the caverns beyond the doors, in a section of the old city that the gnome refers to as Rockblight. If they decide to explore Rockblight, Sark asks them to find out whatever they can about the medusa and kill her if they are able. He offers a payment of 50 gp per character for useful information, plus a diamond worth 1,000 gp if they bring back proof that the medusa is dead.
zh_tw: 衛兵的領袖是一個名叫薩克·斧桶的地底侏儒，他以一種諷刺和悲觀的態度警告角色們有關一個美杜莎潛伏在門外洞穴中的報告，這個區域是老城的一個部分，侏儒稱之為岩石之光。如果他們決定探索岩石之光，薩克要求他們儘可能多地瞭解有關美杜莎的情況，並在有能力的情況下殺死她。他為有用的資訊提供每個角色50金幣的報酬，並且如果他們帶回美杜莎死亡的證據，他還會提供一顆價值1000金幣的鑽石。

english: 11. Caves of Clatter
zh_tw: 11. 喧譁洞穴

english: This cluster of caverns on the eastern end of the settlement serves as a workspace for weaponsmiths and armorsmiths. Traditional svirfneblin arms, including picks, darts, and daggers, along with ring mail, scale mail, and chain mail shirts, are forged and traded here. Less common equipment such as swords and shields can be custom ordered. Prices for weapons and armor are double those listed in the {@i Player's Handbook}.
zh_tw: 這個位於定居點東端的洞穴群是武器匠和護甲匠的工作場所。傳統的地底侏儒武器，包括鎬、飛鏢和匕首，以及環甲、鱗甲和鍊甲衫，都在這裡鍛造和交易。較為罕見的裝備，如劍和盾牌，可以定製。武器和護甲的價格是{@i 玩家手冊}中列出的兩倍。

english: The passages leading to area 17 are sealed off by steel walls that can't be opened.
zh_tw: 通往區域17的通道被鋼壁封死，無法開啟。

english: 12. Residential Caves
zh_tw: 12. 住宅洞穴

english: Map 6.3: Inner Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 地圖 6.3: 布靈登石城內部

english: These caverns branch off into smaller caves serving as hovels for families of svirfneblin. Tunnels lead to secondary chambers that branch out into more hovels. Deep gnome hovels have no doors.
zh_tw: 這些洞穴分叉成更小的洞穴，作為斯維爾芬布人家庭的簡陋住所。隧道通向次級房間，這些房間又分叉出更多的簡陋住所。地底侏儒的簡陋住所沒有門。

english: The locals are willing to talk with the characters, pointing them toward a particular cave that was recently evacuated. A "ghost" manifested there and chased out a family trying to settle within (see area 12a).
zh_tw: 當地人願意與角色們交談，指引他們前往最近被疏散的特定洞穴。那裡出現了一個"鬼魂"，並將一個試圖在那裡定居的家庭趕了出來（見區域12a）。

english: 12a. Vazuk's Home
zh_tw: 12a. 瓦祖克的家

english: Vazuk was a simple leatherworker who died in the drow invasion. His spirit awoke when a family moved into what used to be his home, then began to throw fits and terrorize any creatures coming near.
zh_tw: 瓦祖克曾是一位普通的皮具工人，在卓爾族的入侵中死去。當一個家庭搬進了曾經是他家園的地方時，他的靈魂甦醒了，然後開始大發雷霆，恐嚇任何靠近的生物。

english: Vazuk is a {@creature specter} (use the {@creature poltergeist} variant). He can't be turned while inside his former home. He attacks the characters as soon as they enter the house, all the while screaming "Mine! My stuff! Not yours!"
zh_tw: 瓦祖克是一個{@creature specter||惡靈}（使用{@creature poltergeist||騷靈}變體）。在他從前的家中時，他不能被驅散。一旦角色們進入房子，他就會攻擊他們，同時還在尖叫著"我的！我的東西！不是你的！"

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A character who searches the hovel and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots a concealed hole in the floor. The hole contains a small zurkhwood chest holding eight tiny rubies worth 250 gp each.
zh_tw: 一個角色搜尋小屋並在成功透過一次{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}檢定時，會發現地板上有一個隱藏的洞。洞內有一個小型的祖科木箱子，裡面裝有八顆小顆紅寶石，每顆價值250金幣。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: In addition to the XP earned for defeating Vazuk, each character earns 50 XP if they inform Burrow Warden Jadger (see area 8) that the spirit has been dealt with.
zh_tw: 除了擊敗瓦祖克所獲得的經驗值（XP）之外，如果角色們告知地道守望者賈傑爾（見區域8）已經處理了這個靈魂，每個角色還將獲得50經驗值。

english: 13. Speaking Stones
zh_tw: 13. 會說話的石頭

english: A circle of stone menhirs predating Blingdenstone stands at the center of this small cavern. The gnomes believe this henge is a cluster of truly ancient galeb duhr, venerated as manifestations of the gods. The more religious members of the Stoneheart Enclave cast {@spell augury} and {@spell commune} spells within the circle, interpreting the responses to their entreaties through subtle changes in the vibrations in the bedrock below.
zh_tw: 一個石人立石圈，其歷史早於布靈登石城，位於這個小洞穴的中心。侏儒們相信這個石圈是一群真正的古老石人，作為神的化身而受到崇敬。石心避難所中更虔誠的成員在石圈中施放{@spell augury||卜筮術}和{@spell commune||通神術}法術，透過地下基岩的微妙振動變化來解釋他們祈求的回應。

english: Cleanse the Steadfast Stone
zh_tw: 淨化堅定石

english: Gurnik Tapfinger, head priest of Callarduran Smoothhands in the Stoneheart Enclave, approaches the characters if they show any interest in the Speaking Stones (use the {@creature priest} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual}, but also give Gurnik the Stone Camouflage, Gnome Cunning, and Innate Spellcasting features of a {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome}). He asks them to undertake a task in a closed-off area of the old city known as Rockblight, where the temple of his god stands desecrated. If the characters agree, he gives them a ruby {@item spell gem|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}) containing the {@spell hallow} spell and asks them to place the gem in the Steadfast Stone's menhir (see area 22).
zh_tw: 斯通哈特要塞中卡拉杜蘭·順滑之手的大祭司古爾尼克·叩指，如果角色們對言石表現出任何興趣，他就會接近他們（使用{@creature priest||祭司}的資料，見{@i 怪物圖鑑}，但同時賦予古爾尼克石之偽裝、侏儒狡詐和一個{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}的先天施法特性）。他請求他們在舊城的一個封閉區域——被稱為石疫的地方——執行一項任務，那裡他神祇的神廟已被褻瀆。如果角色們同意，他會給他們一顆包含{@spell hallow||聖居}的紅寶石{@item spell gem|OotA|法術寶石}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}），並要求他們將寶石放置在堅石之柱的巨石柱中（見區域 22）。

english: Gurnik warns them that once they place the gem, Ogrémoch's Bane will send its servants to stop them. They must defeat these servants until the gem awakens three temple guardians, at which point the temple will be cleansed and the characters can leave. Once the characters accomplish this task, Gurnik channels the power of the cleansed temple, bestowing a {@reward blessing of protection} or a {@reward blessing of weapon enhancement} on each of the characters (each player's choice); see "{@book Other Rewards|DMG|7|Other Rewards}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for more information on blessings.
zh_tw: 古爾尼克警告它們一旦他們將寶石放置在指定地點，歐雷莫克之災會派遣它的僕人來阻止他們。他們必須擊敗這些僕人直到寶石喚醒三個廟宇護衛，屆時廟宇將被淨化且角色們可以離開。一旦角色們完成這個任務，古爾尼克會引導淨化廟宇的法力，給予每個角色一個{@reward blessing of protection||護佑祝福}或一個{@reward blessing of weapon enhancement||神兵祝福}(每個玩家的選擇)；詳見{@book 其他獎勵|DMG|7|Other Rewards}中第七章的{@i 城主指南}獲取更多關於祝福的訊息。

english: 14. Diggermattock Hall
zh_tw: 14. 掘鋤大廳

english: This is the home of Dorbo and Senni Diggermattock as well as the "palace" of the provisional government of Blingdenstone. Characters are escorted here if they reveal to the guards in area 1 that they are fleeing from the drow.
zh_tw: 這是多爾博和森妮·掘鋤的家，同時也是布靈登石城臨時政府的"宮殿"。如果角色們在1號區域向守衛透露他們是從卓爾那裡逃出來的，他們將被護送到這裡。

english: Two dozen or so svirfneblin occupy this well-lit cavern, some moving briskly with messenger pouches in hand while others huddle around several stone tables covered in maps and other papers, talking in hushed, serious tones. The back of the room is dominated by a dais carved from the rock of the cavern, atop which rest two stone desks facing each other. Two svirfneblin—one male, one female—sit behind the desks, conferring with advisers and each other. They turn their attention to you as you enter.
zh_tw: 大約兩打左右的地底侏儒佔據了這個明亮的洞穴，一些人手裡拿著信使袋快步走動，而其他人則圍坐在幾張覆蓋著地圖和其他檔案的石桌旁，用低沉而嚴肅的語調交談。房間的後部是一個由洞穴岩石雕刻而成的平臺，上面放著兩張相對的石桌。兩位地底侏儒——一位男性，一位女性——坐在桌子後面，與顧問們和彼此商議。當你進入時，他們將注意力轉向了你。

english: The de facto rulers of Blingdenstone are interested in everything the characters have to say about their adventures, especially if they've witnessed any events related to demonic influence in their visits to other parts of the Underdark.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城的實際統治者對角色們關於他們冒險經歷的一切都感興趣，特別是如果他們在訪問幽暗地域其他地區時目睹了任何與惡魔影響相關的事件。

english: The Diggermattocks offer characters a safe haven on the condition they cause no trouble in the community. If asked about reaching the surface, Dorbo says he'd like to help, but Blingdenstone is under severe pressure and he can't spare anyone to guide them. Moreover, the gnomes don't allow strangers to buy or borrow their maps. Both Dorbo and Senni become evasive and angry if the characters press the issue, at which point the characters must succeed on a group {@dc 15} Charisma check or have the attitude of the svirfneblin worsen.
zh_tw: 掘鋤家族為角色們提供了一個安全避難所，條件是他們不在社群中製造麻煩。如果被問到如何到達地表，多爾博表示他願意幫忙，但布靈登石城目前承受著巨大的壓力，他無法抽出人手來引導他們。此外，侏儒們不允許陌生人購買或借用他們的地圖。如果角色們堅持這個問題，多爾博和森妮會變得迴避且憤怒，此時角色們必須成功進行一次群體的 {@dc 15} 魅力檢定，否則地底侏儒的態度會惡化。

english: If the adventurers offer to help the beleaguered settlement, the svirfneblin leaders mention things the characters can do to help take the pressure off the community and free up its resources. Each task the characters successfully undertake shifts the attitude of the svirfneblin (see "Changing Svirfneblin Attitudes").
zh_tw: 如果冒險者提出幫助這個困境中的定居點，地底侏儒的領袖們會提到角色們可以做的一些事情，以幫助減輕社群的壓力並釋放其資源。角色們成功承擔的每個任務都會改變地底侏儒的態度（見"改變地底侏儒態度"）。

english: "Operation: Ooze There?"
zh_tw: "行動：那裡有軟泥怪？"

english: The Diggermattocks relay rumors that some monster or magic in the northwestern part of the settlement might be responsible for the growing number of oozes in Blingdenstone. If the characters return with information about the Pudding Court and the threat lurking therein, the Diggermattocks pay them with an empty {@item spell gem|OotA} of the highest spell level a spellcaster in the party can cast.
zh_tw: 掘鋤家族轉述了一些謠言，稱定居點西北部的某種怪物或魔法可能是布靈登石城中軟泥怪數量增加的原因。如果角色們帶著有關布丁宮廷及其潛伏威脅的資訊返回，掘鋤家族將用一個空的{@item spell gem|OotA|法術寶石}來支付他們的報酬，該寶石的等級為隊伍中施法者能夠施放的最高法術等級。

english: "Operation: Exterminate?"
zh_tw: "行動：消滅？"

english: The wererats of the Goldwhisker clan are a point of contention among the Diggermattocks. Dorbo wants them out of the warrens to free up living space for hard-working svirfneblin. He also wants to recover the House Center he believes is still in the wererats' grasp (see area 28). Senni argues that the wererats are descendants of Blingdenstone citizens and deserve to stay and rejoin their community.
zh_tw: 金鬚族的鼠人是掘鋤家族爭論的焦點。多爾博希望他們離開洞穴，以便為勤勞的地底侏儒騰出生活空間。他還希望找回他認為仍在鼠人手中的房屋中心（見區域28）。森妮則認為鼠人是布靈登石城市民的後裔，應該留下來重新加入他們的社群。

english: Since the wererats are as territorial and defensive as the svirfneblin, any attempt to parley has been met with violence. Senni asks the characters to venture into the warrens and talk with whomever is in charge. The characters' report will determine whether the svirfneblin step up their efforts to eliminate the wererats or work toward an agreement.
zh_tw: 由於鼠人和地底侏儒一樣具有領土性和防禦性，任何談判嘗試都遭到了暴力回應。森妮請求角色們冒險進入洞穴區與負責人交談。角色們的報告將決定地底侏儒是加大努力消滅鼠人還是朝著達成協議的方向努力。

english: If {@creature Topsy|OotA} or {@creature Turvy|OotA} are with the party, they want to learn more about the wererat community. If their own nature as wererats is revealed to the Diggermattocks or other deep gnomes, the twins are given the choice of going into the wererat-controlled part of Blingdenstone or being cast out of the settlement altogether, which might encourage the characters to meet and talk with the Goldwhisker clan.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西}或{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}與隊伍在一起，他們想要更多地瞭解鼠人社群。如果他們作為鼠人的身份被掘鋤家族或其他地底侏儒發現，這對雙胞胎將被選擇進入由鼠人控制的布靈登石城部分或被完全驅逐出定居點，這可能會鼓勵角色們去見見並與金鬚族人交談。

english: 15. Singing Stones
zh_tw: 15. 歌唱之石

english: This elevated cavern near one of Blingdenstone's main residential areas holds a variety of rocks and crystals in the middle of its bowl-shaped floor. Svirfneblin minstrels skilled in the art of stone singing can alter the pitch of the vibrations emitted by the individual stones, creating an effect similar to an assemblage of harp-playing bards. When the characters initially come here, a {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} named Garra Songstone is playing the crystals for an appreciative audience of {@dice 3d4} deep gnome children (noncombatants).
zh_tw: 這個位於布靈登石城主要居住區附近的高架洞穴在其碗狀地面中央擁有各種岩石和水晶。精通石歌藝術的地底侏儒吟遊詩人能夠改變個別石頭髮出的振動的音調，創造出類似一群彈奏豎琴的吟遊詩人的效果。當角色們最初來到這裡時，一個名叫加拉·歌石的{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}正在為一群欣賞的{@dice 3d4}地底侏儒兒童（非戰鬥人員）演奏水晶。

english: 16. The Foaming Mug
zh_tw: 16. 泡沫杯

english: The Foaming Mug was built as an inn to house foreign guests visiting Blingdenstone. It was abandoned after the drow invasion but has recently reopened. While its supply of surface foods and beverages is meager, the rooms are sized for Medium guests, with comfortable beds and two separate hot springs used for bathing and relaxation. There are no other guests currently, so party members who stay here have the inn to themselves. Many svirfneblin frequent the inn's taproom after work, keeping the place lively. The tavern serves Darklake Stout, an ale that the svirfneblin purchase from duergar traders in Mantol-Derith (see {@adventure chapter 9|OotA|8}).
zh_tw: 泡沫酒杯旅店最初是為接待來訪布靈登石城的國外客人而建的旅館。它在卓爾入侵後被遺棄，但最近重新開放。雖然它供應的地表食物和飲品很有限，但房間是為中等體型的客人設計的，配有舒適的床鋪和兩個獨立的溫泉，用於沐浴和放鬆。目前沒有其他客人，因此住在這裡的隊伍可以獨享整個旅店。許多地底侏儒在下班後經常光顧旅店的酒吧，使這裡保持熱鬧。酒館供應黑暗湖黑啤，這是一種地底侏儒從曼塔-岱瑞絲的灰矮人商人那裡購買的麥酒（詳見{@adventure 第九章|OotA|8}）。

english: Tappy Foamstrap, a bored {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome}, runs the inn. The characters' arrival is the most exciting thing that has happened in months, so she peppers them with questions about their lives and adventures, pushing free drinks and food on them.
zh_tw: 塔皮·泡沫帶，一位無聊的{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}，經營著這家旅店。角色的到來是幾個月來最令人興奮的事情，所以她不斷地詢問他們的生活和冒險經歷，並熱情地為他們提供免費的飲料和食物。

english: Rumor and Hearsay
zh_tw: 謠言與傳聞

english: The svirfneblin community is tight-knit, so rumors spread quickly. Characters who engage with the tavern's patrons while the gnomes' general attitude is indifferent or friendly learn the following information.
zh_tw: 地底侏儒社群關係緊密，因此謠言傳播得很快。當侏儒的普遍態度是不關心或友好時，與酒館顧客互動的角色可以瞭解到以下資訊。

english: Blingdenstone's ghost problem is getting worse, and there are even spirits haunting the catacombs.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城的鬼魂問題正日益惡化，甚至墓穴中也有幽靈出沒。

english: There was a crazy svirfneblin back in the first days of reclamation who disappeared. Some of the scouts claim to have seen him, skulking around the unrecovered areas of the settlement. (The scouts don't know that this gnome is {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}.)
zh_tw: 在收復初期，有一個瘋狂的地底侏儒消失了。一些偵察兵聲稱在定居點未收復區域看到他鬼鬼祟祟地徘徊。（偵察兵不知道這個侏儒是{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}。）

english: The Stoneheart Enclave is closing in on a solution to the threat of Ogrémoch's Bane (untrue). The gnomes call a large unclaimed area in the northeast of the settlement "Rockblight," as earth elementals go mad whenever they go near it.
zh_tw: 石心飛地正在接近解決歐雷莫克之災威脅的方案（不真實）。侏儒們將定居點東北部一大片未被認領的區域稱為"岩石荒蕪之地"，因為每當土元素靠近它時都會發狂。

english: People are divided as to what to do about the wererats living in the southwest caverns. Some want them out, while others propose an alliance of mutual defense.
zh_tw: 人們對居住在西南洞穴中的鼠人持有不同的看法。一些人希望將它們趕走，而另一些人提議建立一個相互防禦的聯盟。

english: A merchant from Gracklstugh says there's an influx of surface-world coins there, but nobody knows where they come from. (See {@area chapter 4|17f|x} for more information.)
zh_tw: 來自格拉克斯圖格的一位商人表示，那裡湧現了大量地表世界的硬幣，但沒人知道它們的來源。（更多資訊請參閱{@area 第四章|17f|x}。）

english: A svirfneblin caravan returning from Whiteshell Mines encountered a parade of dancing myconids. Through their rapport spores, the myconids told the gnomes about a "wedding celebration," which is strange considering that myconids don't celebrate or have weddings. (See {@area chapter 5|252|x} for more information.)
zh_tw: 一支從白貝殼礦井返回的地底侏儒商隊遇到了一群跳舞的菌人。透過它們的共鳴孢子，菌人告訴侏儒們這是一場"婚禮慶典"，這很奇怪，因為菌人並不慶祝或舉辦婚禮。（更多資訊請參見{@area 第五章|252|x}。）

english: The characters can spend a few hours socializing in the taproom of the Foaming Mug. If they do, they gain advantage on their next group Charisma check made to improve the deep gnomes' attitude.
zh_tw: 角色們可以在泡沫杯的酒吧里社交幾個小時。如果他們這樣做，他們在下一次嘗試改善地底侏儒態度的團隊魅力檢定上將獲得優勢。

english: Rockblight
zh_tw: 岩石疫病

english: When the drow attacked Blingdenstone, Ogrémoch's Bane retreated to the far corners of the ruined city, waiting for the time to reemerge and seek out earth elementals to corrupt. The malevolent entity didn't have to wait long, as the drow sent teams of scavengers to loot the treasures the deep gnomes left behind, bringing their own elemental creatures with them.
zh_tw: 當卓爾攻擊布靈登石城時，歐雷莫克之災撤退到了這座被毀城市的最遠角落，等待時機重新出現並尋找土元素來腐化。這個惡毒的實體沒有等待太久，因為卓爾派遣了清道夫團隊去掠奪地底侏儒留下的寶藏，並且帶來了他們自己的元素生物。

english: Map 6.4: Rockblight
zh_tw: 地圖 6.4: 巖疫

english: Ogrémoch's Bane haunted the drow with the same relentless cruelty it did the svirfneblin, turning their elemental servants against them. Eventually, the drow armies departed the city, but when they did, a drow priestess of Lolth named Neheedra Duskryn stayed behind. Neheedra was obsessed with collecting {@item Spell Gem|OotA|spell gems} for their power and beauty, intent on making herself the regal and powerful master of her own underground realm. She commanded a force of drow servants and soldiers with unabashed cruelty, relentlessly driving them to seek out {@item Spell Gem|OotA|spell gems} and increase her own wealth and power.
zh_tw: 歐雷莫克之災以同樣的無情殘酷折磨著卓爾，就像它對待地底侏儒一樣，使他們的元素僕從反抗他們。最終，卓爾軍隊離開了這座城市，但當他們離開時，一位名叫妮希德拉·達斯克林的卓爾羅絲女祭司留了下來。妮希德拉痴迷於收集{@item Spell Gem|OotA|法術寶石}，因為它們的力量和美麗，她決心成為自己地下王國的高貴而強大的主人。她毫不掩飾地殘酷指揮著一支卓爾僕人和士兵的力量，無情地驅使他們尋找{@item Spell Gem|OotA|法術寶石}，增加她自己的財富和權力。

english: Overcome by her own greed and vanity, Neheedra engaged in dark rituals designed to secure her hold on power, imagining that Blingdenstone would one day become a drow enclave with her as its immortal leader. Unfortunately, the magical pacts she struck eventually transformed the vain priestess into a medusa.
zh_tw: 妮希德拉被自己的貪婪和虛榮心所征服，她參與了旨在確保她權力的黑暗儀式，幻想著布靈登石城有一天會成為以她為不朽領袖的卓爾飛地。不幸的是，她達成的魔法契約最終將這位虛榮的女祭司變成了一個美杜莎。

english: Enraged by her fate, Neheedra turned her servants to stone and descended into madness. Over decades, she {@condition petrified} any creature she encountered, eventually catching the attention of Ogrémoch's Bane. Now, the medusa works in concert with the fell entity, creating stone servants animated by its power.
zh_tw: 妮希德拉因命運的打擊而憤怒，將她的僕從變成了石頭，並陷入了瘋狂。幾十年來，她將遇到的任何生物{@condition petrified||石化}，最終引起了歐雷莫克之災的注意。現在，這位美杜莎與那個邪惡實體協同工作，創造出由其力量驅動的石頭僕從。

english: Since the return of the svirfneblin to Blingdenstone, the deep gnomes have studiously avoided sections of the old city that Ogrémoch's Bane and Neheedra inhabit, blocking it off from the rest of the settlement and giving it the name "Rockblight."
zh_tw: 自從地底侏儒返回布靈登石城以來，他們一直刻意避開歐雷莫克之災和妮希德拉居住的老城區部分，將其與定居點的其餘部分隔離開來，並將其命名為"巖疫"。

english: Rockblight: General Features
zh_tw: 巖疫：總體特徵

english: Unlike the reclaimed parts of Blingdenstone, Rockblight is barren, cold, and hostile.
zh_tw: 與布靈登石城收復區域不同，巖疫是不毛之地，寒冷且充滿敵意。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: All parts of Rockblight are dark except for whatever light sources the characters bring with them.
zh_tw: 巖疫的所有區域都是黑暗的，除了角色們自己帶來的光源。

english: Caverns and Corridors
zh_tw: 洞穴和走廊

english: The caverns and connecting tunnels in this part of Blingdenstone are of the same construction seen in Inner Blingdenstone, but are empty and strewn with rubble.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城這一部分的洞穴和連線通道與內布靈登石城所見的建築相同，但它們是空的，並且散落著瓦礫。

english: Humidity
zh_tw: 溼度

english: A few shallow pools and streams run through the area, making the air damp and chill. Pools are {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 幾個淺水池和小溪流穿過這個區域，使空氣潮溼而寒冷。水池是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: 17. Abandoned Residences
zh_tw: 17. 廢棄住宅

english: This large cavern mirrors the residential areas of Inner Blingdenstone, except there is no warmth or joy here—only darkness and signs of carnage.
zh_tw: 這個大型洞穴反映了內布靈登石城的居住區，但這裡沒有溫暖或歡樂——只有黑暗和屠殺的跡象。

english: Every step echoes against walls beyond your circle of light. The air is cold and damp, and you can hear a waterfall somewhere in the blackness, along with faint echoes of battle.
zh_tw: 每一步的回聲都在你光圈之外的牆壁上回蕩。空氣寒冷潮溼，你可以在黑暗中聽到某處的瀑布聲，以及微弱的戰鬥回聲。

english: The echoes of battle are always in the darkness beyond the range of the characters' light and {@sense darkvision}. As characters move toward the apparent source, the echoes become more distant, as though originating somewhere else.
zh_tw: 戰鬥的回聲總是在角色們光亮和{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}範圍之外的黑暗中。當角色們嚮明顯的聲音來源移動時，回聲變得更加遙遠，彷彿是從別處發出的。

english: Unless the characters quickly retreat whence they came, the {@creature ghost} of a svirfneblin named Udhask appears. It uses Horrifying Visage, then attacks with his Withering Touch. If it takes any damage, the ghost shouts "They are coming! Everyone must hide!" It then flees. The characters can follow the fleeing ghost to an old burrow, where it disappears. Within the burrow, Udhask's skeletal remains lie next to a stone bed. There's no evidence that he died a violent death. In fact, when the drow attacked Blingdenstone, Udhask had a heart attack and died while reaching for his loot (see "Treasure").
zh_tw: 除非角色們迅速撤退，否則名為烏達斯克的地底侏儒的{@creature ghost||幽魂}就會出現。它使用恐怖面容，然後用其枯萎之觸攻擊。如果它受到任何傷害，鬼魂就會大喊"他們來了！每個人都必須躲藏！"然後逃跑。角色們可以跟隨逃跑的鬼魂到達一個古老的洞穴，在那裡它消失了。在洞穴內，烏達斯克的骸骨躺在一張石床旁邊。沒有跡象表明他是在暴力中死去的。實際上，當卓爾攻擊布靈登石城時，烏達斯克在伸手拿他的戰利品（見"寶藏"）時心臟病發作而死。

english: Pool and Waterfall
zh_tw: 池塘和瀑布

english: A waterfall fed by an underground freshwater stream pours into a 100-foot-diameter, 10-foot-deep pool that dominates the east end of the cavern. Flanking the pool are two wide, rough-hewn staircases that climb 30 feet to an overlooking cave filled crystals and fungi (area 18). The stream runs through the higher cave before pouring into this one.
zh_tw: 一個由地下淡水溪流補給的瀑布傾瀉入一個直徑100尺、深10尺的水池，這個水池佔據了洞穴東端的主要位置。水池兩側是兩座寬闊的、粗糙鑿成的樓梯，它們上升30尺到達一個俯瞰洞穴，裡面充滿了水晶和真菌（區域18）。溪流穿過上方的洞穴，然後流入這個洞穴。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Udhask's skeleton appears to be reaching under the stone bed. A character who searches under the bed and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds a hidden compartment in the floor. Within the compartment is a rotted pouch containing six 100 gp gems and a {@item potion of invisibility}.
zh_tw: 烏達斯克的骨架似乎在石床下摸索。一個角色若搜尋床下併成功透過{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，會在地板上發現一個隱藏的隔間。隔間內有一個腐爛的小袋，裡面裝有六顆價值100 gp的寶石和一瓶{@item potion of invisibility||隱形藥水}。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Collecting Udhask's bones and taking them to Burrow Warden Jadger's ghost in area 8 completes one of Jadger's tasks.
zh_tw: 收集烏達斯克的骨頭並將其帶到區域8中地道守望者賈傑爾的鬼魂處，可以完成賈傑爾的任務之一。

english: 18. Overlook
zh_tw: 18. 俯瞰

english: A shallow, swiftly flowing stream bisects this cave. Crystalline formations sprout from the floor on both sides of the stream, and rough-hewn staircases at the back of the cave climb 30 feet to a barren stone ledge with a pair of winged statues perched atop it.
zh_tw: 一條淺而急的溪流將這個洞穴一分為二。溪流兩側的地面上生長著晶狀體結構，洞穴後面的粗糙石階上升30尺到達一個貧瘠的石臺，上面有一對帶翅膀的雕像。

english: The "winged statues" on the ledge are two {@creature Gargoyle||gargoyles}. If the characters attack the gargoyles or move within 30 feet of them, the monsters swoop down and attack. In the second round of combat, an insane {@creature earth elemental} rises from the stone floor and joins the fight.
zh_tw: 石臺上的"帶翼雕像"是兩個{@creature Gargoyle||石像鬼}。如果角色們攻擊石像鬼或移動到它們30尺範圍內，這些怪物會俯衝下來攻擊。在戰鬥的第二回合，一個瘋狂的{@creature earth elemental||土元素}從石地板上升起並加入戰鬥。

english: The stream that flows through the cave originates from a naturally formed culvert in the northeast wall, beneath the ledge. The stream is only 3 feet deep.
zh_tw: 流經洞穴的溪流源自東北牆下，石臺下方的一個天然形成的排水溝。這條溪流只有3尺深。

english: The crystal formations growing throughout the cave are large enough for characters to hide behind, but they are neither magical more valuable.
zh_tw: 洞穴中生長的晶狀體結構足夠大，角色們可以藏在其後，但它們既沒有魔法效果也不具有價值。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Among the remains of the earth elemental, the characters can find an {@item Elemental Gem||earth elemental gem}. Before they can use it, however, it must receive a {@spell remove curse} spell from a priest of the Stoneheart Enclave. Otherwise, the elemental summoned by the gem is always hostile toward its summoner. The characters can also harvest samples from the bodies of the corrupted elemental and the gargoyles for Nomi Pathshutter (see "Stoneheart Quarry" in the "Blingdenstone Outskirts" section).
zh_tw: 在土元素的殘骸中，角色們可以找到一顆{@item Elemental Gem||土元素寶石}。然而，在使用它之前，它必須接受石心聚落的牧師施展的{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}法術。否則，由寶石召喚出的元素總是對召喚者懷有敵意。角色們還可以從被腐化的元素和石像鬼的身體上採集樣本，交給諾米·封徑（見"布靈登石城郊區"部分中的"石心採石場"）。

english: 19. Crystal Garden
zh_tw: 19. 水晶花園

english: Light from bioluminescent fungi refracts through large crystal formations erupting from the floor, creating a kaleidoscope of colors on the surrounding walls. The crystals are semitransparent, slightly distorting images seen through them. A statue of a gnome cowers near a crystal outgrowth, holding a broken crystal in its hands.
zh_tw: 來自地面上生長的熒光蘑菇的光線透過半透明的大型水晶結構折射，使得周圍牆壁上呈現出萬花筒般的色彩。這些水晶是半透明的，透過它們看到的影象略有扭曲。一個侏儒雕像蜷縮在水晶生長處附近，手中拿著一塊破碎的水晶。

english: Six nightlights (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2) illuminate this cave. Tunnels in this area climb up to area 20 and down to area 21, and two sets of stairs carved from the walls lead up to area 22.
zh_tw: 六個夜光菌（見第2章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）照亮了這個洞穴。這個區域的隧道向上通往區域20，向下通往區域21，還有兩組從牆壁上雕刻出來的樓梯通向上方的區域22。

english: The statue is actually a {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} named Vort, who was turned to stone by Neheedra the medusa. He tried to use one of the crystals to block the medusa's gaze but failed. Anyone examining the statue notices that the gnome seems to be raising the crystal toward his face, as if to look through it.
zh_tw: 這座雕像實際上是一個名叫沃特的{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}，他被美杜莎妮希德拉變成了石頭。他試圖使用其中一塊水晶來阻擋美杜莎的視線，但失敗了。任何檢查雕像的人都會注意到，侏儒似乎正將水晶舉向他的臉，彷彿要透過它看東西。

english: The crystals here can be used as countermeasures against Neheedra's gaze. A creature with one hand free can hold a crystal to its eyes, gaining advantage on the Constitution saving throw made against Neheedra's gaze. However, the creature makes attack rolls with disadvantage.
zh_tw: 這裡的水晶可以用來作為對抗妮希德拉視線的對策。一隻手空閒的生物可以拿著水晶放在眼前，從而在對抗妮希德拉視線的體質豁免檢定時獲得優勢。然而，該生物進行攻擊擲骰時具有劣勢。

english: 20. Neheedra's Lair
zh_tw: 20. 妮希德拉的巢穴

english: Neheedra Duskryn was part of the expedition sent to loot Blingdenstone of its {@item Spell Gem|OotA|spell gems}. Her abode reflects the richness and elegance of the drow monarch she yearned to be.
zh_tw: 妮希德拉·達斯克林是被派往掠奪布靈登石城的探險隊的一部分，目的是獲取其{@item Spell Gem|OotA|法術寶石}。她的住所反映了她渴望成為的卓爾君主的豐富和優雅。

english: The adornments in this chamber would be more at home in a drow city. Spider-themed tapestries, fine zurkhwood furniture, and racks of expensive clothing fill the area, all of it old and rotted. At the center of the chamber, a female drow sits upon a zurkhwood throne. She stands, eyes closed and arms crossed as if in meditation or prayer. Then her white hair writhes, and you see it is formed of pale, hissing snakes.
zh_tw: 這個房間的裝飾更適合出現在卓爾的城市中。以蜘蛛為主題的掛毯、精美的祖克木傢俱和昂貴的衣物架子填滿了這個區域，所有這些都已老舊腐爛。在房間的中心，一位女性卓爾坐在祖克木寶座上。她站立著，雙眼緊閉，雙臂交叉，彷彿在冥想或祈禱。然後她的白髮扭動，你看到她的頭髮是由蒼白的、嘶嘶作響的蛇組成的。

english: The {@creature medusa} attacks intruders without hesitation. Neheedra's curse has driven her mad, and reasoning with her isn't an option.
zh_tw: 這個{@creature medusa||美杜莎}會毫不猶豫地攻擊入侵者。妮希德拉的詛咒使她瘋狂，與她理論是不可能的。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Five of the dresses in Neheedra's rack are made of spider silk shaped by drow magic. They are worth 200 gp each if sold in the markets of the Underdark. The drow magic on a dress fades when the garment is exposed to sunlight, causing it to fall apart.
zh_tw: 妮希德拉衣架上的五件連衣裙是用蜘蛛絲製成的，由卓爾魔法塑形。如果在市場上的幽暗地域市場出售，每件價值200金幣。當這些連衣裙暴露在陽光下時，上面的卓爾魔法會消失，導致衣物解體。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters divulge the medusa's location to Sark Axebarrel in area 10, they receive the promised reward of 50 gp each. If they deliver Neheedra's head to Sark, he also gives them the 1,000 gp diamond he promised them.
zh_tw: 如果角色們向區域10的薩克·斧桶透露美杜莎的位置，他們將獲得每人50金幣的承諾獎勵。如果他們將妮希德拉的頭交給薩克，他還會給他們承諾的1000金幣的鑽石。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: The characters gain 50 XP each if they successfully report back to Sark, whether they defeat the medusa or not. Upon earning this award, the characters can make a group Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check to improve the gnomes' attitude (see "Changing Svirfneblin Attitudes").
zh_tw: 如果角色們成功向薩克回報，無論是否擊敗美杜莎，他們每人都能獲得50經驗值。在獲得這個獎勵後，角色們可以進行一次集體魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，以改善侏儒族的態度（見"改變地底侏儒態度"）。

english: 21. Drow Statues
zh_tw: 21. 卓爾雕像

english: This cave is filled with thirty statues of drow warriors, all standing as if on guard. In her madness, Neheedra turned these warriors of her house to stone. Over long years, Ogrémoch's Bane has used its power to animate these statues, turning them into elemental creatures.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴裡充滿了三十座卓爾戰士的雕像，它們都站立著，彷彿在守衛。在她的瘋狂中，妮希德拉將她家族的這些戰士變成了石頭。經過漫長的歲月，歐雷莫克之災使用其力量使這些雕像活化，將它們變成了元素生物。

english: When the characters step inside the chamber, six of the statues animate and attack. The statues have the statistics of {@creature animated armor}, except that they are elementals instead of constructs.
zh_tw: 當角色們踏入這個房間時，六座雕像活化並開始攻擊。這些雕像擁有{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}的具體數值，只是它們是元素生物而不是構造物。

english: The statues attack until destroyed but don't leave this area. If the characters spend 1 round or longer in the chamber after defeating the last statue, six more statues animate. This process repeats until either all of the statues are destroyed or until the characters leave the cave. A statue also animates and attacks if touched or otherwise disturbed.
zh_tw: 雕像會攻擊直到被摧毀，但不會離開這個區域。如果角色們在擊敗最後一座雕像後在房間內停留1輪或更長時間，另外六座雕像會活化。這個過程會一直重複，直到所有的雕像都被摧毀或者角色們離開洞穴。如果雕像被觸控或以其他方式被打擾，它也會活化並攻擊。

english: Ogrémoch's Bane
zh_tw: 歐雷莫克之災

english: If every statue in this cave is destroyed, Ogrémoch's Bane appears.
zh_tw: 如果這個洞穴中的每一座雕像都被摧毀，歐雷莫克之災就會出現。

english: As the last statue crumbles, a cloud of dust erupts from its shattered remains and expands to fill the cave.
zh_tw: 當最後一座雕像破碎時，一團灰塵從其破碎的殘骸中爆發出來，並擴散填滿了整個洞穴。

english: The cloud is Ogrémoch's Bane.
