Characters within the cloud can sense its malevolence, and a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check confirms that the cloud is of extraplanar origin. The cloud has a flying speed of 20 feet and is impervious to all damage and spells except the following.
zh_tw: 這片雲霧是歐雷莫克之災。位於雲霧中的角色可以感受到它的惡意，成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定可以確認這片雲霧來自異界。這片雲霧的飛行速度為20尺，並且對所有傷害和法術免疫，除了以下例外。

english: A {@spell gust of wind} spell or similar magic can forcibly move the cloud.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell gust of wind||造風術}法術或類似的魔法可以強行移動這團雲。

english: Casting a {@spell banishment} spell on the cloud sends it back to the Elemental Plane of Air if it fails its Charisma saving throw (it has a +4 modifier to the roll). A {@spell dispel evil and good} spell is equally effective and doesn't require a successful attack roll; however, the caster must be in contact with the cloud.
zh_tw: 對這團雲施放一個{@spell banishment||放逐術}法術，如果它未能透過魅力豁免檢定（它有+4的調整值），就可以將其送回元素位面的風元素界。一個{@spell dispel evil and good||驅逐善惡}法術同樣有效，並且不需要成功的攻擊檢定；然而，施法者必須與雲接觸。

english: Creatures native to the Elemental Plane of Earth (including earth elementals, galeb duhr, gargoyles, and xorn) that come in contact with Ogrémoch's Bane instantly fall under the cloud's sway. The effect lasts as long as the enslaved elementals and Ogrémoch's Bane are on the same plane of existence.
zh_tw: 來自元素位面土元素界的生物（包括土元素、石人、石像鬼和石鼎獸）一旦接觸到歐雷莫克之災，會立即受到雲的控制。這種效果將持續存在，只要被奴役的元素生物和歐雷莫克之災處於同一存在位面。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: If Ogrémoch's Bane is banished back to the Elemental Plane of Earth, award each character 150 XP.
zh_tw: 如果歐雷莫克之災被驅逐回元素位面土元素界，給每個角色150經驗值。

english: 22. Steadfast Stone
zh_tw: 22. 堅定之石

english: Once a temple of Callarduran Smoothhands, the deep gnomes' god of stone and mining, this cavern was named after its long-lost galeb duhr protectors—the {@i dharum suhn} (the "Hearts of Steadfast Stone").
zh_tw: 這個洞穴曾是卡勒杜蘭·滑手的神廟，地底侏儒的石頭和採礦之神，以它長久失散的石人守護者——{@i 達魯姆·蘇恩}（"堅定之石之心"）命名。

english: The floor of this cavern is worn smooth, but the walls are rough. A great menhir carved from a stalagmite stands in the center of the chamber, pockmarked with dozens of empty sockets that might once have held gems.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴的地面被磨得很光滑，但牆壁卻很粗糙。一座巨大的石柱從鐘乳石雕刻而成，矗立在房間的中心，上面佈滿了十幾個空槽，這些槽可能曾經放置過寶石。

english: Characters with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 14 or higher notice that the roughness of the walls outlines several large, vaguely humanoid shapes.
zh_tw: 具有14或更高被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分的角色會注意到牆壁的粗糙度勾勒出幾個大致的人形輪廓。

english: Cleansing the Temple
zh_tw: 淨化神廟

english: If the characters accepted Gurnik Tapfinger's task (see area 13), they can place the ruby {@item spell gem|OotA} he gave them into one of the sockets in the menhir. When they do so, the elementals in the walls begin to stir.
zh_tw: 如果角色們接受了古爾尼克·叩指的任務（見區域13），他們可以將他給他們的紅寶石法術寶石{@item spell gem|OotA|法術寶石}放入石柱的一個插槽中。當他們這麼做時，牆壁中的元素生物開始活動起來。

english: As the ruby begins to glow against the menhir, the walls begin to rumble. Part of one wall shifts, detaches, and charges toward you.
zh_tw: 當紅寶石開始在石柱上發光時，牆壁開始隆隆作響。一部分牆壁移動，脫離開來，並向你們衝過來。

english: An {@creature earth elemental} materializes out of the wall and attacks. When the elemental is reduced to 0 hit points, it crumbles, and a {@creature galeb duhr} emerges from the ground near the menhir in an unoccupied space. The galeb duhr faces outward in a guarding pose, but doesn't move or respond. Another earth elemental then emerges from the wall of the chamber and attacks, when it is destroyed, a second stoic galeb duhr appears. This summoning process repeats once more, until the third earth elemental appears and is destroyed. The elementals ignore the galeb duhr, which continue to stand motionless throughout the fight.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature earth elemental||土元素}從牆壁中凝聚成形併發起攻擊。當元素生物的生命值降至0點時，它會崩解，一個{@creature galeb duhr||石人}在石柱附近的空地上從地面出現。石人面向外採取守護姿勢，但不會移動或作出反應。然後，另一個土元素從洞穴牆壁中出現併發起攻擊，當它被摧毀時，第二個冷靜的石人出現。這個召喚過程再次重複，直到第三個土元素出現並被摧毀。元素生物忽略了石人，它們在整個戰鬥中繼續靜止不動。

english: When the characters reduce three earth elementals to 0 hit points and summon three galeb duhr, a white light shines from the menhir, producing a {@spell hallow} effect protecting the galeb duhr from the influence of Ogrémoch's Bane. The galeb duhr then animate and acknowledge the characters with a grave nod, before settling down in their boulder guise around the menhir.
zh_tw: 當角色們將三個土元素生物的生命值降至0點並召喚出三個石人時，一道白光從石柱中發出，產生一個{@spell hallow||聖居}效果，保護石人不受歐雷莫克之災的影響。然後，石人活化並向角色們致以嚴肅的點頭，之後在石柱周圍以巨石的形態安定下來。

english: Gurnik delivers his promised blessings when the characters return to notify him of their success in the temple. He can sense whether or not the temple has been restored to its former glory, so if the characters fail to cleanse the temple but tell him they succeeded, he knows they're lying, and the deep gnomes' attitude toward the party worsens. If the characters accomplish Gurnik's task, they can make a {@dc 15} group Charisma check to improve the gnomes' attitude, with all characters making the check with advantage.
zh_tw: 當角色們返回向古爾尼克報告他們在神廟中的成功時，他會兌現他所承諾的祝福。他能夠感知神廟是否已恢復昔日的榮耀，因此如果角色們未能淨化神廟卻告訴他他們成功了，他會知道他們在撒謊，深侏儒對隊伍的態度會惡化。如果角色們完成了古爾尼克的任務，他們可以進行一次{@dc 15}的群體魅力檢定來改善侏儒們的態度，所有角色在進行檢定時都具有優勢。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: A wide, descending staircase ends before a wall of collapsed stone that blocks access to the tunnels and caves that constitute the Pudding Court. The debris can be cleared with a few days of work. However, if the characters want to use this passage as an entry point to attack {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}, they can use a volatile concoction brewed by Kazook Pickshine to quickly clear the debris (see "{@area Battle for Blingdenstone|2f2|x}" later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 一段寬闊的下行樓梯在一堵坍塌的石頭牆前結束，這堵牆阻擋了通往構成布丁法庭的隧道和洞穴的通道。這些瓦礫可以透過幾天的工作來清理。然而，如果角色們想使用這條通道作為攻擊{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的入口點，他們可以使用由卡祖克·閃鎬釀造的易揮發混合物來快速清理瓦礫（見本章後面的"{@area 布靈登石城之戰|2f2|x}"）。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: Each character gains 200 XP for restoring the temple.
zh_tw: 每個角色因修復神廟獲得200經驗值。

english: Goldwhisker Warrens
zh_tw: 金鬚族地穴

english: The svirfneblin wererats of the Goldwhisker clan don't remember having lived anywhere but in the ruins of Blingdenstone. They descend from survivors of the drow invasion who became infected with lycanthropy after an unfortunate encounter with a pack of wererats.
zh_tw: 金鬚族的侏儒鼠人不記得除了在布靈登石城廢墟中生活之外的任何地方。他們是卓爾入侵的生還者的後代，在一次不幸的遭遇中感染了鼠人病。

english: For decades, the Goldwhisker svirfneblin have lived and thrived in these caverns, avoiding drow and crazed elementals, and securing their homes in cunning and vicious ways. They aren't willing to leave just because the cowards who fled Blingdenstone when it needed them most have now returned.
zh_tw: 數十年來，金鬚地底侏儒氏族在這些洞窟中生存並繁榮，躲避著卓爾與瘋狂的元素生物，並以狡詐而殘忍的手段保衛家園。他們不願僅因那些在布靈登石城最需要時逃走的懦夫們如今歸來，就輕易放棄這片土地。

english: Goldwhisker Warrens: General Features
zh_tw: 金鬚族巢穴：一般特徵

english: One of the first things lycanthropy cost the svirfneblin was their fastidious tidiness. The wererat warrens are messy, with several areas smelling of mushrooms too ripe for any normal person to eat.
zh_tw: 狼人病給侏儒帶來的第一項損失就是他們對整潔的嚴格要求。地精鼠人的巢穴雜亂無章，有幾個區域的蘑菇氣味過於濃烈，以至於任何正常人都無法食用。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: The wererats light their warrens with nightlight fungi and torchstalks (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 5).
zh_tw: 鼠人用夜光菌和火把草來照亮他們的巢穴（見第5章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）。

english: Traps
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: The wererats have rigged traps throughout the warrens. All wererats know where the traps are and how to avoid them. The traps are marked with russet squares on the map. The first time a party member enters one of these areas, he or she triggers a trap unless the trap has been detected and disarmed. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine the type of trap: 1–2, spiked pit (10 feet deep and lined with zurkhwood spikes); 3–4, collapsing roof; or 5–6, poison darts. See "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for information on each trap.
zh_tw: 鼠人在地道中設定了陷阱。所有鼠人都知道陷阱的位置以及如何避開它們。陷阱在地圖上用赤褐色的方塊標記。第一次有隊員進入這些區域時，除非陷阱被探測並解除，否則他或她將觸發陷阱。擲一枚{@dice d6}來確定陷阱的型別：1-2，尖刺陷坑（深10尺，底部佈滿祖克木尖刺）；3-4，坍塌的屋頂；或5-6，毒箭。關於每個陷阱的詳細資訊，請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}"。

english: 23. Main Entrance
zh_tw: 23. 主入口

english: The svirfneblin installed locked doors to close off this section of the warrens. West of the doors, the wererats have installed a trap (see the "Traps" section in the "Goldwhisker Warrens: General Features" sidebar).
zh_tw: 侏儒安裝了帶鎖的門來封閉巢穴的這一部分。門的西邊，鼠人安裝了一個陷阱（見"金鬚族巢穴：一般特徵"側邊欄中的"陷阱"部分）。

english: Four {@creature svirfneblin wererat|OotA|svirfneblin wererats} (see "Random Encounters in Blingdenstone") attack when the characters trigger, disarm, or avoid the trap. The wererats avoid biting their enemies to minimize the risk of giving them the "gift" of wererat {@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|MM|lycanthropy}. If the characters kill two of the wererats, the survivors retreat to area 25.
zh_tw: 四名{@creature svirfneblin wererat|OotA|斯涅布力狼鼠人}（見"布靈登石城隨機遭遇"）會在角色觸發、解除或避開陷阱時發動攻擊。這些鼠人會避免咬傷敵人，以最小化將鼠人{@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|MM|獸化}的"贈禮"傳給它們的風險。如果角色殺死了兩名鼠人，生還者會撤退到區域25。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Sounds of battle here alert every other wererat in the warrens. Thereafter, the wererats can't be {@status surprised}.
zh_tw: 這裡的戰鬥聲音會驚動迷宮中的所有其他鼠人。此後，鼠人無法被{@status surprised||突襲}。

english: 24. Refuse Pile
zh_tw: 24. 垃圾堆

english: The characters notice a foul stench as they approach this cave. This chamber used to be a small residential area, with homes dug into the walls at various heights, but no one dwells here now.
zh_tw: 當角色們接近這個洞穴時，他們注意到一股難聞的惡臭。這個房間過去是一個小型住宅區，房屋在不同高度的牆壁上挖掘而成，但現在這裡已經無人居住。

english: The pile of refuse dominates the cave. It contains decomposing matter, including a pair of slimy, partially digested svirfneblin corpses. A successful {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check reveals that the gnomes were victims of some kind of ooze.
zh_tw: 一堆廢棄物佔據了洞穴的主體。它包含正在腐爛的物質，包括一對黏滑的、部分被消化的地底侏儒屍體。一次成功的 {@dc 12} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定顯示，這些侏儒是某種軟泥怪的受害者。

english: 25. Hall of Miners
zh_tw: 25. 礦工大廳

english: During Blingdenstone's heyday, this cavern held the old city's smelters and marketplace for ore and uncut gems. It's now the main square of the wererat warrens.
zh_tw: 在布靈登石城鼎盛時期，這個洞穴是舊城市的冶煉廠和礦石及未切割寶石的市場。現在，它是地精鼠人巢穴的主廣場。

english: A small crowd has gathered here. Most of the assembled creatures are deep gnomes, but some have ratlike features—including a fat specimen standing in front of the others, smiling at you with jagged buckteeth. "Peace," the big wererat says. He takes a step forward, arms extended and hands open. "Chipgrin's the name. I'm chief of the Goldwhisker clan. Shall we talk?"
zh_tw: 一小群人聚集在這裡。大多數聚集的生物是地底侏儒，但有些具有類似老鼠的特徵——包括一個站在其他人前面的胖胖的樣本，它用參差不齊的大門牙對你微笑。"和平，"大個兒地精鼠人說。他向前邁出一步，雙臂伸展，雙手張開。"名字是奇普格林。我是金鬚族的首領。我們來談談？"

english: Forty {@creature svirfneblin wererat|OotA|svirfneblin wererats} (see "Encounters in Blingdenstone") are gathered here, making combat a dangerous proposition and likely inspiring the characters to accept Chipgrin's peaceful parley. The wererat boss climbs a set of stairs to the top of a natural rise (area 26), bidding the characters to follow him.
zh_tw: 四十隻{@creature svirfneblin wererat|OotA|斯涅布力狼鼠人}（見"布靈登石城中的遭遇"）聚集在這裡，使得戰鬥成為一個危險的想法，很可能激勵角色們接受奇普格林的和平談判。鼠人首領爬上一組樓梯到達一個自然隆起的頂部（區域26），示意角色們跟隨他。

english: Chipgrin is a {@creature svirfneblin wererat|OotA} with 45 hit points and AC 14 (studded leather).
zh_tw: 奇普格林是一個{@creature svirfneblin wererat|OotA|斯涅布力狼鼠人}，擁有45生命值和14護甲等級（帶釘皮甲）。

english: 26. Chipgrin's Rise
zh_tw: 26. 奇普格林的崛起

english: The leader of the Goldwhisker clan claims this plateau as his personal retreat and also entertains guests here.
zh_tw: 金鬚族的領袖聲稱這個高地是他的個人休養地，並且也在這裡招待客人。

english: Stairs lead to the top of this rise, where the floor is covered with a soft and well-manicured carpet of green moss. The wererat chief sits on a stone chair flanked by two giant rats. Draped over the chair's back is a {@creature cave badger|OotA} pelt. "Let's get down to brass hobnails, then. You were sent by the Diggermattocks 'cause they want us out, right? Right?! Well, they might get their wish soon enough, but in a way they ain't likely to cheer about."
zh_tw: 樓梯通向這個高地的頂部，地面上覆蓋著柔軟且修剪得很好的綠色苔蘚地毯。地精鼠人首領坐在一個石椅上，兩側各有一個巨大的老鼠。石椅背上搭著一個{@creature cave badger|OotA|洞穴獾}皮。"那我們就直奔主題吧。你們是被掘鋤家族家族派來的，因為他們想讓我們離開，對吧？對吧？！嗯，他們可能很快就會如願以償，但可能不會是他們歡呼的方式。"

english: The wererats face constant attacks by the oozes and are close to fleeing the settlement and leaving the other deep gnomes to fend for themselves. However, Chipgrin has learned of the mysterious figure controlling the oozes, and he hopes to use that information to strike a bargain. If the characters are willing to hear what he has to say, Chipgrin goes on to describe the creature he refers to as "{@creature the Pudding King|OotA}."
zh_tw: 鼠人不斷遭受軟泥怪的攻擊，他們即將逃離這個定居點，讓其他地底侏儒自己設法應對。然而，奇普格林得知了一個神秘人物正在控制這些軟泥怪，他希望利用這些資訊來達成交易。如果角色們願意聽他說，奇普格林繼續描述他所指的生物，稱為"{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}"。

english: "I remember him from when he worked in the tunnels, and my kin saw him when he returned. I know who he is, what he's doing, and—most of all—where he can be found! If you and the Diggermattocks want, I can take you straight to him—he what calls himself {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}."
zh_tw: 我記得他，當他在隧道里工作時，我的族人在他回來時也見過他。我知道他是誰，他在做什麼，最重要的是——他在哪裡可以找到！如果你和掘鋤家族們想要，我可以直接把你們帶到他那裡——他自稱是{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}。

english: Map 6.5: Goldwhisker Warrens
zh_tw: 地圖6.5: 金鬚族巢穴

english: The wererat leader remains civil, but he refuses to tell the characters anything more about {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} until he has secured a meeting with the Diggermattocks. If there is any hint of violence, he calls for help.
zh_tw: 地精鼠人首領保持禮貌，但他拒絕告訴角色們更多關於{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的資訊，直到他與掘鋤家族家族安排了會面。如果有暴力的跡象，他會呼救。

english: If the characters decide to fight, all forty {@creature svirfneblin wererat|OotA|svirfneblin wererats} in the surrounding cavern (area 25) rush to attack, in addition to Chipgrin and his two {@creature Giant Rat||giant rats}. Chipgrin orders his fellow wererats to take down clerics first, then any other spellcasters, and to keep melee combatants locked down. He doesn't kill the characters, but makes sure they are infected with wererat {@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|MM|lycanthropy} before dumping them in the maze in Outer Blingdenstone (area 3).
zh_tw: 如果角色們決定戰鬥，周圍洞窟（區域25）中的所有四十個{@creature svirfneblin wererat|OotA|斯涅布力狼鼠人}都會衝過來攻擊，此外還有奇普格林和他的兩隻{@creature Giant Rat||巨鼠}。奇普格林命令他的鼠人同伴先幹掉牧師，然後是任何其他施法者，並纏住近戰戰鬥人員。他不會殺死角色們，但會確保他們在被丟進外圍布靈登石城（區域3）的迷宮之前，感染上鼠人{@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|MM|獸化}。

english: During any negotiation, Chipgrin is affable but firm in his demands. He also asks the characters if they've noticed anything odd among the svirfneblin. The wererats have noticed the greed and aggression growing among their cousins living outside Blingdenstone (see "Blingdenstone Outskirts"). However, they are unaffected by it themselves, given their bestial natures. Chipgrin doesn't know about demon lords, but he's smart and can help the characters connect the dots if they've heard of Juiblex and its unending hunger.
zh_tw: 在任何談判中，奇普格林表現得友好但堅定地提出他的要求。他還詢問角色們是否注意到了侏儒中的任何異常。鼠人注意到了居住在布靈登石城之外的表親們日益增長的貪婪和攻擊性（見"布靈登石城郊區"）。然而，由於他們自身的野蠻本性，他們自己並未受到影響。奇普格林不瞭解惡魔領主，但他很聰明，如果角色們聽說過朱庇萊克斯及其無盡的飢餓，他可以幫助角色們串聯起線索。

english: If either {@creature Topsy|OotA} or {@creature Turvy|OotA} are with the characters, Chipgrin is pleased to welcome them to the Goldwhisker clan. The twins accept the offer unless their bond of friendship with the characters inspires them to remain with the party.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西}或{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}與角色們在一起，奇普格林很高興歡迎他們加入金鬚族。這對雙胞胎會接受這個提議，除非他們與角色們的友誼紐帶促使他們選擇留在隊伍中。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: This encounter tests the characters' skills as diplomats and peacemakers. If they take Chipgrin's message to the Diggermattocks and arrange an audience, Chipgrin suggests that they stick around long enough to see what comes from "all this chit-chat and howdy-do!"
zh_tw: 這次遭遇考驗了角色們作為外交官和和平締造者的技巧。如果他們將奇普格林的資訊傳遞給掘鋤家族，並安排會面，奇普格林建議他們留下來足夠長的時間，看看'所有這些閒聊和問候'會帶來什麼。

english: 27. Secret Tunnel
zh_tw: 27. 秘密隧道

english: The wererats use this secret tunnel to enter and leave their warrens. Oozes have also been using this route to enter Blingdenstone and join {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}'s court. The secret doors are well hidden and require a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to spot.
zh_tw: 鼠人使用這個秘密隧道進出他們的領地。泥怪也利用這條路線進入布靈登石城並加入{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的宮廷。秘密門隱藏得很好，需要透過一個成功的{@dc 18}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能發現。

english: The Pudding Court
zh_tw: 布丁宮廷

english: {@creature The Pudding King|OotA} set up his court in the northwest corner of Blingdenstone, slipping through the wererat warrens with his beloved "children," {@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA} and Prince Livid (see the "Royal Oozes" sidebar). Since his return, {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} has been using the power granted him by Juiblex to summon and command every ooze in the region.
zh_tw: {@creature The Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}在布靈登石城的西北角設立了他的宮廷，帶著他心愛的'孩子們'{@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA|烏木公主}和青灰王子（見'皇家軟泥怪'側邊欄）穿過了鼠人的巢穴。自從他回來以後，{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}一直在使用朱庇萊克斯賦予他的力量，召喚並指揮該地區所有的軟泥怪。

english: Royal Oozes
zh_tw: 皇家軟泥怪

english: {@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA} is a {@creature black pudding} with an Intelligence of 6 (−2) and the ability to hurl blobs of its substance as a ranged weapon attack out to a range of 30 feet. This attack has the same attack bonus, damage, and effect as the black pudding's Pseudopod attack.
zh_tw: {@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA|烏木公主} 是一種{@creature black pudding||黑布丁}，智力為6（−2），並且能夠將其物質團塊作為遠端武器攻擊投擲出去，射程可達30尺。這種攻擊具有與黑布丁的偽足攻擊相同的攻擊加值、傷害和效果。

english: {@creature Gray Ooze||Prince Livid} is a gray ooze with 30 hit points (use the psychic gray ooze variant).
zh_tw: {@creature Gray Ooze||青灰王子} 是一種灰泥怪，有30點生命值（使用心靈感應灰泥怪變體）。

english: 28. House Center
zh_tw: 28. 房屋中心

english: This cavern was once the heart of Blingdenstone's government—a large space with a rocky sphere in its center. The sphere is hollowed out and contains the royal chambers from which the old kings and queens ruled. All of it has been transformed by the presence of {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴曾經是布靈登石城政府的核心——一箇中心有一個岩石球體的廣闊空間。這個球體是空心的，包含王室的房間，舊時的國王和王后們從這裡統治。所有這些由於{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的存在而發生了變化。

english: The walls of this great cavern are covered in slime—dripping, sickening green slime. Echoes of dripping water also fill the cave, in the center of which is a large spherical structure is held up off the floor by stone pillars. Around these pillars crawl dozens of living oozes, heaving forward while reaching out with grasping pseudopods. The sphere's surface, like the cave walls, is covered with slime. Black slime swirls with yellow and gray slime in a disgusting soup, the unearthly patterns in the movements of the slime straining your eyes and tugging at your mind. A disembodied voice fills the cave. "What's this, what's this? Visitors? Now? Not yet! We're not ready! Go away, pests! I will call upon thee and all of Blingdenstone to announce our glad tidings of the Faceless Lord to come at the proper time! Begone!"
zh_tw: 這個巨大洞穴的牆壁上覆蓋著粘液——滴落的，令人作嘔的綠色粘液。滴水的回聲也充滿了洞穴，在中心是一個大型球狀結構，由石柱將其抬離地面。在這些柱子周圍爬行著幾十個活生生的軟泥怪，它們向前推進，同時伸出抓取的偽足。球體的表面，就像洞穴的牆壁一樣，覆蓋著粘液。黑色粘液與黃色和灰色粘液混合在一起，形成一種令人厭惡的湯，粘液流動中的超自然圖案讓你的眼睛感到不適，也牽扯著你的思緒。一個空洞的聲音充滿了洞穴。"這是什麼，這是什麼？訪客？現在？還沒準備好！走開，害蟲！我將在適當的時候召喚你和整個布靈登石城來宣佈無面之主的好訊息！滾開！"

english: Map 6.6: The Pudding Court
zh_tw: 地圖 6.6: 布丁宮廷

english: Hundreds of ooze creatures congregate here, drawn by the will of {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}. They include dozens of {@creature Black Pudding||black puddings}, {@creature Gray Ooze||gray oozes}, and {@creature Ochre Jelly||ochre jellies}, as well as the occasional {@creature gelatinous cube}. If the characters intend to rush this deadly tide, warn them that retreat is a better option, and that this is a fight they aren't likely to survive without strategy and aid. See the "Battle for Blingdenstone" section for the ways the characters can return here and have a chance to triumph.
zh_tw: 數百隻軟泥生物聚集在這裡，受到{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的意志吸引。它們包括數十隻{@creature Black Pudding||黑布丁}，{@creature Gray Ooze||灰泥怪}，和{@creature Ochre Jelly||赭果凍}，以及偶爾出現的{@creature gelatinous cube||凝膠方塊}。如果角色們打算衝向這致命的潮水，警告他們撤退是更好的選擇，並且這是一場沒有策略和援助他們不太可能生還的戰鬥。請參閱"布靈登石城之戰"部分，瞭解角色們如何返回這裡並有機會取得勝利。

english: If {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} is with the party, it attempts to communicate with the other ooze creatures, telling the characters that others of its kind are calling for it to join them. The adventurers can convince the gelatinous cube not to go, but even if it does, {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} might still serve as an ace in the hole during the battle for Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}與隊伍在一起，它會試圖與其他軟泥怪生物交流，告訴角色們它的同類正在召喚它加入它們。冒險者可以說服凝膠立方體不要去，但即使它去了，{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}在布靈登石城的戰鬥中仍可能成為一張王牌。

english: The cavern is damp and has a 180-foot-high ceiling lined with dripping stalactites. The walls are covered with patches of green slime (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Any creature that comes into contact with a wall takes damage as normal.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴潮溼且有一個180尺高的天花板，上面掛滿了滴水的鐘乳石。牆壁上覆蓋著綠色的粘液（見第5章中的{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}（選自{@i 城主指南}））。任何接觸到牆壁的生物都會受到正常傷害。

english: Royal Sphere
zh_tw: 皇家球體

english: The hollowed-out stone sphere is 150 feet in diameter and elevated 10 feet off the ground, such that the top of the sphere is 20 feet below the cave ceiling. Stone ramps without railings climb 30 feet to four small, open doorways in the sides of the sphere. A patch of green slime (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) hangs above each door. The chambers the fill the sphere's interior have been scoured by the ooze creatures, leaving nothing but bare corridors and empty chambers. Even the metalwork has been corroded and eaten away. There is nothing of interest or value within.
zh_tw: 這個中空的石球直徑為150尺，高出地面10尺，使得石球的頂部位於洞穴天花板下方20尺處。沒有欄杆的石制斜坡向上延伸30尺，通往石球側面的四個小型開放入口。每個門的上方都懸掛著一塊綠色黏液（參見{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}第5章中的"{@i 城主指南}"）。填充石球內部的空間已被黏液生物徹底清理，只剩下空曠的走廊和空蕩的房間。甚至連金屬製品也被腐蝕殆盡。內部沒有任何有趣或有價值的東西。

english: 29. Ruined Stockade
zh_tw: 29. 毀壞的圍欄

english: This cavern was once a shrine for Baervan Wildwanderer, the gnomish deity known as the Father of Fish and Fungus. Now it belongs to {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴曾經是貝爾凡·野遊者的神殿，他是被稱為魚和真菌之父的侏儒神。現在它屬於{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}。

english: The sound of dripping water fills this dark cave, and various oozes slither across the walls and floor. Some sort of fungal wall or partition once divided the cave, but that barrier has been destroyed. Beyond it lies more wreckage and debris scoured clean by the oozes.
zh_tw: 滴水聲充滿了這個黑暗的洞穴，各種軟泥怪在牆壁和地板上滑行。曾經有一種真菌牆壁或隔板將洞穴分隔開來，但那個障礙已經被摧毀。在它之外是更多被軟泥怪清理乾淨的殘骸和碎片。

english: This area once contained a stockade fashioned from zurkhwood and trillimac fungi. Here, the deep gnomes kept their deep rothé (Underdark cattle). The place was ransacked during the drow invasion, and {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}'s oozes have dissolved most of what the drow left behind, including the bones of the slaughtered rothé. Two freshwater pools form along the west wall.
zh_tw: 這個區域曾經有一個由祖克木和褶扇菇真菌製成的柵欄。在這裡，地底侏儒們飼養著他們的深地洛斯獸（幽暗地域的牛）。在卓爾的入侵期間，這個地方被洗劫一空，而{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的軟泥怪溶解了卓爾留下的大部分東西，包括被屠殺的洛斯獸的骨頭。兩個淡水池塘沿著西牆形成。

english: Dozens of ooze creatures—{@creature Black Pudding||black puddings}, {@creature Gray Ooze||gray oozes}, and {@creature Ochre Jelly||ochre jellies}—inhabit this cavern. However, they don't attack intruders unless they are harmed or commanded to do so by {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}.
zh_tw: 幾十種軟泥怪生物——{@creature Black Pudding||黑布丁}、{@creature Gray Ooze||灰泥怪}和{@creature Ochre Jelly||赭果凍}——棲息在這個洞穴中。然而，除非它們受到傷害或被{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}命令，否則它們不會攻擊入侵者。

english: This cave is also home to a {@creature gibbering mouther} that isn't under the sway of Juiblex or {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}. It crept into this cave and hides among the oozes, occasionally feeding on them. It looks like a pool of reddish-brown slime in the middle of the cave until one or more characters touch it, whereupon it opens its eyes and attacks.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴也是一隻{@creature gibbering mouther||囈語之口}的棲息地，它不受朱庇萊克斯或{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的影響。它潛入這個洞穴，隱藏在軟泥怪中，偶爾以它們為食。它看起來像洞穴中央的一灘紅棕色粘液，直到一個或多個角色觸碰到它，它才會睜開眼睛並發動攻擊。

english: 30. Throne Room
zh_tw: 30. 寶座室

english: Phosphorescent lichen illuminates this cave, the floor of which is covered with pools of green slime. More green slime clings to the ceiling and forms hideous drapes along the walls. In the middle of the cave, facing east, is a slime-covered throne.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴被熒光苔蘚照亮，地面上覆蓋著綠色的粘液池。更多的綠色粘液附著在天花板上，並沿著牆壁形成可怕的帷幕。在洞穴的中央，面向東方，是一個被粘液覆蓋的寶座。

english: The {@creature The Pudding King|OotA|Pudding King} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) holds court here, attended by his royal "children," {@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA} and {@creature Gray Ooze||Prince Livid} (see the "Royal Oozes" sidebar).
zh_tw: {@creature The Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）在這裡舉行法庭，由他的皇家"孩子"，{@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA|烏木公主}和{@creature Gray Ooze||青灰王子}（見"皇家軟泥怪"側邊欄）陪同。

english: The Pudding's King's throne is made of chiseled stone and sculpted with lidless eyes and gaping mouths. A patch of green slime covers it (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). More patches of green slime hang from the ceiling and form pools on the floor. The pools are easily avoided, while the patches on the ceiling don't fall unless {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} commands them to. {@creature The Pudding King|OotA} can use a bonus action to make a patch of green slime fall from the ceiling onto a creature below.
zh_tw: 布丁王的寶座由鑿刻的石頭製成，雕塑著無眼瞼的眼睛和大張的嘴巴。一塊綠色粘液覆蓋在寶座上（詳見{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}，選自{@i 城主指南}第5章）。更多的綠色粘液從天花板上垂下，在地面上形成池塘。這些池塘很容易避開，而天花板上的粘液塊除非{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}下令，否則不會落下。{@creature The Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}可以使用一個附加動作讓一塊綠色粘液從天花板落到下方的生物身上。

english: In front of the throne is a footstool made from a squat, {@condition petrified} mushroom. The mushroom's cap can be removed, revealing a hollow compartment in the stem where {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} hides his treasure.
zh_tw: 王座前是一個用低矮的{@condition petrified||石化}蘑菇製成的腳凳。蘑菇的菌蓋可以移除，露出莖幹中的空心隔層，{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}在這裡藏匿他的寶藏。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The hidden compartment in {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}'s fungal footstool contains 55 gp, 30 ep, a {@item potion of poison} in a gourd, two {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} written on sheets of dried trillimac ({@spell conjure minor elementals} and {@spell speak with plants}), and a varnished nothic eye that functions as a {@item crystal ball of true seeing} that can be used only once.
zh_tw: 隱藏在{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的菌類腳凳中的隔間包含55金幣，30銀幣，一個裝在葫蘆裡的{@item potion of poison||劇毒藥水}，兩張寫在乾燥的褶扇菇片上的{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（{@spell conjure minor elementals||咒喚微元素群}和{@spell speak with plants||植物交談}），以及一個上漆的諾斯怪眼睛，它作為一個只能使用一次的{@item crystal ball of true seeing||真知水晶球}。

english: Battle for Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 布靈登石城之戰

english: Once the characters see how overwhelming the opposition is inside the Pudding Court, they have little choice but to retreat and report their findings to the Diggermattocks. The deep gnome leaders grimly thank them for their efforts, asking them to wait and attend a council meeting the following day.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們看到布丁法庭內部的對手壓倒性的力量，他們幾乎沒有選擇，只能撤退並向掘鋤家族家族報告他們的發現。地底侏儒的領袖們嚴肅地感謝他們的努力，並要求他們等待，參加第二天的議會會議。

english: The council meeting takes place in Diggermattock Hall (area 14) and includes Chief Dorbo and Quartermaster Senni, Nomi Pathshutter and Gurnik Tapfinger representing the Stoneheart Enclave, Kazook Pickshine representing the Miners' Guild, and Burrow Warden Jadger's ghost or Trisk Adamantelpiece representing the Burrow Wardens. If the characters talked with Chipgrin Goldwhisker and agreed to take his offer to the Diggermattocks, Dorbo and Senni invite him to attend as well.
zh_tw: 議會會議在掘鋤家族大廳（區域14）舉行，包括酋長多爾博和軍需官森妮，諾米·封徑和古爾尼克·叩指代表石心飛地，卡祖克·閃鎬代表礦工公會，以及地道守望者賈傑爾的幽靈或特里斯克·精金披肩代表地穴守衛。如果角色們與奇普格林·金鬚交談並同意將他的提議帶給掘鋤家族，多爾博和森妮也會邀請他參加。

english: Senni asks the characters to inform everyone about what they saw, after which the council debates what to do. If nobody suggests it first, Jadger's ghost says that Blingdenstone has no hope to defeat this threat if the settlement stands divided. That means counting the Goldwhisker wererats as allies and recognizing their right to rejoin the community.
zh_tw: 森妮要求角色們告知所有人他們所看到的，之後議會將討論應該採取什麼行動。如果沒人首先提出，賈傑爾的鬼魂說，如果定居點分裂，布靈登石城就沒有希望擊敗這個威脅。這意味著將金鬚族鼠人視為盟友，並承認他們重新加入社群的權利。

english: Give the characters a chance to ask questions of the svirfneblin regarding what each faction can bring to the table (see "Blingdenstone Factions").
zh_tw: 給角色們一個機會向侏儒詢問每個派系能帶來什麼（見"布靈登石城派系"）。

english: Blingdenstone Factions
zh_tw: 布靈登石城派系

english: The following sections describe what each deep gnome faction has to offer in the Battle of Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 以下部分描述了在布靈登石城之戰中每個地底侏儒派系能提供什麼。

english: The Diggermattocks
zh_tw: 掘鋤家族

english: If the characters don't suggest it, the deep gnome leaders note that fighting all the oozes might not be necessary. If the adventurers can get to {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} and destroy him, the oozes might be reduced to their typically mindless and disorganized state. A large force can serve as a distraction, while the characters sneak in from an alternate route.
zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有提出，地底侏儒的領袖們指出，可能沒有必要與所有的軟泥怪戰鬥。如果冒險者能夠到達{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}並將其摧毀，軟泥怪可能會恢復到它們通常無意識和無組織的狀態。一支大部隊可以作為分散注意力的物件，而角色們則從另一條路線潛入。

english: Dorbo Diggermattock wants the main force to attack from the temple of the Steadfast Stone. Before the battle can get underway, the temple must be cleansed (see area 22). Meanwhile, Senni Diggermattock gives Kazook Pickshine the materials he needs to create an alchemical concoction that can clear the debris blocking the way into the domains of {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}.
zh_tw: 多爾博·掘鋤希望主力部隊從堅定之石神廟發起攻擊。在戰鬥開始之前，神廟必須被淨化（見區域22）。與此同時，森妮·掘鋤給卡祖克·閃鎬提供了他需要的材料，以創造一種可以清除通往{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}領域的障礙物的鍊金藥劑。

english: The Goldwhisker Clan
zh_tw: 金鬚族

english: Chipgrin doesn't know about {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}'s deal with Juiblex, but he knows {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} can command the oozes as if they were intelligent. If the characters help convince Dorbo Diggermattock that the Goldwhisker clan belongs in Blingdenstone, the svirfneblin wererats participate in the battle and prove sturdier than the average deep gnome, taking point on any attack.
zh_tw: 奇普格林不知道{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}與朱庇萊克斯的交易，但他知道{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}能夠像指揮有智慧的生物一樣指揮軟泥怪。如果角色們幫助說服多爾博·掘鋤金鬚族屬於布靈登石城，這些侏儒鼠人將參加戰鬥，並且比一般地底侏儒更堅韌，在任何攻擊中擔任先鋒。

english: The Stoneheart Enclave
zh_tw: 石心飛地

english: Stone is a resilient defense against oozes, making earth elementals the perfect force to combat them. Nomi Pathshutter suggests that if Entémoch's Boon could be found and its summoning circle put to use, the likelihood of victory would increase greatly.
zh_tw: 石頭是對軟泥怪的彈性防禦，使土元素成為對抗它們的完美力量。諾米·封徑建議，如果能找到恩特莫克之恩並利用其召喚圈，勝利的可能性將大大增加。

english: Gurnik Tapfinger says that with Ogrémoch's Bane still lurking, any elemental brought to the battle runs the risk of being driven insane.
zh_tw: 古爾尼克·叩指說，由於歐雷莫克之災仍在潛伏，任何被帶到戰鬥中的元素生物都有被逼瘋的風險。

english: Nomi and Gurnik agree that if the Steadfast Stone is cleansed and Ogrémoch's Bane is banished, the Stoneheart Enclave can protect its elementals during the battle.
zh_tw: 諾米和古爾尼克一致認為，如果堅定之石得到淨化，歐雷莫克之災被驅逐，石心聚落可以在戰鬥中保護其元素生物。

english: The Miners' Guild
zh_tw: 礦工公會

english: Kazook Pickshine can concoct an oil to protect weapons and armor from acid corrosion, but he needs a large quantity of ingredients from Neverlight Grove. If the characters have already been in Neverlight Grove and witnessed the horror of Zuggtmoy, they can discard this idea or brave a stealthy return to the corrupted myconid haven.
zh_tw: 卡祖克·閃鎬可以調配一種油，以保護武器和盔甲不受酸性腐蝕，但他需要從無光林地獲取大量的原料。如果角色們已經去過無光林地並目睹了祖格莫伊的恐怖，他們可以放棄這個想法，或者勇敢地悄悄返回到被腐化的菌人生物的避難所。

english: Another option is to send a shipment of salt to Gracklstugh to trade for high-quality weapons. The characters could escort the caravan if they have already visited the City of Blades and have unfinished business.
zh_tw: 另一個選擇是運送一批鹽到格拉克斯圖格交換高品質武器。如果角色們已經訪問過刀刃之城並且有未完成的事務，他們可以護送商隊。

english: Svirfneblin Spirits
zh_tw: 侏儒精神

english: If the characters have not already completed Burrow Warden Jadger's tasks, doing so convinces Jadger's ghost to rally the other benevolent ghosts of Blingdenstone and join the battle.
zh_tw: 如果角色們尚未完成地道守望者賈傑爾的任務，完成它們將說服賈傑爾的鬼魂召集布靈登石城其他善良的鬼魂加入戰鬥。

english: Task List
zh_tw: 任務列表

english: The success of any plan to rid Blingdenstone of {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} and his minions is more likely if the characters complete the following tasks:
zh_tw: 如果角色們完成以下任務，任何擺脫布靈登石城的{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}和他的臣民的計劃更有可能成功：

english: Convince Dorbo Diggermattock that the Goldwhisker clan deserves to live in Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 說服多爾博·掘鋤金鬚族群有資格居住在布靈登石城。

english: Find Entémoch's Boon.
zh_tw: 尋找恩特莫克之恩。

english: Cleanse the Steadfast Stone (area 22).
zh_tw: 淨化堅定之石（區域22）。

english: Travel to Neverlight Grove and harvest a wagon load of ingredients among its fungal pools and fields.
zh_tw: 前往無光林地並在其真菌池和田野中收集一車貨物的原料。

english: Escort a salt shipment to Gracklstugh to trade for duergar-made weapons.
zh_tw: 護送一批鹽貨物到格拉克斯圖格，以交換由灰矮人制造的武器。

english: Complete one or both tasks set forth by the ghost of Burrow Warden Jadger (see area 8).
zh_tw: 完成由地道守望者賈傑爾的鬼魂設定的一個或兩個任務（見區域8）。

english: Let the players come up with other ideas that might help, such as asking for aid from the stone giants of Gracklstugh or stealing magic weapons from the drow. Some quests might take time to complete, since they require travel through the Underdark.
zh_tw: 讓玩家們提出其他可能有幫助的想法，例如請求格拉克斯圖格的石巨人援助或從卓爾那裡偷取魔法武器。一些任務可能需要時間來完成，因為它們需要穿越幽暗地域。

english: See the "Benefits for Completing Tasks" sidebar for benefits that the characters gain during the Battle of Blingdenstone if they complete certain tasks.
zh_tw: 檢視'完成任務的益處'側邊欄，瞭解角色在布靈登石城之戰中如果完成特定任務所能獲得的益處。

english: Cry Havoc!
zh_tw: 戰爭號令

english: When the characters feel that they have attained their goals and secured their resources, the battle for Blingdenstone can begin.
zh_tw: 當角色們感覺他們已經實現了他們的目標並確保了他們的資源時，布靈登石城之戰就可以開始了。

english: Earth elementals under the control of the Stoneheart Enclave lead the charge, followed by the wererats of Clan Goldwhisker. Svirfneblin under Chief Dorbo Diggermattock form the rearguard and provide ranged support. If the ghosts participate, they attack from above and below. The plan is to get the characters to {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} while the other factions hold the oozes at bay.
zh_tw: 石心飛地控制下的土元素帶頭衝鋒，緊隨其後的是金鬚族的鼠人。在酋長多爾博·掘鋤領導下的地底侏儒組成後衛並提供遠端支援。如果幽靈參與，他們從上方和下方發動攻擊。計劃是在其他派系牽制軟泥怪的同時，讓角色們接近{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}。

english: To reach {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}, the characters must face {@dice 1d4 + 2} encounters, minus one encounter per goal achieved in the "Task List" section. Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the Battle of Blingdenstone Encounters table to determine each encounter.
zh_tw: 為了到達{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}，角色們必須面對{@dice 1d4 + 2}次遭遇，每在"任務列表"部分完成一個目標就減少一次遭遇。擲一個{@dice d6}骰子，並參照布靈登石城戰鬥遭遇表來確定每一次遭遇。

english: Benefits for Completing Tasks
zh_tw: 完成任務的好處

english: Completing certain tasks in Blingdenstone can provide the characters with benefits and allies in the final battle.
zh_tw: 在布靈登石城完成特定任務可以為角色提供好處和盟友來參與最終的戰鬥。

english: If the characters find Entémoch's Boon and share its location with the svirfneblin, or if they cleanse the temple of Callarduran Smoothhands (area 22), an earth elemental aids them. If the characters completed both tasks, the elemental has 15 additional hit points.
zh_tw: 如果角色們發現了恩特莫克之恩並與地底侏儒分享了它的位置，或者他們淨化了卡勒杜蘭·平滑之手的聖殿（區域22），一個土元素將會援助他們。如果角色們完成了這兩項任務，該元素將額外獲得15點生命值。

english: If the characters fetch the ingredients from Neverlight Grove, their metal equipment is immune to the corrosive effects of oozes.
zh_tw: 如果角色們從無光林地取回原料，他們的金屬裝備將對軟泥怪的腐蝕效果免疫。

english: If the characters procure weapons in Gracklstugh, they can call for ranged artillery support during the Battle of Blingdenstone. Each character deals 2 extra damage with each attack during the "Cry Havoc!" encounters, representing covering fire from svirfneblin using duergar-made crossbows.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在格拉克斯圖格獲得了武器，他們可以在布靈登石城之戰中請求遠端炮火支援。在'戰爭號令!'遭遇戰中，每個角色每次攻擊額外造成2點傷害，代表使用灰矮人制造的十字弓的侏儒提供的掩護火力。

english: If the characters complete the tasks set before them by Burrow Warden Jadger, each character can reroll one attack roll or saving throw during the Battle of Blingdenstone as a ghost emerges from the ground to distract foes.
zh_tw: 如果角色們完成了地道守望者賈傑爾交給他們的任務，那麼在布靈登石城之戰期間，每名角色可以重擲一次攻擊骰或豁免骰，因為會有幽靈從地面浮現幹擾敵人。

english: If the characters befriended {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} and brought it to Blingdenstone, the intelligent gelatinous cube joins the battle as their ally. If {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} left the party previously, it can reappear as a surprise ally during the battle.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}成為朋友並將其帶到布靈登石城，這個聰明的凝膠立方體會作為他們的盟友加入戰鬥。如果{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}之前離開了隊伍，它可能會在戰鬥中作為意外的盟友重新出現。

english: Battle of Blingdenstone Encounters
zh_tw: 布靈登石城之戰遭遇戰

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: 1 {@creature black pudding} and 2 {@creature Gray Ooze||gray oozes}
zh_tw: 1個{@creature black pudding||黑布丁}和2個{@creature Gray Ooze||灰泥怪}

english: 1 {@creature gelatinous cube} and 1 {@creature ochre jelly}
zh_tw: 1個{@creature gelatinous cube||凝膠方塊}和1個{@creature ochre jelly||赭果凍}

english: 3 {@creature Gray Ooze||gray oozes} and 1 {@creature ochre jelly}
zh_tw: 3個{@creature Gray Ooze||灰泥怪}和1個{@creature ochre jelly||赭果凍}

english: 2 {@creature Black Pudding||black puddings}
zh_tw: 2 {@creature Black Pudding||黑布丁}

english: During the battle, the voice of {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} can be heard through the layers of oozing miasma, crying out "Fight for your king!" and "Glory to the Faceless Lord!"
zh_tw: 在戰鬥中，可以透過層層流動的迷霧聽到{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的聲音，他高呼著'為你們的國王而戰！'和'榮耀歸於無面之主！'

english: Oozing Royalty
zh_tw: 流淌的王權

english: When the characters defeat the last group of oozes, but before they reach area 30, {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} appears.
zh_tw: 當角色們擊敗最後一群軟泥怪，但在到達區域30之前，{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}出現了。

english: The insane, slime-covered deep gnome points at you and cackles. "Devour them, my precious children! Make your father proud!" He then bolts as two oozes drop from the ceiling in front of you, their dark forms flowing in your direction with unsettling awareness and malevolence.
zh_tw: 這個瘋狂、渾身粘液覆蓋的地底侏儒指著你併發出尖笑。"吞噬他們，我的寶貝孩子們！讓你們的父親感到驕傲！"隨後他逃跑了，因為兩個軟泥怪從你面前的天花板上掉落下來，它們黑暗的形態帶著令人不安的意識和惡意向你流動。

english: The characters must contend with {@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA} and {@creature Gray Ooze||Prince Livid} (see the "Royal Oozes" sidebar). These dimly intelligent oozes defend their master to the death, blocking the characters from reaching the {@creature The Pudding King|OotA|Pudding King} as he retreats to his throne room (area 30).
zh_tw: 角色們必須與{@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA|烏木公主}和{@creature Gray Ooze||青灰王子}（見"皇家軟泥怪"側邊欄）進行對抗。這些智慧有限的軟泥怪誓死保衛它們的主人，阻止角色們接近正在退向其寶座室（區域30）的{@creature The Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}。

english: {@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA} engages in melee, protecting Prince Livid as it uses its Psychic Crush attack. Prince Livid prefers to slink and hide while its Psychic Crush attack recharges.
zh_tw: {@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA|烏木公主} 參與近戰，保護青灰王子，同時使用其心靈衝擊攻擊。青灰王子更傾向於潛行和隱藏，同時其心靈衝擊攻擊正在充能。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: When {@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA} dies, the black pudding disgorges a pair of spellbooks with covers made from troglodyte hide and pages made from trillimac fungus (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2). The covers and pages are coated with a magical varnish that renders them immune to acid damage, protecting them from the pudding's digestive juices. The varnish also protects against water damage.
zh_tw: 當{@creature Princess Ebonmire|OotA|烏木公主}死亡時，黑布丁吐出一對由穴蜥人皮製成的封面和由褶扇菇真菌製成的頁面的法術書（見第2章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）。封面和頁面塗有一層使它們免受強酸傷害的神奇清漆，保護它們不受布丁消化液的侵蝕。這種清漆還可以防止水的損害。

english: A svirfneblin archmage named Lesla Carrowil authored both spellbooks. The wizard spells contained in each book are listed below; feel free to swap out any spell with another of the same level.
zh_tw: 一位名叫蕾絲拉·卡羅威爾的地底侏儒大法師撰寫了這兩本法術書。每本書中包含的法師法術如下所列；您可以隨意將任何法術替換為同一等級的其他法術。
