english: The Pudding King
zh_tw: 布丁王

english: The mad svirfneblin waits for the characters in his disgusting throne room. If the characters haven't seen the throne room before, read the boxed text description of the room (see area 30) and add the following:
zh_tw: 瘋狂的地底侏儒在它令人作嘔的寶座室裡等待著角色們。如果角色們之前沒有見過寶座室，請閱讀房間的框內文字描述（見區域30），並新增以下內容：

english: {@creature The Pudding King|OotA} cowers behind his slime-covered throne and chortles in his joy. "Callooh! Callay! Now you can join the party!" he cackles. "You can be one with the Faceless Lord. Just let yourselves be eaten and disgorged!"
zh_tw: {@creature The Pudding King|OotA|布丁王} 蜷縮在他那覆蓋著粘液的寶座後面，自得其樂地咯咯笑著。"卡洛！卡萊！現在你們可以加入派對了！"他咯咯地笑著。"你們可以與無面領主合為一體。只要讓自己被吃掉再被吐出來就行了！"

english: The {@creature The Pudding King|OotA|Pudding King} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) prefers to cast spells while using the throne for cover. As a bonus action on his turn, he commands a patch of green slime to drop from the ceiling onto one randomly determined party member (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for the rules and effects of green slime).
zh_tw: {@creature The Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）喜歡在寶座的掩護下施放法術。在他的回合上，作為一個附贈動作，他命令一灘綠色粘液從天花板上滴落到一個隨機決定的隊員身上（見《地下城主指南》第5章中的'{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}'，瞭解綠色粘液的規則和效果）。

english: When one or more of the characters close to within reach of {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}, he laughs madly as he tears away his humanoid guise and transforms into an ooze. When he reaches 0 hit points, he shrieks as he dissolves into a dense puddle of goo. Read the following boxed text as he expires:
zh_tw: 當一個或多個角色靠近到可以觸及{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}時，他瘋狂地笑著，撕下他的類人偽裝，變成了一團軟泥。當他的生命值降至0時，他尖叫著溶解成一灘濃密的粘液。在他死去時，閱讀以下方框中的文字：

english: "You haven't won! No! We will rise from our children! We will be reborn from the Faceless Lord! Juiblex will consume the banquet of the Queen of Fungi and we... will... all... grow... !"
zh_tw: "你們沒有贏！不！我們將從我們的孩子們中崛起！我們將從無面領主那裡重生！朱庇萊克斯將吞噬真菌女王的宴會，而我們......將......全部......成長......！"

english: With {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} gone, the oozes lose their organization, but they are still too many and the svirfneblin sound the call to retreat. Three {@creature galeb duhr} led by the ghost of Burrow Warden Jadger arrive to take the characters to safety. If the svirfneblin of Blingdenstone didn't already have a friendly attitude, they become friendly toward the characters after the battle.
zh_tw: 隨著{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的離去，軟泥怪失去了組織，但它們仍然太多，地底侏儒發出撤退的訊號。由地道守望者賈傑爾的鬼魂帶領的三隻{@creature galeb duhr||石人}抵達，將角色們帶到安全地帶。如果布靈登石城的地底侏儒之前沒有友好的態度，他們在戰鬥後會對角色們變得友好。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Back in Diggermattock Hall, the gnome leaders make good on their promise, giving the characters a {@item stone of controlling earth elementals} along with the gratitude of their people.
zh_tw: 回到掘鋤大廳，侏儒領袖們兌現了他們的承諾，給予角色們一塊{@item stone of controlling earth elementals||命令土元素石核}，以及他們人民的感激之情。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: If the characters participated in the battle, they gain a special award of 200 XP each.
zh_tw: 如果角色們參與了戰鬥，他們每人將獲得200 XP的特殊獎勵。

english: Leaving Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 離開布靈登石城

english: The characters can leave Blingdenstone as heroes of the svirfneblin. If they express interest in visiting other Underdark locations, the deep gnomes give them whatever help they can, including placing them in a caravan to Gracklstugh or Neverlight Grove. If the characters ask for help reaching the surface world, the gnomes guiding them to a tunnel that leads there (eventually). They also provide enough food, water, and other basic supplies for the party's journey.
zh_tw: 角色們可以作為地底侏儒的英雄離開布靈登石城。如果他們表示有興趣訪問其他幽暗地域的地點，地底侏儒會盡他們所能提供幫助，包括安排他們加入前往格拉克斯圖格或無光林地的商隊。如果角色請求幫助到達地表世界，侏儒們會引導他們到一條通往那裡的隧道（最終）。他們還為隊伍的旅程提供了足夠的食物、水和其他基本物資。

english: The characters achieve a great victory if they defeat {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}, but their victory is incomplete. {@creature The Pudding King|OotA}'s death is a small setback for Juiblex, and the demon lord might send another minion to command the remaining oozes in Blingdenstone until they are destroyed.
zh_tw: 如果角色們擊敗了{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}，他們將取得一次偉大的勝利，但他們的勝利是不完整的。{@creature The Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的死亡對朱庇萊克斯來說只是一個小挫折，惡魔領主可能會派遣另一個手下指揮布靈登石城剩餘的軟泥怪，直到它們被消滅。

english: The "banquet" {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} referred to is the demonic rite of domination through which Zuggtmoy plans to transform the Underdark into her new abyssal domain. See chapter 16, "{@adventure The Fetid Wedding|OotA|15}," for more information.
zh_tw: "宴會"{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}提到的是祖格莫伊計劃透過統治的惡魔儀式將幽暗地域轉變為她新的深淵領域。更多資訊請見第16章"{@adventure 惡臭的婚禮|OotA|15}"。

english: Chapter 7: Escape from the Underdark
zh_tw: 第7章：逃離幽暗地域

english: This chapter marks the midpoint of {@i Out of the Abyss} and sees the characters finally make their way out of the Underdark. Before their final push to freedom, however, the vengeful drow pursuing the adventurers catch up to them, intent on dragging them back to their domain of perpetual darkness.
zh_tw: 本章標誌著《{@i 逃離深淵}》的中點，角色們終於找到了離開幽暗地域的道路。然而，在他們最終邁向自由之前，追蹤冒險者的復仇卓爾追上了他們，意圖將他們拖回永恆的黑暗領地。

english: If they survive this final confrontation, the characters reach the surface in a place of your choosing. After all their arduous adventures, they are finally safe to return to their homes, and must say goodbye to many of the NPCs who've been traveling with them. Though the characters don't yet know it, their exploits in the Underdark will bring them to the attention of the dwarves of Gauntlgrym, setting the stage for {@adventure chapter 8|OotA|7} and a new call to adventure.
zh_tw: 如果他們在這場最終對決中倖存下來，角色們將在你選擇的地方到達地表。經過所有艱苦的冒險後，他們終於安全地返回家園，並必須向許多與他們一起旅行的NPC告別。儘管角色們還不知道，他們在幽暗地域的壯舉將引起岡特格瑞姆的矮人們的注意，為{@adventure 第八章|OotA|7}和新的冒險召喚鋪平了道路。

english: By the time they reach this point, the characters should be at least 7th level, having overcome countless challenges in their wild and dangerous journey through the locations described in chapters 1 through 6. They should also have reached a terrible conclusion: multiple demon lords of the Abyss are at large in the Underdark and could soon threaten the surface world.
zh_tw: 當他們到達這一點時，角色們至少應該是7級，已經克服了在第1章到第6章描述的地點中遇到的無數挑戰。他們還應該得出一個可怕的結論：無底深淵中的多個惡魔領主在幽暗地域中自由行動，並且可能很快威脅到地表世界。

english: The Way Out
zh_tw: 出路

english: Since their escape from Velkynvelve in {@area chapter 1|022|x}, the characters have sought a way out of the Underdark. Given the somewhat free-form nature of chapters 2 through 6, which the characters can undertake in any order, it's up to you to determine how and where the adventurers finally find their escape route, as best suits the story of their journey through the Underdark.
zh_tw: 自從他們在{@area 第一章|022|x}逃離維爾京維爾夫以來，角色們一直在尋找離開幽暗地域的途徑。鑑於第2章到第6章的自由形式性質，角色們可以以任何順序進行這些章節，因此由你決定冒險者最終如何以及在哪裡找到他們的逃生路線，以最適合他們穿越幽暗地域的旅程故事。

english: Finding the Way
zh_tw: 找到道路

english: Escaping the Underdark is no simple matter. Characters who try to find their own way out might wander for years without stumbling upon the right series of passages to take them to the surface. As the DM, you determine where and when they find the way out. The characters can visit the places described in chapters 3 through 6, using the interconnecting material in chapters 2 and 3, in virtually any order. This makes it problematic to put the way to the surface world in a particular place, since the adventurers could just as easily bypass it as stumble upon it prematurely. Instead, the characters' escape is made possible by a set of conditions that you can implement when the time is right.
zh_tw: 逃離幽暗地域並非易事。試圖自己找到出路的角色可能會漫無目的地徘徊多年，而無法偶然發現正確的通道系列將他們帶到地表。作為地下城主，你決定他們何時何地找到出路。角色們可以訪問第3章到第6章描述的地方，使用第2章和第3章中的相互連線的材料，幾乎可以以任何順序進行。這使得將通往地表世界的路放在一個特定的地方變得有問題，因為冒險者們同樣容易繞過它，也可能過早地偶然發現它。相反，角色們的逃脫是透過一組條件實現的，你可以在適當的時候實施這些條件。

english: Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 布靈登石城

english: The deep gnome settlement (see {@adventure chapter 6|OotA|5}) has the most dealings with the surface world of any community in this region of the Underdark, and the adventurers can find the resources there to guide them out. However, the deep gnomes are dealing with a number of looming threats to their settlement, and they can't afford to help the characters unless the characters help them first.
zh_tw: 地底侏儒定居點（見{@adventure 第六章|OotA|5}）是這個幽暗地域區域中與地表世界打交道最多的社群，冒險者們可以在那裡找到引導他們出去的資源。然而，地底侏儒正在應對一系列迫在眉睫的威脅，他們無法幫助角色們，除非角色們先幫助他們。

english: Since Blingdenstone is the most obvious and reliable location from which to find a way out of the Underdark, you might want to steer the campaign to other locations first. This can be done by treating the other chapters as side adventures to the characters' main journey, with many of those side adventures focused on the characters helping their NPC companions return to their homes in the Underdark.
zh_tw: 由於布靈登石城是最明顯且可靠的離開幽暗地域的地點，您可能想要首先引導戰役到其他地點。這可以透過將其他章節作為角色主要旅程的支線冒險來完成，其中許多支線冒險集中在角色幫助他們的NPC同伴返回他們在幽暗地域的家園。

english: Gracklstugh
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格

english: The duergar of Gracklstugh have fewer dealings with the surface world compared to other Underdark races, relying more on trade flowing through Mantol-Derith (see {@adventure chapter 9|OotA|8}). The paranoid duergar are reluctant to share known routes to the surface world, so the adventurers need to cultivate considerable influence with the gray dwarves to earn such a prize.
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格的灰矮人相較於其他幽暗地域種族與地表世界的聯絡較少，他們更依賴於透過曼塔-岱瑞絲的貿易（參見{@adventure 第九章|OotA|8}）。這些偏執的灰矮人不願分享已知的通往地表世界的路線，因此冒險者需要與這些灰矮人建立深厚的影響力才能獲得這樣的獎勵。

english: The Wormwrithings
zh_tw: 蠕蟲扭道

english: The drow of Menzoberranzan know of several tunnels in this region of the Underdark that lead to the surface world. Characters lucky enough to find one eventually emerge in the Lurkwood, a forest south of the Spine of the World mountains. For more information on the Wormwrithings, see {@adventure chapter 13|OotA|12}.
zh_tw: 魔索布萊城的卓爾知道這個幽暗地域區域有幾個通往地表世界的隧道。足夠幸運找到其中一條的角色最終會出現在潛行森林，這是位於世界之脊山脈以南的一片森林。有關蠕蟲扭道的更多資訊，請見{@adventure 第十三章|OotA|12}。

english: Farther Afield
zh_tw: 更遠的地方

english: Various other tunnels and passages wend their way to the surface in places around the Evermoors or even more remote locations. You can place these wherever you like, if an opportune time for the characters to depart comes along before exploring any of the previous options.
zh_tw: 各種其他的隧道和通道在埃弗摩爾斯周圍或甚至更偏遠的地方蜿蜒通往地表。如果角色在探索之前的任何選項之前，出現了合適的時機離開，你可以隨意放置這些通道。

english: Portals
zh_tw: 傳送門

english: A number of ancient portals can be found in the Underdark. A functional portal is a magical doorway leading to some other specific location in Faerûn. If the characters' choices during the adventure leave them unable to secure escape with the help of the NPCs they meet, you could place a portal in or near one of the locations explored in chapters 2 through 6. If the portal is damaged, the characters might need to repair it. The characters also need to figure out how to activate the portal, or find the key or spell necessary to activate it. A portal can be one-way only and send the adventurers anywhere you want.
zh_tw: 在幽暗地域可以找到一些古老的傳送門。一個功能正常的傳送門是一個通往費倫某個特定地點的魔法門。如果角色在冒險中的選擇使他們無法在他們遇到的NPC的幫助下確保逃脫，你可以在第2章到第6章探索的地點之一或附近放置一個傳送門。如果傳送門損壞了，角色可能需要修復它。角色還需要弄清楚如何啟用傳送門，或者找到啟用它所需的鑰匙或法術。傳送門可能只是單向的，可以將冒險者送到任何你想要他們去的地方。

english: Gaining Access
zh_tw: 獲得入口

english: By the time they have visited the locations detailed in the previous chapters, the characters should have knowledge of a route to the surface world and a map or guide to help them navigate it. These two goals should serve as tools to help motivate the players throughout the earlier chapters of the adventure. As a reward in one chapter, the characters might learn of the existence of a potential route out, leading them to another location in the Underdark where it is supposed to be. Then they need to find a map or guide for the potential route, which could involve them in what is happening in the new location. To complicate the search, they might then discover that a route or guide isn't all they had hoped for, but instead leads them to more promising options.
zh_tw: 當他們訪問了前幾章詳細描述的地點後，角色們應該已經知道了通往地表世界的路線，並且擁有一張地圖或嚮導來幫助他們導航。這兩個目標應該作為工具，幫助激勵玩家在冒險的早期章節中。作為一章中的獎勵，角色們可能瞭解到一條潛在的出路的存在，引導他們前往幽暗地域中的另一個地點，那裡據說有出路。然後他們需要為潛在的路線找到一張地圖或嚮導，這可能涉及到他們在新地點發生的事情。為了使搜尋更加複雜，他們可能隨後發現一條路線或嚮導並不是他們所希望的一切，而是引導他們找到有希望的選擇。

english: As an example, the characters might hear of a potential route to the surface from Gracklstugh. They go to the duergar city and become embroiled in events unfolding there, only to be denied access by the gray dwarves. However, meeting a group of wandering myconids in the city reveals that the myconids of Neverlight Grove know a great deal about the hidden ways of the Underdark.
zh_tw: 例如，角色們可能聽說從格拉克斯圖格有一條可能通往地表的路線。他們前往這個灰矮人城市，並捲入那裡正在發生的事件中，結果卻被灰矮人拒之門外。然而，在一個流浪的菌人群體中遇到，揭示了無光林地的菌人對幽暗地域隱藏的道路知之甚多。

english: Clues and leads should become more plentiful and substantial as the characters approach 7th level, leading them toward their eventual escape route—and with many adventures and encounters happening along the way. If you hand out these hints and opportunities carefully, the characters' path through the Underdark should feel like a smoothly escalating series of discoveries, no matter what order they chose to explore the locations and deal with the challenges of the previous chapters.
zh_tw: 隨著角色接近7級，線索和提示應該變得更加豐富和具體，引導他們走向最終的逃脫路線——沿途還會發生許多冒險和遭遇。如果你仔細地分發這些提示和機會，角色們穿越幽暗地域的路徑應該感覺像是一系列平穩升級的發現，無論他們選擇什麼順序探索地點和應對前幾章的挑戰。

english: Bidding Farewell
zh_tw: 告別

english: When the characters finally reach the surface, it's likely that some of their subterranean companions will choose to remain in the Underdark rather than face the perils of the surface world.
zh_tw: 當角色們最終到達地表時，很可能他們的一些地下同伴會選擇留在幽暗地域中，而不是面對地表世界的險惡。

english: Underdark Natives
zh_tw: 幽暗地域原住民

english: Knowing that many of their NPC companions have homes in the Underdark can be an important part of the decision-making process that guides the characters through the early chapters of this adventure. The Underdark is a dangerous place, and characters might be reluctant to let their newfound friends fend for themselves. Helping some of them return home makes a good incentive to visit locations in the Underdark. {@creature Shuushar the Awakened|OotA|Shuushar}, {@creature Topsy|OotA}, {@creature Turvy|OotA}, {@creature Stool|OotA}, {@creature Rumpadump|OotA}, and {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} would rather remain in the Underdark than suffer sunlight.
zh_tw: 知道他們的許多NPC同伴在幽暗地域有家，可能是引導角色們在本冒險早期章節中做出決策的重要部分。幽暗地域是個危險的地方，角色們可能不願讓新結識的朋友們自生自滅。幫助其中一些人回家，為造訪幽暗地域的地點提供了良好動機。{@creature Shuushar the Awakened|OotA|舒沙爾}、{@creature Topsy|OotA|託普西}、{@creature Turvy|OotA|特威}、{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}、{@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普}和{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}寧願留在幽暗地域也不願忍受陽光。

english: Surface Dwellers
zh_tw: 地表居民

english: Companions such as {@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA|Eldeth} and {@creature Ront|OotA}, who prefer to live on or near the surface, gladly follow the characters all the way out if they can. Eldeth wishes to return to Gauntlgrym, and her presence there can provide a connection for the characters when they visit the dwarven settlement in {@adventure chapter 8|OotA|7}. If Eldeth didn't survive, she might have charged the characters with returning her body or effects to Gauntlgrym. {@creature Ront|OotA} might wish to rejoin his tribe or seek a new home elsewhere, based on how the events in the earlier chapters of the adventure have influenced him. Depending on how he was treated, the orc most likely parts from the characters in peace—out of respect for their battle prowess, if nothing else.
zh_tw: 像偏好居住在地表或附近的同伴，例如{@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA|艾爾德絲}和{@creature Ront|OotA|榮特}，如果可能的話會很高興跟隨角色們一路離開。艾爾德絲希望返回岡特格瑞姆，她的存在可以為角色們在訪問{@adventure 第八章|OotA|7}中的矮人聚居地時提供聯絡。如果艾爾德絲未能倖存，她可能已委託角色們將她的遺體或遺物帶回岡特格瑞姆。{@creature Ront|OotA|榮特}可能希望重新加入他的部落或在別處尋找新家，這取決於冒險早期章節的事件對他的影響。根據他所受到的對待，這個獸人很可能會與角色們和平分別——即便不為別的，也是出於對他們戰鬥能力的尊重。

english: With Friends Like These...
zh_tw: 有這樣朋友......

english: {@creature Buppido|OotA}, {@creature Prince Derendil|OotA}, and Sarith might be gone well before the adventurers are ready to return to the surface, having already revealed their dark secrets and treacherous natures.
zh_tw: {@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}、{@creature Prince Derendil|OotA|德倫迪爾王子}和薩里斯可能在冒險者準備好返回地表之前就已經離開了，因為他們已經揭示了他們的黑暗秘密和背叛的本性。

english: If {@creature Buppido|OotA} or Sarith are still around, either NPC could go mad and attempt to kill the adventurers before they reach the surface world. Derendil might still hold to his delusion of being an elf prince wanting to return to his forest kingdom. However, the quaggoth is poorly suited to travel on the surface, needing shelter from the light during the day. He becomes increasingly irrational and erratic, seeing enemies and plots everywhere, until he eventually accuses the characters of colluding with his enemies and attacks in a mad fury.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Buppido|OotA|布皮多}或薩里斯還在附近，任何一個NPC都可能發瘋並試圖在冒險者到達地表世界之前殺死他們。德倫迪爾可能仍然堅持他作為精靈王子的錯覺，想要返回他的森林王國。然而，幽邃熊怪不適合在地表旅行，需要在白天躲避光線。他變得越來越不理智和反覆無常，到處看到敵人和陰謀，直到他最終指控角色們與他的敵人勾結，並在瘋狂的憤怒中發起攻擊。

english: Confronting the Drow
zh_tw: 面對卓爾

english: The drow from Velkynvelve have pursued their escaped prisoners throughout the first half of the adventure. Along the way, they might have engaged the characters in combat or set up a number of near-miss encounters. At times, the adventurers might have believed they had shaken off their pursuers for good, only to have the drow show up unexpectedly. The characters' departure from the Underdark offers the final opportunity for them to confront their pursuers and settle the score.
zh_tw: 來自維爾京維爾夫的卓爾在冒險的前半部分一直在追蹤他們逃脫的囚犯。一路上，他們可能與角色們進行了戰鬥或設定了一系列幾乎遭遇的情況。有時，冒險者可能認為他們已經徹底擺脫了追蹤者，只有卓爾出人意料地出現。角色們離開幽暗地域提供了最終機會，讓他們面對追蹤者並解決分數。

english: The possibility that her prey might escape drives Ilvara onward. In turn, she relentlessly pushes those under her command to redouble their efforts to catch the characters. At this point, the pursuit level tracking set out in {@area chapter 2|078|x} is no longer relevant. Ilvara and her warriors catch up to the adventurers just before they reach the uppermost level of the Underdark. The adventurers can choose to lead the drow on a risky chase, or stand and fight.
zh_tw: 她的獵物可能逃脫的恐懼驅使伊爾瓦拉不斷前進。相應地，她無情地逼迫她的部下加倍努力抓捕角色們。此時，{@area 第二章|078|x}中設定的追蹤等級已不再適用。就在冒險者們即將到達幽暗地域最上層時，伊爾瓦拉和她的戰士們追上了他們。冒險者們可以選擇帶領這些卓爾進行一場危險的追逐，或是選擇停下來戰鬥。

english: Drow Chase
zh_tw: 卓爾追逐

english: If the adventurers flee from the drow, use the chase rules in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Chases} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} to play out the pursuit. The drow are on foot. If she gets close enough to do so, Ilvara tries to cut off the party's escape by casting {@spell web} across the tunnel ahead. In addition to giving chase, the {@creature drow} in the pursuit party pepper the characters with poisoned crossbow bolts, hoping to render some of them {@condition unconscious}.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者逃離卓爾，使用{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Chases}（選自《{@i 城主指南}》）的追逐規則來模擬追逐過程。卓爾是步行追擊。如果距離足夠近，伊爾瓦拉會嘗試透過在前方隧道施放{@spell web||蛛網術}來切斷隊伍的逃跑路線。除了追擊之外，追逐隊伍中的{@creature drow||卓爾}還會用毒弩箭射擊角色，希望使其中一些人陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}。

english: Chase Complications
zh_tw: 追逐中的意外

english: Each participant in the chase rolls a {@dice d20} at the end of its turn and consults the Drow Chase Complications table. The result (if any) affects the next chase participant in initiative order.
zh_tw: 追逐中的每個參與者在回合結束時擲一個{@dice d20}，並查閱卓爾追逐併發症表。結果（如果有）將影響下一位按主動順序的追逐參與者。

english: If the characters escape from the drow, they can exit the Underdark unopposed. Ilvara returns in disgrace with nothing to show for her considerable efforts, although she and others from Velkynvelve might reappear when the adventurers return to the Underdark (see chapter 15, "{@adventure The City of Spiders|OotA|14}").
zh_tw: 如果角色們從卓爾手中逃脫，他們可以不受阻礙地離開幽暗地域。伊爾瓦拉帶著恥辱返回，儘管她付出了很大的努力，卻一無所獲，儘管她和來自維爾京維爾夫的其他人可能會在冒險者返回幽暗地域時再次出現（見第15章，"{@adventure 蜘蛛之城|OotA|14}"）。

english: If you want to extend the chase, the drow could pursue the characters onto the surface, which places them at a disadvantage once the sun comes up (see "Evening the Odds").
zh_tw: 如果你想延長追逐，卓爾可以追擊角色們到地表，這將在太陽昇起時給他們帶來不利（見"平衡機會"）。

english: If the drow catch up with the characters, the chase becomes a combat (see "Stand and Fight").
zh_tw: 如果卓爾追上了角色們，追逐就會變成戰鬥（見"站立並戰鬥"）。

english: Stand and Fight
zh_tw: 停下來戰鬥

english: If the characters stand and fight, or if the drow catch them, they're in for a tough battle. Ilvara alone is a challenge for a group of 8th-level characters, and she is accompanied by her most powerful servants. The attacking drow force consists of the following:
zh_tw: 如果角色們選擇站立並戰鬥，或者如果卓爾追上了他們，他們將面臨一場艱苦的戰鬥。伊爾瓦拉一個人就足以挑戰一組8級角色，並且她身邊還有她最強大的僕從。攻擊的卓爾部隊由以下組成：

english: Ilvara, {@creature drow priestess of Lolth}, armed with a {@item tentacle rod} in addition to the usual equipment
zh_tw: 伊爾瓦拉，{@creature drow priestess of Lolth||卓爾羅絲女祭司}，除了常規裝備外，還配備了一根{@item tentacle rod||觸鬚權杖}

english: {@creature Asha Vandree|OotA|Asha}, junior drow priestess (use the {@creature priest} stat block in the {@i Monster Manual}, but give Asha the Fey Ancestry, Innate Spellcasting, and Sunlight Sensitivity features of a typical drow)
zh_tw: {@creature Asha Vandree|OotA|阿莎}，低階卓爾祭司（使用{@creature priest||祭司}{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的屬性資料，但給予阿莎典型卓爾的精類血統、天生施法和陽光敏感特性）

english: Shoor and Jorlan, {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} (Jorlan has disadvantage on attack rolls, Dexterity checks, and Dexterity saving throws)
zh_tw: 修爾和喬蘭，{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}（喬蘭在攻擊檢定、敏捷檢定和敏捷豁免檢定上具有劣勢）

english: Four {@creature drow} warriors
zh_tw: 四名{@creature drow||卓爾}戰士

english: If any of the named drow were killed in chapter 1, they have been replaced by other drow with similar statistics.
zh_tw: 如果任何命名的卓爾在第1章中被殺，他們已經被具有類似具體數值的其他卓爾所替代。

english: On her first turn in combat, Ilvara casts {@spell conjure animals} to summon two {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} to fight alongside the drow, while Asha casts {@spell spirit guardians} on herself and concentrates to maintain it. The other drow cast {@spell darkness} to hinder ranged attackers before closing to melee. Shoor protects Ilvara, while Jorlan makes no effort to protect his fellow drow. Ilvara prefers to strike from a distance with her {@item tentacle rod}, or cast spells such as {@spell poison spray} and {@spell ray of sickness}.
zh_tw: 在戰鬥的第一個回合，伊爾瓦拉施展{@spell conjure animals||咒喚獸群}來召喚兩隻{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}與卓爾並肩作戰，而阿莎則對自己施展{@spell spirit guardians||靈體衛士}並集中精神以維持它。其他卓爾施展{@spell darkness||黑暗術}來阻礙遠端攻擊者，然後再靠近進行近戰。修爾保護伊爾瓦拉，而喬蘭沒有努力保護他的卓爾同伴。伊爾瓦拉更喜歡用她的{@item tentacle rod||觸鬚權杖}從遠處攻擊，或者施展如{@spell poison spray||毒氣噴湧}和{@spell ray of sickness||致病射線}這樣的法術。

english: If Ilvara loses more than half her hit points, she attempts to summon a {@creature yochlol} demon.
zh_tw: 如果伊爾瓦拉失去了超過一半的生命值，她會嘗試召喚一個{@creature yochlol||蠟融妖}惡魔。

english: Evening the Odds
zh_tw: 平衡機會

english: The characters might have a couple NPC companions around to help them defeat the drow (see "Bidding Farewell"), but if they need more assistance, consider the following options:
zh_tw: 角色們可能身邊有一兩個NPC夥伴來幫助他們擊敗卓爾（見"告別"），但如果他們需要更多的幫助，可以考慮以下選項：

english: Having pushed themselves to catch up to their prey, the drow all have one level of {@condition exhaustion}.
zh_tw: 由於強迫自己追趕獵物，所有的卓爾都處於一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態。

english: Ilvara and Asha have already expended some of their spell slots.
zh_tw: 伊爾瓦拉和阿莎已經消耗了他們一些法術位。

english: The characters make it to the surface before being intercepted by the drow, and the dark elves follow them into daylight. Under the light of the sun, the drow have disadvantage on their attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks relying on sight. The drow can pursue the characters for 1 hour before their armor and weapons are destroyed by the sunlight.
zh_tw: 角色們在被卓爾攔截之前到達了地表，而卓爾跟隨他們進入了日光之下。在陽光下，卓爾在攻擊骰和依賴視力的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定上處於劣勢。卓爾可以在他們的盔甲和武器被陽光摧毀之前追擊角色們1小時。

english: Asha chooses the confusion of combat as the moment to betray Ilvara, attacking while the elder priestess's back is turned. Ilvara instantly turns her attention to eliminating the traitor, distracting her and weakening the drow side if she succeeds.
zh_tw: 阿莎選擇戰鬥的混亂時刻背叛伊爾瓦拉，趁年長女祭司轉身時發起攻擊。如果成功，伊爾瓦拉立即將注意力轉向消滅叛徒，這會分散她的注意力並削弱卓爾一方。

english: Wanting to deny Ilvara the triumph of recapturing the adventurers, Jorlan turns against his fellow drow, attacking them until he's slain. If he survives, he turns against the characters in his self-destructive fury once all the drow are dead.
zh_tw: 喬蘭不想讓伊爾瓦拉得到重新捕獲冒險者的勝利，他轉而反對他的卓爾同胞，攻擊他們直到他被殺。如果他倖存下來，一旦所有的卓爾都死了，他會在自我毀滅的憤怒中轉而對抗角色們。

english: One or more NPC companions whom the characters left behind in the Underdark show up to help, having spotted the pursuing drow and followed them.
zh_tw: 一個或多個NPC同伴出現來幫助角色們，他們在幽暗地域注意到了追擊的卓爾並跟隨他們。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The characters can claim any equipment and treasure carried by the drow, although drowcraft items don't survive exposure to sunlight (see the "{@adventure Drowcraft Items|OotA|18}" sidebar in appendix B). In addition, if the characters fled Velkynvelve without retrieving specific magic items or valuables, Ilvara can be carrying those items, allowing the adventurers to finally reclaim their property.
zh_tw: 角色們可以索取卓爾所攜帶的任何裝備和財寶，儘管卓爾製造的物品在陽光下無法存活（見附錄B中的"{@adventure 卓爾製品|OotA|18}"側邊欄）。此外，如果角色們在逃離維爾京維爾夫時沒有取回特定的魔法物品或貴重物品，伊爾瓦拉可能攜帶著這些物品，允許冒險者們最終收回他們的財產。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: Each character earns 300 XP if the party makes it to the surface.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍成功到達地表，每個角色將獲得300 XP。

english: Further Adventures
zh_tw: 更多冒險

english: The end of this chapter of {@i Out of the Abyss} forms a break between the first half of the adventure and the second half, which begins when the characters are summoned to an audience with King Bruenor Battlehammer of Gauntlgrym (see {@adventure chapter 8|OotA|7}). You can use the break between the two halves of the adventure to deal with any or all of the following.
zh_tw: 本章節的結束標誌著{@i 逃離深淵}冒險的第一部分與第二部分之間的分界線，當角色被召見至岡特格瑞姆國王布魯諾·戰錘（參見{@adventure 第八章|OotA|7}）時，第二部分開始。你可以利用冒險兩部分之間的這段間歇來處理以下所有或部分事項。

english: Overland Travel
zh_tw: 陸上旅行

english: Once they reach the surface, the characters must still travel some distance to reach civilization. Most of the tunnels that connect to the Underdark in this region lie in or near the Evermoors or the Lurkwood—wild regions filled with ruins and monsters. You can choose to narrate as much of the party's overland travel as you wish, setting up encounters en route. If Eldeth is still with the characters, she wants to set off for Gauntlgrym as soon as possible. If the characters accompany her, this journey can easily form part of the bridging material between this chapter and chapter 8.
zh_tw: 一旦他們到達地表，角色們仍然需要走一段距離才能到達文明世界。這個區域連線到幽暗地域的大多數隧道位於或靠近埃弗摩爾斯或潛伏森林——這些是充滿廢墟和怪物的荒野地區。你可以隨意敘述隊伍的陸地旅行，設定途中的遭遇。如果艾爾德絲仍然和角色們在一起，她希望儘快出發前往岡特格瑞姆。如果角色們陪伴她，這次旅行可以很容易地成為這一章節和第8章之間過渡材料的一部分。

english: Recovery and Downtime
zh_tw: 恢復與休整

english: After their harrowing experiences in the Underdark, the characters might need time to recuperate, ridding themselves of madness and find the means to break curses and cure diseases. Other downtime activities are also possible (as determined by you, the Dungeon Master). For more information on downtime activities, see the "Downtime Activities" sections in {@book chapter 8|PHB|8|Downtime Activities} of the {@i Player's Handbook} and {@book chapter 6|DMG|6|Downtime Activities} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}.
zh_tw: 在經歷了幽暗地域的嚴峻考驗後，角色們可能需要時間來恢復，擺脫瘋狂，並尋找解除詛咒和治癒疾病的方法。其他的休整期活動也是可能的（由你，地下城主決定）。有關休整期活動的更多資訊，請參閱{@book 第八章|PHB|8|Downtime Activities}（選自{@i 玩家手冊}）和{@book 第六章|DMG|6|Downtime Activities}（選自{@i 城主指南}）。

english: Resupply
zh_tw: 補給

english: Characters can visit a surface community or trading post to acquire proper equipment and supplies in exchange for some of the treasures they bring out of the Underdark. By the beginning of {@adventure chapter 8|OotA|7}, they should be properly and fully equipped for the first time since the start of the adventure.
zh_tw: 角色可以訪問地表社群或貿易站，用他們從幽暗地域帶回的寶物換取合適的裝備和補給。到{@adventure 第八章|OotA|7}開始時，他們應該自冒險開始以來首次完全裝備妥當。

english: Warnings
zh_tw: 先兆

english: The events the characters have witnessed during their harrowing escape are likely to make them want to warn the world that demon lords have come to the Underdark. It's only a matter of time before these fiends find their own way out of the depths, threatening the existence of the surface world.
zh_tw: 角色們在他們驚心動魄的逃脫過程中所目睹的事件很可能會讓他們想要警告世界，惡魔領主已經來到了幽暗地域。這些惡魔找到自己的出路只是時間問題，它們威脅著地表世界的存在。

english: Characters belonging to factions might feel compelled to report to their superiors. Others can share what they've learned with well-connected NPCs who can get the word out. The attention gained by the characters as a result leads into the events of {@adventure chapter 8|OotA|7}.
zh_tw: 屬於派系的角色可能會感到有必要向上級彙報。其他人可以與關係網廣泛的NPC分享他們所學到的東西，以便傳播訊息。角色們因此獲得的關注將引導進入{@adventure 第八章|OotA|7}的事件。

english: Level Advancement
zh_tw: 等級提升

english: The characters should be 8th level by the start of the next chapter. If they're not there yet, plan additional encounters so that the characters can earn more experience points during their overland journey to Gauntlgrym.
zh_tw: 角色們在下一章開始時應該達到8級。如果他們還沒有達到，計劃額外的遭遇，以便角色們在前往岡特格瑞姆的陸地旅程中獲得更多的經驗點。

english: If you'd rather skip the encounters and jump ahead to {@adventure chapter 8|OotA|7}, assume that the characters survive a few harrowing encounters en route (which you can describe or not) and gain enough XP to advance to 8th level by the time they reach Gauntlgrym.
zh_tw: 如果你寧願跳過遭遇戰並直接進入{@adventure 第八章|OotA|7}，可以假設角色在途中經歷了數次驚險遭遇（你可以描述或不描述）並獲得了足夠的經驗值，在到達岡特格瑞姆時提升至8級。

english: Drow Chase Complications
zh_tw: 卓爾追逐的複雜情況

english: Complication
zh_tw: 困境

english: Uneven ground threatens to slow your progress. Make a {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check to navigate the area. On a failed check, the ground counts as 10 feet of {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 崎嶇的地面減慢了你的前進步伐。進行一次DC {@dc 10}的敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定以透過該區域。檢定失敗時，該地段視為10尺的{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: A fissure, rocky outcropping, or debris threatens to trip you up. Make a {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. On a failure, you fall {@condition prone}.
zh_tw: 一個裂縫、岩石露頭或碎片可能會絆倒你。進行一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定。若失敗，你將 {@condition prone||伏地}。

english: You disturb a {@creature swarm of bats} that makes one attack against you before quickly scattering.
zh_tw: 你驚擾了一群{@creature swarm of bats||蝙蝠群}，它們在迅速散開前對你發起一次攻擊。

english: A colony of {@creature Piercer||piercers} hangs 20 feet overhead. As you pass, one of them drops and makes an attack against you.
zh_tw: 一群{@creature Piercer||石錐怪}懸掛在頭頂20尺處。當你經過時，其中一隻掉落並對你發起攻擊。

english: You have to dodge around stalagmites and columns. Make a {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. On a failure, you take {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage from running into an obstacle.
zh_tw: 你必須繞過石筍和石柱。進行一次{@dc 10}敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定。如果失敗，你會因為撞到障礙物而受到{@dice 1d4}點鈍擊傷害。

english: A mass of webbing blocks your path. Avoiding it requires a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. On a failure, you are caught in the web and {@condition restrained}. As an action, you can make a {@dc 12} Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to poison and psychic damage).
zh_tw: 一團蛛網擋住了你的去路。避開它需要成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定。若失敗，你將被蛛網纏住並 {@condition restrained||束縛}。作為一個動作，你可以進行一次 {@dc 12} 力量檢定，成功則可以掙脫蛛網。蛛網也可以被攻擊（AC 10；hp 5；易受火焰傷害；對毒性和心靈傷害免疫）。

english: A patch of green slime drops from the ceiling, requiring a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw to avoid. On a failure, you are struck and take 5 ({@dice 1d10}) acid damage. You take 5 ({@dice 1d10}) acid damage again at the start of each of your turns until the slime is scraped off or destroyed (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 一塊綠色黏液從天花板上掉落，需要進行一次成功 {@dc 10} 的敏捷豁免來躲避。若失敗，你會被擊中並受到 5（{@dice 1d10}）點酸性傷害。在每個你的回合開始時，你會再次受到 5（{@dice 1d10}）點酸性傷害，直到黏液被刮掉或摧毀（參見《{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}》在 {@i 城主指南} 的第 5 章中）。

english: The floor beneath you is smooth and slick with moisture, requiring a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw to navigate. On a failed save, you fall {@condition prone}.
zh_tw: 你腳下的地面因溼氣而光滑，需要進行一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免以透過。若豁免失敗，你會 {@condition prone||伏地}。

english: The floor beneath you is littered with sharp rocks and debris, and you must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw to cross it. On a failure, you take {@dice 1d4} piercing damage and the ground counts as 10 feet of {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 你腳下的地面佈滿了尖銳的岩石和碎片，你必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免才能穿過它。若失敗，你將受到 {@dice 1d4} 點穿刺傷害，並且地面被視為 10 尺的 {@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: The chase kicks up a cloud of dust, sand, or spores. You must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw to pass through the cloud. On a failure, you are {@condition blinded} until the end of your turn. While {@condition blinded} in this way, your speed is reduced by half.
zh_tw: 追逐揚起了一片灰塵、沙粒或孢子云。你必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 的體質豁免才能穿過這片雲。若失敗，你在你的回合結束前處於 {@condition blinded||目盲} 狀態。以此方式處於 {@condition blinded||目盲} 時，你的速度減半。

english: No complication.
zh_tw: 無意外。

english: Chapter 8: Audience in Gauntlgrym
zh_tw: 第8章：在岡特格瑞姆的覲見

english: After their escape from the Underdark in chapter 7, the adventurers have time to rest, recuperate, and reorient themselves back in the surface world from which they were taken. Some three months after their return, they receive a summons to the dwarf kingdom of Gauntlgrym in the North. King Bruenor Battlehammer desires an audience with them regarding their experiences in the Underdark. Representatives of several factions with an interest in what is happening in the Underdark will also be in attendance. Following the audience, Bruenor extends an offer to the characters, who are tasked with returning to the Underdark once more on a perilous mission.
zh_tw: 在第7章從幽暗地域逃脫後，冒險者們有時間休息、恢復，並重新適應他們被帶走的地表世界。大約三個月後他們返回，他們收到了北方矮人王國岡特格瑞姆的召喚。布魯諾·戰錘國王希望就他們在幽暗地域的經歷與他們見面。幾個對幽暗地域發生的事情感興趣的派系的代表也將出席。覲見之後，布魯諾向角色們提出了一個提議，他們被指派再次回到幽暗地域執行一項危險的任務。

english: Summoned by Bruenor
zh_tw: 被布魯諾召喚

english: King Bruenor has learned of the characters' exploits from dwarf merchants and couriers recently returned from the Underdark. (If {@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA} was part of the adventurers' successful escape and returned safely to Gauntlgrym, word of the party's heroics came to Bruenor through her. See "Gauntlgrym Connections.") King Bruenor's summons reaches the characters by whatever method best suits the story, depending on where they go and what they are doing following their return to the surface world. It can be in the form of a messenger carrying a handwritten letter bearing the king's seal, or even an {@spell animal messenger} or {@spell sending} spell focused on one or more of the adventurers. Regardless of how it gets to them, the message is simple and clear:
zh_tw: 布魯諾國王從最近從幽暗地域返回的矮人商人和信使那裡得知了角色們的壯舉。（如果{@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA|艾爾德絲·費爾德倫}是冒險者們成功逃脫的一部分，並安全返回岡特格瑞姆，布魯諾國王透過她得知了派對的英雄事蹟。見"岡特格瑞姆聯絡"。）布魯諾國王的召喚以最適合故事的方式傳達給角色們，這取決於他們返回地表世界後的去向和所做的事情。它可以是一位攜帶著帶有國王印章的手寫信件的信使的形式，甚至是針對一個或多個冒險者的{@spell animal messenger||動物信使}或{@spell sending||短訊術}法術。無論它如何到達他們手中，資訊都是簡單明瞭的：

english: {@i Come at once to Gauntlgrym for an audience with King Bruenor Battlehammer, to discuss matters of grave importance concerning your experiences in the Underdark}.
zh_tw: {@i 立即前往高索姆林姆，與布魯諾·戰錘國王會面，討論關於你在幽暗地域的經歷的重要事宜}.

english: Characters belonging to any of the factions involved in the meeting at Gauntlgrym (see "Forging an Alliance") might receive a summons from their faction as well, and could even travel with the representative of that faction to the dwarf hold if circumstances permit. Otherwise, the choice to make the journey is up to the characters, although ignoring Bruenor's request leads the dwarf king to send ever more insistent messages.
zh_tw: 屬於參加岡特格瑞姆會議的任何派系的角色（見"鍛造聯盟"）也可能收到他們派系的傳喚，如果情況允許，甚至可以與該派系的代表一起前往矮人要塞。否則，是否進行旅程的選擇取決於角色，儘管忽視布魯諾的請求會導致矮人國王傳送越來越堅決的資訊。

english: Gauntlgrym Connections
zh_tw: 岡特格瑞姆的聯絡

english: If {@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA} survived and escaped from the Underdark with the characters, she is eager to return home to Gauntlgrym, and does so at the first opportunity. In that case, King Bruenor's summons might come in the form of a personal message or a visit from her, and it's likely Bruenor has heard all about the Underdark exploits from Eldeth.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA|艾爾德絲·費爾德倫}倖存並隨角色們從幽暗地域逃脫，她渴望回到家鄉岡特格瑞姆，並在第一時間這麼做。在這種情況下，布魯諾國王的召喚可能以個人訊息或她的訪問形式到來，而且布魯諾很可能已經從艾爾德絲那裡聽說了所有關於幽暗地域的冒險。

english: If Eldeth didn't survive, she might have charged the characters with returning either her remains or her warhammer and shield to her home. This errand can bring the characters to Gauntlgrym of their own volition even before Bruenor's summons.
zh_tw: 如果艾爾德絲沒有幸存下來，她可能已經要求角色們將她的遺體或者她的戰錘和盾牌帶回她的家鄉。這個差事甚至在布魯諾的召喚之前，就可以讓角色們自願地來到岡特格瑞姆。

english: Either aiding Eldeth's return or honoring her memory enhances the party's reputation with the dwarves of Gauntlgrym. It also reinforces King Bruenor's opinion that these adventurers are the right people to do the job of investigating the happenings in the Underdark.
zh_tw: 無論是幫助艾爾德絲返回還是紀念她，都能提升派對在岡特格瑞姆矮人中的聲譽。這也加強了布魯諾國王的看法，即這些冒險者是調查幽暗地域事件的合適人選。

english: Arrival
zh_tw: 抵達

english: Once the characters arrive at the gates of Gauntlgrym, they are welcomed as the king's guests and escorted into the underground city, through the Vault of Kings (see below), and shown to guest quarters. The dwarves of Gauntlgrym take matters of hospitality seriously, ensuring that the adventurers are offered food, drink, and a chance to rest and refresh themselves before their audience with the king (see "Audience with Bruenor" under "Events in Gauntlgrym").
zh_tw: 一旦角色們抵達岡特格瑞姆的大門，他們將作為國王的客人受到歡迎，並被護送進入地下城市，穿過國王的金庫（見下文），並被帶到客房。岡特格瑞姆的矮人們非常重視好客之道，確保冒險者們在覲見國王之前被提供食物、飲料以及休息和恢復的機會（見"岡特格瑞姆事件"中的"與布魯諾的覲見"）。

english: The characters' arrival is noteworthy, and the dwarves of Gauntlgrym treat them in a manner befitting great dignitaries. You can also have one or two of the faction representatives described under "Forging an Alliance" pass the characters in the corridors of the city, giving them curious looks—and perhaps even making a brief introduction—before moving on.
zh_tw: 角色們的到來引人注目，岡特格瑞姆的矮人們以適合偉大貴賓的方式對待他們。您還可以讓一兩個在"鍛造聯盟"下描述的派系代表在城市的走廊裡經過角色們，給他們好奇的目光——甚至可能進行簡短的介紹——然後繼續前行。

english: Gauntlgrym
zh_tw: 岡特格瑞姆

english: In ages past, the subterranean city of Gauntlgrym was the capital of the ancient dwarven Delzoun Empire. Its cavernous halls—some large enough to contain entire surface villages—were carved with unerring precision, their ceilings soaring scores of feet overhead. Towering statues of dwarven gods and heroes stood vigil over chambers and thoroughfares, the least of which was wide enough to march fifty dwarves standing abreast.
zh_tw: 在遠古時代，地下城市岡特格瑞姆是古代矮人德爾宗帝國的首都。它的洞穴大廳——有些大到足以容納整個地表村莊——被雕刻得無比精確，天花板高聳在頭頂數十尺之上。矮人神和英雄的高大雕像守衛著房間和通道，即使是最小的通道也足以讓五十名矮人並肩行進。

english: The mines of Gauntlgrym produced endless tides of iron, silver, gold, and mithral, and booming trade brought goods and wealth to the city from across Faerûn. But it was the Great Forge that was the burning heart and true treasure of the city. Deep beneath the settled levels of Gauntlgrym, dwarven crafting and elven magic bound the slumbering primordial Maegera, a being of fire and destruction, harnessing its incredible powers to heat the forge. On anvils of adamantine blessed by priests of Moradin, great items of power were forged, their base material infused with a splinter of Maegera's essence. The unceasing wonders flowing from these forges helped make Gauntlgrym into one of the most magnificent cities Faerûn has ever known.
zh_tw: 岡特格瑞姆的礦場產出了無盡的鐵、銀、金和秘銀，繁榮的貿易從費倫各地帶來了商品和財富。但是真正是城市跳動的心臟和真正寶藏的是大熔爐。在岡特格瑞姆定居層的深處，矮人的工藝和精靈的魔法結合喚醒了沉睡的原始生物瑪格瑞拉，一個火與毀滅的存在，利用其難以置信的力量為熔爐加熱。在摩拉丁的牧師祝福的精金砧板上，鍛造出了強大的物品，它們的基礎材料被注入了瑪格瑞拉本質的碎片。從這些熔爐中不斷流出的奇蹟幫助使岡特格瑞姆成為費倫歷史上最輝煌的城市之一。

english: Relations between the great empires of the elves, dwarves, and humans soured as the centuries passed. And so when numberless hordes of orcs smashed into the north, each empire stood alone. The war was brutal and devastating. Gauntlgrym was swarmed by rampaging armies of orcs, and the empire of Delzoun was overrun in the terrible fighting. Ultimately, the dwarves of Delzoun drove back the orcs, but at great cost. The once-mighty dwarven empire was left crippled, never to recover, and the great city of Gauntlgrym was left in the control of an orc horde.
zh_tw: 隨著世紀的流逝，精靈、矮人和人類偉大帝國之間的關係變得緊張。因此，當無數的獸人大軍衝向北方時，每個帝國都孤立無援。戰爭是殘酷和毀滅性的。岡特格瑞姆被狂暴的獸人軍隊圍攻，德爾宗帝國在可怕的戰鬥中被征服。最終，德爾宗的矮人們擊退了獸人，但代價巨大。曾經強大的矮人帝國被留下了殘廢，永遠無法恢復，而偉大的岡特格瑞姆城市被獸人大軍控制。

english: It was humans from nearby Illusk who finally drove the orcs from Gauntlgrym, but their hold on the city proved just as short-lived, as foul creatures from the Underdark swarmed from the depths to claim Gauntlgrym as their own. Over the next thousand years, history turned to legend, and mighty Gauntlgrym was all but forgotten on the surface world. Illithids, duergar, drow, and aboleths vied for control of the fallen city, its treasures, and the primordial still bound within its core. The drow House Xorlarrin eventually took Gauntlgrym, establishing a new city they called Q'Xorlarrin, producing weapons at the forge that they traded and used to pay tribute to Menzoberranzan.
zh_tw: 最終是來自附近伊路斯克的人類將獸人從岡特格瑞姆驅逐出去，但他們對這座城市的控制同樣短暫，因為來自幽暗地域的邪惡生物從深處湧出，聲稱岡特格瑞姆是他們自己的。在接下來的一千年裡，歷史變成了傳說，強大的岡特格瑞姆在地表世界幾乎被遺忘。靈吸怪、灰矮人、卓爾和阿波羅斯爭奪著這座陷落城市的控制權，它的寶藏，以及仍然束縛在其核心的原始生物。卓爾索拉林家族最終佔領了岡特格瑞姆，建立了一個他們稱之為奎索拉林的新城市，在鍛造場生產武器，他們用這些武器進行貿易，並向魔索布萊城支付貢品。

english: In recent years, the dwarf hero Bruenor Battlehammer was able to seize the fabled city back from its drow masters. Bruenor, along with his companions Wulfgar, Cattie-brie, Regis, and Drizzt Do'Urden, gathered many allies from the surface world and nearby Underdark communities and retook the city. They prevented Maegera from being unleashed upon Faerûn, and set about attempting to restore the city to its former glory. Bruenor now sits upon the Great Throne of Moradin, working to rebuild the city and keep it safe—even as a new threat looms in the depths of the Underdark.
zh_tw: 近年來，矮人英雄布魯諾·戰錘能夠從其卓爾主人手中奪回傳說中的城市。布魯諾和他的同伴沃爾夫加、卡蒂布莉、雷吉斯和崔斯特·杜堊登，從地表世界和附近的幽暗地域社群集結了許多盟友，並重新奪回了這座城市。他們阻止了瑪格瑞拉在費倫釋放，並且開始嘗試恢復這座城市的昔日輝煌。布魯諾現在坐在摩拉丁的偉大王座上，致力於重建城市並保持它的安全——即使一個新的威脅在幽暗地域的深處醞釀。

english: The following areas within Gauntlgrym might be of some importance during this part of the adventure, although they don't represent the full measure of the city by any means. A detailed description of every level, chamber, and vault of Gauntlgrym would take up an entire volume of its own, and the characters have limited time to see the wonders of the dwarven city.
zh_tw: 在這次冒險的這一部分中，岡特格瑞姆內的以下區域可能具有某種重要性，儘管它們遠不能代表這座城市的全部。詳細描述岡特格瑞姆的每一個層次、房間和金庫將需要整整一卷書，而角色們有限的時間來欣賞矮人城市的奇觀。

english: Gauntlgrym: General Features
zh_tw: 岡特格瑞姆：總體特徵

english: Gauntlgrym is a city carved out of the living rock, with halls and passages wide enough for the largest dragons to walk through. There are hundreds of levels, twisting stairs, functioning elevators, and a system of mine carts crossing in and out of the central hub of the Iron Tabernacle. The players should feel their characters are in a place of great antiquity, poised on the edge of reclaiming its ancient glory. By no means is the city fully occupied. Indeed, given the relatively small size of Bruenor's occupying force, keeping track of anyone within Gauntlgrym is nearly impossible.
zh_tw: 岡特格瑞姆是一座從活岩石中雕刻出來的城市，擁有足夠最大的龍穿行的大廳和通道。這裡有數百層，曲折的樓梯，運作中的電梯，以及一個礦車系統，這些礦車在鐵製聖所的中心樞紐進出交錯。玩家們應該感覺到他們的角色處於一個極其古老的地方，正處於恢復其古老榮耀的邊緣。城市遠非完全被佔據。實際上，考慮到布魯諾佔領部隊的相對較小規模，在岡特格瑞姆內跟蹤任何人都幾乎是不可能的。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: In the upper levels and around the Iron Tabernacle and Vault of Kings, Gauntlgrym is brightly lit. {@i Driftglobes}, phosphorescent fungi, and huge braziers and troughs of burning coals fill most hallways and chambers. Lights in many parts of the city are dimmed somewhat during the nighttime hours, so that its residents can mark the passage of time on the surface world. In the lower reaches, around the Great Forge, light isn't as ubiquitous. Farther down, and in parts of the city yet to be reclaimed from the ruins of the past, there is no light other than whatever visitors bring with them.
zh_tw: 在上層區域以及鐵製聖堂和國王寶庫周圍，岡特格瑞姆被明亮的燈光照亮。{@i 漂流球}、熒光菌和巨大的火盆以及燃燒的煤槽填滿了大多數走廊和房間。在夜間，城市許多地方的燈光會稍微調暗，以便居民們可以標記地表世界的時間的推移。在較低的區域，圍繞大熔爐，光線並不那麼普遍。再往下，以及在尚未從過去的廢墟中奪回的城市部分，除了訪客帶來的光源外，沒有其他光源。

english: Mine Carts
zh_tw: 礦車

english: Mining was one of Gauntlgrym's primary sources of wealth and materials. To facilitate the movement of ore, as well as the great quantities of stone used to construct and expand the city, the dwarves laid miles of track traversed by mine carts propelled by enchantments woven into their wheels. Even after thousands of years, the tracks remain largely intact and the magic of the carts has not faded. Where the carts trundle steadily throughout the city, Gauntlgrym's residents use them for travel, hopping on and off along the system's wide range of routes. While in Gauntlgrym, the characters can also make use of this convenient transportation system.
zh_tw: 礦業是岡特格瑞姆的主要財富和材料來源之一。為了便於礦石的運輸，以及用於建造和擴建城市的大量石材，矮人們鋪設了數英里的軌道，由編織在礦車輪子中的魔法推動的礦車穿行。即使經過數千年，這些軌道仍然大體完好，礦車的魔力也沒有消退。在礦車穩定地穿行於城市各處的地方，岡特格瑞姆的居民使用它們作為交通工具，沿著系統廣泛的的路線上下跳車。在岡特格瑞姆期間，角色們也可以利用這個方便的交通系統。

english: All tracks eventually lead to a switching station in the Iron Tabernacle. There, posted operators manipulate levers and gears to transfer carts from one track to another.
zh_tw: 所有軌道最終都通向鐵製聖堂中的一個轉換站。在那裡，值班的操作員操作槓桿和齒輪，將礦車從一個軌道轉移到另一個軌道。

english: Ghosts
zh_tw: 幽魂

english: The shades of long-deceased inhabitants of the city, from the time of the Delzoun of old, haunt many of the tunnels and hallways of Gauntlgrym. These spectral remnants are seen passing through ruined sections of the city as if those sections were still intact, following habitual routes, engaging in silent conversation with one another, and generally keeping out of the way of the living. From time to time, the characters might run into a dwarven {@creature ghost} who warns them away from a place of danger, or confront a less beneficial creature such as a {@creature shadow} or {@creature specter}. King Bruenor has decreed the restless dead be left alone for now unless they cause problems.
zh_tw: 這座城市長久以來已故居民的幽靈，來自古老的德爾宗時代，遊蕩在岡特格瑞姆的許多隧道和走廊中。這些幽靈殘餘被看到穿過城市的廢墟部分，就好像那些部分仍然完好無損，沿著習慣性的路線行走，相互進行無聲的對話，通常避開活人的道路。有時，角色們可能會遇到一個矮人{@creature ghost||幽魂}，警告他們遠離危險的地方，或者面對一個不那麼有益的生物，如{@creature shadow||幽影}或{@creature specter||惡靈}。布魯諾國王已經下令，除非不安的死者造成麻煩，否則暫時不要打擾他們。

english: The Vault of Kings
zh_tw: 國王的金庫

english: Large enough to enclose a small town, this high-ceilinged chamber rises above a network of bridges, stone towers, and sturdy walls carved from rock and sheathed in iron and mithral. Dozens of smaller chambers lead out from the Vault of Kings, including sprawling residential areas not yet filled by Gauntlgrym's new occupants.
zh_tw: 這個高天花板的大廳足夠大，可以包圍一個小鎮，它位於由岩石雕刻而成、鐵和秘銀覆蓋的橋樑網路、石塔和堅固牆壁之上。數十個較小的房間從國王之墓延伸出去，包括尚未被岡特格瑞姆新居民填滿的廣闊居住區。

english: The vault is on the same level as the city's main gates and can be reached from there, though a system of smaller gates and checkpoints has been set up to keep potential invaders from reaching as far as the throne room. That section of the vault, where the king spends a considerable amount of his time, is a large hall lined with pillars and benches, intended as a meeting place as much as a seat of rulership. The Great Throne of Moradin is protected by powerful magic, and forcefully ejects anyone but the rightful king who attempts to sit upon it. While so seated, Bruenor has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks—a divine blessing granted to the king of Gauntlgrym by Moradin and the other dwarven gods.
zh_tw: 金庫位於城市主門的同一層面，可以從那裡到達，儘管已經設定了一系列的小門和檢查站，以防止潛在的入侵者到達王座室。金庫的那個部分，國王在那裡度過了相當多的時間，是一個大禮堂，兩旁排列著柱子和長椅，既用作會面場所，也用作統治的座位。摩拉丁的王座受到強大魔法的保護，任何試圖坐上去的人，除了合法的國王，都會被強制彈出。布魯諾坐在上面時，在所有的感知、感知和魅力檢定上都有優勢——這是摩拉丁和其他矮人神賜予岡特格瑞姆國王的神聖祝福。

english: The majority of the city's current inhabitants live and work within the vault, happy to share tales of the city's reclamation and praise Bruenor's leadership at any opportunity. This is where the characters reside as Bruenor's guests, and where the representatives of the five factions are likely to be found. Here, residents and guests alike enjoy access to well-lit passages, comfortable quarters, and substantial amounts of food and drink.
zh_tw: 這座城市的大多數當前居民生活和工作在寶庫內，他們樂於分享城市收復的故事，並在任何機會下讚揚布魯諾的領導。這是角色們作為布魯諾的客人居住的地方，也是五個派系代表可能會被找到的地方。在這裡，居民和客人都可以享受到明亮的通道、舒適的住處以及大量的食物和飲料。

english: The Vault of Kings is heavily patrolled and guarded by shield dwarf {@creature Veteran||veterans} traveling in squads of six. It is the safest part of the city, and the characters can probably depend upon its security enough to rest without interruption in one of the guest suites provided to them, barring any unusual occurrences (see "Events in Gauntlgrym").
zh_tw: 國王之墓由盾矮人{@creature Veteran||老兵}重兵巡邏和守衛，他們以六人小隊的形式巡邏。這是城市中最安全的部分，角色們可能足夠依賴其安全性，在為他們提供的客房套間中休息而不被打擾，除非有不尋常的事件發生（見"岡特格瑞姆中的事件"）。

english: The Iron Tabernacle
zh_tw: 鐵製聖堂

english: The Iron Tabernacle is Gauntlgrym's spiritual and cultural heart as well as its physical center. More than a temple, the tabernacle is an entire section of the city larger than some surface towns, devoted to the faith of the former Delzoun Empire and of the dwarves who answered Bruenor's call to reclaim the city. Vast cathedrals of stone once echoed with the paeans of a thousand chanting voices. Great sculptures in honor of a multitude of gods gazed across an array of shrines and altars. Priests stood ready by night and day to tend to the spiritual needs of their people, and hundreds of stone tablets trumpeted the holy words of Moradin.
zh_tw: 鐵製聖所是岡特格瑞姆的精神和文化中心，也是它的物理中心。這個聖所不僅僅是一座寺廟，它是城市的一個完整區域，比一些地表城鎮還要大，致力於前德爾宗帝國的信仰以及響應布魯諾號召奪回這座城市的矮人們的信仰。曾經，巨大的石頭大教堂迴盪著千人齊聲吟唱的讚美詩。為了紀念眾多神祇而建造的宏偉雕塑，凝視著一片片的神龕和祭壇。牧師們日以繼夜地準備著，以滿足他們人民的精神需求，成百上千的石碑宣揚著摩拉丁的聖言。

english: Like so much else of ancient Gauntlgrym, the Iron Tabernacle isn't what it once was. The intricate patterns and knotwork have faded from the walls, some of the statues have begun to crumble, and many passages are blocked with rubble. The devilish duergar, once in control of the mines below, took delight in defiling the holy icons of the absent dwarves. They defaced statues, tore down altars, and carved obscenities into the sacred tablets. Anything of value, such as silver or mithral trim, gold icons, and hallowed weapons, has been completely scavenged.
zh_tw: 像古代岡特格瑞姆的許多其他部分一樣，鐵製聖堂也不再是它曾經的樣子。牆壁上的複雜圖案和結繩工藝已經褪色，一些雕像開始崩塌，許多通道被碎石堵塞。曾經控制著下方礦井的惡魔矮人（灰矮人）喜歡褻瀆缺席矮人的聖像。他們破壞雕像，推倒祭壇，在神聖的石板上刻下瀆神之詞。任何有價值的東西，如銀或秘銀裝飾、金像和神聖武器，都已被完全掠奪。

english: Rebuilding Faith
zh_tw: 重建信仰

english: Shield dwarf {@creature Priest||priests} have begun the long task of rebuilding, revitalizing, and restoring the Iron Tabernacle to its former glory. The area is vast, and its halls are numerous and multi-leveled. The dwarf priests have restored many shrines and altars, and have cleared paths through the cracked and broken hallways to the Vault of Kings so that Bruenor can make personal visits to the main shrines and offer thanks to the gods. This procession often includes Bruenor's visitors or those ambassadors from the surface who come to Gauntlgrym to seek counsel with the king. Bruenor leads these processions not only to show off the city and its sheer size, but also to take measure of his guests' endurance and patience in matters of spirit.
zh_tw: 盾矮人{@creature Priest||祭司}已開始著手一項漫長的工作：重建、復興並修復鋼鐵聖殿，使其恢復往日的輝煌。這一區域極為廣闊，廳堂眾多且樓層複雜。矮人祭司們已修復了許多聖壇與祭壇，並清理了穿過斷裂走廊通往王者地窖的路徑，以便布魯諾能親自前往主要聖地並感謝諸神。這一遊行隊伍通常包括布魯諾的訪客或來自地表的外交使節——他們來到岡特格瑞姆尋求國王的建議。布魯諾帶領這些遊行不僅是為了展示這座城市及其宏大，也是衡量賓客們在精神事務方面的耐性與毅力。

english: All Roads Lead Here
zh_tw: 條條大路通羅馬

english: As the heart of Gauntlgrym, the Iron Tabernacle is the central hub of the city's passageways and railways. Broad corridors, winding stairs, iron rails, roadways carved into the earth—nearly all the city's major byways pass through the tabernacle. Every part of Gauntlgrym can be reached from this area, albeit sometimes indirectly. Notably, the Vault of Kings is about a mile to the north of the Iron Tabernacle, and the Great Forge is several hundred feet below it and a half mile to the south.
zh_tw: 作為岡特格瑞姆的中心，鐵製聖所是城市通道和鐵路的中心樞紐。寬闊的走廊、蜿蜒的樓梯、鐵軌、雕刻在大地中的道路——幾乎所有城市的主要幹道都穿過聖所。從這個區域可以到達岡特格瑞姆的每個部分，儘管有時是間接的。值得注意的是，國王之墓位於鐵製聖所北面大約一英里處，而大熔爐位於其下方几百尺，南面半英里處。

english: Slumber of Ancients
zh_tw: 古代的沉睡

english: The lowest level of the Iron Tabernacle is a seemingly endless collection of crypts. Laid out according to patterns or traditions now lost to time, the tombs contain thousands of Gauntlgrym's honored dead. Some crypts are simple biers; others are intricate sarcophagi. All include names, titles, and lineage carved into the stone. A number of scholars have been drawn to Gauntlgrym in response to Bruenor's call, hoping to record a complete lineage of the great families of Gauntlgrym, including their possible connections to modern bloodlines, from an exhaustive study of the records carved in the crypt's stones.
zh_tw: 鐵製聖所的最低層是似乎無窮無盡的墓穴群。按照現在已經被時間遺忘的模式或傳統佈局，這些墓穴包含了數千名岡特格瑞姆的尊貴死者。一些墓穴是簡單的靈床；其他的是複雜的石棺。所有的墓穴都在石頭上刻有名字、頭銜和血統。一些學者響應布魯諾的號召來到岡特格瑞姆，希望從墓穴石頭上雕刻的記錄中，透過詳盡的研究，記錄下岡特格瑞姆偉大家族的完整血統，包括它們與現代血統的可能聯絡。

english: Unlike the rest of the Iron Tabernacle, the tombs are unmarred. Spectral dwarves are common in this area, though their spirits remain quiet as long as visitors are respectful of the dead. If any creatures attempt to deface or steal from the sarcophagi, a mob of dwarven {@creature Ghost||ghosts} quickly attacks. Start with a total number of ghosts equal to the number of intruders present, then add two new ghosts for each ghost destroyed.
zh_tw: 與鐵製聖堂的其餘部分不同，這些墓穴保持完好無損。這個區域常見的是矮人幽靈，只要訪客尊重死者，他們的靈魂就會保持安靜。如果有任何生物試圖破壞或從石棺中偷竊，一群矮人{@creature Ghost||幽魂}會迅速發動攻擊。開始時，幽靈的總數等於在場的入侵者數量，然後每消滅一個幽靈，就增加兩個新的幽靈。

english: Iron Tabernacle Random Encounters
zh_tw: 鐵製聖所隨機遭遇

english: The Iron Tabernacle is close enough to some of the lower reaches and fissures in the Underdark that monsters from below occasionally find their way in and set up lairs in one shrine or another. The dwarves impress upon the characters to be on their guard, or to take guards with them, if they visit. From time to time, the sound of combat rings through the tabernacle hallways, a contrast to the chanting voices of the priests and a sure sign that something unwelcome has made its way into this most sacred of places.
zh_tw: 鐵製聖堂距離幽暗地域的某些較低區域和裂縫足夠近，以至於下面的怪物偶爾會找到進入的路徑，並在一個神龕或另一個神龕中建立巢穴。矮人們提醒角色們保持警惕，或者如果他們訪問時，帶上衛兵。時不時地，戰鬥的聲音在聖堂的走廊中迴響，這與祭司們的吟唱聲形成對比，也是不受歡迎的東西侵入這個最神聖之地的明確訊號。

english: Check for a random encounter once every hour of travel in the Iron Tabernacle by rolling a {@dice d20} and consulting the table below to determine what, if anything, the characters meet.
zh_tw: 在鐵製聖所旅行時，每小時擲一次 {@dice d20} 並查閱下面的表格，以確定角色們是否遇到隨機事件。

zh_tw: 鐵製聖所遭遇

zh_tw: 遭遇

zh_tw: 1個矮人{@creature ghost||幽魂}（友好，除非被攻擊）

english: The Great Forge
zh_tw: 大熔爐

english: The Great Forge is a cavernous chamber divided into smaller sections housing furnaces and anvils. Some areas of the cavern are raised on daises of stone, while others stand in shallow pits. Layers of stone catwalks crisscross the chamber, providing not only vantage points but also anchors for pulleys transporting buckets of ore and water throughout the forge. The Great Forge is about a half mile south of the Iron Tabernacle and several hundred feet below it, and can be reached by mine cart or on foot.
zh_tw: 大熔爐是一個巨大的洞穴，被劃分成更小的部分，用來安置熔爐和鐵砧。洞穴的某些區域建在石頭的底座上，而其他區域則位於淺坑中。石制的走道層疊交錯地穿過這個房間，不僅提供了視角，還為滑輪系統提供了錨點，這些滑輪系統在整個熔爐中運輸礦石和水桶。大熔爐位於鐵製聖堂以南大約半英里處，並且比它低幾百尺，可以透過礦車或步行到達。

english: It was said of old that the Iron Tabernacle was Gauntlgrym's heart, the Vault of Kings its mind, and the Great Forge its mighty hands. Here, on adamantine anvils blessed by Moradin's priests, wonders were hammered from iron, mithral, silver, and steel. When Gauntlgrym thrived, the forge echoed with the hammering and songs of a hundred smiths working at once. In time, it might do so again.
zh_tw: 古時候有人說，鐵製聖所是岡特格瑞姆的心臟，國王的金庫是它的大腦，而大熔爐是它強大的雙手。在這裡，在摩拉丁的牧師祝福的精金砧板上，從鐵、秘銀、銀和鋼中鍛造出奇蹟。當岡特格瑞姆繁榮時，熔爐迴盪著一百名鐵匠同時工作的敲打聲和歌聲。假以時日，這樣的情景或許會再次出現。

english: It was the furnaces of the Great Forge that made this place the apex of the dwarf smiths' art, for those furnaces are driven by the power of Maegera the Dawn Titan—a primordial imprisoned below them. Slumbering within the stone, Maegera exudes an unnatural heat that the dwarves tap into by winding coils of copper and adamantine throughout the forge like webs and using them as conduits to transfer magical heat to their furnaces. Runes of power carved into the walls and etched into the coils allow them to withstand the intense energy. Metals melt almost instantly in the furnaces of the Great Forge, and tools cast from those metals are enchanted with motes of primordial essence.
zh_tw: 正是大熔爐的爐火使這個地方成為矮人鐵匠藝術的巔峰，因為這些爐火是由下方囚禁的原始巨人瑪格瑞拉·黎明泰坦的力量驅動的。瑪格瑞拉沉睡在石頭中，散發出矮人透過在熔爐中像蛛網一樣纏繞銅和金剛石線圈並使用它們作為傳導通道將魔法熱量傳遞到他們的爐火中的一種不自然的熱能。刻在牆上和刻線上圈上的力量符文使它們能夠承受強烈的能量。金屬在大熔爐的爐火中幾乎瞬間熔化，從這些金屬鑄造的工具被賦予了原始精華的微粒。

english: When Maegera awoke in the last century, the earth shook, and many of the furnaces' conduits were severed. Today, lengths of twine-thin metal hang limp and broken throughout the rubble of the Great Forge, which lies upon the bones of those unable to escape the collapse of bridges and walls. Other coils remain in place, and the furnaces to which they are linked burn as hot today as they did in centuries gone by.
zh_tw: 當馬埃格拉在上個世紀甦醒時，大地震動，許多熔爐的管道被切斷。今天，細如線繩的金屬管在大熔爐的廢墟中懸掛著，顯得無力而破碎，這些廢墟覆蓋著那些無法逃離坍塌橋樑和牆壁的人的骨頭。其他捲曲的管道仍然保持原位，它們連線的熔爐今天燃燒得和幾個世紀前一樣熾熱。

english: The Fiery Pit
zh_tw: 火坑

english: Heat and ruddy light emanate from a pit in the depths of Gauntlgrym. Chambers and tunnels lead away from this chasm at different heights. Despite channels built into the walls to carry water to the magma below, the heat from the pit is ferocious. Gouts of steam billow up through cracks in the stone to fill the chambers above this area, and the earth rumbles in a pulse like labored breathing.
zh_tw: 從岡特格瑞姆深處的一個坑洞散發出熱量和紅光。房間和隧道從這個裂口的不同高度延伸出去。儘管牆上有專門設計的水渠將水引向下面的巖漿，但坑洞的熱量仍然兇猛。蒸汽從石頭裂縫中噴湧而出，瀰漫在上方的房間中，大地像艱難的呼吸一樣在脈動中隆隆作響。

english: The Fiery Pit is the prison of the primordial known as Maegera, who slumbers fitfully in its depths. The only sign of the entity's presence is a whirlpool of white-hot magma that resembles a great eye, set in the center of the lake of molten rock at the pit's bottom. Maegera sleeps and dreams, half conscious of its surroundings and half delirious with whatever dreams haunt a being of pure destruction.
zh_tw: 火焰之坑是被稱為馬埃格拉的原始生物的監獄，它在坑底不安地沉睡。這個實體存在的唯一跡象是一個漩渦狀的白熱巖漿，它看起來像一隻巨大的眼睛，位於坑底熔岩湖的中心。馬埃格拉在睡夢中，半意識地感知著周圍環境，半瘋狂地做著那些困擾著純粹毀滅生物的夢境。

english: When the mages of the Arcane Brotherhood first tapped into Maegera's power, they used water magic to bind elementals that cooled the primordial's rage and kept it asleep. This bond lasted for centuries until the channels of water were closed through trickery by agents of Thay. With the pit's cooling mechanism shut down, Maegera stirred in its slumber, and its dream of ruination was enough to destroy Gauntlgrym.
zh_tw: 當奧法兄弟會的法師們首次利用瑪格瑞拉的力量時，他們使用水系魔法束縛元素生物，這些元素生物冷卻了原始巨人的憤怒並使其保持沉睡。這種束縛持續了幾個世紀，直到賽爾的代理人透過詭計關閉了水道。隨著坑洞的冷卻機制關閉，瑪格瑞拉在其沉睡中動了動，它的毀滅夢境足以摧毀岡特格瑞姆。

english: In the years following, Maegera groggily awoke from time to time, causing earthquakes throughout the region. Eventually, the primordial was returned to its slumber through the efforts of Bruenor, Drizzt Do'Urden, Jarlaxle, and other heroes. Where Maegera sleeps now, the intense heat it generates once again fires the Great Forge of Gauntlgrym.
zh_tw: 在隨後的歲月裡，馬埃格拉時不時地昏昏沉沉地醒來，導致整個地區發生地震。最終，透過布魯諾、崔斯特·杜堊登、賈拉索和其他英雄的努力，這個原始生物再次回到了沉睡狀態。現在馬埃格拉沉睡的地方，它產生的強烈熱量再次點燃了岡特格瑞姆的大熔爐。

english: Back in Operation
zh_tw: 重新運營

english: Under Bruenor's watchful governance, the Great Forge has again begun to produce metalworks. If the characters are in the market for any metal goods (including arms and armor), or have any such goods in need of repair or replacement, the dwarves of the Great Forge are happy to help. No magic weapons or armor are available for sale, although damaged magic items can be repaired.
zh_tw: 在布魯諾的嚴密治理下，大熔爐再次開始生產金屬製品。如果角色們需要購買任何金屬製品（包括武器和盔甲），或者有任何此類商品需要修理或更換，大熔爐的矮人們樂於提供幫助。沒有魔法武器或盔甲可供出售，儘管損壞的魔法物品可以被修復。

english: The king has left the day-to-day running of the Great Forge to a pair of experienced smiths: Helgrim Candlewick and Rollo Summergold (both shield dwarf {@creature Veteran||veterans}).
zh_tw: 國王已將大熔爐的日常運營交給了兩位經驗豐富的鐵匠：赫爾格林·燭芯 和 羅洛·夏金（兩位都是盾矮人{@creature Veteran||老兵}）。

english: Great Forge Random Encounters
zh_tw: 大熔爐隨機遭遇

english: The Great Forge is always occupied by either Helgrim or Rollo, their apprentices and assistants ({@dice 2d4} shield dwarf {@creature Commoner||commoners}), and shield dwarf {@creature Veteran||veterans} working in squads of six to guard the active furnaces. The characters might also encounter other creatures if they explore the unoccupied areas of the Great Forge. Check for such an encounter once per hour of travel or rest outside the protected areas of the forge by rolling a {@dice d20} and consulting the Great Forge Encounters table to determine what, if anything, comes out of the darkness. If the heroes call for help, four shield dwarf {@creature Veteran||veterans} arrive in {@dice 1d4 + 1} rounds to aid them.
zh_tw: 大熔爐總是被赫爾格里姆或羅洛，他們的學徒和助手（{@dice 2d4}盾矮人{@creature Commoner||平民}），以及六人一組守衛活躍熔爐的盾矮人{@creature Veteran||老兵}所佔據。如果角色們探索大熔爐未被佔據的區域，他們也可能遇到其他生物。在鍛造廠受保護區域外旅行或休息的每一小時，透過擲一個{@dice d20}並查閱大熔爐遭遇表來檢查是否遇到生物，以確定是有任何東西從黑暗中出現。如果英雄們尋求幫助，四名盾矮人{@creature Veteran||老兵}將在{@dice 1d4 + 1}回合內到達以幫助他們。
