english: Events in Gauntlgrym
zh_tw: 岡特格瑞姆的事件

english: This chapter is dominated by negotiation, social activity, and diplomacy—first directed at the characters, then directed by them. The adventurers must first hear what King Bruenor has to say as he entreats them to head back into the Underdark to find out more about the rising threat of the demon lords. Then the characters must help convince the other factions summoned to Gauntlgrym to aid them on their mission. This section of the adventure has some opportunity for action, but players who enjoy plotting, making plans, and pitting NPCs against one another can shine here.
zh_tw: 這一章節以談判、社交活動和外交為主——首先針對角色們，然後由他們來主導。冒險者們必須首先聽取布魯諾國王的話，他懇求他們返回幽暗地域去了解更多關於惡魔領主日益增長的威脅。然後角色們必須幫助說服被召喚到岡特格瑞姆的其他派系來幫助他們完成任務。這個冒險部分有一些行動的機會，但是喜歡策劃、制定計劃和讓NPC相互對抗的玩家可以在這裡大放異彩。

english: Take note of your players' preferences. If they're not much for long periods of conversation with NPCs, you might want to move things along a little more quickly. On the other hand, you can really bring to life not just the faction representatives and the dwarf king in this chapter, but also highlight the personalities and goals of the characters and any NPCs who remain with them.
zh_tw: 注意你的玩家們的偏好。如果他們不喜歡長時間與NPC對話，你可能需要加快程式。另一方面，你不僅可以讓這一章中的派系代表和矮人國王栩栩如生，還可以突出角色及任何留下來的NPC的個性和目標。

english: Audience with Bruenor
zh_tw: 與布魯諾會面

english: After the characters arrive and are shown to guest accommodations, they are allowed some time to refresh and prepare themselves. They are then called to an audience with Bruenor Battlehammer, the king of Gauntlgrym. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 角色們到達並被帶到客房後，他們有一些時間來休息和準備自己。然後他們被召去與岡特格瑞姆的國王布魯諾·戰錘會面。閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: You are taken to a mighty hall in which a red-haired dwarf of fierce and proud demeanor sits upon a massive stone throne, flanked by a number of guards and advisors. Although a long stone table has been set to one side, laid out with refreshments, there do not appear to be any other guests. "Welcome, friends," says the king. "I've a mind to know about the rumblings and rumors about goings-on in the depths outside my city. If ye relate to me what ye know, we can talk about what ye might want to do next."
zh_tw: 你們被帶到一個宏偉的大廳，一個紅髮矮人坐在巨大的石座上，神態兇猛而自豪，兩旁是一些守衛和顧問。儘管大廳一側擺放了一張長石桌，上面擺放著點心，但似乎沒有其他客人。"歡迎，朋友們，"國王說。"我想知道關於我城市外深淵中發生的動靜和謠言。如果你們告訴我你們所知道的，我們可以討論你們下一步可能想要做什麼。"

english: King Bruenor listens carefully to what the adventurers have to say. Once the adventurers have told their tale, Bruenor might have a few questions, particularly concerning the threat of the demon lords. The dwarf king answers questions from the characters if they have any. However, if asked about his overall plans, he says simply that he must consider all the information presented to him and consult with advisors. With the audience at an end, Bruenor tells the characters he will consider all they have told him, and that they will speak again at a welcoming feast later that night.
zh_tw: 布魯諾國王認真傾聽冒險者們所說的話。一旦冒險者們講述了他們的故事，布魯諾可能會提出一些問題，特別是關於惡魔領主威脅的問題。如果角色們有任何疑問，矮人國王也會回答他們的問題。然而，當被問及他的總體計劃時，他簡單地說他必須考慮所有呈現給他的資訊，並與顧問們商量。隨著會面結束，布魯諾告訴角色們他會考慮他們所說的一切，並將在當晚的歡迎宴會上再次交談。

english: Guests at the Feast
zh_tw: 宴會上的賓客

english: After the characters have had a chance to speak with Bruenor and take care of any personal business, the Vault of Kings plays host to a memorable feast. In attendance are representatives of different factions from the surface world, who have come to Gauntlgrym following rumors of bizarre events in the Underdark. If any of the adventurers belong to a faction, representatives of that faction might even be following up on information provided by the characters themselves. See "Forging an Alliance" for more information.
zh_tw: 在角色們有機會與布魯諾交談並處理任何個人事務後，國王的金庫舉辦了一場難忘的盛宴。出席的有來自地表世界不同派系的代表，他們來到岡特格瑞姆是為了追蹤幽暗地域中發生的奇異事件的謠言。如果任何冒險者屬於某個派系，那個派系的代表甚至可能是在跟進角色們自己提供的資訊。有關更多資訊，請參見"建立聯盟"。

english: The celebration serves both to welcome the adventurers, who are seated at the high table with Bruenor, and to provide an opportunity for the representatives of the different factions to gather socially and be officially introduced to the adventurers. In addition to the king and his allies, a number of dwarves from Bruenor's court and important citizens of Gauntlgrym are also present. The feast is also an opportunity for you to include NPCs of your choice who might either be from or visiting Gauntlgrym, or part of the entourage of one of the representatives.
zh_tw: 慶典既是為了歡迎冒險者們，他們與布魯諾一同坐在主桌上，也是為了提供機會讓來自不同派系的代表們社交聚集，並正式向冒險者們介紹。除了國王和他的盟友，布魯諾宮廷中的一些矮人和岡特格瑞姆的重要市民也在場。宴會也是一個機會，讓您可以包括您選擇的NPC，他們可能來自或訪問岡特格瑞姆，或者是某個代表隨行人員的一部分。

english: This is a free-form scene, which you can play out as best suits your group. It can range from a detailed roleplaying session, with characters mixing and mingling with their potential allies and members of Gauntlgrym society, or just a brief description of the event and the characters' initial impressions of the faction representatives, before their later efforts to negotiate with those representatives for the factions' aid.
zh_tw: 這是一個自由形式的場景，你可以根據自己的團隊情況來演繹。它可以是一場詳細的角色扮演會議，角色們與潛在的盟友和岡特格瑞姆社會的成員交流互動，或者只是對事件和角色們對派系代表的初步印象的簡短描述，然後再努力與這些代表進行談判，以爭取派系的幫助。

english: If you want to add some intrigue or action, consider having one of the options from "Enemies Among Us" interrupt the feast, giving the characters an opportunity to demonstrate their abilities in front of their potential patron and allies. Rogue {@creature Fire Elemental||fire elementals} roaring out of the hearth or a disguised {@creature assassin} poisoning one or more of the representatives can completely change the scene.
zh_tw: 如果您想要增加一些陰謀或行動，可以考慮讓"我們中的敵人"中的一個選項打斷宴會，給角色們一個在潛在的贊助人和盟友面前展示他們能力的機會。流氓{@creature Fire Elemental||火元素}從壁爐中咆哮而出，或者偽裝的{@creature assassin||刺客}毒害一個或多個代表，可以完全改變場景。

english: Bruenor's Plan
zh_tw: 布魯諾的計劃

english: Once the feast winds down, Bruenor excuses himself as the guests depart. Shortly thereafter, a servant comes to collect the characters and takes them to a private chamber where the king of Gauntlgrym awaits them. His previously friendly manner has turned grave.
zh_tw: 當宴會接近尾聲，布魯諾向賓客們告退。不久之後，一個僕人來接角色們，帶他們去到一個私人房間，那裡岡特格瑞姆的國王正在等待他們。他之前友好的態度變得嚴肅。

english: "I've told the allies ye met tonight what ye told me," he says. "I invited them here to learn what is happening, to share what we know, and to get their backing for what it is I propose. Ye have braved the Underdark and lived to tell the tale. Ye know, better than anyone, what it is we face, but we need to know more.
zh_tw: "我已經告訴今晚見到的盟友們你們告訴我的事情，"他說。"我邀請他們來這裡瞭解正在發生的事情，分享我們所知道的，並得到他們對我提議的支援。你們勇敢地穿越了幽暗地域並活著回來講述這個故事。你們比任何人都更清楚我們面臨的是什麼，但我們需要知道更多。

english: "The Zhentarim have a stake in a secret Underdark trading post called Mantol-Derith. If ye can get them on our side, they'll guide ye there, where ye can meet with one of their agents, {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA}. He can provide ye with a map to Gravenhollow. It's a legendary place built by the stone giants long ago, said to contain all the knowledge of the depths. If there's answers to be found for what has happened, ye might find them there. If ye are willing to go back, that is.
zh_tw: "渣爾塔利姆（散塔林會）在幽暗地域中有一個名為曼塔-岱瑞絲的秘密貿易站。如果你們能讓他們在我們這邊，他們會引導你們去那裡，在那裡你們可以會見他們的一個代理人，{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}。他可以提供給你們一張去刻文谷的地圖。這是一個由石頭巨人很久以前建造的傳奇之地，據說包含了深淵的所有知識。如果你們要尋找發生了什麼的答案，你們可能會在那裡找到。如果你們願意回去的話。"

english: "I don't propose to send ye into the dark unprepared, and I hope ye make an impression on those gathered here so they'll support our cause and your mission. From all I've seen and heard, there's no one better to do what needs be done.
zh_tw: "我不打算讓你們毫無準備地進入黑暗之中，我希望你們在這裡給聚集的人留下深刻印象，這樣他們就會支援我們的事業和你們的使命。根據我所看到和聽到的一切，沒有人比你們更適合完成需要完成的任務。"

english: "So, what say ye?"
zh_tw: "那麼，你們怎麼看？"

english: Paraphrase Bruenor's speech as needed to handle interjections by the characters. The king provides honest answers to any questions. He truly does believe the characters represent the best option to find out more about the demonic threat, unless they've given him any reason to think otherwise.
zh_tw: 根據需要對布魯諾的講話進行釋義，以處理角色的插話。國王對任何問題都提供誠實的回答。他確實相信角色們代表了了解惡魔威脅的最佳選擇，除非他們給了他任何理由讓他有其他想法。

english: Bruenor assures the adventurers they will have his gratitude and that of all Gauntlgrym—indeed, of all Faerûn—if they are successful. If the characters press for details or try to negotiate compensation for their service, the king points out that Gauntlgrym has considerable space, and he can offer them titles, property, and the products of the Great Forge as rewards. Such mercenary negotiation lowers Bruenor's opinion of the adventurers a bit, but he never loses his genial manner.
zh_tw: 布魯諾向冒險家們保證，如果他們成功，他本人以及所有岡特格瑞姆——實際上，整個費倫——都會對他們感激不盡。如果角色們追問細節或試圖就他們的服務進行談判以獲取報酬，國王指出岡特格瑞姆有相當大的空間，他可以提供給他們頭銜、財產以及偉大熔爐的產品作為獎勵。這種為了金錢的談判稍微降低了布魯諾對冒險家們的看法，但他從未失去他友好的態度。

english: If the characters are agreeable, the king tells them the next step is to bring the various factions on board. One of the reasons he is looking to the adventurers to lead a new mission into the Underdark, apart from their experience, is that they can serve as brokers among all the various parties with an interest in the mission. They need to meet with the different faction representatives, emphasizing the importance of getting the Zhentarim to agree to grant access to Mantol-Derith. Otherwise, the journey to locate Gravenhollow is likely to be much longer and more difficult.
zh_tw: 如果角色們同意，國王告訴他們下一步是讓各個派系加入。他尋求冒險者領導新的任務進入幽暗地域，除了他們的經驗之外，還有一個原因是他們可以作為所有對任務感興趣的各方之間的中介。他們需要與不同的派系代表會面，強調讓散塔林會同意授予進入曼塔-岱瑞絲的通道的重要性。否則，尋找刻文谷的旅程可能會更加漫長和困難。

english: Bruenor Battlehammer
zh_tw: 布魯諾·戰錘

english: The legendary Bruenor Battlehammer is a good dwarf and king, and always has the best interests of his people and home at heart. He is drawn to help characters who follow a strong moral and ethical code, and often seeks their help in return. Use his good humor and folksy demeanor to help endear him to the players. The more the players grow to like him, the easier it is for them to respect his advice and request—and to gain more resources and assistance from him in turn.
zh_tw: 傳奇人物布魯諾·戰錘是一個善良的矮人和國王，總是將他的人民和家園的最佳利益放在心上。他傾向於幫助那些遵循堅強道德和倫理準則的角色，並經常尋求他們的幫助作為回報。利用他的良好幽默感和親切的舉止來幫助他贏得玩家的喜愛。玩家越喜歡他，他們就越容易尊重他的建議和請求——反過來，也就越容易從他那裡獲得更多的資源和幫助。

english: Enemies Among Us
zh_tw: 我們中的敵人

english: Even Gauntlgrym isn't entirely safe, nor is it immune to the influence of the demon lords. During the characters' time in the city, you can implement one or more of the following threats to challenge them—and to potentially disrupt their negotiations with the factions.
zh_tw: 即使是岡特格瑞姆也不是完全安全的，也不會免受惡魔領主的影響。在角色們在城市的時間裡，您可以實施以下一個或多個威脅來挑戰他們——並可能破壞他們與派系的談判。

english: One of the characters' traveling companions is revealed as a traitor or succumbs to madness. This NPC secretly serves one of the demon lords and turns against the adventurers.
zh_tw: 其中一位角色的旅伴被揭露為叛徒或陷入瘋狂。這個NPC暗中為某個惡魔領主服務，轉而對抗冒險者。

english: If any of the party's drow pursuers survived from the previous chapter, they might slip into Gauntlgrym and look to slay their quarry.
zh_tw: 如果任何來自前一章的卓爾追蹤者倖存下來，他們可能會潛入岡特格瑞姆並試圖殺死他們的目標。

english: A dwarf {@creature assassin} belonging to a demon-worshiping cult steals into Gauntlgrym to kill one or more of the faction representatives. Hoping to cast suspicion onto the adventurers, the assassin frames them as demonic agents.
zh_tw: 一個屬於崇拜惡魔的邪教的矮人{@creature assassin||刺客}潛入岡特格瑞姆，企圖殺害一個或多個派系代表。刺客希望將懷疑轉移到冒險者身上，於是將他們陷害為惡魔的代理人。

english: A {@creature doppelganger} spy poses as one of the faction representatives and tries to arrange a private meeting with one or more of the characters, hoping to discover additional information regarding the looming threat. The doppelganger might serve a faction of the Underdark or a surface world faction Bruenor didn't invite (such as the Arcane Brotherhood or the Red Wizards of Thay), or might simply be an opportunist looking to sell information to the highest bidder.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature doppelganger||變形怪}間諜偽裝成派系代表之一，試圖安排與一個或多個角色私下會面，希望發現有關迫在眉睫威脅的額外資訊。這個變形怪可能為幽暗地域的派系或布魯諾沒有邀請的地表世界派系（如奧法兄弟會或賽爾的紅法師）服務，或者可能只是一個尋找機會將資訊出售給出價最高者的機會主義者。

english: Maegera roars within its prison, stirred by the madness and chaos growing within the depths of the Underdark. As a natural reaction to this new stress upon itself, the primordial spawns a trio of {@creature Fire Elemental||fire elementals} that attack the Vault of Kings, setting fire to marketplaces and unleashing chaos upon the dwarven residents. If defeated or somehow convinced to return to the Fiery Pit, the elementals dissipate peacefully and Maegera falls dormant once again... for now.
zh_tw: 瑪格瑞拉在其囚籠中咆哮，被幽暗地域深處不斷增長的瘋狂和混亂所激怒。作為一種對這種新壓力的自然反應，這個原始生物孕育出三個{@creature Fire Elemental||火元素}，它們攻擊了國王之墓，點燃了市場並給矮人居民帶來了混亂。如果被擊敗或者以某種方式被說服返回熾熱之坑，這些元素將會和平消散，瑪格瑞拉將再次陷入休眠......暫時。

english: Forging an Alliance
zh_tw: 建立聯盟

english: King Bruenor has called representatives of the Harpers, the Order of the Gauntlet, the Emerald Enclave, the Lords' Alliance, and the Zhentarim to Gauntlgrym to hear about the state of things in the Underdark and to court their aid in finding out more about the situation. The representatives of each faction receive a briefing on what the characters told Bruenor, and all have an opportunity to converse with the adventurers before making their decisions as to whether they will support Bruenor's plans.
zh_tw: 布魯諾國王召集了豎琴手聯盟、鐵手套教團、翠綠閒庭、領主聯盟和散塔林會的代表來到岡特格瑞姆，瞭解幽暗地域的情況，並爭取他們的幫助以獲取更多情報。每個派系的代表都收到了角色們告訴布魯諾的情況簡報，並且都有機會與冒險者交談，然後決定是否支援布魯諾的計劃。

english: To play out these meetings, use the social interaction rules provided in chapter 8, "{@book Running the Game|DMG|8}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}. Some representatives are fine with meeting the adventurers in the Vault of Kings, but you might have others request a private or even clandestine meeting—perhaps in the characters' quarters, in an out-of-the-way alcove of the Iron Tabernacle, or in the Great Forge.
zh_tw: 為了進行這些會面，請使用第八章 "{@book 運作遊戲|DMG|8}" 中提供的社會互動規則，該規則來自 {@i 城主指南}。一些代表願意在國王的穹頂大廳與冒險者會面，但也可能有其他代表要求私下甚至秘密的會面——或許是在角色的住所、鋼鐵聖所中偏僻的角落，或者在大鍛造爐中。

english: King Bruenor is the original proponent of the adventurers returning to the Underdark to gather additional information, but he knows that success requires the support of the other factions—particularly the Zhentarim. He doesn't, however, have the power to command the factions to help—and in some cases, can't even openly negotiate with them. As King of Gauntlgrym, he can't be seen to favor one faction over another. He is therefore relying on the characters to do the legwork of getting the different factions on board.
zh_tw: 布魯諾國王是冒險者返回幽暗地域收集額外資訊的最初倡導者，但他知道成功需要其他派系的支援——特別是散塔林會。然而，他並沒有權力命令派系提供幫助——在某些情況下，甚至不能公開與他們談判。作為岡特格瑞姆的國王，他不能被看到偏袒一個派系而不是另一個。因此，他依賴於角色們去做說服不同派系加入的工作。

english: If the characters are already involved with one or more factions, and especially if they have previously contacted the factions with news of developments in the Underdark, adjust the information presented below as needed.
zh_tw: 如果角色們已經與一個或多個派系有所牽連，特別是如果他們之前已經與派系聯絡並通報了幽暗地域的發展情況，請根據需要調整下面呈現的資訊。

english: The Harpers
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟

english: Members of this clandestine network of spellcasters and spies pride themselves on being incorruptible defenders of the greater good and champions of the oppressed. Harper agents are trained to act alone and rely on their own resources. When they get into scrapes, they don't count on fellow Harpers to rescue them. Sometimes Harper agents must band together to face world-threatening foes, at which point the deep friendships between them forge the kind of fighting force needed to overthrow tyranny and eradicate evil.
zh_tw: 這個秘密的施法者和間諜網路的成員自豪地認為自己是不可腐蝕的捍衛更大利益的捍衛者和受壓迫者的冠軍。豎琴手聯盟特工被訓練獨立行動並依靠自己的資源。當他們陷入困境時，他們不指望其他豎琴手聯盟來營救他們。有時豎琴手聯盟特工必須聯合起來面對威脅世界的敵人，在這種情況下，他們之間深厚的友誼鍛造出一種所需的戰鬥力，以推翻暴政和根除邪惡。

english: Harper scouts engaged in charting and blocking off Underdark passages leading to the surface world have recently brought back the terrifying news of the demon lords' incursion into the Underdark. Word has spread quickly through their network, and the finest mages in their ranks are researching how to defeat the demon lords and their kind.
zh_tw: 致力於繪製和封鎖通往地表世界的幽暗地域通道的豎琴手偵察兵最近帶回了惡魔領主侵入幽暗地域的可怕訊息。訊息透過他們的網路迅速傳播，他們中最優秀的法師正在研究如何擊敗惡魔領主及其同類。

english: For long years, the Harpers have sworn to put an end to unbridled evil in all its forms—especially evil that wields dark magic. They know the demon lords seek to prey on the weak and corrupt the innocent. The Harpers feel this is the moment they have trained for, and their conscience now calls them to act.
zh_tw: 多年來，豎琴手聯盟誓言要終結所有形式的無法無天的邪惡——特別是那些掌握黑暗魔法的邪惡。他們知道惡魔領主企圖捕食弱者並腐蝕無辜者。豎琴手聯盟感覺這是他們訓練的時刻，他們的良知現在呼喚他們採取行動。

english: Lord Zelraun Roaringhorn
zh_tw: 澤爾朗·咆哮號角勳爵

english: {@i Lawful neutral male human wizard}
zh_tw: {@i 守序中立男性人類法師}

english: {@b Ideals}: Freedom, opportunity, civilization
zh_tw: {@b 理想}: 自由，機會，文明

english: {@b Personality}: Proud, self-assured, fickle, spendthrift
zh_tw: {@b 個性}: 自豪，自信，多變，揮霍無度

english: {@b Potential Resources}: Shield guardian
zh_tw: {@b 潛在資源}：盾衛

english: Lord Roaringhorn hails from a Waterdhavian noble family, with all the self-assurance and pride that entails. He pursued his talent for the arcane arts, but never forgot his roots or lost his fondness for spending his family's considerable income on the finer things in life. He's a confident sort who likes to gamble. Winning over Roaringhorn requires a willingness to dine, drink, and potentially game with him.
zh_tw: 洛林·咆哮之角勳爵來自一個水深港的貴族家庭，擁有所有隨之而來的自信和驕傲。他追求自己對奧術藝術的天賦，但從未忘記自己的根基，也沒有失去用家族可觀的收入享受生活中美好事物的喜好。他是一個自信的人，喜歡賭博。贏得咆哮之角勳爵的青睞需要願意與他共進晚餐、飲酒，並且可能與他一起遊戲。

english: Lord Roaringhorn is accompanied by a shield guardian and holds its control amulet. The shield guardian currently has a {@spell lightning bolt} spell stored within it. A character can gain use of the shield guardian by winning a game of chess against the Harper wizard. Zelraun suggests a match after dinner.
zh_tw: 咆哮號角勳爵由一個盾衛伴隨，並且持有它的控制護身符。盾衛當前儲存了一個{@spell lightning bolt||閃電束}法術。角色可以透過與豎琴手法師下棋贏得比賽來獲得盾衛的使用權。澤爾朗建議晚餐後進行一場對弈。

english: A chess match takes 1 hour, and the outcome is determined by a best-of-three Intelligence check contest. Zelraun's experience gives him a +9 modifier to his Intelligence checks. Zelraun loans the shield guardian and its control amulet to the first character to beat him at the game. If Zelraun proves unbeatable, you can decide that Zelraun, ever the gracious winner, loans the shield guardian and amulet to the party on the provision that the characters vow to redeem themselves with a rematch upon their return from the Underdark.
zh_tw: 一場國際象棋比賽需要1小時，結果由三局兩勝的智力檢定比賽決定。澤爾朗的經驗使他在智力檢定中獲得+9的調整值。澤爾朗將盾牌守衛者及其控制護身符借給第一個在棋局中擊敗他的角色。如果澤爾朗被證明是不可戰勝的，你可以決定，作為一個始終優雅的贏家，澤爾朗將盾牌守衛者和護身符借給隊伍，條件是角色們承諾在從幽暗地域返回時透過複賽來挽回自己的面子。

english: If a character obtains Zelraun's shield guardian and control amulet, photocopy the {@creature Shield Guardian} stat card at the end of this chapter and give it to the player whose character has the amulet. If the amulet changes hands, so too does the shield guardian and its stat card.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色獲得了澤爾朗的盾衛和控制護身符，請影印本章末尾的{@creature Shield Guardian||構裝盾衛}狀態卡，並將其交給擁有護身符的角色的玩家。如果護身符易手，盾衛及其狀態卡也會隨之轉移。

english: If the characters attack Zelraun, use the {@creature archmage} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual} to represent him.
zh_tw: 如果玩家們攻擊澤爾朗，請使用{@creature archmage||大法師}的資料（見於{@i 怪物圖鑑}）來代表他。

english: The Order of the Gauntlet
zh_tw: 鐵手套教團

english: The Order of the Gauntlet is a dedicated, tightly knit group of holy-minded crusaders driven by a finely honed sense of justice and honor. Friendship and camaraderie are important to members of the order, and they share a trust normally reserved for siblings. They seek to uphold justice as best they can, and to continually test their mettle against the forces of evil. There are few, if any, lone operatives in this organization. Working in pairs and small groups reinforces the bonds of friendship and helps keep members from straying off the path of righteousness.
zh_tw: "鐵手套教團"是一個由懷著精細打磨的正義和榮譽感的神聖心志的十字軍組成的專注且緊密團結的團體。友誼和同志情誼對組織成員來說非常重要，他們分享通常只留給兄弟姐妹的信任。他們尋求盡最大努力維護正義，並不斷在邪惡勢力面前考驗自己的勇氣。在這個組織中，很少有，如果有的話，單獨行動的成員。以成對和小團體的形式工作加強了友誼的紐帶，並有助於防止成員偏離正義之路。

english: The Underdark has always been a proving ground for candidates of the order, as well as a frequent destination for veteran paladins, monks, and clerics looking to smite evil. It hasn't taken long for reports of new threats rising in the Underdark to reach the order.
zh_tw: 幽暗地域一直是該秩序候選人的試煉場，也是經驗豐富的聖武士、僧侶和牧師尋求打擊邪惡的常去之地。關於幽暗地域新威脅上升的報告很快就傳到了秩序中。

english: The demon lords embody the kind of evil the Order of the Gauntlet is sworn to destroy. All members of the order see the evolving situation as an opportunity to deal a mighty blow to the forces of the Abyss. They want to send the demon lords howling back into the pit, proving the worth of the order as well as testing their own valor and bravery.
zh_tw: 惡魔領主體現了鐵手套教團誓言要摧毀的那種邪惡。該組織的所有成員都認為不斷發展的局勢是一個向無底深淵勢力發起強大打擊的機會。他們希望讓惡魔領主嚎叫著回到坑裡，證明該組織的價值，同時也考驗他們自己的勇氣和勇敢。

english: Sir Lanniver Strayl
zh_tw: 蘭尼弗·斯特雷爾爵士

english: {@i Lawful good human fighter}
zh_tw: {@i 守序善良人類戰士}

english: {@b Ideals}: Faith, devotion, justice, duty
zh_tw: {@b 理想}: 信仰，奉獻，正義，責任

english: {@b Personality}: Patient, determined, witty
zh_tw: {@b 個性}：耐心，堅定，機智

english: {@b Potential Resources}: Order of the Gauntlet veterans
zh_tw: {@b 潛在資源}: 鐵手套教團的老兵

english: A devout follower of Tyr and a member of the Order of the Gauntlet, Sir Lanniver is the most respected figure among the factions in Gauntlgrym. Little surprises him at this point in his life, and he accepts what comes with a wry wit and an unshakable faith that things will always work out—provided those of good intent do what must be done. If most of the characters in the party are of good alignment, Sir Lanniver is supportive of their mission and wants them to succeed. However, a party of mostly neutral or evil characters will need to work to gain his support.
zh_tw: 作為提爾的虔誠信徒和鐵手套教團的成員，蘭尼弗爵士是岡特格瑞姆派系中最受尊敬的人物。在他生命的這個階段，很少有事情能讓他感到驚訝，他以一種諷刺的幽默感和不可動搖的信念接受一切，相信事情總會有好結果——前提是那些心懷善意的人必須做他們必須做的事情。如果隊伍中的大部分角色是善良陣營，蘭尼弗爵士會支援他們的使命，並希望他們成功。然而，如果隊伍主要由中立或邪惡角色組成，則需要努力贏得他的支援。

english: If he's of a mind to provide aid, Sir Lanniver pledges five human veterans of the order to the party's mission. The veterans' names are Thora Nabal, Sylrien Havennor, Olaf Renghyi, Elias Drako, and Tamryn Tharke. Sir Lanniver can also offer a member of the party a {@item +1 warhammer}, one of a handful of treasures held in trust by the order. He prefers to bestow this weapon on a good- or neutral-aligned cleric or paladin. Feel free to swap this magic weapon with another magic item more useful to the adventurers.
zh_tw: 如果他願意提供幫助，蘭尼弗爵士承諾向隊伍的任務提供五名人類老兵。這些老兵的名字是索拉·納巴爾、西爾裡恩·哈文諾、奧拉夫·倫吉、伊萊亞斯·德拉科和塔姆林·薩克。蘭尼弗爵士還可以向隊伍的一名成員提供一件{@item +1 warhammer||+1 戰錘}，這是秩序保管的少數寶藏之一。他更願意將這件魔法武器贈予善良或中立陣營的牧師或聖武士。如果這把魔法武器對冒險者來說不如其他魔法物品有用，請隨意更換。

english: If the veterans accompany the party, make five photocopies of the {@creature Veteran of the Gauntlet|OotA} stat card at the end of this chapter. If you don't want to control the veterans yourself, you can distribute the stat cards among the players and let them run the NPCs.
zh_tw: 如果老兵們陪同隊伍，那麼請影印本章末尾的{@creature Veteran of the Gauntlet|OotA|試煉場老兵}統計卡片五份。如果你不想自己控制這些老兵，你可以將統計卡片分發給玩家，讓他們來控制這些NPC。

english: Should Sir Lanniver come under attack, use the {@creature knight} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual} to represent him. In addition to the veterans mentioned above, Sir Lanniver travels with a young but able squire (female human {@creature guard}) named Rhiele Vannis.
zh_tw: 如果拉尼維爾爵士遭到攻擊，使用{@creature knight||騎士}的統計資料（來自{@i 怪物圖鑑}）來代表他。除了上述的資深戰士之外，拉尼維爾爵士還與一位年輕但能幹的侍從（女性人類{@creature guard||警衛}）同行，她的名字是莉爾·範尼斯。

english: The Emerald Enclave
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭

english: Members of the Emerald Enclave are spread far and wide across the Sword Coast and the North. They usually operate in isolation, relying on their own abilities and instincts to survive. Living deep in the wilderness demands great fortitude and the mastery of certain fighting and survival skills. Down in the Underdark, far from the wild lands, the Emerald Enclave must remain ever vigilant to avoid being blindsided by unnatural forces.
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭的成員遍佈劍海岸和北方。他們通常獨立行動，依靠自己的能力和直覺來生存。生活在荒野深處需要極大的堅韌和掌握一定的戰鬥及生存技能。在遠離野外的幽暗地域中，翠綠閒庭必須始終保持警惕，以避免被不自然的力量所突襲。

english: Some members of the enclave engage with the people of the world as protectors, emerging from the wilderness to help others survive its perils. Some are charged with defending sacred glades and preserving the natural balance. At times, however, all members of the order are called together to combat foes great enough to disrupt or destroy the natural order. The demon lords are one such threat.
zh_tw: 翡翠聯盟的一些成員作為世界的保護者與人們互動，從荒野中出現幫助他人生存其危險。有些人負責保衛神聖的林間空地並維護自然平衡。然而，有時，所有聯盟成員都被召集起來，以對抗足以破壞或摧毀自然秩序的強大敵人。惡魔領主就是這樣的威脅。

english: Druids and scouts of the Emerald Enclave have recently witnessed the corruption spreading through of the flora and fauna of the Underdark. In particular, they have tracked this corruption back to Zuggtmoy and Juiblex, with the demon lords both infecting different parts of the subterranean realm.
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭的德魯伊和偵察兵最近目睹了腐敗透過幽暗地域的植物和動物傳播。特別是，他們追蹤到這種腐敗源自祖格莫伊和朱庇萊克斯，惡魔領主兩者分別感染了地下王國的不同部分。

english: The Emerald Enclave fights tirelessly against the corruption of nature. Its members are well aware that the newly seen demonic corruption will not be contained within the Underdark for long. Eventually it will break through to the surface and threaten all Faerûn—and by the time it does, it might be too late to stop it.
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭不懈地與自然的腐敗作鬥爭。其成員非常清楚，新發現的惡魔腐敗不會長時間侷限在幽暗地域中。最終它會突破到地表，並威脅到整個費倫——到那時，可能已經太晚了，無法阻止它。

english: Morista Malkin
zh_tw: 莫瑞斯塔·馬爾金

english: {@i Neutral good shield dwarf scout}
zh_tw: {@i 中立善良盾矮人偵察兵}

english: {@b Ideals}: Loyalty, nature, the dwarven people
zh_tw: {@b 理想}: 忠誠，自然，矮人民族

english: {@b Personality}: Stern, stubborn, insightful
zh_tw: {@b 個性}：嚴格，固執，富有洞察力

english: {@b Potential Resources}: Emerald Enclave scouts and giant lizard mounts
zh_tw: {@b 潛在資源}: 翠綠閒庭偵察兵和巨型蜥蜴坐騎

english: Morista Malkin is the only faction representative who currently resides in Gauntlgrym. Originally from the Silver Marches, she heard Bruenor's call to reclaim the glory of the ancient line of Delzoun and followed him to Gauntlgrym. Here, she balances her work with the Emerald Enclave and her loyalty to her people and their cause. Stern and stubborn, Morista sees it as her duty to protect the people of Gauntlgrym from the often savage nature of the Underdark and to remind them of its natural beauty. She serves King Bruenor as an advisor and both admires and respects him.
zh_tw: 莫瑞斯塔·馬爾金是當前居住在岡特格瑞姆的唯一派系代表。她原本來自銀月聯邦，聽到布魯諾號召奪回德爾宗古老血統的榮耀，便跟隨他來到了岡特格瑞姆。在這裡，她平衡了自己在翠綠閒庭的工作以及對民族及其事業的忠誠。嚴肅而固執的莫莉斯塔認為，保護岡特格瑞姆人民免受幽暗地域的野蠻本性侵害，並提醒他們其自然之美是她的責任。她作為顧問為布魯諾國王服務，並且既欽佩又尊敬他。

english: Morista spends some of her time training elite scouts to reconnoiter the Underdark passages near the city. A few months ago, one of her scouts—a wood elf named {@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA}—disappeared while on a mission in the Underdark. Hopeful that the characters might stumble upon Sladis and see him safely back to Gauntlgrym, Morista pledges a team of three shield dwarf scouts to accompany them, along with a giant lizard mount for each enclave scout and each player character. The scouts are named Brim Coppervein, Thargus Forkbeard, and Griswalla Stonehammer.
zh_tw: 莫莉斯塔花了一些時間訓練精英偵察兵，以偵察城市附近幽暗地域的通道。幾個月前，她的一名偵察兵——一個名叫{@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA|斯拉迪斯·瓦迪爾}的木精靈——在執行幽暗地域任務時消失了。莫莉斯塔希望角色們可能會偶然發現斯拉迪斯，並安全地將他帶回岡特格瑞姆，因此她承諾派出一隊三名盾矮人偵察兵陪同他們，每名聯盟偵察兵和每個玩家角色都有一個巨型蜥蜴坐騎。偵察兵的名字分別是布里姆·銅，塔格斯·叉鬍鬚和格里斯瓦拉·石錘。

english: If the characters accept the Emerald Enclave's support, make three photocopies of the {@creature Emerald Enclave Scout|OotA} stat card at the end of this chapter as well as photocopies of the {@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA} stat card (one for each enclave scout and player character). If you don't want to control the scouts and giant lizards yourself, you can distribute their stat cards among the players and let them run the NPCs.
zh_tw: 如果角色們接受了翠綠閒庭的支援，請影印本章末尾的{@creature Emerald Enclave Scout|OotA|翡翠聯盟偵查兵}統計卡片三份，以及{@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|乘用巨蜥}統計卡片的影印件（每個聯盟偵察兵和玩家角色一份）。如果你不想自己控制偵察兵和巨型蜥蜴，你可以將它們的統計卡片分發給玩家，讓他們來控制這些NPC。

english: Should Morista come under attack, use the {@creature scout} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual} to represent her.
zh_tw: 如果莫瑞斯塔遭到攻擊，使用{@creature scout||斥侯}的資料來代表她，資料來自{@i 怪物圖鑑}。

english: The Lords' Alliance
zh_tw: 領主聯盟

english: The Lords' Alliance is a political and economic coalition of cities spread throughout the North and the Sword Coast. The alliance owes its success to effective cooperation and diplomacy between its members, who work to align their separate settlements toward a mutual purpose. This cooperation is easier during times of crisis, making the Lords' Alliance a powerful force when threats require a united front. The agents of the Lords' Alliance work to maintain the delicate network of information and diplomacy that sustains their order, alert for anything that might threaten the alliance's interests. Recent reports of unusual activity from the Underdark might mark one such threat.
zh_tw: 領主聯盟是一個政治和經濟聯盟，其城市遍佈北方和劍海岸。聯盟的成功歸功於其成員之間有效的合作和外交，他們共同努力將各自的定居點統一到一個共同的目標。在危機時期，這種合作更容易實現，使領主聯盟在需要團結一致的威脅面前成為一個強大的力量。領主聯盟的代理人致力於維護維持他們秩序的複雜資訊和外交網路，警惕任何可能威脅到聯盟利益的事情。最近有關幽暗地域異常活動的報告可能標誌著這樣一個威脅。

english: The alliance has noted how many Underdark sites near their settlements have gone quiet. Routine forays and raids onto the surface world have come to a halt, as has the flow of trade and information. Rumors have reached the Lords' Alliance of demon-worshiping cults and chaos around places such as Blingdenstone and Menzoberranzan, though they have little confirmation.
zh_tw: 聯盟已經注意到他們定居點附近的許多幽暗地域地點變得安靜了。對地表世界的例行突襲和襲擊已經停止，貿易和資訊流通也停滯了。有關崇拜惡魔的邪教和諸如布靈登石城和魔索布萊城等地的混亂的謠言已經傳到了領主聯盟耳中，儘管他們幾乎沒有得到確認。

english: The possibility that the demon lords of the Abyss are active in the Underdark is a threat the Lords' Alliance can't ignore.
zh_tw: 來自無底深淵的惡魔領主可能正在幽暗地域活動；這是領主聯盟無法忽視的威脅。

english: Lord Eravien Haund
zh_tw: 埃拉維恩·哈恩德勳爵

english: {@i Lawful neutral half-elf noble}
zh_tw: {@i 守序中立半精靈貴族}

english: {@b Ideals}: Order, society, peace, stability
zh_tw: {@b 理想}：秩序，社會，和平，穩定

english: {@b Personality}: Charming, sly, worldly
zh_tw: {@b 個性}: 迷人，狡猾，世故

english: {@b Potential Resources}: Lords' Alliance guards and spies
zh_tw: {@b 潛在資源}: 領主聯盟的守衛和間諜

english: The representative of the Lords' Alliance is a noble of Tethyrian and moon elf heritage, his youthful looks belying his actual age and experience. Although he hails from Waterdeep, Lord Eravien often travels to other alliance settlements. He's a charming and sly courtier, able to immediately size up any social situation, but his fondness for socializing often distracts him from what's important. As a result, Eravien has heard relatively little of the recent events in the Underdark, and he is initially unconvinced of the importance of the party's mission.
zh_tw: 領主聯盟的代表是一位擁有泰瑟爾人和月精靈血統的貴族，他年輕的外表掩蓋了他的實際年齡和經驗。儘管他來自深水城，埃拉維恩勳爵經常前往其他聯盟定居點。他是一個迷人而狡猾的宮廷人，能夠立即評估任何社交情況，但他對社會活動的熱愛常常使他分心，忽略了重要的事物。結果，埃拉維恩對幽暗地域最近發生的事件瞭解甚少，他最初對隊伍任務的重要性持懷疑態度。

english: If they can convince him otherwise, Lord Eravien arranges for some agents of the Lords' Alliance to join the expedition:
zh_tw: 如果他們能說服他，埃拉維恩勳爵會安排一些領主聯盟的代理人加入探險隊：

english: Five dwarf guards from the alliance city of Mirabar. Their names are Nazrok Blueaxe, Kirsil Mantlehorn, Anzar the Brazen, Gargathine Truesilver, and Splinter Darkmorn.
zh_tw: 來自聯盟城市米拉巴的五名矮人守衛。他們的名字是納茲羅克·藍斧，基爾希爾·曼特霍恩，安扎爾·布拉森，加加瑟恩·真銀，和斯普林特·暗角。

english: Three human spies from the alliance city of Yartar. Their names are Farryl Kilmander, Zilna Oakshadow, and Hilvius Haever.
zh_tw: 來自聯盟城市亞塔的三名人類間諜。他們的名字是法裡爾·基爾曼德，齊爾納·橡影，和希爾維烏斯·海弗。

english: If the party accepts these NPCs into its ranks, make five photocopies of the {@creature Lords' Alliance Guard|OotA} and three photocopies of the {@creature Lords' Alliance Spy|OotA} stat cards at the end of this chapter. If you don't want to control these NPCs yourself, you can distribute their stat cards among the players and let them run the NPCs.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍接受這些NPC加入其行列，請在本章末尾影印五份{@creature Lords' Alliance Guard|OotA|領主聯盟守衛}和三份{@creature Lords' Alliance Spy|OotA|領主聯盟間諜}的狀態卡。如果您不想自己控制這些NPC，您可以將它們的狀態卡分發給玩家，讓他們來操作這些NPC。

english: Eravien knows that the Lords' Alliance has a deep-cover operative in the Underdark. Khelessa Draga, a high elf from Silverymoon, was sent to spy on the drow over a year ago. Eravien knows that Khelessa uses magic to disguise herself as a dark elf and warns the characters not to attack any drow they encounter until they can confirm the target isn't Khelessa in disguise. The Lords' Alliance lost contact with Khelessa months ago, so Eravien doesn't know where she is.
zh_tw: 埃拉維恩知道領主聯盟在幽暗地域中有一個深層臥底。凱萊莎·德拉加，一位來自銀月城的高等精靈，一年多前被派去監視卓爾。埃拉維恩知道凱萊莎使用魔法將自己偽裝成卓爾，並警告角色們在確認目標不是偽裝的凱萊莎之前，不要攻擊他們遇到的任何卓爾。領主聯盟幾個月前就與凱萊莎失去了聯絡，所以埃拉維恩不知道她現在在哪裡。

english: Should Lord Eravien come under attack, use the {@creature noble} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual} to represent him. He travels with three servants (strongheart halfling {@creature Commoner||commoners}) and three well-paid human {@creature Guard||guards}.
zh_tw: 如果伊拉維恩領主遭到攻擊，使用{@creature noble||貴族}的資料（選自{@i 怪物圖鑑}）來代表他。他與三位僕人（強心半身人{@creature Commoner||平民}）和三位高薪的人類{@creature Guard||警衛}同行。

english: The Zhentarim
zh_tw: 散塔林會

english: Members of the shadowy Black Network consider themselves part of an extended family, and rely on the larger organization for resources and security. The Zhentarim recognizes and rewards ambition, granting its members autonomy to pursue their own interests and gain some measure of personal power or influence. In this way, the organization is a meritocracy. The Zhentarim welcomes dangerous times as opportunities. When a merchant caravan needs an escort, a noble needs bodyguards, or a city needs trained soldiers, the Zhentarim provides the best-trained fighting forces money can buy.
zh_tw: 神秘的黑網成員自視為一個大家庭的一部分，並依賴於這個更大的組織來獲取資源和安全。散塔林會認可並獎勵雄心壯志，給予其成員自主權去追求自己的利益並獲得一定程度的個人權力或影響力。以這種方式，該組織是一個精英統治體系。散塔林會歡迎危險時期作為機遇。當商隊需要護送，貴族需要保鏢，或者城市需要訓練有素的士兵時，散塔林會提供了用金錢能買到的最好訓練的戰鬥力量。

english: Zhentarim agents traveling to and from Mantol-Derith have recently passed on information and rumors concerning demonic activity in the Underdark. The organization's members have yet to realize the full extent of the threat, as corruption and madness have already infiltrated their secret outpost since those initial reports (see chapter 9). However, even the most cautious member of the Zhentarim knows that demons at large in the world are bad for business. The organization thus views the possible presence of the demon lords in the Underdark with the same concern as any other external threat to their way of life.
zh_tw: 前往和來自曼塔-岱瑞絲的散塔林會代理人最近傳遞了有關幽暗地域惡魔活動的情報和謠言。該組織的成員還沒有意識到威脅的全部程度，因為自從那些初步報告以來，腐敗和瘋狂已經滲透到他們的秘密前哨站（見第9章）。然而，即使是散塔林會中最謹慎的成員也知道，惡魔在世界上橫行對生意不利。因此，該組織對幽暗地域中可能存在的惡魔領主的存在，抱有與對他們生活方式的任何其他外部威脅同樣的關注。

english: Zhentarim bonds of oath and honor hold the network together and galvanize its members in united purpose. More importantly, those bonds reflect the pattern of tight control that the leaders of the Zhentarim hope to one day see imposed across the North and beyond. The organization is thus willing to commit to stop the demon lords from breaching the surface—knowing that such a fate would destroy the Zhentarim's plans for control of Faerûn.
zh_tw: 散塔林會的誓言和榮譽紐帶將網路維繫在一起，並激勵其成員團結一致。更重要的是，這些紐帶反映了散塔林會領導者希望有朝一日能在整個北方乃至更廣範圍內實施的嚴格控制模式。因此，該組織願意致力於阻止惡魔領主突破到地表——知道這樣的命運將摧毀散塔林會控制費倫的計劃。

english: Davra Jassur
zh_tw: 達芙拉·賈瑟

english: {@i Lawful evil human assassin}
zh_tw: {@i 守序邪惡的人類刺客}

english: {@b Ideals}: Order, discipline, ambition
zh_tw: {@b 理想}: 秩序，紀律，雄心

english: {@b Personality}: Driven, focused, ruthless
zh_tw: {@b 個性}: 有動力，專注，無情

english: {@b Potential Resources}: Zhentarim thugs
zh_tw: {@b 潛在資源}：散塔林會暴徒

english: Graceful and elegant as a blade, Davra Jassur ostensibly recruits promising new talent for the Zhentarim. But she also deals with internal problems, ensuring those problems are nipped in the bud before they can reveal any weakness within the organization. The pragmatic Davra values order and discipline as well as drive and ambition, and she embodies all those traits.
zh_tw: 達芙拉·賈瑟優雅而精緻，表面上為散塔林會招募有前途的新人才。但她也處理內部問題，確保這些問題在暴露組織內部任何弱點之前就被扼殺。務實的達夫拉重視秩序和紀律，以及動力和雄心，她體現了所有這些特質。

english: The Zhentarim's intelligence-gathering resources and access to an established Underdark outpost give the organization the strongest hand of any of the factions, and Davra knows it. Access to Mantol-Derith is key to the plan, and though she ultimately won't withhold that access from the adventurers, she intends to make sure it's not given away for free. Davra deals with the adventurers directly—and privately, if possible—asking for a full share of any treasure the characters claim during their next incursion into the Underdark, and a full reporting to her of all information given to Bruenor or the other faction leaders. If one of the characters is a member of the Zhentarim, Davra tries to make the deal for information with that character alone.
zh_tw: 散塔林會的情報收集資源和對已建立的幽暗地域前哨站的訪問使該組織擁有所有派系中最強大的手段，達夫拉知道這一點。進入曼塔-岱瑞絲的通道是計劃的關鍵，儘管她最終不會拒絕冒險者們的訪問，但她打算確保這種訪問不會白給。達夫拉直接並與冒險者私下交涉，要求在他們下一次進入幽暗地域時獲得任何寶藏的全部份額，並向她完整報告所有提供給布魯諾或其他派系領袖的資訊。如果其中一個角色是散塔林會的成員，達夫拉會嘗試單獨與那個角色交換資訊。

english: In addition to access to the hidden trading post of Mantol-Derith, Davra Jassur can provide Zhentarim mercenaries to fill out the expedition. These eight human thugs proudly wear the crest of the Black Network on their armor. If these NPCs join the party, make eight photocopies of the {@creature Zhentarim Thug|OotA} stat card at the end of this chapter. If you don't want to control these NPCs yourself, you can distribute their stat cards among the players and let them run the NPCs. The thugs' names are Nero Kelvane, Lenora Haskur, Aligor Moonwhisper, Gorath Torn, Saliyra Dalnor, Primwin Halk, Iandro Alathar, and Lhytris Ilgarn. All of them know the route to Mantol-Derith.
zh_tw: 除了可以進入隱藏的貿易站曼塔-岱瑞絲之外，達芙拉·賈瑟還可以提供散塔林會僱傭兵來擴充探險隊。這八名人類暴徒驕傲地在他們的盔甲上佩戴著黑網的標誌。如果這些NPC加入隊伍，那麼請影印本章末尾的{@creature Zhentarim Thug|OotA|散塔林暴徒}統計卡片八份。如果你不想自己控制這些NPC，你可以將它們的統計卡片分發給玩家，讓他們來控制這些NPC。暴徒們的名字是尼羅·凱爾凡，萊諾拉·哈斯克爾，阿利戈爾·月語，戈拉瑟·託恩，薩利拉·達爾諾，普林溫·哈爾克，伊安德羅·阿拉瑟，和萊特里斯·伊爾加恩。他們所有人都知道通往曼塔-岱瑞絲的路線。

english: Davra is an {@creature assassin}. In addition to her weapons, she carries {@item dust of disappearance} and wears {@item goggles of night} while roaming the dark halls of Gauntlgrym.
zh_tw: 達夫拉是一名{@creature assassin||刺客}。除了她的武器外，她還攜帶著{@item dust of disappearance||無蹤粉}，並在漫遊岡特格瑞姆的黑暗走廊時戴著{@item goggles of night||夜視鏡}。

english: The Way Ahead
zh_tw: 前方之路

english: Depending on how negotiations go, the characters are either an advance force to scout and soften up opposition in the Underdark while looking for valuable strategic information, or a diversionary expedition meant to buy time for the surface world to organize a stronger response. Faction representatives not impressed by the adventurers' cause might return to their factions convinced that the characters have little chance of succeeding—or surviving. The others are confident that the characters can live up to the promise they demonstrated in escaping from the drow and the Underdark.
zh_tw: 根據談判的進展，角色們要麼是先遣部隊，負責偵察幽暗地域並削弱對方的抵抗力，同時尋找有價值的戰略資訊；要麼是為了爭取時間，讓地表世界組織更有力的反應而進行的牽制性探險。對冒險者的事業不以為然的派系代表可能會回到他們的派系，並確信角色們成功或生存的機會很小。其他人則相信角色們能夠實現他們從卓爾和幽暗地域逃脫時所展現的承諾。

english: King Bruenor convenes a final gathering of his inner circle of advisors and the adventurers, giving the characters his thanks for their commitment to the fight against the demon lords.
zh_tw: 布魯諾國王召集了他的顧問核心圈和冒險者們的最後集會，向角色們表達了對他們致力於對抗惡魔領主的鬥爭的感謝。

english: "Ye all know the dangers and threats of the world below, and have bought that knowledge with bravery and guile. Even more, in diplomacy have ye forged the first of the connections that will see the North prepared for what might come. If we survive the coming onslaught, we'll have ye to thank, and no dwarf of Gauntlgrym will soon forget it. Ye all have the courage and conviction of heroes. Aye, I'll even say ye remind me of other heroes I've known. From a previous life. ..."
zh_tw: "你們所有人都知道下方世界的危險和威脅，並且已經用勇敢和詭計購買了那些知識。更進一步，在外交上，你們已經建立了將使北方為可能到來的事情做好準備的首批聯絡。如果我們在即將到來的衝擊中倖存下來，我們將感謝你們，岡特格瑞姆的任何矮人都不會很快忘記它。你們所有人都擁有英雄的勇氣和信念。是的，我甚至要說你們讓我想起了我以前認識的其他英雄。來自前世的......"

english: The characters have at least a few days before they must venture into the Underdark again—time they can spend to shape their plans, gather resources, and prepare for the threats that stand ahead of them. When they are ready to brave the Underdark once again, they can start the long and dangerous journey to Mantol-Derith (see chapter 9).
zh_tw: 角色們至少有幾天時間，然後他們必須再次冒險進入幽暗地域——他們可以利用這段時間來制定計劃，收集資源，併為即將面臨的威脅做好準備。當他們準備好再次勇敢地進入幽暗地域時，他們可以開始漫長而危險的前往曼塔-岱瑞絲的旅程（見第9章）。

english: Chapter 9: Mantol-Derith
zh_tw: 第9章：曼塔-岱瑞絲

english: Mantol-Derith has endured for centuries as a neutral outpost where drow, duergar, svirfneblin, and surface dwellers can meet and trade without fearing for their lives. Despite its usefulness and the safety it enjoys, Mantol-Derith has never become a proper town. Those who maintain it as a trade hub have resisted any urge for expansion, apart from installing basic infrastructure to assist with commercial activities.
zh_tw: 曼塔-岱瑞絲作為中立前哨站已經存在了數個世紀，在這裡，卓爾、灰矮人、地底侏儒以及地表居民可以相遇並進行貿易，而不必擔心自己的生命安全。儘管它具有實用性並且享有安全，曼塔-岱瑞絲從未發展成為一個合適的城鎮。那些將其維護為貿易中心的人抵制了任何擴張的衝動，除了安裝基礎設施以協助商業活動。

english: The Zhentarim took over the holdings where surface dwellers conducted business and quickly cornered the market for surface goods, gaining the organization a foothold in the Underdark. This presence grew into a power base that serves the Black Network well, and which is now being made available to the characters.
zh_tw: 散塔林會接管了地表居民進行交易的領地，並迅速壟斷了地表商品市場，為組織在幽暗地域中獲得了立足點。這種存在發展成為一個權力基礎，很好地服務於黑網，並且現在對角色們開放。

english: Upon arrival, however, the characters discover there is no safe haven anywhere in the Underdark with the demon lords running rampant. The safety of Mantol-Derith has been shattered by the demon lord Fraz-Urb'luu, who has turned the trading outpost's various factions against one another.
zh_tw: 然而，當角色們到達時，他們發現在幽暗地域中沒有任何安全的地方，因為惡魔領主們正在猖獗。曼塔-岱瑞絲的安全已被惡魔領主弗拉茲厄魯破壞，他使得貿易前哨站的各個派系相互對立。

english: The characters must navigate and overcome the madness dominating Mantol-Derith in order to find their Zhentarim contact, {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA}. He has the means for them to reach the stone giant library of Gravenhollow (see {@area chapter 11|3cb|x}), whose vast lore might provide some clue as to what has brought the demon lords to the Underdark.
zh_tw: 角色們必須航行並克服支配曼塔-岱瑞絲的瘋狂，以便找到他們的散塔林會聯絡人，{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}。他擁有讓他們到達刻文谷的石巨人圖書館的手段（見{@area 第十一章|3cb|x}），那裡的豐富知識可能提供一些線索，說明是什麼將惡魔領主帶到了幽暗地域。

english: Fraz-Urb'luu's Gem
zh_tw: 弗拉茲厄魯的寶石

english: Having previously been imprisoned for many mortal lifetimes on the Material Plane, Fraz-Urb'luu had taken steps to bind himself to his layer of the Abyss. As soon as he felt the tug of Gromph's spell, Fraz-Urb'luu transferred his evil life force to a specially crafted, magically protected receptacle—a black jewel. However, the spell proved irresistible, and the precious receptacle was cast into the Underdark. As a further indignity, Fraz-Urb'luu found himself trapped within the gem, unable to escape while on the Material Plane.
zh_tw: 弗拉茲厄魯在物質界曾被囚禁了許多凡人的一生，他已採取措施將自己繫結到他的無底深淵層面。當貢夫的法術拉扯他時，弗拉茲厄魯將自己的邪惡生命力轉移到了一個特別製作的、受到魔法保護的容器——一顆黑色的寶石中。然而，法術證明是不可抗拒的，這個寶貴的容器被投入了幽暗地域。更進一步的侮辱是，弗拉茲厄魯發現自己被困在寶石中，無法在物質界逃脫。

english: Anyone who touches the gem risks falling prey to delusional madness. A duergar ale merchant named Krimgol Muzgardt found the gem and took it to Mantol-Derith. By the time he arrived, Krimgol had succumbed to the delusion that he was a {@i calassabrak}—a duergar without honor. He paid Yantha Coaxrock, an honest svirfneblin mage, to appraise the jewel, hoping that he could use it to buy back the goodwill of his clan. Touched by the gem's madness, Yantha lied to Krimgol and told him the gem was worthless. She offered a lump of gold in exchange, whereupon Krimgol suspected treachery and demanded the gem's immediate return. While Krimgol and Yantha argued, one of Yantha's apprentices tried to hide the gem for his mistress but succumbed to its evil power. The apprentice, Flink, took the gem to the drow enclave, hoping to trade it for some rare spell components that he imagined Yantha needing to make Krimgol go away. A gargoyle assigned to watch for thieves spotted the gem and wrested it from Flink, who hid for fear of incurring Yantha's wrath. Soon thereafter, the delusional gargoyle laid eyes on a drow assassin named {@creature Kinyel Druu'giir|OotA} and was instantly smitten by her. The gargoyle gave her the black gem as a token of its devotion, which she, in her madness, mistook as a payment from the drow enclave to assassinate {@creature Lorthuun|OotA}, a maimed beholder allied with the Zhentarim.
zh_tw: 任何觸控寶石的人都可能陷入妄想的瘋狂。一個名叫克林戈·穆茲加特的灰矮人麥芽酒商人發現了這塊寶石，並將其帶到曼塔-岱瑞絲。到他到達時，克林戈已經陷入了妄想，認為自己是一個沒有榮譽的灰矮人{@i 卡拉薩布拉克}。他付錢給一個誠實的地底侏儒法師揚薩·寇克斯洛克來評估這顆寶石，希望他能用它來買回他部族的好感。揚薩在寶石的瘋狂影響下，對克林戈撒謊說寶石毫無價值。她提供了一塊金子作為交換，於是克林戈懷疑有陰謀並要求立即歸還寶石。當克林戈和揚薩爭論時，揚薩的一個學徒試圖為他的女主人藏起寶石，但屈服於它的邪惡力量。這個學徒，弗林克，帶著寶石去了卓爾的飛地，希望用它交換一些他認為揚薩需要的稀有法術成分，以讓克林戈離開。一隻被指派守望小偷的石像鬼發現了寶石，並從弗林克手中奪走了它，弗林克因害怕招致揚薩的憤怒而躲藏起來。不久之後，陷入妄想的石像鬼看到了一個名叫{@creature Kinyel Druu'giir|OotA|金耶爾·德魯吉爾}的卓爾刺客，並立刻被她迷住了。石像鬼將黑色寶石作為其忠誠的象徵送給了她，而她在瘋狂中誤以為這是來自卓爾飛地的報酬，以暗殺與散塔林會結盟的受傷的眼魔{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}。

english: Yantha's theft of the gem led Krimgol to leave and return with duergar reinforcements. They attacked the svirfneblin enclave and captured Yantha, triggering open conflict between the two enclaves. With the fragile truce in Mantol-Derith finally broken, the drow are preparing to take out the weakened duergar and svirfneblin forces. Meanwhile, Druu'giir has infiltrated a drow delegation sent to meet with representatives of the Zhentarim enclave to discuss how best to divvy up Mantol-Derith between them.
zh_tw: 揚薩偷走了寶石導致克林戈離開並帶著灰矮人援軍返回。他們襲擊了地底侏儒的前哨站並捕獲了揚薩，引發了兩個前哨站之間的公開衝突。隨著曼塔-岱瑞絲脆弱的休戰最終破裂，卓爾正準備消滅被削弱的灰矮人和地底侏儒勢力。與此同時，德魯吉爾已經滲透到一個卓爾代表團中，該代表團被派去與散塔林會前哨站的代表會面，討論如何在他們之間分配曼塔-岱瑞絲的最佳方式。

english: Finding and destroying the gem prevents others from falling prey to Fraz-Urb'luu's madness. While imprisoned inside the gem, {@creature Fraz-Urb'luu|MTF} retains his alignment and senses (see {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}), but loses all of his other attributes and can't take actions. The gem is as big as a human fist and has AC 10, 1 hit point, immunity to poison and psychic damage, and immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons. It is also immune to any spell effect that requires a saving throw. While inside the gem, the demon lord can't be attacked, harmed, coerced, or heard. He can be contacted via telepathy, however. Shattering the gem releases Fraz-Urb'luu's life force, which instantly returns to the demon lord's body in the Abyss.
zh_tw: 找到並摧毀寶石可以防止其他人成為弗拉茲厄魯的瘋狂犧牲品。雖然被囚禁在寶石內，{@creature Fraz-Urb'luu|MTF|弗拉茲厄魯}保留了他的陣營和感知（見{@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20}），但失去了他所有其他屬性並且不能採取行動。寶石的大小相當於人類的拳頭，具有AC 10，1點生命值，對毒素和心靈傷害免疫，以及對來自非魔法武器的鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害免疫。它還對任何需要豁免的法術效果免疫。在寶石內部時，惡魔領主不能被攻擊、傷害、強迫或聽到。然而，可以透過心靈感應與他聯絡。打碎寶石會釋放弗拉茲厄魯的生命力量，這會立即返回到無底深淵中惡魔領主的身體。

english: Any creature that touches the gem must succeed on a {@dc 23} Charisma saving throw or succumb to a form of indefinite madness, as determined by rolling on the Indefinite Madness of Fraz-Urb'luu table in {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the madness-inducing effect of the gem for the next 24 hours. The madness lasts until cured.
zh_tw: 任何觸碰寶石的生物都必須進行一次{@dc 23}魅力豁免檢定，若失敗則陷入某種形式的永久性瘋狂，具體種類由{@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20}中弗拉茲厄魯的永久性瘋狂表擲骰決定。成功透過檢定的生物在接下來的24小時內免疫寶石的致瘋效果。這種瘋狂狀態將持續直到被治癒。

english: If the characters destroy Fraz-Urb'luu's gem, award each of them 1,000 XP.
zh_tw: 如果角色們摧毀了弗拉茲厄魯的寶石，給每個人獎勵1000經驗值。

english: Mantol-Derith: General Features
zh_tw: 曼塔-岱瑞絲：一般特徵

english: Characters encounter the following features inside Mantol-Derith.
zh_tw: 角色們在曼塔-岱瑞絲內部遇到了以下特點。

english: Climate
zh_tw: 氣候

english: Mantol-Derith is chilly and damp thanks to the waterfalls and streams flowing through the cavern and into the Darklake.
zh_tw: 由於流經洞穴並流入黑暗湖的瀑布和溪流，曼塔-岱瑞絲寒冷而潮溼。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Mantol-Derith is brightly lit by continual flame spells and crystals in the walls that reflect the light. A network of walkways and small plazas crisscross the rocky ground of the outpost, paved with crushed crystals that also reflect light.
zh_tw: 曼塔-岱瑞絲被持續火焰法術和牆壁中的晶體照亮，這些晶體能夠反射光線。一系列的步道和小廣場交錯在前哨站的岩石地面上，鋪設著也被用來反射光線的碎裂晶體。

english: Reaching Mantol-Derith
zh_tw: 抵達曼塔-岱瑞絲

english: If the characters reached an agreement with Davra Jassur in {@adventure chapter 8|OotA|7}, they can travel to Mantol-Derith along one of the many routes the Zhentarim use to move merchandise to the trade hub from the surface world. The Black Network doesn't reveal the shortest route for security reasons. Instead, its representatives lead the adventurers to a remote cave in the Surbrin Hills, about 180 miles east of Gauntlgrym. Black Network sentries (six human {@creature Veteran||veterans}) guard the cave, which leads to a series of tunnels. These tunnels descend sharply as they wind their way east for another 200 miles. Check for random encounters as the party's expedition makes its way to Mantol-Derith, using the tables in {@area chapter 2|07f|x}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在{@adventure 第八章|OotA|7}與達芙拉·賈瑟達成了協議，他們可以透過散塔林會用來將商品從地表世界運輸到貿易中心的眾多路線之一前往曼塔-岱瑞絲。出於安全原因，黑網不會透露最短的路線。相反，它的代表們會帶領冒險者們前往位於岡特格瑞姆以東約180英里的瑟布林丘陵的一個偏遠洞穴。黑網哨兵（六名人類{@creature Veteran||老兵}）守衛著這個洞穴，洞穴通向一系列隧道。這些隧道在蜿蜒向東延伸另外200英里的過程中急劇下降。當隊伍的遠徵隊前往曼塔-岱瑞絲時，請使用{@area 第二章|07f|x}中的表格檢查隨機遭遇。

english: If the characters are traveling with faction representatives (see {@adventure chapter 8|OotA|7}), these NPCs help the characters overcome random encounters. Whenever a random encounter check yields a "no encounter" result, use that opportunity to roleplay some of these NPCs and develop their personalities as you see fit.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與派系代表一起旅行（見{@adventure 第八章|OotA|7}），這些NPC將幫助角色們克服隨機遭遇。每當隨機遭遇檢查得到"無遭遇"結果時，利用這個機會來扮演這些NPC，並根據你看到的合適方式發展他們的個性。

english: Mantol-Derith abuts the Darklake and is roughly six days' travel from Blingdenstone and Menzoberranzan, and 22 days from Gracklstugh via the Darklake locks (see the overview map of the Underdark in {@area chapter 2|051|x}). Characters accompanied by Zhentarim guides approach Mantol-Derith via a subterranean rift. A narrow trail winds up the side of the rift, ending at a secret door in the northwest corner of the trade hub (area 1a).
zh_tw: 曼塔-岱瑞絲緊鄰黑暗湖，距離布靈登石城與魔索布萊城各約六天路程；若從格拉克斯圖格經黑暗湖船閘前來，則需22天（見{@area 第2章|051|x}的幽暗地域總覽地圖）。由散塔林會嚮導陪同的角色會經由地下裂谷接近曼塔-岱瑞絲。一條狹窄小徑沿裂谷側壁蜿蜒而上，盡頭是貿易中心西北角的一道暗門（區域1a）。

english: Mantol-Derith
zh_tw: 曼塔-岱瑞絲

english: {@b Population}: Approximately 140 (drow, duergar, humans, and svirfneblin)
zh_tw: {@b 人口}：大約140（卓爾、灰矮人、人類和地底侏儒）

english: {@b Government}: Informal council comprised of four chief negotiators (one per enclave), recently dissolved
zh_tw: {@b 政治}: 由四個首席談判代表（每個前哨站一個）組成的非正式委員會，最近已解散

english: {@b Defense}: Private guards
zh_tw: {@b 防禦}: 私人警衛

english: {@b Commerce}: Rare and exotic goods; see each enclave for information on the goods traded by the duergar, the drow, the svirfneblin, and the Zhentarim
zh_tw: {@b 商業}: 稀有和異國情調的商品；有關灰矮人、卓爾、地底侏儒和散塔林會交易的商品資訊，見各個前哨站

english: {@b Organizations}: The drow, duergar, svirfneblin, and Zhentarim enclaves
zh_tw: {@b 組織}: 卓爾、灰矮人、地底侏儒和散塔林會前哨站

english: Thousands of years' worth of trickling water carved out the cavern where the drow, the duergar, and the svirfneblin established Mantol-Derith. Four warehouses have been excavated at the corners of the cavern, each controlled by an enclave and containing offices and temporary lodgings for its merchants.
zh_tw: 數千年滴水穿石的水流雕刻出了這個洞穴，在這裡，卓爾、灰矮人和地底侏儒建立了曼塔-岱瑞絲。洞穴的四個角落各挖掘了一座倉庫，每個倉庫由一個飛地控制，包含有辦公室和商人的臨時住所。

english: Few of Mantol-Derith's denizens are permanent residents. Even the chief negotiators of each enclave return to their centers of power periodically, leaving representatives to conduct business. Everyone in Mantol-Derith is there to trade, negotiate, and, of course, spy on their counterparts in the other enclaves.
zh_tw: 曼塔-岱瑞絲的居民中很少有永久居民。即使是每個飛地的主要談判代表也會定期返回他們的權力中心，留下代表來進行業務。在曼塔-岱瑞絲的每個人都在那裡進行貿易、談判，當然還有監視其他飛地的同行。

english: The arrival of Fraz-Urb'luu has upset the balance of power in Mantol-Derith (see "Fraz-Urb'luu's Gem"), resulting in open conflict between the duergar and svirfneblin. The drow are poised to eliminate both, thus reducing by two the number of enclaves in Mantol-Derith. The drow are simultaneously hoping to preserve the truce with their Zhentarim neighbors. However, a delusional drow assassin threatens to turn the drow and Zhentarim enclaves against one another.
zh_tw: 弗拉茲厄魯的到來打亂了曼塔-岱瑞絲的權力平衡（見"弗拉茲厄魯的寶石"），導致灰矮人和地底侏儒之間爆發了公開衝突。卓爾準備同時消滅兩者，從而將曼塔-岱瑞絲的前哨站數量減少兩個。卓爾同時也希望與他們的散塔林會鄰居保持休戰。然而，一個妄想的卓爾刺客有可能使卓爾和散塔林會前哨站相互對立。

english: The location of Mantol-Derith is a well-guarded secret, and the influence and power merchants gain from access to it isn't something they want to share. Normally, life in Mantol-Derith is regulated by three simple covenants: no stealing of goods from fellow merchants, no disguising of goods by any means, and no use of magic during negotiations and haggling. The punishment for breaking any covenant is equally straightforward: the violator is wrapped in chains and tossed into the Darklake. Recent events in Mantol-Derith have rendered these rules moot.
zh_tw: 曼塔-岱瑞絲的位置是一個嚴密保守的秘密，而且商人們從進入這裡獲得的影響力和權力並不是他們願意分享的。通常情況下，曼塔-岱瑞絲的生活受到三個簡單公約的規範：不得從同行商人那裡偷竊貨物，不得以任何方式偽裝貨物，以及在談判和討價還價期間不得使用魔法。違反任何公約的懲罰同樣直截了當：違規者被鎖鏈捆綁並扔進黑暗湖中。曼塔-岱瑞絲最近發生的事件使得這些規則變得無效。

english: 1. Secret Entrances
zh_tw: 1. 秘密入口

english: Mantol-Derith is hidden behind 10-foot-square secret doors carved to resemble walls of natural stone. A creature within 5 feet of a secret door can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to spot it. Each secret door has an {@spell arcane lock} spell cast on it. Speaking the proper password within 5 feet of a secret door opens it. Opening a secret door by any means other than the correct password triggers a magical disintegration trap on whichever side the door is opened from. Each creature in the 20-foot-square area directly in front of the secret door must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 ({@dice 10d10}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this trap is disintegrated, leaving only its possessions behind.
zh_tw: 曼塔-岱瑞絲隱藏在雕刻成天然石牆外觀的10尺見方的秘門之後。在秘門5尺範圍內的生物可以進行一次{@dc 15}感知({@skill Perception||感知})檢定來發現它。每扇秘門上都施有{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術。在秘門5尺範圍內說出正確口令可以開啟它。透過除正確口令外的任何方式開啟秘門，都會觸發魔法瓦解陷阱，無論從哪一側開門。在秘門正前方20尺見方區域內的每個生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免，未透過則受到55({@dice 10d10})點力場傷害，透過則受到一半傷害。被這個陷阱減少到0生命值的生物會被瓦解，僅留下其物品。

english: 1a. Northwest Entrance
zh_tw: 1a. 西北入口

english: Characters guided by representatives of the Zhentarim arrive at Mantol-Derith via this route—a subterranean rift with a rough-hewn path carved into one wall. This entrance is also used by svirfneblin from Blingdenstone and drow from Menzoberranzan. The switchback path ends at the secret door whose password is "im'yat," a svirfneblin word meaning "darkness."
zh_tw: 由散塔林會代表引導的角色透過這條路線到達曼塔-岱瑞絲——一個地下裂縫，其中一面牆上雕刻著粗糙的路徑。這個入口也被來自布靈登石城的地底侏儒和來自魔索布萊城的卓爾使用。這條曲折的小徑以一扇秘密門結束，密碼是"im'yat"，一個地底侏儒詞，意思是"黑暗"。

english: 1b. North Entrance
zh_tw: 1b. 北入口

english: The password to open this secret door is "belaern," a drow word meaning "wealth." If the characters are being guided by members of the Black Network, they are led through this secret door into the trench that bisects Mantol-Derith (area 2).
zh_tw: 開啟這扇秘密門的密碼是"belaern"，一個卓爾詞彙，意為"財富"。如果角色們正由黑網的成員引導，他們會透過這扇秘密門進入穿過曼塔-岱瑞絲（區域2）的溝渠。

english: 1c. Northeast Entrance
zh_tw: 1c. 東北入口

english: This secret door stands at the back of a naturally formed ledge overlooking the Darklake. The password to open it is "ssussun," a drow word meaning "light." When the characters first gaze upon the ledge, read the following boxed text to the players.
zh_tw: 這扇秘密門位於一個天然形成的巖架後面，俯瞰著黑暗湖。開啟它的密碼是"ssussun"，一個卓爾詞彙，意為"光"。當角色們第一次凝視這個巖架時，請向玩家朗讀以下加框的文字。

english: An elf with long red hair and a backpack sits on a ledge overlooking a vast, water-filled cavern. The elf is dressed in the finest attire and is dipping his bare feet in the murky water. "Care to join me?" he asks with a wry smile.
zh_tw: 一位長髮及腰的紅髮精靈，揹著揹包，坐在一個俯瞰著巨大、充滿水的洞穴的巖架上。這位精靈穿著最華麗的服裝，光著腳浸泡在渾濁的水中。"願意加入我嗎？"他帶著一絲苦笑問道。

english: The figure dipping his feet in the water is {@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA}, a high elf druid and member of the Emerald Enclave. Use the {@creature druid} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual} to represent him, with the following modifications:
zh_tw: 將腳浸入水中的身影是{@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA|斯拉迪斯·瓦迪爾}，一名高等精靈德魯伊，也是翠綠閒庭的一員。使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的{@creature druid||德魯伊}屬性值來代表他，並做以下修改：

english: Sladis is neutral good.
zh_tw: 斯拉迪斯是中立善良。

english: He has {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet.
zh_tw: 他具有達到60尺範圍的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。

english: He speaks Common, Elvish, and Undercommon.
zh_tw: 他說通用語、精靈語和地底共通語。

english: His fey ancestry gives him advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put him to sleep.
zh_tw: 他的精類血統使他在對抗{@condition charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定上具有優勢，魔法無法使他入睡。

english: He can cast the {@spell prestidigitation} cantrip at will and uses it to make his dirt-stained garments look clean.
zh_tw: 他可以隨意施放{@spell prestidigitation||魔法伎倆}戲法，並利用它使他沾滿汙垢的衣物看起來乾淨。

english: {@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA} has always felt a strange attraction to the Underdark, but the demonic incursion has broken his sanity. He kills and eats other humanoids he encounters or, as he calls it, "culls the herd to maintain the natural order." This is considered a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: {@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA|斯拉迪斯·瓦迪爾}一直對幽暗地域有一種奇特的吸引力，但惡魔的入侵使他失去了理智。他會殺死並吃掉他遇到的其他類人生物，或者，用他的話來說，"透過剔除弱者來維持自然秩序。"這被認為是一種永久性瘋狂的表現（參見{@i 城主指南}第8章中的"{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}"）。

english: Sladis happily accompanies the party and graciously offers his services as a guide. He knows how to get to Neverlight Grove, Blingdenstone, Gracklstugh, and Menzoberranzan, but not Gravenhollow. If the characters invite Sladis to accompany them, he thanks them by offering them some "food" (see "Treasure").
zh_tw: 斯拉迪斯很高興地陪伴著隊伍，並慷慨地提供他的導遊服務。他知道如何到達無光林地、布靈登石城、格拉克斯圖格和魔索布萊城，但不知道如何去刻文谷。如果角色們邀請斯拉迪斯陪同他們，他透過提供一些"食物"（見"寶藏"）來表示感謝。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: In addition to his quarterstaff and spell components, Sladis carries a blood-caked flint knife that he uses to cut up his victims, as well as a {@i Heward's handy haversack} stuffed full of severed limbs and eviscerated organs—the uncooked remains of his svirfneblin, grimlock, quaggoth, and drow victims.
zh_tw: 除了他的長棍和施法材料，斯拉迪斯還攜帶一把血跡斑斑的燧石刀，用來切碎他的受害者，以及一個裝滿切斷的四肢和挖出的器官的{@i 霍華德便利袋}——他地底侏儒、幽邃盲族、幽邃熊怪和卓爾受害者的未煮熟殘餘。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: If the characters cure {@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA}'s madness, award each of them 100 XP. If he is safely returned to Morista Malkin in Gauntlgrym (see {@adventure chapter 8|OotA|7}), award each character 150 XP.
zh_tw: 如果角色們治癒了{@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA|斯拉迪斯·瓦迪爾}的瘋狂，給每個人獎勵100 XP。如果他被安全地送回岡特格瑞姆的莫瑞斯塔·馬爾金（見{@adventure 第八章|OotA|7}），給每個角色獎勵150 XP。

english: 1d. South Entrance and Shore
zh_tw: 1d. 南入口和岸邊

english: This secret door to Mantol-Derith lies halfway down a dead-end tunnel stemming from a rocky shoreline that hugs the Darklake. Duergar traders from Gracklstugh use this entrance. The password to open the secret door is "groht," an archaic Dwarvish word meaning "stone."
zh_tw: 這個通往曼塔-岱瑞絲的秘密門位於一個死衚衕隧道的中段，這個隧道源自一個環繞黑暗湖的巖岸。來自格拉克斯圖格的灰矮人商人使用這個入口。開啟秘密門的口令是"groht"，一個古老的矮人詞彙，意思是"石頭"。

english: When the characters first gaze upon the shore, read the following boxed text to the players.
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次凝視岸邊時，向玩家們朗讀以下加框的文字。

english: Someone has pitched a small tent on this pebbled beach overlooking a vast underground lake. Above the sound of water lapping at the shoreline, you hear a soft, feminine voice humming an unfamiliar tune. The voice comes from inside the tent, which is illuminated from within.
zh_tw: 有人在這片俯瞰著巨大地下湖的卵石海灘上搭起了一個小帳篷。在水拍打岸邊的聲音之上，你聽到一個柔和的女性聲音在哼唱一首不熟悉的曲調。聲音來自帳篷內部，帳篷裡面被照亮了。

english: The tent belongs to the figure inside it: a female human named {@creature Rystia Zav|OotA}. Rystia is a chaotic good Harper {@creature spy} from Nesmé who descended into the Underdark two years ago to find Mantol-Derith and infiltrate the Zhentarim enclave there. She got lost in the depths and has no idea how close she's come to finding what she's been looking for. She also has no idea how to get to the surface. Fear, loneliness, and the demonic incursion have driven her mad. She now believes that everyone she encounters is out to kill her. This is considered a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 這個帳篷屬於裡面的一個人物：一位名叫{@creature Rystia Zav|OotA|瑞斯蒂亞·扎夫}的女性人類。瑞絲蒂亞是一位混亂善良的豎琴手{@creature spy||間諜}，來自涅斯梅。兩年前她深入幽暗地域尋找曼塔-岱瑞絲並滲透那裡的散塔林會據點。她在深處迷了路，完全不知道她已經離她一直在尋找的東西有多近。她也不知道如何返回地表。恐懼、孤獨以及惡魔的入侵讓她發瘋了。她現在認為她遇到的每個人都想殺死她。這被視為一種永久性瘋狂形式（見{@i 城主指南}第8章中的"{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}"）。

english: Traps
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: Rystia has planted four spring-loaded hunting traps under the pebbles around her tent. A creature within 15 feet of the tent can spot the hidden traps with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Any creature that approaches within 10 feet of the tent and is unaware of the traps steps on one (see chapter 5, "{@book Equipment|PHB|5|Adventuring Gear}," in the {@i Player's Handbook} for hunting trap rules).
zh_tw: 瑞斯蒂亞 在她的帳篷周圍的鵝卵石下埋設了四個彈簧捕獵陷阱。任何在帳篷15尺範圍內的生物，如果成功透過了一個{@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，可以發現這些隱蔽的陷阱。任何進入帳篷10尺範圍內且未察覺陷阱的生物會踩到其中一個（關於捕獵陷阱的規則，請參見{@book 裝備|PHB|5|Adventuring Gear}，位於{@i 玩家手冊}第5章）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: In addition to her weapons and traps, Rystia possesses a satchel made from carrion crawler hide, inside which are ten pounds of edible fungi. She also carries a full waterskin and three torchstalks (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2), one of which is already lit.
zh_tw: 除了她的武器和陷阱，瑞斯蒂亞還擁有一個由食腐蟲皮製成的小包，在裡面有十磅可食用的真菌。她還攜帶著一個裝滿水的水袋和三個火把柄（見第2章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"），其中一個已經點燃。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: If the characters cure Rystia's madness, award each of them 100 XP.
zh_tw: 如果角色們治癒了瑞斯蒂亞的瘋狂，給每個人獎勵100 XP。

english: 1e. Zhentarim Secret Door
zh_tw: 1e. 散塔林會秘密門

english: The password to open this secret door is "eyebite."
zh_tw: 開啟這個秘密門的密碼是"攝心目光"。

english: The tunnel leading away from Mantol-Derith winds steadily upward, and branches leading to other areas of the Underdark have been sealed off with {@spell wall of stone} spells, leaving a single navigable passage. This passage is clear of monsters, but the Zhents have installed trip wires and pressure plates at irregular intervals. These are triggering mechanisms for collapsing roofs, poison darts, and rolling spheres (see "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). The passage ends at a dungeon complex under a ruined watchtower overlooking the Surbrin River, north of the Evermoors. The Zhentarim have guards stationed throughout the dungeon to keep surface dwellers from finding their way to Mantol-Derith via this route. If the characters find this secret door and use it to make their way back to the surface world, design and populate the Zhentarim dungeon as you see fit.
zh_tw: 從曼塔-岱瑞絲延伸出的隧道穩步向上蜿蜒，通往幽暗地域其他區域的分支已被{@spell wall of stone||石牆術}封鎖，只留下一條可通行的通道。這條通道沒有怪物，但散塔林會成員在不規則間隔處設定了絆線和壓力板。這些是觸發塌陷屋頂、毒鏢和滾動巨石的機制（參見{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}，位於{@i 城主指南}第5章）。通道的盡頭是一座廢棄瞭望塔下的地牢建築群，俯瞰著蘇布林河，位於永暮沼澤以北。散塔林會在地牢各處佈置了守衛，以防止地表居民透過這條路找到曼塔-岱瑞絲。如果角色發現這扇秘密門並利用它返回地表世界，請根據你的想法設計和規劃散塔林會地牢。

english: 2. Trench
zh_tw: 2. 溝渠

english: This 20-foot-wide, 50-foot-deep trench bisects Mantol-Derith from north to south, with a secret door at each end (areas 1b and 1d, respectively). A shattered platform of crystal sits in the middle of the trench—an old magic device once used to lift caravans up into the main cavern of the outpost and back down into the trench. It now lies broken, its magic spent.
zh_tw: 這條20尺寬、50尺深的溝渠從北到南穿過曼塔-岱瑞絲，兩端各有一個秘密門（分別是區域1b和1d）。一個破碎的水晶平臺位於溝渠的中間——這是一個曾經用來將商隊升入前哨站主洞穴並降回溝渠的古老魔法裝置。現在它已經破碎，魔力耗盡。

english: The duergar and drow collaborated to replace the crystal lift with a system of four mechanical lifts, two on each side of the shattered platform. These lifts use magic to power their winches and lighten the loads on the lifts. Each lift is designed for easy use and can be operated as an action simply by pulling on a lever.
zh_tw: 灰矮人和卓爾合作，用四套機械升降機取代了水晶升降機，破碎平臺的每一側都有兩套。這些升降機使用魔法來驅動絞車，並減輕升降機上的負載。每套升降機都設計得易於使用，只需透過拉動一個槓桿即可作為動作簡單操作。

english: The trench's walls sport numerous handholds and can be climbed with a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 溝渠的牆壁上有許多抓手，透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可攀爬。

english: 3. Main Cavern
zh_tw: 3. 主洞穴

english: When the characters exit the trench, they find the normally quiet outpost in chaos.
zh_tw: 當角色們離開溝渠時，他們發現通常安靜的前哨站陷入了混亂。

english: The trench bisects an enormous cavern with a 30-foot-high ceiling supported by naturally formed stone columns. {@spell Continual flame} spells cast on stone lampposts reflect off crystals embedded in the walls and ceiling, illuminating myriad fountains, waterfalls, streams, and pools. Water drips from stalactites onto leather tarps covering clusters of merchant stalls west and east of the trench. Beyond these marketplaces are well-tended gardens of mold and fungi, crystal walkways, and stone bridges. The tranquil beauty of Mantol-Derith is undone by sounds of combat to the northeast, where you hear the thunderous boom of metal against stone and see panicked svirfneblin running from 8-foot-tall duergar.
zh_tw: 這條溝渠將一個巨大的洞穴一分為二，洞穴有一個30尺高的天花板，由自然形成的石柱支撐。在石制路燈柱上施放的{@spell Continual flame||不滅明焰}法術反射在牆壁和天花板中嵌入的水晶上，照亮了無數的噴泉、瀑布、溪流和水池。水滴從鐘乳石滴落到覆蓋在溝渠西邊和東邊的商人攤位群集上的皮革防水布上。在這些市場之外，有精心照料的黴菌和真菌花園、水晶走道和石橋。曼塔-岱瑞絲的寧靜之美被東北方的戰鬥聲破壞了，你聽到金屬撞擊石頭的雷鳴般的轟鳴聲，並看到驚慌失措的地底侏儒從8尺高的灰矮人那裡逃跑。

english: The marketplaces of Mantol-Derith have been closed ever since the duergar attacked the svirfneblin. The duergar are killing any svirfneblin they encounter and breaking into the svirfneblin warehouse (see area 6a).
zh_tw: 自從灰矮人攻擊地底侏儒以來，曼塔-岱瑞絲的市場已經關閉。灰矮人正在殺害他們遇到的任何地底侏儒，並闖入地底侏儒的倉庫（見區域6a）。

english: 3a. West Marketplace
zh_tw: 3a. 西市場

english: The drow and Zhentarim markets are clustered here, on the west side of the trench. However, the tents, stalls, and pens stand empty, the merchants having retreated to their respective enclaves with their goods and livestock. A stream runs nearby, crossed by two stone bridges leading to the drow and Zhentarim enclaves. The stream is 5 feet deep and fed by the Darklake. The water isn't fit for drinking.
zh_tw: 卓爾和散塔林會市場聚集在這裡，在溝渠的西邊。然而，帳篷、貨攤和圍欄都空著，商人已經帶著他們的貨物和牲畜撤退到了他們各自的飛地。附近有一條小溪，由兩座石橋穿過，通向卓爾和散塔林會飛地。這條小溪深5尺，由黑暗湖供水。水不適合飲用。

english: 3b. East Marketplace
zh_tw: 3b. 東部市場

english: The svirfneblin and duergar markets are clustered on the east side of the trench. Most of their tents and stalls have been knocked over, and various goods (see "Treasure") are strewn upon the cavern floor amid the slaughtered corpses of giant lizards and steeders. Characters approaching the market see two enlarged {@creature duergar} chasing a pair of {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnomes} who have cast {@spell blur} spells on themselves. A third unarmed {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} is hiding in plain sight under the wreckage of a zurkhwood stall. He has a pale leather bag tucked under one arm.
zh_tw: 斯維爾弗涅布林和杜爾加市場聚集在溝壑的東側。他們的大部分帳篷和攤位已被掀翻，各種貨物（見"寶藏"）散落在地洞的地面上，周圍是巨蜥和斯提德的屍體。接近市場的角色會看到兩個巨大的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}正在追逐一對對自己施放了{@spell blur||朦朧術}的{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}。第三個手無寸鐵的{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}正躲在一個佐克木攤位的廢墟下，幾乎無處可藏。他的腋下夾著一個蒼白的皮革袋子。

english: If the characters rescue the blurry svirfneblin, they reveal that more duergar are trying to smash into the svirfneblin warehouse (area 6b), and that Yantha Coaxrock, a svirfneblin mage, has been captured and taken to the duergar warehouse (area 5b). The svirfneblin don't know why the duergar broke the peace in Mantol-Derith. If a duergar is captured and interrogated, he or she reveals that Yantha stole a valuable gemstone from a duergar merchant and refused to return it.
zh_tw: 如果角色們救援了模糊不清的地底侏儒，他們會透露更多的灰矮人正試圖闖入地底侏儒倉庫（區域6b），並且地底侏儒法師揚薩·寇克斯洛克被捕並被帶到灰矮人倉庫（區域5b）。地底侏儒不知道為什麼灰矮人破壞了曼塔-岱瑞絲的和平。如果一個灰矮人被捕並受到審問，他或她透露揚薩從一個灰矮人商人那裡偷走了一顆有價值的寶石並拒絕歸還。

english: Peebles
zh_tw: 皮布林斯

english: The svirfneblin holding the bag is {@creature Peebles|OotA}. He came to Mantol-Derith to investigate rumors of a beholder living here. He claims to be fascinated by aberrations, beholders in particular. He has confirmed that there are no beholders in the duergar or svirfneblin enclaves, but he hasn't yet been able to explore the drow or Zhentarim enclaves.
zh_tw: 持有袋子的地底侏儒是{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}。他來到曼塔-岱瑞絲調查有關這裡居住著一隻眼魔的傳言。他聲稱對異怪特別著迷，特別是眼魔。他已經確認在灰矮人或地底侏儒飛地沒有眼魔，但他還沒有能夠探索卓爾或散塔林會飛地。

english: {@creature Peebles|OotA} is the deranged, neutral evil servant of {@creature Xazax the Eyemonger|OotA}, a beholder that hunts other beholders, takes their eyestalks, and grafts them to its own body. {@creature Peebles|OotA} is Xazax's private surgeon. Once he has confirmed the presence of a beholder in Mantol-Derith, {@creature Peebles|OotA} plans to find his "master" and share the news of his discovery. He suggests that the characters take him to the drow or Zhentarim enclave, under the pretense of having information about the duergar attack. Once he has found {@creature Lorthuun|OotA} the beholder, {@creature Peebles|OotA} tries to leave Mantol-Derith at once. If the characters delay his departure, he gets angry at them and claims to be an expert Underdark guide, promising to lead them wherever they wish to go. If they accept his offer, he leads them to {@creature Xazax the Eyemonger|OotA} (see {@adventure chapter 10|OotA|9} for more information).
zh_tw: {@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯} 是瘋狂的中立邪惡僕從，屬於{@creature Xazax the Eyemonger|OotA|眼商札札克斯}，一個獵殺其他眼魔，奪取它們的眼睛觸手，並將其嫁接到自己身上的眼魔。{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯} 是札札克斯的私人外科醫生。一旦他確認了曼塔-岱瑞絲有眼魔的存在，{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯} 計劃找到他的"主人"並分享他的發現。他建議角色們帶他去卓爾或散塔林會飛地，藉口是擁有關於灰矮人攻擊的資訊。一旦他找到了{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩} 這個眼魔，{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯} 就試圖立即離開曼塔-岱瑞絲。如果角色們推遲他的離開，他會對他們生氣，並聲稱自己是一個專家幽暗地域嚮導，承諾帶領他們去任何他們想去的地方。如果他們接受了他的提議，他會帶領他們去{@creature Xazax the Eyemonger|OotA|眼商札札克斯}（見{@adventure 第十章|OotA|9} 瞭解更多資訊）。

english: {@creature Peebles|OotA}'s bag is made from stitched quaggoth hide and contains a pair of sharpened flint knives, a spool of thread made from roper gut, a thin iron needle, two pounds of barrelstalk flesh, and a copper canteen containing a half gallon of water.
zh_tw: {@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}的袋子是用縫合的幽邃熊怪皮製成的，裡面有一對磨尖的燧石刀、一卷由繩索腸製成的線、一根細鐵針、兩磅桶莖肉和一隻裝有半加侖水的銅水壺。

english: Pool
zh_tw: 水池

english: The large pool east of the market is fed by small waterfalls pouring through cracks in the cavern ceiling. The water is fresh and safe to drink. Growing along the shore are {@dice 3d6} waterorbs (see "Fungi of the Underdark").
zh_tw: 市場東側的大水池由洞穴頂部裂縫中傾瀉而出的小瀑布供水。水是新鮮的，安全可飲。沿著岸邊生長的是{@dice 3d6}個水泡果（見"幽暗地域的真菌"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who search the marketplace find a total of {@dice 2d6} 50 gp gems scattered about.
zh_tw: 角色們在市場搜尋時發現了總共 {@dice 2d6} 顆價值 50 gp 的寶石散落各處。

english: 4. Drow Enclave
zh_tw: 4. 卓爾飛地

english: The drow use Mantol-Derith to trade exquisite and exotic goods according to their rarefied tastes. Rare perfumes, potions, distilled beverages, and other alchemical products are some of their regular goods, as well as common and uncommon magic items. House Baenre controls the flow of merchandise here, placing and removing chief negotiators as their efficiency wanes.
zh_tw: 卓爾利用曼塔-岱瑞絲交易符合他們高雅品味的精緻和異國情調的商品。稀有香水、藥劑、蒸餾飲料以及其他鍊金產品是他們的常規商品，還有普通和不常見的魔法物品。班瑞家族控制著這裡的商品流通，根據他們的效率增減首席談判代表。

english: Sirak Mazelor is the current drow representative. A sophisticated merchant, she deals in luxury items from drow artisans: gems of high value, incense, art objects, various magical treasures, and exotic spices and spirits exclusive to the Underdark.
zh_tw: 西拉克·馬澤洛是現任卓爾代表。她是一位精明的商人，經營著卓爾工匠製作的奢侈品：高價值的寶石、香料、藝術品、各種魔法寶藏，以及專屬於幽暗地域的異國香料和烈酒。

english: 4a. Drow Fungi Grove
zh_tw: 4a. 卓爾真菌林

english: This is where the drow cultivate edible and poisonous fungi. In the heart of the fungi grove is a stunted zurkhwood mushroom, 20 feet tall, with a thick stalk and a wide cap that forms a dome, keeping the area underneath dry. The dark elves use the mushroom as a pavilion, and this is where Sirak Mazelor conducts business with visiting traders.
zh_tw: 這裡是卓爾人培育食用和有毒真菌的地方。在真菌林的中心是一株矮小的蘇克木蘑菇，高20尺，有一個粗大的莖和一個寬闊的頂蓋，形成了一個圓頂，保持下面的區域乾燥。卓爾將蘑菇用作亭子，這就是西拉克·馬澤洛與來訪商人進行交易的地方。

english: Six {@creature Gargoyle||gargoyles} perch on natural ledges overlooking the fungi grove. They attack any creature unaccompanied by a drow that approaches the stone double doors leading to the drow warehouse (area 4b). Standing in front of the double doors are two female {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} that do the same.
zh_tw: 六隻{@creature Gargoyle||石像鬼}棲息在自然形成的壁架上，俯瞰著真菌林。它們會攻擊任何沒有卓爾陪伴、接近通往卓爾倉庫（區域4b）的石頭雙門的生物。站在雙門前的是兩名{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}，她們也會採取同樣的行動。

english: Zilchyn Q'Leptin
zh_tw: 齊爾欽·奎普廷

english: Sitting on a zurkhwood bench under the giant zurkhwood mushroom is a male {@creature drow mage} named {@creature Zilchyn Q'Leptin|OotA}. Trained as a wizard in Menzoberranzan, "Zilch" was forced to flee the drow city after a rash of spell component thefts was traced back to him. He can't control his kleptomania, which is considered a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). This madness befell Zilch long before the demon lords arrived, and has only gotten worse since.
zh_tw: 坐在巨大的祖克木蘑菇下的祖克木長椅上的是一位名叫{@creature Zilchyn Q'Leptin|OotA|齊爾欽·奎普廷}的{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}。在魔索布萊城受訓成為法師的"西爾欽"因一系列法術材料盜竊事件被追查到而被迫逃離卓爾城。他無法控制自己的偷竊癖，這種症狀被認為是一種永久性瘋狂（參見{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}，位於{@i 城主指南}的第8章）。這種瘋狂在惡魔領主到來之前很久就降臨在西爾欽身上，並且從那以後只會變得更糟。

english: Zilch lost his spellbook during his escape from Menzoberranzan, and an unfortunate encounter with a black pudding left him with acid scars covering the left side of his body, including his face. In addition to his staff, which doubles as a walking stick, the drow carries a purple bag made of kuo-toa skin that contains hand-drawn maps of the Underdark on sheets of trillimac, material components for all of Zilch's prepared spells, and {@dice 1d4 + 3} stolen trinkets (roll on the Trinkets table in {@book chapter 5|PHB|5|Trinkets} of the {@i Player's Handbook}). Characters can use Zilch's maps to get to Menzoberranzan, Gracklstugh, or the Wormwrithings from Mantol-Derith.
zh_tw: 齊爾欽在逃離魔索布萊城時丟失了他的法術書，而不幸的是，他在與一隻黑色軟泥怪的遭遇中，身體的左側，包括臉部，留下了酸蝕疤痕。除了他的法杖（同時用作手杖），這位卓爾還攜帶著一個由寇濤魚人皮製成的紫色袋子，裡面裝有手繪的幽暗地域地圖，畫在褶扇菇皮紙上，以及齊爾欽所有準備法術的材料成分和{@dice 1d4 + 3}個被偷來的小飾品（可在{@book 第五章|PHB|5|Trinkets}中的{@i 玩家手冊}的小飾品表上擲骰）。角色們可以使用齊爾欽的地圖從曼塔-岱瑞絲前往魔索布萊城、格拉克斯圖格或蠕蟲扭道。

english: Zilch doesn't know what caused the duergar to attack the svirfneblin, but he knows the drow merchants have withdrawn to the warehouse and that the drow are waiting to see how the violence plays out. If the characters seem approachable, Zilch offers to help them get inside the drow warehouse.
zh_tw: 齊爾欽不知道是什麼導致灰矮人攻擊地底侏儒，但他知道卓爾商人已經撤退到倉庫，並且卓爾正在等待看看暴力事件如何發展。如果角色看起來容易接近，齊爾欽願意幫助他們進入卓爾倉庫。

english: If the characters take a short or long rest and Zilch is with them, he attempts to steal something from one randomly determined party member. Far from being a skilled thief, Zilch must succeed at a Dexterity check contested by the passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) scores of every character with line of sight to him. If he wins the contest, Zilch hides the stolen item in his bag and feigns innocence if questioned about the item's disappearance.
zh_tw: 如果角色們進行短休或長休，並且齊爾欽與他們在一起，他會試圖從隨機確定的一名隊伍成員那裡偷東西。齊爾欽遠非一個熟練的小偷，他必須在敏捷檢定中成功，與所有視線範圍內的角色的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分競爭。如果他贏得這場競爭，齊爾欽會將偷來的物品藏在他的包裡，如果被問及物品的失蹤，他會裝作無辜。

english: Flink Thunderbonk
zh_tw: 弗林克·雷擊

english: Huddled against a stone column at the edge of the fungi grove is a cowardly {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} named Flink. He suffers from a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) that makes him want to please his mistress, Yantha Coaxrock, and also causes him to be deathly afraid of her. He uses his Stone Camouflage feature to blend in with the rocky terrain, afraid that the drow and the gargoyles might attack him. If he sees the characters, he runs toward them in a panic, babbling about a stolen gem. A successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation} or {@skill Persuasion}) check or {@spell calm emotions} spell allows Flink to speak coherently, whereupon he reveals the following information:
zh_tw: 蜷縮在真菌林邊緣一根石柱旁的是一個名叫弗林克的膽小 {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}。他患有一種永久性瘋狂形式（參見 {@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}，位於 {@i 城主指南} 第八章），這讓他想要取悅他的女主人揚薩·寇克斯洛克，同時也讓他對她極度恐懼。他利用他的石膚偽裝特性與岩石地形融為一體，害怕卓爾和石像鬼可能會攻擊他。如果他看到角色們，他會驚慌失措地向他們跑去，語無倫次地提及一顆被盜的寶石。成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇} 或 {@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定或 {@spell calm emotions||安定心神} 法術能讓弗林克有條理地說話，此時他會透露以下資訊：

english: A duergar ale merchant named Krimgol Muzgardt asked Flink's mistress, Yantha Coaxrock, to appraise a large black gemstone. For reasons unknown to Flink, Yantha didn't want to give the gemstone back to the duergar and instead offered him a lump of gold in trade. An argument ensued.
zh_tw: 一個名叫克林戈·穆茲加特的灰矮人啤酒商人請弗林克的主人，揚薩·寇克斯洛克，評估一顆大黑寶石。出於弗林克不知道的原因，揚薩不想將寶石歸還給灰矮人，而是向他提供了一塊金子作為交換。隨後發生了爭論。

english: Yantha entrusted the gemstone to Flink. He took it to the drow enclave to buy an eyelash encased in gum arabic—the component for an {@spell invisibility} spell, knowing that's what Yantha would want him to do. Before he could complete this task, a gargoyle snatched the gemstone from Flink's grasp. Flink is afraid Yantha will punish him for losing the gemstone.
zh_tw: 揚薩將寶石託付給了弗林克。他帶著它去了卓爾的聚居地，想要購買一個包裹在阿拉伯膠中的睫毛——這是{@spell invisibility||隱形}法術的成分，他知道那是揚薩希望他做的。在他完成這項任務之前，一隻石像鬼從弗林克手中搶走了寶石。弗林克害怕揚薩會因為他丟失了寶石而懲罰他。

english: Flink has been spying on the gargoyles to find the one that took his gem, but that gargoyle isn't among the ones currently guarding the drow enclave.
zh_tw: 弗林克一直在監視石像鬼，尋找那個拿走他寶石的那個，但那個石像鬼並不在目前守衛卓爾飛地的那些石像鬼當中。

english: 4b. Drow Warehouse
zh_tw: 4b. 卓爾倉庫

english: The drow warehouse is both a fortress and a residence. The stone double doors leading to it have an {@spell arcane lock} spell cast on them, which only Sirak Mazelor and her elite warrior guards can bypass.
zh_tw: 卓爾倉庫既是堡壘又是住所。通往那裡的石制雙扇門上施有{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}咒語，只有西拉克·馬澤洛爾和她精銳的戰士守衛才能透過。

english: Characters who gain entry find the warehouse occupied by two female {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors}, eighteen {@creature drow} merchants, nine {@creature quaggoth} slaves, and six {@creature Giant Lizard||giant lizards} fitted with saddles (use the giant riding lizard statistics in {@area chapter 8|34c|x}). The 30-foot-high ceiling of the warehouse is hidden with thick webs that conceal a dozen {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} loyal to the drow.
