zh_tw: 進入倉庫的角色會發現這裡被兩名女性{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}、十八名{@creature drow||卓爾}商人、九名{@creature quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}奴隸和六隻配備了鞍具的{@creature Giant Lizard||巨蜥}（使用{@area 第八章|34c|x}中的巨型騎乘蜥蜴統計資料）佔據。倉庫高達30尺的天花板被厚厚的蛛網遮蔽，裡面隱藏著十幾只對卓爾忠誠的{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}。

english: The warehouse's denizens attack the party unless the characters are accompanied by a drow. The merchants have been instructed to remain in the warehouse until Sirak Mazelor returns. The drow chief negotiator and her entourage have gone to the Zhentarim enclave (area 7) to meet with representatives of the Black Network, in the hopes of forging an alliance against the unruly duergar and svirfneblin enclaves.
zh_tw: 除非角色們有卓爾陪伴，否則倉庫的居民會攻擊隊伍。商人們已被指示留在倉庫裡，直到西拉克·馬澤洛回來。卓爾首席談判代表和她的隨行人員已經前往散塔林會飛地（區域7），與黑網的代表會面，希望建立一個聯盟，對抗不守規矩的灰矮人和地底侏儒飛地。

english: The drow sleep in cots arranged in neat rows, while the merchants store their valuable wares in three stone buildings. The door to each building is protected by a {@spell glyph of warding} (save {@dc 14}) that triggers an explosive runes effect ({@dice 5d8} thunder damage) when a creature other than a drow opens it.
zh_tw: 卓爾們整齊排列的小床上休息，而商人則將他們的貴重商品存放在三座石質建築中。每座建築的門都受到一個{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}的保護（豁免{@dc 14}），當非卓爾的生物開啟門時，會觸發爆炸符文效果（{@dice 5d8}點雷鳴傷害）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each storage building contains {@dice 2d6} crystal vials of exotic perfume worth 100 gp each, {@dice 3d6} crystal bottles of distilled beverages worth 25 gp each, {@dice 1d4} magic items (determined by rolling on Magic Item Table A in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Treasure Tables} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}), and {@dice 2d6} vials of carrion crawler mucus (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Characters also find {@dice 1d10 × 10} pounds of food and {@dice 1d10 × 5} gallons of water stored in each building.
zh_tw: 每座倉庫都有{@dice 2d6}瓶珍奇香水，裝在水晶小瓶中，每瓶價值100金幣；{@dice 3d6}瓶以水晶瓶盛裝的蒸餾飲品，每瓶價值25金幣；{@dice 1d4}件魔法物品（擲{@i 城主指南}{@book 第7章|DMG|7|Treasure Tables}的魔法物品表A決定）；以及{@dice 2d6}瓶食腐蟲黏液（見{@i 城主指南}第8章的「{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}」）。角色也能在每座倉庫中找到{@dice 1d10 × 10}磅食物與{@dice 1d10 × 5}加侖的水。

english: 5. Duergar Enclave
zh_tw: 5. 灰矮人聚居地

english: The gray dwarves trade mostly in armor and weapons of superior craftsmanship, but their enclave also deals in other metalwork, raw ores, and uncut gemstones. The duergar chief negotiator is Ghuldur Flagonfist, who sells armor, arrowheads, locks, mining and smithing equipment, and smoked Darklake fish. Ghuldur is friends with Krimgol Muzgardt, a gray dwarf merchant who sells frothy Darklake Stout ale.
zh_tw: 灰矮人主要交易工藝精良的盔甲和武器，但他們的聚居地也處理其他金屬製品、原礦石和未切割的寶石。灰矮人首席談判代表是古爾杜·酒壺拳，他出售盔甲、箭頭、鎖具、採礦和鍛造裝置，以及煙燻的黑暗湖魚。古爾杜是克林戈·穆茲加特的朋友，後者是一位灰矮人商人，出售泡沫豐富的黑暗湖烈性黑啤酒。

english: 5a. Duergar Fungi Grove
zh_tw: 5a. 灰矮人真菌林

english: An iron-wrought fence encloses this fungal grove, through which the duergar have carved narrow aisles. The grove contains a host of edible fungi and is illuminated by six nightlight mushrooms (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2). A tunnel in the south wall leads to a set of double stone doors.
zh_tw: 一個鐵製圍欄圍繞著這片真菌林，灰矮人在其中雕刻了狹窄的通道。林中生長著許多可食用的真菌，並由六盞夜光蘑菇照亮（見第2章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）。南牆上的一條隧道通向一對石制雙門。

english: Guarding the fungi grove are four {@condition invisible} {@creature duergar} that attack intruders on sight. Four more {@condition invisible} {@creature duergar} stand in front of the double doors and attack any non-duergar that come into view.
zh_tw: 守衛真菌林的是四個處於{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}，它們會攻擊任何進入視線的入侵者。另外四個處於{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}站在雙扇門前，攻擊任何進入視線的非灰矮人。

english: 5b. Duergar Warehouse
zh_tw: 5b. 灰矮人倉庫

english: The stone double doors to the warehouse are unlocked and open to reveal a 40-foot-high, rough-hewn chamber containing thirty {@creature duergar} merchants and twelve {@creature Male Steeder|MTF|male steeders} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) used as pack animals. These duergar aren't spoiling for a fight and parley with intruders, sharing the following information:
zh_tw: 倉庫的石制雙扇門未上鎖且敞開著，露出一個40尺高的粗糙鑿制的房間，裡麵包含三十名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}商人和十二頭用作馱運動物的{@creature Male Steeder|MTF|雄性騎蛛}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）。這些灰矮人並不尋求戰鬥，而是與入侵者進行談判，分享了以下資訊：

english: A svirfneblin mage stole a gemstone from a duergar ale merchant named Krimgol Muzgardt. Krimgol is a good friend of Mantol-Derith's duergar chief negotiator, Ghuldur Flagonfist.
zh_tw: 一個地底侏儒法師從一個叫克林戈·穆茲加特的灰矮人啤酒商人那裡偷走了一顆寶石。克林戈是曼塔-岱瑞絲灰矮人首席談判代表古爾杜·酒壺拳的好朋友。

english: When the svirfneblin mage refused to return the stolen gem, Flagonfist sent {@condition invisible} duergar to the svirfneblin enclave to capture her and bring her to him for questioning.
zh_tw: 當地底侏儒法師拒絕歸還被盜的寶石時，酒壺拳派遣了處於{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態的灰矮人前往地底侏儒聚居地，將她捕獲並帶到他那裡進行審問。

english: Other svirfneblin tried to free the mage, leading to the first of several armed confrontations. Flagonfist has since sent his duergar guards to storm the neighboring enclave and wipe out the deep gnomes.
zh_tw: 其他地底侏儒試圖解救法師，這導致了第一次幾次武裝衝突。此後，酒壺拳派他的灰矮人守衛去突襲鄰近的飛地並消滅地底侏儒。

english: A 20-foot-high stone building stands in the northeast corner of the warehouse. Inside this unlocked building, Ghuldur Flagonfist and Krimgol Muzgardt (a pair of male {@creature duergar}) are interrogating Yantha Coaxrock, an unarmed female monster deep gnome suffering from a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) that makes her tell lies, even at the risk of harming herself and others. The duergar have dressed her in a robe sewn with gemstones (see "Treasure" below) and suspended her above the mouth of Ghuldur's "pet"—a hungry {@creature xorn}. Ghuldur grasps the rope from which she hangs and is threatening to feed her to the xorn unless she divulges the location of the gem she stole from Krimgol.
zh_tw: 一座20尺高的石質建築矗立在倉庫的東北角。在這座未上鎖的建築內，古爾杜·酒壺拳和克林戈·穆茲加特（一對男性{@creature duergar||灰矮人}）正在審訊一個手無寸鐵的女性地底侏儒——受到一種無限期瘋狂影響的揚薩·寇克斯洛克（見{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}，位於{@i 城主指南}第8章），這種瘋狂使她不斷撒謊，甚至不惜傷害自己和他人。灰矮人給她穿了一件縫有寶石的長袍（見下文"寶藏"部分），並將她懸掛在古爾杜的"寵物"——一隻飢餓的{@creature xorn||石鼎獸}的嘴上方。古爾杜抓住了懸掛她的繩子，威脅要將她餵給石鼎獸，除非她交代從克林戈那裡偷走的寶石的下落。

english: Yantha Coaxrock
zh_tw: 揚薩·寇克斯洛克

english: {@creature Yantha Coaxrock|OotA|Yantha} is the leader of the Stoneheart Enclave based in Blingdenstone (see {@adventure chapter 6|OotA|5}). She is bound with rope and spinning an elaborate lie about how the drow must've {@condition charmed} her and taken Krimgol's gem. She has an Intelligence of 16 (+3) and the following additional feature:
zh_tw: {@creature Yantha Coaxrock|OotA|揚薩} 是位於布靈登石城（見{@adventure 第六章|OotA|5}）的石心聚居地的領導者。她被繩子綁著，正在編造一個精心設計的謊言，講述卓爾是如何{@condition charmed||魅惑}她並拿走了克林戈的寶石。她的智力為16（+3），並具有以下額外特性：

english: Spellcasting
zh_tw: 施法

english: Yantha is a 5th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 13}). She has the following wizard spells prepared:
zh_tw: 揚薩是一位5級施法者。她的施法能力是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 13}）。她準備以下法師法術：

english: Cantrips (at will): {@spell dancing lights}, {@spell friends}, {@spell mending}, {@spell prestidigitation}
zh_tw: 隨意施展的戲法：{@spell dancing lights||舞光術}，{@spell friends||交友術}，{@spell mending||修復術}，{@spell prestidigitation||魔法伎倆}

english: 1st level (4 slots): {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell Tenser's floating disk}
zh_tw: 1環（4個法術位）：{@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言}，{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}，{@spell Tenser's floating disk||譚森浮碟術}

english: 2nd level (3 slots): {@spell detect thoughts}, {@spell hold person}
zh_tw: 2環（3個法術位）：{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}，{@spell hold person||定身類人}

english: 3rd level (2 slots): {@spell sending}
zh_tw: 3環（2個法術位）：{@spell sending||短訊術}

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The storage building contains {@dice 1d10 × 10} pounds of food, {@dice 1d10 × 5} gallons of water, thirty zurkhwood casks of Darklake Stout ale worth 50 gp each, and a plethora of finely crafted metalworks:
zh_tw: 儲存建築包含{@dice 1d10 × 10}磅食物，{@dice 1d10 × 5}加侖水，三十個祖爾木桶裝的黑暗湖烈性黑啤酒，每個價值50金幣，以及大量精心製作的金屬工藝品：

english: {@dice 2d6} battleaxes
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 戰斧

english: {@dice 2d6} glaives
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 月刃

english: {@dice 2d6} lances
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 長矛

english: {@dice 2d6} longswords
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 長劍

english: {@dice 2d6} morningstars
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 晨星

english: {@dice 2d6} war picks
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 把戰鎬

english: {@dice 2d6} warhammers
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 戰錘

english: {@dice 1d6} suits of half-plate
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 套半板甲

english: {@dice 1d6} suits of chainmail
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 套鎖子甲

english: {@dice 1d6} suits of splint mail
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 套鱗甲

english: {@dice 1d6} suits of plate mail
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 套板甲

english: An iron safe stands in a corner of the storage building. The safe weighs 1,000 pounds, is locked, and contains {@dice 1d4} magic items (determined by rolling on Magic Item Table B in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Treasure Tables} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Ghuldur knows the combination to unlock the safe, which otherwise requires a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic to open.
zh_tw: 在儲藏室的一個角落裡，有一個鐵製保險箱。這個保險箱重達1000磅，是鎖著的，裡面裝有{@dice 1d4}件魔法物品（透過擲骰子在{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Treasure Tables}的魔法物品表格B中決定，選自{@i 城主指南}）。古爾杜知道開啟保險箱的密碼，否則需要{@spell knock||敲擊術}或類似的魔法才能開啟。

english: Yantha's gem-studded robe is worth 750 gp.
zh_tw: 揚薩鑲有寶石的長袍價值750金幣。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters cure Yantha's madness, she confesses to giving Krimgol's black gem to her apprentice, Flink Thunderbonk. She doesn't know Flink's current whereabouts but can use a {@spell sending} spell to contact him, whereupon she learns that he's "trapped" in the drow enclave (area 4). She then asks the characters to rescue him.
zh_tw: 如果角色們治癒了揚薩的瘋狂，她承認把克林戈的黑色寶石給了她的學徒弗林克·雷擊。她不知道弗林克目前的下落，但可以使用{@spell sending||短訊術}法術與他聯絡，之後她得知他"被困"在卓爾聚居地（區域4）。然後她請求角色們去救他。

english: Restoring Yantha's sanity doesn't placate Ghuldur or Krimgol. The characters can only appease Krimgol by finding his gem and returning it to him. If he and his pet xorn are defeated in combat, Ghuldur can be persuaded to call off the duergar attacking the svirfneblin enclave (see area 6a).
zh_tw: 恢復揚薩的理智並不能安撫古爾杜或克林戈。角色們只能透過找到他的寶石並歸還給他來安撫克林戈。如果他和他的寵物石鼎獸在戰鬥中被擊敗，古爾杜可以被說服停止灰矮人攻擊地底侏儒飛地（見區域6a）。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: If the characters rescue Yantha, award each of them 100 XP. If they cure her madness, award an additional 150 XP to each character.
zh_tw: 如果角色們救出了揚薩，給每個人獎勵100 XP。如果他們治癒了她的瘋狂，再給每個角色額外獎勵150 XP。

english: 6. Svirfneblin Enclave
zh_tw: 6. 地底侏儒聚居地

english: The deep gnomes look for any opportunity to corner the market on goods their competitors are in short supply of. Gabble Dripskillet, the svirfneblin chief negotiator, used to sell salt, gemstones, and rare minerals from a stall in the eastern market (area 3b), but she and several other svirfneblin merchants were forced to retreat to their warehouse (area 6b) when the duergar attacked.
zh_tw: 地底侏儒尋找任何機會來壟斷競爭對手短缺的商品市場。加布爾·滴鍋，地底侏儒的首席談判代表，過去在東部市場（區域3b）的一個攤位上賣鹽、寶石和稀有礦物，但是當灰矮人發動攻擊時，她和其他幾個地底侏儒商人被迫撤退到他們的倉庫（區域6b）。

english: 6a. Svirfneblin Fungi Grove
zh_tw: 6a. 地底侏儒真菌林

english: The fungal grove in the deep gnome enclave has been left to grow wild. Strewn about the grove are the corpses of a dozen dead svirfneblin, all of whom were killed by duergar.
zh_tw: 地底侏儒聚居地的真菌林已經任其自然生長。林中散佈著一打死去的地底侏儒的屍體，他們都是被灰矮人殺害的。

english: Set into the northeast wall is a set of stone double doors that the svirfneblin have barred from within. Four enlarged {@creature duergar} are breaking through the doors with war picks, and it's only a matter of time before they reduce the doors to rubble. Eight more {@condition invisible} {@creature duergar} stand nearby, ready to storm the svirfneblin warehouse as soon as the doors crumble.
zh_tw: 嵌在東北牆上的是一組石頭雙門，地底侏儒已從內部將其閂上。四名大型化的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}正用戰鎬破門，他們將這些門摧毀成碎石只是時間問題。還有八名{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}站在附近，準備在門倒塌時立即衝進地底侏儒的倉庫。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each dead svirfneblin carries a pouch that contains {@dice 1d4} 50 gp gems.
zh_tw: 每個死去的地底侏儒身上都攜帶著一個袋子，裡面裝有{@dice 1d4}顆價值50金幣的寶石。

english: In addition to species of edible fungi, the svirfneblin grove contains the following exotic fungi (as described in the "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" section of chapter 2):
zh_tw: 除了可食用的真菌種類外，地底侏儒的真菌林還包含以下異國情調的真菌（如第2章"幽暗地域的真菌"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}部分中描述的）：

english: {@dice 2d6} barrelstalks
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 桶語者

english: {@dice 3d6} bluecaps
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6}藍帽怪

english: {@dice 3d6} Nilhogg's noses
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} 尼洛霍格的鼻子

english: {@dice 2d6} tongues of madness
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 瘋狂之舌

english: {@dice 2d6} torchstalks
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6}個火把莖

english: {@dice 2d6} trillimacs
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} 特里米拉克

english: 6b. Svirfneblin Warehouse
zh_tw: 6b. 地底侏儒倉庫

english: Twenty-two {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnomes}, including Gabble Dripskillet, are holed up in this chamber, which is shaped like a cube. The ceiling is 100 feet high, and the walls are lined with niches that serve as residences and storage spaces. Levitating crystal platforms throughout the warehouse allow the deep gnomes to reach these compartments. Each crystal platform can move up, down, or side-to-side on command, but only the deep gnomes know the command words to activate them.
zh_tw: 二十二名{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}，包括加布爾·滴鍋，藏身在這個類似立方體的房間內。天花板高100尺，牆壁上排列著用作居住和儲存空間的壁龕。倉庫中遍佈著懸浮的水晶平臺，使地底侏儒能夠到達這些隔間。每個水晶平臺可以根據命令上下移動或左右移動，但只有地底侏儒知道啟用它們的命令詞。

english: Most of the svirfneblin have retreated to their residential niches. Gabble Dripskillet is the only one at floor level, and she's prepared to negotiate with whoever or whatever breaks through the doors. If the characters deal with the duergar, Gabble is grateful and offers them a reward (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 大部分地底侏儒已經撤退到他們的居住壁龕中。加布爾·滴鍋是唯一一個在地面層的人，她準備與任何破門而入的人或事物進行談判。如果角色們解決了灰矮人的問題，加布爾會非常感激，並提供給他們獎勵（見下方的"寶藏"）。

english: Gabble doesn't know what provoked the duergar into attacking her enclave, but she is friends with Yantha Coaxrock and would like to see the svirfneblin mage returned safely.
zh_tw: 加布爾不知道是什麼激怒了灰矮人攻擊她的聚居地，但她是揚薩·寇克斯洛克的朋友，並希望看到地底侏儒法師安全返回。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Stored throughout the warehouse are sixty 10-pound sacks of salt worth 5 gp each, thirty sacks of precious minerals worth 25 gp each, twenty-four quartz gemstones worth 50 gp each, a dozen amethysts worth 100 gp each, and six peridots worth 500 gp each.
zh_tw: 倉庫中存放著六十個10磅重的鹽袋，每個價值5金幣，三十袋珍貴礦物，每個價值25金幣，二十四個石英寶石，每個價值50金幣，一打紫水晶，每個價值100金幣，以及六個橄欖石，每個價值500金幣。

english: Half way up the southeast wall is a hidden compartment. Finding it requires a successful {@dc 19} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The compartment contains {@dice 1d4} magic items (determined by rolling on Magic Item Table C in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Treasure Tables} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 在東南牆的半高處有一個隱藏的隔間。找到它需要透過一次 {@dc 19} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。隔間內有 {@dice 1d4} 件魔法物品（透過滾動 {@book 第七章|DMG|7|Treasure Tables} 中的魔法物品表 C 來確定，選自 {@i 城主指南}）。

english: Gabble keeps a crystal coffer in her niche. The coffer is worth 100 gp, and it contains a black sapphire pendant on a silver chain worth 5,000 gp. She offers the pendant as a reward to the party for saving her enclave.
zh_tw: 加布爾在她的壁龕裡儲存著一個水晶箱。這個箱子價值100金幣，裡面裝有一個價值5000金幣的黑藍寶石吊墜，吊墜掛在一條銀鏈上。她提供這個吊墜作為獎勵，感謝隊伍拯救了她的飛地。

english: 7. Zhentarim Enclave
zh_tw: 7. 散塔林會聚居地

english: The Zhentarim found great profits in Mantol-Derith by bringing in products impossible to obtain in the Underdark. Items as innocuous as sugar and fresh spices are treasures in high demand here. The surface dwellers trade mostly in raw materials, including wood, fine fabrics, and leathers, but also maintain stocks of perfumes, alcoholic beverages, confectionery, paper, and clothing made by surface artisans with surface materials. The human {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA} leads the Zhentarim enclave in Mantol-Derith and also holds the key to finding the library of Gravenhollow.
zh_tw: 散塔林會在曼塔-岱瑞絲發現了巨大的利潤，他們引進了在幽暗地域無法獲得的產品。像糖和新鮮香料這樣無害的物品在這裡是高需求的寶貝。地表居民主要交易原材料，包括木材、優質織物和皮革，但也儲備了香水、酒精飲料、糖果、紙張以及由地表工匠用地表材料製作的服裝。人類{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}領導著曼塔-岱瑞絲的散塔林會飛地，並且也持有找到刻文谷圖書館的鑰匙。

english: 7a. Zhentarim Encampment
zh_tw: 7a. 散塔林會營地

english: Zhentarim traders cut down most of the fungi grove outside the entrance of their warehouse, keeping only a few small gardens for decoration. In its place they erected a huge pavilion and several smaller tents. Water dripping from the ceiling runs off the tents to form puddles everywhere. The pavilion is where {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA} conducts business, while the smaller tents are set aside for fifteen Black Network merchants (all human {@creature Commoner||commoners}).
zh_tw: 散塔林會商人砍伐了他們倉庫入口外的大部分真菌林，只保留了幾個小花園作為裝飾。取而代之，他們搭建了一個巨大的帳篷和幾個較小的帳篷。從天花板滴下的水順著帳篷流下，到處形成水坑。帳篷是{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}進行商業活動的地方，而較小的帳篷則留給了十五名黑網商人（全部是人類{@creature Commoner||平民}）。

english: Perched on a ledge overlooking the pavilion is a {@creature gargoyle} touched by the madness of Fraz-Urb'luu's gem. Characters with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 13 or higher spot the creature. It's waiting for {@creature Kinyel Druu'giir|OotA}, its "true love," to emerge from the pavilion.
zh_tw: 棲息在俯瞰亭子的壁架上的是一隻被弗拉茲厄魯的寶石瘋狂感染的{@creature gargoyle||石像鬼}。具有13或更高被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分的角色能發現這個生物。它正在等待它的"真愛"，{@creature Kinyel Druu'giir|OotA|金耶爾·德魯吉爾}，從亭子裡出現。

english: Inside the pavilion are four drow: Sirak Mazelor (a female {@creature drow mage} and the chief negotiator of the drow enclave), two female {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors}, and a female {@creature drow assassin|OotA} posing as another elite warrior. The assassin, {@creature Kinyel Druu'giir|OotA}, has Fraz-Urb'luu's gem on her person. She also has the Fey Ancestry, Innate Spellcasting, and Sunlight Sensitivity features of a drow elite warrior. These drow await the arrival of the Zhentarim's chief negotiator, {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA}. A table covered with food and wine stands in the middle of the pavilion, although the drow refuse to partake.
zh_tw: 在帳篷內有四名卓爾：西拉克·馬澤洛（一名女性{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}且是卓爾聚居地的首席談判者），兩名女性{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}，以及一名偽裝成另一名精英武者的女性{@creature drow assassin|OotA|黑暗精靈刺客}。刺客{@creature Kinyel Druu'giir|OotA|金耶爾·德魯吉爾}身上帶著弗拉茲厄魯的寶石。她還擁有卓爾精英武者的妖精血統、天生施法和日照敏感特性。這些卓爾正在等待散塔林會的首席談判者{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}的到來。帳篷中間擺放著一張擺滿食物和紅酒的桌子，儘管卓爾們拒絕享用。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters keep their distance and spy on the Zhentarim enclave for a few minutes, {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA}, {@creature Lorthuun|OotA}, and six human {@creature Thug||thugs} emerge from the nearby warehouse (area 7b) to meet with the drow delegation. Before Sirak can negotiate an alliance, Kinyel attacks the beholder. Unless the characters intervene, Kinyel escapes with 19 hit points remaining. Everyone else is killed in the crossfire.
zh_tw: 如果角色們保持距離並監視散塔林會聚居地幾分鐘，{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}、{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}和六名人類{@creature Thug||暴徒}會從附近的倉庫（區域7b）出現，與卓爾代表團會面。在西拉克能夠談判聯盟之前，金耶爾攻擊了眼魔。除非角色們介入，否則金耶爾帶著剩餘的19點生命值逃跑。其他人在交火中被殺。

english: If the characters confront the drow before Ghazrim and {@creature Lorthuun|OotA} arrive, Sirak orders them to leave at once. If they refuse, she and her warriors attack as Kinyel cuts a {@creature gash|OotA} in the back wall of the pavilion with her sword and finds a place to hide until the beholder appears. If the characters pursue Kinyel, the gargoyle attacks them to protect her. Ghazrim and his entourage arrive {@dice 1d4 + 2} rounds after the battle is joined.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在加茲裡姆和{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}到達之前面對卓爾，西拉克命令他們立即離開。如果他們拒絕，她和她的戰士們會發起攻擊，因為金耶爾用她的劍在亭子的後牆上切開了一個{@creature gash|OotA|撕裂}，並找到一個藏身之處，直到眼魔出現。如果角色們追趕金耶爾，石像鬼會攻擊他們以保護她。加茲裡姆和他的隨從在戰鬥開始後的{@dice 1d4 + 2}回合到達。

english: Kinyel was forced to leave Menzoberranzan in disgrace after failing to assassinate a house rival. Fraz-Urb'luu's gem has afflicted her with a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). She is convinced that the gargoyle who gave her the gem is a messenger from House Druu'giir, and that killing {@creature Lorthuun|OotA} will redeem her.
zh_tw: 金耶爾在暗殺家族對手失敗後，被迫恥辱地離開了魔索布萊城。弗拉茲厄魯的寶石使她患上了一種永久性瘋狂（見第8章"{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}"在{@i 城主指南}中）。她深信給她寶石的石像鬼是德魯吉爾家族的信使，並且殺死{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}將會贖回她的名譽。

english: 7b. Zhentarim Warehouse
zh_tw: 7b. 散塔林會倉庫

english: The double doors leading to the Zhentarim warehouse are made of thick zurkhwood reinforced with iron bands. A window slit at eye level allows two human {@creature Veteran||veterans} stationed inside the doors to peer out into the cavern. They will not open the doors to strangers without {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA}'s permission. The doors are barred from the inside. They have AC 15, 80 hit points, and a damage threshold of 10. They can also be forced open with a {@dc 25} Strength check.
zh_tw: 通往散塔林會倉庫的雙層大門由厚實的祖爾木製成，並用鐵條加固。門上眼睛高度的窗縫讓兩名駐守在門內的{@creature Veteran||老兵}能夠窺視洞穴外的情況。未經{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}的許可，他們不會為陌生人開門。門從內部用門閂鎖住。它們的護甲等級為15，擁有80點生命值，傷害閾值為10。門也可以透過進行一次{@dc 25}力量檢定來強行開啟。

english: The Zhentarim warehouse contains a dozen iron storage sheds filled with neatly sorted merchandise. Two more sheds serve as quarters for {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA} (a human {@creature noble}) and his guards. Ten human {@creature Thug||thugs} (minus any killed in area 7a) are asleep in their bunks but rise quickly if the warehouse comes under attack.
zh_tw: 散塔林會倉庫包含一打鐵製儲物棚，裡面整齊地存放著商品。另外兩個棚子用作{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}（一個人類{@creature noble||貴族}）和他的守衛的住所。十個人類{@creature Thug||暴徒}（減去在區域7a中被殺的）在他們的鋪位上睡覺，但如果倉庫遭到攻擊，他們會迅速起來。

english: {@creature Lorthuun|OotA}, a maimed {@creature beholder}, also guards the warehouse. Years ago, {@creature Lorthuun|OotA} got into a terrible fight with a behir and lost four of its eyestalks. Its spherical body is also covered with scars from the behir's claws and breath weapon. {@creature Lorthuun|OotA} has the statistics of a normal beholder, except that it no longer has its sleep, petrification, disintegration, or death rays. The beholder's adjusted challenge rating is 9 (5,000 XP).
zh_tw: {@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}，一隻受傷的{@creature beholder||眼魔}，也守衛著倉庫。幾年前，{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}與一隻青足龍蛇發生了一場可怕的戰鬥，失去了四根眼梗。它的球形身體也被青足龍蛇的爪子和吐息武器留下了疤痕。除了不再擁有睡眠、石化、解體或死亡射線之外，{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}擁有正常眼魔的具體數值。這個眼魔的調整挑戰等級是9（5000 XP）。

english: Ghazrim and {@creature Lorthuun|OotA} both serve the Zhentarim, but they rarely see eye to eye. They bicker and insult each other like an old married couple, and only their dedication to the Black Network keeps them from turning against one another.
zh_tw: 加茲裡姆和{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}都為散塔林會效力，但他們很少意見一致。他們像一對老夫妻一樣爭吵和互相侮辱，只有他們對黑網的忠誠才讓他們沒有反目成仇。

english: Born into a wealthy family, Ghazrim has the typically smarmy demeanor of the Amnian aristocracy coupled with a biting sense of humor that he uses to diffuse tense situations. He's not afraid of a good fight but is averse to attacking a superior force. If he realizes the characters are in league with the Black Network, he offers them food, wine, and whatever else they need to complete their mission (see "Treasure").
zh_tw: 加茲裡姆出生在一個富裕的家庭，擁有安姆的貴族特有的傲慢態度和尖銳的幽默感，他用這種幽默感來緩解緊張的情況。他不害怕一場好的戰鬥，但不喜歡攻擊優勢力量。如果他意識到角色們與黑網有聯絡，他會為他們提供食物、酒水以及完成他們任務所需的一切（見"寶藏"）。

english: Ghazrim's Shed
zh_tw: 加茲裡姆的棚屋

english: The door to this shed is locked, and Ghazrim carries the only key. In addition to his comfortable bed, Ghazrim has a morbid collection of tiny, malformed creatures in pickle jars on a shelf.
zh_tw: 這個棚屋的門被鎖上了，加茲裡姆持有唯一的鑰匙。除了他舒適的床外，加茲裡姆還有一個病態的收藏，書架上擺滿了裝在泡菜罐裡的微小畸形生物。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door in the west wall opens to reveal a wide tunnel beyond (area 1e). The secret door makes a lot of noise when opened, alerting the warehouse's occupants.
zh_tw: 西牆上的一扇秘密門開啟後，露出了後面的一條寬闊隧道（區域1e）。這扇秘密門在開啟時會發出很大的噪音，提醒倉庫裡的人。

english: Storage Sheds
zh_tw: 儲藏棚

english: The contents of the twelve storage sheds are described below:
zh_tw: 下面描述了十二個儲物棚的內容：

english: {@b Shed 1} contains the Zhents' supplies, consisting of {@dice 2d10 × 10} pounds of food in the form of dried meats, plucked chickens, fresh fruit and vegetables, and loaves of baked bread. There are also six casks of wine worth 50 gp each.
zh_tw: {@b 棚屋1} 包含散塔林會成員的補給品，包括{@dice 2d10 × 10}磅食物，包括乾肉、拔毛雞、新鮮水果和蔬菜以及烤麵包。還有六個桶裝葡萄酒，每個價值50金幣。

english: {@b Shed 2} holds {@dice 1d10} backpacks, {@dice 2d10} bedrolls, {@dice 2d10} blankets, {@dice 2d6} climber's kits, and {@dice 2d6} healer's kits.
zh_tw: {@b 棚屋2}存放有{@dice 1d10}個揹包，{@dice 2d10}個鋪蓋卷，{@dice 2d10}條毯子，{@dice 2d6}套攀爬工具包，以及{@dice 2d6}套治療工具包。

english: {@b Shed 3} contains {@dice 3d6} hooded lanterns, {@dice 3d6} flasks of oil, {@dice 3d6} 50-foot coils of hempen rope, {@dice 3d6} grappling hooks, and {@dice 3d6} tinderboxes.
zh_tw: {@b 3號棚}包含{@dice 3d6}帶罩提燈，{@dice 3d6}瓶油，{@dice 3d6}卷50尺長的麻繩，{@dice 3d6}個抓鉤，以及{@dice 3d6}打火石盒。

english: {@b Shed 4} holds five crates, each one containing {@dice 1d20} days of rations.
zh_tw: {@b 棚屋4}裡有五個箱子，每個箱子裝有{@dice 1d20}天的口糧。

english: {@b Shed 5} contains {@dice 2d10} empty glass bottles, {@dice 2d6} scroll cases, {@dice 2d10} copper tankards, {@dice 2d10} iron pots, {@dice 2d10} empty sacks, and {@dice 2d10} empty waterskins.
zh_tw: {@b 5號棚} 包含 {@dice 2d10} 個空玻璃瓶，{@dice 2d6} 個卷軸盒，{@dice 2d10} 個銅製酒杯，{@dice 2d10} 個鐵鍋，{@dice 2d10} 個空麻袋，以及 {@dice 2d10} 個空水囊。

english: {@b Shed 6} holds {@dice 2d10} empty wooden chests with iron fittings and {@dice 2d10} locks with keys.
zh_tw: {@b 棚屋6}存放有{@dice 2d10}個帶鐵配件的空木箱和{@dice 2d10}把帶鑰匙的鎖。

english: {@b Shed 7} contains {@dice 2d6} jars of ink, {@dice 3d12} blank pieces of parchment, {@dice 3d6} boxes of candles (12 candles per box), and {@dice 2d6} ink pens.
zh_tw: {@b 7號棚}包含{@dice 2d6}罐墨水，{@dice 3d12}張空白羊皮紙，{@dice 3d6}盒蠟燭（每盒12根蠟燭），以及{@dice 2d6}支墨水筆。

english: {@b Shed 8} holds {@dice 3d6} crowbars, {@dice 3d6} hammers, and {@dice 3d6} miner's picks.
zh_tw: {@b 棚屋8}存放著{@dice 3d6}把撬棍，{@dice 3d6}把錘子，以及{@dice 3d6}把礦工鎬。

english: {@b Shed 9} is locked, and {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA} carries the only key. The lock is also trapped with a poison needle (see "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). The shed contains 250 pp, 1,800 gp, 3,300 sp, 6,000 cp, and thirty 100 gp gems in a loose pile.
zh_tw: {@b 棚屋9} 被鎖住了，而且{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}持有唯一的鑰匙。鎖上還裝有帶有毒針的陷阱（詳見《{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}》第5章《{@i 城主指南}》）。棚子裡存放有250 pp（白金幣），1,800 gp（金幣），3,300 sp（銀幣），6,000 cp（銅幣），以及隨意堆放的三十顆每顆價值100 gp（金幣）的寶石。

english: {@b Shed 10} contains {@dice 3d6} jars of spices worth 10 gp each, {@dice 2d6} 10-pound sacks of cinnamon worth 20 gp each, and {@dice 3d6} boxes of soap (12 bars of soap per box).
zh_tw: {@b 棚屋10} 包含 {@dice 3d6} 罐香料，每罐價值 10 gp，{@dice 2d6} 袋 10 磅的肉桂，每袋價值 20 gp，以及 {@dice 3d6} 箱肥皂（每箱 12 條肥皂）。

english: {@b Shed 11} holds four wooden chicken coops, each one containing {@dice 1d6 + 1} live chickens. Sacks of chicken feed are stored on a shelf above the coops.
zh_tw: {@b 棚屋11}存放有四個木製雞籠，每個雞籠裡有{@dice 1d6 + 1}只活雞。雞飼料袋存放在雞籠上方的架子上。

english: {@b Shed 12} is currently empty.
zh_tw: {@b 棚屋12} 目前是空的。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Ghazrim carries a key that unlocks shed 9. He also wears a gold ring fitted with a star ruby (worth 1,000 gp). A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals that the gem radiates a faint aura of divination magic. The gem's star-shaped core is a magical compass that guides the ring's wearer along the safest, shortest route to Gravenhollow. Ghazrim is aware of the ring's property and gives the ring to the characters if they claim to be headed that way.
zh_tw: 加茲裡姆持有一把鑰匙，可以開啟棚屋9。他還佩戴著一枚鑲嵌著星形紅寶石的金戒指（價值1000金幣）。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了這塊寶石散發出微弱的占卜魔法氣息。寶石星形的核心是一個魔法指南針，引導戒指佩戴者沿著最安全、最短的路線前往刻文谷。加茲裡姆知道戒指的屬性，如果角色們聲稱他們正朝那個方向前進，他會將戒指交給他們。

english: Leaving Mantol-Derith
zh_tw: 離開曼塔-岱瑞絲

english: If {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA} dies, characters can remove the ring from his dead hand and use it to find their way to Gravenhollow.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}死亡，角色們可以從他死去的手中取下戒指，並用它找到通往刻文谷的道路。

english: If the characters deduce that Kinyel's gem is responsible for the havoc in Mantol-Derith and inform the chief negotiators of this fact, the ones who are still alive are thankful enough to share disturbing news from their home settlements of Blingdenstone, Gracklstugh, and Menzoberranzan, respectively (see chapter 10, "{@adventure Descent into the Depths|OotA|9}").
zh_tw: 如果角色們推斷出金耶爾的寶石是曼塔-岱瑞絲混亂的原因，並將這一事實告知首席談判代表，那些仍然活著的人會感激地分享來自他們家鄉布靈登石城、格拉克斯圖格和魔索布萊城的令人不安的訊息，分別見第10章'{@adventure 深入深淵|OotA|9}'。

english: Beholder Eyestalks
zh_tw: 眼魔眼梗

english: If {@creature Lorthuun|OotA} is killed, {@dice 1d4} of its eyestalks survive intact. Should {@creature Peebles|OotA} the svirfneblin happen upon the beholder's remains, he uses a flint knife to remove the intact eyestalks, then tucks them in his bag for safe delivery to Xazaz the Eyemonger (see "Follow-Up Encounters").
zh_tw: 若{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}被殺死，牠有{@dice 1d4}根眼梗能保持完好。若地底侏儒{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}偶然發現眼魔的遺骸，他會用燧石小刀切下完好的眼梗，放進袋中，準備安全送交眼商札札克斯（見「後續遭遇」）。

english: Follow-Up Encounters
zh_tw: 後續遭遇

english: Having {@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA} (see area 1c), {@creature Peebles|OotA} (see area 3b), or {@creature Zilchyn Q'Leptin|OotA} (area 4a) join the party can lead to special follow-up encounters in the vicinity of Mantol-Derith, as described below.
zh_tw: 擁有{@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA|斯拉迪斯·瓦迪爾}（見區域1c）、{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}（見區域3b）或{@creature Zilchyn Q'Leptin|OotA|齊爾欽·奎普廷}（區域4a）加入隊伍，可以在曼塔-岱瑞絲附近導致特別的後續遭遇，如下所述。

english: Cricket Catcher
zh_tw: 捕蟀者

english: If {@creature Zilchyn Q'Leptin|OotA} is with the party as it leaves Mantol-Derith, he insists on visiting a nearby cave to retrieve his secret stash of potions.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Zilchyn Q'Leptin|OotA|齊爾欽·奎普廷}和隊伍一起離開曼塔-岱瑞絲，他堅持要訪問附近的一個洞穴去取回他的秘密藥水儲藏。

english: Zilch's cave lies one day's travel west of Mantol-Derith, along the same route the characters must travel to reach Gravenhollow. The cave is swarming with bats and infested with dozens of giant albino cave crickets that feed on the bat guano. The crickets are as big as halflings yet harmless. A happy-go-lucky {@creature kuo-toa} named {@creature Ougalop|OotA} is also here, trying to catch the giant crickets in a homespun net. When he sees other intruders, {@creature Ougalop|OotA} waves at them and continues with his cricket catching. He poses no threat and has no interest in joining the party. The kuo-toa lives in Sloobludop (see {@area chapter 3|112|x}) and is blissfully unaware of recent events there.
zh_tw: 齊爾欽的洞穴位於曼塔-岱瑞絲西邊一天的路程，沿著角色們必須旅行的同一條路可到達刻文谷。洞穴裡充滿了蝙蝠，並被幾十隻巨大的白色洞穴蟋蟀所侵擾，它們以蝙蝠糞便為食。這些蟋蟀有半身人那麼大，但無害。還有一個無憂無慮的{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}名叫{@creature Ougalop|OotA|歐加洛普}，他正試圖用手工網捕捉這些巨大的蟋蟀。當他看到其他入侵者時，{@creature Ougalop|OotA|歐加洛普}向他們揮手並繼續捕捉蟋蟀。他不構成威脅，也沒有興趣加入隊伍。這個寇濤魚人住在斯盧布多普（見{@area 第三章|112|x}），並且對那裡最近發生的事件一無所知。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: On a 30-foot-high shelf overlooking the cave is an old grick nest. Hidden here are three {@item Potion of Vitality||potions of vitality}. Climbing the wall to reach the shelf requires a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 在俯瞰洞穴的30尺高的架子上有一個古老的格里克巢穴。這裡隱藏著三瓶 {@item Potion of Vitality||活力藥水}。爬上牆到達架子需要透過一個 {@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: Amarith's Zoo
zh_tw: 阿瑪瑞斯的動物園

english: If {@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA} joined the party and is still around when the characters are ready to leave Mantol-Derith, he offers to guide them to a cavern roughly eight days' travel west of Mantol-Derith, along the same route the characters must travel to reach Gravenhollow. Sladis claims that the cave is home to another member of the Emerald Enclave: a dwarf named {@creature Amarith Coppervein|OotA}. This news will interest characters searching for Amarith on behalf of Morista Malkin (see {@area chapter 8|346|x}).
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA|斯拉迪斯·瓦迪爾}加入了隊伍，並且在角色們準備離開曼塔-岱瑞絲時仍然在場，他提出要引導他們前往一個洞穴，這個洞穴大約在曼塔-岱瑞絲西邊八天的路程，沿著角色們必須旅行的同一條路可到達刻文谷。斯拉迪斯聲稱這個洞穴是翠綠閒庭的另一名成員的家：一個名叫{@creature Amarith Coppervein|OotA|阿瑪瑞斯·銅脈}的矮人。這個訊息將會引起那些代表莫瑞斯塔·馬爾金尋找阿瑪瑞斯的角色的興趣（見{@area 第八章|346|x}）。

english: {@creature Amarith Coppervein|OotA} is a shield dwarf {@creature veteran} with the following statistical modifications:
zh_tw: {@creature Amarith Coppervein|OotA|阿瑪瑞斯·銅脈} 是一位盾矮人{@creature veteran||老兵}，具有以下統計資料修改：

english: Amarith's alignment is neutral good.
zh_tw: 阿瑪瑞斯的陣營是中立善良。

english: She has {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet.
zh_tw: 她擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}，範圍可達60尺。

english: Amarith's dwarven resilience gives her advantage on saving throws against poison, and she has resistance against poison damage.
zh_tw: 阿瑪瑞斯的矮人韌性使她在對毒素的豁免檢定上獲得優勢，並且她對毒素傷害具有抗性。

english: She wields a warhammer instead of a longsword ({@dice 1d8 + 3} bludgeoning damage on a hit, or {@dice 1d10 + 3} bludgeoning damage if using the weapon with two hands).
zh_tw: 她揮舞的是戰錘而不是長劍（命中時造成{@dice 1d8 + 3}點鈍擊傷害，如果用雙手使用武器則造成{@dice 1d10 + 3}點鈍擊傷害）。

english: Amarith's cavern contains a dozen stalagmites which have been hollowed out and fitted with iron bars to serve as monster cages. Locked in three of these cages are a {@creature rust monster}, a {@creature winged kobold}, and a {@creature fire snake}. Amarith charges 3 cp per person to tour her "zoo."
zh_tw: 阿瑪瑞斯的洞穴中有十二個鐘乳石，它們被挖空並裝上了鐵欄杆，用作怪物籠子。在其中的三個籠子裡分別關著一隻{@creature rust monster||鏽蝕怪}、一隻{@creature winged kobold||帶翼狗頭人}和一條{@creature fire snake||火蛇}。阿瑪瑞斯收取每人3銅幣的費用，供人參觀她的"動物園"。

english: If the characters ask Amarith to join them, she gathers up her belongings and does just that, lamenting that "the zoo business is tough!" Her gear includes a backpack, a bedroll, a lantern with no oil, a tinderbox, an iron pot, ten days of rations (edible fungi), a pouch containing 3 cp, a 50-foot coil of hempen rope with a grappling hook tied to one end, a net, a miner's pick, and a 10-foot pole.
zh_tw: 如果角色們請求阿瑪瑞斯加入他們，她會收拾好自己的行囊並確實這麼做，哀嘆道：'動物園生意真難做！'她的裝備包括一個揹包、一個鋪蓋、一個沒有油的燈籠、一個火絨盒、一個鐵鍋、十天的口糧（可食用的真菌）、一個裝有3枚銅幣的小袋、一個帶有鉤爪的50尺長的麻繩卷、一張網、一把礦工鎬，以及一根10尺長的杆子。

english: Xazax the Eyemonger
zh_tw: 眼商札札克斯

english: If {@creature Peebles|OotA} or the characters harvest {@creature Lorthuun|OotA}'s eyestalks (see the "Beholder Eyestalks" sidebar), {@creature Peebles|OotA} asks to join the party as it leaves Mantol-Derith. After traveling with them for a tenday, {@creature Peebles|OotA} urges the characters to deviate from their preferred route, claiming that they're dangerously close to a nest of purple worms. {@creature Peebles|OotA} uses this lie to propose an alternate route. If the characters follow this detour, {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||Peebles} leads them to the cavern of {@creature Xazax the Eyemonger|OotA}, a terrifying {@creature beholder} that kills others of its kind and grafts their eyestalks to its body. {@creature Peebles|OotA} heads to Xazax's cave regardless of whether the characters follow him or not.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}或者角色們收割了{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}的眼梗（見"眼魔眼梗"側邊欄），{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}請求加入隊伍，當他們離開曼塔-岱瑞絲時。與他們同行十天後，{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}敦促角色們偏離他們首選的路線，聲稱他們非常接近一群紫蟲的巢穴。{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}利用這個謊言提議一條備選路線。如果角色們跟隨這個繞路，{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||皮布林斯}會帶領他們前往{@creature Xazax the Eyemonger|OotA|眼商札札克斯}的洞穴，這是一個可怕的{@creature beholder||眼魔}，它殺死同類並將它們的眼梗嫁接到自己的身體上。無論角色們是否跟隨他，{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}都會前往札札克斯的洞穴。

english: Xazax's cavern has a 30-foot-high ceiling and is unremarkable save for a 20-foot-wide, 100-foot-deep shaft in the middle of the floor. Upon arriving, {@creature Peebles|OotA} calls out, "Master! I've returned!" Moments later, Xazax rises up from the shaft. Xazax has eight extra eyestalks grafted to its body, giving it a total of eighteen, but it can't fire rays from the grafted eyes. If the characters took one or more of {@creature Lorthuun|OotA}'s eyestalks, {@creature Peebles|OotA} demands that the characters surrender them at once. Whether they do or not, Xazax becomes enraged and attacks. Both Xazax and {@creature Peebles|OotA} fight to the death.
zh_tw: 札札克斯的洞穴有一個30尺高的天花板，除了地板中間一個20尺寬、100尺深的井道外，並無特別之處。到達時，{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}大聲喊道："主人！我回來了！"片刻之後，札札克斯從井道中升起。札札克斯在其身體上嫁接了八個額外的眼睛觸手，總共有十八個，但它不能從嫁接的眼睛發射射線。如果角色們拿走了{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}的一個或多個眼睛觸手，{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}要求角色們立刻交出它們。無論他們是否這麼做，札札克斯都會變得憤怒併發起攻擊。札札克斯和{@creature Peebles|OotA|皮布林斯}都將戰鬥至死。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: At the bottom of the beholder's shaft, buried among the shattered remains of {@condition petrified} foes, is a {@item flame tongue} longsword. Scaling the shaft requires a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 在眼魔豎井的底部，埋藏在被{@condition petrified||石化}的敵人的破碎遺骸中，有一把{@item flame tongue||焰舌}長劍。攀爬豎井需要成功透過{@dc 10}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}檢定。

english: Chapter 10: Descent into the Depths
zh_tw: 第10章：深入地底

english: Having survived Mantol-Derith and obtained {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA}'s ring, the adventurers and their allies continue on into the Underdark. This time, rather than escaped prisoners looking for a way out, they are at the head of an expeditionary force ready to challenge whatever the Underdark has to offer.
zh_tw: 在曼塔-岱瑞絲生存下來並得到{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}的戒指後，冒險家們和他們的盟友繼續進入幽暗地域。這一次，他們不再是尋找出路的逃犯，而是一支探險隊的先鋒，準備挑戰幽暗地域所提供的一切。

english: Much of this middle section of the adventure is free-form, dictated largely by the characters' decisions and tactics. The adventurers' immediate destination is the legendary library of Gravenhollow (see {@area chapter 11|3cb|x}), where they gain information that likely takes them to the tower of Araj, home of the mysterious drow archmage {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}. However, the characters are free to explore and visit different places before and after they explore Gravenhollow and unlock its secrets.
zh_tw: 這次冒險的中間部分大多是自由形式的，主要由角色的決定和策略決定。冒險者的直接目的地是傳說中的刻文谷圖書館（見{@area 第十一章|3cb|x}），在那裡他們獲得了可能會帶領他們前往神秘卓爾大法師{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}的家——阿拉傑塔的資訊。然而，在探索刻文谷並解開它的秘密之前和之後，角色們可以自由探索和訪問不同的地方。

english: The events described in chapters 13 through 16 can be interspersed among the material in this part of the adventure, as the characters work to fully understand the new menaces that have appeared in the Underdark, seek new allies and information, and ultimately attempt to create a plan to end the demon lord threat.
zh_tw: 第13章到第16章描述的事件可以穿插在這部分冒險的材料中，因為角色們努力完全理解幽暗地域中出現的新的威脅，尋找新的盟友和資訊，並最終嘗試制定一個計劃來結束惡魔領主的威脅。

english: Character advancement through this section of the adventure is important. The journey from Mantol-Derith to Gravenhollow should involve sufficient encounters and challenges for the characters to reach 10th level by the time they visit the stone giant library. As the characters travel from place to place, check for random encounters as normal (see {@area chapter 2|07f|x}), but swap out the creature encounters with ones presented in this chapter. Ideally, the characters should be 14th level by the time they crash Zuggtmoy's wedding (chapter 16, "{@adventure The Fetid Wedding|OotA|15}"), and 15th level for the final showdown against the demon lords (see chapter 17, "{@adventure Against the Demon Lords|OotA|16}").
zh_tw: 角色在這段冒險中的提升非常重要。從曼塔-岱瑞絲到刻文谷的旅程應該包含足夠的遭遇和挑戰，以便角色們在訪問石巨人圖書館時達到10級。當角色們從一個地方旅行到另一個地方時，像平常一樣檢查隨機遭遇（見{@area 第二章|07f|x}），但將生物遭遇替換為本章中介紹的遭遇。理想情況下，角色們在破壞祖格莫伊的婚禮（第16章，"{@adventure 惡臭的婚禮|OotA|15}"）時應該達到14級，在與惡魔領主的最終對決中（見第17章，"{@adventure 對抗惡魔領主|OotA|16}"）達到15級。

english: Fellow Travelers
zh_tw: 同行旅伴

english: The characters initially traveled through the Underdark as a small group, perhaps joined by a few of their fellow prisoners from Velkynvelve and other allies they met along the way. Now, they return to the subterranean realm at the head of a group of allies that might outnumber the adventurers four-to-one, depending on how many NPCs were recruited from the factions in Gauntlgrym (see {@adventure chapter 8|OotA|7}). This changes some of the conditions described in "{@area Underdark Travel|051|x}" in chapter 2.
zh_tw: 角色們最初作為一小群人穿越了幽暗地域，可能還有來自維爾京維爾夫的一些同伴囚犯以及沿途遇到的其他盟友加入。現在，他們以一群盟友的領頭人的身份返回地下領域，這些盟友的數量可能是冒險家的四倍，這取決於從岡特格瑞姆（見{@adventure 第八章|OotA|7}）的派系中招募了多少NPC。這改變了第2章中"{@area 幽暗地域旅行|051|x}"描述的一些條件。

english: Attacking in Force
zh_tw: 集體進攻

english: When dealing with combat between large groups of creatures—either the adventurers' allies or their foes—you might wish to use the guidelines under "{@book Handling Mobs|DMG|8|Handling Mobs}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}. In some cases, you can simply match forces on one side with those on the other and assume they neutralize each other—for example, a band of shield dwarves fighting for the adventurers against a band of orcs. During such combat, the force on the losing side is wiped out while the winning force suffers a few casualties—anywhere from 10 to 50 percent—based on how difficult you judge the combat was for them.
zh_tw: 當你處理一大群生物之間的戰鬥時——無論是冒險者的盟友還是敵人——你可能會希望使用{@i 城主指南}第8章中的"{@book 處理亂鬥|DMG|8|Handling Mobs}"指南。在某些情況下，你可以簡單地讓一方的力量與另一方的力量相匹配，並假設他們相互中和——例如，一隊為冒險者而戰的盾矮人與一隊獸人戰鬥。在這種戰鬥中，失敗的一方會被殲滅，而勝利的一方則會遭受一些傷亡——從10%到50%不等——這取決於你認為戰鬥對他們來說有多困難。

english: Marching Orders
zh_tw: 行軍指令

english: The tunnels and passages of the Underdark aren't easy routes through which to lead a large group of NPCs. When the characters set out, have the players describe how their expeditionary force is arrayed while traveling in single file, two abreast, and in open formation in wide-open spaces. Also ask the players if any of the NPCs are scouting ahead or serving as a rear guard (see "{@area Scouting|399|x}," below) or if the larger party remains in close formation at all times.
zh_tw: 幽暗地域的隧道和通道不是帶領一大群NPC的易行路線。當角色們出發時，讓玩家們描述他們的探險隊伍是如何在單列、雙列以及在開闊空間中以開放式隊形行進的。還要詢問玩家們是否有NPC在前方偵察或擔任後衛（見下文"偵察"{@area 偵察|399|x}），或者更大的隊伍是否始終保持緊密隊形。

english: The marching order affects where and how different encounters might occur, particularly if they happen while characters are marching single file or two abreast. A threat approaching from above, below, or the flank could strike the middle of the expanded party, making it difficult for the characters at either end to reach it. Likewise, spellcasters must be aware of the allies around them at all times when casting area spells that don't solely target enemies.
zh_tw: 行軍順序會影響不同的遭遇發生的位置和方式，特別是當角色們單列或雙列行軍時。來自上方、下方或側翼的威脅可能會襲擊擴大隊伍的中間部分，使得兩端的角色難以到達。同樣，施法者在施放不僅僅針對敵人的區域法術時，必須始終注意周圍的盟友。

english: Travel Pace
zh_tw: 旅行步調

english: The pace of Underdark travel remains as outlined in {@area chapter 2|051|x}, and the characters move no slower for traveling with a larger party. Although a portion of the expeditionary force might be mounted on giant lizards, the lizards travel at the pace of the rest of the party unless they move out ahead.
zh_tw: 幽暗地域旅行的速度保持如{@area 第二章|051|x}中所述，並且角色們與更大的隊伍一起旅行時速度不會減慢。儘管遠徵軍的一部分可能騎在巨型蜥蜴上，但除非它們超前移動，否則巨型蜥蜴的行進速度與隊伍其他成員保持一致。

english: As noted in {@area chapter 2|051|x}, a fast pace makes it harder for characters to spot ambushers or items of interest, and prevents characters from foraging. A slow pace improves chances of foraging. However, even while traveling at a slow pace, the characters and the NPCs can't use stealth, since they are too large a group to go unnoticed. {@skill Stealth} is an option only for a smaller scouting party traveling away from the main force (see "{@area Scouting|399|x}").
zh_tw: 如{@area 第二章|051|x}所述，快速行進使得角色更難發現伏擊者或感興趣的物品，並且阻礙了角色進行覓食。慢速行進提高了覓食的機會。然而，即使以慢速行進，角色和NPC們也無法使用潛行，因為他們是一個太大的群體，無法不被注意。{@skill Stealth||隱匿}技能僅適用於遠離主力部隊進行偵察的小分隊（見"{@area 偵察|399|x}"）。

english: Navigating
zh_tw: 導航

english: While traveling as part of a larger group, the characters have an easier time navigating their way through the Underdark than they did during their initial escape. The characters' own experience, plus that of their followers, along with maps and other information they might have acquired in Gauntlgrym or elsewhere, give all members of the expanded party advantage on any Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to avoid becoming lost (see chapter 5, "{@book Adventure Environments|DMG|5|Becoming Lost}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 作為一大群體的一部分旅行時，角色們在幽暗地域中導航比他們最初逃亡時更容易。角色們自身的經驗，加上他們追隨者的經驗，以及他們在岡特格瑞姆或其他地方獲得的地圖和其他資訊，使得擴大後的隊伍的所有成員在避免迷路的感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定上具有優勢（參見{@i 城主指南}第5章"{@book 冒險環境|DMG|5|Becoming Lost}"）。

english: Scouting
zh_tw: 偵察

english: A portion of the expanded party can break off in order to travel some distance ahead, scouting for the right path while remaining on the lookout for potential hazards. A smaller group might also lag behind, serving as a rearguard watching for threats coming up behind the characters as they travel. NPCs can serve as scouts or members of a rearguard as the players wish. Some of the adventurers might choose to do so as well.
zh_tw: 擴大後的隊伍的一部分可以分開，以便提前行進一段距離，偵察正確的路徑，同時保持警惕，尋找潛在的危險。一個較小的小組也可能落後，作為後衛，監視著角色們行進時可能出現的威脅。NPC可以根據玩家的意願擔任偵察員或後衛成員。一些冒險家也可能選擇這樣做。

english: A smaller scouting group can make use of stealth to travel unnoticed. If a random encounter occurs during the journey, characters in the scouting party discover it first and can choose whether to avoid or deal with the encounter. If characters in the scouting party notice the encounter without being seen themselves, they can retreat back to the main force to inform the other characters. Similarly, if a random encounter escapes the scouting characters' notice, the encountered creatures can lie in wait for the rest of the characters in order to ambush them.
zh_tw: 一個較小的偵察隊伍可以利用隱蔽性來不被注意地旅行。如果在旅途中發生隨機遭遇，偵察隊伍中的角色首先發現它，並可以選擇是避開還是處理這次遭遇。如果偵察隊伍中的角色在沒有被看到的情況下注意到了遭遇，他們可以撤退回主力部隊去通知其他角色。同樣地，如果隨機遭遇逃過了偵察角色的注意，遭遇的生物可以埋伏等待其他角色，以便對他們進行伏擊。

english: In Command
zh_tw: 指揮中

english: No longer a ragtag band of survivors and prisoners, the adventurers are now in command of a dedicated force of NPC followers. In addition to the advantages that brings, the characters must assume leadership roles as they deal with allies who might not entirely trust or respect them—or each other. Add in the dangers of the Underdark, along with the unpredictable influence of demonic madness, and the characters have several new challenges that must be faced.
zh_tw: 冒險家們不再是一群雜亂無章的生還者和囚犯，現在他們指揮著一支忠誠的NPC追隨者力量。除了帶來的好處之外，角色們還必須承擔領導角色，因為他們要與可能不完全信任或尊重他們（或彼此）的盟友打交道。再加上幽暗地域的危險，以及惡魔瘋狂的不可預測影響，角色們面臨著幾個新的挑戰，必須面對。

english: Personalities
zh_tw: 個性

english: Although the NPCs the characters lead are ostensibly allies, many belong to different factions, and old grudges and differences in ethos aren't easily set aside. Personality conflicts might arise among the followers in the expanded party, and the adventurers would be well advised to head off potential trouble. For example, having Lords' Alliance troops acting as scouts while keeping Zhentarim mercenaries close at hand will help keep those factions from fighting.
zh_tw: 儘管角色們領導的NPC表面上是盟友，但許多人屬於不同的派系，舊有的怨恨和意識形態上的差異並不容易擱置。追隨者之間可能會出現個性衝突，冒險家們最好提前預防潛在的麻煩。例如，讓領主聯盟的部隊擔任偵察員，同時讓散塔林會僱傭兵保持近距離，將有助於防止這些派系發生衝突。

english: Heart of Darkness
zh_tw: 黑暗之心

english: In this phase of the campaign, the characters are moving toward the demon lords and their influence rather than away from it, even as the Underdark sinks deeper into madness and chaos. The characters will make saving throws against acquiring levels of madness, as called for in different encounters and whenever you feel it is appropriate. (See {@area chapter 2|063|x} of the adventure for more information on madness.)
zh_tw: 在戰役的這個階段，角色們正朝著惡魔領主及其影響前進，而不是遠離它，即使幽暗地域進一步陷入瘋狂和混亂。角色們將進行豁免檢定，以防止獲得瘋狂的等級，這在不同的遭遇中會要求，並且每當你認為合適時。（有關瘋狂的更多資訊，請參見冒險的{@area 第二章|063|x}。）

english: The NPCs following the characters into the Underdark are just as vulnerable to demonic madness. However, rather than make saving throws or track madness levels for each individual NPC, use the Random Events table in this chapter to determine when madness appears among those followers.
zh_tw: 跟隨角色進入幽暗地域的NPC同樣容易受到惡魔瘋狂的影響。然而，與其為每個單獨的NPC進行豁免檢定或追蹤瘋狂等級，不如使用本章的隨機事件表來確定瘋狂何時在這些追隨者中顯現。

english: When madness appears among the NPCs, use it not just for its mechanical effects but to create real complications for the adventurers. For example, if the Random Events table indicates that one member of the expanded party suffers long-term madness, you might decide to bestow extreme paranoia on that NPC. In addition to the effect of Wisdom and Charisma checks, that character might believe that the adventurers are actually agents of the demon lords, and are intent on leading the NPCs to their doom.
zh_tw: 當瘋狂出現在NPC中時，不僅利用其機械效果，還要為冒險家們創造真正的複雜局面。例如，如果隨機事件表顯示擴大後隊伍中的一名成員遭受長期瘋狂，你可能會決定賦予該NPC極度的偏執症。除了對感知和魅力檢定的影響外，這個角色可能還會認為冒險家實際上是惡魔領主的代理人，並且打算帶領NPC走向毀滅。

english: Loyalty
zh_tw: 忠誠

english: Having the adventurers leading an expanded party gives you the opportunity to use the optional loyalty rules in chapter 4, "{@book Creating Nonplayer Characters|DMG|4|Optional Rule: Loyalty}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}. You can track the loyalty scores of groups of NPCs, such as those belonging to each faction, rather than having to track NPCs individually. The characters must balance the goals and bonds of their followers in order to maintain and improve their loyalty.
zh_tw: 讓冒險者們帶領一支擴大的隊伍為你提供了使用第四章中可選忠誠規則的機會，該章節名為"{@book 建立非玩家角色|DMG|4|Optional Rule: Loyalty}"，來自{@i 城主指南}。你可以跟蹤一群NPC的忠誠分數，例如屬於每個派系的NPC，而不必單獨跟蹤每個NPC。角色們必須平衡其追隨者的目標和羈絆，以維持並提高他們的忠誠度。

english: Provisions
zh_tw: 供應品

english: The factions in Gauntlgrym see to it that the expeditionary force is well provisioned with whatever the characters' expeditionary force can carry. Food and water aren't easy to come by in the Underdark, as the characters know all too well, and supplies must be managed and safeguarded.
zh_tw: 岡特格瑞姆中的派系確保遠徵軍配備了角色們遠徵軍所能攜帶的一切物資。正如角色們非常清楚的那樣，在幽暗地域不容易獲得食物和水，因此必須妥善管理和保護補給品。

english: If the expeditionary force needs to supplement or replace supplies while traveling, the amounts that characters are able to find become more important with a larger group to support. See "{@book Foraging|DMG|5|Foraging}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}, as well as the guidelines in {@area chapter 2|067|x} of this adventure.
zh_tw: 如果遠徵軍在旅途中需要補充或替換物資，那麼在支援更大團隊的情況下，角色能夠找到的物資數量就變得更加重要。請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 覓食|DMG|5|Foraging}"以及本冒險{@area 第二章|067|x}中的指導方針。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Just as they must ensure sufficient supplies for all the NPCs, the characters need to think about how best to share the spoils of encounters and adventures with their followers. Although the NPCs all accompany the adventurers out of loyalty to their factions—and on orders from their superiors in Gauntlgrym—the characters' treatment of the NPCs influences the loyalty of those followers during the mission into the Underdark.
zh_tw: 正如他們必須確保所有NPC有足夠的補給一樣，角色們需要考慮如何最好地與他們的追隨者分享遭遇和冒險的戰利品。儘管NPC們都是因為對他們所在派系的忠誠——並且是根據岡特格瑞姆中上級的命令——陪伴冒險者，但角色們對待NPC的方式會影響那些追隨者在進入幽暗地域任務期間的忠誠度。

english: The characters should come up with some means for dividing any treasure taken on the expedition between the NPCs. As long as the division is reasonably fair, most of the followers will be content. However, the NPCs will complain if all the choice pieces of treasure go to the adventurers.
zh_tw: 角色們應該想出一些方法，在NPC之間分配探險中獲得的任何財寶。只要分配相對公平，大多數追隨者都會滿意。然而，如果所有的精選財寶都歸冒險家所有，NPC們將會抱怨。

english: The characters might also need to contend with the problem of theft, whether NPCs stealing from spoils not yet divided, stealing from the adventurers, or stealing from each other. Such theft might be driven by sheer greed, or it could be a manifestation of madness. A bout of long-term madness could easily lead to obsession with particular items of treasure—especially magic items—with an obsessed NPC willing to steal or even kill to obtain them.
zh_tw: 角色們可能還需要應對盜竊問題，無論是NPC從尚未分配的戰利品中偷竊，從冒險者那裡偷竊，或彼此之間偷竊。這種盜竊可能純粹是出於貪婪，或者它可能是瘋狂的體現。長期的瘋狂很容易導致對特定寶物——特別是魔法物品——的迷戀，一個迷戀的NPC願意偷竊甚至殺人來獲得它們。

english: Maintaining Order
zh_tw: 維護秩序

english: The adventurers are in command of their NPC followers, and that means they are responsible for welding together disparate forces and maintaining discipline. The characters have a bit of an advantage in this regard, in that the NPCs placed under their command are all well-trained faction operatives, not raw recruits or mercenaries. However, some of these seasoned personnel might question the right of a ragtag band of adventurers to command them, even if their superiors seem to trust the player characters. Likewise, though the individual factions are typically disciplined within their own ranks, members of any faction might bristle at having to work alongside (much less take orders from) members of other factions.
zh_tw: 冒險家們指揮著他們的NPC追隨者，這意味著他們負責將不同的勢力融合在一起並維持紀律。在這一方面，角色們有一些優勢，因為被置於他們指揮下的NPC都是訓練有素的派系特工，而不是新兵或僱傭兵。然而，這些經驗豐富的人員中可能會有人質疑一群雜亂無章的冒險家指揮他們的權利，即使他們的上級似乎信任玩家角色。同樣，儘管各個派系通常在他們自己的隊伍中很有紀律，任何派系的成員都可能對與（更不用說接受命令於）其他派系的成員一起工作感到不滿。

english: Chain of Command
zh_tw: 指揮鏈

english: In addition to deciding how the expeditionary force is organized and distributed (see "{@area Marching Orders|396|x}"), the players must also institute a clear chain of command. One or more of the adventurers might be the field commanders of the expanded party, while others serve as lieutenants. Likewise, the adventurers might appoint some of the NPCs to command positions. Without a clear chain of command, information might not go to the right people, and decisions might not get made quickly enough—or at all. Adding to the challenge of maintaining discipline is the ever-present threat of demonic madness growing among the ranks, creating problems even for seasoned and professional troops (see "{@area Heart of Darkness|39c|x}").
zh_tw: 除了決定遠徵軍的組織和分配方式（見"{@area 行軍指令|396|x}"），玩家們還必須建立一個清晰的指揮鏈。一個或多個冒險者可能是擴大後隊伍的戰場指揮官，而其他人則擔任副手。同樣，冒險者們也可能任命一些NPC擔任指揮職位。沒有清晰的指揮鏈，資訊可能無法傳達給正確的人，決策可能無法快速做出——或者根本無法做出。維持紀律的挑戰增加的是，惡魔瘋狂在隊伍中不斷增長的威脅，即使是經驗豐富的專業部隊也會遇到問題（見"{@area 黑暗之心|39c|x}"）。

english: If the expeditionary force is made up of diverse factions, the players also need to decide how much latitude to give those factions. For example, Zhentarim mercenaries might be eager to torture prisoners for information unless the characters put a stop to it, and members of the Emerald Enclave might place a higher priority on maintaining the balance of nature in the Underdark than on political struggles.
zh_tw: 如果探險隊伍由不同的派系組成，玩家們還需要決定給予這些派系多大的自由度。例如，散塔林會僱傭兵可能急於對囚犯進行拷打以獲取資訊，除非角色們加以制止；而翠綠閒庭的成員可能更重視維護幽暗地域中的自然平衡，而不是政治鬥爭。

english: Splitting the Party
zh_tw: 分隊

english: You can change up the feel of these later chapters of {@i Out of the Abyss} by allowing the players to take on the roles of their faction allies as well as their regular characters. This can range from letting each player control the overall actions of the NPCs in a single faction, to creating multiple subgroups so that characters can split off and have their own adventures. While this involves a good deal more coordination among the game group, it can add a lot of detail, intrigue, and interaction to the campaign.
zh_tw: 你可以透過允許玩家在扮演常規角色的同時，也扮演他們的陣營盟友的角色來改變 {@i 逃離深淵} 這些後期章節的感覺。這可以包括讓每個玩家控制某個單一陣營中 NPC 的總體行動，或者建立多個子組，讓角色可以分頭行動並擁有自己的冒險。雖然這需要遊戲團隊進行更多的協調，但它可以為戰役增添大量細節、陰謀和互動。

english: Random Events
zh_tw: 隨機事件

english: The adventurers must contend with a variety of events as they lead their forces through the Underdark. Every other day of travel or camping in the Underdark, an event automatically occurs. Roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Random Events table, or choose a suitable event.
zh_tw: 冒險者們在帶領他們的隊伍穿越幽暗地域時必須應對各種事件。在幽暗地域中旅行或露營的每隔一天，就會自動發生一個事件。擲一個 {@dice d20} 並查閱隨機事件表，或選擇一個合適的事件。

english: For the rules on madness, see {@area chapter 2|063|x} of this adventure and chapter 8, "{@book Running the Game|DMG|8|Madness}," in the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}.
zh_tw: 有關瘋狂規則的詳細內容，請參見本冒險的{@area 第二章|063|x}以及{@i 城主指南}中的第8章"{@book 運作遊戲|DMG|8|Madness}"。

zh_tw: 事件

english: Battle aftermath
zh_tw: 戰鬥後果

english: Creature encounter
zh_tw: 生物遭遇

english: Demon encounter
zh_tw: 惡魔遭遇

english: Discipline problem
zh_tw: 紀律問題

english: Disease
zh_tw: 疾病

english: Madness
zh_tw: 瘋狂

english: {@condition Poisoned} NPCs
zh_tw: {@condition Poisoned||中毒}的NPC

english: Underdark Outposts
zh_tw: 幽暗地域前哨站

english: Characters can clear out Underdark areas and create defensible outposts where they and their followers can store supplies and take refuge. To ensure that an outpost isn't overrun and looted, guards must be assigned to the outpost while the characters are away.
zh_tw: 角色們可以清理幽暗地域的區域，並建立可以防守的前哨站，他們和追隨者可以在那裡存放補給並尋求庇護。為確保前哨站在角色們離開時不被攻佔和搶劫，必須向前哨站分配守衛。

english: Outposts not only allow scouts to easily backtrack through the Underdark, carrying messages and information to the characters' allies, but also allow additional supplies and reinforcements to reach the expeditionary force with relative ease. Characters without outposts must rely on magic to send messages or receive supplies and reinforcements once their expeditionary force is more than a tenday's travel away from Mantol-Derith.
zh_tw: 前哨站不僅允許偵察兵輕鬆地穿越幽暗地域，攜帶資訊和訊息給角色的盟友，而且還可以讓額外的供應品和增援部隊相對容易地到達探險隊伍。沒有前哨站的角色必須依賴魔法來傳送訊息或接收供應品和增援部隊，一旦他們的探險隊伍距離曼塔-岱瑞絲超過十天的路程。

english: Each Underdark outpost is basically a fortified encampment. It can take one of the following forms:

english: This section addresses what happens if the characters visit places they skipped during their escape from the Underdark, and what might have changed or shifted in their absence.
zh_tw: 這一節討論瞭如果角色們訪問了他們在從幽暗地域逃脫時跳過的地方，以及在他們缺席期間可能發生的變化或轉移。

english: Blingdenstone
zh_tw: 布靈登石城

english: If the adventurers encountered {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} and uncovered evidence of Juiblex's presence near Blingdenstone, they might want to return there to confirm that the svirfneblin settlement remains safe from the demon lord's influence.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者遇到了{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}並發現了朱庇萊克斯在布靈登石城附近存在的證據，他們可能想要返回那裡，以確認地底侏儒定居點是否仍然免受惡魔領主的影響。

english: Alternatively, if the characters didn't previously visit Blingdenstone, news of the challenges faced by the deep gnomes can reach them while they travel through the Underdark. Deep gnome merchants headed to Mantol-Derith bring word of oozes infesting the settlement, giving the characters an opportunity to face off against {@creature the Pudding King|OotA}.
zh_tw: 或者，如果角色之前沒有訪問過布靈登石城，他們在穿越幽暗地域時可以聽到地底侏儒所面臨的挑戰的訊息。前往曼塔-岱瑞絲的地底侏儒商人帶來定居點被軟泥怪侵擾的訊息，給角色們提供了一個對抗{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}的機會。

english: At some point after {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} is dealt with, Juiblex and its servants make their way toward the caverns of Araumycos to crash Zuggtmoy's wedding (see chapter 16, "{@adventure The Fetid Wedding|OotA|15}"). If {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} is among the survivors, he leads the mad march to confront Zuggtmoy and her fungal followers.
zh_tw: 在處理完{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}之後的某個時刻，朱庇萊克斯及其僕從會前往阿勞麥柯的洞穴，目的是闖入祖格莫伊的婚禮（見第16章，"{@adventure 惡臭的婚禮|OotA|15}"）。如果{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}是生還者之一，他將領導瘋狂的行軍去對抗祖格莫伊及其真菌追隨者。

english: Reinforcements
zh_tw: 援軍

english: The deep gnomes of Blingdenstone are valuable allies. In gratitude for the adventurers' aid, they offer to reinforce the party's expeditionary force with twelve {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnomes}. Chief Dorbo Diggermattock can also be persuaded to lend additional aid and troops, if the heroes present a compelling case. Use the information in {@adventure chapter 6|OotA|5} to guide any negotiations or arrangements the adventurers attempt to make with the svirfneblin.
zh_tw: 布靈登石城的地底侏儒是寶貴的盟友。為了感謝冒險者的幫助，他們提出用十二名{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}加強隊伍的遠徵力量。如果英雄們提出了一個有說服力的案例，多爾博·掘鋤首領也可以被說服提供額外的幫助和部隊。使用{@adventure 第六章|OotA|5}中的資訊來指導冒險者嘗試與地底侏儒進行的任何談判或安排。

english: The Darklake
zh_tw: 黑暗湖

english: To move their expeditionary force across the Darklake, the characters must build rafts or coracles from Underdark materials, or seek out duergar or kuo-toa ferries for hire. Each ferry they find can transport up to eight members of the expeditionary force.
zh_tw: 為了將他們的遠徵軍渡過黑暗湖，角色們必須用幽暗地域的材料建造筏子或皮筏，或者尋找灰矮人或寇濤魚人的渡船來僱傭。他們找到的每個渡船可以運送遠徵軍的最多八名成員。

english: {@area Chapter 3|0ea|x} contains information on navigating the Darklake. If the expeditionary force splits up, check for random encounters with each group separately.
zh_tw: {@area 第三章|0ea|x} 包含了關於在黑暗湖中航行的資訊。如果探險隊分開行動，請分別為每個小組隨機遭遇進行檢查。

english: Fallen Sloobludop
zh_tw: 墮落的斯盧布多普

english: If the characters visit Sloobludop, they find the kuo-toa community in ruins. Demogorgon smashed and crushed many of the structures of the settlement, killing about half the kuo-toa community in the process. The survivors have fallen prey to madness and the predations of Underdark monsters in the time since.
zh_tw: 如果角色們訪問斯盧布多普，他們會發現寇濤魚人社群已經毀滅。狄摩高根破壞並摧毀了定居點的許多建築，在這一過程中大約殺死了寇濤魚人社群的一半成員。自那以後，生還者陷入了瘋狂，併成為了幽暗地域怪物的獵物。

english: Obscene altars and shrines are everywhere, many of them depicting elements of Demogorgon's twisted iconography—spirals and "{@creature Y|OotA}" shapes, two-headed creatures, manta rays, and tentacles. Other shrines show the influence of other demon lords, including piles of skulls and bones, strange maze patterns, spore clouds, and fetid pools of ooze. Conflicts are rapidly rising between the various "sects" that have formed.
zh_tw: 到處都是淫穢的祭壇和神龕，其中許多描繪了狄摩高根扭曲的象形文字——螺旋形和"{@creature Y|OotA|歪}"形狀，雙頭生物，鰩魚和觸手。其他神龕展示了其他惡魔領主的影響，包括成堆的頭骨和骨頭，奇怪的迷宮圖案，孢子云，以及惡臭的軟泥池。不同"教派"之間的衝突正在迅速升級。

english: If {@creature Shuushar the Awakened|OotA} (see {@area chapter 1|008|x}) was not killed in a previous chapter of the adventure, the characters find him among Sloobludop's survivors. He is the sole point of calm and reason in the ruined settlement, and the various factions of the kuo-toa show him respect. Shuushar mediates disputes between the kuo-toa and supervises the allocation of their dwindling resources. Even so, the kuo-toa monk isn't sure how long he can sustain his people and keep them from destruction.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Shuushar the Awakened|OotA|覺醒者舒沙爾}（見第1章{@area 第一章|008|x}）在冒險的前幾章中沒有被殺死，角色們會在斯盧布多普的生還者中找到他。他是被毀定居點中唯一的平靜和理性之點，而且各種派系的寇濤魚人都對他表現出尊重。舒沙爾調解寇濤魚人之間的爭端，並監督他們日益減少的資源分配。即便如此，這位寇濤魚人武僧也不確定他能維持他的人民多久，並防止他們走向毀滅。

english: Gracklstugh
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格

english: If the characters visited Gracklstugh previously, the duergar response to their return is dictated by the gray dwarves' prior experience with the characters. The duergar are cautious—if not downright alarmed—at the sight of an armed expeditionary force from the surface world at their gates. They likely refuse entry to the full party, allowing only a select few characters into the Darklake District. {@condition Invisible} duergar guards keep watch on characters in the city at all times, and might even infiltrate the expeditionary force, attempting to eavesdrop on conversations to learn the adventurers' intentions.
zh_tw: 如果角色們之前訪問過格拉克斯圖格，灰矮人對他們返回的反應將由灰色灰矮人與角色們的先前經歷決定。灰矮人對於來自地表世界的武裝遠徵軍出現在他們的大門處感到謹慎——如果不是完全驚慌的話。他們可能拒絕整個隊伍的進入，只允許少數幾個角色進入黑暗湖區域。處於{@condition Invisible||隱形}狀態的灰矮人守衛始終監視著城市中的角色，甚至可能滲透進遠徵軍，試圖竊聽對話以瞭解冒險者的意圖。

english: Chaos in the City
zh_tw: 城市中的混亂

english: The influence of the demon lords grows ever stronger in Gracklstugh. Paranoia and fear are rampant, with duergar barricading themselves in their homes and strongholds, afraid to venture out into the streets—even invisibly. Rumors abound of creatures active in the Darklake, and of secret rituals and offerings made to the dark waters to appease them. A number of foreigners have disappeared, and incoming trade to the city has slowed as outsiders depart or stay away.
zh_tw: 惡魔領主在格拉克斯圖格的影響日益增強。偏執和恐懼盛行，灰矮人將自己封鎖在家中和要塞裡，不敢外出到街道上——即使是隱形的。有關黑暗湖中活躍生物的傳言四起，還有秘密儀式和向黑暗水域獻祭以安撫它們的流言。一些外國人已經失蹤，進入城市的貿易也因為外來者離開或避開而減緩。

english: Conflict between the Keepers of the Flame and the Gray Ghosts thieves' guild comes to a boil. Each side blames the other for recent happenings in the City of Blades and believes it can use the situation to its advantage. Keepers turn up dead, murdered by mysterious assailants, while agents of that order use increasingly brutal methods to ferret out and eliminate the Gray Ghosts—or anyone believed to associate with them.
zh_tw: 火焰守護者和灰鬼盜賊公會之間的衝突達到了沸點。每一方都指責對方是刀刃之城最近事件的幕後黑手，並相信可以利用這種情況為自己謀取利益。守護者被發現死亡，被神秘的襲擊者謀殺，而那個公會的代理人使用越來越殘酷的手段來搜尋並消滅灰鬼——或者任何被認為與他們有關聯的人。

english: Whether due to the intervention of the adventurers, the recent events in the Underdark, or both, {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} the Wyrmsmith knows that the Keepers are deliberately oppressing him, and he plots to thin their ranks and weaken their power. Though the dragon knows that he is effectively trapped in the caverns of Gracklstugh even if he wins his freedom, he hungers for it nonetheless, just as he hungers for revenge against those who oppose him.
zh_tw: 無論是由於冒險者的幹預，還是由於幽暗地域最近的事件，或者兩者兼而有之，{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}這位龍匠知道守護者們在故意壓迫他，他計劃減少他們的人數，削弱他們的力量。儘管這位龍知道即使他贏得了自由，他實際上仍然被困在格拉克斯圖格的洞穴中，但他仍然渴望自由，就像他渴望對那些反對他的人進行報復一樣。

english: Dark Plots
zh_tw: 黑暗陰謀

english: If the characters spend much time in Gracklstugh, they become caught up in a rush of destructive events. A secret alliance of factions within the Council of Savants and the Keepers of the Flame, driven by demonic madness, comes to the conclusion that Gracklstugh's salvation lies in eliminating {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} before he becomes a bigger threat. In the process, both factions plan to acquire a new and far more powerful patron.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在格拉克斯圖格逗留太久，他們將捲入一系列破壞性事件的漩渦中。由於惡魔瘋狂驅使下，智者議會和火焰守護者內的秘密聯盟得出結論，格拉克斯圖格的救贖在於在{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}成為更大的威脅之前消除他。在此過程中，兩個派系都計劃獲得一個新的、更加強大的保護者。

english: The duergar and derro hatch a scheme to sacrifice {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} as an offering to Demogorgon, drawing the demon prince to their city and pledging themselves to the Prince of Demons. A few of them even have delusions that they can somehow bind or influence the demon lord's power, or that the demon lord will lead them in conquering the whole of the Underdark. Meanwhile, rumors mount that the drow of Menzoberranzan are behind the demonic incursion. Tales range from the drow raising a mighty army of demons to a summoning spell gone terribly wrong. A demonic rampage is said to have nearly destroyed the City of Spiders, and characters with knowledge of the situation in Menzoberranzan are of great interest to all the factions of Gracklstugh. Any evidence that the drow are responsible for the presence of the demon lords stokes the already blazing embers of animosity against the dark elves, with the more militant factions of Gracklstugh calling for a renewed war of vengeance against Menzoberranzan.
zh_tw: 灰矮人和迪洛矮人策劃了一個陰謀，打算將{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}作為給狄摩高根的祭品，將這位惡魔王子吸引到他們的城市，並將自己奉獻給惡魔之王。他們中的一些人甚至產生了妄想，認為他們能夠以某種方式束縛或影響惡魔領主的力量，或者惡魔領主將帶領他們征服整個幽暗地域。與此同時，有關魔索布萊城的卓爾是惡魔入侵幕後黑手的謠言四起。從卓爾召喚起一支強大的惡魔軍隊，到召喚咒語出了大錯，各種說法不一。據說一次惡魔的暴走幾乎摧毀了蜘蛛城，對魔索布萊城局勢有所瞭解的角色對格拉克斯圖格的所有派系都極具興趣。任何證明卓爾對惡魔領主存在負有責任的證據，都會加劇對卓爾的敵意，格拉克斯圖格的更激進派系呼籲對魔索布萊城重新發動復仇戰爭。

english: Menzoberranzan
zh_tw: 魔索布萊城

english: The characters might decide to visit Menzoberranzan before heading to Gravenhollow, either to learn what the drow know about the arrival of the demon lords or to assess their involvement in recent events.
zh_tw: 角色們在前往刻文谷之前，可能會決定先訪問魔索布萊城，要麼是為了瞭解卓爾對惡魔領主到來的瞭解，要麼是為了評估他們對最近事件的參與。

english: March on Menzoberranzan
zh_tw: 向魔索布萊城進軍

english: If the characters advance their expeditionary force toward the drow city, word of their approach reaches Menzoberranzan two days before their arrival, and the drow dispatch a well-armed defense force to destroy the surface dwellers. Racing ahead of this drow force is a high elf from Silverymoon named {@creature Khalessa Draga|OotA}. A deep cover agent of the Lords' Alliance, Khalessa has been spying on the drow for years—so long, in fact, that her superiors are beginning to wonder if she's a defector. {@creature Khalessa Draga|OotA|Khalessa} is a loyal alliance {@creature spy} with the following statistical modifications:
zh_tw: 如果角色們將他們的遠徵軍向卓爾城市推進，魔索布萊城會在他們到達前兩天得知他們的接近，卓爾會派出一支裝備精良的防禦力量去摧毀地表居民。在這支卓爾力量之前，有一名來自銀月城的高等精靈名叫{@creature Khalessa Draga|OotA|卡萊莎·德拉加}。卡萊莎是領主聯盟的深層臥底，多年來一直在監視卓爾——事實上，時間如此之長，以至於她的上級開始懷疑她是否是叛徒。{@creature Khalessa Draga|OotA|卡萊莎}是一位忠誠的聯盟{@creature spy||間諜}，具有以下統計修正：

english: Khalessa's alignment is neutral.
zh_tw: 卡萊莎的陣營是中立。

english: She has {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet.
zh_tw: 她擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}，範圍可達60尺。

english: She speaks Common, Elvish, and Undercommon.
zh_tw: 她會說通用語、精靈語和地底通用語。

english: Khalessa's fey ancestry gives her advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put her to sleep.
zh_tw: 卡萊莎的精類血統使她在對抗{@condition charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定上有優勢，魔法也不能讓她入睡。

english: She can cast the {@spell dancing lights} cantrip at will.
zh_tw: 她可以隨意施放{@spell dancing lights||舞光術}戲法。

english: She owns a {@item hat of disguise}, which she uses to appear as a female drow while in the company of drow, and she wears a {@item Piwafwi (Cloak of Elvenkind)|OotA|piwafwi} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}).
zh_tw: 她擁有一頂{@item hat of disguise||易容帽}，她用它在卓爾的陪伴下看起來像一個女性卓爾，她還穿著一件{@item Piwafwi (Cloak of Elvenkind)|OotA|魔斗篷}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}）。

english: Khalessa urges the characters to turn back. If they don't, she fears that the drow force will overwhelm them. Having blown her cover to warn the characters, she asks to stay with them until they reach Gauntlgrym or an alliance settlement.
zh_tw: 卡萊莎敦促角色們回頭。如果他們不這樣做，她擔心卓爾軍隊會壓倒他們。為了警告角色們，她暴露了自己的身份，並請求跟隨他們直到到達岡特格瑞姆或聯盟定居點。

english: The leaders of the drow force are a female {@creature drow elite warrior} named Ryzliir Symryvvin and her consort, a male {@creature drow mage} named Velgor Zolond. They are joined by a prisoner in manacles—an unarmed and unarmored male human {@creature knight} of the Order of the Gauntlet named {@creature Aljanor Keenblade|OotA}. Sir Aljanor was captured during a surface raid months ago, and the drow have beaten him such that he has only 3 hit points remaining. Members of the order traveling in the party's expeditionary force recognize Sir Aljanor instantly and are {@status surprised}; they assumed he had been killed.
zh_tw: 卓爾部隊的領導者是一位名為瑞茲利爾·辛瑞文的{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}女性和她的伴侶，一位名為維爾戈·佐隆德的{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}男性。他們身邊還有一位戴著鐐銬的囚犯——一個未武裝且未穿盔甲的男性人類{@creature knight||騎士}，他是鐵手套教團的成員，名為{@creature Aljanor Keenblade|OotA|阿爾詹諾·基恩布萊德}。幾個月前，阿爾詹諾爵士在一次地面突襲中被捕，卓爾們毆打他，以至於他只剩下3點生命值。隨行的騎士團成員在探險隊的遠徵力量中立即認出了阿爾詹諾爵士，並感到{@status surprised||突襲}；他們以為他已經死了。

english: Ryzliir vows to execute Aljanor unless the characters withdraw their expeditionary force immediately. Under no circumstances will she willingly release her prisoner. If the characters refuse to turn back, Ryzliir kills Aljanor and orders her own force to attack. If the characters leave Aljanor behind or allow him to die, members of the party's expeditionary force in league with the Order of the Gauntlet who make it back to Gauntlgrym report the incident to Sir Lanniver Strayl (see {@area chapter 8|344|x}).
zh_tw: 瑞茲利爾發誓，如果角色們不立即撤回他們的遠徵軍，她將處決阿爾詹諾。在任何情況下，她都不會自願釋放她的囚犯。如果角色們拒絕回頭，瑞茲利爾將殺死阿爾詹諾，並命令她自己的部隊發動攻擊。如果角色們丟下阿爾詹諾或允許他死去，與鐵手套教團有關聯的遠徵軍成員，回到岡特格瑞姆的，會向蘭尼弗·斯特雷爾爵士報告這一事件（見{@area 第八章|344|x}）。

english: Ryzliir and Velgor are mounted on {@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|giant riding lizards} (see the end of {@area chapter 8|34c|x} for statistics), and Aljanor rides behind Velgor. Ryzliir commands a force of six {@creature drow} warriors, twelve {@creature bugbear} slaves, and sixty {@creature goblin} slaves. If all the drow are killed, the goblinoids flee as their morale breaks.
zh_tw: 瑞茲利爾和維爾戈騎乘在{@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|乘用巨蜥}上（見{@area 第八章|34c|x}以獲取具體數值），而阿爾詹諾騎在維爾戈後面。瑞茲利爾指揮著一支由六名{@creature drow||卓爾}戰士，十二名{@creature bugbear||熊地精}奴隸和六十名{@creature goblin||地精}奴隸組成的隊伍。如果所有的卓爾都被殺死，地精類生物會因為士氣崩潰而逃跑。

english: Sir Aljanor has made his peace with Tyr and expects to die. He is disappointed if good lives are lost in a foolish attempt to rescue him. If he survives, he accepts any offer to join the party's expeditionary force and is quick to assume a leadership role.
zh_tw: 阿爾詹諾爵士已與提爾和解，並做好赴死的準備。若有人愚蠢地試圖營救他，卻讓善良的人因此喪命，他會感到失望。若他存活下來，便願意接受加入隊伍遠徵軍的任何邀請，並迅速承擔領導職責。

english: Neverlight Grove
zh_tw: 無光林地

english: If the characters return to Neverlight Grove, myconids loyal to {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA} (including {@creature Stool|OotA} and {@creature Rumpadump|OotA} if they remained behind) try to intercept them before their arrival and warn them off. The myconids say that matters have become grave, and that the characters should avoid the grove at all costs.
zh_tw: 如果角色們返回無光林地，忠於{@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞}的菌人（包括如果他們留下來的{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}和{@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普}）會試圖在他們到達之前攔截他們並警告他們遠離。菌人表示情況已經變得嚴重，角色們應該不惜一切代價避開這片樹林。

english: If the adventurers don't leave immediately, six {@creature Myconid Adult||myconid adults}, four {@creature Quaggoth Spore Servant||quaggoth spore servants}, and four {@creature Awakened Zurkhwood|OotA|awakened zurkhwoods} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) loyal to Sovereign Phylo cut off their retreat. They surround the characters and their followers, offering to escort them to Phylo as the sovereign's honored guests.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們不立即離開，六名{@creature Myconid Adult||蕈人成體}，四名{@creature Quaggoth Spore Servant||幽邃熊怪孢子奴僕}和四名{@creature Awakened Zurkhwood|OotA|覺醒的祖克木}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）忠於君主菲洛將切斷他們的退路。他們包圍了角色和他們的追隨者，提出將他們護送到菲洛那裡，作為主權者的尊貴客人。

english: Sovereign Phylo is friendly and offers all visitors food and drink; however, his offerings are {@condition poisoned}. Each creature that consumes the food or drink must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 8 hours. The creature is also {@condition unconscious} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. Any creature that remains {@condition unconscious} in the grove for 1 hour or more is afflicted by Zuggtmoy's spores, as described in {@area chapter 5|224|x}.
zh_tw: 君主菲洛對所有人友好，併為所有訪客提供食物和飲料；然而，他提供的食物和飲料被{@condition poisoned||中毒}了。每個食用食物或飲料的生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 13}的體質豁免檢定，否則將被{@condition poisoned||中毒}持續8小時。在這種情況下，生物在被{@condition poisoned||中毒}的同時也會{@condition unconscious||昏迷}。任何在樹叢中保持{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態1小時或更長時間的生物，將受到祖格莫伊孢子的影響，如{@area 第五章|224|x}所述。

english: If the characters take Basidia's advice and turn back, the myconid sovereign promises to contact them again when "the time is right to oppose Zuggtmoy" (as described in chapter 16, "{@adventure The Fetid Wedding|OotA|15}").
zh_tw: 如果角色們聽從巴斯狄亞的建議並回頭，菌人人君主承諾會在"反對祖格莫伊的時機成熟時"再次聯絡他們（如第16章"{@adventure 惡臭的婚禮|OotA|15}"中所述）。

english: Velkynvelve
zh_tw: 維爾京維爾夫

english: If the adventurers return to the drow outpost where they were imprisoned, they find Velkynvelve under the command of a {@creature drow mage} named Servan Llarabbar. Six male {@creature drow} report to him, while three more male {@creature drow} and one female {@creature drow elite warrior} have been locked in the slave pen. The prisoners are afflicted with various forms of indefinite madness (roll on the Indefinite Madness table in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Madness} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Even Servan is beginning to show heightened megalomania and paranoia, seeing enemies everywhere. He has delusions of grandeur and fantasies about declaring Velkynvelve independent of Menzoberranzan, rallying followers to his side and eventually toppling the matriarchs of the great houses.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們返回他們曾被囚禁的卓爾前哨站，他們會發現維爾京維爾夫現在由一位名叫瑟凡·拉拉巴的{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}指揮。有六名男性{@creature drow||卓爾}向他彙報，而另外三名男性{@creature drow||卓爾}和一名女性{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}被關在奴隸欄裡。囚犯們遭受了各種形式的永久性瘋狂（在{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Madness}的{@i 城主指南}中的永久性瘋狂表格上擲骰子）。甚至連瑟凡也開始表現出增強的誇大妄想和偏執，到處看到敵人。他有關於宣佈維爾京維爾夫獨立於魔索布萊城的宏偉幻想，召集追隨者到他這邊，並最終推翻大家族的女族長。

english: Chapter 11: Gravenhollow
zh_tw: 第11章：刻文谷

english: The library of Gravenhollow is a bastion of peace and order in an Underdark gone mad. Carved out long ago from the bones of the world and protected by ancient and potent magic, the library possesses a kind of awareness. It blocks and misdirects those unworthy of reaching its gates, even as it facilitates finding the way for those who need it.
zh_tw: 刻文谷圖書館是瘋狂幽暗地域中的和平與秩序堡壘。它很久以前從世界的骨骼中被雕刻出來，並受到古老而強大的魔法的保護，圖書館擁有一種意識。它阻止並誤導那些不值得到達其大門的人，即使它為那些需要它的人提供了找到道路的便利。

english: The adventurers need to find the library in their quest to learn what has happened in the Underdark. Before obtaining the answers they seek, however, they must come to understand Gravenhollow and its keepers—three stone giants who reside within the library. These librarians are tasked with recording and maintaining the lore of their own kind, as well as all the echoes of the past, present, and future haunting the library's halls.
zh_tw: 冒險者們需要找到圖書館，以瞭解幽暗地域中發生了什麼。然而，在獲得他們尋求的答案之前，他們必須理解刻文谷及其守護者——三位居住在圖書館內的石巨人。這些圖書管理員的任務是記錄和維護他們自己種族的知識，以及所有過去、現在和未來回蕩在圖書館大廳的回聲。

english: Gravenhollow is a place where visitors will most certainly find answers. However, those answers might not be the ones the characters wanted—or might even be things they never wanted to know.
zh_tw: 刻文谷是一個訪客肯定能找到答案的地方。然而，這些答案可能並不是角色們想要的——甚至可能是他們從未想要知道的。

english: Going to Gravenhollow
zh_tw: 前往刻文谷

english: The objective of the adventurers' return to the Underdark is to find Gravenhollow. Ancient legends state that every event that has ever occurred in the Underdark is recorded on the countless tablets and cylinders in Gravenhollow's halls. As such, it might be the key to discovering the cause of the demon lords' arrival.
zh_tw: 冒險者返回幽暗地域的目的是找到刻文谷。古老的傳說表明，在幽暗地域發生的每一個事件都被記錄在刻文谷大廳中無數的石碑和圓柱上。因此，它可能是發現惡魔領主到來原因的關鍵。

english: The stone library lies west of the Wormwrithings, 360 miles from Mantol-Derith and 120 miles from Gauntlgrym. Only one tunnel leads to the library, and the magic surrounding Gravenhollow can change where the tunnel's entrance appears among the surrounding passageways, even as that magic allows visitors to locate its entrance. Fortunately for the characters, the library's awareness—in tune with all events in the Underdark—knows that they are coming. As such, the ring obtained from the Zhentarim in Mantol-Derith (see {@adventure chapter 9|OotA|8}) allows them to find the secret site. The journey from Mantol-Derith to Gravenhollow takes 60 days. If the characters {@spell teleport} back to Gauntlgrym and start there, the trip takes 20 days. See {@area chapters 2|051|x} and {@area 10|397|x} for information on traveling in the Underdark.
zh_tw: 石質圖書館位於蠕蟲扭道的西邊，距離曼塔-岱瑞絲 360英里，距離岡特格瑞姆 120英里。只有一條隧道通向圖書館，而環繞刻文谷的魔法可以改變隧道入口在周圍通道中的位置，即使這種魔法也允許訪客找到它的入口。幸運的是，對於角色們來說，圖書館的意識——與幽暗地域的所有事件同步——知道他們要來了。因此，從曼塔-岱瑞絲的散塔林會那裡獲得的戒指（見{@adventure 第九章|OotA|8}）使他們能夠找到這個秘密地點。從曼塔-岱瑞絲到刻文谷的旅程需要60天。如果角色們透過{@spell teleport||傳送術}回到岡特格瑞姆並從那裡出發，旅程需要20天。有關在幽暗地域旅行的資訊，請參見{@area 第二章|051|x}和{@area 10|397|x}。

english: Finding the Way
zh_tw: 找到道路

english: The characters can find the route to Gravenhollow using {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA}'s ring. If they don't have the ring, there are a couple other options available to them.
zh_tw: 角色們可以使用{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}的戒指找到通往刻文谷的路線。如果他們沒有戒指，還有其他幾個選項可供他們選擇。

english: Ghazrim's Ring
zh_tw: 加茲裡姆的戒指

english: The star ruby in Ghazrim's ring has a white, star-shaped core that guides its wearer along the safest, shortest route to Gravenhollow.
zh_tw: 加茲裡姆戒指中的星紅寶石有一個白色的星形核心，它指引佩戴者沿著最安全、最短的路線前往刻文谷。

english: Society of Brilliance
zh_tw: 光輝協會

english: If one or more members of the Society of Brilliance are traveling with the party (see the "{@area Society of Brilliance|0a9|x}" random encounter in chapter 2), they can find the way to Gravenhollow, having found it once before. Any Society of Brilliance member who comes within a day's travel of the library can make a {@dc 15} Intelligence check to find the passage leading to Gravenhollow. If its check fails, it can try again after 8 hours of searching and contemplation.
