zh_tw: 如果旅隊中有一位或多位光明會成員同行（見第2章的"{@area 光輝協會|0a9|x}"隨機遭遇），他們可以找到通往刻文谷的道路，因為他們之前曾找到過。任何在圖書館一天行程範圍內的光明會成員都可以進行一次{@dc 15}智力檢定，以找到通向刻文谷的通道。如果檢定失敗，他們可以在經過8小時的搜尋和思考後再次嘗試。

english: Stone Giant Guide
zh_tw: 石巨人嚮導

english: If the characters don't have the ring to guide them, a duergar NPC (for example, Ghuldur Flagonfist in Mantol-Derith) might suggest that they talk to Stonespeaker Hgraam in Gracklstugh. If the characters helped the stone giants by putting an end to the horrid derro rituals in the Whorlstone Tunnels (see chapter 4), Stonespeaker Hgraam is willing to assign them a guide—a {@creature stone giant} named Jaal—who can lead them to Gravenhollow. As he guides the expeditionary force through the Underdark, Jaal periodically stops to press his hands against ancient stone, as though communing with the rock itself. His mystical connection to the Underdark allows him to find the safest, shortest route to the stone library.
zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有戒指來指引他們，一個灰矮人NPC（例如，在曼塔-岱瑞絲的古爾杜·酒壺拳）可能會建議他們與葛拉格拉克斯圖格的石語者哈格拉姆交談。如果角色們透過結束渦石隧道中可怕的迪洛矮人儀式幫助了石巨人（見第4章），石語者哈格拉姆願意指派他們一個嚮導——一個名叫賈爾的{@creature stone giant||石巨人}——他可以帶領他們到刻文谷。當他引導遠徵隊穿過幽暗地域時，賈爾會定期停下來將手按在古老的石頭上，彷彿在與岩石本身交流。他對幽暗地域的神秘聯絡使他能找到通往石製圖書館的最安全、最短的路線。

english: Veldyskar the Basilisk
zh_tw: 石化蜥蜴維爾迪斯卡爾

english: When the characters are within a day's travel of Gravenhollow, they hear someone singing strange tunes in various languages, the voice echoing down adjacent tunnels. Approaching the sound reveals a {@creature basilisk} named {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} resting in an intersection. No ordinary basilisk, {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} has an Intelligence of 10 (+0) and speaks Common, Dwarvish, Giant, and Undercommon.
zh_tw: 當角色們距離刻文谷一天行程時，他們會聽到有人在用各種語言唱著奇怪的曲調，聲音在相鄰的隧道中迴盪。接近聲音源頭會發現一隻名為{@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}的{@creature basilisk||石化蜥蜴}休息在一個交叉路口。{@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}並非普通的石化蜥蜴，它的智力為10（+0），並且會說通用語、矮人語、巨人和地底通用語。

english: A small group of characters scouting can sneak up on {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} with a successful {@dc 10} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. Any characters who observe the basilisk can note that it keeps its eyes downcast, as if consciously trying to control its petrifying gaze. When {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} becomes aware of the characters, he calls them over, speaking in all the languages he knows until he determines that the characters understand Common.
zh_tw: 一小隊角色偵察時，如果透過了 {@dc 10} 的群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，可以悄悄接近 {@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}。任何觀察石化蜥蜴的角色都會注意到它一直低垂著眼睛，彷彿有意識地試圖控制其石化凝視。當 {@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾} 意識到角色的存在時，他會召喚他們過來，用他所知道的所有語言說話，直到他確定角色們理解了通用語。

english: A many-legged reptile stretches out as if it has been sitting for a long while, avoiding your eyes as it looks to the rocky floor at your feet. "About time you lot arrived! Come! The library bid me guide you to the gates, and I've waited too long for you already."
zh_tw: 一隻多足爬行動物伸展開來，好像已經坐了很久，它避開你的目光，看著你腳下的岩石地面。"你們終於到了！來吧！圖書館讓我引導你們到大門，我已經等你們太久了。"

english: After his initial greeting, {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} speaks only if spoken to, and his answers are brief. With the basilisk as their guide, it takes the characters another eight hours to reach the gates of Gravenhollow.
zh_tw: 在他最初的問候之後，{@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}只有在被問到時才會說話，而且他的回答都很簡短。以石化蜥蜴作為嚮導，角色們還需要八個小時才能到達刻文谷的大門。

english: Untold years ago, a visiting stone giant druid presented the librarians with a gift: {@creature Veldyskar|OotA}, an intelligent basilisk trained to serve the keepers as a guardian and general-purpose helper. The basilisk adapted readily to the timeless nature of the library and embraced his new duties with great dedication.
zh_tw: 無數年前，一位來訪的石巨人德魯伊向圖書管理員們贈送了一件禮物：{@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}，一隻經過訓練，能夠作為守護者和多用途助手服務於守護者的智慧石化蜥蜴。這隻石化蜥蜴很快適應了圖書館的永恆特性，並以極大的奉獻精神承擔了他的新職責。

english: {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} is committed to the protection of the library and its librarians. If trouble arises, his philosophy is to petrify first and ask questions later. Initially, this presented a problem for the stone giant librarians, as the basilisk had some difficulty reconciling his temper and bestial nature with the recognition of what trouble might actually look like. The stone giants taught {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} how to cast {@spell greater restoration}, which the basilisk can do once per day to restore anyone who crosses him.
zh_tw: {@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}致力於保護圖書館及其圖書管理員。如果出現問題，他的原則是先石化再問問題。最初，這對石巨人圖書管理員來說是個問題，因為石化蜥蜴在調和自己的脾氣和野獸本能與真正麻煩可能看起來的樣子之間有些困難。石巨人教會了{@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}如何施放{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}，石化蜥蜴每天可以施放一次這個法術，以恢復任何冒犯他的人。

english: Gates of Gravenhollow
zh_tw: 刻文谷之門

english: A pair of massive basalt doors mark the entrance to Gravenhollow, flanked by stone giant statues that are actually {@creature Stone Golem||stone golems}. The doors are opened simply by pushing, after which the entire expeditionary force can enter along with the characters. The golems turn their heads to watch new arrivals but otherwise remain still. The basilisk {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} guides the characters in through the gates, instructs them to continue straight ahead, then quickly disappears down a side passage.
zh_tw: 一對巨大的玄武岩門標誌著刻文谷的入口，兩側是實際上是{@creature Stone Golem||石魔像}的石巨人雕像。門可以透過推來開啟，之後整個遠徵軍可以和角色們一起進入。魔像轉頭觀察新來的人，但除此之外保持靜止。石化蜥蜴{@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}引導角色們穿過大門，指示他們繼續直走，然後迅速消失在一個側通道中。

english: Walking across the threshold of Gravenhollow is like stepping into another realm. The oppressive gloom of the Underdark is replaced by light and a sense of openness that brings back memories of the surface world. The corridor beyond the gates is wide enough for ten people to walk side by side, and the ceiling's height reminds you of the great halls of Gauntlgrym.
zh_tw: 穿過刻文谷的門檻就像是踏入了另一個領域。幽暗地域的壓抑陰暗被光明和開闊感所取代，這喚起了你對地表世界的回憶。大門後的走廊足夠十個人並排行走，天花板的高度讓你想起了岡特格瑞姆的宏偉大廳。

english: The corridor opens into a central well, with walkways crossing its span to the opposite side. You can barely see the ends of the level to your right and left, with doors opening into so many rooms that you doubt you could explore them all in a single day.
zh_tw: 走廊通向一箇中心井，有走道橫跨其跨度到達對面。你幾乎看不到你右邊和左邊的層級盡頭，門通向如此多的房間，以至於你懷疑你不可能在一天之內探索完它們。

english: The ceiling is bright, with rainbows trapped in hundreds of crystal formations combining to create a warm and inviting illumination. Looking down is a dizzying experience. Staircases connect to different levels below, and you soon lose count of how far down they go.
zh_tw: 天花板明亮，數百個水晶形成中困住的彩虹結合在一起，創造出一種溫暖而誘人的照明。向下看是一種令人眩暈的體驗。樓梯連線到下面的不同層級，你很快就數不清它們延伸了多遠。

english: A stout, rocky creature detaches from the perfectly smooth wall to your left, leaving an imprint of its body in the wall that quickly smooths out and fades from sight. "Trravelerrrrsss. I am Hourm. The masterrrsss arre occupied. Therre arre rroomsss forr all of you. Choose yourr own. The rresourrcesss of Grravenhollow arre at yourr disssposssal. You need only asssk."
zh_tw: 一個結實的岩石生物從你左邊的完美平滑牆面上分離出來，它在牆上留下了自己身體的印記，但很快印記就平滑並從視線中消失了。"旅行者們。我是霍爾姆。大師們正忙。這裡有很多房間供你們選擇。選擇你們自己的。格瑞文霍洛的資源隨你們支配。你們只需要請求。"

english: Hourm, a friendly {@creature galeb duhr}, answers any questions the characters have about Gravenhollow to the best of its ability, including how navigate its levels, and how to access the library's knowledge. After leading the party to living quarters one level below the library's main level, it merges into another wall and disappears.
zh_tw: 霍爾姆，一個友好的{@creature galeb duhr||石人}，盡其所能回答角色們關於刻文谷的任何問題，包括如何在其層級間導航，以及如何獲取圖書館的知識。在帶領隊伍到達位於圖書館主層下方一個層級的居住區後，它融入另一面牆中並消失了。

english: The Stone Library
zh_tw: 石質圖書館

english: When the characters first enter Gravenhollow, the library appears to be a simple arrangement of great cavernous halls carved out from the stone of the Underdark. However, the library is suffused with magic that warps the space within it, and which makes navigating and exploration a unique challenge (see the "{@area Gravenhollow: General Features|3e2|x}" sidebar).
zh_tw: 當角色們首次進入刻文谷時，圖書館看起來像是從幽暗地域的石頭中雕刻出來的巨大洞穴大廳的簡單佈局。然而，圖書館充滿了魔法，這種魔法扭曲了其內部的空間，使得導航和探索成為一個獨特的挑戰（見"{@area 刻文谷：一般特徵|3e2|x}"邊欄）。

english: Each room on each level of Gravenhollow is part of either the Archives of the Past, the Archives of the Present, or the Archives of the Future. Galeb duhr assistants pick up tablets as Gravenhollow's three stone giant librarians carve and catalog them, but the classification system the giants use to organize the library's information is known only to them.
zh_tw: 刻文谷每個層級的每個房間都是過去檔案館、現在檔案館或未來檔案館的一部分。當刻文谷的三位石巨人圖書管理員雕刻和編目石板時，石人助手會收集這些石板，但是巨人用來組織圖書館資訊的分類系統只有他們自己知道。

english: Residents
zh_tw: 居民

english: The library is quiet and peaceful, and visitors are free to move within it as they wish. If anyone has a need to find any other character within Gravenhollow (including one of the librarians), the library subtly directs the character toward its target within minutes.
zh_tw: 圖書館安靜而平和，訪客可以隨心所欲地在其中移動。如果有人需要在刻文谷內找到任何其他角色（包括圖書管理員之一），圖書館會巧妙地在幾分鐘內引導角色朝向目標。

english: The three {@creature Stone Giant||stone giants} who serve as Gravenhollow's librarians don't specifically welcome visitors—or even notice their comings and goings—unless the library directs them to do so. The characters need to seek the keepers out.
zh_tw: 作為刻文谷圖書管理員的三位{@creature Stone Giant||石巨人}並不特別歡迎訪客——甚至不會注意到他們的來來往往——除非圖書館指示他們這樣做。角色們需要去尋找這些守護者。

english: Ulthar
zh_tw: 烏爾薩

english: Ulthar is the Keeper of the Past. He sorts and files ancient texts, maintaining the immeasurably vast catalog that organizes them. When not cross-referencing his expanding collection, he composes epic poetry and is responsible for curating and restoring wall carvings throughout the library.
zh_tw: 烏爾薩是過去檔案館的守護者。他整理並歸檔古老的文字，維護著組織它們的龐大目錄。當他不忙於交叉引用他不斷擴大的收藏時，他創作史詩般的詩歌，並負責策劃和修復圖書館中所有的牆壁雕刻。

english: Ulthar is infinitely patient, always welcoming any chance to discuss history with visitors. Of the three librarians, he is the most willing and likely to spend time with the library's guests. He treats surface dwellers as if they were figments out of dreams, but makes it obvious he believes that such dreams have wisdom to share.
zh_tw: 烏爾薩擁有無限的耐心，總是樂於與訪客討論歷史。在三點陣圖書管理員中，他最願意並且最有可能與圖書館的客人共度時光。他對待地表居民就像他們是夢中的幻影一樣，但很明顯他相信這樣的夢有感知可以分享。

english: Urmas
zh_tw: 烏爾馬斯

english: Urmas, the Keeper of the Present, is the busiest of all the librarians. He commands a vast network of magically augmented subterranean beasts, which he uses as messengers, bringing and sending news from giants throughout the Underdark and sometimes from the "dream" of the surface world. Urmas exchanges messages with Stonespeaker Hgraam (see {@area chapter 4|15d|x}), keeping abreast of events as they pertain to the stone giant community in the duergar city of Gracklstugh.
zh_tw: 烏爾馬斯，現在檔案館的守護者，是所有圖書管理員中最忙碌的。他指揮著一個龐大的魔法增強地下生物網路，他使用它們作為信使，從幽暗地域的巨人那裡帶來和傳送新聞，有時甚至來自"夢"中的地表世界。烏爾馬斯與石語者哈格拉姆交換訊息（見{@area 第四章|15d|x}），瞭解與灰矮人城市格拉克斯圖格的石巨人社群相關的事件。

english: Though Urmas is patient, it quickly becomes obvious that he suffers the characters' questions and presence out of duty and politeness, seeking to return to his work as soon as possible. The giant is distracted by the increasingly dire news brought in by his messengers, including reports from stone giant mystics, as well as elemental servitors such as galeb duhr and xorn. However, if the characters bring news about the demon lords in the Underdark, they have Urmas's immediate and full attention.
zh_tw: 儘管烏爾馬斯很有耐心，但很快就明顯看出，他是出於職責和禮貌忍受角色們的問題和存在，希望盡快回到他的工作中去。這位巨人被他的信使帶來的日益嚴峻的新聞分心，包括來自石巨人神秘主義者的報告，以及像石人和石鼎獸這樣的元素僕從。然而，如果角色們帶來關於幽暗地域中惡魔領主的新聞，他們將立即獲得烏爾馬斯的全神貫注。

english: Ustova
zh_tw: 烏斯托瓦

english: The Keeper of the Future, Ustova is a seer who spends most of her time in constant meditation, transcribing her visions onto stone tablets as she experiences them. Like Urmas, she focuses her efforts on the fate of the different giant communities and clans, sorting through the various threads of destiny and possibility for omens presaging the resurgence of the giants' once-great civilization.
zh_tw: 作為未來檔案館的守護者，烏斯托瓦是一位先知，她大部分時間都在持續的冥想中度過，將她的幻象記錄在石板上，就像她所經歷的那樣。像烏爾馬斯一樣，她專注於不同巨人社群和氏族的命運，篩選各種命運和可能性的線索，尋找預示著巨人曾經偉大文明覆興的徵兆。

english: The irruption of the demon lords into the Underdark has sent powerful ripples of indescribable chaos through Ustova's visions. All she sees of the future is fire, blood, and death, shot through with signs and portents based upon the natures of the demon lords—the bloody spirals and twin-forked symbols of Demogorgon, the excessive growth and rot of Zuggtmoy, visions obscured and clouded by the slime of Juiblex, and so on. She gladly helps any characters who can offer clarity in what she is seeing, treating such information as beneficial visions from the dream that is the world outside the Underdark.
zh_tw: 惡魔領主湧入幽暗地域，給烏斯托瓦的幻象帶來了強烈而難以形容的混沌波動。她所看到的關於未來的一切都是火、血和死亡，其中充滿了基於惡魔領主本質的標誌和徵兆——狄摩高根的血螺旋和雙叉符號，祖格莫伊過度生長和腐爛的跡象，由朱庇萊克斯的粘液所遮蔽和模糊的幻象，等等。她樂於幫助任何能為她所看到的提供清晰度的角色，將這類資訊視為來自幽暗地域之外世界夢境中的有益幻象。

english: Galeb Duhr Assistants
zh_tw: 石人助手

english: The library draws in elemental spirits to animate earth and stone, forming {@creature galeb duhr} to serve as assistants for the keepers. These creatures are humorless but diligent.
zh_tw: 圖書館吸引元素精靈來活化土和石頭，形成{@creature galeb duhr||石人}作為守護者的助手。這些生物沒有幽默感，但勤奮。

english: Echoes
zh_tw: 回聲

english: Gravenhollow "remembers" all who have walked its halls, as well as those who will visit the library in the future. As the characters explore the library, apparitions constantly flicker in and out of existence around them—the echoes of those who have come or will come to Gravenhollow in search of knowledge.
zh_tw: 刻文谷"記得"所有曾經走過它大廳的人，以及將來會訪問圖書館的人。當角色們探索圖書館時，幻影不斷地在他們周圍閃爍出現和消失——那些曾經或將來來到刻文谷尋找知識的人的回聲。

english: The time-displaced echoes in Gravenhollow are a prime opportunity to introduce great NPCs of Faerûn in a way that will not negatively impact the story you want to tell, nor steal the spotlight from the characters. The echoes offer characters the chance to receive advice from experienced adventurers and heroes, and for the players to interact with some of their favorite characters from the Forgotten Realms.
zh_tw: 刻文谷中的時間錯位回聲是引入費倫世界偉大NPC的絕佳機會，這樣做不會對你想講述的故事產生負面影響，也不會從角色那裡奪走焦點。回聲為角色們提供了從經驗豐富的冒險家和英雄那裡獲得建議的機會，也讓玩家們有機會與他們最喜歡的被遺忘的領域的一些角色互動。

english: An echo is a quasi-real duplicate of the original creature, except it has 1 hit point and can't attack or cast spells. An echo reduced to 0 hit points vanishes.
zh_tw: 回聲是原始生物的準真實副本，除了它只有1點生命值，不能攻擊或施法。生命值降至0點的回聲會消失。

english: It's impossible to tell at a glance whether an echo is from the past or the future. Clothing and equipment might help, or characters can simply ask. Interacting with an echo is the same as interacting with the original creature, but because most echoes are in the midst of their own search for knowledge, they prefer to be left alone.
zh_tw: 一眼之間無法判斷一個回聲是來自過去還是未來。服裝和裝備可能會有所幫助，或者角色們可以直接詢問。與回聲互動就像與原始生物互動一樣，但由於大多數回聲正處於他們自己的知識尋找過程中，他們更希望被單獨留下。

english: Echoes appear so often that the characters find one every time they go looking for any information in the library. Use the Echoes in Gravenhollow table to determine who the characters encounter, or place echoes as you see fit.
zh_tw: 回聲出現的頻率如此之高，以至於每當角色們在圖書館尋找任何資訊時，他們都會找到一個回聲。使用刻文谷中的回聲表來確定角色們遇到了誰，或者根據你認為合適的方式放置回聲。

english: Illustrious Visitors
zh_tw: 傑出訪客

english: The time-displaced echoes in Gravenhollow are a prime opportunity to introduce some of the great adventurers and personalities of Faerûn in a way that will not negatively impact the story you want to tell, nor steal the spotlight from the characters. The echoes offer them the chance to receive advice from experienced adventures and heroes, and for the adventurers to meet some of their favorite characters from the world of the Forgotten Realms.
zh_tw: 刻文谷中的時間錯位回聲是引入費倫世界一些偉大冒險家和個性人物的絕佳機會，這樣做不會對你想講述的故事產生負面影響，也不會從角色那裡奪走焦點。回聲為他們提供了從經驗豐富的冒險家和英雄那裡獲得建議的機會，並且讓冒險家們有機會遇見來自被遺忘的領域的一些他們最喜歡的角色。

english: The echoes belong to those who managed to find Gravenhollow, coming there to seek knowledge for whatever all-important purpose or quest drove them there. Each echo is also from a specific point in time (possibly including the future).
zh_tw: 回聲屬於那些設法找到刻文谷的人，他們出於某種極其重要的目的或任務來到這裡尋求知識。每個回聲也來自一個特定的時間點（可能包括未來）。

english: Echoes in Gravenhollow
zh_tw: 刻文谷的回聲

english: Echo
zh_tw: 迴響

english: Alustriel Silverhand
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓·銀手

english: Andarin Zarith
zh_tw: 安達林·札瑞斯

english: Bruenor Battlehammer
zh_tw: 布魯諾·戰錘

english: Elminster
zh_tw: 伊爾明斯特

english: Graz'zt
zh_tw: 格拉茲特

english: Hgraam
zh_tw: 哈格拉姆

english: Jalynfein Oblodra
zh_tw: 賈林費因·歐布羅卓

english: Society of Brilliance
zh_tw: 光輝協會

english: Xetzirbor
zh_tw: 澤茲爾博

english: Yauln
zh_tw: 尤恩

english: Alustriel Silverhand
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓·銀手

english: This legendary wizard and leader appears as a human female in her early twenties. She interacts with the characters with kindness and a certain whimsy, but doesn't disclose what time period she's from, admonishing characters who try to learn too much of the past or future.
zh_tw: 這位傳奇女巫和領袖看起來像是一個二十多歲出頭的人類女性。她以親切和某種幻想與角色們互動，但並不透露她來自哪個時代，還告誡那些試圖瞭解太多過去或未來的角色們。

english: Andarin Zarith
zh_tw: 安達林·札瑞斯

english: This human Red Wizard of Thay will visit Gravenhollow nearly a century in the future. He treats the characters as annoying apparitions and refuses to deal with them.
zh_tw: 這位來自賽爾的人類紅法師將在將近一個世紀後訪問刻文谷。他將角色們視為煩人的幻象並拒絕與他們打交道。

english: Bruenor Battlehammer
zh_tw: 布魯諾·戰錘

english: The dwarf king's red hair has turned mostly white, and he leans heavily on a thick crystal cane. He is old, frail, and quite senile, and he can't remember why he came to Gravenhollow or what he's looking for.
zh_tw: 這位矮人國王的紅髮已經大部分變白，他沉重地依靠著一根厚實的水晶手杖。他年老體弱，相當健忘，記不得自己為何來到刻文谷，也忘記了他在尋找什麼。

english: Elminster
zh_tw: 伊爾明斯特

english: This echo of the future claims to be searching for a long-forgotten spell. If the characters ask the venerable human archmage about the demonic incursion, Elminster reveals that the demonic incursion was the unintended result of a spell cast by Gromph Baenre, a former Archmage of Menzoberranzan. Elminster doesn't reveal what happened to Gromph, for he's reluctant to divulge too much information about the future. If the characters press him for details, Elminster says only that many great heroes were lost to the demonic tide, but several powerful demon lords were driven back to the Abyss.
zh_tw: 這個來自未來的回聲聲稱正在尋找一個被遺忘已久的咒語。如果角色們向這位受人尊敬的人類大法師詢問惡魔入侵的事情，伊爾明斯特透露，惡魔入侵是貢夫·班瑞，一位前魔索布萊城的大法師，施放咒語時意想不到的結果。伊爾明斯特沒有透露貢夫發生了什麼，因為他不願意透露太多關於未來的資訊。如果角色們向他追問細節，伊爾明斯特只說許多偉大的英雄被惡魔潮水吞噬了，但幾個強大的惡魔領主被趕回了無底深淵。

english: Graz'zt
zh_tw: 格拉茲特

english: This echo of Graz'zt (see {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}) is gathering all the information it can about the Underdark. The Dark Prince asks the characters what part of the Underdark they come from. If they mention the surface world, Graz'zt eyes widen as his curiosity is piqued.
zh_tw: 這個格拉茲特的回聲（見{@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20}）正在收集它所能找到的關於幽暗地域的所有資訊。黑暗王子問角色們他們來自幽暗地域的哪個部分。如果他們提到了地表世界，格拉茲特的眼睛會因為好奇心被激發而睜大。

english: Hgraam
zh_tw: 哈格拉姆

english: This younger version of Stonespeaker Hgraam (see chapter 4, "{@area Gracklstugh|15d|x}") treats the characters as spirits and asks them philosophical questions about the nature of dreams. If the characters engage him in conversation, he bids them farewell with the words, "I will remember you."
zh_tw: 這個年輕版的石語者哈格拉姆（見第4章，"{@area 格拉克斯圖格|15d|x}"）將角色們視為精靈，並詢問他們關於夢境本質的哲學問題。如果角色們與他交談，他會用"我會記住你們。"這句話向他們告別。

english: Jalynfein Oblodra
zh_tw: 賈林費因·歐布羅卓

english: This young male drow was cast out of Menzoberranzan after he lost his sight, yet he survived and found his way here. The blind drow came to the library hoping to overcome his blindness and take revenge on his family. Characters familiar with drow lore or history know, with a successful {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check, that House Oblodra was all but wiped out years ago.
zh_tw: 這個年輕的男性卓爾在失明後被逐出了魔索布萊城，但他倖存下來並找到了來到這裡的路。這位失明的卓爾來到圖書館，希望能夠克服自己的失明並向他的家族復仇。熟悉卓爾傳說或歷史的角色，透過一次成功的 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定，可以知道歐布羅卓家族在多年前幾乎被徹底消滅了。

english: Society of Brilliance
zh_tw: 光輝協會

english: The characters encounter echoes of all five members of the Society of Brilliance (see the "{@area Society of Brilliance|0a9|x}" random encounter in chapter 2). Any members of the society traveling with the party know that these are echoes from the past.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了光輝協會所有五名成員的回聲（見第2章中的"{@area 光輝協會|0a9|x}"隨機遭遇）。任何隨隊旅行的學會成員都知道這些是來自過去的回聲。

english: The Society of Brilliance came to Gravenhollow years ago on a pilgrimage of enlightenment. If the characters mention the demonic incursion and postulate a theory of drow involvement, the Society of Brilliance echoes confirm that such an event is inevitable, "given the drow propensity for demon summoning and the inherent unpredictability of {@i faerzress}." These echoes don't have much else to offer, although they can explain how the library works (see the "{@area Gravenhollow: General Features|3e2|x}" sidebar).
zh_tw: 光輝協會幾年前來到刻文谷進行啟蒙朝聖。如果角色們提到惡魔入侵併推測卓爾的參與，光輝協會的回聲確認這樣的事件是不可避免的，'鑑於卓爾召喚惡魔的傾向和{@i 妖光}固有的不可預測性。' 這些回聲沒有太多其他的資訊可以提供，儘管它們可以解釋圖書館的工作原理（見'{@area 刻文谷：一般特徵|3e2|x}'邊欄）。

english: Xetzirbor
zh_tw: 澤茲爾博

english: This mind flayer regards the characters with interest. Xetzirbor refuses to disclose its timeline but hints that it knows about the demonic incursion. The mind flayer tries to entice the characters into telling it what they have discovered, but of its own purpose, Xetzirbor reveals only that it came to Gravenhollow to find a way to save a dying elder brain it calls Cyrog.
zh_tw: 這個奪心魔對角色們表現出興趣。澤茲爾博拒絕透露自己的時間線，但暗示它知道關於惡魔入侵的資訊。這個奪心魔試圖誘使角色們告訴它他們發現了什麼，但關於自己的目的，澤茲爾博只透露它是來到刻文谷尋找拯救一個它稱之為賽羅格的垂死老腦的方法。

english: Yauln
zh_tw: 尤恩

english: A male stone giant from an ancient past, Yauln came to Gravenhollow to seek answers on whether his clan should enter an alliance with the bearer of the Cairngorm Crown (see chapter 4, "{@area Gracklstugh|19c|x}").
zh_tw: 尤恩是一位來自遠古過去的男性石巨人，他來到刻文谷尋求答案，以決定他的氏族是否應該與凱恩戈姆王冠（見第4章，"{@area 格拉克斯圖格|19c|x}"）的持有者結盟。

english: Living Quarters
zh_tw: 生活區

english: Each level of Gravenhollow features rooms reserved for habitation. The galeb duhr keep the rooms clean, and can provide food and drink magically created by the library if asked.
zh_tw: 刻文谷的每個層級都設有預留居住的房間。石人保持房間的清潔，並可以在被請求時，透過圖書館神奇地創造食物和飲料。

english: Librarians' Quarters
zh_tw: 圖書管理員區

english: Urmas and Ustova live on the top level of the library, taking up all the living quarters at either end of that level. Their rooms reflect their duties and personalities. Urmas's quarters contain a collection of carved tablets, as well as actual books and scrolls found nowhere else in the library. Ustova's quarters feature a collection of musical instruments and divination tools, including crystal orbs, bags of bones, and a large mithral basin.
zh_tw: 烏爾馬斯和烏斯托瓦居住在圖書館的最高層，佔據了該層兩端的所有生活區。他們的房間反映了他們的職責和個性。烏爾馬斯的住處收藏了一系列雕刻的石板，以及圖書館其他地方找不到的真正的書籍和卷軸。烏斯托瓦的住處則有一系列樂器和占卜工具，包括水晶球、骨頭袋和一個大型秘銀盆。

english: Ulthar lives on a lower level that he claims is "near the bottom of the library," though such a distinction is meaningless given how distorted distance and direction can be in the library (see the "{@area Gravenhollow: General Features|3e2|x}" sidebar). His quarters are a work of art, covered with murals and wall carvings of his own design, along with workshops where he engages in crafting.
zh_tw: 烏爾薩居住在圖書館的較低層，他聲稱那裡"接近圖書館的底部"，儘管考慮到圖書館中距離和方向的扭曲，這種區分沒有實際意義（見"{@area 刻文谷：一般特徵|3e2|x}"邊欄）。他的住處是一件藝術品，覆蓋著他自己設計的壁畫和牆雕，以及他從事工藝活動的工作室。

english: Guest Quarters
zh_tw: 客房區

english: The guest quarters appear bare until a visitor chooses a room. The next time that room is entered, it is fully furnished according to the character's taste and needs. Characters don't need to make any check to find their guest rooms after exploring the library: they need only wish to return, and the next set of stairs they come to leads them to the appropriate level.
zh_tw: 客房區域看起來空蕩蕩的，直到訪客選擇了一個房間。下一次進入那個房間時，它將根據角色的品味和需求進行全面的裝修。角色在探索圖書館後不需要進行任何檢定來找到他們的客房：他們只需要希望返回，他們到達的下一組樓梯就會帶領他們到達適當的樓層。

english: Walkways
zh_tw: 走道

english: The walkways that surround the central well are wide and mostly empty, with the occasional galeb duhr or visitor echo wandering about. Each level consists of a well opening surrounded by a wide walkway connecting the rooms dug into the surrounding wall. Bridges cross the well at regular intervals, and also connect to stairs to the levels above and below. No matter how far down visitors go, there always appear to be more levels below.
zh_tw: 環繞中央井的走道寬闊且大多空曠，偶爾有石人或訪客回聲在周圍徘徊。每個層次由一個井口和環繞著連線周圍牆壁中挖掘出的房間的寬闊走道組成。橋樑在井上定期交錯，並且也連線到上層和下層的樓梯。無論訪客下到多深，下面似乎總有更多層次。

english: Gravenhollow: General Features
zh_tw: 刻文谷：一般特徵

english: Not even the current librarians know who built Gravenhollow. All they know is that the library has existed since the dawn of giantkind.
zh_tw: 即使是現任圖書管理員也不知道是誰建造了刻文谷。他們所知道的是，這座圖書館自巨人族的黎明時期就已經存在。

english: Power Node
zh_tw: 能量節點

english: Gravenhollow was carved from a titanic geode whose crystals are imbued with magic that concentrates {@i faerzress}. The magic that suffuses the library profoundly affects time and space, altering the perceptions and reality of all beings within its walls.
zh_tw: 刻文谷是由一個巨大的晶洞雕刻而成，其水晶中蘊含著魔法，這種魔法集中了{@i 妖光}。瀰漫在圖書館中的魔法深刻地影響了時間和空間，改變了其牆壁內所有生物的感知和現實。

english: Bigger on the Inside
zh_tw: 內部更大

english: The notion of space works strangely in Gravenhollow. The interior of the library continually expands as lore is added to it, but visitors can still traverse all its floors and chambers with ease. Only the most absentminded and scatterbrained become lost in Gravenhollow.
zh_tw: 在刻文谷，空間的概念運作得很奇怪。隨著知識被新增到圖書館中，其內部不斷地擴充套件，但訪客仍然可以輕鬆地穿越所有的樓層和房間。只有最心不在焉和頭腦混亂的人才會在刻文谷迷路。

english: Universal Language
zh_tw: 通用語言

english: While in Gravenhollow, all creatures gain the benefit of the {@spell comprehend languages} spell.
zh_tw: 當在刻文谷時，所有生物都會獲得{@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言}法術的好處。

english: Hidden from Magic
zh_tw: 隱藏於魔法之外

english: Gravenhollow is a window into the passage of time and history, and the magic permeating the library blocks it off from the real world around it. Though divination magic works normally within the library, no divination effect used outside the library can discern any creature, object, or location within it.
zh_tw: 刻文谷是一扇窺視時間和歷史的視窗，圖書館中瀰漫的魔法將其與周圍的現實世界隔離開來。儘管占卜魔法在圖書館內正常工作，但圖書館外使用的任何占卜效果都無法察覺圖書館內的任何生物、物體或位置。

english: A Place of Peace
zh_tw: 和平之地

english: Visitors to the library of Gravenhollow are expected to conduct themselves with decorum, and to refrain from arguments and violence. Creatures that incite conflict quickly draw the attention of the basilisk {@creature Veldyskar|OotA}, who is quick to use his Petrifying Gaze on troublemakers. If a threat arises that {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} can't handle, the library generates {@dice 3d6} galeb duhr to assist him.
zh_tw: 訪問 刻文谷 圖書館的訪客應保持端莊行為，並避免爭論和暴力。引發衝突的生物很快就會引起石化蜥蜴 {@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾} 的注意，他會迅速使用他的石化凝視對付製造麻煩的人。如果出現了 {@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾} 無法處理的威脅，圖書館會生成 {@dice 3d6} 個石人來協助他。

english: Willful Navigation
zh_tw: 有意識的導航

english: Finding anything in Gravenhollow is an effort of will. Whenever a character seeks a specific location in the library (a particular floor or period of history, for example), the character must make a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom check to find that location. On a failure, the character takes a wrong turn and must make additional checks until successful. If led by one of the library's keepers, characters don't need to make checks to find the location they seek.
zh_tw: 在刻文谷中尋找任何東西都需要意志力。每當一個角色試圖尋找圖書館中的特定位置（例如，特定的樓層或歷史時期），該角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 14} 的感知檢定才能找到該位置。如果檢定失敗，角色會走錯路並且必須進行額外的檢定直到成功。如果在圖書館的管理員帶領下，角色不需要進行檢定即可找到他們想要的位置。

english: Archives
zh_tw: 檔案館

english: Gravenhollow's records are organized by rooms attuned to the past, the present, or the future. Each level has a random number of rooms, arranged without any apparent system other than the library's intuitive ability to direct visitors to where they want to go—or to where the library thinks they need to go.
zh_tw: 刻文谷的記錄按照與過去、現在或未來協調的房間進行組織。每個層次都有隨機數量的房間，除了圖書館直觀地引導訪客到他們想去的地方——或者圖書館認為他們需要去的地方之外，沒有任何明顯的系統。

english: Accessing the Records
zh_tw: 訪問記錄

english: The library keeps its records on stone and crystal slabs, monoliths, and stelae fitting neatly in niches carved into the walls of every room. Thanks to the library's {@spell comprehend languages} effect, anyone can easily decipher and understand the runes and glyphs carved into the stone.
zh_tw: 圖書館將其記錄儲存在石板、水晶板上，以及完美地嵌入每個房間牆壁凹槽中的獨石柱和石碑上。得益於圖書館的{@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言}效果，任何人都可以輕鬆解讀並理解刻在石頭上的符文和象形文字。

english: These records contain only what the librarians were able to write down. Even with their network of messengers and informants, and the visions they receive using the powers of the library, the stone giants are still mortal creatures. As such, the giants' own understanding might limit the characters' ability to locate information in the library.
zh_tw: 這些記錄只包含圖書管理員能夠寫下的內容。即使他們擁有信使和情報網路，以及使用圖書館的力量所獲得的幻象，石巨人仍然是凡人生物。因此，巨人自己的理解可能會限制角色在圖書館中定位資訊的能力。

english: The library's written records deal only with events in the Underdark and the history of giants. Like most stone giants, the librarians consider the surface world a realm of dreams, and what happens there is deemed less important than events in the Underdark.
zh_tw: 圖書館的書面記錄只涉及幽暗地域和巨人的歷史事件。像大多數石巨人一樣，圖書管理員們認為地表世界是一個夢境領域，那裡發生的事情被認為不如幽暗地域中的事件重要。

english: To acquire information not inscribed in the records (including any events outside the Underdark), the characters need a {@item stonespeaker crystal|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}), after which they must find an appropriate archive to query events in the past, present, or future.
zh_tw: 要獲取未記錄在案的資訊（包括幽暗地域以外的任何事件），角色們需要一個{@item stonespeaker crystal|OotA|石語者水晶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}），之後他們必須找到一個合適的檔案庫來查詢過去、現在或未來的事件。

english: Archives of the Past
zh_tw: 過去的檔案館

english: Every room devoted to the records of the past has the same inscription carved above the doorway in runes that anyone who knows Dwarvish or Giant understands:
zh_tw: 在任何記錄過去的房間裡，門楣上都刻有符文，任何懂得矮人語或巨人語的人都能理解：

english: {@i The past is a crystal, for it can be seen from many facets yet it always remains the same.}
zh_tw: {@i 過去是一顆水晶，因為它可以從多個面向被觀察，但它始終保持不變。}

english: These rooms contain crystals of many colors. Ulthar and his assistants periodically move tablets, cylinders, and stelae from the Archives of the Present into these rooms. Some of the records here date back to the mythic times of the earliest giant gods.
zh_tw: 這些房間內含有多種顏色的水晶。烏爾薩和他的助手們會定期將平板、圓筒和石碑從現在的檔案館移動到這些房間。這裡的一些記錄可以追溯到最早的巨人神的神話時代。

english: Annals of History
zh_tw: 歷史年鑑

english: Characters can research the backgrounds of the primary settlements of the Underdark and any well-known characters who dwell there. This lets them know what to expect if they visit those sites in the future, or to better understand some of the events that occurred during a previous visit. For example, they can learn more information about {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}, about the drow siege and demonic assault of Blingdenstone, or any other part of the well-known history of Faerûn.
zh_tw: 角色可以研究幽暗地域主要定居點的背景以及居住在那裡的知名人物。這讓他們知道如果將來訪問這些地點可以期待什麼，或者更好地理解在之前訪問期間發生的一些事件。例如，他們可以瞭解更多關於{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的資訊，關於卓爾對布靈登石城的圍攻和惡魔襲擊，或者關於費倫眾所周知的歷史的任何其他部分。

english: Archives of the Present
zh_tw: 當前檔案館

english: The rooms that contain the works of Urmas have inscriptions carved above the doorway that anyone who knows Dwarvish or Giant can translate:
zh_tw: 包含烏爾馬斯作品的房間門楣上刻有銘文，任何懂得矮人語或巨人語的人都能理解：

english: {@i The present is like sand, ever flowing and escaping one's grasp without mercy or respite.}
zh_tw: {@i 現在就像沙子，不斷流動，毫不留情地從人的手中溜走，沒有憐憫或喘息的機會。}

english: The records in these rooms detail the current state of the Underdark and the giant kingdoms.
zh_tw: 這些房間中的記錄詳細描述了幽暗地域和巨人王國的現狀。

english: Current Affairs
zh_tw: 時事

english: Reading the tablets in these archives provides a good overview of what is going on in the Underdark at the present time. The latest news has a delay of a few days and is often incomplete, becoming more detailed as Urmas obtains more information from his messengers and informants. The reports about the demons' invasion are sketchy and incomplete, but characters can still get a rough idea about which demon lord arrived where. They can learn that Zuggtmoy might be on the move to an undisclosed location, or follow the ravaging paths of Yeenoghu and Baphomet as they gather and rally the races that worship them. Unlike the bits and pieces of news about the other demon lords, a significant amount of information is known about the cults of Demogorgon festering under Gracklstugh, as events there directly affect the resident stone giant clan.
zh_tw: 閱讀這些檔案室中的石板可以很好地概述當前幽暗地域的情況。最新訊息有幾天的延遲，並且常常是不完整的，隨著烏爾馬斯從他的信使和情報員那裡獲得更多資訊，這些訊息會變得更加詳細。關於惡魔入侵的報道是粗略和不完整的，但角色們仍然可以大致瞭解哪個惡魔領主到達了哪裡。他們可以瞭解到祖格莫伊可能正在前往一個未公開的地點，或者跟隨耶諾古和巴弗滅的破壞路徑，因為他們正在聚集和號召崇拜他們的種族。與關於其他惡魔領主的零星新聞不同，關於在格拉克斯圖格下滋生的狄摩高根邪教的資訊相當多，因為那裡的事件直接影響了居住的石巨人族群。

english: Archives of the Future
zh_tw: 未來檔案館

english: The rooms with Ustova's prophetic writings have inscriptions above the doorways that anyone who knows Dwarvish or Giant can decipher:
zh_tw: 包含烏斯托瓦預言性著作的房間，在門楣上刻有銘文，任何懂得矮人語或巨人語的人都能夠解讀：

english: {@i The future is a song we remember, but we cannot rush to its end lest we destroy the melody.}
zh_tw: {@i 未來是一首我們記得的歌，但我們不能急於求成，以免破壞了旋律。}

english: Unlike the other rooms in the library, these archives echo with the sound of running water. The wall niches containing the stone cylinders Ustova favors for scribing are also fountains, where water shimmers over crystals as it falls.
zh_tw: 與圖書館中的其他房間不同，這些檔案室迴盪著流水聲。牆壁上的凹槽中裝有烏斯托瓦偏愛用於刻寫的石柱，同時也是噴泉，水在下落時在水晶上閃爍。

english: Prophetic Visions
zh_tw: 預言幻象

english: The information in the Archives of the Future is uncertain, not only because Ustova focuses on prophecies but also because her visions detail potential futures, not definite outcomes. Urmas and Ustova compare notes often to validate their visions. The prophecies in these rooms are limited to the future of giantkind—and the trials still to come for those once-great races—because this is Ustova's sole interest.
zh_tw: 未來檔案館中的資訊是不確定的，這不僅是因為烏斯托瓦專注於預言，還因為她的幻象詳細描述了可能的未來，而不是確定的結果。烏爾馬斯和烏斯托瓦經常交流筆記以驗證他們的幻象。這些房間中的預言僅限於巨人族的未來——以及那些曾經偉大的種族仍將面臨的考驗——因為這是烏斯托瓦唯一的興趣所在。

english: The Enemy of Our Enemy
zh_tw: 敵人的敵人

english: As the characters explore the library, ideally after encountering an echo or two, they meet the venerable drow archmage {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}, accompanied by Kleve, a {@creature death slaad} bodyguard in its natural form. Vizeran is an {@creature archmage} with the following statistical modifications:
zh_tw: 當角色們探索圖書館時，理想情況下在遇到一兩個回聲之後，他們會遇見受人尊敬的卓爾大法師{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}，由克勒維，一個以自然形態出現的{@creature death slaad||史拉亡蟾}保鏢陪同。維茲蘭是一個具有以下統計修改的{@creature archmage||大法師}：

english: Vizeran's alignment is neutral evil.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的陣營是中立邪惡。

english: Vizeran's fey ancestry gives him advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put him to sleep.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的精類血統使他在對抗被{@condition charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定中獲得優勢，魔法也不能讓他入睡。

english: Vizeran can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: {@spell dancing lights} at will, {@spell darkness} once per day, {@spell faerie fire} once per day (spell save {@dc 15}), and {@spell levitate} (self only) once per day.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭可以天生施放以下法術，且無需材料成分：隨意施放{@spell dancing lights||舞光術}，每天一次{@spell darkness||黑暗術}，每天一次{@spell faerie fire||妖火}（法術豁免{@dc 15}），以及每天一次{@spell levitate||浮空術}（僅限自身）。

english: While in sunlight, Vizeran has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
zh_tw: 在陽光照射下，維茲蘭的攻擊檢定以及依賴視覺的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）技能檢定上會有劣勢。

english: When the characters first encounter Vizeran and Kleve, read the following boxed text to the players.
zh_tw: 當角色們首次遇到維茲蘭和克勒維時，請向玩家閱讀以下加框的文字。

english: Two figures approach—a withered drow clad in dark flowing robes, and a hulking gray-skinned monster resembling a spiky humanoid toad, its wide mouth full of razor-sharp teeth. The drow's pinched and lined face speak to his great age, and his red eyes narrow and appraise you carefully as he approaches.
zh_tw: 兩個身影靠近——一個穿著深色流動長袍的乾癟卓爾，和一個皮膚呈灰色、類似長滿尖刺的人形蟾蜍的龐大怪物，它寬闊的嘴巴里滿是鋒利的牙齒。卓爾那緊繃且佈滿皺紋的臉顯露出他的高齡，他那紅色的雙眼在靠近時仔細地打量著你。

english: Vizeran greets the adventurers cautiously, introduces himself and his companion, and asks what business brings them to Gravenhollow. He remains cool and polite, trying to avoid any tension for fear of inciting violence in this place.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭謹慎地問候冒險者，自我介紹和他同伴，並詢問他們來刻文谷的業務是什麼。他保持冷靜和禮貌，試圖避免任何緊張，以免在這個引起暴力。

english: If the characters are willing to talk to him, Vizeran tells them he has opposed the tyranny of Lolth and her priestesses for centuries. He believes that some kind of demonic invasion of the Underdark is underway, and he has come to Gravenhollow to confirm his suspicions and make plans to combat it.
zh_tw: 如果角色們願意與他交談，維茲蘭會告訴他們，他反對羅絲和她的女祭司們的暴政已經有幾個世紀了。他認為某種惡魔入侵幽暗地域正在進行中，他來到刻文谷是為了確認他的懷疑並制定應對計劃。

english: The drow archmage suggests that the adventurers make their own inquiries—and that they look in particular into Menzoberranzan and its archmage, Gromph Baenre. Vizeran then returns to his quarters, telling the adventurers how to seek the librarians if they don't already know how to do so.
zh_tw: 這位卓爾大法師建議冒險者自己進行調查——特別是調查魔索布萊城及其大法師，貢夫·班瑞。然後維茲蘭回到他的住處，告訴冒險者如果他們還不知道如何做的話，如何尋找圖書管理員。

english: During their time in the library, the characters can meet with Vizeran several times to exchange notes. The drow archmage already knows a lot of what has transpired since the demon lords arrived. He isn't, however, using the library to delve into specific events, so he welcomes the characters' input while remaining tight-lipped about his own intentions and goals.
zh_tw: 在圖書館的時間裡，角色們可以多次與維茲蘭會面交流筆記。這位卓爾大法師已經知道許多惡魔領主到來後發生的事情。然而，他並不是利用圖書館深入研究特定事件，所以他歡迎角色們的見解，同時對自己的意圖和目標保持沉默。

english: If the characters threaten Vizeran, Kleve looms menacingly nearby even as the archmage tries to keep things civil, pointing out that there is nothing to be gained by fighting. If the adventurers attack him or Kleve, Vizeran casts {@spell time stop} and departs before {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} shows up (see "A Place of Peace" in the "{@area Gravenhollow: General Features|3e2|x}" sidebar). Kleve becomes {@condition invisible} and follows his master out of Gravenhollow. Despite their attack upon him, the archmage contacts the characters again in an attempt to forge an alliance (see chapter 12, "{@adventure The Tower of Vengeance|OotA|11}").
zh_tw: 如果角色們威脅維茲蘭，即使大法師試圖保持局面平和，克勒維也會在附近威脅性地出現，指出戰鬥沒有任何好處。如果冒險者攻擊他或克勒維，維茲蘭會施展{@spell time stop||時間停止}法術，然後在{@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}出現之前離開（見"和平之地"在"刻文谷：一般特徵{@area 刻文谷：一般特徵|3e2|x}"側邊欄）。克勒維變得{@condition invisible||隱形}並跟隨他的主人離開刻文谷。儘管他們攻擊了他，大法師還是再次聯絡角色們，試圖建立聯盟（見第12章，"復仇之塔{@adventure 復仇之塔|OotA|11}"）。

english: Approaching the Librarians
zh_tw: 接近圖書館管理員

english: If the characters set out to find a librarian, Ulthar is the one they find first. He and Urmas agree that current events in the Underdark are a serious concern, but their roles as record keepers prevent them from acting in any way other than to provide information. Ulthar will speculate that this is likely why the library allowed Vizeran and the characters to find it so easily.
zh_tw: 如果角色們出發尋找圖書管理員，他們首先找到的是烏爾薩。他和烏爾馬斯都認為幽暗地域當前的事件是一個嚴重的關切，但他們作為記錄保管者的角色阻止了他們以任何方式採取行動，除了提供資訊。烏爾薩會推測，這很可能是圖書館允許維茲蘭和角色們如此容易地找到它的原因。

english: Urmas has been following recent events that might have led to the current crisis. He bids the characters to tell him about their own experiences in the Underdark—specifically, their encounters with the demon lords.
zh_tw: 烏爾馬斯一直在關注可能導致當前危機的最新事件。他請求角色們告訴他他們在幽暗地域中的親身經歷——特別是他們與惡魔領主的遭遇。

english: Ulthar offers the characters one of the library's {@item Stonespeaker Crystal|OotA|stonespeaker crystals}. if they don't have their own, instructing them on how to attune to it. He warns the characters to not let themselves become lost in the visions they will experience.
zh_tw: 烏爾薩提供了圖書館的一塊{@item Stonespeaker Crystal|OotA|石語者水晶}給角色們，如果他們沒有自己的水晶，會指導他們如何與之調諧。他警告角色們不要讓自己迷失在他們將經歷的幻象中。

english: Stonespeaker Crystals
zh_tw: 石語者水晶

english: A creature attuned to a {@item stonespeaker crystal|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}) gains the ability to peer through the veils of time and receive visions of the past, present, and future—but only while in Gravenhollow.
zh_tw: 與{@item stonespeaker crystal|OotA|石語者水晶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}）調諧的生物獲得了穿越時間的帷幕，接收過去、現在和未來幻象的能力——但僅限於在刻文谷。

english: A creature attuned to a {@item stonespeaker crystal|OotA} gains the following additional benefits while in the library:
zh_tw: 與{@item stonespeaker crystal|OotA|石語者水晶}調諧的生物在圖書館中時還會獲得以下額外好處：

english: While standing in the Archives of the Past with the crystal in hand, the creature can choose to experience a vision of the past. After receiving this vision, the creature can't experience another vision of the past until it finishes a long rest.
zh_tw: 當生物手持水晶站在過去檔案館時，可以選擇體驗過去幻象。在接收到這個幻象後，生物在完成一次長休之前不能再體驗另一個過去幻象。

english: While standing in the Archives of the Present with the crystal in hand, the creature can choose to receive a vision of something happening at that moment. After receiving this vision, the creature can't experience another vision of the present until it finishes a long rest.
zh_tw: 當生物手持水晶站在當前檔案館時，可以選擇接收正在發生的事情的幻象。在接收到這個幻象後，生物在完成一次長休之前不能再體驗另一個當前幻象。

english: While standing in the Archives of the Future with the crystal in hand, the creature can choose to receive a glimpse of what might happen if the demon lords aren't stopped. After receiving this vision, the creature can't experience another glimpse of the future until it finishes a long rest.
zh_tw: 當生物手持水晶站在未來檔案館時，可以選擇接收如果惡魔領主不被阻止可能發生的事情的一瞥。在接收到這個幻象後，生物在完成一次長休之前不能再體驗另一個未來幻象。

english: While standing in the appropriate archive, the creature can expend 2 of the crystal's charges to ask a question pertaining to the past, present, or future and receive a truthful answer in the form of a vision.
zh_tw: 當生物站在相應的檔案館中，可以消耗水晶的2個充能點數，提出有關過去、現在或未來的問題，並以幻象的形式接收真實的答案。

english: Characters can expend charges to confirm suspicions, fill in gaps in their knowledge, and see for themselves the events that brought the demon lords into the world. Such research might take several days. Ulthar doesn't give them another {@item stonespeaker crystal|OotA} to speed up the process, but the characters can try to steal one, as the trusting librarian keeps them on a shelf in his quarters. The giant discovers the theft in {@dice 1d4} days, at which point the characters are confronted by {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} and a host of galeb duhr, who politely ask them to leave Gravenhollow at once.
zh_tw: 角色們可以消耗充能來確認懷疑，填補他們知識上的空白，並親眼看到將惡魔領主帶入世界的事件。這樣的研究可能需要幾天時間。烏爾薩沒有給他們另一個{@item stonespeaker crystal|OotA|石語者水晶}來加快程式，但角色們可以嘗試偷一個，因為那位信任的圖書管理員把它們放在他房間裡的架子上。巨人在{@dice 1d4}天后發現盜竊，此時角色們將被{@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}和一群石人禮貌地要求他們立即離開刻文谷。

english: Possible Visions
zh_tw: 可能的幻象

english: The following are the most relevant visions the characters can receive as answers to their questions. Elaborate upon or modify these as needed, and improvise visions for other questions the characters ask based on the information in the adventure.
zh_tw: 以下是角色們可以接收到的與他們問題最相關的幻象。根據需要對這些幻象進行詳細闡述或修改，並根據冒險中的資訊即興創作角色們提出的其他問題的答案。

english: Gromph's Folly
zh_tw: 貢夫的愚行

english: If the characters inquire about Gromph Baenre or the arrival of the demon lords, they receive a vision of how everything started.
zh_tw: 如果角色們詢問有關貢夫·班瑞或惡魔領主的到來，他們會接收到一個幻象，展示了一切是如何開始的。

english: An imperious drow archwizard in spider silk robes casts a mighty conjuration spell. As the ritual draws toward its conclusion, a web of {@i faerzress} energy expands outward. The wizard seems alarmed by this, his efforts to complete the spell growing more crazed as he realizes he's lost control.
zh_tw: 一位傲慢的卓爾大法師身著蛛絲長袍，正在施展強大的咒喚法術。當儀式接近尾聲時，一張{@i 妖光}能量形成的網向外擴張。法師對此顯得驚慌失措，當他意識到自己已經失控時，完成法術的努力變得更加瘋狂。

english: And then, madness! Rifts open in the web of energy around him. These cracks stretch and widen, and through them come horrific fiends that scream, shriek, and howl as they are wrenched from the Abyss and cast into the Underdark.
zh_tw: 然後，瘋狂降臨！在他周圍的能量網中出現了裂縫。這些裂縫伸展並擴大，從中出現的是恐怖的惡魔，它們尖叫、尖嘯、嚎叫，當它們從無底深淵被撕裂出來，被投入幽暗地域時。

english: A woman's deep, dark laugh echoes in your mind as the drow wizard shrinks away from the demonic hordes he has unwittingly unleashed.
zh_tw: 當卓爾法師從他無意中釋放的惡魔軍團退縮時，一個深沉而黑暗的女聲笑聲在你的腦海中迴響。

english: If a character receiving this vision has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 13 or higher, he or she sees a drow insignia on the wizard. If the character is a drow or otherwise familiar with the iconography of Menzoberranzan's drow houses, he or she recognizes the symbol as representing House Baenre. The character can also recall the symbol well enough to draw it, so that another more knowledgeable character can discern its significance.
zh_tw: 如果接收這個幻象的角色具有13或更高的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分，他或她將看到法師身上的卓爾徽章。如果角色是卓爾或以其他方式熟悉魔索布萊城卓爾家族的圖示，他或她將認出這個符號代表班瑞家族。角色也能足夠清楚地回憶起這個符號，以便畫出它，這樣更有知識的角色就能辨別其重要性。

english: Zuggtmoy's Arrival
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊的到來

english: The characters can inquire about Zuggtmoy or the events in Neverlight Grove.
zh_tw: 角色們可以詢問有關祖格莫伊或在無光林地中發生的事件。

english: A cavern of peculiar beauty opens up before you, with lights of every color shining from the pure essence of life, diffused and amplified by the glow of {@i faerzress}. The glow pulses, and you can feel the life in the cavern rotting away, bursting with infection. A mushroom grows in the center of the cave, ever larger and taller, pustules forming and seeping as its stem thickens and its cap reaches to the cavern's ceiling, forming a vast fungal tower.
zh_tw: 一個奇特美麗的洞穴展現在你們面前，由生命純淨本質發出的各種顏色的光，透過{@i 妖光}的光輝被擴散和放大。光輝脈動著，你可以感覺到洞穴中的生命正在腐爛，爆發出感染。洞穴中心生長著一個蘑菇，它不斷變大變高，膿皰形成並滲出，隨著它的莖變粗，菌蓋伸向洞穴的天花板，形成了一個巨大的真菌塔。

english: Two myconids approach the site in awe, not minding the carpet of rot under their feet. You sense their minds come alive in wonder, and as they kneel in worship, you know they are doomed. A voice sounds out within clouds of spores that fall like snow. The voice tells the myconids to prepare for a gift unlike any they have ever known.
zh_tw: 兩個菌人敬畏地走近這個地點，不在意腳下的腐爛地毯。你感覺到他們的心智在驚奇中活躍起來，當他們跪下崇拜時，你知道他們註定要滅亡。一個聲音在像雪一樣飄落的孢子云中響起。這個聲音告訴菌人準備迎接一個他們從未知曉的禮物。

english: If the characters visited Neverlight Grove, they recognize one of the myconids as Sovereign Phylo, while somehow knowing that the other is {@creature Yestabrod|OotA} before it became mutated.
zh_tw: 如果角色們曾訪問過無光林地，他們會認出其中一個菌人為君主菲洛，同時不知何故知道另一個是變異前的{@creature Yestabrod|OotA|葉斯塔布朗}。

english: Juiblex and the Pudding King
zh_tw: 朱庇萊克斯和布丁王

english: As much as the characters learned from fighting {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} in Blingdenstone, they might decide to seek more knowledge of the mad svirfneblin or his fiendish master, Juiblex the Faceless Lord.
zh_tw: 儘管角色們在布靈登石城與{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}戰鬥中學到了很多關於瘋狂的地底侏儒或他的惡魔主人朱庇萊克斯——無面領主的知識，他們可能決定尋求更多關於他們的知識。

english: A deep gnome spurned by others of his kind weeps as he wanders the dark tunnels, talking to the things that crawl and seep from the walls. You see him adopt two slick patches of ooze, sensing his innate power over them. He plays with them as if they were children, chasing them through the gloomy depths.
zh_tw: 一個被自己族人拋棄的地底侏儒在黑暗的隧道中徘徊，邊走邊與從牆壁上爬出來的東西交談。你看到他收養了兩片光滑的軟泥，感覺到他對它們的天賦控制力。他像對待孩子一樣與它們玩耍，在陰鬱的深處追逐它們。

english: Something changes, and the oozes flow away. The deep gnome runs after them, fearful of being alone once again. You feel a great hunger seize him. He experiences visions that pass into your vision, showing what appears as a paradise to him but an oozing nightmare for all others.
zh_tw: 發生了某種變化，軟泥開始流動離開。地底侏儒追在它們後面，害怕再次孤獨。你感覺到他被巨大的飢餓感所佔據。他體驗到的幻象也傳入了你的視野，顯示出對他來說像天堂一樣的地方，但對所有其他人來說卻是一個流淌的噩夢。

english: The great hunger speaks to him, his already broken mind a shield against the hunger's shattering power. That power seems to recognize and acknowledge something in the gnome that will serve it well. The great hunger has a name—Juiblex. And its power... oh, such great and terrible power! It grants the gnome the ability to command the little hungers—his children—so that they can return to the place that cast them out and devour it all!
zh_tw: 巨大的飢餓向他說話，他本已破碎的心智成為抵禦飢餓粉碎力量的盾牌。那種力量似乎認出了侏儒身上的某種東西，這將對它大有裨益。巨大的飢餓有一個名字——朱庇萊克斯。它的力量......哦，如此偉大而可怕的力量！它賦予了侏儒指揮小飢餓——他的孩子們——的能力，以便他們可以返回那個驅逐他們的地方，吞噬一切！

english: Sundered Blades
zh_tw: 斷裂之刃

english: The corruption in Gracklstugh slowly rots duergar society from within, leading it toward a brutal fate.
zh_tw: 格拉克斯圖格中的腐敗正從內部慢慢侵蝕著灰矮人社會，導致它走向一個殘酷的命運。

english: You see a circle of small hooded figures, their forms hunched and emaciated. Their gestures and movements are jerky, indicative of the madness possessing them. They are chanting, swaying to their own words. And then they stop as the glow of {@i faerzress} rises around them, whispering to them in unintelligible sounds. The derro cackle and dance, their hands glowing with a power that isn't theirs. The vision shifts, and suddenly gray dwarves stare down at the red-hot metal on their anvils. The constant rhythm of their hammering falters. Suddenly, brother turns against brother as minds turn inward upon themselves. Sparks fly and a city burns.
zh_tw: 你看到一群戴著兜帽的小身影，他們的姿態駝背且憔悴。他們的動作抽搐，表明他們被瘋狂所佔據。他們在唸誦，隨著自己的話語搖擺。然後他們停下來，因為{@i 妖光}的光輝在他們周圍升起，用難以理解的聲音對他們耳語。迪洛矮人狂笑並跳舞，他們的手散發著不屬於他們的力量。幻象轉變，突然，灰矮人俯視著他們鐵砧上的熾熱金屬。他們不斷敲打的節奏變得不穩定。突然，兄弟反目成仇，心靈向內轉向自己。火花四濺，一座城市在燃燒。

english: Demogorgon's Altar
zh_tw: 狄摩高根的祭壇

english: One of the first brushes the characters might have had with the demon lords was in Sloobludop, where they witnessed the rise of Demogorgon, the so-called "Deep Father" of the mad kuo-toa.
zh_tw: 角色們可能與惡魔領主的第一次接觸是在斯盧布多普，在那裡他們目睹了被稱為瘋狂寇濤魚人（寇濤）的"深淵之父"狄摩高根的崛起。

english: You see a kuo-toa swimming in the gloomy depths of a dark, subterranean lake, uncertain. It turns left and right, trying to find something, even as it's surrounded by a fanged creatures resembling manta rays. The kuo-toa smiles, its needle teeth gleaming even in the darkness. It has seen something. It understands a new secret, and its already unhinged mind plunges further into madness.
zh_tw: 你看到一個寇濤魚人在黑暗的地下湖的陰鬱深處游泳，感到不確定。它左右轉動，試圖找到一些東西，即使周圍是類似魔鬼魚的有齒生物。寇濤魚人微笑了，它的針狀牙齒即使在黑暗中也閃閃發光。它看到了一些東西。它理解了一個新秘密，它本已失衡的心智進一步陷入瘋狂。

english: The kuo-toa curls in on itself, arms extended in worship. Then from the circle of rays, two tentacles emerge—followed by two howling baboon heads.
zh_tw: 寇濤魚人蜷縮起來，雙臂伸展開來崇拜。然後從射線的圓環中，兩個觸手出現——接著是兩個嚎叫的狒狒頭。

english: Fraz-Urb'luu and the Gem
zh_tw: 弗拉茲厄魯和寶石

english: Characters might be curious to know more about the source of the discord in Mantol-Derith, leading to a revelation about Fraz-Urb'luu.
zh_tw: 角色們可能好奇地想要了解更多關於曼塔-岱瑞絲不和的源頭，這將導致關於弗拉茲厄魯的啟示。

english: A rift formed by {@i faerzress} opens wide, illuminating a dark tunnel. The rift spits out a black gem that clatters as it tumbles across the tunnel floor. The gem is picked up by a gray-skinned dwarf, who inspects it closely.
zh_tw: 由{@i 妖光}形成的裂縫敞開，照亮了一個黑暗的隧道。裂縫吐出了一顆黑色的寶石，當它在隧道地板上滾動時發出叮噹聲。這顆寶石被一個膚色灰暗的矮人撿起，他仔細檢查它。

english: The vision shifts to a brightly lit cavern full of crude merchant stalls, where the duergar hands the gem to a svirfneblin for appraisal. The gnome refuses to return the gem, instead giving it to one of her svirfneblin apprentices. The young apprentice skulks away with the gem in his clutches, but is ambushed by a gargoyle. The gargoyle snatches the gem, flies away, and gives it to a female drow. The drow gazes into the black gemstone and sees a hideous demonic face looking back at her. Thoughts of murder and carnage fill her thoughts as she hides the gemstone on her person, draws her shortsword, and coats the blade with poison.
zh_tw: 幻象轉移到一個明亮的洞穴，裡面佈滿了簡陋的商人攤位，灰矮人將寶石交給斯維爾芬布林（地底侏儒）估價。侏儒拒絕歸還寶石，反而把它給了她的一個斯維爾芬布林學徒。年輕的學徒帶著寶石鬼鬼祟祟地離開，但被一個石像鬼伏擊了。石像鬼搶走了寶石，飛走了，然後把它交給了一個女性卓爾。卓爾凝視著黑色的寶石，看到一張醜陋的惡魔面孔在回望著她。當她把寶石藏在身上，拔出短劍並塗上毒藥時，她的腦海中充滿了謀殺和屠殺的念頭。

english: Cyrog Lives! Hail Orcus!
zh_tw: 賽羅格還活著！向奧喀斯致敬！

english: Although Orcus doesn't have a significant role in this adventure, players might wonder what the Demon Lord of Undeath is up to.
zh_tw: 儘管奧喀斯在這次冒險中沒有重要的角色，玩家們可能會好奇不死之惡魔領主在忙些什麼。

english: In the heart of a alien cavern glistening with slime, scores of mind flayers gather around an enormous brain resting in a pool. The brain is dead. You can hear the illithids' incomprehensible thoughts as they mourn its passing. One word echoes louder than the others: Cyrog.
zh_tw: 在一個充滿粘液、閃爍著異域光芒的洞穴中心，許多靈吸怪圍繞著一個安息在池中的巨型大腦聚集在一起。大腦已經死亡。你可以聽到這些靈吸怪難以理解的思想，它們在哀悼它的逝去。一個詞比其他詞更加響亮地迴響：賽羅格。

english: Suddenly, {@i faerzress }bathes the dark and twisted hall in purplish light. A rift opens, and a hulking, horned figure that reeks of putrescence steps out. It raises a skull-tipped wand and points it at the dead elder brain. The elder brain begins to pulsate, and you see intermittent flashes of purple light under its rotting flesh. The mind flayers are aghast as the elder brain speaks to them once more, telling them that Orcus has saved Cyrog, and commanding them to follow it into undeath.
zh_tw: 突然，{@i 妖光}將這個黑暗而扭曲的走廊沐浴在紫色光芒中。一個裂縫開啟，一個散發著腐爛氣息的巨大、有角的身影走了出來。它舉起一個頭骨尖端的魔杖，指向死去的長老大腦。長老大腦開始脈動，你看到它腐爛的肉體下間歇性地閃爍著紫色的光芒。當長老大腦再次對他們說話時，靈吸怪們感到震驚，告訴他們奧喀斯已經拯救了賽羅格，並命令他們跟隨它進入不死之境。

english: The librarians of Gravenhollow know that Cyrog is the name of distant mind flayer settlement. {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} and every member of the Society of Brilliance also knows that Cyrog is named after an ancient elder brain that commands the settlement, which lies deep in the Underdark, thousands of miles to the east.
zh_tw: 刻文谷的圖書管理員們知道賽羅格是一個遙遠的奪心魔定居點的名字。{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}以及光輝協會的每個成員也知道賽羅格是以一個古老的長老大腦命名的，這個長老大腦指揮著定居點，它位於幽暗地域深處，向東數千英里之外。

english: Baphomet, the Horned King
zh_tw: 巴弗滅，有角之王

english: The demon lord Baphomet doesn't play a significant role in this adventure. However, a character seeking clues to the Horned King's whereabouts receive the following vision.
zh_tw: 惡魔領主巴弗滅在這次冒險中並沒有扮演重要的角色。然而，一個尋找有角之王下落線索的角色收到了以下幻象。

english: The smell of blood fills your nostrils as you wander a maze of Underdark tunnels, moving with purpose as your giant hooves crush stones underfoot. {@i Faerzress} light reveals that your shadow is monstrous, suggesting a hulking beast with a crown of horns. With your bloody glaive, you carve a swath through a forest of towering zurkhwood mushrooms that stands in your way. The tunnels beyond would confuse an ordinary mind, but you instinctively know the path you must walk. Every step brings you closer to a magma-filled chasm, lodged in which is an enormous contraption of metal and stone—a weapon capable of reshaping the Underdark itself.
zh_tw: 當你在幽暗地域的迷宮般的隧道中穿行時，血腥味充滿了你的鼻孔，你目標明確地移動著，你巨大的蹄子在腳下踩碎了石頭。{@i 妖光}的光芒揭示出你的影子是怪物般的，暗示著一個戴著角冠的龐大野獸。用你沾滿鮮血的長柄刀，你砍倒了一片高聳的祖爾木蘑菇森林，它們擋住了你的去路。隧道之外的道路會讓普通人感到困惑，但你本能地知道你必須走的路。每一步都讓你更接近一個充滿巖漿的裂隙，其中嵌入了一個巨大的金屬和石頭裝置——一種能夠重塑幽暗地域本身的武器。

english: This vision provides a brief glimpse of the Maze Engine, an arcane device located in the heart of the Labyrinth (see {@area chapter 14|4c8|x}).
zh_tw: 這個幻象提供了迷宮引擎（迷宮引擎）的短暫一瞥，這是一個位於迷宮中心的奧術裝置（見{@area 第十四章|4c8|x}）。

english: Spawn of Yeenoghu
zh_tw: 耶諾古衍體

english: A character that tries to learn more about Yeenoghu, the Demon Lord of Gnolls, receives the following unsettling vision.
zh_tw: 一個試圖瞭解更多關於耶諾古——鬣狗人的惡魔領主的角色，收到了以下令人不安的幻象。

english: A hunched and rotting creature with the head of a fiendish hyena swings a triple-headed flail at a beholder, crushing it. As the eye tyrant falls to the floor, a pack of hyenas leaps onto the corpse and tears off its eyestalks while the demon lord licks the gore off his weapon. As the hyenas feed, they transform into slavering, cackling gnolls before your eyes.
zh_tw: 一個彎腰且腐爛的生物，長著一隻惡魔般的土狼頭，用三頭鏈枷向一個巨眼怪揮去，將其擊碎。隨著眼魔暴君倒地，一群土狼跳上屍體，當惡魔領主舔著他武器上的血跡時，撕扯下它的眼梗。當土狼進食時，它們在你眼前變成了垂涎三尺、狂笑的鬣狗人。

english: Lolth, Demon Queen of Spiders
zh_tw: 羅絲，蜘蛛的惡魔女王

english: If the characters inquire about Lolth, they receive a vision of her home in the Demonweb Pits, confirming that at least one demon lord didn't escape the Abyss.
zh_tw: 如果角色們詢問有關羅絲的資訊，他們會收到一個關於她在魔網深坑中的家園的幻象，這證實至少有一個惡魔領主沒有逃離無底深淵。

english: You behold the true form of the Demon Queen of Spiders—that of a black, bloated arachnid with the head of a female drow. Nestled in the webs all around her are thousands upon thousands of gray eggs. Lolth knows she is being scried, her fury tangible as her mind reaches out to find you. Her shriek of rage as she's shut out by the powerful wards of Gravenhollow echoes in your mind as the vision is suddenly torn away to darkness.
zh_tw: 你看到了蜘蛛的惡魔女王的真正形態——那是一隻黑色、腫脹的蜘蛛，長著一個女性卓爾的頭。在她周圍的網中，有成千上萬的灰色卵。羅絲知道她正在被窺視，她的憤怒可以感知到，因為她的心智伸出來尋找你。當她被刻文谷的強大結界阻擋時，她的憤怒尖叫在你的腦海中迴響，幻象突然被撕裂成黑暗。

english: This vision offers a glimpse of Lolth's plan to drive her rivals out of the Abyss and repopulate its layers with her own demonic offspring. The character experiencing the vision must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 這個幻象展示了羅絲的計劃，她試圖將對手驅逐出無底深淵，並用她自己的惡魔子嗣重新填充其層面。經歷此幻象的角色必須成功透過一次{@dc 16}的感知豁免檢定，否則將獲得一級瘋狂（見第2章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。

english: Other Visions
zh_tw: 其他版本

english: The other visions the characters might look for depend on what they experienced during their escape from the Underdark, and what you want the adventure to focus on (including the activities of other demon lords).
zh_tw: 角色們可能會尋找的其他幻象取決於他們從幽暗地域逃脫過程中的體驗，以及你希望冒險關注的重點（包括其他惡魔領主的活動）。

english: Returning to Vizeran
zh_tw: 返回維茲蘭

english: When the characters have discovered all they are looking to find out, they can go to Vizeran. If they don't, he seeks them out, having finished his own research.
zh_tw: 當角色們發現了他們想要找出的所有資訊後，他們可以去找維茲蘭。如果他們沒有，他也會找到他們，因為他已經完成了自己的研究。

english: "That fool Gromph brought the demon lords down upon us, with his demon queen pulling his strings all the while. He has given Lolth free reign in the Abyss. My own research leads me to believe Gromph used {@i faerzress} to achieve such a summoning, though I am sure he didn't intend this result. Imbecile!
zh_tw: "那個傻瓜貢夫把惡魔領主們引到了我們頭上，而他的惡魔女王一直在幕後操縱。他讓羅絲在無底深淵中自由行動。我個人的研究讓我相信貢夫使用了{@i 妖光}來實現這樣的召喚，儘管我確信他並非有意造成這樣的結果。白痴！"

english: "I can save you months of research—time we clearly don't have. The information I found here has confirmed my theories, and I know how to banish the demon lords back to the Abyss. We can do this only if we work together, if you are willing and daring enough to directly challenge the demon lords. Or perhaps foolhardy is the better word."
zh_tw: "我可以節省你們數月的研究時間——顯然我們沒有這麼多時間。我在這兒找到的資訊已經證實了我的理論，我知道如何將惡魔領主們驅逐回無底深淵。我們只有團結一致，如果你們願意並且足夠勇敢去直接挑戰惡魔領主們，我們才能做到這一點。或者'魯莽'可能是更恰當的詞。"

english: If the characters seem hesitant to work with Vizeran, he reminds them of the peril facing the surface world should the demon lords escape from the Underdark. If the characters accuse Vizeran of having ulterior motives, the drow smiles thinly and agrees. Still, he insists his goal is the same as the characters' own, and he doesn't ask them to involve themselves in his other plans. He points out that he is by far the most inconsequential of the many evils that the characters must contend with.
zh_tw: 如果角色們似乎猶豫與維茲蘭合作，他提醒他們如果惡魔領主從幽暗地域逃脫，地表世界將面臨的危險。如果角色們指責維茲蘭有不可告人的目的，這位卓爾人微微笑著並表示同意。儘管如此，他堅持說他的目標與角色們自己的目標是一致的，他並不要求他們參與他的其他計劃。他指出，與角色們必須應對的眾多邪惡相比，他是最不重要的一個。

english: Vizeran invites the adventurers and their NPC followers to Araj, his tower and stronghold, where they can discuss the matter further. There, he can demonstrate what he intends to do and why he needs the heroes' help. He refuses to discuss plans in detail in Gravenhollow, saying, "The walls here literally have ears, and echoes linger forever." Only his home is secure enough to serve as the place from which to plan the demon lords' defeat.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭邀請冒險家們以及他們的非玩家角色追隨者到阿拉傑，他的塔樓和要塞，在那裡他們可以進一步討論這個問題。在那裡，他可以展示他打算做什麼以及為什麼他需要英雄們的幫助。他拒絕在刻文谷詳細討論計劃，說："這裡的牆壁確實有耳朵，回聲永遠存在。"只有他的家才足夠安全，可以作為計劃擊敗惡魔領主的地方。

english: Leaving Gravenhollow
zh_tw: 離開刻文谷

english: As long as the characters remain respectful guests, the librarians don't mind them staying in Gravenhollow as long as they like. However, the library stops providing new visions after the characters learn the most essential information. If the players persist beyond that point, their efforts prove fruitless, and the librarians or their assistants suggest there is no more they can learn at this time.
zh_tw: 只要角色們保持尊重的客人身份，圖書管理員就不介意他們在刻文谷停留多久。然而，在角色們瞭解到最核心的資訊之後，圖書館就不再提供新的幻象。如果玩家在那個點之後繼續堅持，他們的努力將證明是徒勞的，圖書管理員或他們的助手會建議，目前他們無法再學到更多。

english: The characters can travel with {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|Vizeran}, or he provides them with a map and precise directions to guide them to Araj if they want to deal with other matters in the Underdark first. He emphasizes that time is of the essence. Every day the characters tarry allows the demon lords' power and influence in the Underdark to grow. See chapter 12, "{@adventure The Tower of Vengeance|OotA|11}," for more information about Araj.
zh_tw: 角色們可以與{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭}一起旅行，或者如果他們想先在幽暗地域處理其他事務，他可以提供一張地圖和精確的方向指引他們前往阿拉傑。他強調時間至關重要。角色們拖延的每一天都使得惡魔領主們在幽暗地域的力量和影響力增長。有關阿拉傑的更多資訊，請參見第12章"{@adventure 復仇之塔|OotA|11}"。

english: The last favor the library provides for the adventurers is to have the tunnel out directly connect with routes leading to the characters' desired destination, whether that destination is Araj, Blingdenstone, Menzoberranzan, Gracklstugh, Mantol-Derith, the edge of the Darklake, or somewhere else.
zh_tw: 圖書館為冒險家們提供的最後一個幫助是將隧道出口直接連線到通往他們所期望目的地的路線，無論這個目的地是阿拉傑、布靈登石城、魔索布萊城、格拉克斯圖格、曼塔-岱瑞絲、黑暗湖邊緣，還是其他地方。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: The characters should leave Gravenhollow with a clear picture of what is happening in the Underdark under the influence of the demon lords, and the roles that Gromph Baenre and Lolth have played in creating the crisis. Each character gains 5,000 XP for learning the truth.
zh_tw: 角色們應該帶著對幽暗地域在惡魔領主影響下正在發生的事情的清晰畫面離開刻文谷，以及貢夫·班瑞和羅絲在製造危機中所扮演的角色。每個角色在瞭解真相後獲得5,000 XP。

english: Chapter 12: The Tower of Vengeance
zh_tw: 第12章：復仇之塔

english: Offered an alliance by the drow archmage {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}, the adventurers travel to his tower in the depths of the Underdark. There, they learn more about what he knows of the threat posed by the demon lords—and potentially forge a pact with him to deal with that threat. They must be cautious, however, as their potential ally has his own interests at heart and his own agenda where his fellow drow are concerned.
zh_tw: 在卓爾大法師{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}提出結盟後，冒險家們前往他在幽暗地域深處的塔樓。在那裡，他們可以瞭解更多關於他所知道的惡魔領主所帶來的威脅——並有可能與他結成同盟來應對這一威脅。然而，他們必須小心，因為他們的潛在盟友心中有自己的利益，對於他的卓爾同胞也有自己的計劃。

english: If the characters rebuffed Vizeran's overtures to an alliance in Gravenhollow (see {@area chapter 11|40e|x}), the drow archmage subsequently sends Grin Ousstyl (see later in this chapter) as a peace envoy, renewing the offer and leading the characters to Araj if they accept it. Further exploration of the Underdark on their own might convince the adventurers to at least hear what Vizeran has to say. If they find the means to communicate his offer to their allies on the surface world, those allies encourage the characters to forge an alliance with the drow archmage.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在刻文谷拒絕了維茲蘭結盟的提議（見{@area 第十一章|40e|x}），這位卓爾大法師隨後會派遣格林·奧斯提爾（見本章後面的內容）作為和平使者，重新提出提議，並在角色們接受的情況下帶領他們去見阿拉傑。如果他們自己進一步探索幽暗地域，可能會說服冒險者至少聽聽維茲蘭要說的話。如果他們找到方法將他的提議傳達給他們在地表世界的盟友，那些盟友會鼓勵角色們與卓爾大法師結成聯盟。

english: Reaching the Tower
zh_tw: 到達塔樓

english: Vizeran's tower lies on the edge of the Wormwrithings, about ten days from Menzoberranzan. The map and directions the archmage provides the adventurers in {@area chapter 11|40e|x} allow them to find the cavern where the tower stands without getting lost. Use random encounters from chapter 13, "{@adventure The Wormwrithings|OotA|12}," on the way to the tower.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的高塔位於蠕行之息的邊緣，距魔索布萊城約十天的路程。大法師在{@area 第十一章|40e|x}中為冒險者提供的地圖和方向指引使他們能夠找到高塔所在的洞穴而不會迷路。在前往高塔的路上，使用第13章"{@adventure 蠕蟲扭道|OotA|12}"中的隨機遭遇。

english: The final stretch to reach the tower is through a narrow passage off a side tunnel, concealed by a magically protected secret door. If Vizeran's map comes within 10 feet of the door, soft purple light outlines the word "Araj"—a drow word for "vengeance"—across its surface in spidery Elvish script. Touching the map to the door causes it to open for 1 minute or until the map is more than 100 feet away from it. If the characters travel with Vizeran, the secret door opens on his command.
zh_tw: 到達塔樓的最後一段路程是透過一個側隧道的狹窄通道，該通道被一個魔法保護的秘密門隱藏著。如果維茲蘭的地圖靠近門10尺以內，柔和的紫色光芒就會在門表面用蜘蛛狀的精靈文字勾勒出"阿拉傑"這個詞——在卓爾語中意為"復仇"。將地圖觸控到門上會使其開啟1分鐘，或者直到地圖距離門超過100尺。如果角色們與維茲蘭一起旅行，秘密門會在他的命令下開啟。

english: The adventurers can travel to Araj with the full complement of their expeditionary force. Vizeran allows only the player characters within the tower, though the cavern around it offers space to camp and no risk of encounters. However, if the characters are riding giant lizards or other mounts, those mounts are unable to navigate the narrow route to the tower, and a separate camp farther from the tower will need to be established.
zh_tw: 冒險者可以帶著他們遠徵隊的全體成員前往阿拉傑。維茲蘭只允許玩家角色進入塔內，儘管周圍的洞穴提供了露營的空間，並且沒有遭遇的風險。然而，如果角色們騎著巨型蜥蜴或其他坐騎，這些坐騎無法穿越通往塔樓的狹窄路線，將需要在遠離塔樓的地方建立另一個營地。

english: The passage behind the secret door is narrow enough that you need to move through it single file, occasionally turning sideways to squeeze. It takes about an hour to navigate its pitch-black darkness, and the journey is filled with a constant echo of distant sounds. The passage then widens, opening out into a cavern whose far walls and ceiling are out of sight in the darkness. Bits of quartz and mica in the stone glimmer as they catch the light, showing a footpath worn into the stone floor. At the end of that path, a vast, dark shape rises—an enormous stalagmite carved into a bleak, black tower.
zh_tw: 秘密門後面的通道非常狹窄，你需要一個接一個地透過，偶爾需要側身擠壓。穿過漆黑一片大約需要一個小時，旅途中充滿了遠處聲音的持續迴響。通道隨後變寬，通向一個洞穴，其遠牆和天花板在黑暗中看不見。石頭中的石英和雲母在捕捉到光線時閃爍，顯示出一條磨損在石地板上的小徑。在那條小徑的盡頭，一個巨大的黑暗形狀升起——一個巨大的石筍，被雕刻成一個陰鬱的黑色塔樓。

english: Araj: Vizeran's Tower
zh_tw: 阿拉傑：維茲蘭之塔

english: Vizeran's tower is a enormous stalagmite, carved with a spiraling series of chambers leading up to its peak. The center of the stone spike is hollowed out to form an open vertical shaft. A stone staircase spirals around the shaft, with landings leading to chambers on the upper levels:
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的塔是一座巨大的石筍，上面雕刻著一系列螺旋形的房間，通向它的頂峰。石柱的中心被挖空，形成一個開放的垂直井道。一個石制樓梯環繞著井道螺旋上升，平臺通往上層的房間：

english: {@b Level 1} has a broad antechamber and audience hall.
zh_tw: {@b 第1層}有寬敞的前廳與覲見廳。

english: {@b Level 2} contains kitchens, storage, and currently disused servants' quarters.
zh_tw: {@b 第2層}有廚房、儲藏室，以及目前閒置的僕役住所。

english: {@b Level 3} houses guest bedchambers and a torture chamber for "special guests."
zh_tw: {@b 第3層}有客房，以及為「特殊客人」準備的刑求室。

english: {@b Level 4} contains Vizeran's library and laboratory.
zh_tw: {@b 第4層}是維茲蘭的圖書館與實驗室。

english: {@b Level 5} contains the archmage's private chambers.
zh_tw: {@b 第5層}是大法師的私人寢居。

english: {@b Level 6} is Vizeran's sanctum at the tower's peak, where he spends his time in contemplation and study.
zh_tw: {@b 第6層}位於塔頂，是維茲蘭的密室；他在這裡冥想與研究。

english: The sanctum features a permanent {@spell teleportation circle} that Vizeran can use to return to his home if his need is great. (He uses it only as a last resort, however, given the risks involved in teleporting in the Underdark; see "{@area Faerzress|05f|x}" in chapter 2.) Vizeran doesn't reveal this circle's existence to outsiders unless absolutely necessary, and he never gives away its sigil sequence.
zh_tw: 這個聖所設有一個永久性的{@spell teleportation circle||傳送法陣}，維茲蘭在極度需要時可以使用它返回他的家。（然而，他僅將其作為最後的手段，考慮到在幽暗地域傳送所涉及的風險；見第2章中的"{@area 妖光|05f|x}"。）維茲蘭不會向外界透露這個傳送門的存在，除非絕對必要，他也永遠不會洩露它的符文序列。

english: Vizeran's Tower: General Features
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的塔樓：一般特徵

english: The following features are found throughout the tower.
zh_tw: 整個塔樓中可以發現以下特徵。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: The cavern outside the tower is dark, for the inhabitants of Araj require no light. Inside the tower, occasional {@i driftglobes} shed {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}, with the rest of the place in darkness.
zh_tw: 塔樓外的洞窟一片黑暗，因為阿拉傑的居民不需要光照。塔樓內部，偶爾的{@i 漂流球}會散發出{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}，而該地點的其餘部分則處於黑暗之中。

english: Guards and Wards
zh_tw: 銅牆鐵壁

english: The interior of the tower is under the effect of a permanent {@spell guards and wards} spell to thwart intruders. Vizeran suspends the spell's effects for his guests, allowing them to enter unhindered, but those trying to sneak into the tower must deal with the spell's effects (see "Stealing into Araj"). Additionally, the tower is warded against scrying. Divination spells cast from outside cannot cross the tower's walls unless Vizeran allows it, and he immediately knows if the tower's wards thwart a divination spell.
zh_tw: 塔樓內部受到一個永久性的{@spell guards and wards||銅牆鐵壁}法術的影響，以阻止入侵者。維茲蘭為他的客戶暫停了法術的效果，允許他們不受阻礙地進入，但那些試圖潛入塔樓的人必須應對法術的效果（見"潛入阿拉傑"）。此外，塔樓還受到防護占卜的結界保護。從外部施放的占卜法術無法穿透塔樓的牆壁，除非維茲蘭允許，而且如果塔樓的結界阻止了占卜法術，他會立即知道。

english: Levitation Shaft
zh_tw: 浮力井

english: The central shaft of the tower has a permanent {@spell levitate} spell in effect, such that any creature that steps into the shaft (or that falls off the stairs) is suspended in midair. A creature that speaks the command word {@i aluhal'kafion} ("descend") drops 20 feet per round until it reaches the bottom of the shaft. If the word {@i ku'lam} ("rise") is spoken, a creature rises 20 feet per round until reaching the top level. Movement stops immediately if the creature says {@i ilkalik} ("halt"). While in the tower, Vizeran can deactivate or reactivate the levitation effect as an action.
zh_tw: 塔的中心井道有一個永久的{@spell levitate||浮空術}法術生效，任何踏入井道的生物（或者從樓梯上掉下來的生物）都會懸浮在空中。如果生物說出命令詞{@i aluhal'kafion}（"下降"），則會以每輪20尺的速度下降，直到到達井道底部。如果說出{@i ku'lam}（"上升"）這個詞，生物就會以每輪20尺的速度上升，直到到達頂層。如果生物說出{@i ilkalik}（"停止"），移動會立即停止。在塔內，維茲蘭可以作為一個動作來停用或重新啟用浮力效果。

english: Meeting with Vizeran
zh_tw: 與維茲蘭會面

english: Assuming the adventurers arrive as Vizeran's guests, they find the door to the tower open to them. If they arrive under other circumstances, see "{@area Stealing into Araj|429|x}" at the end of this chapter.
zh_tw: 假設冒險者作為維茲蘭的客人到來，他們會發現塔樓的門向他們敞開。如果他們以其他情況到達，見本章末尾的"{@area 潛入阿拉傑|429|x}"。

english: Past the heavy iron door that is the tower's only visible entrance, a short tunnel extends through five feet of solid rock into a cool, dark chamber. As you enter, a floating orb of pale violet light brightens before you, revealing an opening in the vaulted ceiling and a spiral stone staircase with no railing, climbing up into darkness.
zh_tw: 經過塔樓唯一的可見入口——一扇沉重的鐵門後，一條短隧道穿過五尺厚的堅固岩石，通向一個涼爽、黑暗的房間。當你進入時，一個浮動的淡紫色光球在你前面變亮，顯露出一個在拱形天花板上的開口，以及一個沒有欄杆、盤旋向上進入黑暗的螺旋形石階。

english: Around the stairs, the light reveals a circular audience chamber with cold, unlit lanterns hanging from brackets set into the stone wall, heavy carpets covering the smooth stone floor, and a throne-like stone chair on a raised dais to the left of the entrance.
zh_tw: 樓梯周圍的光線揭示了一個圓形的聽眾室，冷清的未點亮的燈籠懸掛在嵌入石牆的托架上，厚重的地毯覆蓋著光滑的石地板，在入口左側的高臺上有一把類似寶座的石椅。

english: The ball of violet light floats to a stop beneath the center of the open shaft, beyond the foot of the stairs. It then hovers there as if waiting for you.
zh_tw: 紫羅蘭色的光球停在了開放井道中心的下方，樓梯的底部之外。然後它就在那裡懸停，好像在等你。

english: The orb of magical light attempts to guide the characters up the shaft to Vizeran's sanctum at the top of the tower. Characters can climb the stairs if they wish, but any creature that steps past the stairs and into the open shaft activates a magical levitation effect imbued into the shaft (see the "Vizeran's Tower: General Features" sidebar). If the adventurers arrive in Vizeran's company, he informs them of the command words for the levitation effect.
zh_tw: 這個魔法光球試圖引導角色們沿著井道向上到達塔頂維茲蘭的聖所。角色們如果願意，可以爬上樓梯，但是任何生物一旦走過樓梯進入開放的井道就會啟用井道中注入的魔法浮力效果（見"維茲蘭的塔樓：一般特徵"邊欄）。如果冒險家們與維茲蘭一同到達，他會告知他們浮力效果的命令詞。

english: Vizeran DeVir
zh_tw: 維茲蘭·迪威爾

english: {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} is one of the greatest magical talents produced by the drow city of Menzoberranzan. Unfortunately for him, his rise to power came at the same time as one of the other great arcane talents of the City of Spiders, Gromph Baenre. A scion of the First House and as gifted a schemer as he is a mage, Gromph engineered Vizeran's disgrace and exile as an unbeliever in Lolth. Ironically, this might have saved Vizeran's life, as House DeVir was wiped out not long thereafter by its rival, House Do'Urden.
zh_tw: {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}是卓爾城市魔索布萊城培養出的最偉大的魔法天才之一。不幸的是，他崛起的同時，魔索布萊城城另一位偉大的奧術天才，貢夫·班瑞，也在同一時期崛起。作為第一家族的後裔，貢夫既是一個天才的陰謀家也是一個偉大的法師，他策劃了維茲蘭的恥辱和流放，作為羅絲的不信仰者。諷刺的是，這可能救了維茲蘭的命，因為不久之後，德維爾家族就被其對手，杜堊登家族，消滅了。

english: Consigned to solitude in the Underdark, Vizeran didn't perish as most assumed he would. Instead, he put his arcane powers to work to create a safe haven for himself, and spent the following centuries in isolated study, furthering his mastery of the magical arts. He has watched from afar as countless events unfolded in the Underdark and across Faerûn, gathering information and making plans for his eventual return. After waiting for centuries, Vizeran now believes that time has come.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭被放逐到幽暗地域中，與大多數人所假設的不同，他並沒有死去。相反，他運用自己的奧術力量為自己創造了一個安全的避難所，並在隨後的幾個世紀裡進行孤立的研究，進一步提升了他對魔法藝術的掌握。他從遠處觀察了幽暗地域和費倫上無數事件的發展，收集資訊併為他的最終迴歸制定計劃。經過數個世紀的等待，維茲蘭現在相信時機已經到來。

english: Vizeran harbors a thirst for vengeance against his only living rival—Gromph Baenre, the drow Archmage of Menzoberranzan. As a follower of the Elder Elemental Eye, Vizeran also despises Lolth and her influence over the drow. He would like nothing more than to show up Gromph and prove to the drow that Lolth has used them for her own gain. Of course, he also wants to learn whatever arcane secrets have allowed Gromph to tap into magic powerful enough to summon the demon lords to the Underdark.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭渴望對他的唯一活下來的對手——魔索布萊城的卓爾大法師貢夫·班瑞進行復仇。作為一個追隨古老元素之眼的人，維茲蘭也鄙視羅絲以及她對卓爾的影響。他最想做的就是超越貢夫，並向卓爾證明羅絲利用了他們以謀取自己的利益。當然，他也想要了解那些允許貢夫利用足夠強大的魔法召喚惡魔領主到幽暗地域的奧秘秘密。

english: Vizeran makes a powerful but dangerous ally. His plans and goals are entirely self serving, and he will sacrifice the characters without hesitation to further his schemes. Moreover, Vizeran isn't as immune as he believes to the demonic madness growing in the Underdark, which has been feeding his megalomania and his thirst for vengeance against his fellow drow.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭是一個強大但危險的盟友。他的計劃和目標完全是出於自私，他會毫不猶豫地犧牲角色們來推進他的陰謀。此外，維茲蘭並沒有他所認為的對幽暗地域日益增長的惡魔瘋狂的免疫力，這一直在助長他的自大狂和對同胞卓爾的復仇慾望。

english: {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|Vizeran} is an {@creature archmage} with the following statistical modifications:
zh_tw: {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭}是一個{@creature archmage||大法師}，有以下統計資料的修改：

english: Vizeran's alignment is neutral evil.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的陣營是中立邪惡。

english: Vizeran's fey ancestry gives him advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put him to sleep.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的精類血統使他在對抗被{@condition charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定中獲得優勢，魔法也不能讓他入睡。

english: Vizeran can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: {@spell dancing lights} at will, {@spell darkness} once per day, {@spell faerie fire} once per day (spell save {@dc 15}), and {@spell levitate} (self only) once per day.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭可以天生施放以下法術，且無需材料成分：隨意施放{@spell dancing lights||舞光術}，每天一次{@spell darkness||黑暗術}，每天一次{@spell faerie fire||妖火}（法術豁免{@dc 15}），以及每天一次{@spell levitate||浮空術}（僅限自身）。

english: While in sunlight, Vizeran has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
zh_tw: 在陽光照射下，維茲蘭的攻擊檢定以及依賴視覺的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）技能檢定上會有劣勢。

english: Kleve
zh_tw: 克勒維

english: Vizeran holds the control gem of a {@creature death slaad} he calls "Kleve." The slaad serves as the archmage's bodyguard, and is close by at all times. Kleve can change its form to appear as any Small or Medium humanoid, sometimes taking on the appearance of a deep gnome servant or a drow assistant to Vizeran if it wants to blend in. It can also cast {@spell invisibility} to observe silently from hiding, and relies on its true form when it wants to intimidate other creatures. Although cruel by nature, Kleve takes no action to harm anyone without Vizeran's permission.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭持有一個他稱之為'克勒維'的{@creature death slaad||史拉亡蟾}的控制寶石。這個史拉蟾擔任大法師的保鏢，並且總是近在咫尺。克勒維可以改變其形態，呈現出任何小型或中型類人生物的外觀，有時為了融入環境，會採取地底侏儒僕人或卓爾助手的形象。它還可以施展{@spell invisibility||隱形}法術，從隱藏中默默觀察，當它想要恐嚇其他生物時，會依賴其真實形態。儘管天性殘忍，但克勒維在沒有維茲蘭的許可下不會採取任何傷害他人的行動。

english: Kleve's control gem is a smoky crystal that Vizeran wears on a chain around his neck, beneath his robes. As long as Vizeran possesses the gem, the death slaad must obey him and can't be {@condition charmed}.
zh_tw: 克勒維的控制寶石是一塊煙燻水晶，維茲蘭將它佩戴在長袍下的鏈子上。只要維茲蘭擁有這顆寶石，死亡史拉蟾就必須服從他，並且不能被{@condition charmed||魅惑}。

english: Grin Ousstyl
zh_tw: 格林·奧斯提爾

english: The only other person in Araj is Grin Ousstyl, Vizeran's {@creature drow mage} apprentice. A clever troublemaker from an out-of-favor house, Grin worked his way into the outlawed alliance of drow mages known as the Council of Spiders, but was careless and nearly executed for his ambition. Exiled from Menzoberranzan, he was taken in by Vizeran, who plays the role of a shadowy patron of the council. The young drow has continued his magical training under the archmage's tutelage.
zh_tw: 阿拉傑中唯一的另一個人是維茲蘭的{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}學徒格林·奧斯提爾。格林是一個失寵家族的聰明搗蛋鬼，他設法加入了被禁止的卓爾法師聯盟，被稱為蜘蛛議會，但由於他的野心不小心，差點被處決。被魔索布萊城流放後，他被維茲蘭收留，維茲蘭扮演著議會的神秘贊助人角色。這位年輕的卓爾在他的大法師指導下繼續他的魔法訓練。

english: Grin is loyal to his master but not well suited to such a solitary existence. He longs for the opportunity to return to Menzoberranzan, supporting the notion of an uprising to overthrow the matron mothers and end their rule. He is less enthused about the potential of turning his old home into a battlefield for the demon lords, however, and he eventually betrays Vizeran's confidence to the adventurers in an effort to prevent that outcome (see chapter 15, "{@adventure The City of Spiders|OotA|14}").
zh_tw: 格林對他的主人忠誠，但並不太適應這種孤獨的生活。他渴望有機會返回魔索布萊城，支援起義推翻主母們並結束她們的統治。然而，他對於將他的故鄉變成惡魔領主戰場的可能性不太熱衷，最終他為了阻止這一結果，背叛了維茲蘭的信任，向冒險家們透露了這一資訊（見第15章，"{@adventure 蜘蛛之城|OotA|14}"）。

english: Other Inhabitants
zh_tw: 其他居民

english: No other living creatures dwell in Araj, but the tower features a number of magical inhabitants the adventurers might interact with.
zh_tw: 沒有其他生物居住在阿拉傑，但塔樓有一些魔法居民，冒險者可能會與它們互動。

english: Each level of the tower has a permanent {@spell unseen servant} in effect to attend to Vizeran, Grin, and the archmage's guests. Two dozen decorative suits of armor are also on display throughout the tower, all of which are suits of {@creature animated armor} that move and fight at Vizeran's command. Between one and three suits guard each room and corridor of the tower. If Vizeran is threatened, he uses them to run interference, buying him time to escape or counterattack.
zh_tw: 塔的每一層都有一個永久的{@spell unseen servant||隱形僕役}法術生效，以服侍維茲蘭、格林和大法師的客人。兩打裝飾性的盔甲也在塔內各處展示，所有這些都是{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}，它們在維茲蘭的命令下移動和戰鬥。塔的每一間房間和走廊都有一到三套盔甲守衛。如果維茲蘭受到威脅，他會利用它們來幹擾，為他爭取逃跑或反擊的時間。

english: A character who pokes around the tower and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check notes signs that other humanoid creatures were recently present in Araj, including discarded clothing, moldering foodstuffs, and chains and manacles embedded into the walls in some of the tower's rooms. Vizeran dismisses any questions about such matters, but Grin Ousstyl confides to the characters that Vizeran once kept bound minor demons and humanoid slaves in his service. Vizeran banished the demons with the arrival of the demon lords in the Underdark, fearing some hidden connection between the creatures of the Abyss. The slaves held by the drow archmage (most of them acquired from Gracklstugh) are all dead—either lost to madness and killed by Vizeran, or sacrificed as part of the preparations for the archmage's dark ritual.
