Grin Ousstyl doesn't speak directly of that latter fate, saying only that Vizeran's work can be hard on his assistants.
zh_tw: 一個角色在塔中四處探查併成功透過一個{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定時，會注意到其他類人生物最近在阿拉傑出現的跡象，包括丟棄的衣物、腐爛的食物，以及嵌入塔內某些房間牆壁中的鎖鏈和鐐銬。維茲蘭對這類問題避而不談，但格林·奧斯提爾向角色們透露，維茲蘭曾經收服了一些低階惡魔和類人奴隸為他服務。隨著惡魔領主進入幽暗地域，維茲蘭擔心無底深淵生物之間存在某種隱秘聯絡，因而將這些惡魔放逐。被這位卓爾大法師控制的奴隸（大部分是從格拉克斯圖格獲取的）都已經死了——要麼是因為瘋狂而喪生，要麼是被維茲蘭殺死，或作為大法師黑暗儀式準備的犧牲品。格林·奧斯提爾沒有直接提及最後一種命運，只是說維茲蘭的工作對他的助手來說可能很艱難。

english: Vizeran's Scheme
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的計劃

english: {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} invites guests to settle into his study while {@spell Unseen Servant||unseen servants} bring trays of dried mushrooms, smoked rothé meat, and goblets of spicy liquor. The drow archmage takes a cup for himself and makes a point of drinking first, although he scoffs at any suggestion that he would try to poison his guests, given all the trouble he has taken to arrange their meeting.
zh_tw: {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}邀請客人進入他的書房，而{@spell Unseen Servant||隱形僕役}端來一盤盤幹蘑菇、煙燻洛斯獸肉和辣酒杯。這位卓爾大法師為自己拿了一杯，並特別先飲，儘管他對任何他會試圖毒害客人的建議嗤之以鼻，考慮到他為了安排他們的會面所付出的所有麻煩。

english: Within the safe haven of his tower, Vizeran continues the discussion he began with the characters back at Gravenhollow, speaking more on what he knows of the demon lords.
zh_tw: 在塔樓的安全避風港內，維茲蘭繼續了他與角色們在刻文谷開始的討論，更多地談論了他所知道的惡魔領主。

english: "The only one of my kind who could ever match me in the Art is Gromph Baenre. I think we knew from the moment we met that we were destined to be rivals. But where I sought only to master the Art, Gromph was also an astute political manipulator. No more devout than I in the service of the Spider Queen, he arranged for my disgrace and exile. Deprived of my considerable skills, my house fell to our rival, House Do'Urden. Gromph became the Archmage of Menzoberranzan under the auspices of his own house, the First House of the Ruling Council.
zh_tw: "唯一一個在藝術上能與我匹敵的我的同類是貢夫·班瑞。我認為從我們見面的那一刻起，我們就知道我們註定要成為對手。但我尋求的只是掌握藝術，貢夫也是一個精明的政治操縱者。他並不比我更虔誠地為蜘蛛女王服務，他安排了我的恥辱和流放。失去了我相當的能力，我的家族倒在了我們的對手杜堊登家族手中。貢夫在自己的家族，統治委員會的第一家族的支援下，成為了魔索布萊城的大法師。"

english: "Gromph and I only ever had two things in common: our passion for the Art, and our hatred of the manner in which our fellow mages suffer at the hands of the matron mothers and mistresses of the drow. Gromph has always hungered for power, and not even becoming Archmage of Menzoberranzan was enough to satisfy him.
zh_tw: "貢夫和我唯一共同擁有的只有兩件事：我們對藝術的熱情，以及我們對同胞法師們在卓爾主母和女士們手中遭受的方式的憎惡。貢夫一直渴望權力，即使成為魔索布萊城的大法師也不足以滿足他。"

english: "From this tower of exile, I kept watch on Gromph's activities. This was no easy task given his suspicious and circumspect nature. Nonetheless, my observations revealed that he was crafting a unique ritual—one that somehow drew on the energy of {@i faerzress} to channel incalculable arcane power. When Gromph performed this ritual, the walls between the planes shuddered. Then, as you have by now realized, the demon lords were wrenched from their layers of the Abyss and cast about here in the Underdark. What we all witnessed in Gravenhollow confirms this."
zh_tw: "從這個流放之塔，我監視著貢夫的活動。考慮到他猜疑和謹慎的性格，這絕非易事。儘管如此，我的觀察揭示了他正在制定一個獨特的儀式——一個不知何故利用{@i 妖光}的能量來引導難以估量的奧術力量的儀式。當貢夫執行這個儀式時，位面之間的牆壁震動了。然後，正如你們現在所意識到的，惡魔領主們從他們的無底深淵層面被撕扯出來，被投擲到這裡的幽暗地域。我們在刻文谷所見證的一切都證實了這一點。"

english: Vizeran answers questions from the characters as best he can, then makes his proposal. Use the points laid out in the following sections to play out the negotiations, utilizing whatever combination of ability checks and roleplaying you prefer. Vizeran is sincere in his willingness to help, even if his motives are entirely selfish. As such, he's inclined to reach an accord with the characters.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭儘可能回答角色們的問題，然後提出他的提議。使用以下各節中列出的要點來進行談判，利用您喜歡的任何屬性檢定和角色扮演組合。維茲蘭真心願意提供幫助，即使他的動機完全是自私的。因此，他傾向於與角色們達成協議。

english: What Vizeran Knows
zh_tw: 維茲蘭所知道的

english: The characters can learn the following information from Vizeran by asking the right questions; he doles out information sparingly, but a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check might yield additional information if the archmage becomes cagey:
zh_tw: 透過提出正確的問題，角色們可以從維茲蘭那裡瞭解以下資訊；他給出的資訊極為有限，但如果這位大法師變得謹慎，成功的 {@dc 20} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定可能會獲得額外的資訊：

english: Lolth is behind the plot to bring the demon lords to the Underdark through her manipulation of Gromph Baenre. The Spider Queen is using the drow as pawns in her schemes to dispose of her demonic rivals and seize power in the Abyss.
zh_tw: 羅絲是操縱貢夫·班瑞將惡魔領主帶到幽暗地域的幕後黑手。蜘蛛女王利用卓爾作為她計劃中的棋子，以除掉她的惡魔對手並在無底深淵中奪取權力。

english: The demon lords of the Abyss—along with many of their lesser servants and legions—have been set loose in the Underdark following Gromph's ritual.
zh_tw: 無底深淵中的惡魔領主——連同他們的許多次級僕從和軍團——在貢夫的儀式後被釋放到了幽暗地域。

english: The presence of the demon lords is warping the fabric of the Underdark. The {@i faerzress} that permeates so much of the subterranean realm has become a conduit through which the insanity of the demon lords spreads.
zh_tw: 惡魔領主的存在正在扭曲幽暗地域的結構。遍佈這個地下王國的{@i 妖光}已經變成了一個通道，透過它，惡魔領主的瘋狂傳播開來。

english: Gromph Baenre vanished following the ritual. Vizeran has not been able to detect any trace of his rival archmage using any of the resources at his command.
zh_tw: 貢夫·班瑞在儀式後消失了。維茲蘭利用他掌握的所有資源，未能探測到他的對手大法師的任何蹤跡。

english: Demogorgon, the Prince of Demons, arrived in the Claw Rift of Menzoberranzan and rampaged through the city before escaping into the wider Underdark.
zh_tw: 惡魔之王狄摩高根抵達了魔索布萊城的爪裂谷，並在城市中肆虐後逃入了更廣闊的幽暗地域。

english: The intended purpose of Gromph's ritual is unclear, but Vizeran believes that his rival meant to summon and bind one specific demon lord. Vizeran finds it difficult to believe that even Gromph could be arrogant enough to think he could bind all the demon lords of the Abyss at once.
zh_tw: 貢夫儀式的預期目的尚不清楚，但維茲蘭相信他的對手打算召喚並束縛一個特定的惡魔領主。維茲蘭覺得，即使是貢夫，也不可能自大到認為自己能夠一次性束縛所有無底深淵的惡魔領主。

english: The fact that the summoning originated in Menzoberranzan remains largely unknown. If the other races of the Underdark knew, they would have already moved against the drow. The dark elves almost certainly wish to keep this information a secret—assuming they even know it themselves.
zh_tw: 召喚源於魔索布萊城的事實仍鮮為人知。若幽暗地域其他種族知曉此事，他們必定早已對卓爾採取行動。卓爾幾乎肯定希望保守這一秘密——假設他們自己確實知曉此事。

english: Vizeran knows of no means by which Gromph Baenre's ritual can be reversed. However, he believes there might be a different means of sending the demon lords back to the Abyss (see "Vizeran's Plan").
zh_tw: 維茲蘭不知道有什麼方法可以逆轉貢夫·班瑞的儀式。然而，他相信可能有不同的方法將惡魔領主送回無底深淵（見"維茲蘭的計劃"）。

english: What Vizeran Wants
zh_tw: 維茲蘭所想要的

english: Like any other sane creature, Vizeran has no wish to see the Underdark become home to the denizens of the Abyss. He points out that once the demon lords establish domains here, nothing will stop them from surging up to Faerûn to spread their madness and chaos. Indeed, such an outcome is inevitable given enough time.
zh_tw: 像任何其他理智的生物一樣，維茲蘭不希望看到幽暗地域成為無底深淵居民的家園。他指出，一旦惡魔領主在這裡建立了自己的領域，沒有什麼能阻止他們湧向費倫，傳播他們的瘋狂和混亂。事實上，只要時間足夠，這樣的結果將是不可避免的。

english: Vizeran wants desperately to destroy his old rival. But even more so, the archmage dreams of thwarting Lolth and of having the Demon Queen of Spiders revealed to the drow as the treacherous creature she is. His deepest, burning desire is to watch Menzoberranzan destroyed by a demonic rampage. Then the ragged survivors of the drow will turn away from Lolth and her priestesses to seek Vizeran's guidance, letting him take his rightful place as a wise leader among his people.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭極度渴望摧毀他的老對手。但更甚於此，這位大法師夢想著挫敗羅絲，並將蜘蛛惡魔女王作為她真正的奸詐生物揭露給卓爾。他內心深處燃燒的願望是看著魔索布萊城被惡魔的暴行摧毀。然後，卓爾的殘存者將背棄羅絲和她的女祭司，尋求維茲蘭的指導，讓他作為他的人民中明智的領袖，佔據他應有的位置。

english: What Vizeran Offers
zh_tw: 維茲蘭所提供的

english: {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} offers the adventurers his insight, his arcane power, and various magical resources that can help them deal with the demon lords. This includes the following benefits:
zh_tw: {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}向冒險者提供他的洞察力、他的奧術力量以及各種可以幫助他們應對惡魔領主的魔法資源。這包括以下好處：

english: Vizeran offers each character a drow {@item Piwafwi (Cloak of Elvenkind)|OotA|piwafwi} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}).
zh_tw: 維茲蘭給每個角色提供一個卓爾{@item Piwafwi (Cloak of Elvenkind)|OotA|魔斗篷}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}）。

english: Each character will be provided with an amulet that can be used one time as a {@item Scroll of Protection||scroll of protection from fiends}.
zh_tw: 每個角色將獲得一個護身符，該護身符可以作為一次性使用的{@item Scroll of Protection||邪魔守護卷軸}。

english: Vizeran offers the use of Araj as a safe haven in the Underdark, as long as his alliance with the characters lasts. The archmage won't countenance an army being housed within his home, but he opens it to the adventurers and their allies as they need it.
zh_tw: 只要維茲蘭與角色們的聯盟持續存在，他提供阿拉傑作為幽暗地域中的安全避難所。大法師不會容忍在他的家中駐紮軍隊，但根據冒險者及其盟友的需要，他願意開放它。

english: Most important of all, Vizeran can offer a plan to defeat the demon lords—but he needs the adventurers' help to make it happen (see "Vizeran's Plan").
zh_tw: 最重要的是，維茲蘭可以提供一個擊敗惡魔領主的計劃——但他需要冒險者的幫助來實現它（見"維茲蘭的計劃"）。

english: Vizeran is willing to negotiate other reasonable agreements, including tutoring wizards and providing them with opportunities to learn spells from his library. However, the archmage uses any such teaching opportunities to attempt to subtly corrupt his students.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭願意協商其他合理的協議，包括輔導法師並提供機會讓他們從他的圖書館中學習法術。然而，大法師利用任何此類教學機會試圖潛移默化地腐蝕他的學生。

english: Vizeran's Plan
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的計劃

english: At the first sign that the adventurers are open to working with him, the drow archmage explains his plan.
zh_tw: 在冒險者們表現出願意與他合作的第一個跡象時，這位卓爾大法師解釋了他的計劃。

english: "Demons are creatures ruled by madness and hatred, even the greatest and most powerful of them. They war ceaselessly upon each other in the Abyss, and have already begun to do so here. We can play them against each other, and then deal with the weakened victors.
zh_tw: "惡魔是被瘋狂和仇恨支配的生物，即使是它們中最偉大和最強大的也不例外。它們在無底深淵中不斷地相互徵戰，並且已經開始在這裡這樣做。我們可以利用它們相互對抗，然後對付被削弱的勝利者。"

english: "I believe I have the ability to devise and cast a ritual, similar to Gromph's but nowhere near as dangerous or foolish, that will draw the most powerful demon lords together to the site of the original summoning. Once they are brought together, they will try to destroy each other. But though the demon lords might destroy each other's physical manifestations here in our world, their essence cannot be extinguished. They will thus be cast back into the Abyss, as effectively as if they had been banished.
zh_tw: "我相信我有能力設計並施展一個儀式，類似於貢夫的，但遠沒有他的那麼危險或愚蠢，這個儀式將把最強大的惡魔領主聚集到原始召喚的地點。一旦他們聚集在一起，他們將試圖互相毀滅。但儘管惡魔領主們可能會在我們這個世界中毀滅彼此的物質形態，他們的本質無法被熄滅。因此，他們將被重新投入無底深淵，就像被驅逐一樣有效。"

english: "The ritual needs certain components to produce the talisman that will draw the demons. Then a rite to empower and activate it. Then blood and battle such as this world has never seen. Any survivors among the demon lords will be sorely weakened, and should be far easier to destroy.
zh_tw: "這個儀式需要某些成分來製作將吸引惡魔的護身符。然後是一個儀式來賦予它力量並啟用它。然後是這場世界從未見過的血戰。惡魔領主中的任何生還者都將極度虛弱，應該更容易被摧毀。"

english: "All I need are the necessary ingredients," Vizeran says, "and, ideally, a look at Gromph's grimoires and notes from his sanctum." Where the drow archmage watches you, a thin smile curls one corner of his mouth.
zh_tw: "我所需要的只是必要的成分，"維茲蘭說，"而且，理想情況下，能夠一窺貢夫的魔法書和聖所中的筆記。"當這位卓爾大法師注視著你時，他的嘴角微微上揚，露出一絲微笑。

english: The characters can refuse Vizeran at any time, at which point the archmage tells them to leave his home and wishes them good luck surviving in a world dominated by the demon lords. He says he will find other means to deal with the problem on his own.
zh_tw: 角色們可以隨時拒絕維茲蘭，此時大法師會告訴他們離開他的家，並祝願他們在一個由惡魔領主統治的世界中好運生存。他說他會自己找到其他方法來處理這個問題。

english: If the adventurers are willing to ally with him, Vizeran further outlines his needs. He explains that the ritual is powered by a unique talisman he calls "the {@i dark heart}." The talisman's creation requires a number of unique components:
zh_tw: 如果冒險者願意與他結盟，維茲蘭進一步概述了他的需求。他解釋說，這個儀式是由他稱之為"{@i 黑暗之心}"的獨特護身符驅動的。護身符的製作需要一些獨特的元件：

english: The intact and unhatched egg of a purple worm, for channeling great physical power.
zh_tw: 一個完整且未孵化的紫蟲卵，用於引導巨大的物理力量。

english: The central eye of a beholder, to break down magical resistance and overcome magical forces.
zh_tw: 一個眼魔的中央眼球，用於分解魔法抗性並克服魔法力量。

english: Six feathers from six different angels—the authority of the celestial realms and a force to enrage fiendish creatures.
zh_tw: 來自六個不同天使的六根羽毛——天界領域的權威，以及激怒邪惡生物的力量。

english: The heart of a goristro, to reach and influence the hearts of other demons.
zh_tw: 一個巨牛魔的心臟，用於觸及並影響其他惡魔的心臟。

english: Thirteen timmasks, also known as "devil's mushrooms," sprouted from the footprint of a marilith, a balor, or a goristro—a lure to draw demons in.
zh_tw: 十三個提馬斯克，也被稱為"惡魔蘑菇"，它們是從六臂蛇魔、巴洛炎魔或巨牛魔的腳印中發芽的——用來吸引惡魔的誘惑。

english: A few drops of blood or ichor from a demon lord, to connect with the demons the ritual will call.
zh_tw: 幾滴來自惡魔領主的血液或體液，用於與儀式將要召喚的惡魔建立聯絡。

english: Gromph Baenre's grimoires and notes on his ritual, to assist in better understanding the power that summoned the demon lords.
zh_tw: 貢夫·班瑞的魔法書和他關於儀式的筆記，以幫助更好地理解召喚惡魔領主的力量。

english: In his research, Vizeran has located potential sources for all these components, and he can direct the characters to retrieve them as detailed in subsequent chapters. The purple worm egg and the eye of the beholder can be found in the Wormwrithings (see {@adventure chapter 13|OotA|12}). The angel feathers and the demon heart can be claimed in the Labyrinth (see {@adventure chapter 14|OotA|13}). The grimoire is found in Menzoberranzan, the City of Spiders (see {@adventure chapter 15|OotA|14}). Being able to acquire the timmask mushrooms and blood from a demon lord depends on the adventurers' resourcefulness and on the opportunities found in other chapters of the adventure.
zh_tw: 在研究中，維茲蘭已經確定了所有這些元件的潛在來源，他可以指導角色們按照後續章節的詳細說明去取回它們。紫蟲卵和眼魔之眼可以在蠕蟲扭道找到（見{@adventure 第十三章|OotA|12}）。天使羽毛和惡魔之心可以在迷宮中索取（見{@adventure 第十四章|OotA|13}）。魔法書在蜘蛛之城魔索布萊城找到（見{@adventure 第十五章|OotA|14}）。能否獲得提馬斯克蘑菇和惡魔領主的血液取決於冒險者的足智多謀，以及在冒險的其他章節中找到的機會。

english: You can modify the components list if you wish, using the encounters in chapters 13 through 15 as guidelines and opportunities. Additional encounters can easily be inserted into chapters 13 and 14 for any other elements you want to add to the ritual.
zh_tw: 如果您願意，可以修改元件列表，使用第13章至第15章中的遭遇作為指導和機會。您可以輕鬆地在第13章和第14章中插入額外的遭遇，以便向儀式中新增任何其他元素。

english: Vizeran provides the means for the adventurers and their allies to gather the components for the talisman and encourages them to get started immediately. See chapters 13 through 15 for the sources Vizeran has found, then chapters 16 and 17 for the endgame battles against the demon lords.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭為冒險家及其盟友提供了收集護身符元件的手段，並鼓勵他們立即開始。請檢視第13章至第15章以瞭解維茲蘭找到的來源，然後是第16章和第17章，瞭解對抗惡魔領主的最終戰鬥。

english: Victory without Vizeran
zh_tw: 沒有維茲蘭的勝利

english: It is up to you whether or not the adventurers can succeed against the demon lords without Vizeran's aid. They might be able to implement his plan on their own, particularly once he has supplied them with the necessary components and information. The {@i dark heart} talisman to be crafted for the ritual (see {@adventure chapter 15|OotA|14}) can be placed anywhere to draw the demons to it. Likewise, the ritual can be performed in any location in the Underdark imbued with {@i faerzress}. Vizeran has kept this information from the adventurers only because he sees the ritual as his chance to destroy Menzoberranzan and take his revenge on the drow who cast him out.
zh_tw: 是否冒險者可以在沒有維茲蘭幫助的情況下成功對抗惡魔領主取決於您。他們可能能夠獨立實施他的計劃，特別是一旦他為他們提供了必要的元件和資訊。為儀式製作的{@i 黑暗之心}護身符（見{@adventure 第十五章|OotA|14}）可以放置在任何地方以吸引惡魔。同樣，儀式可以在幽暗地域中任何充滿{@i 妖光}的地方進行。維茲蘭之所以沒有向冒險者透露這些資訊，只是因為他認為儀式是他摧毀魔索布萊城並對驅逐他的卓爾進行報復的機會。

english: A player character spellcaster might be able to reproduce Vizeran's work to create and perform the ritual, setting up the scenario in chapter 17, "{@adventure Against the Demon Lords|OotA|16}." Regardless of how the plan unfolds, though, the adventurers should get the opportunity to choose what they'll do about Vizeran when they learn that the drow archmage has not been entirely truthful with them. See chapter 15, "{@adventure The City of Spiders|OotA|14}," for details.
zh_tw: 一個玩家角色的施法者可能能夠複製維茲蘭的工作來建立並執行儀式，設定第17章的情節，"{@adventure 對抗惡魔領主|OotA|16}。" 然而，無論計劃如何展開，冒險者們應該有機會選擇他們將如何處理維茲蘭，當他們得知這位卓爾法師並沒有完全誠實地對待他們時。詳情見第15章，"{@adventure 蜘蛛之城|OotA|14}。"

english: Stealing into Araj
zh_tw: 潛入阿拉傑

english: If the characters don't take warmly to Vizeran's initial offer, they might want to enter Araj covertly instead of at the archmage's invitation. Likewise, once they realize that they are being used by Vizeran to advance his plan to destroy Menzoberranzan, the characters might decide to steal the archmage's secrets and resources to use against the demon lords—or even to slay him just for the sake of looting the place.
zh_tw: 如果角色們對維茲蘭最初的提議並不熱情，他們可能會選擇秘密進入阿拉傑，而不是接受大法師的邀請。同樣，一旦他們意識到自己被維茲蘭利用來推進他摧毀魔索布萊城的計劃，角色們可能會決定竊取大法師的秘密和資源，用來對抗惡魔領主——或者甚至只是為了洗劫這個地方而殺了他。

english: Wards
zh_tw: 大區

english: Getting to the tower undetected is all but impossible. Vizeran knows whenever the secret door accessing the passage to Araj opens, by way of a permanent magical effect similar to a powerful {@spell alarm} spell. Intruders also have to deal with the {@spell guards and wards} spell active within the tower, which places {@spell arcane lock} spells on all the doors and sets {@spell web} spells across the central shaft and stairways. Doors within the Tower of Vengeance (including the main door) have AC 16, 25 hit points, a damage threshold of 5, resistance to thunder damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 不被察覺地到達塔幾乎是不可能的。維茲蘭知道透過通往阿拉傑的秘密通道的隱藏門何時開啟，這是透過一個永久性的魔法效果，類似於強大的{@spell alarm||警報術}法術。入侵者還必須應對塔內活躍的{@spell guards and wards||銅牆鐵壁}法術，它在所有的門上施加了{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術，並在中央井道和樓梯上設定了{@spell web||蛛網術}法術。復仇之塔內的門（包括主門）具有AC 16，25生命值，5點傷害閾值，對雷鳴傷害有抗性，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: A {@spell magic mouth} spell at the entrance to the tower activates when intruders try to open the door, shouting: "You dare to enter here unbidden? Flee for your lives now, while you still can!" Another {@spell magic mouth} placed outside Vizeran's sanctum repeatedly calls out: "Intruders! Beware!" when any intruder approaches within 20 feet of the sanctum door.
zh_tw: 當入侵者試圖開啟塔的入口門時，一個{@spell magic mouth||魔嘴術}法術被啟用，大喊："你們敢不請自來地進入這裡嗎？趁你們還能，快逃命吧！"另一個放置在維茲蘭聖所外的{@spell magic mouth||魔嘴術}在任何入侵者接近聖所門20尺內時會重複喊出："入侵者！小心！"

english: The tower's twenty-four suits of {@creature animated armor} attack anyone who enters Araj without Vizeran's permission, and continue attacking until they are destroyed or he calls them off. At the first sign of trouble, the {@creature death slaad} Kleve stalks intruders invisibly and attempts to attack with surprise. If Kleve is reduced to half its hit points, it retreats to its master's side.
zh_tw: 塔內的二十四套{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}會攻擊任何未經維茲蘭許可進入阿拉傑的人，並持續攻擊直到被摧毀或他叫停。一有麻煩的跡象，{@creature death slaad||史拉亡蟾} 克勒維就會隱形地追蹤入侵者，並試圖以突襲的方式攻擊。如果克勒維的生命值減少到一半，它會撤退到其主人的身邊。

english: Vizeran casts his protective spells before entering combat, along with {@spell invisibility} (renewing the death slaad's {@spell invisibility} as well if he has time). As a last-ditch escape, Vizeran casts {@spell time stop} and uses the opportunity to flee or make a risky {@spell teleport} attempt to a bolt-hole shelter he has hidden in another Underdark location of your choice.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭在進入戰鬥前會施展他的防護法術，同時也會施展{@spell invisibility||隱形}（如果他有時間的話，也會更新死亡史拉蟾的{@spell invisibility||隱形}）。作為最後的逃脫手段，維茲蘭施展{@spell time stop||時間停止}，並利用這個機會逃跑，或者冒險嘗試{@spell teleport||傳送術}到他隱藏在另一個你選擇的幽暗地域地點的隱蔽處。

english: In the event the characters have the opportunity to loot Araj, they find the items listed under "What Vizeran Offers," along with other treasure suitable for a foe of the archmage's power. See chapter 7, "{@book Treasure|DMG|7|Random Treasure}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for guidelines on creating Vizeran's treasury, keeping in mind that the wily drow has likely trapped his most powerful magic items. If he survives and escapes, Vizeran adds those who dare to threaten him and loot his home to the list of people who will suffer his revenge.
zh_tw: 如果角色有機會掠奪阿拉傑，他們會找到在"維茲蘭提供的物品"下列出的物品，以及其他適合與這位大法師實力相當的敵人的寶藏。請參閱"{@book 寶藏|DMG|7|Random Treasure}"（選自《{@i 城主指南}》第7章）以獲取建立維茲蘭寶庫的指南，但請記住，這位狡猾的卓爾很可能為他最強大的魔法物品設定了陷阱。如果他倖存並逃脫，維茲蘭會將那些膽敢威脅他並掠奪他家園的人列入他的復仇名單中。

english: Chapter 13: The Wormwrithings
zh_tw: 第13章：蠕蟲扭道

english: Two of the components that Vizeran needs to craft the talisman for his ritual (see {@area chapter 12|426|x}) can be found relatively close to the archmage's tower. The Wormwrithings are a honeycomb of tunnels spanning hundreds of miles in the northern reaches of the Underdark, carved from the rock by enormous purple worms. A purple worm nest in the Wormwrithings is an ideal place to find an unhatched purple worm egg. Additionally, Vizeran has heard rumors of a beholder living in the Vast Oblivium, a chasm deep within the Wormwrithings. If the characters didn't obtain the central eye from {@creature Lorthuun|OotA} or Xazax (the beholders in chapter 9), they can search the Vast Oblivium for the beholder believed to lair there.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭為他的儀式製作護身符所需的兩種材料（見{@area 第十二章|426|x}）可以在大法師塔附近找到。蠕蟲扭道是位於幽暗地域北部的一片蜂窩狀隧道網路，綿延數百英里，由巨大的紫蟲在岩石中開闢而成。在蠕蟲扭道中的紫蟲巢穴是尋找未孵化的紫蟲蛋的理想地點。此外，維茲蘭聽說在"無盡遺忘"中居住著一隻眼魔，這是蠕蟲扭道深處的一道深淵。如果角色們沒有從{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}或札札克斯（第9章中的眼魔）那裡獲得中央眼，他們可以在無盡遺忘中搜尋據信在那裡棲身的眼魔。

english: The Worm Tunnels
zh_tw: 蠕蟲隧道

english: The nearest purple worm nesting area mapped out for the characters by {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} lies forty-eight miles west of the archmage's tower. The Vast Oblivium lies some twelve miles south of this nursery. Use the guidelines in {@area chapters 2|051|x} and {@area 10|397|x} as the party travels through the Underdark, but use the Wormwrithings Encounters table instead of the random encounter tables in chapter 2. Foraging is more difficult in the Wormwrithings, requiring successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks.
zh_tw: 由{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}為角色們繪製的最接近的紫色蠕蟲巢穴區域位於大法師之塔以西48英里處。無盡虛無位於這個巢穴以南約12英里處。當隊伍穿越幽暗地域時，使用{@area 第二章|051|x}和{@area 10|397|x}中的指南，但使用蠕蟲扭道遭遇表代替第2章中的隨機遭遇表。在蠕蟲扭道區域覓食更加困難，需要成功的{@dc 20}感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。

english: {@i Faerzress} permeates only the fringes of the Wormwrithings. While the party explores this region of the Underdark, spellcasters won't have to deal with the effects described under "{@area Faerzress|05f|x}" in chapter 2.
zh_tw: {@i 妖光} 只滲透到蠕蟲扭道的邊緣地帶。當隊伍探索這個幽暗地域的區域時，施法者不需要處理第二章中"{@area 妖光|05f|x}"所描述的效果。

english: The tunnels created by the purple worms are tubular and roughly 10 feet in diameter. A typical stretch of tunnel is {@dice 1d6} miles long before it intersects with another tunnel or a naturally formed cavern.
zh_tw: 紫蟲創造的隧道呈管狀，直徑大約為 10 尺。一段典型的隧道長度為 {@dice 1d6} 英里，之後才會與其他隧道或自然形成的洞穴相交。

english: Random Encounters
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇

english: As the characters explore the Wormwrithings, check for a random encounter once per day. Roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Wormwrithings Encounters table to determine what, if anything, the characters and their expeditionary force encounter.
zh_tw: 當角色們探索蠕蟲扭道時，每天檢查一次隨機遭遇。擲一個{@dice d20}並查閱蠕蟲扭道遭遇表，以確定角色們和他們的遠徵軍遇到了什麼，如果有的話。

english: When an encounter occurs, roll a {@dice d6} to determine how the area is illuminated. A roll of 1 indicates the area is dimly lit by phosphorescent lichen, while a 2–6 indicates the area is dark. The twisting tunnels of the Wormwrithings give creatures the opportunity to surprise the characters (see "{@area Noticing Threats|058|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 當發生遭遇時，擲一個{@dice d6}來決定該區域的照明情況。擲出1表示該區域由熒光地衣微弱照明，而2-6表示該區域是黑暗的。蠕蟲扭道的曲折隧道為生物提供了突襲角色的機會（見第2章中的"{@area 發覺威脅|058|x}"）。

zh_tw: 蠕蟲扭道遭遇

zh_tw: {@creature Drow||卓爾} 狩獵隊伍

zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} 名矮人{@creature Commoner||平民}

english: Drider
zh_tw: 蛛化卓爾

english: This creature clings to the ceiling and prefers to make ranged attacks against the party. There is a 25 percent chance that the {@creature drider} can cast spells (use the spellcasting variant in the {@i Monster Manual}). The drider flees if reduced to 30 or fewer hit points.
zh_tw: 這種生物依附在天花板上，更喜歡對隊伍進行遠端攻擊。有25%的機率，{@creature drider||蛛化卓爾}可以施法（使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的施法變體）。如果生命值降至30或以下，蛛化卓爾會逃跑。

english: Drow Hunting Party
zh_tw: 卓爾狩獵隊

english: A {@creature drow mage} of House Melarn leads a group of {@dice 1d6} {@creature drow} and {@dice 2d6} {@creature bugbear} slaves through the tunnels in search of a purple worm nursery, where they hope to find a purple worm egg as a gift for their matron mother. If the characters have an egg clearly in their possession, the drow party tries to take it. Otherwise, the drow mage is happy to let the characters and their expeditionary force pass by unchallenged.
zh_tw: 梅拉恩家族的一名{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}帶領著一群{@dice 1d6}名{@creature drow||卓爾}和{@dice 2d6}名{@creature bugbear||熊地精}穿過隧道，尋找紫蟲孵化場，他們希望找到一個紫蟲卵作為給他們的母神的禮物。如果角色們明顯擁有一個卵，卓爾隊伍會試圖奪取它。否則，卓爾法師很樂意讓角色們和他們的遠徵隊不受挑戰地透過。

english: Dwarf Commoners
zh_tw: 矮人平民

english: There is a 75 percent chance that these {@creature Commoner||shield dwarves} are prospectors from Mithral Hall, hunting for precious stones and minerals. Otherwise, they are refugees who became lost in the Underdark after orcs attacked their stronghold and chased them underground. These dwarves are searching for a route to the surface.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Commoner||盾矮人}中有75%的機率是來自米斯拉爾廳的勘探者，他們正在尋找珍貴的寶石和礦物。否則，他們就是在獸人攻擊他們的要塞並把他們趕到地下後，在幽暗地域迷路的難民。這些矮人正在尋找通往地表的路線。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each dwarf carries {@dice 1d10} pounds of food, {@dice 1d4} gallons of water (stored in canteens), and {@dice 1d6} gems worth 10 gp each.
zh_tw: 每個矮人攜帶{@dice 1d10}磅食物，{@dice 1d4}加侖的水（儲存在水壺中），以及{@dice 1d6}顆每顆價值10金幣的寶石。

english: Ettins
zh_tw: 雙頭巨人

english: These {@creature Ettin||ettins} used to be orogs until the {@i faerzress} and the corrupting influence of Demogorgon transformed them into two-headed giants. Their transformation can't be undone. They are starving and attack the party on sight.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Ettin||雙頭巨人}以前是奧格人，直到{@i 妖光}和狄摩高根的腐蝕影響將他們變成了兩個頭的巨人。他們的轉變無法逆轉。他們非常飢餓，一見到隊伍就會攻擊。

english: Flumphs
zh_tw: 呋嚕

english: A cloister of {@creature Flumph||flumphs} floats through the tunnels. These peaceful creatures have been disturbed by the powerful thoughts of the demon lords. They warn the characters that these evil thoughts have polluted the Underdark, and that kindness is the only response to such evil.
zh_tw: 一群{@creature Flumph||呋嚕}在隧道中漂浮。這些和平的生物被惡魔領主的強大思想所擾亂。它們警告角色們，這些邪惡的思想已經汙染了幽暗地域，並且善良是對付這種邪惡的唯一回應。

english: Grick Nest
zh_tw: 穴居攫怪巢穴

english: The characters stumble upon a naturally formed cyst in a tunnel wall. A {@creature grick alpha} and {@dice 2d4} {@creature Grick||gricks} are using the cyst as a nest, attacking anything that passes by.
zh_tw: 角色們偶然發現隧道壁上一個自然形成的囊腫。一個{@creature grick alpha||阿爾法穴居攫怪}和{@dice 2d4} {@creature Grick||穴居攫怪}正在使用這個囊腫作為巢穴，攻擊任何經過的東西。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The walls of the cyst have precious crystals growing out of them. Characters can harvest these crystals, collecting {@dice 3d6} intact crystals worth 50 gp each.
zh_tw: 囊腫的壁上生長著珍貴的水晶。角色們可以採集這些水晶，收集到 {@dice 3d6} 個完整的水晶，每個價值 50 gp。

english: Purple Worm
zh_tw: 紫蟲

english: Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the {@creature Purple Worm} Direction table to determine where the purple worm comes from.
zh_tw: 擲一個{@dice d6}骰子，並參照{@creature Purple Worm||紫蟲}方向表來確定紫蟲從哪裡來。

english: Purple Worm Direction
zh_tw: 紫蟲方向

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Direction
zh_tw: 方向

english: The purple worm comes from behind the party, heading in the same direction and filling the entire tunnel. The party must either stay ahead of the worm or turn and fight it. If they stay ahead of the worm, the tunnel branches after {@dice 1d6} miles.
zh_tw: 紫蟲從隊伍後面來，朝著同一個方向前進，填滿了整個隧道。隊伍必須要麼保持在蟲子前面，要麼轉身與它戰鬥。如果他們保持在蟲子前面，隧道在{@dice 1d6}英里後分叉。

english: The purple worm is moving along the tunnel in the opposite direction as the party and appears in front of them. The party must either reverse course or fight the worm. If they reverse course, the tunnel branches after {@dice 1d6} miles.
zh_tw: 紫色蠕蟲沿著與隊伍相反方向的隧道移動，並出現在他們面前。隊伍必須要麼改變路線，要麼與蠕蟲戰鬥。如果他們改變路線，隧道在{@dice 1d6}英里後分叉。

english: The purple worm is burrowing through the solid rock on a path that intersects with the party's tunnel. The worm erupts from the tunnel wall behind the party, then continues on its way, leaving a new tunnel in its wake. The worm's passage triggers a rockfall in the party's tunnel, and each party member must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) bludgeoning damage from falling debris.
zh_tw: 紫色蠕蟲正在透過堅硬的岩石挖掘一條與隊伍隧道相交的路徑。蠕蟲從隊伍身後的隧道牆壁中爆發出來，然後繼續前行，留下一條新的隧道。蠕蟲的透過引發了隊伍隧道中的巖崩，每個隊伍成員必須成功透過一個 {@dc 13} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則將因墜落的碎石受到 10 ({@dice 3d6}) 鈍擊傷害。

english: Troglodytes
zh_tw: 穴蜥人

english: These {@creature Troglodyte||troglodytes} are heading toward their lair (see "{@area Troglodyte Lair|43c|x}") and attack any other creatures they come across.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Troglodyte||穴蜥人}正朝著他們的巢穴前進（見"{@area 穴蜥人巢穴|43c|x}"），並且會攻擊他們遇到的任何其他生物。

english: Trolls
zh_tw: 巨魔

english: These ravenous, insane {@creature Troll||trolls} attack the party on sight.
zh_tw: 這些渴望食物、瘋狂的{@creature Troll||巨魔}一見到隊伍就會發起攻擊。

english: Umber Hulk
zh_tw: 掘土巨怪

english: This {@creature Umber Hulk||creature} is hidden behind a wall and uses its {@sense tremorsense|MM} to detect passing prey, bursting out of a nearby wall to attack the nearest party member. Randomly determine who is attacked, taking into account any NPCs traveling with the characters.
zh_tw: 這個{@creature Umber Hulk||掘土巨怪}隱藏在牆後，並使用它的{@sense tremorsense|MM|震顫感知}來探測經過的獵物，從附近的牆中突然衝出來攻擊最近的隊員。隨機決定誰被攻擊，同時考慮任何隨角色一起旅行的NPC。

english: Troglodyte Lair
zh_tw: 穴蜥人巢穴

english: Approximately half way between Araj and the worm nursery, the characters' route is blocked by a looming battle between two factions of a troglodyte tribe.
zh_tw: 在阿拉傑和蠕蟲託兒所之間大約一半的路程，角色們的路線被兩個部落的穴蜥人族之間的即將發生的戰鬥阻擋了。

english: A foul stench and a cacophony of faint, hissing voices rises from ahead. The tunnel plunges sharply downward into a vast, open cavern dimly lit by luminous fungi and bisected by an underground stream. Tall reptilian humanoids stand on either side of the stream, waving makeshift weapons and howling threats at each other in a hissing language.
zh_tw: 前方傳來一股惡臭和一陣微弱的嘶嘶聲的嘈雜。隧道陡然向下傾斜，進入一個被髮光蘑菇微弱照亮的廣闊開放洞穴，並被一條地下河流一分為二。高大的爬行類人形生物站在河流的兩側，揮舞著臨時武器，用嘶嘶的語言互相威脅。

english: The group of creatures closest to you has a captive lashed between two stalagmites atop a low rise in the cavern floor. That floor is some twenty feet below you, down a steep but navigable tunnel whose walls are piled high with rubble. The creatures are preoccupied with their conflict and haven't noticed you yet.
zh_tw: 離你最近的生物群體在洞穴地面上的一個低矮隆起處，有俘虜被綁在兩個石筍之間。那個地面在你下方大約二十尺，透過一個陡峭但可以通行的隧道，隧道的牆壁上堆滿了碎石。這些生物忙於他們的衝突，還沒有注意到你。

english: The reptilian humanoids are troglodytes that worship a lesser god called Laogzed—a reptilian horror that dwells in the Abyss. Although Laogzed isn't a demon lord (and so has not been summoned to the Underdark), troglodytes are being drawn across the Underdark to sites where the demon lords have manifested.
zh_tw: 這些爬行類人形生物是穴蜥人，他們崇拜一個叫做勞格茲德的次級神——一個居住在無底深淵中的爬行類恐怖存在。儘管勞格茲德不是一個惡魔領主（因此沒有被召喚到幽暗地域），但穴蜥人正在被吸引到惡魔領主顯現的幽暗地域的地點。

english: Any character who understands the troglodytes quickly learns what drives the conflict. Otherwise, a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check can provide a general sense of what's going on. The troglodytes ambushed and killed a drow scouting party whose leader wielded a magic sword that S'slaar, the troglodyte chieftain, claimed as a trophy. However, S'slaar's war marshal, H'slaat, was the one who killed the drow leader, and who now claims the right to wield the blade.
zh_tw: 任何理解穴居人的角色很快就會瞭解衝突的起因。否則，成功的 {@dc 13} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定可以提供一個大致的情況。穴居人伏擊並殺死了一隊卓爾偵察隊，其隊長攜帶了一把魔法劍，穴居人酋長 斯斯拉爾 將其視為戰利品。然而，斯斯拉爾 的戰爭元帥 赫斯拉特 才是殺死卓爾隊長的人，他現在聲稱有權使用這把劍。

english: The disagreement blossomed into a full-fledged conflict, and the other troglodytes quickly chose sides. On one side of the stream, troglodytes loyal to H'slaat seized S'slaar's mate and are threatening her, hoping to force the chieftain to back down. On his side of the stream, S'slaar is wildly swinging the magic sword and screaming, as the troglodytes loyal to him shout insults and taunts at the other side.
zh_tw: 分歧演變成了全面衝突，其他的穴蜥人迅速選擇了立場。在溪流的一側，忠於赫斯拉特的穴蜥人抓住了斯斯拉爾的配偶並威脅她，希望迫使酋長讓步。在溪流的另一側，斯斯拉爾瘋狂地揮舞著魔法劍並尖叫著，忠於他的穴蜥人則對另一側大聲辱罵和嘲諷。

english: The characters can turn back without being spotted and find an alternate route bypassing the troglodytes, but doing so adds forty-eight miles (and an increased chance of random encounters) to the distance they must travel before they reach the purple worm nursery. If the characters simply watch the standoff unfold, see "{@area Resolving the Standoff|45b|x}" later in this section.
zh_tw: 角色們可以選擇不被察覺地回頭，找到一條繞過穴蜥人的替代路線，但這樣做會增加他們到達紫蟲託兒所之前必須旅行的距離四十八英里（以及增加隨機遭遇的機會）。如果角色們只是觀察對峙的展開，請參閱本節後面的"{@area 解決對峙|45b|x}"。

english: Troglodyte Lair: General Features
zh_tw: 穴蜥人巢穴：一般特徵

english: Characters notice commonly recurring features as they explore the troglodyte lair.
zh_tw: 角色們在探索穴蜥人巢穴時注意到了一些常見的重複特徵。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Nightlights (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2) and other luminous fungi dimly illuminate the caves and tunnels throughout the troglodyte lair.
zh_tw: 夜光菌（見第二章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）和其他發光真菌微弱地照亮了整個穴蜥人巢穴中的洞穴和隧道。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: The main cavern has a 90-foot-high ceiling. Smaller side caverns have 60-foot-high ceilings. Unless noted otherwise, all ceilings have stalactites hanging from them.
zh_tw: 主洞穴有一個90尺高的天花板。較小的側洞穴有60尺高的天花板。除非另有說明，否則所有天花板上都懸掛著鐘乳石。

english: Stench
zh_tw: 惡臭

english: The troglodytes' foul musk can be smelled throughout the lair, although the stench is not strong enough to have any detrimental effect on visitors.
zh_tw: 穴蜥人的惡臭可以在巢穴中嗅到，儘管這種惡臭並不足以對訪客產生任何不利影響。

english: Map 13.1: Troglodyte Lair
zh_tw: 地圖 13.1: 穴蜥人巢穴

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Entrance Tunnel
zh_tw: 1. 入口隧道

english: The worm tunnel the adventurers are traveling through opens up atop a steep slope leading 15 feet down into the open cavern. The slope is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 冒險者們正在穿越的蠕蟲隧道在陡峭的斜坡上方開啟，斜坡向下延伸15尺進入開放的洞穴。斜坡是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: As long as the adventurers aren't calling attention to themselves, they can remain undetected here indefinitely. The troglodytes are too distracted by their standoff to notice them.
zh_tw: 只要冒險者們不引起注意，他們可以在這裡無限期地保持隱蔽。穴蜥人們因為對峙而分心，沒有注意到他們。

english: Rubble is piled up along the walls on either side of the tunnel. The rubble on the east side of the tunnel conceals a hidden passageway. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 15 or higher notices the hidden passage. Anyone actively searching the rubble finds it with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Adventurers who head into the passage beyond the rubble discover the hidden entryway to area 5 at the end of the tunnel.
zh_tw: 隧道的兩側牆壁堆滿了碎石。隧道東側的碎石掩蓋了一條秘密通道。任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）值達到15或更高的角色會注意到這條秘密通道。任何主動搜尋碎石的人，成功透過一個{@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定即可發現它。冒險者若透過碎石後的通道，將在隧道盡頭髮現通向區域5的秘密入口。

english: 2. Cave Floor
zh_tw: 2. 洞穴地面

english: H'slaat, a {@creature troglodyte champion of Laogzed|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}), and twenty-two {@creature Troglodyte||troglodytes} are arrayed in a rough battle line along the south bank of a freshwater stream that nearly bisects the cavern. The stream runs west to east, tumbling down a short waterfall and forming a small pool (area 9). The stream is about 15 feet wide and 3 feet deep at its deepest point. It can be crossed on foot but is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 赫斯拉特，一個{@creature troglodyte champion of Laogzed|OotA|拉歐利的冠軍戰士}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}），以及二十二個{@creature Troglodyte||穴蜥人}沿著一條淡水溪流的南岸排成一條粗糙的戰線，這條溪流幾乎將洞穴一分為二。溪流從西向東流，經過一個短小的瀑布，形成一個小水池（區域 9）。溪流大約有15尺寬，最深處有3尺深。可以步行過河，但屬於{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: The troglodytes are so distracted that it's possible to sneak through this area undetected as long as the adventurers stay close to the cavern walls. Each character must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check or be noticed by the troglodytes.
zh_tw: 穴居人非常分心，只要冒險者們緊貼洞穴牆壁，就有可能在此區域潛行而不被發現。每個角色必須成功透過 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，否則會被穴居人發現。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Any wounded creature entering the stream attracts the {@creature swarm of quippers} from area 11.
zh_tw: 任何受傷的生物進入溪流都會吸引來自區域11的{@creature swarm of quippers||食人魚群}。

english: 3. Rise
zh_tw: 3. 上升

english: This upthrust section of the cavern floor is edged by a steep slope to the southwest and a 6-foot-high cliff elsewhere. The cliff requires a successful {@dc 11} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to climb.
zh_tw: 洞穴地面這個隆起的部分西南邊緣是一個陡峭的斜坡，其他位置則是6尺高的懸崖。爬過這個懸崖需要透過一個成功的 {@dc 11} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: Five {@creature Troglodyte||troglodytes} loyal to H'slaat are stationed here. In addition to their regular attacks, they are armed with javelins that they throw from a pile of twenty-five javelins on the cavern floor near them.
zh_tw: 五個忠於赫斯拉特的{@creature Troglodyte||穴蜥人}駐紮在這裡。除了他們的常規攻擊外，他們還配備了標槍，這些標槍來自洞穴地面上他們附近的一堆二十五根標槍。

english: Javelin
zh_tw: 標槍

english: {@i Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack}: {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@i Hit}: 3 ({@dice 1d6}) piercing damage.
zh_tw: {@i 近戰或遠端武器攻擊}: {@hit 4} 命中，觸及5尺或範圍30/120尺，單一目標。{@i 命中}: 3 ({@dice 1d6}) 穿刺傷害。

english: H'hoort, a {@creature troglodyte} and Chieftain S'slaar's mate, is lashed between two stalagmites here. Another {@creature troglodyte} stands guard next to her. Releasing H'hoort won't earn the adventurers a respite from the opportunistic troglodytes, but if the characters hold her captive, both sides are reluctant to attack them.
zh_tw: 赫霍爾特，一個{@creature troglodyte||穴蜥人}，也是酋長斯斯拉爾的配偶，被綁在兩個石筍之間。另一個{@creature troglodyte||穴蜥人}站在她旁邊守衛。釋放赫霍爾特不會讓冒險者從機會主義的穴蜥人那裡得到喘息的機會，但如果角色們把她扣為人質，雙方都不願意攻擊他們。

english: 4. Basin
zh_tw: 4. 盆地

english: The area north of the stream is dominated by a 5-foot-deep basin. A 10-foot-wide furrow on the east side of the basin slopes down toward area 9.
zh_tw: 溪流以北的區域以一個5尺深的盆地為主導。盆地東側有一個10尺寬的溝槽，向區域9傾斜而下。

english: The troglodyte chieftain has arrayed his forces along the narrow strip of high ground between the basin and the stream. Chieftain S'slaar is a {@creature troglodyte} with 20 hit points and a {@item +2 longsword}. While he wields the sword, S'slaar gains the following action option:
zh_tw: 穴蜥人首領已經在盆地和溪流之間的狹窄高地上部署了他的部隊。首領斯斯拉爾是一個{@creature troglodyte||穴蜥人}，擁有20點生命值和一把{@item +2 longsword||+2 長劍}。當他揮舞這把劍時，斯斯拉爾獲得了以下行動選項：

english: +2 Longsword
zh_tw: +2 長劍

english: {@i Ranged Weapon Attack}: {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@i Hit}: 8 ({@dice 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@dice 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands.
zh_tw: {@i 遠端武器攻擊}: {@hit 6} 命中，觸及範圍 5 尺，單一目標。{@i 命中}: 8（{@dice 1d8 + 4}）揮砍傷害，或 9（{@dice 1d10 + 4}）揮砍傷害若用雙手持握。

english: S'slaar is accompanied by five {@creature Troglodyte||troglodytes} with 20 hit points each and three ordinary {@creature Troglodyte||troglodytes}.
zh_tw: 斯斯拉爾 由五名各有 20 點生命值的{@creature Troglodyte||穴蜥人}陪伴，還有三名普通的{@creature Troglodyte||穴蜥人}。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: S'slaar's {@item +2 longsword} is of drow manufacture (see the "{@adventure Drowcraft Items|OotA|18}" sidebar in appendix B). It has a cross guard shaped like a stylized spider with tiny gems for eyes. Etched into its blade are the words {@i Oloth tlu malla}, which is a drow expression meaning "Darkness be praised."
zh_tw: 斯斯拉爾的{@item +2 longsword||+2 長劍}是卓爾製造的（見附錄B中的"{@adventure 卓爾製品|OotA|18}"側邊欄）。它的護手是蜘蛛形狀的，眼睛部位鑲嵌著微小的寶石。劍刃上刻有'{@i Oloth tlu malla}'的字樣，這是一句卓爾的表達，意思是'讚美黑暗'。

english: 5. Supplies and Captives
zh_tw: 5. 補給和俘虜

english: This area is held by H'slaat's forces. One {@creature troglodyte} guards the cave. A character can sneak past the guard with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check.
zh_tw: 這個地區被赫斯拉特的軍隊控制。一個{@creature troglodyte||穴蜥人}守衛著洞穴。角色可以透過成功的{@dc 12}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定潛行過去。

english: The cave floor is strewn with gnawed bones—the remains of dead dwarves and drow. A circular pit, nine feet deep, holds six captives—two {@creature drow} and four shield dwarf {@creature Commoner||commoners}. These unfortunates were separated from larger groups (see "{@area Random Encounters|42d|x}" earlier in this chapter) and captured by the troglodytes. Every couple of days, one of them is eaten by the tribe. The captives are filthy and weak; each has four levels of {@condition exhaustion} and 1 hit point remaining. Any of the captives can explain the nature of the conflict between H'slaat and S'slaar. If freed, the drow immediately flee into the Underdark, but the dwarves offer to join the expeditionary force if the adventurers liberate them. The drow are male members of House Melarn and are named Rinil and Xol. The shield dwarves hail from the Silver Marches and are named Dauthorn Brightmantle (male), Traldak Xornbane (male), Zulia Stonewhisper (female), and Hargritt Hammerhome (female).
zh_tw: 洞穴地面上散落著被啃咬的骨頭——死去的矮人和卓爾的殘骸。一個九尺深的圓形坑中關押著六名俘虜——兩名{@creature drow||卓爾}和四名盾矮人{@creature Commoner||平民}。這些不幸的人被從較大的群體中分離出來（見本章前面的"{@area 隨機遭遇|42d|x}"），並被穴蜥人俘虜。每隔幾天，他們中的一個就會被部落吃掉。俘虜們骯髒而虛弱；每個都有四個等級的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，只剩下1點生命值。任何一名俘虜都可以解釋赫斯拉特和斯斯拉爾之間的衝突性質。如果被釋放，卓爾會立即逃入幽暗地域，但如果冒險者解放了他們，矮人們願意加入遠徵軍。這些卓爾是梅拉恩家族的男性成員，名叫瑞尼爾和佐爾。盾矮人來自銀月聯邦，名叫道索恩·亮篷（男性）、特拉爾達克·石鼎獸剋星（男性）、祖莉亞·石語（女性）和哈格里特·錘家（女性）。

english: Rubble is piled up along the south wall of the cavern, concealing a hidden passageway to area 1. Anyone with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 15 or higher notices the passage. Anyone actively searching the rubble must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to find it.
zh_tw: 洞穴的南牆邊堆滿了碎石，隱藏著通往區域1的秘密通道。任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）值達到15或更高的角色都會注意到這個通道。任何主動搜尋碎石的角色必須透過一個難度等級為{@dc 10}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能找到它。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Within the cave, four zurkhwood boxes hold a 50-foot length of spider silk rope, four flasks of oil, twenty pounds of rancid food, a pile of moldy blankets, six maces and sixteen javelins (all battered but usable), four casks of unspoiled wine worth 10 gp each, and a locked tribute chest. It takes a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools to open the chest, which contains 180 gp (minted in Menzoberranzan and Gracklstugh), three gems each worth 50 gp each, a {@item potion of gaseous form}, and a {@item +1 dagger} with silvery, weblike filigree worked into the hilt. The dagger is of drow manufacture (see the "{@adventure Drowcraft Items|OotA|18}" sidebar in appendix B). The crude litters that the troglodytes use to bear these goods are propped up against the cave wall.
zh_tw: 洞穴內有四個祖克木箱子，裝著50尺長的蜘蛛絲繩、四瓶油、二十磅變質的食物、一堆發黴的毯子、六根狼牙棒和十六支標槍（均有磨損但仍可使用）、四桶未變質的葡萄酒（每桶價值10金幣），以及一個上鎖的貢品箱。需使用盜賊工具並透過一次{@dc 15}敏捷檢定才能開啟箱子，內有180金幣（鑄幣來自魔索布萊城和格拉克斯圖格）、三顆每顆價值50金幣的寶石、一瓶{@item potion of gaseous form||氣化形體藥水}和一把{@item +1 dagger||+1 匕首}，其柄部裝飾著銀色的蛛網狀花紋。這把匕首是卓爾製造的（參見附錄B中的"{@adventure 卓爾製品|OotA|18}"邊欄）。穴居人用來搬運這些貨物的粗糙擔架靠在洞壁上。

english: 6. Steam Vent
zh_tw: 6. 蒸汽噴口

english: A thick jet of hot steam spews forth from a crack in the floor near the east wall of this cavern. Growing around the steam vent is a patch of fire lichen (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 一股濃厚的熱蒸汽從這個洞穴東牆附近的地面裂縫中噴湧而出。在蒸汽孔周圍生長著一片火地衣（見第二章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）。

english: Anyone with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 13 or higher notices a vein of precious gems embedded in the rock wall behind the steam vent. Anyone actively searching the cavern spots the gem deposit automatically. The gems can't be reached without entering a 10-foot-by-10-foot-by-10-foot cloud of hot steam. Any creature that enters the area or starts its turn there takes {@dice 1d8} fire damage. The litters in area 5 or a similar object can be used to block the steam emerging from the vent for 1 round before weakening and falling apart.
zh_tw: 任何具有 13 或更高被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分的人都會注意到蒸汽噴口後面的巖壁中嵌入的珍貴寶石礦脈。任何積極搜尋洞穴的人都會自動識別出寶石礦床。寶石不能在不進入一個 10 尺 x 10 尺 x 10 尺的熱蒸汽雲團的情況下到達。任何進入該區域或在其內開始回合的生物都會受到 {@dice 1d8} 點火焰傷害。區域 5 中的小床或類似的物體可以用來阻擋從噴口冒出的蒸汽 1 輪，然後才會變弱並分解。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: For each round spent digging at the wall, a character has a 10 percent chance of extracting a gemstone worth 100 gp. The chance increases to 20 percent if the character has a mining background and a miner's pick. After ten such gems are extracted, the deposit is depleted. For each round that any number of characters dig at the wall, there is a 10 percent cumulative chance that the sound attracts the attention of any troglodytes remaining in areas 5 or 7.
zh_tw: 每輪挖掘牆壁，角色有10%的機率挖出價值100金幣的寶石。如果角色有采礦背景和礦工鎬，這個機率會增加到20%。挖出十顆這樣的寶石後，礦脈就會枯竭。任何角色每輪挖掘牆壁時，有10%的累積機率，挖掘聲會吸引區域5或7中剩餘的穴蜥人的注意。

english: 7. Troglodyte Outpost
zh_tw: 7. 穴蜥人前哨站

english: H'slaat stationed four {@creature Troglodyte||troglodytes} here to watch for any of S'slaar's forces that might try to make their way into attack position through the outer caverns. These guards are always on alert. One of them carries a horn that it sounds in the event of an attack. If the horn is blown, eight of the troglodytes in area 2 come through area 5 and into this cave to investigate and shore up the defenses.
zh_tw: 赫斯拉特 在這裡部署了四名 {@creature Troglodyte||穴蜥人}，用來監視 斯斯拉爾 的部隊，以防他們試圖透過外洞穴進入攻擊位置。這些守衛始終保持警惕。其中一名守衛攜帶著一個號角，在遭受攻擊時會吹響。如果號角被吹響，區域 2 中的八名穴蜥人會透過區域 5 進入這個洞穴進行調查並加強防禦。

english: 8. Roper Lair
zh_tw: 8. 石繩怪巢穴

english: This small cavern is filled with stalactites and stalagmites, making the cave floor {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. No phosphorescent lichen grows here, so the cave is dark.
zh_tw: 這個小洞穴裡充滿了鐘乳石和石筍，使得洞穴地面成為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。這裡沒有生長髮光的苔蘚，所以洞穴是黑暗的。

english: Two of the stalagmites are {@creature Roper||ropers}, while four of the stalactites are {@creature Piercer||piercers} (the ropers' offspring). While lying in wait, the creatures are virtually undetectable. Any party member with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 20 or higher notices something unusual about the rock formations in the cave. Unless they are recognized, the ropers and piercers surprise anyone entering the area.
zh_tw: 其中兩個石筍是{@creature Roper||石繩怪}，而四個鐘乳石是{@creature Piercer||石錐怪}（石繩怪的後代）。當這些生物潛伏時，它們幾乎無法被察覺。任何具有被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分20或更高的隊伍成員會注意到洞穴中的岩石形態有些不尋常。除非它們被識別出來，否則石繩怪和穿刺怪會突襲任何進入該區域的人。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Searching the cave reveals the remains of a half-eaten male drow lying against one wall. The drow carries a small pouch containing 30 gp and two {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} ({@spell shield} and {@spell phantasmal force}) written on sheets of trillimac (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 搜尋洞穴會發現一名被吃掉一半的男性卓爾靠在一面牆上的遺體。這名卓爾攜帶著一個小袋子，裡面有30金幣和兩個{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（{@spell shield||護盾術}和{@spell phantasmal force||魅影之力}），它們寫在褶扇菇的葉子上（見第2章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）。

english: If the ropers are killed and cut open, the adventurers find 25 pp in the gizzard of one, and a {@item ring of protection} in the gizzard of the other.
zh_tw: 如果石繩怪被殺死並剖開，冒險者會在其中一個的砂囊中找到25枚鉑金幣，而在另一個的砂囊中發現一個{@item ring of protection||防護戒指}。

english: 9. Sunken Pool
zh_tw: 9. 沉沒池塘

english: Water from the stream pours into this 15-foot-deep grotto, forming a 10-foot-deep pool with a narrow crack in the bottom. The pool's water is safe to drink, and growing around the pool's edge are {@dice 3d6} waterorbs (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 溪流中的水湧入這個15尺深的洞穴，形成了一個10尺深的水池，水池底部有一個狹窄的裂縫。水池中的水安全可飲，水池邊緣生長著{@dice 3d6}個水泡果（見第2章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）。

english: 10. Ruins
zh_tw: 10. 廢墟

english: This large cavern is strewn with zurkhwood beams—enough to make a raft. An old bridge made of moldy zurkhwood planks spans an underground stream in one of the tunnels to the north.
zh_tw: 這個大洞穴裡散佈著祖爾木樑——足夠用來製作一個筏子。一座由發黴的祖爾木木板製成的舊橋橫跨北邊隧道中的一條地下溪流。

english: 11. Spawning Pool
zh_tw: 11. 孵化池

english: The underground stream passes through this cave, traveling west to east. The adventurers can hear something splashing in the water as soon as they enter this area. Any character who enters the stream is immediately attacked by the {@creature swarm of quippers} that has spawned here.
zh_tw: 地下溪流穿過這個洞穴，從西向東流。冒險者們一進入這個區域就能聽到水裡有東西在濺起水花。任何進入溪流的角色會立即被在這裡繁殖的{@creature swarm of quippers||食人魚群}攻擊。

english: 12. Geothermic Vents
zh_tw: 12. 地熱通風口

english: The adventurers feel the heat emanating from this area as they approach. Thick cracks, some as wide as 2 feet, crisscross the cavern floor, opening up to a pool of molten rock 25 feet beneath the cavern. The dull orange glow of the lava below bathes this area in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}.
zh_tw: 冒險者在接近時能感受到從該區域散發出的高溫。一些寬達2尺的厚重裂縫縱橫交錯於洞窟地板，向下通往位於洞窟下方25尺處的一池熔岩。下方熔岩的暗橙色光芒將這片區域籠罩在{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}中。

english: At the end of every minute the adventurers spend here, roll a {@dice d6}. On a roll of 1, {@dice 1d4} {@creature Magma Mephit||magma mephits} emerge from a crack in the floor and attack. No more than twelve mephits appear in a given 24-hour period.
zh_tw: 每當冒險者在這裡度過每一分鐘，擲一個{@dice d6}骰子。如果擲出1點，{@dice 1d4}只{@creature Magma Mephit||熔岩魔蝠}會從地板的裂縫中出現並發動攻擊。在任何給定的24小時內，出現的魔靈不會超過十二隻。

english: 13. Empty Cave
zh_tw: 13. 空洞穴

english: Rocks and small boulders are piled up along the north wall of this otherwise empty cave. The rubble conceals a passageway to area 14, buried during a rockslide. Anyone with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 15 or higher notices the hidden passage. Anyone actively searching the rubble must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to find it.
zh_tw: 岩石和小型圓石堆積在這原本空曠洞穴的北牆上。碎石堆隱藏了一條通往14區的通道，這條通道在一次巖崩中被掩埋了。任何被動的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）分數達到15或更高的人會注意到這條隱藏通道。任何主動搜尋碎石堆的人必須成功透過一個難度等級為{@dc 10}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能找到它。

english: 14. Rally Point
zh_tw: 14. 集結點

english: S'slaar's cavalry troops are gathered in this cavern, waiting for their master's order to attack. Six {@creature Troglodyte||troglodytes} are mounted on six {@creature Giant Lizard||giant lizards}.
zh_tw: 斯斯拉爾 的騎兵部隊聚集在這個洞穴裡，等待他們主人的攻擊命令。六名 {@creature Troglodyte||穴蜥人} 騎在六隻 {@creature Giant Lizard||巨蜥} 上。

english: Rocks and small boulders are piled up along the south wall. The rubble conceals a tunnel to area 13. Anyone with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 15 or higher notices the hidden passage. Anyone actively searching the rubble must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to find it.
zh_tw: 沿著南牆堆滿了岩石和小圓石。這些碎石掩蓋了一條通向區域13的隧道。任何擁有15或更高被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）分數的角色會注意到這個隱藏的通道。任何主動搜尋碎石的角色必須成功透過一個{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定來發現它。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: When the order comes to attack, S'slaar's cavalry bursts through the hidden passageway on the south wall of the cave (see "{@area Resolving the Standoff|45b|x}").
zh_tw: 當攻擊命令下達時，斯斯拉爾 的騎兵透過洞穴南牆上的秘密通道衝出來（見"{@area 解決對峙|45b|x}"）。

english: 15. Exit Tunnel
zh_tw: 15. 出口隧道

english: This purple worm tunnel leads back into the Wormwrithings. Unless they're being pursued, the characters can safely leave the troglodytes behind when they reach this area.
zh_tw: 這條紫蟲隧道通回蠕蟲扭道。除非他們被追趕，否則角色們到達這個區域時可以安全地把穴蜥人留在身後。

english: Resolving the Standoff
zh_tw: 解決對峙

english: H'slaat orders his followers to commence their attack 20 minutes after the characters arrive at area 1. Unless the characters intervene, the conflict plays out as follows:
zh_tw: 赫斯拉特 命令他的追隨者在角色們到達區域 1 後的 20 分鐘開始他們的攻擊。除非角色們介入，否則衝突的發展如下：

english: H'slaat orders his fellow troglodytes in area 2 to rush across the stream while the troglodytes in area 3 rain javelins down on the chieftain's forces. Meanwhile, H'slaat grabs H'hoort from area 3.
zh_tw: 赫斯拉特命令區域2的穴蜥人同伴衝過溪流，同時區域3的穴蜥人向首領的部隊投擲標槍。與此同時，赫斯拉特抓住了區域3的赫霍爾特。

english: H'slaat crosses the stream, dragging her behind him. He threatens to kill her unless the chieftain meets him in battle.
zh_tw: 赫斯拉特 穿過溪流，拖著她跟在他後面。他威脅說如果不酋長與他交戰，他就會殺了她。

english: The troglodytes in areas 5 and 7 try to make their way through the side caverns to attack the chieftain's forces in area 4 from the rear. However, if the ropers and piercers in area 8 have not already been killed by the adventurers, the troglodytes are {@status surprised} and massacred.
zh_tw: 在區域5和7的穴蜥人在嘗試透過側邊洞穴攻擊區域4的酋長部隊時，如果區域8的石繩怪和石錐怪尚未被冒險者殺死，穴蜥人會被{@status surprised||突襲}並遭到屠殺。

english: S'slaar's cavalry in area 14 makes its way through the western side caves and attack H'slaat's forces from behind.
zh_tw: 斯斯拉爾在區域14的騎兵透過西側洞穴前進，並從後方攻擊赫斯拉特的部隊。

english: If the adventurers don't intervene in any way, the battle lasts approximately 20 rounds and ends when H'slaat kills the chieftain in the basin at area 4. Half the troglodytes on both sides are killed in the conflict. Those who remain accept H'slaat as their new chieftain.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者不以任何方式介入，戰鬥將持續大約20回合，並在 赫斯拉特 在區域 4 的盆地殺死酋長時結束。雙方有一半的穴蜥人在衝突中被殺。剩餘的人接受 赫斯拉特 作為他們的新酋長。

english: While the battle is underway, a character can sneak through an area occupied by troglodytes with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check.
zh_tw: 當戰鬥正在進行時，一個角色可以透過成功進行一個 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，潛行穿過被穴居人佔據的區域。

english: As tense as the standoff between H'slaat and S'slaar might be, the troglodytes quickly forget their conflict and unite against common threats, such as the characters and their unwelcome expeditionary force.
zh_tw: 儘管 赫斯拉特 和 斯斯拉爾 之間的對峙可能非常緊張，但穴蜥人很快就會忘記他們的衝突，團結起來對抗共同的威脅，比如角色們和他們不受歡迎的遠徵隊。

english: Voice in the Dark
zh_tw: 黑暗中的聲音

english: After dealing with or avoiding the troglodytes, the adventurers can continue on toward the purple worm nursery. However, within six miles of the nursery they come across an unexpected presence in the darkness.
zh_tw: 在處理或避開穴蜥人之後，冒險者可以繼續前往紫蟲託兒所。然而，在距離託兒所六英里內，他們在黑暗中遇到了一個意想不到的存在。

english: The remnants of a rockfall have opened up a small vaulted cavern along the passageway. Apart from the occasional glowing insect scuttling along the walls, the cavern is dark. Suddenly, a loud voice booms out all around you in Undercommon: "Turn back or suffer a death so horrible you cannot imagine! You have been warned!"
zh_tw: 一次巖崩的殘骸在通道旁開闢了一個小拱形洞穴。除了偶爾有發光的昆蟲沿著牆壁快速爬行外，洞穴是黑暗的。突然，一個響亮的聲音用地下通用語在你們周圍響起："回頭，否則遭受難以想象的可怕死亡！你已經被警告了！"

english: The voice is actually a {@spell minor illusion} cantrip. If no one in the party understands Undercommon, the dire warning is just loud gibberish to them. The cantrip was cast by {@creature Hanne Hallen|OotA}, a young drow allied with House Mizzrym. Hanne has the statistics of a {@creature drow}, with the following modifications:
zh_tw: 這個聲音實際上是一個{@spell minor illusion||次級幻象}戲法。如果隊伍中沒有人懂得地底通用語語言，這個嚴重的警告對他們來說只是大聲的胡言亂語。這個戲法是由{@creature Hanne Hallen|OotA|漢娜·哈倫}施放的，漢娜·哈倫是一個與米茲瑞姆家族結盟的年輕卓爾。漢娜的屬性與{@creature drow||卓爾}相同，但有以下修改：

english: Hanne's AC is 12, or 15 with {@spell mage armor}. She doesn't wear a chain shirt.
zh_tw: 漢娜的AC（護甲等級）是12，或者在使用{@spell mage armor||法師護甲}時是15。她不穿鎖子甲。

english: Her Intelligence is 17 (+3).
zh_tw: 她的智慧（智力）是17（+3）。

english: Add {@skill Arcana} +5 and {@skill Investigation} +5 to her skills.
zh_tw: 在她的職業技能中增加{@skill Arcana||奧秘} +5和{@skill Investigation||調查} +5。

english: Add Common to her list of known languages.
zh_tw: 在她的已知語言列表中增加通用語。

english: Hanne also has the following Spellcasting feature:
zh_tw: 漢娜還有以下施法特性：

english: Spellcasting
zh_tw: 施法

english: Hanne is a 1st-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). She has the following wizard spells prepared:
zh_tw: 漢娜是一位1級施法者。她的施法能力是智力（法術豁免難度{@dc 13}，法術攻擊命中骰{@hit 5}）。她準備了以下法師法術：

english: Cantrips (at will): {@spell minor illusion}, {@spell ray of frost}
zh_tw: 戲法（隨意施放）：{@spell minor illusion||次級幻象}，{@spell ray of frost||冷凍射線}

english: 1st Level (2 slots): {@spell shield}, {@spell mage armor}
zh_tw: 1環（2個法術位）：{@spell shield||護盾術}，{@spell mage armor||法師護甲}

english: Hanne's mother, Zhora Hallen, leads the Dark Hunters—drow explorers who steal purple worm eggs. These eggs are prized by wizards, who use them in various arcane rituals. Hanne was on her first egg run with her mother's team when a passing purple worm burst into the tunnel they were traveling through, separating her from the rest of the group. Convinced that her mother and the rest of the Dark Hunters were killed by the purple worm, the headstrong and half-starved young mage-in-training is attempting to make her way back to Menzoberranzan.
zh_tw: 漢娜的母親，佐拉·哈倫，領導著黑暗獵人——偷紫色蟲卵的卓爾探險者。這些卵被法師們所珍視，他們將其用於各種奧術儀式中。當一條經過的紫蟲衝進他們正在行進的隧道，將她與團隊其他成員分開時，漢娜正在與母親的團隊一起進行她的第一次取卵行動。她堅信她的母親和其餘的黑暗獵人被紫蟲殺害了，這位固執且半飢餓的年輕見習法師正試圖設法回到魔索布萊城。

english: Hanne spotted the adventurers as they approached and tried to scare them away. She's hiding in the rubble along the cavern wall but can be spotted with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 漢娜在冒險者們接近時發現了他們，並試圖將他們嚇跑。她躲在洞穴牆壁旁的廢墟中，但透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定可以發現她。

english: If the adventurers decide to turn back, finding another tunnel going in the right direction adds twenty miles to their journey to the worm nursery. If they press ahead, the voice shouts in Undercommon again: "Fools! Flee now! This is your final warning!" Once the adventurers enter the cavern, Hanne can be spotted with a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. If spotted, Hanne threatens the party with her "powerful magic," but drops her hostile attitude if offered food and water. She can be convinced to tell her story with a successful {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者決定回頭，找到另一條通往正確方向的隧道會使他們前往蠕蟲巢穴的旅程增加二十英里。如果他們繼續前進，那個聲音會再次用地底通用語喊道："蠢貨！快逃！這是你們最後的警告！"一旦冒險者進入洞穴，可以透過一個 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定發現漢娜。如果被發現，漢娜會用她的"強大魔法"威脅隊伍，但如果提供食物和水，她會放下敵意。透過一個成功的 {@dc 12} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，可以說服她講述她的故事。

english: If the characters attack Hanne, she fights to the best of her ability. If the adventurers are friendly toward her, Hanne is willing to travel with them for safety.
zh_tw: 如果角色們攻擊漢娜，她會盡自己最大的能力戰鬥。如果冒險者對她友好，漢娜願意為了安全與他們一起旅行。

english: Worm Nursery
zh_tw: 蠕蟲育嬰室

english: As the characters near the nursery, they get a view of one of its guardians—and might take an unexpected fall.
zh_tw: 當角色們接近託兒所時，他們看到了其中一位守衛的景象——並且可能會意外墜落。

english: As you make your way through a long tunnel, everything around you begins to shake and rumble. Suddenly, the tunnel floor gives way at your feet.
zh_tw: 當你們穿過一條長長的隧道時，周圍的一切開始搖晃和轟鳴。突然，隧道的地面在你們的腳下崩塌。

english: The tunnel through which the characters travel is directly above area 1 of the nursery. The burrowing of a nearby purple worm weakens the tunnel floor, causing a 10-foot section of it to break apart and collapse. Any character in the area must make a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall 25 feet into area 1 below.
zh_tw: 角色們穿行的隧道正位於苗圃區域1的上方。附近一隻紫色蠕蟲的挖掘削弱了隧道地板，導致其中一段10尺的部分破裂並坍塌。該區域內的任何角色必須成功進行一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免檢定，否則將跌落25尺，落入下方的區域1。

english: Map 13.2: The Worm Nursery
zh_tw: 地圖 13.2：蠕蟲託兒所

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Entry Cavern
zh_tw: 1. 入口洞穴

english: Any characters dropped into this dark cave have time to recover, while characters who avoided falling can anchor ropes to the edge of the tunnel floor above, then climb down into the cave. In any event, the characters hear more rumbling off in the distance.
zh_tw: 掉入這個黑暗洞穴的任何角色都有時間恢復，而避免墜落的角色可以在隧道地面的邊緣固定繩索，然後爬下洞穴。無論如何，角色們聽到遠處傳來更多的隆隆聲。

english: 2. Fungus Cave
zh_tw: 2. 真菌洞穴

english: A variety of fungi blankets this dark, 15-foot-high cavern. Every 10 minutes spent foraging here yields {@dice 1d3} pounds of edible fungi per forager (to a maximum of 30 pounds).
zh_tw: 這個黑暗的、15尺高的洞穴被各種真菌覆蓋。在這裡每花費 10 分鐘搜尋，每個搜尋者可以獲得 {@dice 1d3} 磅的可食用真菌（最多 30 磅）。

english: The passage to area 3 is a steep slope leading 10 feet upward, and covered in small rocks and gravel. Moving up the slope requires a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. On a failed check, a character slips and tumbles down to the bottom of the slope, taking no damage. If someone at the top of the slope lowers a rope to help other characters climb, no check is necessary.
zh_tw: 通往區域3的通道是一個陡峭的斜坡，向上延伸10尺，上面覆蓋著小石子和碎石。爬上斜坡需要透過一個{@dc 12}的敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定。如果檢定失敗，角色會滑倒並滾落到斜坡底部，但不會受到傷害。如果有人在斜坡頂部放下繩子幫助其他角色攀爬，則無需進行檢定。

english: Worm Nursery: General Features
zh_tw: 蠕蟲託兒所：一般特徵

english: The characters encounter the following features in the purple worm nursery.
zh_tw: 角色們在紫蟲託兒所遇到了以下特徵。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: All tunnels and chambers are dark unless the text states otherwise.
zh_tw: 除非文字另有說明，否則所有隧道和房間都是黑暗的。

english: Purple Worm Tunnels
zh_tw: 紫蟲隧道

english: The tunnels marked T1, T2, and T3 on the map do not exist when the characters first enter the nursery. They are created by purple worms after the party arrives, as noted here:
zh_tw: 地圖上標記為T1、T2和T3的隧道在角色們第一次進入託兒所時並不存在。它們是由紫蟲在隊伍到達後創造的，如下所述：

english: Fifteen minutes after the party enters area 1, a purple worm digs into area 1, then travels through area 3 and creates tunnel T1 to enter area 8.
zh_tw: 隊伍進入區域1後15分鐘，一條紫蟲挖掘進入區域1，然後穿過區域3，並建立隧道T1進入區域8。

english: Ten minutes after the first worm arrives, a second purple worm enters through the tunnel in area 7. It makes its way through the adjoining echo chamber, then into area 8. Then it digs tunnel T2 into the eastern echo chamber before exiting through the worm tunnel in area 14.
zh_tw: 第一條蠕蟲到達後10分鐘，第二條紫蟲透過區域7的隧道進入。它穿過相鄰的迴音室，然後進入區域8。然後它挖掘隧道T2進入東側的迴音室，再透過區域14的蠕蟲隧道離開。

english: Fifteen minutes after the second worm arrives, another purple worm enters through the tunnel in area 7, digs tunnel T3 from the southern echo chamber into the eastern echo chamber, then exits through the worm tunnel in area 14.
zh_tw: 第二條蠕蟲到達後的15分鐘，又有一條紫蟲透過區域7的隧道進入，從南邊的迴音室挖掘隧道T3進入東側的迴音室，然後透過區域14的蠕蟲隧道離開。

english: Visiting worms are heralded by a low rumbling sound 2 minutes before they appear. (The bats in area 9 also swarm and flee their roost 1 minute before a purple worm appears.) Purple worms ignore intruders except those in areas 5 or 8, but they won't pursue anyone fleeing from those areas.
zh_tw: 來訪的蠕蟲在出現前2分鐘會伴隨著低沉的隆隆聲。（區域9中的蝙蝠在紫蟲出現前1分鐘也會成群結隊地逃離它們的棲息地。）紫蟲會忽略入侵者，除非是在區域5或8的入侵者，但它們不會追擊從這些區域逃跑的任何人。

english: 3. Ossuary
zh_tw: 3. 骨灰堂

english: This 30-foot-high chamber is dimly lit by luminescent lichen. Thousands of bones carpet the cavern floor, including many recognizable as humanoid (primarily dwarf, elf, and goblin) and some belonging to strange and unidentifiable creatures. Exactly where the bones came from is a mystery. A crack in the south wall leads to area 4.
zh_tw: 這個30尺高的洞室由發光的苔蘚微弱照明。成千上萬的骨頭覆蓋著洞穴地面，包括許多可以識別為人形生物（主要是矮人、精靈和地精）的骨頭，還有一些屬於奇怪且無法識別的生物。這些骨頭究竟來自何處是個謎。南牆上的裂縫通向區域4。

english: The tunnel marked T1 on the map doesn't exist until a purple worm creates it fifteen minutes after the party discovers area 1 (see the "{@area Worm Nursery: General Features|464|x}" sidebar). Thus, the characters won't be able to reach area 8 until the tunnel is formed.
zh_tw: 地圖上標記為T1的隧道在紫蟲在隊伍發現區域1後的15分鐘內創造它之前並不存在（見"{@area 蠕蟲託兒所：一般特徵|464|x}"側邊欄）。因此，直到隧道形成後，角色們才能夠到達區域8。

english: 4. Chasm
zh_tw: 4. 裂谷

english: This 30-foot-high unlit cavern has a twenty-foot-wide pit in its center, which descends a thousand feet. Thirty feet down is a small ledge holding the skeletal remains of a moon elf adventurer clad in moldering leather armor.
zh_tw: 這個30尺高的未照明洞穴中心有一個20尺寬的坑，深達一千尺。在下方30尺處有一個小平臺，上面有一個月精靈冒險家的骨骼殘骸，他穿著破舊的皮甲。

english: Scaling the chasm walls without gear requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 在沒有裝備的情況下攀越裂谷牆壁需要透過一次 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The skeleton still wears a {@item ring of free action} on one bony finger.
zh_tw: 骷髏的一根骨頭手指上仍然戴著一枚{@item ring of free action||自由行動戒指}。

english: 5. Echo Chambers
zh_tw: 5. 回聲室

english: These three 60-foot-high caverns, hollowed out and expanded by purple worms, are set around area 8 as a defensive measure. Using their saliva, the worms have created thick, resinous strands that stretch from wall to wall. These strands are 2 feet thick and suspended some 50 feet above the floor.
zh_tw: 這三個60尺高的洞穴是由紫蟲挖掘和擴大的，它們圍繞區域8作為防禦措施。這些蟲子使用它們的唾液製造了厚而粘稠的絲線，這些絲線從牆到牆延伸。這些絲線厚度為2尺，懸掛在離地面50尺的高空中。

english: Any noise in one of these chambers (including a normal speaking voice or metal striking metal) causes the strands to reverberate, creating a loud humming that echoes throughout the surrounding caverns, alerting the {@creature Purple Worm||purple worms} to the presence of trespassers.
zh_tw: 這些洞穴中的任何一箇中的任何噪音（包括正常說話的聲音或金屬撞擊金屬的聲音）都會導致絲線共振，產生響亮的嗡嗡聲，這種聲音在周圍的洞穴中迴盪，提醒{@creature Purple Worm||紫蟲}有入侵者的存在。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the adventurers set off a humming in one of these echo chambers, a distant rumbling can be heard and felt as a purple worm burrows toward the egg chamber, arriving there in {@dice 1d4} minutes (see area 8 for details).
zh_tw: 如果冒險者在這些迴音室中的任何一個引發了嗡嗡聲，可以聽到並感覺到遠處的隆隆聲，因為一條紫蟲正朝卵室挖掘前進，將在{@dice 1d4}分鐘內到達那裡（詳見區域8）。

english: 6. Caretaker's Quarters
zh_tw: 6. 管理員宿舍

english: Phosphorescent lichen clings to the walls of this 30-foot-high cavern. Stronk, a brutish {@creature fomorian}, lairs here. Somehow the giant formed a bond with the purple worms, becoming a caretaker of their eggs. He regularly checks the eggs, brushes fungus off them, and defends them against predators.
zh_tw: 發光的苔蘚附著在這個30尺高的洞穴的牆壁上。斯特朗克，一個粗野的{@creature fomorian||廢陋巨人}，在這裡棲息。不知何故，這個巨人與紫蟲建立了聯絡，成為它們卵的看護者。他定期檢查卵，刷去上面的真菌，並保護它們免受捕食者的侵害。

english: Stronk is sleeping on a pile of skins and loudly snoring when the adventurers arrive. Characters looking around the room can see the remnants of the fomorian's grim meals—travelers lost in the Wormwrithings or egg-hunting adventurers.
zh_tw: 當冒險者們到達時，斯特朗克正睡在一堆皮毛上，大聲地打鼾。環顧房間的角色可以看到廢陋巨人可怕餐食的殘餘——在蠕蟲扭道中迷路的旅行者或尋找蟲卵的冒險者。

english: Venturing into Stronk's lair without waking him requires a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. If awakened, the fomorian shouts out about "killing egg thieves" and "protecting my precious ones," then fights to defend the nesting area and protect the eggs. If Stronk is reduced to half his hit points or fewer, he charges into the adjoining echo chamber (area 5) and bellows to summon a {@creature purple worm} before rejoining the battle.
zh_tw: 在沒有驚醒斯特朗克的情況下進入他的巢穴，需要透過一個成功值為 {@dc 12} 的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定。如果被驚醒，這個巨人會大喊"殺死偷蛋賊"和"保護我的寶貝"，然後為保衛巢穴和保護蛋而戰。如果斯特朗克的生命值減少到一半或更低，他會衝進相鄰的迴音室（區域5）並咆哮召喚一隻 {@creature purple worm||紫蟲}，然後重新加入戰鬥。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: All the treasure Stronk has taken from his victims has been placed under his sleeping skins for safekeeping: 40 pp, an electrum brooch worth 120 gp, six gems worth 50 gp each, two {@item Potion of Greater Healing||potions of greater healing}, and a book of drow poetry worth 100 gp.
zh_tw: 斯特朗克從他的受害者那裡得到的所有財寶都被放在他睡覺的皮毛下面以保安全：40 pp（白金硬幣），一枚價值120金幣的赤金胸針，六顆每顆價值50金幣的寶石，兩瓶{@item Potion of Greater Healing||高等治療藥水}，以及一本價值100金幣的卓爾詩集。

english: 7. Entry Chamber
zh_tw: 7. 入口室

english: This cavern rises to a height of 50 feet and contains many stalagmites and stalactites. A purple worm tunnel leads out into the Wormwrithings through this area, but the tunnel's mouth is 40 feet above the cavern floor. Scaling the rock wall to reach the tunnel requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴高達50尺，內含許多石筍和鐘乳石。一條紫蠕蟲隧道從這裡通向蠕蟲扭道，但隧道入口位於洞穴地面以上40尺處。若要攀爬巖壁到達隧道，需成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Zhora Hallen and her Dark Hunters enter the purple worm nursery by scaling down the rock wall here shortly after the adventurers arrive (see "Dark Hunters," below). Characters can also leave the nursery and return to the Wormwrithings via this route.
zh_tw: 佐拉·哈倫和她的黑暗獵人在冒險者到達後不久透過攀登這裡的巖壁進入紫蟲託兒所（見下文的"黑暗獵人"）。角色們也可以透過這條路線離開託兒所並返回蠕蟲扭道。

english: Hanne's Help
zh_tw: 漢娜的幫助

english: Educated by her mother, {@creature Hanne Hallen|OotA} (see "{@area Voice in the Dark|45c|x}") knows quite a bit about purple worms. If she's traveling with the characters, she realizes that they are in a worm nursery as soon as she enters area 8. She also recognizes the echo chambers (area 5) and understands their function. Hanne won't want to leave the nursery without an egg of her own. If necessary, she'll sneak away from the rest of the party to try to obtain one.
zh_tw: 她由她的母親教育，{@creature Hanne Hallen|OotA|漢娜·哈倫}（見"{@area 黑暗中的聲音|45c|x}"）對紫色蠕蟲瞭解甚多。如果她與角色們一同旅行，她一進入區域8就會意識到他們身處一個蠕蟲育嬰室。她還能認出回聲室（區域5）並理解其功能。漢娜不想在沒有自己的蛋的情況下離開育嬰室。如果有必要，她會從隊伍中溜走，試圖獲得一個蛋。

english: 8. Egg Chamber
zh_tw: 8. 卵室

english: The ceiling of this cavern is 80 feet high. A pair of purple worms have laid their eggs here, cementing them together and anchoring them to the cavern walls with their resinous saliva. Seven clusters hold six eggs each, as noted on the map. Each egg is a silvery sphere 3 feet in diameter. Its shell is tough (AC 20), but an egg is destroyed if it takes any amount of damage.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴的天花板高達80尺。一對紫蟲在這裡產下它們的卵，用它們的樹脂性唾液將它們粘合在一起，並將其錨定在洞穴壁上。七個卵簇中每個包含六個卵，如地圖上所註明。每個卵是一個直徑3尺的銀色球體。它的殼很堅硬（護甲等級20），但是隻要卵受到任何傷害就會被破壞。

english: Three of the four resin strands anchoring the network of egg clusters to the cavern walls feature stray threads that drop all the way down to the cave floor. It's possible to climb up to the strands at these points to reach the eggs. Traversing the strands is slow going; each 1 foot of distance costs 3 feet of movement. Anyone fighting or taking strenuous action atop a strand must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check to avoid falling off. An adventurer who reaches an egg cluster and has a suitable cutting tool (such as a dagger, sword, or axe) can carefully hack an egg out in {@dice 2d4} minutes.
zh_tw: 四根將卵群網路錨定在洞穴壁上的樹脂線中，有三根有著一直延伸到洞穴地面的鬆散線頭。可以爬升到這些線頭處到達卵群。穿越這些線頭速度緩慢；每移動1尺需要消耗3尺的移動距離。任何線上頭上戰鬥或進行劇烈動作的人必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定以避免跌落。一個到達卵群並擁有適合切割工具（如匕首、劍或斧）的冒險者可以在 {@dice 2d4} 分鐘內小心地切割出一個卵。

english: The upper reaches of the egg chamber are covered in webs spun by the giant spiders in area 11. Some of these webs reach all the way down to the egg clusters.
zh_tw: 卵室的上部覆蓋著區域11中巨人蜘蛛所織的網。這些網中的一些一直延伸到卵簇處。

english: For every five minutes the adventurers spend in this room, check for a random encounter by rolling a {@dice d20} and consulting the Egg Chamber Encounters table.
zh_tw: 每當冒險者在這個房間花費五分鐘，透過擲一個{@dice d20}並查閱卵房遭遇表來檢查隨機遭遇。

english: Egg Chamber Encounters
zh_tw: 卵室遭遇戰

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: No encounter
zh_tw: 無事發生

english: 1 {@creature giant spider} from area 11
zh_tw: 來自區域11的1個{@creature giant spider||巨蜘蛛}

english: 1 {@creature purple worm}
zh_tw: 1 {@creature purple worm||紫蟲}

english: The giant spider walks on the ceiling and surprises the adventurers unless someone in the party has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 14 or higher.
zh_tw: 這隻巨型蜘蛛在天花板上行走，並且會突襲冒險者，除非隊伍中有人的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分為 14 或更高。

english: If a purple worm appears, it enters the nursery through the tunnel in area 7 and circles the outside of the cavern. Any party member in the egg chamber can try to hide with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. A failed check means the party member attracts the worm's attention.
zh_tw: 如果出現一條紫色蠕蟲，它會透過區域7的隧道進入育嬰室，並在洞穴外圍遊蕩。任何在卵室中的隊伍成員都可以嘗試透過成功的{@dc 10}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定來隱藏。檢定失敗意味著該隊伍成員將吸引蠕蟲的注意力。

english: The purple worm attacks anyone it detects in the chamber except the giant spiders from area 11 and the fomorian from area 6. It won't pursue fleeing characters anywhere except into the adjoining echo chambers (area 5) or the slop cave (area 10). If it doesn't detect any intruders, the purple worm exits the complex through the tunnel in area 7, passing through the nearest echo chamber along the way.
zh_tw: 紫色蠕蟲會攻擊它在室內探測到的任何人，除了來自區域 11 的巨型蜘蛛和來自區域 6 的廢陋巨人。它不會追擊逃跑的角色，除非是進入相鄰的回聲室（區域 5）或潲水洞（區域 10）。如果它沒有探測到任何入侵者，紫色蠕蟲會透過區域 7 中的隧道離開這個複合體，並在途中穿過最近的回聲室。

english: 9. Bat Cave
zh_tw: 9. 蝙蝠洞

english: This cave is thick with stalactites and stalagmites, and home to thousands of bats. The cavern floor is covered in a thick layer of guano, making the floor {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. The bats spend most of their time clinging to the cavern's 60-foot-high ceiling, but the noise of the purple worms drives them into a shrieking, flapping frenzy.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴裡鐘乳石和石筍密佈，是成千上萬只蝙蝠的棲息地。洞穴地面覆蓋著厚厚的一層糞便，使得地面成為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。這些蝙蝠大部分時間都附著在洞穴60尺高的天花板上，但是紫色蠕蟲的噪音使它們陷入了尖叫、拍打翅膀的狂亂中。

english: Whenever a purple worm enters the area 8 (whether as a random encounter or in response to an alarm from area 5, or as noted in the "Worm Nursery: General Features" sidebar), a {@creature swarm of bats} flies out of the cave 1 minute before the worm appears. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine which way the bats go. On a roll of 1–3, the bats take the shortest route to the tunnel in area 7 and exit through that tunnel. On a roll of 4–6, the bats take the shortest route to the tunnel in area 14 and exit through that tunnel.
zh_tw: 每當一隻紫色蠕蟲進入區域8（無論是作為隨機遭遇，還是作為對區域5警報的響應，或如在"蠕蟲託兒所：一般特徵"邊欄中所註明的），一群{@creature swarm of bats||蝙蝠群}在蠕蟲出現前1分鐘從洞穴中飛出。擲一個{@dice d6}來決定蝙蝠飛往哪個方向。如果擲出1-3，蝙蝠將沿著最短的路線飛向區域7的隧道，並透過該隧道離開。如果擲出4-6，蝙蝠將沿著最短的路線飛向區域14的隧道，並透過該隧道離開。

english: The swarm doesn't attack unless threatened, but any creature that occupies an area the swarm passes through is buffeted by scores of bats, taking {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 除非受到威脅，否則這群生物不會攻擊，但任何佔據這群生物經過區域的生物都會被成群的蝙蝠衝擊，受到{@dice 1d4}點鈍擊傷害。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: When the purple worm that caused the bats to swarm exits the nursery, the bats return to this cave to roost 10 minutes later.
zh_tw: 當引起蝙蝠群聚的紫色蠕蟲離開託兒所後，蝙蝠會在10分鐘後返回這個洞穴棲息。

english: 10. Slop Cave
zh_tw: 10. 泔水洞

english: The floor of this dark, 60-foot-high cavern is covered in a thick layer of viscous purple worm saliva. Consequently, the floor is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. As they enter, adventurers notice dozens of glinting objects in the goo beneath their feet. Further inspection reveals the sparkling objects are precious gems.
zh_tw: 這個黑暗的、60尺高的洞穴地面覆蓋著一層厚厚的粘稠紫色蠕蟲唾液。因此，地面是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。當冒險者進入時，他們注意到腳下的粘液中有數十個閃閃發光的物體。進一步檢查發現這些閃閃發光的物體是珍貴的寶石。

english: For every minute the adventurers spend in this cave, there is a 25 percent chance they attract the attention of {@dice 1d4} {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} from area 11. The spiders scuttle along the walls and ceiling, avoiding the gooey floor.
zh_tw: 冒險者在這個洞穴中每停留一分鐘，就有25%的機率吸引來自區域11的{@dice 1d4}只{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}的注意。蜘蛛沿著牆壁和天花板爬行，避開黏糊糊的地板。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If the adventurers take 10 minutes to search through the goo, they can retrieve a total of twenty 50 gp gems.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者花費10分鐘在粘液中搜尋，他們總共可以回收二十顆價值50金幣的寶石。

english: 11. Spider Nest
zh_tw: 11. 蜘蛛巢穴

english: Giant spiders enjoy a symbiotic relationship with purple worms and are frequently found lairing in purple worm nurseries. The multitude of predators that seek out the worms' eggs provide the spiders with easy prey, while the presence of the spiders provides additional protection for the hatchery.
zh_tw: 巨型蜘蛛與紫蟲享有共生關係，常被發現棲息於紫蟲育嬰巢穴中。大量尋找蟲卵的捕食者為蜘蛛提供了容易捕獲的獵物，而蜘蛛的存在也為孵化場提供了額外的保護。

english: The eastern half of this cavern floor is covered in webs stretching up to the ceiling. See "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for rules about webs. Eight {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} lurk in the nest, minus any killed elsewhere in the nursery.
zh_tw: 洞穴地板的東半部分被延伸至天花板的蛛網覆蓋。有關蛛網的規則，請參見{@i 城主指南}第5章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"。八隻{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}潛伏在巢穴中，減去在幼崽區其他地方被殺死的數量。

english: 12. Chasm
zh_tw: 12. 裂谷

english: A chasm cuts across this cavern, stretching from wall to wall. The chasm is 10 feet wide, 200 feet deep, and slopes down to the southwest at a sixty degree angle. The chasm's slope can be climbed with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A creature that fails the check by 5 or more goes tumbling down the slop to the bottom of the chasm, taking damage from the fall as normal.
zh_tw: 一道深淵橫穿這個洞穴，從一面牆延伸到另一面牆。深淵寬10尺，深200尺，向西南方向以60度角傾斜。深淵的斜坡可以透過一個成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定攀爬。檢定失敗且差值超過5的生物會沿著斜坡翻滾到深淵底部，並如常承受墜落傷害。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: At the bottom of the chasm lie the skeletons of two svirfneblin who tried to leap across the chasm while being chased by a purple worm. Lying near the remains are two miner's picks and a small leather pouch containing a {@item gem of brightness}.
zh_tw: 在裂縫底部躺著兩個地底侏儒的骨架，它們在被紫色蠕蟲追趕時試圖跳過裂縫。在殘骸附近有兩把礦工鎬和一個裝有 {@item gem of brightness||光彩奪目寶石} 的小皮袋。

english: 13. Exit Tunnel
zh_tw: 13. 出口隧道

english: Characters can exit the worm nursery and return to the Wormwrithings via this purple worm tunnel.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過這條紫色蠕蟲隧道離開蠕蟲託兒所，返回到蠕蟲扭道。

english: The Dark Hunters
zh_tw: 黑暗獵手

english: The Dark Hunters consist of Zhora Hallen (a {@creature drow elite warrior}) and ten {@creature drow}. Each carries adventuring equipment (bedroll, rope, a flask of oil), three days' worth of food and water rations, and {@dice 2d6 × 10} gp. Zhora and her comrades survived the purple worm attack that separated them from Hanne (see "{@area Voice in the Dark|45c|x}"). Zhora believes that Hanne is dead.
zh_tw: 黑暗獵人由佐拉·哈倫（一個 {@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}）和十個 {@creature drow||卓爾} 組成。每個人都攜帶著冒險裝備（鋪蓋、繩索、一瓶油）、足夠三天的食物和水配給，以及 {@dice 2d6 × 10} 金幣。佐拉和她的同伴們在紫色蠕蟲的攻擊中倖存下來，這次攻擊使他們與漢娜分開（見"{@area 黑暗中的聲音|45c|x}"）。佐拉認為漢娜已經死了。

english: Twenty minutes after the characters first enter the purple worm nursery through area 1, Zhora and her Dark Hunters enter these caverns through the tunnel in area 7, then scale down to the cavern floor. They spend a few minutes regrouping and making their way through the southern echo chamber, then arrive in area 8 and scale the resin strands to grab two purple worm eggs. If they encounter the adventurers and Hanne isn't present, the drow are hostile, though they might be convinced to enter a temporary truce with a successful {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check.
zh_tw: 角色首次透過區域1進入紫色蠕蟲培育室20分鐘後，佐拉和她的黑暗獵手們透過區域7的隧道進入這些洞穴，然後下降到洞穴地面。他們花費幾分鐘時間重新集結並穿過南部回聲室，隨後到達區域8，並攀爬樹脂絲以獲取兩顆紫色蠕蟲卵。如果他們遇到冒險者且漢娜不在場，這些卓爾將會敵對，但如果成功透過一次{@dc 20}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，他們可能會被說服達成暫時休戰。

english: If Hanne is with the party and has been well treated, she and her mother have a quiet reunion. Zhora gravely promises the adventurers that she will repay the debt she owes them however she can.
zh_tw: 如果漢娜與隊伍在一起並且得到了良好的對待，她和她的母親會有一個平靜的團聚。佐拉嚴肅地向冒險者們承諾，她會盡她所能償還她欠他們的債務。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters reunite Zhora and Hanne, this act of benevolence could lead to Zhora potentially aiding the adventurers in chapter 15, "{@adventure The City of Spiders|OotA|14}." See that chapter for details.
zh_tw: 如果角色們讓佐拉和漢娜團聚，這一仁慈的行為可能會使佐拉在第十五章'{@adventure 蜘蛛之城|OotA|14}'中潛在地幫助冒險者。詳情見該章節。

english: The Vast Oblivium
zh_tw: 廣袤的遺忘之地

english: Following Vizeran's directions, the characters find the chasm known as the Vast Oblivium—the lair of the beholder Karazikar—twelve miles from the purple worm nursery.
zh_tw: 按照維茲蘭的指示，角色們找到了被稱為廣漠遺忘之隙的裂縫——那是巨眼怪卡拉茲卡爾的巢穴——距離紫色蠕蟲託兒所十二英里。

english: The beholder created the Vast Oblivium using its disintegration eye ray. This lair consists of a central chasm known as "Karazikar's Maw," surrounded by ten vertical shafts. These are interconnected with horizontal tunnels resembling "spokes" and honeycombed with small caves used by the beholder's followers and slaves. A web of rope bridges crisscrosses the maw, connecting passages on different levels.
zh_tw: 巨眼怪使用其解離眼球射線創造了廣漠遺忘之隙。這個巢穴由一個被稱為'卡拉茲卡爾之喉'的中心裂縫組成，周圍有十個垂直井道。這些井道透過水平隧道相互連線，類似於'輻條'，並且佈滿了小洞穴，供巨眼怪的追隨者和奴隸使用。一張由繩橋構成的網路交錯在喉部上方，連線不同層次的通道。

english: Inhabitants
zh_tw: 居民
