english: Karazikar considers itself the master of all it surveys. The beholder doesn't live alone, though, keeping its lair well stocked with disposable servants.
zh_tw: 卡拉茲卡爾自認為是它所巡視的一切事物的主宰。不過，這個巨眼怪並不孤獨生活，它保持著巢穴裡充滿了一次性的僕人。

english: Karazikar the Eye Tyrant
zh_tw: 卡拉茲卡爾，眼魔暴君

english: Like most of its kind, this beholder is hateful and paranoid, trusting no one. Its servants are keenly aware that failure to please their master means death or petrification.
zh_tw: 像它的大多數同類一樣，這個巨眼怪充滿惡意且極度偏執，不信任任何人。它的僕人們非常清楚，不能取悅他們的主人意味著死亡或石化。

english: Karazikar has goals beyond simply ruling over its domain. Long ago, the beholder heard rumors of an arcane device known as the Maze Engine, capable of shifting the gears of reality. During the last Great Modron March, Karazikar captured a pentadrone and afterward became convinced the Maze Engine existed in the Underdark. Unfortunately, the modron's axiomatic mind couldn't be broken, and it perished rather than reveal anything. Since then, the beholder has made it known that it's interested in certain "curiosities," and it rewards anyone who brings it more modrons or hints about the existence or location of the Maze Engine (which is described in {@area chapter 14|4c8|x}).
zh_tw: 卡拉茲卡爾的目標不僅僅是統治自己的領地。很久以前，這個巨眼怪聽說了一個神秘的裝置，被稱為迷宮引擎，它能夠改變現實的齒輪。在上一次大型魔冢行進期間，卡拉茲卡爾捕獲了一個五元冢，之後便確信迷宮引擎存在於幽暗地域。不幸的是，魔冢那不可侵犯的心智無法被打破，它寧願死去也不願透露任何資訊。從那時起，巨眼怪就公開表示對某些"珍品"感興趣，並獎勵任何帶給它更多魔冢或關於迷宮引擎存在或位置線索的人（這在 {@area 第十四章|4c8|x} 中有所描述）。

english: Shedrak of the Eyes
zh_tw: 眼睛之沙德拉克

english: The beholder's favorite slave is a human named {@creature Shedrak of the Eyes|OotA}. As Karazikar's "high priest," he leads other slaves in worship of their master and carries out the beholder's commands.
zh_tw: 這個巨眼怪最喜歡的奴隸是一個名叫{@creature Shedrak of the Eyes|OotA|眼睛之沙德拉克}的人類。作為卡拉茲卡爾的'高階祭司'，他領導其他奴隸崇拜他們的主人並執行巨眼怪的命令。

english: Formerly an adventurer from the surface world, Shedrak and his companions delved too deeply into the Wormwrithings. His companions became Karazikar's playthings for a time, but Shedrak alone was able to resist and withstand all ten of the beholder's eye rays. Impressed by this feat of extraordinary luck, Karazikar made the human his acolyte after breaking his mind and his will. Shedrak is completely mad, considers Karazikar a god, and brooks no defiance or disrespect toward his "divine master."
zh_tw: 沙德拉克曾是地表世界的一名冒險者，他和他的同伴深入探索了蠕蟲扭道。他的同伴一度成為了卡拉茲卡爾的玩物，但只有沙德拉克能夠抵抗並承受住巨眼怪全部十道眼球射線。卡拉茲卡爾對這個非凡運氣的壯舉印象深刻，於是在摧毀了他的心智和意志後，使這個人類成為了他的追隨者。沙德拉克完全瘋了，將卡拉茲卡爾視為神明，並且不允許對他的"神聖主人"有任何違抗或不敬。

english: Slaves
zh_tw: 奴隸

english: One hundred slaves of various humanoid races serve the beholder. Some were captured while wandering too far from their Underdark settlements, while others were purchased in the slave bazaars of Menzoberranzan. The youngest slaves were born in the Vast Oblivium and raised here, knowing no other life. Many of the beholder's slaves worship it, particularly those born here, their minds warped by the aberration's charm rays and their lifelong captivity.
zh_tw: 一百名來自不同類人種族的奴隸為巨眼怪服務。有些是在遠離他們幽暗地域定居點時被捕獲的，而其他一些則是在魔索布萊城的奴隸市場上購買的。最年輕的奴隸出生在廣漠遺忘之隙並在這裡長大，他們不知道還有其他生活。許多巨眼怪的奴隸崇拜它，特別是那些在這裡出生的人，他們的心智被這個異怪的魅力射線和他們一生的囚禁扭曲了。

english: All of the slaves fear Karazikar, and the notion of acting against the beholder seems impossible to them. However, witnessing the bravery of the adventurers has a chance to sway them. If the characters demonstrate their willingness to challenge the beholder (including by killing Shedrak), surviving slaves can be convinced to aid them with a successful {@dc 16} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. On a failed check, slaves either attack the characters or hide from them, waiting for Karazikar to deal with them.
zh_tw: 所有的奴隸都害怕卡拉齊卡爾，對他們來說，反抗眼魔的念頭似乎是不可想象的。然而，目睹冒險者們的勇敢行為有可能動搖他們的決心。如果角色們表現出挑戰眼魔的意願（包括殺死謝德拉克），透過一次成功的 {@dc 16} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，倖存的奴隸可以被說服協助他們。如果檢定失敗，奴隸們要麼攻擊角色，要麼躲藏起來，等待卡拉齊卡爾來對付他們。

english: The Vast Oblivium: General Features
zh_tw: 廣漠遺忘之隙：一般特徵

english: The characters encounter the following features in the alien landscape of the Vast Oblivium.
zh_tw: 角色們在廣漠遺忘之隙的異域景觀中遇到了以下特徵。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: The tunnels and chambers of the Vast Oblivium are dimly lit by glowing fungi and lichen.
zh_tw: 廣漠遺忘之隙的隧道和洞室被髮光的真菌和地衣微弱地照亮。

english: Bridges
zh_tw: 橋

english: The central chasm of Karazikar's Maw is 100 feet across, spanned by bridges made of gut and zurkhwood that are anchored to metal rings in the rock walls of the tunnel entrances. The tunnels are staggered so that the bridges cross over each other at different points. From any bridge, a character can climb or drop 10 feet to reach a bridge leading to a tunnel on an adjacent level.
zh_tw: 卡拉茲卡爾之喉的中心裂縫寬100尺，裂縫上搭建了由腸線和祖爾木製成的橋樑，這些橋樑錨固在隧道入口巖壁上的金屬環中。隧道是錯落有致的，因此橋樑在不同的點相互交叉。從任何一座橋樑上，角色可以攀爬或下降10尺到達通往相鄰層隧道的橋樑。

english: Chasm
zh_tw: 大裂谷

english: The chasm of Karazikar's Maw extends some five hundred feet below the lowest bridged tunnels, plunging into darkness. A fall into the chasm deals {@dice 20d6} bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 卡拉齊卡爾之口的裂隙向下延伸至最低的橋接隧道下方約五百尺，陷入黑暗。跌入裂隙會造成{@dice 20d6}點鈍擊傷害。

english: Shafts
zh_tw: 豎井

english: The ten vertical shafts around the perimeter of the chasm are each 30 feet wide and 100 feet from top to bottom. They're located 100 feet from the edge of the chasm and connected to it by tunnels. Each shaft features side chambers and small caverns, and has rope ladders for Karazikar's slaves to move up and down them.
zh_tw: 圍繞裂縫周邊的十個垂直井道每個寬30尺，從頂部到底部100尺。它們位於裂縫邊緣100尺處，並透過隧道與裂縫相連。每個井道都有側室和小洞穴，並且有繩梯供卡拉茲卡爾的奴隸上下移動。

english: Arrival
zh_tw: 抵達

english: When the characters come within a mile of the Vast Oblivium, they feel a growing sense of being watched. They catch glimpses of eyes peering out of the shadows. These eyes close and vanish when anyone tries to focus on them, and adventurers who search for signs of what caused them must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 當角色們進入廣袤遺忘域一英里範圍內時，他們會逐漸感到被監視的感覺。他們會瞥見陰影中有眼睛在窺視。當任何人試圖集中注意力觀察這些眼睛時，它們會閉上並消失。尋找這些眼睛來源跡象的冒險家們必須成功透過一次{@dc 11}的感知豁免檢定，否則將獲得一級瘋狂（詳見第2章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。

english: The characters' tunnel ends at the top of one of the exterior shafts of the Vast Oblivium (see "{@area The Vast Oblivium: General Features|482|x}" sidebar). Characters can use the rope ladders to reach the bottom of the shaft, and from there make their way to the chasm known as Karazikar's Maw.
zh_tw: 角色們的隧道在廣漠遺忘之隙的一個外部豎井頂部結束（見"廣漠遺忘之隙：一般特徵"的側邊欄，{@area 廣漠遺忘之隙：一般特徵|482|x}）。角色們可以使用繩梯到達豎井底部，並從那裡前往被稱為卡拉茲卡爾之喉的裂縫。

english: Welcome to Karazikar's Maw
zh_tw: 歡迎來到卡拉茲卡爾之喉

english: Shedrak meets visitors at the chasm, greeting them in the name of his master, the great {@creature Beholder||Karazikar}, and asking their business. Use the {@creature mage} statistics to represent Shedrak, with the following modifications:
zh_tw: 沙德拉克在裂縫處迎接訪客，以他主人的名義，偉大的{@creature Beholder||眼魔}，向他們問候，並詢問他們的來意。使用{@creature mage||魔法師}的具體數值來代表沙德拉克，並進行以下修改：

english: Shedrak is chaotic evil.
zh_tw: 沙德拉克是混亂邪惡的。

english: He has ten small eyes tattooed on his bald head that allow him to see {@condition invisible} creatures and objects as if they were visible.
zh_tw: 他的光頭上紋有十隻小眼睛，這使他能夠像看到可見生物和物體一樣看到{@condition invisible||隱形}生物和物體。

english: He carries a nonmagical staff topped with a varnished beholder eye. Karazikar can see through this eye and treats it as one of its own eyes for the purpose of using its eye rays. Breaking the staff renders the eye inert and prevents Karazikar from using this property.
zh_tw: 他攜帶著一根無魔法的法杖，法杖頂部裝飾著一個上了漆的巨眼怪眼睛。卡拉茲卡爾可以透過這隻眼睛觀察，並且為了使用它的眼球射線，將其視作自己的眼睛之一。破壞這根法杖會使眼睛失去活性，阻止卡拉茲卡爾使用這個特性。

english: He carries a {@item potion of healing}, a {@item potion of poison}, and a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell globe of invulnerability}.
zh_tw: 他攜帶著一瓶{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}，一瓶{@item potion of poison||劇毒藥水}，以及一張包含{@spell globe of invulnerability||法術無效結界}的{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸}。

english: As long as the adventurers are respectful toward Shedrak and his master—and particularly if they claim to carry messages or items of possible interest to the beholder—Shedrak agrees to lead them to Karazikar.
zh_tw: 只要冒險者們對沙德拉克和他的主人表現出尊重——特別是如果他們聲稱攜帶著可能對巨眼怪感興趣的資訊或物品——沙德拉克同意帶領他們去見卡拉茲卡爾。

english: If the characters become hostile, Shedrak orders them to depart, lest they provoke the wrath of his all-powerful master. If attacked, he uses his {@spell globe of invulnerability} scroll, casts {@spell fly} on himself, and flies into the chasm.
zh_tw: 如果角色們表現出敵意，沙德拉克會命令他們離開，以免激怒他無所不能的主人。如果遭到攻擊，他會使用他的{@spell globe of invulnerability||法術無效結界}卷軸，對自己施放{@spell fly||飛行術}法術，並飛入裂縫中。

english: Shedrak allows up to ten party members accompany him, demanding that the rest of the expeditionary force remain behind. Shedrak then leads the smaller group across a bridge into the middle of Karazikar's Maw.
zh_tw: 沙德拉克允許最多十名隊伍成員陪同他，要求遠徵軍的其餘人員留在後面。然後，沙德拉克帶領這個較小的團隊穿過一座橋樑，進入卡拉茲卡爾之喉的中心地帶。

english: Audience with Karazikar
zh_tw: 與卡拉茲卡爾會面

english: Whether they're escorted by Shedrak or make their own way into Karazikar's Maw, the adventurers first encounter the {@creature beholder} as they cross the chasm. The beholder descends from the shadowy ceiling, staying at least 20 feet away from the bridge.
zh_tw: 無論他們是由謝德拉克護送還是自己進入卡拉茲卡爾之喉，冒險者們第一次遇到{@creature beholder||眼魔}是在他們跨越裂隙時。眼魔從陰暗的天花板上降下，至少保持與橋20尺的距離。

english: If the characters have come to talk, Karazikar hears them out. The beholder is supremely arrogant, and it speaks and understands only Deep Speech and Undercommon. If any of the characters bluff about having information of interest to the beholder, Karazikar mentions the Maze Engine, either to see if the adventurers know of it, or in a scoffing tone to suggest they can't possibly know anything that it has not already learned.
zh_tw: 如果角色們來談話，卡拉茲卡爾會傾聽他們。這個眼魔極其傲慢，它只說和理解深淵語和下層通用語。如果任何角色虛張聲勢，聲稱擁有對眼魔感興趣的資訊，卡拉茲卡爾會提到迷宮引擎，要麼是為了看看冒險者們是否知道它，要麼是以一種嘲笑的語調暗示他們不可能知道它尚未學到的任何東西。

english: Killing Karazikar is the only way to claim the beholder's central eye for Vizeran. At the first hint of violence, the beholder uses its disintegration ray to disintegrate a 10-foot section of the bridge, hoping to plunge one of more party members into the chasm. It then targets enemies with its other eye rays and makes full use of its lair actions (see the {@i Monster Manual}). Against characters who attempt to hide from it, the beholder uses a lair action to cause an eye to open up on a wall with line of effect to a hiding creature, then attacks with one of its eye rays.
zh_tw: 殺死卡拉齊卡爾是維茲蘭獲得眼魔中央眼球的唯一途徑。一旦察覺到暴力跡象，眼魔會使用其瓦解射線將橋樑的一段10尺長的部分瓦解，希望將一名或多名冒險者墜入深淵。然後，它會用其他眼球射線攻擊敵人，並充分利用其巢穴行動（參見 {@i 怪物圖鑑}）。對於試圖躲避它的角色，眼魔會使用巢穴行動在牆壁上開啟一個對其有視線影響的眼球，然後用其中一個眼球射線進行攻擊。

english: Karazikar's slaves fearfully scatter during any confrontation, but if Shedrak is alive, he protects his "god" as best he can. If the beholder is reduced to 45 or fewer hit points, it attempts to flee, ordering Shedrak (if he's still alive) to cover its retreat.
zh_tw: 在任何對抗中，卡拉茲卡爾的奴隸們都會恐懼地四散逃跑，但如果沙德拉克還活著，他會盡其所能保護他的"神"。如果巨眼怪的生命值降至45或更少，它將試圖逃跑，並命令沙德拉克（如果他還活著）掩護其撤退。

english: When the beholder is reduced to 0 hit points, its corpse slowly sinks, falling 10 feet at the start of every turn until it reaches the bottom of the chasm. A character within reach of the beholder can use an action to gouge out its central eye. There is also a 10 percent chance at the end of each turn that the beholder's corpse lands on a bridge.
zh_tw: 當眼魔的生命值降至0點時，它的屍體會慢慢下沉，在每個回合開始時下降10尺，直到到達裂谷的底部。在眼魔夠得到的範圍之內的角色可以使用一個動作去挖出它的中央眼。在每個回合結束時，還有10%的機率眼魔的屍體會落在橋上。

english: Freed Slaves
zh_tw: 解放的奴隸

english: If Karazikar and Shedrak are defeated, the beholder's slaves emerge from various tunnels, file out onto the bridges, and kneel in supplication, worshiping their liberators as gods. Each slave bears the brand of Karazikar on its forehead—a scar shaped like an open eye. The slaves are unarmed and include the following:
zh_tw: 如果卡拉茲卡爾和舍德拉克被擊敗，眼魔的奴隸們會從各個隧道中出現，排成一列走上橋樑，並跪下祈求，將他們的解放者當作神來崇拜。每個奴隸的額頭上都有卡拉茲卡爾的烙印——一個像睜開的眼睛形狀的疤痕。這些奴隸沒有武裝，包括以下人員：

english: 21 shield dwarf {@creature Commoner||commoners}
zh_tw: 21名盾矮人{@creature Commoner||平民}

english: 17 human {@creature Commoner||commoners}
zh_tw: 17名人類{@creature Commoner||平民}

english: 11 moon elf {@creature Commoner||commoners}
zh_tw: 11名月精靈{@creature Commoner||平民}

english: 8 female {@creature drow} and 1 male {@creature drow}
zh_tw: 8名女性{@creature drow||卓爾}和1名男性{@creature drow||卓爾}

english: 5 {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnomes}
zh_tw: 5 {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}

english: 23 {@creature Goblin||goblins}
zh_tw: 23 {@creature Goblin||地精}

english: 15 {@creature Orog||orogs}
zh_tw: 15 {@creature Orog||魔獸人}

english: All of the slaves have four levels of {@condition exhaustion} (see {@book appendix A|PHB|11} of the {@i Player's Handbook}) and can't do much more than eat and follow simple instructions. They join the party's expeditionary force if urged or ordered to do so, but they aren't effective combatants until they've rested and reduced their {@condition exhaustion} level.
zh_tw: 所有的奴隸都有四級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}（參見{@book 附錄A|PHB|11}的{@i 玩家手冊}），他們只能吃飯和遵循簡單的指令。如果被催促或命令，他們會加入隊伍的遠徵軍，但在他們休息並降低{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級之前，他們並不是有效的戰鬥人員。

english: The slaves know several intriguing bits of information:
zh_tw: 這些奴隸知道一些有趣的資訊：

english: Karazikar hid its treasure in the uppermost reaches of the chasm. The only way to reach the treasury is by levitation or flight.
zh_tw: 卡拉茲卡爾將它的寶藏藏在裂谷的最高處。到達寶庫的唯一方式是透過飄浮或飛行。

english: The beholder was preoccupied with finding an arcane contraption called the Maze Engine.
zh_tw: 這個眼魔忙於尋找一種叫做迷宮引擎的神秘裝置。

english: The beholder recently captured a strange mechanical creature that might know where the Maze Engine is located (see "{@area Modron Prisoner|48c|x}" below). The creature is locked in a room sealed with a rolling stone door. The beholder used its telekinesis eye ray to open and close the door.
zh_tw: 巨眼怪最近捕獲了一個奇怪的機械生物，這個生物可能知道迷宮引擎的位置（見下文"{@area 魔冢囚犯|48c|x}"）。這個生物被關在一個用滾動石門封閉的房間裡。巨眼怪使用其心靈遙控眼球射線來開啟和關閉門。

english: Any slaves that don't join the party are anxious to make their way to the nearest peaceful Underdark settlement. The drow are eager to return to Menzoberranzan, the deep gnomes to Blingdenstone. If the characters urge the slaves to leave the Vast Oblivium and make their own way home, they are all killed while trying to escape from the Wormwrithings. If the characters assign members of their expeditionary force to lead the slaves out of the Wormwrithings, the slaves stand a much better chance of making it to safety.
zh_tw: 那些不加入隊伍的奴隸急於前往最近的和平幽暗地域定居點。卓爾渴望返回魔索布萊城，地底侏儒渴望返回布靈登石城。如果角色們催促奴隸離開廣闊遺忘之地並自己回家，他們在試圖逃離蠕蟲扭道時都會被殺害。如果角色們指派他們的遠徵隊伍成員帶領奴隸離開蠕蟲扭道，奴隸們就有更大的機會安全抵達。

english: Lost Friends
zh_tw: 失散的朋友

english: The liberation of the Vast Oblivium makes a useful bit of backstory for introducing or reintroducing a character into the party. If an adventurer or NPC was lost in the Underdark, or if you want an NPC left behind at a settlement to put in a reappearance, have that character appear as a slave taken by Karazikar. Depending on the circumstances, the character might even join up with the adventurers during the final battle to defeat the beholder. Similarly, a new player character joining the party might start out as a prisoner of the beholder, now freed.
zh_tw: 解放廣闊遺忘之地是為引入或重新引入角色進入隊伍提供背景故事的有用方式。如果一個冒險者或NPC在幽暗地域中迷失了，或者你想讓一個留在定居點的NPC重新出現，可以讓這個角色作為被卡拉茲卡爾俘虜的奴隸出現。根據情況，這個角色甚至可能在最終戰鬥中加入冒險者，一起擊敗眼魔。同樣，一個新加入隊伍的玩家角色可能起初是眼魔的囚犯，現在被釋放了。

english: Modron Prisoner
zh_tw: 魔冢囚犯

english: One or more slaves can lead characters to a small room on the uppermost level of the complex. The room is sealed off with a 6-inch-thick circular stone door that can be rolled aside with a {@dc 20} Strength check or opened with a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic. The room holds a damaged {@creature duodrone} that Karazikar recently captured in the hopes of unlocking more information about the Maze Engine.
zh_tw: 一名或多名奴隸可以帶領角色前往建築頂層的一個小房間。房間被一扇6吋厚的圓形石門封鎖，可以透過一個{@dc 20}力量檢定推開，或者使用{@spell knock||敲擊術}或類似的魔法開啟。房間裡有一個受損的{@creature duodrone||二元冢}，這是卡拉齊卡爾最近捕獲的，希望能從中獲取更多關於迷宮引擎的資訊。

english: The duodrone has 1 hit point remaining and speaks its own language of clicks and whirs, always referring to itself as "we" or "us." The demonic madness as scrambled its memory, but if a {@spell greater restoration} spell is cast on it, the modron remembers two things:
zh_tw: 這個二元冢只剩下1點生命值，並且說著自己的咔噠聲和嗡嗡聲語言，總是用"我們"或"我們"來稱呼自己。惡魔的瘋狂已經打亂了它的記憶，但如果對它施放一個{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}法術，這個魔冢就會記起兩件事：

english: "We were part of a great march. We were separated. Then we were lost. Then we were captured. Then we started freaking out. Then you found us."
zh_tw: "我們曾是一次偉大行軍的一部分。我們被分開了。然後我們迷路了。接著我們被俘虜了。然後我們開始恐慌。然後你找到了我們。"

english: "We know nothing about a 'Maze Engine.' However, we can detect an Orderer approximately 289 miles south of our present location." (The "Orderer," claims the modron, is a device that brings order to chaos. It is, in fact, what others refer to as the Maze Engine.)
zh_tw: "我們對'迷宮引擎'一無所知。然而，我們能探測到一個'秩序者'，它大約位於我們當前位置以南289英里處。"（魔冢聲稱，"秩序者"是一種將秩序帶給混亂的裝置。實際上，它就是其他人所說的迷宮引擎。）

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The beholder used its disintegration eye ray to carve a rough likeness of itself in the ceiling of Karazikar's Maw—a great stone beholder face glaring down upon the gaping chasm, its central eye a hollow shaft that leads up to a hemispherical vault where the beholder hides its considerable hoard: 15,000 gp, 1,300 pp, ten assorted gems worth 500 gp each, a {@item gem of seeing}, a {@item necklace of adaptation}, and a {@item robe of eyes}.
zh_tw: 眼魔使用它的解離視線在卡拉茲卡爾之口的天花板上刻下了自己的粗略形象——一個巨大的石制眼魔面孔怒視著裂谷，它的中央眼是一個通向半球形藏寶室的空洞豎井，那裡藏著眼魔的大量寶藏：15,000金幣，1,300鉑金幣，十種不同寶石，每種價值500金幣，一個{@item gem of seeing||真視寶石}，一個{@item necklace of adaptation||適應項鍊}，以及一個{@item robe of eyes||百眼法袍}。

english: Chapter 14: The Labyrinth
zh_tw: 第14章：迷宮

english: More of the components needed for Vizeran's demon summoning ritual can be found in the depths of the Labyrinth—a snarl of twisting tunnels and caves extending approximately 240 miles from north to south and 120 miles east to west. Navigating the Labyrinth is a nightmare, since most tunnels follow a straight path only a short distance before doubling back on themselves or ending abruptly.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭召喚惡魔儀式所需的更多元件可以在迷宮的深處找到——迷宮是一個錯綜複雜的隧道和洞穴網路，從北到南延伸大約240英里，從東到西延伸大約120英里。在迷宮中導航是一場噩夢，因為大多數隧道在直線延伸很短的距離後就會突然折回或戛然而止。

english: Baphomet the Horned King appeared in the Labyrinth when the demon lords were summoned to the Underdark. At the same time, Baphomet's rival Yeenoghu, Demon Lord of Gnolls, has taken to hunting the twisting passages of Baphomet's new domain.
zh_tw: 當惡魔領主們被召喚到幽暗地域時，角王巴弗滅出現在了迷宮中。與此同時，巴弗滅的對手，鬣狗人之惡魔領主耶諾古，開始在巴弗滅的新領地中狩獵那些曲折的通道。

english: Vizeran tells the characters to find the Gallery of Angels, a location in the heart of the Labyrinth lies some three hundred miles from Araj. It is the one place where Vizeran knows the characters can find the angel feathers required for his ritual's talisman. The Maze Engine lies forty-eight miles deeper into the Labyrinth if the characters choose to follow up on clues leading there (see the "{@area March to Nowhere|4b5|x}" and "{@area Maze Engine|4c8|x}" sections for details). The adventurers will also find a few unexpected opportunities to aid in the fight against the demon lords along the way.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭告訴角色們找到天使畫廊，這是位於迷宮中心的一個地點，距離阿拉傑大約三百英里。這是維茲蘭知道角色們可以找到儀式護身符所需的天使羽毛的唯一地方。如果角色們選擇追蹤通往那裡的線索，迷宮引擎位於迷宮深處四十八英里處（詳見"{@area 走向虛無|4b5|x}"和"{@area 迷宮引擎|4c8|x}"部分了解詳細資訊）。冒險者們在途中還會發現一些意想不到的機會，可以幫助對抗惡魔領主。

english: Long ago, the Labyrinth was much like any other part of the Underdark, consisting largely of natural caverns connected by tunnels and underground rivers. The discovery of precious metals and gemstones led dwarves and others to excavate, extending its tunnels and expanding its caves. The results of those efforts saw an insignificant corner of the Underdark transformed into a vast, sprawling network of passages.
zh_tw: 很久以前，迷宮與幽暗地域的其他部分非常相似，主要由天然洞穴、隧道和地下河流連線而成。珍貴金屬和寶石的發現導致矮人和其他種族進行挖掘，擴充套件了它的隧道並擴大了它的洞穴。這些努力的結果是，幽暗地域中一個不起眼的角落轉變成了一個龐大、蔓延的通道網路。

english: Abandoned settlements within the Labyrinth are common, marked out by rusting iron rails and scattered ore carts. Dark mine shafts descend into the unknown depths, while tunnels stretch off in random directions. Rifts both small and large also appear throughout. Many a tunnel ends abruptly at a rift, as if the way ahead was simply sheared off to leave a vast, yawning chasm. Some of these rifts run to depths of a few hundred feet. Others ascend and descend for miles. Many of the rifts show their age by the presence of carved switchback staircases along their walls, or weathered bridges spanning their gaps.
zh_tw: 迷宮中廢棄的定居點很常見，由生鏽的鐵軌和散落的礦車標記出來。黑暗的礦井深入未知的深處，而隧道則向隨機的方向延伸。大小不一的裂縫也遍佈整個迷宮。許多隧道在裂縫處突然結束，就好像前方的道路被簡單地切斷，留下了一個巨大的、張開的裂谷。一些裂縫深達幾百尺。其他的則上升和下降數英里。許多裂縫因牆上雕刻的折返樓梯或橫跨其間隙的風化橋樑而顯露出它們的年代。

english: Characters in the Labyrinth can easily become lost. Traveling through this area follows the rules under "{@area Navigating|05a|x}" in chapter 2, but it takes a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check to avoid becoming lost, rather than a {@dc 10} check. Spellcasters must contend with the effects of the {@i faerzress} for as long as they are in the Labyrinth, also as discussed in {@area chapter 2|05f|x}.
zh_tw: 迷宮中的人物容易迷失方向。穿越此區域遵循第2章"{@area 導航|05a|x}"下的規則，但需要透過一次成功的{@dc 12}感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定來避免迷路，而不是{@dc 10}檢定。施法者在迷宮內時必須應對{@i 妖光}的影響，如第2章{@area 第二章|05f|x}所述。

english: Labyrinth Encounters
zh_tw: 迷宮遭遇

english: This chapter features a number of set encounters. Either as the characters journey to the Labyrinth or return to Vizeran's tower, you can run the "{@area Adamantine Tower|4a0|x}" encounter. Once the characters reach the edge of the Labyrinth, go to the "Spiral of the Horned Lord" encounter.
zh_tw: 這一章節包括一些固定的遭遇。無論是角色前往迷宮還是返回維茲蘭的塔樓，你都可以進行"{@area 精金塔|4a0|x}"遭遇。一旦角色到達迷宮的邊緣，就進行"角王之螺旋"遭遇。

english: Within the Labyrinth, the characters take on the encounters "{@area Filthriddens|4b2|x}," "{@area March to Nowhere|4b5|x}," "{@area Yeenoghu's Hunt|4b8|x}," and "{@area Gallery of Angels|4bc|x}" (their intended destination). They might also take on "{@area The Maze Engine|4c8|x}" encounter, inspired by knowledge gained in {@area chapter 13|47d|x} and an encounter with some modrons in the Labyrinth.
zh_tw: 在迷宮內，角色們將經歷以下遭遇："{@area 汙穢聚落|4b2|x}," "{@area 走向虛無|4b5|x}," "{@area 耶諾古的狩獵|4b8|x}," 以及 "{@area 天使畫廊|4bc|x}"（他們的預定目的地）。他們還可能參與 "{@area 迷宮引擎|4c8|x}" 遭遇，這一遭遇靈感來自於在{@area 第十三章|47d|x}中獲得的知識，以及迷宮中遇到的一些模組的遭遇。

english: Random Encounters
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇

english: Twice each day that the party spends in the Labyrinth (whether traveling or resting), roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Labyrinth Encounters table to determine what, if anything, they encounter. This table replaces the random encounter tables in {@area chapter 2|07f|x} for as long as the party remains in the Labyrinth.
zh_tw: 每當隊伍在迷宮中度過一天（無論是旅行還是休息），每天需擲兩次{@dice d20}，並參考迷宮遭遇表以確定他們是否會遭遇什麼。只要隊伍仍在迷宮中，此表將替代{@area 第二章|07f|x}的隨機遭遇表。

english: Random Encounter Locations
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇地點

english: Random encounters in the Labyrinth take place in one of the following environments, modified as you wish to suit the creatures in the encounter.
zh_tw: 迷宮中的隨機遭遇發生在以下環境之一中，您可以根據遭遇中的生物進行適當的修改。

english: Caves
zh_tw: 洞穴

english: Most caves in the Labyrinth are small (up to 30 feet in diameter), with uneven floors featuring stalagmites, columns, or pools of standing water. A cave has a 10 percent chance of featuring luminescent growth on the walls that fill it with {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. In addition to the tunnel through which the characters enter, there are {@dice 1d3} additional tunnels leading out. These tunnels can exit the cave through the floor, ceiling, or at odd angles.
zh_tw: 大迷宮中的洞穴大多為小型（直徑不超過30尺），地面不平整，遍佈石筍、石柱或積水池。洞穴有10%的機率在牆壁上生長著發光菌群，使其充滿{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。除了角色進入的隧道外，還有{@dice 1d3}條額外的隧道通向別處。這些隧道可能透過地板、天花板或以奇特的角度離開洞穴。

english: Tunnels
zh_tw: 隧道

english: Most tunnels in the Labyrinth are 5 to 10 feet wide, with ceilings {@dice 1d8 + 3} feet high. A tunnel follows a straight path for no more than {@dice 2d4 × 10} feet before it turns.
zh_tw: 迷宮中的大多數隧道寬 5 到 10 尺，天花板高度為 {@dice 1d8 + 3} 尺。一個隧道在轉彎前直線延伸的距離不超過 {@dice 2d4 × 10} 尺。

english: Rifts
zh_tw: 裂縫

english: The Labyrinth is shot through with rifts and chasms formed by upheavals in the earth. Blocks of stone thrust up in some places to hinder movement through passages and caverns, while other areas drop off suddenly, forming escarpments hundreds of feet high. In some places, the earth has shifted horizontally, creating tunnels that end suddenly only to continue hundreds of feet away.
zh_tw: 迷宮中佈滿了由地殼運動形成的裂縫和裂谷。在某些地方，石塊被推起，阻礙了透過通道和洞穴的移動，而其他區域則突然下降，形成了數百尺高的峭壁。在某些地方，地面水平移動，形成了隧道，這些隧道突然結束，但幾百尺外又繼續延伸。

english: Any rift the characters encounter has a 75 percent chance of featuring a bridge or staircase constructed to navigate it.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到的任何裂縫有75%的機率設有橋樑或樓梯，用以透過它。

english: Labyrinth Encounters
zh_tw: 迷宮遭遇

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: No encounter
zh_tw: 無事發生

english: 1 {@creature behir}
zh_tw: 1 {@creature behir||青足龍蛇}

english: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Flumph||flumphs}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Flumph||呋嚕}

english: {@creature Gnoll} pack
zh_tw: {@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}群

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Grell||grells}
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Grell||觸鬚怪}

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Hezrou||hezrous}
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Hezrou||狂蟾魔}

english: {@dice 4d8} {@creature manes}
zh_tw: {@dice 4d8} {@creature manes||原魔}

english: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Minotaur||minotaurs}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Minotaur||牛頭人}

english: 1 {@creature monodrone}
zh_tw: 1 {@creature monodrone||單元冢}

english: {@dice 2d6} {@creature Quaggoth||quaggoths}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} {@creature Quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Shrieker||shriekers}
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Shrieker||尖叫菌}

english: Behir
zh_tw: 青足龍蛇

english: This long-bodied reptile is either prowling a tunnel or resting in a cave when the characters encounter it. The {@creature behir} retreats if reduced to 80 or fewer hit points.
zh_tw: 這種長身體的爬行動物在角色們遇到它時，要麼在隧道中潛行，要麼在洞穴中休息。如果生命值降至80或以下，{@creature behir||青足龍蛇}會撤退。

english: Flumphs
zh_tw: 呋嚕

english: This cloister of {@creature Flumph||flumphs} feeds on the psychic energy they detect from a nearby {@creature mind flayer} that has enslaved {@dice 2d4} {@creature Quaggoth||quaggoths}. The flumphs warn adventurers who communicate with them about the nearby threats, but it is up to the characters whether they wish to engage those threats.
zh_tw: 這個{@creature Flumph||呋嚕}的修道院以它們從附近一個奴役了{@dice 2d4}個{@creature Quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}的{@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}那裡探測到的心靈能量為食。呋嚕警告與它們交流的冒險者有關附近威脅的事情，但是否要應對這些威脅取決於角色們自己。

english: Gnoll Pack
zh_tw: 鬣狗人群體

english: A {@creature gnoll fang of Yeenoghu} named {@creature Kurr|OotA} made his way into the Labyrinth shortly after Yeenoghu was summoned to the Underdark. {@creature Kurr|OotA} brought with him a pack of hyenas and had them feast on the corpses of his slain victims. This heinous act transformed the hyenas into ten {@creature Gnoll||gnolls}. {@creature Kurr|OotA|Kurr's} pack now prowls the Labyrinth in search of Yeenoghu, slaughtering anything and anyone they happen upon.
zh_tw: 在耶諾古被召喚至幽暗地域後不久，一隻名為{@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾}的{@creature gnoll fang of Yeenoghu||鬣狗人·耶諾古毒牙}進入了迷宮。{@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾}帶著一群鬣狗，並讓它們以被屠殺受害者的屍體為食。這一邪惡行徑將這些鬣狗轉化為了十隻{@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}。如今{@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾}獸群遊蕩於迷宮之中尋找耶諾古，屠殺它們遇到的任何事物與生靈。

english: Unknown to his gnoll progeny, {@creature Kurr|OotA} has succumbed to a form of madness that quells his feral demeanor. He's lost his appetite for carnage and is overcome with guilt for all of the creatures he has slain. When his pack happens upon the party, he sends his gnolls into battle but doesn't partake of the violence, hoping that the characters slaughter his brethren. Once they are dead, {@creature Kurr|OotA} bows his head solemnly, begs Yeenoghu's forgiveness (first in his own language and then in Abyssal), and then throws himself at the party's mercy.
zh_tw: 他的鬣狗人後代並不知道，{@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾}已經陷入了一種使他野性舉止平息的瘋狂狀態。他對屠殺不再有興趣，對自己殺害的所有生物感到極度內疚。當他的群體偶然遇到隊伍時，他派他的鬣狗人去戰鬥，但自己卻不參與暴力，希望角色們屠殺他的同族。一旦他們死去，{@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾}莊嚴地低下頭，祈求耶諾古的原諒（先是用他自己的語言，然後用深淵語），然後把自己置於隊伍的仁慈之下。

english: {@creature Kurr|OotA} is suffering from a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) which, if cured, reverts him to a typically feral gnoll. While afflicted with madness, {@creature Kurr|OotA} can't bring himself to kill any living creature except in self-defense. If the characters spare his life, {@creature Kurr|OotA} can act as a guide, for he has explored a great deal of the Labyrinth and can lead the characters along a safe route to an Underdark shanty town (see "{@area Filthriddens|4b2|x}"). Characters have no random encounters if they follow {@creature Kurr|OotA} along this route, although they periodically stumble upon the corpses and bones of Underdark creatures slain by his gnolls.
zh_tw: {@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾} 正遭受著一種永久性瘋狂（參見{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}，在{@i 城主指南}的第8章），如果被治癒，他將恢復為一個典型的野性鬣狗人。在瘋狂的影響下，{@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾} 無法讓自己殺死任何生物，除非出於自衛。如果角色們饒他一命，{@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾} 可以充當嚮導，因為他已經探索了大量迷宮，並能帶領角色們沿著一條安全的路線前往幽暗地域的貧民窟（參見{@area 汙穢聚落|4b2|x}）。如果角色們跟隨{@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾} 走這條路線，他們將不會遭遇隨機遭遇，儘管他們會不時發現被他的鬣狗人殺死的幽暗地域生物的屍體和骨頭。

english: The encounter with {@creature Kurr|OotA}'s pack occurs only once. Any subsequent occurrence of this encounter is with a pack of {@dice 3d6} {@creature Gnoll||gnolls}. These gnolls came to the Underdark with Yeenoghu. They cackle and scream the demon lord's name as they tear into their prey.
zh_tw: 與{@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾}的狼群的遭遇只會發生一次。任何隨後發生的這種遭遇都是與一群{@dice 3d6} {@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}。這些鬣狗人隨耶諾古來到幽暗地域。他們在撕咬獵物時咯咯笑並尖叫著惡魔領主的名字。

english: Grells
zh_tw: 觸鬚怪

english: The {@creature Grell||grells} drop from an overhead shaft to feed.
zh_tw: {@creature Grell||觸鬚怪}從上方的裂縫中降落下來覓食。

english: Hezrous
zh_tw: 狂蟾魔

english: These demons are tearing apart an iron ore cart, a rusted section of mining track, or some other old fixture. Party members can attempt to slip past the demons without arousing their attention. Doing so requires a successful {@dc 11} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. On a failed check, the {@creature Hezrou||demons} detect the party member and attack.
zh_tw: 這些惡魔正在撕毀一輛鐵礦石車、一段生鏽的採礦軌道或其他一些舊設施。隊員們可以嘗試在不引起惡魔注意的情況下悄悄溜過去。這需要透過一個成功難度等級為 {@dc 11} 的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定。如果檢定失敗，{@creature Hezrou||惡魔} 會察覺到隊員併發起攻擊。

english: Manes
zh_tw: 原魔

english: Characters can hear the mewling of this vile mob long before it appears. The {@creature manes} scour the Labyrinth for easy prey and move like a tide of putrid flesh.
zh_tw: 角色們在這群邪惡的暴徒出現之前很久就能聽到它們的哀嚎。{@creature manes||原魔}在迷宮中搜尋容易的獵物，它們像一股腐爛肉體的潮水一樣移動。

english: Minotaurs
zh_tw: 牛頭人

english: These {@creature Minotaur||minotaurs} roams the Labyrinth, slaying creatures in the name of Baphomet.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Minotaur||牛頭人}在迷宮中徘徊，以巴弗滅的名義屠殺生物。

english: Monodrone
zh_tw: 單元冢

english: This modron has become separated from its fellows (see "{@area March to Nowhere|4b5|x}"), and there is a 75 percent chance that it is looking to rejoin them. If the characters can understand its language, the {@creature monodrone} repeatedly says, "We are on the march!"
zh_tw: 這個魔冢已經與其同伴分離（見"{@area 走向虛無|4b5|x}"），並且有75%的機率它正在尋找重新加入它們的方法。如果角色們能夠理解它的語言，{@creature monodrone||單元冢}會反覆說："我們正在行軍！"

english: A monodrone that doesn't want to rejoin its fellows is a rogue modron, made so by the chaotic energies suffusing the Underdark. This rogue monodrone gladly joins the party, saying "Down with Primus!" in its own language over and over. Its alignment is chaotic neutral, and it can only follow one simple task at a time.
zh_tw: 一個不想重新加入同伴的單元冢是一個魔冢遊蕩者，這是由於幽暗地域中充滿的混亂能量所致。這個叛逆的單元冢會高興地加入隊伍，一遍又一遍地用自己的語言說"打倒普里穆斯！"。它的陣營是混亂中立，它一次只能執行一個簡單的任務。

english: Quaggoths
zh_tw: 幽邃熊怪們

english: These {@creature Quaggoth||quaggoths} are hungry and attack the party regardless of its size. If there are five or more quaggoths in the group, one of them is a quaggoth thonot (see the "Variant: Quaggoth Thonot" sidebar in the "Quaggoth" entry of the {@i Monster Manual}). If the thonot dies, the other quaggoths immediately break off their attack and begin feasting on the thonot's remains, hoping to gain its psionic power.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}很餓，會不顧隊伍的規模攻擊他們。如果群體中有五個或更多的幽邃熊怪，其中之一是幽邃熊怪·索諾祭司（見《{@i 怪物圖鑑}》中"幽邃熊怪"條目的"變體：幽邃熊怪·索諾祭司"側邊欄）。如果薩諾特死亡，其他幽邃熊怪會立即停止攻擊，並開始享用薩諾特的遺骸，希望獲得其靈能力量。

english: Shriekers
zh_tw: 尖叫菌

english: The {@creature Shrieker||shriekers} sound off when {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} or a creature is within 30 feet of them. Their shrieking has a 75 percent chance of attracting other monsters, in which case roll again on the Labyrinth Encounters table, treating another shrieker encounter as "no encounter."
zh_tw: 當{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}或一個生物在30尺內時，{@creature Shrieker||尖叫菌}會發出聲音。它們的尖叫聲有75%的機率吸引其他怪物，在這種情況下，在迷宮遭遇表格上重新擲骰，將另一次尖叫菌遭遇視為"無遭遇"。

english: Adamantine Tower
zh_tw: 精金塔

english: The adventurers come across a tower haunted by forces of darkness.
zh_tw: 冒險者們遇到了一座被黑暗力量所困擾的塔。

english: Vaulted chambers bristle with stalactites and stalagmites, slowing your passage as you wend your way across uneven floors. Moving through a narrow passage, you enter a cavern dimly lit by phosphorescent fungi—and are met by the sight of a dark metal tower perched on the edge of a cliff that drops away into darkness.
zh_tw: 拱形的房間佈滿了鐘乳石和石筍，當你在不平坦的地板上蜿蜒前行時，它們減慢了你的行進速度。穿過一條狹窄的通道，你進入一個由熒光菌微弱照亮的洞穴——一座黑色的金屬塔映入眼簾，它坐落在一個懸崖邊上，懸崖向下消失在黑暗中。

english: The square tower is twenty feet on a side and thirty feet high, with arrow slits in each wall. A battlement crowns its top, with a stone gargoyle peering over each side. Set into the middle of the wall facing you is a sturdy-looking door made of the same dark metal as the rest of the tower.
zh_tw: 這座方形塔每邊長二十尺，高三十尺，每一面牆上都有箭縫。塔頂裝飾著城垛，每一邊都有一個石像鬼向下窺視。面對你的牆面中央鑲嵌著一扇堅固的門，門是用與塔身相同的暗色金屬製成的。

english: No ordinary structure, the tower is a {@item Daern's instant fortress} (see chapter 7, "{@book Treasure|DMG|7}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Made entirely of adamantine, the two-story tower has remained sealed since its last owner retreated inside and locked the door behind her—but not before a pair of shadow demons slipped in as well. The demons killed the owner and left her remains on the first floor. The tower can't be tipped over or otherwise moved from its position, and the arrow slits on each level are too narrow for anything bigger than a Tiny creature to squeeze through.
zh_tw: 這並非普通的建築，這座塔是一件{@item Daern's instant fortress||迪恩的摺疊要塞}（參見{@i 城主指南}第七章"{@book 寶藏|DMG|7}"）。這座兩層塔完全由精金打造，自從它的最後一位主人退入其中並鎖上門後，塔就保持封閉狀態——但在此之前，一對影魔也悄悄溜了進去。影魔殺死了主人，並將她的遺骸留在了一樓。這座塔無法被推倒或以其他方式從其位置移動，且每層的箭縫過於狹窄，任何比微型生物更大的東西都無法擠過。

english: A character can learn the tower's command words by casting an {@spell identify} spell on it. The command word to open the front door or the trap door on the roof is "mimsy." The command word to transform the tower into a one-inch metal cube is "brillig," but speaking it has no effect since the shadow demons are still inside. To return the tower to its cube form, the adventurers must first empty it of any creatures.
zh_tw: 一個角色可以透過對它施放{@spell identify||鑑定術}法術來瞭解這座塔的命令詞。開啟前門或屋頂上的活板門的命令詞是"mimsy"。將塔變成一吋金屬立方體的命令詞是"brillig"，但說出來沒有效果，因為陰影惡魔仍然在裡面。要將塔恢復成立方體形態，冒險者們必須首先將其內的生物清空。

english: Four {@creature Gargoyle||gargoyles} perch atop the tower. They remain motionless as the characters enter the cavern, attacking only if anyone attempts to enter, climb, or damage the tower.
zh_tw: 四隻{@creature Gargoyle||石像鬼}棲息在塔頂。當角色們進入洞穴時，它們保持靜止，只有在有人試圖進入、攀爬或破壞塔時才會發起攻擊。

english: This cavern's rough floor has been flattened where the tower stands, while the floor behind the tower has collapsed into a shaft 300 feet deep and 100 feet in diameter. Several tunnels branch off from the rough-walled shaft at various points, allowing the characters to continue their journey after climbing down. They can move around the tower easily if they wish to ignore it.
zh_tw: 這座塔所在的洞穴地面被平整過，而塔後面的地面已經塌陷成一個300尺深、直徑100尺的豎井。幾個隧道從這個粗糙壁面的豎井的不同點分支出去，允許角色們在爬下去後繼續他們的旅程。如果他們願意忽略這座塔，他們可以輕鬆地繞過它移動。

english: First Floor
zh_tw: 一樓

english: The first floor of the tower is an open room. A ladder affixed to the back wall leads up through a trapdoor to the floor above. A pile of bones and moldering clothes lies in the corner—the remains of the tower's former owner.
zh_tw: 塔的一樓是一個開放的房間。一把固定在後牆上的梯子透過一個活板門通向上面的樓層。角落裡有一堆骨頭和腐爛的衣服——那是塔前主人的遺骸。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Searching through the remains turns up two empty potion bottles and a {@item potion of mind reading}.
zh_tw: 在遺骸中搜尋可以找到兩個空藥水瓶和一瓶{@item potion of mind reading||讀心藥水}。

english: Second Floor
zh_tw: 第二層

english: This empty chamber has a ladder affixed to one wall that climbs to an adamantine trap door leading to the roof. The trap door is closed and locked, though the proper command word ("mimsy") can open it.
zh_tw: 這個空蕩蕩的房間的一面牆上固定著一把梯子，梯子通向一個通往屋頂的精金活板門。活板門是關閉並上鎖的，儘管正確的命令詞（"mimsy"）可以開啟它。

english: The two {@creature Shadow Demon||shadow demons} lurk in the darkness of this room and attack the first character who enters, likely taking their prey by surprise.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature Shadow Demon||幽影惡魔}潛伏在這個房間的黑暗中，攻擊第一個進入的角色，很可能會出其不意地捕獲他們的獵物。

english: Battlements
zh_tw: 城垛

english: The top of the tower features an open space surrounded by a crenelated wall. If the four {@creature Gargoyle||gargoyles} have not yet attacked the adventurers, they do so here.
zh_tw: 塔頂是一個被帶有城垛的牆壁圍繞的開放空間。如果四隻{@creature Gargoyle||石像鬼}還沒有攻擊冒險者，它們會在這裡發起攻擊。

english: Spiral of the Horned King
zh_tw: 角冠王的螺旋

english: Minotaurs have roamed the tunnels of the Labyrinth for ages, but as Baphomet's influence grows, so too has the ferocity of his chosen servants. The waxing of Baphomet's power has not gone unnoticed by the packs of gnolls rampaging through the Underdark. The gnolls have begun making inroads into minotaur territory. The latest battlefield in the ancient feud between Baphomet and Yeenoghu is a maze of passages that grant access to the deeper passages of the Labyrinth.
zh_tw: 彌諾陶洛斯在迷宮的隧道中徘徊已有數個世紀，但隨著巴弗滅影響力的增長，他選定的僕從們的兇猛程度也在增加。巴弗滅力量的增強並沒有逃過在幽暗地域肆虐的鬣狗人群的注意。鬣狗人們開始侵入彌諾陶洛斯的領地。在巴弗滅和耶諾古之間古老的宿怨中，最新的戰場是一個迷宮般的通道，這些通道通向迷宮更深處的通道。

english: The tunnel you have been following gradually widens until it opens into a cave with a high ceiling overhead. Patches of glowing fungi cling to the walls and fill the chamber with {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. Columns of stone support the ceiling, the rock marbled with veins of glittering crystal. Across the chamber, a great cleft is ringed by a profusion of sigils and glyphs. Stacked to either side of the opening are two mounds of severed heads.
zh_tw: 你一直跟隨的隧道逐漸變寬，直到它通入一個有著高聳天花板的洞穴。發光的真菌斑塊附著在牆壁上，並用{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}充滿了密閣。石柱支撐著天花板，岩石中夾雜著閃閃發光的水晶脈絡。在密閣的另一邊，一個巨大的裂口周圍環繞著大量的印記和符文。在開口的兩側堆疊著兩堆被斬下的頭顱。

english: The cleft leads to the Spiral of the Horned King—a maze of tunnels and caves along the outer edge of the Labyrinth. Though other routes can be found into the Labyrinth, this entrance is the easiest to find.
zh_tw: 這個裂縫通向角王之螺旋——迷宮的外圍邊緣上的一系列隧道和洞穴。儘管可以找到進入迷宮的其他路線，但這個入口是最容易找到的。

english: Invocations to Baphomet, dire curses, and the inverted names of the gods are scrawled around the cleft in dried blood, and continue on down the tunnel walls. Anyone who can read the Abyssal tongue can tell that this place has been consecrated in the name of Baphomet, the Horned King and lord of minotaurs.
zh_tw: 向巴弗滅的祈禱、可怕的詛咒以及神祇名字的倒寫用幹血在裂縫周圍和隧道壁上潦草地書寫著。任何能讀懂深淵語的人都能分辨出這個地方已經以角王和彌諾陶洛斯領主巴弗滅的名義被奉獻了。

english: The minotaurs tear off their victims' heads, then leave them to "watch" the entrance for intruders. Most of the heads are from gnolls, though different Underdark races can be found if any character wants to sift through the piles.
zh_tw: 彌諾陶洛斯將受害者的頭顱撕下，然後讓它們"守衛"入口，以防入侵者。大部分頭顱來自鬣狗人，儘管如果任何角色想要翻找這些堆堆，也可以發現幽暗地域其他種族的頭顱。

english: Gash the Gnoll
zh_tw: 鬣狗人撕裂

english: Minutes after the characters arrive, they hear the sounds of footsteps approaching. A few moments later, a gnoll slinks from the tunnel ahead.
zh_tw: 角色們到達幾分鐘後，他們聽到了腳步聲接近。片刻之後，一隻鬣狗人從前方的隧道中潛行而出。

english: A gnoll creeps out of the shadows, glancing cautiously at the piles of heads to either side of it. Its filthy body is bent and covered with tatters of clothing and scraps of blood-crusted armor. The creature looks you over with one good eye, the other lost in a mass of scar tissue.
zh_tw: 一隻鬣狗人從陰影中悄悄爬出，謹慎地瞥了瞥它兩邊的頭顱堆。這個生物的身體骯髒彎曲，覆蓋著破爛的衣服和血跡斑斑的盔甲碎片。這個生物用一隻好眼睛打量著你，另一隻眼睛在一團疤痕組織中失去了。

english: This wretched gnoll is named {@creature Gash|OotA}. Thanks to treachery he committed against his kind, the minotaurs spared his life. However, their mercy comes with regular abuse and torment. The gnoll now sees himself as a loyal and willing servant of the brutes, and he is eager to lead gnolls and anyone else to his minotaur masters.
zh_tw: 這個可憐的鬣狗人名叫{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}。由於他對同族的背叛，彌諾陶洛斯饒了他一命。然而，他們的仁慈伴隨著定期的虐待和折磨。現在鬣狗人自視為這些野蠻人的忠誠且樂意的僕人，並且他渴望引導鬣狗人和其他人去見他的彌諾陶洛斯主人。

english: {@creature Gash|OotA} is a {@creature gnoll} with the following modifications:
zh_tw: {@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂} 是一個 {@creature gnoll||鬣狗人}，有以下修改：

english: {@creature Gash|OotA} has 11 hit points.
zh_tw: {@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂} 有 11 點生命值。

english: He has a walking speed of 25 feet.
zh_tw: 他的步行速度是每小時25尺。

english: He has disadvantage on Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws because of the physical and mental abuse he has suffered. A {@spell lesser restoration} spell rids him of these effects.
zh_tw: 由於他遭受的身體和精神虐待，他在感知檢定和感知豁免檢定上具有劣勢。一個{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}法術可以消除這些效果。

english: Cringing and mewling, {@creature Gash|OotA} approaches the party with arms out and head down. He speaks in both Gnoll and Abyssal. If the characters can't understand him, he pantomimes helpful gestures and beckons them to follow him.
zh_tw: 畏縮哀嚎的{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}雙臂張開、頭低垂地走向隊伍。他用鬣狗人語和深淵語說話。如果角色們聽不懂他的話，他會用手勢比劃幫助的動作，並示意他們跟隨他。

english: "Powerful masters," the gnoll whines. "You honor us by your presence. Seek you passage through the maze? The Spiral of the Great Horned King? I can help. Yes. Trust {@creature Gash|OotA} and he will see you through the maze, he will."
zh_tw: "強大的主人，"鬣狗人哀嚎道。"你們的到來使我們感到榮幸。你們是在尋找透過迷宮的道路嗎？大角王的螺旋迷宮？我可以幫忙。是的。相信{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}，他會帶領你們穿越迷宮，他會的。"

english: Any aggressive action sends {@creature Gash|OotA} skittering back into the maze and to his masters. If the characters capture him, he shrieks and screams, drawing one {@creature minotaur} to investigate the racket.
zh_tw: 任何攻擊性行為都會使{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}驚慌失措地逃回迷宮並奔向他的主人。如果角色們抓住他，他會尖叫呼喊，吸引一隻{@creature minotaur||牛頭人}前來調查喧鬧聲。

english: Accepting {@creature Gash|OotA}'s offer transforms the cringing gnoll into a dutiful guide. He leads the characters through passage after passage, choosing directions seemingly at random until the characters encounter the minotaurs. If the battle turns against the minotaurs, {@creature Gash|OotA} flees.
zh_tw: 接受{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}的提議將這個畏縮的鬣狗人轉變成了一個盡職的嚮導。他帶領角色們穿過一個又一個通道，看似隨機地選擇方向，直到角色們遭遇到彌諾陶洛斯。如果戰鬥對彌諾陶洛斯不利，{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}會逃跑。

english: If the adventurers show pity or kindness, {@creature Gash|OotA} becomes confused, as he has never experienced such things. A character can befriend the gnoll with a successful {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. If any character uses magical healing on {@creature Gash|OotA}, the check is automatically successful.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們表現出憐憫或善意，{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}會感到困惑，因為他從未經歷過這些事情。一個角色可以透過成功的{@dc 20}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定與這個鬣狗人建立友誼。如果有任何角色對{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}使用魔法治療，檢定將自動成功。

english: If the characters befriend {@creature Gash|OotA}, he warns them to turn back, flee, and never return. He says his masters are vile minotaurs who wait in the maze, eager to kill all trespassers. If asked, {@creature Gash|OotA} explains that the minotaurs spared his life in exchange for leading travelers into the maze. If the characters insist on entering the maze, {@creature Gash|OotA} goes with them, trying to keep his new friends safe. If the characters defeat the minotaurs and move deeper into the Labyrinth, {@creature Gash|OotA} can accompany them as a follower and guide, giving the characters advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to avoid becoming lost in the Labyrinth.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}成為朋友，他會警告他們回頭、逃跑，並且永不復返。他說自己的主人是邪惡的彌諾陶洛斯，他們在迷宮中等待，渴望殺死所有入侵者。如果被問及，{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}解釋說彌諾陶洛斯為了讓他引導旅行者進入迷宮而饒了他一命。如果角色們堅持進入迷宮，{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}會和他們一起去，盡力保護他的新朋友們的安全。如果角色們擊敗了彌諾陶洛斯並深入迷宮，{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}可以作為追隨者和嚮導陪伴他們，給予角色們在感知({@skill Survival||求生})檢定上的優勢，以避免在迷宮中迷路。

english: Into the Maze
zh_tw: 進入迷宮

english: The minotaurs' maze fills a region of the Underdark one mile on each side. A network of corridors climbing up to higher levels and descending to lower ones by way of ramps, the maze requires time, attention, and patience to navigate. The corridors are 10 feet wide and tall, faced with stone blocks mortared into place. Bits of flesh and bone litter the floor, and splashes of blood cover the walls.
zh_tw: 彌諾陶洛斯的迷宮佔據了幽暗地域一平方英里的地方。這個迷宮由一系列的走廊構成，透過坡道上升至更高層面或下降至更低層面，需要時間、注意力和耐心來導航。走廊寬高各10尺，由石塊砌成並用砂漿固定。走廊地面上散落著肉塊和骨頭，牆壁上沾滿了血跡。

english: When the characters enter the maze, have them choose their pace (fast, normal, or slow). It takes 1 hour to navigate the maze at a fast pace, 2 hours at a normal pace, or 3 hours at a slow pace. Halfway through the journey, the navigator must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. A fast pace imposes a −5 penalty to the check. A slow pace grants a +5 bonus. On a success, the characters find their way out. On a failure, the characters must start the journey from the beginning.
zh_tw: 當角色們進入迷宮時，讓他們選擇他們的速度（快速、正常或慢速）。以快速透過迷宮需要1小時，以正常速度透過需要2小時，以慢速透過需要3小時。在旅程的中途，導航者必須進行一個 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。快速透過會給檢定帶來−5的懲罰，而慢速透過則會帶來+5的加值。如果成功，角色們會找到出路。如果失敗，角色們必須從頭開始旅程。

english: The longer it takes the characters to navigate through the maze, the greater the risk of encountering the creatures within it. Every 30 minutes the party spends in the maze, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Maze Encounters table to see what, if anything, the characters meet.
zh_tw: 角色們在迷宮中導航的時間越長，遇到其中生物的風險就越大。隊伍在迷宮中每花費30分鐘，就投擲一個{@dice d20}骰子，並參考迷宮遭遇表，看看角色們遇到了什麼，如果有的話。

english: If {@creature Gash|OotA} was attacked by the characters and fled into the maze, he does his best to bring threats down on them, in which case roll two d20s and take the higher result. If {@creature Gash|OotA} is friendly to the party and accompanying them, he tries to steer them away from danger, in which case roll two d20s and take the lower result.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}被角色攻擊並逃入迷宮，他會盡其所能給他們帶來威脅，在這種情況下，擲兩個d20骰子並取較高的結果。如果{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}對隊伍友好並陪同他們，他會試圖引導他們遠離危險，在這種情況下，擲兩個d20骰子並取較低的結果。

zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} {@creature Minotaur||牛頭人}
