zh_tw: 屍體

english: The characters stumble upon the headless remains of a butchered corpse belonging to a dead dwarf, gnoll, human, or svirfneblin.
zh_tw: 角色們偶然發現了一具被斬首的屍體殘骸，屬於一個死去的矮人、鬣狗人、人類或地底侏儒。

english: Gnawed Bones
zh_tw: 啃咬過的骨頭

english: A pile of cracked and gnawed bones is laid out around a pool of dried blood.
zh_tw: 一堆破裂並被啃咬過的骨頭散落在一灘乾涸的血跡周圍。

english: Gnoll Pack
zh_tw: 鬣狗人群體

english: A frenzied group of {@dice 2d4} {@creature Gnoll||gnolls} is lost in the maze. The gnolls attack any creatures they see.
zh_tw: 一群瘋狂的{@dice 2d4}只{@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}在迷宮中迷路了。鬣狗人狼會攻擊它們看到的任何生物。

english: Minotaurs
zh_tw: 牛頭人

english: These bloodthirsty {@creature Minotaur||minotaurs} are hunting gnolls but attack any other creatures they happen upon.
zh_tw: 這些嗜血的{@creature Minotaur||牛頭人}正在狩獵鬣狗人，但也會攻擊他們偶然遇到的其他生物。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The first time the characters fight the minotaurs, one of them carries 32 ep and 22 cp in a pouch made from a human face with the eyes and mouth sewn shut. The second time the characters encounter minotaurs, one of them wears silver caps (worth 25 gp each) on the ends of its horns.
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次與牛頭人戰鬥時，其中一個攜帶著32枚金幣和22枚銅幣，裝在一個用人臉製成的袋子裡，眼睛和嘴巴都被縫上了。第二次角色們遇到牛頭人時，其中一個在其角尖上戴著銀色帽飾（每個價值25金幣）。

english: Filthriddens
zh_tw: 汙穢聚落

english: Filthriddens was, until recently, a shanty town of Underdark exiles and refugees. The greatest threat to inhabitants—apart from food shortages—was the minotaurs that raided the settlement from time to time, dragging off screaming prisoners to meet a grisly fate. The recent arrival of the demon lords changed things. A group of minotaurs was on its way to raid Filthriddens when Yeenoghu and a pack of his frenzied followers tore through this part of the Labyrinth, catching the minotaurs off guard and slaughtering them. The sole witness to this carnage was {@creature Grisha|OotA}, an escaped human slave of the drow. Yeenoghu's intercession saved him from the minotaurs.
zh_tw: 汙穢聚落曾是一個由幽暗地域流亡者和難民組成的貧民窟，直到最近。除了食物短缺之外，居民面臨的最大威脅是米諾陶斯人，他們時不時地襲擊這個定居點，把尖叫的囚犯拖走，讓他們面臨可怕的命運。惡魔領主的到來改變了一切。一群米諾陶斯人正前往汙穢聚落進行襲擊，這時耶諾古和他的一群狂熱追隨者穿過了迷宮的這一部分，出其不意地襲擊了米諾陶斯人並將他們屠殺。這場大屠殺的唯一目擊者是{@creature Grisha|OotA|格里沙}，一個逃離了卓爾的人類奴隸。耶諾古的幹預救了他免受米諾陶斯人的侵害。

english: Yeenoghu and his pack moved on, but {@creature Grisha|OotA} took the head of a slain minotaur and brought it back to Filthriddens. The skull became a talisman as {@creature Grisha|OotA} named Yeenoghu as the new protector and patron of Filthriddens. Residents who opposed this dark worship were exiled or executed in short order. The cult of Yeenoghu now controls the settlement, and {@creature Grisha|OotA} rules with an iron fist. He senses the power of Yeenoghu in all things—and particularly in the way in which cultists have begun to rise as undead ghouls after death.
zh_tw: 耶諾古和他的族群已經離開，但{@creature Grisha|OotA|格里沙}取走了一個被殺牛頭人的頭顱，並將其帶回了汙穢聚落。這個頭骨成為了護身符，因為{@creature Grisha|OotA|格里沙}宣佈耶諾古成為汙穢聚落的新守護者和贊助人。反對這種黑暗崇拜的居民很快就被流放或處決了。耶諾古的邪教現在控制了這個定居點，而{@creature Grisha|OotA|格里沙}以鐵腕統治。他感覺到耶諾古的力量無處不在——特別是在邪教成員死後開始作為不死食屍鬼復活的方式中。

english: Grisha's Greeting
zh_tw: 格里沙的問候

english: Filthriddens lies 48 miles from the Spiral of the Horned King, deeper in the Labyrinth. {@creature Kurr|OotA} (see "{@area Random Encounters|490|x}") or {@creature Gash|OotA} (see "{@area Gash the Gnoll|4a8|x}") might lead the characters here if they don't find it on their own.
zh_tw: 汙穢聚落位於迷宮深處，距離有角之王螺旋48英里。如果角色們沒有自行找到這裡，{@creature Kurr|OotA|庫爾}（參見"{@area 隨機遭遇|490|x}"）或{@creature Gash|OotA|撕裂}（參見"{@area 鬣狗人撕裂|4a8|x}"）可能會引導他們到這裡。

english: The cavern that opens up ahead looks like a settlement, with tents and crudely built shanties lining its irregular walls. It appears deserted except for a lone human male kneeling within a circle of burning torchstalk mushrooms in the center of the cave and two ragged figures lurking near a zurkhwood door set into a wall thirty feet distant. The figure in the circle is praying over a rotting minotaur head but stands when he sees you. He's a thin human, and his face and arms are streaked with dry blood.
zh_tw: 前方敞開的洞穴看起來像是一個定居點，帳篷和簡陋搭建的棚屋沿著其不規則的牆壁排列。除了一個孤獨的人類男性跪在一個燃燒的火炬菌圈中心，以及兩個衣衫襤褸的身影潛伏在三十尺遠的牆上的祖克木門前外，這裡看起來已經廢棄了。圈內的人物正在祈禱一個腐爛的牛頭人頭顱，但當他看到你們時站了起來。他是一個瘦弱的人類，他的臉和手臂上佈滿了乾涸的血跡。

english: "Friends," he says, "I have heard the call and I hope you have too. With my own eyes, I saw our Great Lord Yeenoghu slaughter the minotaurs that had plagued us. Now we are free and strong with his blessings. We feast while we live, and thanks to our lord, we will also feast when we are dead. If you've heard the call, come. Join my pack and feel the strength of Yeenoghu."
zh_tw: "朋友們，"他說，"我聽到了召喚，我希望你也一樣。親眼所見，我們的大領主耶諾古屠殺了那些困擾我們的彌諾陶洛斯。現在我們自由了，強大了，得到了他的祝福。我們活著就盛宴，感謝我們的領主，我們死後也將盛宴。如果你們聽到了召喚，來吧。加入我的群落，感受耶諾古的力量。"

english: The figure smiles as he speaks, revealing teeth filed to sharp points.
zh_tw: 那個人物說話時露出微笑，露出牙齒被磨成鋒利的尖端。

english: Filthriddens is contained within a cave roughly 100 feet long and 60 feet wide. The characters enter from a natural tunnel along one of the shorter walls, with another tunnel exiting on the opposite side. Much of the cave is taken up with crude shanties. Most of them stand empty, their inhabitants either exiled or dead.
zh_tw: 汙穢聚落位於一個大約100尺長和60尺寬的洞穴內。角色們從一個較短牆面上的天然隧道進入，另一個隧道在對面一側通向出口。洞穴的大部分被簡陋的棚屋佔據。其中大部分空置著，它們的居住者要麼被流放，要麼已經死去。

english: {@creature Grisha|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) can recount the history of Filthriddens and how Yeenoghu saved its denizens from the oppression of the minotaurs. He can also reveal how he spent years as a slave of the drow. {@creature Grisha|OotA} seeks new disciples to grow his cult's power.
zh_tw: {@creature Grisha|OotA|格里沙}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）可以講述汙穢聚落的歷史以及耶諾古如何將其居民從牛頭人的壓迫中解救出來。他還可以透露他作為卓爾奴隸多年的事情。{@creature Grisha|OotA|格里沙}尋求新的信徒以增強他的邪教力量。

english: Twelve {@creature Cultist||cultists} (a mix of shield dwarves, halflings, and humans) support {@creature Grisha|OotA} if a fight breaks out. Ten of them are hidden in the shanties. Two more stand next to a zurkhwood door, beyond which lies a small side cave where cultists who have died and risen as undead are kept. If battle erupts, the cultists open the door and release six {@creature Ghoul||ghouls}. The ghouls ignore the cultists as long as there are other creatures to feed on.
zh_tw: 十二名{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}（盾矮人、半身人和人類的混合）在戰鬥爆發時支援{@creature Grisha|OotA|格里沙}。其中十個隱藏在棚屋中。另外兩個站在一扇祖爾克木門前，門後是一個小側洞，那裡存放著死去並作為不死生物復活的邪教徒。如果戰鬥爆發，邪教徒會開啟門並釋放六隻{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}。只要還有其他生物可供食用，食屍鬼會忽略邪教徒。

english: March to Nowhere
zh_tw: 走向虛無

english: The Labyrinth is aptly named, for even the most resolute of explorers can become lost in its depths, as a number of modrons discovered to their dismay. Separated long ago from their fellows during the Great Modron March, these modrons have been wandering the Underdark for a long time.
zh_tw: 迷宮這個名字恰如其分，因為即使是最堅定的探險家也可能在其深處迷失方向，正如一些魔冢所痛苦地發現的那樣。這些魔冢在很久以前的偉大魔冢行軍中與同伴分離，它們在幽暗地域中徘徊了很長時間。

english: As the party travels deeper into the Labyrinth, any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 15 or higher hears the sounds of marching feet off in the distance. To investigate the source of the noise, the characters must travel for 15 minutes through cramped tunnels requiring as much climbing as crawling. At the end of this time, the adventurers emerge onto a shelf 15 feet up the wall of a broad, straight tunnel some 20 feet high.
zh_tw: 當隊伍深入迷宮時，任何具有被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分15或更高的角色都能聽到遠處行軍的腳步聲。要調查噪音的來源，角色們必須透過狹窄的隧道行走15分鐘，這些隧道需要攀爬和爬行。在這段時間的最後，冒險者們出現在一個寬闊、直的隧道壁上15尺高的架子上，隧道大約有20尺高。

english: A curious procession of creatures marches along the tunnel below your position. Twelve of the creatures are identical. Each has a round body, spindly arms and legs, a pair of fluttering wings rising above its arms, and a single eye staring out over a wide, smiling mouth. At the column's head stands a creature that looks like an inverted pyramid held up by six legs. It scuttles like a crab. On each side of its body, an eye is set above a mouth. Under the mouth, a single arm grips a spear in its hand.
zh_tw: 一個奇怪的生物隊伍沿著你下方的隧道行進。十二個生物完全相同。每個生物都有一個圓形的身體，細長的手臂和腿，一對在手臂上方飄動的翅膀，以及一隻眼睛盯著一個寬闊、微笑的嘴巴。在隊伍的前方站著一個生物，看起來像一個由六條腿支撐的倒置金字塔。它像螃蟹一樣爬行。在它的身體兩側，每側都有一個眼睛位於嘴巴上方。在嘴巴下方，一隻手臂握著一支矛。

english: Twelve {@creature Monodrone||monodrones} and a {@creature tridrone} have been wandering the Labyrinth since the last Great Modron March. The modrons became separated from their fellows and trapped here. Unable to find their way back to Mechanus, the modrons have been pressing on (and on), knowing that they must find their way back or be destroyed in the process.
zh_tw: 自從上一次偉大的模數行軍以來，十二個{@creature Monodrone||單元冢}和一個{@creature tridrone||三元冢}一直在迷宮中徘徊。這些魔冢與同伴分離並被困在這裡。由於無法找到回到機械境（機械境）的路，魔冢一直在持續前行（並且不斷前行），知道他們必須找到回去的路，否則在這個過程中會被摧毀。

english: The extended march has taxed the modrons to their limit. Most show signs of the frustration of being unable to fulfill their mission. The tridrone has managed to keep the group together, but it feels responsible for their collective fate and their failure to return home. Even if the characters have the ability to communicate with the modrons, the monodrones' ability to communicate is all but spent (see the "{@adventure Roleplaying the Modrons|OotA|13}" sidebar).
zh_tw: 長途跋涉已經將模組機器人逼到了極限。大多數都表現出無法完成任務的挫敗感。三號模組機器人成功地將團隊保持在一起，但它對集體的命運以及未能回家感到責任重大。即使角色們有能力與模組機器人溝通，一號模組機器人的溝通能力幾乎耗盡（參見"{@adventure 扮演魔冢|OotA|13}"邊欄）。

english: Roleplaying the Modrons
zh_tw: 扮演魔冢

english: Modrons have no sense of individuality. They are a collective and refer to themselves as "we" or "us." As a result, modrons don't understand individuality in others. When speaking to a group, the tridrone might focus its attention on the adventurer it believes to be at the top of the party's hierarchy even while talking to another.
zh_tw: 魔冢沒有個體性的概念。它們是一個集體，並且自稱為"我們"或"我們"。因此，魔冢不理解他人的個體性。當與一群人交談時，三元冢可能會將注意力集中在它認為處於團隊等級頂端的冒險者身上，即使它正在與另一個人交談。

english: Monodrones can normally relay messages up to forty-eight words long. However, years of wandering have degraded these creatures so that they can speak only a few words or phrases before sputtering off into clicking and popping noises. Among the words the monodrones repeat are "march," "Mechanus," "seventeen" (the number of cycles of the plane of Mechanus that mark the Great Modron March), and "lost."
zh_tw: 單元冢通常可以轉達長達四十八個詞的資訊。然而，多年的流浪使這些生物退化，以至於它們只能說幾句話或短語，然後就開始發出咔噠聲和噼啪聲。在單元冢重複的詞語中包括"行軍"、"機械境"、"十七"（標誌著偉大魔冢行軍的機械境外界的週期數量），以及"迷路"。

english: The tridrone can be very communicative—provided the characters have a way to speak with it and can allay its suspicions. A character can persuade the tridrone of the party's good intentions with a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. They have advantage on the check if the party includes one or more modrons.
zh_tw: 三階魔像可以非常健談——前提是角色們有方法與之交流，並能消除它的懷疑。一個角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定說服三階魔像相信隊伍的善意。如果隊伍中有一個或多個魔像，他們在檢定上具有優勢。

english: Once convinced of the characters' friendly intentions, the tridrone tells them that it and its fellows are on a mission of supreme importance, though it doesn't reveal the nature of that mission. A character can puzzle out the reason why the modrons might be here by making a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. Success indicates that the character recalls stories about the Great Modron March, which occurs every 289 years and sees a vast army of modrons marching across the Outer Planes. If the check succeeds by 5 or more, the character also knows the last march happened over two hundred years ago, and that these modrons are likely remnants of that march. The tridrone doesn't admit this (not wanting to acknowledge its failure), though it might be convinced to follow the characters if they offer to lead the modrons out of the Labyrinth. Additionally, the tridrone knows the Labyrinth well, and befriending the modrons grants characters a +5 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made to navigate the region.
zh_tw: 一旦確認了角色們的友好意圖，三環模因告訴他們，它和它的同伴們正在執行一項極其重要的任務，儘管它沒有透露任務的具體內容。角色可以透過進行一次 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定來推測模因為何會出現在這裡。成功意味著角色回憶起了關於大模因行軍的傳說，該行軍每289年發生一次，一支龐大的模因軍隊會穿越外位面。如果檢定成功且超過5點或更多，角色還會知道上次行軍發生在兩百多年前，並且這些模因可能是那次行軍的殘餘。三環模因不會承認這一點（不想承認它的失敗），但如果角色們提議帶領模因離開迷宮，它可能會被說服跟隨他們。此外，三環模因對迷宮非常熟悉，與模因交好可以為角色在導航該區域時獲得一次+5的智慧（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定加值。

english: The tridrone warns the characters to avoid the center of the Labyrinth, explaining that a malfunctioning "Orderer" is there. The characters might know the device by its other name: the Maze Engine. Because the device was built on Mechanus, its magical energy resonates with the modrons. The tridrone explains that an Orderer is designed to bring order to chaos by altering reality. A malfunctioning Orderer can be very dangerous, however, altering reality in unexpected ways. The tridrone knows exactly how far it is from the device. Because its knowledge of magic is limited and its focus on rejoining the Great Modron March is all-consuming, the tridrone has never thought about whether the Orderer might provide a solution to the modrons' predicament. If the characters express an interest in investigating this possibility, the tridrone leads the party to the center of the Labyrinth where the Maze Engine is found.
zh_tw: 三元冢警告角色們要避開迷宮的中心，並解釋說那裡有一個故障的"秩序者"。角色們可能知道這個裝置的另一個名字：迷宮引擎。由於該裝置是在機械境建造的，它的魔法能量與魔冢產生共鳴。三元冢解釋說，秩序者旨在透過改變現實來為混亂帶來秩序。然而，一個故障的秩序者可能非常危險，因為它會以意想不到的方式改變現實。三元冢確切地知道它離那個裝置有多遠。由於它對魔法的瞭解有限，而且它專注於重新加入偉大的魔冢行軍，三元冢從未考慮過秩序者是否可能為魔冢的困境提供解決方案。如果角色們表示有興趣調查這種可能性，三元冢將帶領隊伍前往迷宮中心，那裡可以找到迷宮引擎。

english: Yeenoghu's Hunt
zh_tw: 耶諾古的狩獵

english: About twelve miles from their encounter with the modrons, as they travel through the Labyrinth, the characters hear sounds of howling in the distance off and on over the course of many hours. Sometimes the sounds get closer or fade away, echoing strangely through the surrounding tunnels.
zh_tw: 在與魔冢的遭遇地點大約十二英里外，當他們穿越迷宮時，角色們在很多小時的路程中斷斷續續地聽到遠處的嚎叫聲。有時這些聲音會變得更近或逐漸消失，奇怪地在周圍的隧道中迴響。

english: Eventually, the characters enter a smaller tunnel leading upward. As they move forward, they can clearly hear the sound of fighting ahead. Bestial howls and yips can be heard, along with deeper roaring. A successful {@dc 13} Intelligence check recognizes the language of the battle cries as Gnoll. The characters can retreat away from the sounds of combat, but doing so means backtracking for six miles to find another route. If they continue ahead, they are confronted with a grisly scene. Though the characters likely have no firsthand experience of a goristro, they recognize the creature from the information provided to them by {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}.
zh_tw: 最終，角色們進入了一條較小的向上延伸的隧道。當他們向前移動時，可以清楚地聽到前方戰鬥的聲音。野獸般的嚎叫和尖叫聲傳來，同時還有更深的咆哮聲。一次成功的 {@dc 13} 智力檢定可以識別出戰鬥吶喊的語言是鬣狗人語。角色們可以從戰鬥的聲音中撤退，但這樣做意味著要後退六英里才能找到另一條路線。如果他們繼續前進，將會面對一個可怕的場景。儘管角色們可能沒有直接見過巨牛魔，但他們從 {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾} 提供的資訊中認出了這個生物。

english: As you move forward, the sounds of furious battle grow louder. The tunnel ends at a ledge twenty feet above the floor of a large cavern, giving you a perfect view of the conflict below.
zh_tw: 當你們繼續前進時，激烈戰鬥的聲音變得越來越響。隧道在一處懸崖邊緣結束，距離下方大洞穴的地面有二十尺，為你們提供了一個完美的視角來觀察下方的衝突。

english: On the shores of an underground lake, a pack of frenzied gnolls and hyenas surrounds a demon standing nearly twenty feet tall, with massive arms, clawed hands, cloven hooves, and the head of a bull. This is a goristro, whose heart {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} has instructed you to claim.
zh_tw: 在一個地下湖的岸邊，一群瘋狂的鬣狗人和鬣狗圍繞著一個站立近二十尺高、擁有巨大臂膀、爪狀手、分蹄和牛頭的惡魔。這是一隻巨牛魔，其心臟是{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}指示你們要奪取的。

english: Leading the gnolls is a figure of fearful countenance, twelve feet tall with the head of a snarling, amber-eyed hyena. He wields a massive triple flail, whose whirling heads smash into the larger goristro. The gnolls howl their master's name as he strikes swiftly, again and again: "Yeenoghu! Yeenoghu!"
zh_tw: 領導鬣狗人的是一個令人恐懼的人物，身高十二尺，長著一隻咆哮的、琥珀色眼睛的鬣狗頭。他揮舞著一把巨大的三連鞭，其旋轉的頭部猛烈地擊打在較大的巨牛魔身上。鬣狗人在他們的主人迅速而一次又一次地擊打時，高呼他的名字：'耶諾古！耶諾古！'

english: The larger demon roars, slashing with its bull's horns and flailing with its claws, but to no avail. Yeenoghu evades or shrugs off its attacks, even as gnoll archers pepper it with arrows. Then the gnolls swarm the goristro as it begins to falter, bringing it crashing to the ground.
zh_tw: 較大的惡魔咆哮著，用它的牛角猛擊，用爪子亂揮，但都無濟於事。耶諾古輕鬆地躲避或忽視了它的攻擊，即使鬣狗人弓箭手不斷用箭矢射向它。然後，當巨牛魔開始動搖時，鬣狗人蜂擁而上，將其擊倒在地。

english: In less than a minute, the battle is won. The demon lord Yeenoghu pulls back the goristro's head by the horns and rips out its throat with his teeth. He throws back his head and his howl of triumph echoes through the chamber, shaking the stones themselves. Several hyenas nipping at Yeenoghu's heels leap onto the goristro's corpse and begin feasting on its flesh. As you watch, these hyenas transform into gnolls.
zh_tw: 不到一分鐘，戰鬥就結束了。惡魔領主耶諾古抓住巨牛魔的角，用牙齒撕開了它的喉嚨。他仰起頭，勝利的嚎叫聲在洞穴中迴盪，甚至讓石頭本身都在震動。幾隻正圍著耶諾古腳跟的鬣狗跳到巨牛魔的屍體上，開始撕食它的肉。你們邊看邊發現，這些鬣狗轉變成了鬣狗人。

english: Any adventurer witnessing this horrible tableau must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2). If this causes the character to suffer a bout of indefinite madness, determine the nature of the madness using the Madness of Yeenoghu table in {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}.
zh_tw: 任何目睹這一可怕場景的冒險者必須成功進行一次 {@dc 12} 感知豁免檢定，否則將獲得一個瘋狂等級（參見第二章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。如果這導致角色遭受一次不定性瘋狂的發作，請使用 {@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20} 中的耶諾古瘋狂表來確定瘋狂的性質。

english: {@creature Yeenoghu|MTF} (see {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}) has been wandering the Underdark since he was first summoned, and the adventurers have run across him and his pack. The characters' only advantage at this moment is that they haven't yet been detected. Considering their level at this stage of the adventure, the players might be creating new characters quite soon if they dare confront the demon lord.
zh_tw: {@creature Yeenoghu|MTF|耶諾古}（參見{@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20}）自首次被召喚以來，一直在幽暗地域遊蕩，而冒險者們偶然遇到了他和他的追隨者。此刻，角色們唯一的優勢是尚未被發現。考慮到他們在冒險這一階段的等級，如果玩家們膽敢與這位惡魔領主正面交鋒，他們可能很快就要建立新的角色了。

english: If the characters stay hidden and observe, Yeenoghu leaves in short order. He is restless and eager for new prey. Yeenoghu gathers up most of the gnolls and hyenas and leads them down a tunnel on the right side of the cavern. Eight {@creature Gnoll||gnolls} led by a {@creature gnoll pack lord} remain in the cavern, feasting on the goristro's corpse.
zh_tw: 如果角色保持隱蔽並觀察，耶諾古很快就會離開。他不安分，渴望尋找新的獵物。耶諾古召集了大多數鬣狗人和鬣狗，帶領它們進入洞穴右側的一條隧道。由一名{@creature gnoll pack lord||鬣狗人頭領}帶領的八名{@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}仍然留在洞穴中，正在享用戈里斯特羅的屍體。

english: If the characters want to continue forward, the gnolls and hyenas need to be dealt with. Alternatively, if the characters are indecisive or spend too long debating the best course of action, the gnoll pack lord sniffs out the intruders. When it realizes that enemies are present, the pack lord howls to draw the attention of its followers.
zh_tw: 如果角色們想要繼續前進，就需要對付鬣狗人和鬣狗。另外，如果角色們猶豫不決或花費太長時間討論最佳行動方案，鬣狗人族群的首領會嗅出入侵者。當它意識到有敵人存在時，族群首領會嚎叫以吸引其追隨者的注意。

english: Hunted by Yeenoghu
zh_tw: 被耶諾古追捕

english: If you'd like Yeenoghu to play more of a role in this chapter of the adventure, it's easy to do so. When the gnolls killed by the characters do not rejoin the hunt, the demon lord circles back to the site of the goristro's demise and discovers his slain minions—and also picks up the scent of the adventurers.
zh_tw: 如果您希望耶諾古在這次冒險章節中扮演更重要的角色，這很容易做到。當角色們殺死的鬣狗人沒有重新加入狩獵時，惡魔領主會繞回到巨牛魔死亡的地點，發現他被殺的部下——同時也會嗅到冒險者的氣味。

english: Later in the adventure, Yeenoghu hunts down the characters to make them pay for their impudence (ideally when they are much higher in level). Before the final confrontation, give the characters hints that they have become the demon lord's prey. They might face an increasing number of gnoll ambushes, for example. One or more of their attackers might refer to them as "prey of Yeenoghu," or otherwise taunt them by speaking of their impending doom.
zh_tw: 在冒險的後期，耶諾古會追捕角色們，以懲罰他們的傲慢（最好在他們等級更高時）。在最後的對決之前，給角色們一些提示，讓他們知道自己已經成為了惡魔領主的獵物。例如，他們可能會面臨越來越多的鬣狗人伏擊。一個或多個攻擊者可能會稱他們為'耶諾古的獵物'，或者以談論他們即將到來的厄運來嘲諷他們。

english: The characters should have time to prepare for the fight they know is coming, and to think about tactics other than facing Yeenoghu in straight-up combat. For example, becoming the demon lord's quarry might work to their advantage later in the campaign, making them the perfect bait to lure Yeenoghu into a trap in chapter 17, "{@adventure Against the Demon Lords|OotA|16}."
zh_tw: 角色們應該有時間為他們知道的即將到來的戰鬥做準備，並思考除了與耶諾古正面交鋒之外的其他戰術。例如，成為惡魔領主的獵物可能在戰役後期對他們有利，使他們成為在第17章"{@adventure 對抗惡魔領主|OotA|16}"中引誘耶諾古落入陷阱的完美誘餌。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Another tunnel on the opposite side of the cavern heads off in a different direction than where Yeenoghu led his pack. Characters who defeat the remaining gnolls can continue on their way without losing any more time.
zh_tw: 洞穴對面的另一個隧道通向與耶諾古帶領他的群體不同的方向。擊敗剩餘鬣狗人的角色可以繼續他們的旅程，而不會浪費更多時間。

english: The close brush with Yeenoghu pays dividends to the adventurers by delivering two components of Vizeran's ritual into their hands. The first is the heart of the goristro, which the characters can remove from its corpse. The massive heart is the size of a small trunk and weighs nearly one hundred pounds. Any characters close to it while it is being transported imagine that they can occasionally hear it beating. A character who carries the heart, even in a {@item bag of holding} or similar extradimensional space, makes saving throws against madness with disadvantage.
zh_tw: 與耶諾古的近距離接觸為冒險者們帶來了豐厚的回報，將維茲蘭儀式的兩個組成部分交到了他們手中。第一個是巨牛魔的心臟，角色們可以從它的屍體中取出。這個巨大的心臟大小相當於一個小箱子，重量接近一百磅。任何在運輸過程中靠近它的角色都會偶爾想象自己能聽到它的跳動聲。攜帶心臟的角色，即使是在{@item bag of holding||次元袋}或類似的超維度空間中，也會在對抗瘋狂的豁免檢定中處於劣勢。

english: The second component takes the form of a few spatters of a demon lord's blood. A successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds some of Yeenoghu's black blood on the fallen goristro's horns.
zh_tw: 第二個元件以一些惡魔領主血液的飛濺物形式存在。成功的 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定會在倒下的巨牛魔的角上找到一些耶諾古的黑色血液。

english: Gallery of Angels
zh_tw: 天使畫廊

english: This cavern lies deep inside the Labyrinth and contains another ritual component that Vizeran needs.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴位於迷宮深處，包含另一個維茲蘭所需的儀式組成部分。

english: The passage you follow climbs upward as it corkscrews through stone, finally emerging through the floor of a large cavern. The ceiling arches sixty feet overhead, bristling with stalactites that drip water onto stalagmites rising from the uneven and broken floor. Here and there between the stalagmites, several statues of winged humanoids are set in poses of suffering and anguish. Some cover their faces, while others claw at them. Others reach toward the ceiling, their faces twisted into expressions of longing.
zh_tw: 你跟隨的通道在螺旋形地穿過石頭時向上攀升，最後從一個大型洞穴的地面出現。洞穴的天花板高聳六十尺，鐘乳石從上面滴水到不平整且破碎的地面上升起的石筍上。在石筍之間，散佈著幾座展開翅膀的人形雕像，它們擺出痛苦和苦惱的姿勢。有些雕像掩著臉，其他的則在抓自己的臉。還有的雕像伸手向天花板，臉上扭曲成渴望的表情。

english: This chamber houses the {@condition petrified} remains of eight fallen angels, condemned by the gods to pass the ages in the dark depths. Each appears to have been carved from stone in some position of fear, suffering, hatred, or longing. Each statue is spotted with lichen and marred by mineral deposits, which have crystallized out of the water dripping from the ceiling over uncounted years.
zh_tw: 這個房間內安放著八位墮落天使的{@condition petrified||石化}遺骸，他們被諸神判罰在黑暗深處度過無盡歲月。每個雕像似乎都從石頭中雕刻出來，呈現出恐懼、痛苦、仇恨或渴望的姿態。每尊雕像上都佈滿了苔蘚，並被礦物沉積物所侵蝕，這些沉積物是從天花板上滴落的水在無數年裡結晶形成的。

english: Even though they are transformed into stone statues, the fallen angels remain very much alive, their {@condition petrified} bodies having become prisons for their minds and souls. They remember who they were. They know what they did and why they are here. They know everything transpiring around them. Yet they can do nothing. They are trapped forever, and the isolation, darkness, and endless torment of their fate have driven them mad. No spell can undo the angels' curse or free them from their {@condition petrified} state.
zh_tw: 儘管他們被變成了石像，但墮落天使們仍然非常活躍，他們的{@condition petrified||石化}身體已成為他們思想和靈魂的監獄。他們記得自己是誰。他們知道自己做了什麼以及為什麼會在這裡。他們知道周圍發生的一切。然而他們無能為力。他們永遠被困住，孤立、黑暗和無盡命運的折磨使他們瘋狂。沒有任何法術能夠解除天使的詛咒或使他們從{@condition petrified||石化}狀態中解脫出來。

english: Fallen Angels
zh_tw: 墮落天使

english: The angels can communicate, albeit in a limited fashion, with living creatures that touch them.
zh_tw: 這些天使能夠以有限的方式與觸控它們的生物進行交流。

english: A character who makes physical contact with an angel (even through gloves or some other protective covering) knows that angel's name and experiences the effect described below. If you wish, you can roll a {@dice d8} to determine which angel a character touches, rerolling any repeat results. Unless specified otherwise, the effect is instantaneous. While there's no limit to the number of creatures that can touch an angel and be affected by it, a creature that touches an angel and triggers its effect can't trigger that particular angel's effect again until 24 hours have elapsed.
zh_tw: 與天使進行身體接觸的角色（即使是透過手套或其他保護性覆蓋物）會知道那個天使的名字並體驗到下面描述的效果。如果你願意，你可以擲一個{@dice d8}骰子來確定角色觸控的是哪個天使，重複的結果需要重擲。除非另有說明，效果是瞬間發生的。儘管沒有限制可以觸控天使並受其影響的生物數量，但觸控天使並觸發其效果的生物在24小時過去之前不能再觸發那個特定天使的效果。

english: Anaya
zh_tw: 阿納亞

english: This angel reaches toward the ceiling, its face a mask of hatred. A creature that makes contact with this angel must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, taking {@dice 3d6} psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 這個天使向天花板伸出手，它的臉是一張充滿仇恨的面具。任何與之接觸的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定，若失敗則受到 {@dice 3d6} 點心靈傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。

english: Baatral
zh_tw: 巴特瑞爾

english: This angel appears to be reaching out as if offering something. A character making contact with the angel must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or become {@condition charmed} for 1 minute.
zh_tw: 這位天使似乎伸出手，彷彿在提供什麼東西。與該天使接觸的角色必須成功進行一個{@dc 15}魅力豁免檢定，否則將受到{@condition charmed||魅惑}效果影響1分鐘。

english: While the character is {@condition charmed}, the angel has a telepathic link with the character as long as it and the character remain on the same plane of existence. The angel issues commands to the character, and the character does its best to obey those commands if it is conscious. The angel typically commands a character to kill, maim, rob, or otherwise harm its companions.
zh_tw: 當角色處於{@condition charmed||魅惑}狀態時，只要天使和角色處於相同的存在位面，天使就與角色保持心靈感應連結。天使向角色發出指令，如果角色有意識，它會盡力服從這些指令。天使通常命令角色殺害、傷害、搶劫或以其他方式傷害其同伴。

english: Each time an affected character takes damage, he or she makes a new Charisma saving throw against the effect. If the saving throw succeeds, the effect on it ends.
zh_tw: 每次受影響的角色受到傷害，他或她都會對這個效果進行一次新的魅力豁免檢定。如果豁免檢定成功，該效果就會結束。

english: Harajin
zh_tw: 哈拉金

english: This angel points at a spot on the cavern wall, and its mouth hangs open in horror. A character who makes contact with the angel hears horrific screaming and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2).
zh_tw: 這位天使指向洞穴牆壁上的一個點，它的嘴因恐懼而張開。與天使接觸的角色會聽到可怕的尖叫聲，必須成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 的感知豁免檢定，否則會獲得一級瘋狂狀態（見第二章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。

english: Lorabelios
zh_tw: 洛拉貝利奧斯

english: This angel stands feet apart, head downcast, arms at its sides. A character making contact with the angel hears a soft voice say in Common, "Do not lose hope." The character's next Wisdom saving throw is made with advantage.
zh_tw: 這個天使站立著，雙腳分開，頭低垂，雙臂垂在身體兩側。與天使接觸的角色聽到一個柔和的聲音用通用語說道："不要失去希望。"該角色下一次進行感知豁免檢定時將獲得優勢。

english: Nemevon
zh_tw: 奈梅馮

english: This angel holds its hands to its face, concealing its visage. Upon making contact with this angel, the character hears a soft voice repeating two words over and over in the Celestial language: "Kill me." There is no obvious way for the characters to do so, however. The voice persists even if the angel is shattered.
zh_tw: 這個天使雙手掩面，隱藏了它的面容。當角色接觸到這個天使時，會聽到一個柔和的聲音在天界語中一遍又一遍地重複兩個詞："殺了我"。然而，角色們顯然沒有辦法做到這一點。即使天使被摧毀，這個聲音仍然持續存在。

english: Silnia
zh_tw: 希爾妮雅

english: This angel covers its eyes with its arm but appears to be smiling. A character who touches the angel must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, terrifying nightmares haunt the character's sleep during his or her next long rest. The character derives no benefits from that rest and, upon waking, takes {@dice 3d6} psychic damage.
zh_tw: 這位天使用它的手臂遮住眼睛，但似乎在微笑。觸控天使的角色必須進行一個 {@dc 15} 的感知豁免檢定。若檢定失敗，恐怖噩夢將在下一次長休期間侵擾角色的睡眠。角色無法從該次休息中獲得任何益處，並且在醒來時受到 {@dice 3d6} 點心靈傷害。

english: Tamiel
zh_tw: 塔米爾

english: This angel kneels on the floor and buries its face in its arms. A character making contact with the angel hears a soft voice say in Common, "What would you know? Ask and I shall answer." The character must make a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the character takes {@dice 3d6} psychic damage and gains one level of madness. On a success, the character can ask two questions. The angel replies as if the character had successfully cast the {@spell contact other plane} spell.
zh_tw: 這位天使跪在地板上，將臉埋在雙臂中。與之接觸的角色會聽到一個柔和的聲音用通用語說道，"你想知道什麼？問吧，我會回答。"角色必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 的智力豁免檢定。若失敗，角色受到 {@dice 3d6} 的心靈傷害，並獲得一級瘋狂。若成功，角色可以提出兩個問題。天使會以角色成功施展了 {@spell contact other plane||異界探知} 法術的方式回答。

english: Zarod
zh_tw: 扎羅德

english: This angel claws at its eyes, and its face appears torn and rent. When a character makes contact with the angel, it invites the character to ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within seven days. The angel replies as if the character had successfully cast the {@spell divination} spell.
zh_tw: 這個天使在抓自己的眼睛，它的臉上看起來被撕裂了。當一個角色與天使接觸時，它邀請角色提出一個關於特定目標、事件或在七天內將要發生活動的問題。天使的回答就像角色成功施放了{@spell divination||預言}法術一樣。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: The adventurers can chisel or break off stone feathers from the angels' wings. One each from six different angels fulfills the requirements for Vizeran's ritual, although characters can take more feathers if they want.
zh_tw: 冒險者們可以從天使的翅膀上雕刻或折斷石質羽毛。來自六個不同天使的各一片羽毛滿足維茲蘭儀式的要求，儘管角色們願意的話，他們可以取更多的羽毛。

english: Other creatures in the Labyrinth avoid this cavern, making it a safe place for the party to take a long rest.
zh_tw: 迷宮中的其他生物避開這個洞穴，使它成為隊伍安全休息的好地方。

english: The Maze Engine
zh_tw: 迷宮引擎

english: Deep within the Labyrinth lies the Maze Engine—a mechanical, magically powered device capable of altering reality. Modrons refer to the device as an Orderer because it was designed is to bring order to chaos. If the characters activate the Maze Engine, it has the potential to aid their fight against the demon lords.
zh_tw: 在迷宮的深處隱藏著迷宮引擎——一種機械的、由魔法驅動的裝置，能夠改變現實。魔冢稱這個裝置為"秩序者"，因為它的設計目的是為混亂帶來秩序。如果角色們啟用迷宮引擎，它有可能幫助他們對抗惡魔領主的戰鬥。

english: The engine looks like a working model of the Great Wheel (see chapter 2, "{@book Creating a Multiverse|DMG|2|The Great Wheel}," in the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). It's a 20-foot-diameter sphere built of 1-foot-wide bands of magically hardened and shaped bronze, engraved with arcane symbols. Gaps in the bands show various gears and articulation arms within the sphere, which rotate and shift to represent the relationships between the various known planes of existence.
zh_tw: 這個引擎看起來像是一個大輪盤的工作模型（參見第2章「{@book 塑造多元宇宙|DMG|2|The Great Wheel}」，選自{@i 城主指南}）。它是一個直徑為20尺的球體，由1尺寬的魔法加固和成形的青銅帶構成，上面刻有神秘的符號。帶子之間的縫隙顯露出球體內各種齒輪和關節臂，它們旋轉和移動以展示各種已知存在位面之間的關係。

english: Characters might learn about the existence of the Maze Engine from the beholder Karazikar (see {@area chapter 13|47e|x}) or from Vizeran, who has heard rumors about an ancient reality-altering device. Characters might also learn about the engine from Karazikar's modron prisoner or from the modrons lost in the Labyrinth (see "{@area March to Nowhere|4b5|x}").
zh_tw: 角色們可能從眼球怪卡拉茲卡（見{@area 第十三章|47e|x}）得知迷宮引擎的存在，或者從維茲蘭那裡聽說，他聽說了一種古老的現實改變裝置。角色們也可能從卡拉茲卡的魔冢囚犯那裡，或者從迷失在迷宮中的魔冢那裡（見"{@area 走向虛無|4b5|x}"）得知引擎的資訊。

english: Information about the Maze Engine can also be found in Gravenhollow (see {@area chapter 11|3f8|x}). The characters could experience a vision of a journey to the Labyrinth in the library, or read an account of the device in its archives.
zh_tw: 關於迷宮引擎的資訊也可以在刻文谷找到（見{@area 第十一章|3f8|x}）。角色們可能在圖書館中體驗到一段前往迷宮的旅程的幻象，或者在檔案館中閱讀有關該裝置的記載。

english: Reaching the Engine
zh_tw: 到達引擎

english: Located forty-eight miles southeast of the Gallery of Angels, the Maze Engine is wedged halfway down a 20-foot-wide, 100-foot-deep crevasse located in the middle of a large cavern. The bottom of the crevasse is filled with magma. A shimmering curtain of heat rises from the crevasse and makes the cavern hot and dry.
zh_tw: 迷宮引擎位於天使畫廊東南方向48英里處，被卡在一個位於大型洞穴中央的20尺寬、100尺深的裂縫中段。裂縫底部充滿了巖漿。從裂縫中升起的閃爍熱幕使得洞穴變得炎熱乾燥。

english: The roughly spherical engine is 40 feet below the top of the crevasse and 40 feet above the magma. It can be reached by magic or by climbing down to it. The sheer sides of the crevasse require a successful {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to climb. On a failed check, a character makes no progress and dislodges loose stones that clatter down the crevasse into the magma. If the check fails by 5 or more, the climber falls into the magma. Any creature that enters the magma or starts its turn there takes 42 ({@dice 12d6}) fire damage. Every foot moved in the magma costs 5 feet of movement.
zh_tw: 這個大致呈球形的引擎位於冰隙頂部下方40尺處，距離巖漿上方40尺。可以透過魔法或攀爬到達它。冰隙的陡峭側壁需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 12} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定才能攀爬。如果檢定失敗，角色無法取得進展，並且會鬆動一些鬆動的石頭，這些石頭會跌落冰隙，落入巖漿中。如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，攀爬者會墜入巖漿。任何進入巖漿或在其回合開始時位於巖漿中的生物會受到42點（{@dice 12d6}）火焰傷害。在巖漿中每移動一尺需要消耗5尺的移動力。

english: Slaughtertusk
zh_tw: 屠殺之牙

english: Having just recently found the Maze Engine, Baphomet has set a {@creature nalfeshnee} named Slaughtertusk to watch over the crevasse and prevent any creature from approaching the device. Slaughtertusk would rather be helping the Horned King track down and kill Yeenoghu. The nalfeshnee is bored with its assigned task, although it knows better than to disobey the Horned King. Still, rather than immediately destroying any intruders, it toys with them for as long as possible.
zh_tw: 巴弗滅最近才找到迷宮引擎，他指派了一頭名為屠殺之牙的{@creature nalfeshnee||判魂魔}看守裂縫，防止任何生物接近該裝置。屠殺之牙更願意幫助角王追蹤並殺死耶諾古。儘管這頭納爾菲許尼對自己的任務感到無聊，但它深知不能違背角王的命令。不過，它不會立即摧毀任何入侵者，而是儘可能地玩弄他們。

english: Slaughtertusk is happy to let a fight drag on, feasting on its enemies' pain before finally slaying them. If reduced to fewer than 100 hit points, it uses its Summon Demon feature (see the "Variant: Demon Summoning" sidebar in the "Demons" entry of the {@i Monster Manual}) and tries to summon {@dice 1d6} {@creature Vrock||vrocks}. It has a 50 percent chance of succeeding.
zh_tw: 屠殺之牙樂於讓戰鬥拖延下去，先享受敵人的痛苦，最後再殺死他們。如果生命值降到100點以下，它會使用召喚惡魔特性（見{@i 怪物圖鑑}中"惡魔"條目下的"變體：惡魔召喚"側欄），並嘗試召喚{@dice 1d6}只{@creature Vrock||鷲魔}。它有50%的機率成功。

english: Slaughtertusk is a bully at heart and begs for its life if the adventurers have it at their mercy, promising to tell them the secrets of the Maze Engine or anything else they want. At the first opportunity, it teleports away, summoning demonic aid to cover its retreat if possible.
zh_tw: 屠殺之牙本質上是個惡霸，如果冒險者們對其手下留情，它會哀求饒命，承諾告訴他們迷宮引擎的秘密或他們想知道的任何事情。一旦有機會，它會使用傳送逃走，如果可能的話，還會召喚惡魔援助來掩護其撤退。

english: Activating the Engine
zh_tw: 啟用引擎

english: A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check is needed to activate the device by puzzling out its array of gears and levers. It then takes 12 rounds for the engine to "align itself" and activate its magical effect. If an initiative order hasn't already been established by the time the engine activates, have everyone in the party roll initiative.
zh_tw: 需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定來啟用這個裝置，方法是解開其齒輪和槓桿的排列。然後需要 12 輪時間讓引擎"自我調整"並啟用其魔法效果。如果引擎啟用時還沒有確立先攻順序，讓隊伍中的所有成員都投擲先攻。

english: If the tridrone from "{@area March to Nowhere|4b5|x}" accompanies the characters, it can instruct them how to activate the Maze Engine without a check and inform them of how long it takes for the magical effect to occur.
zh_tw: 如果來自"{@area 走向虛無|4b5|x}"的三元冢陪伴角色們，它可以指導他們如何啟用迷宮引擎，無需進行檢定，並告知他們魔法效果發生所需的時間。

english: Shaking Loose
zh_tw: 震動鬆脫

english: The engine, which weighs two tons, is ordinarily set on a solid stone surface. Being wedged partway down a crevasse makes its operation more problematic. When the engine is activated, the vibration of its clacking gears sends showers of loose stones down the crevasse walls.
zh_tw: 這臺引擎重達兩噸，通常放置在堅固的石面上。部分嵌入裂縫中使得其操作更加成問題。當引擎被啟用時，其咔嗒作響的齒輪震動會將鬆動的石頭像陣雨一樣從裂縫壁上震落下來。

english: Once the engine has been activated, it "acts" on initiative count 15.
zh_tw: 一旦引擎被啟用，它會在先制計數15時"行動"。

english: Mephit Madness
zh_tw: 魔蝠狂潮

english: On the round after the Maze Engine activates, two {@creature Magma Mephit||magma mephits} fly out of the magma on initiative count 10. Two more {@creature Magma Mephit||magma mephits} emerge from the magma each round thereafter on the same initiative count, until a dozen mephits have appeared. The mephits attack anyone on or near the Maze Engine.
zh_tw: 在迷宮引擎啟用後的輪次，兩個{@creature Magma Mephit||熔岩魔蝠}在先制計數10時從巖漿中飛出。在此之後的每輪，同樣在先制計數10時，會再有兩隻{@creature Magma Mephit||熔岩魔蝠}從巖漿中出現，直到出現了一打小鬼。這些小鬼會攻擊任何在迷宮引擎附近或上面的人。

english: Shake, Rattle, and Roll
zh_tw: 搖，晃，滾

english: At the end of its turn during round 3, the engine shifts. Any creature standing on it must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. If the save fails by 5 or more, the creature is knocked off the engine into the magma. Otherwise, a creature failing its save slides down the spherical side of the engine but automatically grabs one of its bands before falling. The creature can use an action to try to climb back onto the engine, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 在第3回合結束時，引擎會移動。任何站在上面的生物必須進行一次{@dc 10}的敏捷豁免。如果豁免失敗超過5點，該生物會被丟擲引擎並掉入巖漿中。否則，豁免失敗的生物會沿著引擎的球形表面滑動，但在掉落前會自動抓住其中一個環帶。該生物可以使用一個動作嘗試爬回引擎，成功進行一次{@dc 10}的力量({@skill Athletics||運動})檢定即可爬回。

english: At the end of its turn during round 6, the engine shifts again. The effect is the same as described above, except that a creature hanging onto one of the engine's bands has disadvantage on the saving throw.
zh_tw: 在第6輪結束時，引擎再次發生位移。效果與上文描述相同，不同之處在於，掛在引擎任一皮帶上的生物在豁免檢定上會有劣勢。

english: If a creature falls from the Maze Engine, another creature adjacent to the falling creature and hanging onto one of the engine's bands can attempt to use a free hand to grab the falling creature, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. A creature saved in this manner can use its action to try to climb back onto the engine, doing so with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If the check fails and the creature's weight exceeds the carrying capacity of the creature that grabbed it (see "{@book Lifting and Carrying|PHB|7|Lifting and Carrying}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Player's Handbook}), the creature grabbing it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength check at the start of its next turn or lose its grip on the fallen creature, which then plunges into the magma.
zh_tw: 如果一個生物從迷宮引擎上跌落，另一個鄰近跌落生物並抓住引擎某一帶的生物可以嘗試用一隻空手抓住跌落生物，這需要一個成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免。以這種方式被救起的生物可以使用其動作嘗試攀爬回引擎，這需要一個成功的 {@dc 13} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。如果檢定失敗並且生物的體重超過了抓住它的生物的承載能力（參見 {@i 玩家手冊} 第七章中的 "{@book 抬舉與載重|PHB|7|Lifting and Carrying}"），抓住它的生物必須在其下一回合開始時成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 力量檢定，否則失去對跌落生物的抓握，後者將墜入巖漿中。

english: At the end of each of its turns starting on round 9, the Maze Engine slides down the crevasse, dropping 10 feet toward the magma each round. Any creature on the engine must make a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw each time it drops down to avoid being thrown off. Resolve the effects as described above. On its turn during round 13, the Maze Engine sinks into the magma and is destroyed.
zh_tw: 從第9輪開始，每當迷宮引擎在自己回合結束時，它會沿著裂縫下滑，每輪向巖漿下降10尺。每次引擎下降時，其上的任何生物必須進行一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷豁免，以避免被甩下去。按照上述描述處理效果。在第13輪的回合中，迷宮引擎會沉入巖漿並被摧毀。

english: Shutting Down the Engine
zh_tw: 關閉引擎

english: The engine shuts down if any part of it comes into contact with an {@spell antimagic field} or if it is targeted by a successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 19}). Otherwise, it can only be shut down by a {@spell wish} spell or divine intervention.
zh_tw: 如果引擎的任何部分接觸到{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}，或者它被成功的{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 19}）作用，引擎將關閉。否則，引擎只能透過{@spell wish||祈願術}或神聖幹預來關閉。

english: Maze Engine Effects
zh_tw: 迷宮引擎效果

english: The Maze Engine was damaged when the crevasse opened underneath it and swallowed it up. The engine can't be repaired, and once activated, it does strange and unpredictable things on each of its turns until it is deactivated or destroyed.
zh_tw: 當裂縫在其下方開啟併吞噬了迷宮引擎時，引擎受到了損壞。引擎無法修復，一旦被啟用，它會在每次其回合中做出奇怪和不可預測的事情，直到它被停用或摧毀。

english: On each of the engine's turns, roll a {@dice d100} and consult the Maze Engine Effects table to determine what the engine does.
zh_tw: 在引擎的每個回合，擲一個 {@dice d100} 並查閱迷宮引擎效果表，以確定引擎做了什麼。

english: Effect
zh_tw: 效應

english: The engine emits a flash of golden light. All magic items within 300 feet of the engine are destroyed, except for artifacts, which are cast into the Astral Plane.
zh_tw: 引擎發出一道金色光芒。引擎周圍300尺內的所有魔法物品都被摧毀，除了神器，它們被投射到星界。

english: Arcs of white light play across the surface of the engine until the end of its turn.
zh_tw: 直到它回合結束，白色光弧在引擎表面閃爍。

english: The engine emits a bright flash of white light. All player characters are transported back in time, as they are now, to the moment when the adventure began. They appear in Velkynvelve's slave pen, unshackled and unbound, with all of their experience points, abilities, equipment, and memories.
zh_tw: 引擎發出一道明亮的白光。所有玩家角色被傳送回時間的起點，他們現在的樣子，回到冒險開始的那一刻。他們出現在維爾京維爾夫的奴隸圍欄中，沒有被鎖鏈束縛，擁有所有的經驗值、能力、裝備和記憶。

english: The engine makes a loud "WHAAAH" sound until the start of its next turn. For as long as the sound lasts, the engine projects an {@spell antimagic field} (as the spell) around itself.
zh_tw: 引擎發出響亮的"哇啊"聲，直到其下一回合開始。只要聲音持續，引擎就會在其周圍投射一個{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}（如法術所述）。

english: The hollow interior of the engine flickers with crimson light until the end of its turn, whereupon one dead character or NPC of the DM's choice is restored to life, as though subjected to a {@spell resurrection} spell. The revived creature appears in a safe, unoccupied space within 120 feet of the engine.
zh_tw: 引擎的內部空洞閃爍著深紅色的光芒，直到它的回合結束，屆時，一個已死的角色或DM選擇的NPC將被恢復生命，就像受到了一個{@spell resurrection||復生術}法術的影響。復活的生物出現在引擎120尺範圍內的一個安全、未被佔據的空間中。

english: The engine spews slippery goo that splatters across its outer surface. Saving throws to avoid being knocked off the engine and ability checks made to climb the engine have disadvantage until the engine's next turn.
zh_tw: 引擎噴出滑膩的粘液，這些粘液濺在其外表面。避免被擊落引擎的豁免檢定以及攀爬引擎的屬性檢定在引擎下一回合之前都有劣勢。

english: The engine crackles with lightning. All creatures within 30 feet of the engine must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take {@dice 10d6} lightning damage. A target made primarily of metal or wearing metal armor has disadvantage on its saving throw.
zh_tw: 引擎閃爍著雷電。引擎30尺範圍內的所有生物必須進行一次 {@dc 18} 敏捷豁免，否則受到 {@dice 10d6} 點雷電傷害。主要由金屬構成或穿戴金屬護甲的目標在豁免檢定時具有劣勢。

english: The engine hums until the end of its turn, at which point a {@creature green slaad} appears in a safe space within 120 feet of the engine. The slaad rolls initiative and, on its turn, attacks any other creatures it sees.
zh_tw: 引擎嗡嗡作響，直到其回合結束，此時一個{@creature green slaad||史拉綠蟾}出現在距離引擎120尺內的安全空間中。史拉蟾進行先攻判定，並在其回合攻擊它看到的任何其他生物。

english: The engine groans loudly and turns each creature within 120 feet of it {@condition invisible}. A creature's invisibility lasts until it attacks or casts a spell.
zh_tw: 引擎發出巨大的轟鳴聲，使得它周圍120尺內的所有生物都變得{@condition invisible||隱形}。生物的隱形狀態將持續，直到它進行攻擊或施放法術為止。

english: Loud whispers emanate from the hollow interior of the engine. Each character in direct contact with the engine can increase one ability score of his or her choice by 2, to a maximum of 24.
zh_tw: 從引擎的中空內部傳出低語聲。每個直接接觸引擎的角色可以選擇提升一個能力值2點，最高不超過24。

english: Multicolored arcs of light play across the surface of the engine, which casts a {@spell polymorph} spell (save {@dc 18}) on each creature within 20 feet of it. Any creature that fails the saving throw is polymorphed into a {@creature flying snake}.
zh_tw: 引擎表面閃爍著多色光芒，對20尺內的每個生物施放 {@spell polymorph||變形術}（豁免 {@dc 18}）。任何未能透過豁免的生物將被變形為 {@creature flying snake||飛蛇}。

english: The engine spits out multicolored gemstones. Any character within 20 feet of the engine can use his or her reaction to catch a 500 gp gem with a free hand. The rest of the gemstones fall into the magma and are destroyed.
zh_tw: 引擎噴射出多彩寶石。任何在引擎20尺範圍內的角色都可以使用他或她的反應，用空閒的手抓住一顆價值500金幣的寶石。其餘的寶石掉入巖漿中並被摧毀。

english: The engine emits a flash of yellowish-white light. A randomly determined magic item appears in a safe location within 120 feet of the engine. Roll on Magic Item Table G in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG|7|Random Magic Items} to determine what appears.
zh_tw: 引擎發出一道黃白色的閃光。一件隨機確定的魔法物品出現在引擎120尺範圍內的安全位置。在{@book 城主指南|DMG|7|Random Magic Items}中的魔法物品表G上擲骰，以確定出現的物品。

english: The engine emits a flash of green light. Each creature in direct contact with the engine must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take {@dice 10d6 + 40} force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated. A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying, except artifacts, are reduced to fine dust.
zh_tw: 引擎發出一道綠光。每個與引擎直接接觸的生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 18} 體質豁免檢定，否則會受到 {@dice 10d6 + 40} 點力場傷害。如果此傷害將目標的生命值降至0，它將被解離。被解離的生物及其所穿戴和攜帶的所有物品（除了神器外）都會化為細小的塵埃。

english: The engine flickers with blue light and casts {@spell faerie fire}, targeting all creatures within 20 feet of it (save {@dc 18}). The spell's effect has a duration of 1 minute.
zh_tw: 引擎閃爍著藍光並施放{@spell faerie fire||妖火}, 以所有在其20尺內的生物為目標（豁免{@dc 18}）。該法術效果持續1分鐘。

english: The engine spews harmless, multicolored sparks until the start of its next turn.
zh_tw: 引擎噴射出無害的彩色火花，直到它的下一個回合開始。

english: The engine emits a flash of violet light. Each creature within 20 feet of the engine must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition petrified} until the engine's next turn.
zh_tw: 引擎發出一道紫光。引擎周圍20尺內的每個生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 18}體質豁免，否則將被{@condition petrified||石化}直到引擎的下一回合。

english: The engine plays calliope music. The next time this result is rolled, the music stops.
zh_tw: 引擎播放著蒸汽管風琴音樂。下次再擲出這個結果時，音樂停止。

english: The engine makes a horrible grinding noise. All lawful creatures within 30 feet of it regain all of their hit points.
zh_tw: 引擎發出可怕的磨擦聲。所有距離它30尺內的守序生物恢復其所有生命值。

english: The engine emits a flash of violet-white light. All extraplanar creatures within 100 miles of the engine instantly return to their native planes of existence.
zh_tw: 引擎發出一道紫白色的閃光。引擎周圍100英里內的所有異界生物立即返回到它們原本存在的位面。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If you want to add tension to the end of this encounter, have the Maze Engine trigger a minor eruption after it sinks into the magma, causing the magma to bubble up out of the crevasse, spill into the cavern and nearby tunnels, and force the adventurers and their allies to stay ahead of the magma surge.
zh_tw: 如果你想在這次遭遇的結尾增加緊張感，可以讓迷宮引擎在沉入巖漿後觸發一次小規模的噴發，導致巖漿從裂縫中冒泡湧出，流入洞穴和附近的隧道，迫使冒險家和他們的盟友必須領先於巖漿的湧動。

english: Chapter 15: The City of Spiders
zh_tw: 第15章：蜘蛛之城

english: The center of the chaos and madness now spreading throughout the Underdark is the great drow city of Menzoberranzan. Few of the city's drow residents know that the Demon Queen of Spiders is behind the summoning ritual that brought the demon lords to the Underdark—and that the reward for their faith in Lolth might well be their destruction.
zh_tw: 現在在幽暗地域蔓延的混亂和瘋狂的中心是偉大的卓爾城市魔索布萊城。城市中很少有卓爾居民知道蜘蛛惡魔女王是召喚儀式背後的主使，這些儀式將惡魔領主們帶到了幽暗地域——他們對羅絲的信仰的獎賞很可能就是他們的毀滅。

english: Menzoberranzan was the site of Demogorgon's appearance in the Underdark, and the lash of his tentacles and the crushing tread of his clawed feet left a trail of broken buildings, bodies, and minds. Unfortunately for the drow, the worst may be yet to come if the renegade drow archmage {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} won the adventurers' support for his plan to use a powerful ritual to draw the demon lords and their fiendish servants out of the Underdark and set them against each other. As the demon lords destroy each other in the material world, their dark essences will be drawn back to the Abyss once more. But one of the key parts of Vizeran's plan involves the characters' making sure that the City of Spiders plays host to this final, devastating battle.
zh_tw: 魔索布萊城是狄摩高根在幽暗地域出現的地點，他的觸手鞭撻和爪足的沉重腳步留下了一串破碎的建築、屍體和心靈。不幸的是，對於卓爾來說，如果叛逆的卓爾大法師{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}贏得了冒險者對他計劃的支援，最糟糕的情況可能還在後頭。他的計劃是使用一個強大的儀式將惡魔領主及其邪惡的僕從從幽暗地域中引出，並讓他們相互對抗。當惡魔領主在物質世界中相互毀滅時，他們的黑暗本質將再次被吸引回無底深淵。但是，維茲蘭計劃的關鍵部分之一涉及角色們確保蜘蛛之城成為這場最終、毀滅性戰鬥的東道主。

english: Goals
zh_tw: 目標

english: If the characters are working with {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}, they have two goals in the City of Spiders: obtain Gromph Baenre's demon summoning grimoire, and place Vizeran's talisman in Menzoberranzan to draw the demon lords there for an epic showdown.
zh_tw: 如果角色們正在與{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}合作，他們在蜘蛛之城有兩個目標：獲得貢夫·班瑞的惡魔召喚法術書，並將維茲蘭的護符放置在魔索布萊城，以吸引惡魔領主前來進行一場史詩般的對決。

english: Placing the "Dark Heart"
zh_tw: 放置'黑暗之心'

english: After their adventures in the Wormwrithings and the Labyrinth, the characters can return to Araj to deliver the components they have collected to {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}. Over ten days, the drow archmage uses those components to craft a talisman that looks and feels like a five-pound black heart carved of black stone. Imbued with arcane and fiendish power, the {@i dark heart} talisman acts as a beacon when Vizeran's ritual is performed, drawing all demons presently loose in the Underdark. The talisman radiates faint conjuration magic even before it is activated, but it's primarily a focus for the power of the ritual rather than a source of power itself.
zh_tw: 在蠕蟲扭道和迷宮的冒險之後，角色們可以返回到阿拉傑，將他們收集到的元件交給{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}。在十天的時間裡，這位卓爾大法師使用這些元件製作了一個護身符，看起來和感覺上就像是一個由黑色石頭雕刻而成的五磅重的黑色心臟。這個被賦予了奧術和惡魔力量的{@i 黑暗之心}護身符在維茲蘭的儀式進行時充當信標，吸引幽暗地域中所有遊蕩的惡魔。護身符在被啟用之前就散發出微弱的召喚魔法，但它主要是儀式力量的焦點，而不是力量本身的源泉。

english: Vizeran's plan calls for the adventurers to place the {@i dark heart} in Menzoberranzan. Vizeran would prefer for the {@i dark heart} to be left wherever the characters find Gromph Baenre's grimoire in Sorcere—the center of wizardly training in Menzoberranzan. However, Vizeran tells the characters that placing the talisman anywhere in the City of Spiders will do.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的計劃要求冒險者將{@i 黑暗之心}放置在魔索布萊城。維茲蘭更希望{@i 黑暗之心}被留在角色們在索瑟瑞找到貢夫·班瑞的魔典的地方——魔索布萊城的法師訓練中心。然而，維茲蘭告訴角色們，將護身符放置在蜘蛛之城的任何地方都可以。

english: Obtaining Gromph's Grimoire
zh_tw: 獲得貢夫的魔法書

english: Gromph Baenre's grimoire contains notes and references for his ill-fated demon summoning. Vizeran knows from research at Gravenhollow that the grimoire is in Gromph's sanctum in the tower of Sorcere. To reach the grimoire, the characters need to penetrate one of the most important and well-protected places in the City of Spiders.
zh_tw: 貢夫·班瑞的魔典包含了他不幸的惡魔召喚的筆記和參考資料。維茲蘭從刻文谷的研究中知道，魔典在索瑟瑞塔中貢夫的聖所裡。為了到達魔典，角色們需要滲透到蜘蛛之城最重要且保護最嚴密的地方之一。

english: Fortunately for the characters, Vizeran isn't without allies in the city. The Council of Spiders is a secret alliance of drow mages who want to overthrow Lolth's priestesses. The council has infiltrated Sorcere, the city's academy for arcane magic, and has sympathizers among male drow wizards. Vizeran has already contacted his allies, who have agreed to help the party gain access to the tower and Gromph's sanctum (see "{@area Sorcere|55e|x}" later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 對於角色們來說幸運的是，維茲蘭在城市中並非沒有盟友。蜘蛛議會是一個秘密的卓爾法師聯盟，他們想要推翻羅絲的女祭司。議會已經滲透了索瑟瑞，這座城市的奧術魔法學院，並在男性卓爾法師中擁有同情者。維茲蘭已經聯絡了他的盟友，他們同意幫助隊伍進入塔樓和貢夫的聖所（見本章後面的'{@area 索瑟瑞|55e|x}'）。

english: Statistical Modifications for Drow NPCs
zh_tw: 卓爾NPC的統計資料修改

english: When using the generic stat blocks in {@book appendix B|MM|2} of the {@i Monster Manual} to represent drow NPCs, assume that the drow are neutral evil and speak Elvish and Undercommon. Also give those NPCs the following additional features.
zh_tw: 當使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中 {@book 附錄 B|MM|2} 的通用屬性表來代表卓爾 NPC 時，假設卓爾是中立邪惡且會說精靈語和地底通用語。此外，賦予這些 NPC 以下額外特徵。

english: Fey Ancestry
zh_tw: 妖精血統

english: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.
zh_tw: 卓爾進行對抗{@condition charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定時具有優勢，且魔法效應無法使卓爾陷入睡眠。

english: Innate Spellcasting
zh_tw: 天生施法

english: The drow's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC equal to 10 + the drow's Charisma modifier). The drow can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: {@spell dancing lights} 1/day each: {@spell darkness}, {@spell faerie fire}, {@spell levitate} (self only)
zh_tw: 卓爾天生的施法能力是魅力（法術豁免DC等於10加上卓爾的魅力調整值）。卓爾天生能夠無需材料元件施放以下法術：隨時：{@spell dancing lights||舞光術} 每天一次：{@spell darkness||黑暗術}，{@spell faerie fire||妖火}，{@spell levitate||浮空術}（僅自身）

english: Sunlight Sensitivity
zh_tw: 日照敏感

english: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
zh_tw: 在日光照射下，卓爾的攻擊檢定具有劣勢，其依賴視覺的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定也具有劣勢。

english: Going to Menzoberranzan
zh_tw: 前往魔索布萊城

english: Seventy-two miles of twisting passageways separate Araj from Menzoberranzan. Vizeran has a secret route between the two, which he allows the characters to use if they agree to follow his plan. Otherwise, the characters must travel to Menzoberranzan by commonly known routes monitored by drow scouts, patrols, and outposts. If the characters opt to use Vizeran's secret route, the drow archmage's apprentice, Grin Ousstyl (see {@area chapter 12|41b|x}), accompanies the characters at Vizeran's behest, serving as their guide.
zh_tw: 阿拉傑與魔索布萊城之間隔著長達七十二英里的曲折通道。維茲蘭掌握一條連通兩地的秘密路線；只要角色們同意遵照他的計畫行動，他就允許他們使用。否則，角色必須走常見路線前往魔索布萊城，而這些路線都受到卓爾偵察兵、巡邏隊與前哨站監視。若角色選擇秘密路線，卓爾大法師的學徒格林·奧斯提爾（見{@area 第12章|41b|x}）會奉維茲蘭之命隨行，擔任嚮導。

english: Vizeran strongly suggests that the characters leave their expeditionary force at Araj, asserting that a small team has the best chance of infiltrating the drow city.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭強烈建議角色們在阿拉傑留下他們的遠徵隊伍，他堅稱一個小團隊有最好的潛入卓爾城市的機會。

english: Vizeran's Secret Route
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的秘密路線

english: Grin Ousstyl shows the characters a secret door in the cavern wall outside of Vizeran's tower. Beyond this door is a long and winding tunnel that took Vizeran centuries to create using stone-shaping spells. The passage, which is free of monsters and hazards, ends at a secret door at the bottom of the Westrift in Menzoberranzan. The trip from Araj to the city takes twelve days on foot, during which time Grin says very little. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check can tell that the drow mage is troubled by something, although he refuses to share his private thoughts and concerns.
zh_tw: 格林·奧斯提爾向角色們展示了維茲蘭塔之外的洞壁上一扇秘密門。這扇門後是一條漫長而曲折的隧道，維茲蘭花了幾個世紀的時間使用塑石法術來創造它。這條通道沒有怪物和危險，盡頭是位於魔索布萊城西裂谷底部的一扇秘密門。從阿拉傑到該城市的步行旅程需要十二天，在此期間格林幾乎不說話。任何成功透過{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的角色都可以看出這位卓爾法師被某些事情所困擾，儘管他拒絕分享他的私密想法和憂慮。

english: If the characters read Grin's thoughts or compel him to speak using magic or torture, Grin reveals that he has misgivings about Vizeran's plan. Though he has no affection for the matron mothers and priestesses that govern Menzoberranzan, Grin has no wish to see his birthplace—and its people—destroyed. If Grin sees firsthand the destruction wrought by Demogorgon's rampage through the city, he becomes even more reluctant to see Vizeran's plan through (see "{@area A Change of Heart|55d|x}" later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 如果角色們透過魔法或折磨讀取格林的想法或強迫他說話，格林透露他對維茲蘭的計劃有所疑慮。儘管他對統治魔索布萊城的女族長和女祭司沒有感情，格林並不想看到他的出生地——以及那裡的人民——被摧毀。如果格林親眼看到狄摩高根在城市中肆虐造成的破壞，他將更加不願意看到維茲蘭的計劃得以實施（見本章後面的"{@area 心靈的轉變|55d|x}"）。

english: If the characters prod Grin for information about Menzoberranzan and what they can expect to find there, he relates the information contained in "{@area The Way of Lolth|50d|x}" section. He can also describe the major districts of the city.
zh_tw: 如果角色們向格林詢問有關魔索布萊城的資訊以及他們可以期待在那裡找到什麼，他會提供"{@area 羅絲之路|50d|x}"部分所包含的資訊。他還可以描述這座城市的主要區域。

english: Other Routes
zh_tw: 其他路線

english: Characters who can't avail themselves of Vizeran's secret route or choose not to use it must find another way to Menzoberranzan. There are many routes to choose from, such that the party can approach the City of Spiders from literally any direction. However, all of these routes are known to the drow. The characters might have encountered a drow force on a previous attempt to reach the city (see "{@area March on Menzoberranzan|3bd|x}" in chapter 10). If so, they already know what they're up against. Even if they decline to use Vizeran's secret route, the drow archmage recommends that the characters take Grin Ousstyl with them, not so much as a guide but to help the party talk its way past drow patrols.
zh_tw: 無法使用維茲蘭的秘密路線或選擇不使用它的人物必須找到另一種方式前往魔索布萊城。有眾多路線可供選擇，以至於隊伍實際上可以從任何方向接近蜘蛛之城。然而，所有這些路線都為卓爾所知。人物們可能在之前嘗試到達城市時遇到過卓爾力量（見第10章中的"{@area 向魔索布萊城進軍|3bd|x}"）。如果是這樣，他們已經知道他們將面對什麼。即使他們決定不使用維茲蘭的秘密路線，這位卓爾大法師也建議人物們帶上格林·奧斯提爾，與其說是作為嚮導，不如說是幫助隊伍用話語讓卓爾巡邏隊放行。

english: The demonic invasion has put Menzoberranzan's defenses on high alert, making it even harder than normal for non-drow to approach the city safely by any known route. While the characters are within 18 miles (three days' travel) of the city, use the Drow Patrols table to determine random encounters instead of using the tables in {@area chapter 2|07f|x}. Once every hour, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the table to determine what, if anything, the party encounters.
zh_tw: 惡魔的入侵使魔索布萊城的防禦處於高度警戒狀態，使得非卓爾比平常更難以透過任何已知路線安全接近城市。當角色們在城市18英里（三天的旅行）範圍內時，使用卓爾巡邏隊表來確定隨機遭遇，而不是使用{@area 第二章|07f|x}中的表格。每小時，擲一個{@dice d20}並查閱表格，以確定隊伍遇到了什麼，如果有的話。

english: Drow Defenses
zh_tw: 卓爾防禦

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: No encounter
zh_tw: 無事發生

english: Drow patrol A
zh_tw: 卓爾巡邏隊A

english: Drow patrol B
zh_tw: 卓爾巡邏隊B

english: Drow patrol C
zh_tw: 卓爾巡邏隊C

english: Drow patrol D
zh_tw: 卓爾巡邏隊D

english: Drow Patrol A
zh_tw: 卓爾巡邏隊A

english: The standard patrol consists of two {@creature drow Scout|OotA|drow scouts} mounted on {@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|giant riding lizards} (use the statistics at the end of {@area chapter 8|34c|x}). Characters who can see out to a range of 120 or more and are moving at a normal pace spot the drow scouts with a successful {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. If the characters are moving at a fast pace, they take a −5 penalty to their checks.
zh_tw: 標準巡邏隊由兩名騎乘在{@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|乘用巨蜥}上的{@creature drow Scout|OotA|卓爾斥候}組成（使用{@area 第八章|34c|x}末尾的資料）。視野範圍達到120或更遠且以正常步調移動的角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 16}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定發現卓爾斥候們。如果角色以快速步調移動，他們的檢定會受到−5減值。

english: Unless the characters are moving at a slow pace and being stealthy, the drow spot them with their {@sense darkvision} and withdraw to an outpost located a mile away. Defending the drow outpost are a female {@creature drow elite warrior} (the commander), a male {@creature drow mage}, and sixteen {@creature drow}. The outpost is a four-story tower carved out of a 60-foot-tall, 15-foot-wide column in the middle of a 75-foot-diameter cavern. Both the cavern and the outpost are unlit. A secret door in the column's base leads to the tower interior, but finding it requires a thorough search and a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Arrow slits on each floor allow the drow to cast spells and make ranged attacks in every direction while enjoying {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover} against attacks from the cavern.
zh_tw: 除非角色以緩慢的速度移動並且保持隱秘，否則卓爾會用他們的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}發現他們並撤退到一英里外的哨站。守衛卓爾哨站的是一名女性{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}（指揮官），一名男性{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}和十六名{@creature drow||卓爾}。哨站是一座四層高的塔樓，雕刻在直徑75尺的洞穴中央，高60尺、寬15尺的石柱中。洞穴和哨站都沒有照明。石柱底部的一扇秘密門通向塔樓內部，但要找到它需要進行徹底的搜尋併成功透過{@dc 20}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。每層的箭縫允許卓爾在各個方向施放法術並進行遠端攻擊，同時享{@quickref Cover||3||四分之三掩護}以抵禦來自洞穴的攻擊。

english: If the drow scouts escape and the characters don't follow them, the scouts report to the outpost commander, who organizes a hunting party consisting of her and eight drow (leaving the mage and eight drow to staff the outpost). Use the drow pursuit rules in {@area chapter 2|078|x}, and assume a pursuit level of 4.
zh_tw: 如果卓爾偵察兵逃脫，而角色們沒有追蹤他們，偵察兵會向前哨指揮官報告，指揮官會組織一個由她自己和八名卓爾組成的狩獵隊（留下法師和八名卓爾守衛前哨）。使用{@area 第二章|078|x}中的卓爾追擊規則，並假設追擊等級為4。

english: Drow Patrol B
zh_tw: 卓爾巡邏隊B

english: The characters encounter a {@creature drow elite warrior} and {@dice 1d8} {@creature drow} fighting a {@creature hezrou} demon. The hezrou has {@dice 2d10 + 45} hit points remaining, while each drow has {@dice 2d6} hit points remaining. The drow elite warrior isn't wounded. Without interference, the drow slay the demon, with the drow elite warrior and {@dice 1d4}−1 drow surviving the encounter. If the characters get involved, the encounter becomes a three-way fight, as neither the drow nor the demon are interested in forming an alliance.
zh_tw: 角色們遇見一名{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}和{@dice 1d8}名{@creature drow||卓爾}，正與一隻{@creature hezrou||狂蟾魔}惡魔交戰。狂蟾魔剩餘{@dice 2d10 + 45}點生命值，每名卓爾剩餘{@dice 2d6}點生命值，卓爾精英武者則毫髮無傷。如果沒有人介入，卓爾會殺死惡魔，最終只有卓爾精英武者和{@dice 1d4}−1名卓爾存活。如果角色們加入，戰鬥會變成三方混戰，因為卓爾和惡魔都無意結盟。

english: Characters can keep their distance and avoid the altercation. However, any drow who survive the battle head to the nearest drow outpost {@dice 1d4} miles away. After hearing the survivors' report, the outpost commander organizes a hunting party to search for the characters, as described in "{@area Drow Patrol A|4de|x}."
zh_tw: 角色們可以保持距離，避免衝突。然而，任何在戰鬥中倖存的卓爾都會前往最近的卓爾前哨站，距離為{@dice 1d4}英里。在聽到生還者的報告後，前哨站指揮官組織了一個狩獵隊來尋找角色們，如"{@area 卓爾巡邏隊A|4de|x}"中所述。

english: Drow Patrol C
zh_tw: 卓爾巡邏隊C

english: The characters encounter a drow patrol consisting of a {@creature drow mage}, {@dice 2d4} {@creature drow}, and a group of slaves. Roll a {@dice d10} and consult the Drow Slaves table to determine what slaves are present. Trolls fight to the death; other slaves attempt to flee if all the drow are killed.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了一支由一名{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}、{@dice 2d4}名{@creature drow||卓爾}和一群奴隸組成的卓爾巡邏隊。擲一個{@dice d10}並查閱卓爾奴隸表以確定有哪些奴隸在場。巨魔會戰鬥至死；如果所有卓爾都被殺死，其他奴隸會試圖逃跑。

english: Drow Slaves
zh_tw: 卓爾奴隸

english: Slaves
zh_tw: 奴隸

english: {@dice 3d6} {@creature derro|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19})
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} {@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）

english: {@dice 3d6} {@creature Goblin||goblins}
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} {@creature Goblin||地精}

english: {@dice 3d6} {@creature Orc||orcs}
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} {@creature Orc||獸人}

english: {@dice 2d6} {@creature Quaggoth||quaggoths}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} {@creature Quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}

english: {@dice 1d6} {@creature Troll||trolls}
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} {@creature Troll||巨魔}

english: Drow Patrol D
zh_tw: 卓爾巡邏隊D

english: The characters encounter a {@creature drow mage} riding on the back of a {@creature stone golem} carved from stone and shaped like a giant spider. The mage rides in a howdah that provides {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} against attacks from the ground. Escorting the mage are {@dice 2d4} {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} mounted on {@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|giant riding lizards} (use the statistics at the end of {@area chapter 8|34c|x}). These drow fight to the death to protect their territory.
zh_tw: 角色遇見一名{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}，騎在一尊巨蜘蛛形狀的{@creature stone golem||石魔像}背上。法師乘坐的鞍轎能對抗來自地面的攻擊，提供{@quickref Cover||3||半身掩護}。護衛是{@dice 2d4}名騎乘{@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|乘用巨蜥}的{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}（使用{@area 第8章|34c|x}末尾的資料）。這些卓爾會為了保護領地而戰至最後一刻。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The spider golem's eight eyes are six-inch-diameter red crystal orbs worth 1,000 gp each.
zh_tw: 蜘蛛魔像的八隻眼睛是直徑六吋的紅色水晶球體，每個價值1,000金幣。

english: Menzoberranzan
zh_tw: 魔索布萊城

english: {@b Population}: 20,000 drow plus thousands of slaves (of various races)
zh_tw: {@b 人口}: 20,000名卓爾加上數以千計的奴隸（各種族）

english: {@b Government}: Matriarchal theocracy worshiping Lolth, the Demon Queen of Spiders
zh_tw: {@b 政治}: 崇拜蜘蛛惡魔女王羅絲的母系神權政治

english: {@b Defense}: Large standing army of trained drow warriors and mages, bolstered by armed slaves and magical wards; the citizens of the city create a formidable militia
zh_tw: {@b 防禦}: 由訓練有素的卓爾戰士和法師組成的大型常備軍，輔以武裝奴隸和魔法結界；城市居民組成了一支強大的民兵隊伍

english: {@b Commerce}: Well-trained slaves; various fungi, molds, and exotic creatures for food; poisons, potions, oils, and elixirs; jewelry, perfume, and silk
zh_tw: {@b 商業}: 訓練有素的奴隸；各種食用真菌、黴菌和外來生物；毒藥、藥水、油和靈藥；珠寶、香水和絲綢

english: {@b Organizations}: The Ruling Council (comprised of the matron mothers of the eight most powerful {@creature drow noble|OotA} houses in the city), the Church of Lolth (based in Arach-Tinilith), Bregan D'aerthe (company of drow spies, mercenaries, and assassins)
zh_tw: {@b 組織}：統治議會（由城市中八個最強大的{@creature drow noble|OotA|卓爾貴族}家族的族母組成），羅絲教會（位於阿拉奇-提尼利瑟），布雷甘·達耶（由卓爾間諜、僱傭兵和刺客組成的公司）

english: The City of Spiders is carved out of and built within a great cavern the drow call {@i Araurilcaurak}, its vault soaring a thousand feet above the stone floor. Drow dwellings and strongholds are carved from massive stalagmites and stalactites, connected with delicate-looking bridges of hardened spider silk and lit with coldly glowing eldritch fires.
zh_tw: 蜘蛛之城是在卓爾稱之為{@i 巨柱洞窟}的巨大洞穴中挖掘並建造的，其穹頂高聳於石地板之上一千尺。卓爾的住所和要塞是從巨大的石筍和鐘乳石中雕刻而成，用看起來脆弱的硬化蛛絲橋連線，用冷光閃爍的奧術火焰照亮。

english: Map 15.1: Menzoberranzan
zh_tw: 地圖 15.1: 魔索布萊城

english: The Dark Dominion
zh_tw: 黑暗主宰

english: The rock surrounding the city is honeycombed with tunnels and passageways forming the Dark Dominion, a territory claimed by the drow but not part of the city proper. Home to all manner of Underdark denizens, this maze forms part of Menzoberranzan's defenses as well as its underworld—a dangerous place for dark dealings and clandestine meetings.
zh_tw: 環繞城市的岩石中佈滿了隧道和通道，形成了黑暗統治區，這是一片由卓爾宣稱的領土，但不是城市本身的一部分。這個迷宮是幽暗地域居民的家園，它既是魔索布萊城防禦體系的一部分，也是其幽暗地域的一部分——一個充滿危險交易和秘密會面的場所。

english: The Dark Dominion is a great place for random encounters. When it suits you, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Dark Dominion Encounters table to determine what the party encounters, or choose an encounter that you like.
zh_tw: 黑暗領域是進行隨機遭遇的好地方。當適合時，擲一個{@dice d20}骰子，並參照黑暗領域遭遇表來確定隊伍遇到了什麼，或者選擇一個你喜歡的遭遇。

english: Dark Dominion Encounters
zh_tw: 黑暗主宰遭遇戰

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Bugbear||bugbears}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Bugbear||熊地精}

english: Clandestine meeting
zh_tw: 秘密會面

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Drider||driders}
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Drider||蛛化卓爾}

english: {@creature Drow} patrol
zh_tw: {@creature Drow||卓爾} 巡邏隊

english: {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|drow spore servants} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19})
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|卓爾孢子奴僕}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）

english: Escaped slaves
zh_tw: 逃脫的奴隸

english: {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Goblin||goblins}
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Goblin||地精}

english: {@spell Glyph of warding}
zh_tw: {@spell Glyph of warding||守衛刻文}

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Intellect Devourer||intellect devourers}
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Intellect Devourer||噬腦怪}

english: Bugbears
zh_tw: 熊地精

english: The {@creature Bugbear||bugbears} are branded with the mark of a drow house, identifying them as slaves. They try to sneak up on the party and score an easy kill.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Bugbear||熊地精}身上帶有卓爾家族的標記，表明它們是奴隸。它們試圖悄悄接近隊伍，以取得輕鬆的勝利。

english: Clandestine Meeting
zh_tw: 秘密會面

english: The party happens upon a meeting between a {@creature drow} house representative and some outside business interest. The drow is escorted by {@dice 1d4}−1 {@creature bugbear} bodyguards. The individual with whom the drow is meeting can be any of the following.
zh_tw: 隊伍偶然遇到一個{@creature drow||卓爾}家族代表和一些外部商業利益之間的會面。卓爾由{@dice 1d4}-1名{@creature bugbear||熊地精}保鏢護送。與卓爾會面的人可以是以下任何一種。

english: Duergar Alchemist
zh_tw: 灰矮人鍊金術士

english: This {@creature Duergar Alchemist|OotA|duergar} is trying to procure rare alchemical ingredients or equipment (see the "{@area Duergar Alchemist|1db|x}" sidebar in chapter 4 for statistical modifications).
zh_tw: 這位{@creature Duergar Alchemist|OotA|灰矮人}正試圖採購稀有的鍊金材料或裝置（見第4章"{@area 灰矮人鍊金術士|1db|x}"邊欄瞭解統計資料修改）。

english: Duergar Spy
zh_tw: 灰矮人間諜

english: This {@creature duergar} from Gracklstugh is trying to bribe a drow for information about who is responsible for the demonic invasion.
zh_tw: 這個來自格拉克斯圖格的{@creature duergar||灰矮人}試圖賄賂一名卓爾，以獲取有關誰對惡魔入侵負責的資訊。

english: Human Assassin
zh_tw: 人類刺客

english: This {@creature assassin} does dirty work for the drow and is being hired to eliminate someone on the surface world.
zh_tw: 這位{@creature assassin||刺客}為卓爾做髒活，並且被僱傭去暗殺地表世界的某個人。

english: Khalessa Draga
zh_tw: 卡萊莎·德拉加

english: If the characters haven't already encountered this Lords' Alliance spy, {@creature Khalessa Draga|OotA|Khalessa} (see "{@area March on Menzoberranzan|3bd|x}" at the end of chapter 10) is in her drow disguise, buying information of value to the alliance. When she sees the party, she ends her meeting and tries to find out why the characters are here. If the party includes one or more members of the Lords' Alliance, she offers to help them complete their mission. Otherwise, she is unwilling to break her cover.
zh_tw: 如果角色們尚未遇到這位領主聯盟的間諜，{@creature Khalessa Draga|OotA|卡萊莎}（見第10章末尾的"{@area 向魔索布萊城進軍|3bd|x}"）正偽裝成卓爾，購買對聯盟有價值的資訊。當她看到隊伍時，她結束了會議，並試圖弄清楚角色們為何在此。如果隊伍中包括一個或多個領主聯盟的成員，她會提供幫助以完成他們的任務。否則，她不願意暴露自己的身份。

english: Driders
zh_tw: 蛛化卓爾

english: These outcasts perch atop high ledges or cling to the high ceiling, attacking with their bows while staying out of the range of melee weapons. A {@creature drider} retreats if reduced to 60 hit points or fewer.
zh_tw: 這些流亡者棲息在高高的懸崖上或緊貼在高高的天花板上，用弓箭攻擊，同時保持在近戰武器的攻擊範圍之外。一個{@creature drider||蛛化卓爾}如果生命值降至60點或更少時會撤退。

english: Drow Patrol
zh_tw: 卓爾巡邏隊

english: The characters encounter a patrol consisting of {@dice 2d4} {@creature drow} led by a {@creature drow elite warrior}. The patrol stops and questions any non-drow who aren't slaves, as well as drow they deem suspicious. It might take roleplaying or a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Persuasion}) check to convince the patrol not to attack the party. If Grin Ousstyl is with the party, he quietly suggests that the characters offer the drow a bribe of at least 50 gp. If they do, the characters gain advantage on checks made to talk their way past the patrol.
zh_tw: 隊伍遇到了一支由 {@dice 2d4} 名 {@creature drow||卓爾} 組成的巡邏隊，由一名 {@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者} 領導。巡邏隊會攔下並盤問任何非卓爾且不是奴隸的人，以及他們認為可疑的卓爾。角色需要透過角色扮演或成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Deception||欺瞞} 或 {@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定來說服巡邏隊不攻擊隊伍。如果格林·奧斯提爾與隊伍在一起，他會悄悄建議角色們向卓爾行賄至少 50 金幣。如果他們這樣做，角色在試圖說服巡邏隊放行的檢定時將獲得優勢。

english: Any sign of a large, armed, and potentially hostile group causes the patrol to retreat and seek reinforcements. If the characters remain in the area, the patrol returns with two additional patrols {@dice 1d10} minutes later.
zh_tw: 任何表明有大型、武裝且可能敵對的團體的跡象都會使巡邏隊撤退並尋求增援。如果角色們仍然在該地區，巡邏隊將在{@dice 1d10}分鐘後帶著兩個額外的巡邏隊返回。

english: Drow Spore Servants
zh_tw: 卓爾孢子僕從

english: These drow became infected with Zuggtmoy's spores and have transformed into {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|spore servants}. They silently observe the party but don't attack the characters unless threatened.
zh_tw: 這些卓爾被祖格莫伊的孢子感染，已經轉變成了{@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|孢子僕從}。他們默默地觀察著隊伍，但除非受到威脅，否則不會攻擊角色。

english: Escaped Slaves
zh_tw: 逃脫的奴隸

english: A group of {@dice 1d4} {@creature Commoner||commoners} (of any race) attempts to hide from the approaching party. If spotted, they beg the characters for mercy, explaining that they have escaped from their drow masters following "the great demon's rampage" and have been hiding in the tunnels ever since. The slaves can provide the characters with a detailed description of the attack, confirming that the demon lord Demogorgon was behind the destruction. The slaves are desperate to escape from the drow and pitifully grateful for any aid offered.
zh_tw: 一群{@dice 1d4}個{@creature Commoner||平民}（任何種族）試圖躲避接近的隊伍。如果被發現，他們請求角色們寬恕，解釋說他們在"大惡魔的暴走"之後逃離了他們的卓爾主人，並一直躲在隧道里。這些奴隸可以向角色們提供攻擊的詳細描述，確認惡魔領主狄摩高根是這次破壞的幕後黑手。這些奴隸迫切希望逃離卓爾，對任何提供的幫助都感激不盡。

english: Goblins
zh_tw: 地精

english: The goblins beg for food. If the characters give them food or otherwise treat the goblins well, they show the party a secret door that opens into a forgotten tunnel. Roll a {@dice d10} and consult the Goblin Tunnel table to determine where the tunnel leads.
zh_tw: 地精們乞求食物。如果角色們給他們食物或以其他方式善待地精，他們會向隊伍展示一扇通往被遺忘隧道的秘密門。擲一個{@dice d10}並查閱地精隧道表以確定隧道通向哪裡。

english: Goblin Tunnel
zh_tw: 地精隧道

english: Tunnel Destination
zh_tw: 隧道目的地

english: Kyorbblivvin (see "{@area Kyorbblivvin|51f|x}")
zh_tw: 奇奧布利文（見"{@area 奇奧布利文|51f|x}"）

english: A hidden cave containing {@dice 1d4} {@creature Mind Flayer||mind flayers}
zh_tw: 一個隱藏的洞穴，內含{@dice 1d4}只{@creature Mind Flayer||奪心魔}

english: A hidden cave in which the party can rest without having to worry about random encounters
zh_tw: 一個隱藏的洞穴，隊伍可以在此休息而不必擔心隨機遭遇戰

english: A hidden cave containing {@dice 4d8} {@creature Goblin||goblins} and a {@creature goblin} boss, who will trade a magic item in its possession for the equivalent of 30 days of rations (to determine the item, roll once on Magic Item Table C in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Random Treasure} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide})
zh_tw: 一個隱藏的洞穴，裡面藏有 {@dice 4d8} 只 {@creature Goblin||地精} 和一名 {@creature goblin||地精} 首領，它會用自己持有的一件魔法物品換取相當於 30 天口糧的物資（要確定該物品，請在 {@i 城主指南} 的 {@book 第七章|DMG|7|Random Treasure} 中的魔法物品表 C 上進行一次擲骰）

english: A trap door near the Bazaar (see "{@area The Bazaar|4fb|x}")
zh_tw: 市集附近的一個陷阱門（見"{@area 佈雷什美術博物館大使塔區，中層中央高地|4fb|x}"）

english: Glyph of Warding
zh_tw: 守衛刻文

english: Drow priestesses are fond of placing {@i glyphs of warding} in the tunnels surrounding Menzoberranzan. Such a glyph allows drow to pass safely but triggers whenever a non-drow passes by it. A drow {@spell glyph of warding} has a spell save DC of 13 and an explosive runes effect (see the spell's description in the {@i Player's Handbook}).
zh_tw: 卓爾祭司喜歡在圍繞魔索布萊城的隧道中放置 {@i 守衛刻文}。這種刻文允許卓爾安全透過，但當非卓爾生物經過時會觸發。卓爾的 {@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文} 具有法術豁免 DC 為 13 和爆炸符文效果（參見 {@i 玩家手冊} 中的法術描述）。

english: Intellect Devourers
zh_tw: 噬腦怪

english: Mind flayers like to send {@creature Intellect Devourer||intellect devourers} into the Dark Dominion in search of hosts, using them as spies to keep an eye on the drow city. These intellect devourers creep up behind the party and use their Devour Intellect attack against party members in the rear of the marching order.
zh_tw: 奪心魔喜歡派遣{@creature Intellect Devourer||噬腦怪}進入黑暗領域尋找宿主，利用它們作為間諜來監視卓爾城市。這些奪心魔蝌蚪會悄悄接近隊伍的後方，並使用它們的吞噬智力攻擊行進隊伍的後方成員。

english: Menzoberranzan: General Features
zh_tw: 魔索布萊城: 一般特徵

english: The following features can be found throughout the City of Spiders.
zh_tw: 在蜘蛛之城中可以找到以下特點。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Most streets and buildings are lit by eldritch green, blue, and violet lights as bright as torches (created with {@spell continual flame} spells). Other areas are dark.
zh_tw: 大多數街道和建築物由發出火炬般亮度的詭異綠色、藍色和紫羅蘭色光芒照亮（由{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術創造）。其他區域則是黑暗的。

english: Shielded City
zh_tw: 護盾城市

english: The drow have locked down their city in the wake of Demogorgon's rampage. For the duration of this adventure, creatures can't teleport into or out of Menzoberranzan. In addition, creatures, objects, and spaces within the city can't be targeted by divination spells or perceived through scrying sensors created by divination spells.
zh_tw: 在狄摩高根的暴行之後，卓爾封鎖了他們的城市。在這次冒險期間，生物無法傳送進出魔索布萊城。此外，城市內的生物、物體和空間不能被占卜法術定位，也不能透過占卜法術創造的窺視感測器感知。

english: The Stone Curse
zh_tw: 石化詛咒

english: The "stone curse" is an ancient enchantment woven by the wizards of Sorcere to protect the city from cave-ins. Any character casting {@spell earthquake}, {@spell move earth}, or similar magic within the city triggers a {@spell reverse gravity} spell (save {@dc 18}) centered on the caster, which takes effect before the triggering spell is completed. The {@spell reverse gravity} lasts for 1 minute, and is accompanied by a peal of thunder that alerts everyone nearby. The caster of the triggering spell must make a successful {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration. On a failed check, the triggering spell fails.
zh_tw: "石化詛咒"是由索瑟瑞的巫師編織的古老咒語，旨在保護城市免受塌陷之災。任何在城內施放{@spell earthquake||地震術}、{@spell move earth||地動術}或類似魔法的角色，將觸發一道以施法者為中心的{@spell reverse gravity||反轉重力}法術（豁免{@dc 18}），該法術在觸發的法術完成前生效。{@spell reverse gravity||反轉重力}效果持續1分鐘，並伴隨著一聲雷鳴，提醒附近的每個人。觸發法術的施法者必須成功透過{@dc 18}體質豁免檢定以保持專注。若檢定失敗，觸發的法術將失敗。

english: City Locations
zh_tw: 城市地點

english: Characters who infiltrate Menzoberranzan might find themselves in one or more of the following areas or districts.
zh_tw: 潛入魔索布萊城的角色可能會發現自己處於以下一個或多個區域或區域之中。

english: The Bazaar
zh_tw: 佈雷什美術博物館大使塔區，中層中央高地

english: This 750-foot-wide circle of bare bedrock is a crowded, untidy labyrinth of stalls, many of which were flattened or torn asunder by Demogorgon. Merchants who survived the attack are slowly returning to the Bazaar and cleaning up the mess, but little business is happening here at present. Drow commoners go quietly about their business, heads down and hoods drawn, as drow patrols brutally stamp down anything that resembles theft or looting.
zh_tw: 這個750尺寬的裸露基岩圓圈內，是一個擁擠且雜亂無章的攤位迷宮，其中許多攤位被狄摩高根夷為平地或撕裂。在襲擊中倖存的商人正慢慢回到集市並清理混亂，但目前這裡幾乎沒有什麼生意發生。卓爾平民低頭戴著兜帽，默默地處理他們的事務，而卓爾巡邏隊殘酷地打壓任何類似於盜竊或搶劫的行為。

english: Characters moving through the Bazaar have at least one encounter with a drow patrol consisting of two {@creature drow} mounted on {@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|giant riding lizards} (see the end of {@area chapter 8|34c|x} for statistics). If one or more party members appear to be anything other than drow or slaves in the company of its drow master, the patrol immediately calls for reinforcements, which arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds. These reinforcements consist of {@dice 3d4} {@creature drow} on foot and {@dice 2d4} {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} that scuttle down from nearby rooftops.
zh_tw: 在市集穿行的角色至少會遇到一次由兩名騎在{@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|乘用巨蜥}上的{@creature drow||卓爾}組成的卓爾巡邏隊（見{@area 第八章|34c|x}以獲取具體數值）。如果隊伍成員看起來不是卓爾或其主人的奴隸，巡邏隊會立即呼叫增援，增援將在{@dice 1d4}回合內到達。這些增援包括{@dice 3d4}名步行的{@creature drow||卓爾}和從附近屋頂爬下來的{@dice 2d4}只{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}。

english: The Braeryn
zh_tw: 布里爾林區

english: The Braeryn (also known as "the Stenchstreets") is a shantytown of ramshackle structures overlooking garbage-choked alleyways, inhabited by the dregs of drow society. Fallen priestesses, bankrupt merchants, escaped slaves, and the homeless or maimed are common here, as are visitors to the city who wish to go unnoticed.
zh_tw: 布雷恩（也被稱為"惡臭街"）是一個棚戶區，由搖搖欲墜的建築組成，俯瞰著被垃圾堵塞的小巷，是卓爾社會最底層人士的居住地。這裡常有墮落的女祭司、破產的商人、逃脫的奴隸以及無家可歸或殘疾的人，同樣也有希望在城市中不引人注意的訪客。

english: The population of the Stenchstreets has swelled in the wake of Demogorgon's rampage. Drow who have lost homes or businesses find what shelter they can here, scratching out a meager existence among the roughest folk in Menzoberranzan.
zh_tw: 狄摩高根的暴走之後，惡臭街的人口激增。失去家園或生意的卓爾在這裡尋找避難所，與魔索布萊城中最粗暴的人們一起勉強維持生計。

english: The Braeryn is a great place to find allies or meet an untimely end. Roll for random encounters as the characters explore this district. You can roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Encounters in the Braeryn table, or choose an encounter that you like. The party can avoid random encounters in the Braeryn by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) group check.
zh_tw: 佈雷倫是一個尋找盟友或遭遇不幸的好地方。當角色們探索這個區域時，進行隨機遭遇的擲骰。你可以擲一個 {@dice d20} 並參考佈雷倫遭遇表，或者選擇一個你喜歡的遭遇。隊伍可以透過一個 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）團體檢定成功來避免在佈雷倫的隨機遭遇。

zh_tw: 在佈雷林的遭遇
