english: Bugbears
zh_tw: 熊地精

english: These {@creature Bugbear||bugbears} skulk through the streets, murdering lone travelers or small groups for food. If the party outnumbers them, they follow the characters in the hopes that one or more of them become separated from the larger group, whereupon the bugbears attack.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Bugbear||熊地精}潛行在街道上，為了食物而謀殺獨自旅行者或小團體。如果隊伍人數超過他們，他們會跟蹤角色，希望其中一個或多個與大團體分離，然後巨魔會發起攻擊。

english: Drow Adolescents
zh_tw: 卓爾青少年

english: This roving gang consists of {@dice 1d6 + 6} {@creature drow Bandit|OotA|drow bandits}. If the gang outnumbers the party, the drow attack. Otherwise, they make lewd hand gestures at the party but retreat if accosted.
zh_tw: 這支越野鎬由{@dice 1d6 + 6}個{@creature drow Bandit|OotA|卓爾匪徒}組成。如果匪幫人數超過隊伍，卓爾們會發動攻擊。否則，他們會向隊伍做出下流手勢，但若被挑釁就會撤退。

english: Drow Pickpocket
zh_tw: 卓爾扒手

english: This homeless {@creature drow commoner|OotA} tries to pick the pockets of a random party member. The drow has a {@skill Sleight of Hand} skill modifier of +2.
zh_tw: 這個無家可歸的{@creature drow commoner|OotA|卓爾平民}試圖隨機扒竊一名隊伍成員的口袋。該卓爾擁有+2的{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}技能調整值。

english: Giant Wolf Spiders
zh_tw: 巨狼蛛

english: These {@creature Giant Wolf Spider||spiders} are hungry and crawl out of buildings or descend from rooftops to attack the party.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Giant Wolf Spider||蜘蛛}非常飢餓，它們從建築物中爬出來或從屋頂上下來攻擊隊伍。

english: Infected Drow
zh_tw: 被感染的卓爾

english: This {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|drow} has been infected with Zuggtmoy's spores (see {@area chapter 5|224|x}) and will succumb to the infestation in {@dice 1d12} hours. Strange fungi has already begun sprouting from the drow's head and limbs. The drow offers a 500 gp gemstone in exchange for the party's protection and tries to stay as close to the characters as possible, hoping to infect them with his or her spores when the time comes.
zh_tw: 這隻{@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|卓爾}已被祖格莫伊的孢子感染（見{@area 第五章|224|x}），將在{@dice 1d12}小時內被完全寄生。奇怪的真菌已開始從卓爾的頭部和四肢生長。卓爾提供了一顆價值500金幣的寶石以換取隊伍的保護，並儘可能靠近角色，希望在時機成熟時將其孢子傳染給他們。

english: Mad Drow
zh_tw: 瘋狂的卓爾

english: This {@creature drow commoner|OotA} suffers from a form of indefinite madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). The drow believes he or she is the true voice of Lolth, tasked by the Demon Queen of Spiders to admonish everyone for their lack of devotion, warning that "Demons will consume you all!" The mad drow wears an amulet made from a dead spider.
zh_tw: 這個{@creature drow commoner|OotA|卓爾平民}患有一種永久性瘋狂（參見{@area 瘋狂|063|x}，位於{@i 城主指南}第二章）。這名卓爾相信自己就是羅絲的真實聲音，被蜘蛛惡魔女王委派來譴責所有人缺乏奉獻精神，並警告說"惡魔會吞噬你們所有人！"這名瘋狂的卓爾佩戴著一個由死蜘蛛製成的護符。

english: Shield Dwarf Berserker
zh_tw: 盾矮人狂戰士

english: This chaotic neutral {@creature Berserker||dwarf}—a former slave of the drow—sees nonexistent enemies everywhere, swinging his or her greataxe at the empty air. If a character engages the dwarf in battle or conversation, the dwarf attacks.
zh_tw: 這個混亂中立的{@creature Berserker||矮人}——曾是卓爾的奴隸——到處看到不存在的敵人，向空氣揮舞著他或她的雙手巨斧。如果一個角色與矮人交戰或交談，矮人會攻擊。

english: Svirfneblin Lure
zh_tw: 地底侏儒誘餌

english: A homeless {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} serves as host to an {@creature intellect devourer}. It tries to lure one or more characters to a "secret enclave where enemies of the drow plot to overthrow Menzoberranzan." A successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check reveals something indescribably odd or untrustworthy about the gnome. If the characters follow the possessed gnome, they are led to a cramped cave under a dilapidated building. The cave is the secret lair of another {@dice 2d4} {@creature Intellect Devourer||intellect devourers}.
zh_tw: 一個無家可歸的{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}成為了一個{@creature intellect devourer||噬腦怪}的宿主。它試圖引誘一個或多個角色前往一個"秘密據點，那裡的卓爾敵人密謀推翻魔索布萊城。" 一個成功的{@dc 15} 感知 ({@skill Insight||洞悉}) 檢定會發現這個侏儒身上有某種難以形容的古怪或不信任。如果角色們跟隨這個被附身的侏儒，他們會被帶到一個破舊建築下的狹小洞穴。這個洞穴是另外{@dice 2d4}個{@creature Intellect Devourer||噬腦怪}的秘密巢穴。

english: Donigarten
zh_tw: 多尼加騰

english: Donigarten is the name given a large lake and the surrounding farmland that dominates the eastern part of the cavern. Herds of rothé cattle graze the island at the center of the lake, whose northern and western shores hold broad stretches of slave-tended fungi fields that feed much of Menzoberranzan.
zh_tw: 多尼加騰是一個大湖及其周圍農田的名字，它佔據了洞穴東部的主要部分。一群洛斯獸牛在湖心島上放牧，湖的北部和西部海岸有廣闊的由奴隸照料的真菌田，這些真菌田為魔索布萊城的大部分人口提供食物。

english: The dark, cold waters of the lake have a sinister reputation, dating back to days when notable leaders of the great houses and their honored heroes were cast into the lake, dressed in full regalia and weighed down with stone spars. Many less important drow have been sent by rivals to the bottom of the lake as well, whose depths are suffused with {@i faerzress} that makes them impenetrable to scrying and divination spells.
zh_tw: 這個湖泊的黑暗、冰冷水域有著邪惡的名聲，可以追溯到偉大家族的傑出領袖和他們的英雄被全副武裝地投入湖中，身上綁著重石。許多不那麼重要的卓爾也被對手送到湖底，那裡充滿了使窺視和占卜法術無法穿透的{@i 妖光}。

english: Donigarten was spared from Demogorgon's rampage. Although it is sparsely populated, the area is so vital to the city's survival that drow patrols are common here. Roll for random encounters as the characters cross this district. You can roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Donigarten Encounters table, or choose an encounter that you like. The party can avoid random encounters in Donigarten by succeeding on a {@dc 11} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) group check.
zh_tw: 多尼加騰在狄摩高根的肆虐中倖免於難。儘管這裡人口稀少，但該地區對城市的生存至關重要，因此卓爾的巡邏隊在此處很常見。當角色穿越這個區域時，擲骰決定隨機遭遇。你可以擲一個 {@dice d20} 並參考多尼加騰遭遇表，或者選擇一個你喜歡的遭遇。團隊可以透過成功進行一個 {@dc 11} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）群體檢定來避免在多尼加騰的隨機遭遇。

zh_tw: 多尼加騰遭遇戰

english: {@dice 2d4 + 2} {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|drow spore servants} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19})
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4 + 2} {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|卓爾孢子奴僕}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）

zh_tw: 奴隸農民

english: Drow Patrol
zh_tw: 卓爾巡邏隊

english: This patrol consists of two {@creature drow} mounted on {@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|giant riding lizards} (see the end of {@area chapter 8|34c|x} for statistics). If one or more party members appear to be anything other than drow or slaves in the company of its drow master, the patrol immediately calls for reinforcements, which arrive in {@dice 1d4 + 2} rounds. The reinforcements consist of {@dice 1d4} similar drow patrols.
zh_tw: 這支巡邏隊由兩名騎在{@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|乘用巨蜥}上的{@creature drow||卓爾}組成（統計資料見{@area 第八章|34c|x}）。如果有任何一名冒險者看起來不是卓爾或與其卓爾主人同行的奴隸，巡邏隊會立即呼叫增援，增援將在{@dice 1d4 + 2}輪內到達。增援包括{@dice 1d4}支類似的卓爾巡邏隊。

english: Drow Spore Servants
zh_tw: 卓爾孢子僕從

english: These {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|drow} fell prey to Zuggtmoy's spores and were drawn to the fungi fields of Donigarten, where they now roam as a pack, attacking intruders on sight.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|卓爾}成了祖格莫伊孢子的犧牲品，被吸引到了多尼加騰的真菌田，現在他們作為一個群體在那裡遊蕩，一見到入侵者就攻擊。

english: Escaped Slaves
zh_tw: 逃脫的奴隸

english: A group of {@dice 1d4} {@creature Commoner||commoners} (of any race) fled their masters when Demogorgon attacked and took refuge here. The characters find them hiding in the fields or a nearby building. The slaves can provide the characters with a detailed description of the attack, confirming that Demogorgon was behind the destruction. The slaves are desperate to escape from the drow and pitifully grateful for any aid offered.
zh_tw: 一群{@dice 1d4}個{@creature Commoner||平民}（任何種族）在狄摩高根攻擊時逃離了他們的主人，並在這裡找到了避難所。角色們在田野裡或附近的建築物中發現了他們的藏身之處。這些奴隸可以向角色們提供攻擊的詳細描述，確認狄摩高根是破壞的幕後黑手。這些奴隸迫切希望逃離卓爾，並對任何提供的幫助都感激不盡。

english: Giant Wolf Spiders
zh_tw: 巨狼蛛

english: These {@creature Giant Wolf Spider||spiders} lurk in burrows under the spongy ground, leaping out to attack the party as it passes by. Party members with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 17 or higher aren't {@status surprised} by the spiders.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Giant Wolf Spider||蜘蛛}潛伏在鬆軟地面下的洞穴中，當隊伍經過時跳出來攻擊。擁有17或更高被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分的隊員不會被這些蜘蛛{@status surprised||突襲}。

english: Orc Slave Farmers
zh_tw: 獸人奴隸農夫

english: The drow use orc slaves to farm their fungi fields. The orcs pour water into carefully irrigated dung fields, renewing and expanding the fields with wagonloads of excrement brought in from the city proper. The orcs are so disciplined that they can be relied upon to perform their tasks with minimal or no supervision.
zh_tw: 卓爾使用獸人奴隸來耕種他們的真菌田。獸人們將水倒入精心灌溉的糞肥田中，用從城市中心運來的整車糞便更新和擴大這些田地。這些獸人非常守紀律，可以依靠他們在最少或無需監督的情況下完成他們的任務。

english: The characters encounter {@dice 3d6} orc {@creature Commoner||commoners}. The orcs are chaotic evil and have {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet, but they don't attack drow or anyone accompanied by a drow. There's a 25 percent chance that {@dice 1d4} {@creature drow Guard|OotA|drow guards} are standing within 120 feet of the orcs, quietly resenting the fact that they've been assigned to "watch orcs till our waste." If the orcs come under attack, the drow rush in to protect them.
zh_tw: 角色遭遇{@dice 3d6}獸人{@creature Commoner||平民}。獸人是混亂邪惡且擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}60尺範圍，但它們不會攻擊卓爾或任何由卓爾陪同的人。有25%的機率{@dice 1d4}{@creature drow Guard|OotA|卓爾警衛}站在獸人120尺範圍內，暗自不滿被指派"看守獸人直到我們的廢物"的事實。如果獸人受到攻擊，卓爾會衝鋒保護它們。

english: The Way of Lolth
zh_tw: 羅絲之路

english: Menzoberranzan's principle law is the Way of Lolth. Its tenets are as follows:
zh_tw: 魔索布萊城的主要法則是羅絲之道。其原則如下：

english: There is no god or goddess other than Lolth. Any who follows the dictates of another entity will be slain, preferably as a sacrifice to Lolth.
zh_tw: 除了羅絲之外，沒有其他的神或女神。任何遵循其他實體指示的人將被處死，最好是作為對羅絲的祭品。

english: Ritual worship of any entity other than Lolth is forbidden within the city's vault. Non-drow who violate this tenet are fined and expelled from the city. Second offenders or any drow who do so are slain.
zh_tw: 在城市的金庫內，除了對羅絲的儀式性崇拜之外，崇拜任何其他實體都是被禁止的。違反這一原則的非卓爾將被罰款並驅逐出城。第二次違規者或任何這樣做的卓爾將被處死。

english: Slaves have no rights, and there are no limits to the punishments or duties that can be set for them. Treatment of slaves is the affair of their owners. It is a capital offense for a slave to refuse any order from a drow of the house that owns the slave.
zh_tw: 奴隸沒有權利，對他們可以施加的懲罰或義務沒有任何限制。奴隸的待遇是他們主人的事情。一個奴隸拒絕其所屬家族的卓爾的任何命令都是死罪。

english: A commoner or student of the Academy who refuses to obey a priestess can be punished as the offended priestess sees fit, up to and including death. If the offender is the property of another house and the noble of that house is present and objects, the two must agree on a punishment (usually flogging).
zh_tw: 如果一個平民或學院的學生拒絕服從女祭司，可以根據被冒犯的女祭司的意願受到懲罰，包括直至死刑。如果冒犯者是另一個家族的財產，並且那個家族的貴族在場並反對，兩者必須就懲罰達成一致（通常是鞭打）。

english: Any drow who falsely wears the colors of another house or who deliberately alters his or her appearance to masquerade as one of a different station will be slain.
zh_tw: 任何錯誤地穿戴其他家族顏色的卓爾，或者故意改變自己的外表以偽裝成不同身份的人，都將被處死。

english: Any non-drow who adopts the appearance of a particular drow, a drow of a noble rank, or a drow of a house other than his or her own will be slain.
zh_tw: 任何非卓爾的人若採取特定卓爾的外貌，或者採取貴族等級的卓爾的外貌，或者採取非其所屬家族的卓爾的外貌，都將被處死。

english: If it can be proved that two or more houses attacked another house, all the houses that participated in the attack will be destroyed jointly by the remainder.
zh_tw: 如果能證明兩個或更多的家族攻擊了另一個家族，所有參與攻擊的家族將由剩餘的家族共同摧毀。

english: Duthcloim
zh_tw: 杜斯克萊姆

english: Known commonly as "Manyfolk," the area surrounding the Bazaar and bordered by the Clawrift to the east is home to Menzoberranzan's merchants, tradesfolk, and crafters. Duthcloim features small inns, taprooms, and pleasure houses catering to locals, visitors, and high-status drow seeking distraction. Parts of Duthcloim were damaged or destroyed after Demogorgon emerged from the Clawrift. Nevertheless, business has been booming as drow celebrate the deaths of rivals.
zh_tw: 通常被稱為"萬民區"的地區，環繞著集市，東邊以爪裂谷為界，是魔索布萊城的商人、貿易者和工匠的家園。達斯洛姆擁有小旅館、酒吧和為當地人、訪客以及尋求消遣的高地位卓爾提供服務的娛樂場所。狄摩高根從爪裂谷出現後，達斯洛姆部分地區遭到破壞或毀壞。儘管如此，隨著卓爾慶祝對手的死亡，生意一直非常興旺。

english: If you want a random encounter to occur as the characters make their way through the Duthcloim district, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Duthcloim Encounters table, or choose an encounter that you like. The party can avoid random encounters in Duthcloim by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) group check.
zh_tw: 如果希望在角色穿越杜斯克羅姆區時發生隨機遭遇，擲一個 {@dice d20} 並參考杜斯克羅姆遭遇表，或者選擇一個你喜歡的遭遇。隊伍可以透過成功的 {@dc 13} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）團隊檢定來避免在杜斯克羅姆的隨機遭遇。

english: Bregan D'aerthe Spy
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶間諜

english: A male {@creature drow spy|OotA} takes an interest in the characters and begins shadowing them, attempting to remain unseen. Characters keeping an eye out for trouble spot the drow with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check contested by the drow's Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check.
zh_tw: 一名男性{@creature drow spy|OotA|卓爾間諜}對角色們產生了興趣並開始跟蹤它們，試圖保持不被發現。角色們若留心偵察麻煩，可以透過成功的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定對抗卓爾的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定來發現這名卓爾。

english: The drow is a member of Bregan D'aerthe (see "{@area Unexpected Allies|552|x}" later in this chapter) and reveals as much if the characters confront him. If the characters reveal that they're trying to banish the demon lords back to the Abyss, he offers Bregan D'aerthe's assistance. If they're amenable, he leads them to a Bregan D'aerthe safe house until a meeting with Jarlaxle, the leader of Bregan D'aerthe, can be arranged. While escorted by the spy, the characters have no hostile random encounters.
zh_tw: 這名卓爾是布雷甘·達耶（見本章後面的"{@area 意外盟友|552|x}"）的成員，如果角色們面對他，他會透露這一點。如果角色們透露他們正試圖將惡魔領主驅逐回無底深淵，他會提供布雷甘·達耶的幫助。如果他們願意，他將帶領他們前往布雷甘·達耶的安全屋，直到能安排與布雷甘·達耶的領袖賈拉索會面。在被間諜護送期間，角色們不會有敵對的隨機遭遇。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: The Bregan D'aerthe safe house is a three-story stone tower guarded by four members of Bregan D'aerthe (male {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors}) and maintained by one or more freed slaves (use the {@creature commoner} statistics). While in the safe house, the characters have no hostile encounters.
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶的安全屋是一座三層石塔，由四名布雷甘·達耶成員（男性{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}）守衛，並由一名或多名解放的奴隸（使用{@creature commoner||平民}具體數值）維護。在安全屋內，角色們不會遇到敵對的遭遇。

english: If the characters agree to a meeting with Jarlaxle, the Bregan D'aerthe spy tells them that a drow operative named Krilelyn H'Kar will fetch them when the time comes (see "{@area Private Meetings|556|x}"). The spy then leaves the characters alone.
zh_tw: 如果角色們同意與賈拉索會面，布雷甘·達耶的間諜會告訴他們，到時一個名叫克莉蕾琳·哈卡的卓爾行動員會來接他們（見"{@area 私人會面|556|x}"）。間諜隨後會讓角色們單獨待著。

english: Drow Foot Patrol
zh_tw: 卓爾徒步巡邏隊

english: This patrol consists of {@dice 2d4} {@creature drow}. If one or more party members appear to be anything other than drow or slaves in the company of its drow master, the patrol confronts the party and starts asking questions. If any of the answers arouse suspicion or come across as insolent, the drow attack.
zh_tw: 這支巡邏隊由{@dice 2d4}名{@creature drow||卓爾}組成。如果隊伍中有一個或多個成員看起來不是卓爾或其卓爾主人的奴隸，巡邏隊就會對隊伍進行質問並開始提問。如果任何回答引起懷疑或顯得無禮，卓爾就會發動攻擊。

english: If combat erupts, reinforcements arrive every {@dice 1d4} rounds. Each wave of reinforcements consists of {@dice 2d4} {@creature drow} plus {@dice 1d4} {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} that crawl down from rooftops.
zh_tw: 如果戰鬥爆發，每{@dice 1d4}回合就有增援部隊到達。每一波增援部隊由{@dice 2d4}名{@creature drow||卓爾}加上從屋頂爬下來的{@dice 1d4}只{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}組成。

english: Drow Priestess of Lolth
zh_tw: 卓爾羅絲女祭司

english: A {@creature drow priestess of Lolth} accompanied by a {@creature drow elite warrior} and {@dice 2d4} {@creature drow} is out surveying damaged sections of the city. Merchants and crafters who confront the priestess, claiming to have lost everything in Demogorgon's attack, are banished to the Braeryn. Locals driven mad by the demonic invasion are brought before the priestess and put to death.
zh_tw: 一位{@creature drow priestess of Lolth||卓爾羅絲女祭司}在一名{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}和{@dice 2d4}名{@creature drow||卓爾}的陪同下，正在巡視城市受損的區域。那些聲稱在狄摩高根襲擊中失去一切並直面女祭司的商人與工匠，會被放逐到布瑞爾倫區。因惡魔入侵而發瘋的當地人會被帶到女祭司面前處死。

english: If the characters approach the priestess claiming to have vital information about the demon attack, they can, with a successful {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, convince the priestess to escort them to Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA} (see "{@area Private Meetings|556|x}" later in this chapter). If the check fails by 5 or more, the priestess and her escort attack the party.
zh_tw: 如果角色們接近女祭司，聲稱擁有關於惡魔襲擊的重要資訊，他們可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 20} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，說服女祭司護送他們去見主母 {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}（參見本章後面的"{@area 私人會面|556|x}"）。如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，女祭司及其隨從將攻擊隊伍。

english: Spider Nest
zh_tw: 蜘蛛巢穴

english: The characters stumble upon a spiders' nest containing {@dice 4d6} giant spider eggs with soft, sticky shells. Each egg weighs 20 pounds and has AC 6 and 1 hit point. Disturbing the eggs attracts {@dice 1d4} {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders}, which descend from nearby rooftops to defend the nest.
zh_tw: 角色們偶然發現了一個蜘蛛巢穴，裡面含有{@dice 4d6}個巨型蜘蛛卵，這些卵殼軟且粘。每個卵重20磅，有AC 6和1點生命值。擾亂卵會吸引{@dice 1d4}只{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}，它們會從附近的屋頂上下來保衛巢穴。

english: Statue of Lolth
zh_tw: 羅絲雕像

english: The characters stumble upon a 9-foot-tall statue of Lolth depicted in her drow form. There is a 25 percent chance that the statue was toppled during Demogorgon's rampage, in which case it lies in pieces on the ground.
zh_tw: 角色們偶然發現一尊高9尺的羅絲雕像，雕像以她的卓爾形態呈現。在狄摩高根肆虐期間，有25%的機率這座雕像被推倒，如果是這樣的話，它將散落在地面上。

english: If an intact statue is touched by a non-drow or otherwise defiled, the statue opens its mouth and disgorges a {@creature swarm of insects} (spiders). These spiders crawl down the statue and attack whoever touched or defiled the statue. Once the statue disgorges a swarm, its mouth closes, and it can't release another swarm until 1 hour has passed.
zh_tw: 如果一尊完整的雕像被非卓爾觸控或以其他方式被褻瀆，雕像會張開嘴巴並吐出一群{@creature swarm of insects||昆蟲叢集}（蜘蛛）。這些蜘蛛從雕像上爬下來，攻擊觸控或褻瀆雕像的人。一旦雕像吐出一群，它的嘴巴會關閉，並且在1小時過去之前無法釋放另一群。

english: Common Drow Phrases
zh_tw: 常見的卓爾短語

english: The following are a few key drow phrases you can use when roleplaying dark elves.
zh_tw: 以下是一些關鍵的卓爾短語，您可以在扮演卓爾時使用。

english: {@i Oloth plynn dos}! ("Darkness take you!"), a common drow curse.
zh_tw: {@i Oloth plynn dos}!（"願黑暗吞噬你！"），一個常見的卓爾詛咒。

english: {@i Ssussan}! ("Light!"), another drow curse.
zh_tw: {@i Ssussan}! （"光明！"），另一個卓爾的詛咒。

english: {@i Xun izil dos phuul quarthen, lueth dro.} ("Do as you are ordered, and live.")
zh_tw: {@i Xun izil dos phuul quarthen, lueth dro.}（"服從命令，才能活命。"）

english: {@i Lolth tlu malla}. ("Lolth be praised.")
zh_tw: {@i Lolth tlu malla}。（"羅絲值得讚美。"）

english: {@i Lil alurl velve zhah lil velkyn uss.} ("The best knife is an unseen one.")
zh_tw: {@i Lil alurl velve zhah lil velkyn uss.}（"最好的刀是不被人所見的刀。"）

english: {@i Khaless nau uss}. ("Trust no one.")
zh_tw: {@i Khaless nau uss}。（"不要相信任何人。"）

english: Eastmyr
zh_tw: 東米爾

english: Eastmyr bridges the gap between prosperous Duthcloim and the down-and-out despair of the Braeryn. It is home to common merchants, tradesfolk, mercenaries, and crafters either making their way up the social ladder or trying to slow the downward descent of shifting fortunes. Though this area suffered relatively little damage during Demogorgon's rampage, its population has swelled with formerly high-profile drow forced out of their homes and holdings.
zh_tw: 東米爾填補了繁榮的杜斯克萊姆和布雷恩的絕望之間的差距。這裡是普通商人、貿易者、僱傭兵和工匠們的家園，他們要麼在社會階梯上攀升，要麼試圖減緩財富轉移帶來的下降。儘管這個區域在狄摩高根的暴行中受損相對較少，但其人口已經膨脹，因為原本地位較高的卓爾被迫離開他們的家園和財產。

english: If you want a random encounter to occur as the characters make their way through the Eastmyr district, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Eastmyr Encounters table, or choose an encounter that you like. The party can avoid random encounters in Eastmyr by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) group check.
zh_tw: 如果玩家在東米爾區行進過程中你想要發生一次隨機遭遇，請擲一次{@dice d20}並參考東米爾遭遇表，或者選擇一個你喜歡的遭遇。隊伍可以透過一次{@dc 15}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）群體檢定成功來避免在東米爾區的隨機遭遇。

english: Cult of "Y"
zh_tw: "歪"教團

english: Eastmyr has become a haven for a group of drow driven mad by Demogorgon's rampage. These drow carve the symbol of Demogorgon—a Y with curled ends—into their palms and foreheads, and they can hear the twin voices of the Prince of Demons talking to them, telling them that they will rise from the dregs of drow society to greatness once the nobility is cast down.
zh_tw: 東米爾已成為一群被狄摩高根橫行逼瘋的卓爾的避風港。這些卓爾將狄摩高根的徽記——一個末端捲曲的歪形——刻在自己的手掌和前額上，且他們能聽到惡魔王子歐捷夫的雙重聲音對他們說話，告訴他們一旦貴族被推翻，他們將從卓爾社會的底層崛起至偉大。

english: The characters encounter a group of {@dice 1d4 + 4} {@creature drow Cultist|OotA|drow cultists} wearing cloaks and cowls in the midst of kidnapping a low-ranking {@creature drow noble|OotA}. If the characters kill four or more cultists, the rest flee like rats. Sounds of combat attract the attention of a drow foot patrol (see "{@area Duthcloim|50e|x}" for more information), which arrives in {@dice 1d6} rounds. Any cultists that escape flee to a crumbling tenement a block away that the cult has converted into a shrine to Demogorgon. The shrine contains {@dice 1d4} {@creature Shadow Demon||shadow demons} as well as {@dice 2d4} {@creature drow Cultist|OotA|drow cultists}, each of whom has a "second head" (in the form of a severed drow head on a pole) that the cultist has lashed to his or her body. Painted in wet blood on the shrine's floor is a familiar "Y" symbol.
zh_tw: 角色們遭遇了一群穿著斗篷和兜帽的{@dice 1d4 + 4}名{@creature drow Cultist|OotA|卓爾邪教徒}，他們正在綁架一名低等級的{@creature drow noble|OotA|卓爾貴族}。如果角色們殺死四名或更多邪教徒，其餘的會像老鼠一樣逃走。戰鬥的聲響會吸引一支卓爾徒步巡邏隊的注意（詳見"{@area 杜斯克萊姆|50e|x}"獲取更多訊息），他們將在{@dice 1d6}回合內抵達。任何逃脫的邪教徒都會逃往一個街區外被邪教改造成狄摩高根聖壇的搖搖欲墜的公寓樓。聖壇內有{@dice 1d4}只{@creature Shadow Demon||幽影惡魔}和{@dice 2d4}名{@creature drow Cultist|OotA|卓爾邪教徒}，每名邪教徒都有一個"第二頭部"（以一根長杆上插著的卓爾斷頭形式存在），邪教徒們將其綁在自己身體上。聖壇地板上用新鮮鮮血畫著一個熟悉的"歪"徽記。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: The {@creature drow noble|OotA} offers no reward to his or her rescuers and chastises the drow patrol for not arriving sooner. If the characters demand a reward, the noble frowns and gives them an insignia bearing the mark of his or her house, then instructs the characters to visit the noble's estate "when the light of Narbondel reaches its zenith" to receive their "reward." If the characters visit the noble's estate in Narbondellyn at the appointed time, they are set upon by the house guards, who have orders to eliminate them and dispose of the remains (see "{@area Narbondellyn|52e|x}" for more information on {@creature drow noble|OotA} estates).
zh_tw: 這個{@creature drow noble|OotA|卓爾貴族}對他的或她的救援者不提供任何獎勵，並因為巡邏隊沒有及時到達而斥責卓爾巡邏隊。如果角色們要求獎勵，貴族皺眉並給了他們一個帶有他或她家族標誌的徽章，然後指示角色們在"納邦德爾的光輝達到頂點時"訪問貴族的莊園以領取他們的"獎勵"。如果角色們在指定的時間去納邦德爾林拜訪貴族的莊園，他們將遭到家兵的襲擊，這些家兵接到命令要消滅他們並處理掉屍體（有關{@creature drow noble|OotA|卓爾貴族}莊園的更多資訊，請見"{@area 納邦德爾林|52e|x}"）。

english: Scroll from Narbondel's Shadow
zh_tw: 來自納邦德爾陰影的卷軸

english: A cloaked half-{@creature drow spy|OotA} named Shinzi approaches the characters when they are alone and gives them a scroll bearing an advertisement for Narbondel's Shadow, the "finest rooming house in Menzoberranzan." If the party includes non-drow, Shinzi says that non-drow are "more than welcome at the Shadow." The advertisement doesn't list any prices, but on the back of the scroll is a map marking the location of the rooming house in northeastern Eastmyr, near the Clawrift.
zh_tw: 一名名為辛茲的披著斗篷的半{@creature drow spy|OotA|卓爾間諜}在角色們獨處時接近他們，並給他們一份帶有納邦德爾幽影廣告的卷軸，號稱是"魔索布萊城最優質的住宿家族"。如果隊伍中包含非卓爾成員，辛茲會說非卓爾成員"在幽影更受歡迎"。廣告上沒有列出任何價格，但在卷軸背面有一張地圖，標明瞭這家住宿家族在東米爾東北部靠近爪裂的位置。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Narbondel's Shadow, which wasn't damaged during Demogorgon's rampage, offers some of the best food and lodging money can buy, but the cost is high: 25 gp per night, per person. A strongheart halfling {@creature commoner} named Dalfred Noakes owns and runs the establishment. Dalfred had a violent encounter with a young Hunzrin noble, which left him scarred and without his left ear. He has never forgotten nor forgiven the noble. To this day, he uses a small cave system that doesn't connect with the Dark Dominion to smuggle goods and hide people fleeing angry drow nobles. If the characters look like they could use his help, Dalfred does whatever he can to assist them.
zh_tw: 納邦德爾的陰影在狄摩高根的暴行中沒有受損，提供一些最好的美食和住宿，但代價很高：每人每晚25金幣。一位名叫達爾弗雷德·諾克斯的堅強哈比人{@creature commoner||平民}擁有並經營著這家旅館。達爾弗雷德曾與一位年輕的洪茲林貴族發生暴力衝突，導致他留下疤痕並失去了左耳。他從未忘記也未原諒那位貴族。直到今天，他使用一個不與黑暗主宰相連的小洞穴系統來走私貨物和隱藏逃離憤怒卓爾貴族的人。如果角色們看起來需要他的幫助，達爾弗雷德會盡一切可能來協助他們。

english: The orphaned daughter of a drow merchant and a human slave, Shinzi was adopted by Dalfred and is one of his many spies. She has {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet, as well as the Fey Ancestry and Innate Spellcasting features of a drow (see the "{@area Statistical Modifications to Drow NPCs|4d6|x}" sidebar). However, she doesn't have the Sunlight Sensitivity feature.
zh_tw: 作為一個卓爾商人與人類奴隸的孤兒女兒，辛茲被達爾弗雷德收養，併成為他的眾多間諜之一。她擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}，範圍可達60尺，以及卓爾的妖精血統與天生施法能力（參見"{@area 對卓爾NPC的統計資料調整|4d6|x}"邊欄）。然而，她並不具備日光敏感特徵。

english: Kyorbblivvin
zh_tw: 奇奧布利文

english: Kyorbblivvin is a spider-haunted forest of giant mushrooms that spreads across the northern portion of the Qu'ellarz'orl plateau. Members of the great houses use Kyorbblivvin as a private hunting domain. Drow warriors patrol the forest, alert for poachers and intruders. Check for random encounters in Kyorbblivvin once every hour. Roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Kyorbblivvin Encounters table to determine what, if anything, the characters encounter. The party can avoid random encounters in Kyorbblivvin by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) group check.
zh_tw: 奇奧布利文是一個被蜘蛛困擾的巨型蘑菇森林，橫跨奎拉佐爾高原的北部。大家族成員將奇奧布利文用作私人狩獵領地。卓爾戰士在森林中巡邏，警惕偷獵者和入侵者。每小時在奇奧布利文進行一次隨機遭遇檢定。擲一個{@dice d20}骰子，並參考奇奧布利文遭遇表來確定角色們會遇到什麼（如果有的話）。隊伍可以透過成功進行一次{@dc 15}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）群體檢定來避免在奇奧布利文中的隨機遭遇。

If one or more party members appear to be anything other than drow belonging to one of the eight ruling houses, or slaves in the company of such a drow, the patrol attacks. Each drow carries a horn that it can blow (as an action) to summon reinforcements. The first wave of reinforcements arrives in {@dice 1d4 + 4} rounds and consists of another {@dice 2d4} {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors}. The second wave arrives after ten minutes and consists of {@dice 3d6} {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} mounted on {@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|giant riding lizards} (see the end of {@area chapter 8|34c|x} for statistics).

english: Narbondel
zh_tw: 納邦德爾

english: The most dominant feature within the city, Narbondel is a 1,000-foot-tall column of rock that helps support the cavern ceiling. At the same time each day, the city's Archmage (or a representative from Sorcere) magically heats Narbondel's base, causing the stone to glow. The band of warm light rises slowly up the column to mark the passage of time, taking twenty-four hours to reach the top. The Archmage of Menzoberranzan, Gromph Baenre, has fled the city in the wake of Demogorgon's attack, leaving the task of lighting Narbondel to a host of other wizards.
zh_tw: 納邦德爾是城市中最顯著的地標，它是一根高達1000尺的石柱，幫助支撐著洞穴的天花板。每天的同一時間，城市的大法師（或來自索瑟瑞的代表）會用魔法加熱納邦德爾的基座，使石頭髮光。溫暖的光帶緩慢地沿著石柱上升，標誌著時間的流逝，需要二十四小時才能到達頂部。魔索布萊城的大法師，貢夫·班瑞，在狄摩高根的攻擊後逃離了城市，留下點燃納邦德爾的任務給了許多其他法師。

zh_tw: 新近復活且名譽掃地的附庸家族，在班瑞家族的嚴密控制下，以達莉亞（一位月亮精靈囚犯）為其傀儡領袖

english: Narbondellyn
zh_tw: 納邦德爾林

english: The estates of the various drow houses are clustered beneath the plateau of Qu'ellarz'orl in an area called Narbondellyn, allowing the superiors of those drow to literally look down upon them. Largely untouched during Demogorgon's rampage, the so-called "Broad Streets" district remains the bright center of Menzoberranzan, as the lesser houses vie to outdo each other in shows of wealth, power, and influence. Soaring stalagmite towers and great manors rise across the area, which is also home to luxury shops, pleasure houses, and discriminating merchants.
zh_tw: 各種卓爾家族的領地聚集在奎拉佐爾高原下方一個叫做納邦德爾林的區域，使得那些卓爾的上級能夠字面意義上地俯瞰他們。在狄摩高根的暴走中大部分未受破壞，所謂的"寬街"區域仍然是魔索布萊城的明亮中心，因為較小的家族競相在展示財富、權力和影響力上超越彼此。高聳的石筍塔和宏偉的莊園遍佈該地區，這裡也是奢侈品商店、娛樂場所和挑剔商人的所在地。

english: A noble estate in Narbondellyn maintains its own militia, consisting of fifty or more highly disciplined {@creature drow} warriors and {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors}, with one elite warrior for every ten drow warriors. In addition, an estate holds {@dice 3d6} {@creature drow Noble|OotA|drow nobles} and scores of slaves, {@dice 6d6} of which can be pressed into defending the house. These fighting slaves are usually {@creature Bugbear||bugbears}, {@creature Ogre||ogres}, {@creature Orc||orcs}, or {@creature Quaggoth||quaggoths}. Doors and windows are protected with {@spell glyph of warding} spells (spell save {@dc 13}), and {@dice 2d6} {@creature Gargoyle||gargoyles} watch for trouble from ledges and rooftops.
zh_tw: 納邦德爾林的一處貴族莊園維持著自己的民兵隊伍，由五十名或更多高度紀律化的{@creature drow||卓爾}武者和{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}組成，每十名卓爾武者配有一名精英武者。此外，莊園還擁有{@dice 3d6}名{@creature drow Noble|OotA|卓爾貴族}和大量奴隸，其中{@dice 6d6}名可被徵召保衛家族。這些戰鬥奴隸通常是{@creature Bugbear||熊地精}、{@creature Ogre||食人魔}、{@creature Orc||獸人}或{@creature Quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}。門和窗戶受到{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}法術（法術豁免{@dc 13}）保護，還有{@dice 2d6}只{@creature Gargoyle||石像鬼}在壁架和屋頂上警戒。

english: If you want a random encounter to occur as the characters make their way through the Narbondellyn district, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Narbondellyn Encounters table, or choose an encounter that you like. The party can avoid random encounters in Narbondellyn by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) group check.
zh_tw: 如果希望在角色們穿越納邦德林區時發生隨機遭遇，擲一個{@dice d20}並查閱納邦德林遭遇表，或選擇一個你喜歡的遭遇。隊伍可以透過成功進行一次{@dc 13}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）團隊檢定來避免在納邦德林區的隨機遭遇。

english: Bregan D'aerthe Mercenaries
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶僱傭兵

english: Bregan D'aerthe was instrumental in driving the demons out of Menzoberranzan. Since the incursion, Bregan D'aerthe mercenaries have taken to patrolling the streets of the wealthier districts, accepting payments from drow nobles for the added security.
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶在將惡魔驅逐出魔索布萊城中發揮了重要作用。自從那次入侵之後，布雷甘·達耶的僱傭兵開始在較富裕區域的街道上巡邏，接受卓爾貴族的支付以提供額外的安全保障。

english: The characters encounter a group of {@dice 3d4} male {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors}—all members of Bregan D'aerthe. Unlike most drow patrols, this group is gregarious and jovial. The mercenaries stop the characters to ask their business, but more to alleviate boredom than to throw their weight around. Unless the characters brazenly declare their intention to attack a noble house, the Bregan D'aerthe leader flips them a platinum coin and cheerfully sends them on their way after concluding his "interrogation."
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了一群{@dice 3d4}名男性{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}——全部是布雷甘·達耶的成員。與大多數卓爾巡邏隊不同，這個群體是社交的並且心情愉快。僱傭兵們停下來詢問角色們的事務，但這更多是為了緩解無聊而不是展示他們的權威。除非角色們公然宣告他們打算攻擊一個貴族家族，否則布雷甘·達耶的領袖在結束他的"審訊"後，會愉快地給他們一枚白金硬幣，並送他們上路。

english: The Bregan D'aerthe leader carries a gem-studded minotaur horn. If the characters attack the mercenaries, the leader blows his horn, which can be heard throughout the district. All noble houses go on high alert as reinforcements arrive every round for the next {@dice 1d8} rounds. Each wave of reinforcements consists of an elite drow patrol (see below) and {@dice 1d4} {@creature Gargoyle||gargoyles}.
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶的領袖攜帶著一個鑲嵌寶石的牛頭人號角。如果角色們攻擊這些僱傭兵，領袖就會吹響他的號角，整個區域都能聽到這個聲音。所有貴族家族都會進入高度警戒狀態，接下來的{@dice 1d8}回合中，每一回合都會有增援部隊到達。每一波增援部隊由一支精英卓爾巡邏隊（見下文）和{@dice 1d4}個{@creature Gargoyle||石像鬼}組成。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The gem-studded horn carried by the Bregan D'aerthe leader is worth 2,500 gp. In addition, each drow mercenary has a pouch containing {@dice 2d10} pp.
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶領袖所攜帶的鑲有寶石的號角價值2500金幣。此外，每個卓爾僱傭兵都有一個袋子，裡面裝有{@dice 2d10}個鉑金幣。

english: Elite Drow Patrol
zh_tw: 精英卓爾巡邏隊

english: This patrol consists of two {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} mounted on {@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|giant riding lizards} (see the end of {@area chapter 8|34c|x} for statistics). If one or more party members appear to be anything other than drow or slaves in the company of its drow master, the patrol immediately calls for reinforcements, which arrive in {@dice 1d4 + 2} rounds. The reinforcements consist of {@dice 1d4} similar drow patrols.
zh_tw: 這支巡邏隊由兩名騎在{@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|乘用巨蜥}上的{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}組成（見{@area 第八章|34c|x}末尾的具體數值）。如果隊伍中有一個或多個成員看起來不是卓爾或其卓爾主人的奴隸，巡邏隊會立即呼叫增援，增援將在{@dice 1d4 + 2}回合內到達。增援部隊由{@dice 1d4}支類似的卓爾巡邏隊組成。

english: Noble Entourage
zh_tw: 貴族隨從

english: The characters encounter a {@creature drow noble|OotA} traveling with eight {@creature drow} warriors bearing the symbol and colors of their noble house. There is a 25 percent chance that a {@creature succubus} or {@creature incubus} accompanies the noble in drow form, and a 75 percent chance that the noble is being carried around in a palanquin by unarmed slaves. Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the Drow House Slaves table to determine what kind of slaves and how many.
zh_tw: 角色們遭遇了一位{@creature drow noble|OotA|卓爾貴族}，他正與八名{@creature drow||卓爾}武者同行，這些武者佩戴著其家族的徽記和顏色。有25%的機率一位{@creature succubus||魅魔}或{@creature incubus||夢魔}以卓爾形態伴隨該貴族，且有75%的機率該貴族正被手無寸鐵的奴隸用轎子抬著。擲一枚{@dice d6}並查閱卓爾家族奴隸表格以確定奴隸的型別和數量。

english: Qu'ellarz'orl
zh_tw: 奎拉佐爾

english: Untouched by Demogorgon's rampage, the high southern plateau of Menzoberranzan is home to many of the oldest and greatest noble houses, with House Baenre situated at the plateau's highest point, to the east. At the west end of Qu'ellarz'orl is a small cavern containing a sculpted stalagmite tower. Within this tower rests the Chamber of the Ruling Council, where the matron mothers of the eight great drow houses gather and meet.
zh_tw: 在狄摩高根的暴走中未受破壞，魔索布萊城的高南高原是許多最古老和最偉大的貴族家族的家園，其中班瑞家族位於高原的最高點，朝向東方。奎拉佐爾的西端有一個小洞穴，裡面含有一座雕刻的石筍塔。在這個塔內休息著統治議會的會議室，八個偉大的卓爾家族的母系家長在此聚集和會面。

english: Each noble estate in Qu'ellarz'orl maintains its own militia, consisting of several hundred highly disciplined {@creature drow} warriors and {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors}, with one elite warrior for every ten drow warriors. In addition, an estate holds {@dice 3d12} {@creature drow Noble|OotA|drow nobles} and scores of slaves, {@dice 10d10} of which can be pressed into defending the house. These fighting slaves are usually {@creature Bugbear||bugbears}, {@creature Ogre||ogres}, {@creature Orog||orogs}, or {@creature Quaggoth||quaggoths}. Doors and windows are protected with {@spell glyph of warding} spells (spell save {@dc 13}), and either {@dice 3d6} {@creature Gargoyle||gargoyles} or {@dice 3d6} {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} watch for trouble from ledges and rooftops. These gargoyles and giant spiders have {@sense truesight} out to a range of 120 feet, enabling them to spot {@condition invisible} trespassers.
zh_tw: 奎拉佐爾的每個貴族家族都維持著自己的民兵隊伍，由數百名高度紀律嚴明的{@creature drow||卓爾}武者和{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}組成，每十名卓爾武者中就有一名精英武者。此外，一個家族還擁有{@dice 3d12}名{@creature drow Noble|OotA|卓爾貴族}和大量奴隸，其中{@dice 10d10}名可在保衛家族時被徵召。這些戰鬥奴隸通常是{@creature Bugbear||熊地精}、{@creature Ogre||食人魔}、{@creature Orog||魔獸人}或{@creature Quaggoth||幽邃熊怪}。門和窗戶都受到{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}法術（法術豁免{@dc 13}）的保護，並有{@dice 3d6}只{@creature Gargoyle||石像鬼}或{@dice 3d6}只{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}在壁架和屋頂上警戒。這些石像鬼和巨蜘蛛擁有120尺範圍內的{@sense truesight||真實視覺}，使它們能夠發現{@condition invisible||隱形}的入侵者。

english: Roll for random encounters as the characters cross this district. You can roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Qu'ellarz'orl Encounters table, or choose an encounter that you like. The party can avoid random encounters in Qu'ellarz'orl by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) group check.
zh_tw: 當角色穿越這個區域時，擲骰進行隨機遭遇。你可以擲一個 {@dice d20} 並參考 奎拉佐爾 遭遇表，或者選擇一個你喜歡的遭遇。隊伍可以透過成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）團隊檢定來避免 奎拉佐爾 中的隨機遭遇。

If one or more party members appear to be anything other than drow of one of the eight ruling houses, or slaves in the company of such a drow, the patrol calls for reinforcements, which arrive in {@dice 1d4 + 2} rounds and consist of {@dice 1d4} similar drow patrols.
zh_tw: 這支巡邏隊由兩名騎乘{@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|乘用巨蜥}的{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}組成（見{@area 第八章|34c|x}的具體數值）。如果一個或多個隊伍成員看起來不是屬於八個統治家族的卓爾，或者不是伴隨此類卓爾的奴隸，巡邏隊就會召喚增援，增援在{@dice 1d4 + 2}回合到達，由{@dice 1d4}個類似的卓爾巡邏隊組成。

english: Old Enemies
zh_tw: 老對手

english: It is possible that the adventurers' drow jailers or pursuers from Velkynvelve ({@area chapter 1|022|x}) managed to survive to this point in the campaign, and that they have returned to Menzoberranzan in the wake of Demogorgon's attack and the ongoing chaos. If so, they might be on hand for an unfortunate encounter with the party. If you are looking to throw a twist into the events in the City of Spiders, having an old foe turn up at the least opportune moment to denounce the characters as escaped prisoners and enemies of the drow could well be it.
zh_tw: 冒險家們的卓爾獄卒或來自維爾京維爾夫（{@area 第一章|022|x}）的追捕者有可能在這場戰役中倖存下來，並在狄摩高根的攻擊和持續的混亂之後返回魔索布萊城。如果是這樣，他們可能會在與隊伍的不幸遭遇中出現。如果你想在蜘蛛之城的事件中加入一個轉折，讓一個老對手在最不恰當的時刻出現，揭露角色們作為逃脫的囚犯和卓爾的敵人，這可能就是它。

english: Gargoyles
zh_tw: 石像鬼

english: These creatures are loyal to House Baenre and have magically bestowed {@sense truesight} out to a range of 120 feet. As they fly over the plateau, they keep a watchful eye on everyone and everything. However, they don't attack unless House Baenre's holdings are in jeopardy.
zh_tw: 這些生物忠於班瑞家族，並且透過魔法被賦予了{@sense truesight||真實視覺}，其範圍達到120尺。當它們飛越高原時，它們會警惕地監視每個人和每件事。然而，除非班瑞家族的財產受到威脅，否則它們不會發動攻擊。

english: If the characters drawn attention to themselves, the gargoyles fly back to House Baenre and report what they've seen. Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA}, believing that the characters are potentially of use to her, dispatches eight elite drow patrols (see above) to bring them to her at once. If the characters allow themselves to be brought before the most powerful individual in the city, see the "{@area Private Meetings|556|x}" section for tips on how to roleplay the encounter with Matron Mother Quenthel.
zh_tw: 如果角色們引起了注意，石像鬼會飛回班瑞家族並報告他們所看到的。族長母親{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}認為角色們可能對她有用，便派遣八個精英卓爾巡邏隊（見上文）立即將他們帶到她面前。如果角色們允許自己被帶到這座城市中最有權勢的人面前，請參閱"{@area 私人會面|556|x}"部分，以獲取如何扮演與族長母親奎恩瑟·班瑞的遭遇的建議。

english: Giant Wolf Spiders
zh_tw: 巨狼蛛

english: These {@creature Giant Wolf Spider||spiders} lurk in burrows beneath the gardens, leaping out to attack the party as it passes by. Party members with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 17 or higher aren't {@status surprised} by the spiders.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Giant Wolf Spider||蜘蛛}潛伏在花園下的洞穴中，當隊伍經過時跳出來攻擊。擁有17或更高被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分的隊員不會被這些蜘蛛{@status surprised||突襲}。

english: Groundskeepers
zh_tw: 園丁

english: The characters happen upon {@dice 1d8} {@creature drow Commoner|OotA|drow commoners} tending the decorative fungi fields and gardens that surround the various noble estates. These drow are low-ranking members of their house. They give strangers unpleasant looks but pose little threat.
zh_tw: 角色們偶然遇到{@dice 1d8}名{@creature drow Commoner|OotA|卓爾平民}正在照料環繞各個貴族莊園的裝飾性真菌農田和花園。這些卓爾是他們家族的低等級成員。他們會對陌生人投以不善的目光但幾乎不構成威脅。

english: There is a 25 percent chance that one of the drow groundskeepers is actually a young {@creature drow noble|OotA} who's being punished for some infraction or political misstep. This noble is bold enough to approach the characters and demand to know their business. The noble also seizes any opportunity to reverse his or her recent misfortune, perhaps by rooting out enemy spies or using the characters to dispose of a rival. This noble is treacherous, however, and doesn't make good on any promises or bribes.
zh_tw: 有25%的機率其中一名卓爾園丁實際上是一個因某些違規或政治失誤而受罰的{@creature drow noble|OotA|卓爾貴族}。這位貴族大膽到足以接近角色們並要求知道他們的來意。該貴族還會抓住任何機會扭轉他或她最近的厄運，或許透過剷除仇敵間諜或利用角色們除掉一個競爭對手。然而這位貴族很奸詐，且不會兌現任何承諾或賄賂。

english: Slave Parade
zh_tw: 奴隸遊行

english: To impress its neighbors and rivals, one of the ruling houses organizes a parade of its choicest slaves. The characters encounter the parade as it meanders along the boulevards of Qu'ellarz'orl.
zh_tw: 為了給鄰居和競爭對手留下深刻印象，其中一個統治家族組織了一次其最精選奴隸的遊行。角色們在奎拉佐爾的林蔭大道上游行時遇到了它。

english: Dozens of naked and chained slaves form the parade, their bodies painted with dyes and perfumes. Leading the slave parade is a {@creature drow noble|OotA}, while order is maintained by {@dice 4d6} {@creature drow} warriors in full ceremonial house regalia.
zh_tw: 數十名赤裸且被鎖鏈束縛的奴隸組成了遊行隊伍，他們的身體塗滿了染料和香水。帶領奴隸遊行的是一位{@creature drow noble|OotA|卓爾貴族}，而秩序則由{@dice 4d6}名身著全套家族禮服的{@creature drow||卓爾}武者維持。

english: The Rifts
zh_tw: 裂隙

english: Three large chasms score the floor of the cavern of Menzoberranzan.
zh_tw: 三個大裂縫劃破了魔索布萊城洞穴的地面。

english: Clawrift
zh_tw: 爪裂

english: The Clawrift's uncharted depths have long been rumored to extend into the Abyss. This legend was seemingly proven true when the demon lord Demogorgon emerged from the Clawrift, obliterating the rope bridges that once extended across it. Bregan D'aerthe spies are assessing the damage from their base in a ruined drow compound overlooking the Clawrift. (The compound was once House Oblodra, a powerful drow house that was destroyed by Lolth over one hundred years ago during the Time of Troubles.)
zh_tw: 爪裂谷的未知深度長期以來一直被傳言延伸到無底深淵。當惡魔領主狄摩高根從爪裂谷出現，摧毀了曾經橫跨其上的繩索橋時，這個傳說似乎被證實為真。布雷甘·達耶的間諜們正在他們俯瞰爪裂谷的廢棄卓爾建築基地中評估損失。（該建築曾經是歐布羅卓家族，一個強大的卓爾家族，在一百多年前的混亂時代被羅絲摧毀。）

english: Mistrift
zh_tw: 迷霧裂谷

english: This long gorge at the city's center earned its name from the rolling clouds of steam that forever billow up from below. A number of subterranean streams flow out of the Mistrift's vertical walls, their icy waters cascading down into the darkened void below. Half a mile down, the runoff collects in an ancient aquifer, its waters superheated by an adjacent magma flow. Arcane watermills collect water from the falls, diverting it to an underground cistern that the drow can tap into.
zh_tw: 這座城市中心的這條長峽谷因其從下方不斷湧出的滾滾蒸汽而得名。數條地下溪流從迷霧裂谷的垂直牆壁中流出，冰冷的水流傾瀉進下方的黑暗深淵。半英里深的地方，徑流彙集在一個古老的含水層中，其水被鄰近的巖漿流加熱。神秘的水車從瀑布中收集水，將其引入地下蓄水池，供卓爾取用。

english: Westrift
zh_tw: 西裂谷

english: The newest of the city's large clefts, Westrift swallowed up three drow houses and a score of lesser dwellings when it opened its yawning maw three centuries ago. In more recent years, the rift has become home to hundreds of giant arachnids, which have filled much of the cleft with their webs and nests—to the extent that anyone falling into the rift has a 75 percent chance of being caught in a web, taking no damage from the fall but attracting {@dice 1d4 + 1} hungry {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders}. See "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for rules on escaping webs.
zh_tw: 這座城市最新的巨大裂縫——西裂痕，在三個世紀前張開它那飢渴的大口時，吞噬了三個卓爾家族和二十多處較小的住所。近年來，裂縫已成為數百隻巨型蛛形生物的家園，它們用蛛網和巢穴填滿了大部分裂縫——以至於任何落入裂縫的人有75%的機率被蛛網困住，雖然不會因墜落而受傷，但會引來{@dice 1d4 + 1}只飢餓的{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}。有關逃脫蛛網的規則，請參閱{@i 城主指南}第5章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"。

english: Characters entering Menzoberranzan by means of {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}'s secret tunnel come to a secret door that pulls open to reveal a narrow ledge 60 feet below the lip of the rift. Characters can scale the cleft wall with a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, as there are abundant handholds. Any character who fails the check by 5 or more falls.
zh_tw: 透過{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}的秘密隧道進入魔索布萊城的角色會來到一扇秘密門前，門拉開後會露出裂口邊緣下方60尺處的一個狹窄巖架。角色可以透過成功的{@dc 10}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}檢定攀爬裂縫的牆壁，因為有大量的抓手。任何檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多的角色會墜落。

english: Tier Breche
zh_tw: 提爾布雷契

english: The Great Stair of Tier Breche rises from the floor of Menzoberranzan to the cavern housing the three branches of the Academy: Melee-Magthere, a pyramid-shaped edifice where drow warriors are trained; Arach-Tinilith, a spider-shaped cathedral where drow priestesses worship their demon goddess; and Sorcere, a magnificent tower where drow mages learn to master the magical arts. Non-drow are forbidden from entering this part of the city.
zh_tw: 提爾布雷契的大樓梯從魔索布萊城的地面升起，通往容納學院三個分支的洞穴：近戰-瑪格瑟雷，一個金字塔形狀的建築，卓爾戰士在這裡接受訓練；阿拉奇-提尼利絲，一個蜘蛛形狀的大教堂，卓爾女祭司在這裡崇拜她們的惡魔女神；以及索瑟瑞，一座宏偉的塔樓，卓爾法師在這裡學習掌握魔法藝術。非卓爾族人被禁止進入這座城市的這部分。

english: The stone steps are some three hundred feet wide and rise nearly the same distance. A pair of giant {@creature Jade Giant Spider|OotA|jade spiders} flanks the stairway at the top, ready to animate to attack non-drow that climb the steps. The two jade spiders have the statistics of {@creature Stone Golem||stone golems} with the following statistical modifications:
zh_tw: 這些石階大約有三百尺寬，並且升高了幾乎相同的距離。一對巨大的{@creature Jade Giant Spider|OotA|翡翠蜘蛛}在樓梯頂部兩側，準備活化以攻擊攀登臺階的非卓爾。這兩個翡翠蜘蛛具有{@creature Stone Golem||石魔像}的具體數值，以及以下統計修改：

english: The jade spiders have 250 hit points each.
zh_tw: 每個翡翠蜘蛛有250生命值。

english: They have a climbing speed of 30 feet.
zh_tw: 它們擁有30尺的攀爬速度。

english: They have {@sense truesight} out to a range of 120 feet.
zh_tw: 它們的{@sense truesight||真實視覺} 範圍達到120尺。

english: Roll for random encounters as the characters explore the Academy grounds. You can roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Tier Breche Encounters table, or choose an encounter that you like. The party can avoid random encounters by succeeding on a {@dc 17} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) group check. Sounds of battle are common at the Academy; however, drow guards are trained to tell the difference between training exercises and the sound of real combat. The latter attracts reinforcements in the form of {@dice 1d4} {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} every round until the perceived threat is eliminated.
zh_tw: 當角色們探索學院場地時，進行隨機遭遇的擲骰。你可以擲一個 {@dice d20} 並參考 提爾布雷契 遭遇表，或者選擇一個你喜歡的遭遇。隊伍可以透過成功透過一個 {@dc 17} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）群體檢定來避免隨機遭遇。戰鬥的聲音在學院很常見；然而，卓爾守衛經過訓練，能夠區分訓練演習和真實戰鬥的聲音。後者會每回合吸引 {@dice 1d4} 名 {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者} 增援，直到感知到的威脅被消除。

zh_tw: 提爾布雷契遭遇

english: Drow Acolytes
zh_tw: 卓爾侍僧

english: The characters encounter {@dice 2d6} female {@creature drow Acolyte|OotA|drow acolytes} out for a walk. There is a 25 percent chance that a {@creature drow priestess of Lolth} is with them, filling the young devotees' heads with wisdom and instructing them on the Way of Lolth (see "{@area The Way of Lolth|50d|x}" sidebar). If they come under attack, the acolytes withdraw to Arach-Tinilith while the priestess stands her ground.
zh_tw: 角色們遭遇了{@dice 2d6}名外出散步的女性{@creature drow Acolyte|OotA|卓爾侍僧}。有25%的機率會有一名{@creature drow priestess of Lolth||卓爾羅絲女祭司}與她們同行，向這些青年信徒灌輸感知並指導她們羅絲之道（見"{@area 羅絲之路|50d|x}"側邊欄）。若遭到攻擊，侍僧們會撤步至阿拉克-提尼利斯，而女祭司則會堅守陣地。

english: Drow Mages
zh_tw: 卓爾魔法師

english: The characters encounter {@dice 1d3} {@creature Drow Mage||drow mages} out for a walk. There is a 50 percent chance that these mages are members of the Council of Spiders and of a mind to help the characters infiltrate Sorcere, should the characters reveal that they are in league with {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}. These mages offer to cast {@spell greater invisibility} spells on visible characters and escort the party to Gromph's sanctum in the tower. As long as the characters are under the protection of these mages, they have no hostile encounters until they enter Gromph's sanctum (see "{@area Sorcere|55e|x}" for details).
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了{@dice 1d3}名{@creature Drow Mage||卓爾魔法師}外出散步。有50%的機率這些法師是蜘蛛議會的成員，並且願意幫助角色潛入索瑟瑞，如果角色們透露他們與{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}有聯盟關係。這些法師提出在可見的角色身上施放{@spell greater invisibility||高等隱形術}法術，並護送隊伍到塔中的貢夫的聖所。只要角色們在這些法師的保護下，他們在進入貢夫的聖所之前（見"{@area 索瑟瑞|55e|x}"瞭解詳細資訊）不會有敵對遭遇。

english: Drow Warriors
zh_tw: 卓爾戰士

english: The characters encounter {@dice 4d6} {@creature drow} warriors on a training exercise. There is a 50 percent chance that {@dice 1d4} {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} are with them, providing instruction and discipline. If they spot non-drow on Academy grounds, the drow try to kill any intruder.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了{@dice 4d6}名{@creature drow||卓爾}戰士正在進行訓練演習。有50%的機率會有{@dice 1d4}名{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}與他們一起，提供指導和維持紀律。如果他們發現學院場地上有非卓爾，卓爾會試圖殺死任何入侵者。

english: West Wall
zh_tw: 西牆

english: West Wall (also called "the Old Quarter") is a primarily residential neighborhood. Largely untouched by Demogorgon's assault on the city, West Wall is a quiet district, as its residents like to keep their dark schemes and vile indulgences behind closed doors. Amid the twisted streets and quiet mansions of West Wall stand scores of stone monuments dedicated to important figures and moments in the city's history, as well as numerous statues and graven images of Lolth.
zh_tw: 西牆（也被稱為"老城區"）主要是一個住宅區。西牆基本上沒有受到狄摩高根對城市的攻擊影響，是一個安靜的區域，因為居民們喜歡將他們的黑暗計劃和惡劣放縱隱藏在緊閉的門後。在西牆扭曲的街道和安靜的豪宅中，矗立著許多石碑，它們是為紀念城市歷史上的重要人物和時刻而建，以及無數的羅絲雕像和雕刻影象。

english: Between West Wall and Narbondellyn is a residential neighborhood called Lolth's Web. Its residents built their homes upward, crafting streets of magically calcified strands of spider silk from the cavern floor to the vaulted roof above. Hollow, cocoon-like dwellings are constructed both above and below the layers of webbing.
zh_tw: 在西牆和納邦德爾林之間，有一個叫做羅絲之網的住宅區。那裡的居民向上建造他們的家園，用洞穴地面上的蜘蛛絲魔法鈣化成的細絲製作街道，一直延伸到上面的拱形屋頂。像繭一樣的空心住宅在蛛網層的上方和下方都建造了。

english: Roll for random encounters as the characters cross this district. You can roll a {@dice d20} and consult the West Wall Encounters table, or choose an encounter that you like. The party can avoid random encounters in West Wall by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) group check.
zh_tw: 當角色們穿過這個區域時，擲骰子決定隨機遭遇。你可以擲一個{@dice d20}並參考西牆遭遇表，或者選擇一個你喜歡的遭遇。隊伍可以透過進行一個{@dc 13}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）群體檢定成功來避免在西牆的隨機遭遇。

english: Bandersnatches
zh_tw: 班德斯納奇

english: The characters draw the unwanted attention of the Bandersnatches, a gang of young, demon-worshiping drow who, in the wake of Demogorgon's attack, are eager to create further unrest in the city. Gang members send coded messages to one another by tapping hollow rocks together, creating eerie clicking sounds that echo throughout the otherwise quiet neighborhood. Initially, {@dice 1d4} {@creature drow Bandit|OotA|drow bandits} follow the party, scuttling through dark alleys and across web-strung rooftops while tapping their stones, urging more gang members to converge on the party's location. At the end of each round of clicking stones, another {@dice 1d4} {@creature drow Bandit|OotA|drow bandits} appear. If the number of gang members grows to twenty or more, the bandits surround the party and demand payment of 100 gp per party member for safe passage. If the characters kill four or more bandits, the rest flee before a drow patrol (see below) shows up.
zh_tw: 角色們引起了班德斯納奇的注意，這是一群崇拜惡魔的年輕卓爾組成的幫派，他們在狄摩高根的攻擊後，渴望在城市中製造更多騷亂。幫派成員透過敲擊空心石塊傳遞暗號，製造詭異的嘀嗒聲在寂靜的街區迴響。最初，{@dice 1d4}名{@creature drow Bandit|OotA|卓爾匪徒}會跟蹤隊伍，在黑暗的小巷和佈滿蛛網術的屋頂間穿行，同時敲擊石塊召集更多幫派成員向隊伍的位置聚集。每輪敲擊石塊結束時，會有另外{@dice 1d4}名{@creature drow Bandit|OotA|卓爾匪徒}出現。如果幫派成員數量達到二十或更多，匪徒們會包圍隊伍並要求每位成員支付100GP以獲得安全通行。如果角色殺死四名或更多匪徒，其餘匪徒會在卓爾巡邏隊（見下方）出現前走開。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: The consequence of killing one or more bandits is retaliation. The gang organizes a hunting party to find and kill one party member for every gang member slain. This hunting party is bold enough to leave the West Wall district, and you might have the Bandersnatches try to ambush the characters as they make their way out of Menzoberranzan. The hunting party consists of the gang's leader, her {@creature quasit} advisor, and thirty drow bandits.
zh_tw: 殺死一個或多個匪徒的後果是報復。該團夥組織了一個狩獵隊，尋找並殺死每一個被殺團夥成員的一名隊伍成員。這個狩獵隊足夠大膽，敢於離開西牆區，你可能會嘗試讓班德斯納奇在角色們離開魔索布萊城時伏擊他們。狩獵隊由團夥的領袖、她的{@creature quasit||小惡魔}顧問和三十名卓爾匪徒組成。

english: The leader of the Bandersnatches is a capricious and nihilistic female drow named {@creature Viln Tirin|OotA}. She has the statistics of a {@creature bandit captain} with the following modifications:
zh_tw: 班德斯納奇的領袖是一位反覆無常且虛無主義的女性卓爾，名為{@creature Viln Tirin|OotA|維爾恩·提林}。她的具體數值與{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}相同，但有以下修改：

english: Viln is chaotic evil and has drow features (see the "{@area Statistical Modifications to Drow NPCs|4d6|x}" sidebar).
zh_tw: 維爾恩是混亂邪惡的，具有卓爾特徵（見"{@area 對卓爾NPC的統計資料調整|4d6|x}"側邊欄）。

english: She wields a {@item scimitar of speed} and can make one attack with it as a bonus action on her turn. All of Viln's attacks with the weapon are {@hit 7} to hit and deal 8 ({@dice 1d6 + 5}) slashing damage on a hit.
zh_tw: 她揮舞著一把{@item scimitar of speed||急速彎刀}，並能在她的回合中用一個附贈動作進行一次攻擊。維爾恩用這把武器的所有攻擊都是{@hit 7}命中，並在命中時造成8（{@dice 1d6 + 5}）揮砍傷害。

english: Viln carries four daggers coated with {@item purple worm poison} (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). The poison on a dagger's blade is good for one hit only, whether the poison takes effect or not.
zh_tw: 維爾恩攜帶著四把塗有{@item purple worm poison||紫蟲毒液}的匕首（參見{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}，位於{@i 城主指南}的第8章）。無論毒藥是否生效，匕首刀刃上的毒藥僅對一次攻擊有效。

english: She has a challenge rating of 5 (1,800 XP).
zh_tw: 她的挑戰等級為5（1800經驗值）。

zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶間諜
