zh_tw: 更多資訊請見"{@area 杜斯克萊姆|50e|x}"。

english: Drow Foot Patrol
zh_tw: 卓爾徒步巡邏隊

english: This patrol consists of {@dice 2d4} {@creature drow}. If one or more party members appear to be anything other than drow or slaves in the company of its drow master, the patrol confronts the party and starts asking questions. If any of the answers arouse suspicion or come across as insolent, the drow attack.
zh_tw: 這支巡邏隊由{@dice 2d4}名{@creature drow||卓爾}組成。如果隊伍中有一個或多個成員看起來不是卓爾或其卓爾主人的奴隸，巡邏隊就會對隊伍進行質問並開始提問。如果任何回答引起懷疑或顯得無禮，卓爾就會發動攻擊。

english: Slave Abuse
zh_tw: 奴隸虐待

english: The characters see a {@creature drow noble|OotA} flogging one of a handful of slaves ({@creature Commoner||commoners} of any race) while {@dice 1d4} {@creature bugbear} bodyguards keep an eye out for trouble. Unless the characters intervene, the merciless noble has the slave dragged to the Westrift and unceremoniously tossed into it. The poor slave falls {@dice 3d6 × 10} feet before being caught in a web and cocooned by a {@creature giant spider} (to be devoured later). If the characters come to the slave's defense, the bugbears attack them.
zh_tw: 角色們看到一個{@creature drow noble|OotA|卓爾貴族}正在鞭打少數奴隸（任何種族的{@creature Commoner||平民}），同時{@dice 1d4}個{@creature bugbear||熊地精}保鏢警惕地注視著麻煩。除非角色們幹預，否則無情的貴族會讓奴隸被拖到西裂谷並被隨意扔進去。可憐的奴隸墜落{@dice 3d6 × 10}尺後被蛛網術纏住並被一隻{@creature giant spider||巨蜘蛛}包裹成繭（後文將被吞噬）。如果角色們為奴隸防禦，熊地精們會攻擊它們。

english: Statue of Lolth
zh_tw: 羅絲雕像

english: See "{@area Duthcloim|50e|x}" for more information.
zh_tw: 更多資訊請見"{@area 杜斯克萊姆|50e|x}"。

english: Unexpected Allies
zh_tw: 意外盟友

english: As hostile as Menzoberranzan seems to outsiders, there are powerful figures within the city who want the demon lords expelled from the Underdark and are willing to help the characters accomplish this goal.
zh_tw: 儘管魔索布萊城對外界來說似乎充滿敵意，但城內仍有一些強大的人物希望將惡魔領主驅逐出幽暗地域，並願意幫助角色們實現這一目標。

english: House Baenre
zh_tw: 班瑞家族

english: The matron mother of House Baenre is the voice of Lolth in Menzoberranzan, and despite recent events, maintains absolute control of the city. Quenthel knows how Demogorgon made his way from the Abyss to the City of Spiders. She wasn't surprised to learn that her brother Gromph—the Archmage of Menzoberranzan—was behind it, for she's seen evidence of his growing unhappiness in recent months, and she also knows that Lolth was behind it. Quenthel assumes that Lolth is making some sort of power play in the Abyss.
zh_tw: 班瑞家族的族長母親是魔索布萊城中羅絲的代言人，儘管最近發生了一些事件，她仍然對城市保持著絕對的控制。奎恩瑟知道狄摩高根是如何從無底深淵來到蜘蛛之城的。她得知她的兄弟貢夫——魔索布萊城的大法師——是幕後黑手時並不感到驚訝，因為她在過去幾個月裡看到了他日益增長的不滿，並且她也知道羅絲是幕後推手。奎恩瑟認為羅絲在無底深淵中進行某種權力遊戲。

english: If Quenthel learns that adventurers are trying to rid the Underdark of its demon lord menace, she doesn't stand in their way (see "{@adventure Private Meetings|OotA|14}") and even allows them to travel through the city unmolested.
zh_tw: 如果奎恩瑟得知冒險者們試圖清除幽暗地域中的惡魔領主威脅，她不會阻撓他們（見"{@adventure 私人會面|OotA|14}"），甚至允許他們平安無事地穿越城市。

english: Bregan D'aerthe
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶

english: Bregan D'aerthe is a mercenary company with more power and influence in Menzoberranzan than all the lesser noble houses combined. Bregan D'aerthe benefits from its close ties with House Baenre. The company's founder and leader, Jarlaxle, is brother to both Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA} and Archmage Gromph Baenre, though this fact isn't widely known.
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶是一支傭兵團，在魔索布萊城的權力與影響力，比所有小貴族家族加起來還要大。它與班瑞家族關係密切，並從中受益。傭兵團的創辦人兼領袖賈拉索，與主母{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}及大法師貢夫·班瑞是兄弟姊妹；不過，知道這件事的人並不多。

english: Jarlaxle doesn't care what the demon lords do in the Underdark, but he's worried about the future of Menzoberranzan as well as his secret holdings on the surface world. He wants to know how the demon lords arrived and how to send them back, and members of Bregan D'aerthe will support characters who claim to have those answers.
zh_tw: 賈拉索不在乎惡魔領主在幽暗地域做些什麼，但他也對魔索布萊城的未來以及他在地表世界的秘密財產感到擔憂。他想知道惡魔領主是如何到來的，以及如何將他們送回去，布雷甘·達耶的成員將支援聲稱擁有這些答案的角色。

english: Council of Spiders
zh_tw: 蜘蛛議會

english: Many drow wizards have long sought a means of increasing their power and influence, frustrated that the arcane arts are viewed as secondary to the divine magic of Lolth's priestesses. A secret cabal of noble wizards calling itself the Council of Spiders works to see wizards represented on the Ruling Council—overturning thousands of years of tradition while remaining true to Lolth's will.
zh_tw: 許多卓爾法師長久以來一直在尋找增強自己權力和影響力的方法，他們對奧術被視為羅絲神職人員神聖魔法次要的地位感到沮喪。一個自稱為蜘蛛議會的秘密貴族法師集團致力於讓法師們在統治議會中得到代表——在保持羅絲意志的同時，推翻數千年的傳統。

english: The disappearance of Gromph Baenre and the involvement of {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} in fending off the demonic invasion offers wizards of the council an unparalleled opportunity to advance their agenda. Vizeran has cultivated his role as a patron and ally of the council to gain influence among its members—while giving them no hint of his desire to destroy the drow's obsessive worship of Lolth. Vizeran has told council members that adventurers are helping him banish the demon lords back to the Abyss, and that they might come to Menzoberranzan seeking lore from Gromph's sanctum in Sorcere. The council stands ready to disable the magical wards on the tower, should this come to pass.
zh_tw: 貢夫·班瑞的失蹤以及{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}在抵禦惡魔入侵中的參與，為議會的法師們提供了一個前所未有的機會來推進他們的議程。維茲蘭培養了他作為議會的贊助人和盟友的角色，以在成員中獲得影響力——同時沒有透露他摧毀卓爾對羅絲的痴迷崇拜的願望。維茲蘭告訴議會成員，冒險家們正在幫助他將惡魔領主驅逐回無底深淵，並且他們可能會來到魔索布萊城尋找索瑟瑞貢夫的聖所中的知識。如果事情發展到這一步，議會準備禁用塔上的魔法結界。

english: Private Meetings
zh_tw: 私人會面

english: If House Baenre and Bregan D'aerthe get wind of the party's presence in the city, the characters are confronted by drow tasked with escorting them to a private meeting with the leader of each faction. Jarlaxle sends a devilishly charming and sarcastic male {@creature drow elite warrior} named Krilelyn H'Kar, tasked with leading characters to the ruins of House Do'Urden in the West Wall district. Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA} sends thirty dour {@creature drow elite warrior} mounted on {@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|giant riding lizards} (see the end of {@area chapter 8|34c|x} for statistics), with six {@creature Gargoyle||gargoyles} providing aerial support. They have orders to escort the party to House Baenre atop Qu'ellarz'orl.
zh_tw: 如果班瑞家族和布雷甘·達耶得知隊伍在城市中的存在，角色們將被卓爾護送，前往與各自派系領袖的私人會面。賈拉索派出一個極度迷人且諷刺的男性{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}，名叫克里萊林·赫卡爾（克莉蕾琳·哈卡），負責帶領角色前往西牆區的杜堊登家族廢墟。班瑞家族主母{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}派出三十名嚴肅的{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}騎乘{@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|乘用巨蜥}（見{@area 第八章|34c|x}末尾的具體數值），並有六隻{@creature Gargoyle||石像鬼}提供空中支援。他們接到命令，要護送隊伍前往位於奎拉茲·奧瑞爾（奎拉佐爾）頂部的班瑞家族。

english: Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre
zh_tw: 族長母親奎恩瑟·班瑞

english: Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA} is absolutely loyal to Lolth, but she has suspected for some time that her brother Gromph is not. The archmage has been missing since the disastrous summoning ritual that pulled the demon lords into the Underdark, and no one claims to know his whereabouts. The matron mother and her closest allies have carefully covered up the truth about Gromph's disappearance, proclaiming that the archmage is hard at work investigating the demonic invasion and seeking the means to send the demon lords back to the Abyss. Quenthel doesn't know if Gromph is alive or dead. She knows only that she can't hide his disappearance forever—even as she must ensure that no damage comes to her house as a result of his actions.
zh_tw: 族長母親{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}對羅絲絕對忠誠，但她已經懷疑了一段時間，她的兄弟貢夫並非如此。自從那次災難性的召喚儀式將惡魔領主拉入幽暗地域以來，大法師就失蹤了，沒有人聲稱知道他的下落。族長母親和她最親密的盟友已經仔細掩蓋了貢夫失蹤的真相，宣稱大法師正在努力調查惡魔入侵併尋求將惡魔領主送回無底深淵的方法。奎恩瑟不知道貢夫是活著還是死了。她只知道她不能永遠隱藏他的失蹤——即使她必須確保由於他的行為，她的房子不會受到任何損害。

english: Quenthel doesn't care that the adventurers are fighting to send the demon lords back to the Abyss, or that Menzoberranzan might suffer under another demon lord assault. She's concerned only about House Baenre. By the matron mother's addled logic, Lolth is using the demon lords to test the strength of House Baenre and lay waste to the enemies of the drow. However, the matron mother doesn't want Gromph's spell or damning evidence of his actions falling into the wrong hands.
zh_tw: 奎恩瑟 不關心冒險者們是否在努力將惡魔領主送回無底深淵，或者魔索布萊城可能會在另一次惡魔領主的攻擊下遭受苦難。她只關心班瑞家族。根據主母混亂的邏輯，羅絲正在利用惡魔領主來測試班瑞家族的力量，並摧毀卓爾的敵人。然而，主母不希望貢夫的法術或對他行為的證據落入錯誤之手。

english: Whether the characters are brought in by force or arrive willingly, read the following when they meet {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA}.
zh_tw: 無論角色是被強行帶入還是自願到來，在他們遇見{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}時閱讀以下內容。

english: A vast web of heavy metallic strands forms a kind of fence around a sprawling compound of structures laid out on the plateau at the top of Menzoberranzan's great cavern. Dozens of massive stalagmites and stalactites have been carved and shaped into towers, girded with balconies and walkways, and connected with delicate-looking ramps and bridges. All the compound is lit with blazing light in pale shades of violet, green, and blue. Dozens of drow warriors are stationed on the overlooks and walkways, ever vigilant as they watch your approach.
zh_tw: 一個由厚重金屬絲構成的巨大網路形成了一種柵欄，圍繞著魔索布萊城巨大洞穴頂部高原上展開的建築群。數十個巨大的石筍和石鐘乳被雕刻成形，變成了塔樓，周圍環繞著陽臺和走道，並透過看起來脆弱的坡道和橋樑連線。整個建築群被淡紫色、綠色和藍色的熾烈光芒照亮。數十名卓爾戰士駐守在瞭望臺和走道上，他們時刻警惕著，注視著你的接近。

english: When the characters are taken into the compound, the matron mother welcomes them in her throne room—a massive chamber that occupies the entire fourth level of one tower. She sits upon a throne carved from a single black sapphire, with large diamonds set into its arms shedding light at the matron's command.
zh_tw: 當角色們被帶入這個建築群時，族長母親在她的王座室歡迎他們——這是一個佔據一個塔樓第四層整個空間的巨大房間。她坐在一個由單一黑色藍寶石雕刻而成的王座上，其扶手上鑲嵌著巨大的鑽石，隨著族長的命令而散發光芒。

english: Quenthel doesn't know that {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} is still alive, and any mention of him piques her interest, although she doesn't consider him a threat. After Gromph disappeared, she sent underlings to Sorcere to rid his sanctum of any incriminating evidence. They found none. The matron mother doesn't know about Gromph's secret inner sanctum or the grimoire hidden there. If the characters explain the broad strokes of their goal to get the grimoire out of the city, Quenthel allows and supports their mission—even as she secretly plans to manufacture evidence that the adventurers were behind the ritual that brought the demon lords to the Underdark if they are caught with the grimoire in their possession. She grants permission for the characters to enter Sorcere and instructs the tower's inhabitants not to impede their investigation.
zh_tw: 奎恩瑟 不知道{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}仍然活著，任何提及他的事情都會引起她的興趣，儘管她並不認為他是一個威脅。貢夫消失後，她派手下去索瑟瑞清除他的聖所中的任何罪證。他們沒有找到任何東西。主母不知道貢夫的秘密內部聖所或隱藏在那裡的魔法書。如果角色們向奎恩瑟大致解釋了他們的目標，即把魔法書帶出城市，奎恩瑟允許並支援他們的任務——即使她秘密計劃製造證據，表明如果冒險者們擁有魔法書，他們就是將惡魔領主帶到幽暗地域儀式的幕後黑手。她允許角色們進入索瑟瑞，並指示塔中的居民不要妨礙他們的調查。

english: As a Chosen of Lolth, {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA} is, by herself, a threat comparable to any demon lord. Surrounded by the well-trained guards and magical wards of House Baenre, she could annihilate the adventurers without breaking a sweat. If the characters attack her, use the statistics of the {@creature drow priestess of Lolth} with the following modifications:
zh_tw: 作為羅絲的選民，{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}本身就是一個可以與任何惡魔領主相媲美的威脅。在班瑞家族訓練有素的守衛和魔法結界的環繞下，她可以不費吹灰之力地消滅冒險家們。如果角色們攻擊她，請使用{@creature drow priestess of Lolth||卓爾羅絲女祭司}的具體數值，並進行以下修改：

english: Quenthel has an Armor Class of 19 ({@item +3 scale mail}) and 132 ({@dice 24d8 + 24}) hit points.
zh_tw: 奎恩瑟的護甲等級為19（{@item +3 scale mail||+3 鱗甲}），生命值為132（{@dice 24d8 + 24}）。

english: She has an Intelligence of 18 (+4) and a Wisdom of 20 (+5). Her saving throw bonuses are as follows: Con +8, Wis +12, Cha +11. Her skill bonuses are as follows: {@skill Insight} +12, {@skill Perception} +12, {@skill Religion} +11, {@skill Stealth} +9.
zh_tw: 她的感知值為18（+4），感知值為20（+5）。她的豁免加值如下：體質+8，感知+12，魅力+11。她的技能加值如下：{@skill Insight||洞悉} +12，{@skill Perception||感知} +12，{@skill Religion||宗教} +11，{@skill Stealth||隱匿} +9。

english: She's an 20th-level spellcaster who can cast any cleric spell up to 9th level at will (save {@dc 20}, {@hit 12} to hit with spell attacks).
zh_tw: 她是一個20級的施法者，可以隨意施放任何最高9環的牧師法術（豁免{@dc 20}，法術攻擊命中{@hit 12}）。

english: She wields a {@item tentacle rod}.
zh_tw: 她持有一根{@item tentacle rod||觸鬚權杖}。

english: While seated on her throne, Quenthel can use an action on her turn to cast {@spell disintegrate} (save {@dc 19}). A target that fails its saving throw takes {@dice 10d6 + 40} force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated.
zh_tw: 當奎恩瑟坐在她的王座上時，她可以在她的回合中使用一個動作施放 {@spell disintegrate||解離術}（豁免 {@dc 19}）。未能透過豁免的目標將受到 {@dice 10d6 + 40} 力場傷害。如果此傷害將目標的生命值降至 0，目標將被解離。

english: She has a challenge rating of 22 (41,000 XP).
zh_tw: 她的挑戰等級為22（41,000 XP）。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: If the party gains the support of {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA}, award each character 2,000 XP.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍獲得了{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}的支援，給每個角色獎勵2000 XP。

english: Jarlaxle Baenre of Bregan D'aerthe
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶的賈拉索·班瑞

english: The dashing and dapper commander of the Bregan D'aerthe mercenary company, Jarlaxle Baenre is a drow warrior with centuries of experience. A nonconformist in a culture where failure to conform usually means death or exile, he has learned to walk the line between being too defiant to be part of drow society and being too useful to get rid of.
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶僱傭兵公司的英俊瀟灑、風度翩翩的指揮官，賈拉索·班瑞是一位擁有數個世紀經驗的卓爾戰士。在一個不從眾通常意味著死亡或流放的文化中，他是一個非傳統主義者，他已經學會了在卓爾社會中過於挑釁和太過有用以至於無法擺脫之間走鋼絲。

english: In addition to witnessing first hand the destruction wrought in Menzoberranzan, Jarlaxle understands the terrible implications of the demon lords' arrival in the Underdark, and he knows that his brother Gromph is responsible. Jarlaxle knows that Gromph is hiding in the city of Luskan on the Sword Coast, but he doesn't share this information under any circumstances. Jarlaxle has eyes and ears everywhere in Menzoberranzan, and he takes an interest in the adventurers—particularly if they travel with Grin Ousstyl.
zh_tw: 除了親眼目睹魔索布萊城造成的破壞外，賈拉索還理解惡魔領主來到幽暗地域所帶來的可怕後果，並且他知道這背後是他兄弟貢夫的責任。賈拉索知道貢夫藏在劍海岸的路斯坎城，但他在任何情況下都不會分享這些資訊。賈拉索在魔索布萊城有耳目遍佈，他對冒險者們表現出興趣——特別是如果他們與格林·奧斯提爾同行。

english: If the characters agree to meet with Jarlaxle in House Do'Urden, read the following when they first arrive.
zh_tw: 如果角色們同意在杜堊登家族會見賈拉索，當他們第一次到達時閱讀以下內容。

english: A drow house stands alone and forlorn with its back against the west wall of Menzoberranzan's great vault. Its towers are dark, its walls crumbling and in desperate need of repair. The old fortress has the countenance of a haunted ruin, but here and there you glimpse signs of life: drow in black leather armor standing guard in the shadows and magical flames dancing in the stone braziers that flank the entrance. As you are led inside, a pillared hall strewn with broken statuary looms all around you. Leaning against a cracked pillar is a drow with an eyepatch and a wide-brimmed hat. A saber hangs from his hip, and he cuts a dashing figure. "Well met!" he says with a smile.
zh_tw: 一座卓爾的府邸孤獨而淒涼地背靠在魔索布萊城巨大拱頂的西牆。它的塔樓昏暗，牆壁破敗不堪，急需修繕。這座古老的堡壘看起來像是一個鬧鬼的廢墟，但在這裡和那裡，你瞥見了生命的跡象：穿著黑色皮甲的卓爾在陰影中站崗，魔法火焰在入口兩側的石制火盆中跳躍。當你被領進去時，一個散落著破碎雕像的柱廊大廳映入眼簾。一個戴著眼罩和寬邊帽的卓爾靠在一根裂縫柱子上。一把軍刀掛在他的臀部，他顯得英俊瀟灑。"幸會！"他帶著微笑說道。

english: When Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA} resurrected House Do'Urden, she ordered her brother Jarlaxle to look after the long-abandoned Do'Urden estate. He now uses the ruined drow house as a Bregan D'aerthe base. Most of the house is off-limits to visitors, and Jarlaxle won't allow the characters to stay long.
zh_tw: 當族長母親{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}復活了杜堊登家族時，她命令她的兄弟賈拉索照看長期被遺棄的杜堊登莊園。他現在將這個破敗的卓爾家族作為布雷甘·達耶的基地使用。家族的大部分區域對訪客是禁止的，而且賈拉索不會允許角色們逗留太久。

english: Jarlaxle doesn't want the demon lords rampaging through the Underdark or making it to the surface world. If the characters reveal that their ultimate goal is to send the demon lords back to the Abyss, Jarlaxle gives them whatever aid he can short of doing their "dirty work" for them. If the characters mention {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}, Jarlaxle's interest is piqued, for he thought Vizeran was dead. He warns them not to trust that "relic of a bygone house." If the characters mention Vizeran's plan to make Menzoberranzan the site for the final showdown with the demon lords, Jarlaxle insists that the characters choose a different battleground, warning them that Bregan D'aerthe will oppose any effort to visit further destruction upon the city.
zh_tw: 賈拉索不希望惡魔領主在幽暗地域肆虐，也不希望它們到達地表世界。如果角色們透露他們的最終目標是將惡魔領主送回無底深淵，賈拉索會提供他所能提供的一切幫助，但不會替他們做"髒活"。如果角色們提及{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}，賈拉索的興趣會被激發，因為他以為維茲蘭已經死了。他警告他們不要相信那個"過時家族的遺物"。如果角色們提到維茲蘭計劃將魔索布萊城作為與惡魔領主最終決戰的地點，賈拉索堅持要求角色們選擇一個不同的戰場，並警告他們布雷甘·達耶將反對任何給這座城市帶來更多破壞的努力。

english: If the characters claim to be looking for a safe way into Sorcere, Jarlaxle arranges for a member of the Council of Spiders to visit the party at a Bregan D'aerthe safe house in West Wall. This male {@creature drow mage} brings scrolls of {@spell greater invisibility}—one for each party member—and also gives the characters a password that temporarily bypasses the tower's defenses. Characters who speak the password while inside the tower won't have to deal with the tower's {@spell guards and wards} effect for a period of 1 hour (see "{@area Sorcere|55e|x}" later in this chapter). Bregan D'aerthe makes sure that the characters have no hostile encounters as they make their way to the Academy.
zh_tw: 如果角色們聲稱他們在尋找進入索瑟瑞的安全途徑，賈拉索安排蜘蛛議會的一名成員在西牆的布雷甘·達耶安全屋拜訪隊伍。這位男性{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}帶來了{@spell greater invisibility||高等隱形術}卷軸——每個隊伍成員一個——並且還給了角色們一個密碼，這個密碼可以暫時繞過塔樓的防禦。在塔樓內說出密碼的角色在1小時內不需要處理塔樓的{@spell guards and wards||銅牆鐵壁}效果（見本章後面的"{@area 索瑟瑞|55e|x}"）。布雷甘·達耶確保角色們在前往學院的路上不會遇到敵對的遭遇。

english: Once he becomes aware of Gromph's grimoire, Jarlaxle does everything in his power to make sure the characters get the grimoire out of the city. Once Vizeran's ritual is complete, Jarlaxle plans to send Bregan D'aerthe spies to find Vizeran and steal the grimoire, so that he has evidence he can lord over his brother.
zh_tw: 一旦賈拉索得知了貢夫的魔法書，他會盡一切努力確保角色們將魔法書帶出城市。一旦維茲蘭的儀式完成，賈拉索計劃派遣布雷甘·達耶的間諜去尋找維茲蘭並偷走魔法書，這樣他就有證據可以用來要挾他的兄弟。

english: Vizeran's plan is appealing to Jarlaxle because it doesn't cost him anything. As long as the adventurers are committed to driving the demon lords back to the Abyss, Jarlaxle keeps his Bregan D'aerthe forces on the sidelines, ready to defend Menzoberranzan.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭的計劃對賈拉索來說很有吸引力，因為它不需要他付出任何代價。只要冒險者們致力於將惡魔領主送回無底深淵，賈拉索就讓他的布雷甘·達耶部隊保持觀望，隨時準備保衛魔索布萊城。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: If the party gains the support of Jarlaxle Baenre, award each character 1,500 XP.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍獲得了賈拉索·班瑞的支援，給每個角色獎勵1500 XP。

english: A Change of Heart
zh_tw: 心靈的轉變

english: At some point as the characters explore Menzoberranzan, Grin Ousstyl confesses that his master Vizeran has not been entirely truthful with the adventurers. (If Grin didn't accompany the characters to the city, he pursues and eventually catches up with them to share what he knows.)
zh_tw: 在角色們探索魔索布萊城的過程中，格林·奧斯提爾承認他的主人維茲蘭並沒有完全對冒險家們誠實。（如果格林沒有陪同角色們來到這座城市，他會追趕並最終趕上他們，分享他所知道的資訊。）

english: Grin has studied Vizeran's work in crafting the {@i dark heart} talisman and its associated ritual to draw the demon lords together, and he believes that the ritual will have its intended effect regardless of where the talisman is placed. It doesn't need to be placed in Sorcere, or even in Menzoberranzan. Placing the talisman there only ensures that the drow city becomes the site of the demon lords' battle—and might well be laid waste in the process. If pressed, Grin admits that he isn't absolutely certain that Vizeran's ritual will work if the talisman is placed elsewhere. He's not as learned or powerful as his master.
zh_tw: 格林研究了維茲蘭製作{@i 黑暗之心}護身符及其相關的儀式，以吸引惡魔領主聚集在一起，他認為無論護身符放置在哪裡，儀式都會產生預期的效果。它不需要被放置在索瑟瑞，甚至不需要在魔索布萊城。將護身符放置在那裡只確保了卓爾城市成為惡魔領主戰鬥的地點——並且在此過程中很可能會被摧毀。如果被追問，格林承認他並不完全確定如果護身符被放置在其他地方，維茲蘭的儀式是否會奏效。他沒有他的主人那樣博學或強大。

english: Grin encourages the adventurers place the {@i dark heart} elsewhere and, in so doing, arrange a different battlefield for the demon lord showdown. He refuses to go along with any effort to leave the talisman in Menzoberranzan. If the characters intend to place the {@i dark heart} as planned, they need to find some way to convince Grin or ensure his silence. Alternatively, Grin can betray them to the nearest drow patrol, disclosing Vizeran's plan in the hope of saving the city.
zh_tw: 格林鼓勵冒險家們將{@i 黑暗之心}放置在別處，並因此為惡魔領主的決戰安排一個不同的戰場。他拒絕參與任何將護身符留在魔索布萊城的行動。如果角色們打算按計劃放置{@i 黑暗之心}，他們需要找到某種方法來說服格林或確保他的沉默。或者，格林可以向最近的卓爾巡邏隊出賣他們，披露維茲蘭的計劃，希望拯救這座城市。

english: Sorcere
zh_tw: 索瑟瑞

english: The information the adventurers need to better understand the ritual that summoned the demon lords into the Underdark is in Gromph Baenre's sanctum within Sorcere, Menzoberranzan's academy of wizardry. The archmage's quarters have been declared off limits by Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA}, who's trying to cover up Gromph's involvement in the devastating attack on Menzoberranzan.
zh_tw: 冒險者們需要更好地理解召喚惡魔領主進入幽暗地域的儀式的資訊，位於魔索布萊城的巫術學院索瑟瑞內，貢夫·班瑞的聖所中。大法師的住處已被主母{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}宣佈為禁區，她正試圖掩蓋貢夫參與對魔索布萊城造成破壞性攻擊的事實。

english: The adventurers can safely enter Sorcere with the aid of Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA}, Jarlaxle Baenre, or members of the Council of Spiders. Once inside, the characters on their own, as none of these NPCs or their agents want to be connected to the adventurers if things go awry.
zh_tw: 在族長母親{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}、賈拉索·班瑞或蜘蛛議會成員的幫助下，冒險家們可以安全地進入索瑟瑞。一旦進入，角色們就得靠自己了，因為如果事情出了差錯，這些NPC或他們的代理人不想與冒險家們有任何聯絡。

english: Guards and Wards
zh_tw: 銅牆鐵壁

english: The whole tower is protected by permanent {@spell guards and wards} spells. The tower's drow residents are immune to the effects, but intruders are not. If the characters have the support of the Council of Spiders, members of the council give them a password which, when spoken aloud inside the tower, grants the speaker immunity to the spells' effect for 1 hour. After that, the password magically changes, and any characters still in the tower must deal with the {@spell guards and wards} effect.
zh_tw: 整個塔樓受到永久性的{@spell guards and wards||銅牆鐵壁}法術的保護。塔樓內的卓爾居民對這些效果免疫，但入侵者則不然。如果角色們得到了蜘蛛議會的支援，議會的成員會給他們一個口令，當在塔樓內大聲說出這個口令時，說話者將在1小時內對法術效果免疫。之後，口令會神奇地改變，任何仍在塔樓中的角色都必須應對{@spell guards and wards||銅牆鐵壁}的效果。

english: Random Encounters in Sorcere
zh_tw: 索瑟瑞中的隨機遭遇

english: Inside Sorcere, the characters might encounter drow wizards as well as their apprentices, familiars, and other magical creatures. If they enter with {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA}'s permission, they can avoid most trouble with the tower's inhabitants. Otherwise, stealth and caution will be important.
zh_tw: 在索瑟瑞內部，角色們可能會遇到卓爾法師以及他們的學徒、寵物和其他魔法生物。如果他們得到{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}的許可進入，他們可以避免與塔樓居民的大部分麻煩。否則，隱秘和謹慎將是重要的。

english: Have the characters make four {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) group checks from the moment they enter the tower to when they reach the archmage's sanctum. Each failed group check results in an encounter from the Sorcere Encounters table. The characters make the same checks while exiting the tower.
zh_tw: 讓角色們從進入塔樓的那一刻起，直到抵達大法師的聖所，進行四次{@dc 13}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）群體檢定。每次失敗的群體檢定都會從索瑟瑞遭遇表中觸發一次遭遇。角色們在離開塔樓時也需要進行相同的檢定。

english: If the tower goes on alert (as indicated in some of the encounter descriptions), all characters have disadvantage when making their group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.
zh_tw: 如果塔樓進入警戒狀態（如某些遭遇描述中所指出的），所有角色在進行團隊敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定時都具有劣勢。

english: Sorcere Encounters
zh_tw: 索瑟瑞遭遇

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Drow Mage||drow mages}
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Drow Mage||卓爾魔法師}

english: 1 {@creature giant spider}
zh_tw: 1 {@creature giant spider||巨蜘蛛}

english: 1 {@condition invisible} {@creature quasit}
zh_tw: 1 {@condition invisible||隱形} {@creature quasit||小惡魔}

english: 1 mad {@creature drow mage}
zh_tw: 1名瘋狂的{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}

english: 1 {@creature shadow demon}
zh_tw: 1 {@creature shadow demon||幽影惡魔}

english: {@dice 1d4} slaves
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} 名奴隸

english: 1 {@creature succubus} or {@creature incubus}
zh_tw: 1名{@creature succubus||魅魔}或{@creature incubus||夢魔}

english: Drow Mages
zh_tw: 卓爾魔法師

english: There is a 50 percent chance that these mages have been forewarned of the party's arrival, either by {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} or by Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA}, in which case they let the characters pass. Otherwise, the drow mages assume the characters are intruders and attack unless Grin Ousstyl is with them. If the characters declare that they have {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA}'s permission to be here, they can convince the mages to stand down with a successful {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Persuasion}) check.
zh_tw: 有50%的機率，這些法師已經被 {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾} 或母主 {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}預先警告了隊伍的到達，這種情況下他們會放行隊伍。**否則，卓爾法師們會將角色視為入侵者並發動攻擊，除非格林·奧斯提爾與他們同行。如果角色宣稱他們有 {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}的許可到此，他們可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 12} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞} 或 {@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定說服法師們罷手。

english: If one or more mages fall in battle, the rest use {@spell greater invisibility} spells to turn {@condition invisible} and retreat, putting the tower on alert if it isn't already.
zh_tw: 如果一個或更多的法師在戰鬥中倒下，其餘的法師使用{@spell greater invisibility||高等隱形術}法術變得{@condition invisible||隱形}並撤退，如果塔樓還沒有被警告，這將觸發警報。

english: Giant Spider
zh_tw: 巨蜘蛛

english: This {@creature giant spider} crawls along the walls or ceiling. It ignores the characters unless they take hostile action against it, in which case it attacks.
zh_tw: 這隻{@creature giant spider||巨蜘蛛}在牆壁或天花板上爬行。除非角色對它採取敵對行動，否則它不會理會角色，如果角色採取敵對行動，它就會攻擊。

english: Invisible Quasit
zh_tw: 隱形小惡魔

english: A drow wizard's {@creature quasit} familiar invisibly haunts the halls and chambers of the tower. It follows and observes the characters to find out what they're up to, leaving to alert its master (a {@creature drow mage}) if they enter Gromph's sanctum or are seen leaving it. If the demon escapes, the tower goes on alert.
zh_tw: 一個卓爾法師的{@creature quasit||小惡魔}寵物在塔樓的走廊和房間中無形地出沒。它跟蹤並觀察角色們，以瞭解他們的目的，如果他們進入貢夫的聖所或被看到離開那裡，它會離開以警告它的主人（一個{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}）。如果惡魔逃脫了，塔樓就會進入警戒狀態。

english: Mad Drow Mage
zh_tw: 瘋狂的卓爾法師

english: This {@creature Drow Mage||drow} is afflicted with a form of indefinite madness. Roll on the Indefinite Madness table in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Madness} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} to determine how the madness is expressed.
zh_tw: 這隻{@creature Drow Mage||卓爾}患上了一種永久性瘋狂形式。請根據{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Madness}（選自{@i 城主指南}）中的永久性瘋狂表投擲，以確定瘋狂的表達方式。

english: Shadow Demon
zh_tw: 幽影惡魔

english: A bound servant of a drow mage, this {@creature Shadow Demon||demon} attempts to hide from the characters, then follows to learn what they're up to. It fights the characters only if they attack it, fleeing if reduced to 10 or fewer hit points. If the demon escapes, the tower goes on alert.
zh_tw: 作為卓爾巫師的束縛僕從，這個{@creature Shadow Demon||惡魔}試圖躲避角色們，然後跟蹤他們以瞭解他們的目的。它只有在被攻擊時才會與角色們戰鬥，如果降至10點或更少的生命值時會逃跑。如果惡魔逃脫了，塔樓就會進入警戒狀態。

english: Slaves
zh_tw: 奴隸

english: These {@creature Commoner||commoners} (your choice of race) are on an errand for their drow mage master when they run into the party by accident. If the characters state that they have legitimate business in Sorcere, the slaves answer questions about the tower if asked. If the slaves suspect the characters are trespassers, or if they're threatened or attacked, they flee and call for help. If any slaves escape the encounter, the tower goes on alert.
zh_tw: 這些{@creature Commoner||平民}（你選擇種族）在為他們卓爾法師主人辦事時偶然遇到了隊伍。如果角色們表明他們在索瑟瑞有合法事務，這些奴隸在被問及時會回答有關塔樓的問題。如果奴隸懷疑角色們是非法闖入者，或者如果他們受到威脅或攻擊，他們就會逃跑並呼救。如果有奴隸逃脫了這次遭遇，塔樓就會進入警戒狀態。

english: Succubus or Incubus
zh_tw: 魅魔或夢魘

english: A sometime lover and ally of one of the tower's wizards, this fiend adopts the form of a slave (your choice of race). Curious to see the inside of Gromph's sanctum, the "slave" offers to guide the characters there, taking them along a route that avoids other random encounters. The fiend tries to steal Gromph's grimoire if the opportunity presents itself, first by using its Charm ability to convince a character to part with the book, and then by using Etherealness to disappear with it.
zh_tw: 作為塔樓中某位法師的偶爾情人和盟友，這個惡魔化身為一名奴隸（你可以選擇種族）。出於對貢夫聖所內部的好奇，這個"奴隸"主動提出引導角色們前往那裡，帶領他們走一條可以避開其他隨機遭遇的路線。如果有機會，惡魔會嘗試偷走貢夫的魔法書，首先利用其魅惑能力說服一名角色交出這本書，然後使用以太化能力帶著它消失。

english: Gromph's Outer Sanctum
zh_tw: 貢夫的外聖所

english: The black marble door to Gromph Baenre's chambers is etched with silvery runes around its edge and closed with an {@spell arcane lock} keyed to him. Picking the lock requires a successful {@dc 23} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, while forcing the door open requires a successful {@dc 25} Strength check. A {@spell knock} spell also opens the door, and Grin Ousstyl can have the spell prepared if none of the adventurers knows it.
zh_tw: 通往貢夫·班瑞房間的黑色大理石門上邊緣刻有銀色符文，並用一個只對他有效的{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}鎖定。使用盜賊工具進行成功的{@dc 23}敏捷檢定可以開鎖，而強行開門則需要成功的{@dc 25}力量檢定。一個{@spell knock||敲擊術}也可以開啟門，如果沒有冒險者知道這個法術，格林·奧斯提爾可以準備這個法術。

english: The chamber beyond the door is floored in black marble, lined with shelves laden with books and scrolls, and dominated by a broad desk of polished bone. A plush chair covered with lizard hide sits behind the desk, while a smaller and simpler zurkhwood chair sits facing it on the opposite side. A seven-foot-tall obsidian statue of a four-armed, sword-wielding drow warrior stands behind the desk against one wall. Burning red candles are set about the room in holders made from skeletal hands.
zh_tw: 門後的房間鋪著黑色的大理石地板，四周擺滿了書架，書架上堆滿了書籍和卷軸，房間的中心是一張磨光骨頭製成的寬闊書桌。書桌後面是一把覆蓋著蜥蜴皮的豪華椅子，而在對面的一側則放著一把更小更簡單的紫杉木椅子。一個七尺高的黑曜石雕像，刻畫著一位四臂、持劍的卓爾戰士，矗立在書桌後面的牆上。燃燒的紅色蠟燭散佈在房間內，燭臺由骷髏手製成。

english: {@spell Continual flame} spells have been cast on the dozen candles in the room, filling the area with {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}. If anyone other than Gromph enters the chamber without speaking the word {@i tyrnae} ("quench"), a {@creature fire elemental} appears and attacks the intruders. Casting {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 15}) on the door before it opens disables this trap, but the elemental can't be dispelled once it appears.
zh_tw: 房間內的十幾支蠟燭上被施放了{@spell Continual flame||不滅明焰}法術，使該區域充滿{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}。如果有除貢夫之外的任何人未說出咒語{@i tyrnae}（意為"熄滅"）就進入密閣，一個{@creature fire elemental||火元素}就會出現並攻擊入侵者。在門扉開啟前對其施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 15}）可以解除此陷阱，但元素一旦出現就無法被驅散。

english: If anyone tampers with the desk or the shelves' contents, or attempts to remove anything from the room, the {@creature four-armed statue|OotA} animates and attacks. It has the statistics of a {@creature stone golem}, but replace its Multiattack and Slam action options with the following:
zh_tw: 如果有人試圖篡改書桌或書架上的內容，或試圖從房間中移走任何東西，{@creature four-armed statue|OotA|四臂雕像}會活化並發動攻擊。它的具體數值與{@creature stone golem||石魔像}相同，但將其多重攻擊和猛擊動作選項替換為以下內容：

english: Multiattack
zh_tw: 多重攻擊

english: The golem makes four sword attacks.
zh_tw: 魔像進行四次劍攻擊。

english: Sword
zh_tw: 劍

english: {@i Melee Weapon Attack}: {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@i Hit}: 10 ({@dice 1d8 + 6}) slashing damage.
zh_tw: {@i 近戰武器攻擊}: {@hit 10}命中，觸及5尺，單一目標。{@i 命中}: 10（{@dice 1d8 + 6}）揮砍傷害。

english: Anyone speaking the statue's name ({@i Szashune}) aloud isn't attacked by it.
zh_tw: 任何大聲說出雕像名字（{@i 斯扎舒恩}）的人不會被它攻擊。

english: Trapped Secret Door
zh_tw: 陷阱密門

english: Any party member with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 20 or higher notices a secret door in the wall, while a character searching the room for secret doors must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to find it. Any creature with 12 Hit Dice or fewer that approaches within 5 feet of the secret door without speaking the word {@i khaless} ("trust") triggers an {@spell imprisonment} spell (save {@dc 17}). On a failed save, the creature is trapped in minimus containment inside a gemstone in Gromph's inner sanctum (described in the next section). The trap ceases to exist once a creature becomes imprisoned. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 19}) cast on the secret door removes the trap.
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）達到20或更高的隊伍成員能發現牆上的暗門，而搜尋房間尋找暗門的角色必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能找到它。任何生命骰數為12或更少的生物在沒有說出{@i 卡勒斯}（"信任"）這個詞的情況下接近暗門5尺內時，會觸發一個{@spell imprisonment||禁錮術}法術（豁免{@dc 17}）。如果豁免失敗，該生物將被困在貢夫內室中一顆寶石的微小容器內（見下一節描述）。一旦有生物被禁錮，陷阱將不復存在。對暗門成功施展{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 19}）可以移除該陷阱。

english: Opening the secret door requires a {@spell knock} spell or a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check to assess and manipulate its magic. Beyond it lies a dark void that can't be dispelled or destroyed. Anyone or anything that touches the void is instantly transported to a labyrinthine demiplane similar to that created by a {@spell maze} spell. A creature that succeeds on the {@dc 20} Intelligence check to escape the maze reappears in the middle of the outer sanctum. However, if a creature casts a spell of 5th level or higher while in the demiplane, all creatures and objects in the demiplane instantly appear in Gromph's inner sanctum instead.
zh_tw: 開啟這扇暗門需要一個 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術，或者進行一次成功的 {@dc 20} 智力 ({@skill Arcana||奧秘}) 檢定來評估並操控其魔法。門後是一片無法驅散或摧毀的黑暗虛空。任何觸碰虛空的生物或物體會立即被傳送到一個類似於 {@spell maze||迷宮術} 所創造的迷宮般的半位面中。成功透過 {@dc 20} 智力檢定以逃脫迷宮的生物會重新出現在外層聖所的中心。然而，如果生物在半位面中施放了一個 5 級或更高階的法術，半位面中的所有生物和物體會立即出現在貢夫的內層聖所中。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The collection of rare books and scrolls in the archmage's chambers is worth 15,000 gp, assuming the characters have the means to haul it out. A character who spends 10 minutes poring over the collection can make a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. On a successful check, the character confirms that Gromph's grimoire isn't among the books in the collection and also identifies the collection's five most valuable tomes, worth 1,000 gp each. However, one of these valuable works is trapped with a {@spell glyph of warding} that triggers the third effect of {@spell bestow curse} (save {@dc 17}), and which lasts until dispelled.
zh_tw: 大法師房間內收藏的稀有書籍和卷軸價值 15,000 gp，假設角色們有辦法將其搬出。一個角色如果花 10 分鐘仔細研究這些藏書，可以進行一次 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色將確認貢夫的魔法書不在這些藏書中，並識別出其中最珍貴的五本典籍，每本價值 1,000 gp。然而，其中一本珍貴典籍被 {@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文} 所陷阱，觸發 {@spell bestow curse||降咒} 的第三效果（豁免 {@dc 17}），並且該效果將持續到被驅散為止。

english: The drawers of the desk are sealed with {@spell arcane lock} spells. Picking a drawer's lock requires thieves' tools and a successful {@dc 23} Dexterity check. A {@spell knock} spell or a successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 15}) cast on a drawer removes its magical lock. When opened, the drawers are empty. An effect similar to {@spell Leomund's secret chest} shifts the drawers' contents into an extradimensional space when anyone other than Gromph opens them.
zh_tw: 桌子的抽屜被 {@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖} 法術封印。撬開一個抽屜的鎖需要盜賊工具併成功透過 {@dc 23} 敏捷檢定。施放 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術或在抽屜上成功施放 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 15}）可以移除其魔法鎖。開啟時，抽屜是空的。當除貢夫之外的任何人開啟抽屜時，一個類似於 {@spell Leomund's secret chest||李歐蒙秘藏箱} 的效果會將抽屜中的物品轉移到一個異次元空間中。

english: Gromph's Inner Sanctum
zh_tw: 貢夫的內聖所

english: Read the following text to players whose characters escape Gromph's demiplane (see "{@area Gromph's Outer Sanctum|569|x}") and appear in the archmage's inner sanctum.
zh_tw: 閱讀以下文字給那些角色從貢夫的半位面逃脫（見"{@area 貢夫的外聖所|569|x}"）並出現在大法師內聖所的玩家。

english: This circular chamber is lit by magic candles and floored in black stone, engraved and inlaid with magical diagrams in silver and gold. A female drow stands in the center of one magic circle, hands resting on her hips. Behind her, shelves and cabinets hold ceramic pots, glass vials, and other arcane paraphernalia, while a tome bound in black leather lies open on a lectern, its pages covered in spidery glyphs. The only exit appears to be an archway filled with a black void.
zh_tw: 這個圓形的房間由魔法蠟燭照亮，黑色的石頭地板上刻著銀色和金色的魔法圖陣。一位女性卓爾站在一個魔法圈的中心，雙手叉腰。她身後的架子和櫃子上擺放著陶瓷罐、玻璃瓶和其他奧術用具，而一本黑色皮革裝訂的書在講臺上開啟著，書頁上覆蓋著蜘蛛狀的符文。唯一的出口似乎是一個充滿黑色虛空的拱門。

english: Any creature that touches the dark void is whisked away to the demiplane that separates Gromph's inner and outer sanctums (see the previous section for details).
zh_tw: 任何觸碰到黑暗虛空的生物都會被迅速傳送到分隔貢夫內聖所和外聖所的半位面（詳見上一節）。

english: A {@creature yochlol} demon in drow form—Lolth's messenger to Gromph—is imprisoned within the magic circle. It pretends to be a drow priestess named Y'lara for as long as the disguise is useful, claiming to have been trapped in the circle by the archmage after failing to convince Gromph not to cast his spell (a lie). The demon tries to get the characters to free it by breaking the circle, whereupon it attacks and tries to kill them. As long as the circle is intact, the demon can't leave it and doesn't have line of effect to anything outside of the circle. The yochlol does whatever it can to prevent the adventurers from leaving with Gromph's grimoire (see "Treasure").
zh_tw: 一隻以卓爾形態出現的{@creature yochlol||蠟融妖}惡魔——羅絲派給貢夫的信使——被囚禁在防護法陣中。只要偽裝有用，它就會假裝成一位名叫伊拉拉的卓爾祭司，聲稱因未能說服貢夫不要施放他的法術而被大法師困在法陣中（這是個謊言）。惡魔試圖讓角色們透過破壞法陣來釋放它，然後它會攻擊並試圖殺死它們。只要法陣完好無損，惡魔就無法離開它，也無法對法陣外的任何東西產生線狀效應。這隻蠟融妖會盡其所能阻止冒險者們帶著貢夫的魔法書離開（見"寶藏"）。

english: The characters can bargain with the trapped or defeated demon. It is reluctant to tell them what it knows, but angrily answers questions in exchange for its freedom. The demon tries to convince the characters to release it before it tells them what it knows, and any promises it makes are forgotten once it is freed.
zh_tw: 角色們可以與被困或被擊敗的惡魔討價還價。惡魔不願意告訴他們所知道的資訊，但在獲得自由的交換條件下憤怒地回答問題。惡魔試圖說服角色們在它透露所知資訊之前釋放它，並且一旦它被釋放，它所做的任何承諾都會被忘記。

english: The yochlol was sent by Lolth to "assist" Gromph with his ritual, knowing that it wouldn't work as intended. When Gromph lost control of the ritual, he fled the city, but not before trapping the yochlol. The yochlol knows that Gromph's inability to harness the {@i faerzress} is the reason why the ritual failed, but it doesn't know Gromph's present whereabouts. If the characters ask "Y'lara" what Lolth stands to gain from Gromph casting the ritual, the demon replies, "Chaos."
zh_tw: 蠟融妖被羅絲派來"協助"貢夫進行他的儀式，知道它不會按預期工作。當貢夫失去對儀式的控制時，他逃離了城市，但在此之前困住了蠟融妖。蠟融妖知道貢夫無法駕馭{@i 妖光}是儀式失敗的原因，但它不知道貢夫目前的下落。如果角色們問"伊拉拉"羅絲從貢夫施放儀式中能得到什麼，惡魔回答道："混沌。"

english: If the yochlol is killed, a character who investigates the grimoire can confirm beyond doubt that Gromph was responsible for bringing the demon lords to the Underdark.
zh_tw: 如果蠟融妖被殺死，調查魔法書的角色可以毫無疑問地確認貢夫是將惡魔領主帶到幽暗地域的責任人。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Gromph's grimoire rests atop the lectern near the circle and bears the title {@i Zhaun'ol'leal} ("The Book of the Eight" in Elvish) and describes rituals for summoning and binding powerful demons. It's open to a chapter that talks about the summoning of Demogorgon.
zh_tw: 貢夫的魔法書放在圓圈附近的講臺上，書名為{@i 札恩歐利爾}（在精靈語中意為"八之書"），描述了召喚和束縛強大惡魔的儀式。它翻到了一章，談論了召喚狄摩高根。

english: The various arcane components and ritual items in the workroom are worth 1,000 gp total. A 6,000 gp diamond also sits on a small stand atop a workbench. It contains any creature trapped by the {@spell imprisonment} spell that guards the secret door in Gromph's Outer Sanctum.
zh_tw: 工作室裡各種奧術元件和儀式物品總共價值1,000金幣。在工作臺上的一個小支架上還放著一顆價值6,000金幣的鑽石。它包含了被貢夫外聖所中的秘密門守衛的{@spell imprisonment||禁錮術}法術困住的任何生物。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: If the party acquires Gromph's grimoire, award each character 1,500 XP.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍獲得了貢夫的魔法書，給每個角色獎勵1500 XP。

english: Developments
zh_tw: 發展

english: By the end of this chapter, characters should have Gromph's grimoire and certain knowledge of the archmage's ritual in their possession. Given Grin Ousstyl's information, the characters are faced with a grim choice—place Vizeran's {@i dark heart} talisman in Menzoberranzan or in some other location. If they decide to leave it in Menzoberranzan, they must also decide how to deal with Grin, and possibly the wrath of Jarlaxle Baenre as well.
zh_tw: 到這一章結束時，角色們應該已經獲得了貢夫的魔法書，並且掌握了大法師儀式的確切知識。根據格林·奧斯提爾提供的資訊，角色們面臨著一個嚴峻的選擇——將維茲蘭的{@i 黑暗之心}護身符放置在魔索布萊城還是其他某個地方。如果他們決定將其留在魔索布萊城，他們還必須決定如何處理格林，以及可能還要面對賈拉索·班瑞的憤怒。

english: Chapter 16: The Fetid Wedding
zh_tw: 第16章：惡臭的婚禮

english: Zuggtmoy, Demon Queen of Fungi, plots to "wed" Araumycos, an enormous fungus occupying a large area of the Underdark. After uniting their powers in an unholy mockery of matrimony—in truth, a demonic rite of domination—Zuggtmoy will gain the power to transform the whole of the Underdark into her new Abyssal domain. The only things in her way are a core of resistance in the myconid community, the rage of her rival Juiblex, and the determination of the adventurers.
zh_tw: 真菌的惡魔女王祖格莫伊策劃著與阿勞麥柯"結婚"，阿勞麥柯是一個佔據著幽暗地域大片區域的巨大真菌。在他們的力量在褻瀆婚姻的不神聖模仿中聯合起來——實際上，是一種惡魔的支配儀式——祖格莫伊將獲得將整個幽暗地域轉變為她新的深淵領域的力量。唯一阻礙她的是菌人社群中的抵抗核心，她對手朱庇萊克斯的憤怒，以及冒險家們的決心。

english: The characters receive a warning about Zuggtmoy's plans from Basidia, one of the myconid sovereigns of Neverlight Grove. After traveling to the caverns of Araumycos, they reach out to Araumycos's alien mind with the aid of Basidia's rapport spores, and try to free it from Zuggtmoy's demonic influence. Juiblex seizes the opportunity to crash the wedding, and the two demon lords do battle. When the characters sever Zuggtmoy's link with Araumycos, Juiblex destroys her material form, leaving the adventurers to face the remaining (and weakened) demon lord in battle.
zh_tw: 角色們從無光林地的菌人君主之一巴斯狄亞那裡收到了關於祖格莫伊計劃的警告。在前往阿勞麥柯的洞穴之後，他們在巴斯狄亞的交情孢子的幫助下，試圖將阿勞麥柯從祖格莫伊的惡魔影響中解放出來。朱庇萊克斯抓住機會闖入婚禮，兩個惡魔領主進行了戰鬥。當角色們切斷了祖格莫伊與阿勞麥柯的聯絡時，朱庇萊克斯摧毀了她的物質形態，留下冒險家們去面對剩下的（並且被削弱的）惡魔領主進行戰鬥。

english: Wedding Invitation
zh_tw: 婚禮邀請函

english: The adventurers become caught up in Zuggtmoy's plots when they experience a vision from the rebel myconids of Neverlight Grove, delivered by {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA}. The characters know of Basidia and the myconids' struggles if they visited Neverlight Grove (see {@area chapter 5|224|x}). Otherwise, the myconids reach out to them if they sheltered {@creature Stool|OotA} or {@creature Rumpadump|OotA} for a time.
zh_tw: 當冒險家們從反抗的無光林地菌人那裡獲得一個幻象時，他們就捲入了祖格莫伊的陰謀中，這個幻象是由{@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞}傳遞的。如果角色們訪問過無光林地（見{@area 第五章|224|x}），他們就會知道巴斯狄亞和菌人的鬥爭。否則，如果他們曾經庇護過{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}或{@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普}一段時間，菌人就會聯絡他們。

english: Basidia's vision can come at any point, whether the characters are asleep or awake. You can choose to have the vision affect all or some of the player characters, or to have some of their NPC followers affected as well. Read the following text aloud, making adjustments as necessary if the characters have not met {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA}.
zh_tw: 巴斯狄亞的幻象可以在任何時候出現，無論角色們是睡著還是醒著。你可以選擇讓這個幻象影響所有的或部分玩家角色，也可以選擇讓他們的一些NPC追隨者也受到影響。如果角色們還沒有遇到{@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞}，請根據需要調整以下文字，然後大聲朗讀。

english: A soft, glowing light rises from ahead, emanating from a vast cavern. The entire surface of the cave—floor, walls, and ceiling—is blanketed in moss and fungi, all in shades of white and soft pastels of pink, violet, green, and pale blue. The diffuse light the mushrooms shed makes the vista waver as if seen through mist.
zh_tw: 一束柔和的發光從前方升起，來自一個巨大的洞穴。洞穴的整個表面——地面、牆壁和天花板——都被苔蘚和真菌覆蓋，呈現出白色以及柔和的粉紅色、紫羅蘭色、綠色和淺藍色的色調。蘑菇散發的漫射光使視野像透過薄霧一樣搖曳。

english: "Araumycos," a voice says in your mind. You turn and see a myconid sovereign standing beside you where there was no one before, recognizing Basidia of Neverlight Grove. "The largest and greatest being of our world," the myconid says sadly. "All that you see before you is Araumycos; all this and much more. All is in danger from the corruption that will claim the whole of the world if you do not help us."
zh_tw: "阿勞麥柯，"一個聲音在你的腦海中說道。你轉過身，看到一位菌人君主站在你旁邊，那裡之前沒有人，你認出了無光林地的巴斯狄亞。"我們世界中最大且最偉大的存在，"菌人說道，語氣中帶著悲傷。"你所看到的一切就是阿勞麥柯；所有這些以及更多。如果你們不幫助我們，所有的一切都將面臨腐敗的危險，最終將奪走整個世界。"

english: Although myconids can normally use their rapport spores only over short distances, Basidia explains that Zuggtmoy has been spreading her own spores throughout the Underdark, channeling {@i faerzress}. By tapping into this growing presence, the myconid sovereign can rapport over great distances to ask the characters for their help.
zh_tw: 儘管菌人居民通常只能在短距離內使用它們的共鳴孢子，但巴斯狄亞解釋說祖格莫伊一直在幽暗地域散播她自己的孢子，引導著{@i 妖光}。透過利用這種日益增長的存在，菌人君主可以在很遠的距離上與角色們共鳴，請求他們的幫助。

english: Zuggtmoy, the demon queen who has corrupted the myconids, has made her intentions clear. She is leading her new followers to the vast cavern complex occupied by Araumycos, the largest life-form in the Underdark and perhaps in all the world. There, the two will be bonded in a demonic ceremony, giving Zuggtmoy dominion over a fungal kingdom larger and greater than any surface-world realm. To that end, she and her followers have been performing rituals and releasing spores to lull the great Araumycos into a kind of {@condition charmed} sleep. The full implications are unclear to Basidia and the myconids, but as Araumycos is the oldest and most powerful being known to them, they greatly fear what Zuggtmoy's corruption of it will bring.
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊，這位已經腐蝕了菌人的惡魔女王，已經明確了她的意圖。她正帶領著她的新追隨者前往被阿勞麥柯佔領的廣闊洞穴群，阿勞麥柯是幽暗地域乃至全世界最大的生命形式。在那裡，兩者將在一個惡魔儀式中結合，賦予祖格莫伊對一個比任何地表王國都要龐大和偉大的真菌王國的統治權。為此，她和她的追隨者一直在進行儀式並釋放孢子，使偉大的阿勞麥柯進入一種被{@condition charmed||魅惑}的睡眠狀態。巴斯狄亞和菌人對全部的影響尚不清楚，但作為他們所知最古老且最強大的存在，他們非常擔心祖格莫伊的腐蝕將帶來什麼後果。

english: Fortunately, there is hope. Basidia believes it can assist in creating a rapport between the adventurers and Araumycos's vast, sleeping mind. The characters can help to awaken it and aid its struggle against the demon queen's influence. Or, if there's no other choice, they can destroy Araumycos before Zuggtmoy can claim the great creature as her own.
zh_tw: 幸運的是，還有希望。巴斯狄亞相信它可以幫助建立冒險家和阿勞麥柯廣闊沉睡意識之間的共鳴。角色們可以幫助喚醒它，並協助它抵抗惡魔女王的影響。或者，如果沒有其他選擇，他們可以在祖格莫伊聲稱這個偉大生物為自己所有之前摧毀阿勞麥柯。

english: If {@creature Stool|OotA} or {@creature Rumpadump|OotA} have met the characters and are still alive, they join the rapport between Basidia and the characters, offering their support and encouragement as they implore the adventurers to intervene. If the characters saw the hideous Garden of Welcome in Neverlight Grove—or, worse yet, glimpsed the horrors of Yggmorgus—the myconids remind them that the whole world might become like that if Zuggtmoy unites Araumycos's power with her own.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Stool|OotA|圓凳}或{@creature Rumpadump|OotA|蘭帕丹普}曾經遇見過角色們並且仍然活著，他們將加入巴斯狄亞與角色們之間的聯絡中，提供他們的支援和鼓勵，同時懇求冒險家們介入。如果角色們曾經看到過無光林地中可怕的歡迎花園——或者更糟糕的是，瞥見了伊格莫格斯的恐怖——菌人會提醒他們，如果祖格莫伊將阿勞麥柯的力量與自己的力量結合，整個世界都可能變成那樣。

english: Basidia proposes that the characters travel quickly to Araumycos, where the myconid sovereign will temporarily immunize them against the effects of the demon-tainted spores released by myconids under Zuggtmoy's influence. Basidia will then initiate a rapport with Araumycos while Zuggtmoy and her followers are preoccupied with the wedding ceremony.
zh_tw: 巴斯狄亞提議角色們迅速前往阿勞麥柯，在那裡菌人君主將暫時使他們免受祖格莫伊影響下菌人居民釋放的惡魔汙染孢子的效果。然後，在祖格莫伊及其追隨者忙於婚禮儀式時，巴斯狄亞將與阿勞麥柯建立共鳴。

english: Basidia and its followers can meet the adventurers within Araumycos's vast cavern complex. The sovereign is too closely watched to slip away and meet them before that, and it recommends that the characters avoid contact with other myconids on their travels. Basidia can use the extended rapport link to fix on the characters' location, and promises to find them when they are near the center of Araumycos. The vision then ends.
zh_tw: 巴斯狄亞及其追隨者可以在阿勞麥柯廣闊的洞穴群中與冒險家們會面。由於菌人君主被監視得過於嚴密，無法在此之前溜走與他們會面，它建議角色們在旅途中避免與其他菌人接觸。巴斯狄亞可以使用擴充套件的聯絡連結來確定角色們的位置，並承諾當他們接近阿勞麥柯的中心時會找到他們。幻象隨之結束。

english: Myconid March
zh_tw: 菌人行進

english: Shortly after the party receives Basidia's vision and warning, myconids and fungal creatures throughout the Underdark fall under the influence of Zuggtmoy's spreading spores, making a slow and steady march toward Araumycos, their "queen's betrothed." Thousands are on the move, and the procession has a bizarrely festive air, the fungi capering, dancing, and skipping as they celebrate the impending nuptials.
zh_tw: 在隊伍收到巴斯狄亞的幻象和警告後不久，幽暗地域中的菌人和真菌生物都受到了祖格莫伊傳播孢子的影響，開始緩慢而穩定地向阿勞麥柯進發，他們稱之為"女王的未婚夫"。成千上萬的生物在移動，這個隊伍有一種奇異的節日氣氛，真菌跳躍、跳舞、蹦跳著慶祝即將到來的婚禮。

english: That behavior alone is alarming enough. However, under the demon queen's influence, the myconids and other fungi release clouds of spores as they move through the tunnels of the Underdark. Strange perfumes and scents fill the air. The marching myconids sow chaos as they move through the Underdark, passing around the Darklake. Other intelligent Underdark creatures give the procession a wide berth.
zh_tw: 這種行為本身就足夠令人警覺。然而，在惡魔女王的影響下，菌人和其他真菌在穿過幽暗地域的隧道時釋放出孢子云。空氣中瀰漫著奇異的香氣和氣味。行進中的菌人在穿過幽暗地域時播下混亂，繞過黑暗湖。其他有智慧的幽暗地域生物對這支隊伍保持了一定的距離。

english: Characters making their way toward Araumycos can avoid much of the risk by following Basidia's advice and staying away from the myconid march. If not, they run the risk of falling under Zuggtmoy's sway (see "{@area Random Encounters|57e|x}" in this chapter).
zh_tw: 角色們如果遵循巴斯狄亞的建議，遠離菌人居民的行進路線，就可以避免很多風險，朝著阿勞麥柯前進。如果不這樣做，他們就有被祖格莫伊影響的風險（見本章中的"{@area 隨機遭遇|57e|x}"）。

english: Uninvited Guests
zh_tw: 不速之客

english: The fungi of the Underdark aren't the only ones on the move. Juiblex the Faceless Lord has caught wind of its rival Zuggtmoy's intentions and mobilized an army of oozes now making its way toward Araumycos. The demon lord wants to slow Zuggtmoy's progress toward her goal. More importantly, though, Juiblex seeks the opportunity to appear at the ceremony, either to thwart its rival's intentions, take advantage of Araumycos's vulnerability, or both. Though Araumycos represents the perfect mate to Zuggtmoy, Juiblex sees it only as a living feast of tremendous proportions.
zh_tw: 幽暗地域的真菌並不是唯一在移動的生物。無面領主朱庇萊克斯已經嗅到了其對手祖格莫伊的意圖，並動員了一支史萊姆組成的軍隊，現在正朝著阿勞麥柯前進。這位惡魔領主想要延緩祖格莫伊實現目標的程式。然而，更重要的是，朱庇萊克斯尋求在儀式上出現的機會，無論是為了破壞對手的意圖，還是利用阿勞麥柯的脆弱，或者兩者兼而有之。儘管阿勞麥柯代表了祖格莫伊的完美配偶，但朱庇萊克斯只將其視為一場規模巨大的生命盛宴。

english: With both forces on the move, outbreaks of violence between oozes and fungi become more common, although the followers of Zuggtmoy outnumber the Faceless Lord's creatures.
zh_tw: 隨著兩股勢力都在行動，軟泥怪和真菌之間的暴力衝突變得更加頻繁，儘管祖格莫伊的追隨者數量超過了無面領主的生物。

english: Araumycos: General Features
zh_tw: 阿勞麥柯：一般特徵

english: The domain of Araumycos is a bizarre fungal realm in the heart of the Underdark.
zh_tw: 阿勞麥柯的領域是幽暗地域核心的一個奇異的真菌王國。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Araumycos's tunnels and caverns are dimly lit by phosphorescent fungi.
zh_tw: 阿勞麥柯的隧道和洞穴被熒光真菌微弱地照亮。

english: Terrain
zh_tw: 地形

english: Fungal life fills the caverns and passageways in the region, with visitors literally walking upon and within Araumycos upon entering its domain. The floor is carpeted with thick mold and fungus, creating patches of {@quickref difficult terrain||3} throughout. In some tunnels and caves, fungi growths obstruct passage. Characters either have to climb or hack their way through the fungal growth. In other places, the fungus covering the floor is soft enough that characters can sink into it with no warning. Use the quicksand rules in chapter 5, "{@book Adventure Environments|DMG|5|Quicksand}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for such areas. Creatures that fail to escape become food for Araumycos.
zh_tw: 真菌生命充滿了該區域的洞穴和通道，訪客在進入其領域時實際上是走在阿勞麥柯之上和其中。地面上鋪滿了厚厚的黴菌和真菌，形成了遍佈的{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。在一些隧道和洞穴中，真菌的生長阻礙了通行。角色們要麼需要攀爬，要麼得砍出一條穿過真菌生長的路。在其他地方，覆蓋地面的真菌柔軟到足以讓角色不知不覺地陷入其中。使用第五章"{@book 冒險環境|DMG|5|Quicksand}"中的{@i 城主指南}中的流沙規則來處理這些區域。未能逃脫的生物將成為阿勞麥柯的食物。

english: Araumycos
zh_tw: 阿勞麥柯

english: Some forty miles southeast of the Darklake lies the vast territory of Araumycos (see the Underdark overview map in {@area chapter 2|051|x}).
zh_tw: 在黑暗湖東南約四十英里處，是阿勞麥柯的廣闊領土（見{@area 第二章|051|x}中的幽暗地域概覽圖）。
