english: Subjects of Zuggtmoy, the myconids and their spore servants caper and dance madly to music only they can hear. The myconids insist that all other creatures they meet join them, releasing a cloud of spores if anyone refuses to do so. They can release this cloud once, and any creature within 30 feet of one or more of the myconids when the cloud is released must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition charmed}. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature can do nothing other than dance and use its movement to follow the myconid parade. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each hour, ending the effect on itself on a success. Casting {@spell lesser restoration}, {@spell greater restoration}, {@spell remove curse}, or similar magic on a creature also ends the effect on it.
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊的僕從，真菌人和它們的孢子僕從會瘋狂地隨著只有它們能聽到的音樂跳躍和舞蹈。真菌人堅持要求所有它們遇到的其他生物加入它們，如果任何人拒絕，它們會釋放一片孢子云。它們只能釋放一次這種孢子云，當孢子云釋放時，任何在30尺內的一個或多個真菌人附近的生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 11}體質豁免檢定，否則將被{@condition charmed||魅惑}。當以這種方式被{@condition charmed||魅惑}時，生物除了跳舞並使用其移動跟隨真菌人遊行外，無法做任何其他事情。生物可以在每小時結束時重複豁免檢定，成功則結束對其的效果。對生物施放{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}、{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}、{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}或類似的魔法也會結束對其的效果。

english: The myconids and their spore servants attack only if they're attacked or prevented from continuing on their march.
zh_tw: 菌人和他們的孢子僕從只有在被攻擊或被阻止繼續行進時才會進行攻擊。

english: Oozes
zh_tw: 泥怪

english: The characters encounter one or more oozes. Roll a {@dice d4} and consult the Oozes table to determine what kinds of oozes the characters encounter.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了一個或多個軟泥怪。擲一個{@dice d4}並查閱軟泥表來確定角色們遇到了哪些型別的軟泥怪。

english: d4
zh_tw: d4

english: Oozes
zh_tw: 泥怪

english: 1 {@creature black pudding} and {@dice 1d6} {@creature Gray Ooze||gray oozes}
zh_tw: 1個{@creature black pudding||黑布丁}和{@dice 1d6} {@creature Gray Ooze||灰泥怪}

english: 1 {@creature Ochre Jelly||ochre jellies}
zh_tw: 1 {@creature Ochre Jelly||赭果凍}

english: {@dice 3d6} {@creature Black Pudding||black puddings}
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} {@creature Black Pudding||黑布丁}

english: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Gelatinous Cube||gelatinous cubes}
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Gelatinous Cube||凝膠方塊}

english: If the encounter occurs en route to Araumycos, the oozes are slithering toward the giant fungus. Otherwise, the oozes are feasting on Araumycos itself. In either event, the oozes fight only in self-defense.
zh_tw: 如果遭遇發生在前往阿勞麥柯的途中，這些軟泥怪正向巨大真菌滑行。否則，軟泥怪正在享用阿勞麥柯本身。無論哪種情況，軟泥怪只有在自衛時才會戰鬥。

english: Two-Headed Trolls
zh_tw: 雙頭巨魔

english: Warped by Demogorgon's presence in the Underdark, these trolls have each grown a second head. As part of its Multiattack routine, a {@creature two-headed troll|OotA} can make a Bite attack as a bonus action on its turn. The party encounters {@dice 1d4 + 1} of these hungry creatures, which otherwise have the statistics of a normal troll.
zh_tw: 這些巨魔因狄摩高根在幽暗地域的存在而扭曲，每隻都長出了第二個頭部。作為其多重攻擊的一部分，一隻{@creature two-headed troll|OotA|雙頭巨魔}可以在其回合中以附贈動作發動一次啃咬攻擊。隊伍會遭遇{@dice 1d4 + 1}只這些飢餓的生物，除此之外它們具有正常巨魔的資料。

english: Enter the Groom
zh_tw: 新郎入場

english: In the time it takes the characters to reach Araumycos's caverns after receiving Basidia's message, Zuggtmoy and her fungal entourage arrive at the site of the ceremony, near the center of those caverns. The entourage includes hundreds of {@creature Myconid Adult||myconid adults} and {@creature Myconid Sprout||myconid sprouts}, accompanied by {@creature Awakened Zurkhwood|OotA|awakened zurkhwoods} and {@creature Bridesmaid of Zuggtmoy|OotA|bridesmaids of Zuggtmoy} (both from {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}), as well as ambulatory fungi such as {@creature Violet Fungus||violet fungi} and {@creature Gas Spore||gas spores}. Various spore servants fill out Zuggtmoy's entourage (see the "Myconids" entry of the {@i Monster Manual} and {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19} of this adventure).
zh_tw: 在角色們收到巴斯狄亞的資訊後，前往阿勞麥柯洞穴的這段時間裡，祖格莫伊和她的真菌隨從們已經到達了儀式現場，靠近洞穴的中心。隨從包括數百名{@creature Myconid Adult||蕈人成體}和{@creature Myconid Sprout||蕈人幼體}，以及{@creature Awakened Zurkhwood|OotA|覺醒的祖克木}和{@creature Bridesmaid of Zuggtmoy|OotA|祖格莫伊的伴娘}（兩者均來自{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}），還有諸如{@creature Violet Fungus||紫腐菌}和{@creature Gas Spore||毒氣孢子}等可移動的真菌。各種孢子僕從也加入了祖格莫伊的隨從隊伍（參見{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的"菌人"條目以及本冒險的{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）。

english: Basidia's Aid
zh_tw: 巴斯狄亞的援助

english: As the characters approach the center of Araumycos's great cavern complex, Basidia meets them with a small detachment of loyal myconids. The myconid sovereign explains that it can infuse the characters with rapport spores and neutralized servitor spores, enabling them to blend in with the fungal servitors accompanying Zuggtmoy. The characters then have a few hours to make their way to the center of Araumycos's territory where Zuggtmoy's ritual is set to take place.
zh_tw: 當角色們接近阿勞麥柯巨大洞穴群的中心時，巴斯狄亞帶著一小隊忠誠的菌人居民與他們見面。菌人君主解釋說，它可以注入共鳴孢子和中和僕從孢子，使他們能夠與伴隨祖格莫伊的真菌僕從融為一體。然後，角色們有幾個小時的時間前往阿勞麥柯領土中心，那裡將是祖格莫伊儀式的舉行地點。

english: When they are sufficiently close to the epicenter of the ritual, the characters will be able to enter rapport with Araumycos. Basidia's rapport spores help facilitate the process, but Araumycos's sleeping mind isn't in full control of the defenses of its body, and might interpret the characters' presence as an attack. Basidia warns the characters that they must be on their guard for a reaction from the vast fungus.
zh_tw: 當他們足夠接近儀式的震中時，角色們將能夠與阿勞麥柯建立心靈感應。巴斯狄亞的心靈感應孢子有助於促進這一過程，但阿勞麥柯沉睡的意識並未完全控制其身體的防禦，可能會將角色們的存在解釋為攻擊。巴斯狄亞警告角色們，他們必須警惕巨大真菌的反應。

english: Once the characters have entered rapport, they must seek out Araumycos's sleeping mind and awaken it to the danger it faces. Basidia doesn't know if Zuggtmoy will become aware of what the characters are doing, but if she does, they will have only a limited amount of time before the demon queen tries to stop them.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們建立了聯絡，他們必須尋找阿勞麥柯的沉睡意識並喚醒它，讓它意識到面臨的危險。巴斯狄亞不知道祖格莫伊是否會意識到角色們的行動，但如果她意識到了，那麼在惡魔女王試圖阻止他們之前，角色們將只有有限的時間。

english: Ooze Spies
zh_tw: 軟泥怪間諜

english: Once Basidia has explained the plan to the characters, read the following boxed text aloud to the players.
zh_tw: 一旦巴斯狄亞向角色們解釋了計劃，請向玩家們大聲朗讀以下加框的文字。

english: Even as the myconid sovereign's thoughts fill your mind, you become aware of a faint hissing and fizzing sound. The fungus around you dissolves to a formless goo as something moves in the undergrowth to surround you!
zh_tw: 即使菌人君主的思想充滿了你的腦海，你也開始意識到一種微弱的嘶嘶聲和冒泡聲。你周圍的真菌溶解成了無形的粘液，因為有些東西在灌木叢中移動，將你包圍！

english: A pair of {@creature Regenerating Black Pudding|OotA|regenerating black puddings}, spies for Juiblex, slither through the undergrowth to attack the party. The characters' myconid allies fall back from the fray, desperate to protect {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA} and pleading for the adventurers' aid through the telepathic rapport they share.
zh_tw: 一對{@creature Regenerating Black Pudding|OotA|再生黑色布丁}，作為朱庇萊克斯的間諜，蠕動著穿過灌木叢攻擊隊伍。角色們的菌人盟友退回到戰鬥之外，急切地保護{@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞}，並透過他們共享的心靈感應向冒險者們請求幫助。

english: Empowered by Juiblex, these {@creature Regenerating Black Pudding|OotA|regenerating black puddings} have an Intelligence of 6 (−2) and the following feature, which increases each pudding's challenge rating to 5 (1,800 XP).
zh_tw: 受朱庇萊克斯的強化，這些{@creature Regenerating Black Pudding|OotA|再生黑色布丁}擁有6（-2）的智力，並且具有以下特性，這使得每個布丁的挑戰等級提升到5（1,800 XP）。

english: Regeneration
zh_tw: 復生

english: The pudding regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the pudding takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the pudding's next turn. The pudding dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.
zh_tw: 布丁在其回合開始時恢復10點生命值。如果布丁受到火焰傷害，則布丁的下一個回合開始時此特性不會生效。布丁只有在其回合開始時生命值為0且沒有再生時才會死亡。

english: Across the Fungal Fields
zh_tw: 穿越真菌田野

english: Once the characters receive Basidia's spores and overcome Juiblex's black pudding spies, they should set out at once for the depths of Araumycos as the rapport takes hold. Unfortunately, they have no means of assuring the slumbering fungal entity of their intentions, and the growing threat posed by Zuggtmoy and the demon lords has roused Araumycos's defenses.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們收到巴斯狄亞的孢子並克服了朱庇萊克斯的黑布丁間諜，他們應該立即出發前往阿勞麥柯的深處，因為共鳴開始生效。不幸的是，他們沒有辦法向沉睡的真菌實體保證他們的意圖，而祖格莫伊和惡魔領主帶來的日益增長的威脅已經喚醒了阿勞麥柯的防禦。

english: The pastel colors of fungi transform the caverns you pass through into softly glowing meadows. The floor is spongy, and the myconid spores are making you start to feel drowsy—at least, you hope that's what's behind this strange sensation. Then you feel the ground beneath you shift as something moves—a number of a thick, spiky tendrils bursting from the ground.
zh_tw: 真菌的柔和色彩將你穿過的洞穴變成了柔和發光的草地。地面是海綿狀的，而菌人孢子開始讓你感到昏昏欲睡——至少，你希望這是這種奇怪感覺背後的原因。然後你感覺到地面在你腳下移動——一些粗厚、帶刺的觸鬚從地面爆發出來。

english: Two fungal creatures resembling {@creature Otyugh||otyughs} rise up and attack the characters. Created by Araumycos to perfectly duplicate the abilities, traits, and actions of otyughs, these creatures are plants rather than aberrations. They attack until slain, whereupon each bursts into a cloud of sweet-smelling spores as its body dissolves back into the larger mass of fungi filling the cavern.
zh_tw: 兩個類似{@creature Otyugh||食腐獸}的真菌生物升起並攻擊角色們。這些生物是由阿勞麥柯創造的，以完美複製食腐獸的能力、特性和行動，它們是植物而非異怪。它們會攻擊直到被殺死，之後每個生物都會在身體溶解成填滿洞穴的更大真菌群中時，爆發成一團香甜的孢子云。

english: Read the following to the players when the final creature is defeated.
zh_tw: 當最後一個生物被擊敗時，向玩家宣讀以下內容。

english: The creature bursts like an overfull wineskin, releasing a clear ichor and a cloud of dusty spores. The deflating bulk of its body sinks back beneath the shimmering fungal field where you stand. Your vision starts to swim, and you feel dizzy and faint. Your limbs are numb and your legs no longer support you.
zh_tw: 生物像裝滿酒的皮囊一樣爆裂開來，釋放出清澈的體液和一團塵埃般的孢子。它那萎縮的身軀沉回到你站立的閃爍真菌田野之下。你的視線開始模糊，感到頭暈目眩。你的四肢麻木，腿不再支撐你。

english: A successful {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Nature}) check confirms that the characters are in no physical danger but are entering rapport with Araumycos. The adventurers are {@condition paralyzed} as the myconid spores fully take effect. Even creatures immune to sleep and paralysis are affected as the spores seep into mind and body. The characters collapse harmlessly to the soft surface of Araumycos, its fungus quickly spreading across them as the rapport begins. When this happens, continue with "Into the Gray Dream."
zh_tw: 一次成功的 {@dc 13} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘} 或 {@skill Nature||自然}）檢定確認角色們沒有身體上的危險，而是正在與阿勞麥柯建立心靈共鳴。冒險者們被 {@condition paralyzed||麻痺}，因為菌人的孢子完全生效了。即使對睡眠和麻痺免疫的生物也會受到影響，因為孢子滲透進了他們的心靈和身體。角色們無害地倒在阿勞麥柯柔軟的表面上，真菌迅速在他們身上蔓延，心靈共鳴開始形成。當這種情況發生時，繼續"進入灰色夢境"部分的劇情。

english: Into the Gray Dream
zh_tw: 進入灰色夢境

english: The rapport with Araumycos affects the adventurers like an {@spell astral projection} spell, sending their astral bodies out into the Astral Plane where Araumycos's vast, dreaming mind resides. Their bodies remain {@condition unconscious} in suspended animation while they are projected into the Astral Plane. Read the following aloud to the players.
zh_tw: 與阿勞麥柯的聯絡對冒險者們產生了類似於{@spell astral projection||星界投影}法術的效果，將他們的星界身體傳送到星界平面，那裡是阿勞麥柯廣闊、夢幻的意識所在。在他們被投射到星界平面時，他們的身體處於{@condition unconscious||昏迷}的懸浮狀態。向玩家大聲朗讀以下內容。

english: You are floating, weightless, adrift. A gray, silvery light spreads around you like the dawn of a cloudy day, illuminating a peculiar realm. All of you are floating in a silvery haze that shimmers with swirls of color. Objects drift past in the distance, but whether they are small stones or rocks the size of mountains, you can't say for certain. Your moment of reverie is broken by the sound of Basidia's voice in your mind. "It begins."
zh_tw: 你漂浮著，無重力，漂泊。一種灰色、銀色的光在你周圍蔓延，就像多雲天氣的黎明，照亮了一個奇特的領域。你們所有人都漂浮在銀色的霧氣中，霧氣中閃爍著色彩的漩渦。遠處有物體飄過，但無論是小石頭還是山一樣大的岩石，你都無法確定。巴斯狄亞的聲音在你心中打破了你的沉思。"開始了。"

english: The adventurers, now psychically linked with both the myconid sovereign and Araumycos, are aware of the demon queen and her minions performing Zuggtmoy's demonic ritual.
zh_tw: 冒險者們現在與菌人君主和阿勞麥柯心靈上相連，意識到惡魔女王和她的手下正在進行祖格莫伊的惡魔儀式。

english: Through your link with Basidia, you sense that Zuggtmoy's wedding ceremony has begun. Receiving the myconid's impressions, you become aware of a huge crowd of fungal creatures and spore servants—hundreds, perhaps thousands of them—watching as a grotesque procession makes its way through them. Myconids of all sizes caper madly before a troupe of giant animated mushrooms, bearing a mossy litter upon which sits the Demon Queen of Fungi in all her terrible splendor.
zh_tw: 透過與巴斯狄亞的聯絡，你感覺到祖格莫伊的婚禮儀式已經開始。接收到菌人的印象，你意識到有一大群真菌生物和孢子僕從——可能有數百甚至數千個——觀看著一個怪異的遊行隊伍穿過他們。各種大小的菌人在一群巨大的活化蘑菇前瘋狂地跳躍，它們抬著一個長滿苔蘚的轎子，上面坐著真菌惡魔女王，她以她可怕的輝煌出現。

english: Zuggtmoy is draped and veiled in molds and fruiting mushrooms woven into a grotesque gown. Vaguely humanoid figures set with clusters of luminescent lichen and tumescent fungal growths follow her like bridesmaids, carrying a veil and train of lacy mycelia. Stepping off the litter as her followers set it down, the Demon Queen of Fungi rises to tower above all the creatures around her. "My betrothed," she intones, the meaning of her words clear within the vision. "I am here at last."
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊身披著由黴菌和結果的蘑菇編織成的奇異禮服。模糊的人形身影，點綴著發光的地衣和腫脹的真菌生長物，像伴娘一樣跟隨著她，攜帶著蕾絲狀的菌絲面紗和裙襬。當她的追隨者放下轎子，真菌惡魔女王從轎子上走下來，高高在上地凌駕於周圍的所有生物之上。"我的未婚夫，"她用咒語般的聲音說道，她話語的含義在幻象中清晰可見。"我終於來了。"

english: The Mind of Araumycos
zh_tw: 阿勞麥柯的心靈

english: Navigating on the Astral Plane is largely a matter of thought and perception. The characters feel a psychic "pull" in the right direction as they seek out the consciousness of Araumycos with their own minds. A creature flies through the Astral Plane at a speed in feet equal to 3 × its Intelligence score, but a feeling of timelessness on the plane makes it difficult to judge the length of the journey.
zh_tw: 在星界平面上導航主要是思想和感知的問題。當角色們用他們自己的心智尋找阿勞麥柯的意識時，他們會感覺到一個心靈上的"拉力"指向正確的方向。一個生物在星界平面上的飛行速度等於其智力分數乘以3尺，但是星界平面上的永恆感使得判斷旅程的長度變得困難。

english: The characters' thoughts draw them toward a distant, floating object. It appears to be a hemisphere, until its slow rotation reveals its true form: a giant skull missing its jawbone, formed out of some kind of pale rock. As the characters draw closer, the skull reveals itself to be the size of a small mountain. Its surface is covered in lichens and broad patches of mold, the colors resembling those of Araumycos on the Material Plane.
zh_tw: 角色們的思想將他們吸引向一個遙遠的、漂浮的物體。它看起來像是一個半球形，直到它緩慢旋轉揭示了它的真實形態：一個缺失下頜骨的巨大頭骨，由某種蒼白的岩石形成。隨著角色們靠近，頭骨顯露出它是一座小山的大小。其表面覆蓋著地衣和大片的黴菌，顏色與物質平面上的阿勞麥柯相似。

english: Through the empty eye sockets of the skull, the adventurers can see that its interior is hollow and filled with a bewildering variety of giant fungi. Tendrils and growths extend outward, twining together to form a mass suspended in the middle of the open space—a brain-shaped fungus the size of a castle.
zh_tw: 透過頭骨的空洞眼窩，冒險者們可以看到其內部是空的，充滿了令人困惑的各種巨大真菌。觸鬚和生長物向外延伸，纏繞在一起形成一個懸掛在開放空間中央的團塊——一個城堡大小的腦形真菌。

english: The closer the characters come to the floating skull, the more strongly they feel a presence—the mind of Araumycos, to which they are linked. That consciousness is largely unaware of them, lulled by the insidious influence of Zuggtmoy's spores and unable to resist the demon queen's presence.
zh_tw: 角色們越接近漂浮的頭骨，他們就越強烈地感覺到一種存在——與他們相連的阿勞麥柯的意識。這種意識在很大程度上沒有意識到他們，被祖格莫伊的孢子的陰險影響所麻痺，無法抵抗惡魔女王的存在。

english: Wedding Crashers
zh_tw: 婚禮破壞者

english: When any character enters the skull or touches its surface, the mind of Araumycos stirs—and the Demon Queen of Fungi senses it. Read the following to the players as Zuggtmoy uses the connection of the rapport spores to push into Araumycos's mind.
zh_tw: 當任何角色進入頭骨或觸控其表面時，阿勞麥柯的意識開始甦醒——真菌惡魔女王也感覺到了。當祖格莫伊利用共鳴孢子的聯絡侵入阿勞麥柯的意識時，請向玩家宣讀以下內容。

english: "Who dares?" a voice shouts in your mind. "Who dares disturb my intended nuptials?" Spores and tendrils erupt from the surface of the skull, coalescing before your eyes into the image of the Demon Queen of Fungi, her dead eyes glaring with inhuman fury.
zh_tw: "誰敢？"一個聲音在你的腦海中大喊。"誰敢打擾我預定的婚禮？"孢子和觸鬚從頭骨表面爆發出來，在你的眼前凝聚成真菌惡魔女王的形象，她那死寂的眼睛充滿了非人類的憤怒。

english: Zuggtmoy projects her psychic presence to confront the characters, while at the same time maintaining limited control over her material form. She intends to complete the ritual necessary to grant her full power over Araumycos, needing only to delay or destroy the intruders in order to succeed. The split in the Demon Queen's attention works in their favor, as Zuggtmoy's demonic rival Juiblex chooses that moment to launch its attack and claim Araumycos for its own.
zh_tw: 祖格莫伊投射她的心靈存在來面對角色們，同時保持對她物質形態的有限控制。她打算完成必要的儀式，以授予她對阿勞麥柯的完全控制，只需要推遲或摧毀入侵者就能成功。惡魔女王注意力的分散對他們有利，因為祖格莫伊的惡魔對手朱庇萊克斯選擇那一刻發動攻擊，聲稱阿勞麥柯為自己的。

english: Before Zuggtmoy acts against the adventurers, the demon queen is distracted, turning away to glance at something they can't see. She hisses the name "Juiblex" like a curse, then recoils as if struck. Her image then vanishes.
zh_tw: 在祖格莫伊對冒險者採取行動之前，惡魔女王被分心了，她轉過身去瞥了一眼他們看不見的東西。她像詛咒一樣嘶嘶地說出'朱庇萊克斯'這個名字，然後像被擊中一樣退縮。然後她的形象消失了。

english: The Sleeper Wakes
zh_tw: 沉睡者甦醒

english: As the psychic din awakens Araumycos from its trance, the shimmering colors piercing the silver of the Astral Plane flare even brighter. The following round, Araumycos enters into full rapport with the characters and their myconid allies. The entity reveals that Zuggtmoy has already infected its mind with her demonic influence, which Araumycos can feel growing in strength. It's only a matter of time before it falls to the demon queen's will. Focused but fearful, the entity asks the adventurers to cut out and destroy the diseased part of its mind before it's too late.
zh_tw: 當心靈上的喧囂喚醒阿勞麥柯從其恍惚狀態中醒來時，穿透星界平面銀色的閃爍色彩變得更加明亮。在接下來的回合中，阿勞麥柯與角色們以及他們的菌人盟友完全建立了聯絡。這個實體透露說祖格莫伊已經用她的惡魔影響力感染了它的思想，阿勞麥柯可以感覺到這種影響力在增強。它落入惡魔女王的意志只是時間問題。這個實體專注但害怕，請求冒險者們在為時未晚之前切除並摧毀它思想中病變的部分。

english: The characters are guided to the far side of the suspended fungus cluster inside the skull, where a dark mass is spreading. The first time any character comes within 20 feet of the dark mass, it erupts with the effect of an {@spell Evard's black tentacles} spell. The infected area of Araumycos's mind has AC 13, 100 hit points, and vulnerability to necrotic and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 角色們被引導到頭骨內部懸掛的真菌群落的遠端，那裡有一個黑暗的團塊正在擴散。當任何角色第一次進入黑暗團塊20尺範圍內時，它就會以{@spell Evard's black tentacles||艾伐黑觸手}法術的效果爆發。阿勞麥柯思想中被感染的區域具有AC 13，100生命值，並且對死靈和心靈傷害有易傷性。

english: When the infected area first takes damage, Zuggtmoy senses it and turns her attention away from Juiblex in an attempt to stop the characters. As she exerts her will over Araumycos, a burst of spores spreads out in a cloud from the infected area. Any creature within 20 feet of the infected area must make a successful {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take {@dice 3d6} poison damage and become {@condition poisoned}. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature takes {@dice 3d6} poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw on each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
zh_tw: 當受感染區域第一次受到傷害時，祖格莫伊感知到這一點，並將她的注意力從朱庇萊克斯轉移開，試圖阻止角色們。當她施加意志於阿勞麥柯時，一陣孢子云從受感染區域擴散開來。任何在受感染區域20尺內的生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 19}體質豁免檢定，否則將受到{@dice 3d6}毒素傷害並陷入{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態。當以這種方式{@condition poisoned||中毒}時，該生物在每個回合開始時都會受到{@dice 3d6}毒素傷害。{@condition poisoned||中毒}的生物可以在每個回合重複進行豁免檢定，成功則結束該效果。

english: As the characters destroy more of the infected area, the view beyond the bounds of the skull chamber begins to darken. When the area reaches 0 hit points, a powerful psychic wind howls through the area. Each character must make a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw to avoid the mental effect of a psychic wind (see "{@book The Astral Plane|DMG|2|Astral Plane}" in chapter 2 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). This psychic wind has no location effect, as the rapport ends thereafter and the characters awaken back in their physical bodies. Physical damage and ongoing effects suffered by their astral forms aren't carried over to the characters' physical bodies.
zh_tw: 隨著角色們摧毀更多的感染區域，骷髏室邊界之外的視野開始變暗。當區域的生命值降至0時，一股強大的心靈之風呼嘯而過。每個角色都必須成功進行一次{@dc 15}智力豁免檢定，以避免心靈之風的心理影響（參見{@book 星光位面|DMG|2|Astral Plane}在第2章中的{@i 城主指南}）。這股心靈之風沒有位置上的影響，因為在此之後，心靈聯絡結束，角色們將在他們的實體身體中甦醒。他們的星界形態所遭受的物理傷害和持續效果不會轉移到角色的實體身體上。

english: Let Them Speak Now...
zh_tw: 讓他們現在說吧...

english: If the characters free Araumycos from Zuggtmoy's influence, they weaken the power of the Demon Queen of Fungi, fatally distracting her. With the loss of many of her fungal minions and the amount of power she has expended to perform her ritual, Zuggtmoy is weakened to the point that Juiblex overwhelms her, destroying and consuming her material form and casting her essence back into the Abyss.
zh_tw: 如果角色們使阿勞麥柯擺脫了祖格莫伊的影響，他們就削弱了真菌惡魔女王的力量，使她致命地分心。隨著她失去許多真菌部下以及為了執行她的儀式而消耗的大量力量，祖格莫伊被削弱到朱庇萊克斯壓倒她的程度，摧毀併吞噬了她的物質形態，並將她的本質拋回無底深淵。

english: Characters reduced to 0 hit points in the battle on the Astral Plane are catapulted back to their bodies on the Material Plane. Their rapport with Araumycos is broken, and they are helpless to intervene further in the conflict going on within the entity's mind. You can have a group of oozes or spore servants from the Araumycos Encounters table appear in the cavern where the adventurers entered into rapport with Araumycos, so that characters shunted out of that rapport can defend their compatriots' helpless bodies while the fight continues.
zh_tw: 在星界平面上的戰鬥中生命值降至0的角色會被彈射回物質平面上的身體。他們與阿勞麥柯的聯絡被打破，他們無法進一步幹預實體心智中的衝突。你可以讓一群軟泥怪或孢子僕從出現在冒險者與阿勞麥柯建立聯絡的洞穴中，這樣被彈出聯絡的角色可以保衛他們同伴無助的身體，同時戰鬥繼續進行。

english: If all the characters are defeated on the Astral Plane, the awakened Araumycos remains conscious enough to resist Zuggtmoy with a final effort, sufficient to distract the Demon Queen of Fungi and thereby allowing Juiblex to overwhelm her. In any event, the characters can hear the battle between Juiblex and Zuggtmoy unfolding in the ritual cavern just a few minutes ahead of them.
zh_tw: 如果所有角色在星界平面上被擊敗，甦醒的阿勞麥柯仍然足夠清醒，能夠以最後的努力抵抗祖格莫伊，足以分散真菌惡魔女王的注意力，從而使朱庇萊克斯能夠壓倒她。無論如何，角色們可以聽到朱庇萊克斯和祖格莫伊在儀式洞穴中的戰鬥正在他們前方幾分鐘的地方展開。

english: Retreat!
zh_tw: 撤退！

english: If the adventurers retreat from the sounds of battle, they barely escape from a partial collapse of their local section of Araumycos's cavern complex. They race ahead of a small horde of Zuggtmoy's minions, which are crushed by falling rock that also seals off the characters' escape route. Basidia and some of the myconid rebels survive, and will accompany the adventurers out of Araumycos's caverns before returning to Neverlight Grove to root out any remainder of the demon queen's infestation.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們從戰鬥聲中撤退，他們勉強逃出了阿勞麥柯洞穴群落的區域性部分部分坍塌。他們趕在一小群祖格莫伊的手下前面，這些手下被落下的岩石壓碎，同時也封閉了角色們的逃生路線。巴斯狄亞和一些菌人叛軍存活下來，並將陪同冒險者們離開阿勞麥柯的洞穴，在返回無光林地以清除惡魔女王的殘餘感染之前。

english: To Battle!
zh_tw: 戰鬥！

english: If the adventurers head toward the battle between the two demon lords after awakening from their rapport, they arrive just in time to see the grotesque display of the Faceless Lord slurping up the defeated Zuggtmoy into the mass of its body, enveloping and dissolving her before turning its attention toward the newcomers.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們在從聯絡中覺醒後朝兩位惡魔領主之間的戰鬥前進，他們及時到達，正好看到無面領主將被擊敗的祖格莫伊吸進其身體的一團中，包圍並溶解她，然後轉向新來者。

english: Fighting the Faceless Lord
zh_tw: 與無面領主戰鬥

english: Under normal circumstances, {@creature Juiblex|MTF} (see {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}) would be an overwhelming foe. Fortunately for the adventurers, the Faceless Lord's battle with Zuggtmoy has weakened it. The characters might also have aid from allies, the newly freed myconids, and Araumycos in overcoming the demon lord.
zh_tw: 在正常情況下，{@creature Juiblex|MTF|朱庇萊克斯}（見{@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20}）將是一個勢不可擋的敵人。幸運的是，對於冒險者們來說，無面領主與祖格莫伊的戰鬥削弱了它。角色們也可能得到盟友的幫助，新解放的菌人，以及阿勞麥柯，在克服惡魔領主方面。

english: Apply the following penalties to Juiblex:
zh_tw: 對朱庇萊克斯應用以下懲罰：

english: Its current hit points are 200.
zh_tw: 它當前的生命值為200。

english: It has no more uses of Legendary Resistance for the day.
zh_tw: 它當天不再擁有傳奇抗性使用次數。

english: Its Eject Slime action has been used and must recharge.
zh_tw: 它的噴射粘液動作已經使用並且必須重新充能。

english: It has no lair actions or regional effects.
zh_tw: 它沒有巢穴動作或區域效果。

english: Basidia rallies thirty {@creature Myconid Adult||myconid adults} and thirty-two {@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|drow spore servants} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) to fight alongside the characters. Their attacks are incapable of harming Juiblex. However, as they swarm around the demon lord, one time per round (as agreed upon by the players), a character who would be hit by an attack can have a myconid or a spore servant hit by the attack instead. The myconids can also fight off oozes, allowing the adventurers to focus their attention on the demon lord.
zh_tw: 巴斯狄亞召集了三十個{@creature Myconid Adult||蕈人成體}和三十二個{@creature Drow Spore Servant|OotA|卓爾孢子奴僕}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19})與角色們並肩作戰。他們的攻擊無法傷害朱庇萊克斯。然而，當他們圍繞惡魔領主蜂擁而上時，每輪一次（由玩家同意），一個本應被攻擊擊中的角色可以讓一個菌人或孢子僕從代替被攻擊。菌人還可以擊退軟泥怪，讓冒險者們集中注意力對付惡魔領主。

english: If the adventurers freed it from Zuggtmoy's influence, Araumycos aids them by releasing spores into the cavern, granting all living creatures in the area immunity to poison damage and the {@condition poisoned} condition.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們使它擺脫了祖格莫伊的影響，阿勞麥柯透過向洞穴釋放孢子來幫助他們，賦予區域內所有生物對毒素傷害的免疫以及{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態。

english: Victory or Defeat
zh_tw: 勝利或失敗

english: The characters might overcome two demon lords if they are successful in this chapter. If they fail, terrible consequences unfold for the myconids and other creatures of the Underdark, though the adventurers will get another chance to take the fight to Zuggtmoy, Juiblex, and all the other demon lords in {@adventure chapter 17|OotA|16}.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們在這一章節中成功，他們可能會戰勝兩位惡魔領主。如果他們失敗，對於菌人和其他幽暗地域的生物來說，可怕的後果將會展開，儘管冒險者們將有另一個機會在{@adventure 第十七章|OotA|16}中向祖格莫伊、朱庇萊克斯以及所有其他惡魔領主發起戰鬥。

english: Escaping Defeat
zh_tw: 逃離失敗

english: If the characters lose their battle against Juiblex, their best hope lies in {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}'s ritual. In the worst-case scenario where one or more heroes fall in the fight against the Faceless Lord, their allies might be able to carry them to safety so that they can be healed or restored to life.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在對抗朱庇萊克斯的戰鬥中失敗，他們最好的希望在於{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}的儀式。在最壞的情況下，如果一或多位英雄在對抗無面領主的戰鬥中倒下，他們的盟友可能能夠將他們帶到安全的地方，以便他們可以得到治療或恢復生命。

english: If the adventurers flee from Juiblex, the demon lord pursues them. However, Araumycos (or its death throes) triggers a cave-in, allowing defeated characters to barely escape. Juiblex then turns its attention to feeding on Araumycos and is one of the demon lords drawn into battle by Vizeran's ritual in {@adventure chapter 17|OotA|16}.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們從朱庇萊克斯那裡逃跑，這位惡魔領主會追擊他們。然而，阿勞麥柯（或者它的垂死掙扎）引發了一次塌方，使得被擊敗的角色們勉強逃脫。之後，朱庇萊克斯轉而專注於吞噬阿勞麥柯，併成為在{@adventure 第十七章|OotA|16}中被維茲蘭的儀式吸引進戰鬥的惡魔領主之一。

english: Achieving Victory
zh_tw: 取得勝利

english: If the adventurers succeed, they achieve a great victory with two demon lords banished back to the Abyss. The creatures under the demon lords' influence eventually return to normal. Neither Zuggtmoy nor Juiblex is truly destroyed, however. Each demon lord reforms on its layer of the Abyss, never forgetting those responsible for its defeat.
zh_tw: 如果冒險家們成功，他們將取得一場偉大的勝利，將兩位惡魔領主驅逐回無底深淵。受惡魔領主影響的生物最終恢復正常。然而，祖格莫伊和朱庇萊克斯並沒有真正被摧毀。每位惡魔領主在無底深淵的層面上重新形成，永遠不會忘記那些對其失敗負有責任的人。

english: The elimination of the Demon Queen of Fungi wins the adventurers the eternal gratitude of the surviving myconids of Neverlight Grove. Basidia quickly assumes leadership of the grove, taking steps to heal the minds of those myconids afflicted by demonic corruption. The myconids also declare their intention to cleanse their home of Zuggtmoy's lingering influence.
zh_tw: 消滅真菌惡魔女王贏得了無光林地倖存菌類對冒險者們的永恆感激。巴斯狄亞迅速承擔起林地的領導角色，採取措施治癒那些被惡魔腐蝕折磨的菌類的心靈。菌人還宣佈了他們清除家園中祖格莫伊殘留影響的意圖。

english: The removal of Juiblex from the Underdark causes most oozes and related creatures to revert to their normal state. If {@creature the Pudding King|OotA} survived this long, he retreats to Blingdenstone, but it's a far easier matter for the deep gnomes to deal with him and his oozing minions without Juiblex around.
zh_tw: 將朱庇萊克斯從幽暗地域移除導致大多數軟泥怪和相關生物恢復到它們正常的狀態。如果{@creature the Pudding King|OotA|布丁王}能存活這麼長時間，他會撤退到布靈登石城，但沒有了朱庇萊克斯的存在，對深度地底侏儒來說，處理他和他的軟泥僕從要容易得多。

english: Developments
zh_tw: 發展

english: Even if Araumycos survives, its fate is unclear. The entity's mind has clearly been damaged by both the necessity of cutting away its corruption and the buffeting force of the psychic wind that followed. Basidia and the myconids offer to meld with Araumycos to try to heal it and guide it back to wholeness. Though not as serious as death, the trauma still causes a significant amount of fungal die-off in areas of the creature's domain, potentially uncovering lost ruins or other hidden sites.
zh_tw: 即使阿勞麥柯存活下來，它的命運也不清楚。實體的思想顯然已經被切除腐敗的必要性和隨之而來的心靈風暴的力量所破壞。巴斯狄亞和菌人願意與阿勞麥柯融合，試圖治癒它並引導它恢復完整。雖然不像死亡那麼嚴重，但這次創傷仍然在生物領域的某些地區引起了大量的真菌死亡，可能會揭露出失落的廢墟或其他隱藏地點。

english: In addition to possible victory over one or two demon lords, the adventurers receive one last bequest from the mind of Araumycos. A puff of rapport spores or a lingering psychic connection informs them of one or more of the secrets of the Underdark gathered during the entity's vast existence. If you want to provide the players with any remaining information about virtually anything in the adventure, this is an excellent opportunity to do so.
zh_tw: 除了可能戰勝一兩位惡魔領主之外，冒險者們還從阿勞麥柯的心智中收到了最後一份遺贈。一團共鳴孢子的噴出或持久的心靈聯絡向他們透露了在實體漫長存在期間收集的幽暗地域的一個或多個秘密。如果你想向玩家提供有關冒險中幾乎所有事情的剩餘資訊，這是一個很好的機會。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: In addition to (or instead of) providing information to the adventurers, the last connection to the surviving Araumycos can bestow a {@reward charm of heroism} to all the player characters (see "{@book Other Rewards|DMG|7|Other Rewards}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 除了（或代替）向冒險者們提供訊息外，與倖存的阿勞麥柯的最後聯絡可以授予所有玩家角色一個{@reward charm of heroism||英勇護咒}（參見{@i 城主指南}第七章中的"{@book 其他獎勵|DMG|7|Other Rewards}"）。

english: Additionally, the thirteen timmask mushrooms on the list of required components that Vizeran needs to create his {@i dark heart} talisman (see {@area chapter 12|41b|x}) can be found in the aftermath of the failed wedding ceremony, sprouting in locations touched by Zuggtmoy or Juiblex.
zh_tw: 此外，維茲蘭需要的十三個時鐘菌（見{@area 第十二章|41b|x}）來創造他的'{@i 黑暗之心}'護身符的必需成分列表，可以在失敗的婚禮儀式之後找到，在被祖格莫伊或朱庇萊克斯觸及的地方生長。

english: If the characters didn't collect traces of Yeenoghu's blood from the fallen goristro in {@area chapter 14|4b8|x}, any successful weapon attack against Juiblex in this chapter leaves traces of the Faceless Lord's blood on a character's weapon. Collecting this blood for {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} provides another component he needs to craft his {@i dark heart} talisman.
zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有在{@area 第十四章|4b8|x}中從倒下的巨牛魔那裡收集耶諾古的血跡，那麼在這一章節中對朱庇萊克斯的任何成功的武器攻擊都會在角色的武器上留下無面領主的血跡。為{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}收集這些血液提供了他製作'{@i 黑暗之心}'護身符所需的另一個成分。

english: XP Awards
zh_tw: 經驗值獎勵

english: If the characters rid Araumycos's mind of its demonic infection, award each of them 2,000 XP. If the party delivers to Vizeran all of the components he needs to craft his {@i dark heart} talisman, award each character an additional 2,500 XP.
zh_tw: 如果角色們清除了阿勞麥柯心智中的惡魔感染，給每個人獎勵2,000 XP。如果隊伍為維茲蘭提供了他製作'{@i 黑暗之心}'護身符所需的所有成分，再給每個角色額外獎勵2,500 XP。

english: Chapter 17: Against the Demon Lords
zh_tw: 第17章：對抗惡魔領主

english: In the culmination of {@i Out of the Abyss}, the heroes implement {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}'s scheme to take on the demon lords. The archmage's ritual draws the demon lords together to fight to the death, leaving Demogorgon victorious but weakened as the adventurers face off against the Prince of Demons. Even wounded and weakened, though, Demogorgon is a legendary foe, and the fate of the Underdark and all Faerûn rests on the adventurers' final battle.
zh_tw: 在《{@i 逃離深淵}》的高潮部分，英雄們實施了{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}的計劃來對抗惡魔領主。這位大法師的儀式將惡魔領主們聚集在一起，讓他們戰鬥至死，最終惡魔王子狄摩高根勝出但也被削弱，而冒險者則與這位惡魔王子展開對決。儘管受傷且虛弱，狄摩高根仍是一個傳奇敵人，幽暗地域和整個費倫的命運都取決於冒險者們的最終之戰。

english: Readying the Plan
zh_tw: 準備計劃

english: Over the course of their adventures, the characters have collected the components needed to create the talisman at the center of {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}'s summoning ritual:
zh_tw: 在他們的冒險過程中，角色們收集了創造護身符所需的元件，這個護身符是{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}召喚儀式的核心：

english: The intact and unhatched egg of a purple worm (from the worm hatchery in {@area chapter 13|460|x})
zh_tw: 一個完好無損且未孵化的紫色蠕蟲卵（來自{@area 第十三章|460|x}的蠕蟲孵化場）

english: The central eye of a beholder (from Karazikar in the Vast Oblivium in {@area chapter 13|47e|x}, or some other source).
zh_tw: 眼魔的中央眼（來自{@area 第十三章|47e|x}中的無盡遺忘之地卡拉茲卡，或其他來源）。

english: Six feathers from six different angels (from the {@condition petrified} angels in the Labyrinth in {@area chapter 14|4bc|x})
zh_tw: 來自六位不同天使的六根羽毛（來自{@condition petrified||石化}天使，位於{@area 第十四章|4bc|x}的迷宮中）

english: The heart of a goristro (from the demon slain by Yeenoghu in {@area chapter 14|4b8|x})
zh_tw: 戈洛羅斯特的心臟（來自{@area 第十四章|4b8|x}中耶諾古所殺的惡魔）

english: Thirteen timmasks sprouted from the footprint of a greater demon (from Araumycos's cavern in {@area chapter 16|57d|x}, or elsewhere)
zh_tw: 十三個小蘑菇從一隻大惡魔的足跡中生長出來（來自{@area 第十六章|57d|x}中的阿勞麥柯洞穴，或其他地方）

english: Gromph Baenre's grimoire (from Sorcere in {@area chapter 15|55e|x})
zh_tw: 貢夫·班瑞的魔法書（來自{@area 第十五章|55e|x}的索瑟瑞）

english: A few drops of blood or ichor from a demon lord (from Yeenoghu's battle with the goristro in {@area chapter 14|4b8|x}, or from fighting Juiblex in {@area chapter 16|59f|x})
zh_tw: 幾滴惡魔領主的血液或膿液（來自耶諾古與巨牛魔在{@area 第十四章|4b8|x}的戰鬥，或與朱庇萊克斯在{@area 第十六章|59f|x}的戰鬥）

english: After {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} uses these components to create the talisman known as the {@i dark heart} to draw forth the exiled demon lords from across the Underdark, he expects the adventurers to plant it in Menzoberranzan. Having learned from Vizeran's apprentice Grin Ousstyl of the archmage's secret goal to see the city destroyed, the characters might decide to place the {@i dark heart} talisman elsewhere, determining the battlefield for their confrontation with the demon lords (see "Let This Be Their Battlefield").
zh_tw: 在{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}使用這些元件建立被稱為{@i 黑暗之心}的護身符，以從幽暗地域各地召喚被流放的惡魔領主之後，他期望冒險者們將其植入魔索布萊城。從維茲蘭的學徒格林·奧斯提爾那裡得知大法師秘密目標是看到這座城市被摧毀後，角色們可能會決定將{@i 黑暗之心}護身符放置在其他地方，決定他們與惡魔領主對抗的戰場（見"讓這裡成為他們的戰場"）。

english: Enacting the Plan
zh_tw: 實施計劃

english: Once the {@i dark heart} is in place, the ritual can begin. The adventurers and their allies take up a position not far from the {@i dark heart}, close to where the demons will appear. Where exactly depends on the placement of the talisman and the adventurers' own tactics and plans. They can use a {@spell sending} spell to signal Vizeran to begin the ritual once the talisman is in place. (If none of the characters can cast {@spell sending}, Vizeran can provide the spell on a {@i spell scroll}).
zh_tw: 一旦{@i 黑暗之心}就位，儀式就可以開始了。冒險者們和他們的盟友在離{@i 黑暗之心}不遠的地方佔據一個位置，靠近惡魔將出現的地方。具體位置取決於護身符的放置以及冒險者們自己的戰術和計劃。他們可以使用{@spell sending||短訊術}法術向維茲蘭發出訊號，一旦護身符就位就開始儀式。（如果沒有任何角色能夠施放{@spell sending||短訊術}，維茲蘭可以提供一個包含該法術的{@i 法術卷軸}）。

english: Vizeran (assisted by Grin if the apprentice is available), performs the complex ritual in the sanctum of his tower. The ritual causes the {@i dark heart} to radiate a summons throughout the Underdark using the {@i faerzress}—an irresistible call drawing the demons toward it. When the ritual reaches its conclusion at the end of nine hours, portals of {@i faerzress} form. All the demons and demon lords in the Underdark are drawn through those portals, appearing together in the area around the {@i dark heart} talisman.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭（如果學徒格林可用，則由他協助）在他的高塔聖所執行復雜的儀式。這個儀式使得{@i 黑暗之心}透過{@i 妖光}在幽暗地域中傳播召喚——一個無法抗拒的呼喚，吸引惡魔們向它靠近。當儀式在九小時後結束時，{@i 妖光}的傳送門形成。幽暗地域中的所有惡魔和惡魔領主被吸引穿過這些傳送門，在{@i 黑暗之心}護身符周圍的區域一起出現。

english: Enraged by being forcibly summoned yet again by a ritual, the demons fly into a frenzy once they see each other, beginning a battle to the death. As each demon's material form is destroyed, its essence is banished back into the Abyss. The task of the adventurers is to be close at hand but not get caught up in the battle until one demon lord is left standing, weakened and spent from the conflict. That becomes the adventurers' cue to attack and destroy the last demon lord, banishing it to the Abyss if they succeed.
zh_tw: 被儀式強制召喚而憤怒的惡魔們一旦看到彼此，就會陷入狂暴，開始一場生死戰鬥。每當一個惡魔的物質形態被摧毀，它的本質就會被驅逐回到無底深淵。冒險者們的任務是靠近現場，但不要捲入戰鬥，直到只剩下一位惡魔領主站立，因衝突而變得虛弱和耗盡。那時就是冒險者們發起攻擊並摧毀最後一個惡魔領主的訊號，如果他們成功，就可以將其驅逐到無底深淵。

english: Option: The Lesser of Two Evils
zh_tw: 選項：兩害相權取其輕

english: If you want to pose a moral dilemma for the characters, have Vizeran tell them that the ritual needs a final component, to be delivered while it is performed: the sacrifice of an innocent sentient being, whose blood will fuel and activate the ritual's fiendish magic. Will the adventurers willingly sacrifice one life to stop the demon lords from threatening the Underdark and the whole of Faerûn?
zh_tw: 如果你想給角色們提出一個道德困境，讓維茲蘭告訴他們儀式需要一個最終元件，在執行時提供：一個無辜的有感知生命體的犧牲，其血液將為儀式的惡魔魔法提供動力並啟用它。冒險者們會願意犧牲一個生命來阻止惡魔領主威脅幽暗地域和整個費倫嗎？

english: This kind of moral dilemma can add significant drama to the story. However, it can also be played out as a red herring—by having it be something Vizeran asks for even though it's not necessary. The drow archmage might be testing the characters to see how far they'll go, or he could be afflicted with madness that makes him believe such a sacrifice is necessary even though it isn't.
zh_tw: 這種道德困境可以為故事增添顯著的戲劇性。然而，它也可以被演繹成一個紅鯡魚——讓維茲蘭要求某樣東西，儘管這不是必需的。這位卓爾大法師可能在測試角色們會走多遠，或者他可能患有使他認為這種犧牲是必要的瘋狂的疾病，即使事實並非如此。

english: A character can figure out the truth with a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check, or by consulting Gromph Baenre's grimoire (see {@area chapter 15|570|x}). Alternatively, Grin Ousstyl can tell the characters the truth, enraging his master as a result.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過進行一次 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，或透過查閱貢夫·班瑞的魔法書（參見 {@area 第十五章|570|x}）來找出真相。另外，格林·奧斯提爾可以告訴角色真相，但這樣做會激怒他的主人。

english: Let This Be Their Battlefield
zh_tw: 讓這裡成為他們的戰場

english: The players can choose where their characters confront the demon lords by deciding where to set the {@i dark heart} talisman. Vizeran's preference is anywhere in Menzoberranzan, because he wants all drow to see the poisoned fruits of their misplaced worship of Lolth. However, from what Grin Ousstyl tells them in {@area chapter 15|55d|x}, the adventurers should learn that the talisman can be placed in any location.
zh_tw: 玩家可以透過決定在哪裡放置{@i 黑暗之心}護符來讓他們的角色在何處面對惡魔領主。維茲蘭的偏好是在魔索布萊城的任何地方，因為他希望所有卓爾都能看到他們錯誤崇拜羅絲羅絲的惡果。然而，根據格林·烏斯蒂（格林·奧斯提爾）在{@area 第十五章|55d|x}中告訴他們的內容，冒險者們應該瞭解到護符可以放置在任何一個地點。

english: Wherever the players decide to place the talisman, their characters must travel to that location while Vizeran makes his final preparations for the ritual. Given their experiences in the Underdark, the adventurers should be able to think of a number of likely sites for the final battle. A few likely options are discussed here.
zh_tw: 無論玩家們決定將護身符放置在何處，他們的角色都必須在維茲蘭為儀式做最後的準備時前往那個地點。鑑於他們在幽暗地域的經歷，冒險者們應該能夠想到許多可能的最終戰場地點。這裡討論了一些可能的選項。

english: Staying Behind
zh_tw: 留下

english: One or more of the characters might choose to stay with Vizeran during the nine-hour performance of the ritual, whether to guard against treachery or to reclaim Gromph's grimoire once the ritual is done. If this is the case, you can add some action for those who remain behind by having a small number of the demons summoned by the ritual attracted to the site of the ritual rather than the location of the {@i dark heart} talisman. Alternatively, agents of {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA} or Jarlaxle can attack Araj when the ritual is complete, wanting to silence Vizeran before he can reveal what he knows about Gromph Baenre (see {@area chapter 15|4d5|x}).
zh_tw: 一名或多名角色可能會選擇在九小時的儀式期間留在維茲蘭身邊，無論是以防背叛，還是在儀式結束後奪回貢夫的魔法書。如果是這種情況，你可以為那些留下來的人增加一些行動，讓少量被儀式召喚的惡魔被吸引到儀式地點，而不是{@i 黑暗之心}護符的位置。或者，當儀式完成時，{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}或賈拉索的代理人可以攻擊阿拉傑，希望在維茲蘭透露他所知道的關於貢夫·班瑞的資訊之前讓他沉默（見{@area 第十五章|4d5|x}）。

english: Vizeran might also learn of Grin Ousstyl's betrayal of information to the adventurers, and choose to eliminate him immediately after he's served his purpose in assisting with the ritual. This might lead some characters back to Araj to aid the drow apprentice.
zh_tw: 維茲蘭也可能得知格林·奧斯提爾向冒險者們洩露資訊的行為，並可能選擇在他在儀式協助中發揮了作用之後立即將他除掉。這可能會導致一些角色返回阿拉傑去幫助那位卓爾學徒。

english: Araumycos
zh_tw: 阿勞麥柯

english: At the center of the network of caves and passages inhabited by Araumycos, the cavern where Juiblex and Zuggtmoy battled in {@area chapter 16|59b|x} is a good potential site. If the vast fungal colony is already dead or badly damaged by its abuse at Zuggtmoy's hands, it's in no position to object. Otherwise, it opposes becoming a battlefield out of a sense of self-preservation. Unleashing the demons within Araumycos does considerable damage to the fungal colony, but doesn't destroy it.
zh_tw: 在阿勞麥柯所居住的洞穴和通道網路的中心，朱庇萊克斯和祖格莫伊在 {@area 第十六章|59b|x} 中戰鬥的洞穴是一個潛在的合適地點。如果這片龐大的真菌群落已經死亡或因祖格莫伊的濫用而嚴重受損，它將無力反對。否則，出於自我保護的本能，它會反對成為戰場。在阿勞麥柯內部釋放惡魔會對真菌群落造成相當大的損害，但不會徹底摧毀它。

english: Neverlight Grove
zh_tw: 無光林地

english: If the characters inform the myconids of their need for a place to stage a daring last battle, {@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA} or another myconid representative might offer Neverlight Grove. The ranks of the myconids have been decimated by Zuggtmoy's depredations and the fetid wedding, and many fear their beloved caverns are corrupted. They are willing to seek a new home (perhaps in the caverns of Araumycos) and grateful enough to the heroes that they will sacrifice their old home to help them.
zh_tw: 如果角色們告知菌人生物他們需要一個地方來策劃一場大膽的最後一戰，{@creature Sovereign Basidia|OotA|君主巴斯狄亞}或其他菌人代表可能會提供無光林地。菌人生物的行列已經被祖格莫伊的掠奪和惡臭的婚禮嚴重削減，許多人擔心他們心愛的洞穴已經被腐蝕。他們願意尋找一個新的家園（可能在阿勞麥柯的洞穴裡），並且對英雄們足夠感激，以至於他們願意犧牲他們的舊家園來幫助他們。

english: Sloobludop
zh_tw: 斯盧布多普

english: The ruins of the kuo-toa settlement (see {@area chapter 3|112|x}) could become the site of the final fight against the demon lords. {@creature Shuushar the Awakened|OotA} can be convinced to help evacuate the remaining inhabitants if asked. The nearby Darklake creates its own challenges, particularly given the presence of ixitxachitl loyal to Demogorgon.
zh_tw: 寇濤魚人定居點的廢墟（見{@area 第三章|112|x}）可能成為對抗惡魔領主的最終戰場。如果請求的話，可以說服{@creature Shuushar the Awakened|OotA|覺醒者舒沙爾}幫助撤離剩餘的居民。附近的黑暗湖帶來了自身的挑戰，特別是考慮到忠於混沌之後狄摩高根的伊克西切特的存在。

english: Araj
zh_tw: 阿拉傑

english: Characters looking to double-cross Vizeran—or those with a sense of poetic justice—might hide the {@i dark heart} somewhere in the drow archmage's tower or the surrounding cavern. This reduces the number of bystanders, contains the demons and their battle, and ensures Vizeran's enmity.
zh_tw: 想要背叛維茲蘭的角色——或者那些具有詩意正義感的角色——可能會將{@i 黑暗之心}藏在卓爾大法師的高塔內或周圍的洞穴中。這減少了旁觀者的數量，限制了惡魔及其戰鬥的範圍，並確保了維茲蘭的敵意。

english: Broken Heart
zh_tw: 破碎的心

english: If the characters lose or destroy the {@i dark heart}, they either have to go through the process of gathering the necessary components to make a replacement, or abandon Vizeran's plan. See "{@area Loose Threads|5c6|x}" later in this chapter for ideas about what to do if the plan never gets off the ground.
zh_tw: 如果角色們丟失或摧毀了{@i 黑暗之心}，他們要麼不得不經歷重新收集製作替代品所需的元件的過程，要麼放棄維茲蘭的計劃。如果計劃從未啟動，請參閱本章後面的"{@area 鬆散的線索|5c6|x}"部分，瞭解可以採取哪些措施的想法。

english: Confronting the Demon Lords
zh_tw: 面對惡魔領主

english: The demon lords are some of the most powerful foes a party of adventurers could face. Indeed, any one of them at full strength could wipe out a group of 15th-level characters with ease. Fortunately for the heroes, the goal of Vizeran's plan isn't to fight multiple demon lords, but to turn them against each other. With the right combination of preparation, timing, and execution, the characters set the trap that Vizeran springs with his ritual—and hope whichever demon lord survives is weakened enough for them to destroy it.
zh_tw: 惡魔領主是冒險者隊伍可能面對的最強大的敵人之一。實際上，任何一個處於全力狀態的惡魔領主都能輕易地消滅一群15級的冒險者。幸運的是，對於英雄們來說，維茲蘭計劃的目標不是與多個惡魔領主戰鬥，而是讓他們互相對抗。透過正確的準備、時機和執行的組合，角色們設定了維茲蘭用他的儀式觸發的陷阱——並希望幸存的惡魔領主足夠虛弱，以便他們能夠摧毀它。

english: Allied Forces
zh_tw: 聯盟力量

english: Vizeran is needed to perform the ritual, placing him far from the battle and leaving him with three levels of {@condition exhaustion} (see appendix A of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB|11}) once the ritual is completed. He is thus unwilling to aid the characters during the fight. The archmage prefers to keep Grin Ousstyl to assist him, so the drow mage is likewise unable to assist. However, the adventurers have a number of other allies willing to fight alongside them in this last battle.
zh_tw: 執行儀式需要維茲蘭，這使他遠離戰鬥，並且在儀式完成後會留下三層{@condition exhaustion||力竭}（見{@book 玩家手冊|PHB|11}附錄A）。因此他並不願意在戰鬥期間協助角色們。大法師更傾向於讓格林·奧斯提爾來協助他，因此卓爾法師同樣無法提供幫助。然而，冒險者們擁有許多其他盟友願意在這最後一場戰鬥中並肩作戰。

english: Most of the heroes' allies are of limited use against the demon lords—creatures immune to many forms of attack, including nonmagical weapons. Rather than dealing with the ineffectual attacks of allies or a dozen or more additional actions each round, give characters backed up by a group of allies the following benefits.
zh_tw: 大多數英雄的盟友對惡魔領主的作用有限——這些生物對許多形式的攻擊免疫，包括非魔法武器。與其處理盟友無效的攻擊或每輪十多個額外行動，不如給予由一群盟友支援的角色以下好處。

english: Healing Support
zh_tw: 治療支援

english: A character regains {@dice 2d6} hit points at the end of each of his or her turns, provided the character has at least 1 hit point remaining.
zh_tw: 只要角色至少還有 1 點生命值，角色在每個自己的回合結束時恢復 {@dice 2d6} 點生命值。

english: Tactical Losses
zh_tw: 戰術損失

english: Once each round, when a player character would be hit by an attack, a supporting ally is hit by the attack instead. The adventurers can use this option ten times before their allies are too weakened or depleted to provide assistance.
zh_tw: 每輪一次，當玩家角色將被攻擊命中時，一個支援的盟友會被該攻擊擊中代替。冒險者們可以在他們的盟友因太弱或耗盡而無法提供幫助之前，使用這個選項十次。

english: Heroic Sacrifice
zh_tw: 英勇犧牲

english: Players should never have to think about sacrificing their characters, but you should be prepared for the possibility of one or more of the heroes giving up their lives in order to defeat the evil that has arisen in the Underdark. It's up to you how to handle such a high-stakes event, but consider treating it as an extreme variation of "{@book Success at a Cost|DMG|8|Resolution and Consequences}" from chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}. At the very least, a player deliberately sacrificing his or her character's life in a final, selfless heroic effort—the antithesis of the selfishness and evil of the Abyss—should grant all the character's allies inspiration. The sacrifice might not be enough to win the day on its own, but it can help turn the tide.
zh_tw: 玩家們不應該被迫考慮犧牲他們的角色，但你應該為一兩位或多位英雄在擊敗幽暗地域中崛起的邪惡時獻出生命的可能性做好準備。如何應對這種高風險事件取決於你，但可以考慮將其視為{@i 城主指南}第8章中"{@book 有代價的成功|DMG|8|Resolution and Consequences}"的極端變體。至少，當玩家故意在最終的無私英雄行為中犧牲其角色的生命時——這是無底深淵的自私和邪惡的對立面——應該給予所有該角色的盟友激勵。犧牲本身可能不足以贏得勝利，但它可以幫助扭轉局勢。

english: Rage of Demons
zh_tw: 惡魔之怒

english: Once the {@i dark heart} talisman is placed and the characters signal Vizeran, there's no turning back.
zh_tw: 一旦{@i 黑暗之心}護身符就位並且角色們向維茲蘭發出訊號，就沒有回頭路了。

english: The waiting is the hard part. Time seems to drag as you remain alert, weapons drawn, every nerve singing with the tension in the air all around you.
zh_tw: 等待是最艱難的部分。時間似乎在拖延，你保持警惕，武器出鞘，每根神經都因周圍空氣中的緊張感而緊繃。

english: Finally, a swirling light begins to flare in the darkness. A barely audible humming shakes you to the core, rising and falling like a vast heartbeat in the depths. The glow of {@i faerzress} gathers and brightens, creating swirling pools like holes torn in the air. A roar sounds from far away as shadows move in the depths of those pools of light. The demons are coming.
zh_tw: 終於，黑暗中開始閃爍起旋轉的光芒。一種幾乎聽不見的嗡嗡聲震撼著你的核心，像深淵中的巨大心跳一樣起伏。{@i 妖光}的光芒聚集並變得更加明亮，形成像在空中撕裂的洞一樣旋轉的光池。從遠處傳來一聲吼叫，隨著那些光池深處的影子移動。惡魔們來了。

english: The demon lords described in {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20} of this adventure all appear in the final battle, with the following exceptions:
zh_tw: 本冒險中描述的 {@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20} 中的惡魔領主們都會出現在最終決戰中，以下是例外情況：

english: If Fraz-Urb'luu was not sent back to the Abyss in {@area chapter 9|34f|x}, his gemstone is hurled into the fray by Vizeran's ritual. Unless the characters retrieve it, another demon lord steps on the gem, destroys it, and sends Fraz-Urb'luu's spirit back to the Abyss.
zh_tw: 如果弗拉茲厄魯在{@area 第九章|34f|x}中沒有被送回無底深淵，他的寶石會被維茲蘭的儀式拋入戰鬥中。除非角色們取回它，否則另一個惡魔領主會踩在寶石上，將其摧毀，並將弗拉茲厄魯的靈魂送回無底深淵。

english: If Juiblex and Zuggtmoy were sent back to the Abyss in earlier parts of the adventure, they are not present.
zh_tw: 如果在冒險的早期部分朱庇萊克斯和祖格莫伊被送回了無底深淵，那麼他們不會出現在這裡。

english: Baphomet and Yeenoghu are absent if the characters activated the Maze Engine (see {@area chapter 14|4c8|x}) and the 81–100 result on the Maze Engine Effects table came up.
zh_tw: 若角色啟動過迷宮引擎（見{@area 第14章|4c8|x}），且在迷宮引擎效果表上擲出81–100，巴弗滅與耶諾古便不會在場。

english: Numerous other demons also pour through the portals. For a brief moment, all of the demons and demon lords are disoriented as they attempt to get their bearings after being pulled across the Underdark. Then as their gazes fall upon each other, they roar, bellow, or shriek with a hatred too deep for mortals to truly comprehend, and the terrible battle begins.
zh_tw: 無數其他惡魔也透過傳送門湧入。在短暫的一刻，所有的惡魔和惡魔領主在被拉過幽暗地域後都感到迷失方向。然後，當他們的目光落在彼此身上時，他們發出咆哮、怒吼或尖叫，這種仇恨之深，凡人難以真正理解，可怕的戰鬥開始了。

english: Option: Jimjar's Last Gamble
zh_tw: 選項：吉姆賈爾的最後賭博

english: If the adventurers need some extra help in their epic final battle at the end of the campaign, consider the following option involving {@creature Jimjar|OotA}, the deep gnome gambler they met in the drow slave pen in {@area chapter 1|008|x} of the adventure.
zh_tw: 若冒險者在戰役尾聲的史詩決戰中需要額外援助，可以考慮以下選項：讓{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}介入。他就是角色們在本冒險{@area 第1章|008|x}的卓爾奴隸牢中遇見的地底侏儒賭徒。

english: "{@creature Jimjar|OotA}" isn't at all who he appears. He is, in fact, a god or other great power in disguise—or the Chosen of such a power—and has been watching the heroes since their first encounter in Velkynvelve. His reasons for doing this are his own, but when push comes to shove, he can give the heroes some help in overcoming the demon lords.
zh_tw: "{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}"並非他表面上的那個人。實際上，他是一位神或其它強大的力量偽裝成的——或者是一位被選中的力量——自他們在維爾京維爾夫的第一次相遇以來，他一直在觀察英雄們。他這樣做的原因是他自己的，但當事情變得緊急時，他可以給英雄們提供一些幫助，以克服惡魔領主。

english: At an opportune moment, {@creature Jimjar|OotA} shows up (even returning from death if he appeared to perish earlier in the adventure) and gives the characters a vote of encouragement, telling them, "I bet you can do this." Each character gains inspiration and a {@reward blessing of wound closure} (see "{@book Other Rewards|DMG|7|Other Rewards}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). {@creature Jimjar|OotA} disappears afterward, potentially putting in one last appearance at the end of the adventure to hint as to his true nature before vanishing into the Underdark.
zh_tw: 在一個合適的時機，{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}出現（即使他在冒險早期看似死亡也會復活）並給角色們一個鼓勵的投票，告訴他們："我打賭你們能做到。"每個角色獲得靈感和一個{@reward blessing of wound closure||癒合祝福}（參見{@book 其他獎勵|DMG|7|Other Rewards}在{@i 城主指南}的第7章）。{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}隨後消失，可能在冒險結束時最後一次出現，暗示他的真實本質，然後消失在幽暗地域中。

english: Who is {@creature Jimjar|OotA} really? That depends on your characters and the campaign, but one of the characters' patron deities is a good possibility. He might also be a gnomish god such as Garl Glittergold or Callarduran Smoothhands, known tricksters and shapeshifters, and foes of demons and their ilk. The more important thing is that he serves as a "lucky charm" for the characters when they need him. This option works particularly well if the adventurers have been kind to the sometimes annoying deep gnome over the course of the campaign, earning his respect and gratitude.
zh_tw: {@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆賈爾}究竟是什麼人？這取決於你的角色和戰役，但其中一個角色的守護神是一個很好的可能性。他也可能是像加爾·閃光金（加爾·閃金）或卡拉杜蘭·巧手（卡勒杜蘭·滑手）這樣的侏儒神，他們是眾所周知的惡作劇者和化獸者，也是惡魔及其同類的敵人。更重要的是，他在角色需要他的時候充當了"幸運符"。如果冒險家們在戰役過程中對這位有時令人討厭的地底侏儒表現出善意，贏得了他的尊重和感激，這個選項尤其有效。

english: Demon Showdown
zh_tw: 惡魔對決

english: Ideally, the adventurers and their allies remain hidden from the battling demons, letting them fight it out among themselves. Still, there are challenges for the characters to overcome as they wait. Feel free to include as many of the following as you wish while narrating the struggle between the demon lords and their minions, keeping in mind that the characters will have no time for even a short rest before taking on the main challenge of this encounter—a fight with the sole remaining demon lord.
zh_tw: 理想情況下，冒險家們和他們的盟友在惡魔之間戰鬥時保持隱蔽，讓他們自己相互廝殺。然而，在等待的過程中，角色們需要克服一些挑戰。在敘述惡魔領主和他們的手下之間的鬥爭時，你可以隨意包含以下任意多的挑戰，同時要記住角色們在面對這場遭遇的主要挑戰——與唯一倖存的惡魔領主的戰鬥之前，將沒有時間進行哪怕是短休。

english: Demon Sortie
zh_tw: 惡魔突擊

english: Rampaging lesser demons discover one or more of the characters where they wait out the battle, attacking at once. Roll a {@dice d4} to determine the demons involved.
zh_tw: 狂暴的低階惡魔發現了在戰鬥中等待的角色們，並立即發動攻擊。擲一個{@dice d4}來確定涉及的惡魔。

english: Demon Sortie Force
zh_tw: 惡魔突擊隊

english: d4
zh_tw: d4

english: Demon Sortie
zh_tw: 惡魔突擊

english: 4 {@creature Barlgura||barlguras}
zh_tw: 4 {@creature Barlgura||惡猿魔}

english: 4 {@creature Chasme||chasmes}
zh_tw: 4 {@creature Chasme||喀嘶魔}

english: 2 {@creature Hezrou||hezrous}
zh_tw: 2 {@creature Hezrou||狂蟾魔}

english: 3 {@creature Vrock||vrocks}
zh_tw: 3 {@creature Vrock||鷲魔}

english: Demon Thief
zh_tw: 惡魔小偷

english: An {@condition invisible} {@creature quasit} tries to steal a small, valuable item from a party member. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to notice the theft as it happens. On a failed check, the quasit makes off with the item undetected. You can make the search for the item a loose thread for the conclusion of the adventure. Alternatively, have the quasit killed during the battle, with the stolen item turning up in the aftermath.
zh_tw: 一個 {@condition invisible||隱形} 的 {@creature quasit||小惡魔} 試圖從一名隊伍成員身上偷取一件小而貴重的物品。目標必須在 {@dc 13} 的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定中成功才能注意到盜竊的發生。如果檢定失敗，小惡魔將帶著物品悄然離開。你可以將尋找這件物品作為冒險結尾的一個鬆散線索。或者，讓小惡魔在戰鬥中被殺死，被盜物品在戰鬥結束後被發現。

english: Endangered Allies
zh_tw: 瀕危盟友

english: If any of the player characters' allies are accompanying them, a demon sortie (see above) attacks the NPCs. The characters must decide whether or not to break cover to aid their allies against the demons. If they do, another demon sortie attacks them {@dice 1d4} rounds later.
zh_tw: 如果任何玩家角色的盟友陪伴著他們，一次惡魔突襲（見上文）會攻擊這些非玩家角色。角色們必須決定是否要暴露自己的位置來幫助他們的盟友對抗惡魔。如果他們這麼做了，另一次惡魔突襲將在 {@dice 1d4} 輪後攻擊他們。

english: Option: Playing Out the Battle Option
zh_tw: 選項：展開戰鬥

english: Rather than focusing on the adventurers biding their time and dealing with the fallout of the titanic battle between the demon lords, you can shift focus for this part of the adventure. Consider having the players take control of the various demon lords from {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}, then play out the conflict between them.
zh_tw: 與側重於冒險者們等待時機並處理惡魔領主之間巨人之戰後果不同，你可以為這部分冒險轉移焦點。考慮讓玩家們掌控來自{@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20}中的各個惡魔領主，然後演繹出他們之間的衝突。

english: Assign each player an available demon lord, or allow players to choose one demon lord to control during the battle. You manage any of the remaining demon lords. If there aren't enough demon lords for all the players, you can use {@creature Balor||balors} or other powerful demons to round out their numbers.
zh_tw: 為每位玩家分配一個可用的惡魔領主，或者允許玩家選擇一個惡魔領主在戰鬥中控制。你來管理剩餘的惡魔領主。如果所有的玩家都分配不到足夠的惡魔領主，你可以使用{@creature Balor||巴洛炎魔}或其他強大的惡魔來補充他們的人數。

english: The players control the demons in their battle to the death, with the only restriction being that they can't withdraw from the combat. Brief tactical retreats are permissible, but Vizeran's ritual has filled the demon lords with the rage to do battle.
zh_tw: 玩家們控制惡魔在他們的生死戰鬥中，唯一的限制是他們不能退出戰鬥。短暫的戰術性撤退是允許的，但是維茲蘭的儀式已經讓惡魔領主們充滿了戰鬥的憤怒。

english: The demonic victor of this battle, its hit points and other resources sufficiently depleted, is the foe that the adventurers must overcome in the final confrontation.
zh_tw: 這場戰鬥中的惡魔勝利者，其生命值和其他資源已經大幅度消耗，是冒險家們在最終對決中必須克服的敵人。

english: Near Miss
zh_tw: 千鈞一髮

english: The battle between the demon lords shifts dangerously close to the characters. Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the Near Miss table to determine the result.
zh_tw: 惡魔領主之間的戰鬥危險地靠近了角色們。擲一個{@dice d6}並查閱"近失"表格以確定結果。

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Event
zh_tw: 事件

english: {@b Explosion}. Each creature within 20 feet of a point you choose must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes {@dice 3d6} fire damage, or half as much damage on a success.
zh_tw: {@b 爆炸}. 你選擇的一個點周圍20尺範圍內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 13}敏捷豁免。失敗時，該生物受到{@dice 3d6}點火焰傷害，成功時則受到一半傷害。

english: {@b Flying Debris}. Each creature within 30 feet of a point you choose must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 3d6} bludgeoning damage and falling {@condition prone} on a failure.
zh_tw: {@b 飛散的碎片}. 你選擇的30尺範圍內的每個生物必須進行一個 {@dc 13} 敏捷豁免檢定，失敗則遭受 {@dice 3d6} 鈍擊傷害並陷入 {@condition prone||伏地} 狀態。

english: {@b Close Call}. A character you choose must make a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw to dodge a stray attack. On a failed save, the character takes {@dice 3d6} bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: {@b 千鈞一髮}。你選擇的一個角色必須成功進行一次 {@dc 13} 敏捷豁免來躲避一次流矢攻擊。如果豁免失敗，該角色將受到 {@dice 3d6} 鈍擊傷害。

english: Threatened Bystanders
zh_tw: 受威脅的旁觀者

english: If the battle takes place in a populated area such as Menzoberranzan, the characters spot bystanders under attack by lesser demons that prefer to take on easy prey rather than fighting against their own kind. A dozen {@creature Dretch||dretches} or {@creature manes} (50 percent chance of either) attack, killing and consuming their mortal victims unless the adventurers intervene.
zh_tw: 如果戰鬥發生在人口密集的地區，如魔索布萊城，角色們會看到旁觀者正受到低階惡魔的攻擊，這些惡魔更願意攻擊容易的獵物而不是與自己的同類戰鬥。一群{@creature Dretch||怯魔}或{@creature manes||原魔}（有50%的機率是其中一種）進行攻擊，除非冒險家們介入，否則它們會殺死併吞噬他們的凡人受害者。

english: Against Demogorgon
zh_tw: 對抗狄摩高根

english: After running any events you wish from "The Battle," the struggle between the demon lords comes to an end as Demogorgon proves why he is known as the Prince of Demons.
zh_tw: 演完「戰鬥」一節中你想採用的事件後，惡魔領主之間的混戰終於落幕，狄摩高根也展現了自己何以被稱為惡魔之王。

english: The sounds of battle finally die away, the ground before you stained black and red with demonic blood and ichor. In the terrible grip of Demogorgon, even the mighty Orcus looks almost small. Tentacles hold the Demon Prince of Undeath in a crushing grip, slithering across the maggot-riddled flesh of the horned demon, as they tighten inexorably. A strangled gasp issues from the demon lord's throat as a horrific crunching sound echoes throughout the cavern and his skull-topped wand clatters onto the floor.
zh_tw: 戰鬥的聲音最終消散，你面前的地面被惡魔的血液和膿液染成黑色和紅色。在狄摩高根的可怕掌控下，即使是強大的奧喀斯看起來也幾乎渺小。觸手以壓倒性的握力抓住了不死之惡魔領主，滑過長滿蛆的有角惡魔的肉體，並且不可阻擋地收緊。當惡魔領主的喉嚨中發出窒息的喘息聲時，整個洞穴中迴盪著可怕的碎裂聲，他的頭骨頂部的魔杖掉落在地面上。

english: Demogorgon casts aside the limp form, which melts away as Orcus returns to the Abyss that spawned him. The Prince of Demons throws back his two heads and roars his triumph. As he does, his nearer head turns, burning eyes raking across the battlefield. Filled with bloodlust and battle rage, the demon lord searches for another target.
zh_tw: 狄摩高根拋開了無力的身軀，隨著奧喀斯返回到孕育他的無底深淵中，身軀開始融化。惡魔之王仰起他的兩個頭顱，發出勝利的咆哮。當他這樣做時，他較近的頭顱轉動，燃燒的目光掃過戰場。充滿殺戮慾望和戰鬥狂暴，惡魔領主尋找著下一個目標。

english: Determine the characters' starting positions based on their actions during the battle. Demogorgon should be at least 80 feet away from them initially, unless the players specifically stated they were remaining close to the demon lord.
zh_tw: 根據角色們在戰鬥中的行動確定他們的起始位置。狄摩高根最初應該至少距離他們80尺遠，除非玩家們特別說明他們保持在惡魔領主的附近。

english: Demogorgon has been wounded during the fight, giving the characters an edge in the battle to come. Apply the following penalties to the {@creature Demogorgon|MTF} stat block in {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}:
zh_tw: 狄摩高根在戰鬥中受傷，為角色們即將到來的戰鬥帶來了優勢。將以下懲罰應用於{@creature Demogorgon|MTF|狄摩高根}屬性塊（選自{@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20}）：

english: Demogorgon has 290 hit points remaining and can't regain hit points due to the disruptive nature of Vizeran's {@i faerzress}-empowered ritual.
zh_tw: 狄摩高根還剩下290生命值，由於維茲蘭的{@i 妖光}加持儀式的破壞性質，它無法恢復生命值。

english: He has only one use of Legendary Resistance remaining for the day.
zh_tw: 他當天只剩下一次使用傳奇抗性的機會。

english: His {@spell feeblemind} innate spell is expended, as are all but one use each of {@spell dispel magic}, {@spell fear}, and {@spell telekinesis}.
zh_tw: 他的天賦魔法{@spell feeblemind||弱智術}已經使用完畢，同樣已經用盡的還有除了一次之外的所有{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}、{@spell fear||恐懼術}和{@spell telekinesis||心靈遙控}的使用次數。

english: With all the other demon lords banished back to the Abyss, Demogorgon becomes the focus of the disruptive power of Vizeran's ritual. This imposes a −5 penalty to his attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.
zh_tw: 隨著所有其他惡魔領主被驅逐回無底深淵，狄摩高根成為了維茲蘭儀式破壞性力量的焦點。這對他的攻擊擲骰、屬性檢定和豁免檢定施加了-5的懲罰。

english: Even in his weakened state, the demon lord remains a terrifying opponent, attacking the adventurers in a howling fury as battle is joined.
zh_tw: 即使在虛弱狀態下，這位惡魔領主依然是一個可怕的對手，當戰鬥開始時，他以尖叫的狂暴攻擊冒險家們。

english: Wand of Orcus
zh_tw: 奧喀斯之杖

english: When Orcus is defeated, he drops the {@item Wand of Orcus} (see {@book chapter 7|DMG|7} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}), which falls to the ground. A party member can try to grab the wand before Demogorgon seizes it as a trophy, but any such theft draws the attention and ire of the Prince of Demons. Angry at its master's defeat, the {@item Wand of Orcus} tries to attune itself to the first willing creature other than Demogorgon that touches it. The attunement is instantaneous, allowing the wand's properties to be used during the battle.
zh_tw: 當奧喀斯被擊敗時，他會掉落{@item Wand of Orcus||奧喀斯之杖}（參見{@book 第七章|DMG|7}{@i 城主指南}），這件物品會墜落地面。小隊成員可以嘗試在狄摩高根將其作為戰利品奪取前抓住法杖，但任何此類偷竊行為都會引起惡魔王子的注意與憤怒。由於對主人戰敗感到憤怒，{@item Wand of Orcus||奧喀斯之杖}會嘗試立即與第一個觸碰它且非狄摩高根的自願生物建立同調。這種同調是即時完成的，允許在戰鬥中使用法杖的屬性。

english: Destroying Demogorgon
zh_tw: 摧毀狄摩高根

english: If the characters reduce the Prince of Demons to 0 hit points, they disrupt and destroy his material form. Shrieking and gibbering, the Prince of Demons disintegrates as his foul essence is cast back into the Abyss, ending the demonic threat to the Underdark.
zh_tw: 如果角色們將惡魔之王的生命力降至0點，他們就會破壞並摧毀他的實體形態。惡魔之王尖叫著、胡言亂語著，隨著他邪惡的本質被驅逐回無底深淵，他開始解體，從而終結了對幽暗地域的惡魔威脅。

english: If the characters fail to destroy Demogorgon, see "Demon Lords Triumphant."
zh_tw: 如果角色們未能摧毀狄摩高根，請參見"惡魔領主的勝利"。

english: Alternative Showdown
zh_tw: 替代對決

english: If you prefer, a demon lord other than Demogorgon could be the victor of the demonic showdown and the final foe of the campaign. This is particularly appropriate if the adventurers earned the ire of a specific demon lord during the adventure (including Juiblex or Yeenoghu). Alternatively, one or more of the characters' backgrounds might be tied to a particular demon lord.
zh_tw: 如果您願意，除了狄摩高根之外的另一個惡魔領主可以成為惡魔對決的勝利者和戰役的最終敵人。如果冒險家們在冒險過程中特別激怒了某個特定的惡魔領主（包括朱庇萊克斯或耶諾古），這尤其合適。另外，角色們的背景可能與某個特定的惡魔領主有關。

english: Loose Threads
zh_tw: 鬆散的線索

english: The conclusion of {@i Out of the Abyss} can be relatively quick and straightforward if Vizeran's scheme is successful and the heroes are victorious. The survivors of the battle against the demon lords can make their way out of the Underdark to report to a grateful alliance of surface-world factions that the threat is ended.
zh_tw: 如果維茲蘭的計劃成功並且英雄們取得勝利，{@i 逃離深淵}的結局可能會相對迅速和直接。與惡魔領主戰鬥的生還者可以設法離開幽暗地域，向地表世界派系組成的感激同盟報告威脅已經結束。

english: Major loose threads left hanging at the end of the final battle include the following.
zh_tw: 最終戰鬥結束時留下的主要未解之謎包括以下幾點。

english: Gromph's Grimoire
zh_tw: 貢夫的魔法書

english: After recovering Gromph Baenre's grimoire from Sorcere in {@area chapter 15|55e|x}, the characters might think about what to do with the dark tome once the threat of the demon lords is ended. The knowledge and power the book represents are dangerous in anyone's hands—especially {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA}'s, given what the characters know of him. However, the drow archmage doesn't give up the grimoire willingly.
zh_tw: 在從索瑟瑞的{@area 第十五章|55e|x}回收了貢夫·班瑞的魔典之後，一旦惡魔領主的威脅結束，角色們可能會考慮如何處理這本黑暗的書籍。這本書所代表的知識和力量在任何人手中都是危險的——尤其是對於角色們所瞭解的{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}來說。然而，這位卓爾大法師並不願意放棄這本魔典。

english: Finding a means to get rid of Gromph's grimoire once and for all could be the basis for continued adventures, perhaps even leading characters into the Abyss (see "Into the Demonweb Pits"). Alternatively, if you arrange for the book to be stolen from Vizeran before the characters can deal with it, they might need to recover it to ensure its powers are never misused again.
zh_tw: 找到一個一勞永逸擺脫貢夫的魔法書的方法可以成為繼續冒險的基礎，甚至可能引導角色進入無底深淵（見"進入魔網深坑"）。或者，如果你安排在角色處理之前從維茲蘭那裡偷走這本書，他們可能需要找回它以確保其力量永遠不會再次被濫用。

english: If you prefer to tie up loose ends concerning the grimoire, you can have it banished into the Abyss along with the demon lords. It might be reclaimed by Lolth or lost somewhere within the infinite depths of that plane, at least until it resurfaces again.
zh_tw: 如果您更傾向於解決關於魔典的未決事宜，您可以讓它隨著惡魔領主一起被放逐到無底深淵。它可能會被羅絲回收，或者在那個位面的無限無底深淵中丟失，至少直到它再次出現。

english: Lingering Evil
zh_tw: 殘留的邪惡

english: One or more of the demon lords might remain in the Underdark or on the Material Plane by the end of the campaign, having managed to avoid being drawn into Vizeran's trap. Graz'zt is a good possibility. In this case, a continuing campaign might be necessary for the high-level heroes to acquire the resources they need to take on any remaining demon lords, since the trick with the {@i dark heart} isn't going to work a second time.
zh_tw: 在戰役結束時，一個或多個惡魔領主可能仍然留在幽暗地域或物質界，成功避免了被吸入維茲蘭的陷阱。格拉茲特是一個好的可能性。在這種情況下，可能需要繼續進行戰役，以便高階英雄們獲取他們需要的資源來對抗任何剩餘的惡魔領主，因為使用{@i 黑暗之心}的計策不會再次奏效。

english: The characters' continuing adventures could involve further cooperation with {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} (if he survives) or delving deeper into the Underdark for legendary weapons or magic. The characters might even venture out into the other planes of existence with the aid of Araumycos or the librarians of Gravenhollow, seeking allies, lore, and resources to combat the demon lords and return them to the Abyss.
zh_tw: 角色們的持續冒險可能涉及與{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}（如果他倖存）的進一步合作，或者深入幽暗地域尋找傳說中的武器或魔法。角色們甚至可能在阿勞麥柯或刻文谷的圖書管理員的幫助下，冒險進入其他存在平面，尋找盟友、知識和資源來對抗惡魔領主並將他們送回無底深淵。

english: Into the Demonweb Pits
zh_tw: 進入魔網深坑

english: Ambitious adventurers might decide to take the fight to Lolth, seeking to punish her for what she unleashed on the Material Plane and to undo whatever her scheme might have gained her. Vizeran will be inclined to help them find a way to reach the Demonweb (Lolth's layer of the Abyss), since the drow archmage hates the Demon Queen of Spiders and her subjugation of his race.
zh_tw: 有野心的冒險者可能會決定將戰鬥帶到羅絲面前，尋求懲罰她對物質界釋放的東西，以及撤銷她的計劃可能為她帶來的任何收益。維茲蘭會傾向於幫助他們找到到達魔網深坑（羅絲在無底深淵的層面）的方法，因為這位卓爾大法師憎恨蜘蛛惡魔女王以及她對他種族的統治。

english: As they travel through the Abyss, the characters might discover that the demon lords they defeated in the Underdark are potential allies in this new quest. Those demon lords want their own revenge upon Lolth for her scheme, and it might suit their mad whims to use the adventurers as their agents to achieve it.
zh_tw: 當他們穿越無底深淵時，角色們可能會發現他們在幽暗地域擊敗的惡魔領主是這個新任務中的潛在盟友。這些惡魔領主想要對羅絲的陰謀進行自己的復仇，而且利用冒險家們作為他們的代理人來實現這一點可能符合他們瘋狂的奇想。

english: If and when the characters confront Lolth, they find her pregnant and surrounded by thousands of eggs—her unborn young. When the eggs hatch, the Demon Queen of Spiders plans to send her offspring throughout the Abyss, creating a new generation of demon lords under her sway. How the heroes thwart Lolth's mad scheme remains to be seen!
zh_tw: 如果角色們在何時面對羅絲，他們會發現她懷孕了，周圍環繞著成千上萬的卵——她未出生的後代。當這些卵孵化時，蜘蛛惡魔女王計劃將她的後代分散到整個無底深淵，創造一代新的惡魔領主，受她控制。英雄們如何挫敗羅絲瘋狂的計劃還有待觀察！

english: Demon Lords Triumphant
zh_tw: 惡魔領主的勝利

english: In the event the heroes were not successful, a potential new campaign could take place in a Faerûn threatened—or even ruled—by demon lords with access to the surface world. In addition to their summoned armies of demons and fiendish creatures, they gather worldly forces of chaos and evil to their banners to launch a war against all civilized lands. A world under the assault or rule of the demon lords is a world in need of heroes.
zh_tw: 如果英雄們沒有成功，一個潛在的新戰役可能會發生在費倫世界受到惡魔領主威脅——甚至被統治——的情況下，這些惡魔領主可以進入地表世界。除了他們召喚的惡魔和邪惡生物的軍隊外，他們還聚集了世間的混亂和邪惡勢力，以發動一場針對所有文明土地的戰爭。一個受到惡魔領主攻擊或統治的世界是需要英雄的世界。

english: Gromph Baenre
zh_tw: 貢夫·班瑞

english: The fate of Gromph Baenre, instigator of chaos and Vizeran's rival, remains a mystery. If he yet lives, his role in recent events earns him many new enemies. Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA} handpicks a new Archmage of Menzoberranzan to replace her troublesome brother, knowing Gromph will not be found until he chooses to reappear.
zh_tw: 作為混亂的煽動者和維茲蘭的對手，貢夫·班瑞的命運仍然是個謎。如果他仍然活著，他在最近事件中的角色為他贏得了許多新的敵人。女族長{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}親自挑選了新的魔索布萊城大法師，以取代她麻煩的兄弟，因為她知道貢夫在決定重新出現之前是不會被找到的。

english: Menzoberranzan
zh_tw: 魔索布萊城

english: If the City of Spiders is the site of the demon lords' battle, it is damaged even more than it was by Demogorgon's arrival. Word of the city's misfortune spreads throughout the Underdark, with other races and factions trying to claim some of the power long held by the drow.
zh_tw: 如果蜘蛛之城是惡魔領主戰鬥的地點，它受到的損害甚至超過了狄摩高根到來時。城市不幸的訊息在幽暗地域中傳播開來，其他種族和派系試圖奪取長久以來由卓爾掌握的權力。

english: Despite Vizeran's best efforts, not all drow believe that Lolth is responsible for the disaster, instead blaming a lack of faith in the Demon Queen of Spiders, as well as the power of the wizards. Chaos and agitation for change embroil the city, forcing the already weakened ruling houses to put down challenges to their power even as they make concessions to their rivals.
zh_tw: 儘管維茲蘭盡了最大努力，但並非所有卓爾認為羅絲是災難的罪魁禍首，相反，他們將其歸咎於對蜘蛛女王信仰的缺失，以及法師們的力量。混亂和變革的呼聲困擾著這座城市，迫使本已削弱的統治家族在向對手讓步的同時，還要鎮壓對他們權力的挑戰。

english: A civil war between the drow isn't likely to remain contained within Menzoberranzan—or even the Underdark—as different sides look for resources and advantages. The adventurers could get involved on either side of the conflict, or might aid surface-world factions intent on containing the war in the Underdark until it eventually winds down.
zh_tw: 卓爾之間的內戰不太可能僅侷限在魔索布萊城——甚至幽暗地域——因為不同派系在尋找資源和優勢。冒險者可能會捲入衝突的任何一方，或者可能幫助地表世界的派系，他們打算將幽暗地域的戰爭侷限起來，直到戰爭最終平息。

english: Gauntlgrym
zh_tw: 岡特格瑞姆

english: Even if the heroes eliminate the threat the demon lords represent to Gauntlgrym, the Underdark remains in a state of chaos. The defenders of Gauntlgrym need aid to rebuild and strengthen the city's defenses, and to remain vigilant for new threats gathering in the dark depths of the world. King Bruenor might offer the triumphant heroes noble titles and positions of power in his kingdom in the hope of enlisting their aid against the troubles to come. The adventurers might get the opportunity to earn those titles all over again when an Underdark army marches on the dwarf kingdom, determined to claim Gauntlgrym and the power of the primordial bound within its Great Forge.
zh_tw: 即使英雄們消除了惡魔領主對岡特格瑞姆的威脅，幽暗地域仍然處於混亂狀態。岡特格瑞姆的保衛者需要援助來重建並加強城市的防禦，並保持警惕，以應對在世界黑暗深處聚集的新威脅。布魯諾國王可能會向勝利的英雄們提供貴族頭銜和王國中的權力地位，希望獲得他們的幫助，以對抗即將到來的麻煩。當一支幽暗地域軍隊向矮人王國進軍，決心奪取岡特格瑞姆及其大熔爐中原始力量時，冒險者可能會有機會再次獲得這些頭銜。

english: Vizeran DeVir
zh_tw: 維茲蘭·迪威爾

english: Although he's nominally the party's ally during much of this adventure, {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} can't be underestimated. Once the immediate threat is dealt with, the drow archmage turns his attention to other goals—claiming what he considers his rightful place of power among the drow, and overthrowing the tyrannical rule of Lolth and her priestesses. Vizeran might start a civil war among the dark elves—one that could easily drag in the other civilizations of the Underdark and parts of Faerûn as well.
zh_tw: 儘管在這次冒險的大部分時間裡，他名義上是隊伍的盟友，但{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}的實力不容小覷。一旦直接威脅得到解決，這位卓爾大法師就會將注意力轉向其他目標——聲稱他認為屬於自己的卓爾中的權力地位，並推翻暴虐統治的羅絲及其女祭司。維茲蘭可能會在卓爾中引發內戰——這場戰爭很容易將幽暗地域的其他文明以及費倫的部分地區捲入其中。

english: Although Vizeran won't immediately turn against his former allies, the adventurers would be fools to trust him. He seizes any opportunity to increase his own power and prestige, including holding on to Gromph's grimoire and any ritual components or trinkets the adventurers might have acquired for him.
zh_tw: 儘管維茲蘭不會立即反對他的前盟友，冒險者們若信任他將是愚蠢的。他抓住任何機會來增加自己的力量和聲望，包括保留貢夫的魔典以及冒險者們可能為他獲得的任何儀式元件或小飾品。

english: If the adventurers thwarted Vizeran's revenge scheme by placing the {@i dark heart} talisman somewhere other than Menzoberranzan, they earn the drow archmage's enmity. Vizeran's plots expand to include the adventurers as well as his own people, and the next great challenge the heroes face might come from the archmage as he plans his revenge.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者透過將{@i 黑暗之心}護符放置在魔索布萊城之外的某處挫敗了維茲蘭的復仇計劃，他們將贏得這位卓爾大法師的敵意。維茲蘭的陰謀擴大到包括冒險者以及他自己的人，英雄們面臨的下一個巨大挑戰可能來自大法師，因為他正在策劃他的復仇。

english: Appendix A: Modifying Backgrounds
zh_tw: 附錄A：修改背景

english: This appendix provides alternative background features and bonds for player characters, with options that are strongly connected to the NPCs, themes, and events of this adventure.
zh_tw: 這個附錄提供了與本次冒險中的NPC、主題和事件緊密相關的玩家角色的替代背景特徵和紐帶選項。

english: Substitute Features
zh_tw: 替代特性

english: A player can choose one of the following features to replace the feature normally granted by his or her character's background.
zh_tw: 玩家可以選擇以下特性之一，替換其角色背景通常賦予的特性。

english: Optional Feature: Deep Delver
zh_tw: 可選特性：深挖者

english: You have a knack for making your way in the deep places of the world. You can recall the twists and turns of passageways and tunnels such that you can always retrace your steps underground. You're also well acquainted with foraging and survival in the Underdark, and can determine when sources of food and water are safe to consume. You can always find sufficient food and water for yourself and up to five other people in the Underdark, as long as sustenance is available in the area.
zh_tw: 你在世界深處的通道中有著獨特的天賦。你能記住通道和隧道的曲折，總是能夠重新追溯你在地下的足跡。你也對在幽暗地域中尋找食物和生存非常熟悉，並且能夠判斷食物和水源是否安全可食用。只要該地區有食物和水源，你總是能夠為自己和最多五名其他人在幽暗地域找到足夠的食物和水。

english: Optional Feature: Underdark Experience
zh_tw: 可選特性：幽暗地域經驗

english: You are no casual visitor to the Underdark, but instead have spent considerable time there learning its ways. You are familiar with the various races, civilizations, and settlements of the Underdark, as well as its major routes for travel. If you fail an Intelligence check to recall some piece of Underdark lore, you know a source you can consult for the answer unless the DM rules that the lore is unknown.
zh_tw: 你不是幽暗地域的普通訪客，而是在那裡度過了相當長的時間，學習了它的方式。你熟悉幽暗地域的各種種族、文明和定居點，以及它的主要旅行路線。如果你在智力檢定中失敗，無法回憶起某個幽暗地域的知識片段，你知道可以諮詢的來源以獲得答案，除非DM裁定該知識是未知的。

english: Bond
zh_tw: 牽掛

english: You were once lost in the Underdark, and a group of kuo-toa helped you find your way out. You learned that there are kindly folk even among that otherwise mad race, and remain indebted to them for their aid.
zh_tw: 你曾經在幽暗地域迷路，一群寇濤魚人人幫助你找到了出路。你瞭解到，即便是在那個通常瘋狂的種族中，也有善良的人們，並且你對他們的援助心存感激。

english: You once had the opportunity to meet a circle of myconids—the mushroom folk of the Underdark. They offered you shelter and a chance to "meld" using their telepathic spores, and you have yearned ever since to repeat that experience.
zh_tw: 你曾經有機會遇到一群幽暗地域的菌人——幽暗地域的菌人。他們為你提供了庇護，並提供了使用他們的心靈孢子"融合"的機會，從那時起你就渴望再次體驗那種感覺。

english: One of your best friends in your youth was Morista Malkin, a shield dwarf and member of the Emerald Enclave. Though you haven't seen her in years, you heard she found her way to the reclaimed dwarf hold of Gauntlgrym.
zh_tw: 你年輕時最好的朋友之一是莫瑞斯塔·馬爾金，一位盾矮人，也是翠綠閒庭的成員。儘管你已經多年未見她，但你聽說她找到了通往重新奪回的矮人要塞岡特格瑞姆的路。

english: You once worked for Davra Jassur, a Zhentarim "troubleshooter" recruiting promising new talent for the Black Network. She helped you get your start as an adventurer, and you owe her for that.
zh_tw: 你曾為達芙拉·賈瑟工作。她是散塔林會的一名「排難專家」，負責為黑網招募有潛力的新血。她曾幫你踏上冒險者之路，因此你欠她一份人情。

english: You have long had a curious recurring dream about visiting a vaulted stone library in the depths of the Underdark, and becoming lost in the endless lore it holds.
zh_tw: 你長久以來一直做著一個好奇的反覆出現的夢，夢見自己訪問了幽暗地域深處的一個拱形石製圖書館，並沉浸在它所包含的無盡的傳說中。

english: You studied with a deep gnome alchemist and miner named Kazook Pickshine, who saved your life once when a magical experiment went awry. Last you heard, his family controlled some of the largest mines in the deep gnome settlement of Blingdenstone.
zh_tw: 你曾與一位名叫卡祖克·閃鎬的地底侏儒鍊金術士和礦工一起學習，他曾在一次魔法實驗出錯時救了你的命。據你最後一次聽說，他的家族控制了地底侏儒定居點布靈登石城中一些最大的礦井。

english: What little you know about the Underdark, you learned from living and fighting alongside the Feldrun clan of dwarves. You swore an honor debt to the clan before they joined the forces retaking Gauntlgrym and established themselves there.
zh_tw: 你對幽暗地域所知甚少，這些知識是從與費爾德倫氏族的矮人一起生活和戰鬥中學到的。在他們加入奪回岡特格瑞姆的軍隊並在那建立自己的地位之前，你向這個氏族發誓了榮譽債務。

english: Years ago, a vicious noble named {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA} was implicated in the death of someone you cared about. The crime was covered up, though, and DuLoc disappeared. Rumor has it the Zhentarim aided his escape, but you've sworn to find him one day.
zh_tw: 幾年前，一個名叫{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}的惡毒貴族涉嫌謀殺了你關心的某人。然而，這起罪行被掩蓋了，杜洛克消失了。有傳言稱散塔林會幫助他逃脫，但你發誓有一天要找到他。

english: Years ago, you lost people you loved in a raid by creatures from the Underdark. They disappeared without a trace, either slain or taken into the depths, and you've always wondered whether they might still be alive and held as prisoners.
zh_tw: 幾年前，你在來自幽暗地域的生物的襲擊中失去了你愛的人。他們消失得無影無蹤，要麼被殺害，要麼被帶入深淵，你一直想知道他們是否可能還活著，並被當作囚犯關押。

english: You know the dwarf hold of Gauntlgrym well, having fought alongside the dwarves to help reclaim it. King Bruenor Battlehammer congratulated you on your valor, and you know the price the dwarves paid in blood to regain their home.
zh_tw: 你對矮人要塞岡特格瑞姆非常熟悉，因為你曾與矮人們並肩作戰，幫助他們重新奪回它。布魯諾·戰錘國王對你的英勇表示祝賀，你知道矮人們為了奪回家園付出了血的代價。

english: Afterword
zh_tw: 後記

english: In the Rage of Demons story, demon lords invade the Underdark and spread madness throughout the subterranean realm. (As if the Underdark wasn't dangerous enough already!) The Underdark is home to some of the D&D game's most iconic monsters, as well as cultures both alien and wondrous.
zh_tw: 在《惡魔的憤怒》故事中，惡魔領主侵入了幽暗地域，並在這個地下王國中散播瘋狂。（好像幽暗地域本身還不夠危險似的！）幽暗地域是《龍與地下城》遊戲中一些最具標誌性的怪物的家園，以及既陌生又奇妙的文化。

english: To bring the Underdark to life, Richard Whitters and his concept artists created amazing imagery tied to various Underdark races: kuo-toa waymarkers, illithid "brain urns" and domiciles, duergar architecture, drow costuming, and much, much more. Their concept art was featured a "story bible" that we gave to our licensed partners. That story bible served as inspiration for miniatures, digital projects, and print products like the adventure you hold in your hands.
zh_tw: 為了讓幽暗地域栩栩如生，理查德·惠特斯和他的概念藝術家們為各種幽暗地域種族創造了驚人的影象：寇濤魚人的路標、靈吸怪的"腦甕"和居所、灰矮人的建築、卓爾的服飾等等。他們的概念藝術被收錄在一本"故事聖經"中，我們將其提供給了我們的授權合作伙伴。這本故事聖經為微型模型、數字專案以及你手中的冒險等印刷產品提供了靈感。

english: This appendix contains a sampling of the concept art we commissioned for the Rage of Demons story. We hope that this art further inspires you to run Out of the Abyss or create your own Underdark encounters.
zh_tw: 這個附錄包含了我們為《惡魔的憤怒》故事委託創作的部分概念藝術作品。我們希望這些藝術作品能進一步激發你執行《逃離深淵》或創造你自己的幽暗地域遭遇戰的靈感。
